rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You see a large, black colored ship, with heavy, gold accents docked near your own. It looks to be some sort of large ausar carrier. You wouldn’t normally be paying much attention to it, but you recognize some of the people working around it, and realize that it must be the ship of that kaithrit bounty hunter you met before. You could go over and visit; she did say you were always welcome.
rows.translation: 你看见一艘黑色大型飞船停靠在自己的船附近，舰身带着醒目的金色装饰。那似乎是某种大型奥萨尔航母。平时你大概不会多看它一眼，但你认出了在周围忙碌的几个人，意识到这一定是你之前遇到的那位凯斯里特赏金猎人的飞船。你可以过去拜访；她确实说过随时欢迎你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see a large, black colored ship, with heavy, gold accents docked near your own. It looks to be some sort of large ausar carrier. You wouldn’t normally be paying much attention to it, but you recognize some of the people working around it, and realize that it must be the ship of that kaithrit bounty hunter you met before. You could go over and visit; she did say you were always welcome."

rows.original: Ship
rows.translation: 飞船
rows.raw: "Ship"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: You move around the imposing vessel, passing by a bevy of crew members, most of whom greet you with a small degree of familiarity. One of them points you in the direction of the loading dock and says that’s where Shizuya is right now. You walk over, spying Shizuya and Winston carrying a large crate up a ramp, into their ship. As you move closer, the massive feline spots you and waves at you happily... dropping her half of the crate in the process. Winston tries his best to hold the heavy box back, but there was obviously a reason that both of them were carrying it, and Winston is forced back down the ramp.
rows.translation: 你绕过这艘气势迫人的飞船，沿途经过众多船员，其中大多数都带着几分熟稔向你问候。一名船员为你指了装卸区的方向，说静夜现在就在那里。你走过去，看见静夜和温斯顿正抬着一只大箱子沿坡道走进飞船。你刚靠近一些，那只体型硕大的猫科兽人便发现了你，开心地向你挥手...同时松开了自己抬着的那一边。温斯顿拼命想托住沉重的箱子，可他们两人一起搬它显然事出有因，温斯顿被迫一路退下坡道。
rows.raw: "You move around the imposing vessel, passing by a bevy of crew members, most of whom greet you with a small degree of familiarity. One of them points you in the direction of the loading dock and says that’s where Shizuya is right now. You walk over, spying Shizuya and Winston carrying a large crate up a ramp, into their ship. As you move closer, the massive feline spots you and waves at you happily... dropping her half of the crate in the process. Winston tries his best to hold the heavy box back, but there was obviously a reason that both of them were carrying it, and Winston is forced back down the ramp."

rows.original: “OH MY GOD!” He screams as he’s pushed back into the loading dock.
rows.translation: “我的天啊！”他被推回装卸区时放声尖叫。
rows.raw: "\n\n“OH MY GOD!” He screams as he’s pushed back into the loading dock."

rows.original: Shizuya screams in shock before dashing down the ramp to aid her husky friend. They come out a minute later, Winston seemingly no worse for wear. They shoot you a thumbs up and wave you over. You head up and help them move the crate in, putting yourself on Winston’s side, since Shizuya doesn’t seem to need any help.
rows.translation: 静夜惊叫一声，随即冲下坡道帮助她那位哈士奇朋友。一分钟后，两人走了出来，温斯顿看起来毫发无损。他们向你竖起拇指，招手让你过去。你上前帮忙把箱子搬进去，站到了温斯顿那一侧，因为静夜似乎完全不需要帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nShizuya screams in shock before dashing down the ramp to aid her husky friend. They come out a minute later, Winston seemingly no worse for wear. They shoot you a thumbs up and wave you over. You head up and help them move the crate in, putting yourself on Winston’s side, since Shizuya doesn’t seem to need any help."

rows.original: “Sorry ‘bout that, Winston.” Shizuya worriedly says.
rows.translation: “刚才抱歉啦，温斯顿。”静夜忧心忡忡地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry ‘bout that, Winston.” Shizuya worriedly says."

rows.original: “It’s alright, no harm done.”
rows.translation: “没事，没造成什么损失。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s alright, no harm done.”"

rows.original: “That’s good to hear, but what’s in this crate? It weighs a ton.”
rows.translation: “那就好，不过这箱子里装的是什么？重得要命。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s good to hear, but what’s in this crate? It weighs a ton.”"

rows.original: Shizuya leans her head around the side of the crate. “Replacement parts, repair tools, ammo restock, a few things for Mika.” You guess that lead must have gone somewhere if they need all this.
rows.translation: 静夜从箱子一侧探出脑袋。“替换零件、维修工具、补充弹药，还有给米卡的几样东西。”既然他们需要这么多物资，你猜那些铅弹一定都打到什么地方去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShizuya leans her head around the side of the crate. “Replacement parts, repair tools, ammo restock, a few things for Mika.” You guess that lead must have gone somewhere if they need all this."

rows.original: “Yeeeeep, bastard had way more troops with him than the intel guys told us. It was somethin,’ but we got him.”
rows.translation: “没——错，那个混蛋带的兵比情报人员说的多多了。那一仗可真够呛，不过我们还是抓住了他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeeeeep, bastard had way more troops with him than the intel guys told us. It was somethin,’ but we got him.”"

rows.original: “Great, learn anything?”
rows.translation: “太好了，问出什么了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great, learn anything?”"

rows.original: Both of them go quiet for an awkward second, before Winston starts speaking. “Um, let’s just say he’s not in much condition to tell us much, right now. Kinda... you know, fucked up beyond belief. Not in the blood and guts way, in theeeeeeeee, um, how do I put it? Fucking himself senseless with so many tentacles that we thought he was a bush.”
rows.translation: 两人尴尬地沉默了一会儿，随后温斯顿开口道：“呃，这么说吧，他现在的状况不太适合告诉我们什么。有点...你懂的，惨不忍睹。倒不是血肉横飞的那种，而是，该——怎么形容呢？他被一大堆触手操得神志不清，我们差点以为他是一丛灌木。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBoth of them go quiet for an awkward second, before Winston starts speaking. “Um, let’s just say he’s not in much condition to tell us much, right now. Kinda... you know, fucked up beyond belief. Not in the blood and guts way, in theeeeeeeee, um, how do I put it? Fucking himself senseless with so many tentacles that we thought he was a bush.”"

rows.original: “Yikes.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yikes.”"

rows.original: “Yep, lab boys are trying to see if they can salvage something out of him.”
rows.translation: “对，实验室那帮人正在想办法看看能不能从他身上抢救出点东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep, lab boys are trying to see if they can salvage something out of him.”"

rows.original: “How does that even happen?”
rows.translation: “到底怎么会变成那样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How does that even happen?”"

rows.original: “Pft, fuck if I know. His men didn’t even know. They were freaking the fuck out when they retreated to the bridge. My guess is whoever his boss was put one of those remote release capsules in him, filled it some wacky stuff instead of the usual poison. From the looks of him, he was probably supposed to attack us, but he got caught up screwing himself. People out here play serious. You know, I heard this story; one time this guy is just sitting down, and there’s a tack on his chair. He throws it away, thinking it’s some kind of prank. Next week, BAM, he’s a giant sausage.”
rows.translation: “呸，我他妈怎么知道。他的手下也完全不知道。他们撤到舰桥时全都吓坏了。我猜他的老板在他体内装了一枚远程释放胶囊，只是里面装的不是常见的毒药，而是某种古怪玩意儿。看他那样子，原本大概应该袭击我们，结果却只顾着操自己。这一带的人下手可狠了。对了，我听过这么个故事：有个人坐下时发现椅子上放了枚图钉。他以为是谁在恶作剧，就把它扔了。结果到了下周，砰的一下，他变成了一根巨大的香肠。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Pft, fuck if I know. His men didn’t even know. They were freaking the fuck out when they retreated to the bridge. My guess is whoever his boss was put one of those remote release capsules in him, filled it some wacky stuff instead of the usual poison. From the looks of him, he was probably supposed to attack us, but he got caught up screwing himself. People out here play serious. You know, I heard this story; one time this guy is just sitting down, and there’s a tack on his chair. He throws it away, thinking it’s some kind of prank. Next week, BAM, he’s a giant sausage.”"

rows.original: “You think I’m joking around again, but I swear that one’s real.”
rows.translation: “你又觉得我在开玩笑，但我发誓这件事是真的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You think I’m joking around again, but I swear that one’s real.”"

rows.original: Shizuya chuckles, but you’re mostly speechless, silently pushing the hefty crate all the way up the ramp.
rows.translation: 静夜轻声笑了起来，你却大多时候都哑口无言，只默默将沉重的箱子一路推上坡道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShizuya chuckles, but you’re mostly speechless, silently pushing the hefty crate all the way up the ramp."

rows.original: When you finally get into the hangar proper, you almost feel a sense of vertigo as you take it all in. The bay is massive, easily taking up about half of the ship by itself. Dozens of smaller craft are either suspended high above you, or are parked in one of many large alcoves to be serviced. Workers rush up and down the decks, attending to a wide array of tasks that you couldn’t possibly take in from where you are. One familiar worker, the gryvain from before, drives up to you in a small utility truck.
rows.translation: 终于真正进入机库时，眼前的景象几乎令你产生一阵眩晕。整个机库大得惊人，几乎独自占据了飞船一半的空间。数十艘小型飞行器有的悬挂在你头顶高处，有的停在众多大型凹舱之一接受维护。工人们在各层甲板间匆匆往来，忙着处理五花八门的任务，你站在这里根本不可能尽数看清。一位熟悉的工人，也就是先前那名格里文人，开着一辆小型多用途车来到你们身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you finally get into the hangar proper, you almost feel a sense of vertigo as you take it all in. The bay is massive, easily taking up about half of the ship by itself. Dozens of smaller craft are either suspended high above you, or are parked in one of many large alcoves to be serviced. Workers rush up and down the decks, attending to a wide array of tasks that you couldn’t possibly take in from where you are. One familiar worker, the gryvain from before, drives up to you in a small utility truck."

rows.original: “Ey, there ya are. What ‘appened, ya slip or somethin’?”
rows.translation: “嘿，你们可算来了。怎么回事，脚滑了还是咋的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ey, there ya are. What ‘appened, ya slip or somethin’?”"

rows.original: “Ummm...” Shizuya turns away from Aerowyn in embarrassment.
rows.translation: “呃...”静夜尴尬地转过身，不敢看艾洛温。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ummm...” Shizuya turns away from Aerowyn in embarrassment."

rows.original: “S’alright, long as nobody got ‘urt. Pop that crate on the back and I’ll take it over to the little one.”
rows.translation: “没事，只要没人受伤就好。把箱子放到后面，我给小家伙送过去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“S’alright, long as nobody got ‘urt. Pop that crate on the back and I’ll take it over to the little one.”"

rows.original: You all heft the box onto the back of the truck, exchanging a thumbs up as she drives off. Shizuya turns to you with a smile and a flourish.
rows.translation: 你们合力把箱子抬上车斗，互相竖起拇指示意，随后她便驾车离去。静夜面带笑容，夸张地向你一展双臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou all heft the box onto the back of the truck, exchanging a thumbs up as she drives off. Shizuya turns to you with a smile and a flourish."

rows.original: “Well well, welcome to the ship, glad you came!” Shizuya gives you a huge smile while Winston poses in a showman-like manner, like he’s unveiling the prize on a gameshow. As he does, a large cart of parts falls to the ground from up high.
rows.translation: “哎呀呀，欢迎登船，很高兴你能来！”静夜笑得无比灿烂，温斯顿则像游戏节目主持人揭晓大奖般摆出一副表演姿态。就在他摆姿势时，一辆装满零件的大推车从高处摔落在地。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well well, welcome to the ship, glad you came!” Shizuya gives you a huge smile while Winston poses in a showman-like manner, like he’s unveiling the prize on a gameshow. As he does, a large cart of parts falls to the ground from up high."

rows.original: “It’s okay, it’s okay, it’s okay.” A man races down out of one of the lifts and toward the pile, desperately picking it up.
rows.translation: “没事，没事，没事。”一个男人从某台升降机里冲出来，跑向那堆零件，手忙脚乱地把它们捡起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s okay, it’s okay, it’s okay.” A man races down out of one of the lifts and toward the pile, desperately picking it up."

rows.original: Shizuya and Winston seem to be intentionally ignoring it, allowing the poor guy to scramble his mess together and leave without comment.
rows.translation: 静夜和温斯顿像是故意无视了这一幕，任由那个可怜的家伙收拾好自己闯下的祸，一言不发地离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShizuya and Winston seem to be intentionally ignoring it, allowing the poor guy to scramble his mess together and leave without comment."

rows.original: “... Yeah, welcome! This is the Great Majin, my and Mika’s big ol’ baby.” She starts rattling off technical specs about the ship. Model and serial numbers, cargo capacity, basic stuff,
rows.translation: “...对，欢迎登船！这里是大魔人号，是我和米卡的宝贝大家伙。”她开始如数家珍地介绍飞船的技术规格。型号与序列号、载货量之类的基本资料，
rows.raw: "\n\n“... Yeah, welcome! This is the Great Majin, my and Mika’s big ol’ baby.” She starts rattling off technical specs about the ship. Model and serial numbers, cargo capacity, basic stuff,"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.characterClass === GLOBAL.CLASS_ENGINEER ||
                      flags.PC_UPBRINGING === GLOBAL.UPBRINGING_BOOKWORM
                        ? " pretty interesting, actually."
                        : " boring stuff."

rows.original: pretty interesting, actually.
rows.translation: 其实还挺有意思的。
rows.raw: " pretty interesting, actually."

rows.original: boring stuff.
rows.translation: 全是些无聊的东西。
rows.raw: " boring stuff."

rows.original: “I know I’m not the most thorough with this. If ya want some real in-depth stuff, Mika could probably tell ya the part number of every panel on this ship. Speaking of Mika.” She turns around, motioning you to follow her. Looking where she’s going, you see Aerowyn parked at the other end of the hangar, helping Mika unload the crate you just loaded on.
rows.translation: “我知道自己讲得不够详细。你要是真想了解深入些，米卡大概连这艘船每块面板的零件编号都能告诉你。说到米卡。”她转过身，示意你跟上。顺着她前进的方向望去，你看见艾洛温把车停在机库另一端，正帮米卡卸下你刚才装上去的箱子。
rows.raw: " “I know I’m not the most thorough with this. If ya want some real in-depth stuff, Mika could probably tell ya the part number of every panel on this ship. Speaking of Mika.” She turns around, motioning you to follow her. Looking where she’s going, you see Aerowyn parked at the other end of the hangar, helping Mika unload the crate you just loaded on."

rows.original: <i>“HEY MIKA, SHOW
rows.translation: <i>“喂，米卡，给
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“HEY MIKA, SHOW "

rows.original: WHAT’CHU GOT!” Mika looks over as Shizuya yells loud enough to echo throughout the hangar. The tiny cow shrugs and continues to unload the crate, putting it on a sturdy looking cart. By the time she’s done with that, you make it over to her.
rows.translation: 瞧瞧你的家伙！”静夜的喊声洪亮得足以在整个机库里回荡，米卡闻声望来。那头娇小的牛耸了耸肩，继续卸下箱子，将它放到一辆看起来很结实的推车上。等她忙完，你们也走到了她身边。
rows.raw: " WHAT’CHU GOT!” Mika looks over as Shizuya yells loud enough to echo throughout the hangar. The tiny cow shrugs and continues to unload the crate, putting it on a sturdy looking cart. By the time she’s done with that, you make it over to her."

rows.original: “So, you want to see the hardware, do you?”
rows.translation: “所以，你想看看这些装备，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, you want to see the hardware, do you?”"

rows.original: “Of course.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course.”"

rows.original: “Might as well.”
rows.translation: “看看也无妨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Might as well.”"

rows.original: “Great, great, come on.” She leads you into a small room in the side of the hangar, opening the large shutter door before stepping inside.
rows.translation: “很好，很好，来吧。”她领着你走向机库侧面的一间小屋，打开宽大的卷帘门后走了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great, great, come on.” She leads you into a small room in the side of the hangar, opening the large shutter door before stepping inside."

rows.original: Inside you see a very disorganized workshop with a large, person shaped frame on display.
rows.translation: 屋内是一间十分凌乱的工坊，里面陈列着一具人形框架。
rows.raw: "\n\nInside you see a very disorganized workshop with a large, person shaped frame on display."

rows.original: “Say hello to the XV90 Battlesuit frame; nanocarbon construction for lightweight and high durability, fourteen hardpoint mounts for weapons, tools, armor, whatever the hell you want!” It’s about eight feet tall, with a cannon that’s probably about as big as Mika already mounted on the shoulder. There’s some kind of cockpit in the torso that most likely has all the systems that Mika would need to control the massive suit.
rows.translation: “来认识一下XV90战斗装甲框架；采用纳米碳材料，重量轻且耐久性强，配备十四个挂载点，可以安装武器、工具、装甲，随你想装什么！”它大约八英尺高，肩上已经装着一门体积可能和米卡本人差不多大的加农炮。躯干处设有某种驾驶舱，其中很可能装有米卡操控这套巨型装甲所需的全部系统。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say hello to the XV90 Battlesuit frame; nanocarbon construction for lightweight and high durability, fourteen hardpoint mounts for weapons, tools, armor, whatever the hell you want!” It’s about eight feet tall, with a cannon that’s probably about as big as Mika already mounted on the shoulder. There’s some kind of cockpit in the torso that most likely has all the systems that Mika would need to control the massive suit."

rows.original: “Well, what do you think?”
rows.translation: “怎么样，你觉得如何？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, what do you think?”"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.characterClass === GLOBAL.CLASS_ENGINEER ||
                      flags.PC_UPBRINGING === GLOBAL.UPBRINGING_BOOKWORM
                        ? "It’s cool, but..."
                        : ""

rows.original: It’s cool, but...
rows.translation: 是很酷，不过...
rows.raw: "It’s cool, but..."

rows.original: Isn’t it a little excessive?”
rows.translation: 是不是有点太夸张了？”
rows.raw: "Isn’t it a little excessive?”"

rows.original: “Yes.” She stares at you with a blank smile that tells you that you’re probably not to going to be getting anywhere with that train of thought.
rows.translation: “是的。”她面带毫无波澜的微笑看着你，那副表情告诉你，沿着这个思路说下去大概不会有任何结果。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes.” She stares at you with a blank smile that tells you that you’re probably not to going to be getting anywhere with that train of thought."

rows.original: “Anyway, that cannon you see there needs the barrel and heatsinks replaced. Used it up pretty good in the fight, there. Of course you guys don’t have time to do that, so you guys can just do whatever.” Winston peers in from the entrance of the room.
rows.translation: “总之，你看到的那门炮需要更换炮管和散热器。之前那场战斗把它用得够狠。当然，你们没时间做这些，所以随便做点什么都行。”温斯顿从房间入口探头看了进来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, that cannon you see there needs the barrel and heatsinks replaced. Used it up pretty good in the fight, there. Of course you guys don’t have time to do that, so you guys can just do whatever.” Winston peers in from the entrance of the room."

rows.original: “So, you finally ordered that hydraulic strap-on, ey?”
rows.translation: “所以，你终于订购那根液压穿戴阳具了，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, you finally ordered that hydraulic strap-on, ey?”"

rows.original: “Wh-what, how the...”
rows.translation: “什、什么，你怎么...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wh-what, how the...”"

rows.original: “It’s on the shipment manifest.” Mika is as flushed as she can be at Winston’s revelation, meanwhile Shizuya looks ecstatic.
rows.translation: “它写在货运清单上。”温斯顿揭穿这件事后，米卡的脸已经红到了极点，静夜却欣喜若狂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s on the shipment manifest.” Mika is as flushed as she can be at Winston’s revelation, meanwhile Shizuya looks ecstatic."

rows.original: “YOU DID GET IT! Why didn’t you tell me?” Shizuya lifts little Mika right up off her feet and puts her face to face.
rows.translation: “你真的买了！为什么不告诉我？”静夜一把将娇小的米卡举离地面，让两人的脸正对着彼此。
rows.raw: "\n\n“YOU DID GET IT! Why didn’t you tell me?” Shizuya lifts little Mika right up off her feet and puts her face to face."

rows.original: “I-I was going to save it for your birthday...”
rows.translation: “我、我本来想留到你生日时再拿出来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I was going to save it for your birthday...”"

rows.original: “WINSTON, YA RUINED IT!” Shizuya yells out in disappointment, before getting a big grin on her face. “Well, at least that means we can just use it now.” They grin at each other, and then turn to you, their grins growing wider as they wordlessly ogle you. Shizuya sets the pipsqueak down, coming over to you and wrapping her arm around your back.
rows.translation: “温斯顿，你把惊喜毁了！”静夜失望地喊道，脸上随即又绽开灿烂的笑容。“好吧，至少这意味着我们现在就能用它了。”她们相视而笑，接着转向你，一言不发地盯着你上下打量，笑容愈发灿烂。静夜放下那个小不点，走到你身旁，用胳膊搂住你的后背。
rows.raw: "\n\n“WINSTON, YA RUINED IT!” Shizuya yells out in disappointment, before getting a big grin on her face. “Well, at least that means we can just use it now.” They grin at each other, and then turn to you, their grins growing wider as they wordlessly ogle you. Shizuya sets the pipsqueak down, coming over to you and wrapping her arm around your back."

rows.original: “C’mon, lots more ground to cover.” She leads you out, making sure to let her painfully obvious erections brush into you as she does.
rows.translation: “走吧，还有好多地方要看呢。”她领你离开，同时故意让自己明显得刺眼的勃起阴茎蹭过你的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“C’mon, lots more ground to cover.” She leads you out, making sure to let her painfully obvious erections brush into you as she does."

rows.original: “So pretty much everyone on the ship has their own, small ship. Basically, what you’re looking at here is a mobile military base capable of deploying anything from a small strike team to a small fleet, and also provide long range firing support.” That’s a lot for anybody, let alone a bunch of bounty hunters, or whatever they are.
rows.translation: “所以船上基本每个人都有一艘自己的小型飞船。简单来说，你眼前的是一座移动军事基地，小到一支突击队、大到一支小型舰队都能部署，还可以提供远程火力支援。”这对任何人来说都是相当庞大的阵仗，更别说是一群赏金猎人，或者无论他们究竟是什么人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So pretty much everyone on the ship has their own, small ship. Basically, what you’re looking at here is a mobile military base capable of deploying anything from a small strike team to a small fleet, and also provide long range firing support.” That’s a lot for anybody, let alone a bunch of bounty hunters, or whatever they are."

rows.original: “That’s a lot of hardware.”
rows.translation: “装备可真不少。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a lot of hardware.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, can’t say we haven’t needed it. Lots of stuff to do, and the old girl here’s gotten us through it.”
rows.translation: “是啊，也不能说我们没用上过。要做的事很多，这位老姑娘一路带我们闯了过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, can’t say we haven’t needed it. Lots of stuff to do, and the old girl here’s gotten us through it.”"

rows.original: “What exactly do you do? Winston did say this wasn’t standard procedure.”
rows.translation: “你们到底是做什么的？温斯顿确实说过这次并非常规行动。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What exactly do you do? Winston did say this wasn’t standard procedure.”"

rows.original: “Well, we usually actually know what we’re doing. Not to mention the, sort of, mixing that’s going on with this job.” Mixing? “Look, it’s complicated, I’ll tell ya later.”
rows.translation: “嗯，通常我们其实知道自己在做什么。更别提这次任务里还夹杂着某种别的东西。”夹杂？“听着，这事很复杂，我以后再告诉你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, we usually actually know what we’re doing. Not to mention the, sort of, mixing that’s going on with this job.” Mixing? “Look, it’s complicated, I’ll tell ya later.”"

rows.original: She leads you into one of the lifts, taking you up several decks until you reach a residential deck, one of several. “So there are four residential decks. You’ll remember this one, it has a crew quarters and the mess hall and kitchen. Up another one is the gym; above that is the bar and break room, and the topmost deck is the officer’s quarters, that’s where you’ll usually find me, Mika, and Addy. Aerowyn likes to be near the gym, and Winston shares a room with his boyfriend on this deck. I don’t know about them, but you’re always welcome to pop by my room anytime ya like. Speaking of which.” She presses a button and the lift goes up to the officer’s quarters. “Let’s take a tour of that!”
rows.translation: 她领你走进一台升降机，向上经过数层甲板，抵达了几层居住甲板中的一层。“这里总共有四层居住甲板。这层你会记住的，有船员舱、食堂和厨房。再上一层是健身房；上面一层是酒吧和休息室，最顶层则是军官舱室，平时一般能在那里找到我、米卡和阿迪。艾洛温喜欢待在健身房附近，温斯顿则和男朋友合住在这一层。我不知道他们怎么想，但你想什么时候来我房间都随时欢迎。说到这里。”她按下按钮，升降机随即上升到军官舱室。“我们去那里参观一下吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leads you into one of the lifts, taking you up several decks until you reach a residential deck, one of several. “So there are four residential decks. You’ll remember this one, it has a crew quarters and the mess hall and kitchen. Up another one is the gym; above that is the bar and break room, and the topmost deck is the officer’s quarters, that’s where you’ll usually find me, Mika, and Addy. Aerowyn likes to be near the gym, and Winston shares a room with his boyfriend on this deck. I don’t know about them, but you’re always welcome to pop by my room anytime ya like. Speaking of which.” She presses a button and the lift goes up to the officer’s quarters. “Let’s take a tour of that!”"

rows.original: She takes you down the hall, past the rooms for Adelline and Mika, and stopping in front of her own. “Welp, home sweet home.” She opens up the door and both of you step inside. It’s very spacious, though for someone as large as her, that’s a necessity rather than a luxury
rows.translation: 她带你沿走廊前行，经过阿德琳和米卡的房间，最后停在自己的房门前。“好啦，终于到家了。”她打开门，你们一同走进房间。这里相当宽敞，不过对她这种体型的人来说，这更像必需而非享受
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes you down the hall, past the rooms for Adelline and Mika, and stopping in front of her own. “Welp, home sweet home.” She opens up the door and both of you step inside. It’s very spacious, though for someone as large as her, that’s a necessity rather than a luxury"

rows.original: Rather than a standard bed, there’s a recessed area in the floor that’s filled by a large mattress, and covered in strewn sheets and pillows. Around it sits several shelves, filled with books, comics, holovids, and a very wicked looking sex toy that’s displayed almost reverently with its own holder. Nearby is a den with two large couches, and a massive holoscreen. There’s more small shelves of holovids, with many strewn about on the floor. Frankly, it looks more like the room of a messy college student, rather than the captain of a bunch of bounty hunters.
rows.translation: 那里没有普通的床，取而代之的是地板上一块下沉区域，里面塞着一张大床垫，上面散乱地铺着床单和枕头。四周摆着几排架子，放满书籍、漫画和全息影像，还有一件看起来极其邪恶的性爱玩具，甚至配有专用支架，近乎被当成圣物般供在那里。附近有个起居区，摆着两张大沙发和一块巨大的全息屏幕。小架子上还放着更多全息影像，其中许多散落在地板上。说实话，这里更像邋遢大学生的房间，而不像一群赏金猎人的船长寝室。

rows.original: She casually looks over at you. “Hey.” Wait, how did she get here before you, and why? “If you’re wondering why I’m here, I didn’t realize that there was still coolant in the damn tank of the cannon, so it spilled all over me. I got here first because you dorks are slow as hell.”
rows.translation: 她漫不经心地看向你。“嘿。”等等，她怎么会比你先到，又为什么会在这里？“如果你想知道我为什么在这儿，是因为我没发现那门该死的大炮罐里还有冷却液，结果全洒在我身上了。我先到，是因为你们几个笨蛋慢得要死。”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah.” Shizuya comes up behind you. “Me and Mika have our rooms connected. She’s, uh, you know.”"

rows.original: The hangar of the Great Majin is massive, large enough to house and service several dozen moderately sized ships, as well as many small, single or double person fighters. There are many large alcoves in the side walls where ships are pulled into for service. The ground floor is just as packed and busy. Crates and containers of various sizes are stacked in massive piles around the hangar, and, no matter the time, crew members are always busy moving them around.
rows.translation: 大魔人号的机库十分庞大，足以容纳并维修数十艘中型飞船，以及许多只能搭乘一两人的小型战斗机。两侧墙壁上分布着许多大型凹舱，飞船会被拖入其中接受维护。底层同样拥挤繁忙。各种尺寸的板条箱和货柜在机库四处堆成小山，无论什么时候，船员们总在忙着搬运它们。
rows.raw: "The hangar of the Great Majin is massive, large enough to house and service several dozen moderately sized ships, as well as many small, single or double person fighters. There are many large alcoves in the side walls where ships are pulled into for service. The ground floor is just as packed and busy. Crates and containers of various sizes are stacked in massive piles around the hangar, and, no matter the time, crew members are always busy moving them around."

rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like you came during peak hours here. People are busy as bees, moving large amounts of cargo around, working on docked ships, generally staying busy."

She doesn’t look so busy that you couldn’t talk to her, though. Maybe you could even take her up to her room for a bit. She is the captain, after all, she can take some time off."

What takes you by surprise is when tears begin to flow down her flushed, freckled cheeks. “Thank you! I’m sorry!” she hiccups, futilely wiping at her eyes. “I-I’m suh-sorry I’m such a mess! I-”"

rows.original: Hug
rows.translation: 拥抱
rows.raw: "Hug"

rows.original: Skom & AveryBirb
rows.raw: "Skom & AveryBirb"

rows.original: You pull her into a hug,
rows.translation: 你将她搂入怀中，
rows.raw: "You pull her into a hug,"

rows.original: pressing her head against your chest.
rows.translation: 让她的头贴在你的胸前。
rows.raw: " pressing her head against your chest."

rows.original: putting her head against your shoulder.
rows.translation: 让她的头靠在你的肩上。
rows.raw: " putting her head against your shoulder."

rows.original: Then she’s really crying, great sobs wracking her body as she wraps her arms around you and wails. You gently stroke her head, running your hand through her fiery red hair and soothing the despondent girl.
rows.translation: 随后她彻底哭了出来，巨大的抽泣令她全身颤抖；她用双臂紧紧抱住你，放声哀号。你轻柔地抚摸她的头，让手指穿过那火红的头发，安慰这个陷入绝望的姑娘。
rows.raw: " Then she’s really crying, great sobs wracking her body as she wraps her arms around you and wails. You gently stroke her head, running your hand through her fiery red hair and soothing the despondent girl."

rows.original: It takes a long time for her to stop.
rows.translation: 过了很久，她才终于止住哭泣。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a long time for her to stop."

rows.original: When she’s cried herself out, the dryad takes a long, shuddering breath and looks
rows.translation: 树精把泪水哭干后，长长地颤抖着吸了一口气，随后望向
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she’s cried herself out, the dryad takes a long, shuddering breath and looks"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 上方
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: at you.
rows.translation: 的你。
rows.raw: " at you."

rows.original: “This is... the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me,” she says quietly. “I don’t even care if you just want to fuck me, or whatever. I just- I just want to leave it all behind.”
rows.translation: “这是...别人为我做过的最温柔的事。”她轻声说道。“就算你只是想操我，或者有什么别的目的，我也不在乎。我只是、我只是想把这一切都抛在身后。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is... the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me,” she says quietly. “I don’t even care if you just want to fuck me, or whatever. I just- I just want to leave it all behind.”"

rows.original: She takes your proffered hand and sniffles. “Let’s go.”
rows.translation: 她接过你伸出的手，抽了抽鼻子。“我们走吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes your proffered hand and sniffles. “Let’s go.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, I’ll show you around the ship,” you tell her, walking alongside her and chatting. “It’s nothing like the fancy ships they have in Gildenmere, but it’s getting the job done.”
rows.translation: “好，我带你参观一下飞船。”你一边告诉她，一边与她并肩行走、闲聊起来。“这里比不上吉尔登米尔那些豪华飞船，但足够完成任务。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I’ll show you around the ship,” you tell her, walking alongside her and chatting. “It’s nothing like the fancy ships they have in Gildenmere, but it’s getting the job done.”"

rows.original: “What’s Gildenmere?” she asks, looking at you.
rows.translation: “吉尔登米尔是什么地方？”她望着你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s Gildenmere?” she asks, looking at you."

rows.original: <i>“Oh, it’s the capital city of Myrellion. I went there a little while ago to solve some issues they were having -
rows.translation: <i>“哦，那是米瑞利昂的首都。我前不久去那里解决了一些当地的问题，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh, it’s the capital city of Myrellion. I went there a little while ago to solve some issues they were having -"

rows.original: uhhh, didn’t go so hot to be honest, but it’s the thought that counts.
rows.translation: 呃——老实说，结果不怎么理想，但有这份心就好。
rows.raw: " uhhh, didn’t go so hot to be honest, but it’s the thought that counts."

rows.original: regrettable how it turned out, though.
rows.translation: 可惜最后变成了那样。
rows.raw: " regrettable how it turned out, though."

rows.original: they were right on the verge of civil war when I got there.
rows.translation: 我抵达时，他们已经处在内战边缘了。
rows.raw: " they were right on the verge of civil war when I got there."

rows.original: “Yeah, I’ll show you around the ship,” you tell her, walking alongside her and chatting. “It’s nothing like the fancy ships they have in Ausaril.”
rows.translation: “好，我带你参观一下飞船。”你一边告诉她，一边与她并肩行走、闲聊起来。“这里比不上奥萨瑞尔那些豪华飞船。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I’ll show you around the ship,” you tell her, walking alongside her and chatting. “It’s nothing like the fancy ships they have in Ausaril.”"

rows.original: “What’s Ausaril?” she asks, looking at you.
rows.translation: “奥萨瑞尔是什么地方？”她望着你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s Ausaril?” she asks, looking at you."

rows.original: “Oh, it’s the homeworld of the Ausar. They’re the ones who invented warp gate technology, so they have really advanced ships. Dad took me there during one of his business trips, I’ll never forget it. I want to get one of those ships for myself one day - I bet they feel amazing to fly.”
rows.translation: “哦，那是奥萨尔人的母星。他们发明了跃迁门技术，因此拥有非常先进的飞船。爸爸有一次出差时带我去过那里，我永远都忘不了。我希望有朝一日能给自己弄一艘那样的船——驾驶起来一定棒极了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’s the homeworld of the Ausar. They’re the ones who invented warp gate technology, so they have really advanced ships. Dad took me there during one of his business trips, I’ll never forget it. I want to get one of those ships for myself one day - I bet they feel amazing to fly.”"

rows.original: “Wow, you’re an actual space explorer!” she marvels. Her eyes sparkle with wonder, eager to hear more about the universe you’ve travelled.
rows.translation: “哇，你真的是一名太空探险家！”她惊叹道。她眼中闪烁着好奇的光芒，迫切想听你多讲一些亲历过的宇宙见闻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, you’re an actual space explorer!” she marvels. Her eyes sparkle with wonder, eager to hear more about the universe you’ve travelled."

rows.original: “Hey, Amber, did you know, there’s a Terran myth that claims amber is produced by the sun? Poetic, right?”
rows.translation: “嘿，安珀，你知道吗？有个地球传说声称琥珀是由太阳产生的。很有诗意，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, Amber, did you know, there’s a Terran myth that claims amber is produced by the sun? Poetic, right?”"

rows.original: “Yes! That’s why I chose this name,” she says, pleased. “It has a lot of ties to the sun, and, well, that was kinda who I wanted to be, y’know? The shining sun...”
rows.translation: “知道！所以我才选择这个名字。”她开心地说道。“它与太阳有许多联系，而且，嗯，那大概就是我想成为的人，你懂吧？光芒四射的太阳...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes! That’s why I chose this name,” she says, pleased. “It has a lot of ties to the sun, and, well, that was kinda who I wanted to be, y’know? The shining sun...”"

rows.original: “That’s amazing, uh - I just realized, I don’t know your name! I guess our past um, meetings, haven’t exactly been the kinda environment to get to know each other. Properly, I mean.”
rows.translation: “太了不起了，呃——我才发现，我还不知道你的名字！我想我们过去那些，嗯，会面，确实不太适合互相了解。我是说，正式认识彼此。”
rows.raw: " “That’s amazing, uh - I just realized, I don’t know your name! I guess our past um, meetings, haven’t exactly been the kinda environment to get to know each other. Properly, I mean.”"

rows.original: “It is a little crazy that we’ve known each other for so long without ever introducing ourselves,” you agree, looking at her with a smile. “I’m [pc.name]. [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “我们认识了这么久却从未自我介绍，确实有些不可思议。”你微笑着认同道。“我是[pc.name]。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is a little crazy that we’ve known each other for so long without ever introducing ourselves,” you agree, looking at her with a smile. “I’m [pc.name]. [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: “Steel, huh?” she says, grinning.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，是吗？”她咧嘴笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steel, huh?” she says, grinning."

rows.original: “Well, you can be as hard as steel in at least one place.”
rows.translation: “嗯，你至少有一个地方能硬如钢铁。”
rows.raw: " “Well, you can be as hard as steel in at least one place.”"

rows.original: “Your exterior doesn’t seem so impenetrable to me.”
rows.translation: “我看你的外表也没有那么坚不可摧。”
rows.raw: " “Your exterior doesn’t seem so impenetrable to me.”"

rows.original: “And my name is Amber,” she continues, expression softening into a smile. “Well, that’s just what I chose for myself, anyway. I thought it was nice.”
rows.translation: “我的名字是安珀。”她继续说道，神情柔和成一抹微笑。“不过，那只是我为自己选择的名字。我觉得它很好听。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And my name is Amber,” she continues, expression softening into a smile. “Well, that’s just what I chose for myself, anyway. I thought it was nice.”"

rows.original: “Amber, huh?” you say, nodding. “It’s a nice name. You know, there’s a Terran myth that claims amber is produced by the sun. Poetic, right?”
rows.translation: “安珀，是吗？”你点头说道。“是个好名字。你知道，有个地球传说声称琥珀是由太阳产生的。很有诗意，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Amber, huh?” you say, nodding. “It’s a nice name. You know, there’s a Terran myth that claims amber is produced by the sun. Poetic, right?”"

rows.original: “Yes!”she says, pleased. “It has a lot of ties to the sun, and, well, that was kinda who I wanted to be, y’know? The shining sun...”
rows.translation: “知道！”她开心地说道。“它与太阳有许多联系，而且，嗯，那大概就是我想成为的人，你懂吧？光芒四射的太阳...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes!”she says, pleased. “It has a lot of ties to the sun, and, well, that was kinda who I wanted to be, y’know? The shining sun...”"

rows.original: She trails off, looking at the sky of Mhen’ga and for a moment you wonder if you should start talking about your space adventures again. When she looks back at you, though, she’s wearing an expression of contentment. “Thank you. For everything. Maybe... maybe one day I can really be that person.”
rows.translation: 她的声音渐渐低了下去，望着门加的天空，有那么一刻，你寻思着自己是否该再次谈起太空冒险。然而当她回望你时，脸上却是一副心满意足的神情。“谢谢你。谢谢你所做的一切。也许...也许有一天，我真的能成为那样的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe trails off, looking at the sky of Mhen’ga and for a moment you wonder if you should start talking about your space adventures again. When she looks back at you, though, she’s wearing an expression of contentment. “Thank you. For everything. Maybe... maybe one day I can really be that person.”"

rows.original: “I think you’re doing great already,” you tell her, leaning in to give her a kiss on the cheek. You can feel Amber’s eyes widen a little at the touch of your lips, but she doesn’t shy away. Instead, she smiles a little wider than before and squeezes your hand.
rows.translation: “我觉得你现在已经做得很好了。”你一边告诉她，一边凑近亲吻她的脸颊。你的嘴唇触上安珀时，能感觉到她的眼睛微微睁大，但她并未躲闪。相反，她的笑容比之前更加灿烂，还握紧了你的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think you’re doing great already,” you tell her, leaning in to give her a kiss on the cheek. You can feel Amber’s eyes widen a little at the touch of your lips, but she doesn’t shy away. Instead, she smiles a little wider than before and squeezes your hand."

rows.original: By the time she boards your ship she’s in high spirits, listening intently while you regale her with the tall tales of your interplanetary travel and laughing whenever you point out some quaint peculiarity of the inhabitants. You’ve successfully distracted Amber from her reasons to cry, for now. It’d be a good idea to keep her company every so often just to make sure she’s doing okay.
rows.translation: 登上你的飞船时，她已经兴致高昂。她专心听你讲述那些星际旅行中的夸张奇闻，每当你指出当地居民某种古怪的小习惯，她都会笑出声来。至少暂时而言，你已经成功让安珀忘记了哭泣的理由。最好偶尔陪陪她，确保她一切安好。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time she boards your ship she’s in high spirits, listening intently while you regale her with the tall tales of your interplanetary travel and laughing whenever you point out some quaint peculiarity of the inhabitants. You’ve successfully distracted Amber from her reasons to cry, for now. It’d be a good idea to keep her company every so often just to make sure she’s doing okay."

rows.original: Not to mention introduce her to the other crew members. Some friends would be good for her.
rows.translation: 更不用说还得把她介绍给其他船员。有几个朋友会对她有好处。
rows.raw: " Not to mention introduce her to the other crew members. Some friends would be good for her."

rows.original: Ship
rows.translation: 飞船
rows.raw: "Ship"

rows.original: As it happens, you run into one of them while you’re showing Amber the ship - Anno, friend of everyone.
rows.translation: 带安珀参观飞船时，你碰巧遇到了其中一人——所有人的朋友安诺。
rows.raw: "As it happens, you run into one of them while you’re showing Amber the ship - Anno, friend of everyone."

rows.original: “Oh!” Anno says, wolfish ears perking up immediately. “Hey there, cuties! Who’s your gorgeous friend, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “哦！”安诺说道，一双狼耳立刻竖了起来。“嘿，两位小可爱！[pc.name]，你这位漂亮朋友是谁呀？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh!” Anno says, wolfish ears perking up immediately. “Hey there, cuties! Who’s your gorgeous friend, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: “Hey, Anno,” you say, smiling. “Was just thinking about you, actually - this is Amber. Amber, meet Anno.”
rows.translation: “嘿，安诺。”你微笑着说道。“其实刚才还在想你呢——这是安珀。安珀，这位是安诺。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, Anno,” you say, smiling. “Was just thinking about you, actually - this is Amber. Amber, meet Anno.”"

rows.original: Amber gives Anno a little wave and a nervous smile along with a quiet ‘hey’.
rows.translation: 安珀朝安诺轻轻挥手，露出紧张的笑容，同时小声说了句“你好”。
rows.raw: "\n\nAmber gives Anno a little wave and a nervous smile along with a quiet ‘hey’."

rows.original: “Everyone onboard the ship is a person I hand-picked, Amber,” you tell her, smiling while you pat her tauric half and stroke her fur comfortingly. “You can trust them. Especially Anno, she’ll eat out of your hand if you let her. I don’t think there’s a mean bone in her body.”
rows.translation: “船上的每个人都是我亲自挑选的，安珀。”你微笑着告诉她，同时轻拍她的兽身，抚摸毛皮安慰她。“你可以相信他们。尤其是安诺，只要你愿意，她会乖得直接从你手上吃东西。我觉得她身上没有半点恶意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everyone onboard the ship is a person I hand-picked, Amber,” you tell her, smiling while you pat her tauric half and stroke her fur comfortingly. “You can trust them. Especially Anno, she’ll eat out of your hand if you let her. I don’t think there’s a mean bone in her body.”"

rows.original: “That’s me!” Anno says, winking at Amber. “Nice to meet you, Amber. We should have a chat sometime!”
rows.translation: “说的就是我！”安诺朝安珀眨眨眼。“很高兴认识你，安珀。我们以后应该找时间聊聊！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s me!” Anno says, winking at Amber. “Nice to meet you, Amber. We should have a chat sometime!”"

rows.original: Anno eyes you with a playful grin that speaks volumes. “So, Steele... I really, really hope you weren’t planning on monopolizing this beautiful woman. ‘Cuz uh,” she murmurs, her eyes flitting downwards momentarily, “I can see she’s quite gifted.”
rows.translation: 安诺带着意味深长的顽皮笑容打量你。“所以，斯蒂尔...我真的、真的希望你没打算独占这位美人。因为，呃，”她低声说道，目光短暂地向下扫去，“我看得出她相当有天赋。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno eyes you with a playful grin that speaks volumes. “So, Steele... I really, really hope you weren’t planning on monopolizing this beautiful woman. ‘Cuz uh,” she murmurs, her eyes flitting downwards momentarily, “I can see she’s quite gifted.”"

rows.original: Amber giggles at that, but looks to you for approval. You shrug.
rows.translation: 安珀听了咯咯直笑，却又看向你，等待你的准许。你耸了耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nAmber giggles at that, but looks to you for approval. You shrug."

rows.original: “Hey, I dunno yet. But now that you mention it, actually...”
rows.translation: “嘿，我还不知道呢。不过既然你提到了，其实...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I dunno yet. But now that you mention it, actually...”"

rows.original: You fill Anno in on Amber’s condition and she claps her hands over her mouth in shock.
rows.translation: 你将安珀的状况告诉安诺，她震惊地用双手捂住嘴巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou fill Anno in on Amber’s condition and she claps her hands over her mouth in shock."

rows.original: “That’s horrible! You poor girl!”
rows.translation: “太可怕了！你这个可怜的姑娘！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s horrible! You poor girl!”"

rows.original: Anno catches Amber in a tight, sincere hug, wrapping her arms around the dryad’s back. You smile. Seems like she has one good friend already.
rows.translation: 安诺紧紧而真诚地拥抱安珀，双臂环住树精的后背。你笑了起来。看来她已经有了一个好朋友。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno catches Amber in a tight, sincere hug, wrapping her arms around the dryad’s back. You smile. Seems like she has one good friend already."

rows.original: “So, it might be beneficial to have more than one person to help Amber out, but we’ll see,” you say. “I’m gonna finish up giving her the ship tour and let her take a shower.”
rows.translation: “所以，让不止一个人来帮助安珀或许会有好处，不过以后再看吧。”你说道。“我要继续带她参观飞船，再让她洗个澡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, it might be beneficial to have more than one person to help Amber out, but we’ll see,” you say. “I’m gonna finish up giving her the ship tour and let her take a shower.”"

rows.original: “Oh, a shower,” Amber exclaims, clasping her hands together in glee. “I haven’t had one in so long...”
rows.translation: “哦，洗澡，”安珀惊呼着，欣喜地将双手合在一起。“我已经好久没有洗过了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, a shower,” Amber exclaims, clasping her hands together in glee. “I haven’t had one in so long...”"

rows.original: “Alright, I’ll let you get to it!” Anno chirps, smiling. “You can come by my room any time if you wanna talk, Amber. It’s just down the corridor. See you!”
rows.translation: “好啦，那我就不打扰你们了！”安诺笑着欢快说道。“安珀，如果想聊天，随时都可以来我房间。就在走廊下面。再见！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, I’ll let you get to it!” Anno chirps, smiling. “You can come by my room any time if you wanna talk, Amber. It’s just down the corridor. See you!”"

rows.original: “Bye, Anno!” Amber says, waving as the friendly ausar heads to her room. She turns to you after Anno’s left. “She’s very nice.”
rows.translation: “再见，安诺！”安珀一边说道，一边朝这位友善的奥萨尔人挥手，看着她返回自己的房间。安诺离开后，她转向你。“她人真好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bye, Anno!” Amber says, waving as the friendly ausar heads to her room. She turns to you after Anno’s left. “She’s very nice.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, Anno’s great,” you agree. “C’mon, I’ll show you the hold.”
rows.translation: “是啊，安诺很棒。”你赞同道。“走吧，我带你看看货舱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, Anno’s great,” you agree. “C’mon, I’ll show you the hold.”"

rows.original: You show her around the rest of the ship, though admittedly it’s not a very long tour. She takes particular interest in all the mounting equipment set up in the hold.
rows.translation: 你带她参观飞船的其余部分，不过老实说，整个行程并不算长。她对货舱里设置的各种固定设备尤其感兴趣。
rows.raw: "You show her around the rest of the ship, though admittedly it’s not a very long tour. She takes particular interest in all the mounting equipment set up in the hold."

rows.original: “Oho, wow,” Amber giggles, looking at you slyly. “Looks like someone was ready for my arrival, huh?”
rows.translation: “哦嚯，哇。”安珀狡黠地看着你，咯咯笑道。“看来某个人早就为我的到来做好准备了，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oho, wow,” Amber giggles, looking at you slyly. “Looks like someone was ready for my arrival, huh?”"

rows.original: She gives you a kiss out of nowhere, right on the [pc.skinFurScales] of your cheek.
rows.translation: 她毫无预兆地亲了你一下，正好吻在你脸颊的[pc.skinFurScales]上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a kiss out of nowhere, right on the [pc.skinFurScales] of your cheek."

rows.translation: “嗯，”她终于继续说道，“现在我和你在一起，一切都不一样了。我的意思是，我有地方住、有地方睡，甚至还有饭吃！我有...”她的声音渐渐低了下去，抬起头，睁开蓄满泪光却仍未落泪的双眼。“我有活下去的理由。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well,” she eventually continues, “now that I’m with you, everything’s different. I mean, I have a place to live, sleep, and even eat! I have...” she trails off, raising her head and opening her eyes full of shimmering, unspilled tears. “I have a reason to live.”"

rows.original: You hug Amber against your chest, letting her silently dry her eyes while you run your hand through her hair and rub her back, comforting her with your presence.
rows.translation: 你把安珀抱在胸前，让她默默擦干眼泪，同时用手梳理她的头发、轻抚她的后背，用自己的陪伴安慰她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hug Amber against your chest, letting her silently dry her eyes while you run your hand through her hair and rub her back, comforting her with your presence."

rows.original: “Thanks,” she mutters, pulling back after a little while. “Sorry about that, [pc.name]. I’m still kind of a mess-”
rows.translation: “谢谢，”她嘟囔道，过了一会儿才退开。“抱歉，[pc.name]。我还是一团糟-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks,” she mutters, pulling back after a little while. “Sorry about that, [pc.name]. I’m still kind of a mess-”"

rows.original: “You’re not a mess,” you tell her, stern but calm. “You’re amazing, Amber. The fact we can even stand here and have this conversation is proof of that. So don’t call yourself a mess, okay? It’s not true and I don’t like hearing you be down on yourself.”
rows.translation: “你才不是一团糟，”你语气严肃却平静地告诉她。“你很了不起，安珀。我们现在能站在这里进行这场谈话，本身就是证明。所以别说自己一团糟，好吗？那不是真的，而且我不喜欢听你这样贬低自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re not a mess,” you tell her, stern but calm. “You’re amazing, Amber. The fact we can even stand here and have this conversation is proof of that. So don’t call yourself a mess, okay? It’s not true and I don’t like hearing you be down on yourself.”"

rows.original: “Wow,” Amber says, smiling again. “You really do care about me, huh?”
rows.translation: “哇，”安珀再次露出微笑。“你真的很在乎我，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow,” Amber says, smiling again. “You really do care about me, huh?”"

rows.original: “Of course.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course.”"

rows.original: “How come the teasing only works when you do it?” she mumbles to herself.
rows.translation: “为什么只有你逗我时才会这么有效？”她自言自语地嘟囔道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How come the teasing only works when you do it?” she mumbles to herself."

rows.original: You take a little while to get back on track.
rows.translation: 你们花了一点时间才重新回到正题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a little while to get back on track."

rows.original: “So you don’t mind your current life?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以你不介意现在的生活？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you don’t mind your current life?” you ask."

rows.original: “I mean, if you go to all the effort of finding a cure after you’ve already saved my life, I’ll take it,” Amber says. “Even if we both enjoy it, I know it can be uh, a bit of a burden. It might seem fine now, but maybe after three months have gone by and I’m still showing up at your door breathing hard and needing a fuck you’ll be tired of it.”
rows.translation: “我是说，你都已经救了我的命，如果你又费尽心力找到治疗方法，我会接受的，”安珀说道。“哪怕我们都很享受，我也知道这，呃，可能有些累人。现在也许还没关系，但或许三个月过去以后，我还是气喘吁吁地找上你的房门、急需一场性爱，你就会厌倦了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean, if you go to all the effort of finding a cure after you’ve already saved my life, I’ll take it,” Amber says. “Even if we both enjoy it, I know it can be uh, a bit of a burden. It might seem fine now, but maybe after three months have gone by and I’m still showing up at your door breathing hard and needing a fuck you’ll be tired of it.”"

rows.original: You start to say something but she stops you, explaining herself. “I don’t mean that you’re definitely gonna get tired of me because I suck, or anything! Just that, well, you haven’t lived with the problem.”
rows.translation: 你刚想开口，她便拦住你，继续解释。“我不是说你肯定会因为我很差劲之类的原因而厌倦我！只是，嗯，你还没有真正和这个问题共同生活过。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start to say something but she stops you, explaining herself. “I don’t mean that you’re definitely gonna get tired of me because I suck, or anything! Just that, well, you haven’t lived with the problem.”"

rows.original: “Hmm,” you muse. This is complicated. It looks like she doesn’t mind her current state, but also isn’t averse to being cured of it. You suppose that maybe, in a way, it’s become part of her identity. “So it’s up to me then?”
rows.translation: “嗯，”你沉思起来。这确实很复杂。看起来她不介意现在的状态，但也不抗拒治好它。你觉得从某种意义上说，也许这已经成了她自我认同的一部分。“所以由我决定？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm,” you muse. This is complicated. It looks like she doesn’t mind her current state, but also isn’t averse to being cured of it. You suppose that maybe, in a way, it’s become part of her identity. “So it’s up to me then?”"

rows.original: “I’m sorry to dump that on you,” Amber says, grimacing. “I mean it. I don’t like that I’m weighing you down with personal stuff. But...” she sighs. “I can’t do it myself. I wouldn’t know where to start, or who to see. I’ve barely interacted with anyone in the past few years. I uh, I don’t know if I can really even handle a real society.”
rows.translation: “很抱歉把这件事丢给你，”安珀皱着脸说道。“我是认真的。我不喜欢用私事拖累你。但...”她叹了口气。“我自己做不到。我不知道该从哪里开始，也不知道该找谁。过去几年里，我几乎没和任何人打过交道。我，呃，我甚至不知道自己能不能真正适应正常社会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry to dump that on you,” Amber says, grimacing. “I mean it. I don’t like that I’m weighing you down with personal stuff. But...” she sighs. “I can’t do it myself. I wouldn’t know where to start, or who to see. I’ve barely interacted with anyone in the past few years. I uh, I don’t know if I can really even handle a real society.”"

rows.original: “It’s okay,” you murmur, rubbing one of her soft, furred ears. “It’s okay to be nervous, Amber. And don’t worry, I can handle responsibility.”
rows.translation: “没关系，”你低声说道，揉着她一只柔软、覆有绒毛的耳朵。“感到紧张很正常，安珀。别担心，我能承担这份责任。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s okay,” you murmur, rubbing one of her soft, furred ears. “It’s okay to be nervous, Amber. And don’t worry, I can handle responsibility.”"

rows.original: “Mmmm,” she hums, leaning into your caress.

rows.original: “So you don’t mind being cured or not?” you ask, leaning in to rub her other ear too. “What if it turns you back into a human?”

rows.raw: "\n\n“So you don’t mind being cured or not?” you ask, leaning in to rub her other ear too. “What if it turns you back into a human?”"

rows.original: “Nnnnh... I wouldn’t be too bothered,” she sighs, happily letting you stroke her ears. “I might miss these ear rubs though...”
rows.translation: “嗯啊...我不会太介意，”她叹息道，开心地任你抚摸耳朵。“不过我可能会怀念这样揉耳朵的感觉...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nnnnh... I wouldn’t be too bothered,” she sighs, happily letting you stroke her ears. “I might miss these ear rubs though...”"

rows.original: So in the end, the resolution lies with you. You could cure her, leave her as she is - she doesn’t seem to mind too much either way now that she’s with you - or maybe even change her a little yourself. You don’t think she’d mind, and might even be keen to try out some of them.
rows.translation: 所以最终还是由你决定。你可以治好她，也可以让她保持原样-如今有你陪伴，她似乎并不太在意这两种结果-或者甚至亲自稍微改变她。你觉得她不会介意，甚至可能很想尝试其中一些变化。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo in the end, the resolution lies with you. You could cure her, leave her as she is - she doesn’t seem to mind too much either way now that she’s with you - or maybe even change her a little yourself. You don’t think she’d mind, and might even be keen to try out some of them."

rows.original: If you were to cure her, though, who would you look for to do it? It would be far too dangerous to put Amber’s wellbeing in the hands of a rival corp, especially when you’re in such an ambiguous position yourself as a potential heir.
rows.translation: 不过，如果要治好她，你会找谁来做？把安珀的健康交到竞争对手公司手上实在太危险了，尤其是你自己作为一名潜在继承人的地位尚不明确。

rows.original: She blushes at the romantic implications. “A-anyway, yeah, that’s one of the main things I wanted to do. It all started when I landed a gig painting murals back in my homeworld. Of course we didn’t have, like, professional paints, and the brushes were made from my own hair, but it was a way to get my mind off all the shit that was going on. Then one day, I came across a bunch of minis someone had thrown away; one thing led to the other, and before I knew it I had started a small collection.”
rows.translation: 她因其中的浪漫意味而红了脸。“总、总之，是啊，这就是我最想做的事情之一。一切始于我在家乡接到一份画壁画的工作。当然，我们没有什么专业颜料，画笔也是用我自己的毛做的，但这能让我暂时忘掉周围发生的那些烂事。后来有一天，我偶然发现别人扔掉的一堆模型；事情一件接着一件，等我反应过来时，已经开始收藏这些东西了。”

rows.original: You and Amber spend the next several minutes looking up art supplies online. Since she’ll have to rebuild her collection from scratch, you also look up some porcelain miniatures, but she doesn’t seem very excited about those. To your surprise, what catches her eye are related ads for wargame minis, from high tech armored warriors and tanks, to fantasy dragons. She tries not to let it show, but it’s pretty obvious that she’s already familiar with some of those franchises.

rows.raw: "Trying not to sound awkward, you tell Amber that you need a bit more space at night."

rows.original: She giggles. “It’s OK, you can say it. I’ve noticed how [pc.hasCock|happy your Johnn[pc.hasCocks|ies get|y gets]|worked-up you get] when we’re lying next to each other, just trying to sleep.”

rows.original: “Yeah...” you admit blushing a little despite yourself. You seriously underestimated how horny the deertaur can make you with her mere presence.
rows.translation: “是啊...”你承认道，仍不由自主地微微脸红。你实在低估了鹿人马仅凭存在便能让你多么欲火中烧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah...” you admit blushing a little despite yourself. You seriously underestimated how horny the deertaur can make you with her mere presence."

rows.original: “I mean, I’m happy I have this effect on you, but it doesn’t make it easy for either of us to get proper sleep,” she reasons, putting a finger on her lower lip. “Alright, I’ll go back to sleeping in my room.”
rows.translation: “我是说，我很高兴自己能对你产生这种影响，但这也让我们俩都很难好好睡觉。”她将一根手指放在下唇，推理道。“好吧，我会回自己的房间睡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean, I’m happy I have this effect on you, but it doesn’t make it easy for either of us to get proper sleep,” she reasons, putting a finger on her lower lip. “Alright, I’ll go back to sleeping in my room.”"

rows.original: “Don’t worry, I’ll make sure to visit,” you placate with[pc.mfn| an easy grin| a smile| a smile].

rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, I’ll make sure to visit,” you placate with[pc.mfn| an easy grin| a smile| a smile]."

rows.original: You wake up with a languid yawn, stretching your [pc.toneRange 0 70|[pc.arms]|strong arms] as you blink the sleep away. Suddenly, the smell of freshly-baked sweet pastries wafts into your [pc.nose]. Looking to the side, you see Amber behind a serving cart. In one hand, she holds the lid of a tray. In the other, she holds a folding fan, which she’s currently using to fan the delicious fragrance in your direction.
rows.translation: 你慵懒地打着哈欠醒来，伸展[pc.toneRange 0 70|[pc.arms]|强壮的手臂]，眨去睡意。忽然，新鲜出炉的甜点香气飘入[pc.nose]。你看向一旁，发现安珀站在餐车后面，一只手拿着托盘盖，另一只手拿着折扇，正用它把诱人的香气扇向你。
rows.raw: "You wake up with a languid yawn, stretching your [pc.toneRange 0 70|[pc.arms]|strong arms] as you blink the sleep away. Suddenly, the smell of freshly-baked sweet pastries wafts into your [pc.nose]. Looking to the side, you see Amber behind a serving cart. In one hand, she holds the lid of a tray. In the other, she holds a folding fan, which she’s currently using to fan the delicious fragrance in your direction."

rows.original: You can’t help laughing a little at the sight.
rows.translation: 看到这一幕，你忍不住笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help laughing a little at the sight."

rows.original: “Wakey wakey!” she says, perhaps a bit too cheerfully for your sleepy brain, but you’re far from complaining.
rows.translation: “醒醒，醒醒!”她说道，对你困倦的大脑而言或许过于欢快，但你完全没有怨言。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wakey wakey!” she says, perhaps a bit too cheerfully for your sleepy brain, but you’re far from complaining."

rows.original: “Morning, Amber,” you greet with a smile, meeting her gaze.
rows.translation: “早上好，安珀。”你微笑着问候，与她四目相对。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Morning, Amber,” you greet with a smile, meeting her gaze."

rows.original: “Thought you’d like breakfast in bed. I made it myself!” she beams proudly.
rows.translation: “我想你会喜欢在床上吃早餐。这是我亲手做的!”她骄傲地笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thought you’d like breakfast in bed. I made it myself!” she beams proudly."

rows.original: “You know me well,” you reply with an appreciative nod. “Hmm, let’s see...”
rows.translation: “你很了解我，”你赞许地点点头回答。“嗯，让我看看...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know me well,” you reply with an appreciative nod. “Hmm, let’s see...”"

rows.original: Cardamom buns? “How did you even manage to get cardamom pods out here?!”
rows.translation: 豆蔻面包？“你到底是怎么在这里弄到豆蔻荚的？！”
rows.raw: "\n\nCardamom buns? “How did you even manage to get cardamom pods out here?!”"

rows.original: “Heh, it wasn’t easy, but my [silly|isekai ]online grocery skills are leveling up very well,” she says cheekily. You can’t help laughing.
rows.translation: “嘿，这可不容易，不过我的[silly|异世界]网购技能等级提升得很不错，”她俏皮地说道。你忍不住笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heh, it wasn’t easy, but my [silly|isekai ]online grocery skills are leveling up very well,” she says cheekily. You can’t help laughing."

rows.original: Madeleines? “You really went all-out this time, huh? They look so good!”
rows.translation: 玛德琳蛋糕？“你这次可真是使出了浑身解数啊？看起来真好吃！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMadeleines? “You really went all-out this time, huh? They look so good!”"

rows.original: The deer girl blushes at your compliment. “Took a few tries, but eventually I managed to get it down.”
rows.translation: 鹿女因你的称赞红了脸。“试了几次，不过最后总算掌握诀窍了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe deer girl blushes at your compliment. “Took a few tries, but eventually I managed to get it down.”"

rows.original: You regard her with a knowing smirk. “And I bet you ate all of the failed attempts.”
rows.translation: 你露出心照不宣的坏笑看着她。“我敢打赌，那些失败品都被你吃掉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regard her with a knowing smirk. “And I bet you ate all of the failed attempts.”"

rows.original: “Tee-hee!”

rows.original: Not wasting any more time, you take one of the pastries into your hand and give it a bite, letting out a throaty moan as the heavenly flavor spreads over your tastebuds. The texture is perfect, and the sweetness just right... Amber gazes at you anxiously, awaiting your evaluation of her cooking skills.
rows.translation: 你不再浪费时间，拿起一块糕点咬了一口。天堂般的滋味在味蕾上散开，你不禁发出一声低沉的呻吟。口感无可挑剔，甜度也恰到好处...安珀焦急地注视着你，等待你评价她的厨艺。

The texture is perfect, and the sweetness just right... Amber gazes at you anxiously, awaiting your evaluation of her cooking skills."

rows.original: “Hmm, I’ll give it ten-and-a-half toasts out of eleven coffee cups!” you tease.
rows.translation: “嗯，十一杯咖啡满分的话，我给它十分半片吐司！”你调侃道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm, I’ll give it ten-and-a-half toasts out of eleven coffee cups!” you tease."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn to her with a playful smirk on your lips. “It means you’ll have to bring me breakfast in bed again so I can give it a proper rating,” you say, grabbing another pastry and unceremoniously shoving it into your mouth."

rows.original: “Hey Urbolg, might be a bit of a long shot but you’re pretty well-connected and well-supplied. Any chance you’ve got some tauric ‘equipment’ lying about?” you ask him.
rows.translation: “嘿，乌尔博格，这可能有点碰运气，不过你人脉广、货源也足。你手头有没有一些半人马用的‘装备’？”你问他。

rows.original: “Hnh,” Urbolg says, rubbing his furry chin. “Funny ye ask. With all the morons comin’ through and leaving their junk here, I’ve got quite the collection. Actually, ye’d be helping me out by taking it. Got a whole bunch of harnesses, mounts, restraints, leg-lockers... ye name it, s’probably in there. Why, ye got your romantic eyes set on a ‘taur, kid?” he teases.
rows.translation: “哼，”乌尔博格摸着毛茸茸的下巴说道。“你问得巧了。来这儿的蠢货总把破烂留下，我还真收了相当多。说真的，你拿走还算帮了我的忙。这里有一大堆挽具、架台、束缚器、锁腿器...你说得出的，大概都在里面。怎么，小子，你看上哪个半人马了？”他调侃道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hnh,” Urbolg says, rubbing his furry chin. “Funny ye ask. With all the morons comin’ through and leaving their junk here, I’ve got quite the collection. Why, ye got your romantic eyes set on a ‘taur, kid?” he teases."

rows.original: “Something like that,” you admit. “Besides, ya never know. Could come in handy by itself.”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that,” you admit. “Besides, ya never know. Could come in handy by itself.”"

rows.original: “Aye, that was what I thought when I got it,” Urbolg agrees, nodding. “But I’m a bit of a hoarder, see. So I hope ye got a purpose in mind fer it, else ye’ll end up like me.”
rows.translation: “没错，我当初拿下它们时也是这么想的，”乌尔博格点头表示赞同。“不过我这人有点爱囤东西。所以我希望你已经想好用途了，不然最后就会变得跟我一样。”

rows.original: He gestures at the miscellaneous piles of mechanical junk lying about. Point taken. He helps you pack all of the shiny equipment into your hold, the two of you working up a good sweat while you lug all of the bits and bobs inside. Afterwards, you’re standing in the hold leaning against a mounting platform while you talk.
rows.translation: 他朝四周杂乱堆放的机械破烂比了比。道理很明显。他帮你把所有锃亮的装备装进货舱，你们俩搬着大大小小的零件，忙得出了一身汗。之后，你靠着一个安装平台站在货舱里与他交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe gestures at the miscellaneous piles of mechanical junk lying about. Point taken. He helps you pack all of the shiny equipment into your hold, the two of you working up a good sweat while you lug all of the bits and bobs inside. Afterwards, you’re standing in the hold leaning against a mounting platform while you talk."

rows.original: “Where did you even get all this stuff, Urbolg?” you ask, curious. “It looks mostly new.”
rows.translation: “乌尔博格，你到底是从哪里弄来这些东西的？”你好奇地问。“看起来大多都很新。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where did you even get all this stuff, Urbolg?” you ask, curious. “It looks mostly new.”"

rows.original: “Aye, well. I think it was a couple o’ leithans passing by,” he says, recalling it. “Thing about comin’ here is that it’s easy to get in. Not so easy to get back out. So, they didn’t come back and their ship was just sittin’ there. I took their things ‘fore someone else beat me to the punch.”
rows.translation: “嗯，这个嘛。我记得是几个路过的莱萨人留下的，”他回忆道。“来这里容易，回去可没那么容易。所以他们没回来，飞船就一直停在那里。我赶在别人抢先之前拿走了他们的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aye, well. I think it was a couple o’ leithans passing by,” he says, recalling it. “Thing about comin’ here is that it’s easy to get in. Not so easy to get back out. So, they didn’t come back and their ship was just sittin’ there. I took their things ‘fore someone else beat me to the punch.”"

rows.original: He shrugs matter-of-factly. It’s true - out here, it’s every man and woman for themselves. Might as well pick while the picking’s good. When you’ve both had a short rest after the heavy lifting, Urbolg gives you a wave and heads back into the hangar. He’s good folk, for a pirate.
rows.translation: 他理所当然地耸耸肩。事实的确如此 - 在这种地方，人人都只能靠自己。既然有东西可捡，当然不捡白不捡。搬完重物后，你们俩稍事休息，乌尔博格向你挥挥手，回了机库。作为海盗，他人还不错。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe shrugs matter-of-factly. It’s true - out here, it’s every man and woman for themselves. Might as well pick while the picking’s good. When you’ve both had a short rest after the heavy lifting, Urbolg gives you a wave and heads back into the hangar. He’s good folk, for a pirate."

rows.original: As you are walking up to your ship, you notice something you were not expecting. Amber is standing outside the ship fidgeting bashfully and looking around as if waiting for someone. That someone is most likely you. You walk over to Amber and notice something different about her. Awkwardly, Amber fidgets about standing in front of the ship. Amber acts nervously, the cause becomes obvious looking at her head to toe. She’s wearing a regal bright red dress with small straps that cover up her shoulders. Her impressive bust is pushed up by the tight-fitting clothing, looking more than a little uncomfortable. The pressed up chest spills out the top of her dress. Light sparkles float around her getting a closer look; an inspection reveals glitter on her face and her dress, making her shine beautifully. The dress covers her entire front including some of the deer parts of her body, while the back stops at the point her human and deer halves connect. As you reach her, you also notice her hair is done up as well, loose braids falling off to the side; she must’ve gotten some help with that. On closer inspection, her hair bounces with a light spring and a gentle sheen. As her hair shifts, the sheen tricks your eyes momentarily into seeing a gentle, graceful fire burning. She continues to look around until she sees you walking up to her and looks away from you bashfully. “What’s all this Amber? I’m surprised to see you off the ship, let alone wearing a dress.” You give her another once-over; the bashful taur’s hand creeps up to her hair and idly twirls a stray curl... “I just wanted to do something special for you, e-even if only once.” Amber’s face turns bright red as she speaks. Her tail sways slowly behind her as she twirls her hair in a finger. It is really cute to see her acting so bashful honestly. You just smile at her and can’t help but chuckle a little. Amber’s back legs shuffle nervously, gently tapping her hooves on the ground. “So um would you want to go out on a date with me this holiday season please?” Are you really going to turn down this poor girl that has clearly put a lot of effort into preparing for this night?

rows.raw: " As you are walking up to your ship, you notice something you were not expecting. Amber is standing outside the ship fidgeting bashfully and looking around as if waiting for someone. That someone is most likely you. You walk over to Amber and notice something different about her. Awkwardly, Amber fidgets about standing in front of the ship. Amber acts nervously, the cause becomes obvious looking at her head to toe. She’s wearing a regal bright red dress with small straps that cover up her shoulders. Her impressive bust is pushed up by the tight-fitting clothing, looking more than a little uncomfortable. The pressed up chest spills out the top of her dress. Light sparkles float around her getting a closer look; an inspection reveals glitter on her face and her dress, making her shine beautifully. The dress covers her entire front including some of the deer parts of her body, while the back stops at the point her human and deer halves connect. As you reach her, you also notice her hair is done up as well, loose braids falling off to the side; she must’ve gotten some help with that. On closer inspection, her hair bounces with a light spring and a gentle sheen. As her hair shifts, the sheen tricks your eyes momentarily into seeing a gentle, graceful fire burning. She continues to look around until she sees you walking up to her and looks away from you bashfully. “What’s all this Amber? I’m surprised to see you off the ship, let alone wearing a dress.” You give her another once-over; the bashful taur’s hand creeps up to her hair and idly twirls a stray curl... “I just wanted to do something special for you, e-even if only once.” Amber’s face turns bright red as she speaks. Her tail sways slowly behind her as she twirls her hair in a finger. It is really cute to see her acting so bashful honestly. You just smile at her and can’t help but chuckle a little. Amber’s back legs shuffle nervously, gently tapping her hooves on the ground. “So um would you want to go out on a date with me this holiday season please?” Are you really going to turn down this poor girl that has clearly put a lot of effort into preparing for this night? "

rows.original: WritingDen
rows.raw: "WritingDen"

rows.original: “Sure. Who am I to deny a lovely lady a date?” You smile at her as you watch her face light up in glee. “Before we go [pc.name], I wanted to give you a small gift from...” She cuts herself off glancing sidelong to the present off to the gangway leading onto the ship. She moves over slowly, leaning over to pick the present up. The present isn’t very large around but it’s about the length of your forearm. The wrapping paper is velvety red with slight emerald undertones as the colors overlap with each other. The paper gives off a small shine and has been wrapped without a single wrinkle. Amber brings the gift up to her chest, holding it so tightly her bust nearly spills out from the top of her dress. She clenches the gift firmly, to ensure it doesn’t drop. Glancing at her face, you see her looking at you then off to the side, at the ground, and then back at you finally. She hands you the present slowly, without a word. Words are unnecessary as you see her eyes glow with a small, loving smile creeping on her face. With a small chuckle to yourself, you lightly take the present. You thank Amber for the Christmas gift. Her face lights up. The smile on her face completely covers her cheeks, making her glow brightly from the glitter on her face. You take hold of her hand into yours and intertwine your fingers as you walk along to Anon’s Bar.
rows.translation: “好啊。我怎么能拒绝一位可爱的女士邀我约会呢？”你朝她微笑，看着她的脸因喜悦而亮了起来。 “[pc.name]，我们出发之前，我想把一份来自...的小礼物送给你。”她忽然停下话头，侧眼看向放在通往飞船舷梯旁的礼物。她慢慢走过去，弯腰把礼物捡了起来。 礼物的横截面不大，但长度差不多与你的前臂相当。包装纸是天鹅绒般的红色，两种颜色相叠处隐约透着翡翠色调。纸面微微泛着光泽，包得平整无比，没有一丝褶皱。安珀把礼物抱到胸前，紧紧搂着它，以至于乳房几乎从裙子顶部溢了出来。她用力抓牢礼物，以免它掉下去。 你看向她的脸，只见她先望着你，又转向一旁和地面，最后才再次看你。她一言不发地慢慢把礼物递给你。言语已经没有必要，因为你看见她眼中泛起光芒，脸上也渐渐浮现出一抹充满爱意的微笑。你轻轻笑了笑，小心接过礼物。 你感谢安珀送给你的圣诞礼物。她的脸顿时亮了起来。笑容完全铺满她的双颊，脸上的闪粉令她熠熠生辉。你握住她的手，与她十指相扣，一同走向阿农酒吧。

rows.original: You both reach the bar and walk inside. There is a soft sound of a piano playing a gentle melody for the bar to listen to. There are a few decorations around the bar itself, mostly just small ornaments and candy canes. The lights feel dim, noticing some tiny little gentle green Christmas lights are hanging on the ceiling. The bar feels quite empty at a closer glance. Most of the customers seemed to be with family or loved ones. Luckily you are not here alone as you give Amber’s hand a soft squeeze. Amber smiles, giving your hand a light squeeze as well. You find it slightly difficult getting Amber a seat since she has a deer lower half. You eventually manage to make it up for her by having her kneel on the seat of a booth table; granted that takes some work, but you manage. A waitress comes over and takes your order for food and drinks and then walks away. While you wait for your food and drinks you two sit silently for a while. Amber fiddles with her hair then takes a glance in your direction. You look back at her and smile. Amber blushes lightly but doesn’t look away; she smiles back at you. Her left ear twitches, noticing the blush on her face. You try to say something but the waitress returns with your drinks. You sigh and smile with a sense of nostalgia as you look back on your time spent with Amber. You stare into those shining light blue eyes as you start to get lost in them. While this date was not expected, it is not unwelcome from your favorite deertaur crewmate. You wonder who would put her up to this. The answer seems obvious, but you rather ask to know for certain. “W-who put me up to this?” Amber stares blankly at the sudden question. Her hand’s interlock, but not without fumbling a couple of times first. “I-in truth, nobody did. I’ve been wanting to do something special with you for a while. Outside the ship.” She pauses, taking a deep breath to gather her courage to continue. “I-I have just been too afraid t-to leave the ship without a real reason.” Amber starts to twirl her hair on a single finger staring at the table. A tinge of shame and sadness crosses her face while she speaks. Removing her finger from her hair, she stares back into your eyes. “As I was fighting with my indecision, Anno popped up in the hold seeing me thinking about something. She asked me what was wrong and I told her that I wanted to do something special with you off the ship; even if it was something as simple as a walk, but I know you are busy and I didn’t want to disrupt you at a bad time. Anno made me feel silly. She told me that I wouldn’t be a bother to you. She brought up the holidays and mentioned this was the perfect time to ask you out. She helped me prepare for this ‘surprise’ as she called it. I’ve never worn something so refined before; it feels almost wasted on me.” An enfeebled smile appears on Amber’s face. You are about to say something but Amber shakes her head slightly, attempting to break her out of the negative attitude. Her smile returns to being bright but tender. “A-anyways, sorry about being a downer there. As I said, Anno helped me out choosing a dress and fixed up my hair. She even put a slight amount of glitter on me saying it will bring out the color of the dress and my eyes.” Amber looks down at the table fidgeting in place. Her ears flick with constant motion. She grips tightly the bottom of her dress. This is one busy deertaur when it comes to attempting to hide her embarrassment. You take her chin in your hand and lightly lift her head. You stare again into those beautiful light blue eyes. You plant an arm down for support as slowly you move your body towards Amber across the table. You softly close your eyes as you plant a tender kiss on Amber’s lips. You shift back across the table back in your seat leaving the deertaur beet red. “I-I guess that’s one way to tell someone they are wrong.” She chuckles nervously. As you are just about to ask her another question, your food arrives. You both dig in, finishing the rest of your meal in silence. Once you’re done, you chat with Amber about all sorts of different things. Ranging from how you met, to some of your adventures, and just complimenting how gorgeous she looks. The compliments cause her to act meekly, as she stutters to respond but fails to form a proper response. You laugh as you wonder what is next on the list of things to do.
rows.translation: 你们俩来到酒吧，走了进去。柔和的钢琴声奏着轻缓的旋律，供酒吧里的客人聆听。酒吧四周摆着一些装饰，大多只是小饰品和拐杖糖。灯光显得昏暗，你注意到天花板上悬着一些小巧柔和的绿色圣诞彩灯。 仔细一看，酒吧里显得相当空旷。大多数顾客似乎都去陪伴家人或爱人了。好在你并非独自前来，你轻轻捏了捏安珀的手。安珀微微一笑，也轻轻回握了一下。 安珀的下半身是鹿躯，要替她找到座位有些困难。最后你让她跪在卡座的座位上，总算解决了问题；诚然这费了些功夫，不过你还是做到了。 一位女服务员走过来，记下你们点的食物和饮料后离开。在等待餐点和饮料时，你们俩沉默地坐了一会儿。安珀拨弄着自己的头发，然后朝你瞥了一眼。你回望她，露出微笑。安珀微微脸红，却没有移开视线；她也对你笑了。 她左耳轻轻一颤，脸上的红晕也映入你眼中。你正想说些什么，女服务员却带着饮料回来了。你叹了口气，回想起与安珀共度的时光，怀着怀旧之情微微一笑。你凝视着那双闪亮的浅蓝色眼睛，渐渐迷失其中。 虽然这场约会出乎意料，但最喜欢的鹿人马船员发出邀请，你并不排斥。你想知道是谁怂恿她这么做的。答案似乎显而易见，但你还是宁愿亲口询问，以便确认。 “是-是谁让我这么做的？”面对突如其来的问题，安珀茫然地看着你。她几次笨拙地尝试，才终于把双手十指交扣在一起。“其-其实，没有人。这段时间我一直想和你一起做些特别的事。在飞船外面。”她停下来，深吸一口气，鼓起勇气继续说下去。 “我-我只是一直害怕，没有正当理由就-就离开飞船。”安珀盯着桌面，用一根手指卷起自己的头发。她说话时，脸上掠过一丝羞愧与悲伤。她把手指从头发上抽出来，再次直视你的眼睛。 “我还在犹豫不决时，安诺突然来到货舱，看见我正想着什么。她问我怎么了，我便告诉她，我想在飞船外和你一起做些特别的事；哪怕只是散散步也好，可我知道你很忙，不想在不合适的时候打扰你。安诺让我觉得自己这样很傻。她说我不会给你添麻烦。她提到节日，说现在正是约你出去的最佳时机。她帮我准备了这场她所谓的‘惊喜’。我以前从没穿过这么精致的衣服；穿在我身上几乎是浪费。”安珀脸上浮现出一抹无力的微笑。 你正要说些什么，安珀却轻轻摇头，试图摆脱消极的情绪。她的笑容重新变得明朗而温柔。“总-总之，抱歉刚才说了些扫兴的话。正如我说的，安诺帮我挑了裙子，还整理了头发。她甚至给我抹了一点闪粉，说这样能衬出裙子和眼睛的颜色。”安珀低头看着桌面，坐立不安。她的耳朵不停摆动，双手紧紧攥住裙摆。 这位鹿人马为了掩饰尴尬，动作可真够多的。你用手托住她的下巴，轻轻抬起她的头。你再次凝视那双美丽的浅蓝色眼睛。你撑下一条手臂作为支点，身体越过桌面，慢慢靠近安珀。你轻轻闭上双眼，在安珀唇上印下一个温柔的吻。随后你越过桌面退回座位，只留下满脸通红的鹿人马。“我-我想，这的确是一种告诉别人她错了的方式。”她紧张地轻笑道。 你正要再问她一个问题，食物却送到了。你们俩开始用餐，沉默着吃完剩下的饭菜。结束后，你和安珀聊起各种各样的事情。从你们如何相识，到你经历过的一些冒险，再到单纯称赞她看起来有多么漂亮。听见这些赞美，她表现得很腼腆，结结巴巴地试图回应，却连一句完整的话都说不出来。你笑了起来，好奇活动清单上的下一项是什么。

rows.original: Amber nods her head in agreement. Taking your hand as you help her up, you walk out of the bar. Heading back to your ship you two talk about all sorts of topics. You never did find out how she managed to get off the ship considering her condition. That is a mystery for another time, for now, you just enjoy seeing how Amber would be if she was cured. One day, you may just have to make it happen so you can have more special evenings like this. It’s been a while since you saw Amber so happy and excited for something outside of sex. That smile she gives you is incredibly precious. You feel slightly bad for not continuing the date but you feel incredibly tired. Exhaustion must be catching up with you from all the traveling and adventuring. Once you are back on the ship, you kiss Amber on the lips as you part ways. “Happy Holidays Amber.” You whisper into her ears just before she leaves with a blush on her face.
rows.translation: 安珀点头表示同意。你伸手扶她起身，随后一起走出酒吧。返回飞船的路上，你们俩聊了各种各样的话题。鉴于她的身体状况，你始终不知道她是怎么离开飞船的。这件事只好留待以后再解开，现在你只想欣赏安珀治愈后会有的模样。总有一天，你也许真得让这件事成为现实，好让你们拥有更多这样的特别夜晚。 你已经很久没有见过安珀为了性以外的事情如此开心、兴奋了。她送给你的笑容无比珍贵。你因为没有继续约会而略感愧疚，但自己实在疲惫不堪。四处旅行和冒险的劳累一定正在追上你。回到飞船后，你在与安珀分别时吻了吻她的嘴唇。“安珀，节日快乐。”你在她离开前贴着她的耳朵轻声说道，她的脸上泛起了红晕。

rows.original: “Sorry Amber, but I have some important things to take care of.” Amber’s ears droop, a frown marring her usually cute features. It kills you to let her down, but she gives you a little nod of understanding. “It’s fine, [pc.name]. I know you’re busy, with your dad’s probes and all. Maybe next year?” you hear the hope in her voice. “Yeah, maybe next year.” You place a light hand on her shoulder and go inside the ship beside Amber.
rows.translation: “对不起，安珀，我还有一些重要的事情要处理。”安珀的耳朵垂了下去，平时可爱的脸蛋被愁容笼罩。让她失望令你心痛，但她还是理解地点了点头。 “没关系，[pc.name]。我知道你很忙，还有你父亲的探针什么的。也许明年？”你听得出她声音里的希望。 “是啊，也许明年。”你轻轻把手放在她肩上，与安珀一同走进飞船。
