Hell, the gates in the core are basically running off computers and hardware that haven’t been updated in a millennium - you better hope to God if they break, somebody in-system knows how to fix it.” She chuckles, shaking her head at the thought. “So, anyway, I "

rows.original: rustled some jimmies
rows.translation: 惹恼了不少人
rows.raw: "rustled some jimmies"

rows.original: ruffled some feathers
rows.translation: 触怒了不少人
rows.raw: "ruffled some feathers"

rows.original: with my paper about starting to update and expand on the core tech powering the Gates.”
rows.translation: ，因为我主张开始更新并拓展为跃迁门供能的核心技术。”
rows.raw: " with my paper about starting to update and expand on the core tech powering the Gates.”"

rows.original: “First step: micro-ize the tech. There’s no reason for the Gates to be so damn big, right? Maybe a thousand years ago we needed capital-ship sized platforms for the tech, but nowadays it’s all about microchips so small you can’t even see them, plus holo and hardlight mechanisms. So we spent about a year working to miniaturize the Gates, with a little help from the Joint Ausar Fleet’s R&D, who immediately saw the potential for transmat on the individual scale: imagine being able to invade a planet from orbit, but completely bypassing the planet’s air-to-ground defenses. You just truck into orbit and warp your troops and material behind enemy lines. It could have revolutionized warfare, much less personal travel and planetary transportation. God, imagine standing on Ausaril, then just stepping through a door frame and onto Terra? We could have changed the galaxy!”
rows.translation: “第一步：将技术微型化。跃迁门根本没理由造得那么大，对吧？也许一千年前，我们确实需要主力舰尺寸的平台来承载这项技术，但如今的时代讲究的是肉眼都看不见的微型芯片，以及全息和硬光装置。于是我们花了大约一年时间来缩小跃迁门，还得到了阿沙犬联合舰队研发部的一点帮助。他们立刻看出了个人尺度物质传送的潜力：想象一下，你可以从轨道上入侵一颗行星，却能完全绕过该行星的空对地防御。只要开进轨道，就能把部队和物资跃迁到敌后。它本可以彻底改变战争，更别说个人旅行和行星交通了。老天，想象一下站在阿苏里尔，只需跨过一道门框就到了地球？我们本可以改变整个银河系！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First step: micro-ize the tech. There’s no reason for the Gates to be so damn big, right? Maybe a thousand years ago we needed capital-ship sized platforms for the tech, but nowadays it’s all about microchips so small you can’t even see them, plus holo and hardlight mechanisms. So we spent about a year working to miniaturize the Gates, with a little help from the Joint Ausar Fleet’s R&D, who immediately saw the potential for transmat on the individual scale: imagine being able to invade a planet from orbit, but completely bypassing the planet’s air-to-ground defenses. You just truck into orbit and warp your troops and material behind enemy lines. It could have revolutionized warfare, much less personal travel and planetary transportation. God, imagine standing on Ausaril, then just stepping through a door frame and onto Terra? We could have changed the galaxy!”"

rows.original: Wow. “What happened?” you ask.
rows.translation: 哇。“后来发生了什么？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. “What happened?” you ask."

rows.original: She shrugs and sighs. <i>“We done fucked up. The Fleet pushed us to biological testing too quickly, before we had a complete sample pool. My team got bullied into trying a field test way before we were ready to go: tried to warp a special forces squad into a hostage scenario. One of the King’s kids had been taken by religious fanatics pissed that she’d ditched her dying body for cyberware. Threatening to execute her on live extranet feed. You might have seen it on the news, maybe four years ago? We tried to put six operators in, ended up getting two on the ground, both fucked up pretty badly. No idea where the other four even went. Probably dead.
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩，叹了口气。<i>“我们彻底搞砸了。舰队在样本池尚未完备前，就逼着我们过早进行生物测试。我的团队被迫在远未准备好时进行实地测试：试图把一支特种部队跃迁进一场人质危机现场。国王的一个孩子遭到宗教狂热分子绑架，那些人因为她抛弃垂死的肉身、改装成赛博格而怒不可遏。他们威胁要在外网上直播处决她。你可能在新闻上看过，大概是四年前？我们试图送六名行动人员进去，结果只有两人抵达地面，而且都伤得很重。另外四人去了哪里，我们完全不知道。他们大概已经死了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs and sighs. <i>“We done fucked up. The Fleet pushed us to biological testing too quickly, before we had a complete sample pool. My team got bullied into trying a field test way before we were ready to go: tried to warp a special forces squad into a hostage scenario. One of the King’s kids had been taken by religious fanatics pissed that she’d ditched her dying body for cyberware. Threatening to execute her on live extranet feed. You might have seen it on the news, maybe four years ago? We tried to put six operators in, ended up getting two on the ground, both fucked up pretty badly. No idea where the other four even went. Probably dead."

rows.original: <i>“At least the princess managed to get out in the confusion. Scared the shit out of the bastards, bought a few seconds - enough time for our ground team to kick the door in and put them down.
rows.translation: <i>“至少那位公主趁乱逃了出来。那一幕把那些混蛋吓得够呛，为她争取了几秒钟——足够我们的地面小队破门而入，把他们解决掉。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“At least the princess managed to get out in the confusion. Scared the shit out of the bastards, bought a few seconds - enough time for our ground team to kick the door in and put them down."

rows.original: “That’s... not what Syri told me.”
rows.translation: “那...跟希莉告诉我的不一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s... not what Syri told me.”"

rows.original: “Syri wasn’t involved until after. Some son of a bitch in the Admiralty thought we’d sort the problem out in a hurry if it was my sister going through next time. Turns out that no, science doesn’t work that way. Assholes. At least she survived, unlike the other guy that went through in the second test.” Anno rubs her temples, sighing. “I got out right after that.
rows.translation: “希莉事后才参与进来。海军部某个狗娘养的以为，如果下一次进去的是我妹妹，我们就会赶紧把问题解决。结果证明，并不会，科学不是这么运作的。混蛋。至少她活了下来，不像第二次测试里通过跃迁门的另一个家伙。”安诺揉着太阳穴，叹了口气。“那之后我立刻离职了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Syri wasn’t involved until after. Some son of a bitch in the Admiralty thought we’d sort the problem out in a hurry if it was my sister going through next time. Turns out that no, science doesn’t work that way. Assholes. At least she survived, unlike the other guy that went through in the second test.” Anno rubs her temples, sighing. “I got out right after that."

rows.original: Your dad helped me out of a tough spot after that... I was in a pretty bad place. Gave me a chance to come work for his company, to work without... that hanging over me, without brass breathing down my neck about my projects.”
rows.translation: 之后你父亲帮我摆脱了困境...当时我的状态很糟。他给了我一个机会，让我能为他的公司工作，工作时不必让...那件事一直压在心头，也不必让高层在身后盯着我的项目。”
rows.raw: " Your dad helped me out of a tough spot after that... I was in a pretty bad place. Gave me a chance to come work for his company, to work without... that hanging over me, without brass breathing down my neck about my projects.”"

rows.original: Akkadi R&D
rows.translation: 阿卡迪研发部
rows.raw: "Akkadi R&D"

rows.original: Akkadi Research & Development
rows.translation: 阿卡迪研究与开发部
rows.raw: "Akkadi Research & Development"

rows.original: Ask Anno about her work before joining Steele Tech.
rows.translation: 询问安诺加入斯蒂尔科技前的工作。
rows.raw: "Ask Anno about her work before joining Steele Tech."

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家人
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: “My family?” Anno asks when you broach the topic. “Well, there’s me, my sister, and our parents. I’ve got a pretty big extended family, too, especially on my dad’s side. More cousins, aunts, and uncles than I can count. But they’re not who you’re asking about, are they?”
rows.translation: “我的家人？”你提起这个话题时，安诺问道。“嗯，有我、我妹妹，还有我们的父母。我的大家族也相当庞大，尤其是父亲那边。堂表亲、姑姨和叔伯多得数不过来。不过你想问的不是他们，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“My family?” Anno asks when you broach the topic. “Well, there’s me, my sister, and our parents. I’ve got a pretty big extended family, too, especially on my dad’s side. More cousins, aunts, and uncles than I can count. But they’re not who you’re asking about, are they?”"

rows.original: She chuckles at that, “Right, so uh, my dad’s big into business. Holds a lot of shares in Akkadi, JoyCo, even Steele Tech. You know the type, I’m sure: wealthy socialite, throws the annual charity ball at year’s end for all the other wealthy socialites. He might not be the bad-ass adventurer your dad was, but mine’s still a good guy. Kind, always telling us how proud he is. The kind of man who spends more time thinking up ways to give things away than being a ruthless businessman. Pretty much the opposite of my mom: she’s the business hound of the family. Pulled herself up by the bootstraps. Definitely the one Syri took after. Tough as nails, always pushing us to do better. Pushed hard to get me into a good school, then Akkadi.”
rows.translation: 她轻笑一声，“好吧，我父亲很热衷于商业。他持有阿卡迪、乔伊公司，甚至斯蒂尔科技的大量股份。你肯定知道这种人：富有的社会名流，每年年末都会为其他富豪名流举办年度慈善舞会。他也许不像你父亲那样是个厉害的冒险家，但我父亲依然是个好人。他很和善，总会告诉我们他有多么为我们骄傲。他是那种花在琢磨如何送出东西上的时间，比做无情商人还多的人。几乎和我母亲完全相反：她才是家里的商界猎犬。她白手起家。希莉显然更像她。她坚韧不拔，总是督促我们做得更好。为了让我进一所好学校、之后进入阿卡迪，她竭尽全力地推动我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles at that, “Right, so uh, my dad’s big into business. Holds a lot of shares in Akkadi, JoyCo, even Steele Tech. You know the type, I’m sure: wealthy socialite, throws the annual charity ball at year’s end for all the other wealthy socialites. He might not be the bad-ass adventurer your dad was, but mine’s still a good guy. Kind, always telling us how proud he is. The kind of man who spends more time thinking up ways to give things away than being a ruthless businessman. Pretty much the opposite of my mom: she’s the business hound of the family. Pulled herself up by the bootstraps. Definitely the one Syri took after. Tough as nails, always pushing us to do better. Pushed hard to get me into a good school, then Akkadi.”"

rows.original: “You’d like them,” she adds with a smile. “I couldn’t have asked for better parents.”
rows.translation: “你会喜欢他们的，”她微笑着补充。“我不可能奢求比他们更好的父母了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’d like them,” she adds with a smile. “I couldn’t have asked for better parents.”"

rows.original: She lets out a long breath and leans back, resting her head in her hands. “And then you have my sister, Syri. There’s a good Terran expression for her... black sheep! I can’t imagine her turning out any more... not how our parents wanted. She got the same full ride to the Ausaril School of Technology that I did, and she immediately threw it in their faces and enlisted in the Fleet.” Anno shakes her head, exasperated. “You know, I can see where she was coming from. I still don’t know how I feel about letting the family name carry me through school and all, but didn’t exactly feel the need to tell my folks to get fucked, either.
rows.translation: 她长长吐出一口气，向后靠去，双手枕着头。“然后就是我妹妹希莉。地球人有个很贴切的说法来形容她...害群之马！我简直无法想象她还能变得更...更不符合父母的期望。她和我一样拿到了阿苏里尔理工学院的全额奖学金，却立刻把这份好意甩到父母脸上，跑去加入了舰队。”安诺恼火地摇摇头。“你知道，我能理解她当时的想法。我到现在都不知道该如何看待自己靠着家族名望一路念完学校之类的事，但我也没觉得有必要叫父母滚蛋。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lets out a long breath and leans back, resting her head in her hands. “And then you have my sister, Syri. There’s a good Terran expression for her... black sheep! I can’t imagine her turning out any more... not how our parents wanted. She got the same full ride to the Ausaril School of Technology that I did, and she immediately threw it in their faces and enlisted in the Fleet.” Anno shakes her head, exasperated. “You know, I can see where she was coming from. I still don’t know how I feel about letting the family name carry me through school and all, but didn’t exactly feel the need to tell my folks to get fucked, either."

rows.original: “But that’s Syri for you. She gets so worked up about things. ‘Passionate,’ dad called her,” Anno says with a laugh. “For twins, we really couldn’t be more different. She’s a scary, angry marine lady; I’m a laid-back desk jockey... but I love her to pieces.
rows.translation: “但希莉就是这样。她一碰上事情就格外激动。父亲说那叫‘热情’，”安诺笑着说道。“明明是双胞胎，我们却实在不能更不一样了。她是个吓人又易怒的陆战队女人；我是个悠闲的办公室职员...可我爱死她了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But that’s Syri for you. She gets so worked up about things. ‘Passionate,’ dad called her,” Anno says with a laugh. “For twins, we really couldn’t be more different. She’s a scary, angry marine lady; I’m a laid-back desk jockey... but I love her to pieces."

rows.original: I’m glad we’ve had a chance to get closer here on the ship. I’ve missed her the last couple of years
rows.translation: 我很高兴我们有机会在船上变得更亲近。过去几年里，我一直很想她
rows.raw: " I’m glad we’ve had a chance to get closer here on the ship. I’ve missed her the last couple of years"

rows.original: <i>“I wish we hadn’t grown apart so much the last couple of years. But that’s what you get for working on different sides of the galaxy, I guess
rows.translation: <i>“我真希望过去几年我们没有疏远这么多。但我想，在银河系两端工作就是会这样吧
rows.raw: "<i>“I wish we hadn’t grown apart so much the last couple of years. But that’s what you get for working on different sides of the galaxy, I guess"

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家人
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: Anno’s Family
rows.translation: 安诺的家人
rows.raw: "Anno’s Family"

rows.original: Ask Anno about her family.
rows.translation: 询问安诺的家人。
rows.raw: "Ask Anno about her family."

rows.original: Victor
rows.translation: 维克托
rows.raw: "Victor"

rows.original: “Think you could tell me a little about my Dad?” you ask, remembering Anno’s... experience with your father.
rows.translation: “你能跟我讲讲我父亲吗？”你问道，想起安诺和你父亲之间的...经历。
rows.raw: "“Think you could tell me a little about my Dad?” you ask, remembering Anno’s... experience with your father."

rows.original: She grins. “Sure, [pc.name]. I didn’t know him that well, though. Mostly through work, to be honest, though he kept close tabs on me while I was getting settled in at Steele Tech R&D. He was a good guy... you could see the kindness in his eyes. And the age. Have you ever looked an elephant in the eye? Your dad had that same look, like he’d seen eternity and just smiled as it passed him by.”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑。“当然，[pc.name]。不过我对他也没有那么了解。说实话，主要还是通过工作认识的，虽然我刚在斯蒂尔科技研发部安顿下来时，他一直很照顾我。他是个好人...你能从他眼中看出那份善良。还有岁月。你直视过大象的眼睛吗？你父亲的眼神也是那样，仿佛他见证永恒从身边流过，只是微笑以对。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins. “Sure, [pc.name]. I didn’t know him that well, though. Mostly through work, to be honest, though he kept close tabs on me while I was getting settled in at Steele Tech R&D. He was a good guy... you could see the kindness in his eyes. And the age. Have you ever looked an elephant in the eye? Your dad had that same look, like he’d seen eternity and just smiled as it passed him by.” "

rows.original: Anno smiles, sliding her hand over yours. “You know, he helped me out in a pretty bad time in my life. I was between jobs, basically living off convention speeches and my folks putting me up. He listened to one lecture I gave, not half an hour in a smoky hotel con room with maybe half a dozen washed-up eggheads in it, altogether. I guess he saw something in me. Or my work, anyway. Bought me a drink after my speech and, by night’s end, I had a ship ticket and a job waiting for me on Verdure at the R&D labs. I didn’t even realize until my first day on the job whom the hell I’d met.”
rows.translation: 安诺微笑着，用手覆上你的手。“你知道吗，他在人生中一段相当糟糕的时期帮助了我。当时我没有工作，基本靠参加大会演讲和父母接济生活。他听了我的一场讲座，地点只是烟雾缭绕的旅馆会议室，总共也就半打过气的书呆子，时间还不到半小时。我想，他在我身上看到了某种东西。或者是在我的研究里。演讲后他请我喝了一杯，当晚结束时，我已经拿到一张船票，翠绿星的研发实验室也有一份工作在等着我。直到上班第一天，我才意识到自己遇见的究竟是谁。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno smiles, sliding her hand over yours. “You know, he helped me out in a pretty bad time in my life. I was between jobs, basically living off convention speeches and my folks putting me up. He listened to one lecture I gave, not half an hour in a smoky hotel con room with maybe half a dozen washed-up eggheads in it, altogether. I guess he saw something in me. Or my work, anyway. Bought me a drink after my speech and, by night’s end, I had a ship ticket and a job waiting for me on Verdure at the R&D labs. I didn’t even realize until my first day on the job whom the hell I’d met.” "

rows.original: “You’re a lot like him, you know. You have that same kindness in your eyes,” you say.
rows.translation: “你很像他，知道吗。你们眼中有着同样的善意，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“You’re a lot like him, you know. You have that same kindness in your eyes,” you say."

rows.original: “He always had this amazing humor. That cunning way he’d talk, always circling around you, weaving words around you like a duelist feints,” you say.
rows.translation: “他总是那么幽默。说话时那种狡黠的方式，总绕着你打转，像决斗者佯攻一样用言语把你团团围住，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“He always had this amazing humor. That cunning way he’d talk, always circling around you, weaving words around you like a duelist feints,” you say."

rows.original: “He was a good man. I’ll never forget that. But he always had this hardness to him, like he was made of iron beneath that smile of his. You always had this impression it wouldn’t make him break a sweat to completely destroy you,” you say.
rows.translation: “他是个好人。我永远不会忘记这一点。但他身上总有一种冷硬，仿佛笑容之下是钢铁铸成的。你始终觉得，即便要彻底摧毁你，他也不必流一滴汗，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“He was a good man. I’ll never forget that. But he always had this hardness to him, like he was made of iron beneath that smile of his. You always had this impression it wouldn’t make him break a sweat to completely destroy you,” you say."

rows.original: Anno shrugs and smiles, slipping a comforting arm around your waist. “I miss him too, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 安诺耸耸肩，微笑着用一条手臂安慰地搂住你的腰。“我也想念他，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno shrugs and smiles, slipping a comforting arm around your waist. “I miss him too, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Victor
rows.translation: 维克托
rows.raw: "Victor"

rows.original: Victor Steele
rows.translation: 维克托·斯蒂尔
rows.raw: "Victor Steele"

rows.original: Ask Anno about your father.
rows.translation: 向安诺询问你的父亲。
rows.raw: "Ask Anno about your father."

rows.original: Studies
rows.translation: 学业
rows.raw: "Studies"

rows.original: “So, where’d you go to school?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那么，你在哪里上学？”你问。
rows.raw: "“So, where’d you go to school?” you ask."

rows.original: Anno beams. “Ausaril Tech. Go Jackals, whooo!” she cheers, half sarcastically. “It was the best school for science on the homeworld, so that’s where I went. I was lucky enough to get into the military-sponsored program... kind of like the Terran-Space Coalition’s ‘officer candidate school,’ though it didn’t end up with me doing a tour of duty or anything. Mostly just reservist training, and helped get me military-grade clearance for later when I went to work at Akkadi.”
rows.translation: 安诺喜笑颜开。“阿苏里尔理工。豺狼队加油，呜呼！”她半带讽刺地欢呼。“那是母星最好的科学学府，所以我去了那里。我很幸运地进入了军方资助的项目...有点像地球太空联盟的‘军官候选人学校’，不过最终并没有让我服役之类的。主要只是预备役训练，而且后来我去阿卡迪工作时，这也帮我取得了军用级别的许可。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno beams. “Ausaril Tech. Go Jackals, whooo!” she cheers, half sarcastically. “It was the best school for science on the homeworld, so that’s where I went. I was lucky enough to get into the military-sponsored program... kind of like the Terran-Space Coalition’s ‘officer candidate school,’ though it didn’t end up with me doing a tour of duty or anything. Mostly just reservist training, and helped get me military-grade clearance for later when I went to work at Akkadi.”"

rows.original: She takes a moment to flex her arm muscles in a mock bodybuilder’s pose. “Also helped me get in shape, too. I was a pudgy little shit before, and now look at me - I cut a pretty impressive figure, if I do say so myself!” She gives you a playful wink before she resumes.
rows.translation: 她花了一会儿摆出模仿健美运动员的姿势，屈起手臂肌肉。“这也帮我练好了身材。我以前可是个胖乎乎的小混蛋，现在看看我——要我自己说，我这身材可相当不错！”她俏皮地向你眨眨眼，随后继续说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a moment to flex her arm muscles in a mock bodybuilder’s pose. “Also helped me get in shape, too. I was a pudgy little shit before, and now look at me - I cut a pretty impressive figure, if I do say so myself!” She gives you a playful wink before she resumes. "

rows.original: “Anyway, school. We ausar have always valued technology. Comes from living on a shitty desert planet that’s always trying to kill us. Tech made it possible for us to beat Mother Nature. Or at least escape her and find planets that sucked less. Ausaril Tech was the biggest and best technology academy, and I worked my ass off while I was there. Had my bachelor’s before I was twenty, ended up teaching a few lower-level theory courses a couple of years later.”
rows.translation: “总之，说回学校。我们阿沙犬人一向重视科技。毕竟我们生活在一个糟糕透顶、总想弄死我们的沙漠星球上。科技让我们能够战胜大自然。或者至少逃离她，寻找没那么糟糕的行星。阿苏里尔理工是规模最大、最优秀的科技学院，我在那里拼命学习。不到二十岁就拿到了学士学位，几年后还教过几门低年级理论课程。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, school. We ausar have always valued technology. Comes from living on a shitty desert planet that’s always trying to kill us. Tech made it possible for us to beat Mother Nature. Or at least escape her and find planets that sucked less. Ausaril Tech was the biggest and best technology academy, and I worked my ass off while I was there. Had my bachelor’s before I was twenty, ended up teaching a few lower-level theory courses a couple of years later.”"

rows.original: She smiles, her eyes faraway and reminiscing. “That’s where I met my girlfriend, too. She was a cute little thing, fresh off the galactic rim, just looking to get her pilot’s license and having the damnedest time with all the high-level math. ‘I have computers for all this,’ she was always saying. Good thing I wanted some extra spending money and ended up tutoring on the side. That’s how we actually got together, me and Kaede. Man, I was a real party girl back then, too, always dragging her to games and frat shit. I don’t know how I had time to do any studying, much less work... actually, I do know: by not sleeping ever. I was pretty much a walking pharmacy of stims and caffeine by the time I turned in my last bits of doctoral work. Ended up fainting right in the professor’s office. Plop! Down I went the second I handed it off.”
rows.translation: 她微笑着，目光飘向远方，沉浸在回忆之中。“我也是在那里遇到女朋友的。她是个可爱的小家伙，刚从银河边缘来到这里，只想考个飞行员执照，却被所有高等数学折腾得要命。‘这些事我都有电脑来算，’她总是这么说。幸好我想多赚点零花钱，最后做起了兼职辅导。于是我们才真正走到了一起，我和枫。天啊，那时候我也真是个派对女王，总拉着她去看比赛、参加兄弟会的破事。我都不知道自己哪来的时间学习，更别说工作了...其实我知道：完全不睡觉。交出博士研究最后几部分时，我简直就是一座由兴奋剂和咖啡因支撑的行走药房。最后直接昏倒在教授办公室里。啪嗒！我刚把材料递出去，人就倒下了。”

rows.original: “So you know your dad hired me, of course. Picked me up himself after a convention speech, gave me a job working in Steele Tech’s R&D at corporate headquarters. It was an amazing job, you know: all the resources and expertise of my government-sponsored lab at Akkadi, but half the regulations and red-tape, not to mention no government spooks breathing down my neck. Of course I couldn’t work on warp tech like I’d wanted to - Steele doesn’t have any of the contracts or patents related to the Gates - but it was still an awesome gig.”
rows.translation: “你当然知道，是你父亲雇了我。他亲自在一场大会演讲后找到我，让我到斯蒂尔科技总部的研发部门工作。那份工作非常棒，你知道吗：拥有我在阿卡迪政府资助实验室里享有的全部资源和专业知识，却只有一半的规章制度和繁文缛节，更别说再也没有政府密探在我身后盯着。当然，我没法按自己的愿望研究跃迁技术——斯蒂尔没有任何与跃迁门相关的合同或专利——但那仍是一份极好的差事。”

Of course I couldn’t work on warp tech like I’d wanted to - Steele doesn’t have any of the contracts or patents related to the Gates - but it was still an awesome gig.”"

rows.original: She smiles a bit, her gaze wandering far away. “Especially when Vic gave me my own lab and team right out of the gate. Even Akkadi didn’t do that. I always got the feeling that he trusted me... had faith in me. I don’t know why; I mean, all he had to go on was one shitty lecture I gave and talking over drinks after.” Anno’s smile grows, though it takes on an unmistakably sad quality as she speaks. “While I worked there, I could have sworn... I was certain he was grooming me to take over R&D. I only worked there a couple years, but Vic still gave me more and more responsibility, more teams to oversee, more important projects, entire labs even. Honestly, I’d figured that by now that I would be the head of Applied Sciences or one of the other big divisions.”
rows.translation: 她微微一笑，目光飘向远方。“尤其是维克一开始就给了我自己的实验室和团队。就连阿卡迪也没这么做。我总觉得他信任我...对我抱有信心。我不知道为什么；我的意思是，他能作为判断依据的只有我那场糟糕的讲座，以及之后一起喝酒交谈的经历。”安诺的笑容愈发灿烂，却也随着她继续讲述而带上一种明显的哀伤。“在那里工作时，我敢发誓...我确信他是在培养我接管研发部门。我只在那里干了几年，但维克仍然交给我越来越多的职责、越来越多需要监管的团队、越来越重要的项目，甚至是整座实验室。老实说，我原以为自己现在应该已经成为应用科学部或其他某个大型部门的主管了。”

Honestly, I’d figured that by now that I would be the head of Applied Sciences or one of the other big divisions.”"

rows.original: Anno chuckles, “Who’d have thought your dad’s last project for me would be tossing me out of R&D and to some fucking planetary branch post. I mean, what the hell? Let’s just take one of our best scientists and put her in the middle of bumfuck nowhere to run a store. That makes sense, doesn’t it?” She runs a hand through her snowy hair and sighs. “I still don’t know what I did to deserve that. I MUST have fucked up somewhere, I just... I just can’t see where.
rows.translation: 安诺轻笑一声，“谁能想到，你父亲交给我的最后一个项目，竟然是把我踢出研发部，扔到某个该死的行星分部岗位上。我的意思是，搞什么鬼？让我们把最优秀的科学家之一送到鸟不拉屎的偏僻地方去经营商店。很合理，对吧？”她用手梳过雪白的头发，叹了口气。“我到现在都不知道自己做了什么才落得这个下场。我肯定在什么地方搞砸了，我只是...只是看不出来。

rows.original: “So, what do you think of Nova?” you ask, gesturing out the shop front to the derelict spaceship around you.
rows.translation: “那么，你怎么看诺瓦号？”你指着商店外包围你们的废弃飞船问道。
rows.raw: "“So, what do you think of Nova?” you ask, gesturing out the shop front to the derelict spaceship around you."

rows.original: “Honestly? Scares the hell out of me,” Anno says, matter-of-factly. “The decks creak, pipes and wires break all the time... I’m amazed we have power. And more amazed that when we do, the reactor doesn’t go nuclear. I wouldn’t be surprised if I wake up one morning as a pile of ash. And that’s on a good day.”
rows.translation: “说实话？吓死我了，”安诺直截了当地说道。“甲板咯吱作响，管道和电线总是断裂...我们居然还有电，已经让我震惊。更令我震惊的是，有电时反应堆居然没有发生核爆。我一点都不会奇怪自己哪天早晨醒来变成一堆灰。而这还算好日子。”

And more amazed that when we do, the reactor doesn’t go nuclear. I wouldn’t be surprised if I wake up one morning as a pile of ash. And that’s on a good day.”"

rows.original: Anno shudders. “Sorry to be a downer, boss. It’s not the worst gig in the world: at least I’m not stationed on Galotia or something. Still, this ship’s seen better days, even putting aside the crash. I’m not sure if the Nova got shot down or just fell into the planet’s gravity well, but this place is ancient, and I don’t use the word lightly. I’m still poking around, doing some research on it. I know it’s human, but an extranet search didn’t turn up any trace of it. At least, from before the rushers found it. No departure records, no crew manifest, no record of who owned it... I’ve turned up something about a Bell-Isle-stroke-Grunmann company from the robo-goo-things outside after I net-hacked a few of them, but other than that... nothing. Every computer onboard is either slagged or wiped, and I can’t recover anything. The only databanks I’ve come across are deadlocked. I tried connecting to the reactor’s computer, and got my rig fried for my trouble.”
rows.translation: 安诺打了个寒颤。“抱歉说得这么扫兴，老板。这不是世上最糟的差事：至少我没被派驻加洛提亚之类的地方。不过就算不提坠毁，这艘船的好日子也早已过去。我不确定诺瓦号是被击落，还是直接掉进了行星的重力井，但这里古老得不可思议，我绝不是随便使用这个词。我仍在四处调查，研究它。我知道它属于人类，但在外网上搜索不到任何痕迹。至少在狂奔者发现它之前没有。没有出发记录，没有船员名单，也没有所有权记录...我入侵了外面几个机器人黏液怪后，查到一点关于贝尔岛/格伦曼公司的信息，但除此之外...什么都没有。船上每台电脑不是烧成废渣，就是遭到清空，我什么都恢复不了。遇到的数据库全都彻底锁死。我试着连接反应堆电脑，结果自己的设备被烧毁了。”

Every computer onboard is either slagged or wiped, and I can’t recover anything. The only databanks I’ve come across are deadlocked. I tried connecting to the reactor’s computer, and got my rig fried for my trouble.”"

rows.original: “Something’s seriously wrong with this ship,” she concludes. And quieter, she adds, “When my computer burnt out, I heard... God, it was like the wails of the damned. This place is a tomb.”
rows.translation: “这艘船有非常严重的问题，”她总结道。随后又压低声音补充：“我的电脑烧毁时，我听到了...天啊，就像受诅咒者的哀嚎。这里是一座坟墓。”

rows.original: “Woah.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah.”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” Anno sighs. “It’s like something out of a horror movie, but so far we’re just in the tense part, before the jump scares. There’s even been some disappearances, you know? That Shekel girl or whatever across the way’s been screaming about it, just about starting a riot... but she’s not wrong. I don’t think its slavers, though. The pioneers woke this ship up when they landed, and now?”
rows.translation: “是啊，”安诺叹气。“这就像恐怖电影里的情节，只是目前还处于惊吓镜头前的紧张部分。你知道吗，甚至还发生过人员失踪？对面那个叫谢凯尔还是什么的女孩一直为此大喊大叫，都快发动暴乱了...但她说得没错。不过我不觉得是奴隶贩子干的。拓荒者登陆时唤醒了这艘船，而现在呢？”

rows.original: “Who the raskvel? Or do you mean planet-wide? Or just on the ship? No, don’t ask me that, I don’t know anybody in Nova except the bartender and that stone-cold dominatrix lady that runs the Mess. So, uh, planet-wide. That sounds fun.”
rows.translation: “谁，拉斯克维尔人？还是你指整个星球？或只是船上的人？不，别问我这个，我在诺瓦号上除了酒保和经营混乱酒吧那个冷酷的女支配者，谁也不认识。所以，呃，说整个星球吧。听起来很有趣。”

rows.original: “First thing to know: there are a lot of different species on Tarkus. Really, that’s the trend of the Rush, with multi-species planets. Normally you only get one dominant race per world, like on Terra or Ausaril; here, you’ve got several equally powerful, prominent races sharing the world. The only reason Tarkus seems like the Planet of the Rask is because they’re the ones holding onto Novahome when the pioneers opened the gate up, and of course they landed on the creepy human ship.”
rows.translation: “首先要知道：塔库斯有许多不同物种。其实这正是行星大淘金的趋势，充满多物种行星。通常每个世界只有一个占主导地位的种族，比如地球或阿苏里尔；在这里，却有几个同样强大显赫的种族共享世界。塔库斯之所以看起来像拉斯克星球，只是因为拓荒者开启跃迁门时，正是他们守着诺瓦之家，而且他们当然登陆在那艘诡异的人类飞船上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First thing to know: there are a lot of different species on Tarkus. Really, that’s the trend of the Rush, with multi-species planets. Normally you only get one dominant race per world, like on Terra or Ausaril; here, you’ve got several equally powerful, prominent races sharing the world. The only reason Tarkus seems like the Planet of the Rask is because they’re the ones holding onto Novahome when the pioneers opened the gate up, and of course they landed on the creepy human ship.”"

rows.original: “That could be because Tarkus is actually a hybrid planet made up of several fragments. I don’t know if the different races are natives to the different worlds of Tarkus, if they came here by colonization, or what, but it’s strange.” She pauses a moment for breath, then grins, “I’ve been thinking of writing a book while I’m here, in case you’re wondering.”
rows.translation: “原因可能是塔库斯其实是一颗由多个碎片组成的混合行星。我不知道不同种族是塔库斯各个世界的原住民，还是通过殖民来到这里，或是别的什么，但这很奇怪。”她停下来喘了口气，随后咧嘴一笑，“如果你想知道，我一直考虑趁待在这里写一本书。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That could be because Tarkus is actually a hybrid planet made up of several fragments. I don’t know if the different races are natives to the different worlds of Tarkus, if they came here by colonization, or what, but it’s strange.” She pauses a moment for breath, then grins, “I’ve been thinking of writing a book while I’m here, in case you’re wondering.”"

rows.original: She sighs wistfully. “Anyway, the most important actual races are the sydians and the raskvel. Sydians are pretty interesting: they rip apart metal and eat it, thanks to some kind of chemical on their feelers. Plus they have biological aphrodisiacs in their spit. I think? Could be cum, need to research more. Possibly hands on, if you know what I mean. Either way, I’m sure Xenogen is going to love getting their dirty hands on some... specimens... to dissect. They also have big dicks, big, bulging muscles, and an adversity to clothes, which as a lady who likes the D, is a pretty big bonus. They’re eye candy of the highest order.”
rows.translation: 她惆怅地叹气。“总之，最重要的本地种族是西迪安人和拉斯克维尔人。西迪安人很有趣：多亏触须上的某种化学物质，他们能撕碎金属并吃下去。而且唾液里还有生物催情剂。我想是唾液？也可能是精液，需要进一步研究。也许需要亲手研究，如果你懂我的意思。不管怎样，我肯定异种生物科技会很喜欢把脏手伸向某些...样本...进行解剖。他们还有大阴茎、大块隆起的肌肉，而且讨厌衣服；对于喜欢鸡巴的女士而言，这可是很大的优点。他们是最高级别的养眼尤物。”

rows.original: “Then there’s the raskvel. They’re cute as buttons, but their average I.Q. seems to be about fish, give or take trout. Some are clever repairmen, and I have to admit, they did wonders restoring this ship of theirs, but... they just seem kind of doe-eyed, you know? They’re the kind of aliens I want to have stuffed animals of and cuddle, not have a conversation with. And they smell like dirt and leather. The ones here in Novahome are pretty tame, but watch out if you go outside: they get kind of rapey when nobody’s there to stop them, and those wrenches of theirs pack a punch when they’ve got shotguns built into the grip.”
rows.translation: “然后是拉斯克维尔人。她们可爱极了，但平均智商似乎和鱼差不多，上下浮动一条鳟鱼。有些是聪明的维修工，我得承认，她们修复自己的飞船时创造了奇迹，但是...你知道，她们看起来就是有点天真无邪？这种外星人让我想拥有她们的毛绒玩具来拥抱，而不是与她们交谈。而且她们闻起来像泥土和皮革。诺瓦之家里的还算温顺，但到外面要小心：没有人阻止时，她们会变得有些强奸成性，而且她们的扳手要是握柄内置霰弹枪，打起来相当疼。”

rows.original: Anno blanches at your reaction, her ears and tail all tucking down as she frowns. A moment later, though, she gets a coy grin and leans in as if to whisper. “Actually,” she starts, voice seductive and dripping with sexuality. “I’ve been doing some very delicate work. Classified work. But if you helped me finish, then... I’d have no reason to stick around on Tarkus, and Corporate might approve my transfer. To your ship.”
rows.translation: 安诺看到你的反应后脸色发白，耳朵和尾巴全都垂了下来，眉头紧锁。不过片刻后，她又露出狡黠的笑容，凑近过来，仿佛要低声耳语。“其实，”她开口说道，声音诱惑，充满色情意味。“我一直在做一项非常精密的工作。机密工作。但如果你帮我完成，那么...我就没有理由继续留在塔库斯，公司也可能批准我的调职申请。让我调到你的船上。”

rows.original: “Alright! Now we’re talking!” Anno beams, waving you around the counter and booting up her holoterminal. You step up beside Anno, and are greeted by the sight of a highly detailed 3D projection of what could only be the Nova itself. It truly is a massive ship, now that you can see it in full: longer than a Coalition dreadnought and twice as thick around. Anno’s rigged the display to show power distribution, heat spread, and other various technical minutiae
rows.translation: “好！这才像话！”安诺喜笑颜开，挥手示意你绕过柜台，同时启动她的全息终端。你走到安诺身旁，映入眼帘的是一幅极其细致的三维投影，毫无疑问正是诺瓦号本身。如今看到全貌，你才真正意识到这艘船有多么庞大：它比联盟无畏舰更长，船体粗了整整一倍。安诺设置显示了电力分配、热量扩散及其他种种技术细节

rows.original: section of the ship that seems to be drawing an inordinate amount of power. “Nobody lives there. There’s nothing. It doesn’t even show up on any of the raskvel maps, and they’ve been just about everywhere. I had to crack open old hard-copy schematics from the bridge just to find power lines and air ducts going there, and reconstructed my digital layout from that. It’s a ghost deck, completely off the radar. Deck 13.”
rows.translation: 区域似乎正在抽取极不寻常的大量电力。“那里没人居住。什么都没有。它甚至没出现在任何拉斯克维尔地图上，而他们几乎去过所有地方。我不得不翻出舰桥上的旧式纸质结构图，才找到通往那里的电力线路和通风管道，并据此重建数字布局。这是一层幽灵甲板，完全不在记录之中。第13层甲板。”

rows.original: “A ghost deck?”
rows.translation: “幽灵甲板？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A ghost deck?”"

rows.original: She nods, and presses a button that zooms your view close in on the deck, giving you a cross-section view of it. “It’s an old, old Earth custom, I found out. Skipping floor 13 on buildings, deck 13 on ships and the like. Unlucky number. Nobody even noticed it wasn’t there: Deck 13 in the stair wells and elevators just leads to a mechanical closet, every time. Nothing to look at but old tools. But in the center of the deck? There’s something MASSIVE drawing power from all over the ship.”
rows.translation: 她点点头，按下一个按钮，把视角放大到那层甲板，向你显示其剖面图。“我查到，这是一种非常古老的地球习俗。建筑跳过13楼，船只跳过13层甲板之类的。不吉利的数字。甚至根本没人发现它不在那里：楼梯间和电梯里的第13层甲板每次都只会通往一个机械储物间，里面除了旧工具什么也没有。但甲板中央呢？有某个极其庞大的东西正在从整艘船吸取电力。”

Nobody even noticed it wasn’t there: Deck 13 in the stair wells and elevators just leads to a mechanical closet, every time. Nothing to look at but old tools. But in the center of the deck? There’s something MASSIVE drawing power from all over the ship.”"

rows.original: “Alright. So what? What’s that got to do with your work?”
rows.translation: “好吧。那又怎样？这和你的工作有什么关系？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright. So what? What’s that got to do with your work?”"

rows.original: Anno fidgets. “Well... I don’t know, honestly. I don’t even know WHY I’m here, except that your dad wanted me here. But I can guess: this ship is human, very, very old, and very, very advanced for what it is. My best guess is that the Nova was a generation ship: basically what we all did before the warp gates came around. Load a bunch of people up in a ship with lots of supplies and catapult them towards a habitable star system. But where’s the crew? The Nova was a ghost ship before it crashed, as far as I can tell: no bodies, nothing. And every computer and databank on the ship is either deadlocked or wiped.”
rows.translation: 安诺不安地动了动。“嗯...老实说，我不知道。我甚至不知道自己为什么会在这里，只知道是你父亲希望我来。但我可以猜：这艘船属于人类，非常、非常古老，以它的年代而言却又非常、非常先进。我最合理的猜测是，诺瓦号曾经是一艘世代飞船：基本上就是跃迁门出现前大家使用的方式。让一群人带着大量物资登船，再把他们弹射向一个宜居星系。但船员呢？据我所知，诺瓦号坠毁前就已经是幽灵船：没有尸体，什么都没有。船上的每台电脑和每个数据库不是彻底锁死，就是遭到清空。”

My best guess is that the Nova was a generation ship: basically what we all did before the warp gates came around. The Nova was a ghost ship before it crashed, as far as I can tell: no bodies, nothing. And every computer and databank on the ship is either deadlocked or wiped.”"

rows.original: “Something happened to the crew, boss. Something bad.”

rows.original: She sighs and turns off the display. “Listen. My girlfriend Kaede and I went poking around in a chunk of the Nova that broke off on impact. A big section of the ship. And there was... something inside it. Something alive, or close enough to it. I’ve got some theories, boss, but... I need to see what’s on that ghost deck to be sure. Help me get in there, and we’ll find out what really happened to the Nova. You in?”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，关闭显示器。“听着。我和女朋友枫曾经在诺瓦号撞击时脱落的一块残骸里探索。那是船体很大的一部分。而里面有...某种东西。某种活着的东西，或者足够接近活物。我有一些理论，老板，但是...我必须亲眼看看那层幽灵甲板上有什么，才能确定。帮我进去，我们就能查明诺瓦号究竟发生了什么。你加入吗？”

rows.original: “Alright, alright, let me get my things,” Anno says, slipping out of your grasp with a wink. “I’ll meet you up at your ship, alright?”
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧，让我去拿东西，”安诺说着，向你眨眨眼，从你的怀抱中溜走。“我去你的船上和你碰面，好吗？”

I’d LOVE to come with you, but unless you’ve gotten the whole CEO thing sorted out, I’d lose my job. rows.translation: 快救救我！那些狂热粉丝们齐声尖叫，每个人都试图抢走你那宝贵的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]。让这种事情发生确实并不容易，但你想，这样的经历将来一定会让你更加坚定自己的决心...比如当你在会议室里面对那些年纪更大、更富有、权力更大的对手时。

rows.original: The playful, hurt screams of his fanbase follow him down to the curb and out of sight. “Well, that was kinda weird,” Anno says, laughing breathily. “Good behavior though, for sure! Don’t let the shitty critics get’cha down.” She rubs your cheek. “How’s about we keep it movin’? There’s plenty ‘a flat tires out there like them, no doubt we’ll find the opposite!”
rows.translation: 他那充满童趣、带着些许痛苦的粉丝们的尖叫声一直伴随着他，直到他走到了路缘边，从此消失在人们的视线之外。嗯，那确实有点奇怪。安诺喘着气笑着说。不过，你的表现确实很好！别让那些负面的评论影响到你。她轻轻揉了揉你的脸颊。我们继续前进吧。外面肯定还有很多像他们这样的‘漏气轮胎’，我们一定能找到相反的情况！

rows.original: “Thanks,” you exhale, see her nod and go. As you’ve learned today, petplay isn’t for everyone. You emerge from worry and concern different, resolving to bear the burden if you take it up again. Things might not have gone swimmingly, but like a bike... you can always get back on, try, try again.
rows.translation: 谢谢。你呼出一口气，看到她点了点头，于是便离开了。正如你今天所领悟到的，这种“宠物扮演”并不适合所有人。经历了这些之后，你感到自己变得有所不同了，也决心如果再次尝试的话，一定会承担起由此带来的责任。虽然事情并没有顺利进行，但就像骑自行车一样...你总可以重新开始，继续尝试、再试一次。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks,” you exhale, see her nod and go. As you’ve learned today, petplay isn’t for everyone. You emerge from worry and concern different, resolving to bear the burden if you take it up again. rows.translation: 以及 [pc.barkMeow] 当那些轻拍动作变得过于频繁，而你那已经被“清除记忆”的大脑无法处理这些刺激时，你就会开始呜咽起来。总之，很快你就会变成真正的“吸引点”，吸引着周围的一切 更多 在人群中。
rows.raw: " and [pc.barkMeow] and whimper when the headpats reach critical and your wiped mind can’t process the feedback. Suffice it to say, you quickly become the real attraction, drawing even more of a crowd."

rows.translation: 并非每个人的意图都是善意的。喂，这里又不是什么该死的公园！把你的...那个东西...那个动物...随便什么玩意儿都带到别的地方去吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nNot everyone’s intentions are agreeable. “Hey, this isn’t a fucking park! Take your... thing... animal.... Whatever somewhere else!”"

rows.original: ; driven to irritation by yours and Anno’s popularity, some bad apples have decided to spoil the basket. More food-muffled barbs are thrown from a single table nearby. Strange that nobody speaks in your defense, but nevermind that - these losers are nothing. Who are they to someone like you or Anno? Your [pc.fingers] dig into the ground.
rows.translation: 由于你和安诺的人气太高，一些心怀不满的人决定破坏这种和谐氛围。附近的一张桌子上传来了更多充满恶意的言论。奇怪的是，竟然没有人出来为你辩护不过这些失败者根本不值得理会。对于你或者安诺这样的一个人来说，他们又算什么人呢？你的[pc.fingers]开始在地下挖掘。
rows.raw: "; driven to irritation by yours and Anno’s popularity, some bad apples have decided to spoil the basket. More food-muffled barbs are thrown from a single table nearby. Strange that nobody speaks in your defense, but nevermind that - these losers are nothing. Who are they to someone like you or Anno? Your [pc.fingers] dig into the ground."

rows.original: “Lose the pet and get with us instead, puppy! At least we can talk!”
rows.translation: 失去宠物，还不如跟我们在一起吧，小狗！至少我们可以聊天！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lose the pet and get with us instead, puppy! At least we can talk!”"

rows.original: “HAH! Bet it’s just a rental, not even real!”
rows.translation: 哈！我打赌那只是租来的东西，根本不是真的！
rows.raw: "\n\n“HAH! Bet it’s just a rental, not even real!”"

rows.original: “Or a servant, even worse! Hey, go lord your fucking wealth over someone else! Learn to contribute to society like the rest of us!”
rows.translation: 或者当个仆人吧，那还不如呢！喂，去把你的那些该死的财富分给别人吧！学学我们其他人一样，为社会做出贡献吧！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or a servant, even worse! Hey, go lord your fucking wealth over someone else! Learn to contribute to society like the rest of us!”"

rows.original: “Didn’t join the Rush just to put up with the same shit I saw in the Core!”
rows.translation: 我加入‘Rush’不就是为了摆脱在‘Core’里遇到的那些破事吗！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Didn’t join the Rush just to put up with the same shit I saw in the Core!”"

rows.original: Their belligerent faces reflected in your forebrain, you contemplate revenge. Table doesn’t look sturdy... easy to flip. You feel a secondhand frustration in Anno’s place in such a visceral way that it makes you want to lash out.
rows.translation: 他们那充满敌意的表情映在你的脑海中，让你产生了报复的念头。这张桌子看起来并不结实...很容易被掀翻。你以如此强烈的方式感受到了安诺所经历的沮丧与愤怒，这种情绪让你忍不住想要发泄出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nTheir belligerent faces reflected in your forebrain, you contemplate revenge. Table doesn’t look sturdy... easy to flip. You feel a secondhand frustration in Anno’s place in such a visceral way that it makes you want to lash out."

rows.original: “Hey, don’t lose your cool,” Anno says. “We’ve got this.”
rows.translation: 嘿，别失去冷静。安诺说道。我们一定能处理好这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, don’t lose your cool,” Anno says. “We’ve got this.”"

rows.original: Perform
rows.translation: 执行
rows.raw: "Perform"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Realization hits you like a wave of euphoria: does Anno look worried? No. And, these barbed haranguings do nothing to slow the flow of pet-lovers happy to keep your spirits up. Apologetic words are spoken by the food vendor and your crowd; other, more potent voices begin shouting back at your harassers. The abuse and harassment escalates - they bark like the dog they mock you as.
rows.translation: 这种领悟会像一股愉悦的浪潮一样冲击着你：安诺看起来很担心吗？不。而且，这些尖酸刻薄的辱骂丝毫没有影响到那些热衷于养宠物、愿意让你们保持好心情的人们的热情。食品摊贩和你们这群人纷纷表达了歉意；而其他一些更有影响力的人也开始大声回击那些骚扰你们的人。这种辱骂与骚扰行为愈演愈烈——他们简直就像那些被你们嘲笑的狗一样，不停地叫嚣着。
rows.raw: "Realization hits you like a wave of euphoria: does Anno look worried? No. And, these barbed haranguings do nothing to slow the flow of pet-lovers happy to keep your spirits up. Apologetic words are spoken by the food vendor and your crowd; other, more potent voices begin shouting back at your harassers. The abuse and harassment escalates - they bark like the dog they mock you as."

rows.original: You couldn’t care less.
rows.translation: 你根本毫不在乎。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou couldn’t care less."

rows.translation: A：及格。

rows.translation: 某种模糊而统一的方式将他们从座位上赶走，然后直接把他们赶出场地，让他们满身都是灰尘

rows.original: hands on a job well done. Those hands also find the top of your head, making your cheeks burn with satisfaction. Patience and unwavering obedience to your owner are why things turned out better than you’d thought possible.
rows.translation: 这些手把工作完成得非常出色。它们还会轻轻触碰你的头顶，让你感到无比满足。正是你的耐心以及对主人的绝对服从，才让事情的发展结果超出了你的预期。
rows.raw: " hands on a job well done. Those hands also find the top of your head, making your cheeks burn with satisfaction. Patience and unwavering obedience to your owner are why things turned out better than you’d thought possible."

rows.original: Being a pet is so easy.
rows.translation: 当宠物真是太容易了。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeing a pet is so easy."

rows.original: Woozy minutes pass in elysian relish. Everyone fast forgets the thuggish interruptions, murmuring compliments whilst they relax. “Thought there’d be a fight, that’s why I didn’t say anything...”
rows.translation: 几分钟在愉悦的氛围中悄然流逝。所有人都迅速忘记了那些烦人的打扰，一边放松休息，一边低声赞美着彼此。我以为会发生打架，所以才什么都没说...
rows.raw: "\n\nWoozy minutes pass in elysian relish. Everyone fast forgets the thuggish interruptions, murmuring compliments whilst they relax. “Thought there’d be a fight, that’s why I didn’t say anything...”"

rows.original: “Yeah, that pet looks rough ‘n tough. Wouldn’t want to see those fangs!”
rows.translation: 是啊，那只宠物看起来既凶猛又强壮。真不敢想象它那些獠牙会是什么样子！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, that pet looks rough ‘n tough. Wouldn’t want to see those fangs!”"

rows.original: Those two peek, and you and Anno quickly avert. They’re absolutely right, of course: you can’t imagine being upset that people with non-functioning brains were chiding you. Sure, if you hit back they’d have fallen apart, but, shameful as it is to admit again... you are the pet here, not the individual. That’s Anno’s role, and you’ve more than done your part to ensure that everyone here remembers her as the
rows.translation: 那两个人偷偷看了你们一眼，而你和安诺立刻移开了视线。他们的看法当然完全正确：你根本不可能因为那些“脑子不正常”的人责备你而感到生气。当然，如果你反击的话，他们肯定会崩溃的但尽管承认这一点很丢脸在这里，你才是被宠爱的对象，而不是那个被责备的人。安诺才是那个应该承担这种责任的人，而你也已经做了很多努力，让这里的每个人都记住她才是那个...

Sure, if you hit back they’d have fallen apart, but, shameful as it is to admit again... you are the pet here, not the individual. That’s Anno’s role, and you’ve more than done your part to ensure that everyone here remembers her as the "

rows.original: “That was really good, [pc.name],” Anno praises, firmly patting you on the head. You nuzzle into her palm, and slalom through the zounds of strangers congregating to this spot. “I was watching you the whole time - you didn’t snarl, you didn’t look at them, not even a smug wink. You might not think it means much, but that kind of trust, well... that tickles!” She’s rewarding you jubilantly, her fingers swooping across your [pc.hairNoun] in a way that seems extremely girlish. “I know that must’ve been tough, but you did awesome, and when you do awesome, I get super excited too!”
rows.translation: 真的太棒了，[pc.name]。安诺赞许地拍了拍你的头。你依偎在她的手掌中，穿梭着聚集在这里的陌生人群。我一直都在观察你——你没有咆哮，也没有看他们一眼，甚至没有露出得意的表情。你可能觉得这没什么大不了的，但这种信任...真的让人感到很开心！她兴奋地奖励着你，她的手指在你的[pc.hairNoun]上轻轻滑动，那动作显得格外少女般可爱。我知道那一定很艰难，但你做得太棒了！当你取得成功时，我也会感到无比兴奋！
rows.raw: "“That was really good, [pc.name],” Anno praises, firmly patting you on the head. You nuzzle into her palm, and slalom through the zounds of strangers congregating to this spot. “I was watching you the whole time - you didn’t snarl, you didn’t look at them, not even a smug wink. You might not think it means much, but that kind of trust, well... that tickles!” She’s rewarding you jubilantly, her fingers swooping across your [pc.hairNoun] in a way that seems extremely girlish. “I know that must’ve been tough, but you did awesome, and when you do awesome, I get super excited too!”"

rows.raw: "smile adoringly"

rows.original: Success and happiness make others jealous. Victory through accomplishment.
rows.translation: 成功与幸福会引发他人的嫉妒。真正的胜利源于自己的努力与成就。
rows.raw: "Success and happiness make others jealous. Victory through accomplishment."

rows.original: Obey
rows.translation: 服从。
rows.raw: "Obey"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: No matter how much you try to focus on the good things - some randoms have started shouting down the hecklers - you can’t put the fools out of mind. Weathering a buffet of barbs without retaliation makes you look weak. Whether or not you should have pride, you steal a single moment to make eye contact with one of the disheveled belligerents, and you make a face reserved for any hostile foe encountered beyond safety, instilling them with an unmistakable sense for your livid ire.
rows.translation: 无论你如何努力去关注那些美好的事物——有些陌生人已经开始大声斥责那些挑衅者——你还是无法将这些愚蠢的人从你的脑海中抹去。如果任由他们不断地出言攻击而不予反击，只会让你显得软弱无力。无论你是否应该为此感到骄傲，你还是抓住了一个机会，与其中一个衣衫不整的挑衅者进行了眼神接触，然后你露出了那种只有在面对危险敌人时才会出现的愤怒表情，让他们清楚地感受到你内心的愤怒。
rows.raw: "No matter how much you try to focus on the good things - some randoms have started shouting down the hecklers - you can’t put the fools out of mind. Weathering a buffet of barbs without retaliation makes you look weak. Whether or not you should have pride, you steal a single moment to make eye contact with one of the disheveled belligerents, and you make a face reserved for any hostile foe encountered beyond safety, instilling them with an unmistakable sense for your livid ire."

rows.original: And just like that... they stop, the upstanding folks none the wiser. A passing figure in a nondescript uniform passes by, scans the area with a soldier’s glance, and disappears into an awned doorway.
rows.translation: 就这样...他们停了下来，而那些正直的人们却丝毫没有察觉到什么。一个穿着普通制服的人从旁边经过，用军人般的目光扫视了一下周围，然后消失在了一扇有顶棚的门后。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd just like that... they stop, the upstanding folks none the wiser. A passing figure in a nondescript uniform passes by, scans the area with a soldier’s glance, and disappears into an awned doorway."

rows.original: Your head shimmers with the warmth of an infinite summer. Every headpat and word of praise suffusing your soul feels like a reward for defending your owner’s honor. What’s wrong with being the trained guard [pc.raceCute]? Dissipating into the peace of a loved pet, you delight in the rub and scritch of skin and claw against your [pc.hairNoun], behind your [pc.ears]. These are feelings you’ll come to crave dearly.
rows.translation: 你的头顶仿佛被无尽的夏日阳光所照亮。每一次被轻拍头颅、每一次听到的赞美之词，都让你觉得自己的行为是在捍卫主人的荣誉——因此，担任一名受过训练的护卫，有什么不妥呢？ [pc.raceCute]融入那只你深爱的宠物的宁静之中，你享受着它的皮毛与爪子轻轻摩擦你的身体所带来的愉悦感 [pc.hairNoun]在你身后 [pc.ears]这些正是你会无比渴望拥有的情感。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour head shimmers with the warmth of an infinite summer. Every headpat and word of praise suffusing your soul feels like a reward for defending your owner’s honor. What’s wrong with being the trained guard [pc.raceCute]? Dissipating into the peace of a loved pet, you delight in the rub and scritch of skin and claw against your [pc.hairNoun], behind your [pc.ears]. These are feelings you’ll come to crave dearly."

rows.original: “Thought there was gonna be a fight,” someone murmurs in the tumult.
rows.translation: 还以为会发生一场打斗呢。在喧闹中，有人低声说了些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thought there was gonna be a fight,” someone murmurs in the tumult."

rows.original: “Same! That woman’s got a real good pet there, definitely not someone doing it for sport.”
rows.translation: 一样！那个女人养的宠物确实很棒，绝对不是为了好玩才养的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Same! That woman’s got a real good pet there, definitely not someone doing it for sport.”"

rows.original: “Y’can tell they’re pretty close.”
rows.translation: 可以看出，他们之间的距离相当近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y’can tell they’re pretty close.”"

rows.original: “[pc.name], come,” Anno says, pulling the lead. You emerge from the gathering space no worse for the wear, though something about her tone is off. “I saw what you did. Gave them that no-nonsense tough-[pc.guyGirl] look, didn’t you?” She peeks down in a neutral glance. “I told you not to worry about it, but I guess I can’t be too fussed y’gave some cheek back this time. If you went and made a scene that’d have been uhhh... not good, hehe.”
rows.translation: [pc.name]过来吧。 安诺说着，率先走了出去。你从人群中走出来时，身上并没有受到任何伤害，不过她的语气似乎有些不对劲。 我看到了你所做的事。你直接给了他们严厉的惩罚[pc.guyGirl] 看吧，不是吗？ 她以一种中立的目光向下瞥了一眼。 我早就告诉过你别担心这件事，但这次你实在太胆大了，竟然还敢顶嘴如果你当时去大吵大闹的话，那后果可就...呵呵，不太妙了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name], come,” Anno says, pulling the lead. You emerge from the gathering space no worse for the wear, though something about her tone is off. “I saw what you did. Gave them that no-nonsense tough-[pc.guyGirl] look, didn’t you?” She peeks down in a neutral glance. “I told you not to worry about it, but I guess I can’t be too fussed y’gave some cheek back this time. If you went and made a scene that’d have been uhhh... not good, hehe.”"

rows.original: Anno pivots and pats you square on the head, turning it into a caress of the cheek. “Good [pc.boyGirl], but listen to your owner from now on, okay?”
rows.translation: 安诺转过身来，轻轻拍了拍你的头，这个动作却变成了轻抚你的脸颊。好啦，[pc.boyGirl]，但从现在开始，一定要听你主人的话，好吗？
rows.raw: "Anno pivots and pats you square on the head, turning it into a caress of the cheek. “Good [pc.boyGirl], but listen to your owner from now on, okay?”"

rows.original: Resolving to do better, you nod, clarity of purpose tingling through your veins.
rows.translation: 为了做得更好，你点了点头，一种目标明确的感觉得到了全身涌动。
rows.raw: "\n\nResolving to do better, you nod, clarity of purpose tingling through your veins."

rows.translation: 下一个

rows.translation: 服从。
rows.raw: "Obey"

rows.original: Keep your cool, but put them on notice.
rows.translation: 保持冷静，但还是要让他们知道你的态度。
rows.raw: "Keep your cool, but put them on notice."

rows.original: No!
rows.translation: 不！
rows.raw: "No!"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Not now, not ever! This is how a vendetta starts: with schemes, growls, and a disassociation with good and positive things. Part of you knows this is wrong. You’ll be disobeying your owner... but you were trained in self-defense and survival. Action muscles tensing, your body stiffens and then you pounce, lurching in the direction of your harassers’ table and sweeping your leg against its own, upturning the whole thing in a theatrical crash of food, drink, and flesh.
rows.translation: 现在不行，永远都不行！仇恨就是这样开始的：阴谋诡计、怒吼咆哮，以及与一切善良、积极的事物彻底决裂。你内心深处明白这样做是错误的你正在违抗主人的命令...但你们毕竟接受过自卫与生存的训练。肌肉瞬间紧绷，身体变得僵硬，然后你猛地扑了上去，朝那些骚扰你的人的桌子冲去，用腿踢翻了他们的桌子，顿时食物、饮料和杂物全都洒得到处都是，一片混乱。
rows.raw: "Not now, not ever! This is how a vendetta starts: with schemes, growls, and a disassociation with good and positive things. Part of you knows this is wrong. You’ll be disobeying your owner... but you were trained in self-defense and survival. Action muscles tensing, your body stiffens and then you pounce, lurching in the direction of your harassers’ table and sweeping your leg against its own, upturning the whole thing in a theatrical crash of food, drink, and flesh."

rows.original: “What the fuuuuuUUUUCK!!?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What the fuuuuuUUUUCK!!?”"

rows.original: Irate wails overtake the pleasant murmur; an urgent pull to your leash drags you from the grounds. Disappearing into a slightly-chaotic throng evades whatever retaliation might have been chasing, and eventually, you appear in a different place entirely, lungs quaking with the effort. Veering into an unused dugout for cover, Anno lets out a huff.
rows.translation: 愤怒的哀嚎声取代了原本愉悦的喧闹声；有人急切地拉扯着你的牵引绳，将你从那里拖了出去。你混入了一群混乱的人群中，从而躲过了那些可能正在追捕你的东西。最终，你出现在了一个完全不同的地方，肺部因为剧烈的运动而剧烈震动。你躲进了一个闲置的掩体中，长长地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nIrate wails overtake the pleasant murmur; an urgent pull to your leash drags you from the grounds. Disappearing into a slightly-chaotic throng evades whatever retaliation might have been chasing, and eventually, you appear in a different place entirely, lungs quaking with the effort. Veering into an unused dugout for cover, Anno lets out a huff."

rows.original: “Damn it, [pc.name]... what were you thinking!?” A judicious white finger jabs in your direction. “Don’t answer that - bad [pc.boyGirl]! You gotta know when to chill. Look... ah...” Anno’s sigh is legendary. “Never mind. Look, I have a few hunches of what you go through on the reg, but you can’t be treating people around us like you do some fuck-mad alien. You gotta be tactful. AND...”
rows.translation: 该死，[pc.name]你到底在想什么！？一只灵巧的手指朝你的方向快速移动。别回答那个问题——糟糕的[pc.boyGirl]！你得知道什么时候该闭嘴。看...啊...安诺的叹息堪称“传奇”。没关系。听着，我大概能猜到你在注册时经历了什么，但你不能把我们周围的人当成那些疯狂的外星人一样对待。你得讲究点分寸...还有...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn it, [pc.name]... what were you thinking!?” A judicious white finger jabs in your direction. “Don’t answer that - bad [pc.boyGirl]! You gotta know when to chill. Look... ah...” Anno’s sigh is legendary. “Never mind. Look, I have a few hunches of what you go through on the reg, but you can’t be treating people around us like you do some fuck-mad alien. You gotta be tactful. AND...”"

rows.original: Anno abruptly grips your jaw and points it towards her own fiery expression. “You better keep in mind who your antics reflect on out here. The last thing I want is a reputation for walking problematic pets!” She squeezes a bit harder to drive the point home. “I won’t tolerate a brat, [pc.name].” That same punitive hand pats your cheek. “You make sure you hold onto that warning; now, let’s go!”
rows.translation: 安诺突然抓住你的下巴，将你的脸转向她那充满怒火的表情。你最好记住，你的这些行为会影响到谁。最后一点我我们想要的，就是那种能够妥善照顾有问题的宠物的名声！她用力再大一些，以便让对方更清楚地明白她的意思。我绝不会容忍这种行为。小鬼。[pc.name]。那只同样具有惩罚性的手轻拍着你的脸颊。你一定要记住这个警告；现在，我们出发吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno abruptly grips your jaw and points it towards her own fiery expression. “You better keep in mind who your antics reflect on out here. The last thing I want is a reputation for walking problematic pets!” She squeezes a bit harder to drive the point home. “I won’t tolerate a brat, [pc.name].” That same punitive hand pats your cheek. “You make sure you hold onto that warning; now, let’s go!”"

rows.original: walking her pet; many come forward, asking to pat. You’re surrounded by dozens of lumbering bodies and looming faces drawn to your owner for whatever reason. Some stumblers move in, fumble with words, and are dismissed through muscles of elocution you can’t remember Anno ever having to flex. Not one of them argues.
rows.translation: 她正在遛宠物，许多人走上前请求抚摸那只宠物。不知出于什么原因，有几十个人围在了你身边，他们动作笨拙，面容阴沉，都被你的宠物吸引住了。有些人结结巴巴地想要说话，但你们用那些连安诺自己都从未用过的、极其生硬的表达方式让他们闭嘴了。他们中没有一个人敢争辩。
rows.raw: " walking her pet; many come forward, asking to pat. You’re surrounded by dozens of lumbering bodies and looming faces drawn to your owner for whatever reason. Some stumblers move in, fumble with words, and are dismissed through muscles of elocution you can’t remember Anno ever having to flex. Not one of them argues."

rows.original: It must be good enough to simply be involved. Indeed: you’ve no idea what’s got people coming here, but they’ve all welcomed you as one of their own; hands are laid across your [pc.skinFurScales], brushing against a living, breathing creature just like them whom is enthralled to the will of another - it’s exhilarating.
rows.translation: 只要能够参与其中，那就已经足够好了。事实上：你根本不知道是什么吸引人们来到这里，但他们都把你当作自己人一样欢迎你；他们的手轻轻触碰着你的[pc.skinFurScales]，感受到一个与他们一样、同样受制于他人意志的活生生的生命体存在——这种感觉真是令人兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt must be good enough to simply be involved. Indeed: you’ve no idea what’s got people coming here, but they’ve all welcomed you as one of their own; hands are laid across your [pc.skinFurScales], brushing against a living, breathing creature just like them whom is enthralled to the will of another - it’s exhilarating."

rows.original: More interesting is the fact that a number of bluebloods are in attendance - the differences are noticeable, if you squint. Upper class etiquette wears silk and accessories fashioned from expensive minerals in the midst of boisterous comers-and-goers dressed in wrinkled casual clothing.
rows.translation: 更有趣的是，有不少贵族也出席了这次活动——如果你仔细观察的话，就能发现他们与其他人之间的区别。在上流社会的礼仪中，人们会穿着丝绸制成的服装，并佩戴由珍贵矿物制成的饰品；而在那些穿着皱巴巴的休闲服装、来来去去的人群中，这些贵族的穿着确实显得与众不同。
rows.raw: "\n\nMore interesting is the fact that a number of bluebloods are in attendance - the differences are noticeable, if you squint. Upper class etiquette wears silk and accessories fashioned from expensive minerals in the midst of boisterous comers-and-goers dressed in wrinkled casual clothing."

rows.original: Temptations are everywhere, too. The multitudinous throng wants your attention and they’re doing everything they can to get it.
rows.translation: 诱惑也无处不在。那些成群的人都在试图吸引你的注意，他们会不择手段地达到这个目的。
rows.raw: "\n\nTemptations are everywhere, too. The multitudinous throng wants your attention and they’re doing everything they can to get it. "

rows.raw: "feline"

rows.original: You swear you even hear a few ’pspsps’ sounds - you dare not admit those degrading appeals are triggering some recessed animal instincts.
rows.translation: 你发誓，你甚至真的听到了几声pspsps听起来——你根本不敢承认那些贬低性的言语其实是在激发你内心某些被压抑的动物本能吧。
rows.raw: "You swear you even hear a few ’pspsps’ sounds - you dare not admit those degrading appeals are triggering some recessed animal instincts. "

rows.original: Low voices in your proximity swim with conspiracy... sultry tones tug at your eyes. Was that woman flashing you...? Right here, in public? A few blinks and she’s gone, leaving you to be transfixed by the appraising stare of a dapper male laquine spiffed up in some terran-style red carpet regalia.
rows.translation: 在你附近，那些低沉的声音仿佛蕴含着阴谋...那些撩人的声音吸引着你的目光。那个女人是在向你抛媚眼吗？就在这里，在公共场合？她眨了几下眼，就消失了，留下你一个人，面对那位穿着地球风格红毯礼服、显得十分英俊的男性的审视目光。...
rows.raw: "Low voices in your proximity swim with conspiracy... sultry tones tug at your eyes. Was that woman flashing you...? Right here, in public? A few blinks and she’s gone, leaving you to be transfixed by the appraising stare of a dapper male laquine spiffed up in some terran-style red carpet regalia."

rows.original: “Hey there; want a picture? Studio quality for free!”
rows.translation: 嘿，想要一张照片吗？最高质量的图片，而且完全免费！

rows.original: From the rugged appearance and straight posture of the soft-spoken human, you get a good impression. An expensive-looking camera attached to a lanyard rests on the affable gentleman’s chest.
rows.translation: 从这位说话轻声细语的人粗犷的外表与挺拔的姿态中，你可以感受到他给人的良好印象。这位和蔼可亲的绅士胸前挂着一台外观昂贵的相机，相机通过一根挂绳固定在他的身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the rugged appearance and straight posture of the soft-spoken human, you get a good impression. An expensive-looking camera attached to a lanyard rests on the affable gentleman’s chest."

rows.original: “Ooh...” Anno taps her chin. “That sounds good. What’s your angle?”
rows.translation: 哦...安诺轻敲着自己的下巴。听起来不错。你的计划是怎样的？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh...” Anno taps her chin. “That sounds good. What’s your angle?”"

rows.original: There’s laughter in your periphery, but you’re too distracted to pay attention. Sound is everywhere, and when your eyes settle on the prim and moderate form of a girl who seems to be in her early twenties, she flashes a clinical smile. A terrible tease. You pout, completely unaware of your expression... which just draws more interest.
rows.translation: 周围充满了笑声，但你太过分心，根本无暇注意。声音无处不在；当你的目光落在那个看起来二十出头的、打扮得端庄得体的女孩身上时，她突然露出一种略带嘲讽的笑容。真是太讨厌了...你撇了撇嘴，却完全没意识到自己这个表情正在吸引更多人的注意。

You pout, completely unaware of your expression... which just draws more interest."

Something we can add to the book!”

rows.original: Turning unexpected situations into a net boon is what survival is all about. You can’t stop yourself from being jolted by an outside intelligence, but you can control your reaction. Invisible fingernails jab into your tailbone; the sudden grimace that twists your [pc.face] you quickly morph into an over-excited smile as you leap up, careful not to move too far forward, adding a unique flourish to the final result. Shik!
rows.translation: 将意外情况转化为有利的机会，这才是生存的本质。你无法阻止自己被外界的突发事件所影响，但你可以 可以 控制你的反应。无形的手指甲仿佛刺入了你的尾骨；那种突如其来的痛苦表情 [pc.face] 你迅速露出一个兴奋至极的笑容，跳了上去，同时小心翼翼地避免跳得太远，这样才能为最终的效果增添独特的韵味。 嘶！

rows.original: Anno sticks around, charms the big-wigs into talking about what’s going on, what cultures they’ve taken in. Perhaps viewing her as an equal - and from the way she comports herself, even you could be fooled! - the sleek tourists are happy to explain how far they’ve come from the Core. Why? To find lucrative causes to invest in, and to witness firsthand how the UGC treats its newest constituents.
rows.translation: 安诺留在那里，用她的魅力让那些高层人士开口谈论当前发生的事情，以及他们吸收了哪些文化元素。或许因为人们将她视为平等的对话对象——而从她的举止来看，就连你也可能被她骗到！——这些时髦的游客很乐意解释自己从“核心地区”走了多远。为什么呢？当然是为了寻找有利可图的投资机会，同时也是为了亲眼看看UGC是如何对待它的新成员的。

rows.translation: 无论发生了什么，你绝对不能让这些事情分散你的注意力！
rows.raw: "Whatever’s going on, you absolutely can’t let it distract you!"

rows.original: Obey
rows.translation: 服从。
rows.raw: "Obey"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Be still. Think of nothing. The voice isn’t real. The smile you give the camera is stiffer than you intend; however, a number of invisible fingers grip firmly at your tailbone, make your whole body shake coldly; you so badly want to react... but keep in character, squelch the mewl in your throat even though your traitorous body obliterates the photographer’s finely-detailed planning and petrifies into something inorganic and statuesque. Shik!
rows.translation: 保持静止，什么都不去想。那个声音并不是真实的。你对着相机露出的笑容比你预想的要僵硬得多；然而，有无数无形的手紧紧抓住你的尾骨，让你的整个身体不由自主地颤抖起来你非常想要做出反应...但你必须坚持自己的角色设定，压住喉咙里那股想要哭泣的冲动——尽管你那“叛逆”的身体正在破坏摄影师精心策划好的每一个细节，将你变成一个毫无生气、像雕像一样的存在。嘶！
rows.raw: "Be still. Think of nothing. The voice isn’t real. The smile you give the camera is stiffer than you intend; however, a number of invisible fingers grip firmly at your tailbone, make your whole body shake coldly; you so badly want to react... but keep in character, squelch the mewl in your throat even though your traitorous body obliterates the photographer’s finely-detailed planning and petrifies into something inorganic and statuesque. Shik!"

rows.original: “D’aw, must be camera-shy,” he says innocently, scratching the back of his head. “By the time my finger was moving I couldn’t stop. Doesn’t seem like your pet’s good with waiting around, but when you’re that young, all you want to do is run!”
rows.translation: 哎呀，肯定是害羞了，不敢拍照吧他天真地挠了挠后脑勺，说道。我的手指一旦开始移动，就再也停不下来了。看来你的宠物不太擅长等待吧？不过在那么小的年纪，孩子们最想做的就是奔跑啊！
rows.raw: "\n\n“D’aw, must be camera-shy,” he says innocently, scratching the back of his head. “By the time my finger was moving I couldn’t stop. Doesn’t seem like your pet’s good with waiting around, but when you’re that young, all you want to do is run!”"

rows.original: Hmhm, almost had you!
rows.translation: 嗯，差点就骗到你了！
rows.raw: "\n\nHmhm, almost had you!"

rows.original: Whispers on the wind, the voice fades, as does the clearly unnatural woman projecting it into your thoughts. A sensation not unlike the cold and sweaty breaking of a fever envelops you, and now you’re sweating about as much as Anno, who is now wearing the mother of all can’t-be-helped looks. “Nobody’s expecting triple-A performance all the time, right? Sent you the copy though, but yeah... might not wanna frame it, you looked a little spooked!”
rows.translation: 风中传来低语声，那声音渐渐消失，同时那个将那些话语灌输到你脑海中的女人也消失了。一种类似于退烧时那种既寒冷又出汗的感觉笼罩着你，此刻你流的汗几乎和安诺一样多，而安诺此刻正摆出一副“根本无能为力”的表情。没人会一直期待游戏能达到AAA级的表现吧？文件已经发给你了，不过...你看起来有点吓到吧，可能不太适合把这张图片装裱起来吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nWhispers on the wind, the voice fades, as does the clearly unnatural woman projecting it into your thoughts. A sensation not unlike the cold and sweaty breaking of a fever envelops you, and now you’re sweating about as much as Anno, who is now wearing the mother of all can’t-be-helped looks. “Nobody’s expecting triple-A performance all the time, right? Sent you the copy though, but yeah... might not wanna frame it, you looked a little spooked!”"

rows.original: A white paw wipes the beady perspiration before it stings your [pc.eyes], then pats your cheek lovingly. “S’all past us now, so let’s hang out a bit!”
rows.translation: 一只白色的爪子轻轻擦去你[pc.eyes]上那些晶莹的汗珠，然后充满爱意地轻拍你的脸颊。那些事情都已经过去了，所以我们还是再一起玩一会儿吧！
rows.raw: "\n\nA white paw wipes the beady perspiration before it stings your [pc.eyes], then pats your cheek lovingly. “S’all past us now, so let’s hang out a bit!”"

rows.original: Anno would believe you if you told her. Some mischievous psion spotted an opportunity the moment you showed up. It wasn’t your fault, but... fuck it, whatever. There’s nothing to be done about it now except try to calm down.
rows.translation: 如果你告诉安诺，她一定会相信你的。你一出现，就有某个调皮的灵能者发现了机会这不是你的错，但是...算了，现在也没什么办法了，只能尽量让自己冷静下来吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno would believe you if you told her. Some mischievous psion spotted an opportunity the moment you showed up. It wasn’t your fault, but... fuck it, whatever. There’s nothing to be done about it now except try to calm down."

rows.original: You get shown around to the local big-wigs as they discuss their plans and motivations. Anno is welcomed to join a few, perhaps seen as a social equal. The sleek tourists hail from planets deep in the UGC’s Core quadrants, and all of them have set out to the frontier in search of lucrative causes and endeavors to invest their obscene amounts of wealth in.
rows.translation: 你被引见给了当地的那些重要人物，他们正在讨论自己的计划与动机。安诺也被邀请加入了其中一些讨论，或许大家将他视为与自己地位相当的人。这些外表光鲜的游客来自UGC核心区域深处的各个星球，他们都是为了寻找那些能够带来丰厚利润的事业或项目，从而将自己巨额的财富投入其中而来到这里的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get shown around to the local big-wigs as they discuss their plans and motivations. Anno is welcomed to join a few, perhaps seen as a social equal. The sleek tourists hail from planets deep in the UGC’s Core quadrants, and all of them have set out to the frontier in search of lucrative causes and endeavors to invest their obscene amounts of wealth in."

rows.original: Eventually, the chuffed
rows.translation: 最终，那个恼羞成怒的人
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, the chuffed "

rows.translation: 赫斯卡
rows.raw: "huskar"

rows.original: ausar
rows.translation: 奥萨尔
rows.raw: "ausar"

rows.original: pulls your leash away from the spontaneous gala, dripping with sweat herself. “Holy hell, I shouldn’t have gone in there, but since I had you on the leash, well...”
rows.translation: 她将自己的牵引绳从那场突如其来的聚会上拉了回来，自己也已经满身是汗。天啊，我真不该进去的，不过既然你已经受我的控制了嗯...
rows.raw: " pulls your leash away from the spontaneous gala, dripping with sweat herself. “Holy hell, I shouldn’t have gone in there, but since I had you on the leash, well...”"

rows.original: Arching back, she exhales loudly. “Spending a leisurely stroll having to impress a lot of high-admin executives out to rain money on alien planets isn’t my idea of good petplay, but at least we looked good doing it.” She giggles. “Dr. Anno Dorna and [pc.name], owner and pet, the mysterious and quite possibly criminal duo!”
rows.translation: 她向后仰了仰身子，然后大声地呼了口气。虽然为了让那些高层管理人员对我们在外星星球上的投资行为感到满意而悠闲地散步，实在不符合我心目中‘宠物扮演’的乐趣所在，但至少我们看起来还挺不错的。她咯咯地笑了起来。安诺·多娜博士与她的宠物[pc.name]——这个神秘而又很可能涉及犯罪的二人组！
rows.raw: "\n\nArching back, she exhales loudly. “Spending a leisurely stroll having to impress a lot of high-admin executives out to rain money on alien planets isn’t my idea of good petplay, but at least we looked good doing it.” She giggles. “Dr. Anno Dorna and [pc.name], owner and pet, the mysterious and quite possibly criminal duo!”"

rows.original: Hopefully she won’t dock you any points for snickering at that. Still, you get a smooth, reassuring pat on the head. “Good [pc.boyGirl],” she murmurs. “Where to next, I wonder...”
rows.translation: 希望她不会因为你偷笑而扣你的分数。不过，她还是轻轻地拍了拍你的头，让你感到安心。好的，[pc.boyGirl]。她低声说道。接下来该去哪里呢...
rows.raw: "Hopefully she won’t dock you any points for snickering at that. Still, you get a smooth, reassuring pat on the head. “Good [pc.boyGirl],” she murmurs. “Where to next, I wonder...”"

rows.raw: "Obey"

rows.original: Push out the voice, whatever it takes.
rows.translation: 不惜任何代价，也要把声音发出去。
rows.raw: "Push out the voice, whatever it takes."

rows.original: No!
rows.translation: 不！
rows.raw: "No!"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Pets don’t have to worry about thinking, only acting. Bad pets act belligerently, and without their owner’s consent. You do your best to lead the telepathic teasings to mental dead ends, but the female being linked to your thoughts provokes you with a new ability - invisible fingers grasp at your tailbone, claws like daggers, triggering inactive self-preservation instincts; just like that, you yelp out loud and turn to face your aggressor, growling in frustration. Shik!
rows.translation: 宠物根本不需要思考，只需要行动即可。那些品行不端的宠物会未经主人同意就采取攻击性行为。你竭尽全力试图用心灵感应来干扰它们，让它们的思维陷入僵局，但那个与你的思维相连的雌性宠物却用一种新的方式来激怒你——它的“无形手指”会抓住你的尾骨，它的“匕首般的爪子”会触发你体内那些被长期压抑的自我保护本能；于是，你就会大声叫喊，转过身去面对那个攻击者，愤怒地低吼着。嘶！
rows.raw: "Pets don’t have to worry about thinking, only acting. Bad pets act belligerently, and without their owner’s consent. You do your best to lead the telepathic teasings to mental dead ends, but the female being linked to your thoughts provokes you with a new ability - invisible fingers grasp at your tailbone, claws like daggers, triggering inactive self-preservation instincts; just like that, you yelp out loud and turn to face your aggressor, growling in frustration. Shik!"

rows.original: “Oh dear...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh dear...”"

rows.original: Nothing is there. In fact, most of the background had cleared out of the shot to make this picture special. Wine glass laughter tinkles in your inner ear, fading just in time for you to absorb the backhanded criticisms of the immaculate social strata and the chortling of their lessers.
rows.translation: 那里什么也没有。事实上，为了营造出这种效果，画面中的大部分背景元素都被去掉了。酒杯碰撞发出的清脆声响在你耳边回荡，但这种声音很快便消失了，正好让你能够仔细聆听那些针对那些处于社会高层的人们的挖苦，以及那些处于底层的人们的窃笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nNothing is there. In fact, most of the background had cleared out of the shot to make this picture special. Wine glass laughter tinkles in your inner ear, fading just in time for you to absorb the backhanded criticisms of the immaculate social strata and the chortling of their lessers."

rows.original: “Shame. The [pc.raceCute] seemed more loyal at first glance, but they can’t all be winners, can they?”
rows.translation: 真可惜。乍一看，[pc.raceCute]似乎更可靠些，但毕竟不可能所有人都是赢家，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shame. The [pc.raceCute] seemed more loyal at first glance, but they can’t all be winners, can they?”"

rows.original: “What’s got that one in a tizzy?”
rows.translation: 到底是什么让那个人如此慌张？
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s got that one in a tizzy?”"

rows.original: And so much more. The photographer lowers his head, the moment ruined, and quickly exits stage left. Anno follows suit, tugging you away from the oppressive awkwardness.
rows.translation: 还有更多。摄影师低下了头，这个瞬间就这样被破坏了，他迅速从舞台的左侧离开了。安诺也跟着走了，把你从那种令人窒息的尴尬氛围中拉了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd so much more. The photographer lowers his head, the moment ruined, and quickly exits stage left. Anno follows suit, tugging you away from the oppressive awkwardness."

rows.original: “Geez...” Anno breaks the silence a minute later. “...That got weird. What happened, [pc.name]? Bad itch or something? That just tanked our rep, and believe-you-me that old bored rich people have an insatiable appetite for gossip. Bad [pc.boyGirl],” she sighs. “No pets this time, [pc.name]! Better hope Syri doesn’t find out about this, or I won’t hear the end of it...”
rows.translation: 天啊...一分钟后，安诺打破了沉默。...情况变得太奇怪了。到底发生了什么，[pc.name]？是有什么不好的痒感之类的吗？这件事彻底毁了我们的声誉，相信我，那些无聊的老富人们对八卦可是有着无穷的兴趣。真是糟糕的[pc.boyGirl]。她叹了口气。这次不允许带宠物，[pc.name]！最好希望Syri不要发现这件事，否则我可要被她唠个不停了...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Geez...” Anno breaks the silence a minute later. “...That got weird. What happened, [pc.name]? Bad itch or something? That just tanked our rep, and believe-you-me that old bored rich people have an insatiable appetite for gossip. Bad [pc.boyGirl],” she sighs. “No pets this time, [pc.name]! Better hope Syri doesn’t find out about this, or I won’t hear the end of it...”"

rows.original: You can tell by Anno’s poutiness that she’s more than a little disappointed... and sensitive to what is now, thanks to you, a very possible, uncomfortable sibling moment. Damn it.
rows.translation: 从安诺那撅起的嘴就能看出，她非常失望...而且由于你的缘故，她对这种可能发生的、令人尴尬的兄妹互动场面也显得格外敏感。真该死。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can tell by Anno’s poutiness that she’s more than a little disappointed... and sensitive to what is now, thanks to you, a very possible, uncomfortable sibling moment. Damn it."

rows.translation: 下一个

rows.translation: 不！

rows.translation: 愤怒地拒绝那些奇怪的追求。

rows.translation: 告诉安诺，你必须在这里停下来。
rows.raw: "Tell Anno you have to stop here."

rows.translation: 风景真美
rows.raw: "Nice Scenery"
