rows.original: Anno wanders into a particularly lush space of colorful scenery. A small and convivial group hum to each other as they tend their little garden; some silvery plants made to imitate an exotic organism loll from elevated ledges; several drones flutter in the vicinity, onboard speakers whispering natural ambience, and little spritzers scenting the air with a number of refreshing scents you spend a long time trying to identify.
rows.translation: 安诺走进了一片景色格外繁茂、色彩斑斓的区域。有一小群人正在一起照料他们的小花园，他们边劳作边轻声交谈着；一些模仿外来植物形态的银色植物悬挂在高高的架子上；几架无人机在附近飞来飞去，它们搭载的扬声器不断播放着模拟自然环境的声音，而一些小喷壶则不断向空气中喷洒各种清新的香气，这些气味实在让人难以辨认它们的来源。
rows.raw: "Anno wanders into a particularly lush space of colorful scenery. A small and convivial group hum to each other as they tend their little garden; some silvery plants made to imitate an exotic organism loll from elevated ledges; several drones flutter in the vicinity, onboard speakers whispering natural ambience, and little spritzers scenting the air with a number of refreshing scents you spend a long time trying to identify."

rows.original: They clearly enjoy the time they’re spending together, but they glow when they see the most unusual sight of a [pc.raceShort] being walked by a leather leash.
rows.translation: 他们显然很享受在一起度过的时光，但当他们看到[pc.raceShort]被皮绳牵着走时，他们的脸上露出了惊讶的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey clearly enjoy the time they’re spending together, but they glow when they see the most unusual sight of a [pc.raceShort] being walked by a leather leash."

rows.original: “Oh, welcome!” one greets feelingly - a gryvain in the winter of her life, going by the blue-black tints on the edges of her scales.
rows.translation: 哦，欢迎来到这里！有人满怀感慨地这样说道——那是一条处于生命晚年的格里瓦因，从它鳞片边缘的蓝黑色条纹就能看出这一点。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, welcome!” one greets feelingly - a gryvain in the winter of her life, going by the blue-black tints on the edges of her scales."

rows.original: Introductions are made, social bonds established. The sweeter-than-honey dracoid woman offers Anno a cushioned seat and a snack, invites her to join her and her friends - a human woman with a history of cosmetic modification etched into the skin revealed by her coveralls, and a kaithrit male getting on in his years.
rows.translation: 介绍环节已经结束，社交关系也得以建立。那位甜美如蜜的德拉克oid女性为Anno提供了舒适的座椅和零食，邀请她与自己和自己的朋友们一起相处——那位人类女性身上那些反映她曾经接受过美容手术的痕迹，从她穿着的工作服上就能看出来；而那位kaithrit男性也已年事较高。
rows.raw: "\n\nIntroductions are made, social bonds established. The sweeter-than-honey dracoid woman offers Anno a cushioned seat and a snack, invites her to join her and her friends - a human woman with a history of cosmetic modification etched into the skin revealed by her coveralls, and a kaithrit male getting on in his years."

rows.original: At Anno’s feet you heel, watching people go by. Many stop to stare wonderingly at fronded water decorations, listen to the soft sounds, their journeys relaxed and their minds cleared by the love and care that’s gone into maintaining such strikingly familiar tranquility. In the greater galaxy, it’s easy to lose sight of how important it is to nourish one’s spirit, breathe in the clear, sweet air of peace and quiet.
rows.translation: 站在安诺的脚边，你静静地注视着来往的人们。许多人会停下脚步，好奇地凝视那些装饰着绿叶的水景，聆听那些轻柔的声音；在这样一种充满关爱与呵护的环境中，他们的旅途变得轻松愉快，心灵也得到了净化。在浩瀚的银河系中，人们往往容易忽视这样一个事实：滋养自己的精神、呼吸那些清甜宁静的空气，其实是多么重要的一件事啊。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt Anno’s feet you heel, watching people go by. Many stop to stare wonderingly at fronded water decorations, listen to the soft sounds, their journeys relaxed and their minds cleared by the love and care that’s gone into maintaining such strikingly familiar tranquility. In the greater galaxy, it’s easy to lose sight of how important it is to nourish one’s spirit, breathe in the clear, sweet air of peace and quiet."

rows.original: With the wind in the proverbial willows, Anno idly pets you behind the [pc.ears] as stories and red wine flow. It’s enough to make you feel a little peckish... a little needy... and very tired.
rows.translation: 当微风轻拂着那些象征着柔情的柳树时，安诺在[pc.ears]的陪伴下悠闲地抚摸着你，故事与红酒在空气中流淌这样的场景足以让你感到有些饿...有些渴望...同时也感到非常疲惫。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the wind in the proverbial willows, Anno idly pets you behind the [pc.ears] as stories and red wine flow. It’s enough to make you feel a little peckish... a little needy... and very tired."

rows.original: Perform
rows.translation: 执行
rows.raw: "Perform"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: It occurs to you that the scritches are a subtle encouragement for you to participate in the goings-on. Three gentle faces too warm and kind to be believed wave at you with subtle movements of their eyebrows and tilts of their wizened jaws, and so you shuffle around, making new friends.
rows.translation: 你突然意识到，那些轻挠其实是在巧妙地鼓励你参与正在发生的事情。三张温柔而亲切的面孔，通过微妙的眉毛动作和下巴的倾斜，向你传递着这些信号；于是你便慢慢走过去，结识了一些新朋友。
rows.raw: "It occurs to you that the scritches are a subtle encouragement for you to participate in the goings-on. Three gentle faces too warm and kind to be believed wave at you with subtle movements of their eyebrows and tilts of their wizened jaws, and so you shuffle around, making new friends."

rows.original: The aproned gryvain goes on to tell a somber story with a constant smile on her face. An undiluted bit of personal history that evokes a sense of awe you’re unable to express, only sympathize with through reassuring presence and friendly body language.
rows.translation: 这位系着围裙的格里薇恩一边面带微笑，一边讲述着一个令人心情沉重的故事。她讲述的这些真实经历令人感到敬畏，这种敬畏之情无法用语言表达，人们只能通过她那令人安心的态度与友好的肢体语言来表达自己的同情。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe aproned gryvain goes on to tell a somber story with a constant smile on her face. An undiluted bit of personal history that evokes a sense of awe you’re unable to express, only sympathize with through reassuring presence and friendly body language."

rows.original: Something you’re very suited for, naturally. Words aren’t necessary for [pc.guyGirl]s like you!
rows.translation: 对你来说，这当然是再合适不过的事情了。对于像你这样的 [pc.guyGirl] 来说，文字根本就不是必需的！
rows.raw: " Something you’re very suited for, naturally. Words aren’t necessary for [pc.guyGirl]s like you!"

rows.original: “Oh, thank you,” she sighs, staring straight into your eyes as she strokes your head. Just once, though. It occurs to you quick-as-silver this is what most pets feel like: their masters looking up into the sky or inward to silent memories, all creation spread out before them, cannot help but let their minds wander. The pet simply looks up to that person, acts as their bedrock, their buoy, in the vast helplessness.
rows.translation: 哦，谢谢。她叹了口气，直视着你的眼睛，同时轻抚着你的头。不过，这只发生了一次。你立刻意识到：大多数宠物应该都是这种感受吧——当它们的主人望着天空或陷入沉思时，整个世界都展现在它们面前，它们不由得会走神。而宠物，只是静静地望着那个人，在那无尽的无助之中，成为主人最坚实的依靠、最温暖的港湾。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, thank you,” she sighs, staring straight into your eyes as she strokes your head. Just once, though. It occurs to you quick-as-silver this is what most pets feel like: their masters looking up into the sky or inward to silent memories, all creation spread out before them, cannot help but let their minds wander. The pet simply looks up to that person, acts as their bedrock, their buoy, in the vast helplessness."

rows.original: “It’s amazing what our youngers get up to these days, isn’t it?”
rows.translation: 现在的年轻人真是干出了一些令人惊叹的事情，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s amazing what our youngers get up to these days, isn’t it?”"

rows.original: “Seen better,” replies the human in a sticky voice, with the grin of someone who’s about to lay out some straight exaggerations - which she does. No filter: she picks out a tale from her childhood full of love and adventure that you come very close to outright claiming was a movie you saw some years back. Sadly, a pet doesn’t banter in the traditional sense. You’re only here to look good and make others feel good. Make them not care about what they say, only help their eyes drift over the middle distance until they can’t help but give up some facts.
rows.translation: 看起来好多了。她用黏糊糊的声音回答着，脸上带着那种准备说出一堆夸张话的人特有的笑容——果然，她开始讲起了自己童年里那些充满爱与冒险的故事。她毫无保留地讲着，那些故事听起来简直就像几年前看过的电影一样。可惜，宠物是不会用传统意义上的方式与人开玩笑的。它们的存在只是为了让自己看起来更好看，让别人感到开心而已。它们的作用只是让人们的视线在远处游移，直到最终让人忍不住放弃继续听下去一些事实。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seen better,” replies the human in a sticky voice, with the grin of someone who’s about to lay out some straight exaggerations - which she does. No filter: she picks out a tale from her childhood full of love and adventure that you come very close to outright claiming was a movie you saw some years back. Sadly, a pet doesn’t banter in the traditional sense. You’re only here to look good and make others feel good. Make them not care about what they say, only help their eyes drift over the middle distance until they can’t help but give up some facts."

rows.original: Anno laughs all the same, and she tells a story of her own. Now you’re imagining her in a cheerleader’s outfit...
rows.translation: 安诺还是笑了起来，然后开始讲述自己的故事。现在，你们应该会想象她穿着啦啦队队员的服装吧...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno laughs all the same, and she tells a story of her own. Now you’re imagining her in a cheerleader’s outfit..."

rows.original: The slender, pinch-lipped kaithrit is slow to open up, but eventually hints at past relationships with both of the generous women. They roll their eyes, unembarrassed by the astonishing half-details he utters. Every sentence spoken is its own drama with this fluffy cat. You make yourself comfortable nearby, tease him into continuing when you sense him about to leave off, keep the rumor mill spinning until they’re all too tired to speak.
rows.translation: 这个身材纤细、总是紧闭着嘴唇的凯思里特并不容易敞开心扉，但最终还是透露了自己与那两位慷慨的女士之间曾经有过某种关系。听到他说的这些半真半假的事情，她们只是翻了个白眼，并没有觉得有什么尴尬。对这只爱说闲话的猫来说，它说的每一句话都像是一出戏剧。你可以坐在它旁边，逗它继续说下去；当感觉到它想要停止说话时，就再继续刺激它，让这些谣言不断传播，直到它们都累得说不出话来为止。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe slender, pinch-lipped kaithrit is slow to open up, but eventually hints at past relationships with both of the generous women. They roll their eyes, unembarrassed by the astonishing half-details he utters. Every sentence spoken is its own drama with this fluffy cat. You make yourself comfortable nearby, tease him into continuing when you sense him about to leave off, keep the rumor mill spinning until they’re all too tired to speak."

rows.original: That’s when Anno stands, thanks them each, and you follow her ever-onward. It almost feels criminal to leave the social garden.
rows.translation: 就在这时，安诺站了起来，向他们每个人都道了谢，然后你们便跟随她继续前进。离开这个社交空间，简直让人觉得有些遗憾
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s when Anno stands, thanks them each, and you follow her ever-onward. It almost feels criminal to leave the social garden."

rows.original: “Y’know, I wouldn’t have faulted you if you went for a nap there. Running fountains always make me wanna stretch ‘n sleep, but you really made their day, I could tell.” Anno’s headpats are glorious and eternally validating. “Goooood [pc.boyGirl]. Better not get too cozy, because when you go all out... ehh lemme put it this way: you keep that up, and I’ll go all out on you, in the most fun ways.”
rows.translation: 你知道吗，如果你去那里小睡一会儿，我也不会责怪你的。那些喷泉总是让我想伸伸腰、睡一会儿，但你能让它们真正‘活跃’起来，这一点我看得出来。安诺的轻拍动作既令人感到愉悦，又能让人感受到无尽的认同感。好极了，[pc.boyGirl]。不过最好别太放松，因为当你全力以赴的时候...嗯，这么说吧：如果你继续这样，我也会用最有趣的方式全力以赴对付你。
rows.raw: "“Y’know, I wouldn’t have faulted you if you went for a nap there. Running fountains always make me wanna stretch ‘n sleep, but you really made their day, I could tell.” Anno’s headpats are glorious and eternally validating. “Goooood [pc.boyGirl]. Better not get too cozy, because when you go all out... ehh lemme put it this way: you keep that up, and I’ll go all out on you, in the most fun ways.”"

rows.original: As for the kaithrit, his demureness betrays his huge perverse streak. Once-pinched lips give form to scandalous half-details that make the two women scoff and roll their eyes. All the while, you’re impressed by the feline’s comedic timing and ability to infuse humor and awful puns in his retelling of some sordid things that you’re damn sure are fake but can’t overcome the irritable desire to believe in and root for him.
rows.translation: 至于那个凯思里特，他那娴静的外表其实掩盖了他那极其扭曲的本性。当他紧抿双唇时，那些令人震惊的细节就会从他的话语中泄露出来，让那两个女人忍不住发笑、翻白眼。与此同时，你也会被这种“猫一般的幽默感”所折服——他总能将一些肮脏、恶心的事情重新讲述出来，同时加入幽默的元素和令人捧腹的双关语绝对没错。这些都是假的，但我还是无法抑制自己想要相信他、支持他的冲动。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs for the kaithrit, his demureness betrays his huge perverse streak. Once-pinched lips give form to scandalous half-details that make the two women scoff and roll their eyes. All the while, you’re impressed by the feline’s comedic timing and ability to infuse humor and awful puns in his retelling of some sordid things that you’re damn sure are fake but can’t overcome the irritable desire to believe in and root for him."

rows.original: “Almost makes you wanna go home, right? But we can’t waste time! Gotta really make the most of our being out here, [pc.name]!” Her hand claps to your head, her nails stroking sensitive nerves gingerly. “Good [pc.boyGirl]. Wouldn’t have held it against you if you took a nap, but seeing you still ready to go, with a bit of energy, that’s what I like. This is what makes this kinda thing so much fun!”
rows.translation: 简直让人想回家，对吧？但我们不能浪费时间！必须充分利用我们在这里的每一刻，[pc.name]！她的手轻拍着你的头，她的指甲小心翼翼地触碰着你那些敏感的神经。做得好，[pc.boyGirl]。如果你小睡一会儿的话，我也不会怪你的，但看到你仍然精神饱满、准备继续行动，这才是我喜欢的。正是这样的态度才让这类事情变得如此有趣！

rows.original: It might be anecdotal, but power naps always seem to have a better-than-average chance of enabling lucid dreaming states. One second you’re leaping through windows across wide fields, ceaseless energy flowing between existences, and then you’re seeing familiar things in space: UGC flagships, battles between pirates, and you between them, a rider in the sky, a formless entity cogitating on the traversal of life through the void...
rows.translation: 虽然这可能只是个人经验，但小睡似乎确实能增加进入清醒梦状态的概率。前一秒你还在广阔的田野间穿越窗户，在不同的存在之间自由穿梭，充满能量；下一秒，你就会在梦中看到熟悉的事物：UGC的主力舰、海盗之间的战斗，而你自己则置身其中，成为天空中的一名骑手，或者是一个正在思考生命如何穿越虚无的无形存在...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt might be anecdotal, but power naps always seem to have a better-than-average chance of enabling lucid dreaming states. One second you’re leaping through windows across wide fields, ceaseless energy flowing between existences, and then you’re seeing familiar things in space: UGC flagships, battles between pirates, and you between them, a rider in the sky, a formless entity cogitating on the traversal of life through the void..."

rows.original: And then you’re shaken and stirred; you wake briskly, stretching the cricks from dormant muscles. “It’s really quite something what our youngers get up to these days, isn’t it?” asks the gryvain, who then laughs at her friends’ responses.
rows.translation: 然后你被惊醒了，迅速从睡梦中清醒过来，同时活动那些因为长时间未使用而变得僵硬的肌肉。现在的年轻人真是干出了一些了不起的事情，不是吗？她问了格里瓦因，而格里瓦因则嘲笑她朋友们给出的回答。

If you were on this side of the leash I’d probably be yawning the whole time! So, don’t sweat it.”

rows.original: Shedding your liberties and individuality to be leashed and led around by the neck has given you ample time to think about everything, let the reality sink in. You are a [pc.raceShort], a conscious person with codified rights. Yet, when people look at you, it’s easy for them to forget all that and just see you for what you’re currently pretending to be, and treat you accordingly - a lower class, but a highly-endearing one.
rows.translation: 放弃自己的自由与个性，被他人牵着鼻子走，其实给了你充足的时间去思考一切，去认清现实。你是一个[pc.raceShort]，一个拥有法定权利的有意识个体。然而，当别人看到你时，他们很容易忘记这一切，只看到你目前所假装的形象，然后据此来对待你——你属于较低的社会阶层，但却非常惹人喜爱。

You are a [pc.raceShort], a conscious person with codified rights. Yet, when people look at you, it’s easy for them to forget all that and just see you for what you’re currently pretending to be, and treat you accordingly - a lower class, but a highly-endearing one."

rows.original: Were you standing up and walking around like normal, it’d be different. Is this sort of thing really so common, or is it just that easy for others to find amusement in it?
rows.translation: 如果你能像正常人一样站起来走动，情况就会不同了。这种事情真的这么常见吗，还是说别人觉得这种行为很有趣，因此很容易就能发现它呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nWere you standing up and walking around like normal, it’d be different. Is this sort of thing really so common, or is it just that easy for others to find amusement in it?"

rows.original: Whatever your thoughts, the logical conclusions leave you feeling flushed with submissive lust. Your situation could mean anything to them. Maybe they see this roleplay for what it is. rows.raw: "\n\nRaucous laughter erupts from the less empathetic, the heave of your alabaster owner’s body a cartoonish attraction for them. Anno bounds up to her feet with a veteran soldier’s speed, carefully-styled hair tousled, dirt on her top. “F-Fuck, [pc.name], why’d you...”"

rows.original: She about drags you from the area, dripping sweat from her chin. Under an awning, she catches her breath, staring at you in distress. “Why didn’t you stop when I told you? I said it three times, [pc.name]! There were people in front of us, were you sleep-walking!?”
rows.translation: 她几乎是把你从那片区域拖了出来，下巴上的汗往下滴。在一处遮阳篷下，她喘着气，痛苦地盯着你。“我叫你停的时候你为什么不停？我说了三遍，[pc.name]！我们前面还有人，你是在梦游吗！？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe about drags you from the area, dripping sweat from her chin. Under an awning, she catches her breath, staring at you in distress. “Why didn’t you stop when I told you? I said it three times, [pc.name]! There were people in front of us, were you sleep-walking!?”"

rows.original: Your [pc.ears] dip melancholically.
rows.translation: 你的[pc.ears]忧郁地垂了下去。
rows.raw: "Your [pc.ears] dip melancholically."

rows.original: Your chin lowers melancholically.
rows.translation: 你的下巴忧郁地垂了下来。
rows.raw: "Your chin lowers melancholically."

rows.original: “Ahhhh, damn it...” Anno wipes the sweat from her brow, then tightens that same hand upon your jaw. “[pc.name], focus! Okay? You can’t get distracted out here. Don’t let that happen again, alright?”
rows.translation: “啊啊啊，该死...” 安诺擦了擦额头的汗，然后用同一只手捏紧你的下巴。“[pc.name]，集中精神！行吗？在外面你可不能分心。别再让这种事发生了，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhhh, damn it...” Anno wipes the sweat from her brow, then tightens that same hand upon your jaw. “[pc.name], focus! Okay? You can’t get distracted out here. Don’t let that happen again, alright?”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “Good. Now, let’s hope nobody caught that on video. Last thing I wanna get is an email from Syri with it attached!”
rows.translation: “好。现在，但愿没人把那个拍成视频。我最不想收到的就是希莉发来一封带着它的邮件！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. Now, let’s hope nobody caught that on video. Last thing I wanna get is an email from Syri with it attached!”"

rows.original: The walk continues, Anno’s intense fluster like a second companion.
rows.translation: 你们继续走着，安诺那股强烈的慌乱就像第二个同伴一样跟着。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe walk continues, Anno’s intense fluster like a second companion."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No!
rows.translation: 不！
rows.raw: "No!"

rows.original: Just get yourself in order and hope for the best!
rows.translation: 先把自己整理好，然后往好处想吧！
rows.raw: "Just get yourself in order and hope for the best!"

rows.translation: 退出

rows.translation: 告诉安诺，你必须在这里停下来。
rows.raw: "Tell Anno you have to stop here."

rows.raw: "William"

rows.translation: 演出来

rows.original: People are piling into this area for reasons you can’t yet divine. So many large bodies running past you make your head spin, and the faint paranoia of getting trampled surfaces. Anno leads you slow and steady to where the crowds were racing. A makeshift circle has been set up, and a number of gladragged agents levy fees against prospecting performers looking to take center-stage.
rows.translation: 人们正往这片区域涌来，原因你暂时还猜不透。那么多庞大的身躯从你身边跑过，让你头晕目眩，隐隐约约的“会被踩扁”的偏执感浮了上来。安诺稳稳当当地领着你走向人群奔涌的地方。那里围出了一个临时场地，几个穿得花里胡哨的经纪人正向想来上台试运气的表演者收取费用。
rows.raw: "\n\nPeople are piling into this area for reasons you can’t yet divine. So many large bodies running past you make your head spin, and the faint paranoia of getting trampled surfaces. Anno leads you slow and steady to where the crowds were racing. A makeshift circle has been set up, and a number of gladragged agents levy fees against prospecting performers looking to take center-stage."

rows.original: “A thousand creds, huh?” Anno muses. “Looks like a talent show!”
rows.translation: “一千信用点，嗯？”安诺沉吟道。“看来是场才艺秀！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A thousand creds, huh?” Anno muses. “Looks like a talent show!”"

rows.translation: 安诺绕过表演坑，命令你跟在她脚边，自己在一张没人占的椅子上坐下。一个

rows.translation: 昆达里安男性

rows.translation: 蓝皮肤、满身鳞片的男性，你的 CODEX 终端发出一声提示音，表明他是昆达里安人

rows.original: Cundarians
rows.raw: "Cundarians"

rows.original: , passionate and full of determination, stands idle. And then, he suddenly breaks into a fervid dance that’s difficult to follow. Despite the gorilla-like broadness of his hyper-masculine shape - his dense, firm pecs glisten with sweat, drawing plenty of swooning looks to meticulously exercised clusters - he marries the agility of a cheetah with the fierceness of a lion.
rows.translation: ，满怀激情与决心，静静地站着。然后，他突然跳起一段热烈得让人跟不上的舞蹈。尽管他那超男性化的身形有着大猩猩般的宽阔 - 他紧实浓密的胸肌闪着汗光，把不少痴迷的目光引向那刻意练出的肌群 - 他却把猎豹的敏捷与狮子的凶猛结合在了一起。
rows.raw: ", passionate and full of determination, stands idle. And then, he suddenly breaks into a fervid dance that’s difficult to follow. Despite the gorilla-like broadness of his hyper-masculine shape - his dense, firm pecs glisten with sweat, drawing plenty of swooning looks to meticulously exercised clusters - he marries the agility of a cheetah with the fierceness of a lion."

rows.original: Whatever styles and techniques inspired him, it’s clear to see that a lot of effort went into perfecting his own. A glance to the judges, nodding surreptitiously amongst themselves, affirms the notion. When he whips himself into a ten-eighty spin, limbs pinwheeling out, the chiseled actor comes to a stop in a stylish pose; his heaves for breath bulge his fatigued musculature, making almost the entirety of the female audience gasp.
rows.translation: 不管他借鉴了什么风格与技巧，都能明显看出他为完善自己的一套付出了大量心血。朝评委们瞥一眼，他们正互相偷偷点头，印证了这一点。当他猛地转出一记一千零八十度的回旋、四肢像风车般展开时，这位轮廓分明的演员以一个潇洒的姿势停了下来；他粗重的喘息让疲惫的肌肉鼓起，几乎让全场女性观众都倒吸一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever styles and techniques inspired him, it’s clear to see that a lot of effort went into perfecting his own. A glance to the judges, nodding surreptitiously amongst themselves, affirms the notion. When he whips himself into a ten-eighty spin, limbs pinwheeling out, the chiseled actor comes to a stop in a stylish pose; his heaves for breath bulge his fatigued musculature, making almost the entirety of the female audience gasp."

rows.original: “Maaaaan, I wanna get his number...” Anno mewls with a mouthful of popcorn. Where’d she get that, anyway?
rows.translation: “天——哪，我想要他的号码...”安诺嘴里塞满爆米花地喵喵道。话说她哪儿弄来的爆米花？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maaaaan, I wanna get his number...” Anno mewls with a mouthful of popcorn. Where’d she get that, anyway?"

rows.original: Demonstrating his proficiency, earning a deserved ten-out-of-freaking-ten from the excited talent scouts, the rippling hunk departs. Too bad for his admirers - he doesn’t give them so much as a cool guy’s peek.
rows.translation: 他展现出娴熟的技巧，从兴奋的星探们那里赢得了当之无愧的十分-满分-十分，这个肌肉虬结的壮汉离开了。对他的仰慕者来说太可惜了 - 他连给她们酷哥式的一瞥都不肯。
rows.raw: "\n\nDemonstrating his proficiency, earning a deserved ten-out-of-freaking-ten from the excited talent scouts, the rippling hunk departs. Too bad for his admirers - he doesn’t give them so much as a cool guy’s peek."

rows.original: “Hello-hello, sapient of high class and servile delights!” a four-eyed, yellow-feathered
rows.translation: “你好你好，品味高雅、专享服侍之乐的智慧生命！”一个四只眼、黄色羽毛的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello-hello, sapient of high class and servile delights!” a four-eyed, yellow-feathered "

rows.raw: "Toves"

rows.original: tove
rows.translation: 托芙
rows.raw: "tove"

rows.original: avian creature - known as a ‘tove’ according to your ever-clever codex -
rows.translation: 鸟类生物 - 根据你那本一向聪明的CODEX，它被称为‘托芙’ -
rows.raw: "avian creature - known as a ‘tove’ according to your ever-clever codex -"

rows.original: greets Anno from behind, tipping a tiny slanted hat as he puffs out his finely-tailored doublet. “Ingenuous apologeticalliness for this sudden dialogue tamperbothering your most excellent of moods, but I couldn’t keep my three good eyes from descryinoticing your immaculate refinement of poise and posture as well as your obdurate control over the [pc.eyeColor]-eyed [pc.raceShort]; in-dee-dubitably, my best eye can pick talent out at over two-hundred paces - Camarilla paces, of-course-to-be-primprudently-honest!”
rows.translation: 从背后向安诺打招呼，一边扶了扶一顶斜戴的小帽子，一边挺起胸膛，把那件剪裁精良的紧身上衣撑得鼓起。“为这突如其来的搭话搅扰了您绝佳的兴致，在下满怀天真地抱愧歉疚，但在下那三只完好的眼睛实在管不住，非要瞧见察觉您那无可挑剔的举止仪态，以及您对这位[pc.eyeColor]眼睛的[pc.raceShort]那坚定不移的掌控；确-实-无-疑-地，在下这只最棒的眼睛能在两百多步开外挑出人才 - 卡玛利拉步，当然，出于-谨慎-的-坦白说！”
rows.raw: " greets Anno from behind, tipping a tiny slanted hat as he puffs out his finely-tailored doublet. “Ingenuous apologeticalliness for this sudden dialogue tamperbothering your most excellent of moods, but I couldn’t keep my three good eyes from descryinoticing your immaculate refinement of poise and posture as well as your obdurate control over the [pc.eyeColor]-eyed [pc.raceShort]; in-dee-dubitably, my best eye can pick talent out at over two-hundred paces - Camarilla paces, of-course-to-be-primprudently-honest!”"

rows.original: Anno sighs. “Would you get to the point?”
rows.translation: 安诺叹了口气。“你能直接说重点吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno sighs. “Would you get to the point?”"

rows.original: “Yes-sir-ee-ma’am!” He adjusts his quad monocle and smooths his necktie with a smug yet endearing charisma. “I can’t promise the gilded ticketroutes to Ronasca or Fetina B - not without being oiled and defeathered! - but a petshow is just what we need to enspicen up our illustrious acting center!”
rows.translation: “好咧，先生女士！”他调了调那副四重单片眼镜，带着一种既自得又讨人喜欢的魅力抹平领带。“我可不敢保证通往罗纳斯卡或费蒂娜B的镀金航线 - 除非先被人抹上油、拔光毛！ - 不过宠物秀正是我们给辉煌的演艺中心添点风味所需要的东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes-sir-ee-ma’am!” He adjusts his quad monocle and smooths his necktie with a smug yet endearing charisma. “I can’t promise the gilded ticketroutes to Ronasca or Fetina B - not without being oiled and defeathered! - but a petshow is just what we need to enspicen up our illustrious acting center!”"

rows.original: Acting center. Really? You keep your thoughts to yourself, but are almost certain he saw the eye roll.
rows.translation: 演艺中心。真的？你没把想法说出口，但几乎可以肯定他看到了你翻白眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nActing center. Really? You keep your thoughts to yourself, but are almost certain he saw the eye roll."

rows.original: “To reclarificulate, your sucrasweet and pretty collar-friend can perform for a crowd for the gratification of many patronfluentials eager to witness new talent and swallow the memories of starly-studded performances behind sparklemirror eyes!”
rows.translation: “重新阐清一下，你那位甜滋滋又戴着漂亮项圈的朋友可以为观众献演，让许多爱慕新秀、渴望在闪镜眼眸后囫囵吞下星光熠熠表演记忆的恩客显贵们心满意足！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“To reclarificulate, your sucrasweet and pretty collar-friend can perform for a crowd for the gratification of many patronfluentials eager to witness new talent and swallow the memories of starly-studded performances behind sparklemirror eyes!”"

rows.original: “So you’re asking me to put [pc.name] on the spot, make [pc.himHer] do a few tricks?” Anno grins.
rows.translation: “所以你是在让我把[pc.name]叫出来当众表演，让[pc.himHer]耍几个把戏？”安诺咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’re asking me to put [pc.name] on the spot, make [pc.himHer] do a few tricks?” Anno grins."

rows.original: “Ab-so-posolutely! For free! Understandings are fastidiously achieved should you discover reasons to dislike this graceweather deal!”
rows.translation: “绝、绝对没问题！完全免费！如果您发现有什么理由不喜欢这笔天降好运的交易，我们都会一丝不苟地达成谅解！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ab-so-posolutely! For free! Understandings are fastidiously achieved should you discover reasons to dislike this graceweather deal!”"

rows.original: Anno looks to you for an answer. The tilt of her head suggests that you don’t have to. Will you take the stage?
rows.translation: 安诺看向你，等你回答。她歪着头的样子表明你并不非得回答。你要上台吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno looks to you for an answer. The tilt of her head suggests that you don’t have to. Will you take the stage?"

rows.original: Perform
rows.translation: 执行
rows.raw: "Perform"

rows.original: William
rows.raw: "William"

rows.original: Excitement is its own form of communication, and you radiate it. Such persuasiveness allows you to skip the queue of thronging wanna-bes (much to their chagrin). The obsequious avian announces your entry, ushering Anno and yourself to the middle of the ring. Echoing applause muffles to the low murmurs, breaths, and sniffles of an expectant audience.
rows.translation: 兴奋本身就是一种沟通方式，而你浑身散发着它。这样的说服力让你得以跳过那群蜂拥的跃跃欲试者（他们为此懊恼不已）。那只谄媚的鸟人高声通报你的入场，把安诺和你引到擂台中央。回荡的掌声渐渐低落，变成满怀期待的观众的低声议论、呼吸和抽鼻声。
rows.raw: "Excitement is its own form of communication, and you radiate it. Such persuasiveness allows you to skip the queue of thronging wanna-bes (much to their chagrin). The obsequious avian announces your entry, ushering Anno and yourself to the middle of the ring. Echoing applause muffles to the low murmurs, breaths, and sniffles of an expectant audience."

rows.original: “What’s most important in a pet?” Anno asks aloud; her blue eyes track the layers of bodies and heads for any potential answer.
rows.translation: “宠物身上最重要的是什么？”安诺出声问道；她蓝色的眼睛扫过层层叠叠的身体和脑袋，寻找任何可能的答案。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s most important in a pet?” Anno asks aloud; her blue eyes track the layers of bodies and heads for any potential answer."

rows.original: “Training!” blurts a guy from the back.
rows.translation: “训练！”后面有人脱口而出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Training!” blurts a guy from the back."

rows.original: “Exactly. When you’ve got a trained pet - a good pet - pretty much anything’s possible.” The curvesome canid slips into a different kind of suit, her hard stops firing up the viewers. “This is [pc.name], and [pc.heShe]’s a quick learner. Wasn’t so long ago [pc.heShe] wanted to try being on the fun side of the leash, and I’m super happy about [pc.hisHer] progress. But don’t take MY word for it...”
rows.translation: “正是如此。当你拥有一只训练有素的宠物 - 一只好宠物 - 几乎一切皆有可能。” 这位曲线玲珑的犬族女人换上了另一种款式的紧身衣，她利落的镜头切换让观众们热血沸腾。“这位是 [pc.name]，[pc.heShe] 学得很快。不久前 [pc.heShe] 还想试试站在牵绳愉快的那一端，我对 [pc.hisHer] 的进步非常满意。不过别光听我一面之词...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly. When you’ve got a trained pet - a good pet - pretty much anything’s possible.” The curvesome canid slips into a different kind of suit, her hard stops firing up the viewers. “This is [pc.name], and [pc.heShe]’s a quick learner. Wasn’t so long ago [pc.heShe] wanted to try being on the fun side of the leash, and I’m super happy about [pc.hisHer] progress. But don’t take MY word for it...”"

rows.original: Simplicity is the ultimate form of sophistication, it’s been said. You don’t have to be fancy about this, just do exactly as you’re told and put a little spin on it. Everyone’s seen a terran-style dog show by now whether they’ve wanted to or not, but it’s far more interesting to see an eager [pc.boyGirl] follow commands to the letter.
rows.translation: 有人说，简约是最高级的精致。这事你不必搞什么花样，只要照吩咐一板一眼地做，再添点小小的花巧。事到如今，无论愿不愿意，人人都见过地球风格的犬展，但看一个热切的[pc.boyGirl]一丝不苟地听从指令，可有意思得多。
rows.raw: "\n\nSimplicity is the ultimate form of sophistication, it’s been said. You don’t have to be fancy about this, just do exactly as you’re told and put a little spin on it. Everyone’s seen a terran-style dog show by now whether they’ve wanted to or not, but it’s far more interesting to see an eager [pc.boyGirl] follow commands to the letter."

rows.original: Animated by instinctual obeisance and tempered by a Rusher’s physique, you warm up in a circular run then leap through a hoop, shake when told, roll over when bidden, and walk close to the edge to harvest appreciation. You can tell by the smiles and the gentleness in their hands that this is one of the more interesting things they’ve ever seen. It really does take talent to make a [pc.manWoman] into a cute [pc.raceCute] debasing [pc.himHer]self for others total bemusement.
rows.translation: 凭本能的臣服驱动、又经冲袭者的体格锤炼，你先绕圈热身跑，然后跃过圆环，听到指令就抖身，被吩咐就翻身打滚，还走到边缘附近去收割赞赏。从他们的笑容和手上的温柔，你能看出这是他们见过相当有趣的事情之一。要把一个[pc.manWoman]变成一只可爱的[pc.raceCute]，为了别人的十足乐子而作践[pc.himHer]自己，还真得有点本事。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnimated by instinctual obeisance and tempered by a Rusher’s physique, you warm up in a circular run then leap through a hoop, shake when told, roll over when bidden, and walk close to the edge to harvest appreciation. You can tell by the smiles and the gentleness in their hands that this is one of the more interesting things they’ve ever seen. It really does take talent to make a [pc.manWoman] into a cute [pc.raceCute] debasing [pc.himHer]self for others total bemusement."

rows.original: By the end of it, you’re sweating and panting
rows.translation: 到结束时，你已汗流浃背、气喘吁吁
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the end of it, you’re sweating and panting"

rows.original: - keep that long tongue of yours out! It’s all part of a good act
rows.translation: - 把你那条长舌头伸在外面！这都是演好戏的一部分
rows.raw: " - keep that long tongue of yours out! It’s all part of a good act"

rows.original: . Such is your loyalty to Anno that you can’t help but give your canid mistress everything she wants from you. Smile, [pc.barkMeow]... even purr a little. Suffice it to say, your appearance was a rousing success. The judges quite liked it, and seem displeased that their business cards are politely declined.
rows.translation: 。你对安诺的忠诚就是如此，你忍不住要把这位犬族女主人想从你身上得到的一切都献给她。笑一个吧，[pc.barkMeow]... 甚至轻轻呼噜两声。总之，你这次出场大获成功。评委们相当喜欢，只是名片被礼貌地回绝，似乎让他们有些不太痛快。
rows.raw: ". Such is your loyalty to Anno that you can’t help but give your canid mistress everything she wants from you. Smile, [pc.barkMeow]... even purr a little. Suffice it to say, your appearance was a rousing success. The judges quite liked it, and seem displeased that their business cards are politely declined."

rows.original: Anno winks at the thankful bird-like hawker before guiding you onwards. “That was a fucking lot of fun, [pc.name]. Bet you enjoyed getting to stretch your legs! Wish you could’ve seen the SNEER on one chick’s face.”
rows.translation: 安诺朝那个道谢的鸟形小贩眨了眨眼，然后带着你继续往前走。“刚才真他妈太好玩了，[pc.name]。我打赌你很享受活动腿脚的机会！真希望你能看到那小妞脸上那副嗤笑。”

rows.original: Anno raises her paw in a bubbly wave. “Hiya! This is my pet, [pc.name]. Before we get started, I have just one very important question...” The fervor is low right now, but she’s building anticipation, matching herself to the level of excitement. “What’s the most important thing to do with a pet?”
rows.translation: 安诺举起爪子，活泼地挥了挥。“嗨呀！这是我的宠物，[pc.name]。在我们开始之前，我只有一个非常重要的问题...”此刻狂热值还很低，但她正在铺垫期待，把自己调到与兴奋度相称的状态。“对待宠物最重要的事情是什么？”

rows.original: “You bet! And I’ve got one of my most well-trained pets with me today. Look at [pc.himHer], all cute with [pc.hisHer] [pc.eyeColor] eyes and [pc.lipColor] smile!” Letting yourself be exhibited and complimented in the same breath, and then to feel a dozen other intelligent beings leveling their expectations on you, is overwhelming. The colors around you turn gauzy and drab in the moment. “Anyone’ll tell you training a good pet’s a super hard job, especially a sweetie like [pc.name], but I’ve made awesome progress and I think you’ll all quite like what I have to show, but don’t take MY word for it...”
rows.translation: “那当然！而且我今天带来的可是我最训练有素的宠物之一。看看[pc.himHer]，多可爱，[pc.hisHer]那双[pc.eyeColor]的眼睛，[pc.lipColor]的笑容！”被人这样一边展示一边夸赞，还要承受十几个其他智慧生命落在你身上的期待，这一切让你透不过气。这一刻，周围的颜色都变得朦胧而灰暗。“谁都会告诉你，训好一只宠物是超级难的活儿，尤其是像[pc.name]这样的小甜心，可我取得了惊人的进展，我想你们都会很喜欢我要展示的东西，不过别只听我一个人说...”

rows.original: Your owner takes on a strong, commanding presence as she demands the simplest acts of obedience. Anno’s whole body squirms with some amount of stage fright and delight as she rules her future boss. You crawl to her, shake her hand, smile as you do it, and feel so very small. Starting from here stiffens your nerve for progressively difficult tasks, such as rolling over, [pc.barkMeow]ing on command, and even leaping up for a treat. Men and women you’ll never know watch, enraptured.
rows.translation: 你的主人摆出一副强势、威严的架势，要求你完成最简单的服从动作。安诺在支配自己未来的老板时，全身都带着几分怯场和兴奋扭动着。你爬到她面前，跟她握手，握手时还笑着，感觉自己渺小得不行。从这里开始，你的胆子一点点硬了起来，去应付越来越难的任务，比如打滚、按命令[pc.barkMeow]叫，甚至跳起来讨块点心。你永远不会认识的男男女女们看得入了迷。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour owner takes on a strong, commanding presence as she demands the simplest acts of obedience. Anno’s whole body squirms with some amount of stage fright and delight as she rules her future boss. You crawl to her, shake her hand, smile as you do it, and feel so very small. Starting from here stiffens your nerve for progressively difficult tasks, such as rolling over, [pc.barkMeow]ing on command, and even leaping up for a treat. Men and women you’ll never know watch, enraptured."

rows.original: There were little gasps and coos at first, from Anno and others, but now there’s clapping. The white noise of glorious affirmation encompasses you, and a happy, purely animalistic sound escapes your open mouth. Anno’s taught you how to walk and then how to run all in the span of ten fascinating minutes. It’s so... easy. You suppose you should feel something like shame or degradation, but you can’t dig out such emotions, you’re enjoying yourself.
rows.translation: 起初是安诺和其他人发出的轻细抽气与低喃，但现在响起了掌声。那荣耀般肯定的白噪音将你包围，一声纯粹出于本能的快乐声音从你张开的嘴里逸出。安诺在短短十分钟迷人的时间里教会了你走路，然后又教会了你奔跑。这真是... 太简单了。你以为自己该感到羞耻或屈辱，却怎么也挖不出那样的情绪，你很享受。

The scrape of long nails and the brush of calloused hands to your [pc.ears] and [pc.skin] as you skirt the acting ring are heavenly. rows.original: Anno flicks his beak as she stands and leads you away. His perturbed squawks fade into indistinct background tones. After a few more quiet seconds pass by, you feel a warm rush of palpable contentment. Knowing, and having in this case, someone watching out for your best interests, regardless of the how, is always a luscious sensation.
rows.translation: 安诺起身领你走开时，他弹了弹喙。他那不安的叫声渐渐淡成模糊的背景音。又静静过了几秒，你感到一股温热而切实的满足涌上来。知道有人在替你着想、护着你的利益，而在此情形下确实有这么个人，不管方式如何，那总是一种甜美的感觉。

rows.original: Tavros is a jewel socketed between the wild, wild west of unsettled quadrants and the slow-moving borders of its conquerors. It’s an oasis - and it’s indicative of the perverted civilization the UGC plans to bring to the unknown alien races inhabiting the beyond. Anno drifts through the tumultuous mercantile promenades, the looming prefabricated residential zones, the tides of Rushers out here to strike it rich, and finally leads you into the clearer air of a multi-colored parkway.

rows.original: And something more, probably. Life on the frontier is a warped facsimile of life in the Core. Tavros has strict rules and mandates about public-facing displays of erotica, and yet when you squint, you can see it’s a competition among its residents to break those rules. Around the leafy trees, in the shades of awnings and unused tents, skin, fur, and scales gleam. Suddenly you note every pore on your [pc.face] opens and flushes; a quadruply-endowed male slinks into a hedge maze in pursuit of amazonian beauty.

Dr. Belle strides towards the Accu-Pitch labs. The bored expression on her face lightens when she looks across and takes a patient second to recognize you; a grin colors the human herm’s features with a strange kind of mischief that makes your heart skip.
rows.translation: 在布满节点的舱壁另一侧，你的[pc.eyes]落到一个熟悉的身影上，你的潜意识只把这个人跟最深、最炽热的臣服荣耀感联系在一起。贝尔博士正大步走向精准音调实验室。她望过来，耐心地花了一秒钟才认出你，脸上那副无聊的神情随之缓和；一抹古怪的顽皮笑意染上这个人类雌雄同体的面容，让你的心漏跳一拍。

Dr. Belle strides towards the Accu-Pitch labs. The bored expression on her face lightens when she looks across and takes a patient second to recognize you; a grin colors the human herm’s features with a strange kind of mischief that makes your heart skip."

rows.original: “Ahhh, [pc.name],” Belle approaches with a genial smile. “I see you’re busy exploring that special side of yourself. It’s refreshing to see a [pc.boyGirl] so honest with [pc.himHer]self. I wonder... have our sessions helped you learn just a bit more about yourself?” She’s silent for a moment, considering Anno with razor eyes.
rows.translation: “啊，[pc.name]，”贝尔带着和蔼的笑容走近。“我看你正忙着探索自己那特别的一面。能看到一个[pc.boyGirl]对[pc.himHer]自己这么诚实，真是让人耳目一新。我在想...我们的疗程有没有帮你多了解自己一点？”她沉默了片刻，用刀锋般的目光打量着安诺。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahhh, [pc.name],” Belle approaches with a genial smile. “I see you’re busy exploring that special side of yourself. It’s refreshing to see a [pc.boyGirl] so honest with [pc.himHer]self. I wonder... have our sessions helped you learn just a bit more about yourself?” She’s silent for a moment, considering Anno with razor eyes."

rows.original: “Oh good, good,” Belle says, smirking. She knits her fingers contemplatively. “I happen to know [pc.name] quite intimately.” The fair-skinned herm-scientist almost seems like she’s got one eye on you and one eye on Anno, her manner of speech that charming. “[pc.name] is a loyal volunteer in many of my experiments, each of which is focused on the distinct facets of a sapient’s agreeableness to suggestion. In other words, how to be a good [pc.boyGirl] for [pc.hisHer] mistress.”
rows.translation: “哦好，好，”贝尔说着，露出得意的笑。她若有所思地交扣起手指。“我碰巧对[pc.name]相当熟悉。”这位肤色白皙的雌雄同体科学家几乎像是一只眼睛盯着你、一只眼睛盯着安诺，说话的腔调就是那么迷人。“[pc.name]是我许多实验里的忠实志愿者，每一项都着眼于智慧生命对暗示的顺从性在不同侧面的表现。换句话说，就是怎样当个乖巧的[pc.boyGirl]，好好伺候[pc.hisHer]女主人。”

In other words, how to be a good [pc.boyGirl] for [pc.hisHer] mistress.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe human’s gaze falls on you with palpable force. There’s a glimmer of... something in her eyes. “Let’s see... if you can figure out just who your owner is right now.”"

rows.original: Unbidden thoughts surface like crabs from beach sand in your conscience, crowding out the others as they skate through your mind. You’re getting kind of a... sound beyond it, a weird buzz in the periphery that muddies your clarity. It’s so close to being overwhelming, but your senses are able to tune out the noise - A in C major repeating ad infinitum. “Turn and face your real owner, [pc.name]. The one who gives you all the pets you need. The one who satisfies your needs. In this universe, there are pets... like you.”
rows.translation: 不请自来的念头像沙滩里的螃蟹一样从你意识里冒出来，滑过你脑中时把别的念头都挤开了。你渐渐听出某种...声音在它之后，外围有奇怪的嗡鸣，把你的清明搅浑。它几乎就要把人淹没，但你的感官还能把那股噪音滤掉 - C大调里的A音，无休无止地重复。“转过来，面对你真正的主人，[pc.name]。那个给你所需要的一切抚摸的人。那个满足你需求的人。在这个宇宙里，有宠物...像你这样的。”

The one who gives you all the pets you need. The one who satisfies your needs. In this universe, there are pets... like you.”"

Acting with a fervor aggravated by inner turmoil, you cringe away from the looming sonic-scientist and wrap yourself around Anno’s leg, clutching it tight. rows.original: And... gone. Just like that. Perhaps not the result she was hoping for. Maybe she’s even gone to sulk. Gooooood [pc.boyGirl],” she murmurs, scritching heady ecstasy into your [pc.skin], expunging the last of those artificial disturbances. “Wasn’t worried one single iota! Something tells me she was up to no good, so you keep this up and there just might be a niiiice treat back home for ‘ya.”
rows.translation: 然后...走了。就这么走了。也许这不是她希望的结果。她甚至可能是去生闷气了。之后你大概能补偿她，但现在，安诺蓝眼睛里那道鲜明的光彩给你注入了一片幸福的安宁。“我就知道你能轻轻松松过关。真——乖[pc.boyGirl]，”她低声说，一边抓挠着往你的[pc.skin]里揉进令人眩晕的极乐，把那些人工干扰的最后一点残余清除干净。“一点都不担心！我总觉得她没安好心，所以你要继续保持，家里说不定有份美——美的奖励在等着你。”

I expect to see you later. And, oh my... it looks like you haven’t trained [pc.himHer] well, tsk tsk.”

rows.original: Situated on Uveto is Rhenworld, a subsidiary of Steele Tech, and one trip down the space elevator are the local Steele Tech offices headed by Dr. Lessau. Intermingling in the cafeteria are employees and reps of the respective corporations; black and gold sidles seamlessly around green and orange. The longer you stand there fidgeting, averting your eyes, chewing your bottom lip... the more Anno starts to wonder just why the future of Steele Tech is having trouble being honest with [pc.himHer]self.

I am absolutely, positively, not asking you to rig anything, just, y’know...” She pokes a finger into your chest. “Asking you to throw me a bone.”

There’s tons of upsides though: I’ll give you lots of scritchies and brushies if you’re really good.”

We go out for a ‘lil while, catch some eyes, enjoy our day... see how you handle being down there... and then we come home. What happens after, mmmmm... you’ve got a few ideas by now I bet.” Feather-white fingers brush your hip, “Just remember: you and I can stop anytime, but trust me, the elation and satisfaction of going through the whole thing is worth it. Promise. Sooooo...”

rows.original: You nod, and tell the ravenette ausar you’ll think about it. She grins, and buys you both another round. The next couple hours go by pleasantly, with Anno and Syri regaling you with the misadventures of their youth, their various petty rivalries and in-jokes. Finally, several beers later, a slightly-inebriated, companionable silence falls over the trio of you. You excuse yourself then, leaving the two ausars to privately catch up.
rows.translation: 你点点头，告诉这位黑发的奥萨尔你会考虑。她咧嘴一笑，又给你们俩各买了一杯。接下来的几个小时过得很愉快，安诺和希莉跟你讲她们年轻时的荒唐经历、各种小心眼的较劲和只有她们懂的笑话。最后，又喝了几杯啤酒，微醺的、融洽的沉默笼罩了你们三个。你随即告辞，留下两个奥萨尔私下叙旧。

rows.original: Deciding to check in on your science pup, you make your way over to where Anno’s sitting... just a moment too late, as a tall ausar man saunters up to her. He’s packing way more cologne than any reasonable fellow ought to, radiating off a designer-torn leather jacket and greased-back black hair that screams “pretty rich boy.” He leans confidently against the bar next to Anno and wiggles his towering jackal-ears, flashing her a big, toothy smile.

rows.original: By the time you get over to them, Anno’s lips are twisted in an unbecoming grimace. The ausar stud keeps on with his wanna-be charming grin, talking just softly enough that you can’t make out exactly what he’s saying. Not that he’s being subtle about his intentions, if his gaze being locked raptly to Anno’s chest with a firm package tenting his jeans is any indication. By the time you get close enough to hear him saying something about how he and Anno would “make some fuckin’ hot pups, y’know babe?” you can see Anno’s had exactly enough of the oh-so-suave playboy.

Plus, it shows you respect me enough to ask.” You tell her you won’t just sneak up on her when she’s with company next time, and her smile brightens, her tail wagging happily. “Thanks, boss,” she says, squeezing your hand in hers appreciatively. “I don’t like making a fuss about things, but I appreciate you accommodating me on this. It matters. Now that’s out of the way, how about we get a drink, and see where that takes us?” She leads you back into the bar by the hand, her thumb caressing your knuckles tenderly.

rows.original: Floor 80: the master penthouse. The elevator slides open to reveal a shining marble hallway decorated by genuine canvas paintings and ancient iron blades hanging from the walls. rows.original: “How did you end up here?” you ask her. “Did the pirates kidnap you?”

rows.raw: "“How did you end up here?” you ask her. “Did the pirates kidnap you?”"

rows.original: Ardia nods slowly. “Yeah, right off my homeworld. The part of Hauâ Mai I grew up on is basically one island-wide resort, a real magnet for wealthy tourists looking for a beaches and jungle getaway. I thought I’d be safe from this kinda thing, until I made the mistake of joining a mission trip to one of the, uh, less civilized parts of the planet. I’d heard slavers target the dzaan tribes that still choose to live out in the jungles like they’re still on the homeworld, but we had a bodyguard at our camp and took as many safety precautions as we could. Wasn’t enough, I guess! Middle of the night, a ship comes in and orbits the village we were staying with. Lots of screaming, blinding lights, pirates flying down on jetpacks and grabbing people. Most of the missionaries got out okay, but I guess I was just the slowest tillabeast in the herd. Some big bastard in orange armor came out of the sky, grabbed me by hips, and jump-jetted me away to his ship.”
rows.translation: 阿尔迪娅缓缓点头。“对，就在我的母星上。豪阿迈上我长大的那片地区，基本就是覆盖整座岛屿的度假村，特别吸引想去海滩和丛林度假的富裕游客。我原以为自己不会遇上这种事，直到我犯了个错误，加入前往星球上某个，呃，没那么文明地区的传教团。我听说奴隶贩子会把那些仍选择像在母星时代一样住在丛林里的德赞部落当作目标，但我们的营地有保镖，也采取了能想到的一切安全措施。看来还是不够！半夜里，一艘飞船闯进来，环绕我们借宿的村庄飞行。到处是尖叫、刺眼强光，还有海盗背着喷气背包飞下来抓人。大多数传教士都平安逃掉了，可我大概就是兽群里跑得最慢的那头提拉兽。一个穿橙色盔甲的大混蛋从天而降，抓住我的腰，启动跳跃喷射器，把我带回了他的船。”

Most of the missionaries got out okay, but I guess I was just the slowest tillabeast in the herd. Some big bastard in orange armor came out of the sky, grabbed me by hips, and jump-jetted me away to his ship.”"

Shoulda listened to my mom and stayed in shape, but instead I spent my formative years focusing on the softer kinda figure-building,” Ardia half-laughs, patting a hand on her soft belly, just beneath the full mounds of her F-cup tits. “Besides, dzaan legs just weren’t made for running.”

rows.original: Ardia thinks for a moment. “Well, there’s lots of gangs here. This place is like some sort of pirate haven, a neutral ground for a bunch of different groups. I got captured by the Star Vipers, a bunch of real nasty pieces of work that love their drugs and poisons. I must have gotten stuck with twenty needles before you found me! They’re the ones that take the most pleasure slaves, from what I heard. Then there’s the Cyber Punks, real original guys that love their cybernetic augments and limbs. Rat’s Raiders are probably the least evil, they’re just thieves... though they try and make themselves look altruistic, I don’t buy it. The Corona Lords are psychos that love radiation and plasma... I can’t believe they don’t all kill themselves with the getups they run around in.”
rows.translation: 阿尔迪娅想了一会儿。“嗯，这里有很多帮派。这地方就像某种海盗乐园，是许多不同团体的中立地带。我是被星蝰抓来的，那是一群特别狠毒的家伙，最喜欢毒品和毒药。你找到我之前，我肯定挨了二十多针！据我听说，他们抓走的性奴最多。然后是赛博朋克，一群特别‘有创意’、喜欢义体强化和机械肢体的家伙。鼠帮劫掠团大概没那么邪恶，他们只是一群小偷...不过他们总想把自己装成利他主义者，我才不信。日冕领主是一群热爱辐射和等离子体的疯子...真不敢相信他们穿着那些行头到处跑，居然没有把自己全弄死。”

The press of bodies means you spend most of the trip with Ardia’s breasts squished against you; their owner spends it blushing and trying to avoid eye contact while something starts poking you progressively more urgently in the thigh from her direction. Soon, the shuttle is passing through a huge vacuum-shielded bay door, several times bigger than the entrance you flew your ship through, obviously made to berth some sort of full-on capital ship."

rows.original: Which is exactly what it’s doing. Your entrance to the spacedock grants you a long-panning view of a heavy corvette in the last stages of construction, covered in scaffolding and workers welding on exterior armor or lavishing the hull with dark orange paint.
rows.translation: 而它现在正是这么做的。你走进太空港，视野缓缓铺展开，一艘重型护卫舰正处于建造的最后阶段，舰体罩着脚手架，工人们有的在焊外装甲，有的在给船壳刷上深橙色涂料。

They’ve got everything they need to process the materials for their vessels, with dozens of technicians and engineers maneuvering between the vast rows of semi-automated machines printing out plates of metal armor and interior hardware. Several other slaves make less-subtle gasps of awe, earning a harsh “Quiet down!” from the guard.
rows.translation: 你的目光很快落到海盗舰船下方广阔的制造设施。他们拥有处理舰船材料所需的一切；数十名技术人员与工程师穿梭在一排排庞大的半自动机器之间，机器正打印金属装甲板和内部设备。其他奴隶也发出惊叹，随即换来守卫严厉的一声“安静！”

They’ve got everything they need to process the materials for their vessels, with dozens of technicians and engineers maneuvering between the vast rows of semi-automated machines printing out plates of metal armor and interior hardware. rows.original: “Oh, well we’re amazing swimmers and half-decent fliers if I do say so myself. I’m a bit out of practice in the air, but I’m told I look more at home in the water than on the land. The wings are actually great for maneuverability - additional control surfaces, even if the extra drag will keep me from winning a race with any other aquatic species.” Azra wraps her wings around herself and happily strokes them. “They get in the way sometimes, but you can’t beat the freedom they offer - or the aesthetics. More than once I’ve seen a nun equate me with an angel.” She shakes her head disbelievingly. “It’s hard to let them down once they get so excited.”
rows.translation: “哦，要我自己说，我们是出色的游泳者，飞行能力也还算过得去。我在空中有些缺乏练习，不过别人都说，我在水里比在陆地上更自在。翅膀特别有助于转向，相当于额外的控制翼面，尽管附加阻力会让我无法在比赛中战胜其他水生种族。”阿兹拉用翅膀裹住自己，开心地抚摸起来。“它们有时会碍事，但那份自由无可比拟，外观也一样。我不止一次见过修女把我比作天使。”她难以置信地摇摇头。“她们一旦那么兴奋，就很难让她们失望。”

rows.raw: "\n\nIf you thought you had seen Azra blush before, the crimson hue suffusing her cheeks proves you haven’t, not really. She turns almost incandescent, her wings feathers visibly ruffling with shocked nervousness."

rows.original: “My presence here already imposes on you so much. A date would be too much,” she says. “Besides, we are strapped for time, are we not? If we delay too long, others will claim the juiciest research, and you will miss your chance for glory
rows.translation: “我在这里出现已经给你添了太多麻烦。再约个会就太过分了，”她说。“再说，我们时间很紧，不是吗？要是耽搁太久，最肥的研究就会被别人抢走，而你会错过扬名的机会
rows.raw: "\n\n“My presence here already imposes on you so much. A date would be too much,” she says. “Besides, we are strapped for time, are we not? If we delay too long, others will claim the juiciest research, and you will miss your chance for glory"

rows.original: and fame
rows.translation: 和名声

rows.original: . I will not let you miss a once in a lifetime opportunity, Captain [pc.name].” Azra nods like someone who has worked tirelessly to convince herself of a difficult but necessary truth. “But I’m open to dinner once we’ve both had time to settle down a bit, assuming you haven’t satisfied yourself on the fruits of the frontier.” She waggles her eyebrows all too knowingly.
rows.translation: 。我不会让你错过一生仅有一次的机会，[pc.name]船长。”阿兹拉点头，仿佛是个不辞辛劳、终于说服自己接受某个艰难却必要事实的人。“不过，等我们都稍微安顿下来，我愿意和你共进晚餐，前提是你还没有用边疆的果实满足自己。”她一脸心知肚明地挑动眉毛。
rows.raw: ". I will not let you miss a once in a lifetime opportunity, Captain [pc.name].” Azra nods like someone who has worked tirelessly to convince herself of a difficult but necessary truth. “But I’m open to dinner once we’ve both had time to settle down a bit, assuming you haven’t satisfied yourself on the fruits of the frontier.” She waggles her eyebrows all too knowingly."

rows.translation: 你结结巴巴地试图回答，却惹得阿兹拉放声大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sputter for a response, sending Azra into uproarious laughter."

rows.original: “Just because I’ve had kids doesn’t mean I’ve forgotten how kids are made. A young adventurer like yourself is bound to get into more than a few trysts, especially one bold enough to date a woman twice [pc.hisHer] age.”
rows.translation: “我生过孩子，不代表我就忘了孩子是怎么造出来的。像你这样的年轻冒险者，免不了会有不少风流韵事，尤其是一个胆子大到敢和年龄是[pc.hisHer]两倍的女人约会的家伙。”

rows.original: “I would adore the chance to share a meal with you, [pc.name], I assure you, but the frontier will not wait for us to spend all our time tied up in interpersonal dalliances,” she says. “Trust me when I say that what we have is beautiful. Instead of lounging in front of a adventure holo, we’re living one. Every time we go out into the wilds, we get to be the first UGC citizens to lay eyes on new species and curiosities.” Her tail swings up to wrap around your back, fins curling over your side affectionately. “When this is all over, you have my permission to take me wherever your heart fancies - within reason.” Her eyes twinkle knowingly. “No whorehouses.”
rows.translation: “我向你保证，[pc.name]，我很愿意和你共进一餐，不过边疆不会等我们把全部时间耗在人际风流韵事上，”她说道。“相信我，我们拥有的经历非常美好。我们没有躺着观看冒险全息剧，而是亲身活在其中。每次进入荒野，我们都有机会成为最先亲眼看见新物种和奇观的银河联合邦联公民。”她的尾巴扬起，缠住你的后背，尾鳍深情地卷过你身侧。“等这一切结束，你可以带我去任何心仪的地方，只要合理。”她的眼中闪着心照不宣的光。“妓院除外。”

Instead of lounging in front of a adventure holo, we’re living one. rows.original: “Awww man, but those are fuuuuun!”
rows.translation: “哎呀，可那些实在太好玩——了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww man, but those are fuuuuun!”"

rows.original: “A real shame, that.”
rows.translation: “真是遗憾。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A real shame, that.”"

rows.original: “I’d take you somewhere so much better than that.”
rows.translation: “我会带你去比那儿好得多的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d take you somewhere so much better than that.”"

rows.original: “No whorehouses. Gotcha. But just for the record, you didn’t say anything about sex arcades.”
rows.translation: “不去妓院，明白了。不过声明一下，你可没说不能去性爱游乐场。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No whorehouses. Gotcha. But just for the record, you didn’t say anything about sex arcades.”"

rows.translation: “我才不会带你去那种寒酸地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I’d take you anywhere that dumpy.”"

rows.original: A gentle ruffle fills the air as Azra laughs, wings shaking. “The whores would probably offer to pay you for sex, you know. Famous galaxy-explorers with statuesque suula maidens on their arm tend to cut a pretty dashing figure, if I do say so myself.” Azra leers at you for a moment before reining herself in. “I certainly think it’s a good look on you.”
rows.translation: 阿兹拉笑着，翅膀轻颤，空气里响起一阵轻柔的簌簌声。“你知道吗，那些妓女大概会倒过来付钱跟你做爱。有名的星系探险家，臂弯里挽着雕像般的苏拉少女，往往都显得相当英姿飒爽，要我说的话。”阿兹拉色眯眯地看了你一会儿，才收敛起来。“我确实觉得这挺适合你的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA gentle ruffle fills the air as Azra laughs, wings shaking. “The whores would probably offer to pay you for sex, you know. Famous galaxy-explorers with statuesque suula maidens on their arm tend to cut a pretty dashing figure, if I do say so myself.” Azra leers at you for a moment before reining herself in. “I certainly think it’s a good look on you.”"

rows.original: Straightening up, you give Azra your smokiest look. If she thinks you’re eye-candy, you’re going to be the best damned eye-candy she’s seen on this side of the Milky Way.
rows.translation: 你挺直身体，向阿兹拉投去最诱人的目光。既然她觉得你秀色可餐，那你就要成为她在银河系这一侧见过最美味的视觉享受。
rows.raw: "\n\nStraightening up, you give Azra your smokiest look. If she thinks you’re eye-candy, you’re going to be the best damned eye-candy she’s seen on this side of the Milky Way."

rows.original: “Ooh la la!” Azra trills, fanning herself. “You’re something else, but surely you’re interested in more than a date with your resident xenobiologist, however lovely she might be.” She pauses, eyes far away in thought. “You... don’t have to worry I’m going to dance out of your life with a random alien just because I’m a suula. I’m more of a one-person woman, and I’m more than old enough to know that isn’t likely to change. If that was what you were worried about.”
rows.translation: “哦啦啦！”阿兹拉颤声说着，给自己扇风。“你可真是与众不同，不过你感兴趣的肯定不只是跟你的常驻外星生物学家约个会吧，不管她有多可爱。”她停顿了一下，眼神飘向远处陷入思索。“你...不用担心我会因为自己是苏拉，就随便跟哪个外星人跳着舞离开你的生活。我更偏向专一的人，而且我这把年纪早就明白，这一点不太会改变。要是你担心的就是这个的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh la la!” Azra trills, fanning herself. “You’re something else, but surely you’re interested in more than a date with your resident xenobiologist, however lovely she might be.” She pauses, eyes far away in thought. “You... don’t have to worry I’m going to dance out of your life with a random alien just because I’m a suula. I’m more of a one-person woman, and I’m more than old enough to know that isn’t likely to change. If that was what you were worried about.”"

rows.translation: 阿兹拉听罢咧开大嘴，亮出森林般密集的匕首状象牙。“这大概是大多数非苏拉人最先问的问题。你忍了这么久才问，我得称赞你。”

rows.original: You shrug and explain that you just followed the conversation.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，解释说只是顺着对话跟下来而已。
rows.raw: "You shrug and explain that you just followed the conversation."

rows.original: “Well, suulas are a race with three sexes: males, females, and hermaphrodites. As you might imagine, a mix like that can make the dating scene pretty volatile. Not only are there boys and girls, there’s girl-boys in there with a little bit for everybody.” Azra speaks as if explaining a basic fact of life. You suppose, to her, it is. “So most of us wind up being at least a little bit bisexual, if not a lot, which almost invariably leads to having partners who can appeal to our varied interests. Boy meets girl meets dickgirl, or sometimes just boy meets a pair of very close twins.”
rows.translation: “嗯，苏拉是有三种性别的种族：男性、女性和雌雄同体。你可以想象，这样的组合会让约会圈相当不稳定。不光有男孩和女孩，中间还有女孩气的男孩，谁都能在里面找到点自己想要的。”阿兹拉说得像在解释一条基本的生活常识。你想，对她来说大概确实如此。“所以我们大多数人最后至少都有点双性恋，哪怕不是非常，这几乎不可避免地让我们拥有能满足各自不同口味的伴侣。男孩遇上女孩，再遇上扶她女孩，或者有时候就是男孩遇上一对非常亲密的双胞胎。”

rows.original: You point out that doesn’t really explain their penchant for polyamory, just bisexuality.
rows.translation: 你指出，这其实解释不了他们对多元恋的偏好，只解释了双性恋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou point out that doesn’t really explain their penchant for polyamory, just bisexuality."

rows.original: “Be patient. I’m explaining.” Azra boops you on the nose before continuing on. “The other part of it is that we’re quite good at sharing our feelings, especially romantic feelings. When we’re attracted to someone, we get really attracted to them. Most suula are so good at it that they’re capable of feeling that way about more than one person at a time. Don’t get your hopes up too high, though. I’m not nearly as good at it as my schoolmates were.” She shrugs. “When I found my stud, I didn’t do anything but bury him in love, 26 Valderean hours a day, 456 days a year. I think I would’ve been okay with him having someone else, but I only had eyes for him, while I had him.”
rows.translation: “耐心点，我正在解释。”阿兹拉轻点你的鼻尖，随后继续。“另一方面，我们很善于分享感受，尤其是浪漫情感。被某人吸引时，我们会真的深深迷上对方。大多数苏拉人非常擅长这件事，能够同时对不止一个人产生这种感情。不过别抱太大希望，我远不如同学们擅长。”她耸耸肩。“找到自己的种马之后，我什么都没做，只是用爱淹没他，每天二十六个瓦尔德里亚小时，每年四百五十六天。我想他若还有别人，我也能接受，但只要拥有他，我眼中就只有他。”

rows.translation: 那只有翅膀的鲨鱼女孩梦幻般地叹了口气。<i>“那是...

rows.original: Someday I’m going to let myself feel like that again.

rows.raw: "Someday I’m going to let myself feel like that again."

rows.original: You ask her how they keep from getting jealous.
rows.translation: 你问她，她们是怎么做到不嫉妒的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how they keep from getting jealous."

rows.original: “We’re just wired differently than terrans and ausar I guess. Culture may play into it as well. To a suula, love and intimacy are these amazing, wonderful things that are meant to be shared. Why wouldn’t you want someone you love to feel even more of it? Terrans can be so greedy, wanting to keep the love all to themselves.” Azra sighs. “If your boyfriend or girlfriend has true affection for you, another lover isn’t going to stop them from caring about you. It isn’t a finite resource to be hoarded. It’s as limitless as the light from a star.” She pauses, then looks you dead in the eye. “And don’t even get into the mathematical energy output of the sun. I was being metaphorical.”
rows.translation: “我想，我们的天性就是与泰伦人和奥萨尔不同。文化也可能参与其中。对苏拉而言，爱与亲密是美妙绝伦、理应分享的事。你为何不愿让心爱之人感受更多？泰伦人有时太贪婪，想把爱全部据为己有。”阿兹拉叹息。“如果你的男友或女友真心爱你，另一个爱人不会阻止他们关心你。爱不是需要囤积的有限资源，它像星光一样无穷无尽。”她停顿一下，直视你的双眼。“也别跟我讨论太阳输出能量的数学计算。我只是在打比方。”

rows.translation: “我倒更想看一群灵能者争论爱蕴含多少能量，然后我们可以赌谁会赢。”
rows.raw: "“I’d be more interested in watching a bunch of psionics argue over the energy content of love. Then we could bet on a winner.”"

rows.translation: 阿兹拉淡淡一笑。“你对我的文化如此感兴趣，这对我意义重大。你还有其他问题，还是我们该继续冒险了？”

rows.original: Are you religious?

rows.original: Azra shakes her head slowly. “Not anymore. I was when I was younger. Went to the Church of the One every two weeks alongside my mother and sire.” She pauses, remembering. “The religion came to our planet when we were uplifted, along with the stained glass, sermons, and hymns. It was the last part that most appealed to my people. Any opportunity to gather a crowd of us together and raise our voices in uplifting song was bound to be successful. Even someone like me, who can’t hold a tune to save her life, could lose herself in the shared masses.”
rows.translation: 阿兹拉缓缓摇头。“现在不信了。年轻时信过，我每两周都会和母亲、血亲一起去唯一神教会。”她停下来回忆。“我们的种族得到启蒙时，宗教随彩绘玻璃、布道和圣歌一同来到星球。最吸引族人的是最后一项。只要有机会把一群苏拉聚起来，齐声唱响振奋人心的歌曲，就必然会获得成功。即使像我这样完全不会唱歌的人，也能沉浸在众人的合唱中。”

And prune juice tastes nasty. Now, do you have anything to ask me that isn’t about how I’m twice your age?”
rows.translation: “哎呀，年轻人就是没耐心，”鲨鱼女夸张地呻吟道。“非要知道的话，按泰伦标准年算，我今年47岁，才刚进入巅峰期。”她屈起手臂鼓了鼓二头肌。“我从没像现在这么强壮，脑子也照样灵光，所以别想着给我点杯西梅汁，再把我丢到退休星球去。”阿兹拉俏皮地朝你晃了晃手指。“我可不吃这一套。再说西梅汁难喝死了。好了，你有没有什么想问我的，只要别问我怎么年纪是你的两倍？”

rows.original: Azra says, “For starters, it’s not what most would consider a job. I don’t have a boss. I don’t clock in anywhere or hang around a watercooler talking about the latest gravball match. It sounds pretty great, I’m sure.”
rows.translation: 阿兹拉说道：“首先，它不是多数人理解的那种工作。我没有老板，不必去任何地方打卡，也不会在饮水机旁闲聊最新的重力球赛。听起来肯定很棒。”

rows.original: “But I’m my own boss. That means I have to make myself do my work without any external pressure. I have to get up every morning and force myself to sit down and peel apart genomes instead of catching the latest episode of The Youthful and Sleepless. If I slack off, I hurt myself and have no one else to blame. Not that different from being a captain out on the Rush, I imagine.” Azra nods to you. “Not everybody can do it.”
rows.translation: “但我就是自己的老板。这意味着没有任何外部压力时，我也必须迫使自己工作。每天早上，我都得起床，强迫自己坐下来拆解基因组，而不是追看《青春不眠》的最新一集。如果偷懒，受害的是我自己，也不能责怪别人。我想，这与在行星开拓潮中担任船长没有太大区别。”阿兹拉朝你点头。“不是人人都做得到。”

rows.original: You agree but ask her if she can give you more specifics, more details on the exact kind of work she does.
rows.translation: 你表示同意，但问她能不能说得更具体些，多讲讲她究竟做的是哪种工作。

rows.original: “Oh, well I used to work at home, buying exotic plant samples to study in hopes of finding valuable mutations, enzymes, and the like. People will sell you almost anything on the extranet if you know where to look.” Azra gestures to her codex. “I’d spend most of my day hunched at my workstation, pouring over holoscreens filled with genetic data and computer simulations trying to unravel the secrets of alien life. It’s almost as much art as science, puzzling out the relevant genes and how to best recode the sequence for use in other plants or animals. The latter part is usually done by the scientists at Xenogen, JoyCo, or another biotech firm, but I dabble.”
rows.translation: “哦，我以前在家工作，购买异星植物样本进行研究，希望发现有价值的突变、酶之类的东西。只要知道去哪里找，人们什么都肯在星网上卖给你。”阿兹拉指了指她的资料库。“我每天大部分时间都趴在工作台前，钻研满是遗传数据和计算机模拟的全息屏幕，试图解开外星生命的奥秘。要找出相关基因，并弄清楚怎样重新编码序列，才能用于其他植物或动物，这几乎既是艺术也是科学。后半部分通常由异源生物科技、欢乐公司或其他生物科技公司的科学家完成，不过我也会自己尝试。”

It’s almost as much art as science, puzzling out the relevant genes and how to best recode the sequence for use in other plants or animals. The latter part is usually done by the scientists at Xenogen, JoyCo, or another biotech firm, but I dabble.”"

rows.original: “How do you get paid?”
rows.translation: “你靠什么赚钱？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How do you get paid?”"

rows.original: Azra idly spins her pointer finger in a circle. “I have contacts at most of the major firms ever since college. I take my research, and pitch a watered down version of my findings, then see who will pay me the most for it. JoyCo tends to try to lowball me most of the time, but they’ll always offer something. Xenogen’ll typically pay the best, but they’re picky about what they’ll take. I imagine they try to match my findings to a project in development, and if there isn’t one, back off.”
rows.translation: 阿兹拉漫不经心地用食指画着圈。“自从大学毕业后，我在大多数大型企业里都有熟人。我会拿着自己的研究成果，向他们介绍一版有所保留的发现，然后看看谁愿意出最高价。欢乐公司通常总想压我的价，不过多少都会开出点条件。异源生物科技一般给得最好，但他们对收什么很挑剔。我猜他们会把我的发现与正在开发的项目进行匹配，要是没有合适的项目，就会退出。”

Xenogen’ll typically pay the best, but they’re picky about what they’ll take. I imagine they try to match my findings to a project in development, and if there isn’t one, back off.”"

Sure,

rows.original: She lets out an enormous sigh. “Okay, well the biggest one is a plant-derived elasticizing agent... and lubricant.” Her blush deepens to a sunset crimson. “It comes from a carnivorous plant that used it to aid in consumption of larger prey... which makes it ideal for helping partners of vastly mismatched sizes make... things... fit.” She shrugs. “It’s everywhere nowadays. I’m told it’s particularly popular with laquines and leithans, especially those with terran lovers. The terran vaginal canal is renowned for its lack of flexibility.” She forces a cough. “It uh... goes by Peggy’s Elasticizing Oil nowadays. I didn’t get to pick the name, or the branding. I just... uh... figured out the genetics and the use for it.”
rows.translation: 她长长地叹了口气。“好吧，其中最了不起的是一种植物提取的弹性增强剂...以及润滑剂。”她脸上的红晕加深成日落般的绯红。“它来自一种食肉植物，那种植物用它来帮助吞食体型更大的猎物...所以它非常适合帮助体型差距悬殊的伴侣让...那些部位...顺利契合。”她耸了耸肩。“现在到处都能见到它。听说它尤其受拉奎因和莱坦人欢迎，特别是那些有泰伦伴侣的人。泰伦人的阴道以缺乏延展性闻名。”她勉强咳了一声。“呃...如今它叫佩姬弹性润滑油。名字和品牌都不是我选的。我只是...呃...找出了相关遗传机制和用途。”

rows.original: Azra stammers for a second, then stops, straightening her back and collecting herself. When she resumes speaking, it is with poise and a small smile. “We’re all sexual creatures here, Captain [pc.name]. You, me... and most of the galactic populace. Even the galotians, creatures which merely divide, have come to enjoy sensuous acts. I have no more reason to be ashamed of my lewder discoveries than the universe does for giving birth to protein feeders in the first place. There are whole phylums of plants designed entirely around exploiting the reproductive instincts, behaviors, and fluids of animals.” Her blush returns. “I for one find such behaviors... fascinating.”
rows.translation: 阿兹拉结巴了片刻，随即停下，挺直腰背，让自己镇定下来。再次开口时，她举止从容，脸上带着淡淡的微笑。“我们在这里都是有性生物，[pc.name]船长。你、我...以及银河系里的大多数居民。就连只靠分裂繁殖的加洛提安人，也学会了享受感官欢愉。我没有理由为自己那些更淫荡的发现感到羞耻，就像宇宙不必为最初孕育出蛋白质摄食者而羞耻一样。有整整几个门类的植物，完全围绕着利用动物的繁殖本能、行为和体液而演化。”她的脸又红了。“就我个人而言，我觉得这种行为...非常迷人。”

rows.original: A staticky voice reverberates out of the ceiling, “Heyyyy! Since you cunts broke my door, I think I’m gonna have to break you. No hard feelings!” Three recessed turrets swivel out of the wall in front of you, each armed with a different type of gun. At a glance, you guess there’s a machine-gun, a flamethrower, and some kind of ray-gun.
rows.translation: 夹杂静电噪声的嗓音从天花板上回荡：“嘿——！既然你们这些贱货弄坏了我的门，我想我只好也把你们弄坏。别往心里去！”三座嵌入式炮塔从前方墙壁中转出，各自装备不同枪械。粗略一看，你猜它们分别是机枪、火焰喷射器和某种射线枪。

rows.original: A familiar voice broadcasts from the ceiling, “Heyyyy! You guys are pretty smart for off-worlders, rewiring the door like that.” It pitches into a husky whisper. “How about a test? Mmmm... don’t die, ‘kay?”

rows.original: You nod to Azra and circle closer to the village, distancing yourself to give her some cover before you emerge. Dessicated flowers crackle under your [pc.feet] as you close in, and the infested zil sultrily spins about. He’s handsome, for a zil, his armor plates fully retracted to expose as much of his svelte form as possible.
rows.translation: 你朝阿兹拉点点头，绕得更靠近村子，在与她拉开距离方便自己现身之前先给她一些掩护。你逼近时，干枯的花在你[pc.feet]下噼啪作响，那只被虫寄生的兹尔风骚地转过身来。以兹尔的标准来说他很英俊，甲片完全收起，尽可能多地露出他那修长的身形。

Dessicated flowers crackle under your [pc.feet] as you close in, and the infested zil sultrily spins about. He’s handsome, for a zil, his armor plates fully retracted to expose as much of his svelte form as possible."

rows.original: “Need some rel-hey hey hey! Whoa!” He steps back, tail slipping off his dick to join its sisters in waving behind in him alarm. “You trespass upon our grounds! This is a violation of the Behrt accord!” He starts to raise his hand to his mouth.
rows.translation: “需要我帮你缓——嘿嘿嘿！哇哦！”他后退一步，尾巴从鸡巴上滑开，加入姐妹们的行列，在身后惊恐挥舞。“你们闯入了我们的领地！这是对贝尔特协议的违反！”他开始把手抬向嘴边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Need some rel-hey hey hey! Whoa!” He steps back, tail slipping off his dick to join its sisters in waving behind in him alarm. “You trespass upon our grounds! This is a violation of the Behrt accord!” He starts to raise his hand to his mouth."

rows.raw: "attack"

rows.original: “Oh, you’re too much of a wimp to take on one single off-worlder? Did gluing all of those pussies on your ass turn you into one too?”
rows.translation: “哦，你连一个外星人都对付不了，也太怂了吧？把那么多逼粘到屁股上，是不是把你也变成逼了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you’re too much of a wimp to take on one single off-worlder? Did gluing all of those pussies on your ass turn you into one too?”"

rows.original: He slowly lowers his hand. His face settles into a scowl. “When I’m done with you, you’ll wish I had summoned my village.” A stun-gun slips into his hand from somewhere. “And when your spirit is broken, you can house more of my pets. Yes...”
rows.translation: 他缓缓放下手，脸色沉成怒容。“等我收拾完你，你会希望我当初把整个村子召来了。”一把电击枪不知从哪里滑进他手中。“等你的意志被摧毁，还能容纳更多我的宠物。没错...”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe slowly lowers his hand. His face settles into a scowl. “When I’m done with you, you’ll wish I had summoned my village.” A stun-gun slips into his hand from somewhere. “And when your spirit is broken, you can house more of my pets. Yes...”"

rows.original: While the angrily buzzing alien closes in on you, Azra circles to the other side of the clearing to approach a particularly vibrant flower specimen. You’d better win, for both sakes.
rows.translation: 那只怒气冲冲嗡嗡作响的外星生物逼近你时，阿兹拉绕到空地另一边，去接近一株格外鲜艳的花。为了你们俩，你最好赢。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the angrily buzzing alien closes in on you, Azra circles to the other side of the clearing to approach a particularly vibrant flower specimen. You’d better win, for both sakes."

rows.original: jungle
rows.raw: "jungle"

rows.original: “Fuck your accords. Now that I’ve found your village, I’m going to bring an army back with me to torch it!” You turn tail and sprint for the jungle edge.
rows.translation: “去你的协议。既然我找到了你们的村子，我就要带一支军队回来把它烧成灰！”你转身就跑，朝丛林边缘狂奔。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck your accords. Now that I’ve found your village, I’m going to bring an army back with me to torch it!” You turn tail and sprint for the jungle edge."

rows.original: “No!” screams the zil, moments before he takes the bait. His chitinous feet thump heavily through the flower patch as he chases you into the woods.
rows.translation: “不！”吉尔尖叫道，片刻后便中了圈套。他追着你冲进树林，几丁质双脚沉重踏过花圃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” screams the zil, moments before he takes the bait. His chitinous feet thump heavily through the flower patch as he chases you into the woods."

rows.original: He’s fast. Faster than you could’ve imagined with all the extra weight on his ass. He doesn’t quite fly, but his fluttering wings give him the extra edge to run you down before you get very far. You make one last attempt to zig and zag between two moss-covered trees, but he’s more maneuverable by far and shoulder checks you before you can round the second one.
rows.translation: 他很快。屁股上背着那么多额外重量，速度仍快得超乎想象。他不算真正飞行，但扑动翅膀带来的优势足以在你跑远前追上。你最后一次尝试在两棵覆满苔藓的树间左右变向，但他的机动性强得多，在你绕过第二棵树前便用肩膀把你撞翻。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s fast. Faster than you could’ve imagined with all the extra weight on his ass. He doesn’t quite fly, but his fluttering wings give him the extra edge to run you down before you get very far. You make one last attempt to zig and zag between two moss-covered trees, but he’s more maneuverable by far and shoulder checks you before you can round the second one."

rows.original: You tumble through enough dead leaves and dirt to make you look like a long-dead tree when you stagger up to your [pc.feet]. The snake-infested zil is brandishing a stun gun and blocking your escape, but at least you’re far enough from the village that he can’t call for help.
rows.translation: 你从足够多的枯叶与泥土中翻滚而过，踉跄站上[pc.feet]时，看起来像棵死了很久的树。这个被蛇寄生的吉尔挥舞着电击枪，挡住你的退路；不过至少你离村庄够远，他无法呼叫援助。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tumble through enough dead leaves and dirt to make you look like a long-dead tree when you stagger up to your [pc.feet]. The snake-infested zil is brandishing a stun gun and blocking your escape, but at least you’re far enough from the village that he can’t call for help."

rows.original: You’ll have to fight him to buy Azra time.
rows.translation: 你得和他打一场，为阿兹拉争取时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll have to fight him to buy Azra time."

rows.original: He’s fast. In the open, he closes most of the distance, aided by the fluttering of his wings. You make it into the forest before his chitinous claws can latch onto you. With the trees in abundance, you use their bulk to deny him his advantage in raw speed by rapidly changing direction, forcing him spring between them to keep up. Still, he remains hot on your heels, the incessant buzzing of his wings a constant reminder that the angry alien could catch you at any moment.
rows.translation: 他很快。在开阔地带，借助不断扑动的翅膀，他迅速拉近大部分距离。你赶在几丁质利爪抓住自己前进入森林。借助大量树木，你迅速改变方向，利用粗壮树干抵消他的纯粹速度优势，迫使他在树间弹跳追赶。尽管如此，他仍紧跟在你身后；翅膀持续不断的嗡鸣时刻提醒你，愤怒的异星人随时可能追上。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s fast. In the open, he closes most of the distance, aided by the fluttering of his wings. You make it into the forest before his chitinous claws can latch onto you. With the trees in abundance, you use their bulk to deny him his advantage in raw speed by rapidly changing direction, forcing him spring between them to keep up. Still, he remains hot on your heels, the incessant buzzing of his wings a constant reminder that the angry alien could catch you at any moment."

rows.original: From that terror comes adrenalin, and with adrenalin comes speed. You double your evasive tactics, springing from tree to tree. When that doesn’t work, you slide under low vines and duck into denser foliage where his wings will count for nothing. There, you finally have the advantage. His footfalls sound farther and farther away as you plunge deeper and deeper into the dense jungle.
rows.translation: 恐惧催生肾上腺素，肾上腺素又带来速度。你把闪避的动作加倍，在树与树之间弹跳。见那样不管用，你又从低垂的藤蔓下滑过，钻进更茂密的枝叶里，在那里他的翅膀毫无用处。在那里，你终于占了上风。随着你越来越深地钻进密林，他的脚步声听起来越来越远。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom that terror comes adrenalin, and with adrenalin comes speed. You double your evasive tactics, springing from tree to tree. When that doesn’t work, you slide under low vines and duck into denser foliage where his wings will count for nothing. There, you finally have the advantage. His footfalls sound farther and farther away as you plunge deeper and deeper into the dense jungle."

rows.original: A few minutes later, you’re relatively sure you’ve lost him. You double back around, using your Codex to keep from getting lost. You jump at every buzzing insect that flies by, but the infested zil is well and truly behind you.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你比较确信已经甩掉他了。你绕了回去，用CODEX终端避免迷路。每有嗡嗡飞过的虫子你都吓一跳，不过那座虫害肆虐的兹尔确实已经被你远远甩在身后。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few minutes later, you’re relatively sure you’ve lost him. You double back around, using your Codex to keep from getting lost. You jump at every buzzing insect that flies by, but the infested zil is well and truly behind you."

rows.original: You emerge from the woods to find Azra in the middle of packing away a brightly colored flower.
rows.translation: 你从树林里出来，发现阿兹拉正在把一朵色彩鲜艳的花收起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou emerge from the woods to find Azra in the middle of packing away a brightly colored flower."

rows.original: “[pc.name]! I was so worried he was going to catch you,” Azra says, scaled tail wagging behind her. “Let’s get out of here before he comes back.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]！我真担心他会抓住你，”阿兹拉说道，覆鳞尾巴在身后摇摆。“趁他还没回来，我们离开这里吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]! I was so worried he was going to catch you,” Azra says, scaled tail wagging behind her. “Let’s get out of here before he comes back.”"

rows.original: You give her an affirmative nod and leave for Mhen’ga. On your way back, you wonder if the zil will figure out that it was all a ruse. Probably not. He didn’t seem like the type to miss one flower.
rows.translation: 你肯定地点头，动身返回门加。回程路上，你思考那个吉尔是否会发现一切只是骗局。大概不会。他看起来不像会想念一朵花的类型。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her an affirmative nod and leave for Mhen’ga. On your way back, you wonder if the zil will figure out that it was all a ruse. Probably not. He didn’t seem like the type to miss one flower."

rows.translation: “呃....”你绞尽脑汁寻找说辞。“嗯...呃...啊。我真该提前想好这个。
rows.raw: " “Uh....” You rack your brain for something to say. “Well... uh... Huh. I really should have thought about this in advance."
