rows.original: Instead of calling for help, the zil slaps his palm into his face, chitin clacking noisily. Behind him, the tails hungrily slide against one another, and when his fingers fall away, he’s smiling devilishly. “You’re too stupid to be a threat to us.” He steps closer. “And if I take you down myself, I can keep you as my toy. You could be a good host, tend to my brothers while I rest, so many of my children nesting on you. Yes...” He pulls out a stun gun. Where did he get that?
rows.translation: 兹尔没有呼救，反而一巴掌拍在脸上，甲壳发出响亮碰撞声。身后的尾巴饥渴地相互滑擦；等他放下手指时，脸上已浮现邪恶笑容。“你蠢得根本威胁不到我们。”他走近一步。“而且如果亲手打倒你，我就能留下你当玩具。你可以成为优秀宿主，在我休息时照料兄弟们，让我的众多孩子在你身上筑巢。没错...”他掏出一把电击枪。那是从哪儿弄来的？
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead of calling for help, the zil slaps his palm into his face, chitin clacking noisily. Behind him, the tails hungrily slide against one another, and when his fingers fall away, he’s smiling devilishly. “You’re too stupid to be a threat to us.” He steps closer. “And if I take you down myself, I can keep you as my toy. You could be a good host, tend to my brothers while I rest, so many of my children nesting on you. Yes...” He pulls out a stun gun. Where did he get that?"

rows.original: Azra made good use of your distraction to approach the flower patch from the other side, and she gestures for you to keep stalling as she nods next to a particularly vibrant specimen.
rows.translation: 阿兹拉很好地利用了你制造的干扰，从另一边靠近花丛，她示意你继续拖延，同时朝一株格外鲜艳的花点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nAzra made good use of your distraction to approach the flower patch from the other side, and she gestures for you to keep stalling as she nods next to a particularly vibrant specimen."

rows.original: You’ll have to fight!
rows.translation: 你必须战斗！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll have to fight!"

rows.original: “I had to get a closer look at you. I’ve never seen anyone quite like you before.” You gesture at him, waving your hand at his tails. “What you have done with those snakes... it’s incredible. How did you get so many? I thought they limited themselves to one to a host?”
rows.translation: “我必须走近点看看你。我以前从没见过你这样的人。”你朝他比划，挥手指向他的尾巴。“你对那些蛇所做的事情...真不可思议。你怎么弄到这么多？我还以为每名宿主只能寄生一只？”
rows.raw: " “I had to get a closer look at you. I’ve never seen anyone quite like you before.” You gesture at him, waving your hand at his tails. “What you have done with those snakes... it’s incredible. How did you get so many? I thought they limited themselves to one to a host?”"

rows.original: The zil leans back, eyes wide. “You... approve?” His antennae twitch, and his expression twists into a sly smile. “I suppose even a skyling can see the beauty in this.” One slavering cunt-snake slurps its way back down his dick while he talks, lending his voice a small hitch of pleasure. “I can feel more pleasure than any creature in the jungles. Only the predator pitchers are my equals, barely. And I can give my tribe relief. My entire tribe, with just me.”
rows.translation: 那只兹尔往后一靠，眼睛睁大了。“你... 认可？” 他的触角抽动了一下，表情扭成一个狡黠的笑。“我想，就算是个天上来客也能看出这里面的美。” 他说话时，一条流着口水的阴穴蛇咕噜一声顺着他的鸡巴爬了回去，让他的声音带上了一丝快感的顿挫。“我能感到的快感比丛林里任何生物都多。只有那些捕食猪笼草能与我相比，也就勉强而已。而且我能给我的部族带来解脱。整个部族，只靠我一个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zil leans back, eyes wide. “You... approve?” His antennae twitch, and his expression twists into a sly smile. “I suppose even a skyling can see the beauty in this.” One slavering cunt-snake slurps its way back down his dick while he talks, lending his voice a small hitch of pleasure. “I can feel more pleasure than any creature in the jungles. Only the predator pitchers are my equals, barely. And I can give my tribe relief. My entire tribe, with just me.”"

rows.original: Now that he’s talking to you, the words spill out of the infested zil. He goes on to describe just how he’s gotten so many snakes attached to himself. Apparently the secret is to hand-raise the offspring, then entice themselves to attach alongside their mother. It can be a trying process, but one that results in the most amazing orgasms ever.
rows.translation: 既然开始与你交谈，这名被寄生的兹尔便滔滔不绝。他继续描述自己如何让这么多蛇附在身上。显然，秘诀是亲手抚养后代，再诱使它们与母亲一同附着。过程可能相当艰难，但能带来最不可思议的高潮。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that he’s talking to you, the words spill out of the infested zil. He goes on to describe just how he’s gotten so many snakes attached to himself. Apparently the secret is to hand-raise the offspring, then entice themselves to attach alongside their mother. It can be a trying process, but one that results in the most amazing orgasms ever."

rows.original: You feign interest. It isn’t hard; his bragging is packed full of information on the parasites that wouldn’t show up in any extranet article.
rows.translation: 你假装很感兴趣。这并不难；他的吹嘘里塞满了各种关于那些寄生虫的信息，那些东西任何外联网文章里都不会写。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feign interest. It isn’t hard; his bragging is packed full of information on the parasites that wouldn’t show up in any extranet article."

rows.original: Meanwhile, Azra has finished extracting the plant. She slips the containment vessel into her pack, flashes you a thumbs up, then fades into the foliage. For a big girl, she’s surprisingly good at hiding.
rows.translation: 与此同时，阿兹拉已经完成植物提取。她把密封容器塞进背包，朝你竖起拇指，随后隐入枝叶。以她的体型而言，藏身本领出奇地好。
rows.raw: "\n\nMeanwhile, Azra has finished extracting the plant. She slips the containment vessel into her pack, flashes you a thumbs up, then fades into the foliage. For a big girl, she’s surprisingly good at hiding."

rows.original: “Perhaps you should come to the village, starling. We could have-”
rows.translation: “也许你该来村里，小椋鸟。我们可以-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps you should come to the village, starling. We could have-”"

rows.original: “No thanks,” you interject, giving him a friendly wave. “I just remembered I left my ship idling. Have fun!”

rows.original: The pink-colored mushrooms, so-called ‘slutshrooms’ have taken to captivity with gusto. Azra has them growing in a bed of iron-enriched soil, kept moist by a steady stream of mist from a climate simulation unit. A holographic display at the base of the planter reads, “Scortum Duonus.” Azra wasted no time in naming her discoveries. Further notes expound that preliminary tests reveal them to be non-toxic, if unpredictable.
rows.translation: 粉色蘑菇，也就是所谓的“淫荡菇”，热情适应了圈养生活。阿兹拉把它们种在富含铁质的土床里，由气候模拟装置持续喷出水雾保持湿润。种植槽底部的全息显示写着“Scortum Duonus。”阿兹拉毫不耽搁地为自己的发现命名。进一步注释说明，初步测试显示它们无毒，但效果难以预测。

rows.original: The motherhusks have taken to captivity with gusto. Already, a two foot spire of segmented growth has emerged from a bed of rust-red soil intermixed with silvery aluminium filings. A hardlight terrarium keeps the floating spores safely contained, so as not to contaminate the lab - or Azra’s ovaries. The sharky scientist has placed a small display at the base that reads “Matar Factorum.” Further notes explain that you are free to harvest the smaller spires surrounding the main growth. Simply press a button on the right side to reduce the strength of the hardlight shield to a fist-permeable level.

rows.original: The lofty xenobiologist sees your bedroom eyes on her crotch, sees your [pc.hand] drift toward her loins. Those first, soft trembles of eagerness move through her like a swarm of pixies. In this heart-racing closeness, she squirms, giving tacit approval to everything that you’re doing. “I think... you’ve been ignoring yourself...” you muse aloud, watching her lips plush. “Why don’t I see to that? It’s a captain’s job to look after the crew with [pc.hisHer] life.” You flash a coquettish smile[pc.faceHasFangs| that shows a bit of fang]. If suula had a few chameleon genes, Azra’s scales would change colors right now. “Haha,” the big, motherly angel laughs, her expression an attractive mix of coy and demure. “That’s okay, [pc.name]... erm...” Feathery wings shuffle as she steals a few looks at the entrance to her quarters, then at you, considering tons of variables. “...R-Right here? What did you have in mind?” There it is. The sultriest of grins spreads over her sharky snout. No longer is she making a show of considering this, but you’ve got her hooked! A delicate hand imbued with a lifetime of empathy and encouragement strokes over your [pc.hairNoun], accentuating that silky, maternal expression. Fuck, she’s so cute when she’s like this. “Devious [pc.boyGirl], seducing a woman right in her lab... mhmhm. What if a hacker looked in on the camfeeds?! Maybe even a peacekeeper wondering what we’re up to! How would that make you feel, captain? It wouldn’t do to have anyone gossiping about your character... or mine.” “That’s fine,” you answer, dropping to your [pc.knees] and moving quickly under her large workbench, [pc.eyes] level with her melon-sized bulge. “They won’t see me.” Azra stumbles a little bit at your probing, a phenomenon of palpable force that makes even you shudder.

rows.original: Azra is quick to nod, but motions dismissively as she speaks, “Yes, but it’s more of a formality than a necessity. rows.original: “Okay, let me just connect, and... wow these scanners are next level. No wonder you bring this thing everywhere.” She chews her bottom lip softly while she types, muttering something about, “excessive security validations,” and “bureaucratic nonsense,” before finally flipping it around to show you the screen. Six paragraphs in a font so small you can barely read them precede a much larger declaration. “THE FOLLOWING PARTIES DO HEREIN DECLARE TO ENTER INTO A LIFETIME STUD BONDSHIP IN PERPETUITY, AS LONG AS BOTH CONTINUE TO DRAW BREATH.” One side lists your full legal name, [pc.fullName], and a “Stud” designation. The other displays Azra Lutashai. Below each is a box designated for a confirmation thumb-print. Diminutive text further specifies that unique patterned limbs are not a pre-requisite. Pressure will trigger a full-body biological scan. Azra’s thumb rests heavily upon her confirmation box, and with a gentle whir, the Codex finishes scanning her, placing a confirmation check alongside her digit. She looks up at you, eyes moist with emotion, pupils blown out by love and sincerity. She almost whimpers when she suggests, “Your turn.” The once light device feels as heavy as a brick as it’s passed back into your hand, weighted down by the significance of what you’re about to do. You lean up for kiss one more time, and as you’re losing yourself in Azra’s love once more, your thumb presses down firmly on the confirmation box. You don’t even notice the tingles of a high-energy, full-body bio-scan, but you do notice how Azra grabs you by the [pc.hips] and holds you tightly, like she never wants to let you go again. On the screen, nearly forgotten, is a brilliant green pop-up displaying “CONGRATULATIONS!” beneath a blizzard of virtual confetti. Neither of you pays it much mind. You set it down so you can focus on the kiss. Azra fiddles with her

There’s only one place where they have a healthy pink glow: on the edge of the village.

rows.original: Quickly rising to your feet, you turn to look at the svelte, pale-skinned newcomer, who seems to be a nyrea, as evidenced by the quill-like hair, ink-black eyes and the chitinous plates covering their limbs. The alien has a lithe, lightly-toned build clad in a skimpy gladiatorial armor made from dark leather and chain links. On their back, an old but well-maintained rifle. The nyrea’s face is androgynous, leaning slightly toward the feminine. There are hints of masculinity here and there, such as the slender lips, but all it does is give them a cutesy look that ruins their attempt to look pissed-off. He may be the least feminine of them, but he’d be easily called a femboy on the Extranet, especially with a cute face like that. No-one on the civilized side of the U.G.C. would bat an eyelash if he switched to feminine pronouns. “Well, that’s because most of us are kept behind locked doors, or sometimes even in chains,” he explains. “Not the most pleasant of fates, if you ask me.” Azra gives him a sympathetic smile. “It’s a good thing you managed to escape, then.” “So that you could stare at my chest?” the male teases with a smirk. “Not that I blame you for being bewitched by this elegant physique,” he adds, running a hand over his slender chest and smooth midsection. “Oh! My apologies, I didn’t realize I was staring,” Azra says, momentarily disconcerted. If you were to guess, you’d say the nyrea is just assuming things, but she has decided to roll with it for the sake of diplomacy. She continues: “Please forgive my curiosity, it’s just that I’ve read that nyrea tend to have generous breasts, but your physique is on the more masculine side by galactic standards.”

rows.original: “Looks like we have a winner,” you declare half-smugly. “I hope you’re satisfied.” “Oh yes, very! Thank you for taking the time to indulge me, it gets so boring down here.” “And my reward?” you ask. “Oh, I did promise to throw in a little something, didn’t I?” The nyrea gets up and starts to rummage through a chest hidden behind some rocks. “Ah, here it is!” He takes out a small piece of illegal-looking tech and presents it to you. “I got this the other day from another star-traveler, but I don’t have any use for it. Hopefully it will serve you well.”
rows.translation: “看来胜者已经诞生了，”你半是得意地宣布。“希望你满意。” “哦，是的，非常满意！谢谢你愿意花时间陪我玩，下面实在太无聊了。” “那我的奖励呢？”你问。 “哦，我确实答应加点小彩头，对吧？”尼瑞亚人站起来，开始翻找藏在几块岩石后的箱子。“啊，在这里！”他取出一小块看起来不太合法的科技装置，递给你。“前几天从另一个星际旅行者那里拿到的，但我用不上。希望它能为你好好效力。”
rows.raw: "“Looks like we have a winner,” you declare half-smugly. “I hope you’re satisfied.” “Oh yes, very! Thank you for taking the time to indulge me, it gets so boring down here.” “And my reward?” you ask. “Oh, I did promise to throw in a little something, didn’t I?” The nyrea gets up and starts to rummage through a chest hidden behind some rocks. “Ah, here it is!” He takes out a small piece of illegal-looking tech and presents it to you. “I got this the other day from another star-traveler, but I don’t have any use for it. Hopefully it will serve you well.”"

rows.original: You give the cocky male a teasing[pc.mfn| grin| smile| smile]. “You were saying?” The nyrea returns your expression in kind. “I guess we’ll have to go for a third game to determine a winner.”
rows.translation: 你给了这个自大的雄性一个挑逗的[pc.mfn| grin| smile| smile]。“你刚才说什么？” 那个尼瑞亚人以同样的表情回敬你。“看来我们得再来第三局才能分出胜负了。”
rows.raw: "You give the cocky male a teasing[pc.mfn| grin| smile| smile]. “You were saying?”\n\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\tThe nyrea returns your expression in kind. “I guess we’ll have to go for a third game to determine a winner.”"

rows.raw: "“I guess I’m taking this one,” you tease.\n\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t“Such arrogance,” the nyrea says, but there’s no bite in his voice. “We’re just getting started, honey.”"

rows.original: “Is everything in order?” you ask. “Yes. The mineral profile is not very different from what’s found in most U.G.C. planets’ caves, so we should be able to recreate it without much difficulty, but I got a few more substrate samples, just in case,” the scientist says.
rows.translation: “一切都妥当了吗？”你问。 “是的。矿物组成与大多数银河联合邦联星球洞穴中发现的并没有太大区别，所以重现它应该不难；不过为防万一，我又采集了一些基质样本，”科学家说道。

rows.original:
The moment you make to reach for your [pc.weapon], the nyrea reacts with lightning speed, grabbing a grenade from his belt and hurling it in your general direction while he dashes the opposite way.

rows.original: Clearing your throat, you ask: “Would you be open to an offer?” The myr queen narrows her eyes, scrutinizing you from head to toe. “I’m listening; you have one chance,” she says at length. The scientist looks at you with fear in her violet eyes. These rogues are probably just trying to intimidate you with all the talk of abducting Azra, but you can’t rule out the possibility that they might be serious. If they get their hands on her, she might be turned into a venom addict, all of her vast intellect wasted as they drag her around like a mere sex slave. A ‘trench wife’, as the red myr like to call it. Come to think of it, the queen seems to be the one calling the shots here; what gives? With how red venom works, the gold ought to have become submissive, but instead the red is the one that looks almost demure towards the gold. Well, no time to puzzle it out when the red still has a finger curled around the trigger of her net thrower, ready to fire at the slightest hint of defiance, and the gold’s four hands hover close to the thick whip on her belt and the shield on her back. A wrong move here could be dangerous

rows.original: going to shoulder this cost on your own — your pride as a Steele would accept no less. Besides, “this is a small price to pay for the advancement of science,” you say with a wink. The suula smiles warmly, her eyes shining with newfound admiration. With a few taps on your Codex, you transfer the credits to an anonymous chit, which you then hand to the queen with a diplomatic smile on your face. She briefly checks the amount on her own device before smiling back. “A pleasure doing business with you, offworlder. If only all Rushers were as forthcoming as you...” You scoff. “Not everyone can pull that much money out of their back end, you know.” The queen laughs darkly. “I suppose you’re right.” You and Azra keep your hands close to your weapons just in case, but the ant-girls prove true to their word. Not only do they grant you safe passage, they also escort you as close as possible to the main cave system before breaking off. Thanks to their navigation, travel time is cut in half, and you manage to avoid any further encounters. It’s a small benefit next to the exorbitant amount you had to pay, but isn’t that what being rich is all about? Having the ability to make problems disappear by throwing disproportionate amounts of money at them? Your father, light-years away, is probably scolding you from the grave right now, but that doesn’t change the fact that you’ve avoided a dangerous confrontation; one that might have had consequences not just for you, but Azra as well. With a clear conscience and lighter pockets, you and the scientist make your way back...

rows.original: You fix the gold myr with a hard stare and ask her what happened to her pride as a queen. Shouldn’t she be helping her fellow golds repopulate? You’re sure she would receive a warm welcome in Gildenmere, and her authority as queen should be more than enough for her to keep a red myr servant by her side. She rolls her eyes. “Do you think I’ve never thought of that? Reality is not so simple, kid. Gosh, you speak just like my former queen, and I don’t mean that as a compliment. She’s dead, by the way, betrayed by the very people who once supported her. You must have been born with a diamond honey bottle in your mouth to spout that kind of naíve nonsense.” Making a conscious effort to ignore the sting of her bemused words, you turn to the red and try to appeal to her pride as a member of the federation. Is she really okay with hiding in shame and resorting to banditry? What would her fellow soldiers say if they- “I NEVER ASKED TO BE CONSCRIPTED, OKAY?” the red cuts you short, her hands clenching into fists and her pretty face contorting into a visage of unfiltered bitterness. “All I wanted was to live life as a farmer with my family, and now... NOW THEY’RE ALL DEAD! A-all because of this STUPID WAR!!” The girl’s body trembles visibly, and tears stream out of her eyes as she grits her teeth, trying to regain her composure.

rows.original: The gold doesn’t seem to have a ranged weapon, so she’s not an immediate threat; the red one is the problem. Judging from her steady aim and unflinching stance, you’d wager she has a lot of military experience — if you want to seize the initiative, you’ll have to disrupt her focus for a second. “You’re[pc.isBimbo|, like,] making a big mistake,” you state[pc.isBimbo| with a casual, almost detached calm, like a teen chewing bubblegum| with calm and confidence]. The queen raises an eyebrow, her lips curled into a mocking smirk. “Oh? Please enlighten us, wise star traveler.” You smirk back. “I[pc.isBimbo|‘m, like,| just happen to be] the heir of SteeleTech. My[pc.isNude| friend’s][pc.isBimbo| super-duper-high-tech] gear has already filmed your faces and recorded everything that’s been said so far.” Azra gives you a quizzical look, to which you reply with a subtle wink. Thankfully, the myr aren’t close enough to catch this exchange with their species’ relatively poor eyesight. You continue: “All I have to do is give a voice command, and all of this will be sent back to headquarters, making you two a public enemy of one of the largest megacorps in the universe.” The red scoffs. “Good try, but we’re no strangers to living life on the run. What can a mere company do on a planet they barely even know?” You scoff back. “You think you’ve already got it bad with your forbidden love? Bad news[pc.isBimbo|, hon,|:] the scale is[pc.isBimbo|, like,] totally different from anything you Rush bumpkins can imagine. Megacorps NEVER forget a grudge; SteeleTech will stop at nothing to eliminate you; we’ll buy the whole fucking planet if we have to. And if we can’t, we’ll do everything in our power to make your lives miserable. These caves will be swarming with mercenaries hired to bring you back, dead or alive. Now, try to imagine being hunted like animals, forced to run and hide every single day of your lives, having to take turns sleeping to avoid getting ambushed... You’ll never have peace!” Despite the queen’s attempt to retain her cynical attitude, you can see the tension in her face and the tight grip on her whip; she’s not sure if you’re bluffing or not, but she’s ready for a fight either way. The red, however, is very much affected: her face turns a paler shade, lips trembling as she eats your words like poison — no doubt your colorful description has evoked memories of her time in service. From what you’ve heard, the Scarlet Federation is not so different in how it deals with grudges, which makes your subterfuge all the more believable to the ex-soldier. “Y-you think[pc.mfn| he’s| she’s| they’re] telling the truth?” she asks, turning to the gold for guidance. At this point, it’s clear you won’t be able to avoid a fight, since the gold didn’t fully buy your words, but you can use the red’s hesitation to your advantage. The moment her eyes aren’t on you anymore, you jump to one side[pc.hasWeapon| while quickly drawing your weapon,] and Azra jumps to the other. The red swivels immediately and fires her net thrower, but she’s a second too late, and the net lands harmlessly on the spot where the suula used to be. “Damn it!” the ant-girl says, already reloading her gun. The gold queen sneers at your deception, effective though it was, and draws her set of shield & whip, cracking the latter on the ground with a sharp, terrifying sound that echoes loudly throughout the cave. “Very well! If it’s a fight you want, a fight you’ll have!”

rows.original: As interesting as all this might be, you’re sure it’s better to keep it a secret — there’s no telling what the Scarlet Federation would do if this knowledge was made public. So, instead of commenting on the political repercussions, you regard the gold myr with skepticism. “Let me get this straight... you shook off the addiction and grew more powerful than your captor but still decided to stay with her? Are you[pc.isAss| fucking stupid| kidding me]?!” The red looks away, shame and guilt written all over her face, but Clea smiles tenderly. “Love works in mysterious ways. Living with Bo for as long as I had, I could see her for who she truly was, and the choice was mine to make in the end. I don’t regret it.” Your gaze falls on the red. “So, what’s your side of the story?” Boshra hesitates for a moment, biting her lower lip once again while crossing her chitin-clad arms under her breasts. You doubt she realizes how tantalizing she looks when she’s being bashful like that. “It’s nothing out of the ordinary; I’m just another deserter. Me and my family were normal farmers, until we were conscripted. They died halfway through the war; I’m the last one alive. When I realized I was doing to others the same thing that happened to my family, I- I just couldn’t stay in the army anymore.” She grows more agitated as she speaks, her body quivering with a whirlwind of barely repressed emotions. “I hate this stupid war... I wish I could kill all the bitches who thought this was a good idea. Most of them never had to fight for a single day in their rotten lives!” By that point, Boshra is grinding her teeth, her nails digging into her sides hard enough to draw blood. Thankfully, Cleantha steps in to placate her, putting an arm around the red’s shoulder. “Shhh... it’s all in the past now. Here, have a drink to calm yourself,” she offers, cupping one of her lower tits. Boshra accepts the offer without question, wrapping her plump lips around Cleantha’s large nipple and suckling on it for a long moment.

The golds adopt it officially and hail the anonymous researcher as a hero. You find it uncharacteristic of Azra to do something with such far-reaching and potentially dangerous consequences. When you ask her about it, the reply is: “You may be right, but this issue has become personal to me. I believe people should have the right to choose, like we had.” This puts you in an introspective mood. Looking back on your choices, you could say you probably made the right ones. Some doors were closed, others opened — such is life. “Serious talk aside, what do you say we go have some fun with the girls?” you ask with a lascivious smirk. Azra giggles. “Well, I guess I’m due for another break...”

rows.original: Once you’re both out of the shower and have taken a moment to settle back in, you meet Azra in her office and watch as she moves the samples from their containers to a provisory environment, though she admits she’ll have to build custom enclosures for them soon, so that she can propagate the species without risk of contamination. Curious, you ask what she plans to do when the Rush is over. “Hmm,” the suula muses, distracted as she measures each sample. “Short term? I would return home to my lovely daughters who were kind enough to watch over the house while we’ve been gallavanting around the stars. I’d love to hear Jell’s latest vocal performance in person and see Kryz’s new project. She’s been keeping me in suspense about it, telling me that if I want to find out what she’s up to, I’ll have to come home and see with my own eyes. Twerp.” She smiles wistfully. “After that? The samples we’ve collected on this Rush should keep me busy for a decade. New biologies mean new compounds, new adaptations, and new breakthroughs to better the universe - and new deposits in my retirement account, not that I’d ever tire of picking apart the mysteries of life itself!” Tail swishing happily, the big shark-woman flashes her razor teeth in a broad smile. “I couldn’t have done it without you, [pc.name]. This Rush? The expeditions we’ve done? They’re not just progress for the galaxy, they’re financial independence for my family. They’re going to fund a whole new lab with new-gen AIs - the new models from KihaCorp

rows.original: I’m thankful for the offer, but I’m not cut out to manage others. Just thinking about it gives me a headache, to be honest.” Well, she doesn’t have to lead, she could- Azra stops you in your tracks by closing her eyes and shaking her head. “Sorry, I’m not giving up my independence. I want to focus on projects that catch my interest, not have someone tell me what to do. No matter how much freedom you tried to give me, I would still be tied down by the responsibilities of working for a company and having other people depend on my work, which might not always align with corporate needs.” You ponder her words for a moment, then let out a resigned sigh. At the end of the day, she’s right: joining a company would mean giving up some of her freedom, and that’s precisely why she has been working as an independent researcher all this time. Come think of it, you feel like she’s told you this before, though not in those exact words. “Alright, I [pc.isAss|guess|understand; sorry if I made you uncomfortable. rows.original:
Well, the display says it’s safe to inhale for thirty seconds, so why not give it a try? Time to shed some pounds for science!

		The air coming from the gas mask smells strangely... pristine, for lack of a better word. You half-expected a moldy odor, but instead it feels even cleaner than the filtered air of your ship. It reminds you of that time your father took you to visit a resort recreating the Alps from Earth, before most of the planet got ruined by overdevelopment. A sort of ‘invigorating coolness’ spreads through your body with each inhalation, until the timer beeps to tell you thirty seconds have passed. That felt more like ten...

		If the information on the display is accurate, fat reduction should take place over a period of six days, so now all you have to do is wait.
rows.translation:
好吧，显示屏说安全吸入时间是三十秒，那为什么不试试呢？是时候为了科学减掉几磅了！

		防毒面具中吹出的空气闻起来异乎寻常地……纯净，只能这么形容。你原以为会闻到霉味，实际却比船上过滤后的空气还清新。它令你想起父亲曾带你参观一座重现地球阿尔卑斯山的度假村，那时地球大部分地区还没有被过度开发毁掉。每吸一口气，某种“提神的凉意”便扩散到全身，直至计时器发出蜂鸣，告诉你三十秒已经过去。感觉更像只有十秒……

		若显示的信息准确，减脂过程会持续六天，所以现在只需等待。
rows.raw:
"Well, the display says it’s safe to inhale for thirty seconds, so why not give it a try? Time to shed some pounds for science!

		The air coming from the gas mask smells strangely... pristine, for lack of a better word. You half-expected a moldy odor, but instead it feels even cleaner than the filtered air of your ship. It reminds you of that time your father took you to visit a resort recreating the Alps from Earth, before most of the planet got ruined by overdevelopment. A sort of ‘invigorating coolness’ spreads through your body with each inhalation, until the timer beeps to tell you thirty seconds have passed. That felt more like ten...

		If the information on the display is accurate, fat reduction should take place over a period of six days, so now all you have to do is wait."

So easy to poop out!” There has always been a certain undercurrent to your relationship with Dizzy, and it’s when she does shit like this that it becomes impossible to ignore. You’re fucking your mom. You sink a little further beneath the sheets, the weight of Oedipus himself on your chest. “Aww, don’t be like that sweetheart!” Really not helping. “If I manage to wear you out that means I’m doing a good job both out here...” She waves her spatula in the direction of the kitchen. “...and in here. That’s the most satisfying feeling in the world to have. Why don’t you have a shower and get dressed? I’ll have something nice for my [pc.mf|big hungry|hungry little] captain by the time [pc.he]’s up.” You extract yourself from your kaithrit cook’s bed, casting your eye out for your clothes, and... yes, of course. It’s all neatly folded waiting for you on the dresser. Put those on, and pretend you’re a grown [pc.mf|man|woman] again. ]

rows.original: You say you’re after some advice. “Of course, sweetpea.” [diz.name] rubs your hand. “With the life you lead, I’m surprised your head doesn’t burst open most evenings!” [diz.atShip |Just the sound of the kettle being turned on and the bubbling of water is kind of relaxing. |She leads you into the staff canteen and turns the kettle on. Just the sound of bubbling water is kind of relaxing. ] “Now. How much closer are you to discovering your daddy’s next probe? [randCrew anno mitzi eitan sera ardia azra kase shekka |How’s Anno doing? |Has that poor gabilani castaway been getting herself all over you again? |I hope that big furry bruta Eitan hasn’t been throwing his weight around again. |Has Sera been getting up to her mischief again? |That Ardia certainly is a good eater, isn’t she? |How have you been getting on with Azra? |How’s that kaithrit boy of yours doing? I hope you’re disciplining him, kaithrits boys need plenty of discipline. |How’s Shekka doing? She’s so adorable! ]” The plump kaithrit uses details of your last conversation to coax you out, surprising details you remember only mentioning in passing. But yeah, they do warrant expanding on, don’t they? Who else asks you about this stuff? You’ve long since stopped feeling awkward about using Dizzy as your anxiety dump. She’s a very good listener, and once she pierces the dam of your mind with some kind but seeking questions a flood of troubles come pouring out. She encourages and affirms actions that you lay out in front of her; she leads you away from other matters you wanted to discuss, and later you realize she was gently discouraging you from other actions you were considering taking. Inner parts of you relax; your throat starts to ache. Smoky Roshan tea helps. “How are we feeling?” she smiles, squeezing you into a squishy hug. “Better? Good. You’ve got a lot on your plate, but you’ve also got a good head on your shoulders. You’ve just got to remember how to use it, sometimes.” She giggles raspily and releases you. “Now. Were you after anything else, sugarsnap?”
rows.translation: 你说自己想听听她的建议。 “当然可以，小甜豆。”[diz.name]揉了揉你的手。“过着你这样的生活，我都惊讶你的脑袋怎么没有每天晚上炸开！” [diz.atShip |光是听见水壶打开、水开始沸腾的声音，就让人有些放松。 |她领你走进员工餐厅，打开水壶。光是听见水沸腾的声音，就让人有些放松。 ] “那么。离找到你爸爸的下一个探针又近了多少？[randCrew anno mitzi eitan sera ardia azra kase shekka |安诺最近怎么样？ |那个可怜的加比拉尼遇难者是不是又在你身上到处乱蹭了？ |希望伊坦那个毛茸茸的大块头没有再仗着体型欺负人。 |塞拉是不是又在四处捣蛋了？ |阿迪亚的胃口确实很好，是不是？ |你和阿兹拉相处得怎么样？ |你家的那个凯斯里特男孩怎么样了？希望你有好好管教他，凯斯里特男孩可是需要大量管教的。 |谢卡最近怎么样？她太可爱了！ ]” 这名丰满的凯斯里特人利用你们上次谈话中的细节诱导你敞开心扉，其中某些细节详细得令人惊讶，你只记得自己当时随口提过。不过没错，那些事情确实值得深入说说，不是吗？还有谁会询问你这些事呢？ 你早已不再因把迪兹当成倾倒焦虑的对象而感到尴尬。她很擅长倾听，一旦她用一些温柔却直指要害的问题刺穿你思绪的堤坝，种种烦恼便会如洪水般倾泻而出。对于你摆在她面前的行动，她会予以鼓励和肯定；对于其他本想讨论的事情，她则会将你引开，而你后来才意识到，她是在温和地劝你放弃其他正在考虑的行动。你内心深处的某些部分放松下来，喉咙也开始隐隐作痛。烟熏罗珊茶对此颇有帮助。 “我们感觉怎么样？”她微笑着，将你搂进柔软的怀抱。“好些了吗？很好。你肩上的担子很重，但脑袋也很灵光。只是有时候，你得记得该怎么用它。” 她沙哑地咯咯笑着，松开了你。 “那么，你还想要些什么吗，小甜豆？”

rows.original: “What was I like when I was young?” A ghost of a smile appears on her round face, and she turns slightly in her chair to present the wide, form-dominating swell of her bosom to you. “Why, am I not good-looking enough for you now, cuddlebum? Did you want Dizzy when she could leap through parties and turn every head in the room? When her smile was fresh and she could touch her heels by bending over backwards?” [pc.nmh |“I’ve got Bizzy for that,” you grin, ogling her generous curves. “You’re good as you are.” |“Mmm, well maybe,” you grin, ogling her generous curves. “What I’m seeing now is a hell of a consolation prize.” |“Mmm, well maybe,” you grin, ogling her generous curves. “What I’m seeing now is a hell of a consolation prize.” ] Dizzy’s smile fades as her mind turns back. There’s a faint buzzing sound from the back of her head, and her expression grows calmer. “I guess I was pretty similar to you, sweetpea,” she says. “All I wanted when I was growing up was to get out into the galaxy and have as much fun as I possibly could. Except I didn’t come from anything special. My parents more or less kicked me out when I hit adulthood. So when things got... serious... I didn’t have anywhere to turn. No big space station nursery for Dizzy to put her kits in, and go back to bumming around the funnest parts of space.” She doesn’t say it with much bitterness; just a vague, misty sadness. “I could’ve dumped Zeddy with one of the corporations, you can do that if you’re from Rosha and a few other kaithrit colonies. But I remembered what it felt like to be unwanted. I never wanted a kit of mine to feel that way,” she says, tigerishness suddenly breaking through the misty melancholy. “So I settled on Gaerys, where they were advertising for workers. Not fun work, not high-paying work, but steady work, which is what you need when you’re raising one on your own.” “How did Lizzy and Bizzy come about?” you ask. She laughs awkwardly and sighs, twiddling a claw on the tabletop. “Dizzy was still pretty silly back then, honeybuns. But when someone as well paid as a Pyrite dock manager takes you as his girl, well, you start to dream, don’t you? Maybe life won’t always be as hard and dirty as it is on a hydro planet. And so maybe you ignore the warning signs, and what your friends are telling you, because that dream is too good to wake up from. I went into work one morning belly over my waistband with Bizzy and he was just... gone. I found out later his term on Gaerys had finished. He’d never intended sticking around, even after getting me pregnant twice.” She twists her needle claw back and forth on the table for a while. “You have to be very careful who you put your faith in, blossom,” she says with that sad, vague smile. “That’s why I — never really believed you, about Bizzy, at first. Most folks just say anything to get what they want out of you. That’s how the galaxy teaches them to act.”
rows.translation: “我年轻时是什么样？”她圆润的脸上浮现一丝若有若无的微笑，身体在椅子上微微转动，将占据整副身形的宽阔饱满胸脯展示给你。“怎么，抱抱宝贝，我现在不够好看了吗？你想要的是那个能在派对间轻盈穿梭、让房间里所有人回头的迪兹？那个笑容还很清新，向后弯腰就能摸到脚跟的迪兹？” [pc.nmh |“那种事有比兹就够了，”你咧嘴笑着，目光贪婪地扫过她丰满的曲线。“你现在这样就很好。” |“嗯，也许吧，”你咧嘴笑着，目光贪婪地扫过她丰满的曲线。“不过眼前的景象也算是极佳的安慰奖。” |“嗯，也许吧，”你咧嘴笑着，目光贪婪地扫过她丰满的曲线。“不过眼前的景象也算是极佳的安慰奖。” ] 迪兹的笑容逐渐消失，思绪回到过去。她脑后传来轻微的嗡鸣声，神情也变得平静。 “我想，那时的我跟你很像，小甜心，”她说道。“成长过程中，我唯一想要的，就是闯进银河，尽可能玩个痛快。可我的出身并不特别。成年后，父母差不多就把我赶出了家门。所以等事情变得...严肃起来...我根本无处可去。没有一座大型太空站的育儿所能让迪兹寄放幼崽，再回到太空中最好玩的地方四处闲逛。” 她说这些话时并没有多少怨恨，只有一丝朦胧而遥远的悲伤。 “我本可以把泽迪送给某家公司。来自罗莎和另外几个凯斯里特殖民地的人都可以这么做。但我还记得自己不被需要是什么感觉。我绝不希望自己的孩子也有这种感受。”她说道，朦胧忧郁中透出母虎般的强硬。“所以我在盖里斯定居下来，那里当时正招工。工作既不好玩，薪水也不高，但胜在稳定，而独自抚养孩子最需要的就是稳定。” “那莉兹和比兹又是怎么来的？”你问道。她尴尬地笑了笑，叹息着，用一根爪尖在桌面上来回划弄。 “那时的迪兹还很傻，甜心宝贝。可当一个薪水丰厚的黄铁矿码头经理把你当作他的女人，你难免会开始做梦，对吧？也许生活不会永远像在水世界上那样艰难肮脏。于是你可能会无视那些警告信号，无视朋友们的话，因为那个梦实在太美好，让人不愿醒来。有一天早上，我挺着怀比兹的大肚子去上班，他却已经...走了。后来我才知道，他在盖里斯的任期已经结束。哪怕让我怀孕两次，他也从没打算留下。” 她用针状爪尖在桌面上来回划了好一阵。 “你必须非常小心，别轻易相信别人，小花，”她带着那种悲伤而恍惚的微笑说道。“所以，一开始我从未真正相信你所说的比兹。大多数人为了从你身上得到想要的东西，什么话都说得出口。银河就是这样教会他们行事的。”

Except I didn’t come from anything special. My parents more or less kicked me out when I hit adulthood. So when things got... serious... I didn’t have anywhere to turn. No big space station nursery for Dizzy to put her kits in, and go back to bumming around the funnest parts of space.” She doesn’t say it with much bitterness; just a vague, misty sadness. “I could’ve dumped Zeddy with one of the corporations, you can do that if you’re from Rosha and a few other kaithrit colonies. But I remembered what it felt like to be unwanted. I never wanted a kit of mine to feel that way,” she says, tigerishness suddenly breaking through the misty melancholy. “So I settled on Gaerys, where they were advertising for workers. Not fun work, not high-paying work, but steady work, which is what you need when you’re raising one on your own.” “How did Lizzy and Bizzy come about?” you ask. She laughs awkwardly and sighs, twiddling a claw on the tabletop. “Dizzy was still pretty silly back then, honeybuns. But when someone as well paid as a Pyrite dock manager takes you as his girl, well, you start to dream, don’t you? Maybe life won’t always be as hard and dirty as it is on a hydro planet. And so maybe you ignore the warning signs, and what your friends are telling you, because that dream is too good to wake up from. I went into work one morning belly over my waistband with Bizzy and he was just... gone. I found out later his term on Gaerys had finished. He’d never intended sticking around, even after getting me pregnant twice.” She twists her needle claw back and forth on the table for a while. “You have to be very careful who you put your faith in, blossom,” she says with that sad, vague smile. “That’s why I — never really believed you, about Bizzy, at first. Most folks just say anything to get what they want out of you. That’s how the galaxy teaches them to act.” "

rows.original: Her life
rows.raw: "Her life"

rows.original: “Oh, little Bezeneria. What a sweet thing she was when she was young. Never squawled like Zed did, never climbed onto the top of the shelves and sulked like Lizzy did.” Dizzy’s smile is wide and nostalgic. “She believed and did anything her big brother and sister said to her. I had to stop her jumping into a turbine intake once because Lizzy told her to. My word did Lizzy catch a spanking that time. I used to take her out to the river delta, where the marshlands are, and I think that’s where she was at her happiest, chasing around with her net and toy camera. When the mists rose you got so many rainbows...” “What was she like when she got older?” “Ants in her pants. They all did.” Dizzy laughs raspily, then sighs. “Who wouldn’t? Gaerys is no place for a young person, unless they’re looking to disappear. Zed enlisted with the Confederate navy as soon as he was old enough and Lizzy, top marks in her class, got a good starter position with Pyrite. She wanted to track down her dad. Bezeneria though... she always had her head in the clouds. All those posters of extranet stars and celebrities, doing photo shoots of all her friends... she didn’t understand you don’t get to live that kind of life if you start where she did. And there’s so many people out there waiting to take what little you have for thinking that you can.” She chuckles a little again. “She didn’t even have... you know.” She makes round gestures in front of her. “The bigger you are as a female kaithrit, the more attractive. She wouldn’t even be able to make it as a gold digger, or a model. I worried about her so much.[var0| Not exactly a problem anymore!” She laughs a little, then sighs. “I think it became a bit of a thing for her, you know, about not being big. So as soon as she could she went in the complete opposite direction.[var1| I do hope she’ll reconsider and get them reduced, once her career’s progressed a bit.]]” “But you paid for her AV degree anyway.” “Yes, I did. With the bit of money I had saved, and the — loan. Carver type companies have partners on every dead-end world like Gaerys, they know they’re full of poor suckers. I knew what it meant.” Her jaw is firm, but her tone is pleading. “But you’d do the same thing, wouldn’t you? I — my life was over by then, who cares what happens to this fat old bagpuss, but I could at least give my girl her dream. Just once, I wanted her to catch the rainbow.” The smile that appears on her face now is so poignant it’s almost painful to look at. “And she did. Maybe not in the way I imagined, but it never works out quite the way you think, does it? The bit of silly young Dizzy that set it all in motion — she wasn’t wrong to hope. You did all that, [pc.name], you made it real. You’re my angel.”
rows.translation: “哦，小贝泽妮莉娅。她小时候真是个甜心。她从不像泽德那样号啕大哭，也不像莉兹那样爬到架子顶上生闷气。”迪兹露出开怀而怀念的笑容。“哥哥姐姐让她做什么、让她相信什么，她都会照做。有一次，莉兹叫她跳进涡轮进气口，我不得不拦住她。天哪，那次莉兹可挨了一顿屁股。我以前常带她去河流三角洲，去那片湿地。我想，她拿着网和玩具相机到处追逐的时候最快乐。雾气升起时，能看到那么多彩虹...” “她长大后是什么样？” “一刻都闲不住。他们几个都这样。”迪兹沙哑地笑了笑，随后叹息一声。“谁又能不这样？盖里斯不适合年轻人，除非他们想就此消失。泽德一到年龄就加入了邦联海军；莉兹则以全班最高分毕业，在黄铁矿工业找到了一份不错的入门职位。她想找到自己的父亲。可贝泽妮莉娅... 她总是满脑子幻想。墙上贴满了外联网明星与名流的海报，还给所有朋友拍写真... 她不明白，从她那样的起点出发，根本过不上那种生活。而外面有太多人等着利用你这种想法，把你仅有的一切也夺走。” 她又轻轻笑了一声。 “她甚至都没有... 你知道的。”她在身前比画出圆润的形状。“雌性凯斯里特的身材越大，就越有吸引力。她连拜金女或模特都做不成。我那时实在太担心她了。[var0|不过现在倒完全不是问题了！” 她轻笑一声，随后叹了口气。 “我想，身材不够丰满这件事成了她的一个心结。所以她一有能力，就彻底走向了另一个极端。[var1|我真希望等事业有所发展后，她会重新考虑，把它们缩小一些。]]” “但你还是替她支付了视听专业的学费。” “对，我付了。用我攒下的那点钱，还有那笔——贷款。卡弗之流的公司在盖里斯这种没有出路的世界都有合作方，他们知道那里尽是穷困而好骗的人。我明白这意味着什么。”她绷紧下颌，语气却近乎恳求。“但你也会做同样的事，对不对？我——我的人生那时已经结束了，谁会在乎这个又老又胖的猫娘会落得什么下场？但至少我能把梦想交给女儿。哪怕只有一次，我也想让她抓住那道彩虹。” 此刻浮现在她脸上的微笑无比凄美，几乎令人不忍直视。 “而她做到了。也许不是我想象中的方式，但事情从来不会完全按设想发展，对吧？当初推动这一切的那个年轻愚蠢的迪兹——她抱有希望并没有错。是你成就了这一切，[pc.name]，是你让梦想成真。你是我的天使。”

rows.original: Bizzy
rows.raw: "Bizzy"

rows.original: “So Carver indentured you after you couldn’t pay back the loan?” you say. “What was that like?” “I knew what was going to happen sweetpea, it wasn’t much of a shock.” Dizzy tucks a strand of white hair behind a triangular ear and smiles wryly. “I’d already done plenty of this type of work by then. Making the credits to raise three kids on your own isn’t a joke. It was the reason they were happy to take me on, despite my age. They put me in one of their orbital casinos, and honestly dear it was just a relief to get off Gaerys. There’s only so many shades of gray you can take.” “And I knew what I had to do.” She taps the table for emphasis. “Make friends with the other girls and boys who still have their minds, they’re the only ones who are going to look out for you. Endear yourself to the clients, so you become a favorite. Say no to the pleasure patches and stims, as tempting as they are. I got on fine, to begin with anyway. Really, the actual job — I liked it.” She shrugs her shoulders and smiles. “It’s more fun than being a space docker, let me tell you! I bring a little joy into people’s lives, there’s nothing wrong with that is there?” “To begin with?” you ask gingerly. “Well... even if you’re disciplined and a good earner, once a company like Carver’s have you, they keep you.” Twiddle twiddle, goes the claw on the table. “You gotta take boob-firming mods, or we’re transferring you to one of the really sleazy places. You gotta take anti-agathics, otherwise we’ll be knocking your price way down. The cost of those mods go on top of what you’re already paying back, with interest. You never leave, not until you’re completely used up or ready to be put into a fluid farm. I knew all that when I went to them, as I said. It was worth it, cherryblossom. [var0|You’re a parent, you understand right?|You’d know if you were a parent.]” “I did fight pretty hard not to be sent out to Dhaal, though.” Just a trace of harsh bitterness in the pearly melancholy. “Paragon don’t allow indentured to communicate off-world, they don’t even want where they’re being sent to be known. And — talking with Bizzy from time to time was so important to me. But Carver wanted some of her best assets with Paragon to stake her claim there, ones that she thought could bring back clientele again and again, and how much do you think she cares that the asset in question didn’t like it?” The rubenesque kaithrit stares down at the table for a few moments, then shakes off all those bad memories with an enjoyably jiggly shrug of her shoulders. “That’s all in the past now, honeybuns. I was lucky; I met you. My angel.”
rows.translation: “所以，你还不起贷款后，卡弗就让你签下契约服役？”你说道。“那是什么感觉？” “我知道会发生什么，小甜豆，所以并没有多震惊。”迪兹把一缕白发别到三角耳后，苦笑起来。“那时我已经做过很多这类工作。独自赚钱养大三个孩子可不是闹着玩的。尽管我年纪不小，他们仍乐意收下我，原因就在这里。他们把我安排进一座轨道赌场。老实说，亲爱的，能离开盖里斯本身就让我松了口气。一个人能忍受的灰暗色调终究有限。” “而且我知道自己该做什么。”她敲了敲桌面以示强调。“和那些还保有心智的姑娘与男孩交朋友，他们才是唯一会照应你的人。讨客人喜欢，好让自己成为宠儿。快乐贴片与兴奋剂再诱人也要拒绝。最初我过得还不错。说真的，那份工作本身——我挺喜欢。”她耸耸肩，露出微笑。“这可比当太空码头工有趣多了，我跟你说！我给人们的生活带来一点快乐，这没什么不对，是吧？” “最初？”你小心翼翼地问。 “嗯... 即使你守规矩又会赚钱，一旦落进卡弗这种公司的手里，他们就会一直攥着你。”桌上的爪尖来回划弄。“你必须接受坚挺乳房的改造，否则我们就把你调去真正肮脏的场所。你必须使用抗衰老药，否则我们就大幅压低你的价码。这些改造的费用会连本带利地叠加到原有欠款上。你永远别想离开，除非被彻底榨干，或者已经可以送进体液农场。我说过，去找他们时，我就知道这一切。这是值得的，小樱桃。[var0|你也是父母，应该能够理解，对吧？|如果你当过父母，自然就会明白。]” “不过，为了不被送去达尔，我确实拼命抗争过。”珍珠般朦胧的哀伤中，透出一丝尖锐的苦涩。“典范公司不许契约奴与外星联系，甚至不愿让外界知道他们被送到哪里。而且——偶尔和比兹聊聊对我实在太重要了。可卡弗想把手中最好的几项资产送给典范，好在那里占下一席之地；她要的是那些能让客人一次次回来的资产。你觉得她会在乎那项资产本人乐不乐意吗？” 这个身材丰腴如画中美人的凯斯里特低头盯着桌面片刻，随后用一次令人赏心悦目的、颤巍巍的耸肩甩掉所有糟糕回忆。 “如今那些都过去了，甜心宝贝。我很幸运，遇见了你。我的天使。”

rows.original: Paragon
rows.raw: "Paragon"

rows.original: “Tell me about your mods,” you say. “Did Paragon give you all of them?” “No, Carver gave me a couple, back before she subcontracted me.” She cups the vast, dumpling-like swells of her breasts, lifts them up a bit, lets them fall. Though tides of plump flesh ripple mesmerically across them, they retain a perkiness that suggests silicone. But they are entirely real, a joy to sink your hand into. “Aren’t they nice?” she beams. “Memmory Gland is heaven-sent for older girls like me. And I was given a round of anti-agathics, so I will look like this for a good twenty years yet.” “Carver prefers gene mods... and Paragon prefers synthetics I guess,” you supply, gazing down at her tails. She brings the two dark gray appendages snaking upwards, deftly twirls their smooth heft around each other into a helix. “They’re cutting edge apparently. Supposed to show off how skillful and sexy their implants can be. I do miss my old tails sometimes, but the fluff can be so annoying to comb and these are a lot of fun, I have to admit. I can get up to all sorts with them.” You reach out and, when she doesn’t pull them away, stroke one of them, reaching your grip around its warm, smooth heft, observing the pleasure in the kaithrit’s emerald’s eyes and the scratchy purr which starts up in the back of her throat. “And the... sticks?” you say, turning your gaze up to her head. The two four inch long synthetic twigs crossed together beneath her hair bun appear to be a decorative tie at first glance, but up close you can see they’re actually fused to her scalp[diz.tuggedAntenna| ...or if you happen to give them a good tug in the heat of things.] “They’re, um... antenna, sugarsnap. Connected to my brain. They do a few things.” She laughs self-consciously, shifting in her seat. “They identified the species of my clients right away and downloaded dietary information, so I was never in danger of poisoning anyone. [diz.atShip|I just look at someone and woosh, my head’s just filled with food suggestions and warnings! Still very useful now I’m working here[crewRange 2|, you have so many different crew!]|[diz.atNursery|Now I use it to access teacher aids for different species. I just think about my lesson plans for today and whoosh, it’s all there! It’s so useful[var0|, particularly since you have so many kinds of children here].]] They’re also, um... sensitive. More so than my tails. Paragon love giving their employees extra erogenous zones I guess, they certainly do a good job keeping ol’ Dizzy’s engine turning over.” She twirls her hair embarrassedly, looking you over in a slightly hungrier fashion. “Do they do anything else?” you ask.[flags.DIZZY_TALK_PARAGON| “You once said something about them keeping you sedate. Do they still do that?”] “They... make the bad feelings go away,” she says at last. She gathers her formidable self up and suddenly frowns at you furiously. There’s a familiar buzzing sound, and the frown melts away into placidity. “I used to get very sad when I... thought about things, and sometimes very angry. Now, when I feel emotions building up inside me, I feel the hum, and then they dissipate. I can still remember everything, but it’s like a... sea, great and gray, instead of a geyser, rising up.” “Would you like to get rid of it?” you ask.[flags.MET_DR_LESSAU| “Steele Tech does have a leading modifications doctor on Uveto...”] “I’ve thought about it.” She twiddles her claw across the table surface. “I would’ve done anything to get Paragon out of my head, once. But now I’m free of them... I don’t mind it so much. If it really was controlling how I feel I wouldn’t hate them and Carver, would I? And it is useful. Wherever I’m working it seems to calibrate to what I’m doing, so it always gives me the basic information I need without me having to search around the extranet manually. That’s pretty great to have, I can’t deny.” “You also like having them played with,” you grin. “Admit it.” “You stop that. Naughty [pc.boy].” She’s smiling though, a little bit of color in her cheeks. “You like them, clearly. And that’s the main reason they’re staying.”
rows.translation: “跟我说说你身上的改造吧，”你说道。“它们全都是典范公司给你装的吗？” “不是，在把我的契约转包出去以前，卡弗给了我几项。”她双手托住自己那两团硕大、犹如饺子般鼓胀的乳房，稍稍抬起，然后任其落下。丰腴的肉浪在上面迷人地荡漾开来，可它们依然坚挺得让人以为里面填了硅胶。但它们完完全全是真的，手掌陷进去时触感令人愉悦。 “很不错吧？”她喜气洋洋地说道。“对我这种年纪不小的姑娘来说，‘乳忆腺’简直是上天的恩赐。我还接受了一轮抗衰老药治疗，所以至少未来二十年，我都会保持现在这副模样。” “卡弗更喜欢基因改造... 而典范公司大概更偏爱合成植入体，”你接话道，目光落向她的尾巴。她让两条深灰色的附肢蜿蜒上探，灵巧地将光滑而沉甸甸的尾身彼此缠绕成螺旋状。 “听说它们采用了最尖端的技术，应该是用来展示他们的植入体能有多精巧、多性感。我有时确实会怀念以前的尾巴，可蓬松的毛梳起来实在烦人，而且我不得不承认，这两条尾巴很好玩。我能用它们做各种各样的事。” 你伸出手；见她没有把尾巴缩回去，便抚摸起其中一条，用手握住温暖、光滑而沉甸甸的尾身。凯斯里特那双翡翠色眼眸中流露出的愉悦，以及从喉咙深处响起的沙哑呼噜声，都被你尽收眼底。 “那这些... 棍子呢？”你说道，将目光转向她的头顶。两根四英寸长的合成细枝交叉在她的发髻下，乍看像是装饰性的发簪，但凑近后，你便能看出它们其实与她的头皮融为一体[diz.tuggedAntenna| ...或者，如果你碰巧在激情正酣时用力拽过它们，也会知道。] “它们是，呃... 天线，小甜豆。和我的大脑相连。它们有好几种功能。”她有些难为情地笑了笑，在座位上挪动着身体。“它们能立刻识别客人的种族，下载相应的饮食资料，这样我就永远不会不小心让谁中毒。[diz.atShip|我只需看一个人一眼，嗖的一下，脑袋里就会装满食物建议和警告！现在我在这里工作，这功能依然很有用[crewRange 2|，你的船员种族实在太多了！]|[diz.atNursery|如今我用它为不同种族调用教学辅助资料。只要想一想今天的教案，嗖的一下，资料就全有了！非常实用[var0|，尤其是这里有这么多不同种族的孩子]。]]它们还，呃... 很敏感，比我的尾巴还敏感。我想典范公司就是喜欢给员工增添新的性感带。他们确实很会让老迪兹的引擎一直运转。” 她尴尬地绕弄着头发，以略显饥渴的目光打量你。 “它们还有别的功能吗？”你问道。[flags.DIZZY_TALK_PARAGON| “你曾说过，它们会让你保持镇静。现在还会吗？”] “它们... 会让那些糟糕的情绪消失，”她终于说道。她挺起自己魁梧的身躯，忽然怒气冲冲地瞪向你。一阵熟悉的嗡鸣声响起，那副怒容随即化为平静。“以前，每当我... 思考某些事情，就会变得非常难过，有时还会非常愤怒。如今，当我感觉情绪在体内越积越多时，就会感受到那阵嗡鸣，随后情绪便消散了。我依然记得一切，可那感觉像是一片... 广阔而灰暗的海，不再像喷泉般向上喷涌。” “你想摆脱它吗？”你问道。[flags.MET_DR_LESSAU| “斯蒂尔科技在乌维托确实有一位顶尖的改造医生...”] “我考虑过。”她用爪尖在桌面上来回划弄。“曾经，我愿意做任何事，只求把典范公司赶出我的脑袋。但现在我已经摆脱了他们... 我没有那么介意了。如果它真的控制了我的感受，我就不会憎恨他们和卡弗，对吧？而且它确实有用。无论我在哪里工作，它似乎都会根据我正在做的事情进行校准，总能直接给我所需的基础资料，不必手动搜索外联网。不得不承认，拥有这功能相当棒。” “你也喜欢别人玩弄它们，”你笑道。“承认吧。” “别闹了。淘气的[pc.boy]。”不过她正微笑着，脸颊略带红晕。“显然，你很喜欢它们。这才是它们会留下来的主要原因。”
rows.raw: " “Tell me about your mods,” you say. “Did Paragon give you all of them?” “No, Carver gave me a couple, back before she subcontracted me.” She cups the vast, dumpling-like swells of her breasts, lifts them up a bit, lets them fall. Though tides of plump flesh ripple mesmerically across them, they retain a perkiness that suggests silicone. But they are entirely real, a joy to sink your hand into. “Aren’t they nice?” she beams. “Memmory Gland is heaven-sent for older girls like me. And I was given a round of anti-agathics, so I will look like this for a good twenty years yet.” “Carver prefers gene mods... and Paragon prefers synthetics I guess,” you supply, gazing down at her tails. She brings the two dark gray appendages snaking upwards, deftly twirls their smooth heft around each other into a helix. “They’re cutting edge apparently. Supposed to show off how skillful and sexy their implants can be. I do miss my old tails sometimes, but the fluff can be so annoying to comb and these are a lot of fun, I have to admit. I can get up to all sorts with them.” You reach out and, when she doesn’t pull them away, stroke one of them, reaching your grip around its warm, smooth heft, observing the pleasure in the kaithrit’s emerald’s eyes and the scratchy purr which starts up in the back of her throat. “And the... sticks?” you say, turning your gaze up to her head. The two four inch long synthetic twigs crossed together beneath her hair bun appear to be a decorative tie at first glance, but up close you can see they’re actually fused to her scalp[diz.tuggedAntenna| ...or if you happen to give them a good tug in the heat of things.] “They’re, um... antenna, sugarsnap. Connected to my brain. They do a few things.” She laughs self-consciously, shifting in her seat. “They identified the species of my clients right away and downloaded dietary information, so I was never in danger of poisoning anyone. [diz.atShip|I just look at someone and woosh, my head’s just filled with food suggestions and warnings! Still very useful now I’m working here[crewRange 2|, you have so many different crew!]|[diz.atNursery|Now I use it to access teacher aids for different species. I just think about my lesson plans for today and whoosh, it’s all there! It’s so useful[var0|, particularly since you have so many kinds of children here].]] They’re also, um... sensitive. More so than my tails. Paragon love giving their employees extra erogenous zones I guess, they certainly do a good job keeping ol’ Dizzy’s engine turning over.” She twirls her hair embarrassedly, looking you over in a slightly hungrier fashion. “Do they do anything else?” you ask.[flags.DIZZY_TALK_PARAGON| “You once said something about them keeping you sedate. Do they still do that?”] “They... make the bad feelings go away,” she says at last. She gathers her formidable self up and suddenly frowns at you furiously. There’s a familiar buzzing sound, and the frown melts away into placidity. “I used to get very sad when I... thought about things, and sometimes very angry. Now, when I feel emotions building up inside me, I feel the hum, and then they dissipate. I can still remember everything, but it’s like a... sea, great and gray, instead of a geyser, rising up.” “Would you like to get rid of it?” you ask.[flags.MET_DR_LESSAU| “Steele Tech does have a leading modifications doctor on Uveto...”] “I’ve thought about it.” She twiddles her claw across the table surface. “I would’ve done anything to get Paragon out of my head, once. But now I’m free of them... I don’t mind it so much. If it really was controlling how I feel I wouldn’t hate them and Carver, would I? And it is useful. Wherever I’m working it seems to calibrate to what I’m doing, so it always gives me the basic information I need without me having to search around the extranet manually. That’s pretty great to have, I can’t deny.” “You also like having them played with,” you grin. “Admit it.” “You stop that. Naughty [pc.boy].” She’s smiling though, a little bit of color in her cheeks. “You like them, clearly. And that’s the main reason they’re staying.” "

rows.original: “Well, I’m not sure!” She smiles at you full on, eyes shining. “The anti-ageing mods will keep me looking like this for another twenty years I was told, and that’s about the length of my contract with you. So don’t worry... you’ve got plenty more of this to look forward to, if you like.” Her hand slides over the sumptuous swell of her breast. “After that... well, I don’t really know!” She laughs raspily. “Is there anyone who knows where they’ll be in twenty years? I hope Zed will have made it a bit further up the ladder in the navy, and Lizzy will have settled down some. And Bizzy will be independent — no offense blossom, but even good indenturehood isn’t the same as being free when you’re that age, is it? And me... well.” A warm hand lands on your [pc.knee]. Tiny claws prickle your [pc.hasLowerGarment|[pc.lowerUndergarment]|[pc.skinFurScales]]. “Maybe I can persuade my owner to give me another round of anti-agathics?” she says quietly. “I love this job, and — I want to stay close to my angel. It makes me feel safe. You’re the fourth best thing that’s ever happened to me, [pc.name]. If you aren’t willing, well — perhaps I’ll retire. Move into hassling Bizzy full time. You can decide, when the time comes. As I said, twenty years is an awful long time.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我也不确定！” 她正面朝你微笑，双眼闪闪发亮。 “他们告诉我，抗衰老改造能让我在接下来二十年里保持这副模样，而这也差不多正是我与你的契约期限。所以别担心... 只要你愿意，今后还有很多这样的享受等着你。” 她的手滑过自己奢华隆起的乳房。 “再往后... 嗯，我真的不知道！”她沙哑地笑道。“谁能知道自己二十年后会在哪里？我希望泽德能在海军里再往上爬一些，莉兹也能稍微安定下来。还有比兹，希望她能独立——小花，无意冒犯，可在人生那个年纪，就算是条件不错的契约生活，也终究不等于自由，对吧？至于我... 嗯。” 一只温暖的手落在你的[pc.knee]上。细小的爪尖刺挠着你的[pc.hasLowerGarment|[pc.lowerUndergarment]|[pc.skinFurScales]]。 “也许我可以说服自己的主人，再给我来一轮抗衰老治疗？”她轻声说道。“我喜欢这份工作，而且——我想留在我的天使身边。这让我感到安全。[pc.name]，你是发生在我身上第四美好的事情。如果你不愿意，那么——也许我会退休。搬去全天候烦扰比兹。等时机到了，由你决定。我说过，二十年可是非常、非常漫长的时间。”

rows.original: [diz.collared |That silver collar of hers is an eyesore — a reminder of bad times. [flags.DIZZY_COLLAR |“Leash off!” With a click and a tiny hiss of released air, Dizzy’s collar gapes open at the back and falls to the ground. “You sure, sweetpea?” Dizzy frowns at you with a quizzical little smile. “I thought you decided you liked me wearing that thing. If I didn’t know any better, I’d say you were teasing your poor old [diz.atShip |cook |[diz.atNursery |teacher |studio director ] ] with it.” You keep your reasons behind your roguish smile. You retrieve and stow the fallen collar, in case you change your mind again. |Presumably Paragon put it on her because it has some kind of disabling function, so she couldn’t just run away when they plonked her out on that taxi rank. The question is, how do you get it off? “Oh, well I don’t know sweetpea!” Dizzy flushes a bit and touches the silver band around her neck when you put it to her. “But — Paragon liked their voice-activated gizmos. There’s probably a phrase the owner — that’s you — has to say.” The next five minutes turns into a guessing game. “Collar off!” “Collar deactivate!” “Disconnect, collar!” “Slave free!” “Indentured free!” “Bare!” “Unclasp!” “Let go, you bastard!” “Leash off!” There’s a click and a tiny hiss of releasing air. The collar gapes open from the back, then clatters to the ground. Dizzy’s neck is left appealingly bare. “Are you sure about this, pudding? Well... thank you.” The kaithrit milf draws you into a big hug. Like being hugged by a warm armchair. “I never liked that thing. It felt like having Paragon’s hand around my throat. Now...” She touches her neck, relishing it with a smile. “It feels like how I am. Free.” Well, kind of, anyway. You retrieve and stow the Paragon collar, just in case you ever change your mind. ] |Actually, didn’t Dizzy look more attractive wearing the collar? A stylish reminder of who she belongs to.[var0 | And doesn’t it match up with Bizzy’s just perfectly? ] You bring the opened silver clasp out and say you’re going to put it back on her. [flags.DIZZY_REM_COLLAR |“You want me to wear that thing again?” Dizzy sighs with jokey exasperation. “On again, off again, you never make up your mind! You are naughty teasing me with it, aren’t you.” She remains still as you draw close to her and fit the slim device around her neck, though. It clicks shut seamlessly, perfectly molded to fit the plus-sized kaithrit. “There.” She touches the metal with a little hum and blows you a kiss. “Feel like maybe we should do something soon where I’m wearing only this, don’t you?” You think that’s a very good idea. |“Oh. I — didn’t realize you’d kept that.” Dizzy looks glum, but then with a smile puts a brave face on it. “You like how I look when I wear it, sweetpea? Does it get you all rambunctious to know you own me?” She better believe it. “Well — that’s good enough for me.” She remains still as you draw close to her and fit the slim device around her neck. It clicks shut seamlessly, perfectly molded to fit the plus-sized kaithrit. “There.” She touches the metal with a little hum and blows you a kiss. “Feel like maybe we should do something soon where I’m wearing only this, don’t you?” You think that’s a very good idea. ] ]

rows.original: Your stomach waxes nostalgic as the memory of those pungent, enticing spices that used to hit you when you opened Dizzy’s door floats through it. Wouldn’t it be nice to have that onboard your ship? And be able to bend that fat ass over a kitchen counter whenever the fancy took you? Various parts of your body agree that yes, that would be a fine thing indeed. “You want me to be your ship’s cook?” says Dizzy, an almost disbelieving smile spreading across her face. “Really? Oh sweetpea, that would be perfect! As long as we stopped in at Tavros from time to time, so I can visit Bizzy and pick up fresh stock.” She picks herself up and brushes herself down in a business-like manner. “I need to visit the markets on this space station, see if I can find some reliable suppliers. Bizzy... you do everything [pc.name] tells you to do, ok? We owe [pc.him] everything. I’ll be back as often as I can to make sure you’re looking after yourself.” “Yes mom. Ok mom,” Bizzy answers, watching Deziere march purposefully from the room. Her tone is meek, but her tails are arched all the way up. You get the impression this arrangement suits Bizzy just fine — she will get to see Dizzy from time to time, but the matriarch also won’t be in her hair. For her part, Dizzy gives you an extra squeezy hug before departing for Tavros’s lower reaches. “You truly are my angel, [pc.name], and I don’t think I’ll ever be able to truly thank you.” She kisses you full on the lips. “Whatever you want me to do, I’ll do it. I mean that.”

rows.original: You consider the situation for a moment: the milodan army, now essentially slave labor, is rebelling in spite of the supposedly temporary nature of their imprisonment. In short, they’re behaving like violent, unruly brutes, and Ula is unwilling to use the sort of brutality that would be necessary to bring them to heel. Still, perhaps there is another way. These milodans are intensely tribal, perhaps even moreso than the clannish korgonne...
rows.translation: 你思考片刻：米洛丹军队如今本质上已沦为奴工，却仍在反抗，尽管他们的监禁据称只是暂时的。简而言之，他们表现得像一群暴力、难以管束的野蛮人，而乌拉又不愿采用令他们服从所必需的残酷手段。不过，也许还有另一种办法。这些米洛丹人有极强的部落观念，或许甚至比重视氏族的科尔贡人更强...

rows.original: Like most korgonne jewelry, this particular piece is largely composed of Savicite, but you can tell right away that Ula has given you something a cut above the typical korgonne craftsmanship. The gemstone’s facets are smooth and unblemished, causing the light to reflect through the radioactive crystal in dizzying ways. Feathery strands of platinum weave a protective cocoon around it, and a twisted loop of gold and platinum strands gives way into a solid gold chain with multiple options for wearing on the neck, arm, or thigh as Ula did.
rows.translation: 与大多数科尔贡首饰一样，这件饰品主要由萨维石制成，但你一眼就能看出，乌拉给你的东西远胜寻常科尔贡工艺品。宝石切面光滑无瑕，光线在放射性晶体中反射，形成令人目眩的效果。羽毛般的铂金细丝在周围编织成保护茧，金丝与铂金丝扭结成环，再延伸为一条纯金链，可按乌拉的方式佩戴在颈部、手臂或大腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\nLike most korgonne jewelry, this particular piece is largely composed of Savicite, but you can tell right away that Ula has given you something a cut above the typical korgonne craftsmanship. The gemstone’s facets are smooth and unblemished, causing the light to reflect through the radioactive crystal in dizzying ways. Feathery strands of platinum weave a protective cocoon around it, and a twisted loop of gold and platinum strands gives way into a solid gold chain with multiple options for wearing on the neck, arm, or thigh as Ula did."

rows.original: Showing Ula’s trinket to the guard earns you a look of surprise, respect, and an escort to the lowest mines in the hold, where the milodans are no doubt busy at work.
rows.translation: 把乌拉的信物给守卫看，换来了惊讶与敬重的目光，还有一路护送，把你带到据点最底层的矿场，米洛丹人无疑正在那里忙碌。
rows.raw: "Showing Ula’s trinket to the guard earns you a look of surprise, respect, and an escort to the lowest mines in the hold, where the milodans are no doubt busy at work."

rows.original: This deep, you’d expect visibility to be exceedingly poor, but the frequently placed glowing crystals (and naturally occurring veins of them here or there) keep the rough-hewn passage illuminated. The ceilings are higher here than elsewhere, no doubt a result of adjustments for the hold’s taller captives. It would be almost pleasant if it wasn’t for the acrid, sulfurous odor in the air and the smothering geothermal heat roiling out of Uveto’s ocean-buried core.
rows.translation: 深入到这种地方，能见度理应极差，但频繁安置的发光晶体，以及零星天然矿脉，照亮了粗凿通道。这里的天花板比其他地方更高，无疑是为了适应要塞中身材较高的俘虏。若非空气中弥漫着刺鼻硫磺气味，以及从乌维托海洋深处地核翻涌而出的窒息地热，这里几乎称得上舒适。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis deep, you’d expect visibility to be exceedingly poor, but the frequently placed glowing crystals (and naturally occurring veins of them here or there) keep the rough-hewn passage illuminated. The ceilings are higher here than elsewhere, no doubt a result of adjustments for the hold’s taller captives. It would be almost pleasant if it wasn’t for the acrid, sulfurous odor in the air and the smothering geothermal heat roiling out of Uveto’s ocean-buried core."

rows.original: The sounds of pickaxes chipping against stone is everywhere, almost musical, except for in one direction: toward the captive milodan. From the haphazard impacts, you can already tell that their hearts aren’t in the work. They vary between faint, child-like strikes and booming impacts of frustrated muscles pushed to their limit by futile rage. Through it all, the echos of rough-housing rumble down the halls.
rows.translation: 镐头凿击岩石的声音无处不在，几乎颇有韵律，唯独一个方向例外：米洛丹俘虏所在之处。从杂乱无章的敲击中，你已经能听出他们根本无心工作。声音时而像孩童敲打般微弱，时而是沮丧肌肉被徒劳怒火逼至极限后发出的轰然巨响。粗暴嬉闹的回声始终穿过厅道隆隆传来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sounds of pickaxes chipping against stone is everywhere, almost musical, except for in one direction: toward the captive milodan. From the haphazard impacts, you can already tell that their hearts aren’t in the work. They vary between faint, child-like strikes and booming impacts of frustrated muscles pushed to their limit by futile rage. Through it all, the echos of rough-housing rumble down the halls."

rows.original: The guards around the milodan living area briefly stop you - until you present Ula’s favor once more. You begin to explain why you’re here, but one waves you to silence. “Don’t care so long as not have to stopping more fights. Follow.” He crooks his finger to follow, and leads you to your target, his fellows shaking their heads in annoyance.
rows.translation: 米洛丹生活区周围的守卫短暂拦住你，直到你再次出示乌拉的信物。你开始解释来意，其中一人却挥手让你安静。“只要不用再制止更多打斗，就不在乎。跟上。”他勾起手指示意你跟随，将你领向目标；同伴们则懊恼地摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe guards around the milodan living area briefly stop you - until you present Ula’s favor once more. You begin to explain why you’re here, but one waves you to silence. “Don’t care so long as not have to stopping more fights. Follow.” He crooks his finger to follow, and leads you to your target, his fellows shaking their heads in annoyance."

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: KORGONNE_MALE_GRAY
rows.raw: "KORGONNE_MALE_GRAY"

rows.original: Korgonne
rows.translation: 科尔贡
rows.raw: "Korgonne"

rows.original: B
The lighting is poor; the natural light from the surface hardly reaches this far down, and the best the milodan have are luminous stones embedded into the walls.
rows.translation: 光线昏暗；地表的自然光几乎无法抵达这种深度，米洛丹能得到的最好照明只有嵌入墙壁的发光石。
rows.raw: "The lighting is poor; the natural light from the surface hardly reaches this far down, and the best the milodan have are luminous stones embedded into the walls."

rows.original: What you do see is what appears to be the entire invading milodan army, each of them holding a pickaxe and chopping away at the stony walls. Bright, illustrious stones clatter to the stony floor where the chipping milodan pick it up and place it in a pouch near to their position. You see two of them fight over a small pebble, before one prevails and puts it in their own bag – they must be rewarded based on their performance. Each of the milodan are connected to the others via an elongated chain, attached to cuffs around their ankles.
rows.translation: 你确实能看见的，似乎是整支入侵的米洛丹军队。每人手持一把镐头，不停凿击石墙。明亮耀眼的石头哐当落上石质地面，负责开凿的米洛丹将其捡起，放入所在位置附近的袋子。你看见其中两人为一颗小石子争斗，直到一人获胜，将石子放入自己的袋子；看来他们会按表现获得奖励。每名米洛丹都通过一条长链与其他人相连，链条连接着脚踝上的镣铐。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you do see is what appears to be the entire invading milodan army, each of them holding a pickaxe and chopping away at the stony walls. Bright, illustrious stones clatter to the stony floor where the chipping milodan pick it up and place it in a pouch near to their position. You see two of them fight over a small pebble, before one prevails and puts it in their own bag – they must be rewarded based on their performance. Each of the milodan are connected to the others via an elongated chain, attached to cuffs around their ankles."

rows.original: Some of them notice you, and they sneer and spit. They recognize you. One of them shouts something, but is silenced when your korgonne escort jabs them with the dull end of their spear.
rows.translation: 有些人注意到你，随即冷笑吐唾。他们认出了你。其中一人大喊了些什么，却被护送你的科尔贡用长矛钝端一捅，顿时安静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nSome of them notice you, and they sneer and spit. They recognize you. One of them shouts something, but is silenced when your korgonne escort jabs them with the dull end of their spear."

rows.original: In the far corner, you see one more robust milodan standing taller than his fellows: an absolute brick wall of a milodan, with a blue mohawk of hair, wielding a pickaxe twice the size of the others, and striking the wall with twice the force. He has a number of sacks near to him, each of them filled to the brim with glowing jewels, and he’s well on his way working on his next. He isn’t a part of the chain-gang: instead, he’s wearing a chain-link harness around his torso, connecting him to the floor, locking him in place while still giving him full motion of his arms.
rows.translation: 在最远的角落，你看见另一名强壮的米洛丹人，比同伴都高大：简直是一堵米洛丹砖墙，留着蓝色莫霍克发型，挥舞着一把尺寸是别人两倍的鹤嘴锄，砸墙力道也是两倍。他身边放着许多麻袋，每袋都装满发光宝石，而下一袋也快装好了。他并非锁链苦工队的一员；相反，他躯干上套着锁链编成的束具，与地板相连，把他锁在原地，却仍让双臂能够自由活动。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the far corner, you see one more robust milodan standing taller than his fellows: an absolute brick wall of a milodan, with a blue mohawk of hair, wielding a pickaxe twice the size of the others, and striking the wall with twice the force. He has a number of sacks near to him, each of them filled to the brim with glowing jewels, and he’s well on his way working on his next. He isn’t a part of the chain-gang: instead, he’s wearing a chain-link harness around his torso, connecting him to the floor, locking him in place while still giving him full motion of his arms."

rows.original: Unlike the others, he is silent and diligent in his work, perhaps owing to his solidarity from the rest of the gang. He doesn’t notice you and the korgonne guard approach – that is, until your escort jabs him in the rib with the dull end of his spear. Even then, the massive milodan doesn’t react with pain or discomfort, and more like he just noticed that a child was trying to get his attention.
rows.translation: 和别的人不同，他干活时沉默而勤勉，也许是因为他总与帮里其他人格格不入。他没注意到你和那个科尔贡卫兵走近——直到你的护卫用长矛的钝头戳了一下他的肋部。即便那时，这个魁梧的米洛丹人也没有露出疼痛或不适的反应，更像是他刚注意到有个小孩在试图引起他的注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnlike the others, he is silent and diligent in his work, perhaps owing to his solidarity from the rest of the gang. He doesn’t notice you and the korgonne guard approach – that is, until your escort jabs him in the rib with the dull end of his spear. Even then, the massive milodan doesn’t react with pain or discomfort, and more like he just noticed that a child was trying to get his attention."

rows.original: You have
rows.translation: 你有
rows.raw: "You have"

rows.original: Having
rows.translation: 有
rows.raw: "Having"

rows.original: company,” the korgonne guard says, and steps aside, giving you and the war alpha your space.
rows.translation: 作伴，”那名科尔贡守卫说着，退到一旁，给你和战争首领让出空间。
rows.raw: " company,” the korgonne guard says, and steps aside, giving you and the war alpha your space."

rows.original: It takes a moment for the war alpha to recognize you in the light of the dungeon. “You,” he thrums, his voice low. He turns his pickaxe down, slamming the flat head of the pick onto the floor.
rows.translation: 战斗首领花了一会儿才在地牢光线下认出你。“是你，”他低声隆隆道。他把鹤嘴锄朝下，扁平锄头重重砸在地面。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a moment for the war alpha to recognize you in the light of the dungeon. “You,” he thrums, his voice low. He turns his pickaxe down, slamming the flat head of the pick onto the floor."

rows.original: The loud boom causes the milodan chain-gang to stop and watch. You have an audience.
rows.translation: 巨大的爆炸声让米洛丹苦役队停下来看着。你有观众了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe loud boom causes the milodan chain-gang to stop and watch. You have an audience."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"
