rows.translation: 战争首领
rows.raw: "War Alpha"

rows.original: You introduce yourself as [pc.name] Steele. You’ve come to
rows.translation: 你自我介绍为[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。你是来
rows.raw: "You introduce yourself as [pc.name] Steele. You’ve come to "

rows.original: bargain.
rows.translation: 交易。
rows.raw: "bargain."

rows.original: talk.
rows.translation: 谈谈。
rows.raw: "talk."

rows.original: The war alpha flexes his chest in front of you, blowing himself up, probably to try and intimidate you. “I am Eitan, son of Laklan, [pc.name] Steele, and I had come to steal the korgonne Hold and wear its princess like a loincloth,” the war alpha responds as soon as you finish your sentence. The other milodan whoop in laughter. “Not everything goes as we intend, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: 这个战争阿尔法在你面前挺起胸膛，把胸肌鼓得老大，大概是想吓唬你。“我是埃坦，拉克兰之子，[pc.name]斯蒂尔，我来，是为了抢下科尔贡人的要塞，把他们的公主像缠腰布一样穿在身上，”你话音刚落，这位战争阿尔法就答道。其他米洛丹人哄堂大笑。“不是每件事都能如我们所愿，[pc.name]斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe war alpha flexes his chest in front of you, blowing himself up, probably to try and intimidate you. “I am Eitan, son of Laklan, [pc.name] Steele, and I had come to steal the korgonne Hold and wear its princess like a loincloth,” the war alpha responds as soon as you finish your sentence. The other milodan whoop in laughter. “Not everything goes as we intend, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: You wait for the milodan to calm down before you try again.
rows.translation: 你等米洛丹人冷静下来，才再次尝试。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait for the milodan to calm down before you try again."

rows.original: You ask Eitan if the korgonne had been treating him and his people as well as they could – are they in need of anything? You could provide them with some provisions, if they’re in need.
rows.translation: 你询问埃坦，科尔贡人是否已经尽可能善待他和族人——他们还缺什么吗？如果需要，你可以提供一些补给。
rows.raw: " You ask Eitan if the korgonne had been treating him and his people as well as they could – are they in need of anything? You could provide them with some provisions, if they’re in need."

rows.original: You remind Eitan that it could have been worse: Ula has him working in her mines, but she could have just as easily made him into a personal butler or something. He should count his blessings that all you want is to talk!
rows.translation: 你提醒埃坦，情况本可以更糟：乌拉只是让他在矿井干活，却也完全可以把他变成私人管家之类的。他该为此庆幸，因为你只想谈话！
rows.raw: " You remind Eitan that it could have been worse: Ula has him working in her mines, but she could have just as easily made him into a personal butler or something. He should count his blessings that all you want is to talk!"

rows.original: You remind Eitan that you had beaten him in fair combat – hell, if you remember right, it was a two-on-one, so it wasn’t even fair, and he still lost. He should consider himself lucky that all you want is to talk.
rows.translation: 你提醒埃坦，自己是在公平战斗中击败他的——见鬼，如果没记错，当时是二对一，甚至算不上公平，可他仍然输了。他应该庆幸你只想谈话。
rows.raw: " You remind Eitan that you had beaten him in fair combat – hell, if you remember right, it was a two-on-one, so it wasn’t even fair, and he still lost. He should consider himself lucky that all you want is to talk."

rows.original: Eitan pauses for a moment, and the air of the dungeon goes still and silent – and then he lunges at you, the sound of his chains snapping into place beneath him to keep him still. It was a feint, and he knew he wasn’t going to get nearly close enough to you,
rows.translation: 埃坦停顿了一下，地牢里的空气静止无声 – 然后他朝你猛扑过来，身下的锁链绷紧定住的声音响起，把他拉在原地。那只是虚晃一招，他知道自己根本不可能靠得离你足够近，
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan pauses for a moment, and the air of the dungeon goes still and silent – and then he lunges at you, the sound of his chains snapping into place beneath him to keep him still. It was a feint, and he knew he wasn’t going to get nearly close enough to you, "

rows.original: but you nonetheless flinch. He, and the rest of the milodan, start laughing uproariously at you and your weakness. You were supposed to keep up the stronger image, considering you had beaten him in a fight, but you couldn’t.
rows.translation: 但你还是缩了一下。他和其他米洛丹人开始冲着你和你这份软弱放声大笑。你本该维持住更强硬的形象，毕竟你在打斗中赢了他，可你做不到。
rows.raw: "but you nonetheless flinch. He, and the rest of the milodan, start laughing uproariously at you and your weakness. You were supposed to keep up the stronger image, considering you had beaten him in a fight, but you couldn’t."

rows.original: but so did you, and you don’t flinch, standing your ground just outside of his reach. The milodan chain-gang ‘oooh’ at your stalwartness; you know that Eitan was hoping you would show weakness, and you wonder how he’ll react to you not falling for it.
rows.translation: 但你也一样，而且毫不退缩，站在他触及范围之外坚守阵地。米洛丹锁链苦工们为你的坚定发出“哦——”的起哄声；你知道埃坦本想看见你示弱，不禁好奇你没有上当后，他会作何反应。
rows.raw: "but so did you, and you don’t flinch, standing your ground just outside of his reach. The milodan chain-gang ‘oooh’ at your stalwartness; you know that Eitan was hoping you would show weakness, and you wonder how he’ll react to you not falling for it."

rows.original: “You ask if my people need anything?” he asks. “Turn around and present yourself, [pc.name] Steele. It’s been too long since I’ve last been relieved, and the show would give my people a boost to their morale!”
rows.translation: “你问我的族人需不需要什么？” 他问道。“转过身去，把自己献出来，[pc.name] 斯蒂尔。我上一次得到释放已经太久了，而这场表演能给我的族人提振士气！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You ask if my people need anything?” he asks. “Turn around and present yourself, [pc.name] Steele. It’s been too long since I’ve last been relieved, and the show would give my people a boost to their morale!”"

rows.original: The milodan whoop and cheer at the idea. It’s clearly a popular one with them.
rows.translation: 米洛丹人们为这个主意欢呼大叫。显然这很合他们的胃口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe milodan whoop and cheer at the idea. It’s clearly a popular one with them."

rows.original: Hell, you’ll admit, it’s a hot as fuck idea, but as much as you probably wouldn’t mind it under any other context, you need to keep a stern showing. You’re in control here.
rows.translation: 见鬼，你承认这想法性感得要命；换个情境，你大概一点也不介意，但现在必须保持严厉姿态。掌控局面的是你。
rows.raw: " Hell, you’ll admit, it’s a hot as fuck idea, but as much as you probably wouldn’t mind it under any other context, you need to keep a stern showing. You’re in control here."

rows.original: “My people and I owe you nothing, [pc.name] Steele,” Eitan continues, hefting his massive pickaxe up with one hand and slinging it over his shoulder. “We have lost the war, and this is our punishment. Every one of us has accepted that this is where we will die... unless, of course, a larger, stronger army of milodan warriors does what we couldn’t.”
rows.translation: “我和我的人不欠你任何东西，[pc.name]斯蒂尔，”埃坦接着说，单手拎起他那把巨大的镐，甩到肩上。“我们输掉了战争，这就是我们的惩罚。我们每个人都接受了这里就是我们葬身之地...除非，当然，一支更庞大、更强悍的米洛丹战士大军能做到我们没能做到的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My people and I owe you nothing, [pc.name] Steele,” Eitan continues, hefting his massive pickaxe up with one hand and slinging it over his shoulder. “We have lost the war, and this is our punishment. Every one of us has accepted that this is where we will die... unless, of course, a larger, stronger army of milodan warriors does what we couldn’t.”"

rows.original: You argue that it doesn’t have to be that way. He and his people don’t have to die in this dark hole in their enemy’s prison.
rows.translation: 你争辩说，事情不必如此。他和族人没必要死在敌人监狱的这个黑暗洞穴里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou argue that it doesn’t have to be that way. He and his people don’t have to die in this dark hole in their enemy’s prison."

rows.original: “Death would be better than whatever you would suggest,” he snaps. “We would sooner turn our axes on each other than integrate into the korgonne’s ranks, or whatever I’m sure you’d like to offer.”
rows.translation: “死也比听你提的那些建议强，”他厉声说。“我们宁可把斧头转向彼此，也不会并入科尔贡人的队伍，或者你八成想提的任何花样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Death would be better than whatever you would suggest,” he snaps. “We would sooner turn our axes on each other than integrate into the korgonne’s ranks, or whatever I’m sure you’d like to offer.”"

rows.original: You insist that he try and think rationally. You get that he’s mad that he lost the war, but moping in a dungeon and forcing the rest of his people to mope with him for the rest of their lives is a stubborn, selfish decision for a leader like himself to make. You offer again: all you want is to talk. If he gives you what you want, then you can give him something in return.
rows.translation: 你坚持让他试着理性思考。你明白他因战败而愤怒，但一辈子闷在地牢里，还强迫其余族人陪他一起消沉，是他这种领袖作出的固执而自私的决定。你再次提出条件：只想谈谈。如果他给你想要的，你也能回报他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou insist that he try and think rationally. You get that he’s mad that he lost the war, but moping in a dungeon and forcing the rest of his people to mope with him for the rest of their lives is a stubborn, selfish decision for a leader like himself to make. You offer again: all you want is to talk. If he gives you what you want, then you can give him something in return."

rows.original: Something else. Something material that he could use.
rows.translation: 某种别的东西。某种他能用得上的实物。
rows.raw: " Something else. Something material that he could use."

rows.original: Eitan looks
rows.translation: 埃坦看着
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan looks "

rows.translation: 低头看
rows.raw: "down at"

rows.original: up at
rows.translation: 抬头望向
rows.raw: "up at"

rows.original: at
rows.translation: 看着
rows.raw: "at"

rows.original: you, the corner of his lip curling upward and his eyes narrowing. He doesn’t immediately respond with something sarcastic or abrasive – which is good, because it means he’s considering your offer.
rows.translation: 你，嘴角向上翘起，双眼眯细。他没有立刻用讽刺或粗暴的话回应——这是好事，因为说明他正在考虑你的提议。
rows.raw: " you, the corner of his lip curling upward and his eyes narrowing. He doesn’t immediately respond with something sarcastic or abrasive – which is good, because it means he’s considering your offer."

rows.original: “What do you have to gain?” he asks.
rows.translation: “你能得到什么好处？”他问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do you have to gain?” he asks."

rows.original: You’d just like to get a better understanding of milodan culture: from how they think, to why they’re in a war with the korgonne. It’s not a complete lie, but you figure he probably wouldn’t respond positively if you told him you’re trying to convert him from his tribal-warfare way of thinking.
rows.translation: 你只是想更好地了解米洛丹文化：从他们如何思考，到为何与科尔贡人交战。这并非完全的谎言，但你估计，要是告诉他自己正试图让他摆脱部落战争式思维，他大概不会有积极反应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d just like to get a better understanding of milodan culture: from how they think, to why they’re in a war with the korgonne. It’s not a complete lie, but you figure he probably wouldn’t respond positively if you told him you’re trying to convert him from his tribal-warfare way of thinking."

rows.original: “And you would provide me anything I like in return?” he asks.
rows.translation: “那作为回报，你会给我任何我想要的东西？”他问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you would provide me anything I like in return?” he asks."

rows.original: “Within reason,” you reply, and you list some things that you could provide him and his people: more food and water; softer, larger bedding; maybe escorts to the surface for some fresh air and sunlight.
rows.translation: “在合理范围内，”你回答，并列出一些你能为他和他族人提供的东西：更多食物和水；更柔软、更宽大的床铺；也许还有护送他们到地表呼吸新鲜空气、晒晒太阳。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Within reason,” you reply, and you list some things that you could provide him and his people: more food and water; softer, larger bedding; maybe escorts to the surface for some fresh air and sunlight."

rows.original: He hums, his hand rubbing at the shaft of his pickaxe. “Bring to me...” he hesitates, trying to decide what it is that he wants. “Food. An exotic food, not native to our planet. I know you have the means to travel beyond the night stars. Prove to me that you mean what you say by bringing to me an exotic food, and then I will give you your conversation.”
rows.translation: 他低哼着，一只手摩擦鹤嘴锄的长柄。“给我带来……”他迟疑片刻，试图决定自己想要什么。“食物。一种并非产自我们星球的异域食物。我知道你有穿越夜空群星的手段。给我带来异域食物，证明你所言非虚，然后我就给你想要的谈话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hums, his hand rubbing at the shaft of his pickaxe. “Bring to me...” he hesitates, trying to decide what it is that he wants. “Food. An exotic food, not native to our planet. I know you have the means to travel beyond the night stars. Prove to me that you mean what you say by bringing to me an exotic food, and then I will give you your conversation.”"

rows.original: Eitan wants to eat something exotic. It’s a fairly mundane request. As soon as you have something for him to eat, he promises to give you some conversation.
rows.translation: 埃坦想吃某种异域食物。这请求相当普通。只要你带来能让他吃的东西，他就答应与你谈谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan wants to eat something exotic. It’s a fairly mundane request. As soon as you have something for him to eat, he promises to give you some conversation."

rows.original: You tell him that you’ll hold up your word, and that you expect he’ll hold up his.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，自己会信守承诺，也希望他同样守信。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that you’ll hold up your word, and that you expect he’ll hold up his."

rows.original: “I’m not going anywhere,” he says, and ends the conversation by turning back to his wall and swinging at it with his massive pickaxe. The milodan chain-gang, understanding the conversation to be over, resume their own tasks as if they had never stopped.
rows.translation: “我哪儿也不去，”他说完，转过身去面对墙壁，抡起那把巨大的镐头砸了上去，就这样结束了这场对话。米洛丹的苦役队明白谈话已经结束，便各自重新干起活来，仿佛从未停下过。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not going anywhere,” he says, and ends the conversation by turning back to his wall and swinging at it with his massive pickaxe. The milodan chain-gang, understanding the conversation to be over, resume their own tasks as if they had never stopped."

rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.translation: 下一个

rows.raw: "KORGONNE_MALE_"

rows.translation: 科尔贡
rows.raw: "Korgonne"

rows.original: B

You head down towards the bottommost level of the korgonne Hold. Already, the sound of the milodan captives chipping away at the mines reaches your ears. You wonder if the Hold will ever run out of things for them to mine.
rows.translation: 你朝科尔贡堡垒最底层走去。米洛丹俘虏开凿矿井的声音已经传入耳中。你不禁想，堡垒里可供他们开采的东西是否终有耗尽的一天。
rows.raw: "You head down towards the bottommost level of the korgonne Hold. Already, the sound of the milodan captives chipping away at the mines reaches your ears. You wonder if the Hold will ever run out of things for them to mine."

rows.original: The two korgonne guards recognize you as you approach. They don’t bother asking questions anymore; they know why you’re there. The one to the left turns and beckons you to follow, leaving his post so that he can lead you into the prison.
rows.translation: 你靠近时，两名科尔贡守卫认出了你。他们不再费心提问；都知道你为何而来。左边那名守卫转身招手让你跟上，离开岗位，带你进入监狱。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two korgonne guards recognize you as you approach. They don’t bother asking questions anymore; they know why you’re there. The one to the left turns and beckons you to follow, leaving his post so that he can lead you into the prison."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The milodan chain gangs pause their work momentarily once you and your korgonne guard escort enter the prison. Once they see that it’s you, they suppose that you’re here for their alpha, and they resume their work – but at with less fervor, more interested in you and him than they are bashing at a wall with a pick.
rows.translation: 你与科尔贡护卫进入监狱时，米洛丹锁链苦工队短暂停下工作。看到是你，他们猜想你为首领而来，于是恢复劳作——但热情有所减退，比起挥锄砸墙，他们对你和他更感兴趣。
rows.raw: "The milodan chain gangs pause their work momentarily once you and your korgonne guard escort enter the prison. Once they see that it’s you, they suppose that you’re here for their alpha, and they resume their work – but at with less fervor, more interested in you and him than they are bashing at a wall with a pick."

rows.original: Eitan is where you found him last: chained to the far corner with a harness, wielding a pickaxe larger than all the others, chipping chunks of ore larger than any other milodan could. Likewise, at your approach, he places the head of his pick onto the floor and takes a deep breath, calming his overworked body so you can have a proper conversation with him.
rows.translation: 埃坦还在上次发现他的地方：身穿束具，被锁在最远的角落，挥舞比其他人都大的鹤嘴锄，凿下任何其他米洛丹人都无法比拟的巨大矿块。同样，你一靠近，他便把锄头放在地上，深吸一口气，让过度劳累的身体平静下来，以便与你好好交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan is where you found him last: chained to the far corner with a harness, wielding a pickaxe larger than all the others, chipping chunks of ore larger than any other milodan could. Likewise, at your approach, he places the head of his pick onto the floor and takes a deep breath, calming his overworked body so you can have a proper conversation with him."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” he says, his voice gruff and sore. Spending all this time in the mines must be torturous for their throats. “Did you bring to me what I asked for?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说，声音沙哑而疼痛。在矿里待这么久，对他们的嗓子一定是种折磨。“我让你带的东西，你带来了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” he says, his voice gruff and sore. Spending all this time in the mines must be torturous for their throats. “Did you bring to me what I asked for?”"

rows.original: Eitan progression values have somehow become corrupted. eitanRequestSuccessful() was passed the value
rows.raw: "Eitan progression values have somehow become corrupted. eitanRequestSuccessful() was passed the value "

rows.original: Don’t share any of your food with Eitan.
rows.translation: 别把你的任何食物分给埃坦。
rows.raw: "Don’t share any of your food with Eitan."

rows.original: You lift your arms and spin on the spot, showing off your outfit to Eitan. This is exactly what he asked for: for you to wear something sexy so he can think about it when he’s alone at night. You feel you’re on a store shelf, spinning around and showing off to any would-be customer what they can get for the right price – all you need is a price tag to put the cherry on top. You’re supposed to be the one in charge of the conversations, here, and flaunting the goods is a good way to demean that.
rows.translation: 你举起双臂，在原地转了一圈，向埃坦展示自己的装束。这正是他的要求：穿上性感衣物，让他夜晚独处时可以回想。你感觉自己仿佛站在商店货架上，旋转着向任何潜在顾客展示，只要出对价钱就能得到什么——只差挂上一张价签就大功告成。这里本该由你掌控谈话，而炫耀自己的“商品”可不利于维持这种地位。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lift your arms and spin on the spot, showing off your outfit to Eitan. This is exactly what he asked for: for you to wear something sexy so he can think about it when he’s alone at night. You feel you’re on a store shelf, spinning around and showing off to any would-be customer what they can get for the right price – all you need is a price tag to put the cherry on top. You’re supposed to be the one in charge of the conversations, here, and flaunting the goods is a good way to demean that."

rows.original: But – on the other hand, showing yourself off like this feels undeniably sexy. It’s you he wanted to show off, and it’s you he’ll be thinking about later. Maybe that can be a strength of yours – maybe you’re more in control of the conversation than you thought.
rows.translation: 但是——另一方面，这样展示自己的感觉无可否认地性感。他想看的正是你，以后惦记的也会是你。也许这能成为你的力量——也许你对谈话的掌控比自己以为的更多。
rows.raw: " But – on the other hand, showing yourself off like this feels undeniably sexy. It’s you he wanted to show off, and it’s you he’ll be thinking about later. Maybe that can be a strength of yours – maybe you’re more in control of the conversation than you thought."

rows.original: Eitan leans back and grins as you move and display your body underneath the sexy clothing. He rubs at his chin with his right palm and he shifts from one leg to the other. The pants he was given by the korgonne are slipshod and hang off his body loosely, and they, and he, do nothing to mask the budding erection your movements are giving him.
rows.translation: 你在性感衣物下活动身体、尽情展示时，埃坦向后仰身咧嘴笑了。他用右掌摩擦下巴，重心从一条腿移到另一条腿。科尔贡人给他的裤子做工粗糙，松垮垂在身上；无论裤子还是他本人，都完全没有掩饰你动作令他萌生的勃起。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan leans back and grins as you move and display your body underneath the sexy clothing. He rubs at his chin with his right palm and he shifts from one leg to the other. The pants he was given by the korgonne are slipshod and hang off his body loosely, and they, and he, do nothing to mask the budding erection your movements are giving him."

rows.original: You end the pirouette by putting your hands on your hips and swishing them to one side.
rows.translation: 你结束旋转，双手叉腰，把胯往一侧一摆。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou end the pirouette by putting your hands on your hips and swishing them to one side."

rows.original: It’s embarrassing that you’ve had to put yourself to this level, and you keep having to remind yourself why you’re even going through the effort for Eitan in the first place.
rows.translation: 要让自己落到这种地步，实在令人难堪，你还得不断提醒自己，当初到底为什么要为埃坦费这份力气。
rows.raw: " It’s embarrassing that you’ve had to put yourself to this level, and you keep having to remind yourself why you’re even going through the effort for Eitan in the first place."

rows.original: “Very nice,” Eitan congratulates, his tongue swishing out to lick at his chops after the show. “Your alien cultures really know the value of showing less. Sometimes it’s sexier to wear something revealing than it is to go naked.”
rows.translation: “非常不错，”展示结束后，埃坦赞许道，舌头滑出来舔了舔嘴角。“你们异星文化确实懂得少露一些的价值。有时穿暴露的衣服，比全裸更加性感。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very nice,” Eitan congratulates, his tongue swishing out to lick at his chops after the show. “Your alien cultures really know the value of showing less. Sometimes it’s sexier to wear something revealing than it is to go naked.”"

rows.original: You’re not positive if that’s a compliment towards you, or towards non-milodan culture in general, or what.
rows.translation: 你也说不准那是在夸你，还是在夸非米洛丹的通用文化，或者别的什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not positive if that’s a compliment towards you, or towards non-milodan culture in general, or what."

rows.raw: "I can’t imagine that was easy for you to have done"

rows.original: , [pc.name] Steele,” he says as he leans on his overturned pickaxe. “You have earned your conversation. Ask away.”
rows.translation: ，[pc.name]斯蒂尔，”他倚在翻倒的镐子上说道。“你已经赢得了这场谈话。尽管问吧。”
rows.raw: ", [pc.name] Steele,” he says as he leans on his overturned pickaxe. “You have earned your conversation. Ask away.”"

rows.original: Don’t let Eitan drink your booze.
rows.translation: 别让埃坦喝你的酒。
rows.raw: "Don’t let Eitan drink your booze."

rows.original: Don’t give Eitan any medicine.
rows.translation: 不给埃坦任何药。
rows.raw: "Don’t give Eitan any medicine."

rows.original: On second thought, he looks better naked.
rows.translation: 再一想，他不穿衣服更好看。
rows.raw: "On second thought, he looks better naked."

rows.original: ERROR
rows.raw: "\n\nERROR"

rows.original: Escape!
rows.translation: 逃跑！
rows.raw: "Escape!"

rows.original: Escape!
rows.translation: 逃跑！
rows.raw: "Escape!"

rows.original: Run from the bug!
rows.translation: 快逃离那只虫子！
rows.raw: "Run from the bug!"

rows.original: continue
rows.raw: "continue"

rows.original: Give the Milo
rows.translation: 把米洛给
rows.raw: "Give the Milo "

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Nothing"

rows.original: You tell him that you did not, and that you’re here for a visit regardless.
rows.translation: 你告诉他你并没有，不过你还是来探望一下。
rows.raw: "You tell him that you did not, and that you’re here for a visit regardless."

rows.original: <i>“Our agreement is that you give me what I want, [pc.name] Steele, and in return, I answer your questions. I asked you
rows.translation: <i>“我们的协议是，你给我想要的东西，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，而我回答你的问题。我要求你
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Our agreement is that you give me what I want, [pc.name] Steele, and in return, I answer your questions. I asked you"

rows.original: for an exotic food, not native to Uveto
rows.translation: 为了一种并非乌维托本土所产的异域食物
rows.raw: " for an exotic food, not native to Uveto"

rows.original: to wear something enticing that I can entertain myself with at night
rows.translation: 穿上诱人的衣服，让我夜里可以拿来消遣
rows.raw: " to wear something enticing that I can entertain myself with at night"

rows.original: for a drink that would undo the tension in me - and hopefully didn’t taste as badly as what Pyrite gave me
rows.translation: 给我一杯能解除体内紧张的饮料——而且希望别像派莱特给我的那么难喝
rows.raw: " for a drink that would undo the tension in me - and hopefully didn’t taste as badly as what Pyrite gave me"

rows.original: for medicine for my people, and for a trip to the surface for fresh air and sunlight
rows.translation: 为族人提供药物，并让我们去地表呼吸新鲜空气、晒晒阳光
rows.raw: " for medicine for my people, and for a trip to the surface for fresh air and sunlight"

rows.original: for something to wear underneath these chains so they’ll stop chafing me
rows.translation: 给我某种能穿在这些锁链下面的东西，让它们别再磨伤我
rows.raw: " for something to wear underneath these chains so they’ll stop chafing me"

rows.original: fresh water for my people
rows.translation: 给我的族人新鲜饮水
rows.raw: " fresh water for my people"

rows.original: an audience with the chieftain of the korgonne
rows.translation: 求见科尔贡人的酋长
rows.raw: " an audience with the chieftain of the korgonne"

rows.original: to report this bug in the forums
rows.translation: 到论坛上报告这个 bug
rows.raw: " to report this bug in the forums"

rows.original: .” He hefts his mighty pickaxe with an irritated grunt and turns his back to you. “We have nothing to discuss until you give me what I want.”
rows.translation: 。”他烦躁地哼了一声，提起巨大的鹤嘴锄，背对着你。“在你给我想要的东西之前，我们无话可谈。”
rows.raw: ".” He hefts his mighty pickaxe with an irritated grunt and turns his back to you. “We have nothing to discuss until you give me what I want.”"

rows.original: Without another word, he returns to his work, toiling away at a rock wall with his pick. He doesn’t respond to anything you say after that.
rows.translation: 他不再多说一句，转身继续干活，用镐子凿着一堵岩壁。之后你说什么他都不再回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout another word, he returns to his work, toiling away at a rock wall with his pick. He doesn’t respond to anything you say after that."

rows.original: You tell him you did.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，自己已经给了。
rows.raw: "You tell him you did."

rows.original: You reach into your pack and retrieve the
rows.translation: 你把手伸进背包，取出
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach into your pack and retrieve the "

rows.original: that you had brought just for Eitan. You aren’t sure what he finds most palatable – sweet, sour, juicy, tart, whatever – but he didn’t give you an instruction beyond ‘exotic.’ Hopefully, even if he doesn’t like it, he’ll still behave.
rows.translation: 那是你专门为埃坦带来的东西。你不确定他觉得什么最合口味 – 甜的、酸的、多汁的、酸涩的，什么都有可能 – 但他除了‘异域风味’之外没给过你别的指示。但愿就算他不喜欢，他也还是会守规矩。
rows.raw: " that you had brought just for Eitan. You aren’t sure what he finds most palatable – sweet, sour, juicy, tart, whatever – but he didn’t give you an instruction beyond ‘exotic.’ Hopefully, even if he doesn’t like it, he’ll still behave."

rows.original: Eitan handles the
rows.translation: 埃坦拿着这
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan handles the "

rows.original: surprisingly gingerly, as if he were afraid he’d crush it between his fingers if he weren’t careful. You figure that he doesn’t know how to eat it: the natives of Uveto survive on whatever they can catch or harvest in the harsh snowy landscapes, and with teeth like his, he probably only eats meat.
rows.translation: 时出奇小心，仿佛稍不留神就会在指间把它压碎。你猜他不知道该怎么吃：乌维托原住民依靠严酷雪原上能够捕获或采集的任何东西生存，而以他那样的牙齿，大概只吃肉。
rows.raw: " surprisingly gingerly, as if he were afraid he’d crush it between his fingers if he weren’t careful. You figure that he doesn’t know how to eat it: the natives of Uveto survive on whatever they can catch or harvest in the harsh snowy landscapes, and with teeth like his, he probably only eats meat."

rows.original: You teach him how to eat the
rows.translation: 你教他如何吃这
rows.raw: "\n\nYou teach him how to eat the "

rows.original: – it’s hardly an ordeal, but it’s not a lesson you were expecting to teach. All the same, he follows your instructions to the letter, devouring the food with the appetite of a large man that hadn’t eaten something fulfilling in weeks. You notice that some of the other milodan watch on enviously; some of them even drool at the idea of getting something half-decent to eat.
rows.translation: – 这算不上什么苦差事，但也不是你原本以为要教的一课。尽管如此，他还是把你的指示一字不差地照做，用一个大块头男人好几周没吃过一顿饱饭的胃口把食物吞了个精光。你注意到另外几个米洛丹人在旁边羡慕地看着；有几个光是想到能吃到点像样的东西，口水就流下来了。
rows.raw: " – it’s hardly an ordeal, but it’s not a lesson you were expecting to teach. All the same, he follows your instructions to the letter, devouring the food with the appetite of a large man that hadn’t eaten something fulfilling in weeks. You notice that some of the other milodan watch on enviously; some of them even drool at the idea of getting something half-decent to eat."

rows.original: Eitan finishes the
rows.translation: 埃坦吃完了这
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan finishes the "

rows.original: , the entire thing, in only a few moments. “That’s not how I was expecting it to taste,” he says, wiping his mouth with the back of his dirty, naked arm. “But then, I should hope it wouldn’t taste like something I’m familiar with.”
rows.translation: ，几乎几口就把整个东西吞光。“味道和我预想的不一样，”他说着，用肮脏裸臂的手背擦嘴。“不过，它最好确实别像我熟悉的东西。”
rows.raw: ", the entire thing, in only a few moments. “That’s not how I was expecting it to taste,” he says, wiping his mouth with the back of his dirty, naked arm. “But then, I should hope it wouldn’t taste like something I’m familiar with.”"

rows.original: You ask him if he liked it.
rows.translation: 你问他是否喜欢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him if he liked it."

rows.original: “It was alright,” he answers, then hefts his mighty pickaxe and turns towards his wall. “You have asked your question. Our conversation is over. Bring me another if you want to ask anything more.”
rows.translation: “还行吧，”他答道，然后举起他那把巨大的镐子，转身面向他的矿壁。“你的问题问过了。我们的交谈结束了。还想再问什么，就再给我带一个来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was alright,” he answers, then hefts his mighty pickaxe and turns towards his wall. “You have asked your question. Our conversation is over. Bring me another if you want to ask anything more.”"

rows.original: You gawk and insist that he can’t be serious (and you’re careful to not phrase it as a question).
rows.translation: 你目瞪口呆，坚持说他不可能是在认真（而且你小心地没把它说成问句）。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gawk and insist that he can’t be serious (and you’re careful to not phrase it as a question)."

rows.original: “Being a milodan means putting yourself above all others. If I can’t beat you in a fight, [pc.name] Steele, and you want something from me, then I’ll do what I can to make it worth it to me.” He swings the pick once, and immediately a chunk of the wall falls to his feet. “Besides, the food the korgonne give us is tasteless and paltry. I’ll take this opportunity to get a decent meal out of it.”
rows.translation: “身为米洛丹人，就意味着把自己置于一切之上。如果我在战斗中打不过你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，而你又想从我这里得到什么，那我就会尽力让此事对自己划算。”他挥动一次鹤嘴锄，一块墙体立刻落到脚边。“况且，科尔贡人给我们的食物寡淡又少得可怜。我会利用这个机会换一顿像样的饭。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Being a milodan means putting yourself above all others. If I can’t beat you in a fight, [pc.name] Steele, and you want something from me, then I’ll do what I can to make it worth it to me.” He swings the pick once, and immediately a chunk of the wall falls to his feet. “Besides, the food the korgonne give us is tasteless and paltry. I’ll take this opportunity to get a decent meal out of it.”"

rows.original: He doesn’t say anything more. If you want a real conversation out of him, you’ll need to bring him some more exotic food.
rows.translation: 他没再说什么。如果你想跟他有场真正的交谈，得给他带些更稀奇的食物。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe doesn’t say anything more. If you want a real conversation out of him, you’ll need to bring him some more exotic food."

rows.original: You also make a mental note to be more careful with your questions, so you never have to deal with this again...
rows.translation: 你也在心里记下一笔：以后提问得更加谨慎，免得再次处理这种事……
rows.raw: "\n\nYou also make a mental note to be more careful with your questions, so you never have to deal with this again..."

rows.original: EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS
rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.original: As you reach into your pack for the
rows.translation: 当你伸手进背包去拿那
rows.raw: "As you reach into your pack for the "

rows.original: you got for Eitan, you bitterly think to yourself about the efforts you’re going through to try and find a middle-ground between the milodan and the korgonne.
rows.translation: 你为埃坦弄来的那东西，你苦涩地暗自想着自己为了在米洛丹和科尔贡之间找出折中点所费的力气。
rows.raw: " you got for Eitan, you bitterly think to yourself about the efforts you’re going through to try and find a middle-ground between the milodan and the korgonne."

rows.original: On the one hand, Eitan is just hungry, and he’s only doing what he thinks is a free meal ticket for the least amount of work. But still, you can’t say you enjoy being taken advantage of like that.
rows.translation: 一方面，埃坦只是饿了，而且只是把这看作一张付出最少劳动就能免费吃饭的饭票。但即便如此，你也不能说自己喜欢被这样占便宜。
rows.raw: " On the one hand, Eitan is just hungry, and he’s only doing what he thinks is a free meal ticket for the least amount of work. But still, you can’t say you enjoy being taken advantage of like that."

rows.original: You’re just trying to help, and Eitan is deliberately being difficult. You’re going to be very careful with how you phrase anything you say up to your next question.
rows.translation: 你只是想帮忙，埃坦却故意为难你。在提出下一个问题前，你会极其谨慎地斟酌每一句话。
rows.raw: " You’re just trying to help, and Eitan is deliberately being difficult. You’re going to be very careful with how you phrase anything you say up to your next question."

rows.original: You darkly fantasize about him choking on it. Surely the next alpha in line wouldn’t be as difficult.
rows.translation: 你阴暗地幻想他被它呛住的样子。下一个排队的阿尔法肯定没这么难搞。
rows.raw: " You darkly fantasize about him choking on it. Surely the next alpha in line wouldn’t be as difficult."

rows.original: Once again, Eitan eats the entire thing, leaving nothing behind to discard. He sighs through his nose as he wipes his mouth with the back of his naked, dirty arm again.
rows.translation: 埃坦再次把整个东西吃得一干二净，没留下任何需要丢弃的部分。他又用肮脏裸臂的手背擦嘴，从鼻中呼出一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce again, Eitan eats the entire thing, leaving nothing behind to discard. He sighs through his nose as he wipes his mouth with the back of his naked, dirty arm again."

rows.original: “Now,” he says, his tongue licking a long, wide strand across his lips and sabre teeth, “I’m sure you have a much more thorough question to ask me this time, [pc.name] Steele.” He hefts the pickaxe up with one hand and slams the point into the floor, locking it in place so he can lean against its upturned handle. “Ask me.”
rows.translation: “现在，”他说着，舌头宽而长地舔过嘴唇和剑齿，“我相信这次你有个更加周全的问题要问我，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”他单手举起鹤嘴锄，把尖端砸进地板固定起来，以便靠在朝上的长柄上。“问吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now,” he says, his tongue licking a long, wide strand across his lips and sabre teeth, “I’m sure you have a much more thorough question to ask me this time, [pc.name] Steele.” He hefts the pickaxe up with one hand and slams the point into the floor, locking it in place so he can lean against its upturned handle. “Ask me.”"

rows.original: You have a handful, actually, but you only get one at a time. Whatever question you don’t think to ask will be gated behind some other demand of his.
rows.translation: 实际上你有一肚子问题，但你一次只能问一个。任何你没想到要问的问题，都会被他的其他要求挡在后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a handful, actually, but you only get one at a time. Whatever question you don’t think to ask will be gated behind some other demand of his."

rows.original: Still, you know exactly what question you want to ask this time.
rows.translation: 不过，你很清楚这次自己想问什么问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, you know exactly what question you want to ask this time."

rows.original: You give Eitan the
rows.translation: 你把这交给埃坦：
rows.raw: "You give Eitan the "

rows.original: that you had promised him, but you remind him that he promised he would only drink it when he’s not working the pickaxe. The liquid sloshes against its container noisily as Eitan handles it, flipping it top over bottom and testing its heft. You imagine he doesn’t need any instruction on how to open a bottle.
rows.translation: 那是你答应给他的，但你提醒他，他自己承诺过只在不用镐干活的时候才喝。埃坦摆弄着容器，把里面的液体晃得响亮地拍打着容器壁，把瓶子上下翻来倒去，掂着它的分量。你想他大概不需要任何人教他怎么开瓶子。
rows.raw: " that you had promised him, but you remind him that he promised he would only drink it when he’s not working the pickaxe. The liquid sloshes against its container noisily as Eitan handles it, flipping it top over bottom and testing its heft. You imagine he doesn’t need any instruction on how to open a bottle."

rows.original: “But what if I get thirsty?” Eitan asks. It’s not a serious question and you know he’s just being difficult, but you tell him again to not drink it while he’s working. The last thing anybody needs - not yourself, not himself, not his milodan companions, and not any of the korgonne - is a milodan of his size and stature, and with his emotions towards his captives, getting drunk and whipping around a pickaxe of that size.
rows.translation: “可我要是渴了怎么办？”埃坦问道。这不是个认真的问题，你知道他只是在闹别扭，但你还是又提醒了他一遍，干活的时候不许喝。任何人，你自己、他自己、他那些米洛丹同伴、还有任何一个科尔贡人，最不需要的就是一个像他这样体型、又怀着对俘虏的这般情绪的米洛丹，喝得烂醉，抡着那么大的镐子乱挥。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But what if I get thirsty?” Eitan asks. It’s not a serious question and you know he’s just being difficult, but you tell him again to not drink it while he’s working. The last thing anybody needs - not yourself, not himself, not his milodan companions, and not any of the korgonne - is a milodan of his size and stature, and with his emotions towards his captives, getting drunk and whipping around a pickaxe of that size."

rows.original: Eitan laughs at how insistent, almost panicky, you are at him not getting drunk while on the job. “Very well, [pc.name] Steele, you have my word that I will not drink this drink until after the work day is done.” He places the bottle on the floor - as far from himself as his chains will allow him to reach, so that the debris from the wall doesn’t fall onto it. “Can you promise me that it tastes better than what Pyrite gave me?”
rows.translation: 你几乎惊慌地坚持不许埃坦上工时喝醉，让他大笑起来。“很好，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我向你保证，工作结束之前不会喝这饮料。”他把瓶子放在地上——放到锁链所能触及、离自己最远的位置，免得墙上碎屑落进去。“你能保证它比派莱特给我的好喝吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan laughs at how insistent, almost panicky, you are at him not getting drunk while on the job. “Very well, [pc.name] Steele, you have my word that I will not drink this drink until after the work day is done.” He places the bottle on the floor - as far from himself as his chains will allow him to reach, so that the debris from the wall doesn’t fall onto it. “Can you promise me that it tastes better than what Pyrite gave me?”"

rows.original: Well, first of all, taste is subjective. Everybody has a different palate, especially for something as divisive as alcohol. And second, he never told you what Pyrite Industries actually gave him.
rows.translation: 首先，味觉因人而异。每个人的口味都不同，尤其是酒这种意见分歧极大的东西。其次，他从没告诉你派莱特工业究竟给了他什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, first of all, taste is subjective. Everybody has a different palate, especially for something as divisive as alcohol. And second, he never told you what Pyrite Industries actually gave him."

rows.original: “I suppose I didn’t,” he says, rubbing at his chin as he tries to remember what it was that Pyrite Industries had given him to drink. “I guess it doesn’t matter. So long as this drink relieves me of my tension, I’ll just have to put up with the flavor.” He slams his pickaxe into the ground hard enough to lodge it into place, and he leans on its upturned handle. “You may ask me your question, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “我想是没有，”他揉着下巴说，努力回想黄铁矿工业给他喝的到底是什么。“算了，反正也不重要。只要这酒能让我放松下来，味道我就忍了。”他把鹤嘴锄狠狠砸进地里，砸得牢牢卡在原地，然后靠在上翘的锄柄上。“你可以问了，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose I didn’t,” he says, rubbing at his chin as he tries to remember what it was that Pyrite Industries had given him to drink. “I guess it doesn’t matter. So long as this drink relieves me of my tension, I’ll just have to put up with the flavor.” He slams his pickaxe into the ground hard enough to lodge it into place, and he leans on its upturned handle. “You may ask me your question, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: You hand Eitan the
rows.translation: 你把这交给埃坦：
rows.raw: "You hand Eitan the "

rows.original: , just like he had asked for:
rows.translation: ，正如他所要求的：
rows.raw: ", just like he had asked for:"

rows.original: a small medipen filled with a sloshing liquid, with an opening on one side and a plunger on the other.
rows.translation: 一支装着晃荡液体的小型医疗注射笔，一端有开口，另一端有推杆。
rows.raw: " a small medipen filled with a sloshing liquid, with an opening on one side and a plunger on the other."

rows.original: “What is this?” he asks, taking the pen from your fingers gingerly. He lets it rolls from his fingers to his palm – the whole pen can’t reach across the size of his massive hand. “This doesn’t look like any medicine I’ve ever seen.”
rows.translation: “这是什么？”他问道，小心翼翼地把你指间的笔拿走。他让它从指间滚到掌心 – 整支笔还不到他那巨掌宽度的一半。“这看起来不像我见过的任何药。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What is this?” he asks, taking the pen from your fingers gingerly. He lets it rolls from his fingers to his palm – the whole pen can’t reach across the size of his massive hand. “This doesn’t look like any medicine I’ve ever seen.”"

rows.original: Considering he lives in the snowy wastes with a tribe of other technologically-lacking milodan, you’re not surprised that he was expecting a traditional mortar-and-pestle type of medicine. You explain what a medipen is and how it functions: Eitan only needs to press the opening against his skin and press the plunger. His skin will absorb the medicine and protect him from whatever disease he’s trying to avoid.
rows.translation: 考虑到他住在雪原上，跟一群同样缺乏技术的米洛丹人组成部落，他会期待那种传统研钵配研杵式的药物，你一点也不意外。你解释说医疗笔是什么、怎么用：埃坦只需要把开口按在皮肤上，按下推杆。他的皮肤会吸收药液，保护他免受他想防的那种疾病的侵害。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering he lives in the snowy wastes with a tribe of other technologically-lacking milodan, you’re not surprised that he was expecting a traditional mortar-and-pestle type of medicine. You explain what a medipen is and how it functions: Eitan only needs to press the opening against his skin and press the plunger. His skin will absorb the medicine and protect him from whatever disease he’s trying to avoid."

rows.original: Eitan hums to himself, picking up the medipen with his other hand, pinching it between two fingers. You aren’t sure what material the pen is made of, but you wouldn’t be surprised if he could snap it in half accidentally. He turns it over in his fingers twice more before following your instructions and he puts the opening of the pen against his fur.
rows.translation: 埃坦低声哼着，用另一只手拿起注射笔，夹在两根手指间。你不确定笔由什么材料制成，但即便他不小心把它折成两半，你也不会惊讶。他又在指间翻转两次，随后按你的指示，把笔的开口抵在毛发上。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums to himself, picking up the medipen with his other hand, pinching it between two fingers. You aren’t sure what material the pen is made of, but you wouldn’t be surprised if he could snap it in half accidentally. He turns it over in his fingers twice more before following your instructions and he puts the opening of the pen against his fur."

rows.original: You clarify that it needs to be against his skin, and that just putting it on his fur isn’t enough. He grunts, and does as you say, digging the pen deep into his fur until the point is right up against his skin.
rows.translation: 你澄清说，它必须贴着皮肤，仅仅放在毛上可不够。他咕哝一声，照你说的做，把注射笔深深埋进毛发，直到尖端紧贴皮肤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clarify that it needs to be against his skin, and that just putting it on his fur isn’t enough. He grunts, and does as you say, digging the pen deep into his fur until the point is right up against his skin."

rows.original: Before he presses the plunger, his eyes flit up to the milodan chain-gang, and he hesitates. His thumb hovers over the plunger, ready to press, but his mouth curls indecisively as he struggles with himself. You turn to see what he’s looking at – is he reconsidering using the medicine on himself?
rows.translation: 在按下推杆之前，他的目光飘向那群被锁链串着的米洛丹囚工，犹豫了。他的拇指悬在推杆上方，随时可以按下，但嘴角却举棋不定地扭着，像是在跟自己较劲。你顺着他视线的方向看过去 – 他是在重新考虑要不要把这药用到自己身上？
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore he presses the plunger, his eyes flit up to the milodan chain-gang, and he hesitates. His thumb hovers over the plunger, ready to press, but his mouth curls indecisively as he struggles with himself. You turn to see what he’s looking at – is he reconsidering using the medicine on himself?"

rows.original: Ultimately, he decides to go through with it, and he presses the button on the pen down. The medipen ejects the medicine onto his skin, and he flinches. “Colder than I was expecting,” he tells you. “How long do I hold it here?”
rows.translation: 最后，他决定就这么做，按下了笔上的按钮。医疗笔把药液喷到他皮肤上，他缩了一下。“比我想的要凉，”他告诉你。“我要把它按在这儿多久？”
rows.raw: "\n\nUltimately, he decides to go through with it, and he presses the button on the pen down. The medipen ejects the medicine onto his skin, and he flinches. “Colder than I was expecting,” he tells you. “How long do I hold it here?”"

rows.original: Just as he asks that, the medipen beeps. “Until now,” you say, and you extend your hand for him to give the empty pen back. At first, he goes to just toss it aside, but when he sees your extended hand, he gives you the garbage back.
rows.translation: 就在他问出这话时，医疗笔响了。“到刚才为止，”你说着，伸出手让他把那支空笔递回来。起初他只想把它丢到一边，但看到你伸着的手，他还是把那玩意儿还给了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as he asks that, the medipen beeps. “Until now,” you say, and you extend your hand for him to give the empty pen back. At first, he goes to just toss it aside, but when he sees your extended hand, he gives you the garbage back."

rows.original: a dose of modern medicine, about large enough for someone with Eitan’s frame for it to be effective. Eitan was hoping to use it to stave off disease and infection, and you promise that the
rows.translation: 一剂现代药物，剂量大到足以对埃坦这种体格的人生效。埃坦希望用它抵御疾病和感染，而你保证这
rows.raw: " a dose of modern medicine, about large enough for someone with Eitan’s frame for it to be effective. Eitan was hoping to use it to stave off disease and infection, and you promise that the "

rows.original: will get the job done.
rows.translation: 能够完成任务。
rows.raw: " will get the job done."

rows.original: He turns it over in his hand, weighing it in his palm. It’s not large enough to pool over the sides of his hand. “I’m mostly familiar with herbal medicines and poultices from my tribe,” he says. “I’m not sure what this even is.”
rows.translation: 他把那东西在手里翻过来，用掌心掂了掂。它小得甚至盖不满他的手掌。“我主要熟悉的是我们部落的草药和药膏，”他说。“我连这到底是什么都不确定。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe turns it over in his hand, weighing it in his palm. It’s not large enough to pool over the sides of his hand. “I’m mostly familiar with herbal medicines and poultices from my tribe,” he says. “I’m not sure what this even is.”"

rows.original: In your culture, medicines can take many shapes and come in many forms. The most common that anyone can purchase are tablets or pills that are meant to be swallowed, but they can come in the form of liquid injections, or patches placed on the skin, or even inhaled and exhaled.
rows.translation: 在你的文化里，药物有各种形态与形式。任何人都能买到的最常见种类，是用于吞咽的药片或药丸，但它们也可以是液体注射剂、贴在皮肤上的贴片，甚至可以吸入再呼出。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn your culture, medicines can take many shapes and come in many forms. The most common that anyone can purchase are tablets or pills that are meant to be swallowed, but they can come in the form of liquid injections, or patches placed on the skin, or even inhaled and exhaled."

rows.original: For this medicine in particular, you explain to Eitan what it does and how he’s meant to handle it. At first, he’s hesitant - the line between medicine and poison can often be a thin one - but, owing to the progress you two have made, he follows your instructions and applies the medicine as you say.
rows.translation: 关于这种特定药物，你向埃坦解释其作用与使用方法。他起初有所迟疑——药物与毒物之间往往只有一线之隔——但鉴于你们取得的进展，他依照指示，按你说的方式使用药物。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor this medicine in particular, you explain to Eitan what it does and how he’s meant to handle it. At first, he’s hesitant - the line between medicine and poison can often be a thin one - but, owing to the progress you two have made, he follows your instructions and applies the medicine as you say."

rows.original: “In any other position, [pc.name] Steele, I wouldn’t have trusted that what I just took was medicine. For all I know, it could be some magic brew that’ll transform me into you.”
rows.translation: “若是处在别的境地，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我绝不会相信刚才服下的是药。就我所知，它也可能是什么魔法药剂，会把我变成你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In any other position, [pc.name] Steele, I wouldn’t have trusted that what I just took was medicine. For all I know, it could be some magic brew that’ll transform me into you.”"

rows.original: You muse to yourself that you suppose his worries aren’t entirely unfounded in today’s day and age.
rows.translation: 你暗自想着，在如今这世道，他的担忧倒也并非完全没有根据。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou muse to yourself that you suppose his worries aren’t entirely unfounded in today’s day and age."

rows.original: “We’ll see if this medicine of yours makes me sicker than any disease,” he says as he leans onto his overturned pickaxe. “I suppose I’ll have to trust that your word is true. And if that’s the case, then I owe you another conversation.”
rows.translation: “看看你的药会不会让我病得比任何疾病都重吧，”他靠在倒置的鹤嘴锄上说道。“看来我只能相信你说的是真话。若确实如此，那我又欠你一次谈话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ll see if this medicine of yours makes me sicker than any disease,” he says as he leans onto his overturned pickaxe. “I suppose I’ll have to trust that your word is true. And if that’s the case, then I owe you another conversation.”"

rows.original: At that moment, the missing milodan from earlier is escorted back down from the outside. It was only a few moments outdoors, but he looks more energetic than some of his dirtier inmates. And once he’s chained back in, the milodan to his right is unchained and escorted out, continuing the cycle.
rows.translation: 就在这时，刚才不见了的那个米洛丹人被从外面押了回来。他在外头只待了一小会儿，但看上去比一些更脏的囚犯还有精神。等他重新被锁回去，他右边的米洛丹人就被解开锁链、押了出去，如此循环继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that moment, the missing milodan from earlier is escorted back down from the outside. It was only a few moments outdoors, but he looks more energetic than some of his dirtier inmates. And once he’s chained back in, the milodan to his right is unchained and escorted out, continuing the cycle."

rows.raw: "After clearing your throat, you inform Ula that you have a favor to ask of her, related to your self-appointed reformation project."

rows.original: You grin right back, explaining that while Eitan was standoffish at first, he’s been more and more amenable to talking with you over you time. Not long ago, he wasn’t thinking of anything but himself and his own amusement, yet now you’ve gotten him to think of someone besides himself for a change. He asked for medicine for his people, and to allow them a little time on the surface each day for fresh air.
rows.translation: 你也朝她咧嘴一笑，解释道：埃坦起初虽然冷淡，但随着时间推移，他越来越愿意与你交谈。不久前，他脑中除了自己和自己的乐子外什么都没有，可如今你终于让他换个方式，开始考虑自己以外的人。他为族人索要药物，还希望允许他们每天在地表待一小会儿，呼吸新鲜空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grin right back, explaining that while Eitan was standoffish at first, he’s been more and more amenable to talking with you over you time. Not long ago, he wasn’t thinking of anything but himself and his own amusement, yet now you’ve gotten him to think of someone besides himself for a change. He asked for medicine for his people, and to allow them a little time on the surface each day for fresh air."

rows.original: “No.” Ula’s response is fast and frank. “
rows.translation: “不。”乌拉的回答又快又直白。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“No.” Ula’s response is fast and frank. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Leaving the door open all day, sending the cat-dogs in and out one at a time... it would leave us so vulnerable. We are not so strong as to reveal ourselves to the world at all times."
                : "Having secret door opening all day, sending cat-dogs in and out one at time. Korg’ii Hold not strong enough for reveal self to rest of world all times."

rows.original: Leaving the door open all day, sending the cat-dogs in and out one at a time... it would leave us so vulnerable. We are not so strong as to reveal ourselves to the world at all times.
rows.translation: 整天敞着门，让猫狗们一个一个地进进出出...那会让我们多么脆弱。我们还没强大到可以时时刻刻向世界暴露自己。
rows.raw: "Leaving the door open all day, sending the cat-dogs in and out one at a time... it would leave us so vulnerable. We are not so strong as to reveal ourselves to the world at all times."

rows.translation: 整天开着密门，让猫狗一只一只地进出。科尔吉要塞不够强，不能一直向世界暴露自己。
rows.raw: "Having secret door opening all day, sending cat-dogs in and out one at time. Korg’ii Hold not strong enough for reveal self to rest of world all times."

rows.original: ” She must see the crestfallen look on your face, because stretches out from her throne to ruffle your hair, giggling softly. “
rows.translation: ” 她一定是看到了你脸上沮丧的神情，因为她从王座上探身过来揉乱你的头发，轻声笑着。“
rows.raw: "” She must see the crestfallen look on your face, because stretches out from her throne to ruffle your hair, giggling softly. “"

                ? "Don’t worry. There are small openings higher up in the hold. Aliens call them... balconies? Like balconies. The Milodans can go there if they need sun for their health"
                : "Not worry. Small openings higher up in hold. Alien have word for... balcony? Like balcony. Milodan can go there for sunning, if need sunning for health."

rows.original: Don’t worry. There are small openings higher up in the hold. Aliens call them... balconies? Like balconies. The Milodans can go there if they need sun for their health
rows.translation: 别担心。据点高处有一些小开口。外星人管它们叫...阳台？类似阳台吧。米洛丹人需要晒太阳保持健康时，可以去那里

rows.original: That... sounds like an agreeable compromise, and you say as much.

rows.raw: "\n\nThat... sounds like an agreeable compromise, and you say as much."

rows.original: “Good.” Ula folds her stubby arms across her sizeable chest. “
rows.translation: “很好。”乌拉把短粗手臂交叉在丰满胸前。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good.” Ula folds her stubby arms across her sizeable chest. “"

korgiTranslate()
                ? "The milodans should be thankful I’m so charitable."

rows.original: Milos be thanking-full Ula have such charity.

rows.original: You thank Ula for it. It’ll definitely get you some points with Eitan – he’s really been listening to you lately.
rows.translation: 你为此感谢乌拉。这肯定能让你在埃坦那里加点分 – 他最近真的很听你的话。

rows.original: Eitan holds his status as the Alpha of the milodan above everything else, and he’s come to rely on – and abuse – all the amenities that includes. You haven’t convinced him to not covet all those things, but he did promise to reconsider his actions as the milodan’s role model.
rows.translation: 埃坦把米洛丹首领的地位置于一切之上，并逐渐依赖——乃至滥用——这一身份附带的所有便利。你没能说服他停止渴望那些东西，但他确实答应重新审视自己身为米洛丹榜样的行为。
rows.raw: "Eitan holds his status as the Alpha of the milodan above everything else, and he’s come to rely on – and abuse – all the amenities that includes. You haven’t convinced him to not covet all those things, but he did promise to reconsider his actions as the milodan’s role model."

rows.original: Eitan is under the impression that the elders of his tribe were against getting help from outsiders like yourself, because it risked diluting their culture and way of life, but it turned out that he had never had a real sit-down with them to discuss the future of his kind. You’ve convinced him to at least give it a try, starting with his fellow prisoners.
rows.translation: 埃坦一直以为，部落里的长老们反对接受像你这样的外来者的帮助，因为那有稀释他们文化和生活方式的风险，但结果他从未真正坐下来和他们讨论过自己族群的未来。你已说服他至少试一试，从他那些囚犯同伴开始。

rows.original: Eitan truly wants peace between the korgonne and the milodan, but before you had spoken to him, he thought it was only possible via extermination. He said himself that he has a lifetime’s worth of anger and grief to work through, but give him some time, and he may reconsider that peace is possible without any more bloodshed.
rows.translation: 埃坦真心希望科尔贡与米洛丹之间实现和平，但在你与他交谈前，他以为唯有灭绝一方才能做到。他亲口说，自己有一生积累的愤怒与悲痛需要消化；给他一点时间，他也许会重新考虑，承认和平无需更多流血也能实现。

rows.original: Eitan’s father was the tribe’s caregiver; he has two sisters, each of them in a different tribe; and his mother, Edrei, was the Alpha of his tribe before him. She was well-beloved by all, and Eitan grew to resent her reputation, thinking that he couldn’t possibly match it, so he instead didn’t even try and abused his privileges as Alpha. You’ve convinced him to at least consider trying to behave like Edrei did.

rows.original: Eitan is the largest and the strongest of the milodan, and he commands no small amount of respect among them. You ask him how that came to be: what training regimen did he undergo? What drove him to be what he is?
rows.translation: 埃坦是米洛丹中最高大最强壮的一个，在族中享有相当高的敬意。你问他这是怎么来的：他经历过什么样的训练？是什么驱使他成为现在的样子？
rows.raw: "Eitan is the largest and the strongest of the milodan, and he commands no small amount of respect among them. You ask him how that came to be: what training regimen did he undergo? What drove him to be what he is?"

rows.original: “My body was forged from combat,” he explains, pointing at various spots on his torso and drawing line across his leg. You hadn’t noticed against his thick fur coat, but the spots he pointed to had thinner fur than the rest – they’re scars. You imagine his skin beneath his fur is pockmarked with them. “I was the biggest of the cubs of my generation. Food has been scarce all my life, and when you’re hungry, you fight, and if you want to win, you must be strong.”
rows.translation: “我的身体由战斗锻造而成，”他解释着，指向躯干各处，又沿腿划出一道线。隔着厚重毛皮，你之前没注意到那些位置的毛比别处更稀薄——那都是伤疤。你猜毛皮下的皮肤已经遍布疤痕。“我是同代幼崽中最大的。食物在我的一生中始终稀缺；饥饿时就要战斗，想获胜就必须强壮。”

You imagine his skin beneath his fur is pockmarked with them. “I was the biggest of the cubs of my generation. Food has been scarce all my life, and when you’re hungry, you fight, and if you want to win, you must be strong.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYou note that he makes it sound as though all he did was fight. It must have been a difficult life, all through adolescence."

rows.original: “I’d hunt, of course. There is no wild animal that I can’t overpower, save for a Frostwyrm. If ever there was large game to be hunted near our tribe, I would hunt it – and I would get the biggest haul of it.”
rows.translation: “我当然会狩猎。除了霜龙，没有任何野兽是我无法制服的。只要部落附近有大型猎物，我就会猎杀它——而且拿走最多的收获。”

rows.original: “I have the largest form, [pc.name] Steele, and I need the most food. If any milodan wanted more than their share, they would have to earn it from me. Since being named the Alpha of my tribe, I have had my share of challengers for any number of reasons, whether for the title and the ego that comes with it, or for the food, or the right to any of the bodies in the tribe – and they have all failed against me.”
rows.translation: “我的体型最大，[pc.name] 斯蒂尔，所以我也需要最多的食物。如果有哪个米洛丹想要多过自己那一份，就得从我这里挣到。自从被推举为部落的阿尔法以来，我应付过不少挑战者，理由五花八门，有的是为了这个名号和随之而来的自尊，有的是为了食物，有的是为了部落里任何一具身体的所有权 – 而他们全都在我面前败了。”

Since being named the Alpha of my tribe, I have had my share of challengers for any number of reasons, whether for the title and the ego that comes with it, or for the food, or the right to any of the bodies in the tribe – and they have all failed against me.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe milodan chain-gang behind you slowly stop their mining, one by one, each of them taken by surprise at your assertion."

rows.original: “The circumstances were unfair,” he counters, his tone suddenly serious and dire.
rows.translation: “当时的条件并不公平，”他反驳道，语气忽然变得严肃而危险。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The circumstances were unfair,” he counters, his tone suddenly serious and dire."

rows.original: Correct, they were – it was him and one of his buddies versus just you. It was two-on-one, and you still won.
rows.translation: 没错，确实不公平——当时是他和一个同伴对付你一人。二对一，而你仍然赢了。
rows.raw: "\n\nCorrect, they were – it was him and one of his buddies versus just you. It was two-on-one, and you still won."

rows.original: His lip curls on the side of his mouth, showing you his jagged, clenched teeth, and he sighs in frustration. There’s a truth to what you say, and they all know it. If you truly wanted to assert yourself as the Alpha of the milodan, Eitan would have no choice but to abdicate.
rows.translation: 他一侧嘴唇卷起，露出紧咬的参差利齿，懊恼地叹了口气。你的话确有道理，而所有人都清楚。如果你真想宣告自己是米洛丹人的阿尔法，艾坦便别无选择，只能退位。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis lip curls on the side of his mouth, showing you his jagged, clenched teeth, and he sighs in frustration. There’s a truth to what you say, and they all know it. If you truly wanted to assert yourself as the Alpha of the milodan, Eitan would have no choice but to abdicate."

rows.original: You confirm (without phrasing it as a question) to Eitan that, if indeed you were to be named Alpha, as would be your right, then his body would be yours to mate with, whether he consented or not. It would be an awfully far way for someone like him to fall, after his boasting about having a ‘body forged from combat.’
rows.translation: 你向艾坦确认——并没有把话说成疑问——如果你确实依照自身权利被尊为阿尔法，那么无论他是否同意，他的身体都将属于你，任你交配。他曾夸耀自己拥有‘由战斗锻造的身体’，如今若跌落到这般境地，落差可真够大的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou confirm (without phrasing it as a question) to Eitan that, if indeed you were to be named Alpha, as would be your right, then his body would be yours to mate with, whether he consented or not. It would be an awfully far way for someone like him to fall, after his boasting about having a ‘body forged from combat.’"

rows.original: You stare at each other, and you feel as though you’re in combat with a tiger, locked in a zoo’s cage. Any sudden movement you make would probably make Eitan lash out at you, and you’re not so sure that his harness made of chains would totally stop him. His title as Alpha means everything to him, and you could take it all – to add insult to his injury of being made a prisoner in his enemy’s home.
rows.translation: 你们彼此凝视，令你感觉自己正和一头老虎战斗，被一同锁在动物园的笼子里。你的任何突然动作大概都会引得艾坦向你扑来，而你不太确定他身上那副锁链束具真能完全拦住他。阿尔法头衔对他而言就是一切，而你可以夺走全部——更是在他沦为敌人故乡阶下囚的伤口上撒盐。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at each other, and you feel as though you’re in combat with a tiger, locked in a zoo’s cage. Any sudden movement you make would probably make Eitan lash out at you, and you’re not so sure that his harness made of chains would totally stop him. His title as Alpha means everything to him, and you could take it all – to add insult to his injury of being made a prisoner in his enemy’s home."

rows.original: You assuage Eitan by telling him that you don’t intend to take his title as Alpha from him. It belongs to him.
rows.translation: 你安抚艾坦，告诉他你不打算夺走他的阿尔法头衔。那属于他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assuage Eitan by telling him that you don’t intend to take his title as Alpha from him. It belongs to him."

rows.original: He, however, isn’t totally convinced, you can tell. Not that you won’t take his title, but that it still belongs to him. You had earned it. He would never admit it, of course, but it’s obvious to you, and to him, and to every milodan in the mine.
rows.translation: 不过你看得出来，他并未完全信服。不是不相信你不会夺走头衔，而是不相信头衔仍属于他。你确实赢得了它。当然，他永远不会承认，可你、他以及矿井里的每个米洛丹人都心知肚明。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe, however, isn’t totally convinced, you can tell. Not that you won’t take his title, but that it still belongs to him. You had earned it. He would never admit it, of course, but it’s obvious to you, and to him, and to every milodan in the mine."

rows.original: You explain to Eitan that as much as it would be your right, you believe that a person’s autonomy is something that should never be infringed upon. You can’t just impose yourself onto others just because you’re strong enough that nobody can say ‘no’ to you. When you defeated him in combat, he was in a vulnerable enough state that you could have taken advantage of him, but you didn’t. From his attitude, you doubt he would’ve done the same if he won instead.
rows.translation: 你向艾坦解释，尽管你确实有这项权利，但你认为任何人的自主权都绝不应受到侵犯。不能仅仅因为自己强大到没人敢说‘不’，便把自己强加给别人。你在战斗中击败他时，他处于足够脆弱的状态，你本可以趁人之危，却没有这样做。从他的态度来看，如果获胜的是他，你怀疑他绝不会作出同样选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain to Eitan that as much as it would be your right, you believe that a person’s autonomy is something that should never be infringed upon. You can’t just impose yourself onto others just because you’re strong enough that nobody can say ‘no’ to you. When you defeated him in combat, he was in a vulnerable enough state that you could have taken advantage of him, but you didn’t. From his attitude, you doubt he would’ve done the same if he won instead."

rows.original: As the Alpha of the milodan, he should be an example for the others to aspire to, and him shoving his dick into any nearby hole, whether they want it or not, will only inspire others to do unto him as he does unto them. You beat him in a fight and you’re giving him his autonomy – you warn that, one day, he’s going to lose another fight, and if he doesn’t change his attitude, his opponent won’t extend the same mercy.
rows.translation: 作为米洛丹人的首领，他本该是其他人仰慕的榜样，而他只要见到个洞就把鸡巴塞进去、也不管对方愿不愿意，这只会让其他人有样学样，对他做他做过的事。你在打斗中赢了他，还给了他自主权 – 你警告他，总有一天他会在另一场打斗中落败，而如果他不改变态度，他的对手可不会给予同样的宽恕。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the Alpha of the milodan, he should be an example for the others to aspire to, and him shoving his dick into any nearby hole, whether they want it or not, will only inspire others to do unto him as he does unto them. You beat him in a fight and you’re giving him his autonomy – you warn that, one day, he’s going to lose another fight, and if he doesn’t change his attitude, his opponent won’t extend the same mercy."

rows.original: Eitan’s mouth uncurls, and his face is turned downward in thought. You’ve struck a chord with him: his eyes narrow and his chews at nothing as he stirs on your words. “It’s my right,” he whispers to himself, but he crooks his head to one side, unsure if he believes his own words.
rows.translation: 艾坦卷起的嘴唇松弛下来，低着脸陷入思考。你的话触动了他：他眯起眼睛，空嚼着嘴，反复琢磨你的说辞。“这是我的权利，”他低声自语，却又把头歪向一边，似乎不确定自己是否相信这句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s mouth uncurls, and his face is turned downward in thought. You’ve struck a chord with him: his eyes narrow and his chews at nothing as he stirs on your words. “It’s my right,” he whispers to himself, but he crooks his head to one side, unsure if he believes his own words."

rows.original: Before you let the conversation end, you continue that that way of thinking extends beyond just mating with whoever, whenever: it also applies to the other privileges he has as Alpha, including sharing the food. To his credit, he’s right when he says that his bigger body needs more food, but being altruistic with what meagre catches are available will go a further way with his respect among the milodan than hoarding an unfair share just because he can.
rows.translation: 在谈话结束前，你继续说明，这种思维方式不只适用于随时和任何对象交配，也适用于他作为阿尔法享有的其他特权，包括食物分配。公平地说，他声称庞大身体需要更多食物确实没错；然而面对数量微薄的猎物时，展现无私远比仅仅因为有能力便囤积不公平的份额，更能赢得米洛丹人的尊敬。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you let the conversation end, you continue that that way of thinking extends beyond just mating with whoever, whenever: it also applies to the other privileges he has as Alpha, including sharing the food. To his credit, he’s right when he says that his bigger body needs more food, but being altruistic with what meagre catches are available will go a further way with his respect among the milodan than hoarding an unfair share just because he can."

rows.original: Eitan takes a deep breath, sighing through his nose. “This is how we have done it since the milodan first came to be, [pc.name] Steele. The Alpha having first and last say in all matters has been how we have done it since well before I was a cub.”
rows.translation: 艾坦深吸一口气，从鼻中叹息。“自米洛丹人诞生以来，我们一直如此行事，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。早在我还是幼崽之前，一切事务都由阿尔法作出最先和最终决定，这就是我们的做法。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan takes a deep breath, sighing through his nose. “This is how we have done it since the milodan first came to be, [pc.name] Steele. The Alpha having first and last say in all matters has been how we have done it since well before I was a cub.”"

rows.original: It may have started before him, but it can end with him. He is the Alpha of the milodan. He can decide where the Alpha’s privileges begin and end from his generation onward, and he can make the title of Alpha something to respect rather than fear.
rows.translation: 这一切或许在他之前就开始了，但可以结束在他手里。他是米洛丹人的阿尔法。他可以决定从自己这一代起，阿尔法的特权从何处开始、到何处为止，也可以让“阿尔法”这个称号成为值得敬重而非恐惧的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt may have started before him, but it can end with him. He is the Alpha of the milodan. He can decide where the Alpha’s privileges begin and end from his generation onward, and he can make the title of Alpha something to respect rather than fear."

rows.original: He laughs to himself, once, under his breath, almost like a hiccup. “I will admit that you have given me much to think about, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “But I cannot and I will not promise anything. You can’t ask the Alpha of the milodan to gut the rights of the Alpha of the milodan and expect him to agree on the spot.”
rows.translation: 他低声独自笑了一下，几乎像是打嗝。“我承认，你让我有许多事情需要思考，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说道。“但我不能、也不会作出任何承诺。你不能要求米洛丹人的阿尔法剥夺米洛丹阿尔法的权利，还指望他当场答应。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe laughs to himself, once, under his breath, almost like a hiccup. “I will admit that you have given me much to think about, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “But I cannot and I will not promise anything. You can’t ask the Alpha of the milodan to gut the rights of the Alpha of the milodan and expect him to agree on the spot.”"

rows.original: You concede that you can’t, but as long as he’s got something to think about while he picks away at that mine, you’ll be satisfied.
rows.translation: 你承认确实不能；不过只要他在矿井里挥镐时有事情可以思考，你便满足了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou concede that you can’t, but as long as he’s got something to think about while he picks away at that mine, you’ll be satisfied."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You haven’t had the pleasure of interacting with the milodan outside of Uveto
rows.translation: 你还没在乌维托之外与米洛丹人打过交道的荣幸
rows.raw: "You haven’t had the pleasure of interacting with the milodan outside of Uveto"

rows.original: ICEQUEEN COMPLETE
rows.raw: "ICEQUEEN COMPLETE"

rows.original: ICEQUEEN COMPLETE
rows.raw: "ICEQUEEN COMPLETE"

rows.original: --well except your encounter with Zaalt
rows.translation: ——好吧，除了你与扎尔的相遇
rows.raw: "--well except your encounter with Zaalt"

rows.original: . You understand that they’ve become a star-faring race, but he and his tribe are still here on Uveto. You ask Eitan if he could describe his race’s culture: their values; how they establish a hierarchy; why some tribes are still on Uveto; whatever he can tell you.
rows.translation: 。你知道他们已经成为一个星际航行种族，可他和自己的部落仍留在乌维托。你问艾坦能否描述一下他的种族文化：他们的价值观、如何建立等级制度、为何有些部落仍留在乌维托，以及他能告诉你的任何事情。
rows.raw: ". You understand that they’ve become a star-faring race, but he and his tribe are still here on Uveto. You ask Eitan if he could describe his race’s culture: their values; how they establish a hierarchy; why some tribes are still on Uveto; whatever he can tell you."

rows.original: Eitan doesn’t immediately answer. He scratches at his chin and his lip curls in consideration. He maintains eye contact with you, though: he hasn’t ignored your questions and he’s trying to put his thoughts to words.
rows.translation: 艾坦没有立刻回答。他挠着下巴，嘴唇因思索而卷起。不过他始终与你保持目光接触：他没有忽略你的问题，只是在努力把想法组织成语言。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan doesn’t immediately answer. He scratches at his chin and his lip curls in consideration. He maintains eye contact with you, though: he hasn’t ignored your questions and he’s trying to put his thoughts to words."

rows.original: “I feel that my species has become... segregated, over the generations,” he starts. “Centuries ago, Uveto first made contact with aliens calling themselves... the ‘Akkadi,’ if I remember right.” He crooks his head. “I’m not sure if that’s what they called themselves, actually. Oral history has a way of becoming muddied over time.”
rows.translation: “我觉得自己的种族经过一代代发展，已经变得...彼此割裂，”他开口道。“几个世纪前，乌维托首次与自称...‘阿卡迪’的外星人接触，如果我没记错的话。”他歪了歪头。“其实我不确定那是不是他们对自己的称呼。口述历史经过岁月流逝，总会变得混乱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I feel that my species has become... segregated, over the generations,” he starts. “Centuries ago, Uveto first made contact with aliens calling themselves... the ‘Akkadi,’ if I remember right.” He crooks his head. “I’m not sure if that’s what they called themselves, actually. Oral history has a way of becoming muddied over time.”"

rows.original: “Whatever, it’s not important,” he says, standing upright. “What’s important is that the milodan, from that point on, had become... apart from themselves. There were tribes that took the Akkadi up on their offers and joined them in the stars, bringing food, medicine, and tools from elsewhere in the universe. And there were tribes that remained here on Uveto, my own among them.”
rows.translation: “随便吧，这不重要，”他站直身体说道。“重要的是，从那时起，米洛丹人就变得...彼此分离。有些部落接受阿卡迪的提议，随他们前往群星，从宇宙其他地方带回食物、药品和工具。另一些部落仍留在乌维托，其中便包括我的部落。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whatever, it’s not important,” he says, standing upright. “What’s important is that the milodan, from that point on, had become... apart from themselves. There were tribes that took the Akkadi up on their offers and joined them in the stars, bringing food, medicine, and tools from elsewhere in the universe. And there were tribes that remained here on Uveto, my own among them.”"

rows.original: If you remember right, Eitan was wearing Pyrite Heavy Industries equipment during the siege of the Hold. He must not value his tribe’s traditions, if he was so willing to don their gear.
rows.translation: 如果你没记错，围攻堡垒时艾坦穿着黄铁重工的装备。如果他如此乐意穿戴他们的装备，那他一定并不看重部落传统。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you remember right, Eitan was wearing Pyrite Heavy Industries equipment during the siege of the Hold. He must not value his tribe’s traditions, if he was so willing to don their gear."

rows.original: “I am no fool, [pc.name] Steele,” he says coldly. “The patriarch of my tribe would see us fester on the frozen coasts in those huts made of ice. I was fed stories all my life of other milodan that had left our ‘ancestral home’ for another life beyond Uveto.” The corners of his lips curl inward, showing the glint of his sharp teeth in what little light there was in the prison. “When I was given my chance to leave this frozen hell behind me, I seized it. All I had to do was take the Korg’ii Hold and end the war between us so that I could sell the Hold and the land around it to Pyrite, and I would be given all the means I’d need to leave Uveto behind me forever.”
rows.translation: “我不是傻瓜，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他冷冷说道。“我的部落族长愿意看着我们在冰冻海岸上、那些冰块搭成的茅屋里腐烂。我从小听着其他米洛丹人的故事长大；他们离开我们的‘祖先故乡’，前往乌维托之外追求另一种生活。”他嘴角向内卷起，在监狱微弱的光线中露出尖牙寒芒。“当我得到机会摆脱这片冰冻地狱时，我抓住了它。我只需攻下科尔格堡垒，结束我们之间的战争，以便把堡垒和周围土地卖给黄铁重工；作为交换，我会得到永远离开乌维托所需的一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am no fool, [pc.name] Steele,” he says coldly. “The patriarch of my tribe would see us fester on the frozen coasts in those huts made of ice. I was fed stories all my life of other milodan that had left our ‘ancestral home’ for another life beyond Uveto.” The corners of his lips curl inward, showing the glint of his sharp teeth in what little light there was in the prison. “When I was given my chance to leave this frozen hell behind me, I seized it. All I had to do was take the Korg’ii Hold and end the war between us so that I could sell the Hold and the land around it to Pyrite, and I would be given all the means I’d need to leave Uveto behind me forever.”"

rows.original: For someone that was born and raised on Uveto, he sure does hate it.
rows.translation: 对一个在乌维托出生长大的人来说，他还真是讨厌那地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor someone that was born and raised on Uveto, he sure does hate it."

rows.original: “We survive on meager hunts wearing little more than sheets around our crotches, [pc.name] Steele,” he spits. “The warmest day on Uveto is colder than the fiercest winter night from wherever you come from, not that I’ll ever know the difference now. So much as falling asleep at the wrong time could mean freezing to death. A disease could wipe out an entire tribe in the space of half a generation. The wisest men and women of my backwards tribe would rather we put up with all of that than see we become something more, like what some other milodan had accomplished.”
rows.translation: “我们穿着不过几块裹在胯间的布，依靠微薄猎获生存，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他啐道。“乌维托最温暖的日子，也比你故乡最猛烈的冬夜更冷，不过如今我永远都不会知道两者差异。仅仅在错误的时间睡着，就可能被冻死。一场疾病能在不到半代人的时间里消灭整个部落。我那落后部落中最有智慧的男女，宁愿让我们忍受这一切，也不愿看见我们变得更好，像其他一些米洛丹人已经做到的那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We survive on meager hunts wearing little more than sheets around our crotches, [pc.name] Steele,” he spits. “The warmest day on Uveto is colder than the fiercest winter night from wherever you come from, not that I’ll ever know the difference now. So much as falling asleep at the wrong time could mean freezing to death. A disease could wipe out an entire tribe in the space of half a generation. The wisest men and women of my backwards tribe would rather we put up with all of that than see we become something more, like what some other milodan had accomplished.”"

rows.original: It’s clear to you that he has some strong opinions about his own culture and what some of the milodan in his tribe value. You turn your gaze to the milodan chain-gang behind you – they must all be like-minded units from his village, all vying for something better.
rows.translation: 你很清楚，他对自己的文化、以及他部落里某些米洛丹所看重的东西，有着强烈的看法。你把目光转向身后那队米洛丹囚工 – 他们一定都是他村里志同道合的家伙，全都在争取更好的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s clear to you that he has some strong opinions about his own culture and what some of the milodan in his tribe value. You turn your gaze to the milodan chain-gang behind you – they must all be like-minded units from his village, all vying for something better."

rows.original: “And look where it got us,” he scoffs. “You’re wrong anyway. Most of them are here because I told them to fight. I am the Alpha, and they will do as I say. Only a few of them think as I do.”
rows.translation: “看看这把我们带到了什么境地，”他嗤笑道。“反正你错了。他们多数在这里，是因为我命令他们战斗。我是阿尔法，他们会照我说的做。只有少数人与我想法相同。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And look where it got us,” he scoffs. “You’re wrong anyway. Most of them are here because I told them to fight. I am the Alpha, and they will do as I say. Only a few of them think as I do.”"

rows.original: You hum in thought, considering what to say (without phrasing it as a question) next. Taking a chance, you speculate aloud that Eitan didn’t care about any of them, and that he was only trying to get himself off Uveto.
rows.translation: 你若有所思地哼了一声，考虑接下来该说什么，同时避免将其措辞成问题。你决定冒险一试，出声推测埃坦根本不在乎他们任何人，只想让自己离开乌维托。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hum in thought, considering what to say (without phrasing it as a question) next. Taking a chance, you speculate aloud that Eitan didn’t care about any of them, and that he was only trying to get himself off Uveto."

rows.original: He laughs at the insinuation. “I can command them to do as I say, [pc.name] Steele, but I can’t make them want what I want.” He licks his lips. “Not yet, anyway. If I could attune my mind to be like that of a Frostwyrm’s, my will would be theirs with just a thought.”
rows.translation: 他对这个暗示大笑起来。“我可以命令他们照我说的做，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，但无法让他们想要我想要的东西。”他舔舔嘴唇。“至少现在还不行。如果我能把心智调谐得像霜龙一样，只需一个念头，我的意志就会成为他们的意志。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe laughs at the insinuation. “I can command them to do as I say, [pc.name] Steele, but I can’t make them want what I want.” He licks his lips. “Not yet, anyway. If I could attune my mind to be like that of a Frostwyrm’s, my will would be theirs with just a thought.”"

rows.original: Won’t he be in for a surprise, you think to yourself. “Still.”
rows.translation: 他可有得吃惊了，你心想。 “不过。”
rows.raw: " Won’t he be in for a surprise, you think to yourself. “Still.”"

rows.original: He rubs at his chin again. “I’ve given up on trying to elevate my tribe as a whole. If they want to freeze on Uveto, they can for all I care. I am only concerned with getting myself off the planet.”
rows.translation: 他再次摩挲下巴。“我已经放弃提升整个部落。要是他们想冻死在乌维托，我根本不在乎。我唯一关心的就是让自己离开这颗星球。”
rows.raw: " He rubs at his chin again. “I’ve given up on trying to elevate my tribe as a whole. If they want to freeze on Uveto, they can for all I care. I am only concerned with getting myself off the planet.”"

rows.original: From the sounds of things, he must have thought that Pyrite Heavy Industries was his only opportunity to get off Uveto’s surface, and that he hadn’t considered alternatives.
rows.translation: 从听到的这些来看，他一定以为黄铁矿重工是他离开乌维托地表的唯一机会，而且他根本没考虑过其他出路。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the sounds of things, he must have thought that Pyrite Heavy Industries was his only opportunity to get off Uveto’s surface, and that he hadn’t considered alternatives."

rows.original: Eitan huffs through his nose, indignant at your insinuation. “Pyrite was the only one that approached my tribe. They gave me a simple task and promised a reward. The Akkadi hadn’t come. Nobody else had.”
rows.translation: 埃坦从鼻子里重重呼了口气，对你的暗示感到愤慨。“黄铁矿工业是唯一找上我们部落的。他们给了我一个简单的任务，还许诺了报酬。阿卡迪的人没来，其他人也没来。”
