rows.raw: "\n\nEitan huffs through his nose, indignant at your insinuation. “Pyrite was the only one that approached my tribe. They gave me a simple task and promised a reward. The Akkadi hadn’t come. Nobody else had.”"

rows.original: From where you’re standing, it sounds to you that Eitan had sit on his laurels in his tribe all his life until something happened to him, rather than him trying to reach out to others. If he wanted to get help from the stars, he could have tried approaching Irestead, which was a short walk south from the Korg’ii Hold, or he could have tried negotiating with the korgonne from the start.
rows.translation: 在你看来，埃坦一辈子都躺在部落中的功劳簿上，直到某件事发生在他身上，而不是主动设法接触其他人。如果想从群星间获得帮助，他本可以尝试前往科尔吉要塞南方不远处的艾尔斯泰德，或者一开始就尝试与科尔贡谈判。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom where you’re standing, it sounds to you that Eitan had sit on his laurels in his tribe all his life until something happened to him, rather than him trying to reach out to others. If he wanted to get help from the stars, he could have tried approaching Irestead, which was a short walk south from the Korg’ii Hold, or he could have tried negotiating with the korgonne from the start."

rows.original: “We are at war with the korgonne, [pc.name] Steele!” he bellows, opening his mouth wide to shout his words at you. “If there is any one sentiment I share with my tribe, it’s that I would rather be skinned alive than consort with my enemies. And approaching your [pc.race] tribe to the south? Look at me!” he shouts, standing up and beating his chest once, the chain harness clanking against itself loudly. “I tower above the average peasant in your tribe. I have teeth best used for carving flesh, and the tribal milodan of Uveto are known to be combative at best! None of your kind would approach with a kind word at any attempt!”
rows.translation: “我们与科尔贡正处于战争状态，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔！”他咆哮着张大嘴，对你吼出这番话。“如果说我和部落有什么共同想法，那就是我宁愿被活剥皮，也不愿勾结敌人。至于接近南方的[pc.race]部落？看看我！”他大喊着站起身，用力捶了一下胸膛，锁链束具彼此碰撞，发出响亮哐当声。“我比你们部落的普通平民高大得多。我长着最适合撕割血肉的牙齿，而乌维托的部落米洛丹人也以好斗著称，充其量如此！无论如何尝试，你的同族都不可能带着善意言辞接近我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We are at war with the korgonne, [pc.name] Steele!” he bellows, opening his mouth wide to shout his words at you. “If there is any one sentiment I share with my tribe, it’s that I would rather be skinned alive than consort with my enemies. And approaching your [pc.race] tribe to the south? Look at me!” he shouts, standing up and beating his chest once, the chain harness clanking against itself loudly. “I tower above the average peasant in your tribe. I have teeth best used for carving flesh, and the tribal milodan of Uveto are known to be combative at best! None of your kind would approach with a kind word at any attempt!”"

rows.original: “I did,” you say.
rows.translation: “我就这么做了，”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I did,” you say."

rows.original: “That’s a confident thing for you to say while I’m wearing this,” he says, gripping at his harness, “and only after you had defeated me in combat.”
rows.translation: “你在我戴着这个的时候说这种话可真够自信的，”他说着，抓住身上的束带，“而且还只是在战斗中打败我之后。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a confident thing for you to say while I’m wearing this,” he says, gripping at his harness, “and only after you had defeated me in combat.”"

rows.original: In your defense, he struck first. But you two are getting sidetracked. The point you’re trying to make is that you are approaching him; you are a starfarer; and you have connections. You can give Eitan what he wants.
rows.translation: 替你说句公道话，是他先动的手。不过你们俩已经跑题了。你想表达的重点是，你正在主动接近他；你是星际旅行者；而且你拥有人脉。你能给埃坦想要的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn your defense, he struck first. But you two are getting sidetracked. The point you’re trying to make is that you are approaching him; you are a starfarer; and you have connections. You can give Eitan what he wants."

rows.original: But, you continue, why stop with just Eitan? He’s made it clear what his wants are: food, clothing, medicine, and to live somewhere warm. You could arrange to have all those things for the milodan if he wanted. Pyrite only extended that offer to him, but you can do more.
rows.translation: 但你继续说道，为什么只帮助埃坦就停下？他已经明确说明自己的需求：食物、衣物、药品，以及住在温暖的地方。只要他愿意，你可以安排让所有米洛丹都得到这些东西。黄铁矿工业只向他一人提出了那个条件，但你能做得更多。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, you continue, why stop with just Eitan? He’s made it clear what his wants are: food, clothing, medicine, and to live somewhere warm. You could arrange to have all those things for the milodan if he wanted. Pyrite only extended that offer to him, but you can do more."

rows.original: “Even if you could, [pc.name] Steele, it isn’t about what I want,” he insists. “My tribe is backwards and forgotten because that’s how they like it.”
rows.translation: “即使你真能做到，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，问题也不在我想要什么，”他坚持道。“我的部落落后又被遗忘，是因为他们喜欢这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even if you could, [pc.name] Steele, it isn’t about what I want,” he insists. “My tribe is backwards and forgotten because that’s how they like it.”"

rows.original: You muse that he would only think that if he were sitting in on the meeting between Pyrite and his elders. He doesn’t answer; instead, he straightens and, for the first time since you’ve met on more amicable footing, averts his gaze. Assuming that to not be the case, then he must think that because he’s had this conversation with his elders after Pyrite Industries spoke with him privately.
rows.translation: 你思忖道，只有亲自旁听了黄铁矿工业与长老们之间的会议，他才会这么想。他没有回答，反而挺直身体；自从你们在较为友好的关系下见面以来，他第一次移开目光。假设并没有那场会议，那么他之所以如此认为，肯定是因为黄铁矿工业私下与他交谈后，他曾和长老们谈过这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou muse that he would only think that if he were sitting in on the meeting between Pyrite and his elders. He doesn’t answer; instead, he straightens and, for the first time since you’ve met on more amicable footing, averts his gaze. Assuming that to not be the case, then he must think that because he’s had this conversation with his elders after Pyrite Industries spoke with him privately."

rows.original: “Pyrite approached me alone, [pc.name] Steele,” he grumbles, barely loud enough to be heard over the milodan chain-gang. “I told them that Pyrite would give us the means to defeat the korgonne, and in exchange, we would allow Pyrite room to manufacture on their land. I kept the rewards to myself because I knew the elders, and most others, wouldn’t approve.”
rows.translation: “黄铁矿工业只找了我一人，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他咕哝道，声音几乎被米洛丹锁链劳工队的响动淹没。“我告诉他们，黄铁矿工业会给我们击败科尔贡的手段；作为交换，我们会允许黄铁矿工业在他们的土地上腾出空间生产。我把给自己的报酬藏了起来，因为我知道长老和其他大多数人不会赞同。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Pyrite approached me alone, [pc.name] Steele,” he grumbles, barely loud enough to be heard over the milodan chain-gang. “I told them that Pyrite would give us the means to defeat the korgonne, and in exchange, we would allow Pyrite room to manufacture on their land. I kept the rewards to myself because I knew the elders, and most others, wouldn’t approve.”"

rows.original: In that case, it sounds like a serious lack of trust and communication between him and his elders. Surely they wouldn’t turn away from the promise of a better life, including medicine to save their sick and their young. Maybe they only ‘fed’ him those stories about milodan traveling to the stars because they had given up hope that the same offer would be extended to them. Maybe they were bitter that they weren’t approached sooner, and by a kinder voice. And maybe the others in his tribe only agree with the elders because they’ve been led along all their lives too, and he’s the only one with the wherewithal to try and think differently.
rows.translation: 既然如此，他和长老之间听起来严重缺乏信任与沟通。他们肯定不会拒绝过上更好生活的承诺，其中还包括能拯救病患与幼童的药品。也许他们之所以只给他“灌输”那些米洛丹前往群星间的故事，是因为已经不再指望自己也会得到同样的邀请。也许他们怨恨没有更早受到接触，而且来者的声音也不够友善。也许部落里的其他人只是因为一生都被长老牵着走，才会赞同长老；而他是唯一具备主见、愿意尝试不同想法的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn that case, it sounds like a serious lack of trust and communication between him and his elders. Surely they wouldn’t turn away from the promise of a better life, including medicine to save their sick and their young. Maybe they only ‘fed’ him those stories about milodan traveling to the stars because they had given up hope that the same offer would be extended to them. Maybe they were bitter that they weren’t approached sooner, and by a kinder voice. And maybe the others in his tribe only agree with the elders because they’ve been led along all their lives too, and he’s the only one with the wherewithal to try and think differently."

rows.original: Eitan hums to himself, his eyes at his feet, considering your words. You end by making him a deal: if he can at least try to communicate with his fellow prisoners about the benefits of not being so insular and reaching out to a friendly hand, then, down the line, you can see about getting them the things he had asked for: more food, medicine, and maybe even a life off of Uveto.
rows.translation: 埃坦低头看着双脚，独自哼声思考你的话。最后，你向他提出一项交易：如果他至少愿意尝试与其他囚犯沟通，让他们明白不再如此封闭、向友善援手敞开心扉的好处，那么日后你可以设法替他们弄到他要求的东西：更多食物、药品，甚至可能让他们离开乌维托生活。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums to himself, his eyes at his feet, considering your words. You end by making him a deal: if he can at least try to communicate with his fellow prisoners about the benefits of not being so insular and reaching out to a friendly hand, then, down the line, you can see about getting them the things he had asked for: more food, medicine, and maybe even a life off of Uveto."

rows.original: Eitan hums to himself, then grins and laughs once. “It’s always so much easier to just tell them what to do,” he says. “If I had these things forced onto them, they would take it, whether or not they want it.”
rows.translation: 埃坦自顾自地哼着，然后咧嘴一笑，笑了一声。“直接命令他们做什么，总是轻松得多，” 他说。“如果我把这些东西硬塞给他们，不管他们想不想要，他们都会接受。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums to himself, then grins and laughs once. “It’s always so much easier to just tell them what to do,” he says. “If I had these things forced onto them, they would take it, whether or not they want it.”"

rows.original: You frown at his idea of humor.
rows.translation: 你对他所谓的幽默皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown at his idea of humor."

rows.original: “I make no promises, [pc.name] Steele. We milodan can be difficult sometimes. But,” he says, “as long as I’m wearing this–” He shrugs, making the chains on him jingle. “I suppose I have nothing to lose trying to spread the word.”
rows.translation: “我不作保证，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我们米洛丹有时很难说服。不过，”他说道，“只要我还戴着这东西。”他耸耸肩，身上的锁链叮当作响。“我想，尝试传播消息也没什么可失去的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I make no promises, [pc.name] Steele. We milodan can be difficult sometimes. But,” he says, “as long as I’m wearing this–” He shrugs, making the chains on him jingle. “I suppose I have nothing to lose trying to spread the word.”"

rows.original: Him putting in the effort is the least you can ask for.
rows.translation: 他肯花心思，这已经是你最起码能要求的了。
rows.raw: "\n\nHim putting in the effort is the least you can ask for."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to use your one question to focus on the milodan’s perspective on the war. You’ve heard the occasional story from the korgonne side; what’s the milodan’s point of view on the whole thing?
rows.translation: 你决定用唯一的问题专门询问米洛丹对战争的看法。你偶尔听过科尔贡一方的故事；米洛丹如何看待整件事？
rows.raw: "You decide to use your one question to focus on the milodan’s perspective on the war. You’ve heard the occasional story from the korgonne side; what’s the milodan’s point of view on the whole thing?"

rows.original: He chews at nothing as he considers your question. “Is that old korgonne that we ambushed in the snow still the chieftain?” he asks instead.
rows.translation: 他空嚼着，思考你的问题。“我们在雪地里伏击的那个老科尔贡人还是酋长吗？”他反而这么问。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe chews at nothing as he considers your question. “Is that old korgonne that we ambushed in the snow still the chieftain?” he asks instead."

rows.original: You tell him that he actually gave the position to his daughter after the fighting was over. He’s her advisor now.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，战斗结束后他其实把这个位置交给了自己的女儿。他现在是她的顾问。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that he actually gave the position to his daughter after the fighting was over. He’s her advisor now."

rows.original: “The war between us has been going since before his time. All I’ve ever known about the korgonne is that we’ve been fighting. It’s just a fact.”
rows.translation: “我们之间的战争在他那个时代以前就开始了。我对科尔贡唯一的了解，就是我们一直在交战。这只是个事实。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The war between us has been going since before his time. All I’ve ever known about the korgonne is that we’ve been fighting. It’s just a fact.”"

rows.original: He knows that’s not a satisfactory answer, so he continues before you interject. “I won’t pretend that the milodan are in the right. There’s hardly ever a ‘right side’ in a war, and our aggression is why we’re here in this hole in the first place. But that doesn’t excuse what the korgonne have done to us all my life.”
rows.translation: 他知道这算不上令人满意的答案，于是在你插话之前继续说了下去。“我不会假装米洛丹人站在正义一边。战争里几乎从来就没有什么‘正义一方’，而我们之所以会待在这个鬼地方，起因正是我们自己的侵略。但这也不能为科尔贡人一辈子对我们做的事开脱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe knows that’s not a satisfactory answer, so he continues before you interject. “I won’t pretend that the milodan are in the right. There’s hardly ever a ‘right side’ in a war, and our aggression is why we’re here in this hole in the first place. But that doesn’t excuse what the korgonne have done to us all my life.”"

rows.original: You muse that vengeance must have been one of his motivators for doing what he did.
rows.translation: 你思忖道，复仇肯定是驱使他采取那些行动的动机之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou muse that vengeance must have been one of his motivators for doing what he did."

rows.original: “Of course, [pc.name] Steele, but vengeance was just one.” He leans on his pickaxe, placing both hands on the butt of its handle, one on top of the other, and resting his chin on them. “Less than a generation ago, the korgonne had negotiated a ceasefire when their chief offered to surrender himself to us.”
rows.translation: “当然，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，但复仇只是其中一个。”他靠在镐头上，双手一上一下放在握柄末端，下巴搁在手背上。“不到一代人以前，科尔贡首领提出向我们投降，随后科尔贡与我们谈成了停火。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, [pc.name] Steele, but vengeance was just one.” He leans on his pickaxe, placing both hands on the butt of its handle, one on top of the other, and resting his chin on them. “Less than a generation ago, the korgonne had negotiated a ceasefire when their chief offered to surrender himself to us.”"

rows.original: “Surely,” you muse, as a sign of good faith, the milodan kept him around rather than execute him.
rows.translation: “想必，”你思忖着，作为善意的表示，米洛丹人留他一命而不是处死他。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Surely,” you muse, as a sign of good faith, the milodan kept him around rather than execute him."

rows.original: “The trade wasn’t made with my tribe, so I wouldn’t know. I’d like to learn what we did with him just as badly as you, I think. Maybe not for the same reasons, though.” He straightens his back and keeps a smooth face, preventing you from getting a good read on what he means. “We went from out-and-out war with each other to petty skirmishes between single korgonne and milodan out in the snow. And that’s how it stayed for most of my life, well after I was made Alpha, and well before,” he pauses, glancing towards the milodan chain-gang, “this.”
rows.translation: “那场交易并非与我的部落达成，所以我不知情。我想和你一样迫切地了解我们如何处置了他，不过原因或许不同。”他挺直后背，保持平静表情，让你无法看透话中深意。“我们从彼此全面开战，变成单个科尔贡与米洛丹在雪地中发生小规模冲突。在我的大半生里，情况一直如此；那远在我成为阿尔法之后，也远在，”他停下来，瞥向米洛丹锁链劳工队，“这一切之前。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The trade wasn’t made with my tribe, so I wouldn’t know. I’d like to learn what we did with him just as badly as you, I think. Maybe not for the same reasons, though.” He straightens his back and keeps a smooth face, preventing you from getting a good read on what he means. “We went from out-and-out war with each other to petty skirmishes between single korgonne and milodan out in the snow. And that’s how it stayed for most of my life, well after I was made Alpha, and well before,” he pauses, glancing towards the milodan chain-gang, “this.”"

rows.original: If Eitan were willing to trade that peace, however strenuous it was, you say that he must not have been very comfortable with it in the first place.
rows.translation: 你说，如果埃坦愿意拿那份和平去交易，无论它多么来之不易，那他一开始就肯定没怎么安于它。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf Eitan were willing to trade that peace, however strenuous it was, you say that he must not have been very comfortable with it in the first place."

rows.original: “I wouldn’t trust a korgonne to wash my underclothes,” he says bitterly. “We have been enemies for generations, [pc.name] Steele. I agreed to nothing, never mind some silly ceasefire. When Pyrite approached my tribe with offers of gaining the upper hand and taking their Hold for ourselves in exchange for shiny rocks that we can’t eat or use for warmth, it seemed like an obvious choice.” The corners of his lips curl into a small snarl. “We would have succeeded if it were only the korgonne we had to deal with.”
rows.translation: “我连内衣都不敢交给科尔贡清洗，”他愤恨地说道。“我们已经世代为敌，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我什么都没同意，更别提某种愚蠢停火。黄铁矿工业接触我的部落，提出帮我们占据上风、夺取他们的要塞作为自己的领地，交换条件只是我们不能吃、也无法用来取暖的亮晶晶石头；这显然是个不假思索的选择。”他的嘴角扭成轻微怒容。“如果只需对付科尔贡，我们本来已经成功了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wouldn’t trust a korgonne to wash my underclothes,” he says bitterly. “We have been enemies for generations, [pc.name] Steele. I agreed to nothing, never mind some silly ceasefire. When Pyrite approached my tribe with offers of gaining the upper hand and taking their Hold for ourselves in exchange for shiny rocks that we can’t eat or use for warmth, it seemed like an obvious choice.” The corners of his lips curl into a small snarl. “We would have succeeded if it were only the korgonne we had to deal with.”"

rows.original: So, then, it wasn’t only vengeance that motivated him, you say (without phrasing it as a question), but self-gain, and to advance a war that had been paused.
rows.translation: 那么，驱使他的动机不只是复仇，你说（没有把它说成疑问句），还有私利，以及推动一场已经暂停的战争。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, then, it wasn’t only vengeance that motivated him, you say (without phrasing it as a question), but self-gain, and to advance a war that had been paused."

rows.original: “Ask any milodan or korgonne and they would tell you that the war never ended, [pc.name] Steele. Tensions were always high between us. Fighting constantly broke out. It was just done with fewer weapons, and with... alternative wounds for the loser, let’s say.” He palms at his junk through his shoddy pants to emphasize his meaning. “I was given the chance to end it once and for all. Take their Hold; enslave every last one of them; name the milodan as the victors.”
rows.translation: “你可以问任何米洛丹或科尔贡，他们都会告诉你，战争从未结束，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我们之间的关系始终紧张，战斗不断爆发。只不过使用的武器更少，而败者会受到...换一种方式的创伤，这么说吧。”他隔着粗制裤子用手掌摸弄胯间，强调自己的意思。“我获得了一个彻底终结战争的机会。夺取他们的要塞；奴役他们每一个人；宣布米洛丹成为胜者。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ask any milodan or korgonne and they would tell you that the war never ended, [pc.name] Steele. Tensions were always high between us. Fighting constantly broke out. It was just done with fewer weapons, and with... alternative wounds for the loser, let’s say.” He palms at his junk through his shoddy pants to emphasize his meaning. “I was given the chance to end it once and for all. Take their Hold; enslave every last one of them; name the milodan as the victors.”"

rows.original: Even if he succeeded, he must have known that eventually, his own people would consider him a war criminal. He broke the ceasefire, after all.
rows.translation: 就算他成功了，他一定也知道，自己的族人最终会把他当成战争罪犯。毕竟是他破坏了停火协议。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven if he succeeded, he must have known that eventually, his own people would consider him a war criminal. He broke the ceasefire, after all."

rows.original: “I don’t care,” Eitan answers simply. “It’s war.”
rows.translation: “我不在乎，”埃坦干脆地回答。“这是战争。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t care,” Eitan answers simply. “It’s war.”"

rows.original: He’s made his views on the war itself very clear. But apparently the thought of trying to end the war peaceably had never crossed his mind, either.
rows.translation: 他对这场战争本身的看法已经说得非常清楚。但显然，试着和平结束战争这个念头也从没在他脑中闪过。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe’s made his views on the war itself very clear. But apparently the thought of trying to end the war peaceably had never crossed his mind, either."

rows.original: “Of course not. I have told you, [pc.name] Steele, I do not trust the korgonne. It doesn’t matter if they approach us, or if we approach them.”
rows.translation: “当然不。我告诉过你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我不信任科尔贡。无论是他们接近我们，还是我们接近他们，都无关紧要。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course not. I have told you, [pc.name] Steele, I do not trust the korgonne. It doesn’t matter if they approach us, or if we approach them.”"

rows.original: Eitan had told you that the ceasefire came about when a korgonne chieftain surrendered himself in exchange for the peace. That chieftain didn’t have to give himself up like that, but he did because he thought it would have been best for both races if they had stopped the bloodshed. Throwing all pretences of not guiding his statements with non-questions to the wind, you ask him if he wouldn’t have done the same if the positions were reversed.
rows.translation: 埃坦曾告诉你，停火源于一名科尔贡酋长以自己投降为条件换取和平。那名酋长并非非得如此牺牲自己，可他还是这么做了，因为他认为停止流血对两个种族都最有利。你彻底抛开不以问题引导他说辞的伪装，直接问他，假如双方立场互换，他是否也会作出相同选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan had told you that the ceasefire came about when a korgonne chieftain surrendered himself in exchange for the peace. That chieftain didn’t have to give himself up like that, but he did because he thought it would have been best for both races if they had stopped the bloodshed. Throwing all pretences of not guiding his statements with non-questions to the wind, you ask him if he wouldn’t have done the same if the positions were reversed. "

rows.original: “I would not have. I’m not stupid enough to trust my enemies like that.” He grunts at you. “And don’t think I had to answer that, [pc.name] Steele. I know what you’re doing. This conversation could have stopped whenever I wanted.”
rows.translation: “我不会那么做。我还没蠢到会那样信任敌人。”他朝你哼了一声。“而且别以为我非得回答这个问题，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我知道你在做什么。只要我想，这场谈话随时都可以停止。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I would not have. I’m not stupid enough to trust my enemies like that.” He grunts at you. “And don’t think I had to answer that, [pc.name] Steele. I know what you’re doing. This conversation could have stopped whenever I wanted.”"

rows.original: You note that, from what you’re hearing, Eitan has believed from the start that the korgonne are nothing but vile liars and warmongers. If that one chieftain was really so insincere... what was his goal? To surrender himself so that the milodan would lower their guard, a vulnerability that the korgonne never capitalized on? Eitan was the one that broke the ceasefire, not them.
rows.translation: 你指出，照你听到的说法，埃坦从一开始就认定科尔贡人全是卑劣的骗子和战争贩子。如果那位酋长真的如此虚伪...他的目的又是什么？让自己投降，好让米洛丹人放松戒备，而科尔贡人却从未利用这份破绽？打破停火协议的是埃坦，而不是他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou note that, from what you’re hearing, Eitan has believed from the start that the korgonne are nothing but vile liars and warmongers. If that one chieftain was really so insincere... what was his goal? To surrender himself so that the milodan would lower their guard, a vulnerability that the korgonne never capitalized on? Eitan was the one that broke the ceasefire, not them."

rows.original: “I don’t know, and I don’t care.” He narrows his eyes, standing steadfast against you and your logic. He’s just waiting for you to get tired and give up.
rows.translation: “我不知道，也不在乎。”他眯起眼睛，坚定地对抗着你和你那套道理。他就等着你累了、放弃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know, and I don’t care.” He narrows his eyes, standing steadfast against you and your logic. He’s just waiting for you to get tired and give up."

rows.original: You try one last thought before you leave. You ask him if he even wants peace.
rows.translation: 离开前，你最后想到一件事。你问他是否想要和平。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try one last thought before you leave. You ask him if he even wants peace."

rows.original: “I do,” he says, “but I don’t believe it’s possible as long as both races still live. We milodan have killed and kidnapped our share of korgonne over the generations, but they are no better than us. They’ve shed my people’s blood before and they’ll do it again.”
rows.translation: “我确实想，”他说，“但只要两个种族仍然都活着，我就不相信和平有可能实现。世世代代以来，我们米洛丹人杀害和绑架过不少科尔贡人，但他们也不比我们高尚。他们以前流过我族人的血，以后还会再做一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I do,” he says, “but I don’t believe it’s possible as long as both races still live. We milodan have killed and kidnapped our share of korgonne over the generations, but they are no better than us. They’ve shed my people’s blood before and they’ll do it again.”"

rows.original: Ula didn’t kill him, though. She didn’t kill any of his people.
rows.translation: 可乌拉没有杀他，也没有杀害他的任何族人。
rows.raw: "\n\nUla didn’t kill him, though. She didn’t kill any of his people."

rows.original: “That doesn’t mean anything,” he states coldly. “Just because she hasn’t, doesn’t mean she won’t.”
rows.translation: “那什么都说明不了，”他冷冷地说。“她只是还没做，不代表她不会做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That doesn’t mean anything,” he states coldly. “Just because she hasn’t, doesn’t mean she won’t.”"

rows.original: It sounds to you like Eitan is being haunted by the decisions of the generations before him. You take him at face value when he says he wants peace, but he’s so paranoid that the korgonne currently in charge is just as bloodthirsty as the leaders before her, when the last chieftain, her own father, was willing to do what his predecessor did by sacrificing himself for the greater good. The korgonne have been trying for three generations to try and establish a more permanent peace between the two factions, and Eitan destroyed all that effort by breaking the ceasefire based on what happened before he was even around to make decisions, and not based on what’s happening now.
rows.translation: 在你听来，埃坦正被前几代人的决定纠缠不休。他说自己渴望和平时，你愿意相信他；可他又偏执地认定如今掌权的科尔贡人和她之前的首领一样嗜血，哪怕上一任酋长，也就是她的亲生父亲，曾愿意效仿自己的前任，为了更大的利益牺牲自己。科尔贡人已经连续三代试图在两个阵营之间建立更持久的和平，而埃坦却依据自己出生、能作出决定之前发生的往事打破停火协议，毁掉了所有努力，而不是根据如今正在发生的事情作出选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds to you like Eitan is being haunted by the decisions of the generations before him. You take him at face value when he says he wants peace, but he’s so paranoid that the korgonne currently in charge is just as bloodthirsty as the leaders before her, when the last chieftain, her own father, was willing to do what his predecessor did by sacrificing himself for the greater good. The korgonne have been trying for three generations to try and establish a more permanent peace between the two factions, and Eitan destroyed all that effort by breaking the ceasefire based on what happened before he was even around to make decisions, and not based on what’s happening now."

rows.original: “What’s happening now, [pc.name] Steele, is that my people and I are chained to the korgonne’s mines and forced to do menial labor until we die.”
rows.translation: “如今正在发生的事，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，就是我和我的族人被锁在科尔贡人的矿井里，被迫从事苦役，直到死去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s happening now, [pc.name] Steele, is that my people and I are chained to the korgonne’s mines and forced to do menial labor until we die.”"

rows.original: You promise Eitan that, if he has the bravery to do what his predecessors couldn’t and reciprocate negotiations for peace, his fate doesn’t have to end in the korgonne mines. He doesn’t have to like it – you can’t imagine Ula would be too thrilled to sit in a room and discuss peace treaties with him either, after what had happened – but if you and her can come to an understanding, and he really wants peace, then the war can stop with his generation.
rows.translation: 你向埃坦保证，如果他有勇气去做前人未能做到的事，回应和平谈判，那么他的命运不必终结在科尔贡人的矿井里。他不必喜欢这件事；发生了那一切之后，你无法想象乌拉会有多么乐意和他坐在同一间屋里讨论和平条约。但如果你和她能达成共识，而他又真的渴望和平，那么战争就能终结在他这一代。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou promise Eitan that, if he has the bravery to do what his predecessors couldn’t and reciprocate negotiations for peace, his fate doesn’t have to end in the korgonne mines. He doesn’t have to like it – you can’t imagine Ula would be too thrilled to sit in a room and discuss peace treaties with him either, after what had happened – but if you and her can come to an understanding, and he really wants peace, then the war can stop with his generation. "

rows.original: His brow furrows, and he casts his eyes to the beaten floor between you two. A low, long, throaty, contemplative hum rumbles from his throat. “I am only Alpha of one tribe, [pc.name] Steele,” he starts–
rows.translation: 他皱起眉头，目光落到你们两人之间被踩实的地面上。一声低沉、漫长、沙哑而沉思的哼声从他喉咙里滚出。“我只是一个部落的阿尔法，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他开口道–
rows.raw: "\n\nHis brow furrows, and he casts his eyes to the beaten floor between you two. A low, long, throaty, contemplative hum rumbles from his throat. “I am only Alpha of one tribe, [pc.name] Steele,” he starts–"

rows.original: You cut him off by saying that that sounds like quitter talk, which is hardly becoming of an Alpha. And besides: he said earlier that the old korgonne chieftain gave himself to a different tribe, and he respected the ceasefire as established by them until Pyrite Industries injected themselves into the matter. There’s clearly some communication and respect going on between the milodan tribes. If he announced to all the milodan that peace had been achieved – at his hand, mind! – then they would respect his announcement in turn.
rows.translation: 你打断他，说这话听着像懦夫的腔调，可一点也不像个阿尔法该有的样子。另外还有一点：他刚才提到，那位老科尔贡酋长把自己献给了另一个部族，而他也一直尊重对方定下的停火，直到黄铁矿工业插进这件事里。米洛丹各部族之间显然有着某种沟通与尊重。如果他向全体米洛丹宣布和平已经达成 – 而且是由他亲手促成，记住了！ – 那他们也会反过来尊重他的宣告。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cut him off by saying that that sounds like quitter talk, which is hardly becoming of an Alpha. And besides: he said earlier that the old korgonne chieftain gave himself to a different tribe, and he respected the ceasefire as established by them until Pyrite Industries injected themselves into the matter. There’s clearly some communication and respect going on between the milodan tribes. If he announced to all the milodan that peace had been achieved – at his hand, mind! – then they would respect his announcement in turn."

rows.original: Eitan chews at nothing again, digesting what you’re saying. He takes a deep sigh, in and out through his nose. Peace between the korgonne and the milodan was in front of him this whole time, and he hadn’t realized it until now, too blinded by the wrongs committed in the war to see past them.
rows.translation: 埃坦又咀嚼起不存在的东西，消化着你的话。他深深叹气，用鼻子一呼一吸。科尔贡人与米洛丹人之间的和平一直摆在他面前，他直到现在才意识到；战争中犯下的错误蒙蔽了他，让他无法越过它们看清未来。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan chews at nothing again, digesting what you’re saying. He takes a deep sigh, in and out through his nose. Peace between the korgonne and the milodan was in front of him this whole time, and he hadn’t realized it until now, too blinded by the wrongs committed in the war to see past them."

rows.original: Of course, he doesn’t admit as much.
rows.translation: 当然，他并没有承认这一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, he doesn’t admit as much."

rows.original: “I have a lifetime’s worth of anger towards the korgonne to sort through, [pc.name] Steele,” he admits with a lighter tone than usual. “I will not ask for mercy, and I will not ask to negotiate. Not today. Not tomorrow.”
rows.translation: “我有整整一辈子的愤怒要对着科尔贡人清算，[pc.name]斯蒂尔，”他承认道，语气比平常轻快。“我不会求饶，也不会要求谈判。不是今天。不是明天。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have a lifetime’s worth of anger towards the korgonne to sort through, [pc.name] Steele,” he admits with a lighter tone than usual. “I will not ask for mercy, and I will not ask to negotiate. Not today. Not tomorrow.”"

rows.original: How about... after then?
rows.translation: 那么...之后呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow about... after then?"

rows.original: He takes another sigh through his nose. “We’ll see.”
rows.translation: 他又从鼻子里叹了口气。“到时再说。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe takes another sigh through his nose. “We’ll see.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: When you and Eitan first properly introduced yourself, you recall that he called himself ‘son of Laklan.’ You ask who that is – presumably it’s the name of one of his parents. What kind of milodan were they? Does he have other family?
rows.translation: 你想起你和埃坦第一次正式自我介绍的时候，他自称‘拉克兰之子’。你问那是谁 – 大概是他某位家长的名字。那是个什么样的米洛丹？他还有别的家人吗？
rows.raw: "When you and Eitan first properly introduced yourself, you recall that he called himself ‘son of Laklan.’ You ask who that is – presumably it’s the name of one of his parents. What kind of milodan were they? Does he have other family?"

rows.original: “I am the oldest of a litter of three. My two siblings, both sisters, have since moved to their own clans, and I’m unsure of what has become of them. The youngest was an excellent fisherwoman, and the next-oldest was an excellent teacher, so I’d imagine they’ve found their own places in their own tribes doing their own things.” He rubs at his chin again and a low, contemplative growl escapes his throat. “I...,” he starts, then interrupts himself. “No, it’s best I hadn’t.”
rows.translation: “我是一窝三只里最年长的。我那两个同胞都是妹妹，后来各自搬去了自己的族群，我也不清楚她们如今怎样了。最小的那个是极好的渔妇，排行第二的是极好的老师，所以我想她们都在自己的部落里找到了自己的位置，做着自己的事吧。”他又摩挲了一下下巴，喉咙里逸出一声低沉而若有所思的低吼。“我...，”他开了口，又自己打断了自己。“不，还是不说为好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am the oldest of a litter of three. My two siblings, both sisters, have since moved to their own clans, and I’m unsure of what has become of them. The youngest was an excellent fisherwoman, and the next-oldest was an excellent teacher, so I’d imagine they’ve found their own places in their own tribes doing their own things.” He rubs at his chin again and a low, contemplative growl escapes his throat. “I...,” he starts, then interrupts himself. “No, it’s best I hadn’t.”"

rows.original: You make a note to consider going back to that later.
rows.translation: 你记下这件事，打算稍后再考虑回到这个话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make a note to consider going back to that later."

rows.original: “Anyway, Laklan is my father,” he answers simply. “He was neither an alpha of the tribe, nor was he a wiseman. He was an average hunter, of average build. His contribution to my lineage and to our tribe was that he was the caretaker: he tended to the wounded; he repaired the weapons; and he prepared the kills from the hunt.”
rows.translation: “总之，拉克兰是我父亲，”他淡淡地回答。“他既不是部族的阿尔法，也不是什么智者。他只是个普通的猎人，体格也普通。他对我的血脉、对我们部族的贡献，就在于他是看护者：他照料伤员；修理武器；还把狩猎带回的猎物处理妥当。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, Laklan is my father,” he answers simply. “He was neither an alpha of the tribe, nor was he a wiseman. He was an average hunter, of average build. His contribution to my lineage and to our tribe was that he was the caretaker: he tended to the wounded; he repaired the weapons; and he prepared the kills from the hunt.”"

rows.original: That’s interesting, that Laklan is so far removed from Eitan. It’s a wonder that he announced himself as Laklan’s son.
rows.translation: 有意思，拉克兰与埃坦相差如此之远。他竟自称是拉克兰的儿子，真是奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s interesting, that Laklan is so far removed from Eitan. It’s a wonder that he announced himself as Laklan’s son."

rows.original: “Why would I not?” he asks sincerely, his voice pitching upward in surprise at the insinuation. “Caretaking is an important part of any tribe. He may not have been the strongest or most efficient hunter, but his work was vital to the survival of my tribe. If he himself were ever sick or injured, it was up to the rest of the clan to recuperate him, so that he could resume his duties to the clan.”
rows.translation: “我为什么不呢？”他诚恳地问，声音因这句暗含的意思而惊讶地拔高。“照料人是任何部落里重要的一环。他也许不是最强壮、最高效的猎人，但他的工作对我部落的存续至关重要。如果他自己病了或受了伤，就该由族里其余的人来照料他康复，好让他能重新担起对氏族的职责。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why would I not?” he asks sincerely, his voice pitching upward in surprise at the insinuation. “Caretaking is an important part of any tribe. He may not have been the strongest or most efficient hunter, but his work was vital to the survival of my tribe. If he himself were ever sick or injured, it was up to the rest of the clan to recuperate him, so that he could resume his duties to the clan.”"

rows.original: You hadn’t expected Eitan to take such a progressive stance towards his father’s position in the clan. He speaks as though he has a lot of respect for his father – as he should – but, obviously, he didn’t exactly follow in his father’s footsteps to be a tribe’s caretaker.
rows.translation: 你没料到埃坦对他父亲在部族中的地位会持这么开明的态度。他说话的样子像是很敬重他的父亲 – 这是应该的 – 但是，显然他并没有真的追随父亲的脚步，去当一个部族的看护人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hadn’t expected Eitan to take such a progressive stance towards his father’s position in the clan. He speaks as though he has a lot of respect for his father – as he should – but, obviously, he didn’t exactly follow in his father’s footsteps to be a tribe’s caretaker."

rows.original: “I did not follow in my father’s footsteps, no,” he corroborates. “I....” He winces uncharacteristically, his mouth curling into a snarl for only a moment. “I followed in my mother’s.”
rows.translation: “我没有追随我父亲的脚步，没有，”他确认道。“我....”他不寻常地皱了一下，嘴角只在一瞬间卷成龇牙的表情。“我追随的是我母亲的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I did not follow in my father’s footsteps, no,” he corroborates. “I....” He winces uncharacteristically, his mouth curling into a snarl for only a moment. “I followed in my mother’s.”"

rows.original: You tilt your head in surprise and say nothing. You don’t know how to ask him to repeat himself without phrasing it as a question.
rows.translation: 你惊讶地歪了歪头，什么也没说。你不知道该怎样让他重复一遍，又不把话说成一个问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tilt your head in surprise and say nothing. You don’t know how to ask him to repeat himself without phrasing it as a question."

rows.original: “My mother’s name was Edrei. She was the alpha to our tribe. The largest and the strongest and most beloved of them all.”
rows.translation: “我母亲名叫埃德蕾。她曾是我们部族的阿尔法，是所有人中体型最大、最强壮，也最受爱戴的那个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My mother’s name was Edrei. She was the alpha to our tribe. The largest and the strongest and most beloved of them all.”"

rows.original: You make a note of his adjective choice and to go back to it later. Instead, you wonder if the title of Alpha is hereditary, or if Eitan had to earn it from Edrei like any other milodan.
rows.translation: 你记下他选择的形容词，准备之后再回来追问。你转而思考，阿尔法的头衔是否世袭，还是埃坦也得像其他米洛丹人一样，从埃德蕾手里赢得它。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make a note of his adjective choice and to go back to it later. Instead, you wonder if the title of Alpha is hereditary, or if Eitan had to earn it from Edrei like any other milodan."

rows.original: At the non-question, Eitan’s nose curls into itself as he snarls at the memory. “An Alpha raising another Alpha isn’t unusual, and the offspring has to earn the title in combat.” He glances away, mumbling words to himself that you can’t make out. Talking about his mother is clearly a bit of a sour point for him.
rows.translation: 面对这个并非问题的说法，埃坦回想起往事，鼻子因怒吼而皱起。“由一名阿尔法抚养出另一名阿尔法并不罕见，而后代必须在战斗中赢得头衔。”他移开视线，低声自言自语着你听不清的话。谈起母亲显然会触到他的痛处。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the non-question, Eitan’s nose curls into itself as he snarls at the memory. “An Alpha raising another Alpha isn’t unusual, and the offspring has to earn the title in combat.” He glances away, mumbling words to himself that you can’t make out. Talking about his mother is clearly a bit of a sour point for him."

rows.original: You ask him to repeat himself, assuming repetition to be a freebie question.
rows.translation: 你让他再说一遍，以为重复一遍算是个免费问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him to repeat himself, assuming repetition to be a freebie question."

rows.original: “She was injured by a Frostwyrm long before I was ready to challenge her. Although she was still Alpha, she took the title of fertility priestess nearly overnight, and she was put in the rare position of being both titles at once. She wasn’t capable of combat anymore, but we still had a tradition to uphold, and she needed to abdicate her title as Alpha quickly. I,” he grimaces, but in frustration rather than shame, “slapped her once, and that was the battle. I had claimed my title from her.”
rows.translation: “早在我准备好挑战她之前，她就被一条霜龙所伤。尽管仍是阿尔法，她几乎一夜之间又接下了生育祭司的头衔，罕见地同时身负两种头衔。她已经无法战斗，但我们仍有必须维护的传统，她需要尽快让出阿尔法之位。我，”他龇牙咧嘴，但那是出于挫败，而非羞愧，“只扇了她一巴掌，战斗就结束了。我从她手里夺得了自己的头衔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She was injured by a Frostwyrm long before I was ready to challenge her. Although she was still Alpha, she took the title of fertility priestess nearly overnight, and she was put in the rare position of being both titles at once. She wasn’t capable of combat anymore, but we still had a tradition to uphold, and she needed to abdicate her title as Alpha quickly. I,” he grimaces, but in frustration rather than shame, “slapped her once, and that was the battle. I had claimed my title from her.”"

rows.original: If she was really incapable of combat herself, then it sounds to you like she just wanted her son to ascend and she took advantage of a loophole.
rows.translation: 如果她真的已经无法战斗，那么在你听来，她只是想让儿子继位，并利用了一处规则漏洞。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf she was really incapable of combat herself, then it sounds to you like she just wanted her son to ascend and she took advantage of a loophole."

rows.original: “Exactly!” Eitan bellows, extending both of his hands to you, palms up. “As Alpha, it was her responsibility to uphold the tradition of passing on the title by combat. She had abused our tribe’s systems to get out of fighting me!”
rows.translation: “正是如此！”埃坦咆哮着，向你伸出双手，掌心朝上。“作为阿尔法，她有责任维护通过战斗传承头衔的传统。她滥用了我们部族的制度，好逃避与我的战斗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly!” Eitan bellows, extending both of his hands to you, palms up. “As Alpha, it was her responsibility to uphold the tradition of passing on the title by combat. She had abused our tribe’s systems to get out of fighting me!”"

rows.original: That’s... not what you meant at all, and from the way he’s phrasing it, that’s probably not what Edrei intended when she threw the fight. You’d sooner think that she threw the fight because she wanted her son to ascend, and not so much because she was injured.
rows.translation: 这...跟你原本的意思完全不一样，而且从他说话的方式听来，这大概也不是埃德蕾故意输掉那场比赛时的本意。你更愿意相信，她故意输掉是因为想让自己的儿子晋升，而不是因为她受了伤。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... not what you meant at all, and from the way he’s phrasing it, that’s probably not what Edrei intended when she threw the fight. You’d sooner think that she threw the fight because she wanted her son to ascend, and not so much because she was injured."

rows.original: Eitan says nothing and taps his foot on the stony floor impatiently. The thought that his mother passed him the title without a fight because she loved him, and not because she was looking out for her own well-being, had crossed his mind, but he clearly doesn’t want to think of it that way.
rows.translation: 埃坦什么也没说，不耐烦地用脚点着石质地面。他曾想过，母亲毫无争斗地把头衔传给他，是因为爱他，而不是因为她只顾自己的安稳；但他显然不愿意那样去想。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan says nothing and taps his foot on the stony floor impatiently. The thought that his mother passed him the title without a fight because she loved him, and not because she was looking out for her own well-being, had crossed his mind, but he clearly doesn’t want to think of it that way."

rows.original: Going back to the earlier thought, you assume that, because she was ‘beloved by all,’ the ceremony that came with passing on the title to him must have been rather grand.
rows.translation: 回到先前的想法，你猜想，既然她‘受到所有人爱戴’，把头衔传给他的仪式想必相当隆重。
rows.raw: "\n\nGoing back to the earlier thought, you assume that, because she was ‘beloved by all,’ the ceremony that came with passing on the title to him must have been rather grand."

rows.original: “Oh yes,” he says mockingly, waving his palms and shrugging his shoulders in what can only be described as ‘aggressive indifference.’ “Every milodan in the tribe was there to congratulate Edrei on what a fine son she had raised. How they would miss her being the alpha of the tribe, and how she would make a fine priestess instead. How they knew her son Eitan would follow in her footsteps.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然，”他语带讥讽地说着，摊开手掌、耸着肩膀，那副样子只能被形容为‘咄咄逼人的漠不关心’。“部落里每一个米洛丹都在那儿，祝贺埃德蕾养出了这么个好儿子。说他们会多么怀念她当部落首领的日子，又说她改当女祭司会多么合适。说他们早就知道她儿子埃坦会追随她的脚步。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yes,” he says mockingly, waving his palms and shrugging his shoulders in what can only be described as ‘aggressive indifference.’ “Every milodan in the tribe was there to congratulate Edrei on what a fine son she had raised. How they would miss her being the alpha of the tribe, and how she would make a fine priestess instead. How they knew her son Eitan would follow in her footsteps.”"

rows.original: You take it that he wasn’t interested in doing that.
rows.translation: 你明白了，他对做那件事不感兴趣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take it that he wasn’t interested in doing that."

rows.original: “They revered her, [pc.name] Steele. Male or female, betrothed or not – going from Alpha of the tribe to priestess of the tribe has a way of giving you a reputation. One that her son couldn’t hope to match.”
rows.translation: “他们敬爱她，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。无论男女，无论有没有婚约，从部族的阿尔法变成部族的祭司，总会让一个人获得名望，一种她的儿子根本无望企及的名望。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They revered her, [pc.name] Steele. Male or female, betrothed or not – going from Alpha of the tribe to priestess of the tribe has a way of giving you a reputation. One that her son couldn’t hope to match.”"

rows.original: From the sounds of things, Eitan resents his mother for being popular, and he hasn’t been able to live up to her legacy. You doubt he’d want to be named ‘priestess’ himself, so you don’t mention it. You imply that she must have been one hell of a leader.
rows.translation: 听起来，埃坦怨恨母亲广受欢迎，而自己一直无法继承她的威望。你怀疑他不会想让别人称自己为‘祭司’，所以没有提起。你暗示她一定是位极其出色的首领。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the sounds of things, Eitan resents his mother for being popular, and he hasn’t been able to live up to her legacy. You doubt he’d want to be named ‘priestess’ himself, so you don’t mention it. You imply that she must have been one hell of a leader."

rows.original: “I could be a better one!” he shouts, the chains of his harness rattling at his booming voice. “But the milodan tribesmen and women are all too busy fawning and reminiscing and crying about ‘what could have been’ if Edrei hadn’t been injured.” He calms down and hangs his head, his hands clenching into fists over and over. “Sometimes, [pc.name] Steele,” he mutters, “it feels like I’m not the Alpha of the tribe, and I’m just a sit-in for my mother.”
rows.translation: “我能做得比她更好！”他大吼一声，束具上的链条在洪亮嗓音中哗啦作响。“可米洛丹族人们全都忙着吹捧、缅怀，还在为埃德蕾若是没有受伤，‘本来可能发生的一切’哭哭啼啼。”他平静下来，垂下脑袋，双手一次又一次攥成拳头。“有时候，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他低声说道，“我感觉自己并不是部族的阿尔法，只是母亲的临时替代者。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I could be a better one!” he shouts, the chains of his harness rattling at his booming voice. “But the milodan tribesmen and women are all too busy fawning and reminiscing and crying about ‘what could have been’ if Edrei hadn’t been injured.” He calms down and hangs his head, his hands clenching into fists over and over. “Sometimes, [pc.name] Steele,” he mutters, “it feels like I’m not the Alpha of the tribe, and I’m just a sit-in for my mother.”"

rows.original: Recognizing that Eitan is in a bit of a vulnerable state, you take the chance and ask what kind of Alpha she was. Surely there’s a reason why the tribe liked her so much.
rows.translation: 意识到埃坦正处于有些脆弱的状态，你抓住机会，询问她是怎样的阿尔法。部族如此喜爱她，肯定有其原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nRecognizing that Eitan is in a bit of a vulnerable state, you take the chance and ask what kind of Alpha she was. Surely there’s a reason why the tribe liked her so much."

rows.original: Eitan takes a deep breath through his nose as he considers even answering the question. “Compassionate,” he answers after a long moment. “Generous. She smiled a lot.”
rows.translation: 埃坦用鼻子深吸一口气，似乎在考虑要不要回答这个问题。“有同情心，”他过了好一会儿才答道。“宽厚。她经常笑。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan takes a deep breath through his nose as he considers even answering the question. “Compassionate,” he answers after a long moment. “Generous. She smiled a lot.”"

rows.original: It’s easy to see where the divide might have started, if she’s all of those things, particularly since he himself... isn’t. You suppose she wasn’t much for combat herself, despite being Alpha.
rows.translation: 如果她确实拥有所有这些品质，就很容易看出分歧可能从何处开始，尤其是他自己...并没有。你猜她本人或许也不太热衷战斗，尽管身为阿尔法。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s easy to see where the divide might have started, if she’s all of those things, particularly since he himself... isn’t. You suppose she wasn’t much for combat herself, despite being Alpha."

rows.original: “A very un-Alpha-like attitude, don’t you think?” he confirms.
rows.translation: “这态度可一点也不像阿尔法，你不觉得吗？”他确认道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A very un-Alpha-like attitude, don’t you think?” he confirms."

rows.original: So, then, the attack on the korgonne must not have been approved by her.
rows.translation: 那么，对科尔贡人的袭击一定没有得到她的批准。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, then, the attack on the korgonne must not have been approved by her."

rows.original: “It was not,” he confirms again.
rows.translation: “才不是，”他再次确认。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was not,” he confirms again."

rows.original: Clearly, the idea of trying to lead by her example had crossed his mind, and he wasn’t for it. You wonder why that might be.
rows.translation: 显然，试图像她那样以身作则的念头也曾在他脑中闪过，而他并不打算这么做。你想知道这是为什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nClearly, the idea of trying to lead by her example had crossed his mind, and he wasn’t for it. You wonder why that might be."

rows.original: “Because I don’t believe Edrei is what an Alpha should be,” he says sternly. “The Alpha of the tribe is the strongest of them all, [pc.name] Steele. Anything and everything belongs to the Alpha – it is the Alpha’s right . The Alpha shouldn’t shy from combat or challenges, and the Alpha shouldn’t give what’s theirs to anyone else. She was too soft for a leader.”
rows.translation: “因为我不认为埃德蕾符合一名阿尔法应有的样子，”他严厉地说道。“部族的阿尔法理应是所有人中最强的，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。一切事物都属于阿尔法，这是阿尔法的权利。阿尔法不该逃避战斗或挑战，也不该把自己的东西送给别人。她作为首领太软弱了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because I don’t believe Edrei is what an Alpha should be,” he says sternly. “The Alpha of the tribe is the strongest of them all, [pc.name] Steele. Anything and everything belongs to the Alpha – it is the Alpha’s right . The Alpha shouldn’t shy from combat or challenges, and the Alpha shouldn’t give what’s theirs to anyone else. She was too soft for a leader.”"

rows.original: And yet, Edrei is beloved by all in her tribe, and he’s admitted that the rest of the tribe’s attitude towards him makes his title feel hollow. Clearly, she had figured something out. You ask, if it’s adoration he wants, if he’s even tried to do what she’s done and act as a more benevolent leader.
rows.translation: 然而，埃德蕾在她的部族里深受所有人爱戴，而他也承认，部族其他人对他的态度让他觉得自己的头衔空洞无力。显然，她想通了其中的道理。你问他，如果他要的是爱戴，他有没有哪怕试过像她那样做个更仁厚的领袖。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd yet, Edrei is beloved by all in her tribe, and he’s admitted that the rest of the tribe’s attitude towards him makes his title feel hollow. Clearly, she had figured something out. You ask, if it’s adoration he wants, if he’s even tried to do what she’s done and act as a more benevolent leader."

rows.original: “I don’t need to act like Edrei does, [pc.name] Steele. I am the Alpha. The tribe will give me what I want, when I want it.”
rows.translation: “我不需要像埃德蕾那样行事，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我是阿尔法。部族会在我想要的时候，给我想要的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t need to act like Edrei does, [pc.name] Steele. I am the Alpha. The tribe will give me what I want, when I want it.”"

rows.original: That doesn’t answer your question, and he knows it.
rows.translation: 那并没有回答你的问题，而他也清楚这一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat doesn’t answer your question, and he knows it."

rows.original: He sighs through his nose. “No,” he admits.
rows.translation: 他从鼻子里叹了口气。“没有，”他承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs through his nose. “No,” he admits."

rows.original: You tell Eitan that he can have it one of two ways – either keep abusing his privileges above the other milodan as their Alpha by indiscriminately taking what doesn’t belong to him and have his reputation among his tribes-people remain as it is, or he can swallow his pride and try to be a bit more like his mother. She threw the match against him so that he could have those privileges in the first place, and if you were Edrei, you’d feel that behaving as he is would be a serious betrayal of that trust. He has a lot of animosity towards his mother and the standards she’s established, but it’s up to him whether he wants to meet those standards, even if he’ll only be able to do it by giving up the things he feels he’s earned.
rows.translation: 你告诉埃坦，他只能二选一：要么继续滥用身为阿尔法而凌驾于其他米洛丹人之上的特权，不分青红皂白地夺取不属于自己的东西，并任由自己在族人中的名声维持现状；要么就咽下骄傲，试着变得更像他的母亲。她故意输掉与他的比赛，才让他首先获得了那些特权；如果你是埃德蕾，看到他如今这般行事，一定会觉得这是对那份信任的严重背叛。他对母亲和她树立的标准怀有许多敌意，但是否愿意达到那些标准取决于他自己，哪怕为此必须放弃那些他自认为已经挣得的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Eitan that he can have it one of two ways – either keep abusing his privileges above the other milodan as their Alpha by indiscriminately taking what doesn’t belong to him and have his reputation among his tribes-people remain as it is, or he can swallow his pride and try to be a bit more like his mother. She threw the match against him so that he could have those privileges in the first place, and if you were Edrei, you’d feel that behaving as he is would be a serious betrayal of that trust. He has a lot of animosity towards his mother and the standards she’s established, but it’s up to him whether he wants to meet those standards, even if he’ll only be able to do it by giving up the things he feels he’s earned."

rows.original: Eitan’s hands have curled into fists so tight that you think his claws might dig into his palms hard enough to draw blood, if he isn’t careful. His breathing is steady, and his eyes are on you as he digests what you’ve said to him – you take the lack of any snappy comeback as a good sign, that he’s considering your words and that they’ve had a serious effect on him.
rows.translation: 埃坦的双手攥成拳头，攥得那么紧，你觉得他要是不小心，爪子可能会深陷掌心划出血来。他的呼吸平稳，眼睛盯着你，消化着你对他说的话–你把他没有立刻反驳当作好兆头，说明他在考虑你的话，而且这些话确实重重地影响了他。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s hands have curled into fists so tight that you think his claws might dig into his palms hard enough to draw blood, if he isn’t careful. His breathing is steady, and his eyes are on you as he digests what you’ve said to him – you take the lack of any snappy comeback as a good sign, that he’s considering your words and that they’ve had a serious effect on him."

rows.original: Before you leave, you want to go back to one thing he said a while ago. When he was talking about his sisters, he was about to say something, but then decided that ‘it was better that he hadn’t.’ You don’t ask him to clarify, leaving it implied between you that he should.
rows.translation: 临走之前，你想回到他刚才说过的某件事上。当他谈到他的姐妹们时，他本来要说什么，但随后又觉得‘他还是没说比较好。’你没有要求他解释清楚，只是让这层暗示留在你们之间：他应该说明。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you leave, you want to go back to one thing he said a while ago. When he was talking about his sisters, he was about to say something, but then decided that ‘it was better that he hadn’t.’ You don’t ask him to clarify, leaving it implied between you that he should."

rows.original: “I hadn’t told them about my attack on the korgonne Hold,” he says, his voice relaxing. “It was better that I hadn’t because I didn’t want them to worry, or to try and stop me, or to warn Edrei.”
rows.translation: “我没跟他们说过我袭击科尔贡要塞的事，”他说，声音松弛下来。“我没说反而更好，因为我不想让他们担心，也不想让他们试图阻止我，或者去警告埃德雷。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hadn’t told them about my attack on the korgonne Hold,” he says, his voice relaxing. “It was better that I hadn’t because I didn’t want them to worry, or to try and stop me, or to warn Edrei.”"

rows.original: You assure Eitan that he doesn’t have to try and take after Edrei right this moment, if he doesn’t want to. It’s easier said than done to swallow your pride. But leaving his sisters out of the loop and deliberately acting in a way his mother wouldn’t approve would have hurt them more than any physical thing he could do to anyone in his own tribe. Rebuilding his relationships with them would be a good start to repairing his reputation among the milodan.
rows.translation: 你向埃坦保证，如果他不愿意，现在不必立刻努力效仿埃德蕾。咽下自己的骄傲说起来容易，做起来却很难。但把姐妹们蒙在鼓里，又故意做出母亲不会赞同的事，对她们造成的伤害会超过他能施加给本族任何人的肉体伤害。重建与姐妹们的关系，会是修复他在米洛丹人中声誉的良好开端。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure Eitan that he doesn’t have to try and take after Edrei right this moment, if he doesn’t want to. It’s easier said than done to swallow your pride. But leaving his sisters out of the loop and deliberately acting in a way his mother wouldn’t approve would have hurt them more than any physical thing he could do to anyone in his own tribe. Rebuilding his relationships with them would be a good start to repairing his reputation among the milodan."

rows.original: Eitan takes another deep sigh through his nose. “I’ll think about it,” he tells you.
rows.translation: 埃坦又从鼻子里深深叹了口气。“我会考虑的，”他告诉你。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan takes another deep sigh through his nose. “I’ll think about it,” he tells you."

rows.original: It’s better than a ‘no.’
rows.translation: 至少比一句‘不’要好。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s better than a ‘no.’"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Now, if I’m not mistaken, [pc.name] Steele, I remember our agreement being that I would give you more conversation, but only if you give me anything that I ask for first.”
rows.translation: “好了，如果我没记错，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我们的约定是我会跟你多聊一些，但前提是你得先把我索要的任何东西都给我。”
rows.raw: "“Now, if I’m not mistaken, [pc.name] Steele, I remember our agreement being that I would give you more conversation, but only if you give me anything that I ask for first.”"

rows.original: You remind him – within reason. Anything he wants, within reason.
rows.translation: 你提醒他，必须合情合理。他想要什么都行，但必须合情合理。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remind him – within reason. Anything he wants, within reason."

rows.original: “Right. Within reason.” He smiles an uncomfortable, mischievous, maybe even predatory smile, showing off his massive sabre teeth. “I have just the idea.”
rows.translation: “对，合情合理。”他露出一个令人不安、顽皮，甚至也许带着掠食意味的笑容，显摆着巨大的剑齿。“我正好有个主意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. Within reason.” He smiles an uncomfortable, mischievous, maybe even predatory smile, showing off his massive sabre teeth. “I have just the idea.”"

rows.original: “Unfortunately, I haven’t had the opportunity to see the stars and other planets for myself, [pc.name] Steele. I have you to thank for that.” He flicks his thumbs under the chains of his harness as if they were overall straps. “I’m blind and dumb to all the different cultures of the universe. I’ll never know what it’s like to be among different people, and speak their language... and appreciate the body in their ways.”
rows.translation: “遗憾的是，我一直没有机会亲眼看看星辰和其他行星，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。这可得谢谢你。”他把拇指勾到束具的链条下，仿佛那是工装裤的背带。“我对宇宙中形形色色的文化一无所知。我永远不会知道置身于不同人群之间、说他们的语言...以及用他们的方式欣赏肉体是什么感觉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Unfortunately, I haven’t had the opportunity to see the stars and other planets for myself, [pc.name] Steele. I have you to thank for that.” He flicks his thumbs under the chains of his harness as if they were overall straps. “I’m blind and dumb to all the different cultures of the universe. I’ll never know what it’s like to be among different people, and speak their language... and appreciate the body in their ways.”"

rows.original: You shiver at the insinuation of what it is he wants, but you don’t interrupt and let him finish the thought before you reject him.
rows.translation: 他暗示出的欲望让你打了个寒颤，但你没有打断，而是让他说完这个念头，再拒绝他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shiver at the insinuation of what it is he wants, but you don’t interrupt and let him finish the thought before you reject him."

rows.original: “You might not have noticed, but the milodan men and women tend to not wear very much,” he laughs. “It leaves so little to the imagination! And down here, that’s all I have. I want you to wear an outfit for me that another culture would find sexually appealing. Give me something to think about at night, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “你可能没注意到，但米洛丹男人和女人往往都穿得不多，”他笑道。“留给想象的空间太少了！可在这里，想象就是我的全部。我想让你为我穿上一套在另一种文化眼中很有性吸引力的服装。给我一点晚上可以回味的东西，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might not have noticed, but the milodan men and women tend to not wear very much,” he laughs. “It leaves so little to the imagination! And down here, that’s all I have. I want you to wear an outfit for me that another culture would find sexually appealing. Give me something to think about at night, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: Eitan wants you to put on a little show for him by wearing something sexy. You suppose it could have been something far worse.
rows.translation: 埃坦想让你穿上性感服装，为他表演一番。你想，情况本来可能糟糕得多。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan wants you to put on a little show for him by wearing something sexy. You suppose it could have been something far worse."

rows.original: With his demand made clear, he hefts his massive pickaxe and turns his back to you, resuming his work.
rows.translation: 他的要求已经说得很明白，于是他扛起那把巨大的镐，转身背对你，继续干活。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith his demand made clear, he hefts his massive pickaxe and turns his back to you, resuming his work."

rows.original: Eitan taps on his lower jaw, his left arm wrapped around his chest as he thinks to himself. “What should I ask of you this time?” he wonders aloud, his eyes roaming the ceiling of the mine. There are only so many things he could ask from you, so he knows he needs to make it count. “Your last,” he chuckles, “‘gift’ will get me through a listless night or two. Maybe I should have you wear less?”
rows.translation: 埃坦用手指轻敲下颌，左臂环在胸前，独自思考。“这次该向你要什么呢？”他出声琢磨着，目光在矿井顶棚上游移。他能向你索要的东西终究有限，所以知道自己必须让每次机会都物有所值。“你上次的，”他轻笑道，“‘礼物’足够让我熬过一两个无聊的夜晚了。也许我该让你少穿一点？”
rows.raw: "Eitan taps on his lower jaw, his left arm wrapped around his chest as he thinks to himself. “What should I ask of you this time?” he wonders aloud, his eyes roaming the ceiling of the mine. There are only so many things he could ask from you, so he knows he needs to make it count. “Your last,” he chuckles, “‘gift’ will get me through a listless night or two. Maybe I should have you wear less?”"

rows.original: You grit your teeth. As much as you like to think you’re making progress with him, it’s difficult to say for sure when he says things like that.
rows.translation: 你咬紧牙关。你很愿意相信自己正在让他有所改观，可当他说出这种话时，实在很难确定。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grit your teeth. As much as you like to think you’re making progress with him, it’s difficult to say for sure when he says things like that."

rows.original: “No, that’d be a waste, I think. I shouldn’t waste this opportunity on things I can’t touch. Living in this dark mine and doing nothing but swinging a pick for all hours of the day in the name of my enemies tends to have you yearn for the physical, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “不，我觉得那太浪费了。我不该把这次机会浪费在自己碰不到的东西上。住在这座阴暗的矿井里，打着敌人的旗号，整天除了挥舞矿镐什么也不做，往往会让人渴望实际的接触，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, that’d be a waste, I think. I shouldn’t waste this opportunity on things I can’t touch. Living in this dark mine and doing nothing but swinging a pick for all hours of the day in the name of my enemies tends to have you yearn for the physical, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: He lowers his gaze and his mouth straightens as he starts to seriously think about what it is he wants. He only gets one thing at a time, and like he said, he’s smart enough to not waste it.
rows.translation: 他垂下目光，嘴角拉平，开始认真思考自己到底想要什么。他每次只能得到一样东西，而且正如他所说，他足够聪明，不会浪费机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe lowers his gaze and his mouth straightens as he starts to seriously think about what it is he wants. He only gets one thing at a time, and like he said, he’s smart enough to not waste it."

rows.original: “During my short time with Pyrite, they introduced me to a type of drink that I had never had before. I wasn’t much for the taste, but the effect it had on me when I drank enough has had me craving a bit for some more, to feel that way again.”
rows.translation: “我在黄铁矿工业待的那段短暂时间里，他们让我接触了一种我从没喝过的饮料。我不太喜欢它的味道，但喝得足够多以后产生的效果，却让我一直有点渴望再来一些，再次感受那种状态。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“During my short time with Pyrite, they introduced me to a type of drink that I had never had before. I wasn’t much for the taste, but the effect it had on me when I drank enough has had me craving a bit for some more, to feel that way again.”"

rows.original: You ask him to go more into detail about how he felt when he drank enough of the drink. You have an idea of what it is he wants, but it’s better to be safe than sorry.
rows.translation: 你让他更详细地说说喝够这种饮料之后是什么感受。你已经大概猜到他想要什么，但谨慎总比后悔好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him to go more into detail about how he felt when he drank enough of the drink. You have an idea of what it is he wants, but it’s better to be safe than sorry."

rows.original: “It ruined my sense of balance and it made my vision swim, but it also... unwound me, I suppose. I don’t often get to really relax, [pc.name] Steele, given my status as alpha – whether it’s fighting or mating, my body is usually tensed up over one thing or another. And working in the mines underneath the korgonne Hold has me wound up. The drink you get me doesn’t have to be the same ones that Pyrite gives me – like I said, I wasn’t for the taste. Whatever makes me feel the same way again.”
rows.translation: “它破坏了我的平衡感，也让我的视野摇晃，但它也...让我放松下来，大概吧。我很少能真正放松，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔；以阿尔法的身份，无论战斗还是交配，我的身体通常都会为了这样或那样的事情紧绷着。而在科尔吉要塞地下的矿井干活，更让我绷得死紧。你给我弄来的饮料不必跟黄铁矿工业给我的一样，正如我所说，我不喜欢那种味道。只要能让我再次产生同样的感觉就行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It ruined my sense of balance and it made my vision swim, but it also... unwound me, I suppose. I don’t often get to really relax, [pc.name] Steele, given my status as alpha – whether it’s fighting or mating, my body is usually tensed up over one thing or another. And working in the mines underneath the korgonne Hold has me wound up. The drink you get me doesn’t have to be the same ones that Pyrite gives me – like I said, I wasn’t for the taste. Whatever makes me feel the same way again.”"

rows.original: It seems that the milodan aren’t immune to the effects of alcohol, just like the rest of the universe. Eitan wants something alcoholic to drink. That sounds fairly simple to you.
rows.translation: 看来米洛丹人和宇宙中的其他人一样，也无法免疫酒精的作用。埃坦想要一些含酒精的饮料。这听起来相当简单。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems that the milodan aren’t immune to the effects of alcohol, just like the rest of the universe. Eitan wants something alcoholic to drink. That sounds fairly simple to you."

rows.original: You tell him that you can find him something to drink, but he has to promise he’ll only drink it when he’s not swinging that pickaxe. Giving a very strong milodan with some seething emotions towards the korgonne some alcohol while he’s chained up and swinging a pick around sounds like a bad time to you.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，你可以替他找些喝的，但他必须保证只在不挥舞那把矿镐时饮用。一个极其强壮、对科尔贡人怀有满腔怒火的米洛丹人，被锁着链子、挥舞矿镐时又喝下酒精，在你看来绝不会有好结果。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that you can find him something to drink, but he has to promise he’ll only drink it when he’s not swinging that pickaxe. Giving a very strong milodan with some seething emotions towards the korgonne some alcohol while he’s chained up and swinging a pick around sounds like a bad time to you."

rows.original: Eitan huffs through pursed lips, but nods. “Fine,” he answers, and then hefts his mighty pickaxe with one hand and turns back to his wall. With the clank of his pick against the ore, your conversation is over.
rows.translation: 埃坦抿着嘴呼了口气，但还是点点头。“好吧，”他回答，随后单手扛起那把沉重的矿镐，转身面向墙壁。随着矿镐敲上矿石发出铿锵声，你们的谈话结束了。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan huffs through pursed lips, but nods. “Fine,” he answers, and then hefts his mighty pickaxe with one hand and turns back to his wall. With the clank of his pick against the ore, your conversation is over."

rows.original: You stand idle now that your formal conversation is over, waiting for Eitan to tell you what it is he wants for you to get for him. You’ve been making some decent progress with him, trying to convince him that his way of thinking is aggressive and wrong, but you’re not there yet. You just need to keep it up for a bit, and that means getting him something so he’ll keep talking.
rows.translation: 正式谈话结束后，你站在原地无所事事，等着埃坦告诉你他想让你替他弄来什么。你在他身上已经取得了不错的进展，正试图说服他那套思维方式既好斗又错误，但还没有完全成功。你只需再坚持一阵子，而这意味着得给他弄来某样东西，好让他继续开口。
rows.raw: "You stand idle now that your formal conversation is over, waiting for Eitan to tell you what it is he wants for you to get for him. You’ve been making some decent progress with him, trying to convince him that his way of thinking is aggressive and wrong, but you’re not there yet. You just need to keep it up for a bit, and that means getting him something so he’ll keep talking."

rows.original: Eitan, however, doesn’t say anything, not right away. He rests both his hands on the butt of his overturned pickaxe, and his eyes are on the chain-gang of milodan, each of them working to chip away at the mines. His eyes are narrowed in thought and his breathing comes out slowly and evenly; you shift from one side to the other to try and get his attention, and he ignores you. It’s almost as if he’s having a conversation with himself.
rows.translation: 然而埃坦什么也没说，至少没有马上开口。他双手撑在倒插在地上的镐柄末端，目光落在那队米洛丹苦役身上，他们每个人都在凿着矿脉。他眯起眼睛若有所思，呼吸缓慢而均匀；你左右挪动身体想引起他的注意，他却理都不理。简直就像他在跟自己对话。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan, however, doesn’t say anything, not right away. He rests both his hands on the butt of his overturned pickaxe, and his eyes are on the chain-gang of milodan, each of them working to chip away at the mines. His eyes are narrowed in thought and his breathing comes out slowly and evenly; you shift from one side to the other to try and get his attention, and he ignores you. It’s almost as if he’s having a conversation with himself."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” he begins, his voice low and gravelly. “Tell me. Can you name an enemy that can’t be seen; that no armor can protect you from; that no weapon can defeat; and can conquer someone as strong as myself?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]斯蒂尔，”他开口道，声音低沉沙哑。“告诉我。你能说出一个看不见、任何盔甲都护不住你、任何武器都打不败，还能征服像我这么强的人的敌人吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” he begins, his voice low and gravelly. “Tell me. Can you name an enemy that can’t be seen; that no armor can protect you from; that no weapon can defeat; and can conquer someone as strong as myself?”"

rows.original: You admit that you aren’t certain. You were lost as soon as he asked you to name an invisible opponent.
rows.translation: 你承认自己不确定。他一让你说出一个看不见的对手的名字，你就懵了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admit that you aren’t certain. You were lost as soon as he asked you to name an invisible opponent."

rows.original: “Disease,” he answers simply. He frowns and keeps his eye on the milodan chain-gang as he says the word. “No matter how strong I get, disease can find a way to bring me down.”
rows.translation: “疾病，”他简单地回答。他皱着眉，说出这个词时，目光始终盯着那群被铁链串在一起的米洛丹苦工。“无论我变得多么强壮，疾病总能找到办法把我打倒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Disease,” he answers simply. He frowns and keeps his eye on the milodan chain-gang as he says the word. “No matter how strong I get, disease can find a way to bring me down.”"

rows.original: “Disease,” you answer. It wasn’t a particularly subtle riddle, if indeed it was one.
rows.translation: “疾病，”你回答。如果这真算谜语，那也算不上特别含蓄。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Disease,” you answer. It wasn’t a particularly subtle riddle, if indeed it was one."

rows.original: Eitan’s eyes turn to yours, and he smiles. “I had expected nothing less from you, [pc.name] Steele.” His eyes go from your own, to your [pc.feet], then back up. “You would have made a fine alpha yourself, you know. In some other tribe.”
rows.translation: 艾坦望向你的双眼，露出微笑。“我就知道你不会让我失望，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”他的目光从你的眼睛落到[pc.feet]，随后再次抬起。“你知道吗，你自己也会成为出色的阿尔法。当然，是在另一个部落里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s eyes turn to yours, and he smiles. “I had expected nothing less from you, [pc.name] Steele.” His eyes go from your own, to your [pc.feet], then back up. “You would have made a fine alpha yourself, you know. In some other tribe.”"

rows.original: “I’m worried that, in the conditions we’re in, with so little fresh air and sunlight, the conditions are perfect for disease to strike my people and me. This time, Steele, I want two things from you.”
rows.translation: “我担心，在我们如今的条件里，新鲜空气和阳光都这么少，正是疾病来袭我的人民和我自己的绝佳条件。这一次，斯蒂尔，我想向你要两样东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m worried that, in the conditions we’re in, with so little fresh air and sunlight, the conditions are perfect for disease to strike my people and me. This time, Steele, I want two things from you.”"

rows.original: He lifts his massive, furry hand and extends his index finger. “The first is that I want each of us to see the outside for a moment. Lead us one-by-one if you must. A bit of fresh air will help stave off disease and weakness.” He lifts his middle finger next. “And second, I want medicine. Pyrite had shown me what your star-faring peoples are capable of with medicine. I want some of it for myself. And I don’t trust anything from the korgonne, so I don’t want any of their medicine.”
rows.translation: 他举起毛茸茸的巨手，伸出食指。“第一，我希望我们每个人都能暂时去外面看看。必须的话，就逐个带我们出去。呼吸一点新鲜空气，有助于抵御疾病和虚弱。”接着他竖起中指。“第二，我要药品。黄铁重工向我展示过你们这些星际航行民族的医疗能力。我想要一些药给自己用。而且我不相信科尔贡人的任何东西，所以不要他们的药。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe lifts his massive, furry hand and extends his index finger. “The first is that I want each of us to see the outside for a moment. Lead us one-by-one if you must. A bit of fresh air will help stave off disease and weakness.” He lifts his middle finger next. “And second, I want medicine. Pyrite had shown me what your star-faring peoples are capable of with medicine. I want some of it for myself. And I don’t trust anything from the korgonne, so I don’t want any of their medicine.”"

rows.original: Eitan may be hoarding the medicine, but he’s at least trying to think of his people by advocating them getting some fresh air. That’s a start! You’ll have to ask Ula about bringing the milodan aboveground for some fresh air and sunlight, and you’ll need to find some medicine for Eitan.
rows.translation: 艾坦也许会独占药物，但他至少在努力为同胞考虑，主张让他们呼吸一点新鲜空气。这是个开始！你得询问乌拉能否让米洛丹人到地面呼吸新鲜空气、晒晒太阳，而且你还得为艾坦找到一些药品。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan may be hoarding the medicine, but he’s at least trying to think of his people by advocating them getting some fresh air. That’s a start! You’ll have to ask Ula about bringing the milodan aboveground for some fresh air and sunlight, and you’ll need to find some medicine for Eitan."

rows.original: Ula should be easy to convince, but where can you find some medicine...?
rows.translation: 说服乌拉应该很容易，但你能去哪里找药呢...？
rows.raw: "\n\nUla should be easy to convince, but where can you find some medicine...?"

rows.original: Eitan stands mostly still, leaning on his overturned pickaxe, as he digests his conversation with you. Lately, he’s been more and more contemplative after your discussions; with every long-winded discussion, you’re having more and more of an impact on him. You wonder what it is that he’s going to ask from you this time.
rows.translation: 艾坦大致站在原处不动，倚着倒转的鹤嘴锄，消化刚才与你的谈话。最近，每次和你讨论过后，他都会变得越来越爱思考；随着一次次长篇讨论，你对他的影响也愈发明显。你想知道这次他会向你提出什么要求。
rows.raw: "Eitan stands mostly still, leaning on his overturned pickaxe, as he digests his conversation with you. Lately, he’s been more and more contemplative after your discussions; with every long-winded discussion, you’re having more and more of an impact on him. You wonder what it is that he’s going to ask from you this time."

rows.original: “These last few times we’ve spoken, it’s been getting harder and harder to think of what it is I want, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “Before you and I started speaking regularly, I would have asked for anything from weapons to having you service me.”
rows.translation: “最近这几次谈话里，我越来越难想到自己想要什么了，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说道。“在你我开始定期交谈之前，我可能会提出任何要求，从武器到让你服侍我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“These last few times we’ve spoken, it’s been getting harder and harder to think of what it is I want, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “Before you and I started speaking regularly, I would have asked for anything from weapons to having you service me.”"

rows.original: His insinuation that he’d have you go down on him is so casual. But you suppose you aren’t surprised, given the privileges he’s been used to as the alpha.
rows.translation: 他如此随意地暗示要你为他口交。不过想到他身为阿尔法时习惯享受的特权，你觉得这并不意外。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis insinuation that he’d have you go down on him is so casual. But you suppose you aren’t surprised, given the privileges he’s been used to as the alpha."

rows.original: “Although I suppose that’s considered a rude thing to say in your culture,” he admits. That surprises you. “I’ve asked for exotic food; I’ve asked for you to dress enticingly; and I’ve asked for medicine. If I’m to ask for something that I need, I shouldn’t waste it.”
rows.translation: “不过我想，在你们的文化里，这种话被视为无礼，”他承认道。这一点确实令你惊讶。“我要求过异域食物，要求过你穿得诱人，也要求过药品。如果要索取自己需要的东西，我就不该浪费机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Although I suppose that’s considered a rude thing to say in your culture,” he admits. That surprises you. “I’ve asked for exotic food; I’ve asked for you to dress enticingly; and I’ve asked for medicine. If I’m to ask for something that I need, I shouldn’t waste it.”"

rows.original: You tell him that if he’s having a hard time deciding, he doesn’t have to ask for anything at all, and you two could talk for free.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，如果实在难以决定，他根本不必提出任何请求，你们俩可以免费聊聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that if he’s having a hard time deciding, he doesn’t have to ask for anything at all, and you two could talk for free."

rows.original: He smirks at that. “We could,” he says, “and I’ll consider it... but only if you wear this,” he continues, thumbing at his chain harness, “and you start swinging around this.” He pats at the butt of his overturned pickaxe. “As long as I’m a prisoner, I’ll take any advantage I can get, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: 他闻言咧嘴一笑。“我们可以，”他说，“而且我会考虑...但前提是你穿上这个，”他用拇指指了指锁链束具，继续道，“然后开始挥动这个。”他拍了拍倒转鹤嘴锄的尾端。“只要我还是囚犯，就会利用自己能得到的任何优势，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe smirks at that. “We could,” he says, “and I’ll consider it... but only if you wear this,” he continues, thumbing at his chain harness, “and you start swinging around this.” He pats at the butt of his overturned pickaxe. “As long as I’m a prisoner, I’ll take any advantage I can get, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: “Fair enough,” you reply.
rows.translation: “有道理，”你回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fair enough,” you reply."

rows.original: “Although that does give me an idea.” He hooks both his thumbs underneath the chains of his harness again. “These chains chafe and dig into my fur with all the heavy motion. I want you to bring me something that I can wear underneath it that can help me with that.”
rows.translation: “不过那确实给了我一个主意。”他再次把双手拇指勾进束具锁链下方。“大幅动作时，这些锁链会摩擦皮肤、勒进毛发。我希望你给我带件能穿在下面、缓解这种情况的衣物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Although that does give me an idea.” He hooks both his thumbs underneath the chains of his harness again. “These chains chafe and dig into my fur with all the heavy motion. I want you to bring me something that I can wear underneath it that can help me with that.”"

rows.original: Eitan wants you to bring him an undershirt. It’s probably the most innocuous request he’s made. Either he’s really running low on ideas for what to ask for, or he’s just trying to not be so intrusive on your day-to-day life – which would be a far cry from the Eitan you once knew.
rows.translation: 艾坦希望你给他带一件汗衫。这大概是他提出过最无害的要求。要么他真的快想不出该索取什么了，要么只是不想再过多干扰你的日常生活——这与曾经那个艾坦简直判若两人。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan wants you to bring him an undershirt. It’s probably the most innocuous request he’s made. Either he’s really running low on ideas for what to ask for, or he’s just trying to not be so intrusive on your day-to-day life – which would be a far cry from the Eitan you once knew."

rows.original: “I’m looking forward to our next discussion... and my under-thing to wear,” he tells you before he picks up his pick and turns back to the wall, resuming his manual labor.
rows.translation: “我期待我们的下次谈话...还有要穿在里面的那件东西，”他告诉你，随后拿起鹤嘴锄，转身面对墙壁，继续体力劳动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m looking forward to our next discussion... and my under-thing to wear,” he tells you before he picks up his pick and turns back to the wall, resuming his manual labor."

rows.original: EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS
rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS
rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.original: You return to Eitan with the
rows.translation: 你带着艾坦要的
rows.raw: "You return to Eitan with the "

rows.original: that he had asked for. He doesn’t thank you for it – but he doesn’t say much of anything. As soon as his eyes meet yours, his lips curl downward into a contemplative frown, and he says nothing as he works the undershirt on, worming it down beneath the chains without removing them. It’s a struggle, and the shirt wasn’t meant for someone with his titanic frame, but he gets it on, even if it’s a little small for him.
rows.translation: 回来找他。他没有道谢——事实上几乎什么都没说。他的目光刚与你相遇，嘴角便向下卷成若有所思的皱眉；他一言不发地穿上汗衫，没有卸下锁链，而是扭动着将衣服塞到锁链下面。这并不容易，而且这件衣服并非为他那巨人般的体格设计，但他还是穿上了，尽管略显小了一点。
rows.raw: " that he had asked for. He doesn’t thank you for it – but he doesn’t say much of anything.
