As soon as his eyes meet yours, his lips curl downward into a contemplative frown, and he says nothing as he works the undershirt on, worming it down beneath the chains without removing them. It’s a struggle, and the shirt wasn’t meant for someone with his titanic frame, but he gets it on, even if it’s a little small for him."

rows.original: Every time before, Eitan would greet you with his confident, if a little smug, smirk, no matter how exhausted he’d been from all the mining. This, however, Eitan appears... pensive. Normally, he’d invite you to ask him something, but not this time. His eyes are cast to the ground, not in submission, but in thought.
rows.translation: 以前每次见面，无论采矿让他多么疲惫，艾坦都会以自信、或许略显自负的笑容迎接你。然而这一次，艾坦看起来...若有所思。通常他会请你提问，但这次没有。他把视线投向地面，并非表示服从，而是在思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvery time before, Eitan would greet you with his confident, if a little smug, smirk, no matter how exhausted he’d been from all the mining. This, however, Eitan appears... pensive. Normally, he’d invite you to ask him something, but not this time. His eyes are cast to the ground, not in submission, but in thought."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” he says after a moment. His voice is lower and smoother than usual. “Every time you’ve approached me and given me what I’ve asked for, you asked me a question, and we would have a bit of a back-and-forth for a while.” You don’t respond – it wasn’t a question, but merely a statement. “This time, I have something I’d like to ask you.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”片刻后他说道，声音比平常更低沉平缓。“每次你来找我、给我带来所求之物时，都会问我一个问题，然后我们会来回讨论一阵。”你没有回应——这不是问题，只是一句陈述。“这次，我有件事想问你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” he says after a moment. His voice is lower and smoother than usual. “Every time you’ve approached me and given me what I’ve asked for, you asked me a question, and we would have a bit of a back-and-forth for a while.” You don’t respond – it wasn’t a question, but merely a statement. “This time, I have something I’d like to ask you.”"

rows.original: That’s an interesting turn. You tell Eitan that you’re listening.
rows.translation: 这发展很有意思。你告诉艾坦，自己正在听。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s an interesting turn. You tell Eitan that you’re listening."

rows.original: “You’ve given me much to think about all this time. From what it means to be the alpha, to the segregated culture surrounding my people, to the milodan’s relationship with the korgonne, to my personal standing with my family. I’ve abused my privileges as alpha and I’ve instigated violence for....” He pauses and looks to the milodan next to him, still toiling away in chains at the mines beneath his enemy’s living space. “For nothing but the sake of violence, I suppose.”
rows.translation: “一直以来，你给了我许多值得思考的事情。从担任阿尔法的意义，到围绕族人的分裂文化，再到米洛丹人与科尔贡人的关系，以及我个人在家族中的地位。我滥用了阿尔法特权，也挑起了暴力，只是为了....”他停顿下来，看向身旁的米洛丹人；对方仍戴着锁链，在敌人居所下方的矿井中辛苦劳作。“我想，只是为了暴力本身。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve given me much to think about all this time. From what it means to be the alpha, to the segregated culture surrounding my people, to the milodan’s relationship with the korgonne, to my personal standing with my family. I’ve abused my privileges as alpha and I’ve instigated violence for....” He pauses and looks to the milodan next to him, still toiling away in chains at the mines beneath his enemy’s living space. “For nothing but the sake of violence, I suppose.”"

rows.original: Eitan has come a long way, clearly. Your time with him has had an obvious effect, down to himself calling his own actions ‘abusive.’ He’s even downright remorseful for even starting the violence against the korgonne in the first place.
rows.translation: 显然，艾坦已经成长了许多。你与他相处的时间产生了明显影响，甚至让他亲口称自己的行为属于‘滥用’。他甚至真心后悔最初挑起针对科尔贡人的暴力。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan has come a long way, clearly. Your time with him has had an obvious effect, down to himself calling his own actions ‘abusive.’ He’s even downright remorseful for even starting the violence against the korgonne in the first place."

rows.original: “Tell me about yourself, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “All we’ve spoken about is myself and my way of thinking and doing. You’re compassionate enough to give me what I want when all you want in exchange is to talk; you’re well-off enough to explore the stars at a whim; and I’ve had enough time to come to terms with the fact that you can beat me in combat. How does one,” he says, motioning to your whole body, his own chains clinking with the motion of his arms, “do all that?”
rows.translation: “跟我说说你自己吧，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说道。“我们谈论的一直都是我，以及我的思维和行事方式。你富有同情心，愿意给我想要的东西，交换条件仅仅是谈话；你又足够富裕，可以随心所欲地探索群星；而且我有足够时间接受你能在战斗中击败我的事实。一个人究竟如何，”他指向你的全身，手臂动作令身上锁链叮当作响，“做到这一切？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me about yourself, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “All we’ve spoken about is myself and my way of thinking and doing. You’re compassionate enough to give me what I want when all you want in exchange is to talk; you’re well-off enough to explore the stars at a whim; and I’ve had enough time to come to terms with the fact that you can beat me in combat. How does one,” he says, motioning to your whole body, his own chains clinking with the motion of his arms, “do all that?”"

rows.original: That’s a hell of a question. To start with, you ask Eitan if he understands the concept of ‘economy.’ “I’m afraid I don’t,” he answers, and you give him a quick, base rundown on concepts like ‘money’ and ‘fair exchanges.’ Him being the alpha for most of his life and taking advantage of everything that that means, it takes him a moment to understand the idea of exchanging a note that says it’s worth something for a good or service, but he gets it well enough by the time you’re done.
rows.translation: 这可真是个大问题。首先，你问艾坦是否理解‘经济’这个概念。“恐怕不懂，”他回答，于是你快速而基础地介绍了‘金钱’和‘公平交换’等概念。他一生大部分时间都是阿尔法，享尽这一身份带来的好处，因此花了一会儿才理解用一张宣称自身具有价值的纸换取商品或服务的观念；不过等你讲完时，他已经理解得足够好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a hell of a question. To start with, you ask Eitan if he understands the concept of ‘economy.’ “I’m afraid I don’t,” he answers, and you give him a quick, base rundown on concepts like ‘money’ and ‘fair exchanges.’ Him being the alpha for most of his life and taking advantage of everything that that means, it takes him a moment to understand the idea of exchanging a note that says it’s worth something for a good or service, but he gets it well enough by the time you’re done."

rows.original: You tell Eitan that you’re the child of a man that owned a lot to his name. When he passed away, he challenged you to follow in his footsteps and travel the stars in search of items that can only be handled by someone in your bloodline, and if you succeed, you’ll inherit everything that he left you. It’s somewhat similar to how he took the title of Alpha from his mother.
rows.translation: 你告诉艾坦，自己是一名拥有众多财产之人的孩子。父亲去世时，他向你提出挑战：追随他的足迹遨游群星，寻找只有你血脉中人才能处理的物品；如果成功，你将继承他留下的一切。这与他从母亲手中夺得阿尔法头衔有些相似。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Eitan that you’re the child of a man that owned a lot to his name. When he passed away, he challenged you to follow in his footsteps and travel the stars in search of items that can only be handled by someone in your bloodline, and if you succeed, you’ll inherit everything that he left you. It’s somewhat similar to how he took the title of Alpha from his mother."

rows.original: You regale to Eitan that your journey has taken you to man-made planets called ‘stations’ that rest among the stars
rows.translation: 你向埃坦讲述，你的旅程带你去了被称为‘空间站’的人造星球，它们静卧在群星之间
rows.raw: "\n\nYou regale to Eitan that your journey has taken you to man-made planets called ‘stations’ that rest among the stars"

rows.original: , to planets teeming with jungle life and thick forests
rows.translation: ，前往遍布丛林生物与茂密森林的星球
rows.raw: ", to planets teeming with jungle life and thick forests"

rows.original: , to desert planets sunken in garbage and refuse
rows.translation: ，到淹没在垃圾与废料中的荒漠星球
rows.raw: ", to desert planets sunken in garbage and refuse"

rows.original: , to planets with deep underground networks and caves that reach far lower than the mines you and he are standing in now
rows.translation: ，到那些有着深不见底的地下网络和洞穴的星球，那些洞穴比你们俩此刻站着的矿坑还要深得多
rows.raw: ", to planets with deep underground networks and caves that reach far lower than the mines you and he are standing in now"

rows.original: RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS
rows.raw: "RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS"

rows.original: . You’ve fought with pirates
rows.translation: 。你跟海盗交过手
rows.raw: ". You’ve fought with pirates"

rows.original: RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS
rows.raw: "RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS"

rows.original: and you’ve become fast friends with others
rows.translation: 而你和另外一些人很快成了朋友
rows.raw: " and you’ve become fast friends with others"

rows.original: ; you’ve made some difficult decisions
rows.translation: ；你做过一些艰难的决定
rows.raw: "; you’ve made some difficult decisions"

rows.original: ; you’ve overcome obstacles in your path towards claiming your inheritance, including your own kin
rows.translation: ；你已经在夺取继承之路上克服了种种障碍，包括你自己的血亲
rows.raw: "; you’ve overcome obstacles in your path towards claiming your inheritance, including your own kin"

rows.original: ; you’ve given your own personal wealth to others for their well-being and expected nothing in return
rows.translation: ；你把自己的私人财富给了别人改善他们的生活，却不求回报
rows.raw: "; you’ve given your own personal wealth to others for their well-being and expected nothing in return"

rows.original: ; and you’ve
rows.translation: ；而且你已经
rows.raw: "; and you’ve "

rows.original: done it all while keeping yourself chaste and ready for the one that truly matters to you.
rows.translation: 做完了这一切，同时还保持贞洁，为那个真正对你重要的人留着。
rows.raw: "done it all while keeping yourself chaste and ready for the one that truly matters to you."

rows.original: taken your share of lovers in your time.
rows.translation: 这些年你也睡过不少情人。
rows.raw: "taken your share of lovers in your time."

rows.original: And on top of all of that... you’ve done what
rows.translation: 而除了这一切之外...你还做了什么
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd on top of all of that... you’ve done what"

rows.original: , by his own admission, no milodan has ever done before: you’ve defeated a Frostwyrm. Not only did you beat it in combat, but you slew it and took its scales for yourself.
rows.translation: ；据他自己承认，这是此前从未有米洛丹人完成的壮举：你击败了一头霜虫。不仅在战斗中战胜它，还将其杀死，亲手取走了鳞片。
rows.raw: ", by his own admission, no milodan has ever done before: you’ve defeated a Frostwyrm. Not only did you beat it in combat, but you slew it and took its scales for yourself."

rows.original: Eitan’s eyes widen. “You’re lying,” he spouts, almost instinctively, but he reels himself back. “Right? No one can slay a Frostwyrm. Not even the strongest of the milodan alphas can do it.”
rows.translation: 艾坦睁大双眼。“你在撒谎，”他几乎本能地脱口而出，却又控制住自己。“对吧？没人能杀死霜虫。即使最强的米洛丹阿尔法也做不到。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s eyes widen. “You’re lying,” he spouts, almost instinctively, but he reels himself back. “Right? No one can slay a Frostwyrm. Not even the strongest of the milodan alphas can do it.”"

rows.original: If he ever gets out of the korgonne mines, you invite him to check for himself. You tell him to journey east, towards the Uveto ocean, where a Frostwyrm was known to roost. It’s not there anymore.
rows.translation: 如果他有朝一日能离开科尔贡矿井，你邀请他亲自去验证。你让他向东前进，走向乌维托海洋；那里曾有一头霜虫筑巢。如今它已不在那里了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf he ever gets out of the korgonne mines, you invite him to check for himself. You tell him to journey east, towards the Uveto ocean, where a Frostwyrm was known to roost. It’s not there anymore."

rows.original: Eitan’s eyes lay unflinchingly on yours, his hands clenching and unclenching, but he doesn’t try to argue or deny you.
rows.translation: 埃坦的目光毫不退缩地迎着你，双手握紧又松开，但他没有试图争辩或否认。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s eyes lay unflinchingly on yours, his hands clenching and unclenching, but he doesn’t try to argue or deny you."

rows.original: , the milodan hadn’t ever dreamed of doing: not only did you defeat a Frostwyrm in combat... but you then went on to mate with it.
rows.translation: ，这是米洛丹人从来连做梦都不敢想的事：你不仅在战斗中击败了一条霜龙...之后还跟它交配了。
rows.raw: ", the milodan hadn’t ever dreamed of doing: not only did you defeat a Frostwyrm in combat... but you then went on to mate with it."

rows.original: “You’re lying,” he says immediately, his eyes narrowing.
rows.translation: “你在撒谎，”他立刻说道，同时眯起眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re lying,” he says immediately, his eyes narrowing."

rows.original: You continue: not only did you mate with it, but you successfully crossbred with it. You have a clutch of Frostwyrm half-breeds out in the Uveto ocean waiting for you.
rows.translation: 你接着说：你不只是和它交配了，你还成功杂交了。在乌维托外海里，有一窝霜龙混血后代正等着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou continue: not only did you mate with it, but you successfully crossbred with it. You have a clutch of Frostwyrm half-breeds out in the Uveto ocean waiting for you."

rows.original: “That’s impossible,” he says, his words coming out harsher and sterner. “I had believed you up until now, [pc.name] Steele, but now I think your whole story might be some naive lie to try and get me to lower my inhibitions.”
rows.translation: “这不可能，”他说道，话语变得更加严厉生硬。“此前我一直相信你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，但现在我觉得，你的整个故事可能只是天真的谎言，想骗我放松戒备。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s impossible,” he says, his words coming out harsher and sterner. “I had believed you up until now, [pc.name] Steele, but now I think your whole story might be some naive lie to try and get me to lower my inhibitions.”"

rows.original: If you were the type to lie, especially after everything you’ve done for Eitan, you probably would have done it by now. [frostwyrm.name] isn’t exactly the type to be welcoming towards guests – you had to fend her off two or three times yourself before you two came to an understanding – so you can’t exactly introduce Eitan to her. You instead ask Eitan to consider two things: if you were going to lie, why would you wait until now to do it, and if you were going to lie, why would it be about something so over-the-top? Why wouldn’t you lie about something smaller?
rows.translation: 如果你是会撒谎的人，尤其考虑到为艾坦所做的一切，大概早就已经撒了。[frostwyrm.name]可不是会欢迎客人的类型——在彼此达成谅解前，你自己都不得不击退她两三次——因此无法把艾坦介绍给她。于是你请艾坦思考两点：如果你打算撒谎，为何要一直等到现在？而如果要撒谎，为何偏偏编造如此夸张的事情？为什么不说一个更小的谎？
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you were the type to lie, especially after everything you’ve done for Eitan, you probably would have done it by now. [frostwyrm.name] isn’t exactly the type to be welcoming towards guests – you had to fend her off two or three times yourself before you two came to an understanding – so you can’t exactly introduce Eitan to her. You instead ask Eitan to consider two things: if you were going to lie, why would you wait until now to do it, and if you were going to lie, why would it be about something so over-the-top? Why wouldn’t you lie about something smaller?"

rows.original: Eitan grumbles to himself and chews at nothing as he considers your words. You’ve been nothing but honest up until now, and he knows it, but to think that someone had not only bested a Frostwyrm in combat, and not only mated with it, but also crossbred with it, is so grandiose that you think the only way to truly convince him is if he sees it for himself.
rows.translation: 埃坦自言自语地嘟囔着，空嚼着嘴，琢磨你的话。到目前为止你一直诚实无欺，他也知道，但想到有人不仅在一场战斗中击败了一条霜龙，还和它交配，甚至和它杂交，这实在太过离谱，你觉得唯一能真正说服他的办法，就是让他亲眼看到。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan grumbles to himself and chews at nothing as he considers your words. You’ve been nothing but honest up until now, and he knows it, but to think that someone had not only bested a Frostwyrm in combat, and not only mated with it, but also crossbred with it, is so grandiose that you think the only way to truly convince him is if he sees it for himself."

rows.original: Your journey to inherit your father’s legacy has taken you all over the universe, and you still have so much more to see and more planets to visit. You’ve accomplished more than you could have dreamed was possible before you visited so many different cultures and locations. Mediating the conflict between the milodan and the korgonne, and doing what you can to rehabilitate Eitan, is just another step on your adventure.
rows.translation: 继承父亲遗产的旅程带你走遍宇宙，可仍有太多景象等待你观看，还有更多星球等待造访。在接触如此众多不同文化与地点之前，你从未想过自己能取得这么多成就。调解米洛丹人与科尔贡人的冲突，并竭尽所能帮助艾坦改过自新，只是你冒险旅程中的又一步。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour journey to inherit your father’s legacy has taken you all over the universe, and you still have so much more to see and more planets to visit. You’ve accomplished more than you could have dreamed was possible before you visited so many different cultures and locations. Mediating the conflict between the milodan and the korgonne, and doing what you can to rehabilitate Eitan, is just another step on your adventure."

rows.original: Eitan sighs as you end your story, his chin resting in his hand. “‘Rehabilitate,’ huh?” he says above a low, throaty growl. “On the one hand, [pc.name] Steele, I don’t like the idea of you trying to manipulate my way of thinking. I am the alpha of the milodan, and in the end, it’s up to me to decide what that means.” He hums to himself again. “But on the other... like I said, I’ve been thinking about our talks and your way of thinking. Maybe ‘rehabilitate’ isn’t too far off the mark.”
rows.translation: 你的故事结束后，艾坦叹了口气，用手托住下巴。“‘改过自新’，是吗？”他压着低沉的喉音说道。“一方面，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我不喜欢你试图操纵我的思维方式。我是米洛丹人的阿尔法，最终由我决定这一身份意味着什么。”他又独自沉吟。“但另一方面...正如我所说，我一直在思考我们的谈话和你的思维方式。也许‘改过自新’这个说法并没有偏离太远。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan sighs as you end your story, his chin resting in his hand. “‘Rehabilitate,’ huh?” he says above a low, throaty growl. “On the one hand, [pc.name] Steele, I don’t like the idea of you trying to manipulate my way of thinking. I am the alpha of the milodan, and in the end, it’s up to me to decide what that means.” He hums to himself again. “But on the other... like I said, I’ve been thinking about our talks and your way of thinking. Maybe ‘rehabilitate’ isn’t too far off the mark.”"

rows.original: You ask if there’s anything more you can do for him.
rows.translation: 你问他还有没有你能帮上忙的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if there’s anything more you can do for him."

rows.original: Eitan sighs through his nose again and looks around his space. He looks at the massive pickaxe beside him, and he looks at his chain harness, and he looks at the wall he had been picking at for what seems like a lifetime, now. He looks at you, and at your korgonne escort, and himself. And he looks at the milodan chain-gang, not too far away, most of them still toiling at the mines but a handful of them watching you and Eitan with some curiosity.
rows.translation: 埃坦又从鼻子里叹了口气，环顾自己所在的这片地方。他看了看身旁那把巨大的镐头，又看了看身上的锁链挽具，再看看自己挖了仿佛一辈子的那面墙。他看看你，看看护送你来的科尔贡人，又看看自己。然后他望向不远处那队被锁链串起来的米洛丹人，他们大多还在矿里苦干，但有几个人正好奇地打量着你跟埃坦。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan sighs through his nose again and looks around his space. He looks at the massive pickaxe beside him, and he looks at his chain harness, and he looks at the wall he had been picking at for what seems like a lifetime, now. He looks at you, and at your korgonne escort, and himself. And he looks at the milodan chain-gang, not too far away, most of them still toiling at the mines but a handful of them watching you and Eitan with some curiosity."

rows.original: “I want one more thing,” he says after an eternity. “I want water.”
rows.translation: “我还想要一样东西，”仿佛过了永恒，他才说道。“我要水。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I want one more thing,” he says after an eternity. “I want water.”"

rows.original: “Water?” you parrot, looking for confirmation. You know for a fact that Ula’s been sending him enough food and water.
rows.translation: “水？”你重复道，想得到确认。你确知乌拉一直在给他送足够多的食物和水。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Water?” you parrot, looking for confirmation. You know for a fact that Ula’s been sending him enough food and water."

rows.original: “But not for me. For them.”
rows.translation: “但不是为我。是为他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But not for me. For them.”"

rows.original: He nods towards his people, all chained by the ankles and the waist together in a long line, chipping at the savicite walls.
rows.translation: 他朝自己的族人点点头，他们脚踝和腰都被锁在一起，排成长长的一列，正凿着萨维石的墙壁。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe nods towards his people, all chained by the ankles and the waist together in a long line, chipping at the savicite walls."

rows.original: “Bring me enough water to quench each of them. That’s what I want from you this time, [pc.name] Steele.” He hefts his massive pickaxe up with his left hand and slings it over his shoulder. “We’ll see where our conversations go next time.”
rows.translation: “给我带足够的水来，让它们每一个都解渴。这就是我这次想从你这里得到的，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”他用左手提起那把巨大的镐，把它甩到肩上。“下次我们再看看谈话会走向哪里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bring me enough water to quench each of them. That’s what I want from you this time, [pc.name] Steele.” He hefts his massive pickaxe up with his left hand and slings it over his shoulder. “We’ll see where our conversations go next time.”"

rows.original: He turns his back to you and returns to his labor, swinging his pick at the uneven walls. Chips of stone clank to the floor at his feet with every massive swing. Your conversation is over, and if you want to speak with Eitan again, you’ll have to ask Ula for more water for the milodan.
rows.translation: 他背对你，回去继续劳作，挥舞鹤嘴锄砸向凹凸不平的墙壁。每一次势大力沉的挥击都会让石屑铿锵落在脚边。你们的谈话结束了；如果还想再与艾坦交谈，你必须请乌拉为米洛丹人提供更多水。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe turns his back to you and returns to his labor, swinging his pick at the uneven walls. Chips of stone clank to the floor at his feet with every massive swing. Your conversation is over, and if you want to speak with Eitan again, you’ll have to ask Ula for more water for the milodan."

rows.translation: 你选择谈论米洛丹囚犯，而不是她更感兴趣的话题，令乌拉看起来很失望；但她像任何优秀女酋长一样，等你说完请求才作出回应。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla looks crestfallen that you’ve chosen to talk about the milodan prisoners instead of a topic she’d be more interested in, but like any good chieftess, she waits for you to finish your request before responding. <i>“"

rows.translation: 我不明白。他们没有足够的水吗？真的那么渴吗？
rows.raw: "I’m confused. Do they not have enough water? Are they really that thirsty?"

rows.original: Am confuse. Is current waterings not enough? Milodan really such thirsty?
rows.translation: 不明白。现在供水还不够？米洛丹真有那么渴？
rows.raw: "Am confuse. Is current waterings not enough? Milodan really such thirsty?"

rows.original: You explain that Eitan - the War Alpha - requested it for his people, not for himself. He’s trying to look out for his people instead of simply using them as tools, like he used to. He could have asked you for any favor in the universe, and he chose to make sure his people’s palates were suitably moistened. That he chose to eschew standard milodan culture for his charges is a really big deal. This could be the beginning of a tremendous breakthrough!
rows.translation: 你解释说，这是艾坦——那位战争阿尔法——为族人提出的要求，而不是为了自己。他正试图照顾族人，不再像以前那样仅仅把他们当作工具。他本可以向你请求宇宙中的任何恩惠，却选择确保族人能充分润湿口腔。他愿意为了自己负责的人背离米洛丹传统文化，是一件非常重大的事情。这可能是一项巨大突破的开端！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain that Eitan - the War Alpha - requested it for his people, not for himself. He’s trying to look out for his people instead of simply using them as tools, like he used to. He could have asked you for any favor in the universe, and he chose to make sure his people’s palates were suitably moistened. That he chose to eschew standard milodan culture for his charges is a really big deal. This could be the beginning of a tremendous breakthrough!"

rows.original: Ula’s eyes wander the room as she considers it. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉打量着房间，思索着这件事。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla’s eyes wander the room as she considers it. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "I must admit, [pc.name]... I don’t want the fang-cats happy. Maybe hunger pangs and thirsty throats are good punishment for what they did to us."
                : "Am admitting, [pc.name]... Ula not want fang-cats happy. Maybe thinking thirst-having and hunger-panged is good payment for what to do to Korg’ii."

rows.original: I must admit, [pc.name]... I don’t want the fang-cats happy. Maybe hunger pangs and thirsty throats are good punishment for what they did to us.
rows.translation: 我得承认，[pc.name]...我不想让那些獠牙猫好过。也许让它们挨饿、嗓子发干，对它们对我们做的事来说，算是合适的惩罚。
rows.raw: "I must admit, [pc.name]... I don’t want the fang-cats happy. Maybe hunger pangs and thirsty throats are good punishment for what they did to us."

rows.raw: "Am admitting, [pc.name]... Ula not want fang-cats happy. Maybe thinking thirst-having and hunger-panged is good payment for what to do to Korg’ii."

rows.original: ” Her jaw sets, and her eyes dart back to you, ice-hard. “
rows.translation: ”她咬紧下颚，目光重新射向你，冰冷坚硬。“
rows.raw: "” Her jaw sets, and her eyes dart back to you, ice-hard. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()

                : "But Ula not rule from anger. Chief, chieftess... any good leader do what right for people. Even if hard or hurt own heart to do."

rows.original: But I won’t rule from anger. Chief, chieftess... any good leader does what’s right for the people, even if it’s hard or hurts your own heart to do.
rows.translation: 但我不会受愤怒支配。酋长、女酋长...任何优秀领袖都应为族人做正确的事，哪怕这样很难，或会伤自己的心。
rows.raw: "But I won’t rule from anger. Chief, chieftess... any good leader does what’s right for the people, even if it’s hard or hurts your own heart to do."

rows.original: But Ula not rule from anger. Chief, chieftess... any good leader do what right for people. Even if hard or hurt own heart to do.
rows.translation: 但乌拉不会凭怒气统治。头儿、女头儿...任何好的首领都会为人民做对的事。哪怕做起来很难，哪怕要伤自己的心。
rows.raw: "But Ula not rule from anger. Chief, chieftess... any good leader do what right for people. Even if hard or hurt own heart to do."

rows.original: ” She nods. “
rows.translation: ”她点点头。“
rows.raw: "” She nods. “"

                : "Milodan having waters, and Ula glad know you, [pc.name]. You best alien."

rows.original: The milodan will have their water, and I’m glad I know you, [pc.name]. You truly are the best alien.
rows.translation: 米洛丹人会得到他们的水，而我很高兴认识你，[pc.name]。你真是最好的外星人。

rows.raw: "Milodan having waters, and Ula glad know you, [pc.name]. You best alien."

rows.original: EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS
rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.original: You had expected there to be a commotion when you first came into the prison mines after having spoken with Ula. Maybe some general merriment, or, worst-case, maybe a scuffle over who gets more water now that there’s a surplus of the commodity, but, perhaps more unnervingly, there’s nothing out of the ordinary at all to be heard.
rows.translation: 你原本以为，与乌拉交谈后第一次进入监狱矿井时会听见一阵骚动。也许是普遍的欢庆；最坏的情况，也许会有人因水源如今有了富余、争抢谁能得到更多而打起来。然而更令人不安的是，这里完全听不见任何异常动静。
rows.raw: "You had expected there to be a commotion when you first came into the prison mines after having spoken with Ula. Maybe some general merriment, or, worst-case, maybe a scuffle over who gets more water now that there’s a surplus of the commodity, but, perhaps more unnervingly, there’s nothing out of the ordinary at all to be heard."

rows.original: When you round the corner and you’re brought into the mine proper, you see the milodan chain-gang, each of them carrying a heavy pouch, either in their hand or on their hip. They slosh with liquid with every movement; Ula had kept to her word and sent down excess water for each of them to enjoy. But most of them are acting as if there’s nothing new at all to their day: some of them are chugging their water – apparently they were more parched than you had realized – but most of them are just back to the grind.
rows.translation: 拐过墙角、正式进入矿井后，你看见那队戴着锁链的米洛丹劳工，每人都拿着一个沉重水袋，或提在手里，或挂在髋边。每次移动，袋中液体都会晃荡；乌拉信守承诺，送下足量的额外饮水供每个人享用。但他们大多表现得仿佛今天根本没有任何新鲜事：其中几人正大口灌水——显然他们比你意识到的更加口渴——不过多数人已经重新埋头苦干。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you round the corner and you’re brought into the mine proper, you see the milodan chain-gang, each of them carrying a heavy pouch, either in their hand or on their hip. They slosh with liquid with every movement; Ula had kept to her word and sent down excess water for each of them to enjoy. But most of them are acting as if there’s nothing new at all to their day: some of them are chugging their water – apparently they were more parched than you had realized – but most of them are just back to the grind."

rows.original: Standing in the corner of the room is Eitan, with his pickaxe flipped over and his hands resting one over the other on the butt of the handle. His expression is sour and his eyes are cast downward. He doesn’t have any additional water of his own – he specifically asked for more water for his people, and not for him, so you wouldn’t be surprised if he didn’t get any.
rows.translation: 站在房间角落的是埃坦，他把镐子倒过来，双手一上一下搭在柄尾上。他脸色阴沉，眼睛垂向地面。他自己没有多出来的水–他特意要求多给他族人一些水，而不是给他自己，所以就算他一点也没拿到，你也不会意外。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding in the corner of the room is Eitan, with his pickaxe flipped over and his hands resting one over the other on the butt of the handle. His expression is sour and his eyes are cast downward. He doesn’t have any additional water of his own – he specifically asked for more water for his people, and not for him, so you wouldn’t be surprised if he didn’t get any."

rows.original: You wonder what’s gotten Eitan into such a sour mood. He got exactly what he asked for – this should be a happy moment for him, and for you, but that’s clearly not the case. You know you should talk with him some more, but he also doesn’t look like he’s in an especially talkative mood, and you might just make it worse.
rows.translation: 你想知道什么让艾坦的心情如此糟糕。他得到了自己要求的一切——这本该是他和你共同的快乐时刻，可事实显然并非如此。你知道应该再和他谈谈，但他看起来也实在没有聊天的心情，你或许只会让情况恶化。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder what’s gotten Eitan into such a sour mood. He got exactly what he asked for – this should be a happy moment for him, and for you, but that’s clearly not the case. You know you should talk with him some more, but he also doesn’t look like he’s in an especially talkative mood, and you might just make it worse."

rows.original: If you had to guess, Eitan was hoping his reputation with his own people would flip like a switch for the good deed he did. He told you that his mother was ‘beloved by all’ when she was alpha, and he was probably fantasizing about getting the same recognition for this one thing that he did, and when he didn’t get it, it soured his mood. You know that it’ll take more than one good deed, and you’re sure he’s smart enough to know that too – you just hope he doesn’t think it was a waste of time.
rows.translation: 要你猜的话，埃坦原本盼着凭自己这件善举，他在族人心中的名声能像开关一样一下子翻转过来。他告诉过你，他母亲当首领的时候‘深受所有人爱戴’，而他大概一直在幻想，靠自己做成的这一件事就能换来同样的认可；结果没得到，他的心情就坏了。你知道光靠一件善举远远不够，你也相信他足够聪明，明白这个道理，你只希望他别觉得那是白费工夫。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you had to guess, Eitan was hoping his reputation with his own people would flip like a switch for the good deed he did. He told you that his mother was ‘beloved by all’ when she was alpha, and he was probably fantasizing about getting the same recognition for this one thing that he did, and when he didn’t get it, it soured his mood. You know that it’ll take more than one good deed, and you’re sure he’s smart enough to know that too – you just hope he doesn’t think it was a waste of time."

rows.original: One of the male milodan, the closest to Eitan on the chain, keeps glancing over his shoulder with every swing of his pick, and before you can approach Eitan yourself, the milodan disrupts the chain by stepping away from his post and approaching his alpha. The milodan stood a head shorter than Eitan and wasn’t nearly as wide, giving you a perspective on how large the alpha is. The milodan had to tilt his head backward just to meet Eitan’s gaze eye-to-eye.
rows.translation: 锁链上距离艾坦最近的一名男性米洛丹，每次挥动鹤嘴锄都会回头瞥上一眼。你还没来得及亲自走近艾坦，他便离开岗位，打乱整条队伍，走向自己的阿尔法。这名米洛丹比艾坦矮了整整一个头，也远不如他宽壮，让你直观感受到这位阿尔法究竟多么庞大。他必须把头向后仰，才能与艾坦平视。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the male milodan, the closest to Eitan on the chain, keeps glancing over his shoulder with every swing of his pick, and before you can approach Eitan yourself, the milodan disrupts the chain by stepping away from his post and approaching his alpha. The milodan stood a head shorter than Eitan and wasn’t nearly as wide, giving you a perspective on how large the alpha is. The milodan had to tilt his head backward just to meet Eitan’s gaze eye-to-eye."

rows.original: The smaller milodan said something, but you’re too far away to hear, and his voice is drowned out by the sound of picks against ore. It’s a quick, one-sided conversation, with Eitan standing and listening. But, most importantly, you can make out the words ‘thank you’ before the milodan returns to his position with his pickaxe, swinging away like nothing happened.
rows.translation: 个头较小的米洛丹说了些什么，可距离太远，你听不清楚；他的声音被鹤嘴锄敲击矿石的声响淹没。这是一场短暂而单方面的谈话，艾坦只是站着倾听。不过最重要的是，你听清了‘谢谢’两个字；随后那名米洛丹便拿着鹤嘴锄回到岗位，继续挥动，仿佛什么都没发生。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe smaller milodan said something, but you’re too far away to hear, and his voice is drowned out by the sound of picks against ore. It’s a quick, one-sided conversation, with Eitan standing and listening. But, most importantly, you can make out the words ‘thank you’ before the milodan returns to his position with his pickaxe, swinging away like nothing happened."

rows.original: Those two little words have an effect on Eitan. His body doesn’t move; his eyes don’t rise from the downward stare; and his expression doesn’t un-cloud – save for his brow, which unfurrows. It’s such a slight change to his look that
rows.translation: 那短短两个词对埃坦起了作用。他的身体没有动；他的眼睛没有从那低垂的凝视中抬起；他的表情也没有放晴 – 只有眉心舒展了些。他神情的变化如此细微，以至于
rows.raw: "\n\nThose two little words have an effect on Eitan. His body doesn’t move; his eyes don’t rise from the downward stare; and his expression doesn’t un-cloud – save for his brow, which unfurrows. It’s such a slight change to his look that "

pc.reflexes() < 20
                ? "you’re surprised that even you managed to pick it up"

rows.original: you’re surprised that even you managed to pick it up
rows.translation: 连你自己竟然都能听清，着实令你意外
rows.raw: "you’re surprised that even you managed to pick it up"

rows.original: you doubt anyone else could have noticed it
rows.translation: 你怀疑别人根本不可能注意到
rows.raw: "you doubt anyone else could have noticed it"

rows.original: , but it’s enough to let you know that it’s changed his mood.
rows.translation: ，但已足够让你知道，这改变了他的心情。
rows.raw: ", but it’s enough to let you know that it’s changed his mood."

rows.original: Eitan doesn’t acknowledge you at first when you approach him. He’s still absorbing what had just happened and how he should process it.
rows.translation: 你走近埃坦时，他一开始没有理会你。他还在消化刚刚发生的事，以及自己该如何面对。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan doesn’t acknowledge you at first when you approach him. He’s still absorbing what had just happened and how he should process it."

rows.original: Hopefully, it’s enough to get him over whatever funk he’s in, but you keep yourself available all the same, just in case he needs to talk some more things out with you.
rows.translation: 希望这足以让他摆脱低落情绪；不过你仍留在附近，以防他还需要与你谈谈，梳理更多心事。
rows.raw: " Hopefully, it’s enough to get him over whatever funk he’s in, but you keep yourself available all the same, just in case he needs to talk some more things out with you."

rows.original: It may not be the fantasy he was hoping would come true, but, with any luck, that one little sign of appreciation would let him know that he’s on the right track.
rows.translation: 这也许不是他期待成真的那种幻想，但运气好的话，那一点小小的赞许会让他知道自己走对了路。
rows.raw: " It may not be the fantasy he was hoping would come true, but, with any luck, that one little sign of appreciation would let him know that he’s on the right track."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” Eitan finally says after a solemn few moments. You stand at attention, ready for whatever he’s about to say.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”庄严沉默了片刻后，艾坦终于开口。你立正站好，准备听他说出任何话。
rows.raw: "“[pc.name] Steele,” Eitan finally says after a solemn few moments. You stand at attention, ready for whatever he’s about to say."

rows.original: He takes a deep breath: in, then holds it, then out, in a single, long, smooth exhale through his mouth. His body visibly deflates, as if years and years of tension had left him with that one breath.
rows.translation: 他深吸一口气：吸入，屏住，然后从嘴里以一道漫长而平稳的呼气吐出。身体肉眼可见地松弛下来，仿佛多年来积累的紧张都随这一口气离开了。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe takes a deep breath: in, then holds it, then out, in a single, long, smooth exhale through his mouth. His body visibly deflates, as if years and years of tension had left him with that one breath."

rows.original: “Tell the korgonne chieftain that I would have an audience with her,” he says. “We’ll discuss the future between the korgonne and the milodan.”
rows.translation: “告诉科尔贡的酋长，我要与她面谈，”他说。“我们会谈谈科尔贡与米洛丹之间的未来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell the korgonne chieftain that I would have an audience with her,” he says. “We’ll discuss the future between the korgonne and the milodan.”"

rows.original: You don’t want to dissuade him – that’s a big thing that he wants to do, and it’s the goal you and Ula were hoping to achieve from the start – but you remind him that his reputation with Ula isn’t exactly in good standing. She remembers what he nearly did to her in the throne room.
rows.translation: 你不想打击他——他想做的是一件大事，也是你和乌拉从一开始便希望实现的目标——但你提醒他，自己在乌拉心中的名声可算不上好。她还记得他差点在王座厅里对她做出的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t want to dissuade him – that’s a big thing that he wants to do, and it’s the goal you and Ula were hoping to achieve from the start – but you remind him that his reputation with Ula isn’t exactly in good standing. She remembers what he nearly did to her in the throne room."

rows.original: “I’m not excited about it myself, [pc.name] Steele,” he admits. “A part of me is furious at the idea of making peace with the korgonne. We’ve been enemies for generations. And seeking peace only after I’ve been defeated will be seen as weakness and submission.” He sighs again. “But that’s my pride getting in the way of what I know is the greater good. A generations-long war can end with us.” He inhales sharply through his nose; this whole time, his eyes still haven’t met yours. “At the very least, peace between the milodan and the korgonne means no alpha after me would have to endure the same humiliation.”
rows.translation: “我自己也不期待这件事，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他承认道。“想到要与科尔贡人讲和，我心中有一部分怒不可遏。我们世代为敌。而且只在我战败之后寻求和平，会被视作软弱和屈服。”他再次叹息。“但那只是我的骄傲，正在妨碍我明知属于更大利益的事情。延续数代的战争可以在我们手中结束。”他猛地用鼻子吸气；自始至终，他的眼睛仍未与你相遇。“至少，米洛丹人与科尔贡人之间实现和平，意味着我之后的阿尔法不必忍受同样的耻辱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not excited about it myself, [pc.name] Steele,” he admits. “A part of me is furious at the idea of making peace with the korgonne. We’ve been enemies for generations. And seeking peace only after I’ve been defeated will be seen as weakness and submission.” He sighs again. “But that’s my pride getting in the way of what I know is the greater good. A generations-long war can end with us.” He inhales sharply through his nose; this whole time, his eyes still haven’t met yours. “At the very least, peace between the milodan and the korgonne means no alpha after me would have to endure the same humiliation.”"

rows.original: You’ve done it: you’ve gotten Eitan to seek peace between the two races. All that’s left now is to tell Ula that Eitan wants to speak with her. She’ll probably be exactly as thrilled about it as he is, but she’s got a cool head on her shoulders, and you know she’s looking forward to some real progress, too.
rows.translation: 你成功了：你让艾坦主动寻求两个种族之间的和平。现在只需告诉乌拉，艾坦想和她谈话。她对此大概会和他一样‘兴奋’，但她头脑冷静，而且你知道，她同样期待真正的进展。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve done it: you’ve gotten Eitan to seek peace between the two races. All that’s left now is to tell Ula that Eitan wants to speak with her. She’ll probably be exactly as thrilled about it as he is, but she’s got a cool head on her shoulders, and you know she’s looking forward to some real progress, too."

rows.original: When you enter Ula’s room, you find her pacing back and forth across it, her hands behind her back. She doesn’t look particularly perplexed, but the body language is nonetheless unsubtle.
rows.translation: 进入乌拉房间时，你发现她双手背在身后，来回踱步。她看起来并没有特别困惑，但这种肢体语言仍然十分明显。
rows.raw: "When you enter Ula’s room, you find her pacing back and forth across it, her hands behind her back. She doesn’t look particularly perplexed, but the body language is nonetheless unsubtle."

rows.raw: ",” she laughs, smiling warmly as she waits for your instruction."

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "To be honest, this whole time, I couldn’t decide on how I felt about you talking with the milodan alpha. On the one hand, I don’t think the milodan deserve to live out the rest of their lives in my mines, but on the other, I haven’t forgotten what the alpha nearly did to me, and I still haven’t forgiven him for it."
                : "Honest-having, Ula not sure how feelinged when [pc.name] talking at big milo. Milo not-might deserving of mine-work forever, but Ula unforgiving what big milo almost do."

rows.original: To be honest, this whole time, I couldn’t decide on how I felt about you talking with the milodan alpha. On the one hand, I don’t think the milodan deserve to live out the rest of their lives in my mines, but on the other, I haven’t forgotten what the alpha nearly did to me, and I still haven’t forgiven him for it.
rows.translation: 说实话，一直以来，我都无法确定自己对你和米洛丹阿尔法谈话有什么感受。一方面，我不认为米洛丹人应该在我的矿井里度过余生；但另一方面，我没有忘记那位阿尔法差点对我做出的事，而且至今仍没有原谅他。
rows.raw: "To be honest, this whole time, I couldn’t decide on how I felt about you talking with the milodan alpha. On the one hand, I don’t think the milodan deserve to live out the rest of their lives in my mines, but on the other, I haven’t forgotten what the alpha nearly did to me, and I still haven’t forgiven him for it."

rows.original: Honest-having, Ula not sure how feelinged when [pc.name] talking at big milo. Milo not-might deserving of mine-work forever, but Ula unforgiving what big milo almost do.
rows.translation: 诚实说，乌拉不知道[pc.name]和大米洛谈话时该有什么感觉。米洛也许不该永远做矿工，但乌拉不原谅大米洛差点做的事。
rows.raw: "Honest-having, Ula not sure how feelinged when [pc.name] talking at big milo. Milo not-might deserving of mine-work forever, but Ula unforgiving what big milo almost do."

rows.original: ” She stands up straight and brushes a lock of hair from her eyes, both of them narrowed into slits as she remembers the night of the invasion, and how dangerously close Eitan came to violating her. “
rows.translation: ” 她挺直身子，把一绺头发从眼前拨开，双眼眯成一条缝，因为她想起了入侵的那一夜，想起埃坦当时离侵犯她有多近。“
rows.raw: "” She stands up straight and brushes a lock of hair from her eyes, both of them narrowed into slits as she remembers the night of the invasion, and how dangerously close Eitan came to violating her. “"

"I’ve been thinking that, if you’ve really, really been trying to get through to him, and you really think you’re getting close, then I should try and be a little more supportive." : "Ula thinking that, if [pc.name] really-really try and fix big milo and really-really getting close, then Ula harder trying too."

rows.original: I’ve been thinking that, if you’ve really, really been trying to get through to him, and you really think you’re getting close, then I should try and be a little more supportive.
rows.translation: 我一直在想，如果你的确，真的 在努力让他听进去，而且你真的觉得快成功了，那我应该试着多支持你一点。
rows.raw: "I’ve been thinking that, if you’ve really, really been trying to get through to him, and you really think you’re getting close, then I should try and be a little more supportive."

rows.original: Ula thinking that, if [pc.name] really-really try and fix big milo and really-really getting close, then Ula harder trying too.
rows.translation: 乌拉觉得，如果[pc.name]真的真的努力修好大米洛，而且真的真的取得进展，那乌拉也会更努力尝试。
rows.raw: "Ula thinking that, if [pc.name] really-really try and fix big milo and really-really getting close, then Ula harder trying too."

rows.original: You’re glad she thinks that way, because Eitan specifically asked for an audience with her.
rows.translation: 你很高兴她这么想，因为艾坦明确要求与她会面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re glad she thinks that way, because Eitan specifically asked for an audience with her."

rows.original: At the news, her expression, and her jaw, drop, and her body tenses. <i>“
rows.translation: 听到这消息，她的表情和下巴一起垮了下来，身体绷紧。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the news, her expression, and her jaw, drop, and her body tenses. <i>“"

rows.translation: 你是说那个米洛丹阿尔法还想让我单独和他在一个房间里又一次？
rows.raw: "You’re saying the milodan alpha wants me alone in a room with him again?"

rows.original: [pc.name] saying big milo wanting second chance at Ula-raping?
rows.translation: [pc.name]说大米洛想再试一次强奸乌拉？
rows.raw: "[pc.name] saying big milo wanting second chance at Ula-raping?"

rows.original: You had every intention of sitting in, and you’ve proven you can handle him. Besides, if Eitan is telling the truth, and you have no reason to believe he isn’t, he wants to talk with her to discuss peace. He wants to formally end the war between the korgonne and the milodan once and for all.
rows.translation: 你本来就打算旁听，而且你已经证明自己能应付他。再说，如果埃坦说的是真话，而你也没有理由认为他在撒谎，那他想和她谈谈，讨论和平。他想正式为科尔贡人与米洛丹人之间的战争画上句号，一劳永逸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou had every intention of sitting in, and you’ve proven you can handle him. Besides, if Eitan is telling the truth, and you have no reason to believe he isn’t, he wants to talk with her to discuss peace. He wants to formally end the war between the korgonne and the milodan once and for all."

rows.original: Ula groans at the news. She puts her face into both her palms and just stays there for a moment, absorbing everything you’re telling her.
rows.translation: 乌拉听到消息后呻吟了一声。她把脸埋进双手里，就那么待了一会儿，消化着你告诉她的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nUla groans at the news. She puts her face into both her palms and just stays there for a moment, absorbing everything you’re telling her."

rows.raw: "” she tells you, her voice muffled through her hands. You worry that she won’t, but soon enough, she relaxes, pulling her paws away to reveal her determined expression. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "I’m not going to let fear tell me what to do. I won’t let old hurts dig the tunnel of our future. My father hated milos more than any korg, but he tried for peace. It was a mistake then... but I am understanding why he kept trying. If this works, the whole tribe will have a safer future. If not, only I pay for the mistake."
                : "Ula not let fear tell what do. Not let old hurts dig future. Father hating milos more than any korg, but he try for peace. Was mistake then... but am understanding why he still try. If work, whole tribe have safer future. If not, only chief pay for mistake."

rows.original: I’m not going to let fear tell me what to do. I won’t let old hurts dig the tunnel of our future. My father hated milos more than any korg, but he tried for peace. It was a mistake then... but I am understanding why he kept trying. If this works, the whole tribe will have a safer future. If not, only I pay for the mistake.
rows.translation: 我不会让恐惧替我决定该怎么做。我也不会让旧日的伤痛替我们挖好未来的隧道。我父亲比任何科尔贡人都更恨米洛丹人，但他为和平努力过。当时那是个错误...可我现在明白他为什么一直不肯放弃了。如果这次能成，整个部族都会有一个更安全的未来。如果不成，那这个错误也只由我一个人来承担。
rows.raw: "I’m not going to let fear tell me what to do. I won’t let old hurts dig the tunnel of our future. My father hated milos more than any korg, but he tried for peace. It was a mistake then... but I am understanding why he kept trying. If this works, the whole tribe will have a safer future. If not, only I pay for the mistake."

rows.original: Ula not let fear tell what do. Not let old hurts dig future. Father hating milos more than any korg, but he try for peace. Was mistake then... but am understanding why he still try. If work, whole tribe have safer future. If not, only chief pay for mistake.
rows.translation: 乌拉不让恐惧告诉自己该做什么。不让旧伤挖坏未来。父亲比任何科尔格人都更恨米洛，但他仍尝试和平。当时是错误...但现在明白他为什么仍要尝试。如果成功，整个部落都有更安全未来。如果失败，只有酋长为错误付出代价。
rows.raw: "Ula not let fear tell what do. Not let old hurts dig future. Father hating milos more than any korg, but he try for peace. Was mistake then... but am understanding why he still try. If work, whole tribe have safer future. If not, only chief pay for mistake."

rows.original: And you saved me before. Saved me more than once! If you’re here, I’m sure it will be fine.
rows.translation: 而且你以前就救过我。不止一次救过我！有你在，我肯定一切都会好的。
rows.raw: "And you saved me before. Saved me more than once! If you’re here, I’m sure it will be fine."

rows.original: And [pc.name] save Ula before. Savinged many times! If [pc.name] here, it be fine.
rows.translation: 而且[pc.name]以前救过乌拉。救过好多次！有[pc.name]在，就没事。
rows.raw: "And [pc.name] save Ula before. Savinged many times! If [pc.name] here, it be fine."

rows.original: She stands up straight and heads to the door of her room, then out to the halls of the Hold. From there, she flags down the first warrior she finds and mouths a few words to them that you can’t make out.
rows.translation: 她站直身体，走向房门，随后进入堡垒的走廊。她拦下遇见的第一名战士，动嘴低声说了几句话，但你没能听清。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands up straight and heads to the door of her room, then out to the halls of the Hold. From there, she flags down the first warrior she finds and mouths a few words to them that you can’t make out."

rows.original: Wait here with me
rows.translation: 陪我在这里等
rows.raw: "Wait here with me"

rows.translation: 米洛丹阿尔法很快就会来见我们。
rows.raw: "The milodan alpha will be joining us soon."

rows.original: Big milo coming.
rows.translation: 大米洛丹要来了。
rows.raw: "Big milo coming."

rows.translation: 下一个

rows.translation: 乌拉与艾坦
rows.raw: "Ula & Eitan"

rows.original: B & Fenoxo
rows.raw: "B & Fenoxo"

rows.original: You and Ula wait in a tense silence, counting the minutes as you wait for Eitan to be brought up from the mines. She goes back to her pacing, her claw between her teeth; she rehearses talking points to herself, followed by rebuttals, before she finds a flaw or an inconsistency with her own arguments and she starts again.
rows.translation: 你和乌拉在紧张的沉默中等待，数着艾坦从矿井被带上来前流逝的一分一秒。她重新开始来回踱步，爪子抵在牙齿间；她独自排演谈话要点和相应反驳，随后发现自己的论点存在缺陷或矛盾，又从头开始。
rows.raw: "You and Ula wait in a tense silence, counting the minutes as you wait for Eitan to be brought up from the mines. She goes back to her pacing, her claw between her teeth; she rehearses talking points to herself, followed by rebuttals, before she finds a flaw or an inconsistency with her own arguments and she starts again."

rows.original: The general noise of motion and community coming from the Hold hush to a whisper, and you know you’re not waiting for much longer: the sound of heavy footsteps, accompanied by the clinking of chain against chain, reverberate through the open hallways, and soon, Eitan, escorted by two large-but-still-dwarfed korgonne warriors, is brought to Ula’s chamber. Looking at him and his circumstances, it’s difficult to believe that this isn’t the first time he’s been in here.
rows.translation: 堡垒里日常活动和社群交谈的嘈杂声降为低语，你知道不必再等多久：沉重脚步伴随锁链相互碰撞的叮当声，在开放走廊中回荡。很快，艾坦在两名身材高大、却仍被他衬得矮小的科尔贡战士押送下，被带进乌拉的房间。看着他和眼前处境，很难相信这不是他第一次来到这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe general noise of motion and community coming from the Hold hush to a whisper, and you know you’re not waiting for much longer: the sound of heavy footsteps, accompanied by the clinking of chain against chain, reverberate through the open hallways, and soon, Eitan, escorted by two large-but-still-dwarfed korgonne warriors, is brought to Ula’s chamber. Looking at him and his circumstances, it’s difficult to believe that this isn’t the first time he’s been in here."

rows.original: Eitan keeps his mouth shut. His eyes go to you first, then to Ula, and they stay there. He’s still wearing the chain harness, but since he’s not chained to the floor, the korgonne used the loose strands of chain to wrap and bind his wrists.
rows.translation: 埃坦闭着嘴不说话。他的目光先落到你身上，然后移向乌拉，就停在那儿。他还戴着那副锁链胸具，但既然他没有被锁在地上，科尔贡人就拿松开的链子缠住他的手腕，把他绑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan keeps his mouth shut. His eyes go to you first, then to Ula, and they stay there. He’s still wearing the chain harness, but since he’s not chained to the floor, the korgonne used the loose strands of chain to wrap and bind his wrists."

rows.original: The tension between him and Ula is palpable, and it wouldn’t take much for Ula to call off the whole thing and send him back to the dungeons.
rows.translation: 他和乌拉之间的紧张气氛显而易见，只要一点小事，乌拉就会取消整件事，把他送回地牢。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tension between him and Ula is palpable, and it wouldn’t take much for Ula to call off the whole thing and send him back to the dungeons."

rows.original: “Leave,” she instead says to the guards. With that one word, they turn and leave her chamber, standing guard at the entrance, leaving just her, you, and Eitan alone in there.
rows.translation: “退下，”她改而对守卫们说。就这一个字，他们转身离开了她的房间，在入口处站岗，只留下她、你和埃坦在里面。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Leave,” she instead says to the guards. With that one word, they turn and leave her chamber, standing guard at the entrance, leaving just her, you, and Eitan alone in there."

rows.original: Ula is half Eitan’s height, if even that, and he’s so tall compared to the generally-minuscule korgonne that his head brushes against the ceiling. Without her prompt, Eitan sinks to one knee, then the other, and then falls onto his rump, crossing his massive furry legs in front of himself. Even in his sitting posture, Ula only meets him eye-to-eye standing upright.
rows.translation: 乌拉的身高只有艾坦一半，甚至还不到；与普遍身材极小的科尔贡人相比，他高得脑袋都擦到天花板。乌拉尚未开口，艾坦便先单膝跪下，再跪下另一边，随后一屁股坐倒，把毛茸茸的巨腿盘在身前。即使他已经坐下，乌拉也必须直立才能与他平视。
rows.raw: "\n\nUla is half Eitan’s height, if even that, and he’s so tall compared to the generally-minuscule korgonne that his head brushes against the ceiling. Without her prompt, Eitan sinks to one knee, then the other, and then falls onto his rump, crossing his massive furry legs in front of himself. Even in his sitting posture, Ula only meets him eye-to-eye standing upright."

rows.original: “You and I have history, chieftain,” Eitan finally starts, rolling his shoulders and leaning forward. “Let’s not make this any more awkward than it needs to be and get right to it. I’d imagine [pc.name] Steele has told you why I asked for an audience with you.”
rows.translation: “我们之间有段历史，酋长，”艾坦终于开口，一边转动肩膀、向前倾身。“别让这件事变得比必要程度更加尴尬，直接进入正题吧。我想[pc.name]·斯蒂尔已经告诉你，我为何请求与你会面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You and I have history, chieftain,” Eitan finally starts, rolling his shoulders and leaning forward. “Let’s not make this any more awkward than it needs to be and get right to it. I’d imagine [pc.name] Steele has told you why I asked for an audience with you.”"

rows.translation: 一开始我几乎不敢相信。米洛丹人和科尔贡人曾经和平相处，直到你们撒谎、杀戮，无缘无故地入侵我们的家园。
rows.raw: "I could hardly believe it at first. The milodan and the korgonne had peace before you lied, murdered, and invaded our home unprovoked."

rows.raw: "Not-belief Ula had of first. Milo and korg peace-having before cat-dogs lie, murder, and invade."

                : "Thinking milos peace-wanting only because milos lost. Not peace-giving to korgonne if won."

rows.original: I’m sure you’re only after peace now that you lost. I doubt you’d give us the same peace if you won.
rows.translation: 我确信你现在想要和平，只是因为输了。要是你赢了，我怀疑你根本不会给我们这样的和平。
rows.raw: "I’m sure you’re only after peace now that you lost. I doubt you’d give us the same peace if you won."

rows.original: Thinking milos peace-wanting only because milos lost. Not peace-giving to korgonne if won.
rows.translation: 觉得米洛人只因战败才想要和平。若米洛人获胜，不会给科尔贡人和平。
rows.raw: "Thinking milos peace-wanting only because milos lost. Not peace-giving to korgonne if won."

rows.original: “Probably not,” he admits. “If I never lost the one fight that mattered most, I wouldn’t have learned the humility I know now.” Despite Ula’s obvious hate for him, he sits still, totally unfazed by her. “Chieftain, I grew up believing that the korgonne were my sworn enemies, and it’s taken a lot of time and thinking for me to swallow my pride and admit to my enemy that I was in the wrong. If you don’t think I’m being honest when I say we can make peace, then send me back down. I’ve accepted that I might never leave.”
rows.translation: “大概不会，”他承认道。“如果我没有输掉那场最重要的战斗，就不会学会如今明白的谦逊。”尽管乌拉明显憎恨他，他仍安稳坐着，完全不为所动。“酋长，我从小便相信科尔贡人是自己的死敌；经过漫长时间和思考，我才终于咽下骄傲，向敌人承认自己错了。如果你不相信我是真心认为我们可以实现和平，那就把我送回下面。我已经接受自己也许永远无法离开的事实。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably not,” he admits. “If I never lost the one fight that mattered most, I wouldn’t have learned the humility I know now.” Despite Ula’s obvious hate for him, he sits still, totally unfazed by her. “Chieftain, I grew up believing that the korgonne were my sworn enemies, and it’s taken a lot of time and thinking for me to swallow my pride and admit to my enemy that I was in the wrong. If you don’t think I’m being honest when I say we can make peace, then send me back down. I’ve accepted that I might never leave.”"

rows.translation: 乌拉稳住站姿，消化着他的道歉时，忍不住咬着牙关。
rows.raw: "\n\nUla stands her ground, unable to keep from working her jaw as she processes his apology. "

rows.original: Eitan takes a deep breath himself and hesitates before answering. You bet he’s been rehearsing his own statements to himself, like what she did before he came. “A formal end to the war between the korgonne and the milodan,” he answers clearly. “No truces. No stalemates. An agreement to end the conflict for good. And for my people and I to be released from your mines.”
rows.translation: 埃坦自己也深吸一口气，回答前犹豫了一下。你猜他一直在心里排练自己的说辞，就像她在他来之前做的那样。“正式结束科尔贡和米洛丹人之间的战争，”他清楚地答道，“不要停战协定。不要僵持。要一份永久结束冲突的协议。还要让我们族人和我从你们的矿里获释。”

rows.original: Eitan reels in surprise at the demand. “All of them?” he parrots. “Including the medicine? I won’t do that, chieftain; after everything I’ve been through to get my people medicine, and to get us modern weapons and defenses from Frostwyrms and aliens, I won’t just hand them away. We’d be better off staying in your mines.”
rows.translation: 听到这个要求，埃坦惊得晃了一下。“全部？”他重复道。“连药也算？我不会那么做的，酋长；我千辛万苦才给族人弄到药，才从霜龙和外星人那里给我们换来现代的武器和防御，我不会就这么交出去。我们还不如留在你的矿里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan reels in surprise at the demand. “All of them?” he parrots. “Including the medicine? I won’t do that, chieftain; after everything I’ve been through to get my people medicine, and to get us modern weapons and defenses from Frostwyrms and aliens, I won’t just hand them away. We’d be better off staying in your mines.”"

rows.original: ,” Ula retorts.
rows.translation: ，”乌拉反驳道。
rows.raw: ",” Ula retorts."

rows.original: He breathes in deep through his nose. He’ll have some explaining to do among the milodan. “Fine,” he eventually grunts through clenched teeth. “I agree to your terms. But... just know that I’m putting a lot of trust in you for this.” Ula says nothing in response. “Anything else?”
rows.translation: 他用鼻子深深吸了一口气。回到米洛丹人之中以后，他少不了要费一番口舌解释。“好吧，”他终于咬紧牙关，低声说道。“我同意你的条件。但是...你要知道，在这件事上，我把很大的信任交给了你。”乌拉没有回应。“还有别的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe breathes in deep through his nose. He’ll have some explaining to do among the milodan. “Fine,” he eventually grunts through clenched teeth. “I agree to your terms. But... just know that I’m putting a lot of trust in you for this.” Ula says nothing in response. “Anything else?”"

rows.original: Tapping her paw on the ground, Ula looks away from the mass of milodan muscle and toward you, finding solace in a friendly face while she thinks. Her expression cycles through four or five different emotions before she returns her gaze to the prisoner with a shuddering sigh: “No.”
rows.translation: 乌拉用爪子轻敲地面，把目光从那一大团米洛丹肌肉身上移开，转向了你；思考时，她从一张友善的面孔上寻求慰藉。她脸上的神情连续变换了四五种，最后才颤抖着叹了口气，重新看向俘虏：“没有。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTapping her paw on the ground, Ula looks away from the mass of milodan muscle and toward you, finding solace in a friendly face while she thinks. Her expression cycles through four or five different emotions before she returns her gaze to the prisoner with a shuddering sigh: “No.”"

rows.original: Eitan nods, and he lets out a deep breath. He must have been holding it since they started. “We have a deal.”
rows.translation: 埃坦点点头，长长地吐出一口气。他大概从谈判开始时就一直屏着呼吸。“成交。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan nods, and he lets out a deep breath. He must have been holding it since they started. “We have a deal.”"

rows.original: You, Eitan, and the entire chain-gang of milodan are standing outside of the korgonne Hold in the afternoon. Ula and every adult korgonne capable of carrying a weapon are with you. Some part of her still fears that this entire negotiation was nothing more than another front for another sneak attack. Older, wizened korgonne are busy ushering in a stockpile of Pyrite Industries weaponry and technology into the Hold.
rows.translation: 下午，你、埃坦，还有那一整队米洛丹苦役，都站在科尔贡人的据点外。乌拉和每一个能拿起武器的成年科尔贡人都在你身边。她心里仍有一部分在害怕，这场谈判不过是又一次偷袭的幌子。年长而干瘦的科尔贡人正忙着把一批黄铁矿工业的武器和技术搬进据点。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou, Eitan, and the entire chain-gang of milodan are standing outside of the korgonne Hold in the afternoon. Ula and every adult korgonne capable of carrying a weapon are with you. Some part of her still fears that this entire negotiation was nothing more than another front for another sneak attack. Older, wizened korgonne are busy ushering in a stockpile of Pyrite Industries weaponry and technology into the Hold. "

rows.original: The stockpiles arrived in the morning. Ula’s father himself hand counted the items as they were presented. He was sceptical that they were being sincere with how many weapons they were giving away, but he was honor bound to abide by Ula’s judgements. His opinion did nothing to better Ula’s mood, but she wisely deferred to your expertise in the field.
rows.translation: 储备物资在早晨运抵。物品呈上来时，乌拉的父亲亲自逐件清点。他怀疑对方是否真心愿意交出如此多的武器，但为了荣誉，他必须遵从乌拉的判断。他的意见丝毫没有改善乌拉的心情，不过她明智地选择在这个领域听从你的专业判断。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe stockpiles arrived in the morning. Ula’s father himself hand counted the items as they were presented. He was sceptical that they were being sincere with how many weapons they were giving away, but he was honor bound to abide by Ula’s judgements. His opinion did nothing to better Ula’s mood, but she wisely deferred to your expertise in the field."

rows.original: ,” Ula says to Eitan, flanked on either side by a pair of warrior korgonne. Her words come out stilted, through a stiff mouth; as much as she wanted the milodan out of her mines, and even though she got everything she demanded out of their negotiations, she still can’t stand the sight of Eitan and is eager to have him gone. “
rows.translation: ，”乌拉对埃坦说道，两侧各站着一名科尔贡战士。她嘴唇僵硬，话语也显得生涩；尽管她希望米洛丹人离开矿井，也在谈判中得到了自己要求的一切，但她仍然无法忍受看到埃坦，只盼他尽快离开。“

rows.original: Ula, noticing his downtrodden expression, relaxes her body and sighs herself – more in exasperation than in stress or sadness. “Eitan,” she says, calling him by his name for the first time, “
rows.translation: 乌拉注意到他沮丧的神情，身体放松下来，自己也叹了口气，与其说是紧张或悲伤，倒不如说是恼怒。“埃坦，”她说道，第一次直呼他的名字，“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla, noticing his downtrodden expression, relaxes her body and sighs herself – more in exasperation than in stress or sadness. “Eitan,” she says, calling him by his name for the first time, “"

joinAfter.expression:

                ? "maybe it doesn’t mean much coming from me, but... being a good leader means making hard decisions. Harder than stone. I doubt I’ll ever be able to stand being around you, but... I can respect you."
                : "maybe coming from Ula not mean much, but... being good leader means decisions hard. Harder than stone. Doubt ever able to stand you, but... Ula can respect."

rows.original: maybe it doesn’t mean much coming from me, but... being a good leader means making hard decisions. Harder than stone. I doubt I’ll ever be able to stand being around you, but... I can respect you.
rows.translation: 也许由我来说并没有多少意义，但是...当一个好领袖，就意味着必须做出艰难的决定。比石头还要坚硬。我恐怕永远都受不了和你待在一起，但是...我能尊重你。

rows.raw: "maybe coming from Ula not mean much, but... being good leader means decisions hard. Harder than stone. Doubt ever able to stand you, but... Ula can respect."

rows.original: ” She nods slightly, her features the calmest you’ve seen in Eitan’s presence. “

rows.raw: "” She nods slightly, her features the calmest you’ve seen in Eitan’s presence. “"

                ? "I hope the chiefs and chieftesses of the future don’t have to deal with these worries."
                : "Hoping chiefs and chieftesses of future not have these worries."

rows.original: I hope the chiefs and chieftesses of the future don’t have to deal with these worries.
rows.translation: 我希望未来的酋长们和女酋长们不必再操这些心。
rows.raw: "I hope the chiefs and chieftesses of the future don’t have to deal with these worries."

rows.original: Eitan lifts his head high enough to meet her gaze. You can tell he’s terribly conflicted about it all – having to shirk the attitudes he’s built up all his life about being alpha, and having to submit to the demands of a korgonne less than half his size – but he knows that he’s making the overall better decision, and the pain of his humiliation will be temporary.
rows.translation: 埃坦把头抬到足以与她对视的高度。你看得出来，这一切让他内心极度矛盾；他不得不抛开自己一生以来身为阿尔法所形成的观念，还必须服从一名体型不到自己一半的科尔贡人的要求。然而，他知道自己做出了总体上更好的决定，而屈辱带来的痛苦也只是暂时的。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan lifts his head high enough to meet her gaze. You can tell he’s terribly conflicted about it all – having to shirk the attitudes he’s built up all his life about being alpha, and having to submit to the demands of a korgonne less than half his size – but he knows that he’s making the overall better decision, and the pain of his humiliation will be temporary."

rows.original: “Likewise,” he responds, apparently not in the mood to waste words.
rows.translation: “彼此彼此，”他回应道，显然没心情多费口舌。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Likewise,” he responds, apparently not in the mood to waste words."

rows.original: Ula leans to the guard on her left. You recognize it as one of the two guards maintaining the post at the prison. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉凑向左边那名守卫。你认出这是驻守监狱的两名守卫之一。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla leans to the guard on her left. You recognize it as one of the two guards maintaining the post at the prison. <i>“"

rows.original: ,” she instructs, and her guard steps forward, the key to their shackles bouncing off his hip. One by one, he undoes the shackles at their ankles; when one is released, the guard instructs them to step away from the gang before he undoes the next. And they repeat this process until they’re all released, their chain lying flaccid in the snow.
rows.translation: ，”她命令道。她的守卫走上前，镣铐钥匙在他髋侧弹跳。守卫逐个解开他们脚踝上的镣铐；每释放一人，他都会命令对方离开苦工队，然后才解开下一个。这个过程不断重复，直到所有人都被释放，那条锁链软塌塌地躺在雪地上。
rows.raw: ",” she instructs, and her guard steps forward, the key to their shackles bouncing off his hip. One by one, he undoes the shackles at their ankles; when one is released, the guard instructs them to step away from the gang before he undoes the next. And they repeat this process until they’re all released, their chain lying flaccid in the snow."

rows.original: The milodan are silent the entire time, unsure of how to react to the scenario. Many of them turn to Eitan, their alpha, for instruction: should they attack? Should they refuse freedom in the name of their pride, since, to them, freedom means having to grovel to their enemies?
rows.translation: 米洛丹人全程一言不发，不知道该如何应对眼前的局面。许多人转头看向他们的阿尔法埃坦，等待指示：他们该进攻吗？他们是否应该为了骄傲而拒绝自由，因为对他们来说，自由意味着必须向敌人卑躬屈膝？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe milodan are silent the entire time, unsure of how to react to the scenario. Many of them turn to Eitan, their alpha, for instruction: should they attack? Should they refuse freedom in the name of their pride, since, to them, freedom means having to grovel to their enemies?"

rows.original: But Eitan stands steadfast and unmoving. He gives them no hint or instruction. And each of them are at a total loss for it. The milodan are a warrior race, and submitting, even for the greater health of both themselves and the korgonne in the long run, has them at ends with themselves. So, they do what Eitan is doing: stand silent and stoic.
rows.translation: 但埃坦坚定地站在原地，一动不动。他没有给出任何暗示或指示。每个人都因此彻底不知所措。米洛丹是一个战士种族，即使长远来看，服从有利于他们自身和科尔贡人的共同福祉，他们也会为此陷入自我冲突。于是，他们照着埃坦的样子去做：沉默而坚忍地站着。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut Eitan stands steadfast and unmoving. He gives them no hint or instruction. And each of them are at a total loss for it. The milodan are a warrior race, and submitting, even for the greater health of both themselves and the korgonne in the long run, has them at ends with themselves. So, they do what Eitan is doing: stand silent and stoic."

rows.raw: "We will release your alpha once you are out of eyesight"

rows.original: At first, the milodan don’t move. Ula is not their alpha. “Do as she says,” Eitan says over his shoulder – and, hesitantly, one by one, the milodan turn and march, making their way towards their tribe’s home. Eitan doesn’t turn to see them leave.
rows.translation: 起初，米洛丹人一动不动。乌拉并非他们的阿尔法。“照她说的做，”埃坦头也不回地说道。米洛丹人迟疑着逐一转身行进，踏上返回部族家园的路。埃坦没有回头目送他们离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first, the milodan don’t move. Ula is not their alpha. “Do as she says,” Eitan says over his shoulder – and, hesitantly, one by one, the milodan turn and march, making their way towards their tribe’s home. Eitan doesn’t turn to see them leave."

rows.original: Once the last milodan is over the hill and they’re all out of eyesight, the guard approaches Eitan. He drops to his knees to let the guard reach the lock pressed between his shoulder-blades; with a click and the turn of the key, the chain harness is undone, and the harness hangs limply on his body. He could remove it like a shirt. He’s free.
rows.translation: 最后一名米洛丹人翻过山丘、所有人都消失在视野中后，守卫走向埃坦。埃坦跪倒在地，好让守卫够到压在他肩胛骨之间的锁；随着一声咔哒和钥匙的转动，锁链束具被解开，松垮垮地挂在他身上。他可以像脱衬衫一样把它脱掉。他自由了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the last milodan is over the hill and they’re all out of eyesight, the guard approaches Eitan. He drops to his knees to let the guard reach the lock pressed between his shoulder-blades; with a click and the turn of the key, the chain harness is undone, and the harness hangs limply on his body. He could remove it like a shirt. He’s free."

rows.original: With that, she turns and leaves, making her way back into the Hold. Her guards maintain their stance until she’s safe inside, and then they turn to enter the Hold themselves, leaving just you and Eitan in the snow.

rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, she turns and leaves, making her way back into the Hold. Her guards maintain their stance until she’s safe inside, and then they turn to enter the Hold themselves, leaving just you and Eitan in the snow."
