rows.original: B

Once Ula and the other korgonne are safely inside the Hold, Eitan turns on the spot to face you. His wrists are still bound by the chains, but they, like the rest of his harness, are loose, and he could easily wriggle them off with a few shakes.
rows.translation: 乌拉和其他科尔贡人安全进入要塞后，埃坦原地转身面对你。他的双腕依然被锁链绑着，但那些锁链和束具的其他部分一样松垮，只需抖动几下就能轻易挣脱。
rows.raw: "Once Ula and the other korgonne are safely inside the Hold, Eitan turns on the spot to face you. His wrists are still bound by the chains, but they, like the rest of his harness, are loose, and he could easily wriggle them off with a few shakes."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” he begins. You can see something in his eyes that you never saw before – a type of sincere, earnest clarity that was clouded by the attitudes and aggressions that you had talked him out of. It was as if he had cataracts that blinded him from seeing the korgonne as anything other than an opposing peoples to be subdued and eradicated, and while you doubt he’d ever call them ‘friends,’ you can at least tell that he’s swallowed all that fury, and now, all he wants is to go home.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他开口说道。你在他眼中看见了某种从未见过的东西，一种真挚、诚恳的清明；此前，它一直被你已经劝他放下的偏见和敌意所遮蔽。仿佛他曾患有白内障，使他眼中的科尔贡人只是一群必须征服并消灭的敌对民族。虽然你怀疑他永远不会称他们为“朋友”，但至少你看得出来，他已经咽下了全部怒火，如今只想回家。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” he begins. You can see something in his eyes that you never saw before – a type of sincere, earnest clarity that was clouded by the attitudes and aggressions that you had talked him out of. It was as if he had cataracts that blinded him from seeing the korgonne as anything other than an opposing peoples to be subdued and eradicated, and while you doubt he’d ever call them ‘friends,’ you can at least tell that he’s swallowed all that fury, and now, all he wants is to go home."

rows.original: He, however, doesn’t phrase it as such. In fact, he doesn’t say much of anything at first, at a loss for the words you’d just decided for him to yourself. A moment ticks by awkwardly between you two as he struggles with his next sentence.
rows.translation: 然而，他并没有这样表达。事实上，他起初几乎什么都没说，完全找不到你刚刚在心里替他决定好的那些词句。两人之间尴尬地过去了片刻，他苦苦斟酌着下一句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe, however, doesn’t phrase it as such. In fact, he doesn’t say much of anything at first, at a loss for the words you’d just decided for him to yourself. A moment ticks by awkwardly between you two as he struggles with his next sentence."

rows.original: “The direction... of not just my life,” he stutters, making it up as he goes, “but of all the milodan... would have been... uncertain, if it weren’t for you. In the past, I would have preferred that I were victorious over the korgonne. Failing my attack led to one embarrassment after another, as the alpha of the milodan, but... knowing how it ends, and that no milodan alpha after me will suffer the same embarrassments, I’m not sure I would prefer it any other way. There is more to life than fighting and war, and it’s my own fault for having seen it that way in the first place.”
rows.translation: “不只是我人生的方向...”他结结巴巴地说，一边说一边现编，“而是所有米洛丹人的方向...本来都会...不确定，要不是因为你。从前，我宁愿自己在与科尔贡的争斗中获胜。那次进攻失败后，作为米洛丹的阿尔法，我经历了一次又一次的难堪，可是...知道结局是这样，而且我之后的米洛丹阿尔法都不会再遭受同样的难堪，我不确定我还希望有别的结果。人生不止是战斗和战争，一开始把它看成那样，是我自己的错。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The direction... of not just my life,” he stutters, making it up as he goes, “but of all the milodan... would have been... uncertain, if it weren’t for you. In the past, I would have preferred that I were victorious over the korgonne. Failing my attack led to one embarrassment after another, as the alpha of the milodan, but... knowing how it ends, and that no milodan alpha after me will suffer the same embarrassments, I’m not sure I would prefer it any other way. There is more to life than fighting and war, and it’s my own fault for having seen it that way in the first place.”"

rows.original: That’s... wow. That’s a touching, sensitive thing to say, especially for a guy like him.
rows.translation: 这真是...哇。尤其对他这样的人来说，这句话既感人又细腻。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... wow. That’s a touching, sensitive thing to say, especially for a guy like him."

rows.original: “You are welcome in my tribe, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “In fact, I would enjoy your company for a visit, if you can. We have more things to... discuss.”
rows.translation: “我的部族欢迎你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说。“事实上，如果你有空来访，我会很享受你的陪伴。我们还有更多事情要...讨论。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are welcome in my tribe, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “In fact, I would enjoy your company for a visit, if you can. We have more things to... discuss.”"

rows.original: You allow your eyes to fall down Eitan’s body: from his face, to his barrel chest, to his washboard abs hidden beneath that thin undershirt you gave him, to those thin pants with holes that the korgonne gave him to keep him decent. When you eye the bulge in his pants and you see the way his tail swishes when you stare at it, you get a pretty solid idea of what it is he wants to ‘discuss’ with you in his tribe.
rows.translation: 你任由目光顺着埃坦的身体往下滑：从他的脸，到他那桶状的胸膛，到被那件你给他的薄内衣遮住的搓板腹肌，再到那条科尔贡人给他遮羞的、破了洞的薄裤子。当你盯着他裤裆处的鼓起，又看到他尾巴在你注视时摆动的样子，你就相当确定他想在自己的部落里跟你‘讨论’些什么了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou allow your eyes to fall down Eitan’s body: from his face, to his barrel chest, to his washboard abs hidden beneath that thin undershirt you gave him, to those thin pants with holes that the korgonne gave him to keep him decent. When you eye the bulge in his pants and you see the way his tail swishes when you stare at it, you get a pretty solid idea of what it is he wants to ‘discuss’ with you in his tribe."

rows.original: Still, the ball’s in your court. He’s giving you the option to visit, and hell, it doesn’t have to go any further than words if you don’t want. You tell him that you’ll consider it.
rows.translation: 不过，主动权还在你手里。他给了你上门拜访的选项，而且说实话，如果你不愿意，也不一定非要越过言语的界限。你告诉他你会考虑。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, the ball’s in your court. He’s giving you the option to visit, and hell, it doesn’t have to go any further than words if you don’t want. You tell him that you’ll consider it."

rows.original: “You can find us to the south and east from your offworlder settlement,” he instructs. “Towards the ocean where the Frostwyrm makes its territory. You’ll find that we aren’t very... approachable to strangers, but if you say my name, they’ll know to turn to me first.”
rows.translation: “从你们外星人定居点往东南走就能找到我们，”他指示道。“朝着海洋、霜龙划定领地的方向走。你会发现我们对陌生人不太...友善，但只要报上我的名字，他们就会知道先来找我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can find us to the south and east from your offworlder settlement,” he instructs. “Towards the ocean where the Frostwyrm makes its territory. You’ll find that we aren’t very... approachable to strangers, but if you say my name, they’ll know to turn to me first.”"

rows.original: You tell him you’ll keep it in mind as he lifts the now-loose harness up and over his head, tossing it into the snow at the foot of the Hold’s trap door. He turns and makes for his tribe’s home without another word.
rows.translation: 你告诉他自己会记在心上。他将已经松开的束具举过头顶脱下，扔进要塞活板门脚下的雪地。随后他转过身，一言不发地朝部族家园走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him you’ll keep it in mind as he lifts the now-loose harness up and over his head, tossing it into the snow at the foot of the Hold’s trap door. He turns and makes for his tribe’s home without another word."

rows.original: Eitan can now be found at his tribe, east of Irestead.
rows.translation: 现在可以在伊尔斯泰德以东的部族里找到埃坦。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan can now be found at his tribe, east of Irestead."

rows.original: EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS
rows.raw: "EITAN_PRISONER_NEGOTIATIONS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: UVGR O34
rows.raw: "UVGR O34"

rows.original: Tent
rows.translation: 帐篷
rows.raw: "Tent"

rows.original: Tent
rows.translation: 帐篷
rows.raw: "Tent"

rows.original: The biggest tent in the tribe belongs to Eitan and his family. This is where you’d be if you’re looking for anyone in the alpha’s line.
rows.translation: 部族里最大的帐篷属于埃坦及其家人。如果你要找阿尔法血脉中的任何人，就应该来这里。
rows.raw: "The biggest tent in the tribe belongs to Eitan and his family. This is where you’d be if you’re looking for anyone in the alpha’s line."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Alpha’s Tent
rows.translation: 阿尔法的帐篷
rows.raw: "Alpha’s Tent"

rows.original: B
You show yourself into the alpha’s tent.
rows.translation: 你走进了首领的帐篷。
rows.raw: "You show yourself into the alpha’s tent."

rows.original: It’s fairly plush and welcoming, at least compared to the exposed air of the tribe’s common ground just out front. The floor is hard and warm, and is covered in all manner of carpets to provide a soft, sturdy experience for your feet (or your rump, if you sat). The tent is so large that it’s split into compartments, and thin, wispy drapes cover them to provide only token privacy – you can see pretty much straight through them.
rows.translation: 这里相当豪华舒适，至少与门外部族公共场地无遮无掩的环境相比是如此。地面坚硬而温暖，铺满各式各样的地毯，让你的双脚踩上去柔软而稳当，如果坐下，屁股也会有同样感受。帐篷大得被分成了多个隔间，轻薄飘逸的帘幕遮住各处，却只能提供象征性的隐私，你几乎可以直接看穿它们。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s fairly plush and welcoming, at least compared to the exposed air of the tribe’s common ground just out front. The floor is hard and warm, and is covered in all manner of carpets to provide a soft, sturdy experience for your feet (or your rump, if you sat). The tent is so large that it’s split into compartments, and thin, wispy drapes cover them to provide only token privacy – you can see pretty much straight through them."

rows.original: Unfortunately, it doesn’t look like anyone is home. Eitan is on your ship, and you aren’t sure where the rest of his family are. The tent gives you some relief from the cold, so you can stay and rest if you want, but there’s otherwise nothing here.
rows.translation: 不幸的是，看样子没人在家。埃坦在你的船上，你不确定他家里其他人在哪儿。这顶帐篷能让你稍微躲开寒冷，所以你想留下休息也行，但除此之外这里什么都没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnfortunately, it doesn’t look like anyone is home. Eitan is on your ship, and you aren’t sure where the rest of his family are. The tent gives you some relief from the cold, so you can stay and rest if you want, but there’s otherwise nothing here."

rows.original: Sitting in the center of the tent is Eitan, his hands wringing together and his eyes cast downward in thought. When he looks up to see you, his expression lifts, and he beckons you to join him, patting the seat next to him on the floor.
rows.translation: 埃坦坐在帐篷中央，双手绞在一起，低垂着眼睛沉思。他抬头看见你后，神情顿时明朗起来，拍了拍自己身旁地板上的座位，招手示意你过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting in the center of the tent is Eitan, his hands wringing together and his eyes cast downward in thought. When he looks up to see you, his expression lifts, and he beckons you to join him, patting the seat next to him on the floor."

rows.original: Eitan
rows.translation: 埃坦
rows.raw: "Eitan"

rows.original: Eitan
rows.translation: 埃坦
rows.raw: "Eitan"

rows.original: Speak with Eitan, the milodan’s current alpha, and the one you’ve helped rehabilitate from the korgonne mining prison.
rows.translation: 与米洛丹人现任阿尔法埃坦交谈；你曾帮助他从科尔贡矿场监狱中改过自新。
rows.raw: "Speak with Eitan, the milodan’s current alpha, and the one you’ve helped rehabilitate from the korgonne mining prison."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: B
Eitan’s Tribe
rows.translation: 埃坦的部落
rows.raw: "Eitan’s Tribe"

rows.original: As comforting as the alpha’s homestead is compared to the exposed vacancy of the milodan tribe’s common ground, it’s time to leave. You turn your back on the warm, comfortable tent and return to the tribe’s open area.
rows.translation: 虽然与米洛丹部族空旷无遮的公共场地相比，阿尔法的住所令人倍感舒适，但该离开了。你转身背对温暖舒适的帐篷，回到部族的露天区域。
rows.raw: "As comforting as the alpha’s homestead is compared to the exposed vacancy of the milodan tribe’s common ground, it’s time to leave. You turn your back on the warm, comfortable tent and return to the tribe’s open area."

rows.original: You take Eitan’s invitation and park yourself right beside him.
rows.translation: 你接受了埃坦的邀请，直接在他身旁坐下。
rows.raw: "You take Eitan’s invitation and park yourself right beside him."

rows.original: “Welcome again, [pc.name] Steele. It’s good to see you,” he says, patting you on the shoulder warmly and smiling at you. You admit to yourself that it’s nice to get this kind of attention from him – you really get the sense that you’re welcome with him, and that he considers you a friend. “What can I do for you this time?”
rows.translation: “再次欢迎你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。很高兴见到你，”他说着，亲切地拍了拍你的肩膀，朝你微笑。你在心里承认，得到他这样的关注感觉很好；你真切感到他欢迎你，并把你视为朋友。“这次我能为你做些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome again, [pc.name] Steele. It’s good to see you,” he says, patting you on the shoulder warmly and smiling at you. You admit to yourself that it’s nice to get this kind of attention from him – you really get the sense that you’re welcome with him, and that he considers you a friend. “What can I do for you this time?”"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外观
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: For someone that comes from a society that doesn’t have electricity, Eitan is well-spoken and opinionated. Ask him for one of them on something!
rows.translation: 对一个来自没有电力的社会的人来说，埃坦谈吐不错，而且很有主见。找个话题，让他讲一个吧！
rows.raw: "For someone that comes from a society that doesn’t have electricity, Eitan is well-spoken and opinionated. Ask him for one of them on something!"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 做爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 做爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You can’t deny that Eitan has an enviable body, and he probably fucks like an engine. It’s time to see if all those talks about putting other’s needs before his own applies to his lovemaking.
rows.translation: 你无法否认埃坦有一副令人羡慕的身体，而且他干起人来大概像台发动机。该看看他那些把他人需求置于自身之前的说法，是否也适用于床笫之事了。
rows.raw: "You can’t deny that Eitan has an enviable body, and he probably fucks like an engine. It’s time to see if all those talks about putting other’s needs before his own applies to his lovemaking."

rows.original: Spar
rows.translation: 对练
rows.raw: "Spar"

rows.original: You ask Eitan how he keeps in shape ever since you got him out of the mines. You understand that he’s had a... particular lifestyle before his failed invasion of the korgonne Hold, and although he hasn’t done anything violent since then (which you congratulate), you also aren’t sure how he manages to keep the massive, muscular form he’s maintained since then.
rows.translation: 你问埃坦，自从你把他救出矿井后，他是如何保持体形的。你知道在入侵科尔贡要塞失败以前，他过着一种...特别的生活方式；虽然此后他没有再做任何暴力之事，对此你还称赞了他，但你也不清楚他究竟如何维持住这副一直以来都硕大健壮的身材。
rows.raw: "You ask Eitan how he keeps in shape ever since you got him out of the mines. You understand that he’s had a... particular lifestyle before his failed invasion of the korgonne Hold, and although he hasn’t done anything violent since then (which you congratulate), you also aren’t sure how he manages to keep the massive, muscular form he’s maintained since then."

joinAfter.expression: eitan.isCrew() ? "Not a lot,” he replies. “The food is plentiful, and there is no place for me to hunt larger game, so my hunting skills are wasted here. Your ship has equipment that’s good for maintaining a person’s body, but I still haven’t gotten used to using them. And, on Uveto, there was no shortage of prospective mates to keep me busy – mating is an excellent way to keep in shape, but the pickings are far slimmer here" : "There are lots of ways to keep a body as strong as mine, especially in a world as unforgiving as ours,” he says. “Whenever you aren’t around, I try to keep busy by joining the hunting packs and bringing home food for the tribe. Mating is also a decent way to keep in shape as well"

rows.original: Not a lot,” he replies. “The food is plentiful, and there is no place for me to hunt larger game, so my hunting skills are wasted here. Your ship has equipment that’s good for maintaining a person’s body, but I still haven’t gotten used to using them. And, on Uveto, there was no shortage of prospective mates to keep me busy – mating is an excellent way to keep in shape, but the pickings are far slimmer here
rows.translation: 没做多少，”他回答道。“这里食物充足，也没有地方让我猎取大型猎物，所以我的狩猎本领在这里无用武之地。你的飞船上有适合维持身体状态的设备，但我还是不习惯使用它们。而在乌维托，愿意交配的对象从来不缺，足够让我保持忙碌；交配是保持体形的绝佳方式，但这里的选择少得多
rows.raw: "Not a lot,” he replies. “The food is plentiful, and there is no place for me to hunt larger game, so my hunting skills are wasted here. Your ship has equipment that’s good for maintaining a person’s body, but I still haven’t gotten used to using them. And, on Uveto, there was no shortage of prospective mates to keep me busy – mating is an excellent way to keep in shape, but the pickings are far slimmer here"

rows.original: There are lots of ways to keep a body as strong as mine, especially in a world as unforgiving as ours,” he says. “Whenever you aren’t around, I try to keep busy by joining the hunting packs and bringing home food for the tribe. Mating is also a decent way to keep in shape as well
rows.translation: 有很多办法能让身体保持得像我一样强壮，尤其是在我们这样严酷无情的世界里，”他说。“每当你不在时，我都会试着加入狩猎队，为部族带回食物，让自己保持忙碌。交配同样也是一种不错的健身方式
rows.raw: "There are lots of ways to keep a body as strong as mine, especially in a world as unforgiving as ours,” he says. “Whenever you aren’t around, I try to keep busy by joining the hunting packs and bringing home food for the tribe. Mating is also a decent way to keep in shape as well"

rows.original: ”, he laughs. “Why do you ask?”
rows.translation: ”，他笑道。“你为什么这么问？”
rows.raw: "”, he laughs. “Why do you ask?”"

rows.original: In turn, you answer his question with a question: is he familiar with the concept of ‘sparring?’
rows.translation: 你反过来用问题回答他的问题：他可熟悉‘对练’这一概念？
rows.raw: "\n\nIn turn, you answer his question with a question: is he familiar with the concept of ‘sparring?’"

rows.original: “Yes,” he answers. “It’s mock-combat in a controlled environment.” He turns his gaze askance and raises an eyebrow at you. “Are you suggesting we fight, [pc.name] Steele?”
rows.translation: “是的，”他回答道。“就是在受控环境下进行模拟战斗。”他斜眼看向你，扬起一边眉毛。“你是在提议我们打一场吗，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” he answers. “It’s mock-combat in a controlled environment.” He turns his gaze askance and raises an eyebrow at you. “Are you suggesting we fight, [pc.name] Steele?”"

rows.original: If anyone’s proven that they can handle someone with Eitan’s size, it would be yourself, you respond. He’s done well in maintaining his aggression, but it could still be useful, and even healthy, to have an outlet from time to time. If he wants to keep his body strong and his instincts sharp, fighting against you in, as he described it, a controlled environment, could be a good way to get in some exercise and to let out those building combative instincts.
rows.translation: 你回答道，如果有人证明过自己能对付埃坦这般体型的家伙，那个人就是你。他在控制自身攻击性方面做得很好，但偶尔有个宣泄渠道仍会很有用，甚至有益健康。如果他想保持强壮的身体和敏锐的本能，那么在一个如他所说的受控环境里与你交手，既能锻炼身体，也能释放不断积聚的好斗本能。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf anyone’s proven that they can handle someone with Eitan’s size, it would be yourself, you respond. He’s done well in maintaining his aggression, but it could still be useful, and even healthy, to have an outlet from time to time. If he wants to keep his body strong and his instincts sharp, fighting against you in, as he described it, a controlled environment, could be a good way to get in some exercise and to let out those building combative instincts."

rows.original: He isn’t convinced, and in fact, his eyebrows crease as he considers your response. “Is that safe?” he asks. “I’ve done a lot of soul-searching to try this newer, more passive lifestyle, [pc.name] Steele, and I’m worried that fighting might make me... prefer my older lifestyle again.”
rows.translation: 他并不信服，事实上，在琢磨你的回答时，他的眉头皱了起来。“那样安全吗？”他问。“为了尝试这种更新、更被动的生活方式，我做了很多自我反省，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我担心打斗会让我...重新偏爱以前那种生活方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe isn’t convinced, and in fact, his eyebrows crease as he considers your response. “Is that safe?” he asks. “I’ve done a lot of soul-searching to try this newer, more passive lifestyle, [pc.name] Steele, and I’m worried that fighting might make me... prefer my older lifestyle again.”"

rows.original: You tell him that if he doesn’t want to, you two don’t have to. But if he does ever regress, it’d be better to do it against you, when you’ve proven that you can beat him, in a place where you two have control over whatever happens during your sparring session.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，如果他不愿意，你们两个就不必这么做。但如果他真的有一天故态复萌，最好把对象选成你，因为事实证明你能够击败他，而且你们可以选个场所，掌控切磋期间发生的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that if he doesn’t want to, you two don’t have to. But if he does ever regress, it’d be better to do it against you, when you’ve proven that you can beat him, in a place where you two have control over whatever happens during your sparring session."

rows.original: Eitan hums, his hand against his chin as he considers your words. “Fine,” he says after a bit. He stands. “I suppose you’re right in that there would be nobody else would be a better training partner.
rows.translation: 埃坦沉吟着，手托着下巴思量你的话。“行吧，”过了一会儿他才说。他站起身。“我想你说得对，毕竟也不会有别人会是更好的训练搭档了。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums, his hand against his chin as he considers your words. “Fine,” he says after a bit. He stands. “I suppose you’re right in that there would be nobody else would be a better training partner."

rows.original: But this room is too small for us to spar in.”
rows.translation: 但这间屋子太小了，我们没法在里面切磋。”
rows.raw: " But this room is too small for us to spar in.”"

rows.original: You generally keep the ship’s hold sparsely occupied: it wouldn’t take much effort to move things around and give you two a larger space to work with. It’s a short trip down into the ship’s belly, and, as you had said, it’s just a matter of moving some things around and cleaning the hold up a bit until you two have an arena large enough for a decent sparring session.
rows.translation: 你通常不会在飞船货舱里堆放太多东西：稍微挪动一下物品，就能给你们腾出更大的活动空间。前往飞船腹部的路程很短，而且正如你所说，只需移动一些东西、稍微清理一下货舱，你们就拥有了一片足够宽敞、能好好切磋的场地。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou generally keep the ship’s hold sparsely occupied: it wouldn’t take much effort to move things around and give you two a larger space to work with. It’s a short trip down into the ship’s belly, and, as you had said, it’s just a matter of moving some things around and cleaning the hold up a bit until you two have an arena large enough for a decent sparring session."

rows.original: We can start right here.”
rows.translation: 我们可以就在这里开始。”
rows.raw: " We can start right here.”"

rows.original: You stand along with him and help him tidy up the common room, giving you two a larger arena to move around in. Once it’s cleared away, it’s just you and Eitan, and he’s ready to square off against you.
rows.translation: 你和他一起站起来，帮他收拾公共休息室，为你们两人腾出更大的活动场地。收拾干净后，就只剩你和埃坦，他准备好和你对峙了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand along with him and help him tidy up the common room, giving you two a larger arena to move around in. Once it’s cleared away, it’s just you and Eitan, and he’s ready to square off against you."

rows.original: “When you’re ready,” he says, putting one foot in front of the other and raising both clawed hands in front of himself.
rows.translation: “你准备好就动手吧，”他说着，一只脚挪到另一只脚前面，把两只带爪的手举到身前。
rows.raw: "\n\n“When you’re ready,” he says, putting one foot in front of the other and raising both clawed hands in front of himself."

rows.original: You’re sparring against Eitan!

rows.original: “If you’d like,” he answers, pulling himself to his feet. “I haven’t seen much action since after I was released from the korgonne. Fighting is good for the blood.”
rows.translation: “如果你愿意的话，”他一边回答，一边站起身。“自从科尔贡人释放我以后，我就没怎么活动过筋骨。战斗能让血液沸腾。”

rows.original: A few times now, Eitan’s mentioned that whenever a milodan is taken from their tribe and introduced into modern society, he’s described that milodan as ‘uplifted.’ It was also one of his driving reasons for launching his attack on the korgonne: because Pyrite Industries had offered to uplift him. You ask him what that means, exactly, from the milodan’s point of view.
rows.translation: 埃坦已经提过几次，每当一名米洛丹人离开部族、进入现代社会，他都会把那名米洛丹人称作“得到提升”。这也是促使他进攻科尔贡人的主要原因之一：黄铁工业曾提出要提升他。你问他，从米洛丹人的角度来看，这究竟意味着什么。
rows.raw: "A few times now, Eitan’s mentioned that whenever a milodan is taken from their tribe and introduced into modern society, he’s described that milodan as ‘uplifted.’ It was also one of his driving reasons for launching his attack on the korgonne: because Pyrite Industries had offered to uplift him. You ask him what that means, exactly, from the milodan’s point of view."

rows.original: Eitan hums and slumps in his seat at the question. “Maybe you haven’t noticed, [pc.name] Steele, but my tribe’s lifestyle doesn’t involve things like modern medicine or electricity,” he starts. “All my people from my generation and younger know that being uplifted would mean an end to the general hardships we have to face, but it’s tougher to convince the wisemen and the elders that life could be better if we accepted help.”
rows.translation: 埃坦哼了一声，听到问题后瘫坐在座位上。“也许你没注意到，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，但我部族的生活方式里没有现代医学或电力这种东西，”他开口说道。“我这一代以及更年轻的族人都知道，得到提升意味着我们日常面对的艰难困苦将就此终结，但要说服智者和长老接受帮助能让生活变得更好，就困难多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums and slumps in his seat at the question. “Maybe you haven’t noticed, [pc.name] Steele, but my tribe’s lifestyle doesn’t involve things like modern medicine or electricity,” he starts. “All my people from my generation and younger know that being uplifted would mean an end to the general hardships we have to face, but it’s tougher to convince the wisemen and the elders that life could be better if we accepted help.”"

rows.original: He rubs at his chin as he recalls something, and from the grin on his face, he considers it a fond memory. “I remember when Pyrite first approached me and showed me the miracles a more advanced society than my own is capable of,” he says. “Weapons that could fell a Frostwyrm, or clear out whole rooms of korgonne. Medicines that could cure any illness or heal any wound. The one I was with, he demonstrated by cutting his palm open – with a little spray of something from a metal can, the wound was healed without a scar.”
rows.translation: 他回忆起某件事，抚摸着下巴；从脸上的笑容来看，那是一段美好回忆。“我还记得黄铁最初接触我，向我展示比我的社会更先进的文明能够创造的奇迹，”他说。“能够击倒霜龙，或清空整间屋子里所有科尔贡人的武器。能够治愈任何疾病或伤口的药物。当时和我见面的人亲自做了演示，他割开自己的手掌，只用金属罐里喷出的一点东西，伤口便愈合了，连疤痕都没留下。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe rubs at his chin as he recalls something, and from the grin on his face, he considers it a fond memory. “I remember when Pyrite first approached me and showed me the miracles a more advanced society than my own is capable of,” he says. “Weapons that could fell a Frostwyrm, or clear out whole rooms of korgonne. Medicines that could cure any illness or heal any wound. The one I was with, he demonstrated by cutting his palm open – with a little spray of something from a metal can, the wound was healed without a scar.”"

rows.original: Eitan’s eyes light up, and he leans into you as he continues. “Never having to worry about hunting for food, much less running out of it. Being able to control the heat of the air around you, so you’re never cold again. Speaking with someone else from some distant tribe in a matter of moments. It all seemed so... fantastic.”
rows.translation: 埃坦双眼一亮，继续说话时朝你倾过身。“永远不必担心狩猎食物，更不用担心食物耗尽。能够控制周围空气的温度，从此再也不会感到寒冷。只需片刻便能和某个遥远部族的人交谈。这一切听起来都如此...不可思议。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s eyes light up, and he leans into you as he continues. “Never having to worry about hunting for food, much less running out of it. Being able to control the heat of the air around you, so you’re never cold again. Speaking with someone else from some distant tribe in a matter of moments. It all seemed so... fantastic.”"

rows.original: You admit that there are a lot of conveniences and pleasantries that you’ve learned to take for granted nowadays. Even something as mundane as being able to talk over such a large distance could be seen as magic to someone as out-of-the-loop as Eitan. But clearly, and like he said, the people in charge of the milodan tribes aren’t as keen as taking in help.
rows.translation: 你承认，自己如今已经把许多便利与舒适视为理所当然。即使是隔着如此遥远的距离交谈这般寻常的事，在埃坦这样与世隔绝的人眼中也可能如同魔法。不过，显而易见，正如他说的那样，米洛丹各部族的掌权者并不怎么热衷于接受帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admit that there are a lot of conveniences and pleasantries that you’ve learned to take for granted nowadays. Even something as mundane as being able to talk over such a large distance could be seen as magic to someone as out-of-the-loop as Eitan. But clearly, and like he said, the people in charge of the milodan tribes aren’t as keen as taking in help."

rows.original: At that, Eitan sighs and slumps in his spot again. “I know what I’d like to say,” he starts. “I’d like to say that the elders are just stuck in their ways, and that we, the milodan, can’t survive forever by ourselves. There are fewer Frostwyrms now then there ever were before, and I’m worried that whatever took them out will happen to us as well. What we have now is what we’ve had for generations, and if it’s worked for them, they think it’ll work for us.”
rows.translation: 听到这里，埃坦叹了口气，再次瘫坐回去。“我知道自己想说什么，”他开口道。“我想说长老只是墨守成规，而我们米洛丹人不可能永远独自生存下去。如今霜龙的数量比过去任何时候都少，我担心消灭它们的东西同样会降临在我们身上。我们现在拥有的一切，祖祖辈辈以来一直如此；既然这套方式对先人有效，他们就认为对我们也会有效。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that, Eitan sighs and slumps in his spot again. “I know what I’d like to say,” he starts. “I’d like to say that the elders are just stuck in their ways, and that we, the milodan, can’t survive forever by ourselves. There are fewer Frostwyrms now then there ever were before, and I’m worried that whatever took them out will happen to us as well. What we have now is what we’ve had for generations, and if it’s worked for them, they think it’ll work for us.”"

rows.original: “But,” he sighs, “I accepted Pyrite’s help, and look where it got me.”
rows.translation: “可是，”他叹道，“我接受了派瑞特的帮助，看看它把我带到了哪儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But,” he sighs, “I accepted Pyrite’s help, and look where it got me.”"

rows.original: You ask if that’s his fault for disobeying the wishes of his elders and trying to do what’s best for him and his tribe, or if it’s Pyrite Industry’s fault for taking advantage of a difficult situation his tribe is in, and trying to capitalize on that by instigating conflict.
rows.translation: 你问道，这究竟是他的错，因为他违背长老意愿，试图做对自己和部族最有利的事；还是黄铁工业的错，因为他们利用他部族所处的困境，企图通过煽动冲突从中牟利。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if that’s his fault for disobeying the wishes of his elders and trying to do what’s best for him and his tribe, or if it’s Pyrite Industry’s fault for taking advantage of a difficult situation his tribe is in, and trying to capitalize on that by instigating conflict."

rows.original: “Whether the blame is with Pyrite is beside the point, [pc.name] Steele,” he responds. “I took a chance with them, and I failed. I did more harm to my tribe and to myself than if I had done what the elders wanted from me and did nothing.”
rows.translation: “责任归不归黄铁矿工业，已经不重要了，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他答道。“我跟他们赌了一把，结果输了。我给我的部族和我自己造成的伤害，反而比当初服从长老们的意思、什么都不做还要大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whether the blame is with Pyrite is beside the point, [pc.name] Steele,” he responds. “I took a chance with them, and I failed. I did more harm to my tribe and to myself than if I had done what the elders wanted from me and did nothing.”"

rows.original: You ask if, after having spent his time with you so far, he’s put some thought into expressing his experiences at being ‘uplifted’ himself. Surely his tribe’s elders aren’t so stubborn that they’d turn a deaf ear to him now that he’s been a part of modern society himself.
rows.translation: 你问他，和你相处了这么久之后，他有没有想过把自己被‘提升’的经历表达出来。既然他自己都已经成了现代社会的一部分，他部族的长老们总不至于顽固到对他充耳不闻吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if, after having spent his time with you so far, he’s put some thought into expressing his experiences at being ‘uplifted’ himself. Surely his tribe’s elders aren’t so stubborn that they’d turn a deaf ear to him now that he’s been a part of modern society himself."

rows.original: Eitan laughs darkly at the question, his lips curling into a sarcastic smile. “Remember that we’re milodan, [pc.name] Steele,” he answers. “My stubbornness is what got me, and what kept me, in that prison in the first place. Imagine me, but a generation older, and set even harder in my ways.”
rows.translation: 埃坦听到这个问题后阴沉地笑了，双唇勾起讥讽的笑容。“别忘了我们是米洛丹人，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他回答。“正是我的固执让我一开始被关进那座监狱，也让我一直被关在那里。想象一下比我年长一代，而且比我更加顽固不化的人吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan laughs darkly at the question, his lips curling into a sarcastic smile. “Remember that we’re milodan, [pc.name] Steele,” he answers. “My stubbornness is what got me, and what kept me, in that prison in the first place. Imagine me, but a generation older, and set even harder in my ways.”"

rows.original: So, what, he’s just given up? He’s taking all the benefits of being uplifted for himself, without trying to bring it to his tribe?
rows.translation: 所以呢，他就这么放弃了？他只顾自己享受得到提升的全部好处，却不试着把这些带给自己的部族？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, what, he’s just given up? He’s taking all the benefits of being uplifted for himself, without trying to bring it to his tribe?"

rows.original: “I said that I’m stubborn, [pc.name] Steele,” he repeats, smiling a more genuine smile than before. “I haven’t given up yet. I doubt I’ll ever get my whole tribe uplifted like I am, thanks to you, but maybe there’s some way to bring the ‘uplifting’ to them. If I can find some more of that spray from the metal cans that can heal wounds without leaving scars, not even they would be thick enough to turn medicine like that away.”
rows.translation: “我说过我很固执，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他重复道，笑得比之前真诚了些。“我还没放弃。多亏了你，我怀疑我永远没法让整个部族都像我一样被提升，但也许有办法把这种‘提升’带给他们。如果我能再找到一些那种金属罐里的喷雾，能治好伤口还不留疤，就算他们再愚钝，也不会把这种药拒之门外。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I said that I’m stubborn, [pc.name] Steele,” he repeats, smiling a more genuine smile than before. “I haven’t given up yet. I doubt I’ll ever get my whole tribe uplifted like I am, thanks to you, but maybe there’s some way to bring the ‘uplifting’ to them. If I can find some more of that spray from the metal cans that can heal wounds without leaving scars, not even they would be thick enough to turn medicine like that away.”"

rows.original: From the sounds of things, Eitan has hope, and he has an idea. You wonder to yourself if there’s any way you’ll be able to help him out in the future.
rows.translation: 听起来，埃坦怀有希望，而且已经有了想法。你暗自思忖，将来自己是否有办法帮上他的忙。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the sounds of things, Eitan has hope, and he has an idea. You wonder to yourself if there’s any way you’ll be able to help him out in the future."

rows.original: So, then, is his dream to be ‘uplifted’ dead in the water, just like that? Being ‘uplifted’ means having a better life. Is his want for himself and his people to live better extinguished with one failure?
rows.translation: 那么，他“得到提升”的梦想就这样彻底泡汤了吗？“得到提升”意味着过上更好的生活。一次失败就熄灭了他希望自己和族人生活得更好的愿望吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, then, is his dream to be ‘uplifted’ dead in the water, just like that? Being ‘uplifted’ means having a better life. Is his want for himself and his people to live better extinguished with one failure?"

rows.original: “Not to me,” he answers, “but it does to the elders of the tribe. Being the alpha only gets me so far. One failure is enough to convince them that I haven’t had a smart idea rattling anywhere in my skull. I doubt that even the Akkadi themselves could convince them to start moving forward now.”
rows.translation: “对我来说没有，”他回答，“但对部落的长老们来说有。当阿尔法也只能让我走到这一步。一次失败就足以让他们认定我脑子里没装过什么聪明主意。我怀疑现在就算阿卡迪人亲自来，也没法说服他们开始往前走。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not to me,” he answers, “but it does to the elders of the tribe. Being the alpha only gets me so far. One failure is enough to convince them that I haven’t had a smart idea rattling anywhere in my skull. I doubt that even the Akkadi themselves could convince them to start moving forward now.”"

rows.original: It sounds like he’s resigned to the fact that he won’t be able to convince the higher-ups in his hierarchy that having modern conveniences would be a better thing for his people. You don’t want to entertain the thought of a future where Eitan succeeded and annexed the Hold after slaughtering the korgonne, but it’s difficult to think that his own people wouldn’t be better off if he had – provided Pyrite Industries kept to their promises.
rows.translation: 听起来，他已经认命了，认为自己无法说服体系中的高层相信，现代化便利设施能让族人过得更好。你不愿设想这样一种未来：埃坦成功屠杀科尔贡人并吞了要塞。但很难不去想，假如黄铁工业信守承诺，他的族人是否真的会过得更好。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like he’s resigned to the fact that he won’t be able to convince the higher-ups in his hierarchy that having modern conveniences would be a better thing for his people. You don’t want to entertain the thought of a future where Eitan succeeded and annexed the Hold after slaughtering the korgonne, but it’s difficult to think that his own people wouldn’t be better off if he had – provided Pyrite Industries kept to their promises."

rows.original: You ask if it’s still out of the question that he ‘uplift’ himself. Maybe he can’t do his whole race, or even his whole tribe, all at once, but if he can start with himself, it’d be putting one foot in front of the other.
rows.translation: 你问他，难道就连“提升”自己也仍然完全不可能吗？也许他无法一次提升整个种族，甚至无法一次提升整个部族，但若能从自己开始，也算是一步接一步地向前走。

rows.translation: 说完，他自行前往空间站，留下你独自在帐篷里，而他先行一步。若你还有事情要办，在离开追上他之前仍可以处理。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, he makes his own way to the station. You’re left alone in his tent while he goes ahead. If you have any business left to do, you can still do it before you leave to catch up."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You let your mind wander as you sit with Eitan in his home. You’ve been playing with a fantasy for a little bit, where you suggest he join your crew as a bodyguard and heavy-duty everyman, but you aren’t sure how receptive he would be to the offer. He has duties here on Uveto, after all.
rows.translation: 你与伊坦坐在他家中，思绪开始游荡。你已经把一个幻想玩味了一阵：建议他作为保镖和重型杂役加入船员，但不确定他会多么愿意接受。毕竟，他在乌维托还有职责。
rows.raw: "You let your mind wander as you sit with Eitan in his home. You’ve been playing with a fantasy for a little bit, where you suggest he join your crew as a bodyguard and heavy-duty everyman, but you aren’t sure how receptive he would be to the offer. He has duties here on Uveto, after all."

rows.original: “Speak your mind, [pc.name] Steele,” Eitan says suddenly. “It’s obvious that you have something on it.”
rows.translation: “说出你的想法，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”伊坦突然说道。“你显然有心事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Speak your mind, [pc.name] Steele,” Eitan says suddenly. “It’s obvious that you have something on it.”"

rows.original: You ask him if it were really that obvious.
rows.translation: 你问他，真的有那么明显吗。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him if it were really that obvious."

rows.original: “Being in my sort of position, you learn how to read a person’s body language quickly,” he answers. “Our bodies are usually more honest than our mouths.”
rows.translation: “身处我这种位置，会很快学会读懂一个人的肢体语言，”他回答。“我们的身体往往比嘴更诚实。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Being in my sort of position, you learn how to read a person’s body language quickly,” he answers. “Our bodies are usually more honest than our mouths.”"

rows.original: Well, you’re caught, so there isn’t any sense in drawing things out. You turn your body to face him full-on, but he doesn’t immediately reciprocate the action. You ask him if he’s recently thought of leaving Uveto.
rows.translation: 好吧，既然被撞见了，拖着也没意义。你转过身正面朝他，但他没有立刻跟着转身。你问他最近有没有想过离开乌维托。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’re caught, so there isn’t any sense in drawing things out. You turn your body to face him full-on, but he doesn’t immediately reciprocate the action. You ask him if he’s recently thought of leaving Uveto."

rows.original: “Not recently,” he answers casually. “If you recall, one of my, uh... incentives for leading the attack on the korgonne was because Pyrite had offered to uplift me and my tribe to be among you offworlders. Whenever a milodan leaves the world in one of your kind’s flying machines, we call that milodan ‘uplifted.’ I was hoping to be uplifted, myself.”
rows.translation: “最近没有，”他随意回答。“如果你还记得，我，呃...带领族人攻击科尔贡人的诱因之一，就是黄铁工业曾提出，将我和部落提升为你们这些外星人中的一员。每当米洛丹人乘你们族人的飞行机器离开这个世界，我们便称那名米洛丹人‘升格’了。我曾希望自己也能升格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not recently,” he answers casually. “If you recall, one of my, uh... incentives for leading the attack on the korgonne was because Pyrite had offered to uplift me and my tribe to be among you offworlders. Whenever a milodan leaves the world in one of your kind’s flying machines, we call that milodan ‘uplifted.’ I was hoping to be uplifted, myself.”"

rows.original: Unfortunately, you can’t exactly accommodate an entire tribe, but you were wondering if he wouldn’t be against... joining your crew. You could always use more security detail, and he would make an excellent bodyguard. Also, he’d be the strongest person on your crew
rows.translation: 遗憾的是，你无法容纳整个部落，不过你想知道他是否反对...加入你的船员。你总能用上更多安保人员，而他会是个优秀保镖。此外，他将毫无疑问是船员中最强壮的人
rows.raw: "\n\nUnfortunately, you can’t exactly accommodate an entire tribe, but you were wondering if he wouldn’t be against... joining your crew. You could always use more security detail, and he would make an excellent bodyguard. Also, he’d be the strongest person on your crew "

rows.original: bar none
rows.translation: ，无人能及
rows.raw: "bar none"

rows.original: after yourself
rows.translation: 照顾你自己
rows.raw: "after yourself"

rows.original: , and you could put him to work doing some labor in the ship’s cargo hold whenever you needed.
rows.translation: ；而且需要时，你可以让他在飞船货舱做些体力活。
rows.raw: ", and you could put him to work doing some labor in the ship’s cargo hold whenever you needed."

rows.original: Eitan scratches his chin and casts his gaze across the tent. He doesn’t look terribly surprised by the offer – he probably knew exactly where the conversation was going after your initial question. But he didn’t have an answer ready.
rows.translation: 埃坦挠了挠下巴，目光扫过帐篷内部。他对这个提议似乎并不太惊讶 – 你最初那个问题之后，他大概就清楚这场对话要往哪儿走了。但他还没想好答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan scratches his chin and casts his gaze across the tent. He doesn’t look terribly surprised by the offer – he probably knew exactly where the conversation was going after your initial question. But he didn’t have an answer ready."

rows.original: “Maybe I shouldn’t,” he says.
rows.translation: “也许我不该这样，”他说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe I shouldn’t,” he says."

rows.original: Then, nothing more. You wait for a bit, and then awkwardly ask him to elaborate.
rows.translation: 然后就没下文了。你等了一会儿，才尴尬地请他详细说说。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, nothing more. You wait for a bit, and then awkwardly ask him to elaborate."

rows.original: “It feels very selfish to me,” he continues. “I fail my attack on the korgonne; then I tell the other milodan tribes that the war between us has ended; and then I pick up and leave Uveto. It might look like I’m running, and that I’m not being responsible for my actions as alpha. You’re the one that taught me that I should try and act more like a leader.”
rows.translation: “这让我觉得非常自私，”他继续说道。“我进攻科尔贡人失败；接着我告诉其他米洛丹部落，我们之间的战争已经结束；然后我收拾东西离开乌维托。看起来可能像我在逃跑，没有以阿尔法身份为自己的行为负责。是你教会我，应该尽量表现得更像一名领袖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It feels very selfish to me,” he continues. “I fail my attack on the korgonne; then I tell the other milodan tribes that the war between us has ended; and then I pick up and leave Uveto. It might look like I’m running, and that I’m not being responsible for my actions as alpha. You’re the one that taught me that I should try and act more like a leader.”"

rows.original: “But then,” he says, shrugging his shoulders and looking at his left hand, “exploring the stars and uplifting myself could broaden my understanding of how to be a good leader. What encouraged me to start the attack in the first place was a close-minded view of how I thought the world should work. If I left, I could come back a better alpha for the milodan.”
rows.translation: “但换个角度，”他耸耸肩，看着自己的左手说道，“探索群星、提升自己，或许能拓宽我对如何成为好领袖的理解。最初鼓励我发动攻击的，是一种狭隘的看法，是我认为世界应该如何运作。若我离开，日后便能作为一名更优秀的米洛丹阿尔法归来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But then,” he says, shrugging his shoulders and looking at his left hand, “exploring the stars and uplifting myself could broaden my understanding of how to be a good leader. What encouraged me to start the attack in the first place was a close-minded view of how I thought the world should work. If I left, I could come back a better alpha for the milodan.”"

rows.original: This is a very surprising train of thought. You tell Eitan that you weren’t expecting such a broad introspection on the possibility of leaving his tribe behind.
rows.translation: 这个思路非常出人意料。你告诉埃坦，你没想到他会对离开部落这种可能性做出如此宽泛的反思。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is a very surprising train of thought. You tell Eitan that you weren’t expecting such a broad introspection on the possibility of leaving his tribe behind."

rows.original: “To be honest, I’ve been thinking about it since I was still a prisoner,” he says. “Not about being a good leader – that way of thinking came after – but about what it would mean if I succeeded, and Pyrite uplifted me and my tribe. What I could have expected. And if my wanting to be uplifted so badly was a part of why I was there, hitting a wall with a pick for days on end.”
rows.translation: “说实话，从我还在当囚犯时便一直在考虑这件事，”他说。“不是考虑成为好领袖——那种想法是后来才有的——而是考虑若我成功、黄铁工业将我和部落升格，会意味着什么，我本可以期待什么。还有，我如此强烈地渴望升格，是否也是我最终身陷囹圄、日复一日挥镐敲墙的原因之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“To be honest, I’ve been thinking about it since I was still a prisoner,” he says. “Not about being a good leader – that way of thinking came after – but about what it would mean if I succeeded, and Pyrite uplifted me and my tribe. What I could have expected. And if my wanting to be uplifted so badly was a part of why I was there, hitting a wall with a pick for days on end.”"

rows.original: He hasn’t given you a yes or a no, but you don’t push him any further or faster than he’s going. He’ll answer you on his own time.
rows.translation: 他既没答应，也没拒绝；你没有逼他走得比自身节奏更快。他会在合适的时候自己回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hasn’t given you a yes or a no, but you don’t push him any further or faster than he’s going. He’ll answer you on his own time."

rows.original: “Fine,” he says, turning to face his body towards you, just as you had to him. “[pc.name] Steele, I accept. I won’t learn anything new staying here.”
rows.translation: “好吧，”他说着转身正对你，就像你刚才面对他那样。“[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，我接受。留在这里学不到任何新东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine,” he says, turning to face his body towards you, just as you had to him. “[pc.name] Steele, I accept. I won’t learn anything new staying here.”"

rows.original: That’s... great! You tell Eitan that you can lead him to your ship right now. It’ll take you two through Irestead, but nobody will give him a hard time as long as he’s with you.
rows.translation: 这...太好了！你告诉伊坦，现在就可以带他去飞船。你们得穿过艾尔斯泰德，不过只要他和你在一起，就没人会找他麻烦。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... great! You tell Eitan that you can lead him to your ship right now. It’ll take you two through Irestead, but nobody will give him a hard time as long as he’s with you."

rows.original: Eitan stands and extends his hand to you, so he can lift you to your own [pc.feet]. “I’d appreciate that. Your people were about as welcoming to me as mine were to you. Having an escort would be nice.”
rows.translation: 伊坦站起身，朝你伸手，好将你拉回自己的[pc.feet]。“那就太感谢了。你们的人对我的欢迎程度，和我的族人对你差不多。有个护送者会很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan stands and extends his hand to you, so he can lift you to your own [pc.feet]. “I’d appreciate that. Your people were about as welcoming to me as mine were to you. Having an escort would be nice.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Considering Eitan is leaving not only his tribe, but his planet, you’d have thought there would have been more ceremony and fanfare. He’s being ‘uplifted,’ which you thought was a big deal to the milodan, but apparently they, or at least Eitan’s tribe, don’t waste a lot of time with goodbyes. There were well-wishes and good-lucks, but it was all fairly formal, like they were all co-workers and Eitan was just punching out to go home.
rows.translation: 考虑到埃坦不仅要离开他的部族，还要离开他的星球，你本以为会有更多仪式和排场。他正在被‘提升’，你原以为这对米洛丹来说是天大的事，但显然他们，至少埃坦的部族，并不在告别上花太多时间。有祝福，也有道别，但一切都相当正式，就像他们都是同事，而埃坦只是打卡下班回家。
rows.raw: "Considering Eitan is leaving not only his tribe, but his planet, you’d have thought there would have been more ceremony and fanfare. He’s being ‘uplifted,’ which you thought was a big deal to the milodan, but apparently they, or at least Eitan’s tribe, don’t waste a lot of time with goodbyes. There were well-wishes and good-lucks, but it was all fairly formal, like they were all co-workers and Eitan was just punching out to go home."

rows.original: Although it isn’t a particularly long walk back to Irestead, Eitan is standing tall the whole way, with an excited stride you weren’t expecting from him. Before Irestead is in sight, you ask him what he thinks being uplifted will be like.
rows.translation: 回到艾尔斯泰德的路并不特别漫长，但伊坦全程昂首挺胸，步伐兴奋得出乎你的预料。在看到艾尔斯泰德之前，你问他觉得升格会是什么样。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough it isn’t a particularly long walk back to Irestead, Eitan is standing tall the whole way, with an excited stride you weren’t expecting from him. Before Irestead is in sight, you ask him what he thinks being uplifted will be like."

rows.original: “I could give you any number of fantasies, [pc.name] Steele,” he replies, “but I couldn’t begin to guess. All I want is to be uplifted. I’ll figure out what that means when it happens.”
rows.translation: “我可以告诉你无数种幻想，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他回答，“但我根本猜不到。我只想得到升格。等真正发生时，我会弄清那意味着什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I could give you any number of fantasies, [pc.name] Steele,” he replies, “but I couldn’t begin to guess. All I want is to be uplifted. I’ll figure out what that means when it happens.”"

rows.original: You assure Eitan that there’s nothing wrong with putting yourself first in life – it’s only a problem when he puts others down to get there. This isn’t such a case.
rows.translation: 你向埃坦保证，把自己放在人生第一位并没有错 – 只有为了达到目的而贬低别人时才是问题。这次并不属于那种情况。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure Eitan that there’s nothing wrong with putting yourself first in life – it’s only a problem when he puts others down to get there. This isn’t such a case."

rows.original: “So you’ve been teaching me,” he answers.
rows.translation: “所以你一直在教我，”他回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’ve been teaching me,” he answers."

rows.original: Like Eitan had told you, and like you had expected, the denizens of Irestead gave you both any number of looks as you made your way through the station towards the space elevator. Some of them were awed that such a massive milodan could exist (and the average milodan was already fairly large); some nervously turned or walked away from you both, knowing of the milodan’s reputation and wary of one as big as him; and more than a handful of them openly fucked him with their eyes – he’s a statuesque male wearing very little below the waist, so it was hardly unexpected. And given the way Eitan’s body language shifted the deeper into Irestead you went, he probably noticed them too, but he had the sense to not interrupt your walking.
rows.translation: 正如伊坦告诉你的，也正如你所预料的，当你们穿过空间站前往太空电梯时，艾尔斯泰德的居民以各种目光打量你们。有些人惊叹竟然存在如此庞大的米洛丹人，而普通米洛丹人本就已相当高大；有些人知道米洛丹人的名声，忌惮像他这般魁梧的个体，紧张地转身或避开你们；还有远不止少数的人公然用目光肏他——他是一名身材如雕像般、腰部以下衣着极少的男性，这也不足为奇。从你们越深入艾尔斯泰德、伊坦肢体语言便越发生变化来看，他大概也注意到了，不过他还算明智，没有打断你们的行程。
rows.raw: "\n\nLike Eitan had told you, and like you had expected, the denizens of Irestead gave you both any number of looks as you made your way through the station towards the space elevator. Some of them were awed that such a massive milodan could exist (and the average milodan was already fairly large); some nervously turned or walked away from you both, knowing of the milodan’s reputation and wary of one as big as him; and more than a handful of them openly fucked him with their eyes – he’s a statuesque male wearing very little below the waist, so it was hardly unexpected. And given the way Eitan’s body language shifted the deeper into Irestead you went, he probably noticed them too, but he had the sense to not interrupt your walking."

rows.original: Its common technology to you, but the space elevator catches Eitan by surprise: once the elevator takes off and you lift into the Uveto sky, his hands and face press against the glass viewing ports, watching the world disappear beneath him. He has a myriad of questions the whole way – what an ‘elevator’ is, for starters – and you try to answer them all to the best of your ability. He’s like a kid that’s only now discovering the world around himself.
rows.translation: 这对你而言是常见技术，但太空电梯却令埃坦大吃一惊：电梯启动、载着你们升入乌维托天空后，他把双手和脸都贴在玻璃观景窗上，看着脚下的世界逐渐消失。一路上他有数不清的问题，首先就是“电梯”究竟是什么，而你尽己所能地逐一作答。他就像个直到现在才开始发现周遭世界的孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nIts common technology to you, but the space elevator catches Eitan by surprise: once the elevator takes off and you lift into the Uveto sky, his hands and face press against the glass viewing ports, watching the world disappear beneath him. He has a myriad of questions the whole way – what an ‘elevator’ is, for starters – and you try to answer them all to the best of your ability. He’s like a kid that’s only now discovering the world around himself."

rows.original: Eitan’s eyes can’t stay focused ahead of himself once you’re in the promenade: the world around him is totally artificial, and while he’s still getting the same stares as he did on Irestead, he’s started staring at them back, having gotten a taste of what alien life is really like, and how the natural form could look so much different from his own.
rows.translation: 进入步行街后，埃坦的眼睛根本无法专注于正前方：周遭世界完全由人工建造。尽管他仍会遭受和在艾尔斯泰德时一样的注视，但他已经开始反过来盯着他们看，初次领略异星生命真正的模样，以及自然形态能与自己相差多么遥远。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan’s eyes can’t stay focused ahead of himself once you’re in the promenade: the world around him is totally artificial, and while he’s still getting the same stares as he did on Irestead, he’s started staring at them back, having gotten a taste of what alien life is really like, and how the natural form could look so much different from his own."

rows.original: He remains respectfully silent when you bring him to the ship’s hangar, and you introduce him to your own ship, [pc_ship.theName]. You tell him that this is what you two will be traveling in, and this is how you’ll be going from planet to planet.
rows.translation: 你把他带进飞船机库时，他始终恭敬地保持沉默。你向他介绍自己的飞船[pc_ship.theName]，告诉他你们两个将乘它旅行，也会以这种方式从一颗行星前往另一颗行星。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe remains respectfully silent when you bring him to the ship’s hangar, and you introduce him to your own ship, [pc_ship.theName]. You tell him that this is what you two will be traveling in, and this is how you’ll be going from planet to planet."

rows.original: “It’s the size of a mountain!” he exclaims. “And it can travel across the stars? I can hardly imagine it moving an inch!”
rows.translation: “它有山那么大！”他惊叹道。“而且它还能穿越星际？我简直无法想象它能挪动一英寸！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s the size of a mountain!” he exclaims. “And it can travel across the stars? I can hardly imagine it moving an inch!”"

rows.original: You ask him how he thought wayfarers like yourself traveled across the stars.
rows.translation: 你问他，他以为像你这样的旅人是怎么穿越星海的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask him how he thought wayfarers like yourself traveled across the stars."

rows.original: He hesitates at the question. “Now that you ask, I haven’t put much thought into it,” he answers.
rows.translation: 听到这个问题，他犹豫了。“你这么一问，我倒没怎么想过，”他答道。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hesitates at the question. “Now that you ask, I haven’t put much thought into it,” he answers."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You give him a quick tour of the ship: everything from the loading bay and cargo hold, to the mess hall, to the bridge, to the engine room, to the captain’s quarters, and finally, to the crew’s quarters. Eitan, being fairly large, has a hard time moving from place to place through the ship - through door frames and down hallways. It’ll be a while before he stops bonking his head on the ceiling.
rows.translation: 你带他快速参观飞船：从装卸舱和货舱，到食堂、舰桥、引擎室、船长舱，最后是船员舱。埃坦体型相当庞大，很难穿过门框和走廊，在飞船里从一处移动到另一处。他恐怕还得过上一阵子，才能不再一头撞上天花板。
rows.raw: "You give him a quick tour of the ship: everything from the loading bay and cargo hold, to the mess hall, to the bridge, to the engine room, to the captain’s quarters, and finally, to the crew’s quarters. Eitan, being fairly large, has a hard time moving from place to place through the ship - through door frames and down hallways. It’ll be a while before he stops bonking his head on the ceiling."

rows.original: As you go, you detail to him what you expect from him as a crewmate on your ship. He has no experience with working on a ship or exploring the stars, but he’s a very large man, and you can find uses for that kind of muscle. On top of the fairly mundane, like lifting boxes or moving munitions, outer space isn’t always the safest place to be, and you might run into... undesirables during your adventures. Violence isn’t always the answer, but, sometimes, it is, and having a huge guy like Eitan around can be useful for that.
rows.translation: 一路上，你向他详细说明自己对船员的要求。他没有在飞船上工作或探索星海的经验，但他身材魁梧，而这样的肌肉总能派上用场。除了搬箱子、转移弹药之类相当普通的工作，外太空也不总是最安全的地方，你在冒险期间可能会遇到...某些不受欢迎的家伙。暴力并不总是答案，但有时确实是；身边有埃坦这样的大块头，在这种时候很有用。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you go, you detail to him what you expect from him as a crewmate on your ship. He has no experience with working on a ship or exploring the stars, but he’s a very large man, and you can find uses for that kind of muscle. On top of the fairly mundane, like lifting boxes or moving munitions, outer space isn’t always the safest place to be, and you might run into... undesirables during your adventures. Violence isn’t always the answer, but, sometimes, it is, and having a huge guy like Eitan around can be useful for that."

rows.original: All of the crew quarters look fairly identical – meaning, small, especially for a guy like Eitan – but you tell him that he’s allowed to whichever quarters isn’t already occupied.
rows.translation: 所有船员舱看起来几乎一模一样，也就是说都很小，尤其是对埃坦这样的大块头而言。不过你告诉他，只要某间舱室还没有人住，他就可以选那一间。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll of the crew quarters look fairly identical – meaning, small, especially for a guy like Eitan – but you tell him that he’s allowed to whichever quarters isn’t already occupied."

rows.original: He frowns as he examines some of the options he has. “It’s all a bit of a step down from the alpha’s living space back home, isn’t it?” he says.
rows.translation: 他皱着眉检查几个可选的房间。“跟故乡阿尔法的住所相比，这些全都有些降级了，不是吗？”他说。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe frowns as he examines some of the options he has. “It’s all a bit of a step down from the alpha’s living space back home, isn’t it?” he says."

rows.original: It surprises you to hear him say that, but at the same time, he likely doesn’t understand everything that he’s getting in his quarters - he wouldn’t understand how to work the climate control or the viewport at a first glance. You make a note to teach him of all the amenities he’s actually getting later.
rows.translation: 听他这么说你很意外，但同时，他大概并不了解自己舱室里配的那些东西 - 他乍看之下不会知道怎么操作气候控制或观景窗。你记下之后要教他认识他实际得到的全部便利设施。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt surprises you to hear him say that, but at the same time, he likely doesn’t understand everything that he’s getting in his quarters - he wouldn’t understand how to work the climate control or the viewport at a first glance. You make a note to teach him of all the amenities he’s actually getting later."

rows.original: “This isn’t what I had in mind when I thought I was going to be uplifted,” he remarks. “What about the captain’s quarters? That was larger than all of these. Can I have that?”
rows.translation: “我以为自己会被启蒙时，想象的可不是这样，”他评论道。“船长舱呢？那里比这些房间都大。我能住那里吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This isn’t what I had in mind when I thought I was going to be uplifted,” he remarks. “What about the captain’s quarters? That was larger than all of these. Can I have that?”"

rows.original: “Absolutely not,” you answer firmly. That’s where you sleep, after all! If he doesn’t like it, he’s free to back out – you may be ‘uplifting’ him, but being naturalized into modern society means having to put up with conditions he might not be used to, and that means tight living spaces.
rows.translation: “绝对不行，”你斩钉截铁地回答。毕竟你才睡在那里！如果他不喜欢，大可以退出；你或许是在“启蒙”他，但融入现代社会意味着必须忍受一些他不习惯的条件，其中就包括狭窄的居住空间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Absolutely not,” you answer firmly. That’s where you sleep, after all! If he doesn’t like it, he’s free to back out – you may be ‘uplifting’ him, but being naturalized into modern society means having to put up with conditions he might not be used to, and that means tight living spaces."

rows.original: Eitan hums in thought as he considers your ultimatum. “What else does it mean?” he asks; not to goad you, but because he’s genuinely curious.
rows.translation: 埃坦沉吟着考虑你的最后通牒。“那还意味着什么？”他问道；不是想激你，而是他真的好奇。
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan hums in thought as he considers your ultimatum. “What else does it mean?” he asks; not to goad you, but because he’s genuinely curious."

rows.original: Well, the first thing that comes to mind is that, as long as Eitan is on your ship, and he is in your crew, it means that you are the captain, and that means that your word and instruction is final. You tell him to think of the crew as another tribe, and you’re the alpha.
rows.translation: 首先浮现在脑海中的一点是，只要埃坦待在你的飞船上，而且是你的船员，就意味着你是船长，而这意味着你的话和命令就是最终决定。你让他把船员视作另一个部族，而你就是阿尔法。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, the first thing that comes to mind is that, as long as Eitan is on your ship, and he is in your crew, it means that you are the captain, and that means that your word and instruction is final. You tell him to think of the crew as another tribe, and you’re the alpha."

rows.original: He hums again, scratching at his chin. “This is all beginning to sound like I’ve made a terrible mistake,” he laughs. “But if there’s any one thing that I still am, [pc.name] Steele, it’s that I’m stubborn. You’ve started me on a better life on Uveto, so I’d trust that my experiences with being uplifted will be better with you than any other... what did you call yourself? A ‘captain?’”
rows.translation: 他又哼了一声，挠着下巴。“这一切开始让我觉得自己犯了个大错，”他笑道。“但如果说我依然保有什么品质，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，那就是固执。你让我在乌维托开始了更好的生活，所以我相信，跟着你接受启蒙，总会比跟着其他任何...你怎么称呼自己来着？‘船长？’更好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe hums again, scratching at his chin. “This is all beginning to sound like I’ve made a terrible mistake,” he laughs. “But if there’s any one thing that I still am, [pc.name] Steele, it’s that I’m stubborn. You’ve started me on a better life on Uveto, so I’d trust that my experiences with being uplifted will be better with you than any other... what did you call yourself? A ‘captain?’”"

rows.original: “That’s right,” you say. You think that about covers it. You’re normally fairly lax about dress code, but if he really wants to go the extra mile and feel like he’s with you and your crew, there should be a spare Steele Tech uniform underneath the bed. The material the suits are made of are fairly flexible, so it should conform to his size.
rows.translation: “没错，”你说。你觉得大致就是这样了。你平时对着装规定挺宽松的，但如果他真想多做一步、想觉得自己跟你和你的船员是一伙的，床底下应该还有一套备用的斯蒂尔科技制服。这种制服的面料相当有弹性，应该能贴合他的身形。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right,” you say. You think that about covers it. You’re normally fairly lax about dress code, but if he really wants to go the extra mile and feel like he’s with you and your crew, there should be a spare Steele Tech uniform underneath the bed. The material the suits are made of are fairly flexible, so it should conform to his size."

rows.original: Eitan ducks his head into one of the unoccupied crew spaces and remains there a moment longer than the others. “I’ll take this one,” he says, leaning back out to face you. “I think it may be larger than the others by a palm or two.”
rows.translation: 埃坦把头探进一间空着的船员舱，比其他人多停留了一会儿。“我要这间，”他说着探回身来面向你。“我觉得它可能比其他的大出一两掌。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan ducks his head into one of the unoccupied crew spaces and remains there a moment longer than the others. “I’ll take this one,” he says, leaning back out to face you. “I think it may be larger than the others by a palm or two.”"

rows.original: That’s probably just his eyes playing tricks on him, but if he wants it, you aren’t going to dissuade him. You tell him it’s his.
rows.translation: 那大概只是他的眼睛在捉弄自己，但既然他想要，你也不会劝阻。你告诉他，这间归他了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s probably just his eyes playing tricks on him, but if he wants it, you aren’t going to dissuade him. You tell him it’s his."

rows.original: He pulls out of the doorway and stands beside you in the cramped hallway, his massive body contorting to the side just to fit. “So,” he drones, “what happens next?”
rows.translation: 他退出门口，站到狭窄走廊里你的身旁；庞大的身体必须扭向一侧才能容身。“那么，”他拖长声音，“接下来做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pulls out of the doorway and stands beside you in the cramped hallway, his massive body contorting to the side just to fit. “So,” he drones, “what happens next?”"

rows.original: For him? Not a lot – he just stands by and waits for your further instruction. You grant him shore leave whenever you’re docked, and he has your permission to wander the ship as he likes, but when you tell him to do something, he needs to do it. If he doesn’t think he should touch something, then he should not touch it. Other than that... it’s just a bit of waiting.
rows.translation: 对他而言？没多少事。他只需待命，等待你的进一步指示。飞船停靠时，你会准许他上岸休假，也允许他随意在船上走动；但你让他做什么，他就必须照办。如果他觉得某件东西不该碰，那就绝对不要去碰。除此之外...就只是等上一阵子。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor him? Not a lot – he just stands by and waits for your further instruction. You grant him shore leave whenever you’re docked, and he has your permission to wander the ship as he likes, but when you tell him to do something, he needs to do it. If he doesn’t think he should touch something, then he should not touch it. Other than that... it’s just a bit of waiting."

rows.original: “May I touch you?” he asks.
rows.translation: “我可以碰你吗？”他问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“May I touch you?” he asks."

rows.original: The question takes you aback. <i>“Uh...
rows.translation: 这个问题让你措手不及。<i>“呃...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question takes you aback. <i>“Uh... "

rows.original: I... don’t see the harm...?
rows.translation: 我...觉得应该没什么坏处...？
rows.raw: "I... don’t see the harm...?"

rows.original: yes?
rows.translation: 是吗？
rows.raw: "yes?"

rows.original: With your permission, he steps into you and wraps you in his giant arms, squeezing you to his chest. “My experience with Pyrite did not end well. I won’t waste this opportunity a second time, [pc.name] Steele,” he says, holding you against his fluffy, muscular chest.
rows.translation: 得到你的许可后，他走到你面前，用巨大的双臂环住你，把你挤在胸前。“我在黄铁矿工业的经历没有善终。我不会第二次浪费这个机会，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说着，把你按在毛茸茸而肌肉结实的胸膛上。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your permission, he steps into you and wraps you in his giant arms, squeezing you to his chest. “My experience with Pyrite did not end well. I won’t waste this opportunity a second time, [pc.name] Steele,” he says, holding you against his fluffy, muscular chest."

rows.original: You weren’t expecting that
rows.translation: 你完全没料到会这样
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weren’t expecting that"

rows.original: . You don’t reciprocate the hug - at least, not as thoroughly as he’s giving you yours. You awkwardly reach for his shoulder and give it a few reassuring pats.
rows.translation: 。你没有回抱他 - 至少，没有他抱你抱得那么彻底。你笨拙地伸手去够他的肩膀，安抚地拍了几下。
rows.raw: ". You don’t reciprocate the hug - at least, not as thoroughly as he’s giving you yours. You awkwardly reach for his shoulder and give it a few reassuring pats."

rows.original: , but far be it from you to turn down a hug from someone as large, fluffy, and firm as Eitan is. You reciprocate the hug as best as you can, worming your arms out from underneath him, and wrapping them around his ribs, pulling him into you.
rows.translation: ，但你实在没有理由拒绝埃坦这样高大、毛茸茸又结实的人给予的拥抱。你尽力回抱他，把双臂从他身下钻出来，环住他的肋侧，将他拉向自己。
rows.raw: ", but far be it from you to turn down a hug from someone as large, fluffy, and firm as Eitan is. You reciprocate the hug as best as you can, worming your arms out from underneath him, and wrapping them around his ribs, pulling him into you."

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isAss()
                ? "Eitan, sensing your unease, doesn’t let the hug last for too long."
                : "It turns out, Eitan’s a good hugger. His size makes it easy for him."

rows.original: Eitan, sensing your unease, doesn’t let the hug last for too long.
rows.translation: 埃坦察觉到你的不安，没有让这个拥抱持续太久。
rows.raw: "Eitan, sensing your unease, doesn’t let the hug last for too long."

rows.original: It turns out, Eitan’s a good hugger. His size makes it easy for him.
rows.translation: 事实证明，埃坦很会拥抱。凭他的体型，这对他很容易。
rows.raw: "It turns out, Eitan’s a good hugger. His size makes it easy for him."

rows.original: When he disengages and heads into his own quarters, it air of your ship feels just a bit cooler.
rows.translation: 当他抽身离开、走回自己的舱室时，你飞船里的空气似乎凉了一点。
rows.raw: " When he disengages and heads into his own quarters, it air of your ship feels just a bit cooler."

rows.original: Eitan is now your crewmate!
rows.translation: 埃坦现在是你的船员了！
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan is now your crewmate!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Uveto Station
rows.raw: "Uveto Station"

rows.original: You tell Eitan that he’s dismissed from his duties for the time being. It’s time for him to go home to his tribe for now.
rows.translation: 你告诉埃坦，他目前可以暂时卸下职责。现在该让他回到自己的部族了。
rows.raw: "You tell Eitan that he’s dismissed from his duties for the time being. It’s time for him to go home to his tribe for now."

rows.original: You can give him a ticket on the next starship back to Uveto, where he can ride in relative comfort, and he’ll know where to go once he lands at Irestead.
rows.translation: 你可以给他一张下一班星舰返回乌维托的船票，让他相对舒适地乘船回去；而且他在艾尔斯泰德降落后会知道该往哪里走。
rows.raw: " You can give him a ticket on the next starship back to Uveto, where he can ride in relative comfort, and he’ll know where to go once he lands at Irestead."

rows.original: He looks at you with a tilted head and arched eyebrows. “Have I done something wrong?” he asks.
rows.translation: 他歪着头、挑起眉毛看你。“我做错什么了吗？”他问。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe looks at you with a tilted head and arched eyebrows. “Have I done something wrong?” he asks."

rows.original: You tell him that, no, he’s been a model crewmate - it’s just that you have some short-term plans that require more space on your ship, and it’d be best if it were him that you dismissed. You promise that you’ll be back for him when you need him, and in the meantime, he can take what he’s learned from his uplifting back to his tribe and be a better leader for them.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，不是的，他一直是名模范船员；只是你有一些短期计划，需要飞船里腾出更多空间，而最适合暂时遣散的人是他。你保证需要他时会回来接他；与此同时，他可以把接受启蒙后学到的东西带回部族，成为更优秀的首领。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that, no, he’s been a model crewmate - it’s just that you have some short-term plans that require more space on your ship, and it’d be best if it were him that you dismissed. You promise that you’ll be back for him when you need him, and in the meantime, he can take what he’s learned from his uplifting back to his tribe and be a better leader for them."

rows.original: Eitan sighs at your words, clearly unconvinced. “I was hoping my uplifting would be longer,” he says. But he doesn’t argue, and he stands. “I remember you saying that, as long as you are captain, what you say, goes. And if that means going home, then that’s what that means.”
rows.translation: 听完你的话，埃坦叹了口气，显然没有被说服。“我本来希望自己的启蒙能持续更久，”他说。但他没有争辩，而是站起身来。“我记得你说过，只要你还是船长，你的话就必须照办。如果这意味着回家，那就是回家。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEitan sighs at your words, clearly unconvinced. “I was hoping my uplifting would be longer,” he says. But he doesn’t argue, and he stands. “I remember you saying that, as long as you are captain, what you say, goes. And if that means going home, then that’s what that means.”"

rows.original: You reiterate that it’s not necessarily forever, and if he’s willing to come back to sail with you, you’ll have him as soon as you have the space.
rows.translation: 你再次强调，这未必是永远告别；如果他愿意回来与你一同航行，你一有空间就会接纳他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reiterate that it’s not necessarily forever, and if he’s willing to come back to sail with you, you’ll have him as soon as you have the space."

rows.original: “I’ll hold you to that,” he says. “
rows.translation: “我会记住你这句话的，”他说。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll hold you to that,” he says. “"

joinAfter.expression:
e
                ? "I can find my own way back to my tribe"
                : "I will accept your offer to take an alternative way home to my tribe"

rows.original: I can find my own way back to my tribe
rows.translation: 我能自己找到回部落的路
rows.raw: "I can find my own way back to my tribe"

rows.original: I will accept your offer to take an alternative way home to my tribe
rows.translation: 我接受你的提议，换一种方式回到自己的部族
rows.raw: "I will accept your offer to take an alternative way home to my tribe"

rows.original: . Thank you for the opportunity to travel with you, [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: 。谢谢你给我与你一同旅行的机会，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: ". Thank you for the opportunity to travel with you, [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: In several swift motions, he’s out of the Steele Tech uniform he’s put on, reverting back to his simple, tribal loincloth.
rows.translation: 几个利落的动作，他就脱下了刚穿上的斯蒂尔科技制服，换回他那条简单的部落缠腰布。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn several swift motions, he’s out of the Steele Tech uniform he’s put on, reverting back to his simple, tribal loincloth. "

rows.original: And that’s all that he wears when he makes his own way through the orbital station and through Irestead.
rows.translation: 他穿过轨道站、走过伊尔斯泰德时，身上就只穿这些。
rows.raw: "And that’s all that he wears when he makes his own way through the orbital station and through Irestead."

rows.original: You bet that’d be a fun sight to see while he’s in transit back home.
rows.translation: 你敢说，他在回家途中一定会成为一道有趣的风景。
rows.raw: "You bet that’d be a fun sight to see while he’s in transit back home."

rows.original: Well, at least you know where to find him if you want him back.
rows.translation: 好吧，至少你知道想让他回来时该去哪里找他。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, at least you know where to find him if you want him back."

rows.original: EITAN
rows.raw: "EITAN"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Wait,” you say.
rows.translation: “等等，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“Wait,” you say."

rows.original: Ula stops and tilts her head. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉停下来，歪了歪头。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla stops and tilts her head. <i>“"

rows.original: You want to do something else
rows.translation: 你想做别的事情
rows.raw: "You want to do something else"

rows.original: Something else wanting
rows.translation: 想做别的事情
rows.raw: "Something else wanting"

rows.original: Ula Kiddo Pets Cooldown
rows.raw: "Ula Kiddo Pets Cooldown"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” Ula gently coos, so as not to disturb her nursing children. “
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”乌拉温柔地咕哝，为了不惊扰正在吃奶的孩子。“
rows.raw: "“[pc.name],” Ula gently coos, so as not to disturb her nursing children. “"

rows.original: Did you see our puppies? They’re so cute, huh?
rows.translation: 你看到我们的幼崽了吗？它们好可爱，对吧？
rows.raw: "Did you see our puppies? They’re so cute, huh?"

rows.original: See Ula puppies? Much cute, yes?
rows.translation: 看到乌拉的小狗崽了吗？很可爱，对吧？
rows.raw: "See Ula puppies? Much cute, yes?"

rows.original: You nod warmly.
rows.translation: 你温柔地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod warmly."

rows.original: “Go ahead, touch.” She tips her head toward the closest one. “
rows.translation: “来吧，摸摸看。”她朝最近的一只偏了偏头。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go ahead, touch.” She tips her head toward the closest one. “"

rows.original: Give pets.
rows.translation: 摸摸头。
rows.raw: "Give pets."

rows.original: Give them a pet.
rows.translation: 摸摸它们。
rows.raw: "Give them a pet."

rows.original: You hesitantly reach out and give your recently born child a scratch between the ears.
rows.translation: 你迟疑地伸出手，挠了挠你刚出生的孩子两耳之间的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hesitantly reach out and give your recently born child a scratch between the ears. "

rows.original: His
rows.translation: 他的
rows.raw: "His"

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她的
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: tail wags happily, though he does not slow his suckling in the slightest.
rows.translation: 尾巴高兴地摇着，不过他丝毫没有放慢吮吸。
rows.raw: " tail wags happily, though he does not slow his suckling in the slightest. "

rows.original: His
rows.translation: 他的
rows.raw: "His"

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她的
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: fur is stunningly soft, almost silken. ou switch to gentle pats and slow strokes, then give your other child a little attention. In short order, they both fall asleep on Ula’s tits.
rows.translation: 的毛软得惊人，几乎像丝绸。你改成轻柔的拍抚和缓慢的抚摸，然后也给另一个孩子一点关注。很快，他们俩都在乌拉的奶子上睡着了。
rows.raw: " fur is stunningly soft, almost silken. ou switch to gentle pats and slow strokes, then give your other child a little attention. In short order, they both fall asleep on Ula’s tits."

rows.original: You smile. “They’re so cute.”
rows.translation: 你笑了。“它们真可爱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile. “They’re so cute.”"

rows.original: Ula nods and gently slides them into white cloth slings. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉点点头，轻轻把它们塞进白色布兜里。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla nods and gently slides them into white cloth slings. <i>“"

rows.original: One second. Best we let the sleeping pups lie.
rows.translation: 等一下。最好别打扰熟睡的幼崽。
rows.raw: "One second. Best we let the sleeping pups lie."

rows.original: One second. Best let sleeping pups lie.
rows.translation: 等一下。最好让熟睡的幼崽继续睡。
