rows.raw: "After I ran away, they changed their minds, but now I’ve changed mine. I don’t want male korg visiting. I’d rather [pc.name], you, visit."

rows.original: After runninged away, they change minds, but now I change mine. No want korg visiting. Rather [pc.name] visit.
rows.translation: 逃跑以后，他们改变想法，但现在我改变想法。不想科尔格来访。更想[pc.name]来访。
rows.raw: "After runninged away, they change minds, but now I change mine. No want korg visiting. Rather [pc.name] visit."

rows.original: ” The korgonne
rows.translation: ”这名科尔贡
rows.raw: "” The korgonne "

rows.original: chieftess
rows.translation: 女酋长
rows.raw: "chieftess"

rows.original: princess
rows.translation: 公主
rows.raw: "princess"

rows.original: smiles sidelong at you.
rows.translation: 侧过脸来朝你微笑。
rows.raw: " smiles sidelong at you."

rows.original: “Awww, thanks so much!” You squeeze her tight. “I love visiting you, little cuddle-pup!”
rows.translation: “哇，太谢谢啦！”你紧紧抱住她。“我最喜欢来看你了，小抱抱狗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww, thanks so much!” You squeeze her tight. “I love visiting you, little cuddle-pup!”"

rows.original: “Thanks, toots.” You squeeze her shoulder affectionately.
rows.translation: “谢啦，小妞。”你亲昵地捏了捏她的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, toots.” You squeeze her shoulder affectionately."

rows.original: “Awww, thanks!” You squeeze her affectionately. “I enjoy these visits too.”
rows.translation: “啊——，谢谢！”你亲昵地搂了搂她。“我也喜欢这些拜访。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww, thanks!” You squeeze her affectionately. “I enjoy these visits too.”"

rows.original: “Oh really?” You ask, smiling broadly. “Then I’ll have to visit twice as much.”
rows.translation: “真的吗？”你灿烂地笑着问道。“那我得多来一倍次数才行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh really?” You ask, smiling broadly. “Then I’ll have to visit twice as much.”"

rows.original: “Good thing I’m here then,” you quip.
rows.translation: “那幸好我在这里，”你打趣道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good thing I’m here then,” you quip."

rows.original: Ula blushes. “Good.”
rows.translation: 乌拉脸红了。“很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nUla blushes. “Good.”"

rows.original: You ask her if that means she’ll be the chief someday.
rows.translation: 你问她，这是不是意味着她有一天会当上酋长。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if that means she’ll be the chief someday."

rows.original: Snorting, the canine woman laughs. <i>“
rows.translation: 那犬族女人嗤笑一声。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nSnorting, the canine woman laughs. <i>“"

rows.original: I’m doubting it! The elders choose the next Chieftain. Usually it is a child of the old Chief. Not this time. They think I’m too crazy, reckless, and weak.
rows.translation: 我看不会！长老会选出下一任酋长。通常是老酋长的孩子。这次不会。他们觉得我太疯狂、鲁莽又软弱。
rows.raw: "I’m doubting it! The elders choose the next Chieftain. Usually it is a child of the old Chief. Not this time. They think I’m too crazy, reckless, and weak."

rows.original: Am doubting! Elders choosing next Chieftain. Usually old-Chief offspring. Not this time. Think me too crazy. Reckless. Weak.
rows.translation: 俺怀疑！长老们在选下一任酋长。通常是老酋长的后代。这次不是。他们觉得俺太疯。鲁莽。软弱。
rows.raw: "Am doubting! Elders choosing next Chieftain. Usually old-Chief offspring. Not this time. Think me too crazy. Reckless. Weak."

rows.original: ” She snorts. “
rows.translation: ”她哼了一声。“
rows.raw: "” She snorts. “"

rows.original: We would do better if we learned from the aliens. We could learn science-magic to make boom-tubes of our own. Milodans wouldn’t stand a chance against korg with core-magic. Aliens couldn’t gloat in the sky above if we had ships of our own. Nobody could take from the small tribes or steal our gems! No more thievery! Only respect!
rows.translation: 如果向外星人学习，我们会做得更好。我们可以学习科学魔法，制造自己的轰鸣管。如果科尔格有了核心魔法，米洛丹人根本毫无胜算。如果我们拥有自己的飞船，外星人就不能在头顶的天空耀武扬威。没人能从小部族手中夺取东西或偷走我们的宝石！不再有偷窃！只有尊重！
rows.raw: "We would do better if we learned from the aliens. We could learn science-magic to make boom-tubes of our own. Milodans wouldn’t stand a chance against korg with core-magic. Aliens couldn’t gloat in the sky above if we had ships of our own. Nobody could take from the small tribes or steal our gems! No more thievery! Only respect!"

rows.original: We do better if learn from aliens. Learn alien science-magic so can make boom-tubes of own. Milodans not stand chance against korg with core-magic. Aliens no gloat in sky above if korg have fly-ships of own. No take holds from small tribes for steal sparkles! No take! Only respect!
rows.translation: 向外星人学习就做得更好。学习外星科学魔法，就能造自己的轰鸣管。科尔格有核心魔法，米洛丹就没胜算。科尔格有自己飞船，外星人就不能在上面天空炫耀。不许为偷闪亮东西夺走小部族要塞！不许夺！只有尊重！
rows.raw: "We do better if learn from aliens. Learn alien science-magic so can make boom-tubes of own. Milodans not stand chance against korg with core-magic. Aliens no gloat in sky above if korg have fly-ships of own. No take holds from small tribes for steal sparkles! No take! Only respect!"

rows.original: ” Ula punches one fist into the other. “
rows.translation: ”乌拉一拳砸进另一只手掌。“
rows.raw: "” Ula punches one fist into the other. “"

rows.original: That’s what I’d do if I got to be chief.
rows.translation: 要是我当上首领，我就会这么做。
rows.raw: "That’s what I’d do if I got to be chief."

rows.original: That what I do if got be chief.
rows.translation: 如果当上酋长，那就是我要做的。
rows.raw: "That what I do if got be chief."

rows.original: You rock back in surprise. She’s quite the progressive little firecracker!
rows.translation: 你惊讶地往后一仰。她可真是个思想前卫的小炮仗！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rock back in surprise. She’s quite the progressive little firecracker!"

rows.original: Want to talk about something else?
rows.translation: 想聊点别的？
rows.raw: "Want to talk about something else?"

rows.original: Want talk something else?
rows.translation: 想聊点别的吗？
rows.raw: "Want talk something else?"

rows.original: ” Ula strokes your knee affectionately.
rows.translation: ” 乌拉深情地抚着你的膝盖。
rows.raw: "” Ula strokes your knee affectionately."

rows.translation: 乌拉的角色
rows.raw: "Ula’s Role"

rows.translation: 乌拉的角色
rows.raw: "Ula’s Role"

rows.original: You already spoke of this.
rows.translation: 你已经谈过这个了。
rows.raw: "You already spoke of this."

rows.original: “How many other tribes does Uveto have?”
rows.translation: “乌维托还有多少别的部落？”
rows.raw: "“How many other tribes does Uveto have?”"

rows.original: Ula shrugs. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉耸耸肩。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla shrugs. <i>“"

rows.original: How many stars are in the sky? Too many for any one person to know. Very many. Uveto’s bigger than a pregnant korg’s appetite, though there are less clans now than there were.
rows.translation: 天上有多少颗星星？多到没有任何一个人能数清。非常非常多。乌维托比一头怀孕科尔贡的胃口还大，不过现在的部族比从前少了。
rows.raw: "How many stars are in the sky? Too many for any one person to know. Very many. Uveto’s bigger than a pregnant korg’s appetite, though there are less clans now than there were."

rows.original: How many stars in sky? Too many for one to know. Many. Uveto bigger than pregnant korg appetite, though less now than was.
rows.translation: 天上有多少星星？多得没人能数清。很多。乌维托比怀孕科尔格的胃口还大，不过现在比以前少了。
rows.raw: "How many stars in sky? Too many for one to know. Many. Uveto bigger than pregnant korg appetite, though less now than was."

rows.original: ” She taps her palm. “
rows.translation: ”她敲了敲手掌。“
rows.raw: "” She taps her palm. “"

rows.original: Some were milodan-killed. Some were driven to the snows by mining.
rows.translation: 有些是被米洛丹人杀死的。有些是被采矿逼到雪地里的。
rows.raw: "Some were milodan-killed. Some were driven to the snows by mining."

rows.original: Some milodan-killed. Some driven to snow by sparkle-mining.
rows.translation: 有些被米洛丹人杀了。有些因采闪石被逼进雪地。
rows.raw: "Some milodan-killed. Some driven to snow by sparkle-mining."

rows.original: ” She punches her fist into her hand. “
rows.translation: ”她一拳砸进手掌。“
rows.raw: "” She punches her fist into her hand. “"

rows.original: Smaller clans joined together to make bigger, stronger clans. This is a new thing. Korgonne don’t like so many snouts in one burrow, but we do it anyway. Better than losing a war or starving.
rows.translation: 较小的氏族联合起来，组成更大、更强的氏族。这是新出现的事。科尔贡人不喜欢一个洞穴里挤进太多口鼻，但我们还是这么做。总比输掉战争或活活饿死好。
rows.raw: "Smaller clans joined together to make bigger, stronger clans. This is a new thing. Korgonne don’t like so many snouts in one burrow, but we do it anyway. Better than losing a war or starving."

rows.original: Small clans join together. Make bigger, stronger clan. This new. Korgonne no like much many snouts in one burrow, but do anyway. Better than lose war or starve.
rows.translation: 小氏族联合起来。组成更大、更强的氏族。这是新的。科尔贡人不太喜欢一个洞里塞这么多鼻子，但还是这么做了。总比输掉战争或者饿死好。
rows.raw: "Small clans join together. Make bigger, stronger clan. This new. Korgonne no like much many snouts in one burrow, but do anyway. Better than lose war or starve."

rows.original: You ask if her clan is such a conglomerate.
rows.translation: 你问她的氏族是否也是这种联合体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if her clan is such a conglomerate."

rows.original: Nope! Korg’ii clan has had much success. Our
rows.translation: 不是！科尔吉氏族一直很成功。我们的

rows.raw: "father-Chief was"

rows.translation: 聪明。我们躲起来，从那些更笨的外星人那儿偷东西。
rows.raw: " smart. We hide and steal from the dumber aliens."

rows.original: Nope! Korg’ii clan much success.
rows.translation: 才不！科尔吉氏族大获成功。
rows.raw: "Nope! Korg’ii clan much success. "

rows.original: father-Chief
rows.translation: 父亲酋长
rows.raw: "father-Chief"

rows.translation: 头儿
rows.raw: "Chief"

rows.original: smart. Hide. Steal from dumb aliens.
rows.translation: 聪明。躲起来。偷傻外星人的东西。
rows.raw: " smart. Hide. Steal from dumb aliens."

rows.raw: "” The "

rows.translation: 女酋长
rows.raw: "chieftess"

rows.original: princess
rows.translation: 公主
rows.raw: "princess"

rows.original: pats your knee apologetically. <i>“
rows.translation: 歉疚地拍了拍你的膝盖。<i>“
rows.raw: " pats your knee apologetically. <i>“"

rows.original: No offense. We don’t take as much as many other clans. We don’t want to draw the other aliens’ ire. We’re better hidden too. Right under your noses. The secret entrance makes us tough to find.
rows.translation: 无意冒犯。我们夺取的东西没有许多其他氏族那么多。我们不想招来其他外星人的怒火。我们也藏得更好。就在你们眼皮底下。秘密入口让我们很难被找到。
rows.raw: "No offense. We don’t take as much as many other clans. We don’t want to draw the other aliens’ ire. We’re better hidden too. Right under your noses. The secret entrance makes us tough to find."

rows.original: No offense. We not take so much as other clans. Not draw alien ire. Better hidden too. Right under nose. Secret entrance make tough find.
rows.translation: 别见怪。我们不像其他氏族拿那么多。不招外星人怨恨。也更隐蔽。就在鼻子底下。秘密入口很难找。
rows.raw: "No offense. We not take so much as other clans. Not draw alien ire. Better hidden too. Right under nose. Secret entrance make tough find."

rows.original: ” She smiles proudly.
rows.translation: ” 她得意地笑了。
rows.raw: "” She smiles proudly."

rows.original: “But other clans steal more?”
rows.translation: “但别的氏族偷得更多？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But other clans steal more?”"

rows.original: Ula chitters with mirth. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉开心地咯咯笑起来。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla chitters with mirth. <i>“"

rows.original: Much more! Sparkle-Claws pride themselves on taking things from aliens. They roam far from their hold, using those magic belts to stay warm. They even have flash-shooters, bang-sticks, and all kinds of other core-magic. Formidable fighters!
rows.translation: 多得多！闪爪氏族以夺取外星人的东西为荣。他们远离要塞四处游荡，用那些魔法腰带保暖。他们甚至还有闪光射击器、砰响棍和各种其他核心魔法。是可怕的战士！
rows.raw: "Much more! Sparkle-Claws pride themselves on taking things from aliens. They roam far from their hold, using those magic belts to stay warm. They even have flash-shooters, bang-sticks, and all kinds of other core-magic. Formidable fighters!"

rows.original: Many more! Sparkle-Claws pride selves on taking from aliens. Roam far from hold. Use magic belt, stay warm. Have flash-shooters, bang-sticks, and other core-magic. Strong fighters.
rows.translation: 多很多！闪爪以夺外星人东西为荣。远离要塞游荡。用魔法腰带，保持温暖。有闪光射击器、砰响棍和其他核心魔法。强大战士。
rows.raw: "Many more! Sparkle-Claws pride selves on taking from aliens. Roam far from hold. Use magic belt, stay warm. Have flash-shooters, bang-sticks, and other core-magic. Strong fighters."

rows.original: ” She flexes a pudgy bicep. “
rows.translation: ” 她绷了绷肉乎乎的肱二头肌。“
rows.raw: "” She flexes a pudgy bicep. “"

rows.original: They scared off the aliens. Nobody tries to mine their territory. Tech makes them strong. Stronger than the Korg’ii.
rows.translation: 他们吓跑了外星人。没人敢来他们的领地采矿。技术让他们强大。比科尔吉伊人还强。
rows.raw: "They scared off the aliens. Nobody tries to mine their territory. Tech makes them strong. Stronger than the Korg’ii."

rows.original: Scare aliens. No try mine territory. Tech make strong. Stronger than Korg’ii.
rows.translation: 吓跑外星人。别想进我的地盘。科技让人变强。比科尔吉更强。
rows.raw: "Scare aliens. No try mine territory. Tech make strong. Stronger than Korg’ii."

rows.original: ” The dog-girl’s expression becomes pensive. “
rows.translation: ”狗女孩的表情变得若有所思。“
rows.raw: "” The dog-girl’s expression becomes pensive. “"

rows.original: But they don’t know core-magics. They don’t keep their tech strong. Rust damages it or worse. Always they need to steal more.
rows.translation: 但他们不懂核心魔法。他们不保养自己的科技。锈蚀会损坏它，甚至更糟。他们总是需要偷更多。
rows.raw: "But they don’t know core-magics. They don’t keep their tech strong. Rust damages it or worse. Always they need to steal more."

rows.original: But not know core-magics. Not keep tech strong. Rust-breaking or worse. Always needing more stealings.
rows.translation: 但不懂核心魔法。不能保持技术强大。锈蚀崩坏，或者更糟。总是需要更多偷来的东西。
rows.raw: "But not know core-magics. Not keep tech strong. Rust-breaking or worse. Always needing more stealings."

rows.original: You nod thoughtfully. Without knowledge of how to maintain a weapon, especially in these harsh climes, it wouldn’t last long.
rows.translation: 你若有所思地点点头。如果不懂得如何维护武器，尤其是在这样恶劣的气候中，它根本用不了多久。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod thoughtfully. Without knowledge of how to maintain a weapon, especially in these harsh climes, it wouldn’t last long."

rows.original: Some clans don’t use any core-magic - only korgonne-craft. Those clans are dumb. They do the worst of all, unless very far from the sky-spire,
rows.translation: 有些氏族完全不使用核心魔法 - 只用科尔贡手艺。那些氏族很蠢。他们过得最差，除非离天空尖塔非常远，
rows.raw: "Some clans don’t use any core-magic - only korgonne-craft. Those clans are dumb. They do the worst of all, unless very far from the sky-spire,"

rows.original: Some clans no use core-magic. Only korgonne-craft. Those clans dumb. Do worst of all, unless very far from sky-spire,
rows.translation: 有些氏族不用核心魔法。只用科尔贡手艺。那些氏族很蠢。他们过得最差，除非离天空尖塔非常远，
rows.raw: "Some clans no use core-magic. Only korgonne-craft. Those clans dumb. Do worst of all, unless very far from sky-spire,"

rows.translation: 公主

rows.translation: 解释道。<i>“
rows.raw: " explains. <i>“"

rows.original: Wyrm-Murder clan are the only exception. A strong people. They hunt frostwyrms. All their hunters have full suits of frostwyrm scale. It even stops some core-bangs.
rows.translation: 屠龙氏族是唯一的例外。一个强悍的民族。他们猎杀霜龙。所有猎手都穿着整套霜龙鳞甲。那甚至能挡下一些核心爆弹。
rows.raw: "Wyrm-Murder clan are the only exception. A strong people. They hunt frostwyrms. All their hunters have full suits of frostwyrm scale. It even stops some core-bangs."

rows.original: Wyrm-Murder clan only exception. Strong people. Hunt frostwyrms. All hunters wear full suit of scales. Even stops some core-bangs.
rows.translation: 杀龙氏族是唯一例外。强大族人。猎杀霜龙。所有猎人都穿全套鳞甲。甚至能挡住一些核心轰击。
rows.raw: "Wyrm-Murder clan only exception. Strong people. Hunt frostwyrms. All hunters wear full suit of scales. Even stops some core-bangs."

rows.original: She runs her fingers over your armor. “You know, yes?”
rows.translation: 她用手指抚过你的盔甲。“你知道，对吧？”
rows.raw: " She runs her fingers over your armor. “You know, yes?”"

rows.original: She sighs heavily. <i>“
rows.translation: 她沉重地叹了口气。<i>“
rows.raw: " She sighs heavily. <i>“"

rows.original: Korg’ii Clan only has a few, but we can make it, if someone has the scales.
rows.translation: 科尔吉氏族只有寥寥几个，但只要有人鳞片够硬，我们就能办成。
rows.raw: "Korg’ii Clan only has a few, but we can make it, if someone has the scales."

rows.original: Korg’ii only have few, but know how make, if scales getted.
rows.translation: 科尔吉只有几个，但知道怎么造，只要鳞片够硬。
rows.raw: "Korg’ii only have few, but know how make, if scales getted."

rows.original: “Impressive.”
rows.translation: “令人印象深刻。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Impressive.”"

rows.original: Ula grins. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉咧嘴一笑。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla grins. <i>“"

rows.original: Good to see we korgonne can wow you.
rows.translation: 很高兴我们科尔贡人能让你大开眼界。
rows.raw: "Good to see we korgonne can wow you."

rows.original: Good see korgonne wow alien.
rows.translation: 看见科尔贡真好 哇 外星人。
rows.raw: "Good see korgonne wow alien."

rows.translation: 我们也有自己的魔法。那么，你是想聊点什么，还是想钻进来偎着？
rows.raw: "We have magic of our own. Now, do you want to talk about something, or snuggle in?"

rows.translation: 有自己魔法。现在，你想聊别的？还是想抱抱？

rows.translation: 其他部族

rows.original: You’ve already had this conversation.
rows.translation: 你们已经谈过这个了。
rows.raw: "You’ve already had this conversation."

rows.original: “Why don’t I tell you about guns?”
rows.translation: “不如我跟你讲讲枪吧？”
rows.raw: "“Why don’t I tell you about guns?”"

rows.original: “Boomers?” Ula’s ears perk up, and her eyes brighten. “Want know.” Her tail wags hard, slapping your back as she leans in, locking her arm with yours.
rows.translation: “婴儿潮一代？”乌拉的耳朵竖了起来，眼睛发亮。“想知道。”她的尾巴用力摆着，拍在你背上，同时凑过来挽住你的手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Boomers?” Ula’s ears perk up, and her eyes brighten. “Want know.” Her tail wags hard, slapping your back as she leans in, locking her arm with yours."

rows.original: You start off by giving a basic explanation of gunpowder weapons: what gunpowder is and how it propels the bullet, the different kinds of actions and shells that exist.
rows.translation: 你首先对火药武器作了基本说明：火药是什么，它如何推动子弹，以及现存的不同枪机原理和弹药种类。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start off by giving a basic explanation of gunpowder weapons: what gunpowder is and how it propels the bullet, the different kinds of actions and shells that exist."

rows.original: Ula often interrupts you with specific questions. She asks why so many different techniques of measuring bullets and competing specifications exist, why some shells contain single bullets and others explosive, and why it’s called gunpowder when modern formulations are more of a paste.
rows.translation: 乌拉经常打断你，提出具体问题。她问为什么会有那么多不同的子弹计量方式和彼此竞争的规格，为什么有些弹药装着单颗子弹、另一些却会爆炸，以及现代配方更像糊状物，为什么仍被称为火药。
rows.raw: "\n\nUla often interrupts you with specific questions. She asks why so many different techniques of measuring bullets and competing specifications exist, why some shells contain single bullets and others explosive, and why it’s called gunpowder when modern formulations are more of a paste."

rows.original: You answer them all to the best of your ability, then go over basic maintenance. Should she get her hands on an old-style weapon, you’d like her to keep it in good shape after all.
rows.translation: 你尽己所能地回答了所有问题，然后讲解了基本保养。毕竟，要是她弄到一把老式武器，你希望她能把它保养好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer them all to the best of your ability, then go over basic maintenance. Should she get her hands on an old-style weapon, you’d like her to keep it in good shape after all."

rows.original: Pulling cloths and furs from a nearby container, Ula assembles herself a primitive cleaning kit. She meticulously arranges them, then sets them aside after making a note to acquire some oil. “Know so much.”
rows.translation: 乌拉从附近的箱子里翻出布块和毛皮，给自己凑了一套简陋的清洁工具。她一丝不苟地把它们摆好，又记下要弄些油来，然后把东西放到一边。“懂这么多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPulling cloths and furs from a nearby container, Ula assembles herself a primitive cleaning kit. She meticulously arranges them, then sets them aside after making a note to acquire some oil. “Know so much.”"

rows.original: You giggle at that. “Just like sex, you gotta like, have proper lubrication!”
rows.translation: 你咯咯笑了。“就像做爱一样，你得，那个，有足够的润滑！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou giggle at that. “Just like sex, you gotta like, have proper lubrication!”"

rows.original: You let out a pleased grunt.
rows.translation: 你满意地哼了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let out a pleased grunt."

rows.original: You snort. <i>“I know what I’ve been around my whole life. Same as you.
rows.translation: 你哼了一声。<i>“我当然了解陪伴了自己一辈子的东西。你也一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou snort. <i>“I know what I’ve been around my whole life. Same as you."

rows.original: You wave your hand dismissively. <i>“It only seems that way because I’ve been exposed to it my entire life. I am sure there are many techniques your tribe knows that would stump me at first blush.
rows.translation: 你不以为然地挥挥手。<i>“只是因为我一生都接触这些东西，所以才显得如此。我相信你的部族掌握着许多技巧，乍一接触也会让我摸不着头脑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave your hand dismissively. <i>“It only seems that way because I’ve been exposed to it my entire life. I am sure there are many techniques your tribe knows that would stump me at first blush."

rows.original: Keep an open mind, and you’ll be surprised what you can learn.”
rows.translation: 保持开放心态，你会惊讶于自己能学到多少。”
rows.raw: " Keep an open mind, and you’ll be surprised what you can learn.”"

rows.original: Exactly. I don’t know that much yet, but I’m learning fast. Want to talk more? Tell me of more core-magics?
rows.translation: 没错。我现在懂得还不多，但学得很快。想继续聊吗？再告诉我一些核心魔法？
rows.raw: "Exactly. I don’t know that much yet, but I’m learning fast. Want to talk more? Tell me of more core-magics?"

rows.original: Ula good stupid. Much learnings. Talk more? Tell of more core-magic?
rows.translation: 乌拉是好笨蛋。学到很多。再聊吗？再讲更多核心魔法？
rows.raw: "Ula good stupid. Much learnings. Talk more? Tell of more core-magic?"

rows.original: I’ll be sharing this with the tribe. Hopefully we can make the Pyrite-issue guns last longer.
rows.translation: 我会把这些知识分享给部族。希望我们能让黄铁配发的枪械使用得更久。
rows.raw: " I’ll be sharing this with the tribe. Hopefully we can make the Pyrite-issue guns last longer."

rows.original: Ula share with tribe. Make Pyrite guns last longer.
rows.translation: 乌拉会分享给部族。让黄铁枪械用得更久。
rows.raw: " Ula share with tribe. Make Pyrite guns last longer."

rows.original: Explain Guns
rows.translation: 讲解枪械
rows.raw: "Explain Guns"

rows.original: Explain Guns
rows.translation: 讲解枪械
rows.raw: "Explain Guns"

rows.original: You already spoke of this.
rows.translation: 你已经谈过这个了。
rows.raw: "You already spoke of this."

rows.original: “I’d like to explain electricity to you.”
rows.translation: “我想给你讲讲电是什么。”
rows.raw: "“I’d like to explain electricity to you.”"

rows.original: Ula seems confused. “Elec...tit-city?”
rows.translation: 乌拉一脸困惑。“电...奶力？”
rows.raw: "\n\nUla seems confused. “Elec...tit-city?”"

rows.translation: “火花？闪电？”你把手猛地挥向地面，同时模仿雷鸣声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sparks? Lightning?” You jerk your hand down toward the ground and mimic the sound of thunder."

rows.translation: “噢噢噢，”身材曲线玲珑的可人儿动了动嘴。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oooooh,” the curvaceous cutie mouths. “"

rows.translation: 你是说电击！
rows.raw: "You mean shocks!"

rows.original: You mean zaps!
rows.translation: 你是说电击！
rows.raw: "You mean zaps!"

rows.original: “Suuure.” You avoid getting into the theory of it.
rows.translation: “当——然。”你避开不去讲其中的理论。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Suuure.” You avoid getting into the theory of it."

rows.original: Not like you care to remember. Booooring!
rows.translation: 反正你也不愿意记住。无聊死了！
rows.raw: " Not like you care to remember. Booooring!"

rows.original: Instead you focus on the practical: conductors and insulators, explaining how it can travel through certain metals with ease but can be stopped by a thin layer of rubber or certain hides.
rows.translation: 你转而专注于实用知识：导体和绝缘体，并解释电流如何轻易穿过某些金属，却能被一层薄橡胶或某些兽皮阻挡。
rows.raw: " Instead you focus on the practical: conductors and insulators, explaining how it can travel through certain metals with ease but can be stopped by a thin layer of rubber or certain hides."

rows.original: Ula’s face is a studious mask, but she interrupts you before your lecture can get too far. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉的脸是一副认真钻研的面具，但你的说教还没展开多少，她就打断了你。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nUla’s face is a studious mask, but she interrupts you before your lecture can get too far. <i>“"

rows.original: How do you get it? How do you store it?
rows.translation: 你要怎么得到它？怎么储存它？
rows.raw: "How do you get it? How do you store it?"

rows.original: How get? How pocket zaps?
rows.translation: 怎么弄到？口袋怎么电？
rows.raw: "How get? How pocket zaps?"

rows.original: Once more, you try to keep it simple. Rather than get into the theory of how various generators work, you tell her about solar panels and how they capture light - sunpower - and turn it into electrical power, carrying it via rubber-wrapped wires to charge a chemical power cell. You compare the battery to a jar and the wires to a pipe, slowly filling it so that it can be carried around and used elsewhere.
rows.translation: 你再次努力把事情说得简单些。你没有深入讲解各种发电机的工作原理，而是告诉她太阳能板如何捕捉光线，也就是太阳之力，并将其转化为电力，再通过橡胶包裹的电线传输，为化学电池充电。你把电池比作罐子，把电线比作管道，慢慢将其装满，好让它能够随身携带，在别处使用。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce more, you try to keep it simple. Rather than get into the theory of how various generators work, you tell her about solar panels and how they capture light - sunpower - and turn it into electrical power, carrying it via rubber-wrapped wires to charge a chemical power cell. You compare the battery to a jar and the wires to a pipe, slowly filling it so that it can be carried around and used elsewhere."

rows.original: This seems to placate the ever-curious Ula for now, though you have no doubt that she’d love a chance to understand it in more detail.
rows.translation: 眼下，这似乎暂时满足了永远充满好奇心的乌拉，不过你毫不怀疑，只要有机会，她一定很乐意更深入地理解这些知识。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis seems to placate the ever-curious Ula for now, though you have no doubt that she’d love a chance to understand it in more detail."

rows.original: “Thanks-having!” The fluffy dog-girl hugs you tight. “
rows.translation: “谢谢-有！”毛茸茸的狗女孩紧紧抱住你。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks-having!” The fluffy dog-girl hugs you tight. “"

rows.original: I learned so much. Our hunters won’t need to throw out zap-guns that don’t zap any more. I just need to have them find some charged batteries or a so-lar panel to charge them back up. We can even make the warm-belts that have gone cold work again!
rows.translation: 我学到了好多。猎人们再也不必扔掉那些不放电的电击枪了。只需让他们找到有电的电池或太阳能板，就能重新充电。我们甚至能让已经变冷的保暖腰带再次工作！
rows.raw: "I learned so much. Our hunters won’t need to throw out zap-guns that don’t zap any more. I just need to have them find some charged batteries or a so-lar panel to charge them back up. We can even make the warm-belts that have gone cold work again!"

rows.original: Learn much. Hunters not need throw out zap-gun with no more zaps. Just need find charge-battery or so-lar paneling for good use. And warm-belt! Warm belt can work again with elec-tric-it-y-filled battery?
rows.translation: 学了很多。猎人不用扔掉没电的电击枪。只要找到充电电池或太阳能板就能好好用。还有暖腰带！装满电的电池能让暖腰带重新工作？
rows.raw: "Learn much. Hunters not need throw out zap-gun with no more zaps. Just need find charge-battery or so-lar paneling for good use. And warm-belt! Warm belt can work again with elec-tric-it-y-filled battery?"

rows.original: I learned so much. Maybe some hunters will let me have a zap-gun that doesn’t zap any more. Then I just need to find a charged battery or so-lar paneling for me to use... And a warm-belt!
rows.translation: 我学到了好多。也许有些猎人愿意把不再放电的电击枪给我。然后我只需找一块有电的电池或太阳能板来用……还有保暖腰带！
rows.raw: "I learned so much. Maybe some hunters will let me have a zap-gun that doesn’t zap any more. Then I just need to find a charged battery or so-lar paneling for me to use... And a warm-belt!"

rows.original: Learn much. Maybe hunters let Ula have zap-gun that no zap no more. Then just need find charge-battery or so-lar paneling for own use. And warm-belt! Warm-belt can work again with elec-tric-it-y-filled battery?
rows.translation: 学很多。也许猎人让乌拉有不再放电的电击枪。然后只需找有电电池或太-阳-能板自己用。还有保暖腰带！装满电-力的电池能让保暖腰带重新工作？
rows.raw: "Learn much. Maybe hunters let Ula have zap-gun that no zap no more. Then just need find charge-battery or so-lar paneling for own use. And warm-belt! Warm-belt can work again with elec-tric-it-y-filled battery?"

rows.raw: "I learned so much. Many thanks! Want to talk about something else now?”"

rows.original: Much learn. Many thanks. Other talks now?
