rows.translation: 现在已经不重要了。想怎么叫就怎么叫吧。在我变得和雪一样冰冷之前，我的名字仍由自己保留。
rows.raw: "Doesn’t matter now. Call me what you want. My name is mine until I go as cold as the snow."

rows.original: Not mattering now. Call what want. Naming mine to keep until pass into forever-colds.
rows.translation: 现在不重要。随你想叫。名字归我保留，直到进入永恒寒冷。
rows.raw: "Not mattering now. Call what want. Naming mine to keep until pass into forever-colds."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You ask him about Ula, his daughter, and what he thinks of how she’s doing as Chieftess.
rows.translation: 你问起他女儿乌拉，以及他觉得她这个女酋长当得如何。
rows.raw: "You ask him about Ula, his daughter, and what he thinks of how she’s doing as Chieftess."

rows.original: Ula’s dumb,
rows.translation: 乌拉很笨，
rows.raw: "Ula’s dumb,"

rows.original: Ula dumb,
rows.translation: 乌拉笨，
rows.raw: "Ula dumb,"

rows.original: ” he announces without pause. “
rows.translation: ”他毫不停顿地宣布。“
rows.raw: "” he announces without pause. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "She’s too young to know how stupid she is. Thinks every idea is the best just because she’s the one to have it - sort of like an elder, if I’m being honest. The young and the old aren’t so different, but fat chance getting either side to admit it."
                : "Too young for knowing how stupid is. Think every idea is best idea just because she having it. Sort of like Elder korgs if being honest. Old and young not so different, but most not see it."

rows.original: She’s too young to know how stupid she is. Thinks every idea is the best just because she’s the one to have it - sort of like an elder, if I’m being honest. The young and the old aren’t so different, but fat chance getting either side to admit it.
rows.translation: 她太年轻，还不知道自己有多蠢。觉得每个主意都是最棒的，只因为那是她自己想出来的——说实话，这一点倒有点像长老。年轻人与老人并没有那么不同，不过想让任何一方承认这一点，可没什么可能。
rows.raw: "She’s too young to know how stupid she is. Thinks every idea is the best just because she’s the one to have it - sort of like an elder, if I’m being honest. The young and the old aren’t so different, but fat chance getting either side to admit it."

rows.original: Too young for knowing how stupid is. Think every idea is best idea just because she having it. Sort of like Elder korgs if being honest. Old and young not so different, but most not see it.
rows.translation: 太年轻，不知道什么叫蠢。以为每个主意都是最好的主意，只因为是她在想。说实话，有点像科尔格长老。老的小的没那么大不同，但大多数人看不见。
rows.raw: "Too young for knowing how stupid is. Think every idea is best idea just because she having it. Sort of like Elder korgs if being honest. Old and young not so different, but most not see it."

rows.original: ” He snorts in amusement. “
rows.translation: ” 他好笑地哼了一声。“
rows.raw: "” He snorts in amusement. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "It took me longer than it should have to realize it. The time for torch-passing was long ago."
                : "Me not see it for too long. Timing for torch-passing such long ago."

rows.original: It took me longer than it should have to realize it. The time for torch-passing was long ago.
rows.translation: 我花了太久才意识到这一点。传递火炬的时候早就过去了。
rows.raw: "It took me longer than it should have to realize it. The time for torch-passing was long ago."

rows.original: Me not see it for too long. Timing for torch-passing such long ago.
rows.translation: 我太久没有看见。传递火炬的时机很久以前。
rows.raw: "Me not see it for too long. Timing for torch-passing such long ago."

rows.original: Your surprise at his critical opinion shows plain as day.
rows.translation: 你对他这番批评意见的惊讶，明明白白写在脸上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour surprise at his critical opinion shows plain as day."

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Don’t get the wrong idea!"
                : "Not get wronging idea!"

rows.original: Don’t get the wrong idea!
rows.translation: 别误会！
rows.raw: "Don’t get the wrong idea!"

rows.original: Not get wronging idea!
rows.translation: 别误会！
rows.raw: "Not get wronging idea!"

rows.original: ” He leans forward onto one knee and jabs his finger at you as he speaks. “
rows.translation: ” 他单膝前倾，说话时用手指戳着你。“
rows.raw: "” He leans forward onto one knee and jabs his finger at you as he speaks. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Ula proved herself. All new Chiefs are dumb, and all old Chiefs get dumb. She’ll learn from her mistakes. The mark of a good Chieftain or Chieftess is how fast they can learn from the problems they create."
                : "Ula prove self. All new Chiefs dumb. All old Chiefs get dumb. Only way learn by mistaking. Will know if she good Chieftess by how fast learning from Ula-make problems."

rows.original: Ula proved herself. All new Chiefs are dumb, and all old Chiefs get dumb. She’ll learn from her mistakes. The mark of a good Chieftain or Chieftess is how fast they can learn from the problems they create.
rows.translation: 乌拉已经证明了自己。所有新酋长都很笨，所有老酋长也会变笨。她会从错误中学习。优秀男酋长或女酋长的标志，就是能以多快的速度从自己造成的问题中吸取教训。
rows.raw: "Ula proved herself. All new Chiefs are dumb, and all old Chiefs get dumb. She’ll learn from her mistakes. The mark of a good Chieftain or Chieftess is how fast they can learn from the problems they create."

rows.original: Ula prove self. All new Chiefs dumb. All old Chiefs get dumb. Only way learn by mistaking. Will know if she good Chieftess by how fast learning from Ula-make problems.
rows.translation: 乌拉证明自己。所有新酋长都蠢。所有老酋长也会变蠢。唯一的学习方式就是犯错。看她从乌拉制造的问题里学得多快，就知道她是不是个好女酋长。
rows.raw: "Ula prove self. All new Chiefs dumb. All old Chiefs get dumb. Only way learn by mistaking. Will know if she good Chieftess by how fast learning from Ula-make problems."

rows.original: ” He leans back a bit, and scratches at his beard. “
rows.translation: ”他往后靠了靠，抓了抓胡子。“
rows.raw: "” He leans back a bit, and scratches at his beard. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "I think Ula will learn well. She knew more core-magics than any elder even before making friends with you. If she can manage her pride, she may be the best Chief we’ve ever had. Maybe that’s just my fatherly pride speaking, though."
                : "Think Ula good learner. Knew more core-stuff than any elder, even before making alien-friend. If not over-pride, she maybe be best chief in time. Maybe just silly father-thinking, though."

rows.original: I think Ula will learn well. She knew more core-magics than any elder even before making friends with you. If she can manage her pride, she may be the best Chief we’ve ever had. Maybe that’s just my fatherly pride speaking, though.
rows.translation: 我认为乌拉会学得很好。甚至在与你成为朋友之前，她懂的核心魔法就已经比任何长老都多。如果能控制住傲气，她或许会成为我们有史以来最优秀的酋长。不过，也可能只是我身为父亲的骄傲在说话。
rows.raw: "I think Ula will learn well. She knew more core-magics than any elder even before making friends with you. If she can manage her pride, she may be the best Chief we’ve ever had. Maybe that’s just my fatherly pride speaking, though."

rows.original: Think Ula good learner. Knew more core-stuff than any elder, even before making alien-friend. If not over-pride, she maybe be best chief in time. Maybe just silly father-thinking, though.
rows.translation: 觉得乌拉很会学习。即使交外星朋友前，懂的核心东西也比任何长老多。如果不过度骄傲，她以后也许是最好酋长。不过也许只是傻父亲想法。
rows.raw: "Think Ula good learner. Knew more core-stuff than any elder, even before making alien-friend. If not over-pride, she maybe be best chief in time. Maybe just silly father-thinking, though."

rows.original: The old korg shrugs, apparently finished.
rows.translation: 老科尔贡耸耸肩，似乎说完了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe old korg shrugs, apparently finished."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Since Ula’s mother doesn’t seem to be around, you ask the old korg about who she was and what happened to her.
rows.translation: 乌拉的母亲似乎不在身边，于是你向这个年迈的科尔贡人询问她是怎样的人，又发生了什么事。
rows.raw: "Since Ula’s mother doesn’t seem to be around, you ask the old korg about who she was and what happened to her."

rows.original: The former Chief nods slowly, his face solemn. <i>“
rows.translation: 前任头儿缓缓点头，面色凝重。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe former Chief nods slowly, his face solemn. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "She went cold long ago, when Ula was still a young pup."
                : "She colded long ago, when Ula still young pup."

rows.original: She went cold long ago, when Ula was still a young pup.
rows.translation: 她很久以前就变冷了，那时乌拉还是只小幼崽。
rows.raw: "She went cold long ago, when Ula was still a young pup."

rows.original: She colded long ago, when Ula still young pup.
rows.translation: 她很久以前冷掉了，那时乌拉还是小幼崽。
rows.raw: "She colded long ago, when Ula still young pup."

rows.original: ” He turns away from you to look out the window, gaze lost in the snows beyond. “
rows.translation: ”他转过身望向窗外，目光消失在远方的雪原里。“
rows.raw: "” He turns away from you to look out the window, gaze lost in the snows beyond. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "She was a strong woman, Ula’s mother - the best warrior in the tribe, even. She hunted kor’diiaks all by herself. Once, she was ambushed by two milodans and still won. The only wound she took was the tip of one ear - no big loss. It made her stand out even more. If she was pretty before, well... then she was the prettiest girl in the entire hold. I’m still not sure why she picked me, but I’m happy she did."
                : "Strong woman. Best warrior in tribe, even. Hunt kor’diiaks all by self. Once ambush by double milodans and still win. Only lose tip of ear - no big loss. Make her stand out even more. Already prettier than other females. Still not quite sure why she pickinged me, but happinying she did."

rows.original: She was a strong woman, Ula’s mother - the best warrior in the tribe, even. She hunted kor’diiaks all by herself. Once, she was ambushed by two milodans and still won. The only wound she took was the tip of one ear - no big loss. It made her stand out even more. If she was pretty before, well... then she was the prettiest girl in the entire hold. I’m still not sure why she picked me, but I’m happy she did.
rows.translation: 她是个坚强的女人，乌拉的母亲——甚至是部族中最优秀的战士。她独自猎杀科尔迪亚克兽。有一次，她遭到两个米洛丹人伏击，却依然取胜。唯一受的伤只是失去了一只耳朵尖——没什么大不了，反而令她更加醒目。如果说以前的她就很漂亮，那么...之后她就是整个要塞最美的姑娘。我仍不知道她为什么选中了我，但很庆幸她这样做了。
rows.raw: "She was a strong woman, Ula’s mother - the best warrior in the tribe, even. She hunted kor’diiaks all by herself. Once, she was ambushed by two milodans and still won. The only wound she took was the tip of one ear - no big loss. It made her stand out even more. If she was pretty before, well... then she was the prettiest girl in the entire hold. I’m still not sure why she picked me, but I’m happy she did."

rows.original: Strong woman. Best warrior in tribe, even. Hunt kor’diiaks all by self. Once ambush by double milodans and still win. Only lose tip of ear - no big loss. Make her stand out even more. Already prettier than other females. Still not quite sure why she pickinged me, but happinying she did.
rows.translation: 强大女人。甚至是部落最棒战士。独自猎杀科尔迪亚克。曾被两个米洛丹伏击，仍然获胜。只失去耳尖——不算大损失。反而让她更显眼。本来就比其他雌性漂亮。仍不太明白她为什么选我，但很高兴她这样做。
rows.raw: "Strong woman. Best warrior in tribe, even. Hunt kor’diiaks all by self. Once ambush by double milodans and still win. Only lose tip of ear - no big loss. Make her stand out even more. Already prettier than other females. Still not quite sure why she pickinged me, but happinying she did."

rows.original: You tilt your head and ask if she courted him.
rows.translation: 你歪了歪头，问她有没有追求过他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tilt your head and ask if she courted him."

rows.original: The white-furred dog-man nods, turning to you curiously. <i>“
rows.translation: 那只白毛狗男点点头，好奇地转向你。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white-furred dog-man nods, turning to you curiously. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "It is the korg way. Females are the keepers of our breeding urges. When they want pups, they share with the males. Are aliens not like this?"
                : "Is korg way. Females keepers of breeding urges. Share with males when wanting pups. Aliens not like this?"

rows.original: It is the korg way. Females are the keepers of our breeding urges. When they want pups, they share with the males. Are aliens not like this?
rows.translation: 这是科尔贡人的方式。雌性掌管着我们的繁育冲动。当她们想要幼崽时，就会与雄性分享。外星人不是这样吗？
rows.raw: "It is the korg way. Females are the keepers of our breeding urges. When they want pups, they share with the males. Are aliens not like this?"

rows.original: Is korg way. Females keepers of breeding urges. Share with males when wanting pups. Aliens not like this?
rows.translation: 这是科尔贡的规矩。雌性掌管繁育的欲望。想要幼崽时才与雄性分享。外星人不是这样吗？
rows.raw: "Is korg way. Females keepers of breeding urges. Share with males when wanting pups. Aliens not like this?"

rows.original: “A few, perhaps, but not most.”
rows.translation: “也许有几个，但不是大多数。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A few, perhaps, but not most.”"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Aliens are weird as always."
                : "Aliens weird as always."

rows.original: Aliens are weird as always.
rows.translation: 外星人还是一如既往地古怪。
rows.raw: "Aliens are weird as always."

rows.original: Aliens weird as always.
rows.translation: 外星人还是很古怪。
rows.raw: "Aliens weird as always."

rows.original: ” He waves you off and continues, “
rows.translation: ”他挥手打发你，继续道：“
rows.raw: "” He waves you off and continues, “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Her name was Juko. I share her name to keep her memory warm, even if her body is cold. She took me, and she shared much warmth. It seemed like we had more than anyone else in the tribe."
                : "Her name Juko. I give for keeping memory warm, even if body cold. She take me, share much warmth. Most warms in tribe, me thinking."

rows.original: Her name was Juko. I share her name to keep her memory warm, even if her body is cold. She took me, and she shared much warmth. It seemed like we had more than anyone else in the tribe.
rows.translation: 她叫朱科。我沿用她的名字，让她的记忆保持温暖，哪怕她的身体已经冰冷。她收留了我，也分享了许多温暖。那时我们拥有的似乎比部落里任何人都多。
rows.raw: "Her name was Juko. I share her name to keep her memory warm, even if her body is cold. She took me, and she shared much warmth. It seemed like we had more than anyone else in the tribe."

rows.original: Her name Juko. I give for keeping memory warm, even if body cold. She take me, share much warmth. Most warms in tribe, me thinking.
rows.translation: 她叫茱可。我用这个名字让记忆保持温暖，哪怕身体已经冰冷。她选择我，与我分享许多温暖。我觉得，是部落里最多的温暖。
rows.raw: "Her name Juko. I give for keeping memory warm, even if body cold. She take me, share much warmth. Most warms in tribe, me thinking."

rows.original: Is he... blushing?
rows.translation: 他这是...脸红了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIs he... blushing?"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "And from all that sharing of warmth came a daughter! She looked perfect. Healthy. Maybe she was a little small, but what pup isn’t? We named her Ula and raised with love. She wanted to be a hunter like her mother at first."
                : "And from all warms came daughter! Look perfect. Healthy. Maybe little small, but what pup not? Name Ula and raise with love. She want be hunter like mother at first."

rows.original: And from all that sharing of warmth came a daughter! She looked perfect. Healthy. Maybe she was a little small, but what pup isn’t? We named her Ula and raised with love. She wanted to be a hunter like her mother at first.
rows.translation: 而分享那么多温暖后，我们有了一个女儿！她看起来完美无缺，十分健康。也许个头有点小，可哪只幼崽不小呢？我们给她取名乌拉，用爱把她养大。起初，她想像母亲一样成为猎人。
rows.raw: "And from all that sharing of warmth came a daughter! She looked perfect. Healthy. Maybe she was a little small, but what pup isn’t? We named her Ula and raised with love. She wanted to be a hunter like her mother at first."

rows.original: And from all warms came daughter! Look perfect. Healthy. Maybe little small, but what pup not? Name Ula and raise with love. She want be hunter like mother at first.
rows.translation: 所有温暖带来一个女儿！看起来完美。健康。也许有点小，但哪只幼崽不小？取名乌拉，用爱养大。起初她想像母亲一样当猎人。
rows.raw: "And from all warms came daughter! Look perfect. Healthy. Maybe little small, but what pup not? Name Ula and raise with love. She want be hunter like mother at first."

rows.original: ” He shakes his head. “
rows.translation: ”他摇摇头。“
rows.raw: "” He shakes his head. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "It wasn’t meant to last, not after Juko went cold. We all knew it might happen. It’s the risk all hunters take. They get to see the snows and go where they want, but they can go cold at any time."
                : "Not last. Not after Juko colding. Known might happen. Is hunter risk. Get see all snows, go where want, but can colding any day, any time."

rows.original: It wasn’t meant to last, not after Juko went cold. We all knew it might happen. It’s the risk all hunters take. They get to see the snows and go where they want, but they can go cold at any time.
rows.translation: 这一切注定无法长久，尤其在茱可变冷之后。我们都知道这可能发生。所有猎人都要承担这种风险。他们能看见雪原，能去想去的地方，却也可能随时陷入冰冷。
rows.raw: "It wasn’t meant to last, not after Juko went cold. We all knew it might happen. It’s the risk all hunters take. They get to see the snows and go where they want, but they can go cold at any time."

rows.original: Not last. Not after Juko colding. Known might happen. Is hunter risk. Get see all snows, go where want, but can colding any day, any time.
rows.translation: 没能长久。茱可变冷之后就不行。知道可能发生。这是猎人风险。能看所有雪，去想去地方，但任何一天、任何时候都可能变冷。
rows.raw: "Not last. Not after Juko colding. Known might happen. Is hunter risk. Get see all snows, go where want, but can colding any day, any time."

rows.original: Leaning closer, you ask, “What happened?”
rows.translation: 你凑近些问：“发生什么了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLeaning closer, you ask, “What happened?”"

rows.original: “Frostwyrm.” The former chief practically spits the word. “
rows.translation: “霜龙。”前任酋长几乎是把这个词啐了出来。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Frostwyrm.” The former chief practically spits the word. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "There were more scale-dragons back then, before the Wyrm-Murder tribe got better and smarter about killing them. A bad hunting season drove Juko farther out than normal. When that great beast attacked, she fought back."
                : "More scale-dragons back then, before Wyrm-Murder tribe find smart ways to kill. Bad hunting season lead Juko faring than normal. Great beast attacking, and she fight back."

rows.original: There were more scale-dragons back then, before the Wyrm-Murder tribe got better and smarter about killing them. A bad hunting season drove Juko farther out than normal. When that great beast attacked, she fought back.
rows.translation: 那时候的鳞龙更多，杀虫部落还没有变得更擅长、更聪明地猎杀它们。糟糕的狩猎季迫使茱可走得比平常更远。那头巨兽发动袭击时，她奋起反击。
rows.raw: "There were more scale-dragons back then, before the Wyrm-Murder tribe got better and smarter about killing them. A bad hunting season drove Juko farther out than normal. When that great beast attacked, she fought back."

rows.original: More scale-dragons back then, before Wyrm-Murder tribe find smart ways to kill. Bad hunting season lead Juko faring than normal. Great beast attacking, and she fight back.
rows.translation: 那时鳞龙更多，杀虫部落还没找到聪明猎杀方法。糟糕狩猎季让茱可走得比平常更远。巨兽袭击，她就反击。
rows.raw: "More scale-dragons back then, before Wyrm-Murder tribe find smart ways to kill. Bad hunting season lead Juko faring than normal. Great beast attacking, and she fight back."

rows.original: ” He thumps his chest. “
rows.translation: ”他拍了拍胸膛。“
rows.raw: "” He thumps his chest. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Juko was strong. She didn’t get eaten. She gouged its eye out with her spear, but the wyrm stole her arm for a trophy. Both retreated after, but Juko only made it halfway back on her own, before other hunters could find her."
                : "Juko strong. Not eaten. She take eye with spear but wyrm taking arm for trophy. She make it halfway back on own, before other hunters finding."

rows.original: Juko was strong. She didn’t get eaten. She gouged its eye out with her spear, but the wyrm stole her arm for a trophy. Both retreated after, but Juko only made it halfway back on her own, before other hunters could find her.
rows.translation: 朱科很强。她没有被吃掉。她用长矛把它的眼珠剜了出来，可那条巨龙把她的手臂夺去当了战利品。之后双方都退走了，但朱科只靠自己走了一半路，其他猎人才找到她。
rows.raw: "Juko was strong. She didn’t get eaten. She gouged its eye out with her spear, but the wyrm stole her arm for a trophy. Both retreated after, but Juko only made it halfway back on her own, before other hunters could find her."

rows.original: Juko strong. Not eaten. She take eye with spear but wyrm taking arm for trophy. She make it halfway back on own, before other hunters finding.
rows.translation: 朱科很强。没被吃掉。她用矛夺走它一只眼，但巨蛇也拿下她一条手臂当战利品。她独自走了一半回去的路，其他猎人才找到她。
rows.raw: "Juko strong. Not eaten. She take eye with spear but wyrm taking arm for trophy. She make it halfway back on own, before other hunters finding."

rows.original: ” A tear rolls down his cheek. “
rows.translation: ”一滴泪水沿他脸颊滚落。“
rows.raw: "” A tear rolls down his cheek. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "She was cold before making it home, but not before telling her story to her hunting friends. They told me, and the rest of the tribe, her story. We won’t forget it."
                : "Went cold before making home, but not before telling story to hunter-friends, and they telling to tribe. We not forgetting."

rows.original: She was cold before making it home, but not before telling her story to her hunting friends. They told me, and the rest of the tribe, her story. We won’t forget it.
rows.translation: 她还没回到家就已经冷了，但在那之前，她把自己的故事讲给了狩猎的伙伴们。他们告诉了我，也告诉了部落里的其他人。我们不会忘记。
rows.raw: "She was cold before making it home, but not before telling her story to her hunting friends. They told me, and the rest of the tribe, her story. We won’t forget it."

rows.original: Went cold before making home, but not before telling story to hunter-friends, and they telling to tribe. We not forgetting.
rows.translation: 回到家前就变冷了，但在那之前，她把故事告诉猎人朋友，他们又告诉部落。我们不会忘记。
rows.raw: "Went cold before making home, but not before telling story to hunter-friends, and they telling to tribe. We not forgetting."

rows.original: You express your condolences.
rows.translation: 你表达了哀悼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou express your condolences."

rows.original: You suggest that a wound to the eye could be every bit as fatal as a dismembered arm.
rows.translation: 你提出，眼睛上的伤和断掉的手臂一样可能致命。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suggest that a wound to the eye could be every bit as fatal as a dismembered arm."

rows.original: “She knew the risks.”
rows.translation: “她知道其中的风险。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She knew the risks.”"

rows.original: With a slow stroke of his beard, Ula’s father gives you the slightest nod. <i>“
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲慢慢捋了捋胡子，朝你极轻地点了下头。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a slow stroke of his beard, Ula’s father gives you the slightest nod. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "After, Ula didn’t want to be a hunter anymore, but she didn’t want to stay in the burrow either. She wanted to explore and find better ways than the old ways - ways where our hunters wouldn’t have to be scared of the long cold."
                : "After, Ula not want be hunter, but not want stay in burrow either. She wanting explore. Want find better ways than old ways - ways where hunters not have be scared of long colds."

rows.original: After, Ula didn’t want to be a hunter anymore, but she didn’t want to stay in the burrow either. She wanted to explore and find better ways than the old ways - ways where our hunters wouldn’t have to be scared of the long cold.
rows.translation: 从那以后，乌拉不再想当猎人，却也不愿留在地洞。她想探索外界，寻找比古老方式更好的办法——让猎人不必再害怕漫长冰冷的办法。
rows.raw: "After, Ula didn’t want to be a hunter anymore, but she didn’t want to stay in the burrow either. She wanted to explore and find better ways than the old ways - ways where our hunters wouldn’t have to be scared of the long cold."

rows.original: After, Ula not want be hunter, but not want stay in burrow either. She wanting explore. Want find better ways than old ways - ways where hunters not have be scared of long colds.
rows.translation: 之后，乌拉不想当猎人，也不想留在地洞。她想探索。想找比旧方法更好的方法——让猎人不必害怕漫长冰冷。
rows.raw: "After, Ula not want be hunter, but not want stay in burrow either. She wanting explore. Want find better ways than old ways - ways where hunters not have be scared of long colds."

rows.original: ” He shakes his head. “
rows.translation: ”他摇摇头。“
rows.raw: "” He shakes his head. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "She’s a silly girl, sometimes."
                : "Silly girl sometimes."

rows.original: She’s a silly girl, sometimes.
rows.translation: 她有时候真是个傻姑娘。
rows.raw: "She’s a silly girl, sometimes."

rows.original: Silly girl sometimes.
rows.translation: 有时是傻姑娘。
rows.raw: "Silly girl sometimes."

rows.original: With no further words forthcoming, you suppose this conversation to be over.
rows.translation: 对方再没说话，你便认为这次对话结束了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith no further words forthcoming, you suppose this conversation to be over."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You ask the former Chief what he thinks about aliens.
rows.translation: 你问前任头儿是怎么看待外星人的。
rows.raw: "You ask the former Chief what he thinks about aliens."

rows.original: It’s not obvious
rows.translation: 这不是明摆着
rows.raw: "It’s not obvious"

rows.original: Not obvious
rows.translation: 不明显
rows.raw: "Not obvious"

rows.original: ?” He snorts out a laugh. “
rows.translation: ？” 他嗤笑了一声。“
rows.raw: "?” He snorts out a laugh. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Aliens are mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. They think they’re better than everyone else and have no respect for anybody without core-magic. They come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just to dig up some rocks."
                : "Aliens mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. Thinking self is better than all others. No respect for those without core-magic. Come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just for digging out rocks."

rows.original: Aliens are mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. They think they’re better than everyone else and have no respect for anybody without core-magic. They come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just to dig up some rocks.
rows.translation: 外星人大多是垃圾。懒惰，贪婪。他们自以为高人一等，不尊重任何没有核心魔法的人。他们来到乌维托，只为了挖几块石头，就把小氏族赶出堡垒。
rows.raw: "Aliens are mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. They think they’re better than everyone else and have no respect for anybody without core-magic. They come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just to dig up some rocks."

rows.original: Aliens mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. Thinking self is better than all others. No respect for those without core-magic. Come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just for digging out rocks.
rows.translation: 外星人大多垃圾。懒惰。贪婪。觉得自己比所有人都好。不尊重没有核心魔法的人。来到乌维托，把小氏族赶出堡垒，只为挖石头。
rows.raw: "Aliens mostly garbage. Lazy. Greedy. Thinking self is better than all others. No respect for those without core-magic. Come to Uveto and drive small clans out of holds just for digging out rocks."

rows.original: ” He spits. “
rows.translation: ”他啐了一口。“
rows.raw: "” He spits. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Every alien has a little bit of a gem-heart inside them, always wanting more money no matter how much hurt they cause."
                : "Every alien have small bit of gem-heart inside, always wanting for more sparkle no mattering how much hurt caused."

rows.original: Every alien has a little bit of a gem-heart inside them, always wanting more money no matter how much hurt they cause.
rows.translation: 每个外星人体内都有一点宝石之心，无论造成多少伤害，永远都想要更多钱。
rows.raw: "Every alien has a little bit of a gem-heart inside them, always wanting more money no matter how much hurt they cause."

rows.original: Every alien have small bit of gem-heart inside, always wanting for more sparkle no mattering how much hurt caused.
rows.translation: 每个外星人心里都有一点宝石之心，总想要更多闪光，不管会受多少伤。
rows.raw: "Every alien have small bit of gem-heart inside, always wanting for more sparkle no mattering how much hurt caused."

rows.original: You fumble for a response.
rows.translation: 你支吾着想不出该怎么回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou fumble for a response."

rows.original: Don’t worry
rows.translation: 别担心
rows.raw: "Don’t worry"

rows.original: Not worry
rows.translation: 不担心
rows.raw: "Not worry"

rows.original: .” The old korg waves disarmingly. “
rows.translation: 。” 老科尔贡无害地摆了摆手。“
rows.raw: ".” The old korg waves disarmingly. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Gem-hearts can still be good, can put their urges to work for the good of the clan. Some aliens are the same way. It’s just hard to know which, especially when most are so villainous."
                : "Gem-hearts can still be good, still put urges for good of clan. Some alien same way. It just hard for knowing which. Most not that way."

rows.original: Gem-hearts can still be good, can put their urges to work for the good of the clan. Some aliens are the same way. It’s just hard to know which, especially when most are so villainous.
rows.translation: 宝石之心也能是好的，能把它们的欲望用在为部族谋福利上。有些外星人也是如此。只是很难分辨是哪些，尤其当大多数都那么邪恶时。
rows.raw: "Gem-hearts can still be good, can put their urges to work for the good of the clan. Some aliens are the same way. It’s just hard to know which, especially when most are so villainous."

rows.original: Gem-hearts can still be good, still put urges for good of clan. Some alien same way. It just hard for knowing which. Most not that way.
rows.translation: 宝石之心也能做好事，也能把冲动用于氏族利益。有些外星人也一样，只是很难知道哪些是。大多数都不是。
rows.raw: "Gem-hearts can still be good, still put urges for good of clan. Some alien same way. It just hard for knowing which. Most not that way."

rows.original: ” He scratches his beard in thought. “
rows.translation: ”他若有所思地挠挠胡须。“
rows.raw: "” He scratches his beard in thought. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Two tribes, our old allies, are gone now. Their holds got chewed up like food for alien machines. One found safety with another clan. A lot of snouts had to squeeze into one burrow, but at least they’re safe. The other vanished. Milodans or aliens must have taken them and made them slaves."
                : "Two tribes, old allies, gone now. Holds chewed up like machinefood. One find safety in other clan. Many snouts one burrow, but safe. Other disappear. Thinking milodan or alien take. Make slaving."

rows.original: Two tribes, our old allies, are gone now. Their holds got chewed up like food for alien machines. One found safety with another clan. A lot of snouts had to squeeze into one burrow, but at least they’re safe. The other vanished. Milodans or aliens must have taken them and made them slaves.
rows.translation: 两个部落，我们过去的盟友，如今都消失了。他们的堡垒像食物一样被外星机器嚼碎。其中一个在另一氏族那里找到了安全之所。许多口鼻不得不挤进同一个地洞，但至少他们安全了。另一个消失无踪。一定是米洛丹人或外星人抓走了他们，把他们变成奴隶。
rows.raw: "Two tribes, our old allies, are gone now. Their holds got chewed up like food for alien machines. One found safety with another clan. A lot of snouts had to squeeze into one burrow, but at least they’re safe. The other vanished. Milodans or aliens must have taken them and made them slaves."

rows.original: Two tribes, old allies, gone now. Holds chewed up like machinefood. One find safety in other clan. Many snouts one burrow, but safe. Other disappear. Thinking milodan or alien take. Make slaving.
rows.translation: 两个部落，旧盟友，现在没了。堡垒像机器食物一样被嚼碎。一个在其他氏族找到安全。许多口鼻挤一个地洞，但安全。另一个消失。觉得是米洛丹或外星人抓走，变成奴隶。
rows.raw: "Two tribes, old allies, gone now. Holds chewed up like machinefood. One find safety in other clan. Many snouts one burrow, but safe. Other disappear. Thinking milodan or alien take. Make slaving."

rows.original: After a pause to gather yourself, you ask if any tribes have good relations with the aliens.
rows.translation: 你停顿片刻平复心绪，询问是否有任何部落与外星人关系良好。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a pause to gather yourself, you ask if any tribes have good relations with the aliens."

rows.original: “Maybe one or two.” The grizzled elder admits. “
rows.translation: “也许有一两个。”那位头发花白的长老承认道。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe one or two.” The grizzled elder admits. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Some trade shinies with the alien town - Irestead is its name, I think. Ula’s leading the Korg’ii the same way, now. Maybe it’s for the best. Maybe we need to let the old ways go cold, but the thought leaves my heart heavy anyway."
                : "Some trade shinies with alien hold. Iresteading is name, thinking. Ula taking Korg’ii same way, now. May be best. Maybe old ways need let go cold, but heavy heart anyway."

rows.original: Some trade shinies with the alien town - Irestead is its name, I think. Ula’s leading the Korg’ii the same way, now. Maybe it’s for the best. Maybe we need to let the old ways go cold, but the thought leaves my heart heavy anyway.
rows.translation: 有些部落会与外星城镇交易亮晶晶的东西——我想那里叫艾尔斯泰德。如今乌拉也正以同样方式领导科尔格人。也许这是最好的选择。也许我们需要让旧传统归于冰冷，可这个想法仍令我心情沉重。
rows.raw: "Some trade shinies with the alien town - Irestead is its name, I think. Ula’s leading the Korg’ii the same way, now. Maybe it’s for the best. Maybe we need to let the old ways go cold, but the thought leaves my heart heavy anyway."

rows.original: Some trade shinies with alien hold. Iresteading is name, thinking. Ula taking Korg’ii same way, now. May be best. Maybe old ways need let go cold, but heavy heart anyway.
rows.translation: 有些会和外星堡垒交易亮晶晶。名字是艾尔斯泰德，我想。现在乌拉也这样带领科尔格人。也许最好。也许旧方法该放任变冷，但心仍沉重。
rows.raw: "Some trade shinies with alien hold. Iresteading is name, thinking. Ula taking Korg’ii same way, now. May be best. Maybe old ways need let go cold, but heavy heart anyway."

rows.original: ” He sighs. “
rows.translation: ”他叹了口气。“
rows.raw: "” He sighs. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Your ways feel too strange. Perhaps we can talk about something different."
                : "Alien ways feel strange. Talk different."

rows.original: Your ways feel too strange. Perhaps we can talk about something different.
rows.translation: 你们的生活方式感觉太过陌生。也许我们可以聊点别的。
rows.raw: "Your ways feel too strange. Perhaps we can talk about something different."

rows.original: Alien ways feel strange. Talk different.
rows.translation: 外族人的做派很奇怪。说话也不一样。
rows.raw: "Alien ways feel strange. Talk different."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You ask him about the shirt he’s wearing.
rows.translation: 你问他穿的那件衬衫。
rows.raw: "You ask him about the shirt he’s wearing."

rows.original: “What shirt?” the old korgonne growls. “
rows.translation: “什么衬衫？”年老的科尔贡人低吼道。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“What shirt?” the old korgonne growls. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "I don’t see any shirt. What’s a shirt?"
                : "I no see any shirt. What is shirt?"

rows.original: I don’t see any shirt. What’s a shirt?
rows.translation: 我没看见什么衬衫。衬衫是什么东西？
rows.raw: "I don’t see any shirt. What’s a shirt?"

rows.original: I no see any shirt. What is shirt?
rows.translation: 我没看见什么衬衫。衬衫是什么？
rows.raw: "I no see any shirt. What is shirt?"

rows.original: ” He waves an arm around in annoyance. “
rows.translation: ”他烦躁地挥了挥手臂。“
rows.raw: "” He waves an arm around in annoyance. “"

joinAfter.expression: korgiTranslate() ? "You drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if your head wasn’t so full of silly thoughts, you wouldn’t see silly shirts." : "Alien drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if not make silly thoughts, not see silly shirts."

rows.original: You drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if your head wasn’t so full of silly thoughts, you wouldn’t see silly shirts.
rows.translation: 你喝了太多疯癫水。也许你的脑袋里没有装满愚蠢想法，就不会看见愚蠢衬衫。
rows.raw: "You drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if your head wasn’t so full of silly thoughts, you wouldn’t see silly shirts."

rows.original: Alien drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if not make silly thoughts, not see silly shirts.
rows.translation: 外星人喝太多疯癫水。也许不想愚蠢事情，就看不见愚蠢衬衫。
rows.raw: "Alien drink too much crazy-water. Maybe if not make silly thoughts, not see silly shirts."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You inquire as to why he pursued peace with the Milodans, knowing the risks.
rows.translation: 你问他，明知风险，为什么还要向米洛丹人寻求和平。
rows.raw: "You inquire as to why he pursued peace with the Milodans, knowing the risks."

rows.original: “Not knowing all risks.” The shaggy old korg slumps. “
rows.translation: “不知道所有风险。”毛发蓬乱的老科尔贡人垮下肩膀。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not knowing all risks.” The shaggy old korg slumps. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "I thought I might be killed or enslaved. I didn’t think I’d be drugged and forced to show them the entrance to the hold. If I knew... if I had any idea, I would have killed myself when I was ambushed."
                : "Thought might be made cold or slavinged. Did not thinking druggings and forcing to show hold entrance. If knowinged... if knowinged at all, would have killed self when ambushed."

rows.original: I thought I might be killed or enslaved. I didn’t think I’d be drugged and forced to show them the entrance to the hold. If I knew... if I had any idea, I would have killed myself when I was ambushed.
rows.translation: 我以为自己会被杀掉或者被奴役。我没想到会被下药，还被迫带他们去找货舱入口。如果我知道... 如果我能预料到，我在被伏击时就会了结自己。
rows.raw: "I thought I might be killed or enslaved. I didn’t think I’d be drugged and forced to show them the entrance to the hold. If I knew... if I had any idea, I would have killed myself when I was ambushed."

rows.original: Thought might be made cold or slavinged. Did not thinking druggings and forcing to show hold entrance. If knowinged... if knowinged at all, would have killed self when ambushed.
rows.translation: 以为会被弄冷，或者被当成奴隶。没想到会被下药，还被逼着展示、守住入口。要是知道...要是早知道一点，被伏击的时候就该杀了自己。
rows.raw: "Thought might be made cold or slavinged. Did not thinking druggings and forcing to show hold entrance. If knowinged... if knowinged at all, would have killed self when ambushed."

rows.original: ” He openly weeps. “
rows.translation: ”他毫不掩饰地哭起来。“
rows.raw: "” He openly weeps. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "So much hurt and pain, all because I foolishly tried for peace, thinking I was only risking myself. It was the worst mistake I ever made as Chief."
                : "So much hurt and pain, all because I try for peace, thinking only risking self. Worst mistake ever make as chief."

rows.original: So much hurt and pain, all because I foolishly tried for peace, thinking I was only risking myself. It was the worst mistake I ever made as Chief.
rows.translation: 这么多伤害和痛苦，全因我愚蠢地尝试和平，以为自己只是在拿自身冒险。那是我担任酋长以来犯下最严重的错误。
rows.raw: "So much hurt and pain, all because I foolishly tried for peace, thinking I was only risking myself. It was the worst mistake I ever made as Chief."

rows.original: So much hurt and pain, all because I try for peace, thinking only risking self. Worst mistake ever make as chief.
rows.translation: 那么多的伤害和痛苦，都是因为我想求和平，只想着拿自己冒险。当首领以来犯下的最大错误。
rows.raw: "So much hurt and pain, all because I try for peace, thinking only risking self. Worst mistake ever make as chief."

rows.original: Patting him on the shoulder, you listen in silence as he’s wracked by sobs.
rows.translation: 你拍拍他的肩膀，静静地听着他抽泣不止。
rows.raw: "\n\nPatting him on the shoulder, you listen in silence as he’s wracked by sobs."

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "But still, I had to try somehow. Maybe another way would have been smarter, but I didn’t think of it."
                : "But still, must try somehow. Maybe another way smarter, but I not think of it."

rows.original: But still, I had to try somehow. Maybe another way would have been smarter, but I didn’t think of it.
rows.translation: 但还是，我总得想办法试试。也许换个方法会更聪明，可我当时没想到。
rows.raw: "But still, I had to try somehow. Maybe another way would have been smarter, but I didn’t think of it."

rows.original: But still, must try somehow. Maybe another way smarter, but I not think of it.
rows.translation: 但还是得想办法试试。也许有别的更聪明的办法，但我想不出来。
rows.raw: "But still, must try somehow. Maybe another way smarter, but I not think of it."

rows.original: ” He straightens a little. “
rows.translation: ” 他稍稍挺直身子。“
rows.raw: "” He straightens a little. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "When I was but a small pup, all korgonne and milodan were at war. We were always fighting and killing and slaving. So many hunters came home covered in scars or worse. It was just as bad for the milodans too, though they might not admit it. Korgonne are small but fierce. We had better weapons than the milodans and sometimes better armors too. You can still find ice stained purple with blood if you know where to dig. Whole tribes were lost on both sides, even pups and kittens."
                : "When was just small pup, all korgonne and milodan at war. Always killing and fighting and slaving. So many hunters covered in claw scars or come home cold. Just as bad for milodans too, though they not admit. Korgonne small but fierce. Have better weapons than cats and better armors sometimes too. If dig down a little in right place, can still find where ice stained purple with blood. Whole tribes of korgonne and milodan lost, even pups and kittens."

rows.original: When I was but a small pup, all korgonne and milodan were at war. We were always fighting and killing and slaving. So many hunters came home covered in scars or worse. It was just as bad for the milodans too, though they might not admit it. Korgonne are small but fierce. We had better weapons than the milodans and sometimes better armors too. You can still find ice stained purple with blood if you know where to dig. Whole tribes were lost on both sides, even pups and kittens.
rows.translation: 我还只是只小崽子的时候，所有科尔贡和米洛丹人都在打仗。我们一直在打、在杀、在抓奴。好多猎人回家时满身伤疤，或者更糟。米洛丹人的日子也一样难过，虽然他们未必肯承认。科尔贡人个子小，但凶悍。我们的武器比米洛丹人好，有时盔甲也更好。只要知道去哪儿挖，你现在还能找到被血染成紫色的冰。双方都有整个部落消失，连小崽子和小猫崽都没能幸免。
rows.raw: "When I was but a small pup, all korgonne and milodan were at war. We were always fighting and killing and slaving. So many hunters came home covered in scars or worse. It was just as bad for the milodans too, though they might not admit it. Korgonne are small but fierce. We had better weapons than the milodans and sometimes better armors too. You can still find ice stained purple with blood if you know where to dig. Whole tribes were lost on both sides, even pups and kittens."

rows.original: When was just small pup, all korgonne and milodan at war. Always killing and fighting and slaving. So many hunters covered in claw scars or come home cold. Just as bad for milodans too, though they not admit. Korgonne small but fierce. Have better weapons than cats and better armors sometimes too. If dig down a little in right place, can still find where ice stained purple with blood. Whole tribes of korgonne and milodan lost, even pups and kittens.
rows.translation: 我还只是小幼崽时，所有科尔贡人和米洛丹人都在打仗。总是杀戮、战斗、奴役。太多猎人浑身爪痕，或冰冷地回到家。米洛丹人也一样惨，尽管他们不承认。科尔贡人个头小，却很凶猛。有时武器比猫更好，护甲也更好。如果在正确地方向下挖一点，仍能找到冰被鲜血染成紫色的地方。整个科尔贡和米洛丹部落消失，连幼崽和小猫也不例外。
rows.raw: "When was just small pup, all korgonne and milodan at war. Always killing and fighting and slaving. So many hunters covered in claw scars or come home cold. Just as bad for milodans too, though they not admit. Korgonne small but fierce. Have better weapons than cats and better armors sometimes too. If dig down a little in right place, can still find where ice stained purple with blood. Whole tribes of korgonne and milodan lost, even pups and kittens."

rows.original: You knew the two groups weren’t friendly, but you didn’t know they were that unfriendly.
rows.translation: 你知道两个族群关系不友好，却不知道竟然如此不友好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou knew the two groups weren’t friendly, but you didn’t know they were that unfriendly."

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Father knew the war had to end or everyone would be too weak to survive - such a wise korg. He gathered the leaders of almost every korgonne tribe along with the milodan tribal alphas for talks."
                : "Father knew must end or all grow too weak for survive. Wise korg. He gather leaders of almost all korgonne tribes and biggest milodan tribe-alphas for talks."

rows.original: Father knew the war had to end or everyone would be too weak to survive - such a wise korg. He gathered the leaders of almost every korgonne tribe along with the milodan tribal alphas for talks.
rows.translation: 父亲知道战争必须结束，否则所有人都会虚弱得无法生存——真是睿智的科尔格人。他召集几乎每个科尔贡部落的领袖，以及米洛丹各部落的阿尔法进行会谈。
rows.raw: "Father knew the war had to end or everyone would be too weak to survive - such a wise korg. He gathered the leaders of almost every korgonne tribe along with the milodan tribal alphas for talks."

rows.original: Father knew must end or all grow too weak for survive. Wise korg. He gather leaders of almost all korgonne tribes and biggest milodan tribe-alphas for talks.
rows.translation: 父亲知道必须结束，否则所有人都会变得太弱，无法生存。睿智科尔格。他召集几乎所有科尔贡部落领袖，还有最大米洛丹部落的阿尔法会谈。
rows.raw: "Father knew must end or all grow too weak for survive. Wise korg. He gather leaders of almost all korgonne tribes and biggest milodan tribe-alphas for talks."

rows.original: ” His expression turns somber once more. “
rows.translation: ” 他的神情再次变得凝重。“
rows.raw: "” His expression turns somber once more. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "The milodans didn’t like talking with us anymore than we liked talking with them, not after killing so much of each other, but my father talked anyway."
                : "Milodans not like talking with korg anymore than korgonne like talking with fang-cats, not after each kill so many of other, but father talk anyway."

rows.original: The milodans didn’t like talking with us anymore than we liked talking with them, not after killing so much of each other, but my father talked anyway.
rows.translation: 米洛丹人不想跟我们说话，就像我们也不想跟他们说话一样，尤其是在彼此杀了那么多人之后，但我父亲还是谈了。
rows.raw: "The milodans didn’t like talking with us anymore than we liked talking with them, not after killing so much of each other, but my father talked anyway."

rows.original: Milodans not like talking with korg anymore than korgonne like talking with fang-cats, not after each kill so many of other, but father talk anyway.
rows.translation: 米洛丹人不喜欢和科尔格人说话，就像科尔贡人不喜欢和尖牙猫说话一样；双方杀死那么多彼此族人后更是如此，但父亲仍然谈判。
rows.raw: "Milodans not like talking with korg anymore than korgonne like talking with fang-cats, not after each kill so many of other, but father talk anyway."

rows.original: You ask, “And they made peace?”
rows.translation: 你问：“那他们讲和了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask, “And they made peace?”"

rows.original: The ex-Chieftain shakes his head slowly. <i>“
rows.translation: 前任酋长慢慢摇了摇头。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ex-Chieftain shakes his head slowly. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "No. Not from words. Anger and pain alike were too deep for words to heal those wounds. Father tried everything he could until he finally came up with an option the fang-kitties liked: trading his life for ending the war."
                : "No. Not from words. Pains too deep for word-healing. Father try everything until finally come up with option fang-kitties like: his life for ending war."

rows.original: No. Not from words. Anger and pain alike were too deep for words to heal those wounds. Father tried everything he could until he finally came up with an option the fang-kitties liked: trading his life for ending the war.
rows.translation: 不，不是靠言语。愤怒和痛苦同样深重，言语无法治愈那些伤口。父亲尝试了一切办法，最终想出一个尖牙猫喜欢的选择：用自己的生命换取战争结束。
rows.raw: "No. Not from words. Anger and pain alike were too deep for words to heal those wounds. Father tried everything he could until he finally came up with an option the fang-kitties liked: trading his life for ending the war."

rows.original: No. Not from words. Pains too deep for word-healing. Father try everything until finally come up with option fang-kitties like: his life for ending war.
rows.translation: 不，不是言语。痛苦太深，言语治不好。父亲尝试所有办法，最后想出尖牙猫喜欢的选择：用他的生命换战争结束。
rows.raw: "No. Not from words. Pains too deep for word-healing. Father try everything until finally come up with option fang-kitties like: his life for ending war."

rows.original: There’s no hiding your gasp.
rows.translation: 你无法掩饰自己的惊呼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s no hiding your gasp."

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Ula’s grandfather, the wisest Chief in our history, gave himself over to the milodans in exchange for the future safety of all korgonne. We don’t know what happened to him after and probably never will. Maybe they gave him over to the forever cold right away, but they might have tortured or enslaved him. Either way, the war ended. Milodan and korgonne hunters stopped trying to kill each other on sight. Maybe they’ll tussle in the snow, make the loser give punishment licks or share warmth, but nobody is driven into the cold."
                : "Ula’s grandfather, wisest Chief ever, gave self over to milodans for safety-having of all korgonne. Tribe not know what happen to him and probably never know. Maybe colded. Maybe tortured. Maybe he live as slave for long times, but war end. Milodan and korgonne hunters stop trying kill each other. Maybe tussle in snow, make punishment licks or warms, but none cold."

rows.original: Ula’s grandfather, the wisest Chief in our history, gave himself over to the milodans in exchange for the future safety of all korgonne. We don’t know what happened to him after and probably never will. Maybe they gave him over to the forever cold right away, but they might have tortured or enslaved him. Either way, the war ended. Milodan and korgonne hunters stopped trying to kill each other on sight. Maybe they’ll tussle in the snow, make the loser give punishment licks or share warmth, but nobody is driven into the cold.
rows.translation: 乌拉的祖父，我们历史上最睿智的酋长，将自己交给米洛丹人，以换取所有科尔贡人未来的安全。我们不知道他后来遭遇什么，大概永远也不会知道。也许他们立刻让他归于永恒冰冷，也可能折磨或奴役了他。无论如何，战争结束了。米洛丹和科尔贡猎人不再见面便试图杀死对方。也许他们会在雪地扭打，让败者接受惩罚舔舐或分享温暖，但没有人会被赶入严寒。
rows.raw: "Ula’s grandfather, the wisest Chief in our history, gave himself over to the milodans in exchange for the future safety of all korgonne. We don’t know what happened to him after and probably never will. Maybe they gave him over to the forever cold right away, but they might have tortured or enslaved him. Either way, the war ended. Milodan and korgonne hunters stopped trying to kill each other on sight. Maybe they’ll tussle in the snow, make the loser give punishment licks or share warmth, but nobody is driven into the cold."

rows.original: Ula’s grandfather, wisest Chief ever, gave self over to milodans for safety-having of all korgonne. Tribe not know what happen to him and probably never know. Maybe colded. Maybe tortured. Maybe he live as slave for long times, but war end. Milodan and korgonne hunters stop trying kill each other. Maybe tussle in snow, make punishment licks or warms, but none cold.
rows.translation: 乌拉祖父，最睿智酋长，把自己交给米洛丹，换所有科尔贡人的安全。部落不知道他后来怎样，大概永远不知道。也许变冷。也许受折磨。也许长期做奴隶，但战争结束。米洛丹和科尔贡猎人不再试图杀死彼此。也许雪地扭打，要求惩罚舔舐或温暖，但没人变冷。
rows.raw: "Ula’s grandfather, wisest Chief ever, gave self over to milodans for safety-having of all korgonne. Tribe not know what happen to him and probably never know. Maybe colded. Maybe tortured. Maybe he live as slave for long times, but war end. Milodan and korgonne hunters stop trying kill each other. Maybe tussle in snow, make punishment licks or warms, but none cold."

rows.original: ” He pauses to gather his breath, exhausted from the speech. “
rows.translation: ”他停下来喘息，被这番长谈累得筋疲力尽。“
rows.raw: "” He pauses to gather his breath, exhausted from the speech. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "His plan worked so well that most still fight that way to this day, trying to keep the peace. Until one tribe went back to killing... I just wanted to end the suffering - to live up to my father’s memory."
                : "Last so long that most still fight that way for keeping peace, until one tribe go back for killing. Just wanted for make suffering stop. Try to live up to father-memory."

rows.original: His plan worked so well that most still fight that way to this day, trying to keep the peace. Until one tribe went back to killing... I just wanted to end the suffering - to live up to my father’s memory.
rows.translation: 他的计划奏效得很好，直到今天大多数族人仍用那种方式战斗，努力维持和平。直到有一个部族重新开始杀戮...我只是想结束苦难 - 对得起我父亲的遗志。
rows.raw: "His plan worked so well that most still fight that way to this day, trying to keep the peace. Until one tribe went back to killing... I just wanted to end the suffering - to live up to my father’s memory."

rows.original: Last so long that most still fight that way for keeping peace, until one tribe go back for killing. Just wanted for make suffering stop. Try to live up to father-memory.
rows.translation: 持续很久，大多数人仍用这种方式维持和平，直到一个部落重新开始杀戮。我只想让痛苦停止，努力不辜负父亲的记忆。
rows.raw: "Last so long that most still fight that way for keeping peace, until one tribe go back for killing. Just wanted for make suffering stop. Try to live up to father-memory."

rows.original: His actions make a lot more sense in light of that. “The ones still holding to the peace - what do you think of them?”
rows.translation: 了解这一切后，他的行动便合理多了。“那些仍在维持和平的人——你怎么看他们？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHis actions make a lot more sense in light of that. “The ones still holding to the peace - what do you think of them?”"

rows.original: The old dog shrugs. <i>“
rows.translation: 老狗耸耸肩。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe old dog shrugs. <i>“"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                ? "Not much. They’re sort of like you aliens: always wanting and always ready to fight to have whatever they’ve got their sights on. Maybe it’s their nature. Maybe it’s because they don’t have burrows of their own. They’re too big for easy digging and have to live among the cold snows. Maybe if we korgonne lived like that, we’d be angry and fighty too. I don’t know. I was too busy trying to keep the hold safe from the worst of them to make friends, but maybe Ula can. She made friends with an alien, after all."
                : "Not muching. Sort of like aliens. Always wanting and always ready for fight to have. Maybe is nature. Maybe is from now having burrows of own. Too big for diggings easy. They live in snows and cold. Maybe if korg live like that, they angry and fighty too. Not know. Too busy trying for keep hold safe from bad fang-cats to friend-make, but maybe Ula can. She have nice alien-friend, after all."

rows.original: Not much. They’re sort of like you aliens: always wanting and always ready to fight to have whatever they’ve got their sights on. Maybe it’s their nature. Maybe it’s because they don’t have burrows of their own. They’re too big for easy digging and have to live among the cold snows. Maybe if we korgonne lived like that, we’d be angry and fighty too. I don’t know. I was too busy trying to keep the hold safe from the worst of them to make friends, but maybe Ula can. She made friends with an alien, after all.
rows.translation: 没什么。他们有点像你们外星人：总想得到东西，也随时准备为夺取看中的东西而战。也许这是天性。也许是因为他们没有自己的地洞。他们体型太大，不容易挖掘，只能住在冰冷雪原。也许科尔贡人那样生活，也会变得愤怒好斗。我不知道。我过去忙着保护堡垒免受最恶劣的尖牙猫侵害，没空交朋友，但也许乌拉可以。毕竟她和一个外星人成了朋友。
rows.raw: "Not much. They’re sort of like you aliens: always wanting and always ready to fight to have whatever they’ve got their sights on. Maybe it’s their nature. Maybe it’s because they don’t have burrows of their own. They’re too big for easy digging and have to live among the cold snows. Maybe if we korgonne lived like that, we’d be angry and fighty too. I don’t know. I was too busy trying to keep the hold safe from the worst of them to make friends, but maybe Ula can. She made friends with an alien, after all."

rows.original: Not muching. Sort of like aliens. Always wanting and always ready for fight to have. Maybe is nature. Maybe is from now having burrows of own. Too big for diggings easy. They live in snows and cold. Maybe if korg live like that, they angry and fighty too. Not know. Too busy trying for keep hold safe from bad fang-cats to friend-make, but maybe Ula can. She have nice alien-friend, after all.
rows.translation: 没什么。有点像外星人。总想要东西，随时准备为得到东西而战。也许是天性。也许因为没有自己的地洞。太大，不容易挖掘。他们住在冰雪严寒里。也许科尔格人这样生活，也会愤怒好斗。不知道。过去太忙着保护堡垒不受坏尖牙猫侵害，没空交朋友，但也许乌拉可以。毕竟她有个好外星朋友。
rows.raw: "Not muching. Sort of like aliens. Always wanting and always ready for fight to have. Maybe is nature. Maybe is from now having burrows of own. Too big for diggings easy. They live in snows and cold. Maybe if korg live like that, they angry and fighty too. Not know. Too busy trying for keep hold safe from bad fang-cats to friend-make, but maybe Ula can. She have nice alien-friend, after all."

rows.original: With no further speech forthcoming, you consider if you’d like to ask him anything else.
rows.translation: 他没有再说什么，你考虑是否还想问些别的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith no further speech forthcoming, you consider if you’d like to ask him anything else."

rows.original: Ula’s Father
rows.translation: 乌拉的父亲
rows.raw: "Ula’s Father"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You ask him what he thinks of you.
rows.translation: 你问他怎么看你。
rows.raw: "You ask him what he thinks of you."

rows.original: pregnancy/ula sired
rows.raw: "pregnancy/ula sired"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "What do I think of you?"
                    : "What am thinking of [pc.name]?"

rows.original: What do I think of you?
rows.translation: 我怎么看你？
rows.raw: "What do I think of you?"

rows.original: What am thinking of [pc.name]?
rows.translation: 我对[pc.name]有什么看法？
rows.raw: "What am thinking of [pc.name]?"

rows.original: ” the old korg muses aloud. “
rows.translation: ”年老的科尔格人大声思索。“
rows.raw: "” the old korg muses aloud. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "I have many thoughts: gratefulness for saving the hold, yes. I also owe you for saving Ula as well. The dumb she-pup might have died if not for you."
                    : "Having many thoughts. Gratefulness for hold saving, yes. More thanking for Ula-saving too. Dumb she-pup might be forever-cold if not for alien."

rows.original: I have many thoughts: gratefulness for saving the hold, yes. I also owe you for saving Ula as well. The dumb she-pup might have died if not for you.
rows.translation: 我有很多想法：是的，感谢你拯救堡垒。我也欠你救下乌拉的恩情。那个愚蠢的雌性幼崽若没有你，可能已经死了。
rows.raw: "I have many thoughts: gratefulness for saving the hold, yes. I also owe you for saving Ula as well. The dumb she-pup might have died if not for you."

rows.original: Having many thoughts. Gratefulness for hold saving, yes. More thanking for Ula-saving too. Dumb she-pup might be forever-cold if not for alien.
rows.translation: 想很多。感谢保住货舱，是的。更感谢救了乌拉。要不是外来者，傻母崽可能永远都是冷的。
rows.raw: "Having many thoughts. Gratefulness for hold saving, yes. More thanking for Ula-saving too. Dumb she-pup might be forever-cold if not for alien."

rows.original: ” He reaches out to grab your hand, his grip surprisingly tight. “
rows.translation: ”他伸手握住你的手，力道出乎意料地大。“
rows.raw: "” He reaches out to grab your hand, his grip surprisingly tight. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "I’m also angry. You ruined Ula for korgonne males. I know it’s you siring her puppies. Many puppies."
                    : "Also angry. [pc.name] ruin Ula for korgonne males. I knowing you sire puppies. Many puppies."

rows.original: I’m also angry. You ruined Ula for korgonne males. I know it’s you siring her puppies. Many puppies.
rows.translation: 我也很生气。你把乌拉毁了，科尔贡的雄性再也没法要她。我知道是你让她怀上了小狗。很多小狗。
rows.raw: "I’m also angry. You ruined Ula for korgonne males. I know it’s you siring her puppies. Many puppies."

rows.original: Also angry. [pc.name] ruin Ula for korgonne males. I knowing you sire puppies. Many puppies.
rows.translation: 也生气。[pc.name]把乌拉弄坏了，科尔贡男性没法要了。我晓得你会让她怀小狗。很多小狗。
rows.raw: "Also angry. [pc.name] ruin Ula for korgonne males. I knowing you sire puppies. Many puppies."

rows.original: ” He snorts. “
rows.translation: ”他哼了一声。“
rows.raw: "” He snorts. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "I welcomed you into the hold, and you bred my daughter like a rutting milodan."
                    : "I welcome into hold, and you breed daughter like rutting fang-cat."

rows.original: I welcomed you into the hold, and you bred my daughter like a rutting milodan.
rows.translation: 我欢迎你进了货舱，你却像头发情的米洛丹一样把我的女儿配了种。
rows.raw: "I welcomed you into the hold, and you bred my daughter like a rutting milodan."

rows.original: I welcome into hold, and you breed daughter like rutting fang-cat.
rows.translation: 我欢迎你进洞，然后你就像发情的獠牙猫一样让女儿受孕。
rows.raw: "I welcome into hold, and you breed daughter like rutting fang-cat."

rows.original: ” His lips peel back, revealing a surprisingly sharp set of canines. “
rows.translation: ”他的嘴唇掀开，露出一排出奇锋利的犬齿。“
rows.raw: "” His lips peel back, revealing a surprisingly sharp set of canines. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "Don’t think I’m happy about this. It’s Ula’s smiles and what you did for the tribe that keep you welcome."
                    : "Not think me happying about this. It Ula smiles and tribe-saving that keep you welcoming."

rows.original: Don’t think I’m happy about this. It’s Ula’s smiles and what you did for the tribe that keep you welcome.
rows.translation: 别以为我乐意这样。是乌拉的笑容和你为部落做的事，才让你继续受这里欢迎。
rows.raw: "Don’t think I’m happy about this. It’s Ula’s smiles and what you did for the tribe that keep you welcome."

rows.original: Not think me happying about this. It Ula smiles and tribe-saving that keep you welcoming.
rows.translation: 别以为我为此高兴。是乌拉的笑容和救氏族的事让我一直欢迎你。
rows.raw: "Not think me happying about this. It Ula smiles and tribe-saving that keep you welcoming."

rows.original: ” He lets you go. “
rows.translation: ”他放开你。“
rows.raw: "” He lets you go. “"

joinAfter.expression:
korgiTranslate()
                    ? "I’m not sure if you’re the smartest alien of all time or the dumbest. Hopefully for your pups, it’s the former."
                    : "Not sure if alien smartest alien of all time or dumbest. Hopefully for pups, will be smarts."

rows.original: I’m not sure if you’re the smartest alien of all time or the dumbest. Hopefully for your pups, it’s the former.
rows.translation: 我不确定你是史上最聪明的外星人，还是最愚蠢的。为了你的幼崽着想，希望是前者。
rows.raw: "I’m not sure if you’re the smartest alien of all time or the dumbest. Hopefully for your pups, it’s the former."

rows.original: Not sure if alien smartest alien of all time or dumbest. Hopefully for pups, will be smarts.
rows.translation: 不晓得这外星人是古往今来最聪明的还是最蠢的。希望为了小狗，会聪明些。
rows.raw: "Not sure if alien smartest alien of all time or dumbest. Hopefully for pups, will be smarts."

rows.original: You awkwardly scratch the back of your neck, fishing for a reply.
rows.translation: 你尴尬地挠挠后颈，搜寻合适的回答。

rows.original: Eitan chuckles with a hint of excitement. “I am certain you can. I accept, [pc.name] Steele,” he says, heartily. “It’ll be nice being able to sleep in a bed that can fit my size.” Eitan stands up and takes one last look at his bed. “I will certainly not miss this,” he mutters. Eitan grabs his things, or what little he has at least, and starts walking with you to the captain’s room. “If you were going to ask me to share a bed with you, you should have just let me take this room the first time you brought me here.” Well, you weren’t planning on having him come here at first, but having Eitan in bed with you would be like having an extra blanket of huge muscle and fur on you. “So I am to keep you warm? Like a blanket?” he asks with disbelief. You nod, though you’re sure you can find more reasons to keep him around in the room as you spend more time with him in the captain’s room. The muscly milodan chuckles before putting his stuff down on the bed. You direct him to where he can unpack. Not like there’s a lot to move, so it takes about a minute before it’s done. You sit on the bed together after the incredible amount of nothing you had to put away. You ask him if he’s excited to join you in the captain’s quarters. “Well, this is where I wanted to sleep the first time I came onto the ship. But, enduring the small quarters for a while and coming here feels like a reward.” He ponders for a moment. “If I had to go back there, I can’t oppose you. Though, it would be hard to go back to such a small room after being here,” he chuckles. You tell him you’re glad that he’s looking forward to sleeping with you. With a nod, you head out of the room, ready for the next adventure awaiting you. Eitan is now sharing a bed with you.
rows.translation: 艾坦带着一丝兴奋轻笑。“我确信你可以。我接受，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他爽快说道。“能睡在一张容得下我体型的床上，一定很舒服。”艾坦站起身，最后看了一眼自己的床。“我肯定不会怀念这个，”他嘟囔道。 艾坦拿起自己的东西——或者说至少是那寥寥几件——开始和你一起走向船长室。 “如果你本来就打算邀请我同床，第一次带我来时就该直接让我住进这间房。” 好吧，你起初并没打算让他来这里，不过让艾坦和你同床，就像身上多盖一条由巨大肌肉和毛发组成的毯子。 “所以我要负责让你暖和？像毯子一样？”他难以置信地问。你点点头，不过相信随着他在船长室待得更久，你还能找到更多把他留在房里的理由。肌肉发达的米洛丹轻笑一声，把东西放到床上。 你告诉他可以在哪里收拾行李。反正没多少东西可搬，大约一分钟便完成了。把那少得惊人的物品收好后，你们一起坐在床上。你问他是否期待加入船长舱。 “嗯，我第一次登船时确实就想睡在这里。不过，在狭小舱室忍耐一阵再来到这里，感觉像得到了奖励。”他思考片刻。“如果必须回去，我无法反对你。不过在这里住过以后，再回到那样狭小的房间会很困难，”他轻笑道。 你告诉他，很高兴他期待与你同床。你点点头，走出房间，准备迎接下一场冒险。 艾坦现在与你同床。

rows.original: You ask Eitan if he would enjoy sharing the bed with others among the crew members[silly| like some sussy bakas]. He mentioned that he was used to being in large piles with others in the tribe. “Well yes, I would welcome more people into the bed. It would remind me more of home if there were others to surround me- no, to surround us as we slept.” The milodan ponders. His hand on his chin like a philosopher. “While I don’t think that there would be a LOT of room for multiple people, I would not be opposed to others.” Well, that’s good to know. You may know some people who could definitely help remind Eitan of his home. You can now share the bed with Eitan and other crew members

rows.original: You approach Eitan, asking about sharing a bed with him again. You’ve been missing his furry body and the warmth it brings you. “Ah, another chance at the large bed,” Eitan beams. “Gladly. Allow me to provide you warmth for the night as we had done in the past. rows.original: “Oh, uhm, if I may speak freely, Captain,” he stutters, fiddling with his holopad, “Miss Dorna... she’s... well, I wouldn’t exactly says she’s ‘bothering’ me, but she’s very... persistent, and big.” He pauses and takes a deep breath in an attempt to compose himself, “She’s very interested in... certain parts of me, and it just... raises my blood pressure a bit when I’m left alone with her, is all.”

rows.original: “It’s not very big,” Kase says, pondering his relationships for a moment, “There’s my mother, she works for Pyrite as a laborer on the planet I grew up on, while my father works for a local real estate company selling plots of land on colony to smaller corporations.” He pauses for a moment and smiles, going through memories of his parents, “My mother’s such a gentle-giant, tall and imposing but the nicest woman you’ll ever met. My father, on the other hand, is quite reserved, intelligent, though caring. They both taught me most of what I knew about math when I was younger too.”
rows.translation: “家里人不多，”凯斯思索片刻后说道，“母亲在我长大的星球上为派莱特当工人，父亲则在当地房地产公司工作，把殖民地土地卖给小型企业。”他停顿片刻，回忆父母时露出微笑。“母亲是个温柔的巨人，高大威严，却是你能遇见最善良的女人。父亲则相当内敛聪明，但也很关爱家人。他们还教会了年幼的我大部分数学知识。”

My father, on the other hand, is quite reserved, intelligent, though caring. They both taught me most of what I knew about math when I was younger too.”"

rows.original: Sure enough, Kase soon finishes his paperwork and stands up from his seat, walking towards you. “Miss Dorna, I believed I’ve finished,” he says, handing the datapad off to your crewmate.

rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, Kase soon finishes his paperwork and stands up from his seat, walking towards you. “Miss Dorna, I believed I’ve finished,” he says, handing the datapad off to your crewmate."

rows.original: Anno quickly takes the device, flipping through the pages of holographic forms and papers while Kase looks on anxiously. Finally, Anno speaks up, “Looks like everything’s in order. Welcome aboard, Kase!” With that, she extends a hand to shake his.
rows.translation: 安诺迅速接过设备，翻阅一页页全息表格和文件，凯斯则在旁边焦虑地看着。终于，安诺开口道：“看起来一切都没问题。欢迎加入，凯斯！”说完，她伸出手与他握手。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno quickly takes the device, flipping through the pages of holographic forms and papers while Kase looks on anxiously. Finally, Anno speaks up, “Looks like everything’s in order. Welcome aboard, Kase!” With that, she extends a hand to shake his."

rows.original: The kaithrit smiles wide and accepts Anno’s gesture, shaking her hand and thanking her, but before they can get friendly, your ausar companion gasps before exclaiming, “Oh right! I need to go get you something!”
rows.translation: 凯斯里特灿烂地笑着接受安诺的好意，与她握手并表示感谢；但两人还没来得及熟络，你的奥萨尔同伴便倒吸一口气，惊呼道：“噢，对了！我得去给你拿样东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kaithrit smiles wide and accepts Anno’s gesture, shaking her hand and thanking her, but before they can get friendly, your ausar companion gasps before exclaiming, “Oh right! I need to go get you something!”"

rows.original: And like that she’s off towards another room, leaving you and Kase alone for a moment, silent. Your newly hired kitty boy breaks the silence soon enough.
rows.translation: 话音刚落，她便赶往另一个房间，留下你和凯斯短暂地独处，彼此沉默。新雇来的猫男孩很快打破了寂静。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd like that she’s off towards another room, leaving you and Kase alone for a moment, silent. Your newly hired kitty boy breaks the silence soon enough. "

rows.original: “So, Captain, you’re the Steele, then?” he asks quietly.
rows.translation: “那么，船长，你就是那位斯蒂尔了？”他轻声问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, Captain, you’re the Steele, then?” he asks quietly."

rows.original: You tell him you most certainly are.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，自己当然确定。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him you most certainly are. "

rows.original: Kase gulps, “Well, I just wanted to thank you again for giving me this opportunity, and I will do all that is in my power to make your journey run smoothly.”
rows.translation: 凯斯咽了口口水，“嗯，我只是想再次感谢你给我这个机会，我会尽我所能让你的旅程顺利进行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKase gulps, “Well, I just wanted to thank you again for giving me this opportunity, and I will do all that is in my power to make your journey run smoothly.”"

rows.original: “Oh, well, it’s been fine, more or less,” he says, keeping his straight and proper posture, “Steele Tech has been keeping me busy with work, plenty of accounting and logistics operations that can be taken care of remotely.” Kase pauses and lets out a long sigh, “But, in all honesty, Captain, it’s nowhere near the... purpose I felt working on your ship.”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well, it’s been fine, more or less,” he says, keeping his straight and proper posture, “Steele Tech has been keeping me busy with work, plenty of accounting and logistics operations that can be taken care of remotely.” Kase pauses and lets out a long sigh, “But, in all honesty, Captain, it’s nowhere near the... purpose I felt working on your ship.”"

rows.original: “In all honesty, Captain,” he says, keeping his straight posture, “It’s been quite boring. There’s been odd jobs here and there, but none of it even comes close to working on the ship with you.” Kase pauses and lets out a long sigh, “But, I’ll be here if that’s where you need me,
