rows.original: When you crest one last snow dune, you finally see what can only be the milodan tribe that Eitan invited you to.
rows.translation: 翻过最后一座雪丘时，你终于看见了那个地方；那只能是埃坦邀请你前往的米洛丹部族。
rows.raw: "When you crest one last snow dune, you finally see what can only be the milodan tribe that Eitan invited you to."

rows.original: What you see is a number of pitched tents – more than a dozen but less than thirty – in a semi-circle formation, with the ‘mouth’ of the tribe opening towards a beaten path that other milodan come and go from. The tents are made from furs and leathers of Uveto’s native wildlife stitched together, forming tight-knit and sturdy canvases that don’t even flap in the wind. Milodan of all shapes and sizes are milling about, each of them responsible for some job: the youngest ones are grooming the older ones, while the able-bodied ones are either bringing in a fresh kill or are dressing down an earlier one.
rows.translation: 你看见许多搭起的帐篷，超过十二顶但不到三十顶，呈半圆形排列；部族的“入口”朝向一条踩踏出来的小径，其他米洛丹人不断从那里进出。帐篷由乌维托本土野生动物的毛皮和兽皮缝合而成，组成紧密结实的篷布，在风中甚至纹丝不动。各种体形和身材的米洛丹人四处忙碌，每个人都负责某项工作：最年幼者替年长者梳理毛发，身强体壮者则把新鲜猎物带回来，或处理先前猎到的动物。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you see is a number of pitched tents – more than a dozen but less than thirty – in a semi-circle formation, with the ‘mouth’ of the tribe opening towards a beaten path that other milodan come and go from. The tents are made from furs and leathers of Uveto’s native wildlife stitched together, forming tight-knit and sturdy canvases that don’t even flap in the wind. Milodan of all shapes and sizes are milling about, each of them responsible for some job: the youngest ones are grooming the older ones, while the able-bodied ones are either bringing in a fresh kill or are dressing down an earlier one."

rows.original: You aren’t really sure how to approach the tribe, though. Eitan told you that his name would be enough to get you to him, but... well, how do you approach any milodan? Every single one you met before Eitan was aggressive
rows.translation: 不过你不太确定该怎么接近那个部落。埃坦告诉过你，报他的名字就足以让你见到他，但...嗯，你到底该怎么接近任何一个米洛丹人呢？在埃坦之前你遇到的每一个都充满敌意
rows.raw: "\n\nYou aren’t really sure how to approach the tribe, though. Eitan told you that his name would be enough to get you to him, but... well, how do you approach any milodan? Every single one you met before Eitan was aggressive"

rows.original: --well, except the ones you ‘hunted’ with Syri--
rows.translation: --呃，除了那些你和希莉一起‘猎捕’的--
rows.raw: "--well, except the ones you ‘hunted’ with Syri--"

rows.original: and Eitan himself needed to be whittled down over time.
rows.translation: 而且就连埃坦本人也需要一点一点地磨掉锋芒。
rows.raw: "and Eitan himself needed to be whittled down over time."

rows.original: But then you figure,
rows.translation: 但随后你又想到，
rows.raw: "\n\nBut then you figure, "

rows.original: you have to believe that Eitan was telling the truth, and that the milodan aren’t so immediately bloodthirsty that they’ll take you to their alpha once you say his name. If you didn’t believe Eitan’s word, then why are you here in the first place?
rows.translation: 你必须相信埃坦说的是实话，也必须相信米洛丹人不会嗜血到一见面就动手，只要你报出他的名字，他们便会带你去见阿尔法。若是不相信埃坦的话，那你一开始又为什么来这里？
rows.raw: "you have to believe that Eitan was telling the truth, and that the milodan aren’t so immediately bloodthirsty that they’ll take you to their alpha once you say his name. If you didn’t believe Eitan’s word, then why are you here in the first place?"

rows.original: fuck it; if any milodan were to start something with you, you damn-near singlehandedly cleared them all out of the korgonne Hold when they attacked, and you’ve subdued their alpha. What’s a sentry going to do to you?
rows.translation: 管他的；要是有任何米洛丹人想找你麻烦，当他们进攻科尔贡要塞时，你几乎凭一己之力将其全部清除，而且你还制服过他们的阿尔法。区区一个哨兵又能把你怎么样？
rows.raw: "fuck it; if any milodan were to start something with you, you damn-near singlehandedly cleared them all out of the korgonne Hold when they attacked, and you’ve subdued their alpha. What’s a sentry going to do to you?"

rows.original: When you approach the tribe by cresting the hill and making its way down its broad side, a patch of snow explodes to your side. You freeze in place, and look toward the tribe’s walls - on one of the higher towers stands a milodan with a rifle trained on your position. That was a warning shot. Eitan wasn’t kidding.
rows.translation: 你翻过山丘，沿着宽阔山坡向下，接近部族时，身旁的一片积雪突然炸开。你停在原地，望向部族的围墙；一座较高的塔楼上站着一名米洛丹人，步枪正瞄准你所在的位置。那是警告射击。埃坦所言不虚。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you approach the tribe by cresting the hill and making its way down its broad side, a patch of snow explodes to your side. You freeze in place, and look toward the tribe’s walls - on one of the higher towers stands a milodan with a rifle trained on your position. That was a warning shot. Eitan wasn’t kidding."

rows.original: Still, you don’t move, and you’re soon joined by another milodan warrior, this one wielding a spear made from stone. You say Eitan’s name, and that changes everything. The milodan already in front of you widens his eyes, straightens his back, lifts his spear, and waves his hand behind him to the incoming wave of milodan warriors. They all stop.
rows.translation: 尽管如此，你仍一动不动，另一名米洛丹战士很快来到你身边，这人挥舞着一根石制长矛。你报出埃坦的名字，一切顿时改变。已经站在你面前的米洛丹人睁大双眼、挺直脊背、抬起长矛，并朝身后正涌来的米洛丹战士挥手。他们全都停了下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, you don’t move, and you’re soon joined by another milodan warrior, this one wielding a spear made from stone. You say Eitan’s name, and that changes everything. The milodan already in front of you widens his eyes, straightens his back, lifts his spear, and waves his hand behind him to the incoming wave of milodan warriors. They all stop."

rows.original: Still, you aren’t given a warm welcome: instead of trying to gut you, the milodan
rows.translation: 不过，你仍未得到热情欢迎：米洛丹人虽然没有试图剖开你的肚子，却
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, you aren’t given a warm welcome: instead of trying to gut you, the milodan "

rows.original: grabs you by the arm and yanks you behind him, marching you into the tribe’s perimeter. That’s hardly a way to treat a guest of their alpha, but you figure it might be best to go at their pace rather than try and raise a ruckus.
rows.translation: 抓住你的胳膊，把你猛地扯到身后，押着你进入部族范围。这可不是对待阿尔法贵客的方式，不过你觉得最好还是顺着他们的步调走，而不是试图大闹一场。
rows.raw: "grabs you by the arm and yanks you behind him, marching you into the tribe’s perimeter. That’s hardly a way to treat a guest of their alpha, but you figure it might be best to go at their pace rather than try and raise a ruckus."

rows.original: tries to grab you by the arm, but you’re not about to stand for that; you whip your arm back and say Eitan’s name again while motioning for the milodan to keep walking. The warrior glares at you, unappreciative of your standoffishness, but doesn’t try again.
rows.translation: 试图抓住你的胳膊，但你可不会任其摆布；你猛地抽回手臂，再次报出埃坦的名字，同时示意那名米洛丹人继续带路。战士怒视着你，对你的冷淡态度颇为不满，但没有再次尝试。
rows.raw: "tries to grab you by the arm, but you’re not about to stand for that; you whip your arm back and say Eitan’s name again while motioning for the milodan to keep walking. The warrior glares at you, unappreciative of your standoffishness, but doesn’t try again."

rows.original: You’re led to the largest tent in the tribe by a huge margin, taking up easily more than four times the space as the next-largest tent. The inside is fairly lavish, for an indigenous tribe like the milodan: the snow is covered with something hard and comparatively warm, likely just stones or wood, and they’re covered with plush carpets, some of them clearly not-Uvetan in nature and likely pillaged from an Irestead caravan, while others are made of fur, likely from the hide of some poor native animal. The tent is large enough to be separated into compartments, each room covered in thin, draping materials to give some semblance of privacy, although you can make out what appears to be a bed lying on the floor through some of them.
rows.translation: 你被领到部族中遥遥领先的最大帐篷，面积轻易超过第二大帐篷四倍。对米洛丹这样的原住民部族而言，内部称得上相当奢华：积雪上铺着某种坚硬而较为温暖的东西，或许只是石头或木材，其上又覆盖着柔软地毯；其中一些显然并非乌维托产物，很可能是从艾尔斯特德商队劫掠而来，另一些则由毛皮制成，大概取自某只可怜的本土动物。帐篷大得足以分成多个隔间，每个房间都由轻薄垂落的材料遮住，勉强提供几分隐私，不过透过其中几道帘幕，你仍能辨认出地面上似乎铺着一张床。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re led to the largest tent in the tribe by a huge margin, taking up easily more than four times the space as the next-largest tent. The inside is fairly lavish, for an indigenous tribe like the milodan: the snow is covered with something hard and comparatively warm, likely just stones or wood, and they’re covered with plush carpets, some of them clearly not-Uvetan in nature and likely pillaged from an Irestead caravan, while others are made of fur, likely from the hide of some poor native animal. The tent is large enough to be separated into compartments, each room covered in thin, draping materials to give some semblance of privacy, although you can make out what appears to be a bed lying on the floor through some of them."

rows.original: Sitting in the center of the tent, his head hanging in his hands, is Eitan. He’s no longer wearing the shoddy pants the korgonne gave him and he’s replaced them with the same signature loincloth that the other warriors wear, although he still has the undershirt you gave him on. At the sound of you and your milodan escort approaching, he lifts his gaze, and his eyes widen in surprise when he sees it’s you.
rows.translation: 埃坦坐在帐篷中央，双手捧着低垂的脑袋。他不再穿着科尔贡人给他的粗制裤子，换上了其他战士都穿的标志性缠腰布，不过身上仍穿着你给他的汗衫。听到你和米洛丹护卫靠近的声音，他抬起目光，发现来者是你后，惊讶地睁大双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nSitting in the center of the tent, his head hanging in his hands, is Eitan. He’s no longer wearing the shoddy pants the korgonne gave him and he’s replaced them with the same signature loincloth that the other warriors wear, although he still has the undershirt you gave him on. At the sound of you and your milodan escort approaching, he lifts his gaze, and his eyes widen in surprise when he sees it’s you."

rows.original: “[pc.name] Steele,” he says, his voice lifting with his body as he stands to greet you. It’s the first time since you really started talking with him that he sounded something better than neutral – in the short time he’s been out of the korgonne prison, his spirits have already lifted.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说着，起身迎接你，声音也随身体一同扬起。自从你真正开始与他交谈以来，这是他的语气第一次听起来比中性更加积极；离开科尔贡监狱还没多久，他的精神便已经振作起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name] Steele,” he says, his voice lifting with his body as he stands to greet you. It’s the first time since you really started talking with him that he sounded something better than neutral – in the short time he’s been out of the korgonne prison, his spirits have already lifted."

rows.original: His eyes go to the milodan warrior you’re with. “Leave us be,” Eitan tells the warrior, “and let the tribe know that this one is welcome.”
rows.translation: 他的目光转向与你同行的米洛丹战士。“让我们单独待着，”埃坦对战士说道，“并通知部族，这个人受我们欢迎。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHis eyes go to the milodan warrior you’re with. “Leave us be,” Eitan tells the warrior, “and let the tribe know that this one is welcome.”"

rows.original: At that, your escort leaves without another word to spread the news.
rows.translation: 听到这话，你的护送者没再多说一句就离开，去传播这个消息了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that, your escort leaves without another word to spread the news."

rows.original: “Like I told you, [pc.name] Steele, my people aren’t the most approachable towards strangers,” he laughs.
rows.translation: “就像我跟你说过的，[pc.name] 斯蒂尔，我族人对陌生人可不太亲近，”他笑着说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I told you, [pc.name] Steele, my people aren’t the most approachable towards strangers,” he laughs. "

rows.original: He places one hand on your shoulder, guiding you in from the cold of the exposed tribe, and motions you to the seat beside his own, inviting you to sit. If nothing else, he’s already a fairly gracious host.
rows.translation: 他把一只手放在你的肩膀上，引着你离开部族露天区域的寒冷，并示意你坐到他自己的座位旁，邀请你入座。不管怎么说，他已经算得上相当殷勤的主人。
rows.raw: "He places one hand on your shoulder, guiding you in from the cold of the exposed tribe, and motions you to the seat beside his own, inviting you to sit. If nothing else, he’s already a fairly gracious host."

rows.original: He extends his hand for you to take, which you do – though his hand is rough, probably from all that time swinging big, heavy pickaxes around, his grip is gentle. He only holds it long enough to lead you to the spot beside where he was sitting, but it’s a gentlemanly gesture all the same.
rows.translation: 他伸出手让你握住，你照做了；他的手很粗糙，大概是长时间挥舞巨大沉重鹤嘴锄留下的痕迹，但握力却很轻柔。他只握到足以把你领到自己刚才座位旁的位置，但这依然是绅士之举。
rows.raw: "He extends his hand for you to take, which you do – though his hand is rough, probably from all that time swinging big, heavy pickaxes around, his grip is gentle. He only holds it long enough to lead you to the spot beside where he was sitting, but it’s a gentlemanly gesture all the same."

rows.original: “It’s good to see that you’ve found my tribe without issues, [pc.name] Steele,” he says as he lowers himself to his own sitting position. “I was hoping you would come.”
rows.translation: “很高兴看到你顺利地找到了我的部落，[pc.name]斯蒂尔，”他说着，也坐了下来。“我一直希望你会来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s good to see that you’ve found my tribe without issues, [pc.name] Steele,” he says as he lowers himself to his own sitting position. “I was hoping you would come.”"

rows.original: You tell him that it wouldn’t be very polite to turn down an invitation from the alpha himself. And he’s already been rather accommodating, such as whitelisting your name with just a sentence.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，拒绝阿尔法亲自发出的邀请可不太礼貌。而且他已经十分照顾你，例如只用一句话就把你的名字加入了通行名单。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him that it wouldn’t be very polite to turn down an invitation from the alpha himself. And he’s already been rather accommodating, such as whitelisting your name with just a sentence."

rows.original: He smiles at you. It’s a genuine, charming, lip-curling, teeth-gleaming smile that disarms you. “You’ll find that I have many more obligations to show you, [pc.name] Steele, as my guest. You need only say the word.”
rows.translation: 他朝你微笑。那是真诚、迷人、嘴角上扬、牙齿闪亮的微笑，令你卸下戒心。“你会发现，作为我的客人，我还有许多更周到的待客之道要向你展示，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。你只要开口就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe smiles at you. It’s a genuine, charming, lip-curling, teeth-gleaming smile that disarms you. “You’ll find that I have many more obligations to show you, [pc.name] Steele, as my guest. You need only say the word.”"

rows.original: You glance at his body and the way how it strains the undershirt it’s contained in. You have a pretty clear idea on what sort of amenities someone like him is capable of.
rows.translation: 你瞥向他的身体，看着那具身躯如何把汗衫撑得紧绷。你相当清楚，像他这样的人能够提供什么样的招待。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance at his body and the way how it strains the undershirt it’s contained in. You have a pretty clear idea on what sort of amenities someone like him is capable of."

rows.original: You know, if you want.
rows.translation: 你知道的，只要你想。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou know, if you want."

rows.original: B
Eitan’s Tribe
rows.translation: 埃坦的部落
rows.raw: "Eitan’s Tribe"

rows.original: You crest the familiar snow done and are greeted once again by the sprawling image of a milodan tribe just a few dozen paces away.
rows.translation: 你翻过熟悉的雪丘，再次看到几十步外绵延开来的米洛丹部族景象。
rows.raw: "You crest the familiar snow done and are greeted once again by the sprawling image of a milodan tribe just a few dozen paces away."

rows.original: When you approach, you spot one of the milodan snipers on the tribe’s tower with his rifle trained on you, but once he sees it’s you, he lowers his weapon and resumes his lookout. The guardsman at the tribe’s opening even waves you in. Honestly, the milodan can be cordial when they know to be – they’re just jumpy around strangers, is all.
rows.translation: 你走近时，发现部族高塔上的一名米洛丹狙击手正用步枪瞄着你，但一看清是你，他就放下武器，继续放哨。部族入口的守卫甚至挥手放你进去。说实话，米洛丹人在知道该客气的时候是挺客气的 – 他们只是对陌生人容易紧张罢了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you approach, you spot one of the milodan snipers on the tribe’s tower with his rifle trained on you, but once he sees it’s you, he lowers his weapon and resumes his lookout. The guardsman at the tribe’s opening even waves you in. Honestly, the milodan can be cordial when they know to be – they’re just jumpy around strangers, is all."

rows.original: You make your way to the center of the tribe. The alpha’s tent is in front of you – it’s difficult to miss, being the largest of them all by a long shot – but now that you’re generally accepted as an extended guest of the tribe, you could travel anywhere and speak to anyone, if you wanted.
rows.translation: 你走向部族中央。阿尔法的帐篷就在前方；它遥遥领先于其他所有帐篷，是最大的那顶，很难错过。不过，既然你已被普遍接受为部族的外来贵客，只要愿意，你可以前往任何地方，与任何人交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make your way to the center of the tribe. The alpha’s tent is in front of you – it’s difficult to miss, being the largest of them all by a long shot – but now that you’re generally accepted as an extended guest of the tribe, you could travel anywhere and speak to anyone, if you wanted."

rows.original: You drop your attack stance and tell Eitan that you surrender.
rows.translation: 你放下进攻架势，告诉埃坦自己投降。
rows.raw: "You drop your attack stance and tell Eitan that you surrender."

rows.original: At first, Eitan maintains his stance, but once he’s confident that you mean no further aggression yourself, he relaxes, lowering his guard. “As you say, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “The fight wouldn’t be proper if one of us was incapable or unwilling. If you ever want to spar again, you know where I’ll be.”
rows.translation: 起初，埃坦依旧保持架势；但确认你确实不打算继续进攻后，他便放松下来，解除戒备。“如你所愿，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”他说。“如果一方无力或不愿继续，这场战斗就不公平。以后想再切磋，你知道该去哪里找我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first, Eitan maintains his stance, but once he’s confident that you mean no further aggression yourself, he relaxes, lowering his guard. “As you say, [pc.name] Steele,” he says. “The fight wouldn’t be proper if one of us was incapable or unwilling. If you ever want to spar again, you know where I’ll be.”"

rows.original: At least he doesn’t seem to be too annoyed about it, seeing as you’re the one who wanted to spar him.
rows.translation: 至少他似乎没有为此太过恼火，毕竟是你主动想与他切磋。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least he doesn’t seem to be too annoyed about it, seeing as you’re the one who wanted to spar him."

rows.original: A shivering figure lurks in shadowy darkness at the rear of the cave, its large, canine ears quivering in distress. Features are difficult to make out without getting any closer, but it is clear from the mop of snow-soaked hair and chattering teeth that whatever is cowering back there is suffering from some serious hypothermia.
rows.translation: 洞穴后方阴森黑暗的角落里蜷缩着一道颤抖身影，硕大的犬耳因痛苦而不断发颤。不靠近很难看清其特征，但从一头被雪浸透的乱发和打颤的牙齿来看，缩在那里的不明人物正遭受严重的低体温症。
rows.raw: "\n\nA shivering figure lurks in shadowy darkness at the rear of the cave, its large, canine ears quivering in distress. Features are difficult to make out without getting any closer, but it is clear from the mop of snow-soaked hair and chattering teeth that whatever is cowering back there is suffering from some serious hypothermia."

rows.original: Maybe you could help her out and improve relations with the locals...
rows.translation: 也许你可以帮她一把，改善与当地人的关系...
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe you could help her out and improve relations with the locals..."

rows.original: She seems to be gathering her strength for another trip into the wilds. If you mean to help her, do it soon.
rows.translation: 她似乎正在积蓄力气，准备再次进入荒野。如果你打算帮她，就快点去。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to be gathering her strength for another trip into the wilds. If you mean to help her, do it soon."

rows.original: You doubt the korgonne will stick around too much longer. Delay too long, and you’ll miss your chance to help her out.
rows.translation: 你觉得这名科尔贡人不会再停留太久。拖延过久，你就会错过帮助她的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou doubt the korgonne will stick around too much longer. Delay too long, and you’ll miss your chance to help her out."

rows.original: She hasn’t left, but you’re sure that she’ll have to take off eventually. A cave is a poor substitute for a home. And with her departure, you’ll miss out on any chance to help her or her people out.
rows.translation: 她还没有离开，但你确定她终究得走。洞穴毕竟不能当作家。而一旦她离去，你就会错失任何帮助她或她族人的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hasn’t left, but you’re sure that she’ll have to take off eventually. A cave is a poor substitute for a home. And with her departure, you’ll miss out on any chance to help her or her people out."

rows.original: If you don’t help her out now, she’s probably going to be gone forever in a few days.
rows.translation: 如果现在不帮助她，几天后她大概就会永远消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you don’t help her out now, she’s probably going to be gone forever in a few days."

rows.original: Figure
rows.translation: 想个办法
rows.raw: "Figure"

rows.original: The korgonne you met here is long gone. You’ll probably never see her again.
rows.translation: 你在这儿遇到的那个科尔贡女人早已离开。你大概再也见不到她了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne you met here is long gone. You’ll probably never see her again."

rows.original: Clan Chieftain
rows.translation: 氏族酋长
rows.raw: "Clan Chieftain"

rows.original: Korg Meeting
rows.translation: 会见科尔格
rows.raw: "Korg Meeting"

rows.original: KORGII R10
rows.raw: "KORGII R10"

rows.original: The guards hustle you through winding tunnels and up a spiral staircase hewn from solid stone. In stark contrast to the frigid exterior, it’s nearly as warm as a sauna inside Korg’ii Hold. By the time you climb to the next level, you’re
rows.translation: 守卫催促着你穿过蜿蜒隧道，登上一道由整块石头凿成的螺旋阶梯。与外面的严寒形成鲜明对比，科尔吉要塞内部几乎像桑拿房一样温暖。当你爬到下一层时，已经
rows.raw: "The guards hustle you through winding tunnels and up a spiral staircase hewn from solid stone. In stark contrast to the frigid exterior, it’s nearly as warm as a sauna inside Korg’ii Hold. By the time you climb to the next level, you’re "

rows.original: panting and
rows.translation: 气喘吁吁，而且
rows.raw: "panting and "

rows.original: sweating. No wonder the korgs you pass are naked, tongues hanging loose from their canine maws to assist their attempts to vent heat. You wipe moisture from your brow as your escort comes to a stop.
rows.translation: 汗流浃背。难怪你沿途遇到的科尔格都一丝不挂，舌头从犬吻中松垮垂下，帮助他们散热。当护送者停下脚步时，你擦去了额头上的汗水。
rows.raw: "sweating. No wonder the korgs you pass are naked, tongues hanging loose from their canine maws to assist their attempts to vent heat. You wipe moisture from your brow as your escort comes to a stop."

rows.original: Intricately worked script and pictographs crawl across a stone door nearly two korgs tall, its surface polished to a mirror finish. For all the tribal banter and savage behavior, it would seem their clan is home to dedicated craftspeople with skill to rival coreward artisans, however primitive their tools.
rows.translation: 精雕细琢的文字与象形图案爬满一扇近两名科尔格高的石门，表面被打磨得如同镜面。尽管他们言谈粗野、举止凶蛮，这个氏族似乎拥有专心投入的工匠；无论工具多么原始，其技艺都足以媲美核心星域的匠人。
rows.raw: "\n\nIntricately worked script and pictographs crawl across a stone door nearly two korgs tall, its surface polished to a mirror finish. For all the tribal banter and savage behavior, it would seem their clan is home to dedicated craftspeople with skill to rival coreward artisans, however primitive their tools."

rows.original: The bigger of your two guards raps the butt of his spear against the door, then leans to a hole, identical to the hundreds hiding the Hold’s entrance. “Ula’s alien-friend arriving!”
rows.translation: 两名守卫中体型较大的那个用矛尾敲击门扉，随后凑向一个孔洞；它与隐藏要塞入口的数百个孔洞别无二致。“乌拉的外星朋友来了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bigger of your two guards raps the butt of his spear against the door, then leans to a hole, identical to the hundreds hiding the Hold’s entrance. “Ula’s alien-friend arriving!”"

rows.original: “Come. Waiting such times!” a gruff voice answers.
rows.translation: “快进来。都等这么久了！”一个粗哑的声音答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come. Waiting such times!” a gruff voice answers."

rows.original: The big one nods to his shorter compatriot, who twists a handle and pushes, swinging the huge monolithic portal back with surprising ease. From the corner of your eye you can spy a set of heavy hinges, polished to the same sheen as the door’s surface. Light from the chamber beyond dazzles your eyes.
rows.translation: 大个子朝较矮的同伴点点头，后者转动把手向前推，出乎意料地轻松将巨大的整块石门向后打开。你从眼角瞥见一组沉重铰链，其表面和门扉一样被打磨得光亮。门后房间里的光芒令你眼花缭乱。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe big one nods to his shorter compatriot, who twists a handle and pushes, swinging the huge monolithic portal back with surprising ease. From the corner of your eye you can spy a set of heavy hinges, polished to the same sheen as the door’s surface. Light from the chamber beyond dazzles your eyes."

rows.original: Once you adjust to the change in brightness and uncover your eyes, you’re dazzled by the sheer display of opulence within. Every wall is hewn from whitish stone, the surface worked into carved murals of korgonne heroism. Glowing crystals held aloft by chains of gold cast amber luminance over rocky tapestries, flickering slightly. In one corner, you can see a single armored korg fighting off three frostwyrms single-handedly. In another, a horde of fluffy barbarians riding six-legged bears trample milodans underpaw.
rows.translation: 等你适应亮度变化，移开遮住眼睛的手后，室内陈设展现的极尽奢华再次令你目眩。每一面墙都由白色石头凿成，表面刻着歌颂科尔贡英雄事迹的壁画。金链高悬着发光水晶，为岩石织锦洒下略微闪烁的琥珀色光芒。一个角落里，你看见一名披甲科尔格独力击退三条霜龙；另一处则描绘着一大群骑乘六足熊的毛茸茸野蛮人，将米洛丹人践踏在爪下。

Glowing crystals held aloft by chains of gold cast amber luminance over rocky tapestries, flickering slightly. In one corner, you can see a single armored korg fighting off three frostwyrms single-handedly. In another, a horde of fluffy barbarians riding six-legged bears trample milodans underpaw."

rows.original: Furniture of bone and rock decorates the interior. Fuzzy blankets and plush-looking pillows offer comfort to the otherwise unforgiving furniture. In the center of it all is an enormous throne. It dominates the view, and on it rests the undoubted leader of this tribe of korgonne. The heavyset elder regards you with milky blue eyes and strokes the wispy curls of a beard every bit as white as the rest of his fur. You could sit him down in front of a snow-drift and he’d disappear.
rows.translation: 骨头和岩石制成的家具装饰着室内。毛茸茸的毯子和看似柔软的枕头，为原本坚硬无情的家具增添了舒适感。正中央是一张巨大的王座。它主宰了全部视野，其上坐着这支科尔贡部族毋庸置疑的领袖。身材肥硕的长老用乳白色蓝眼睛打量你，同时抚摸稀疏卷曲的胡须；胡须和身上其余毛发一样雪白。把他放在雪堆前，他准会消失得无影无踪。

rows.original: While this room may have once been vastly different from others in the hold, that uniqueness has been smothered in tradition since Ula’s ascension to Chieftess and the resulting relocation of her father. Tribal art decorates the walls. Squared off, angular corners are hidden by woven blankets and intricate sculptures. Furniture not that dissimilar from your own has been replaced with baskets, stoneware, and crude metal bins. The only feature to survive the transition unharmed is the majestic, transparent aluminum window on the southern wall, looking out of across the deadly-beautiful snows of Uvetan countryside.
rows.translation: 这间房曾经或许与堡垒中的其他房间截然不同，但乌拉升任女酋长、父亲随之搬迁后，传统已经掩盖了那种独特。部落艺术装饰着墙壁。方正锐利的墙角被编织毯与精巧雕塑遮住。与自家家具颇为相似的物品已被篮筐、石器和粗糙金属箱取代。转变过程中唯一毫发无损保留下来的特色，是南墙上宏伟的透明铝窗；透过它可以眺望乌维托乡野致命而美丽的雪原。

Angular grooves split and rejoin each other in an artist’s impression of futuristic adornment. One wall even has a transparent aluminum window, looking out over the deadly-beautiful Uvetan countryside.

rows.original: Ula slurps a savory-smelling soup from a stone bowl while balancing a written report in her other hand. To one side, a young messenger looks to her deferentially.
rows.translation: 乌拉从石碗里吸溜着香气浓郁的汤，另一只手还托着一份书面报告。一旁，一名年轻的信使恭敬地望着她。

rows.translation: 乌拉没有坐在王座上，而是把自己安置在旁边的书桌前，爪子里握着一支简陋的笔。宽大的石桌上堆满了写满潦草字迹的羊皮纸。你进门时，她的一只耳朵转了过来，但她仍坚定地处理着部落的事务。

rows.original: As the epicenter of the New Texan tourism empire, Big Tee’s ranch house wouldn’t seem a likely place for a small, sit-down dinner, but appearances are often deceiving. The gift shop, barbeque restaurant, and governor’s office are a facade shown to guests, carefully designed to display the rustic atmosphere and brazen sensibilities that turned the planet into a tourism darling of the well-to-do and nothing else. rows.original: Big T’s office stands empty. Without New Texas’s famous governor there to fill out the immense void behind the desk, the spacious work area feels hollow - like an arena without a sports team or a plinth without a statue. Still, there’s no denying the classiness of the place. Rich mahogany bookshelves line the walls, packed with a wide array of books - some of them even wreathed in leather bindings. rows.original: Gianna stares at the floor. “I’m worried, [pc.name]. If this dinner doesn’t go well...” Her eyes flicker sadly. “I won’t be able to go with you. Out there, I’m not a person, just property - even if that is all I was ever made to be. He’s never going to let me fly into space where my rights are negligible with someone he doesn’t think will take good care of me.” She straightens, looking up to you with the faintest bit of hope in her robotic eyes. “I know him. He’ll want someone well rounded. Gutsy but not foolhardy, funny yet capable of seriousness when the time comes for it, and honest when you should be and silver tongued the rest of the time.” She holds your hand. “You can do this, and then... I’ll be your companion - for real.”

rows.original: It’s at that exact moment that the elevator comes to a comfortable stop, somewhere under the planet’s rural surface. The doors woosh open, greeting you with a pair of security bulls so giant that their horns almost scrape on a ceiling well taller than ten feet. The brutes, clad in classy suits made bulky by muscle and thin armor plating, don’t physically react to the ‘ding’ of your arrival or your sudden appearance. They stand still and impassive for long seconds, then one raises a chunky palm to the device in his ear. He nods near imperceptibly before growling, “You’re expected. First door on the left for the governor’s private residence.”
rows.translation: 就在这时，电梯在星球乡村地表下的某处平稳地停了下来。门唰地滑开，迎接你的是一对公牛保安，块头大得犄角几乎能蹭到远高于十英尺的天花板。这些壮汉穿着考究的西装，被肌肉和薄薄的装甲片撑得鼓鼓囊囊，对你抵达时的‘叮’声和你突然出现都没有任何身体上的反应。他们一动不动、面无表情地站了好几秒，然后其中一个抬起厚实的手掌，按向耳边的装置。他几乎看不出来地点了点头，才低吼道：“有人在等你。总督的私宅在左边第一扇门。”

Not on my watch!” He laughs softly to himself as he reaches out for both of your hands, making his iron grip the connecting point between his adopted daughter and her lover. “But you won me over, kiddos.” He squeezes with near painful tightness, moisture beading at the corners of his eyes. “I’d have to be a monster to keep you two apart - and to keep you from finding real happiness in the stars, however dangerous they may be.” Big T’s vice-like pressure relents. “I’ll have your visa updated by the time you hit the surface, baby. Just make sure not to leave without saying goodbye to yours truly.” Looking straight into Gianna’s eyes, the governor taps just to the left of his sternum, directly over his heart. “I’m gonna miss you.”
rows.translation: 总督缓缓清了清嗓子。“[pc.name]...吉安娜跟我说起你时，我是有怀疑的。我的小火花宝贝要跟某个C.E.O.造出来的花花[pc.boyGirl]私奔？我绝不允许！”他低声自笑，伸手握住你们两人的手，以铁钳般的大手将养女和她的爱人连接起来。“不过你们这些小家伙说服我了。”他几乎捏得人生疼，眼角泛起泪光。“要是还把你们分开——不让你去群星间寻找真正的幸福，不管那里有多危险——那我就真成怪物了。”大T钳子般的压力终于放松。“宝贝，等你回到地面时，我会更新好你的签证。只要确保离开前亲自来跟我道别。”总督直视吉安娜双眼，轻敲胸骨左侧、正对心脏的位置。“我会想你的。”
rows.raw: "The governor slowly clears his throat. “[pc.name]... when Gianna told me about you, I had my doubts. My little bundle of sparks running off with some C.E.O.-spawned play[pc.boyGirl]? Not on my watch!” He laughs softly to himself as he reaches out for both of your hands, making his iron grip the connecting point between his adopted daughter and her lover. “But you won me over, kiddos.” He squeezes with near painful tightness, moisture beading at the corners of his eyes. “I’d have to be a monster to keep you two apart - and to keep you from finding real happiness in the stars, however dangerous they may be.” Big T’s vice-like pressure relents. “I’ll have your visa updated by the time you hit the surface, baby. Just make sure not to leave without saying goodbye to yours truly.” Looking straight into Gianna’s eyes, the governor taps just to the left of his sternum, directly over his heart. “I’m gonna miss you.”"

rows.original: Gianna springs out of her chair and rushes over to her dad. “I won’t, not even if Zephyr tries to keep me out.” Her eyes flicker from the emotional overload surging through her circuits. “I don’t care how big she is.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜从椅子上弹起来，冲向她的爸爸。“我不会的，就算泽菲尔想把我挡在外面也一样。”她的眼睛因为涌过线路的过载情绪而闪动。“我才不管她有多大。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna springs out of her chair and rushes over to her dad. “I won’t, not even if Zephyr tries to keep me out.” Her eyes flicker from the emotional overload surging through her circuits. “I don’t care how big she is.”"

rows.original: “Deal,” the governor agrees with flushing cheeks before remembering that he’s not alone in the room with his daughter. “Ahem. Sorry ‘bout that. Not very polite of me, ignoring my guest like that.” He looks back over his shoulder. “Though that gives me an idea... GT, you don’t mind if we have a little to drink now, do ye?”
rows.translation: “一言为定。”总督双颊泛红地答应，随后才想起房间里不只有自己和女儿。“咳。抱歉。我这样无视客人，确实不太礼貌。”他回头看向身后。“不过这倒让我有个主意...GT，我们现在喝点酒，你不会介意吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Deal,” the governor agrees with flushing cheeks before remembering that he’s not alone in the room with his daughter. “Ahem. Sorry ‘bout that. Not very polite of me, ignoring my guest like that.” He looks back over his shoulder. “Though that gives me an idea... GT, you don’t mind if we have a little to drink now, do ye?”"

rows.original: Giggling, the android says, “Of course not, Dad... and thank you, again.”
rows.translation: 机器人咯咯笑着，说道：“当然不会，爸爸... 还有，再次谢谢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGiggling, the android says, “Of course not, Dad... and thank you, again.”"

rows.original: “Bah! Don’t make a big deal out of it.” T grins roguishly, clearly happier to put the emotional outbursts behind him.
rows.translation: “呸！别把它当回事。”T露出痞气的笑，显然更乐意把那些情绪爆发抛在身后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bah! Don’t make a big deal out of it.” T grins roguishly, clearly happier to put the emotional outbursts behind him."

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 滚出去
rows.raw: "Git Gone"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You storm to the door, full of fire and disappointment, wishing you could rewind time and do it all over again, but alas, time travel remains a theoretical science. At least you can still see Gianna as much as you want. It will have to do, for now.
rows.translation: 你怒气冲冲地走向门口，满腔怒火与失望，恨不得把时间倒回去重来一遍，但可惜，时间旅行仍只是一门理论科学。至少你还能想见吉安娜多少次就见多少次。眼下也只能这样了。
rows.raw: "You storm to the door, full of fire and disappointment, wishing you could rewind time and do it all over again, but alas, time travel remains a theoretical science. At least you can still see Gianna as much as you want. It will have to do, for now."

rows.original: Your trip back to the surface passes in silent introspection. Zephyr’s office passes by in a blur. Did she even say anything to you? Whatever. The mansion’s porch is a fine place to brood for now...
rows.translation: 回地面的路上，你在沉默的自省中度过。泽菲尔的办公室一闪而过，模糊成一片。她到底有没有跟你说过什么？算了。眼下宅邸的门廊倒是个适合闷头想心事的好地方...
rows.raw: "\n\nYour trip back to the surface passes in silent introspection. Zephyr’s office passes by in a blur. Did she even say anything to you? Whatever. The mansion’s porch is a fine place to brood for now..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Big T clears his throat. “It’s clear you both want this, but... I can’t in good conscience let little ol’ GT here go into space with you. It’s a dangerous place out there. People disappear. Fleets disappear! And [pc.name], Vic’s kid or not, you couldn’t so much as impress a backwoods governor. How in seven hells am I ‘sposed to think yer gonna keep my girl safe if you can’t keep me happy, let alone some stars-blasted pirate lord?” He rubs his brow as if saying this physically hurts him.
rows.translation: 大T清了清嗓子。“很明显你们俩都想要这个，可是...我良心上不能放小GT跟你进太空。外面那地方很危险。人会消失。舰队也会消失！还有你，[pc.name]，管你是不是维克的孩子，你连个穷乡僻壤的总督都打动不了。你连让我开心都做不到，我他妈到底该怎么相信你能护住我闺女，更别说对付什么天杀的星际海盗领主？”他揉着眉心，仿佛说这些话让他肉体作痛。
rows.raw: "Big T clears his throat. “It’s clear you both want this, but... I can’t in good conscience let little ol’ GT here go into space with you. It’s a dangerous place out there. People disappear. Fleets disappear! And [pc.name], Vic’s kid or not, you couldn’t so much as impress a backwoods governor. How in seven hells am I ‘sposed to think yer gonna keep my girl safe if you can’t keep me happy, let alone some stars-blasted pirate lord?” He rubs his brow as if saying this physically hurts him."

rows.original: “No!” Gianna covers her mouth, seeming to shrink down by the second.
rows.translation: “不！”吉安娜捂住嘴，看上去一秒比一秒缩得更小。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” Gianna covers her mouth, seeming to shrink down by the second."

rows.original: Big T exhales. “Sorry GT. But you can see why, can’t ya? You’re a smart a girl, an [pc.name]... [pc.heShe] jus’ ain’t up to the job. You’re precious cargo half the galaxy’d give an arm or a leg to own, and the UGC sure as fuck ain’t looking out for somebody they sold with a receipt.” He pounds the table hard enough to knock over his glass. “Fuck. Would it have killed ya to convince me?” He stares daggers at you. “Making me make my girl cry... why don’t you go ahead an’ see yerself out?! I gotta calm down my girl here.”
rows.translation: 大T呼出一口气。“抱歉，GT。但你该明白原因，对吧？你是个聪明姑娘，而[pc.name]... [pc.heShe]就是不胜任。你是珍贵货物，半个银河系的人宁愿断胳膊少腿也想拥有你，而UGC他妈的绝不会照看一个被他们开着收据卖掉的人。”他猛捶桌面，力道大得打翻了酒杯。“操。说服我有那么难吗？”他恶狠狠地瞪着你。“居然害我的姑娘哭...你为什么不自己滚出去？！我得在这里安慰我的姑娘。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T exhales. “Sorry GT. But you can see why, can’t ya? You’re a smart a girl, an [pc.name]... [pc.heShe] jus’ ain’t up to the job. You’re precious cargo half the galaxy’d give an arm or a leg to own, and the UGC sure as fuck ain’t looking out for somebody they sold with a receipt.” He pounds the table hard enough to knock over his glass. “Fuck. Would it have killed ya to convince me?” He stares daggers at you. “Making me make my girl cry... why don’t you go ahead an’ see yerself out?! I gotta calm down my girl here.”"

rows.original: You sit there, poleaxed by the news.
rows.translation: 你坐在那儿，被这消息惊得呆住了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit there, poleaxed by the news."

rows.original: Big T mistakes your shock for reticence and waves his hand. “I ain’t saying you can’t see her no more. Just no goin’ off into space. I’m sure she’ll be delighted to see more of you next time you’re in the barn... tomorrow. Now go on. Git.”
rows.translation: 大T把你的震惊当成了沉默，挥了挥手。“我不是说你以后就不能见她了。只是别再跑进太空去。我敢说她下回在谷仓见到你...明天，一定会很高兴多见你几面。行了，去吧。滚吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T mistakes your shock for reticence and waves his hand. “I ain’t saying you can’t see her no more. Just no goin’ off into space. I’m sure she’ll be delighted to see more of you next time you’re in the barn... tomorrow. Now go on. Git.”"

rows.original: You’re about to refuse when you remember that you’re potentially hundreds of feet belong ground in a secret government complex with two trigger-happy guards waiting not far outside. As much as you hate it to admit, it there’s nothing you can do right now but return to the surface.
rows.translation: 你正要拒绝，却想起自己可能身处地下数百英尺的秘密政府建筑群中，外面不远处还有两个动不动就开枪的守卫。虽然不愿承认，但你现在除了返回地面，什么也做不了。
rows.raw: "You’re about to refuse when you remember that you’re potentially hundreds of feet belong ground in a secret government complex with two trigger-happy guards waiting not far outside. As much as you hate it to admit, it there’s nothing you can do right now but return to the surface."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The drinks go down smooth - so smooth that you don’t swallow so much as an inhale. Alcohol has never been this smooth or this delectable. You’d have a hard time savoring it if you wanted to, and you didn’t, not once your body realized just how well it would quench your thirst. The others devour their drinks in similar fashion. Even Gianna, an artificial woman with no need of alcohol or flavor, downs hers in record time. It feels good to put the glasses back down as one. In this moment, the three of you are united in purpose like never before.
rows.translation: 酒液顺滑入喉——顺滑得与其说是吞下，不如说是吸了进去。你从未喝过如此顺口、如此美味的酒。即使想要细细品味也很难做到，而你根本不想，尤其是身体意识到它能多么有效地解渴之后。其他人也以相似方式一饮而尽。就连不需要酒精或味道的人造女人吉安娜，也以创纪录的速度喝光了她那杯。三个人同时放下酒杯的感觉很好。在这一刻，你们三人前所未有地目标一致。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drinks go down smooth - so smooth that you don’t swallow so much as an inhale. Alcohol has never been this smooth or this delectable. You’d have a hard time savoring it if you wanted to, and you didn’t, not once your body realized just how well it would quench your thirst. The others devour their drinks in similar fashion. Even Gianna, an artificial woman with no need of alcohol or flavor, downs hers in record time. It feels good to put the glasses back down as one. In this moment, the three of you are united in purpose like never before."

rows.original: “Another for the road!” Big T demands, refilling the glasses.
rows.translation: “上路前再来一杯！” 大T要求道，又把杯子倒满。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Another for the road!” Big T demands, refilling the glasses."

rows.original: There’s no reason to refuse after a single drink, and you’re soon raising your glasses to a second string of toasts. Despite the joy in the air, there’s an undercurrent of sadness as well. Like high school friends celebrating for the last time before college, change looms everpresent. One chapter is ending and another beginning. For Gianna and her bovine father, this may well be the last time they meet like this, and the make the most of it. He sweeps her up in a hug as he drains his glass, kissing her softly on the forehead once he finishes. “Just so you know... if [pc.name] betrays you...”
rows.translation: 喝过一杯之后根本没有拒绝的理由，你们很快又举杯进行第二轮祝酒。尽管空气中洋溢着喜悦，底下也潜藏一股悲伤。就像高中好友在上大学前最后一次庆祝，变化始终迫在眉睫。一个篇章正在结束，另一个即将开始。对吉安娜和她的牛族父亲而言，这很可能是他们最后一次这样相聚，因此两人尽情珍惜。他喝干杯中酒时将她一把抱起，喝完后轻柔地亲吻她的额头。“你要知道...如果[pc.name]背叛你...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s no reason to refuse after a single drink, and you’re soon raising your glasses to a second string of toasts. Despite the joy in the air, there’s an undercurrent of sadness as well. Like high school friends celebrating for the last time before college, change looms everpresent. One chapter is ending and another beginning. For Gianna and her bovine father, this may well be the last time they meet like this, and the make the most of it. He sweeps her up in a hug as he drains his glass, kissing her softly on the forehead once he finishes. “Just so you know... if [pc.name] betrays you...”"

rows.original: Gianna shushes him with a finger. “[pc.HeShe] won’t.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜伸出一根手指示意他安静。“[pc.HeShe]不会的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna shushes him with a finger. “[pc.HeShe] won’t.”"

rows.original: Silence falls, and after a few more tender seconds, they part. Gianna extends her hand to you, and you take it, rising out of your seat with a smile. Big T reaches out too, to shake your hand one more time. This time, you don’t consider anything other than shaking it back. It would ruin the moment.
rows.translation: 沉默降临，又过了几秒温存的时刻，她们分开了。吉安娜向你伸出手，你握住它，微笑着从座位上起身。大T也伸出手来，想再跟你握一次手。这一次，你除了回握之外什么都没多想。要是拒绝，就会毁掉这一刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nSilence falls, and after a few more tender seconds, they part. Gianna extends her hand to you, and you take it, rising out of your seat with a smile. Big T reaches out too, to shake your hand one more time. This time, you don’t consider anything other than shaking it back. It would ruin the moment."

rows.original: “Keep her safe.”
rows.translation: “保护好她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Keep her safe.”"

rows.original: “Safer than a prized stud’s balls!” you quip, already imagining the chance to fondle those priceless orbs...
rows.translation: “比头号种马的蛋蛋还安全！”你打趣道，已经在想象摸到那对无价之球的机会了...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Safer than a prized stud’s balls!” you quip, already imagining the chance to fondle those priceless orbs..."

rows.original: You nod silently. No more words need be exchanged.
rows.translation: 你默默点头。不必再交换更多话语。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod silently. No more words need be exchanged."

rows.original: “I will,” you promise earnestly.
rows.translation: “我会的，”你认真地保证。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will,” you promise earnestly."

rows.original: “Nobody touches her without going through me. Unless it’s a real kinky threesome.” You shoot finger guns to Gianna. You aren’t sure if her giggle is genuine or not, but you appreciate it all the same.
rows.translation: “谁想碰她都得先过我这一关。除非是真正够变态的三人行。”你朝吉安娜比了个手指枪。你不确定她的轻笑是真是假，但你还挺受用的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nobody touches her without going through me. Unless it’s a real kinky threesome.” You shoot finger guns to Gianna. You aren’t sure if her giggle is genuine or not, but you appreciate it all the same."

rows.original: “Won’t be a problem,” you answer with your best steely-eyed stare on.
rows.translation: “不会成问题，” 你回答，摆出最冷峻的眼神。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Won’t be a problem,” you answer with your best steely-eyed stare on."

rows.original: Big T nods and picks up the empty wine bottle. “It’s been a real hoot, dining with you two. G, you can get [pc.himHer] back to the surface, I trust?”
rows.translation: 大T点点头，拿起空酒瓶。“跟你们俩一起吃饭真是乐事。G，你能把[pc.himHer]送回地面吧，我信得过你？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T nods and picks up the empty wine bottle. “It’s been a real hoot, dining with you two. G, you can get [pc.himHer] back to the surface, I trust?”"

rows.original: Gianna nods emphatically. “Of course, Daddy.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜用力点头。“当然了，爸爸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna nods emphatically. “Of course, Daddy.”"

rows.original: “Good. I gotta git to a conference call afore long. The wheels of government don’t wait long for one bull, no matter what he’s got written on his office door.” Big T grumbles, “Some days I feel more like a paper farmer than a governor. Bah! Wasting time jawing again.” He turns away, striding briskly to a private office, tail lashing back and forth with every step.
rows.translation: “很好。我不久后得去参加电话会议。政府的车轮不会为一头公牛停太久，不管他办公室门上写着什么。”大T咕哝道：“有些日子，我觉得自己更像种文件的农夫，而不是总督。呸！又在闲扯浪费时间了。”他转身离开，快步走向私人办公室，尾巴随着每一步来回甩动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good. I gotta git to a conference call afore long. The wheels of government don’t wait long for one bull, no matter what he’s got written on his office door.” Big T grumbles, “Some days I feel more like a paper farmer than a governor. Bah! Wasting time jawing again.” He turns away, striding briskly to a private office, tail lashing back and forth with every step."

rows.original: It’s time to go.
rows.translation: 该走了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s time to go."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: The guards don’t give you any trouble on the way back. Neither does Zephyr, up top. A knowing smirk is all it takes from the secretary to know that she knows, somehow, that you got the greenlight. How about that.
rows.translation: 回来的路上守卫没找你麻烦。上面那位泽菲尔也没有。那秘书只需一个心照不宣的坏笑，你就知道她不知怎么已经晓得你拿到了绿灯许可。真有意思。
rows.raw: "The guards don’t give you any trouble on the way back. Neither does Zephyr, up top. A knowing smirk is all it takes from the secretary to know that she knows, somehow, that you got the greenlight. How about that."

rows.original: Out front, on the ranch house’s porch, Gianna stops you with a
rows.translation: 来到外面牧场宅邸的门廊上，吉安娜用一个
rows.raw: "\n\nOut front, on the ranch house’s porch, Gianna stops you with a "

rows.original: confident
rows.translation: 自信
rows.raw: "confident"

rows.original: gentle
rows.translation: 轻柔的
rows.raw: "gentle"

rows.original: tentative
rows.translation: 犹豫的
rows.raw: "tentative"

rows.original: hand on your chest. “Give me an hour or two to get in my goodbyes, and I’ll be ready to go, okay?”
rows.translation: 一只手按在你胸口。“给我一两个小时去道别，然后就准备好出发了，好吗？”
rows.raw: " hand on your chest. “Give me an hour or two to get in my goodbyes, and I’ll be ready to go, okay?”"

rows.original: You say, “Okay,” right back.
rows.translation: 你立刻回了一句，“好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say, “Okay,” right back."

rows.original: Gianna grabs you by the face and kisses you hard, full-on, her synthetic tongue doing things organics could only dream of. When she finally deigns to release you from the hellishly pleasurable liplock, you’re confused and gasping, wobbling on your feet. “See you soon.” She strides away
rows.translation: 吉安娜捧住你的脸，结结实实地吻了上来；她的合成舌头施展着有机生物只能梦想的花样。等她终于大发慈悲，把你从这场快感如地狱般猛烈的唇吻中释放出来时，你脑袋发懵、气喘吁吁，双脚也摇摇晃晃。“很快再见。”她大步离去
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna grabs you by the face and kisses you hard, full-on, her synthetic tongue doing things organics could only dream of. When she finally deigns to release you from the hellishly pleasurable liplock, you’re confused and gasping, wobbling on your feet. “See you soon.” She strides away"

rows.original: , dump truck-sized donk swaying.
rows.translation: ，那卡车般巨大的翘臀来回摇摆。
rows.raw: ", dump truck-sized donk swaying."

rows.original: , knowingly swishing her heart-shaped heiny around for your benefit.
rows.translation: ，特意为你扭动那颗心形美臀。
rows.raw: ", knowingly swishing her heart-shaped heiny around for your benefit."

rows.original: , proudly displaying her tight little booty for your enjoyment.
rows.translation: ，得意地展示她那紧致的小屁股供你欣赏。
rows.raw: ", proudly displaying her tight little booty for your enjoyment."

rows.original: Gianna leans in close,
rows.translation: 吉安娜凑近，
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna leans in close, "

rows.original: bloated
rows.translation: 肿胀的

rows.original: I’m curious, Big T. What do you lift?
rows.translation: 我很好奇，大T。你举多少？
rows.raw: "I’m curious, Big T. What do you lift?"

rows.original: You must have a pretty crazy max bench press with a chest like that.” You gesture to the barely hidden patch of rippling pecs on his chest with your fork.
rows.translation: 有这么一副胸膛，你的卧推极限一定相当离谱。”你用叉子指了指他胸口那片几乎遮不住的、起伏的胸肌。
rows.raw: " You must have a pretty crazy max bench press with a chest like that.” You gesture to the barely hidden patch of rippling pecs on his chest with your fork."

rows.original: “Oh, I don’t know, haven’t gone that hard to the paint in years.” Is he blushing? “Pressing a thousand pounds seems a lot more important when you’re a young buck instead of an old bull. Ain’t no reason to get myself laid up in the hospital competing with all the hot-blooded studs in the gym when I got responsibilities needing my personal touch. Besides, if we get giga-varmints nosing around the resort again, we’ll need every able bodied bull we can get. Chainguns are heavy lifting.”
rows.translation: “哦，我不知道，已经好多年没练得那么拼了。”他脸红了吗？“年轻公牛才会觉得卧推一千磅特别重要，老公牛可不会。明明有需要我亲自处理的责任，我没理由为了和健身房里那些热血种牛较劲，把自己练进医院。再说，要是巨型害兽又跑来度假村捣乱，我们会需要每一头还能动的公牛。链枪可不轻。”

Besides, if we get giga-varmints nosing around the resort again, we’ll need every able bodied bull we can get. Chainguns are heavy lifting.”"

rows.translation: 所以他不举铁？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo he doesn’t lift?"

rows.original: “Oh don’t go sour on me, [pc.name]. I saw that look. I’m not that old. I still put in my time at the church of iron when I get a chance. I’m just maintaining instead of building. ‘Got nothing to prove to rich boy tourists and dumb young’uns. Doesn’t mean I don’t work up enough of a sweat to get the cow-girls mooing, though. I jus’ lift like I’m in a pop-country band: all volume.” He smirks. “Even got some dumbbells under my desk upstairs in case I feel like impressing some doe-eyed heiress with a thousand hundred-pound curls.” He flexes, nearly splitting the seam of his shirt. “Too bad most of the galaxy’s afraid to let New Texans play their sports.” He exhales a cloud of cigar smoke. “Those pussies don’t know what they’re missing.”
rows.translation: “哦，别对我露出那副扫兴表情，[pc.name]。我看见了。我还没那么老。有机会时我还是会去钢铁教堂花时间锻炼，只不过现在是维持，而不是增肌。‘我可没什么需要向富家少爷游客和蠢笨小年轻证明的。’但这不代表我不能练出满身汗，让那些母牛姑娘哞哞直叫。我只是像乡村流行乐队那样举铁：只练次数。”他咧嘴一笑。“我楼上的办公桌下面甚至放了几只哑铃，万一哪天想用一千次百磅弯举给哪个眼神天真的女继承人留下印象呢。”他绷紧肌肉，衬衫接缝几乎裂开。“可惜银河系大部分地方都不敢让新德州人参加他们的体育比赛。”他吐出一团雪茄烟。“那些懦夫根本不知道自己错过了什么。”

rows.original: “You don’t say?” Big T rubs his bearded chin thoughtfully. “Sounds like there’s a bigger market for that sort of thing than I thought. Might oughtta see if some of our best breeding stock’s up to the challenge of a little off-planet work. Make enough to retire off of in a year or two of stuffy CEO breeding, assuming you don’t mind the competition, GT.”
rows.translation: “真的假的？”大T若有所思地揉着胡子拉碴的下巴。“听起来这行的市场比我想的大。也许该看看咱们最好的几头种畜能不能接下这点外星上的活儿。干上一两年给那些古板的CEO配种，挣的钱就够退休了，前提是你不介意有竞争，GT。”

[pc.name] already picked me over the wonders of this planet.” She looks at you, eyes shaping into hearts of their own accord. “The rest of the galaxy can bury itself between your legs as long as I have [pc.himHer]. Not that I’d ever keep [pc.name] from diving between your legs

rows.original: You ask, “What about you? You know all about my Dad, but what was yours like? I can’t even imagine what it would be like to grow up here.”
rows.translation: 你问道：“那你呢？你很了解我父亲，可你的父亲是什么样的人？我甚至无法想象在这里长大是什么感觉。”
rows.raw: "You ask, “What about you? You know all about my Dad, but what was yours like? I can’t even imagine what it would be like to grow up here.”"

rows.original: Big T sets down his fork and puffs thoughtfully on his cigar. “My pops? Heh. First time I’ve been asked about him really. Everybody around here? They know all about him. Too famous not to, so there’s nothing to ask.” He twists around, one arm casually bracing on his chair back as gestures at a distant portrait of an equally large man with a beard the size of a transport shuttle. “Governor James Church Tee reigned for damn near most of his life, so I guess you can say governing runs in our blood.” He scratches his bearded chin. “Guess it has since the colony ships first touched down, ages back. Can trace a line through my sires all the way back to the first lander’s captain.” He thumps his chest proudly. “Strong genes ran in my family even before the Treatment.”
rows.translation: 大T放下叉子，若有所思地吸了口雪茄。“我老爹？嘿。这还真是第一次有人问起他。至于这里的所有人？他们都很了解他。他太有名了，大家不可能不知道，所以根本没什么可问的。”他转过身，一条胳膊随意搭在椅背上，指向远处一幅肖像；画中同样身材高大的男人，留着运输穿梭机般硕大的胡须。“詹姆斯·丘奇·提州长几乎执政了一辈子，所以可以说治理才能流淌在我们的血液里。”他挠挠长满胡须的下巴。“我猜从很久以前殖民船首次着陆时就是如此。沿着我的父系一路追溯，可以一直追到首艘登陆船的船长。”他骄傲地拍了拍胸膛。“早在接受改造之前，我们家族就拥有强健的基因。”

Can trace a line through my sires all the way back to the first lander’s captain.” He thumps his chest proudly. “Strong genes ran in my family even before the Treatment.”"

rows.original: You nod thoughtfully at that. New Texas may vote for their government, but it seems they’ve been happy to stick to a single family for most of their history. “What was he like?”
rows.translation: 你若有所思地点点头。新德州或许会投票选举政府，但在他们历史的大部分时间里，大家似乎都乐于支持同一个家族。“他是个怎样的人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod thoughtfully at that. New Texas may vote for their government, but it seems they’ve been happy to stick to a single family for most of their history. “What was he like?”"

rows.original: “Dad?” Governor T leans back, the chair creaking dangerously under his weight. “He was a tough old bull. Once, I saw him haul a flipped tractor out of the mud by hisself. He flipped it up on its wheels and drove it back to the barn all alone, rather than ‘let some fool farmer bedevil himself with something as complicated as a set of wheels.’” Big T makes quotes with his fingers before laughing. “Don’t get me wrong, he had a soft side. Usually only came out for my ma though. Winona was her name. Could put his fire right out if he got stupid worked up about something. Lucky for me.”
rows.translation: “我爸？”T州长向后靠去，椅子在他的重量下危险地吱嘎作响。“他是头强硬的老公牛。有一次，我亲眼看见他把一辆翻倒的拖拉机从泥里拖出来。他一个人把它翻回轮子上，再开回谷仓，因为他不愿‘让哪个傻瓜农民被轮子这种复杂玩意儿折腾得焦头烂额。’”大T用手指比出引号，随后笑了起来。“别误会，他也有温柔的一面，不过通常只对我妈展露。她叫薇诺娜。要是他为某件事蠢兮兮地大发雷霆，她能立刻把他的火浇灭。我可真幸运。”

rows.original: You raise your eye. “Get in trouble a lot?”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛。“经常惹麻烦？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your eye. “Get in trouble a lot?”"

rows.original: “You could say that,” Big T admits. “Being the governor’s eldest comes with a bushelful of expectations. Been that way for generations. Everybody expects you to go into politics, so when you have one little barnyard dalliance with a tourist that got where they shouldn’t ought to have got...” He snorts. “Let’s just say I spent a summer working a farm on the other side of the planet, where I couldn’t disappoint my daddy like that again.”
rows.translation: “可以这么说，”大T承认道。“当州长的长子，就得承担一箩筐期望。几代人来都是如此。所有人都指望你从政，所以当你只是在谷仓里跟某个不该跑到那里的游客偷欢一次...”他哼了一声。“这么说吧，我花了整整一个夏天在星球另一头的农场干活，在那里就不会再那样让父亲失望。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You could say that,” Big T admits. “Being the governor’s eldest comes with a bushelful of expectations. Been that way for generations. Everybody expects you to go into politics, so when you have one little barnyard dalliance with a tourist that got where they shouldn’t ought to have got...” He snorts. “Let’s just say I spent a summer working a farm on the other side of the planet, where I couldn’t disappoint my daddy like that again.”"

rows.original: “That sounds hard.”
rows.translation: “听起来好难。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That sounds hard.”"

rows.original: You reach out to touch his arm comfortingly.
rows.translation: 你伸手安慰地碰了碰他的手臂。
rows.raw: " You reach out to touch his arm comfortingly."

rows.original: “It was, but I learned my lesson. A lot of grown-ass bulls still haven’t. You can’t go sticking your prong in every wet hole in the patch, least not without paying a price for it.” His horns sway with his laughter. “Dad welcomed me home just the same after that. Can’t be too sore at him for it when he took me under his wing right after. Taught me everything I needed to know about dealing with paperwork and people, jus’ like his pa did - and pa, and so on.”
rows.translation: “确实如此，但我吸取了教训。许多成年的公牛到现在都没学会。你不能把肉棒塞进这片土地上的每一个湿洞，至少不能不付出代价。”他的双角随着笑声摇摆。“不过那之后，父亲还是照样欢迎我回家。紧接着他就把我置于羽翼之下，我也没法太怨他。他教会了我处理文件和与人打交道所需的一切，就像他父亲教他那样 - 再上一代也是，如此代代相传。”

rows.original: “What happened to them?” you ask.
rows.translation: “后来他们怎么样了？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What happened to them?” you ask."

rows.original: Big T sighs. “Retired eventually. Dad bought himself a ship, called himself ‘Captain James Church Tee’ and decided to explore every nook and cranny he could get at that hadn’t already been charted in the last Rush. Had a whole decade of fun before we stopped getting messages from him.” He looks off into the distance, lost in the maze of memory. “Never quite figured out what happened to him. Maybe he just picked somewhere to lay down and die. Maybe some pirates got ‘im. Can’t say. One thing I do know - he looked danger in the eye and flipped it the bird. Not a lot of men can say that, bull or otherwise.”
rows.translation: 大T叹了口气。“最后退休了。父亲给自己买了艘船，自称‘詹姆斯·丘奇·提船长’，决定探索上一次星球热潮中尚未绘入星图的每个角落。他痛痛快快地玩了整整十年，后来我们就再没收到他的消息。”他望向远方，迷失在记忆的迷宫里。“我们始终没弄明白他发生了什么。也许他只是找了个地方躺下等死。也许遇上了海盗。说不准。我只知道一件事 - 他直视危险的双眼，还对它竖起了中指。没有多少男人能这么说，无论是不是公牛。”

rows.original: Sensing the topic has reached a tender point, you apologize for bringing up the topic.
rows.translation: 察觉到这个话题触到了痛处，你为自己提起它而道歉。
rows.raw: "\n\nSensing the topic has reached a tender point, you apologize for bringing up the topic."

rows.original: “Pshaww! Don’t you worry none.” Big T claps you on the back. It feels like sitting through an earthquake. You swear you felt your teeth rattle. “Death’s a farmer’s oldest friend. Part of the great cycle, if you traffic with those hippy types. Me? I ‘spose he’s up in bull heaven, plowing momma to pieces and hollering up holy hell at any angels that start slacking.” He flashes a sea of pearly whites at you. “Life ain’t got no meaning without an ending, and Dad? He found his in style. Maybe in another fifty years I’ll do the same.” He glances Gianna’s way. “Though I guess you can see why I worry about little GT bein’ out in space now. Guess it’s time I gave you some resolution one way or the other ‘bout this.”
rows.translation: “呸！别瞎担心。”大T拍了拍你的背，感觉就像坐着经历了一场地震。你敢发誓自己的牙齿都被震得格格作响。“死亡是农民最古老的朋友。要是和那些嬉皮士打交道，他们会说这是伟大循环的一部分。至于我？我猜他正在公牛天堂里把妈妈耕得七零八落，还对任何开始偷懒的天使扯着嗓子破口大骂。”他向你露出满口珍珠般洁白的牙齿。“人生若没有终点就毫无意义，而父亲？他以自己的方式找到了终点。也许再过五十年，我也会这么做。”他瞥向吉安娜。“不过我想你现在也能明白，我为什么会担心小GT待在太空。看来是时候给你一个明确答复，告诉你这件事到底行不行了。”

rows.raw: "“Can I get a copy of your barbecue recipe? This is delicious!” you gush."

rows.original: Stormclouds brew behind Big T’s eyes. “Uhh, I’m not sure how things work with yer family, but in my family, the family barbecue recipe doesn’t get handed out to off-worlders, and it sure as spit don’t get passed around like a cow-girl in her first week of Treatin’.” He drops his fork and puffs stubbornly at his cigar. “Ain’t nobody on this dirtball’d think to ask me that, that’s fer sure.”
rows.translation: 大T眼中酝酿起暴风云。“呃，我不知道你们家是什么规矩，但在我们家，家传烧烤配方不会交给外星人，更不会像刚接受改造第一周的母牛姑娘那样到处传来传去。”他放下叉子，固执地抽着雪茄。“这颗土球上绝对没人会想到问我这种事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nStormclouds brew behind Big T’s eyes. “Uhh, I’m not sure how things work with yer family, but in my family, the family barbecue recipe doesn’t get handed out to off-worlders, and it sure as spit don’t get passed around like a cow-girl in her first week of Treatin’.” He drops his fork and puffs stubbornly at his cigar. “Ain’t nobody on this dirtball’d think to ask me that, that’s fer sure.”"

rows.original: Gianna scooches her chair closer to Big T, whispering, “[pc.name] isn’t from around here. [pc.HeShe] didn’t know!”
rows.translation: 吉安娜把椅子挪近大T，低声说道：“[pc.name]不是本地人。[pc.HeShe]不知道！”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna scooches her chair closer to Big T, whispering, “[pc.name] isn’t from around here. [pc.HeShe] didn’t know!”"

rows.original: Big T pats her hand once before pushing it away. “I know, but it don’t make it any less wrong!” He turns back to you. “The answer’s no. You want my recipe, you pry it outta my cold dead hands, or make Gianna an honest woman, marry her, and settle down on planet. Then you wouldn’t need ask stupid questions. I’d just give it to ya.” He slaps the table. “Asking for another man’s barbecue recipe! Coreward barbarians, the lot.”
rows.translation: 大T拍了一下她的手，随后推开。“我知道，但这并不会让问题变得没那么过分！”他转回来看你。“答案是不行。你想要我的配方，就从我冰冷僵硬的手里撬出来；或者让吉安娜成为正经女人，娶她，然后在星球上定居。那样你就不必问这种蠢问题，我会直接把配方给你。”他一掌拍在桌上。“竟然向另一个男人讨要烧烤配方！你们全都是核心星域的野蛮人。”

rows.original: Now it’s Gianna’s turn to pout. “Daaaaaad.”
rows.translation: 这下轮到吉安娜撅嘴了。“爸————爸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNow it’s Gianna’s turn to pout. “Daaaaaad.”"

rows.original: “Fine, fine.” Big T throws up his hands. “But my dad woulda had [pc.himHer] tied up in miscreant manor for a few hours after a question like that. Yer lucky GT’s such a softie.” You get the impression he’s still peeved about it but doing his best to tamp down on his anger. “Anyway, guess we better wrap this dinner up before you ask for my PornSchlub password. I still owe you an answer about taking GT with ya on your little Rush quest.”
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧。”大T举起双手。“不过我父亲要是听见这种问题，早就把[pc.himHer]绑起来，扔进恶徒庄园关上几个小时。幸亏GT这么心软。”你感觉他仍对此十分恼火，只是在竭力压住怒气。“总之，我们最好结束这顿晚餐，免得你接下来又问我要PornSchlub密码。我还欠你一个答复，关于是否让GT跟你一起去执行那小小的星球热潮任务。”

rows.original: “Running a corp is really complicated, and I don’t really feel like I totally get it, ya know? There’s all kinds of charts, and graphs, and patents to learn about, and you have to manage soooo many people.” You pout dejectedly. “My best bet is probably finding someone smart enough to handle the day-to-day who’s trustworthy enough not to tank the company for a quick buck from its rivals.”
rows.translation: “经营公司真的很复杂，我觉得自己还没完全弄明白，你懂吧？有各种图表、曲线和专利要学习，还得管理那——么多人。”你沮丧地撅起嘴。“最好的办法大概是找个足够聪明、能处理日常事务的人，同时又足够可靠，不会为了从竞争对手那里捞笔快钱就把公司搞垮。”

rows.original: “Really?” Big T shifts in his seat to downplay the skepticism oozing out of every pore. “No plans at all? Surely there’s something that has yer interest, some department you’d like to reprioritize...” He shakes his head. “You better figure somethin’ out before you roll up on the end of your journey. The corp game’s a dangerous one, full of sharks that swim through innocent blood as easily as water - or gold. You paddle out in the middle of it without a course, and you’ll sink for sure.” Another swig of milk vanishes into the governor’s gullet. “That’s advice I’ll give ya free of charge. You best heed it,
rows.translation: “真的？”大T在座位上挪了挪，试图掩饰从每个毛孔里渗出的怀疑。“完全没有计划？肯定有某些东西让你感兴趣吧，有哪个部门是你想重新确定优先级的...”他摇摇头。“在旅程结束之前，你最好想清楚。商界游戏十分危险，到处都是鲨鱼，它们能像游过水 - 或黄金 - 一样轻易游过无辜者的鲜血。你要是毫无航向地划到中间，肯定会沉下去。”又一大口牛奶消失在州长的喉咙里。“这条建议免费送你。你最好听进去，

rows.original: “Don’t mention it. Really.” The handsome bullman flashes his pearly whites in a brief display of mischievous delight. “Don’t need Pyrite execs banging down my door looking for more ‘backwoods wisdom’ if you stumble into prosperity in five years. Seriously. I’d rather be relaxing at my desk with a beer, some barbecue, and teasing whichever awestruck tourists work up the balls to slip past Zephy, bless her heart.” Returning to the aforementioned barbecue, Big T leads the table into a brief bout of near-silent consumption.
rows.translation: “别客气。真的。” 这个英俊的牛头人咧嘴一笑，露出一口白牙，短暂地流露出促狭的得意。“要是你五年后真的发了迹，我可不想让黄铁矿工业的高管们堵着我的门，来讨要更多‘乡下智慧’。说真的。我宁愿坐在办公桌前，喝着啤酒、吃点烤肉，逗一逗那些鼓起胆量绕过泽菲尔的看呆了眼的游客，愿老天保佑她。” 大T回到方才说的那顿烤肉上，带着整桌人短暂地陷入几乎无人说话的进食。

rows.original: “Mining,” you answer with certainty. “It’s the one industry guaranteed to profit from Rush discoveries. Core planets are already tapped. Plenty of mines from the last Rush have already shuttered - I actually had to shelter at an abandoned Steele Tech facility when I first joined the Rush. Light drive blew out, and I had to putter over to search for parts. Not my proudest moment for sure.” You shake your head at the memory.
rows.translation: “采矿，”你肯定地回答。“这是唯一保证能从星球热潮的发现中获利的行业。核心星球早已开采殆尽，上一次热潮建立的许多矿场也已经关闭 - 我刚加入星球热潮时，甚至不得不在一座废弃的斯蒂尔科技设施里避难。光速引擎坏了，我只好慢吞吞地赶过去寻找零件。那肯定不是我最值得骄傲的时刻。”你想起那段回忆，摇了摇头。

rows.original: “And look at other industries. Mods? With every new species we discover, the larger our own genetic libraries grow - and the less likely we are to discover anything particularly new out there. Entertainment? It’s more glutted with competition every... single... day. Weapons? Do we want to go that deep into an industry where we won’t just be dealing with corporate spies but excessively well armed ones? No, mining is where it’s at. That’s the industry that’ll make us bank over the next century.”
rows.translation: “再看看其他行业。改造剂？每发现一个新物种，我们自己的基因库就会扩大 - 而在外面发现真正新鲜事物的可能性也会降低。娱乐业？竞争一天比一天...更加...饱和。武器？我们真想如此深入一个不仅要应付商业间谍，还要应付全副武装商业间谍的行业吗？不，采矿才是正确方向。未来一个世纪，正是这个行业会让我们赚得盆满钵满。”

rows.original: The twin points of Big T’s horns dip at you as he nods respectfully. “Pretty smart thinking. I gotta agree. Stroke of brilliance on your old man’s part, convincing you to hit up the Rush yerself before taking over the company. You double up on potential finds between your own claims and the company’s sponsored scouts.” He produces a cigar, a lighter, and somehow sparks it one smooth motion. In between puffs to get it started, he adds, “Only real problem’s locals. Can’t really claim on some civilization’s assets without some kinda agreement. ‘Course that’s not a problem if they’re real primitives. UGC’ll happily watch you strip the gold right out from right underneath their feet.” Two rings of smoke blow out of his nostrils. “Not very sporting, but them’s the breaks.”
rows.translation: 大T两根角尖随着赞许的点头朝你垂下。“想得真聪明。我也赞成。你父亲让你在接管公司之前亲自参加星球热潮，真是神来之笔。你自己的发现权加上公司资助的侦察员，潜在发现就翻了一倍。”他拿出一根雪茄和打火机，不知怎的以一套流畅动作将其点燃。趁着吞云吐雾让雪茄燃起来时，他补充道：“唯一真正的问题是当地人。没达成某种协议，就不能把某个文明的资产据为己有。当然，如果他们真的很原始，那就不成问题。联合银河邦联会乐得看着你把他们脚底下的黄金全部挖走。”两圈烟雾从他鼻孔中喷出。“不太光彩，但现实就是这样。”

rows.original: You shake your head emphatically. “No. That’s not how I operate. The way I see it, there’s more to life than profit. It’s not that hard to give the locals a fair cut of their wealth, or dig a little slower if it means we can preserve the rest of the biosphere. Dying planets don’t do anybody any good, least of us the UGC.”
rows.translation: 你坚决地摇头。“不，我不是这么做事的。在我看来，人生不只有利润。给当地人公平分配属于他们的财富并不难；若能借此保护其余生物圈，挖慢一点也没什么。垂死的星球对任何人都没好处，尤其对联合银河邦联没有。”

rows.original: Big T’s crystal clinks against your own with surprising gentleness for the mountain of muscle behind it. “The sad truth,” he agrees.
rows.translation: 大T的水晶杯碰在你的杯上，对于他那一身肌肉山来说，力道轻柔得令人意外。“可悲的真相，”他赞同道。
