rows.original: “Doesn’t mean I have to be mean about it. We can cut deals when the terms are right. I could all but obliterate Steele Tech’s safety and standards departments and we’d look like champions of environmental conservation next to Pyrite or MaxCorp. No reason to piss on the family name for a slightly bigger credit chit.”
rows.translation: “但这并不表示我必须那么刻薄。条件合适时，我们可以达成交易。我几乎可以彻底裁撤斯蒂尔科技的安全与标准部门，可与黄铁或麦克斯公司相比，我们仍会显得像环境保护的典范。没理由为了一张稍大一点的信用点凭证玷污家族名声。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doesn’t mean I have to be mean about it. We can cut deals when the terms are right. I could all but obliterate Steele Tech’s safety and standards departments and we’d look like champions of environmental conservation next to Pyrite or MaxCorp. No reason to piss on the family name for a slightly bigger credit chit.”"

rows.original: Across the table, Gianna is the picture of satisfied relaxation, now casually sampling different combinations of flavor capsules to discover new taste profiles. She reaches out to pat your arm approvingly, and Big T notices. His smile is infectious as he returns to his meal.
rows.translation: 桌子对面，吉安娜一副心满意足、放松自在的模样，正随意尝试不同风味胶囊组合，探索新的味觉特征。她伸手赞许地拍了拍你的手臂，大T也注意到了。他的笑容富有感染力，随后继续用餐。
rows.raw: "\n\nAcross the table, Gianna is the picture of satisfied relaxation, now casually sampling different combinations of flavor capsules to discover new taste profiles. She reaches out to pat your arm approvingly, and Big T notices. His smile is infectious as he returns to his meal."

rows.original: While you chomp away, you realize that this lull is the perfect time for you to ask a question of your own. Is there anything you’d like to ask the big guy?
rows.translation: 你一边大嚼，一边意识到这段冷场正是你提问的好时机。你有什么想问这位大家伙的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you chomp away, you realize that this lull is the perfect time for you to ask a question of your own. Is there anything you’d like to ask the big guy?"

rows.original: Mining
rows.translation: 采矿
rows.raw: "Mining"

rows.original: Steele Tech was born as a mining corporation, and you intend to continue that core business.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔科技起家时是一家采矿公司，而你打算继续做这项核心业务。
rows.raw: "Steele Tech was born as a mining corporation, and you intend to continue that core business."

rows.original: Mods
rows.translation: 身体模组
rows.raw: "Mods"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: “Mods are the future, and Xenogen shouldn’t have the monopoly on them,” you answer. “Look at New Texas. Your mods are what put this place on the map. Without them, you’d blend in with hundreds of other agriworlds. Instead, you’ve become a high class tourist destination and the galaxy’s premiere source of milk, not to mention all regular crops you produce. Now imagine I can find the talent to produce another mod on the level of the Treatment - not necessarily the same thing but a product of similar complexity and sophistication. What about a single medipen with a dozen species and absolutely zero taint? Or a highly targeted cure for psychosis or depression without a single side effect? It’s not impossible.”
rows.translation: “改造剂才是未来，异种生物科技不该垄断它们，”你回答。“看看新德州。正是你们的改造剂让这里声名远扬。没有它们，你们只会淹没在数百个农业世界之中。可如今，你们成了高级旅游胜地，也是银河系首屈一指的牛奶产地，更不用说还生产各种常规作物。现在想象一下，如果我能找到人才，制造出另一种达到改造剂水平的产品 - 不一定是同样的东西，但复杂度和精密度相当。比如一支能适配十几个物种、污染度绝对为零的医疗注射笔怎么样？或者一种高度针对精神病或抑郁症、毫无副作用的疗法？这并非不可能。”
rows.raw: "“Mods are the future, and Xenogen shouldn’t have the monopoly on them,” you answer. “Look at New Texas. Your mods are what put this place on the map. Without them, you’d blend in with hundreds of other agriworlds. Instead, you’ve become a high class tourist destination and the galaxy’s premiere source of milk, not to mention all regular crops you produce. Now imagine I can find the talent to produce another mod on the level of the Treatment - not necessarily the same thing but a product of similar complexity and sophistication. What about a single medipen with a dozen species and absolutely zero taint? Or a highly targeted cure for psychosis or depression without a single side effect? It’s not impossible.”"

rows.original: Big T nods along at that. “Definitely not. The UGC’s been picking at our Treatment data for centuries, trying to ferret out its secrets. I don’t know how successful they’ve been, but I sure as shit haven’t seen a depression cure hit the e-net ads yet.”
rows.translation: 大T对此点头附和。“绝对没有。UGC几百年来一直在撬我们的改造疗程数据，想挖出其中的秘密。我不知道他们成功了多少，但我他妈是绝对没在电子网上见过什么抑郁症疗法的广告。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T nods along at that. “Definitely not. The UGC’s been picking at our Treatment data for centuries, trying to ferret out its secrets. I don’t know how successful they’ve been, but I sure as shit haven’t seen a depression cure hit the e-net ads yet.”"

rows.original: “Exactly. And it’s the kind of industry that’s entirely about people. Geneticists, doctors, and programmers. You don’t need a labor army if you can get a few brilliant minds working alongside you, and what better place to find the disruptive thinkers of the future than out on the Rush? Young upstarts are throwing themselves into the stars, and these new planets bring whole new perspectives and arrangements of neurons to the table. Now’s the time to steal Xenogen’s bacon, and I intended to do it.”
rows.translation: “没错。而且这种行业完全以人才为核心：遗传学家、医生和程序员。只要有几位杰出头脑与你并肩工作，就不需要一支劳工大军；还有哪里比星球热潮更适合寻找未来的颠覆性思想家？年轻的新秀正投身群星，而这些新星球带来了全新的视角和神经元排列。现在正是抢走异种生物科技饭碗的时机，而我打算这么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly. And it’s the kind of industry that’s entirely about people. Geneticists, doctors, and programmers. You don’t need a labor army if you can get a few brilliant minds working alongside you, and what better place to find the disruptive thinkers of the future than out on the Rush? Young upstarts are throwing themselves into the stars, and these new planets bring whole new perspectives and arrangements of neurons to the table. Now’s the time to steal Xenogen’s bacon, and I intended to do it.”"

rows.original: Not a single word of disagreement is uttered, in fact, Big T raises his glass in a toast. “I’ll drink to that, even if it is just milk.” He nudges Gianna playfully. “GT made me promise to stay away from the hard stuff today, and I gotta say, she was probably right to do so.” A deep, belly laugh booms across the echoing dining room.
rows.translation: 没有人吐出半句反对，事实上，大T还举杯致意。“哪怕杯里只有牛奶，这也值得喝一杯。”他顽皮地推了推吉安娜。“GT让我保证今天不碰烈酒，我得说，她这么做大概是对的。”一阵低沉的捧腹大笑响彻回荡的餐厅。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot a single word of disagreement is uttered, in fact, Big T raises his glass in a toast. “I’ll drink to that, even if it is just milk.” He nudges Gianna playfully. “GT made me promise to stay away from the hard stuff today, and I gotta say, she was probably right to do so.” A deep, belly laugh booms across the echoing dining room."

rows.original: You meet the toast, and soon you’re all chuckling away, allowing the conversation to gracefully die down for a bit. It wouldn’t do to let a home cooked meal get cold after all. However, after a few minutes of chewing and delighting in the artfully perfected flavor profile, you realize that it would be a perfect time for you to take the conversation’s reins and ask Big T a question for a change...
rows.translation: 你与他碰杯，很快大家都轻笑起来，任由谈话优雅地暂歇片刻。毕竟不能让一顿家常饭菜放凉。然而，在咀嚼了几分钟、享受精心完善的风味后，你意识到现在正适合接过谈话的缰绳，换你向大T提出一个问题...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou meet the toast, and soon you’re all chuckling away, allowing the conversation to gracefully die down for a bit. It wouldn’t do to let a home cooked meal get cold after all. However, after a few minutes of chewing and delighting in the artfully perfected flavor profile, you realize that it would be a perfect time for you to take the conversation’s reins and ask Big T a question for a change..."

rows.original: Mods
rows.translation: 身体模组
rows.raw: "Mods"

rows.original: Xenogen needs more competition.
rows.translation: 异种生物科技需要更多竞争。
rows.raw: "Xenogen needs more competition."

rows.original: Entertainment
rows.translation: 娱乐
rows.raw: "Entertainment"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You sweep out your arms theatrically. “Entertainment! That’s what the people want, and what they crave. It’s one of the only industries with potential for perpetual growth. When your home is warm and your belly is full, what do you do? Flip through the extranet for a holomovie, or a funny clip, or even dive into a completely sense-immersive game. People will always be looking for the next big thing in entertainment, which makes it the perfect medium to break into from outside.”
rows.translation: 你戏剧性地张开双臂。“娱乐业！这才是人们想要、渴望的东西。它是少数拥有永久增长潜力的行业之一。家里温暖、肚子吃饱以后，你会做什么？翻阅外联网寻找全息电影、有趣短片，甚至进入完全沉浸感官的游戏。人们永远都会寻找娱乐界的下一件大事，因此它也成了外来者进军的完美媒介。”
rows.raw: "You sweep out your arms theatrically. “Entertainment! That’s what the people want, and what they crave. It’s one of the only industries with potential for perpetual growth. When your home is warm and your belly is full, what do you do? Flip through the extranet for a holomovie, or a funny clip, or even dive into a completely sense-immersive game. People will always be looking for the next big thing in entertainment, which makes it the perfect medium to break into from outside.”"

rows.original: “But you said it yourself, people are always moving on to the next big thing,” Big T observes. “Why work so hard to grow a crop that’ll probably wither before harvest?”
rows.translation: “可你自己说过，人们总是在追逐下一个大热门，”大T评论道。“何必费那么大劲去种一茬很可能还没收割就枯萎的作物？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But you said it yourself, people are always moving on to the next big thing,” Big T observes. “Why work so hard to grow a crop that’ll probably wither before harvest?”"

rows.original: “For one, the returns can be massive in the short term - stratospheric. Sure, we could hit a dry spell where we don’t gain any traction, but when we land a home run, it could fill the coffers for a decade. And what’s more, we don’t have to give up our mining industry. It’s stable, secure profit, and it’s only going to grow after this Rush. When entertainment slips, minerals will keep the gears turning until we print our next hit, and if we somehow get pressured out of mining, we’ll at least have the marketing power to rebrand ourselves into whatever industry we want to tackle.”
rows.translation: “首先，短期回报可能高得惊人 - 直冲云霄。当然，我们可能会陷入作品毫无起色的低谷，但只要打出一记全垒打，就能填满未来十年的金库。更重要的是，我们不必放弃采矿业。它拥有稳定可靠的利润，在这次星球热潮后只会继续增长。娱乐业务下滑时，矿产会维持齿轮转动，直到我们推出下一部热门作品；要是我们不知怎么被挤出了采矿业，至少还有足够的营销力量重新塑造品牌，进军任何想要挑战的行业。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“For one, the returns can be massive in the short term - stratospheric. Sure, we could hit a dry spell where we don’t gain any traction, but when we land a home run, it could fill the coffers for a decade. And what’s more, we don’t have to give up our mining industry. It’s stable, secure profit, and it’s only going to grow after this Rush. When entertainment slips, minerals will keep the gears turning until we print our next hit, and if we somehow get pressured out of mining, we’ll at least have the marketing power to rebrand ourselves into whatever industry we want to tackle.”"

rows.original: Big T shrugs. “Not sure I follow all of yer reasoning. Seems like a gamble from my end, but to be honest, our tourism’s about the same. It surges and crashes based on what the folks in the core think is trendy, but milk keeps us plenty liquid in the asset department.” He chortles softly to himself. “Guess it’s working out for us. No reason why it couldn’t for you. I ‘preciate you cluing me in like this, [pc.name]. I do.”
rows.translation: 大T耸了耸肩。“不敢说你的道理我全听明白了。从我这头看，像是场赌博，但说实话，咱们的旅游业也差不多。它涨还是崩，全看核心区那些家伙觉得什么时髦，不过牛奶让我们在资产这块儿一直够流动。”他自顾自地轻声笑了笑。“看来这招对咱们挺管用。没道理对你就行不通。多谢你把这事透给我，[pc.name]。真的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T shrugs. “Not sure I follow all of yer reasoning. Seems like a gamble from my end, but to be honest, our tourism’s about the same. It surges and crashes based on what the folks in the core think is trendy, but milk keeps us plenty liquid in the asset department.” He chortles softly to himself. “Guess it’s working out for us. No reason why it couldn’t for you. I ‘preciate you cluing me in like this, [pc.name]. I do.”"

rows.original: Silence falls as the governor drops the subject, returning to the remaining portion of his feast. You dig in as well, unwilling to let the home cooking turn cold on your plate, and while you chew, you realize that you haven’t had much opportunity to ask any questions yourself. You finish your mouthful. Now would be the perfect time.
rows.translation: 州长结束话题，回去享用盛宴的剩余部分，房间也陷入沉默。你同样大快朵颐，不愿让盘中的家常菜变凉；咀嚼时，你意识到自己还没多少机会提出问题。你咽下嘴里的食物，现在正是绝佳时机。
rows.raw: "\n\nSilence falls as the governor drops the subject, returning to the remaining portion of his feast. You dig in as well, unwilling to let the home cooking turn cold on your plate, and while you chew, you realize that you haven’t had much opportunity to ask any questions yourself. You finish your mouthful. Now would be the perfect time."

rows.original: Entertainment
rows.translation: 娱乐
rows.raw: "Entertainment"

rows.original: Entertainment is where it’s at - an industry that can’t dry up like a well or mineshaft.
rows.translation: 娱乐业才是最靠谱的行当——这产业不会像水井或矿井那样枯竭。
rows.raw: "Entertainment is where it’s at - an industry that can’t dry up like a well or mineshaft."

rows.original: Weapons
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: “I’m definitely going to push the company’s weapons development department. One thing the Rush has shown me is just how often survival can come down to the end of a barrel or the point of a spear. Too many people think that might makes right, and if those people have the biggest guns...”
rows.translation: “我肯定会推动公司的武器研发部门。星球热潮让我明白，生存往往取决于枪管末端或长矛尖端。太多人认为强权即真理，而如果那些人拥有最大的枪...”
rows.raw: "“I’m definitely going to push the company’s weapons development department. One thing the Rush has shown me is just how often survival can come down to the end of a barrel or the point of a spear. Too many people think that might makes right, and if those people have the biggest guns...”"

rows.original: Big T nods, “There’s no convincing a sonofabitch so determined to feel right that he’ll put a hole in your head to do it. I know. Met a few in my day. Mostly dead or in jail now, thank God. I take it you’re saying you ain’t one of them people?”
rows.translation: 大T点点头，“一个狗娘养的要是执意证明自己正确，甚至不惜在你脑袋上开个洞，那就没法说服他。我知道，这辈子遇见过几个。谢天谢地，现在多半已经死了或进了监狱。我猜你是说自己不属于那类人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T nods, “There’s no convincing a sonofabitch so determined to feel right that he’ll put a hole in your head to do it. I know. Met a few in my day. Mostly dead or in jail now, thank God. I take it you’re saying you ain’t one of them people?”"

rows.original: “You got it.” You smile warmly at Gianna. “The galaxy needs its best weapons in the right hands, not toted by every two bit pirate with a chip on his shoulder. There’s no way the Black Void scored that much military-grade Reaper gear without the help of somebody on the inside, or the whole damn corp being so rotten that they don’t care whose colony gets flattened by a capital ship grade rail cannon. It’s rough out there.”
rows.translation: “没错。”你温暖地对吉安娜微笑。“银河系需要让最好的武器掌握在正确的人手中，而不是由每个心怀怨恨的三流海盗扛着。若没有内部人员协助，黑色虚空不可能弄到那么多军用级收割者装备；要不就是整家公司已经腐烂到根本不在乎谁的殖民地会被主力舰级轨道炮夷平。外面的日子很艰难。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You got it.” You smile warmly at Gianna. “The galaxy needs its best weapons in the right hands, not toted by every two bit pirate with a chip on his shoulder. There’s no way the Black Void scored that much military-grade Reaper gear without the help of somebody on the inside, or the whole damn corp being so rotten that they don’t care whose colony gets flattened by a capital ship grade rail cannon. It’s rough out there.”"

rows.original: Big T nods silently.
rows.translation: 大T默默地点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T nods silently."

rows.original: “But we already have the mineral acquisition and refinement down. That means we don’t have to rely on outside suppliers for material, and I know we have to have a decent amount of manufacturing prowess scattered around. There are Steele Tech weapons out there. Sure, the Terran military won’t come crawling to us as their first choice for a refit, but that can change. We just need the right products and the right minds to devise them. We already have a pretty good reputation, ethically. We leverage that right, and we can pull talent that wouldn’t touch the other corps - people with the skills to invent the next big thing, but only if it’s handled responsibly.” You nod. “That’s the idea anyway, responsible weapons development.”
rows.translation: “但矿物采集和精炼这块我们已经搞定了。这意味着原料方面不必依赖外部供应商，而且我知道我们各处应该散布着相当可观的制造实力。外面确实有斯蒂尔科技的武器。当然，地球军方不会把我们当成改装装备的首选对象，但这可以改变。我们只需要合适的产品，以及能设计出那些产品的合适人才。我们在道德方面已经享有相当好的声誉。只要善加利用，就能吸引到那些绝不会碰其他企业的人才——他们有本事发明下一个划时代的东西，前提是研发过程必须负责任。”你点点头。“总之，理念就是负责任地研发武器。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But we already have the mineral acquisition and refinement down. That means we don’t have to rely on outside suppliers for material, and I know we have to have a decent amount of manufacturing prowess scattered around. There are Steele Tech weapons out there. Sure, the Terran military won’t come crawling to us as their first choice for a refit, but that can change. We just need the right products and the right minds to devise them. We already have a pretty good reputation, ethically. We leverage that right, and we can pull talent that wouldn’t touch the other corps - people with the skills to invent the next big thing, but only if it’s handled responsibly.” You nod. “That’s the idea anyway, responsible weapons development.”"

rows.original: “That’s something I can drink to, not that I have any beer handy.” Big T raises his glass, clinking it against your own. “GT made me promise to skip on the beer, but I guess it was a good idea to stay sharp, feasting the ol’ brainmeats like this.” He chuckles before digging back into his own plate. “Don’t let it get cold now.”
rows.translation: “这话值得喝一杯，虽然我手头没有啤酒。”大T举起杯子，跟你的杯子碰了一下。“GT让我保证不碰啤酒，不过像这样喂饱这老脑子、保持清醒，倒也是个好主意。”他轻笑一声，又埋头吃起自己那盘。“别让它凉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s something I can drink to, not that I have any beer handy.” Big T raises his glass, clinking it against your own. “GT made me promise to skip on the beer, but I guess it was a good idea to stay sharp, feasting the ol’ brainmeats like this.” He chuckles before digging back into his own plate. “Don’t let it get cold now.”"

rows.original: You don’t. You dig right in, letting the conversation lapse. While you work on eating, you realize that you haven’t had a chance to do much asking of your own. Maybe you could guide the conversation for a change. Is there something you’d like to ask Big T?
rows.translation: 你没有。你直接埋头吃起来，任由谈话暂时中断。吃着吃着，你意识到自己还没什么机会提出问题。也许这次可以由你来引导话题。你有什么想问大T的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t. You dig right in, letting the conversation lapse. While you work on eating, you realize that you haven’t had a chance to do much asking of your own. Maybe you could guide the conversation for a change. Is there something you’d like to ask Big T?"

rows.original: Weapons
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Arms dealing is the way to go.
rows.translation: 军火生意才是正路。
rows.raw: "Arms dealing is the way to go."

rows.original: How do you respond?
rows.translation: 你要怎么回答？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow do you respond?"

rows.original: No Promise
rows.translation: 不作保证
rows.raw: "No Promise"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: “I can’t promise that.” You stop eating for a moment. “It’s an impossible question. You’re asking me how I’ll accomplish an unrealistic task. Even if I lived here, what’s stopping that mystery Dzaan from drugging me and abducting me? Nothing but luck, same as is space. The only difference is that out there, we’ll have the choice about when we want to take risks - and when we want to come here to hunker down and enjoy this cooking.” You nod to Big T before digging back into the potatoes. “I can tell you I’ll do my damnedest to keep her safe, not only because I care about her, but because it’s in my self interest to do so.”
rows.translation: “这我没法保证。”你停下进食。“这是个无法回答的问题。你是在问我要如何完成一项不切实际的任务。就算我住在这里，谁能阻止那个神秘的德赞给我下药再绑走我？什么都阻止不了，只能靠运气，和在太空里一样。唯一的区别是，到了外面，我们可以选择什么时候冒险——又什么时候回到这里躲避风头，享受这些饭菜。”你朝大T点点头，又继续吃起土豆。“我可以告诉你，我会拼尽全力保护她，不仅是因为我在乎她，还因为这样做符合我自己的利益。”
rows.raw: "“I can’t promise that.” You stop eating for a moment. “It’s an impossible question. You’re asking me how I’ll accomplish an unrealistic task. Even if I lived here, what’s stopping that mystery Dzaan from drugging me and abducting me? Nothing but luck, same as is space. The only difference is that out there, we’ll have the choice about when we want to take risks - and when we want to come here to hunker down and enjoy this cooking.” You nod to Big T before digging back into the potatoes. “I can tell you I’ll do my damnedest to keep her safe, not only because I care about her, but because it’s in my self interest to do so.”"

rows.original: Big T’s brow drops. He didn’t like the sound of that last bit.
rows.translation: 大T眉头一沉。他不喜欢最后那句话的意味。
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T’s brow drops. He didn’t like the sound of that last bit."

rows.original: “In space, our fates are more or less entwined. If something bad happens to her, it’s going to happen to me too, and if something happens to me while I’m away from the ship...” you sigh, “...then there won’t be anything stopping her from using my ride to get home. The Rush isn’t like the core. Customs are virtually nonexistent, and filing flight plans is something only freighters worry about.” You glance to Gianna. “I don’t want to lose her, though. I really don’t. It’s why I’m here, sitting down for dinner with you while the other Rushers are scooping up credits by the billions. Because of Gianna. She’s worth it.”
rows.translation: “在太空里，我们的命运多少是绑在一起的。要是她出了什么事，我也会一起遭殃；要是我离开飞船时出了什么事...”你叹了口气，“...那也就没人能阻止她开着我的船回家。星球淘金热地带可不像核心区。那里几乎没有海关，只有货船才会操心申报飞行计划。”你看向吉安娜。“但我不想失去她。真的不想。这就是为什么我会坐在这里陪你吃晚饭，而其他淘金客正以十亿为单位捞取信用点。都是为了吉安娜。她值得。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In space, our fates are more or less entwined. If something bad happens to her, it’s going to happen to me too, and if something happens to me while I’m away from the ship...” you sigh, “...then there won’t be anything stopping her from using my ride to get home. The Rush isn’t like the core. Customs are virtually nonexistent, and filing flight plans is something only freighters worry about.” You glance to Gianna. “I don’t want to lose her, though. I really don’t. It’s why I’m here, sitting down for dinner with you while the other Rushers are scooping up credits by the billions. Because of Gianna. She’s worth it.”"

rows.original: “Hawww!” Big T slaps his leg. “That’s all ya had to say, partner. So let’s brush that one under the table. Ain’t nobody gonna handle getting hooked on some dzaan turboslut anyhow. What about your company? Gotta be going back to it after the Rush, right? What you think you’re gonna do with it? Focus on mining and resource acquisition like your daddy, may he rest peace, or branch out? Steele Tech’s got its fingers in a lot of pies, but it’s only a major player in one or two. I figure you got some plan by now, more than 20 years in the making.”
rows.translation: “哈——！”大T一拍大腿。“你早这么说不就行了，伙计。那咱们就把这事揭过去吧。反正谁都应付不了对某个德赞超级荡妇上瘾的事。那你的公司呢？淘金热结束后总得回去接手，对吧？你打算拿它怎么办？像你老爸那样专注于采矿和资源收购，愿他安息，还是拓展别的业务？斯蒂尔科技涉足的领域不少，但真正占据主要地位的也就一两个。我想你现在应该已经有计划了，毕竟酝酿了二十多年。”

rows.original: You violently shake your head in denial. “Not a chance in hell. I don’t throw away my friends and lovers just for some good sex, not even if it’s addictive. Hell, I’d just have to charm that leithan or dzaan into joining the crew. And ya know what then? Then Gianna’d have two people to play with, maybe even the chance to fill up on whatever twisted alien chemicals our mystery lover has, so she could feed it to me when I need my fix.” You nod firmly to the affable bull. “I don’t abandon my friends. If you ask me, it’s the rest of the galaxy that needs to worry about getting swept off their feet.” You shoot a finger gun at Gianna.
rows.translation: 你猛烈摇头否认。“绝无可能。我不会只为一场好炮就抛弃朋友和爱人，哪怕那玩意会让人上瘾。真要那样，我只需哄那个莱坦人或德赞加入船员。然后你猜怎么着？吉安娜就有两个人陪她玩了，甚至还能从我们的神秘情人那里装满那些古怪的外星化学物质，等我犯瘾时再喂给我。”你坚定地朝这头和善的公牛点头。“我不会抛弃朋友。要我说，该担心被迷得神魂颠倒的是银河系其他人。”你朝吉安娜比了个手枪手势。

rows.original: “Courage has its uses, [pc.name].” Big T doesn’t look impressed. “But bravado is a double-edged sword. I’ve seen bulls bigger than starfighters felled by a short-stack’s psi-beams. I watched a man with the willpower to train for ten hours a day fall to the sweet seduction of woman’s pheromones, now little more than a blubbering mess of fat and lust. No person is an immovable object, but the galaxy? She’s an unstoppable force ain’t nobody can prepare for. Rigid conviction don’t matter near as much as the ability to adapt to what comes at you. Anything else is just tears in the rain...” He looks off far away, as if remembering some long forgotten trauma.
rows.translation: “勇气有勇气的用处，[pc.name]。”大T看起来并未受到打动。“但逞强是一把双刃剑。我见过比星际战机还大的公牛倒在一个矮个子的灵能射线下。我见过一个意志坚强到每天训练十小时的男人，拜倒在女人甜美的信息素诱惑下，如今只剩一团流着口水、满是肥肉和欲望的烂泥。没有人是不可撼动的物体，可银河系呢？她是一股无人能够防备的不可阻挡之力。僵化的信念远不如适应迎面而来之事的能力重要。除此之外的一切，都不过是雨中的泪水...”他望向远方，仿佛回忆起某段早已被遗忘的创伤。

No person is an immovable object, but the galaxy? She’s an unstoppable force ain’t nobody can prepare for. Rigid conviction don’t matter near as much as the ability to adapt to what comes at you. Anything else is just tears in the rain...” He looks off far away, as if remembering some long forgotten trauma."

rows.original: You clear your throat, turning to look Big T straight in the eye. “I’m not any of those people. I’m [pc.name] Steele. I don’t fuck up like that, and if I was going to, it would be because I wanted to. And you know what? I’d have the courtesy to drop her off here if I was going to. I own my ship, and I plot my own course. That puts me well above the rest of this debt-ridden excuse for a galaxy in my books.” You fold your arms across your chest proudly.
rows.translation: 你清了清嗓子，转头直视大T的眼睛。“我跟那些人都不一样。我是[pc.name] 斯蒂尔。我不会那样搞砸，如果我真要搞砸，那也是因为我想。而且你知道吗？如果我真要那么做，我至少会有那份礼数，把她送到这里来。船是我的，航线也是我自己定的。在我看来，这让我远远高过这个负债累累、勉强算个银河的其余所有人。”你骄傲地双臂抱胸。

I own my ship, and I plot my own course. That puts me well above the rest of this debt-ridden excuse for a galaxy in my books.” You fold your arms across your chest proudly."

rows.original: Gianna watches the exchange, wide-eyed and unsure.
rows.translation: 吉安娜睁大眼睛、不知所措地看着这番交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna watches the exchange, wide-eyed and unsure."

rows.original: “You don’t back down easy, kid. I’ll give you that.” T raises his glass to you before taking another sip. “If you answer all your challenges with that sorta fire in your eyes, well, I can get behind that. Just make sure you keep it pointed in the right direction. Heat like that has a way of cooking everything around it.” He nods. “Makes me wonder though, what are your plans for Steele Tech... Gonna get into the military game? Try to crush Reaper Armaments and turn yourself into the premiere weapons vendor? After all that, it sounds like something you might want. Strength begets strength, right?”
rows.translation: “你小子不轻易服软，这点我服。”T 朝你举了举杯子，又啜了一口。“要是你面对所有挑战时，眼里都带着那股火，那我倒是能支持。只是别忘了把它对准正确的方向。那样的火候，最容易把周围的一切都烤熟。”他点点头。“不过我倒挺好奇，你对斯蒂尔科技有什么打算... 要进军军工？想着碾平收割者军械、把自己做成头号武器供应商？说到底，那听起来像是你可能会想要的东西。强盛招来强盛，对吧？”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hrmph. Still not much of an answer.” The governor turns to his adoptive daughter. “I just want to keep you safe, kiddo. Really.”"

rows.translation: 吉安娜腼腆地笑了，皮肤微微泛红。“我知道，爸爸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGianna smiles meekly, skin going a little rosy. “I know, Daddy.”"

rows.original: “[pc.name].” Big T drops your name like a hammer. “Jus’ so you know, I appreciate a good joke as much as the next bull, but one thing I don’t joke around about is keeping me and mine safe.” He reaches out to rub Gianna’s shoulder fondly, fingers as thick as screwdriver handles careful on her flawless synthskin. “But if she’s fine with it, so be it... I’m no stranger to diplomacy.” He polishes off his milk, wipes away the resultant mustache, and refills his glass from a dew-covered pitcher. “Matter of fact, you’re gonna be in need of some post-Rush, aren’t ya? Got plans for running Steele Tech? Gonna branch out into the entertainment industry for a change, or try something else? I’m sure you have some ideas, growing up your whole life in Vic’s shadow.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]。”大T像落锤般砸下你的名字。“先说明白，我和其他公牛一样喜欢好笑话，但有一件事我绝不开玩笑，那就是保护我和我的家人。”他伸手慈爱地揉了揉吉安娜的肩膀，手指粗得像螺丝刀柄，却小心翼翼地抚过她无瑕的合成皮肤。“不过既然她不介意，那就这样吧... 外交这事我也不陌生。”他喝光牛奶，擦掉留下的奶胡子，又从挂着露珠的水罐中倒满杯子。“说起来，淘金热结束后你也得找点事做，对吧？有经营斯蒂尔科技的计划吗？打算破例进军娱乐产业，还是尝试别的？你这一辈子都活在维克的阴影下，肯定有些想法吧。”

rows.original: Rocking back on his chair, Big T nods approvingly. “That’s an answer I can respect. Didn’t lie. Didn’t pretend you’re infallible, but promised me 110% anyway.” He waves his hand. “Not really any better answer to, ‘how do you guarantee something you can’t?’ Just be careful with how quickly you pledge yerself to things. The easier you make promises, the more you’ll break them, and broken promises aren’t like bones. They don’t heal nearly so easy.”
rows.translation: 大T向后靠在椅子上，赞许地点了点头。“这答案我尊重。没撒谎。没装成自己不会出错，可还是跟我保证 110%。”他挥了挥手。“对‘你怎么保证一件你保证不了的事？’这问题，真没更好的答案了。只是别太快把自己许给什么事。承诺给得越轻易，违背的就越多，而背弃的承诺不像骨头。它们可没那么容易长好。”

rows.original: Big T polishes off his milk and goes for another, pouring a crisp, full glass from a pitcher so chilly it drips with dew. “Well, what about after the Rush? You give any thoughts to what you’ll do with Steele Tech once you slide into the pilot’s seat? The market pages have been wild with speculation ever since yer daddy passed, may he rest in peace.” He bows his head respectfully. “I’ve heard tell of everything from rushing into the weapons market to trying to muscle into Xenogen’s share of the mod market. Ain’t no secret Steele Tech’s dipped its toes into that shark-infested pool from time to time.”
rows.translation: 大T 把牛奶喝干，又要了一杯，从一个冰得直滴水珠的壶里倒出满满一杯清冽的牛奶。“那么，冲刺赛之后呢？等你坐进驾驶座，对斯蒂尔科技有什么打算，想过没有？自打你爹过世以后，市场版面上那些猜测可是闹翻了天，愿他安息。”他恭敬地低下头。“我听人说过的说法可多了，从杀进武器市场，到硬挤进泽诺根在改造件市场那杯羹里。斯蒂尔科技时不时把脚伸进那片鲨鱼横行的水域，这可不是什么秘密。”

rows.original: Big T cocks his head. “What do you mean by that? I heard they can take pills to be less addictive, but nothing about something to make you immune to ‘em.”
rows.translation: 大T歪了歪头。“你这话是什么意思？我听说它们有药片可以降低成瘾性，但没听说过有什么能让人对它们免疫的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T cocks his head. “What do you mean by that? I heard they can take pills to be less addictive, but nothing about something to make you immune to ‘em.”"

rows.original: “Because I’m already addicted!” You jerk your thumb over your shoulder, back toward the giant barn of a spaceport. “Got my own alpha back on the ship after I saved her from some slavers in a pirate base around Zhèng Shi. A real cutie that one. I guess I just couldn’t keep her jizz out of my mouth, and uh...” Your mouth is suddenly dry, wishing that the salty food you were shoveling in was pure, unadulterated Ardia-spunk. You lick your [pc.lipsChaste]. “Yeah, I’m kind of hooked on her, but it’s not like she can drag me off somewhere, because she’s coming with me, not the other way around. Gianna and her are going to get along fabulously, I’m sure.”
rows.translation: “因为我已经上瘾了！”你用拇指指向身后，指向那座巨型谷仓般的太空港。“我在郑石附近一座海盗基地从奴隶贩子手里救出了自己的阿尔法，她现在就在船上。那姑娘可爱极了。我想我就是忍不住让她的精液流进嘴里，然后，呃...”你的嘴突然干了，真希望刚才塞进嘴里的咸食是纯粹、未经稀释的阿迪娅精液。你舔了舔[pc.lipsChaste]。“对，我算是对她上瘾了，但她又不能把我拖去什么地方，因为是她跟我走，不是我跟她走。我相信吉安娜和她一定会相处得非常融洽。”

A real cutie that one. Gianna and her are going to get along fabulously, I’m sure.”"

rows.original: Gianna actually smirks at that, somehow not surprised by the admission in the slightest. Maybe her sensors picked it up already? Regardless, she seems pleased by the opportunity for additional socialization among the stars - another potential friend (or lover!) in the making.
rows.translation: 吉安娜竟然露出了坏笑，对这番坦白似乎丝毫不感到意外。也许她的传感器早就察觉了？无论如何，她似乎很期待在群星之间获得更多社交机会——又一位潜在的朋友（或爱人！）即将出现。

rows.original: “Huh.” A wrinkle of concern works across Big T’s face. “Didn’t expect ya to say that. Didn’t expect anyone to say that. Dzaan alphas are usually a heap of trouble. Had to arrest more than one of them for trying to rustle up some New Texan cattle, if you get my meaning.” There’s respect in his voice, but something else too. Concern? “Not sure what it says about you that you got addicted in the first place. Doesn’t exactly reek of sound judgement. More like the foolish risk a teenager would take.”
rows.translation: “嗯。”大T脸上掠过一道担忧的皱纹。“没想到你会这么说。没想到会有人这么说。德赞阿尔法通常都是天大的麻烦。我还抓过不止一个，罪名是想偷新德克萨斯人的牛，你懂我意思吧。”他语气里带着敬意，但也掺着点别的东西。担忧？“你一开始就上了瘾，我真不知道这说明你什么。这可闻不出多少明智判断的味道。更像是小年轻才会冒的蠢险。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh.” A wrinkle of concern works across Big T’s face. “Didn’t expect ya to say that. Didn’t expect anyone to say that. Dzaan alphas are usually a heap of trouble. Had to arrest more than one of them for trying to rustle up some New Texan cattle, if you get my meaning.” There’s respect in his voice, but something else too. Concern? “Not sure what it says about you that you got addicted in the first place. Doesn’t exactly reek of sound judgement. More like the foolish risk a teenager would take.”"

rows.original: You raise your finger to object, but he’s right. It’s exactly like a teenager to think themselves special or somehow immune from the obvious consequences of their actions. “But hey, it worked out, right?”
rows.translation: 你抬起手指想反驳，但他说得对。以为自己是特别的，或者以为什么方式能免于自己行为显而易见的后果，这完全是青少年的想法。“不过嘿，结果不是挺好的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your finger to object, but he’s right. It’s exactly like a teenager to think themselves special or somehow immune from the obvious consequences of their actions. “But hey, it worked out, right?”"

rows.original: “It did. Maybe you got your daddy’s luck. You don’t get as far as he did without it.” He scratches his ear. “But you make a compelling point. Maybe that hypotheti-macal leithan winds up joining your ship too, toting you around as your personal caddy. I could see it.” He nods. “But talking about your daddy reminds me, what about Steele Tech? I’m sure you must be figuring on running the show after you get done sowing your oats on the Rush. Surely you got some plans for the ol’ mining company of your own. You had what, 20 years to come up with ‘em? Maybe you’ll try and muscle out Xenogen? I know Steele Tech’s got some mod tech of its own, even if it never got as big as Xenogen’s products.”
rows.translation: “确实如此。也许你继承了你老爸的运气。没那运气，他也走不了那么远。”他挠了挠耳朵。“不过你说得很有道理。也许那个假设中的莱坦人最后也会上你的船，像私人球童一样把你带来带去。我能想象。”他点点头。“不过说到你老爸，我就想起斯蒂尔科技。等你在淘金热里播完野种后，肯定打算接掌大局吧。我相信你对这家老矿业公司肯定有自己的计划。你有多久，二十年，来琢磨这些了？也许你会试着挤掉异源生物科技？我知道斯蒂尔科技也有自己的改造技术，只是从未像异源生物科技的产品那样做大。”

rows.original: Minutes pass in relative quiet as the group returns to enjoying the sumptuous repast. Big T spoons heaping mountains of alternate foods in quick succession. First some grits, then some more barbecue. Then a quick swallow of milk to wash it down before venturing into the potatoes. As he chews, you can tell he’s thinking, his brow ever so slightly furrowed as he considers the next question.
rows.translation: 众人重新享用丰盛的饭菜，几分钟在相对安静中流逝。大T接连舀起堆得像小山一样的各种食物。先是玉米糁，然后又是烤肉。接着迅速咽下一口牛奶冲食，才开始进攻土豆。咀嚼时，你看得出他在思考；考虑下一个问题时，他的眉头微微皱起。
rows.raw: "Minutes pass in relative quiet as the group returns to enjoying the sumptuous repast. Big T spoons heaping mountains of alternate foods in quick succession. First some grits, then some more barbecue. Then a quick swallow of milk to wash it down before venturing into the potatoes. As he chews, you can tell he’s thinking, his brow ever so slightly furrowed as he considers the next question."

rows.original: Gianna’s leg daringly stretches under the table toward you, mischievously stroking her bare toes against your thigh. Those wiggly digits climb higher and higher, tickling at sensitive skin until it’s a struggle not to squirm. All the while, she feigns complete indifference, picking through her palette of sumptuous flavor.
rows.translation: 吉安娜的腿大胆地从桌下朝你伸来，光裸的脚趾调皮地摩挲着你的大腿。那些扭动的脚趾越爬越高，搔弄着敏感肌肤，让你几乎忍不住扭动身体。与此同时，她却装作完全不在意，细细品尝着盘中丰盛的滋味。

All the while, she feigns complete indifference, picking through her palette of sumptuous flavor."

rows.original: Gianna’s leg stretches under the table to find your [pc.foot], though instead of getting into any hanky-panky, her toes reassuring drum against you as if to say, “Don’t worry. I’m right here with you.” Even when inundated with countless distilled flavors and her adoptive dad’s presence, she works to keep your spirits high.
rows.translation: 吉安娜从桌下伸腿去碰你的[pc.foot]，不过她没有做什么轻浮举动，而是用脚趾令人安心地轻叩着你，仿佛在说：“别担心。我就在你身边。”即便沉浸在无数浓缩风味和养父的陪伴中，她仍努力让你振作起来。

rows.original: Gianna slowly picks at her palette of sumptuous flavors, her luminous eyes casually wandering between her future owner and adoptive father. It seems like she’s making a point of being quiet to allow the organics at the table time to finish intaking their sustenance.

rows.original: “I wouldn’t,” you answer. “It works for you. It helped turn your planet into one of the galaxy’s premiere tourist darlings. Your milk is like white gold. Untold billions flow into your pockets because of it.” You gesture broadly at the planet beyond. “Suicide is a problem of the past. Depression? Wiped out. It works for you, and at this point, it’s as much a part of your cultural identity as the name ‘New Texas’ itself.”
rows.translation: “我不会改，”你回答。“它很适合你们。它帮助你们的星球成为银河系最受欢迎的旅游宠儿之一。你们的牛奶就像白色黄金。数不清的几十亿信用点因此流进你们的口袋。”你朝外面的星球宽泛地一挥手。“自杀已经成了过去的问题。抑郁？被一扫而空。它很适合你们，而且到了现在，它已经像‘新德克萨斯’这个名字本身一样，成为你们文化认同的一部分。”

It works for you, and at this point, it’s as much a part of your cultural identity as the name ‘New Texas’ itself.”"

rows.original: Big T nods along at each point in sequence. “Ayup.” He winks at Gianna. “It’s one of the reasons GT here stuck around as long as she did. This little firecracker loves making people happy, and New Texans? We love bein’ happy.” He chuckles, a deep, full-throated thing. “Ain’t that right, sugarplum?”
rows.translation: 大T按顺序逐条点头。“没错。”他朝吉安娜眨眨眼。“这也是GT在这里待了这么久的原因之一。这个小辣椒喜欢让人开心，而新德克萨斯人呢？我们就喜欢开心。”他发出浑厚、响亮的笑声。“对不对，小甜心？”

rows.original: Gianna flushes hotly. You get the impression she’s doing it as much for Big T as any actual embarrassment, half simulation of biological processes, half a show for her father. “It’s true.” She leans your way. “I may miss out on most of the sex around here, but I once gave a cow-girl a shoulder rub so good she squirted. You can’t imagine how nice that felt for me. Just... contentment.”
rows.translation: 吉安娜顿时羞得发烫。你觉得她这么做与其说是真的尴尬，不如说有一半是为了配合大T——一半是在模拟生物过程，一半是在父亲面前做戏。“是真的。”她朝你这边倾来。“我也许错过了这里大部分的性爱，但我曾经给一个奶牛女孩按摩肩膀，舒服得让她喷了出来。你无法想象那让我有多愉快。就是... 满足。”

It’d be a PR disaster for [pc.name], not to mention the planet’s reputation - not that it isn’t the stuff of dreams for a girl like me.” She sighs breathily. “Of course I’d accept if [pc.name] asked me. I’d do it in a nanosecond. It would be my pleasure.” She all but exhales the word in a cloud of sensuality, leaving no doubts as to how the wedding night would be spent.
rows.translation: 吉安娜像被打了一下似的缩了缩。“爸爸...我爱你，可是...别忘了我是仿生人。这对[pc.name]会是一场公关灾难，更别提这颗星球的名声了 - 倒不是说这对像我这样的女孩不是梦寐以求的事。”她气息急促地叹了口气。“要是[pc.name]问我，我当然会答应。我会在一纳秒之内答应。那是我的荣幸。”她几乎是把那个词随着一团性感的气息吐出来，让人毫不怀疑洞房花烛夜会怎么过。

I’d do it in a nanosecond. It would be my pleasure.” She all but exhales the word in a cloud of sensuality, leaving no doubts as to how the wedding night would be spent."

rows.original: You try to pick your words carefully, letting the idea of a wedding fall by the wayside. “I guess, I wouldn’t want to live here because I don’t really like what the Treatment does to people.” Right away, you hold up your hands and say, “Present company excluded of course, but it’s not something I would want for myself. It makes a lot of changes up top that I’m just not comfortable with.” You tap at your forehead. “This might sound crazy coming from someone visiting New Texas and asking to take a companion with [pc.himHer] into space, but sometimes it’s nice talking to girls that don’t want to screw.”
rows.translation: 你努力谨慎斟酌措辞，把婚礼的想法搁到一旁。“我想，我不愿住在这里，是因为我不太喜欢改造疗程对人造成的影响。”你立刻举起双手说道：“当然，在场各位除外，但这不是我希望自己接受的东西。它对脑子造成了许多改变，让我很不自在。”你点了点额头。“这话从一个来新德克萨斯游玩、还想带一名伴侣跟[pc.himHer]进入太空的人嘴里说出来，也许听着很荒唐，可有时候，和不想做爱的女孩聊聊天也挺好的。”

rows.original: Big T sets down a fully-loaded fork, staring straight at you. His nostrils flare. Beside him, Gianna’s face goes flat. She’d rather completely disable her emotional output subroutines than dare further inflame what feels like an incredibly intense situation. The governor folds his hands in front of him, cracking one knuckle loudly as he thinks. “It took a lot of balls to say that to me.”
rows.translation: 大T把一把堆满食物的叉子放下，直直盯着你。他的鼻孔张了张。在他身边，吉安娜的脸沉了下来。她宁可彻底关掉自己的情绪输出子程序，也不愿再给这个感觉极度紧张的局面添一点火。这位总督在身前交叠双手，思考时把一根指节按得咔哒作响。“敢对我说那种话，你胆子不小。”

rows.translation: “胆子比我的保镖还大。更糟的是，这话他妈诚实得让我知道你是认真的。”他抽了抽鼻子。“妈的，我都闻得出来。最糟糕的是，我并非完全不同意你。”

rows.original: “I knew I liked little GT here the moment I met her. Didn’t know why.” Big T shrugs. “She smelled all wrong. Like a machine, not a person. Didn’t have a whiff o’ pheromones about her, cept whatever her last screw left clinging on. But I loved talking to her, [pc.name]. This girl’s something special. She jaws away, and it makes sense.” He clears his throat, reaching for a long pull of milk to buy time as he searches for the right words. “She’ll notice things about you that you ain’t never seen before. She’ll help you with things you didn’t even know you needed help with. There’s some faux cows out here a bit like her, but they ain’t so good at talking with an assful of dick.”
rows.translation: “我见到小GT的那一刻就知道自己喜欢她，只是不知道为什么。”大T耸耸肩。“她闻起来完全不对。像机器，不像人。身上没有一丝信息素的味道，除了上一个操她的人留下的那一点。不过我喜欢和她聊天，[pc.name]。这姑娘很特别。她滔滔不绝地说话，而且说得有道理。”他清了清嗓子，长饮一口牛奶来争取时间，寻找合适的措辞。“她会注意到你身上一些你从未发现的事。她会在你根本不知道自己需要帮助的地方帮你。这里有些伪奶牛和她有点像，但屁股里塞满鸡巴时，她们可没这么会说话。”

rows.original: Trying your best to banish a blush from the prospect of marriage, you try to steady for your voice for your answer. “It’s a tempting offer. It really is, but there’s a whole galaxy out there waiting to be explored. I have to go on the Rush.” You stab into your potato, hard. “Forget about Steele Tech if I don’t. They’ll implode or turn into the very worst sort of corporation. I shouldn’t say more.” Taking a quick bite, you tilt your head in Big T’s direction while you chew. “I almost wish I could take that offer. It sounds... relaxing... compared to what I have to do.”
rows.translation: 想到结婚这件事，你竭力压下脸红，努力稳住声音作答。“这是个诱人的提议。真的很诱人，但外面还有整片银河等待探索。我必须参加星球淘金热。”你用力把叉子刺进土豆。“如果我不去，就别提斯蒂尔科技了。他们要么会垮掉，要么会变成最糟糕的那类公司。我不该再多说。”你迅速咬了一口，咀嚼时把头偏向大T。“我几乎希望自己能接受那个提议。和我必须做的事相比，那听起来... 很轻松...”

rows.original: Smiling merrily, you counter, “But what if I wanted her to stay with me, at Steele Tech’s headquarters? Maybe marriage won’t be in the cards, back in the core, but that doesn’t stop New Texas from having a connection to the galaxy’s premiere megacorp.” You take a small bite of potato, allowing the suspense to build. “Think about it. Gianna and I brave the Rush. Sure, it’s dangerous, but think of the connections we could make and the resources we could discover. We could be as wealthy as my dad ever was - before I set foot in the boardroom. And as for that risk?” You shrug. “You said it yourself. I’m Victor Steele’s [pc.sonDaughter]. If I handle the Rush half as well as he did...”
rows.translation: 你愉快地微笑着反问：“可要是我想让她跟我一起住在斯蒂尔科技总部呢？回到核心区后，也许结婚并不在计划之内，但这并不妨碍新德克萨斯与银河系首屈一指的超级企业建立联系。”你小口咬下土豆，任由悬念积聚。“想想吧。吉安娜和我勇闯星球淘金热。当然，这很危险，但想想我们可以建立的人脉和发现的资源。我们可以在我踏进董事会之前，就变得像我老爸曾经那样富有。至于那份风险？”你耸耸肩。“你自己也说了。我是维克托·斯蒂尔的[pc.sonDaughter]。只要我应对星球淘金热的本事有他一半...”

rows.original: He snorts. “...A counter offer like that? Shit! You’re definitely yer daddy’s sprout. Gonna be a shark in the boardroom in a few years, mark my words.” He stuffs his face with a bit of barbecue, swishing his milk around his glass before washing it down. “Damn fine way of avoiding commenting on my offer itself. Doesn’t show none of yer hand but you wanna show, and from where I’m sitting, it’s a real strong one.” He stares, sharp-eyed and probing for a few seconds while his nostrils flare. “I’d have to be ten kinds of plastered to pass up an offer like that. You’re a sharp one, you are.” He jabs his fork in your direction, nodding along.

Big T’s fork dangles in the air, still heaped with steaming smoked meat. Gianna’s fingers hang unfeelingly over her plate while her eyes flicker, her artificially created mind racing through a thousand possibilities at its highest possible clock speed.

rows.original: , scritching you in that spot right behind the ears that gets your tail wagging
rows.translation: ，挠在你耳后那个能让尾巴摇起来的地方
rows.raw: ", scritching you in that spot right behind the ears that gets your tail wagging"

rows.original: . “Why don’t we go for a walk? Some fresh air will lift those spirits, and afterward I can cook you that recipe I got from Yammi - this time without the aphrodisiacs.” She giggles. “Promise.”
rows.translation: 。“我们去散散步怎么样？新鲜空气会让你振作起来；之后我可以给你做雅米交给我的那道菜——这次不加催情剂。”她咯咯笑道。“保证。”
rows.raw: ". “Why don’t we go for a walk? Some fresh air will lift those spirits, and afterward I can cook you that recipe I got from Yammi - this time without the aphrodisiacs.” She giggles. “Promise.”"

rows.original: Yeah, a walk would do you some good.
rows.translation: 是啊，散散步对你有好处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, a walk would do you some good."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Many years later...
rows.translation: 许多年后...
rows.raw: "Many years later..."

rows.original: You look over your holdings on New Texas with a smile. With Gianna by your side, every venture you’ve tackled has prospered. She’s a fountain of affirmation and emotional support that you never knew you needed until you had it. When a ranch hand is slacking, she’s the one that can tell from a single glance at the daily drone flyover. When varmints get too close to your holdings, she’s the one that answers the door with your favorite gun and a backpack of spare ammo. Gianna isn’t just your companion in the bedroom, she’s there for everything, putting every ounce of her artificially developed intellect to work to help you succeed.
rows.translation: 你微笑着审视自己在新德克萨斯的产业。有吉安娜陪在身边，经手的每一项事业都蒸蒸日上。她如同源源不绝的肯定和情感支持；直到拥有以后，你才知道自己一直需要这些。牧场工人偷懒时，她仅看一眼每日无人机巡查画面就能发现。害兽太过接近产业时，她会拿着你最喜欢的枪和装满备用弹药的背包去应门。吉安娜不只是在卧室里陪伴你；她参与一切，动用每一分人工培育出的智慧帮助你取得成功。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look over your holdings on New Texas with a smile. With Gianna by your side, every venture you’ve tackled has prospered. She’s a fountain of affirmation and emotional support that you never knew you needed until you had it. When a ranch hand is slacking, she’s the one that can tell from a single glance at the daily drone flyover. When varmints get too close to your holdings, she’s the one that answers the door with your favorite gun and a backpack of spare ammo. Gianna isn’t just your companion in the bedroom, she’s there for everything, putting every ounce of her artificially developed intellect to work to help you succeed."

rows.original: Heck, if it wasn’t for her, there wouldn’t even be a New Kentucky. She was the one that identified Mhen’ga as the perfect site for an expansion of New Texan life. The land is lush, almost excessively so. The locals are friendly in exactly the ways that New Texan appetites are primed to appreciate. The zil in particular were ripe for introduction to civilization - and mead. While the transition from primal jungle world to productive colony was rocky at times, it’s been nothing but a boon to both planets.
rows.translation: 见鬼，如果没有她，甚至不会有新肯塔基。正是她认定门加是扩展新德克萨斯生活方式的完美地点。那里的土地繁茂，甚至有些过头；当地人友善的方式恰好迎合新德克萨斯人的胃口。尤其是泽尔人，已准备好接受文明——还有蜂蜜酒。虽然从原始丛林世界向高产殖民地的过渡有时颇为坎坷，但它给两颗星球带来的只有好处。
rows.raw: "\n\nHeck, if it wasn’t for her, there wouldn’t even be a New Kentucky. She was the one that identified Mhen’ga as the perfect site for an expansion of New Texan life. The land is lush, almost excessively so. The locals are friendly in exactly the ways that New Texan appetites are primed to appreciate. The zil in particular were ripe for introduction to civilization - and mead. While the transition from primal jungle world to productive colony was rocky at times, it’s been nothing but a boon to both planets."

rows.original: New Kentucky’s reputation as a honeyed land of plenty is growing fast, and though you’ve chosen to live on New Texas for now, Flahne has been keen to keep in touch with you ever since you talked Big T into appointing her as colonial administrator. Most of the news is good. Sure, there was that plantation that had to be bought out (and at entirely too high of a markup!), but the naleen-managed resort town has been a hit with kaithrit the galaxy over.
rows.translation: 新肯塔基作为富饶蜜乡的名声迅速增长。尽管你暂时选择住在新德克萨斯，自从你说服大T任命弗兰为殖民地行政长官后，她一直热衷于与你保持联系。消息大多不错。没错，确实有一座种植园不得不被收购（而且溢价高得离谱！）；不过由纳林人经营的度假小镇已在全银河的凯斯瑞特人中大受欢迎。
rows.raw: "\n\nNew Kentucky’s reputation as a honeyed land of plenty is growing fast, and though you’ve chosen to live on New Texas for now, Flahne has been keen to keep in touch with you ever since you talked Big T into appointing her as colonial administrator. Most of the news is good. Sure, there was that plantation that had to be bought out (and at entirely too high of a markup!), but the naleen-managed resort town has been a hit with kaithrit the galaxy over."

rows.original: And as a bonus, the medical research company you founded with Big T’s help is already paying dividends on naleen-derived muscle relaxants and vanae milk based virility enhancements....
rows.translation: 额外的好处是，你在大T帮助下创办的医学研究公司，已开始从纳林人衍生的肌肉松弛剂与以瓦娜伊乳汁为基础的壮阳增强剂中获得回报....
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd as a bonus, the medical research company you founded with Big T’s help is already paying dividends on naleen-derived muscle relaxants and vanae milk based virility enhancements...."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You watch the sun set on another warm summer day, sitting on your front porch. Your beautiful wife is next to you, holding your hand, as gorgeous as the day you met. You crack a craggy smile and doze off.
rows.translation: 你坐在自家前廊，看着又一个温暖夏日的夕阳西下。你美丽的妻子在你身旁，握着你的手，美得和你们初见那天一样。你咧开满是皱纹的嘴笑了笑，打起了瞌睡。
rows.raw: "You watch the sun set on another warm summer day, sitting on your front porch. Your beautiful wife is next to you, holding your hand, as gorgeous as the day you met. You crack a craggy smile and doze off."

rows.original: What a wonderful life.
rows.translation: 多么美好的人生。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat a wonderful life."

rows.original: GOOD END
rows.translation: 美好结局
rows.raw: "GOOD END"

rows.original: Marry Her
rows.translation: 娶她
rows.raw: "Marry Her"

rows.original: Fuck the Rush. You have everything you need right here!
rows.translation: 去他的行星开拓潮。你需要的一切都在这里！
rows.raw: "Fuck the Rush. You have everything you need right here!"

rows.original: The table’s surface is as smooth as glass, yet it’s set with rustic, knitted placemats rather than the sort of finery you’d expect in such a lavishly decorated home. They depict pleasant fields, picket fences, and a few branches of apple-laden orchard, rendered by an apparently loving hand - a relative of the big bull, perhaps?
rows.translation: 桌面光滑如玻璃，却铺着质朴的针织餐垫，而不是这般奢华住宅中理应出现的精美用品。餐垫描绘着怡人的田野、尖桩篱笆和几枝挂满苹果的果树，显然出自一双充满爱意的手——也许是这头大公牛的亲戚？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe table’s surface is as smooth as glass, yet it’s set with rustic, knitted placemats rather than the sort of finery you’d expect in such a lavishly decorated home. They depict pleasant fields, picket fences, and a few branches of apple-laden orchard, rendered by an apparently loving hand - a relative of the big bull, perhaps?"

rows.original: “Supper’s up!” announces Big T with a raucous holler from the kitchen. He strides around the corner clad in an apron, casually balancing a tray stacked high with piles of barbecue, potatoes, fried okra, and all the butter and grits any good ol’ [pc.boyGirl] could ever ask for. Waiters the universe over would be jealous of coordination and strength. The way he smoothly slides the meals in front of you leaves you seriously wondering if he could tote the entire thing on a single finger. Probably! “You won’t find finer barbecue on New Texas - not even in my own damn house! This here’s the good version of the Tee family recipe. Had to hold a few tidbits from the mass market version, ye see.” He winks and slides the steaming hot food in front of you, the guest, before presenting Gianna with a palette of what looks like different colored rocks. Lastly, he deploys an even grander plate to his own setting, stacked with a mountain of sauce-drenched beef high enough for a raskvel to ski down.
rows.translation: “晚餐好啦！”大T从厨房发出喧闹吆喝。他穿着围裙从转角大步走来，轻松平衡着一只高高堆满烧烤、土豆、炸秋葵，以及任何正经老[pc.boyGirl]想要的所有黄油和粗玉米粉粥的托盘。全宇宙的侍者都会嫉妒他的协调性和力量。他流畅地把餐点滑到你面前，让你不禁认真怀疑：他是不是能用一根手指托起整只托盘。多半可以！“整个新德克萨斯都找不到更好的烧烤——就算在我自己该死的家里也没有！这才是蒂家配方的上等版本。你瞧，大众市场版本里有几样秘料我得藏着。”他眨眨眼，先把热气腾腾的食物滑到身为客人的你面前，再给吉安娜端上一盘看似不同颜色石头的东西。最后，他在自己座位前放下一只更加宏伟的餐盘，上面堆着一座淋满酱汁的牛肉山，高得足以让拉斯克维尔人在上面滑雪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Supper’s up!” announces Big T with a raucous holler from the kitchen. He strides around the corner clad in an apron, casually balancing a tray stacked high with piles of barbecue, potatoes, fried okra, and all the butter and grits any good ol’ [pc.boyGirl] could ever ask for. Waiters the universe over would be jealous of coordination and strength. The way he smoothly slides the meals in front of you leaves you seriously wondering if he could tote the entire thing on a single finger. Probably! “You won’t find finer barbecue on New Texas - not even in my own damn house! This here’s the good version of the Tee family recipe. Had to hold a few tidbits from the mass market version, ye see.” He winks and slides the steaming hot food in front of you, the guest, before presenting Gianna with a palette of what looks like different colored rocks. Lastly, he deploys an even grander plate to his own setting, stacked with a mountain of sauce-drenched beef high enough for a raskvel to ski down."

rows.original: The tray slips neatly into a silver rack along the wall, and at long last, Big T - New Texas’s supreme authority figure - sits down with you and the woman you’d like to fly into space.
rows.translation: 托盘整齐滑进墙边的银色架子；终于，大T——新德克萨斯的最高权威——与你和这位你想带上太空的女人一同落座。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tray slips neatly into a silver rack along the wall, and at long last, Big T - New Texas’s supreme authority figure - sits down with you and the woman you’d like to fly into space."

rows.original: Dig In!
rows.translation: 开吃！
rows.raw: "Dig In!"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Unwilling to wait a second longer - or display any rudeness for your host’s cooking, you dig right into the piled meat, discovering that Big T was exactly right about the BBQ recipe. It’s smoky without being overpowering. Salty and sweet balance in perfect harmony. The accompanying milk is as good as milk can get, as you’d expect from the pride and joy of the local economy. Before long, you’re forced to take one of the cow-patterned napkins and dab the smeared mess off your cheeks.
rows.translation: 你不想再多等一秒 - 也不想对主人做的饭菜失礼，于是直接开动，大嚼那堆烤肉，发现大T对这道烧烤配方的评价一点没错。烟熏味十足却不压人。咸与甜平衡得恰到好处。配来的牛奶也是牛奶能达到的极致，不出所料，这可是当地经济的骄傲与喜悦。没过多久，你就不得不拿起一张奶牛花纹的餐巾，把蹭在脸颊上的糊糊擦掉。
rows.raw: "Unwilling to wait a second longer - or display any rudeness for your host’s cooking, you dig right into the piled meat, discovering that Big T was exactly right about the BBQ recipe. It’s smoky without being overpowering. Salty and sweet balance in perfect harmony. The accompanying milk is as good as milk can get, as you’d expect from the pride and joy of the local economy. Before long, you’re forced to take one of the cow-patterned napkins and dab the smeared mess off your cheeks."

rows.original: It’s then that you realize Big T and Gianna are both looking at you with flat expressions. Neither has touched their plates. The bovine brute inhales a large breath before letting most of it slowly exhale. He waves dismissively. “Guess I shoulda letcha know we say grace around these parts. That’s on me.” He clears his throat. “I hope ya don’t mind if we do anyway.”
rows.translation: 就在这时，你才意识到大T和吉安娜都面无表情地看着你，两人谁也没碰餐盘。这个牛族壮汉深吸一口气，又缓缓吐出大半。他不以为意地摆摆手。“我大概该提前告诉你，我们这里吃饭前要祷告。怪我。”他清清嗓子。“希望你不介意我们还是照做。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s then that you realize Big T and Gianna are both looking at you with flat expressions. Neither has touched their plates. The bovine brute inhales a large breath before letting most of it slowly exhale. He waves dismissively. “Guess I shoulda letcha know we say grace around these parts. That’s on me.” He clears his throat. “I hope ya don’t mind if we do anyway.”"

rows.original: You look to Gianna, expecting support. She folds her hands in preparation, chewing a nervous lip at your performance thus far. It would seem your faux pas hasn’t done you any favors. Apologizing is the best you can do, but it’s hard to sound convincing with a dent that size in your meal and a dirty fork hanging off the side.
rows.translation: 你看向吉安娜，指望她支持你。她双手交叠，做好准备，为你到目前为止的表现紧张地咬着嘴唇。看来你那个失礼之举并没给你带来任何好处。你能做的只有道歉，可你的餐食上凹着那么大一个坑，旁边还挂着把脏叉子，实在很难让人信服。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look to Gianna, expecting support. She folds her hands in preparation, chewing a nervous lip at your performance thus far. It would seem your faux pas hasn’t done you any favors. Apologizing is the best you can do, but it’s hard to sound convincing with a dent that size in your meal and a dirty fork hanging off the side."

rows.original: “Don’t fret overmuch ‘bout it,” Big T drawls, waving once more. The tension eases as he folds his hands together to recite his prayer. As a bull, he’s biologically predisposed to short speech, and it shows in his prayer. It’s nowhere near as long as what you’d find on Terra, more a gruff recitation of thankfulness wrapped in folksy charm and brief rumination. Before you know it, he’s saying, “Amen, and dig in!” Fork in hand, the bovine brute proceeds to demolish a half pound of beef in a few bites, washing it down with a tall glass of milk and a followup spoon of grits.
rows.translation: “别太放在心上，”大T拖长乡音说道，再次摆手。双手交握开始祷告后，紧张气氛有所缓解。身为公牛，他在生理上倾向于简短讲话，这一点也体现在祷词中。它远没有地球上的祷告那么长，更像裹着乡土魅力和简短沉思、粗犷地表达感恩。转眼间，他已经说到“阿门，开吃！”牛族壮汉拿起叉子，几口消灭半磅牛肉，又用一大杯牛奶和随后一勺粗玉米粉粥送下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t fret overmuch ‘bout it,” Big T drawls, waving once more. The tension eases as he folds his hands together to recite his prayer. As a bull, he’s biologically predisposed to short speech, and it shows in his prayer. It’s nowhere near as long as what you’d find on Terra, more a gruff recitation of thankfulness wrapped in folksy charm and brief rumination. Before you know it, he’s saying, “Amen, and dig in!” Fork in hand, the bovine brute proceeds to demolish a half pound of beef in a few bites, washing it down with a tall glass of milk and a followup spoon of grits."

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 开吃！
rows.raw: "Dig In!"

rows.original: Despite how hungry you’re getting, you know it would be bad form to rush into eating. You should probably wait.
rows.translation: 尽管越来越饿，你知道贸然开吃很失礼。最好还是等等。
rows.raw: "Despite how hungry you’re getting, you know it would be bad form to rush into eating. You should probably wait."

rows.original: You’re hungry enough to eat a horse!
rows.translation: 你饿得能吃下一匹马！
rows.raw: "You’re hungry enough to eat a horse!"

rows.original: Wait
rows.translation: 等待
rows.raw: "Wait"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: Big T leads the way into dinner by folding his hands together in the traditional Terran symbol for prayer, joined immediately by Gianna and yourself soon after. While he launches into a brief recitation about thankfulness packed with folksy charm, you find yourself thankful for your decision not to rush into a massive social blunder. The planet’s charismatic leader rambles on a little longer before wrapping up with a solemn “Amen.”
rows.translation: 大T双手交握，摆出地球人传统的祈祷姿势，率先进入晚餐；吉安娜立刻跟上，你也随后照做。他开始以乡土魅力十足的方式简短表达感恩时，你也庆幸自己没有仓促犯下严重的社交错误。这颗星球魅力非凡的领袖又絮叨了一会儿，才以庄严的“阿门。”结束。
rows.raw: "Big T leads the way into dinner by folding his hands together in the traditional Terran symbol for prayer, joined immediately by Gianna and yourself soon after. While he launches into a brief recitation about thankfulness packed with folksy charm, you find yourself thankful for your decision not to rush into a massive social blunder. The planet’s charismatic leader rambles on a little longer before wrapping up with a solemn “Amen.”"

rows.original: Bulls aren’t much for words, but Big T’s a fair bit more loquacious than most. He spoke longer than you’d expect most of the cows around here to tolerate. By local standards, he was practically rambling! On Terra, the indulgent upper class would scoff at it. Personally, you’re thankful for the chance to eat.
rows.translation: 公牛都不太爱说话，但大T比大多数公牛健谈得多。他讲的时间比你预想的、这附近大多数母牛能忍受的还要长。按当地标准，他简直算得上在絮叨了！在泰拉，那些养尊处优的上层阶级会对此嗤之以鼻。就你个人而言，你只庆幸能有口饭吃。
rows.raw: "\n\nBulls aren’t much for words, but Big T’s a fair bit more loquacious than most. He spoke longer than you’d expect most of the cows around here to tolerate. By local standards, he was practically rambling! On Terra, the indulgent upper class would scoff at it. Personally, you’re thankful for the chance to eat."

rows.original: “Dig in!” Fork in hand, the bovine brute proceeds to demolish a half pound of beef in a few bites, washing it down with a tall glass of milk and a followup spoon of grits.
rows.translation: “开吃！”牛族壮汉手持叉子，几口消灭半磅牛肉，又用一大杯牛奶和随后一勺粗玉米粉粥送下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dig in!” Fork in hand, the bovine brute proceeds to demolish a half pound of beef in a few bites, washing it down with a tall glass of milk and a followup spoon of grits."

rows.original: You join him, unwilling to make the obvious mistake of refusing the governor’s home cooking at a time like this, however your feelings about the food. You have to admit, he’s right about the BBQ recipe. It’s smoky without being overpowering. Salty and sweet balance in perfect harmony. The accompanying milk is as good as milk can get, as you’d expect from the pride and joy of the local economy. Before long, you’re forced to take one of the cow-patterned napkins and dab the smeared mess off your cheeks.
rows.translation: 你也加入他；无论对食物有什么感觉，此时显然不能犯下拒绝总督家常菜这种错误。你不得不承认，他说烧烤配方很棒是对的。烟熏味浓郁却不过分；咸味与甜味完美平衡。配餐牛奶也达到了牛奶所能拥有的最高品质，不愧是当地经济的骄傲与珍宝。没过多久，你便不得不拿起一张奶牛图案餐巾，擦去脸颊上涂抹的污渍。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou join him, unwilling to make the obvious mistake of refusing the governor’s home cooking at a time like this, however your feelings about the food. You have to admit, he’s right about the BBQ recipe. It’s smoky without being overpowering. Salty and sweet balance in perfect harmony. The accompanying milk is as good as milk can get, as you’d expect from the pride and joy of the local economy. Before long, you’re forced to take one of the cow-patterned napkins and dab the smeared mess off your cheeks."

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Patience is a virtue... or so they say."

rows.original: Big T hustles over to the kitchen, leaving you alone with Gianna and a table set for three. It’s clear who’s meant to sit at the head, but will you be seating yourselves, or are you going to see the companion android into her chair first?
rows.translation: 大T快步走向厨房，留下你、吉安娜和一张摆好三人餐具的桌子。谁该坐在主位一目了然；但你们要自行落座，还是先把伴侣仿生人送到椅边？
rows.raw: "\n\nBig T hustles over to the kitchen, leaving you alone with Gianna and a table set for three. It’s clear who’s meant to sit at the head, but will you be seating yourselves, or are you going to see the companion android into her chair first?"

rows.translation: 一同坐下
rows.raw: "Both Sit"

rows.original: Fenoxo
rows.raw: "Fenoxo"

rows.original: You both slide into your chairs without the need for any further speech. The chair are heavy enough that shifting them takes a bit of effort, but after a moment, you’re sitting across from the Gianna
rows.translation: 你们无需再说什么，双双滑入座椅。椅子非常沉重，挪动起来有些费力；片刻后，你坐在吉安娜对面
rows.raw: "You both slide into your chairs without the need for any further speech. The chair are heavy enough that shifting them takes a bit of effort, but after a moment, you’re sitting across from the Gianna"

rows.original: and bathing in her beatific smile.
rows.translation: 沐浴在她那幸福的笑容里。

rows.translation: “哦，你、你好，多尔娜小姐，”这名猫科伪娘回答道，因她靠近而明显变得紧张；除此之外，他仍继续工作，每敲一下全息板都摇摇头。

rows.original: The kaithrit peels himself from the glowing screen of his datapad and looks towards his fellow crewmate, his face turning a little red, “I... it’s just this equation I’m having trouble with... I must have some variables mixed up somewhere because these results I’m getting aren’t rational.”
rows.translation: 这名凯斯利特把目光从数据板的发光屏幕移开，望向船员同伴，脸上微微泛红，“我...只是解这个方程时遇到了麻烦...肯定是把某处变量弄混了，因为算出的结果不合理。”

rows.original: “Hmm,” Anno ponders, taking hold of his holopad and turning it towards her. The ausar’s brow furrows with concentration as she bites at her lower lip, blue eyes running all over the screen while Kase does the same. It only take a few moments for Anno to come to some sort of conclusion, happily exclaiming “Oh!” and lifting a fluffy finger to point a the screen. “Here, and here,” she says, tapping at the holographic display, “See you should’ve flipped the signs since the variable being used for division is negative. If you do that, everything should come out right.” After, pressing her fur-covered digits to the screen a few more times, she pulls back, and Kase’s eyes go wide with disbelief.
rows.translation: “嗯，”安诺沉思着，拿过他的全息板转向自己。奥萨专注地皱起眉头，咬着下唇；她的蓝眼睛扫遍屏幕，凯斯也做着同样的事。仅仅片刻后，安诺似乎就得出了结论，开心地喊道“哦！”，举起毛茸茸的手指指向屏幕。“这里，还有这里，”她一边说，一边敲击全息显示器，“看，你本该把符号反过来，因为作为除数的变量是负数。这样一改，所有结果应该就都正确了。”随后，她又用覆满毛发的手指按了几下屏幕，才退开身子；凯斯难以置信地睁大双眼。

Once, they wiped out a planet - unintentionally, perhaps, but they did it.”
rows.translation: “因为我是狸猫。我在狸猫控制的太空长大，而‘虚空...在我们一些偏远殖民地周围，他们多得像苍蝇。我们好像每周都能从新闻里听见最新暴行——药物被盗、村庄被焚，学院被夷为平地，学生遭绑架去做奴隶，或者天知道被拿去做什么。”琪萝虽然看着你，眼神却飘到了千里之外。“凡是你能说出来的，他们都做过。有一次，他们毁灭了一颗星球——也许并非故意，但确实做了。”

Once, they wiped out a planet - unintentionally, perhaps, but they did it.”"

rows.original: “A whole planet?”
rows.translation: “整颗星球？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A whole planet?”"

rows.original: Kiro curls her tail into her lap, petting it slowly. “Yeah. A whole mining colony. Of course, the world was a hellhole. Terrans and ausars wouldn’t touch it. We did, though. Plunked down an enormous hardlight generator and capital ship-class air purification system. Built a whole city in a bubble, and it fucking worked like gangbusters. We were pulling enough Oxonium out of that rock to drop the prices across the entire galaxy. All gone like that.” She snaps her fingers.
rows.translation: 琪萝把尾巴卷进怀里，慢慢抚摸。“是啊，一整座采矿殖民地。当然，那世界是个地狱。地球人和奥萨都不会碰，但我们碰了。我们放下一座巨型硬光发生器和主力舰级空气净化系统，在气泡里建起整座城市，而且妈的效果好得惊人。我们从那块岩石里开采的奥克索姆矿，足以压低整个银河的价格。一下子全没了。”她打了个响指。

rows.original: Listening attentively, you ask what happened to it.
rows.translation: 你专心听着，问它出了什么事。
rows.raw: "\n\nListening attentively, you ask what happened to it."

rows.original: “Black Void showed up one day. We never really understood why. We didn’t stockpile a ton of ore there - it got shipped off for refining on a more developed planet.” Kiro shrugs. “All we know are they cracked our hardlight shield from orbit - the one were using to keep the area habitable - and scoured what was left after most of the inhabitants were already dead.” She pauses. “My theory is that they wanted the hardlight shield and atmosphere systems for themselves, to set up a secret base on some other planet that nobody would ever think to check. Making off with a pile of Oxonium was likely a secondary benefit.”
rows.translation: “有一天，黑色虚空出现了。我们一直没弄懂原因。那里没有囤积大量矿石——矿石都会运到更发达的星球精炼。”琪萝耸耸肩。“只知道他们从轨道上击破了我们的硬光护盾——就是用来保持区域宜居的那个——在大部分居民已经死亡后，又把剩下的都洗劫一空。”她顿了顿。“我的理论是，他们想夺走硬光护盾和大气系统，在没人会想到搜查的另一颗星球上建立秘密基地。顺走一堆奥克索姆矿大概只是附带收益。”

rows.original: “Cruel,” you observe.
rows.translation: “残忍，”你评论道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cruel,” you observe."

rows.original: “Yeah, that’s one word you could call them.” Kiro shakes her head, then brushes a chocolate lock out of her eyes. “They give pirates a bad name by every possible definition. A lot of us have scruples, Angel. We only go after targets that deserve it - or that can afford to take an ‘L’ on their cargo every now again. Megacorps and the mega rich - no offense. The Void? They’ll fuck anybody for anything. A ship could be hauling nothing and still get jumped. They’d sell the crew into slavery, the ship for scrap, and probably file an insurance claim on behalf of the missing captain while they’re at it. They’re bad news, and I’ll be damned but that isn’t even the worst part.”
rows.translation: “是啊，可以这么形容他们。”琪萝摇摇头，将一缕巧克力色头发拨出眼前。“无论从哪个定义来说，他们都败坏了海盗的名声。我们许多人有原则，天使。我们只抢罪有应得的目标——或者偶尔损失一船货也承受得起的对象。巨型公司和超级富豪——无意冒犯。虚空呢？他们为了任何东西都会去害任何人。一艘什么也没运的船都可能遭袭。他们会把船员卖为奴隶，把船拆成废料，顺便还可能替失踪船长提交保险索赔。他们绝对是坏消息，可我敢说，这甚至还不是最糟的部分。”

rows.original: “Well...” Kiro lamely folds her hands into her lap. “It is to me, [pc.name]. I got into the pirate game so I didn’t have to follow the laws of ‘polite society.’ I look at the universe and I see it rotting from the inside, most people so busy struggling to put food on their plate that they’ll gladly work themselves to death for their next meal. Anybody not firmly slotted in as a cog in the machine is too busy making it harder on those that are to fix anything, because they’ll get a bigger bonus if their indentured servants don’t cost as much in safety equipment or produce 1.35% more handwoven spinarran silk.” She thumps her fist on a table. “The whole system’s so broken that fucking with the top of it felt good, [pc.name]... and maybe even necessary.”
rows.translation: “嗯...”琪萝无力地把双手叠在腿上。“对我来说是，[pc.name]。我加入海盗行当，就是为了不必遵守‘文明社会’的法律。我看着宇宙，只看见它从内部腐烂；大多数人忙着为盘中食物挣扎，甘愿为了下一顿饭工作到死。凡是没有牢牢卡进机器当齿轮的人，都忙着给齿轮制造更多困难而不是修好一切，因为如果契约奴工不用花那么多安全设备费用，或者手工编织的斯宾兰丝绸多生产1.35%，他们就能拿到更多奖金。”她一拳砸在桌上。“整个制度烂透了，去搞最顶层的人让我感觉很爽，[pc.name]...甚至也许很有必要。”

rows.original: “Yeah there’s more gangs. I just wanted to run down the worst of the bunch first, in case you had to go somewhere,” Kiro says, leaning back with a smile. “Next up would be the Cyber Punks. As the name might imply, they specialize in cybernetic augmentation and high tech jobs... which means I didn’t cross paths with them all that much. They’re in charge of the station security for the most part. A bit too orderly for my tastes, but I suppose that’s why I never got to run a space station.” She glances at you sidelong, like she’s about to share a secret. “I did get to hear about what they do with people that piss them off.”
rows.translation: “是啊，还有更多帮派。我只是先介绍最糟的那一个，以防你得去什么地方，”琪萝笑着向后靠。“接下来是赛博朋克。正如名字暗示，他们专精机械增强和高科技任务...所以我不太会和他们碰上。他们基本负责空间站安保。对我的口味来说有点过于井然有序，但我猜这就是我从没机会经营空间站的原因。”她侧眼看你，仿佛要分享秘密。“我确实听说过，他们会怎样处理惹怒自己的人。”

rows.original: “Brainwash them.” Kiro shivers at the memory of being in Doctor Po’s clutches. “Just like that Illustria bitch tried to do to me, but the fast and dirty version. See, they’ve got these virtual reality visors they can snap onto your face that tap straight into your brain. They can make you see and feel anything with one of those on, and if they want to hit you with some really hardcore stuff, there’s nothing you can do about it once you’re in there.” She pauses. “If you’re lucky, they’ll just use them to pacify you long enough to drag you out of the way.”
rows.translation: “给他们洗脑。”琪萝想起落入波博士手中的经历，颤抖起来。“就像伊露丝翠娅那个婊子想对我做的那样，只不过是又快又粗糙的版本。他们有这种虚拟现实面罩，能直接扣在你脸上并接入大脑。戴上以后，他们能让你看到、感觉到任何东西；如果想用真正猛烈的内容轰炸你，一旦进去就完全无能为力。”她顿了顿。“运气好时，他们只会用它让你安静足够久，好把你拖走。”

rows.original: “Not at all. You want friendly? Go find some of Rat’s Raiders. They’ll greet you like old friends while they empty your pockets and maybe try to sweet talk their way into your pants while they’re at it. Not that unusual for pirates, except you almost always find them in groups.” Kiro crosses her arms in annoyance. “If you can’t handle yourself in a solo scrap, you probably shouldn’t be a pirate.”
rows.translation: “一点也不用。你想要友善？去找鼠帮劫掠团那帮人吧。他们会像老朋友一样跟你打招呼，一边把你口袋掏空，说不定还顺手甜言蜜语地哄着往你裤子里钻。对海盗来说这也不算稀奇，只不过你几乎总能碰到他们成群结伙。”琪罗恼火地抱起手臂。“你要是连单挑打架都应付不来，大概就不该当海盗。”

rows.original: Kiro sighs. “They’re hard to stay mad at. Just make sure you have plenty of fodder in your pockets to pay them off with if you meet them. Fake gemstones, spoofed credsticks, that sort of thing. Give them something they want, and they’ll be your best friend. Your best fuckbuddies, if they fancy you.”
rows.translation: 琪罗叹了口气。“很难一直生他们的气。要是你遇上他们，记得口袋里多备些零碎好处打发他们。假宝石、伪造的信用棒，诸如此类。给他们想要的东西，他们就会成你最好的朋友。要是他们看上你，就是最好的炮友。”

rows.original: “Just don’t underestimate them because they’re mousey-looking critters. They stick together in highly-coordinated teams that seem almost perfectly engineered to cover for each other’s weaknesses.” Kiro taps her chin. “My advice would be to avoid fighting them at all if you can help. If you can’t... carry grenades - preferably ones of multiple damage types. I’m pretty sure a few of them have some of the elementally defensive shields KihaCorp has been pushing lately.”
rows.translation: “只是别因为它们长得像老鼠就小看它们。它们会结成配合极好的小队抱团行动，简直像是专门设计来互相弥补弱点的。”琪罗敲了敲下巴。“我的建议是，能不打就尽量别打。要是躲不开...那就带上手榴弹 - 最好是几种伤害类型都有的。我相当肯定，其中有几只装着基哈公司最近力推的那种元素防御护盾。”

I gotta respect their leader for holding back on that. If they tried, all they’d wind up doing is weakening both groups to the point where the Star Vipers or Corona Lords would consider making a play to take command.

rows.original: The tanuki looks over her shoulder, not bothering to hide the wry smile growing on her ink-black lips. “Oh yeah? And I guess since nobody’s standing behind me, you want to invite the Dread Pirate Kiro Tamahime onboard, bounties and all. Have I got the right of it?” Her bushy tail swishes just above the floor, kicking up a breeze you can feel whistling by your cheek.
rows.translation: 狸猫越过肩头望来，毫不掩饰墨黑嘴唇上浮现的讥笑。“哦，是吗？我猜你看见身后没人，就想邀请恐怖海盗琪萝·玉姬连同所有悬赏一起登船。我说对了吗？”她蓬松尾巴在地面上方摆动，掀起一阵从你脸颊旁呼啸而过的微风。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tanuki looks over her shoulder, not bothering to hide the wry smile growing on her ink-black lips. “Oh yeah? And I guess since nobody’s standing behind me, you want to invite the Dread Pirate Kiro Tamahime onboard, bounties and all. Have I got the right of it?” Her bushy tail swishes just above the floor, kicking up a breeze you can feel whistling by your cheek."

rows.original: “Oh yeah! We’re gonna have lots of fun, and go on adventures. It’ll be super-rad!”
rows.translation: “哦耶！我们会玩得很开心，还要去冒险。那会超酷的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah! We’re gonna have lots of fun, and go on adventures. It’ll be super-rad!”"

rows.original: “Hell yeah!” You grin back, twice as wide. The galaxy can’t possibly throw anything at you worse than Po.
rows.translation: “那是当然！”你也咧嘴笑回去，咧得更开。银河系也不可能扔给你比波更糟的东西了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell yeah!” You grin back, twice as wide. The galaxy can’t possibly throw anything at you worse than Po."

rows.original: You nod confidently. You wouldn’t have chased after her if you were afraid of a little trouble.

rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod confidently. You wouldn’t have chased after her if you were afraid of a little trouble."

rows.original: “I think so, assuming that I’m talking to the real Kiro Tamahime and not a devilishly attractive imposter. I’ll have to find a way to convince her to come onboard so I can scan her, just to be sure...”
rows.translation: “我想是的，前提是我正在和真正的琪萝·玉姬说话，而不是漂亮得要命的冒牌货。我得想办法说服她登船，方便扫描确认...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think so, assuming that I’m talking to the real Kiro Tamahime and not a devilishly attractive imposter. I’ll have to find a way to convince her to come onboard so I can scan her, just to be sure...”"

rows.original: “Come on Kiro, don’t fuck with me. You know I’m serious. I didn’t run from Po, and I’m not running from whatever other baggage you bring along.” After a second, you think to add, “Just don’t pack like this is a pleasure cruise.”
rows.translation: “得了吧，琪罗，别跟我胡闹。你知道我是认真的。我没从波身边逃走，我也不会从你带来的任何其他包袱旁边逃走。” 过了一会儿，你想起该补一句，“只是别收拾得像要坐游轮享乐似的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on Kiro, don’t fuck with me. You know I’m serious. I didn’t run from Po, and I’m not running from whatever other baggage you bring along.” After a second, you think to add, “Just don’t pack like this is a pleasure cruise.”"

rows.original: Kiro’s smile only grows. “To be honest, I was starting to doubt that you’d change your mind.” Swifter than a stimmed-up kaithrit, she strikes your shoulder with a rough-yet-affable punch. “You shouldn’t have kept me waiting, Angel.” Her face sours as her short snout dips toward the table. “Truth is, that business with Po really soured me on the whole solo act. It’ll be nice to run with a crew again.” Kiro leans against the same shoulder she just struck, her poofy tail wrapping affectionately around your [pc.leg]. “Doubly so if I get to work with a captain as fuckable as you.”
rows.translation: 琪萝笑得更加灿烂。“老实说，我开始怀疑你永远不会改变主意。”她快得像注射兴奋剂的凯斯利特，粗暴却友好地一拳打在你肩上。“不该让我等这么久，天使。”短短口鼻朝桌子低下，她脸色变得难看。“说真的，波那件事让我彻底厌倦单干。重新和船员一起行动会很不错。”琪萝靠上刚打过的肩膀，蓬松尾巴亲昵缠住你的[pc.leg]。“尤其还能为像你这样好操的船长工作。”

rows.original: “Hey, one more thing - if you’re taking me, you’re taking my ship too. I don’t know what you’re flying at the moment, but if it’s a real hunk of junk, I’d rather have you at the helm than slum it in a clunker.” Kiro slaps a keyfob down on the table. “The Blade’ll fly for you, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “嘿，还有件事——要带我，就得连我的船一起带走。我不知道你目前开什么，但要真是一堆废铁，我宁可让你掌舵，也不愿挤在破烂里。”琪萝把钥匙扣拍到桌上。“刀锋号会为你飞行，[pc.name]。”
