rows.translation: 佩姬把手臂直直伸出，掌心朝内，像是想跟人握手。她确实握到了，只是方式和你预想的不同：琪罗的手伸出来，手指与佩姬的交扣，然后两人开始了一套繁复的握手礼，先是互拍手腕；接着抬起手臂对撞手肘；再把手臂扭回身前放下，腾出空间让两人前倾互撞额头；最后用空着的那只手往前一揽，乍看像是友好的拥抱，直到她们一扭身，抬手在对方屁股上拍了一巴掌。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige extends her hand straight out, her palm facing inside, as if she were looking for a handshake. She gets one, but not the way you had expected: Kiro’s hand reaches out and interlocks her fingers with Paige’s, and then they begin an elaborate handshake, by clapping each other by the wrists; lifting their arms and bumping each other’s elbows; twisting their arms back down in front of their bodies, giving them room to lean forward and headbutt each other; and finishing with their free hand wrapping forward in what at first looks like a friendly embrace, until they twist and open-hand slap each other on the ass."

rows.original: After the mutual slap on the ass, neither of them pull away. They stay together (their hands respectfully moving upward, towards the upper side of their tails), enjoying each other’s warmth. After a moment, you see Paige’s chest heave with a start – she’s crying a bit.
rows.translation: 互拍屁股后，两人都没有退开。她们依偎在一起（双手尊重地向上移，靠近彼此尾巴上方），享受对方的温暖。片刻后，你看到佩姬的胸膛突然起伏——她有点哭了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter the mutual slap on the ass, neither of them pull away. They stay together (their hands respectfully moving upward, towards the upper side of their tails), enjoying each other’s warmth. After a moment, you see Paige’s chest heave with a start – she’s crying a bit."

rows.original: “Is this real? Is this real life?” asks Paige, her face lifting and resting her chin on Kiro’s shoulder. Her arms wrap around Kiro’s torso, holding her closer; her fingers grip onto Kiro’s vest hard enough that, if she pulled a bit, she might tear right through it. “Is it real that my guardian angel just happens to be on a first-name basis with my best friend?”
rows.translation: “这是真的吗？这是真实的人生吗？”佩姬问道，抬起脸把下巴搁在琪罗的肩上。她双臂环住琪罗的躯干，把她抱得更近；手指抓琪罗的背心抓得那么紧，只要再使点劲，就可能直接撕穿。“我的守护天使恰好跟我最好的朋友熟到能直呼其名，这也是真的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this real? Is this real life?” asks Paige, her face lifting and resting her chin on Kiro’s shoulder. Her arms wrap around Kiro’s torso, holding her closer; her fingers grip onto Kiro’s vest hard enough that, if she pulled a bit, she might tear right through it. “Is it real that my guardian angel just happens to be on a first-name basis with my best friend?”"

rows.original: Rather than reply with any kind of tact, Kiro laughs openly. “Gods, we’ve rubbed off on each other too well, Paige. I’ve been calling [pc.name] ‘angel’ for... I think forever, now.”
rows.translation: 琪罗没有机智地回应，反而公开大笑。“诸神啊，我们彼此影响得太深了，佩姬。我已经叫[pc.name]‘天使’叫了... 我想都快一辈子了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRather than reply with any kind of tact, Kiro laughs openly. “Gods, we’ve rubbed off on each other too well, Paige. I’ve been calling [pc.name] ‘angel’ for... I think forever, now.”"

rows.original: Paige laughs once, and then takes a deep, sniffling breath through her nose. “[pc.name] paid for my surgery. What did [pc.heShe] do for you?”
rows.translation: 佩姬笑了一声，然后用鼻子深深吸了一口气，带着抽噎的鼻音。“[pc.name]付钱让我做了手术。[pc.heShe]又为你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige laughs once, and then takes a deep, sniffling breath through her nose. “[pc.name] paid for my surgery. What did [pc.heShe] do for you?”"

rows.original: “Rescued me twice. First from myself,” Kiro replies, her tone light and cheerful while her voice is soft.
rows.translation: “救了我两次。第一次是从我自己手里，”琪罗回答，语气轻快愉快，声音却很柔和。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rescued me twice. First from myself,” Kiro replies, her tone light and cheerful while her voice is soft."

rows.original: “Your balls get too big?” Paige interrupts, laughing again.
rows.translation: “你的睾丸又变得太大了？”佩姬打断她，再次笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your balls get too big?” Paige interrupts, laughing again."

rows.original: “Yep.” Then, Kiro’s expression changes, and her tone lowers. “Then, [pc.heShe] saved me from... someone else.”
rows.translation: “对。”接着，琪罗的表情变了，声音也低了下来。“然后，[pc.heShe]把我从...另一个人手里救了出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep.” Then, Kiro’s expression changes, and her tone lowers. “Then, [pc.heShe] saved me from... someone else.”"

rows.original: “‘Someone else?’”
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Someone else?’”"

rows.original: “I’ll tell you later, honey.” Just as quickly, Kiro changes back to her happy self, overjoyed at being reunited with her childhood friend. She leans back, her hands traveling down Paige’s arms and holding both her hands, interlocking their fingers. “Tonight’s a night for celebrations! The Tamahime Pirates, together again!” She turns her head towards you. “With a plus one! Lock the door and get over here, already!”
rows.translation: “以后告诉你，亲爱的。”转眼间，琪罗又变回那个开心的自己，为和童年好友重逢而欢喜不已。她向后靠去，双手顺着佩姬的手臂滑下，握住她的双手，十指相扣。“今晚是庆祝的夜晚！玉姬海盗团，又聚齐了！”她转头看向你。“还多带了一个！把门锁上，赶紧过来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll tell you later, honey.” Just as quickly, Kiro changes back to her happy self, overjoyed at being reunited with her childhood friend. She leans back, her hands traveling down Paige’s arms and holding both her hands, interlocking their fingers. “Tonight’s a night for celebrations! The Tamahime Pirates, together again!” She turns her head towards you. “With a plus one! Lock the door and get over here, already!”"

rows.original: You do as you’re commanded: you engage the electric lock on your door, and you approach the two girls. As soon as you’re in arm’s length, Kiro grips you by the shoulder and yanks you between her and Paige. She says nothing; her arms wrap tightly around you both, locking you close to her body. Paige does the same to you and Kiro, and, taking their lead, you do the same to them.
rows.translation: 你按命令行事：启动门上的电子锁，走近两个姑娘。刚进入伸手可及的距离，琪罗便抓住你的肩膀，把你拽到她和佩姬中间。她一言不发，双臂紧紧环住你们两人，把你们锁在自己身旁。佩姬也对你和琪罗做了同样的事；你顺着她们，也同样抱住两人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do as you’re commanded: you engage the electric lock on your door, and you approach the two girls. As soon as you’re in arm’s length, Kiro grips you by the shoulder and yanks you between her and Paige. She says nothing; her arms wrap tightly around you both, locking you close to her body. Paige does the same to you and Kiro, and, taking their lead, you do the same to them."

rows.original: Conversation is a bit light – the three of you simply enjoy each other’s company for a while. Kiro and Paige take deep, excited breaths, in through their noses and out their mouths, as they try to contain themselves. Girlish giggles make for the ambience of the room as the three of you share an intimate group hug; in fact, Kiro is shaking in pure delight and excitement at finally having met Paige once again.
rows.translation: 交谈不多——你们三人只是享受了一阵彼此陪伴的时光。琪罗和佩姬兴奋地深呼吸，从鼻中吸气、口中呼气，努力克制自己。你们三人亲密地抱作一团，姑娘们的咯咯笑声构成房间里的氛围；事实上，终于再次见到佩姬令琪罗因纯粹的喜悦和兴奋而浑身颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\nConversation is a bit light – the three of you simply enjoy each other’s company for a while. Kiro and Paige take deep, excited breaths, in through their noses and out their mouths, as they try to contain themselves. Girlish giggles make for the ambience of the room as the three of you share an intimate group hug; in fact, Kiro is shaking in pure delight and excitement at finally having met Paige once again."

rows.original: “We have so much shit to do,” Kiro says happily, her head leaning against Paige’s. “It’s been so long, Paige. I... I knew you were alive and safe, in Tavros, and I wanted to... I, I wanted to visit, I wanted to, like, send you a message, or maybe take a yoga class or something....” She begins to stutter as the words fall apart in her mouth; apparently, it just took a moment for the emotions to catch up to her. “I dunno, I dunno how I was gonna do it. I was gonna put on a disguise, or, or, I thought of maybe sending you snail-mail, or I was gonna ask Mason to help–”
rows.translation: “我们还有一大堆破事要办，”琪罗高兴地说，头靠在佩姬头上。“都这么久了，佩姬。我...我知道你活着，好好地待在塔夫罗斯站，我一直想...我、我想去看你，我想，比如，给你发条消息，或者一起去上个瑜伽课什么的....”话说到一半就散了架，她开始结巴起来；看来只是情绪迟了一步才追上她。“我不知道，我不知道我到底打算怎么弄。我本来想化个装，或者、或者，我想过给你寄实体信，或者去找梅森帮忙–”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We have so much shit to do,” Kiro says happily, her head leaning against Paige’s. “It’s been so long, Paige. I... I knew you were alive and safe, in Tavros, and I wanted to... I, I wanted to visit, I wanted to, like, send you a message, or maybe take a yoga class or something....” She begins to stutter as the words fall apart in her mouth; apparently, it just took a moment for the emotions to catch up to her. “I dunno, I dunno how I was gonna do it. I was gonna put on a disguise, or, or, I thought of maybe sending you snail-mail, or I was gonna ask Mason to help–”"

rows.original: “Hey,” Paige interrupts, leaning forward to boop her nose against Kiro’s. “You’re not gonna cry in front of me and [pc.name], are you, Kiro Tamahime?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”佩姬打断她，向前倾身，用鼻尖轻碰琪罗的鼻子。“你不会要在我和[pc.name]面前哭吧，玉姬琪罗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” Paige interrupts, leaning forward to boop her nose against Kiro’s. “You’re not gonna cry in front of me and [pc.name], are you, Kiro Tamahime?”"

rows.original: “Shut up!” shouts Kiro defiantly through the building spittle in her grinning mouth. “You’re one to talk!”
rows.translation: “闭嘴！”琪罗倔强地喊道，咧开的嘴里积起唾液。“你还有脸说我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shut up!” shouts Kiro defiantly through the building spittle in her grinning mouth. “You’re one to talk!”"

rows.original: Paige can’t help but laugh well-meaningly. “Kiro Tamahime,” she repeats, her voice low and reverent, still reeling from meeting her again.
rows.translation: 佩姬忍不住善意地笑起来。“玉姬琪罗，”她重复道，声音低沉而敬畏，仍沉浸在重逢的震撼中。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige can’t help but laugh well-meaningly. “Kiro Tamahime,” she repeats, her voice low and reverent, still reeling from meeting her again."

rows.original: Paige sniffles long and hard through her nose, trying to maintain her own composure. Neither of them say anything for another few moments, too caught up in the rush of finally having been reunited to say anything more. Delicately, so as to not ruin the moment, you suggest that the three of them take a seat. Like Kiro said, you three have a lot of catching up to do.
rows.translation: 佩姬用鼻子长长地用力抽泣，努力保持镇定。接下来几个瞬间，两人谁也没有说话，终于团聚的激动令她们无暇多言。为了不破坏这一刻，你轻声建议三个人坐下来。正如琪罗所说，你们三人有许多近况要聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige sniffles long and hard through her nose, trying to maintain her own composure. Neither of them say anything for another few moments, too caught up in the rush of finally having been reunited to say anything more. Delicately, so as to not ruin the moment, you suggest that the three of them take a seat. Like Kiro said, you three have a lot of catching up to do."

rows.original: Kiro takes another deep breath through her nose. “Yeah,” she agrees, mustering the strength to finally pull away from the huddle. Gripping you both tight as a vice, she makes her way to your bed, plopping herself down on its edge; you both help Paige to it, and then, your hand still locked with Kiro’s, you pull out your desk chair and sit on it. While your bed is bigger than theirs, you wouldn’t want to get in between the girls.
rows.translation: 琪罗又用鼻子深吸一口气。“好，”她同意道，终于鼓起力量离开拥抱。她如虎钳般紧紧搂着你们俩，走到你的床边，一屁股坐在床沿；你们一起扶佩姬过去，随后你的一只手仍与琪罗紧握，另一只手拉出书桌椅坐下。虽说你的床比她们的更大，但你可不想挤在两个姑娘中间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro takes another deep breath through her nose. “Yeah,” she agrees, mustering the strength to finally pull away from the huddle. Gripping you both tight as a vice, she makes her way to your bed, plopping herself down on its edge; you both help Paige to it, and then, your hand still locked with Kiro’s, you pull out your desk chair and sit on it. While your bed is bigger than theirs, you wouldn’t want to get in between the girls."

rows.original: Paige and Kiro are too caught up in each other’s presence to break the ice any further than that; sitting side-by-side, they’re comfortable with simply holding hands and leaning against each other for some time more.
rows.translation: 佩姬和琪罗太过沉浸在彼此的存在中，无心进一步打破沉默；她们肩并肩坐着，只是牵手、彼此依靠一段时间，便已感到满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige and Kiro are too caught up in each other’s presence to break the ice any further than that; sitting side-by-side, they’re comfortable with simply holding hands and leaning against each other for some time more."

rows.original: Looks like it’s up to you to get the conversation going this time.
rows.translation: 看来这一次得由你来开启对话。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like it’s up to you to get the conversation going this time."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: B
“So, like, is she your ship’s fitness instructor, or something? Last I heard, Paige wouldn’t leave her little apartment for anything other than her work,” Kiro asks.
rows.translation: “所以说，她是你船上的健身教练之类的吗？我上次听说时，佩姬除了工作，什么事都不能让她离开那间小公寓，”琪罗问道。
rows.raw: "“So, like, is she your ship’s fitness instructor, or something? Last I heard, Paige wouldn’t leave her little apartment for anything other than her work,” Kiro asks."

rows.original: Yes, Paige does teach yoga on your ship, to keep yourself and your crew in shape, but that’s actually her night job. Her day job is that she’s your ship’s navigator.
rows.translation: 没错，佩姬确实在你船上教瑜伽，好让你和船员保持身材，但那其实是她的夜间兼职。她的正职是你船上的领航员。
rows.raw: "\n\nYes, Paige does teach yoga on your ship, to keep yourself and your crew in shape, but that’s actually her night job. Her day job is that she’s your ship’s navigator."

rows.original: “How’d you do that?” she asks incredulously. “Last I heard, Paige was blind. How’s she gonna navigate with no eyesight?”
rows.translation: “你怎么办到的？”她难以置信地问。“我上次听说时，佩姬还是盲人。没有视力，她怎么导航？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d you do that?” she asks incredulously. “Last I heard, Paige was blind. How’s she gonna navigate with no eyesight?”"

rows.original: You reply that you had paid for Paige’s surgery and that she joined your crew in part to pay you back, and in part because she wanted to be with you.
rows.translation: 你回答说佩姬的手术费是你付的，她加入你的船员队伍，一部分是为了还你人情，一部分是因为她想和你在一起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you had paid for Paige’s surgery and that she joined your crew in part to pay you back, and in part because she wanted to be with you."

rows.original: “What the hell?” Kiro asks, her breath catching in her throat. “Didn’t she say that surgery would cost her a million credits or something?”
rows.translation: “搞什么鬼？”琪罗问道，呼吸卡在喉咙里。“她不是说手术要花一百万信用点之类的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What the hell?” Kiro asks, her breath catching in her throat. “Didn’t she say that surgery would cost her a million credits or something?”"

rows.original: “Half a million,” you correct her. You lead Kiro to your own quarters and show her in before instructing her to wait while you get Paige.
rows.translation: “五十万，”你纠正她。你把琪罗带到自己的房间，让她进去等候，自己则去找佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Half a million,” you correct her. You lead Kiro to your own quarters and show her in before instructing her to wait while you get Paige."

rows.original: “In your own quarters, huh?” she snickers, pinching her thighs together to try and tame her flagging-but-still-powerful erection. “I’m not sure what it is you’re implying, angel.”
rows.translation: “在你自己的房间，对吧？”她窃笑着夹紧大腿，努力控制正在减弱却依旧有力的勃起。“我不太明白你在暗示什么，天使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In your own quarters, huh?” she snickers, pinching her thighs together to try and tame her flagging-but-still-powerful erection. “I’m not sure what it is you’re implying, angel.”"

rows.original: You tell her that the truth is that your quarters are larger and more comfortable than their own. Paige told you that she hadn’t seen Kiro in years, and you’re sure they’d appreciate a comfy atmosphere for such a reunion. If having a ‘happy ending’ was all that you had in mind, you could have invited either of them to their own quarters, for some cramped, stuffy, fluffy three-way action. Besides, Paige might suspect something if you told her to meet you at someone else’s quarters.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，真相是你的房间比她们的更大、更舒适。佩姬说自己已经多年没见琪罗，你相信她们会喜欢在舒适的氛围中重逢。要是你一心只想要个‘快乐结局’，大可以邀请她们中的任何一人去自己的房间，挤在狭窄闷热的毛绒空间里来场三人行。另外，要是你叫佩姬去别人的房间见面，她或许会起疑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that the truth is that your quarters are larger and more comfortable than their own. Paige told you that she hadn’t seen Kiro in years, and you’re sure they’d appreciate a comfy atmosphere for such a reunion. If having a ‘happy ending’ was all that you had in mind, you could have invited either of them to their own quarters, for some cramped, stuffy, fluffy three-way action. Besides, Paige might suspect something if you told her to meet you at someone else’s quarters."

rows.original: “Okay, okay, I get it,” Kiro laughs again, setting herself onto your bed and
rows.translation: “好了好了，我知道了，”琪罗又笑起来，坐到你的床上，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, okay, I get it,” Kiro laughs again, setting herself onto your bed and "

rows.original: making herself comfortable
rows.translation: 让自己舒服地坐好
rows.raw: "making herself comfortable"

rows.original: crossing her legs
rows.translation: 交叉双腿
rows.raw: "crossing her legs"

rows.original: . “You have zero ulterior motives, Angel, and you’re expecting absolutely nothing in return after getting me all hot and bothered in my own room. I understand.”
rows.translation: 。“你毫无私心，天使，你在我的房间里把我撩得欲火焚身，却完全不指望任何回报。我明白了。”
rows.raw: ". “You have zero ulterior motives, Angel, and you’re expecting absolutely nothing in return after getting me all hot and bothered in my own room. I understand.”"

rows.original: Well, as long as she understands. You step toward the ship’s intercom and you dial up Paige’s quarters. “Navigator Paige, please come to my personal quarters,” you say clearly.
rows.translation: 好吧，只要她明白就好。你走向飞船的对讲机，拨通佩姬的舱室。“领航员佩姬，请到我的私人舱室来，”你清楚地说。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, as long as she understands. You step toward the ship’s intercom and you dial up Paige’s quarters. “Navigator Paige, please come to my personal quarters,” you say clearly."

rows.original: “On my way, captain!” Paige replies a moment later.
rows.translation: “马上就到，船长！”佩姬片刻后答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On my way, captain!” Paige replies a moment later."

rows.original: Kiro hums at the display. “You use your ship’s intercom for booty calls?” she asks, amused.
rows.translation: 琪罗对着这一幕哼了一声。“你用船上的通讯器约炮？”她饶有兴致地问。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro hums at the display. “You use your ship’s intercom for booty calls?” she asks, amused."

rows.original: “Like you wouldn’t, if you had a crew,” you say back.
rows.translation: “好像你有了船员就不会这么做似的，”你回嘴道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like you wouldn’t, if you had a crew,” you say back."

rows.original: “You got me!” she says jovially, her breasts bouncing underneath her laughter.
rows.translation: “被你说中了！”她快活地说，双乳在笑声中颤动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You got me!” she says jovially, her breasts bouncing underneath her laughter."

rows.original: Then, there’s a knock on your door, the sound of your knuckles against the metal reverberating through the cold hallway of the ship. It swings open without your invitation; on the other side is Paige, your Ausar navigator.
rows.translation: 接着，你的门响起敲击声，指节敲在金属上的声音回荡在飞船冰冷的走廊里。门未经邀请便打开了；另一边是你的奥萨人导航员佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, there’s a knock on your door, the sound of your knuckles against the metal reverberating through the cold hallway of the ship. It swings open without your invitation; on the other side is Paige, your Ausar navigator."

rows.original: “Captain?” asks Paige, her eyes scanning the room as she enters – until her eyes meet Kiro’s.
rows.translation: “船长？”佩姬问道，她走进来时眼睛扫视着房间–直到目光与琪罗相接。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain?” asks Paige, her eyes scanning the room as she enters – until her eyes meet Kiro’s."

rows.original: “Uh,” Kiro stutters, at a loss for words – a rarity for her. “Hey there, Bookworm.”
rows.translation: “呃，”琪罗结巴着，一时语塞 – 这对她来说很罕见。“嘿，书虫。”

rows.original: For Kiro’s part, her face keeps slate still and she doesn’t outwardly react to your question. She masks her face with her hair, looking studiously away to shield her eyes. “The Ausar that runs the yoga studio, right?” she asks. Her body language is watery and smooth, making sure you can’t get a read on her. “I’ve heard the name, but I’m not familiar with the woman, if that’s what you’re asking.”
rows.translation: 至于琪罗，她的脸纹丝不动，对你的问题没有露出任何外在反应。她用头发遮住脸，刻意把目光移开，好挡住眼睛。“开瑜伽馆的那个奥萨尔，对吧？”她问。她的肢体语言流动而平滑，确保你读不出她的心思。“这名字我听过，但我跟那位女士不熟，如果你是问这个的话。”

rows.original: You take a seat next to Kiro. She’s already got a mug half-downed in her hand, and when you take your spot, she takes a hearty swig of it. “Well come on,” she says playfully, nudging you in the shoulder. “You gonna have a drink or what?”
rows.translation: 你在琪罗旁边坐下。她手里已经拿着半杯喝掉的啤酒，你一坐好，她便畅快地大灌一口。“快点嘛，”她顽皮地说道，用肩膀撞了撞你。“你到底喝不喝？”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep, it’s me alright,” she responds, pulling herself to her feet to meet her friend. “It’s good to see you again!”"

rows.original: Paige extends her hand straight out, her palm facing inside, as if she were looking for a handshake. She gets one, but not the way you had expected: Kiro’s hand reaches out and interlocks her fingers with Paige’s, and then they begin an elaborate handshake, by clapping each other by the wrists; lifting their arms and bumping each other’s elbows; twisting their arms back down in front of their bodies, giving them room to lean forward and headbutt each other; and finishing with their free hand wrapping forward in what at first looks like a friendly embrace, until they twist and open-hand slap each other on the ass.
rows.translation: 佩姬把手臂直直伸出，掌心朝内，像是想跟人握手。她确实握到了，只是方式和你预想的不同：琪罗的手伸出来，手指与佩姬的交扣，然后两人开始了一套繁复的握手礼，先是互拍手腕；接着抬起手臂对撞手肘；再把手臂扭回身前放下，腾出空间让两人前倾互撞额头；最后用空着的那只手往前一揽，乍看像是友好的拥抱，直到她们一扭身，抬手在对方屁股上拍了一巴掌。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige extends her hand straight out, her palm facing inside, as if she were looking for a handshake. She gets one, but not the way you had expected: Kiro’s hand reaches out and interlocks her fingers with Paige’s, and then they begin an elaborate handshake, by clapping each other by the wrists; lifting their arms and bumping each other’s elbows; twisting their arms back down in front of their bodies, giving them room to lean forward and headbutt each other; and finishing with their free hand wrapping forward in what at first looks like a friendly embrace, until they twist and open-hand slap each other on the ass."

rows.original: “Holy shit!” Paige nearly shrieks in delight, gripping onto Kiro by the shoulders. Her eyes go wide as saucers and her mouth hangs open in the widest, childlike grin you think you’ve ever seen her make.
rows.translation: “我操！”佩姬兴奋得几乎尖叫，抓住琪罗的双肩。她的双眼睁得像碟子一样大，嘴巴张开，露出你觉得自己见过的她最灿烂、最孩子气的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Holy shit!” Paige nearly shrieks in delight, gripping onto Kiro by the shoulders. Her eyes go wide as saucers and her mouth hangs open in the widest, childlike grin you think you’ve ever seen her make."

rows.original: “I know, right?!” Kiro responds, just as elated at their good fortune. “Goddamn, we sure know how to pick ‘em, don’t we, Bookworm?”
rows.translation: “我就说吧？！”琪罗回应，同样因她们的好运欣喜若狂。“该死，我们可真会挑人，对吧，书虫？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, right?!” Kiro responds, just as elated at their good fortune. “Goddamn, we sure know how to pick ‘em, don’t we, Bookworm?”"

rows.original: “Is this real? Is this real life?” asks Paige, her eyes flitting from Kiro’s to your general direction. “Is it real that my favorite yoga student just happens to be on a first-name basis with my best friend?”
rows.translation: “这是真的吗？这是真实人生吗？”佩姬问，双眼从琪罗转向你的大致方向。“我最喜欢的瑜伽学生竟然恰好和我最好的朋友直呼其名，这是真的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this real? Is this real life?” asks Paige, her eyes flitting from Kiro’s to your general direction. “Is it real that my favorite yoga student just happens to be on a first-name basis with my best friend?”"

rows.original: “Oh, please, honey, let’s not pretend that [pc.heShe] doesn’t just ‘know’ either of us. I doubt we’d let someone like [pc.himHer] get this deep between us by doing some yoga and grabbing some drinks.” Kiro slaps Paige on the ass once again, allowing herself to get more than a little bit of a handful while she’s at it. “You know me as well as I know you.”
rows.translation: “哦，拜托，亲爱的，别假装[pc.heShe]只是‘认识’我们中的任何一个。我不觉得我们会让[pc.himHer]仅靠做几次瑜伽、喝几杯酒，就深深插进我们之间。”琪罗再次拍了佩姬的屁股，同时顺手狠狠抓了一大把。“你了解我，正如我了解你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, please, honey, let’s not pretend that [pc.heShe] doesn’t just ‘know’ either of us. I doubt we’d let someone like [pc.himHer] get this deep between us by doing some yoga and grabbing some drinks.” Kiro slaps Paige on the ass once again, allowing herself to get more than a little bit of a handful while she’s at it. “You know me as well as I know you.”"

rows.original: “Well–” Paige starts, nervously tilting her head from side to side, until she breaks down into a lazy, red-handed grin. “Yeah.”
rows.translation: “嗯–”佩姬开口道，紧张地把头左右歪来歪去，直到终于绷不住，露出一个慵懒又心虚的坏笑。“是啊。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well–” Paige starts, nervously tilting her head from side to side, until she breaks down into a lazy, red-handed grin. “Yeah.”"

rows.original: Kiro’s head turns, her hair swishing around her shoulders from the jerking motion, to face you. “You!” she demands, her steely gaze fixated on you. “Lock the door and get over here!”
rows.translation: 琪罗猛然转头面向你，头发随动作甩过肩头。“你！”她命令道，钢铁般的目光紧盯着你。“锁门，然后过来！”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro’s head turns, her hair swishing around her shoulders from the jerking motion, to face you. “You!” she demands, her steely gaze fixated on you. “Lock the door and get over here!”"

rows.original: You do as you’re commanded: you key in the lock’s code, and you approach the two girls. As soon as you’re in arm’s length, Kiro grips you by the shoulder and yanks you between her and Paige. She says nothing; her arms wrap tightly around you both, locking you close to her body. Paige does the same to you and Kiro, and, taking their lead, you do the same to them.
rows.translation: 你照命令行事：输入锁的密码，然后走向那两个女孩。你才刚进到一臂之内，琪罗就抓住你的肩膀，把你拽到她和佩姬中间。她什么也没说；双臂紧紧环住你们俩，把你贴在她身上。佩姬也照样抱住你和琪罗，你便跟着她们的做法，同样抱住她们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do as you’re commanded: you key in the lock’s code, and you approach the two girls. As soon as you’re in arm’s length, Kiro grips you by the shoulder and yanks you between her and Paige. She says nothing; her arms wrap tightly around you both, locking you close to her body. Paige does the same to you and Kiro, and, taking their lead, you do the same to them."

rows.original: Conversation is a bit light – the three of you simply enjoy each other’s company for a while. Kiro and Paige take deep, excited breaths, in through their noses and out their mouths, as they try to contain themselves. Girlish giggles make for the ambience of the room as the three of you share an intimate group hug; in fact, Kiro is shaking in pure delight and excitement at finally having met Paige once again.
rows.translation: 交谈不多——你们三人只是享受了一阵彼此陪伴的时光。琪罗和佩姬兴奋地深呼吸，从鼻中吸气、口中呼气，努力克制自己。你们三人亲密地抱作一团，姑娘们的咯咯笑声构成房间里的氛围；事实上，终于再次见到佩姬令琪罗因纯粹的喜悦和兴奋而浑身颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\nConversation is a bit light – the three of you simply enjoy each other’s company for a while. Kiro and Paige take deep, excited breaths, in through their noses and out their mouths, as they try to contain themselves. Girlish giggles make for the ambience of the room as the three of you share an intimate group hug; in fact, Kiro is shaking in pure delight and excitement at finally having met Paige once again."

rows.original: “We have so much shit to do,” Kiro says happily, her head leaning against Paige’s. “It’s been so long, Paige. I... I knew you were alive and safe, in Tavros, and I wanted to... I, I wanted to visit, I wanted to, like, send you a message, or maybe take a yoga class or something....” She begins to stutter as the words fall apart in her mouth. “I dunno, I dunno how I was gonna do it. I was gonna put on a disguise, or, or, I thought of maybe sending you snail-mail, or I was gonna ask Mason to help–”
rows.translation: “我们有太多狗屁事要做了，”琪罗开心地说道，脑袋靠在佩姬头上。“已经太久了，佩姬。我... 我知道你还活着，在塔夫罗斯很安全，我想... 我、我想去看你，想给你发消息，也许参加一堂瑜伽课什么的....”话语在她嘴里散乱，她开始结巴。“我不知道，不知道自己要怎么做。我本来想乔装打扮，或者、或者，我想过也许给你寄平信，或者请梅森帮忙——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We have so much shit to do,” Kiro says happily, her head leaning against Paige’s. “It’s been so long, Paige. I... I knew you were alive and safe, in Tavros, and I wanted to... I, I wanted to visit, I wanted to, like, send you a message, or maybe take a yoga class or something....” She begins to stutter as the words fall apart in her mouth. “I dunno, I dunno how I was gonna do it. I was gonna put on a disguise, or, or, I thought of maybe sending you snail-mail, or I was gonna ask Mason to help–”"

rows.original: “Hey,” Paige interrupts, leaning forward to boop her nose against Kiro’s. “You’re not gonna cry in front of me and [pc.name], are you, Kiro Tamahime?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”佩姬打断她，向前倾身，用鼻尖轻碰琪罗的鼻子。“你不会要在我和[pc.name]面前哭吧，玉姬琪罗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” Paige interrupts, leaning forward to boop her nose against Kiro’s. “You’re not gonna cry in front of me and [pc.name], are you, Kiro Tamahime?”"

rows.original: “No!” shouts Kiro defiantly through the building spittle in her grinning mouth. “Shut up!”
rows.translation: “不！”琪罗咧着嘴，带着满口积聚的唾沫不服气地喊道。“闭嘴！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No!” shouts Kiro defiantly through the building spittle in her grinning mouth. “Shut up!”"

rows.original: Paige can’t help but laugh well-meaningly. “Kiro Tamahime,” she repeats, her voice low and reverent, still reeling from meeting her again. “Brought to tears by little old me.”
rows.translation: 佩姬忍不住善意地笑起来。“玉姬琪罗，”她重复道，声音低沉而敬畏，仍沉浸在重逢的震撼中。“居然被小小的我感动到落泪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige can’t help but laugh well-meaningly. “Kiro Tamahime,” she repeats, her voice low and reverent, still reeling from meeting her again. “Brought to tears by little old me.”"

rows.original: Paige sniffles long and hard through her nose, trying to maintain her own composure. Neither of them say anything for another few moments, too caught up in the rush of finally having been reunited to say anything more. Delicately, so as to not ruin the moment, you suggest that the three of you take a seat. Like Kiro said, you three have a lot of catching up to do.
rows.translation: 佩姬用鼻子长长地用力抽泣，努力保持镇定。接下来几个瞬间，两人谁也没有说话，终于团聚的激动令她们无暇多言。为了不破坏这一刻，你轻声建议三个人坐下来。正如琪罗所说，你们三人有许多近况要聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige sniffles long and hard through her nose, trying to maintain her own composure. Neither of them say anything for another few moments, too caught up in the rush of finally having been reunited to say anything more. Delicately, so as to not ruin the moment, you suggest that the three of you take a seat. Like Kiro said, you three have a lot of catching up to do."

rows.original: Kiro takes another deep breath through her nose. “Yeah,” she agrees, mustering the strength to finally pull away from the huddle. Gripping you both tight as a vice, she makes her way to your bed, plopping herself down on its edge; you both help Paige to it, and then, your hand still locked with Kiro’s, you pull out your desk chair and sit on it. Your bed isn’t all that big, after all, and you wouldn’t want to get in between the girls.
rows.translation: 琪罗又用鼻子深吸一口气。“好，”她同意道，终于鼓起力量离开拥抱。她如虎钳般紧紧搂着你们俩，走到你的床边，一屁股坐在床沿；你们一起扶佩姬过去，随后你的一只手仍与琪罗紧握，另一只手拉出书桌椅坐下。毕竟你的床也没那么大，而且你不想挤在两个姑娘中间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro takes another deep breath through her nose. “Yeah,” she agrees, mustering the strength to finally pull away from the huddle. Gripping you both tight as a vice, she makes her way to your bed, plopping herself down on its edge; you both help Paige to it, and then, your hand still locked with Kiro’s, you pull out your desk chair and sit on it. Your bed isn’t all that big, after all, and you wouldn’t want to get in between the girls."

rows.original: Paige and Kiro are too caught up in each other’s presence to break the ice any further than that; sitting side-by-side, they’re comfortable with simply holding hands and leaning against each other for some time more.
rows.translation: 佩姬和琪罗太过沉浸在彼此的存在中，无心进一步打破沉默；她们肩并肩坐着，只是牵手、彼此依靠一段时间，便已感到满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige and Kiro are too caught up in each other’s presence to break the ice any further than that; sitting side-by-side, they’re comfortable with simply holding hands and leaning against each other for some time more."

rows.original: Looks like it’s up to you to get the conversation going this time.
rows.translation: 看来这一次得由你来开启对话。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like it’s up to you to get the conversation going this time."

rows.original: B!
You ask the women what sort of relationship they had growing up. If you remember right, Paige told you that they met each other in some kind of gymnastics class?
rows.translation: 你询问两个女人，她们成长过程中是什么关系。如果没记错，佩姬说她们是在某种体操课上认识的？
rows.raw: "You ask the women what sort of relationship they had growing up. If you remember right, Paige told you that they met each other in some kind of gymnastics class?"

rows.original: “That’s right,” Paige answered, nudging Kiro in the shoulder. “Gosh, imagine what our parents would think if they knew this was where something as innocuous as a gymnastics class was going to take us. Piracy and polyamory; how scandalous!”
rows.translation: “说得对，”佩姬答道，用肩膀碰了碰琪罗。“天啊，想象一下，要是爸妈知道这就是当初一节人畜无害的体操课最后会把我们带到的地方，他们会怎么想。海盗行径加上多角恋；多么伤风败俗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right,” Paige answered, nudging Kiro in the shoulder. “Gosh, imagine what our parents would think if they knew this was where something as innocuous as a gymnastics class was going to take us. Piracy and polyamory; how scandalous!”"

rows.original: “I don’t even know why my old lady wanted me in that class,” says Kiro, shrugging in indifference. “I guess it was good exercise and all, but she enrolled me in my early teens; she must have known that putting a developing Kui-Tan in a class full of other developing teenagers, where the exercise was to do a lot of bouncing, was probably not the best combination.”
rows.translation: “我都不知道我家老太太为什么想让我上那门课，”琪罗无所谓地耸耸肩说道。“我猜那确实是不错的锻炼，但她在我刚进入青春期时给我报名；她肯定该知道，把一个发育中的奎坦人放进满是其他发育中青少年的班级，而运动内容又包括大量弹跳，可能不是最好的组合。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t even know why my old lady wanted me in that class,” says Kiro, shrugging in indifference. “I guess it was good exercise and all, but she enrolled me in my early teens; she must have known that putting a developing Kui-Tan in a class full of other developing teenagers, where the exercise was to do a lot of bouncing, was probably not the best combination.”"

rows.original: You ask if the two ladies had ever been romantically involved. Paige didn’t talk about Kiro much, and when she did, it was usually about their capabilities as pirates.
rows.translation: 你问两位女士是否曾有过恋爱关系。佩姬很少谈琪罗，即使谈起，通常也是说她们作为海盗的本事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if the two ladies had ever been romantically involved. Paige didn’t talk about Kiro much, and when she did, it was usually about their capabilities as pirates."

rows.original: “I mean, we thought about it,” Paige answers. “We even gave it a try for... six months, I think? We tried to call ourselves girlfriends, but it never really stuck. I dunno; we’d both see somebody cute and we’d both try to go after them, and we’d forget that we’re only supposed to have eyes for each other.”
rows.translation: “我是说，我们确实想过，”佩姬回答。“我们甚至尝试了... 我想有六个月？我们试着称彼此为女朋友，但一直没真正适应。我不知道；我们俩只要看见可爱的人，都会试着去追，然后忘了自己应该只看着对方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean, we thought about it,” Paige answers. “We even gave it a try for... six months, I think? We tried to call ourselves girlfriends, but it never really stuck. I dunno; we’d both see somebody cute and we’d both try to go after them, and we’d forget that we’re only supposed to have eyes for each other.”"

rows.original: “We fucked a lot, though,” interjected Kiro.
rows.translation: “不过我们操了很多次，”琪罗插嘴道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We fucked a lot, though,” interjected Kiro."

rows.original: “Yeah we did.” Paige’s fingers interlock with Kiro’s, and her body relaxes – if you weren’t listening to Paige’s words right now, you’d easily make the mistake that they were a couple, with their body language towards one another. “Sometimes I wonder if it would have been so bad to try and keep it up. Way back in the day, Kiro and I agreed that if we couldn’t go steady with each other, then maybe it wasn’t meant to be. So we kept it on the friends-with-benefits level.”

But,” she pauses, her fingers going across the groove of her scar across both her eyes, “if I had known that this would happen, and the crap I had to deal with afterward... I’m not sure if I would have stuck with it all. But, then again, I say this in hindsight; if I could travel back in time and tell my younger self to pull out of the game while I was ahead, I’m not sure if I would have listened.”"

rows.original: Kiro nudges at Paige affectionately, nodding towards you. “Hey, look at the bright side.”
rows.translation: 琪罗亲昵地蹭了蹭佩姬，朝你点点头。“嘿，往好处想想。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro nudges at Paige affectionately, nodding towards you. “Hey, look at the bright side.” "

rows.original: Her lips curl inward as she realizes what she just said. “Uh, you know what I mean.” She clears her throat.
rows.translation: 她意识到自己刚说了什么，嘴唇抿了进去。“呃，你知道我什么意思。”她清了清嗓子。
rows.raw: "Her lips curl inward as she realizes what she just said. “Uh, you know what I mean.” She clears her throat. "

rows.original: “Sure, that one job went south in a hurry – but if all that didn’t happen, neither of us would have met [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “当然，那次任务很快就彻底搞砸了，但如果那些事情没有发生，我们谁都不会遇见[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "“Sure, that one job went south in a hurry – but if all that didn’t happen, neither of us would have met [pc.name].”"

rows.original: “Sure?” she answers indecisively. “I mean, don’t get me wrong, [pc.name],
rows.translation: “你确定？”她犹豫不决地回答。“我是说，别误会，[pc.name]，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure?” she answers indecisively. “I mean, don’t get me wrong, [pc.name], "

rows.original: you’re a huge part of my life and I wouldn’t be here with Kiro today if it weren’t for you
rows.translation: 你是我生命中极其重要的一部分，要不是你，我今天也不会和绮罗一起待在这里
rows.raw: "you’re a huge part of my life and I wouldn’t be here with Kiro today if it weren’t for you"

rows.original: you’ve gone above and beyond what I could have expected from anybody, and I love you with all my heart for it
rows.translation: 你做得远远超出了我对任何人能有的期待，为此我全心全意地爱你
rows.raw: "you’ve gone above and beyond what I could have expected from anybody, and I love you with all my heart for it"

rows.original: , but... I dunno, guys, I really liked my eyes. Is it wrong of me to want those years of my life back?”
rows.translation: ，但是...我不知道，各位，我真的很喜欢自己的眼睛。希望找回人生中失去的那些年，难道是我的错吗？”
rows.raw: ", but... I dunno, guys, I really liked my eyes. Is it wrong of me to want those years of my life back?”"

rows.original: In an effort to diffuse Paige’s emotions about her eyes, you tell her that you understand completely, and that it’s alright to pine for a reality that could have been. You don’t take it personally: it was a difficult thing Paige had to go through. “Thanks, [pc.name], it means a lot to me to hear you say that.”
rows.translation: 为了缓和佩姬对眼睛的情绪，你告诉她自己完全理解，怀念一种原本可能实现的人生并没有错。你不会往心里去；佩姬不得不经历的事十分艰难。“谢谢，[pc.name]，听你这么说对我意义重大。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn an effort to diffuse Paige’s emotions about her eyes, you tell her that you understand completely, and that it’s alright to pine for a reality that could have been. You don’t take it personally: it was a difficult thing Paige had to go through. “Thanks, [pc.name], it means a lot to me to hear you say that.”"

rows.original: You try to steer the conversation towards something a little happier. You ask the two ladies what their favorite heist was.
rows.translation: 你试着把话题引向轻松一点的事。你问两位女士她们最喜欢的一次劫案是哪次。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to steer the conversation towards something a little happier. You ask the two ladies what their favorite heist was."

rows.original: “Oh, that one’s easy,” Kiro says happily, leaning backward with a goofy smile as she reminisces about her favorite con. “Okay, so, picture it: we get some intel that some precious minerals are getting shipped out of Uveto. Uveto exports lots of minerals that are used for aphrodisiacs and the like, and they go for a good price in the market.”
rows.translation: “噢，这个简单，”绮罗开心地说，回忆起最喜欢的骗局时带着傻乎乎的笑容向后靠去。“好，想象一下：我们得到情报，说有一批珍贵矿物即将运离乌维托。乌维托出口许多用于催情剂之类产品的矿物，在市场上能卖个好价钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that one’s easy,” Kiro says happily, leaning backward with a goofy smile as she reminisces about her favorite con. “Okay, so, picture it: we get some intel that some precious minerals are getting shipped out of Uveto. Uveto exports lots of minerals that are used for aphrodisiacs and the like, and they go for a good price in the market.”"

rows.original: “I remember this one,” Paige laughs.
rows.translation: “我记得这次，”佩姬笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I remember this one,” Paige laughs."

rows.original: “We had to hit them fast; shipments carrying precious cargo out of Terra don’t get UGC escorts until they leave the Siretta system, and the TSC can’t escort any caravans before then because then they’d be spreading their manpower too thin, which meant, with the technology available at the time, we had about a two hour window to intercept them. So, we just had to stakeout around a nearby planet’s orbit until the ship came by; board them; take their loot; and buzz off before their distress signal could be received and acted on.”
rows.translation: “我们得速战速决；运载着贵重货物离开泰拉的货船，在驶出西雷塔星系之前是不会有UGC护航的，而TSC在那之前也没法给任何商队护航，因为那样人力就摊得太薄了。也就是说，以当时能用的技术，我们只有大约两个小时的窗口去截住他们。所以我们只能在附近某颗行星的轨道上蹲守，等那艘船经过；登船；抢走货物；然后在他们的求救信号被收到并作出反应之前溜之大吉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We had to hit them fast; shipments carrying precious cargo out of Terra don’t get UGC escorts until they leave the Siretta system, and the TSC can’t escort any caravans before then because then they’d be spreading their manpower too thin, which meant, with the technology available at the time, we had about a two hour window to intercept them. So, we just had to stakeout around a nearby planet’s orbit until the ship came by; board them; take their loot; and buzz off before their distress signal could be received and acted on.”"

rows.original: You respectfully sit patiently while Kiro excitedly tells her story. “Turns out, though, that some ballsy fuckers had beaten us to it! A rival gang called the Terrace of the Free Market – not an especially large gang, but they liked to step on our toes every now and again. Like right then! They had gotten to the transport before Paige and I did, and they were already taking our shit before we had to chance to steal it!”
rows.translation: 绮罗兴奋讲述故事时，你礼貌而耐心地坐着。“然而事实证明，有些胆大包天的混蛋抢先一步！那是一个名叫自由市场露台的敌对团伙，规模算不上特别大，却时不时喜欢踩我们的脚。就像当时！他们比我和佩姬先到运输船，我们还没来得及下手，他们就已经在偷属于我们的东西了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respectfully sit patiently while Kiro excitedly tells her story. “Turns out, though, that some ballsy fuckers had beaten us to it! A rival gang called the Terrace of the Free Market – not an especially large gang, but they liked to step on our toes every now and again. Like right then! They had gotten to the transport before Paige and I did, and they were already taking our shit before we had to chance to steal it!”"

rows.original: Kiro’s hands move animatedly around herself as she tells the story, and her eyes are wide and lit, elating in remembering every facet of the heist. “So, Paige and I, we briefly considered just letting them have it and cut our losses on fuel and time. There would always be another mark to hit later, right?”
rows.translation: 讲故事时，绮罗双手在身旁生动比划，眼睛睁得又大又亮，为回忆劫案的每个细节而兴奋。“所以，我和佩姬短暂考虑过干脆把东西让给他们，只认下燃料和时间的损失。以后总会有另一个目标可以动手，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro’s hands move animatedly around herself as she tells the story, and her eyes are wide and lit, elating in remembering every facet of the heist. “So, Paige and I, we briefly considered just letting them have it and cut our losses on fuel and time. There would always be another mark to hit later, right?”"

rows.original: “Fuck that!” Paige said.
rows.translation: “去他妈的！”佩姬说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck that!” Paige said."

rows.original: “Yeah, fuck that! We had come all that way, just for some pissy upstarts to try and get the jump on the Tamahime Pirates? If they wanted a fight, we’d give them a fight!”
rows.translation: “对，去他的！我们跑了这么远，难道就是让一群恼人的暴发户抢在玉姬海盗团前面？既然他们想打，我们就陪他们打！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, fuck that! We had come all that way, just for some pissy upstarts to try and get the jump on the Tamahime Pirates? If they wanted a fight, we’d give them a fight!”"

rows.original: Paige leans towards you, one hand against her face to hide it from Kiro’s gaze. “I didn’t agree to that name, by the way,” she whispers to you, winking.
rows.translation: 佩姬向你靠近，一只手挡在脸侧，避开绮罗视线。“顺便说一句，我可没同意这个名字，”她朝你低语，眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige leans towards you, one hand against her face to hide it from Kiro’s gaze. “I didn’t agree to that name, by the way,” she whispers to you, winking."

rows.original: “Anyway, Paige and I, we board the ship right then and there, guns blazing; tasers crackling; the whole nine yards. Figured we’d get the jump on them and try to overwhelm them before they even had a chance to fight back. And it went pretty well! There were only three of them, and Paige and I, we knew how to carry ourselves in a fight. It wasn’t all that hard to knock the Terrace around and steal those jewels for ourselves.”
rows.translation: “总之，我和佩姬当场登船，枪火四射、电击枪噼啪作响，所有手段全用上了。我们打算抢占先机，在他们有机会还手前将其压倒。而且进展很顺利！他们只有三个人，我和佩姬又都知道如何在战斗中照顾自己。揍翻露台帮，把那些宝石抢给自己，并不算太难。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, Paige and I, we board the ship right then and there, guns blazing; tasers crackling; the whole nine yards. Figured we’d get the jump on them and try to overwhelm them before they even had a chance to fight back. And it went pretty well! There were only three of them, and Paige and I, we knew how to carry ourselves in a fight. It wasn’t all that hard to knock the Terrace around and steal those jewels for ourselves.”"

rows.original: “Here comes the good part,” Paige interrupts.
rows.translation: “精彩的部分来了，”佩姬插嘴道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here comes the good part,” Paige interrupts."

rows.original: “Yeah! So, we had control of the ship and the cargo. We just needed to move the things onto my ship, and we’d be off. But wouldn’t you fuckin’ know it? The whole thing took too long, and we let the UGC catch up to us from outside Siretta. So, that cargo ship was boarded for a third time, and this time, it was a bunch of cops!”
rows.translation: “没错！所以，我们控制了飞船和货物。只需把东西搬上我的飞船，就能离开。但他妈谁能想到？整件事耗时太久，我们让银河联合邦联从西蕾塔外面追了上来。于是，那艘货船被登船了第三次，而这次来的是一群警察！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah! So, we had control of the ship and the cargo. We just needed to move the things onto my ship, and we’d be off. But wouldn’t you fuckin’ know it? The whole thing took too long, and we let the UGC catch up to us from outside Siretta. So, that cargo ship was boarded for a third time, and this time, it was a bunch of cops!”"

rows.original: You ask Kiro what she and Paige did then.
rows.translation: 你问琪罗她和佩姬当时做了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Kiro what she and Paige did then."

rows.original: “Fought ‘em off, of course!” Kiro boasts proudly, puffing out her chest in triumph. “Paige and I, we were outnumbered, but, like that one classical album was called, at no point we were ever outgunned. It was a damn free-for-all between us, the Terrace, and the UGC. Every woman for themselves!”
rows.translation: “当然是把他们打退了！”琪罗得意地炫耀，挺起胸膛。“佩姬和我寡不敌众，但就像那张经典专辑的名字说的，我们在火力上从来没输过。那就是我们、台地帮和银河邦联之间的一场大混战。每个女人都只顾自己！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fought ‘em off, of course!” Kiro boasts proudly, puffing out her chest in triumph. “Paige and I, we were outnumbered, but, like that one classical album was called, at no point we were ever outgunned. It was a damn free-for-all between us, the Terrace, and the UGC. Every woman for themselves!”"

rows.original: You shuffle forward on your seat, hanging on Kiro’s every word.
rows.translation: 你在座位上向前挪动，全神贯注地聆听绮罗的每一句话。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shuffle forward on your seat, hanging on Kiro’s every word."

rows.original: “The thing about piracy is that, while you might want to ‘leave your mark’ on the world, you don’t want to stick around for it, you know? Paige and I, we just wanted to start hauling ass as soon as we got those jewels. As soon as we got back to my ship, the day would be ours.”
rows.translation: “当海盗有件事：你或许想在世上‘留下印记’，但绝不能留下来等别人发现，明白吗？我和佩姬只想拿到宝石后立刻拔腿就跑。只要回到我的飞船上，那天的胜利就属于我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The thing about piracy is that, while you might want to ‘leave your mark’ on the world, you don’t want to stick around for it, you know? Paige and I, we just wanted to start hauling ass as soon as we got those jewels. As soon as we got back to my ship, the day would be ours.”"

rows.original: While the answer was kind of forgone, you ask Kiro if she and Paige made it aboard Kiro’s ship safely.
rows.translation: 虽然答案基本已经注定，你还是问琪罗，她和佩姬是否安全登上了琪罗的飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile the answer was kind of forgone, you ask Kiro if she and Paige made it aboard Kiro’s ship safely."

rows.original: “We almost didn’t!” Kiro continues. “Some rookie upstart managed to pull Paige away. I could tell she was new because she was so excited to start prattling off our rights that she hadn’t even got the cuffs on her before she started running her mouth.” Kiro laughed, patting Paige on the shoulder. “She didn’t have a lot of field experience, and Paige didn’t have much issue fighting her off. One to the face,” Kiro said, mimicking the action in slow motion against Paige’s face, “and one in the gut,” she said, hooking the same fist to Paige’s abs, “and Officer Hot-To-Trot was down long enough for us to make it away. Once we were aboard and I had the lock shut behind us, we were off.”
rows.translation: “我们差点就没成功！”绮罗继续道。“有个新来的暴发户成功把佩姬拖走。我一眼就看出她是新人，因为她兴奋地开始喋喋不休地念我们的权利，手铐甚至还没戴上就已经管不住嘴了。”绮罗笑着拍了拍佩姬的肩膀。“她没多少实战经验，佩姬毫不费力就挣脱了她。先往脸上一拳，”绮罗说着，在佩姬脸旁慢动作模仿，“再往肚子上一拳，”她又说着，用同一只拳头勾向佩姬的腹肌，“急不可耐警官就倒下了，给我们留下足够时间逃走。等我们登船，我锁上身后的门，便立刻出发。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We almost didn’t!” Kiro continues. “Some rookie upstart managed to pull Paige away. I could tell she was new because she was so excited to start prattling off our rights that she hadn’t even got the cuffs on her before she started running her mouth.” Kiro laughed, patting Paige on the shoulder. “She didn’t have a lot of field experience, and Paige didn’t have much issue fighting her off. One to the face,” Kiro said, mimicking the action in slow motion against Paige’s face, “and one in the gut,” she said, hooking the same fist to Paige’s abs, “and Officer Hot-To-Trot was down long enough for us to make it away. Once we were aboard and I had the lock shut behind us, we were off.”"

rows.original: “And that’s the story of our favourite heist,” Paige concludes for Kiro. “A free-for-all between us, a rival faction, and the police, and we even made a personal enemy in the force along the way.”
rows.translation: “这就是我们最爱的那次抢劫的故事，”佩姬替琪罗做了总结。“我们、一个敌对派系和警察之间的一场混战，半路上我们还在警队里树了个私敌。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s the story of our favourite heist,” Paige concludes for Kiro. “A free-for-all between us, a rival faction, and the police, and we even made a personal enemy in the force along the way.”"

rows.original: “Is the statute of limitations on those minerals over by now?” Paige asks.
rows.translation: “那些矿物的追诉时效现在过了吗？”佩姬问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is the statute of limitations on those minerals over by now?” Paige asks."

rows.original: “Oh, absolutely. This was years ago, Paige; we could wag our asses in front of those cops and the most they’d be able to do is admire them.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然。这是好几年前的事了，佩姬；我们就算在那些警察面前扭屁股，他们最多也只能欣赏一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, absolutely. This was years ago, Paige; we could wag our asses in front of those cops and the most they’d be able to do is admire them.”"

rows.original: PAIGE_KIRO_PIRACY_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_KIRO_PIRACY_CD"

rows.original: PAIGE_KIRO_PIRACY_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_KIRO_PIRACY_CD"

rows.original: B!

Paige and Kiro sigh in unison as they calm down from their laughing and conversing. Paige looks totally at ease, sitting here in your personal quarters, with the two most special people in her life – it’s almost hard to believe that this was the same woman that was having a hard time leaving her own apartment not too long ago. And Kiro, likewise, has one of the most sincere smiles you’ve ever seen on a woman, much less on her.
rows.translation: 佩姬和绮罗异口同声地叹息，逐渐从欢笑与交谈中平静下来。佩姬坐在你的私人住舱里，身边是生命中最特别的两个人，看起来完全自在；很难相信就在不久前，同一个女人甚至难以离开自己的公寓。同样，绮罗也露出你在任何女人脸上见过最真诚的笑容之一，更不用说是在她脸上。
rows.raw: "Paige and Kiro sigh in unison as they calm down from their laughing and conversing. Paige looks totally at ease, sitting here in your personal quarters, with the two most special people in her life – it’s almost hard to believe that this was the same woman that was having a hard time leaving her own apartment not too long ago. And Kiro, likewise, has one of the most sincere smiles you’ve ever seen on a woman, much less on her."

rows.original: All three of you sit in relaxed silence for a time, simply enjoying the physical company of each other. You have a couple thoughts going through your head that you don’t bother to say out loud. One of them is less of a thought and more of a fantasy: based on one of their earlier conversations, they both mentioned that they wouldn’t mind ‘sharing’ you, and ever since then, you’ve had a hard time shaking the thought of getting them both into the same bed with you.
rows.translation: 你们三人放松地沉默片刻，只是享受彼此实际相伴的感觉。脑海里掠过几个你懒得说出口的想法。其中一个与其说是想法，不如说是幻想：根据她们先前的一次谈话，两人都提到不介意“共享”你；从那以后，你始终难以摆脱把她们一起带上床的念头。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll three of you sit in relaxed silence for a time, simply enjoying the physical company of each other. You have a couple thoughts going through your head that you don’t bother to say out loud. One of them is less of a thought and more of a fantasy: based on one of their earlier conversations, they both mentioned that they wouldn’t mind ‘sharing’ you, and ever since then, you’ve had a hard time shaking the thought of getting them both into the same bed with you."

rows.original: “So, are we gonna fuck or what?” Kiro asks suddenly, breaking the moments-long, maybe minutes-long, silence. “I can’t be the only one that’s had it on her mind since we both just kinda blurted out that we’d be okay with sharing.”
rows.translation: “所以，我们到底要不要做爱？”绮罗突然问道，打破了持续几秒、也许几分钟的沉默。“我们刚才都脱口说出可以共享之后，我不可能是唯一一直想着这件事的人吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, are we gonna fuck or what?” Kiro asks suddenly, breaking the moments-long, maybe minutes-long, silence. “I can’t be the only one that’s had it on her mind since we both just kinda blurted out that we’d be okay with sharing.”"

rows.original: “Gosh, you too?” Paige asks, smiling slyly to Kiro as her legs cross. “I mean, I really enjoyed catching up and all, but it was kinda hard to get the idea out of my head ever since we brought it up.”
rows.translation: “天哪，你也是？” 佩姬问道，双腿交叠，狡黠地冲琪罗一笑。“我是说，我真的很享受叙旧什么的，可自从我们提起那主意，我就一直很难把它从脑子里赶出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gosh, you too?” Paige asks, smiling slyly to Kiro as her legs cross. “I mean, I really enjoyed catching up and all, but it was kinda hard to get the idea out of my head ever since we brought it up.”"

rows.original: As long as everyone’s being open about it, you admit that you had been thinking about it, too. You hope that saying that doesn’t make you a bad person or anything; when you say it, it feels like the only reason you reunited the girls is so you could take advantage of the situation.

rows.raw: "\n\nSeconds later, there’s a hard knock on your door. You don’t tell Paige to enter; she shows herself in. When her eyes meet Kiro’s, both their mouths split into knowing, playful grins."

rows.original: “Hey again, Bookworm,” says Kiro playfully, her bushy tail swishing as Paige locks the door behind her.
rows.translation: “又见面了，书虫，”琪罗顽皮地说道；佩姬在身后锁门时，她蓬松的尾巴轻轻摆动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey again, Bookworm,” says Kiro playfully, her bushy tail swishing as Paige locks the door behind her."

rows.original: You arrive at your ship, and you settle Kiro into your personal quarters. She begins to lounge, making herself at home, as you make your way back through Tavros and all the way back to Paige’s unit.
rows.translation: 你回到自己的飞船，把琪罗安置在你的私人舱室里。她开始懒洋洋地躺着，像在自己家一样，而你穿过塔夫罗斯站，一路走回佩姬的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou arrive at your ship, and you settle Kiro into your personal quarters. She begins to lounge, making herself at home, as you make your way back through Tavros and all the way back to Paige’s unit."

rows.original: It’s a bit of a routine: you get to the door; Iddi lets you in and hollers for his momma; you tell Paige that you have a guest waiting for her in the hangar; and then that sly, sultry grin spreads across her mouth as she tells you to wait so she can get dressed. When you had first done this, Paige was apprehensive as could be and was trying to shy her face away from any onlookers that could be nearby; now, she’s... no less reserved, but she’s definitely got a bit more spring in her step, knowing exactly what’s in the books up ahead.
rows.translation: 这多少成了一套惯例：你走到门口；伊迪让你进去，朝他妈妈大喊；你告诉佩姬，机库里有位客人在等她；然后那抹狡黠诱人的笑容便在她嘴角展开，她叫你等着，好让自己穿衣服。第一次这么做时，佩姬紧张得不能再紧张，努力把脸避开附近可能出现的任何旁观者；如今，她... 并没有变得不那么拘谨，但步伐中显然多了几分活力，因为她完全知道接下来会发生什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a bit of a routine: you get to the door; Iddi lets you in and hollers for his momma; you tell Paige that you have a guest waiting for her in the hangar; and then that sly, sultry grin spreads across her mouth as she tells you to wait so she can get dressed. When you had first done this, Paige was apprehensive as could be and was trying to shy her face away from any onlookers that could be nearby; now, she’s... no less reserved, but she’s definitely got a bit more spring in her step, knowing exactly what’s in the books up ahead."

rows.original: The trip back to your ship is uneventful, and when you show yourself into your quarters, there is Kiro, looking exactly as proper as you left her. She’s entertaining herself with her codex and with some errant notepads you had scattered around your quarters; as soon as her eyes fall on Paige, she drops everything.
rows.translation: 返回飞船的路途风平浪静；等你进入自己的房间，琪罗就在那里，看起来和你离开时一样规矩。她用资料库和你散落在房间里的几本记事簿自娱自乐；双眼一落到佩姬身上，她便放下了一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe trip back to your ship is uneventful, and when you show yourself into your quarters, there is Kiro, looking exactly as proper as you left her. She’s entertaining herself with her codex and with some errant notepads you had scattered around your quarters; as soon as her eyes fall on Paige, she drops everything."

rows.original: “Heya, Bookworm,” Kiro says delightedly, standing and gripping Paige by the wrist, dragging you both into the room. You make sure to lock the door behind you.
rows.translation: “嘿，书虫，”琪罗高兴地说，站起身抓住佩姬的手腕，把你们俩都拖进房间。你确保随后把门锁好。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya, Bookworm,” Kiro says delightedly, standing and gripping Paige by the wrist, dragging you both into the room. You make sure to lock the door behind you."

rows.original: You make it to the door, Kiro’s grip tight on your wrist, and she stops you from pressing the button to open the door. You’re alone in the entrance to your ship.
rows.translation: 你们走到门边，琪罗仍紧紧抓住你的手腕；她阻止你按下开门按钮。飞船入口处只有你们两人。
rows.raw: "You make it to the door, Kiro’s grip tight on your wrist, and she stops you from pressing the button to open the door. You’re alone in the entrance to your ship."

rows.original: “Paige got out of the game for a reason,” Kiro explains, confident that her voice won’t travel beyond the elevator. “Sorry for holding back, but I can’t have anyone know that we’re associated, for her sake.”
rows.translation: “佩姬退出这一行是有原因的，”琪罗解释道，确信自己的声音不会传出电梯。“抱歉有所隐瞒，但为了她，我不能让任何人知道我们有关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Paige got out of the game for a reason,” Kiro explains, confident that her voice won’t travel beyond the elevator. “Sorry for holding back, but I can’t have anyone know that we’re associated, for her sake.”"

rows.original: You tell her that it’s alright, and that you understand.
rows.translation: 你告诉她没关系，自己理解。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that it’s alright, and that you understand."

rows.original: “How much has she told you?” You relay an abridged version of what Paige told you: that she and Kiro were close friends growing up; that they were both partners in crime; and that Paige received her injury while ‘on the job.’ After that, she took a bunch of gene mods to disguise herself and opened a modest yoga studio to pay the bills.
rows.translation: “她告诉你多少？”你转述了佩姬所说的简略版本：她和琪罗从小就是亲密朋友；两人曾是犯罪搭档；佩姬是在‘工作中’受的伤。此后，她接受一系列基因改造来伪装自己，又开了一间普通的瑜伽馆维持生计。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How much has she told you?” You relay an abridged version of what Paige told you: that she and Kiro were close friends growing up; that they were both partners in crime; and that Paige received her injury while ‘on the job.’ After that, she took a bunch of gene mods to disguise herself and opened a modest yoga studio to pay the bills."

rows.original: “That’s about the short of it, yeah,” Kiro says – she’s rocking on her heels and toes and her hands can’t seem to find a comfortable spot on her body. She can’t help but smile as she remembers her Ausar friend, and her eyes keep going from the steel doors of the elevator to you. She’s suddenly quite giddy. “Wow, small universe, huh? I almost can’t believe it! My angel and my best friend growing up know each other!” You smile at her, but say nothing – and she takes it as an admission. “Lemme guess, Steele: you’re a little more familiar with each other than that, am I right?”
rows.translation: “简而言之，差不多就是这样，”琪罗说道——她在脚跟与脚尖之间来回摇晃，双手似乎怎么也找不到舒服的摆放位置。想起自己的奥萨人朋友，她忍不住微笑，双眼不断在电梯钢门与你之间移动。她突然变得兴奋极了。“哇，宇宙真小，对吧？我简直不敢相信！我的天使和我从小最好的朋友竟然认识！”你朝她微笑，却一言不发——她把这当成了默认。“让我猜猜，斯蒂尔：你们可不只是认识，彼此还稍微更熟悉一点，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s about the short of it, yeah,” Kiro says – she’s rocking on her heels and toes and her hands can’t seem to find a comfortable spot on her body. She can’t help but smile as she remembers her Ausar friend, and her eyes keep going from the steel doors of the elevator to you. She’s suddenly quite giddy. “Wow, small universe, huh? I almost can’t believe it! My angel and my best friend growing up know each other!” You smile at her, but say nothing – and she takes it as an admission. “Lemme guess, Steele: you’re a little more familiar with each other than that, am I right?”"

rows.original: You don’t deny it, and instead ask if Kiro could blame you. “You?” she asks, then leans back, scanning your form. “If you were some slut that I picked up at a bar that happened to do yoga on the side, I’d be a little more concerned. Not just for Paige’s safety, but because she could do so much better than just some slut.”
rows.translation: 你没有否认，反而问琪罗能不能怪你。“你？”她问道，随后向后靠，打量你的身材。“要是你只是我从酒吧捡回来、碰巧兼职做瑜伽的某个荡妇，我会更担心一点。不只是担心佩姬的安全，还因为她值得比区区一个荡妇更好的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t deny it, and instead ask if Kiro could blame you. “You?” she asks, then leans back, scanning your form. “If you were some slut that I picked up at a bar that happened to do yoga on the side, I’d be a little more concerned. Not just for Paige’s safety, but because she could do so much better than just some slut.”"

rows.original: She wraps her arm around your shoulders, pulling you closer to her and pressing her cheek against yours. “But you’re no slut. Well, I mean, you get around, but I’m okay with that, and knowing Paige, she’s okay with that too. You’re one of the good ones, Steele.” Kiro turns her head, and her tongue slides out, drawing a fat lick across your neck. “And, knowing Paige, she wouldn’t mind sharing.”
rows.translation: 她用手臂环住你的肩膀，把你拉近，脸颊贴住你的脸。“但你不是荡妇。好吧，我是说，你确实到处留情，不过我不介意；以我对佩姬的了解，她也不介意。你是好人之一，斯蒂尔。”琪罗转过头，舌头滑出，在你脖子上粗粗舔过一道。“而且，以我对佩姬的了解，她不会介意分享。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wraps her arm around your shoulders, pulling you closer to her and pressing her cheek against yours. “But you’re no slut. Well, I mean, you get around, but I’m okay with that, and knowing Paige, she’s okay with that too. You’re one of the good ones, Steele.” Kiro turns her head, and her tongue slides out, drawing a fat lick across your neck. “And, knowing Paige, she wouldn’t mind sharing.”"

rows.original: Kiro smacks the door release and sends you on your way. “I’ll be waiting, angel,” she says, her eyes roving around the walls of your room. “I’ll try to keep myself from getting too ready.”
rows.translation: 琪罗拍下开门按钮，让你上路。“我会等着，天使，”她说道，双眼扫视你房间四周的墙壁。“我会尽量克制自己，别准备得太过充分。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiro smacks the door release and sends you on your way. “I’ll be waiting, angel,” she says, her eyes roving around the walls of your room. “I’ll try to keep myself from getting too ready.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You make it to the elevator, Kiro’s grip tight on your wrist, and she presses the button to bring you to the hangar. You’re alone in the metal tube as it whirrs and begins to descend.
rows.translation: 你们来到电梯前，琪罗紧紧抓着你的手腕，按下按钮要把你送去机库。金属筒子里只有你们俩，它在嗡鸣中开始下降。
rows.raw: "You make it to the elevator, Kiro’s grip tight on your wrist, and she presses the button to bring you to the hangar. You’re alone in the metal tube as it whirrs and begins to descend."

rows.original: “Paige got out of the game for a reason,” Kiro explains, confident that her voice won’t travel beyond the elevator. “Sorry for the games, but I can’t have anyone know that we’re associated, for her sake.”
rows.translation: “佩姬退出这一行是有原因的，”琪罗解释道，确信自己的声音不会传出电梯。“抱歉耍这些花招，但为了她，我不能让任何人知道我们有关系。”

rows.original: When you arrive at the hangar, you show Kiro into your [pc_ship.short], and you show her to your personal quarters. You tell her to make herself at home; Paige isn’t here, and you have to go get her. “I’ll be waiting, angel,” she says, her eyes roving around the walls of your room. “I’ll try to keep myself from getting too ready.”
rows.translation: 抵达机库后，你领琪罗进入自己的[pc_ship.short]，把她带到私人房间。你让她随意些；佩姬不在这里，你得去把她找来。“我会等着，天使，”她说道，双眼扫视你房间四周的墙壁。“我会尽量克制自己，别准备得太过充分。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the hangar, you show Kiro into your [pc_ship.short], and you show her to your personal quarters. You tell her to make herself at home; Paige isn’t here, and you have to go get her. “I’ll be waiting, angel,” she says, her eyes roving around the walls of your room. “I’ll try to keep myself from getting too ready.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: When you arrive at the hangar, you show Kiro into your [pc_ship.short], and you lead her by the hand towards your personal quarters. You explain that you and Paige are more ‘familiar with each other’ than Kiro had guessed: you had convinced her to join your crew as a navigator.
rows.translation: 抵达机库后，你领琪罗进入自己的[pc_ship.short]，牵着她走向私人房间。你解释说，你和佩姬比琪罗猜测的‘更熟悉彼此’：你已经说服她加入船员，担任导航员。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you arrive at the hangar, you show Kiro into your [pc_ship.short], and you lead her by the hand towards your personal quarters. You explain that you and Paige are more ‘familiar with each other’ than Kiro had guessed: you had convinced her to join your crew as a navigator."

rows.original: “How’d you do that?” she asks incredulously. “Last I heard, Paige was blind. How’s she gonna navigate with no eyesight?”
rows.translation: “你怎么办到的？”她难以置信地问。“我上次听说时，佩姬还是盲人。没有视力，她怎么导航？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d you do that?” she asks incredulously. “Last I heard, Paige was blind. How’s she gonna navigate with no eyesight?”"

rows.original: You reply that you had paid for Paige’s surgery and that she joined your crew in part to pay you back, and in part because she wanted to be with you.
rows.translation: 你回答说佩姬的手术费是你付的，她加入你的船员队伍，一部分是为了还你人情，一部分是因为她想和你在一起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you had paid for Paige’s surgery and that she joined your crew in part to pay you back, and in part because she wanted to be with you."

rows.original: “What the hell?” Kiro asks, her breath catching in her throat. “Didn’t she say that surgery would cost her a million credits or something?”
rows.translation: “搞什么鬼？”琪罗问道，呼吸卡在喉咙里。“她不是说手术要花一百万信用点之类的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What the hell?” Kiro asks, her breath catching in her throat. “Didn’t she say that surgery would cost her a million credits or something?”"

rows.original: “Half a million,” you correct her. You show Kiro into your personal quarters and wave your hand to the room, allowing her to sit whenever she likes. As you do, you reach for the ship’s intercom, and dial up Paige’s quarters. “Navigator Paige, please come to my personal quarters,” you say into the ship’s microphone.
rows.translation: “五十万，”你纠正她。你领琪罗进入私人房间，朝房间挥手，表示她可以随意落座。同时，你伸手操作飞船内部通信，拨通佩姬的房间。“导航员佩姬，请到我的私人房间来，”你对着飞船麦克风说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Half a million,” you correct her. You show Kiro into your personal quarters and wave your hand to the room, allowing her to sit whenever she likes. As you do, you reach for the ship’s intercom, and dial up Paige’s quarters. “Navigator Paige, please come to my personal quarters,” you say into the ship’s microphone."

rows.original: “On my way, captain!” Paige replies seconds later.
rows.translation: “马上就到，船长！”佩姬几秒后答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On my way, captain!” Paige replies seconds later."

rows.original: “Feel free to ask her yourself,” you say as you take your own seat, at a small desk in the corner of the room, next to Kiro on your bed. The seconds pass by palpably – Kiro’s hands fidget on her lap, and her lips quiver with excitement. She’s very eager to meet Paige again.
rows.translation: “你可以亲自问她，”你说着，在房间角落的小书桌旁坐下，就在床上的琪罗旁边。一秒秒时间清晰地流逝——琪罗双手在腿上坐立不安地摆弄，双唇因兴奋颤抖。她非常渴望再次见到佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Feel free to ask her yourself,” you say as you take your own seat, at a small desk in the corner of the room, next to Kiro on your bed. The seconds pass by palpably – Kiro’s hands fidget on her lap, and her lips quiver with excitement. She’s very eager to meet Paige again."

rows.original: Then, there’s a knock on your door, the sound of knuckles against the metal reverberating through the cold hallway of the ship. It swings open without your invitation; on the other side is Paige, your Ausar navigator.
rows.translation: 接着，你的门响起敲击声，指节撞上金属的声音回荡在飞船冰冷的走廊里。门未经邀请便打开了；另一边是你的奥萨人导航员佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, there’s a knock on your door, the sound of knuckles against the metal reverberating through the cold hallway of the ship. It swings open without your invitation; on the other side is Paige, your Ausar navigator."

rows.original: “Captain?” asks Paige, her eyes scanning the room as she enters – until her eyes meet Kiro’s.
