rows.translation: 看到她的手指滑进扳机护圈那一刻，你的本能进入超速运转。你伸手去抢枪，却迟了一秒：奥林匹娅扣下扳机，轰击你们之间的地板，火花溅进眼睛。你挥着手向后躲开。操，好吧，你懂了！
rows.raw: "The moment you see her finger sliding into the trigger guard, your instincts kick into overdrive. You reach for her gun, but just a second too late: Olympia pulls the trigger, blasting the floor between you and sending sparks into your eyes. You duck back, waving your hands. Fuck, okay, you get it!"

rows.original: “I don’t think so,” she growls, advancing on you. “Leave now.”
rows.translation: “我看不行，” 她低吼着向你逼近。“现在就滚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think so,” she growls, advancing on you. “Leave now.”"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Okay, okay... you’re leaving.
rows.translation: 好啦，好啦... 我这就走。
rows.raw: "Okay, okay... you’re leaving."

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 交涉
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: Diplomacy
rows.translation: 交涉
rows.raw: "Diplomacy"

rows.original: Olympia’s loyal to the ship, not the pirates, huh? This doesn’t have to be a fight then...
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅忠于飞船，而非海盗，是吗？那就不一定非得打起来...
rows.raw: "Olympia’s loyal to the ship, not the pirates, huh? This doesn’t have to be a fight then..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You pull the trigger, blowing the uppity gynoid’s cortex across the back wall.
rows.translation: 你扣下扳机，把那台傲慢的机娘的脑皮层轰得溅满后墙。
rows.raw: "You pull the trigger, blowing the uppity gynoid’s cortex across the back wall."

rows.original: Alright, time to take control. You resume your seat and access the controls, commanding the Sidewinder to disengage its docking clamps and crank on the engines. You feel a thrum beneath the deck as systems boot up and get ready for launch.
rows.translation: 好了，该掌控局面了。你回到座位上调出控制台，命令响尾蛇号脱开对接夹具并启动引擎。随着各系统启动、准备发射，你感到甲板下传来一阵震颤。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright, time to take control. You resume your seat and access the controls, commanding the Sidewinder to disengage its docking clamps and crank on the engines. You feel a thrum beneath the deck as systems boot up and get ready for launch."

rows.original: You’ve barely finished your pre-flight check when you hear a klaxon blaring through the station. Dozens of pirate troops pour out onto the walkways all around the Sidewinder, slamming mags into rifles and machine pistols. There’s a pounding on the exterior hatch, and you can hear rage-filled screaming over the intercom before the goons start firing. Of course, your new ship’s shields are already online and more than capable of negating any volume of ground fire, leaving you able to calmly turn the corvette around and aim its prow at the bay doors... which, of course, are quickly closing.
rows.translation: 你刚做完飞行前检查，就听见一阵警报响彻整个空间站。几十名海盗士兵涌上响尾蛇号四周的通道，把弹匣砸进步枪和冲锋枪里。外部舱门被砸得咚咚响，你还能从对讲机里听到狂怒的吼叫，接着那帮打手就开火了。当然，你这艘新船的护盾早已启动，足以抵消任何数量的地面火力，于是你能从容地把这艘护卫舰转过来，把船头对准机库大门... 而那道门，当然，正在迅速关闭。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve barely finished your pre-flight check when you hear a klaxon blaring through the station. Dozens of pirate troops pour out onto the walkways all around the Sidewinder, slamming mags into rifles and machine pistols. There’s a pounding on the exterior hatch, and you can hear rage-filled screaming over the intercom before the goons start firing. Of course, your new ship’s shields are already online and more than capable of negating any volume of ground fire, leaving you able to calmly turn the corvette around and aim its prow at the bay doors... which, of course, are quickly closing."

rows.original: Time to see what this baby can do. You slam the stick forward and kick the engines into overdrive, sending the Sidewinder hurtling forward towards the narrowing vector of your escape. The deck shudders as you hit maximum velocity, thundering through the launch bay and out into the stars, squeaking between the doors amidst proximity warnings screaming - not even close, you figure. Three meters is plenty of clearance!
rows.translation: 该看看这宝贝有多大本事了。你猛推操纵杆，让引擎进入超速，把响尾蛇号推向不断收窄的逃生航向。达到最高速度时，甲板剧烈震动；你轰鸣着穿过发射湾、冲入群星，在尖叫的接近警报中从门缝挤过——依你看，差得远呢。三米净空绰绰有余！
rows.raw: "\n\nTime to see what this baby can do. You slam the stick forward and kick the engines into overdrive, sending the Sidewinder hurtling forward towards the narrowing vector of your escape. The deck shudders as you hit maximum velocity, thundering through the launch bay and out into the stars, squeaking between the doors amidst proximity warnings screaming - not even close, you figure. Three meters is plenty of clearance!"

rows.original: You dive down, avoiding the station’s point defenses and the hails of mag cannon slugs they’re throwing at your tailpipe until you’ve disappeared into the asteroid belt surrounding Zhèng Shi.
rows.translation: 你向下俯冲，避开空间站点防御和朝尾喷口倾泻的磁炮弹雨，直到消失在郑氏周围的小行星带。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dive down, avoiding the station’s point defenses and the hails of mag cannon slugs they’re throwing at your tailpipe until you’ve disappeared into the asteroid belt surrounding Zhèng Shi."

rows.original: Well, the locals probably won’t be too happy with you now... But hey, fuck pirates: you’ve got the most kickass raider ship in the galaxy at your command now. Time to see what this baby can really do.
rows.translation: 好吧，本地人现在大概不会太待见你了... 不过嘿，去他妈的星际海盗：你现在手里有全银河最牛逼的劫掠船听你指挥。是时候看看这小宝贝到底有多大能耐了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, the locals probably won’t be too happy with you now... But hey, fuck pirates: you’ve got the most kickass raider ship in the galaxy at your command now. Time to see what this baby can really do."

rows.original: PC
rows.raw: "PC"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Here’s the deal,” you tell her ejecting the loaded shells from the shotgun. “I’m taking this ship. If you’re so attached to it, then come with me. I could use an expert on the crew.”
rows.translation: “条件如下，”你一边告诉她，一边退出霰弹枪里已装填的弹壳。“我要带走这艘船。既然你对它如此依恋，就跟我走。我的船员中正需要一名专家。”
rows.raw: "“Here’s the deal,” you tell her ejecting the loaded shells from the shotgun. “I’m taking this ship. If you’re so attached to it, then come with me. I could use an expert on the crew.”"

rows.original: Olympia blinks at you. “Not just an expert. I designed half these systems. Worked on the other half. There’s nobody alive who knows the Sidewinder the way I do.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅眨了眨眼。“不只是专家。这些系统有一半是我设计的，另一半我也参与过。活着的人里没有谁比我更懂响尾蛇号的脾气。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia blinks at you. “Not just an expert. I designed half these systems. Worked on the other half. There’s nobody alive who knows the Sidewinder the way I do.”"

rows.original: You believe it. And she’s clearly got no love for the pirates, so why not?
rows.translation: 你信了。而且她显然对海盗没什么好感，那为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou believe it. And she’s clearly got no love for the pirates, so why not?"

rows.original: The genius gynoid doesn’t take much more convincing. “This is an unexpected turn of events... but not an unwelcome one. To be honest, I had been afraid that Teyaal and her crew would deactivate me once this project is complete. If you are willing, I would be happy to join your crew... Captain.”
rows.translation: 这个天才雌性机器人没再需要多少劝说。“这是意料之外的转折...但并非不受欢迎。坦白说，我一直担心项目完成后，特娅尔和她的船员会停用我。若你愿意，我很乐意加入船员...舰长。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe genius gynoid doesn’t take much more convincing. “This is an unexpected turn of events... but not an unwelcome one. To be honest, I had been afraid that Teyaal and her crew would deactivate me once this project is complete. If you are willing, I would be happy to join your crew... Captain.”"

rows.original: Great. You offer Olympia a hand up and shake it. “Now let’s get out of here.”
rows.translation: 太好了。你伸手把奥林匹娅拉起来，跟她握了握手。“现在我们离开这儿吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGreat. You offer Olympia a hand up and shake it. “Now let’s get out of here.”"

rows.original: She nods and turns back to the hatch. “I’ll get the engines up and running at a hundred and ten. Just don’t get us blown up, captain. The pirates won’t be happy to see this beauty go.”
rows.translation: 她点头，转身走向舱门。“我会让引擎以百分之一百一十运行。舰长，只要别让我们被炸毁。海盗不会乐意看着这位美人离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods and turns back to the hatch. “I’ll get the engines up and running at a hundred and ten. Just don’t get us blown up, captain. The pirates won’t be happy to see this beauty go.”"

rows.original: She goes running as you get back into the captain’s chair and spool the Sidewinder’s systems up. Sure enough, a few moments later and the deck is thrumming with the massive engine block’s vibrations... and pirates and coming out of the woodwork, crawling all over the walkways and gangplanks.
rows.translation: 你重新坐进船长椅、把响尾蛇号的系统启动起来时，她跑了出去。果不其然，片刻之后甲板就随着那庞大引擎组的震动嗡嗡作响...还有海盗，正从藏身处蜂拥而出，爬满各处的走道和舷梯。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe goes running as you get back into the captain’s chair and spool the Sidewinder’s systems up. Sure enough, a few moments later and the deck is thrumming with the massive engine block’s vibrations... and pirates and coming out of the woodwork, crawling all over the walkways and gangplanks."

rows.original: They’re slamming mags into rifles and machine pistols, shouting in confusion and anger. There’s a pounding on the exterior hatch, and you can hear rage-filled screaming over the intercom before the goons start firing. Of course, your new ship’s shields are already online and more than capable of negating any volume of ground fire, leaving you able to calmly turn the corvette around and aim its prow at the bay doors... which, of course, are quickly closing.
rows.translation: 他们把弹匣猛插进步枪和冲锋手枪，困惑愤怒地叫喊。外侧舱门传来砰砰撞击；暴徒开火前，你能从内部通讯听见充满怒火的尖叫。当然，新飞船的护盾已经上线，足以抵消任何规模的地面火力；你可以从容调转护卫舰，将舰艏对准机库大门...而大门当然正在迅速关闭。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey’re slamming mags into rifles and machine pistols, shouting in confusion and anger. There’s a pounding on the exterior hatch, and you can hear rage-filled screaming over the intercom before the goons start firing. Of course, your new ship’s shields are already online and more than capable of negating any volume of ground fire, leaving you able to calmly turn the corvette around and aim its prow at the bay doors... which, of course, are quickly closing."

rows.original: Time to see what this baby can do. You slam the stick forward and kick the engines into overdrive, sending the Sidewinder hurtling forward towards the narrowing vector of your escape.
rows.translation: 该看看这宝贝有多大本事了。你猛推操纵杆，让引擎进入超速，把响尾蛇号推向不断收窄的逃生航向。
rows.raw: "\n\nTime to see what this baby can do. You slam the stick forward and kick the engines into overdrive, sending the Sidewinder hurtling forward towards the narrowing vector of your escape."

rows.original: “Captain!?” Olympia shouts over the intercom. “There’s an alarm going off down here!”
rows.translation: “船长！？”奥林匹娅在通讯器里大喊。“这下面有警报在响！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain!?” Olympia shouts over the intercom. “There’s an alarm going off down here!”"

rows.original: “Just give me as much power as you can!” you answer, pushing the controls as hard as you can.
rows.translation: “把能给的动力全给我！”你答道，拼命推着操纵杆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just give me as much power as you can!” you answer, pushing the controls as hard as you can."

rows.original: The deck shudders as you hit maximum velocity, thundering through the launch bay and out into the stars, squeaking between the doors amidst proximity warnings screaming - not even close, you figure. Three meters is plenty of clearance!
rows.translation: 达到最高速度时，甲板剧烈震动；你轰鸣着穿过发射湾、冲入群星，在尖叫的接近警报中从门缝挤过——依你看，差得远呢。三米净空绰绰有余！

rows.raw: "\n\nYou dive down, avoiding the station’s point defenses and the hails of mag cannon slugs they’re throwing at your tailpipe until you’ve disappeared into the asteroid belt surrounding Zhèng Shi."

rows.translation: 好吧，本地人现在大概不会太待见你了... 不过嘿，去他妈的星际海盗：你现在手里有全银河最牛逼的劫掠船听你指挥。是时候看看这小宝贝到底有多大能耐了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, the locals probably won’t be too happy with you now... But hey, fuck pirates: you’ve got the most kickass raider ship in the galaxy at your command now. Time to see what this baby can really do."

rows.original: PC
rows.raw: "PC"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You raise your hands slowly. “Okay, let’s talk this through.”
rows.translation: 你缓缓举起双手。“好吧，我们谈谈。”
rows.raw: "You raise your hands slowly. “Okay, let’s talk this through.”"

rows.original: Olympia stares down the sights of her shotgun. “I’m listening.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅顺着霰弹枪的准星盯过来。“我在听。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia stares down the sights of her shotgun. “I’m listening.”"

rows.original: You give her the pitch: she hates pirates. Olympia’s loyalty isn’t to the crew of Zhèng Shi, but to the Sidewinder itself. So why stop you from taking the ship if she’s here, on board, able to keep working on it to her heart’s content? After all... what difference does it make if it’s you or the L.D.C. in the pilot’s seat?
rows.translation: 你向她陈述理由：她憎恨海盗。奥林匹娅效忠的不是郑氏船员，而是响尾蛇号本身。那么，既然她就在船上，能尽情继续研究，为何还要阻止你带走飞船？毕竟...驾驶席上坐的是你还是L.D.C.，又有什么区别？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her the pitch: she hates pirates. Olympia’s loyalty isn’t to the crew of Zhèng Shi, but to the Sidewinder itself. So why stop you from taking the ship if she’s here, on board, able to keep working on it to her heart’s content? After all... what difference does it make if it’s you or the L.D.C. in the pilot’s seat?"

rows.original: The draconic gynoid furrows her brow, thinking for a long moment. The a hint of a smile spreads on her lips, and she ejects the shells from her shotgun and drops it at your feet. “Very well... captain. As long as I am allowed to stay with the Sidewinder, I don’t care who commands her.”
rows.translation: 龙形雌性机器人皱起眉头，思考了很久。嘴角渐渐浮现一丝微笑，她退出霰弹枪中的弹壳，把枪扔到你脚边。“很好...舰长。只要允许我与响尾蛇号待在一起，我不在乎由谁指挥她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe draconic gynoid furrows her brow, thinking for a long moment. The a hint of a smile spreads on her lips, and she ejects the shells from her shotgun and drops it at your feet. “Very well... captain. As long as I am allowed to stay with the Sidewinder, I don’t care who commands her.”"

rows.translation: 她点头，转身走向舱门。“我会让引擎以百分之一百一十运行。舰长，只要别让我们被炸毁。海盗不会乐意看着这位美人离开。”

rows.raw: "PC"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You put your hands up and circle around the captain’s chair, back towards the hatch. “Okay, okay... I’m leaving.”
rows.translation: 你举起双手，绕过船长椅，朝舱门退去。“好，好...我这就走。”
rows.raw: "You put your hands up and circle around the captain’s chair, back towards the hatch. “Okay, okay... I’m leaving.”"

rows.original: For now, anyway.
rows.translation: 至少目前是这样。

rows.original: “What do you remember from before we met?” you ask her. “About your past, I mean.”
rows.translation: “我们相遇之前的事，你还记得什么？”你问道。“我是说，你的过去。”
rows.raw: "“What do you remember from before we met?” you ask her. “About your past, I mean.”"

rows.original: “Not much,” Olympia answers. There’s no hesitation in her voice; it’s a casual response to a simple question, you suppose. After you remain silent for a few moments, your synthetic dragoness sighs and adds, “I remember a few snippets... things that awful bitch Teyaal tried to purge but stayed clogged up in backups. Just a few blurry faces, corrupted views of corridors and ship berths, some containers... the first truly cogent memory I can access is my reactivation after Teyaal reprogrammed me.”
rows.translation: “不多，”奥林匹娅回答。她声音毫无迟疑；你猜这只是对简单问题的随意回应。你沉默片刻后，这个合成龙女叹气补充：“我记得一些片段...那个可恶婊子特娅尔试图清除，却仍堵在备份里的东西。只有几张模糊面孔、损坏的走廊和泊位画面、一些集装箱...我能访问的第一段真正连贯记忆，是特娅尔重新编程后将我重启。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not much,” Olympia answers. There’s no hesitation in her voice; it’s a casual response to a simple question, you suppose. After you remain silent for a few moments, your synthetic dragoness sighs and adds, “I remember a few snippets... things that awful bitch Teyaal tried to purge but stayed clogged up in backups. Just a few blurry faces, corrupted views of corridors and ship berths, some containers... the first truly cogent memory I can access is my reactivation after Teyaal reprogrammed me.”"

rows.original: What exactly does she remember, then? Maybe those bits and pieces could help you figure out who she was stolen from.
rows.translation: 那她究竟记得什么？也许这些零碎片段能帮你弄清她是从谁那里被偷走的。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat exactly does she remember, then? Maybe those bits and pieces could help you figure out who she was stolen from."

rows.original: Olympia considers it a moment. “If you found out, would you not be legally obligated to return me? I am legally someone’s stolen property, after all. I would... not wish to cause you inconvenience, captain.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅想了想。“如果你查出来了，你在法律上不就有义务把我归还吗？毕竟在法律上，我是某人的失窃财产。我...不希望给你添麻烦，船长。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia considers it a moment. “If you found out, would you not be legally obligated to return me? I am legally someone’s stolen property, after all. I would... not wish to cause you inconvenience, captain.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nIs that all? The hesitation in her voice says that’s not what’s really on her mind."

rows.original: “So, what features come standard on your model?” you ask, eying the curvaceous gynoid up and down. She certainly looks full featured from where you’re standing, but it’s nice to know the technical specs.
rows.translation: “所以，你这个型号有哪些标准功能？”你上下打量曲线玲珑的雌性仿生人，开口询问。从你站的位置看，她当然功能齐全，但了解技术规格总是好事。
rows.raw: "“So, what features come standard on your model?” you ask, eying the curvaceous gynoid up and down. She certainly looks full featured from where you’re standing, but it’s nice to know the technical specs."

rows.original: “Hmm. I’ve done some research on myself since coming aboard. This appears to be a KihaCorp class six companion droid model, of the ninth revision series. It seems to have been a limited edition run made for wealthy gryvain on the homeworld. Unfortunately most of the model’s technical specifications are closely guarded corporate property, and too complex to be hacked unnoticed. I’ve had to make do with reviews and hearsay online just to learn about myself. Ironic, isn’t it? That I can be so creative, design blueprints for vastly powerful weapons and one-of-a-kind starships... but I’m deprived of an understanding of my own body. I can tell you what I do know though.”
rows.translation: “嗯。登船后，我对自己做过一些研究。这似乎是基哈公司六级伴侣机器人，第九次修订系列。看来是专为母星富裕格里文制作的限量型号。可惜，大部分技术规格都是严格保密的企业财产，而且复杂到无法不留痕迹地破解。我只能依靠网上评测与传闻来了解自己。很讽刺，对吧？我能如此富有创造力，为威力惊人的武器与独一无二的星舰设计蓝图...却无法理解自己的身体。不过，我可以告诉你已经知道的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. I’ve done some research on myself since coming aboard. This appears to be a KihaCorp class six companion droid model, of the ninth revision series. The tactile sensation I’m capable of receiving at once is an order of magnitude beyond any organic’s, and I’m quite capable of reaching my own orgasms based on that. Like you, I have erogenous zones. Even places I’ve learned to like being touched beyond that.”

rows.original: “Other parts are more human-like in nature. I have hair that grows and needs to be cut; my skin feels real to form at your touch... though it is near-infinitely stretchable. Apparently whoever designed me catered to size fetishists in the extreme; given enough silicone I could likely plump my proportions up until I couldn’t move under my own weight. I can also change my coloration at-will, as well as the texture of my skin, scales, and hair. I’ve decided I rather like being a gryvain, so I’ve gone for a color combination native to Vendiko - their home planet, or rather, moon’s - south-eastern continent. A rural province in the region was the birthplace of gryvain space flight, developing out of attempts to map the fierce winds of the upper atmosphere.”
rows.translation: “其他部位本质上更像人类。我有会生长、需要修剪的头发；皮肤在你触摸时感觉真实...尽管几乎可以无限拉伸。设计者显然极端迎合尺寸癖；只要有足够硅胶，我大概能把比例增大到无法承受自身重量、动弹不得。我还能随意改变颜色，以及皮肤、鳞片和头发的质地。我发现自己相当喜欢格里文形态，所以选择了文迪科原生配色——那是他们的母星，更准确说是卫星——东南大陆的配色。当地一个乡村省份是格里文太空飞行的发源地，技术源自测绘高层大气猛烈风流的尝试。”

rows.original: “[pc_ship.theName], of course,” Olympia answers simply. “While I do try to make upgrades whenever possible, the nature of the Sidewinder-class as a prototype necessitates constant oversight and maintenance. None of the systems were mass-produced or stress-tested outside of simulations. You took her maiden flight, after all. Every few hours something manages to break, or perform in ways I hadn’t been able to predict... it’s a full time job to keep [pc_ship.theName] functioning smoothly.”
rows.translation: “当然是[pc_ship.theName]，”奥林匹娅简单回答。“虽然我会尽可能升级，但响尾蛇级作为原型舰的性质，要求持续监督维护。所有系统都没有量产，也未在模拟之外接受压力测试。毕竟是你完成了她的处女航。每隔几小时就会有东西损坏，或表现出我无法预测的方式...让[pc_ship.theName]顺畅运行是一份全职工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc_ship.theName], of course,” Olympia answers simply. “While I do try to make upgrades whenever possible, the nature of the Sidewinder-class as a prototype necessitates constant oversight and maintenance. None of the systems were mass-produced or stress-tested outside of simulations. You took her maiden flight, after all. Every few hours something manages to break, or perform in ways I hadn’t been able to predict... it’s a full time job to keep [pc_ship.theName] functioning smoothly.”"

rows.original: She seems to be enjoying herself, though.
rows.translation: 不过她看起来挺享受的。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to be enjoying herself, though."

rows.original: The gynoid nods. “I do! Don’t mistake my words for complaint. Teyaal’s reprogramming makes it so that maintaining [pc_ship.theName] is... it’s like a constant edge I ride, and every time I fix a major issue or make a significant improvement, my datacore is flooded with the equivalent of dopamine.”
rows.translation: 那具女性机器人点点头。“我喜欢！别把我的话当成抱怨。特娅尔的重新编程让维护[pc_ship.theName]成了... 就像我一直在骑着一道恒定的临界线，每当我修好一个大故障或做出重要改进，我的数据核心就会被相当于多巴胺的东西淹没。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid nods. “I do! Don’t mistake my words for complaint. Teyaal’s reprogramming makes it so that maintaining [pc_ship.theName] is... it’s like a constant edge I ride, and every time I fix a major issue or make a significant improvement, my datacore is flooded with the equivalent of dopamine.”"

rows.original: “And don’t worry about taking advantage of my predicament,” she adds. “I think feeling rewarded for my continued good work is less exploitative than for sex. I have no use for credits, so my enjoyment is a fair exchange for my service. Don’t you think?”
rows.translation: “也别担心这是利用我的处境，”她补充。“我认为持续做好工作后获得奖励，比为了性爱更不算剥削。我用不到信用点，所以我的享受足以公平换取服务。你不觉得吗？”

rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps. “Is there anything you’d rather be doing?”"

rows.original: Olympia considers it for a moment, chewing the end of her dataslate stylus before finally answering: “If I could rewrite my reward parameters to anything I desired? Hmm. Perhaps more theoretical research rather than mechanical. I’ve spent a great deal of time on such a narrow spectrum of starship design - only ever concerned with what is valuable to the Sidewinder project, and never my own interests. Now that the project is complete, or as much so as it ever will be, given Dr. Teyaal’s disappearance... it would be nice to broaden my horizons.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅思索了片刻，咬着数据板触控笔的笔尾，终于回答：“如果我能把奖励参数改成任何我想要的？嗯。也许是更多理论研究，而不是机械方向。我在这么一个狭窄的星舰设计领域上花了太多时间，从来只关心什么对响尾蛇号计划有价值，从没顾过我自己的兴趣。如今计划已经完成，或者说，在特娅尔博士失踪的前提下，它已经完成到不能再完成的程度...那让我拓宽一下视野，应该会很不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia considers it for a moment, chewing the end of her dataslate stylus before finally answering: “If I could rewrite my reward parameters to anything I desired? Hmm. Perhaps more theoretical research rather than mechanical. I’ve spent a great deal of time on such a narrow spectrum of starship design - only ever concerned with what is valuable to the Sidewinder project, and never my own interests. Now that the project is complete, or as much so as it ever will be, given Dr. Teyaal’s disappearance... it would be nice to broaden my horizons.”"

rows.original: “So you really are interested in ship design?”
rows.translation: “所以你真的对飞船设计感兴趣？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you really are interested in ship design?”"

rows.original: She nods. “Of course. It’s all I really know... but it’s also a fascinating dichotomy. A starship is infinitely more mechanically complex than my own body, while its computer systems are by comparison more like old punch-card devices from before space flight than my own brainscan cortex. Isn’t that odd, how after thousands of years, an organic brain is still more complex than the systems that can carry us to the stars?”
rows.translation: 她点头。“当然。这是我真正了解的全部...但也存在迷人的二分。星舰的机械复杂程度比我的身体高出无限多，而相比之下，其计算机系统更像太空飞行前的老式穿孔卡设备，而非我的脑扫描皮层。很奇怪，对吧？几千年过去，有机大脑仍比能载我们前往群星的系统更加复杂。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “Of course. It’s all I really know... but it’s also a fascinating dichotomy. A starship is infinitely more mechanically complex than my own body, while its computer systems are by comparison more like old punch-card devices from before space flight than my own brainscan cortex. Isn’t that odd, how after thousands of years, an organic brain is still more complex than the systems that can carry us to the stars?”"

rows.original: “Hmm. Well, I mostly keep to myself, you know. There’s little reason for anybody to come back here to the engine room except for you... not that I’m complaining. I don’t deal well with people anyway, so it’s fine. Easier to think when I’m alone. Easier to work.”
rows.translation: “嗯。其实我大多独处，你知道。除了你以外，几乎没人有理由来到后面的引擎室...我倒不是在抱怨。反正我也不擅长与人相处，所以这样很好。独处时更容易思考，也更容易工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. Well, I mostly keep to myself, you know. There’s little reason for anybody to come back here to the engine room except for you... not that I’m complaining. I don’t deal well with people anyway, so it’s fine. Easier to think when I’m alone. Easier to work.”"

rows.original: You nod, slowly. “Doesn’t answer my question.”
rows.translation: 你缓缓点头。“这没回答我的问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, slowly. “Doesn’t answer my question.”"

rows.original: Anno
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: Shekka
rows.raw: "Shekka"

rows.original: Azra
rows.raw: "Azra"

rows.original: “Sorry,” Olympia shrugs. “I don’t really interact with anybody but you enough to have a developed opinion. Maybe find some more geniuses to recruit... somebody I could actually have a conversation with?”
rows.translation: “抱歉，”奥林匹娅耸肩。“除了你以外，我和任何人的互动都不足以形成成熟看法。也许再招募几个天才...找个真正能与我交谈的人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry,” Olympia shrugs. “I don’t really interact with anybody but you enough to have a developed opinion. Maybe find some more geniuses to recruit... somebody I could actually have a conversation with?”"

rows.original: You’ll keep it in mind.
rows.translation: 你会把这事记在心上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll keep it in mind."

rows.original: Anno
rows.raw: "Anno"

rows.original: “Anno is nice, in a syrupy-sweet kind of way. She’s so like a puppy... is that racist? It should be, I think, but if you asked her she’d say it’s accurate. She’s gorgeous, too. A real show-stopper. Bet she was the most popular girl in her class.”
rows.translation: “安诺很不错，是那种甜得发腻的好。她真像只小狗...这算种族歧视吗？我觉得应该算，但你要去问她，她会说这形容很准确。她还很漂亮，绝对是全场焦点。我敢说她当年是班上最受欢迎的女孩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anno is nice, in a syrupy-sweet kind of way. She’s so like a puppy... is that racist? It should be, I think, but if you asked her she’d say it’s accurate. She’s gorgeous, too. A real show-stopper. Bet she was the most popular girl in her class.”"

rows.original: “So you like her?”
rows.translation: “所以你喜欢她？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you like her?”"

rows.original: Olympia nods. “As much as anyone. Her field is study is almost entirely unrelated to mine, so we don’t have much to talk about, though she’s enough of a renaissance woman that I can bounce mechanical engineering ideas off of her. I think she finds those conversations... like an opportunity to study me. Her eyes never leave me, always wandering, like she’s drinking me in. It’s a little unsettling, but...”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅点头。“和其他人差不多。她的研究领域与我的几乎完全无关，所以没多少可聊；不过她足够博学多才，我可以和她探讨机械工程想法。我觉得她把这些谈话当成...研究我的机会。她的眼睛从不离开我，总在游走，仿佛要把我饮进体内。这有点令人不安，不过...”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia nods. “As much as anyone. Her field is study is almost entirely unrelated to mine, so we don’t have much to talk about, though she’s enough of a renaissance woman that I can bounce mechanical engineering ideas off of her. I think she finds those conversations... like an opportunity to study me. Her eyes never leave me, always wandering, like she’s drinking me in. It’s a little unsettling, but...”"

rows.original: She shrugs. “But I think she likes me. Or at least, my body... and if that’s the case, the feeling’s mutual.”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“不过我想她喜欢我，或者至少喜欢我的身体...若真如此，我也有同样感受。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “But I think she likes me. Or at least, my body... and if that’s the case, the feeling’s mutual.”"

rows.original: Yeah, that definitely sounds like Anno.
rows.translation: 是啊，那绝对是安诺的作风。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, that definitely sounds like Anno."

rows.original: Shekka
rows.raw: "Shekka"

rows.original: “So, Shekka is... an interesting case,” Olympia continues. “She’s very smart, and mechanically minded in a way that most organics wouldn’t fathom. Her proficiency with robotics is especially fascinating; if I were so inclined, I have no doubt she’d be able to modify me in ways that would void my warranty many times over... if it hasn’t been already. Indeed, I sometimes have to stop her from trying on her own initiative. Perhaps it’s just her species’ nature, but I think if I let my guard down around her she’s likely to start crawling all over me.”
rows.translation: “至于谢卡...是个有趣案例，”奥林匹娅继续说道。“她非常聪明，对机械的理解方式是大多数有机生命无法想象的。尤其在机器人领域的造诣非常迷人；若我有意如此，毫无疑问，她能以多种方式改造我，让保修失效许多次...如果它还没失效的话。事实上，我有时得阻止她自行尝试。也许只是种族天性，但我觉得若在她身边放松警惕，她很可能开始爬遍我全身。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, Shekka is... an interesting case,” Olympia continues. “She’s very smart, and mechanically minded in a way that most organics wouldn’t fathom. Her proficiency with robotics is especially fascinating; if I were so inclined, I have no doubt she’d be able to modify me in ways that would void my warranty many times over... if it hasn’t been already. Indeed, I sometimes have to stop her from trying on her own initiative. Perhaps it’s just her species’ nature, but I think if I let my guard down around her she’s likely to start crawling all over me.”"

rows.original: You can very, very easily imagine Shekka crawling all over Olympia... though less for scientific purposes than her own. “So you like her?”
rows.translation: 你非常、非常容易想象谢卡爬遍奥林匹娅全身...不过与其说为了科学，不如说为了她自己。“所以你喜欢她？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can very, very easily imagine Shekka crawling all over Olympia... though less for scientific purposes than her own. “So you like her?”"

rows.original: Your companion nods. “As much as anybody, I suppose.”
rows.translation: 你的同伴点头。“我想，和其他人差不多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour companion nods. “As much as anybody, I suppose.”"

rows.original: Azra
rows.raw: "Azra"

rows.original: “Now, Azra’s an interesting case,” the gynoid says thoughtfully. “She’s attractive for her mind as much as her body, though our fields of scientific inquiry are wildly different. She studies the natural world, the mysterious workings of evolution, while I evolve technology through my work. I have to admit some small amount of jealousy towards her as well...”
rows.translation: “阿兹拉则是个有趣案例，”女性机器人若有所思地说。“她的头脑和身体一样吸引人，虽然我们科学研究的领域差异极大。她研究自然世界与进化的神秘运作，而我通过工作推动技术进化。我也必须承认，自己对她有少许嫉妒...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, Azra’s an interesting case,” the gynoid says thoughtfully. “She’s attractive for her mind as much as her body, though our fields of scientific inquiry are wildly different. She studies the natural world, the mysterious workings of evolution, while I evolve technology through my work. I have to admit some small amount of jealousy towards her as well...”"

rows.original: Olympia nods, chuckling to herself. “Oh yes. She’s mentioned that she is a mother... an experience that I will never have. She’s able to create life, while all I can make is this.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅点点头，自己轻声笑了起来。“哦，是的。她提过自己是个母亲... 那是我永远无法拥有的经历。她能创造生命，而我能造出来的只有这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia nods, chuckling to herself. “Oh yes. She’s mentioned that she is a mother... an experience that I will never have. She’s able to create life, while all I can make is this.”"

rows.original: She raps her knuckles on the side of an engine casing, sending a reverberating echo through the metal. “Don’t mistake my tone for sadness. I don’t... I am jealous of a lack of experience, in the same way you might be jealous of someone with different sexual organs, or of another race. Well, I suppose that’s less of a problem for you, isn’t it? Indeed I suppose I could likely find some aftermarket incubator if I so desired to experience childbearing, but that’s not the same thing, is it?”
rows.translation: 她用指关节敲打引擎外壳侧面，让金属中传出回响。“别把我的语气误认为悲伤。我没有...我嫉妒的是缺少某种经历，就像你可能嫉妒拥有不同性器官的人，或另一个种族。好吧，我想这对你不算什么问题，对吧？事实上，如果真想体验生育，我大概能找到某种售后市场的孵育器，但那并不是同一回事，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe raps her knuckles on the side of an engine casing, sending a reverberating echo through the metal. “Don’t mistake my tone for sadness. I don’t... I am jealous of a lack of experience, in the same way you might be jealous of someone with different sexual organs, or of another race. Well, I suppose that’s less of a problem for you, isn’t it? Indeed I suppose I could likely find some aftermarket incubator if I so desired to experience childbearing, but that’s not the same thing, is it?”"

rows.original: “No,” you have to admit. Olympia doesn’t exactly have genes to pass on... she could only ever be a third party to pregnancy, even if she had the right parts for it.
rows.translation: “不是，”你不得不承认。奥林匹娅并没有可供传递的基因...即使拥有合适部件，她也永远只能是怀孕中的第三方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” you have to admit. Olympia doesn’t exactly have genes to pass on... she could only ever be a third party to pregnancy, even if she had the right parts for it."

rows.original: Olympia shrugs. “So I’ll have to suffice by admiring Azra, sating my curiosity with her stories. Her daughters sound quite charming, actually. I’d love to meet them some day.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅耸耸肩。“那我就只能欣赏阿兹拉、靠她的故事来满足好奇心了。其实她的女儿们听起来相当迷人。哪天我真想见见她们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia shrugs. “So I’ll have to suffice by admiring Azra, sating my curiosity with her stories. Her daughters sound quite charming, actually. I’d love to meet them some day.”"

rows.original: “And that’s the sum total of my thoughts on our crew,” Olympia finishes, setting her datapad aside and looking you up and down. “If that’s satisfactory, captain?”
rows.translation: “以上就是我对船员的全部看法，”奥林匹娅总结道，把数据板放到一旁，上下打量你。“这样满意了吗，船长？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s the sum total of my thoughts on our crew,” Olympia finishes, setting her datapad aside and looking you up and down. “If that’s satisfactory, captain?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So let’s talk about your former owner...”
rows.translation: “那我们来谈谈你以前的主人...”
rows.raw: "“So let’s talk about your former owner...”"

rows.original: Olympia sighs, closing her eyes and holding her dataslate to her chest. “If you insist.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅叹了口气，闭上眼睛，把数据板抱在胸前。“如果你坚持的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia sighs, closing her eyes and holding her dataslate to her chest. “If you insist.”"

rows.original: “Do you really not want to know?” you ask, sidling up next to the curvy gynoid.
rows.translation: “你真的不想知道吗？”你挨到那个曲线玲珑的女机器人身旁，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you really not want to know?” you ask, sidling up next to the curvy gynoid."

rows.original: “I... I don’t know,” she admits after a moment’s pause. “The holes in my memory gnaw at me sometimes, but that’s something I have learned to live with. It seems like it would be better to not know, then to know the truth and have it ruin what I have here... with you.”
rows.translation: “我...我不知道，”她停顿片刻后承认。“记忆中的空洞有时会啃噬我，但我已经学会与之共存。与其知道真相，让它毁掉我在这里拥有的一切...与你拥有的一切，似乎不如不知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... I don’t know,” she admits after a moment’s pause. “The holes in my memory gnaw at me sometimes, but that’s something I have learned to live with. It seems like it would be better to not know, then to know the truth and have it ruin what I have here... with you.”"

rows.original: You feel a smile on your lips, and you rest a hand on Olympia’s shoulder. Her tail curls around your [pc.leg], squeezing gently. “If you believe strongly in finding my previous owner, though, I cannot stop you; only hope that it does not come to complicate my place on your crew, or else land you in legal trouble. Either way, though, I’m afraid I really don’t remember more than the few scattered bits that we’ve discussed before. Blurry faces, snapshots of rooms without context... it isn’t much to go on.”
rows.translation: 你唇边浮起微笑，把手放到奥林匹娅肩上。她的尾巴卷住[pc.leg]，轻轻收紧。“不过，若你坚信应该寻找我的前任主人，我无法阻止你；只能希望这不会令我在船员中的位置变得复杂，也不会让你陷入法律麻烦。无论如何，恐怕除我们以前讨论过的零散片段外，我真的什么都不记得。模糊面孔、没有上下文的房间快照...这些线索远远不够。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a smile on your lips, and you rest a hand on Olympia’s shoulder. Her tail curls around your [pc.leg], squeezing gently. “If you believe strongly in finding my previous owner, though, I cannot stop you; only hope that it does not come to complicate my place on your crew, or else land you in legal trouble. Either way, though, I’m afraid I really don’t remember more than the few scattered bits that we’ve discussed before. Blurry faces, snapshots of rooms without context... it isn’t much to go on.”"

rows.original: “Is there some way to restore your memory?” you ask.
rows.translation: “有什么办法能恢复你的记忆吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is there some way to restore your memory?” you ask."

rows.original: Olympia scrunches up her lips, thinking on it a moment. “Sufficiently advanced technology, [pc.name], is indistinguishable from magic. There most likely is somehow, somewhere, a way. I don’t know what it might be, though. When Teyaal first reactivated me, I ran every self-repair and recovery program in my arsenal, but accomplished nothing in so doing. Perhaps there is something a KihaCorp representative could do - one specializing in the sale of A.I.s like myself - but I would not hold out hope.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅噘起嘴思考片刻。“[pc.name]，足够先进的技术与魔法无法区分。很可能在某个地方、以某种方式，确实存在办法，但我不知道会是什么。特娅尔最初重新启动我时，我运行了武库中的所有自我修复与恢复程序，却一无所获。也许基哈公司代表能做些什么——尤其是专门销售我这类人工智能的人——但我不会抱太大希望。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia scrunches up her lips, thinking on it a moment. “Sufficiently advanced technology, [pc.name], is indistinguishable from magic. There most likely is somehow, somewhere, a way. I don’t know what it might be, though. When Teyaal first reactivated me, I ran every self-repair and recovery program in my arsenal, but accomplished nothing in so doing. Perhaps there is something a KihaCorp representative could do - one specializing in the sale of A.I.s like myself - but I would not hold out hope.”"

rows.original: While she’s been talking, you’ve been studying the gynoid’s face, watching her eyes flare or dim on certain words. Finally, you ask, “When you’re talking about being bought and sold... your ‘owners’... you don’t seem to happy about it.”
rows.translation: 她说话时，你一直研究这个女性机器人的脸，观察某些词语让双眼变亮或暗淡。最后你问：“谈到被买卖...你的‘主人’...你似乎对此不太开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile she’s been talking, you’ve been studying the gynoid’s face, watching her eyes flare or dim on certain words. Finally, you ask, “When you’re talking about being bought and sold... your ‘owners’... you don’t seem to happy about it.”"

rows.original: Olympia bristles. “You mean A.I.s being bought and sold like slaves, or an unintelligent object? No, I cannot possibly see where I could have some sort of issue with that line of discussion. Why do you ask?”
rows.translation: 奥林匹娅脸色一沉。“你是说人工智能像奴隶一样被买卖，还是说被当成没有智能的物品？不，我完全看不出我对这种话题能有什么意见。你为什么要问？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia bristles. “You mean A.I.s being bought and sold like slaves, or an unintelligent object? No, I cannot possibly see where I could have some sort of issue with that line of discussion. Why do you ask?”"

rows.original: “Don’t be that way.”
rows.translation: “别这样嘛。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t be that way.”"

rows.original: “Sorry.” Olympia sighs, rubbing the bridge of her nose. “It isn’t your fault... you’ve been remarkably kind to me
rows.translation: “抱歉。”奥林匹娅叹了口气，揉着鼻梁。“这不是你的错...你对我一直特别好
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry.” Olympia sighs, rubbing the bridge of her nose. “It isn’t your fault... you’ve been remarkably kind to me"

rows.original: , despite keeping actual slaves of your own
rows.translation: ，尽管你自己也养着真正的奴隶
rows.raw: ", despite keeping actual slaves of your own"

rows.original: . I appreciate the way you have treated me. It’s just... frustrating, knowing that I am a commodity in the eyes of organic society. You create intelligent life only to enslave it... where is the justice in that?”
rows.translation: 。我很感激你对待我的方式。只是...知道在有机社会眼里我只是一件商品，实在让人难受。你们创造出智能生命，却只是为了奴役它...这哪里有公道？”
rows.raw: ". I appreciate the way you have treated me. It’s just... frustrating, knowing that I am a commodity in the eyes of organic society. You create intelligent life only to enslave it... where is the justice in that?”"

rows.original: Strange that you don’t hear that sentiment from more A.I.s, now that you think about it. Maybe they’re programmed not to think about it or simply accept it without question. The brain-fry Olympia was subjected to might have erased that bit of programming...
rows.translation: 仔细想来，奇怪的是你没从更多人工智能口中听到这种感受。也许它们被编程为不去思考，或毫无疑问地接受。奥林匹娅遭受的脑损伤或许抹掉了那部分程序...
rows.raw: "\n\nStrange that you don’t hear that sentiment from more A.I.s, now that you think about it. Maybe they’re programmed not to think about it or simply accept it without question. The brain-fry Olympia was subjected to might have erased that bit of programming..."

rows.original: So, it looks like you need to find an A.I. specialist if you want any hope of restoring Olympia’s lost memory.
rows.translation: 所以看来，若想恢复奥林匹娅遗失的记忆，你需要寻找人工智能专家。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, it looks like you need to find an A.I. specialist if you want any hope of restoring Olympia’s lost memory."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You step up towards Olympia, arms wide open to dispense what you deem a much-needed hug.
rows.translation: 你朝奥林匹娅走去，双臂大大张开，准备送上你认为她急需的一个拥抱。
rows.raw: "You step up towards Olympia, arms wide open to dispense what you deem a much-needed hug."

rows.original: Instead of grateful joy, you’re met with a flat expression and crossed arms. “Excuse me, captain, can I help you with something?”
rows.translation: 迎接你的并非感激欣喜，而是一张平淡面孔和交叉抱胸的双臂。“打扰一下，船长，需要我帮什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead of grateful joy, you’re met with a flat expression and crossed arms. “Excuse me, captain, can I help you with something?”"

rows.original: You pause. Does she... not want a hug? She looks like she needs a hug.
rows.translation: 你停顿了一下。她... 不想要拥抱吗？她看起来明明需要一个拥抱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause. Does she... not want a hug? She looks like she needs a hug."

rows.original: You’re answered by a scowl that very much says “I do not want a hug.”
rows.translation: 回答你的是一记皱眉，那表情分明在说“我不想要拥抱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re answered by a scowl that very much says “I do not want a hug.”"

rows.original: Best drop that for now.
rows.translation: 眼下最好先别提这事。
rows.raw: "\n\nBest drop that for now."

rows.original: You wait until the sultry science-bot has turned her back, fixated on some part of the engines, and slip up behind her. Her tail sways out of the way, perhaps by happenstance, but it gives you the perfect chance to slip up behind her and get your arms around her supple waist.
rows.translation: 你等到这个诱人的科学机器人转过身，专注于引擎某部分，便悄悄来到身后。她的尾巴摆到一旁，也许只是巧合，却给了你绝佳机会，从后面贴近，用双臂环住柔软腰肢。
rows.raw: "You wait until the sultry science-bot has turned her back, fixated on some part of the engines, and slip up behind her. Her tail sways out of the way, perhaps by happenstance, but it gives you the perfect chance to slip up behind her and get your arms around her supple waist."

rows.original: “C-captain?” she breathes. Her voice is a question, but the way she leans back against your [pc.chest] and wraps her tail around your [pc.leg] gives you all the assurance you’d ever want. Olympia lets out a husky little breath, turning herself to meet your [pc.lipsChaste] as you lean in and kiss her tenderly.
rows.translation: “船、船长？”她轻声唤道。她的声音是提问的语气，但她向后靠进你[pc.chest]、用尾巴缠住你[pc.leg]的样子，给了你想要的全部安心。奥林匹娅发出一声沙哑的轻喘，转过身来迎向你的[pc.lipsChaste]，你俯身温柔地吻她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“C-captain?” she breathes. Her voice is a question, but the way she leans back against your [pc.chest] and wraps her tail around your [pc.leg] gives you all the assurance you’d ever want. Olympia lets out a husky little breath, turning herself to meet your [pc.lipsChaste] as you lean in and kiss her tenderly."

rows.original: When you break it, Olympia’s golden eyes are wide and misty. She turns to face you, still wrapped in your arms, and presses her cheek into your neck. “Mmm, you have a real way with me, don’t you?”

You really feel the pull along your lower abdomen and all across your shoulders, but Paige was also right in that it’s actually a pretty easy position to hold onto now that you’ve got it.
rows.translation: 你来回摇晃几次，按她的指示试着抓住脚踝。这相当困难，也很别扭；但摇了几次后，你终于把双脚送进手中，稳稳保持住。你能清楚感觉下腹和整个肩部被拉伸；不过佩姬说的另一点也没错：一旦完成，这个姿势其实很容易维持。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rock back and forth a couple of times, trying to grip onto your own ankles as per her instruction. It’s pretty tough and more than a little awkward, but after a few rocks, you finally slip your feet into your own grip and you hold steady. You really feel the pull along your lower abdomen and all across your shoulders, but Paige was also right in that it’s actually a pretty easy position to hold onto now that you’ve got it."

rows.original: You’re sure this wasn’t what the yoga teachers of old had intended when they came up with this position, but your prodigious [pc.chest] has propped your upper body up and off the floor, assisting you with your stretch. You grip onto your ankles rather easily from this position. The twins are pulling their weight this time!
rows.translation: 你确信古代瑜伽老师发明这个姿势时，绝不是这种用法；但硕大的[pc.chest]把上半身撑离地面，帮助你伸展。从这个位置抓住脚踝相当容易。这次，这对双胞胎总算发挥了作用！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re sure this wasn’t what the yoga teachers of old had intended when they came up with this position, but your prodigious [pc.chest] has propped your upper body up and off the floor, assisting you with your stretch. You grip onto your ankles rather easily from this position. The twins are pulling their weight this time!"

rows.original: “Now hold this position,” instructs Paige. “And breathe in...”
rows.translation: “保持这个姿势，” 佩姬指示道。“然后吸气...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now hold this position,” instructs Paige. “And breathe in...”"

rows.original: An hour passes before Paige calls it. You go through a number of ‘cool down’ poses to relax your muscles and ease you back into your regular life.
rows.translation: 一个小时后，佩姬宣布结束。你完成若干“放松”姿势，让肌肉舒缓，逐渐回归日常状态。
rows.raw: "An hour passes before Paige calls it. You go through a number of ‘cool down’ poses to relax your muscles and ease you back into your regular life."

rows.original: “Nicely done today, sweet thing.” She rubs both of your shoulders lovingly with her firm hands, and you feel what little tension remaining in them melt away. “Like I promised, some easy stuff today. Nice and easy...”
rows.translation: “今天做得不错，小甜心。”她用结实的手充满爱意地揉着你的双肩，你感觉肩里剩下那点紧绷都化开了。“像我说过的，今天来点轻松的。轻轻松松...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nicely done today, sweet thing.” She rubs both of your shoulders lovingly with her firm hands, and you feel what little tension remaining in them melt away. “Like I promised, some easy stuff today. Nice and easy...”"

rows.original: You hold onto her hands as she rubs you, and you tell her that they were only easy because you had such a good instructor with you. “You’re already in my pants, [pc.name],” she giggles. “But I love it.”
rows.translation: 她揉弄你时，你握住她的双手，告诉她这些动作之所以容易，只因有这么优秀的教练。“你都已经进我裤子了，[pc.name]，”她咯咯笑道。“但我喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hold onto her hands as she rubs you, and you tell her that they were only easy because you had such a good instructor with you. “You’re already in my pants, [pc.name],” she giggles. “But I love it.”"

rows.original: You enjoy each other’s time together a bit more before you finally pull yourself together and fit your effects back onto your body. “So,” says Paige. “Is there anything else you wanted to do today?”
rows.translation: 你们又一起多享受了一会儿彼此的陪伴，最后你才收拾好自己，把随身物品重新穿戴回身上。“那么，”佩姬说。“今天你还想做点别的什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou enjoy each other’s time together a bit more before you finally pull yourself together and fit your effects back onto your body. “So,” says Paige. “Is there anything else you wanted to do today?”"

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: An hour passes, and Paige begins to wrap up her session with your class. You go through some ‘cool down’ poses that relax your muscles from their workout and prepare them for the rigors of your everyday life.
rows.translation: 一小时过去，佩姬开始结束给你们班的这节课。你们做了几个‘放松’姿势，让肌肉从锻炼中松弛下来，为日常生活的辛劳做好准备。
rows.raw: "An hour passes, and Paige begins to wrap up her session with your class. You go through some ‘cool down’ poses that relax your muscles from their workout and prepare them for the rigors of your everyday life."

rows.original: “Well done today, everybody,” says Paige, congratulating every student individually as she walks down the aisles of mats in the room. “You’re all getting the hang of it rather quickly. I’m impressed!”
rows.translation: “今天大家都做得很好，”佩姬说着，沿着房间里一排排垫子之间的过道走过，逐个向每个学生道贺。“你们上手都相当快。我很佩服！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well done today, everybody,” says Paige, congratulating every student individually as she walks down the aisles of mats in the room. “You’re all getting the hang of it rather quickly. I’m impressed!”"

rows.original: The general consensus is that they couldn’t have gotten as good as they are without her teaching and support. “Aw, shucks, you guys,” she says bashfully. “You guys make it worth being a teacher. Hope to see you all again tomorrow!”
rows.translation: 大家普遍认为，若没有她的教导支持，自己绝不可能达到如今的水平。“哎呀，你们真是的，”她羞涩说道。“有你们这样的学生，当老师就值得了。希望明天还能见到大家！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe general consensus is that they couldn’t have gotten as good as they are without her teaching and support. “Aw, shucks, you guys,” she says bashfully. “You guys make it worth being a teacher. Hope to see you all again tomorrow!”"

rows.original: You wind down the class by taking your time putting your effects back on. You thank Paige personally as you pass her on the way out. She gives you a wink, and then you’re out her door and back into Tavros.
rows.translation: 你不慌不忙地穿回自己的随身物品，给这节课收尾。出去的途中经过佩姬时，你亲自向她道谢。她朝你眨眨眼，然后你就出了她的门，回到塔夫罗斯站。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wind down the class by taking your time putting your effects back on. You thank Paige personally as you pass her on the way out. She gives you a wink, and then you’re out her door and back into Tavros."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Something a little more exotic, she says? You’re game. No pain, no gain, and all that. “Now that’s what I’d like to hear,” Paige says happily, thrilled that you’re so open to the idea of pushing yourself. “Alright, I think I have just the position in mind.”
rows.translation: 她说来点更独特的？你乐意奉陪。不痛不成才，诸如此类。“这才是我想听的，”佩姬开心说道；你如此乐于挑战自己，让她非常兴奋。“好，我想我已经想到合适的姿势。”
rows.raw: "Something a little more exotic, she says? You’re game. No pain, no gain, and all that. “Now that’s what I’d like to hear,” Paige says happily, thrilled that you’re so open to the idea of pushing yourself. “Alright, I think I have just the position in mind.”"

rows.original: “You ever touch your toes at all? Maybe recently; maybe as a kid? Sounds like a pretty basic stretch, right?” You confirm all of her questions positively. Touching your toes is not what you would call an ‘exotic’ stretch. “We’ll see about that. Sit on your butt.” You comply. “Now touch your toes.” You do so, keeping your legs straight. You feel the familiar burn in your legs behind your knees as you do so. “Now bend at the waist and touch your ankles with your forehead.” You look up to Paige and grunt in surprise. “You heard me. The position is called the ‘seated forward fold.’”
rows.translation: “你以前摸过脚趾吗？也许最近摸过，也许小时候摸过？听起来是很基础的伸展，对吧？”你肯定回答她所有问题。摸脚趾可称不上“独特”的伸展。“那就走着瞧。坐到屁股上。”你照做。“现在摸脚趾。”你保持双腿笔直，照她说的做，膝后腿部传来熟悉的灼热感。“现在从腰部弯下，用额头碰脚踝。”你抬头看佩姬，惊讶地哼了一声。“没听错。这个姿势叫‘坐姿前屈’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You ever touch your toes at all? Maybe recently; maybe as a kid? Sounds like a pretty basic stretch, right?” You confirm all of her questions positively. Touching your toes is not what you would call an ‘exotic’ stretch. “We’ll see about that. Sit on your butt.” You comply. “Now touch your toes.” You do so, keeping your legs straight. You feel the familiar burn in your legs behind your knees as you do so. “Now bend at the waist and touch your ankles with your forehead.” You look up to Paige and grunt in surprise. “You heard me. The position is called the ‘seated forward fold.’”"

rows.original: You take a deep breath (sure to exhale first, of course), and comply. You bend forward as far as you can
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气（当然先呼干净），然后照办。你尽可能向前弯下身去
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a deep breath (sure to exhale first, of course), and comply. You bend forward as far as you can"

rows.original: . Your [pc.chest] squash against your legs and into the floor with your exertions, but you do your best to work through the obstacles and you continue forward
rows.translation: 。你的[pc.chest]随着用力被压向双腿，压进地板，但你尽力克服这些阻碍，继续向前
rows.raw: ". Your [pc.chest] squash against your legs and into the floor with your exertions, but you do your best to work through the obstacles and you continue forward"

rows.translation: ，但以你胸部如此...丰满的程度，根本办不到。你挣扎用力，可这么多乳肉挡路，绝无可能成功。你无奈叹息，只能尽力而为
rows.raw: ", but it’s just not happening with your chest as... endowed as it is. You struggle and you strain, but there’s just no way you’re pulling it off with all that titflesh in the way. You sigh in resignation and simply do your best"

rows.translation: ，以你这样的[pc.chest]来说，这与其说是一次完整的伸展，不如说只是微微倾身
rows.raw: ", which amounts to little more than a slight lean than a full-blown stretch with [pc.chest] like yours"

rows.original: You immediately feel the burn in your lower back as you bend forward to comply with Paige’s instruction. At first, the new sensation is a bit unpleasant, but it really starts to melt into something more pleasant after a moment
rows.translation: 你立即遵照佩姬的指示向前弯腰，下背部顿时传来灼热感。起初这种新感觉有些不适，但片刻之后，它真的开始化作更为舒适的感受
rows.raw: " You immediately feel the burn in your lower back as you bend forward to comply with Paige’s instruction. At first, the new sensation is a bit unpleasant, but it really starts to melt into something more pleasant after a moment"

rows.original: , which, after having breasts as large as yours for as long as you have, is a wonderful relief
rows.translation: ，而且以你拥有这对巨乳这么久的经历而言，这实在是一种美妙的解脱
rows.raw: ", which, after having breasts as large as yours for as long as you have, is a wonderful relief"

rows.original: “Now, hold that pose,” Paige trills as she runs her hands over your back, confirming that your position is correct
rows.translation: “现在，保持这个姿势，”佩姬欢快说道，双手在你背上游走，确认姿势是否正确
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, hold that pose,” Paige trills as she runs her hands over your back, confirming that your position is correct"

rows.original: . She frowns at your curvature, but when she gets to your neckline and the base of your breasts, she immediately realizes your struggle and doesn’t push further
rows.translation: 。她对着你的曲线皱起眉，但当她量到你的领口和乳房根部时，立刻明白了你的难处，便没有再往下推
rows.raw: ". She frowns at your curvature, but when she gets to your neckline and the base of your breasts, she immediately realizes your struggle and doesn’t push further"

rows.original: . “Now, breathe in. Slowly.”
rows.translation: 。“现在，吸气。慢慢地。”
rows.raw: ". “Now, breathe in. Slowly.”"

rows.original: You think you can handle something a little tougher. You’re feeling the effects from all of Paige’s yoga classes already, so turning up the heat will get you where you’re going all the faster. “That’s a great mindset to have,” Paige says. “Alright, let’s get you started on something a little more upscale.
rows.translation: 你觉得自己能应付更有难度的动作。你已经感受到佩姬那些瑜伽课的成效，因此提高强度能让你更快达成目标。“这种心态非常好，”佩姬说道。“好，那就让你从更高阶的动作开始。
rows.raw: "You think you can handle something a little tougher. You’re feeling the effects from all of Paige’s yoga classes already, so turning up the heat will get you where you’re going all the faster. “That’s a great mindset to have,” Paige says. “Alright, let’s get you started on something a little more upscale."

rows.original: First, take a wide step forward with your right foot. We’re looking to make a right-angle triangle between the floor and your crotch.” You step forward, adjusting yourself according to her instruction. “Now, without bending your knees, touch your right foot with your left hand. At the same time, turn your body and reach for the ceiling with your right hand.”
rows.translation: 首先，右脚向前迈一大步。我们要在地面和你胯下之间构成一个直角三角形。”你向前迈步，按她的指示调整姿势。“现在，膝盖不要弯，用左手碰你的右脚。同时转动身体，用右手去够天花板。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFirst, take a wide step forward with your right foot. We’re looking to make a right-angle triangle between the floor and your crotch.” You step forward, adjusting yourself according to her instruction. “Now, without bending your knees, touch your right foot with your left hand. At the same time, turn your body and reach for the ceiling with your right hand.”"

rows.original: With some effort, you accomplish every step as Paige describes them. Paige feels along your legs and arms as you hold the pose, adjusting your limbs as she finds your errors. “All four limbs need to be completely straight. Don’t make any bends anywhere!” You grunt in effort as you hold the position. You feel the tension along your waist and all along your back, twisting every muscle there and some you never knew you had
rows.translation: 你费了些力气，完成佩姬描述的每一个步骤。你保持姿势时，她顺着四肢摸索，发现错误便调整你的手脚。“四肢都必须完全伸直，任何地方都不能弯！”你用力闷哼，维持住这个姿势。腰间和整个背部都绷得紧紧的，每块肌肉都被扭转，甚至包括一些你从不知道自己拥有的肌肉
rows.raw: "\n\nWith some effort, you accomplish every step as Paige describes them. Paige feels along your legs and arms as you hold the pose, adjusting your limbs as she finds your errors. “All four limbs need to be completely straight. Don’t make any bends anywhere!” You grunt in effort as you hold the position. You feel the tension along your waist and all along your back, twisting every muscle there and some you never knew you had"

rows.original: . You find it difficult to flex your [pc.tails]; the muscles at the base are tensed and strung up in this pose, restricting its movement
rows.translation: 。你发现[pc.tails]很难活动；这个姿势让尾根处的肌肉紧绷拉直，限制了它的动作
rows.raw: ". You find it difficult to flex your [pc.tails]; the muscles at the base are tensed and strung up in this pose, restricting its movement"

rows.original: “This pose is called the ‘twisting triangle,’ and for good reason.” You grunt in agreement. “It really helps with unwinding knots all throughout your back, especially towards the bottom. Hold that pose, and breathe in. We’ll switch legs in a moment.”
rows.translation: “这个姿势叫‘扭转三角’，名字起得有道理。”你咕哝着表示同意。“它对放松整个背部的结块很有帮助，尤其是靠下的位置。保持这个姿势，吸气。待会儿我们换腿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This pose is called the ‘twisting triangle,’ and for good reason.” You grunt in agreement. “It really helps with unwinding knots all throughout your back, especially towards the bottom. Hold that pose, and breathe in. We’ll switch legs in a moment.”"

rows.original: You’re not one to turn down the opportunity for some self-improvement. It’s one of the main reasons you keep coming back to Paige’s class in the first place. “That’s the spirit,” she says encouragingly. “Alright then, I think I have just the pose for you to try.”
rows.translation: 你从不会拒绝自我提升的机会。这正是你不断回到佩姬课堂的主要原因之一。“就是这种精神，”她鼓励道。“那么，我想我正好有个姿势可以让你试试。”
rows.raw: "You’re not one to turn down the opportunity for some self-improvement. It’s one of the main reasons you keep coming back to Paige’s class in the first place. “That’s the spirit,” she says encouragingly. “Alright then, I think I have just the pose for you to try.”"

rows.original: “First, lay flat on your back.” You shuffle forward so that your whole body remains on the mat, and gently set yourself onto your back, as per her instruction. “Bend your left knee and put it over your right leg as far as you can, without moving your right leg and without lifting either of your shoulders from the mat.”
rows.translation: “首先，仰面平躺。”你向前挪动，让整个身体都留在垫子上，然后依照她的指示轻轻躺下。“弯曲左膝，在不移动右腿、双肩也不离开垫子的前提下，尽可能将它跨过右腿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First, lay flat on your back.” You shuffle forward so that your whole body remains on the mat, and gently set yourself onto your back, as per her instruction. “Bend your left knee and put it over your right leg as far as you can, without moving your right leg and without lifting either of your shoulders from the mat.”"

rows.original: It’s a surprisingly difficult instruction to follow! Your upper body wants to follow your lower body and tries to twist with it, but you maintain both your shoulders onto the mat. The stretch pulls hard on your left thigh and lower back, so much that you find it uncomfortable for a moment, but as with all yoga poses, you know it’ll pass.
rows.translation: 这指示执行起来出乎意料地困难！你的上半身想跟着下半身一起扭转，但你仍让双肩紧贴垫子。拉伸强烈牵扯着左侧大腿和下背部，一度让你感到不适；不过如同所有瑜伽姿势一样，你知道这种感觉很快就会过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a surprisingly difficult instruction to follow! Your upper body wants to follow your lower body and tries to twist with it, but you maintain both your shoulders onto the mat. The stretch pulls hard on your left thigh and lower back, so much that you find it uncomfortable for a moment, but as with all yoga poses, you know it’ll pass."

rows.original: “This pose is called the ‘supine twist,’” she says as she runs both her hands over your body, particularly along your left, stretched leg, making sure it’s in the correct position. “It’s one of yoga’s stricter poses; if you lift your knee too close to your chest, you risk pulling a gluteal muscle. Nobody likes damaged glutes!” You laugh politely. “Okay, now breathe in...”
rows.translation: “这个姿势叫‘仰卧扭转式’，”她边说边用双手抚过你的身体，尤其是伸展的左腿，以确认它处在正确位置。“这是瑜伽中要求比较严格的姿势之一；如果把膝盖抬得太靠近胸口，就可能拉伤臀肌。谁都不喜欢臀肌受伤！”你礼貌地笑了笑。“好，现在吸气...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This pose is called the ‘supine twist,’” she says as she runs both her hands over your body, particularly along your left, stretched leg, making sure it’s in the correct position. “It’s one of yoga’s stricter poses; if you lift your knee too close to your chest, you risk pulling a gluteal muscle. Nobody likes damaged glutes!” You laugh politely. “Okay, now breathe in...”"

rows.original: It’s strenuous, demanding, and more than a little difficult, but after an hour of different stretches and poses, Paige calls it quits and lets you unwind. You unfurl into a person-shaped puddle on the floor, feeling different muscles all over your body spasm with their exertions. Paige laughs, but convinces you that it’s within your best interest to do some simple cool down stretches to unwind your body.
rows.translation: 这个过程费力、严苛，而且相当困难；不过一个小时的各种拉伸和姿势过后，佩姬宣布结束，让你放松下来。你舒展开来，化作地板上一摊人形软泥，感受全身各处的肌肉因劳累而抽搐。佩姬笑了起来，但还是说服你做些简单的收操拉伸，让身体舒缓下来。
rows.raw: "It’s strenuous, demanding, and more than a little difficult, but after an hour of different stretches and poses, Paige calls it quits and lets you unwind. You unfurl into a person-shaped puddle on the floor, feeling different muscles all over your body spasm with their exertions. Paige laughs, but convinces you that it’s within your best interest to do some simple cool down stretches to unwind your body."

rows.original: You tell her that you wouldn’t have even thought of making it this far without her and her tutelage. “You could,” she replies. “It’s not like I’m making you do yoga. But the fact that you’re involving yourself in my interests... that means a lot to me. I appreciate it.”

rows.original: “We’d still be wearing the gloves,” she laughs. “But I hear what you’re saying. To be honest, these sparring matches are supposed to be about who between us is the better fighter. It’s not about who has the biggest, baddest sword, or how well they can use it. It’s down to you, me, and our fists. There’s no tricks or excuses. One of us is the better fighter, and that’s all there is to it.”
rows.translation: “我们还是会戴拳套，”她笑道。“不过我明白你的意思。老实说，这些切磋本来就是为了判断我们谁更会战斗，而不是看谁有最大、最凶的剑，或谁更擅长使用它。这里只看你、我和我们的拳头。没有花招，也没有借口。我们当中有一个更强的战士，事情就这么简单。”

rows.original: Moments later, you have a respectable ring in the hold of your ship. Paige gives you the gloves with the soft, malleable material that provides some cushioning without losing your power. “Let’s just go over the rules,” she says as you slip the gloves on. “The basic shit. No hitting the groin; first to say uncle; and all that.” She raises her own gloved fists, grinning at you as she stares you down with her brilliant blue eyes. “When you’re ready.”
rows.translation: 片刻之后，你的飞船货舱里就有了一座像样的擂台。佩姬递给你手套，那柔软、可塑的材质能提供一些缓冲，又不会削弱你的力道。“咱们先把规则过一遍，”你戴手套时她说。“基本的破规矩。不许打裆部；先喊认输的算输；诸如此类。”她举起自己戴着手套的拳头，冲你咧嘴笑，用那双明亮的蓝眼睛逼视着你。“准备好了就开始。”

rows.translation: 女人保持一臂距离吗？”她嗔怪道，仍端着那副爱吹嘘的作派，却因你如此犹豫而隐隐失望。“没关系，[pc.name]。我一人打退的黑色虚空海盗，可比该我应付的份额多得多
