rows.original: , so I’m not exactly a slouch. When you’re feeling a bit braver, feel free to come at me. I’ll be here!”
rows.translation: ，所以我可不是什么好对付的软柿子。等你胆子再大一点，随时可以来挑战我。我会在这儿等你！”
rows.raw: ", so I’m not exactly a slouch. When you’re feeling a bit braver, feel free to come at me. I’ll be here!”"

rows.original: You can’t help but feel you’ve let Paige down a bit, but still, you kind of value your personal health. Maybe you’ll take her advice and come back when you’re ‘braver.’
rows.translation: 你不禁觉得自己让佩姬有点失望，但你还是挺珍惜自己的身体。也许你会听从她的建议，等自己“更勇敢”时再回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but feel you’ve let Paige down a bit, but still, you kind of value your personal health. Maybe you’ll take her advice and come back when you’re ‘braver.’"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PAIGE
rows.raw: "PAIGE"

rows.original: With some reluctance, you tell Paige that, when it comes to hot-bunking with each other, you two need to return to a more professional distance, and that she should go back to sleeping in her own bunk for the time being.
rows.translation: 你有些不情愿地告诉佩姬，关于彼此共睡一张床这件事，你们需要恢复更职业的距离；眼下她应该回自己的铺位睡觉。
rows.raw: "With some reluctance, you tell Paige that, when it comes to hot-bunking with each other, you two need to return to a more professional distance, and that she should go back to sleeping in her own bunk for the time being."

rows.original: “Aw, dang,” she says, and although the disappointment is real in her voice, you can tell that she isn’t exactly too beat up about your call. “I’m not going to try and argue with you, captain, so I guess it was fun while it lasted. Let me know if you ever change your mind, though; it’s not like I’m going anywhere.”
rows.translation: “唉，真遗憾，”她说道。尽管你确实能听出她语气中的失望，但也看得出她并没有因为你的决定太过难受。“我不会试着跟你争辩，船长，所以我想，有过那么一段开心时光就够了。不过如果你哪天改变主意，记得告诉我；反正我又不会去哪里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw, dang,” she says, and although the disappointment is real in her voice, you can tell that she isn’t exactly too beat up about your call. “I’m not going to try and argue with you, captain, so I guess it was fun while it lasted. Let me know if you ever change your mind, though; it’s not like I’m going anywhere.”"

rows.original: PAIGE
rows.raw: "PAIGE"

rows.original: You look around Paige’s quarters and see how she has the place set up. She has a little desk with two chairs; a monitor that connects directly to Iddi, along with whatever programming a monitor can receive in these fringe areas of the universe; some books; and a bed that’s half as big as yours and probably not as comfy.
rows.translation: 你环顾佩姬的住舱，看看她如何布置这里。她有一张配着两把椅子的小书桌；一台与伊迪直接相连的显示器，也能接收宇宙边缘地区可收到的各种节目；几本书；还有一张只有你的床一半大、恐怕也没那么舒服的床。
rows.raw: "You look around Paige’s quarters and see how she has the place set up. She has a little desk with two chairs; a monitor that connects directly to Iddi, along with whatever programming a monitor can receive in these fringe areas of the universe; some books; and a bed that’s half as big as yours and probably not as comfy."

rows.original: You try and keep your expression as straight-laced as you can when you ask Paige if she’d like to spend the nights with you.
rows.translation: 你尽量板着脸，问佩姬愿不愿意和你一起过夜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try and keep your expression as straight-laced as you can when you ask Paige if she’d like to spend the nights with you."

rows.original: <i>“Do we not do that already?
rows.translation: <i>“我们不是已经会那样做了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Do we not do that already?"

rows.original: You, me, and whoever else on the crew is okay with sharing?
rows.translation: 你、我，还有船上其他愿意一起分享的人？
rows.raw: " You, me, and whoever else on the crew is okay with sharing?"

rows.original: ” she asks, not initially understanding your meaning. You explain more clearly that, while you’re the captain of the ship and that affords you some privileges, your bed can comfortably hold two, and that you’d like someone to hold when you sleep in it at night.
rows.translation: ”她问道，起初没明白你的意思。你解释得更清楚些：你是这艘船的船长，因此享有一些特权；你的床足够舒适，可以睡下两个人，而你希望晚上睡觉时能抱着某个人。
rows.raw: "” she asks, not initially understanding your meaning. You explain more clearly that, while you’re the captain of the ship and that affords you some privileges, your bed can comfortably hold two, and that you’d like someone to hold when you sleep in it at night."

rows.original: “My goodness, that’s an adorable way to phrase it,” she giggles. “But hey,” she continues, outstretching her hand for you to hold and with a warm smile on her face, “I’d love to be your teddy for you to hold at night.”
rows.translation: “我的天，这说法可真可爱，”她咯咯笑着。“不过嘛，”她伸出手让你握住，脸上带着温暖的笑容，继续说，“我很愿意当你的泰迪熊，让你晚上抱着睡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My goodness, that’s an adorable way to phrase it,” she giggles. “But hey,” she continues, outstretching her hand for you to hold and with a warm smile on her face, “I’d love to be your teddy for you to hold at night.”"

rows.original: You squeeze her hand affectionately. “Two questions, though,” she continues, “first, am I still calling you ‘captain’ when we’re snug under the rugs? Or can I call you [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 你亲昵地捏了捏她的手。“不过有两个问题，”她继续道，“第一，我们舒舒服服钻在被窝里时，我还要叫你‘船长’吗？还是能叫你[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squeeze her hand affectionately. “Two questions, though,” she continues, “first, am I still calling you ‘captain’ when we’re snug under the rugs? Or can I call you [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You tell her that you’re okay with her calling you by your name. “And second, is this really all about us holding each other like teddies? Or are you just trying to ask for a lay and you’re taking a weirdly roundabout way to it?”
rows.translation: 你告诉她，可以直接叫你的名字。“第二，这真的只是为了让我们像抱泰迪熊一样抱着彼此吗？还是你只是想约炮，却偏要绕这么大一个圈子开口？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’re okay with her calling you by your name. “And second, is this really all about us holding each other like teddies? Or are you just trying to ask for a lay and you’re taking a weirdly roundabout way to it?”"

rows.original: Grinning yourself, you answer by saying that you’ll let the night decide how you’re both feeling.
rows.translation: 你也笑了，回答说让今晚来决定你们俩的感受吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrinning yourself, you answer by saying that you’ll let the night decide how you’re both feeling."

rows.original: “Okay, sweet thing,” she says, blowing you a kiss and releasing your hand. “I’ll see you tonight, then.”
rows.translation: “好吧，小甜心，”她说道，给了你一个飞吻，松开你的手。“那今晚见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, sweet thing,” she says, blowing you a kiss and releasing your hand. “I’ll see you tonight, then.” "

rows.original: PAIGE
rows.raw: "PAIGE"

rows.original: You eye Paige’s bed. It’s clean and tidy, but the sheets look a little stiff, and the mattress doesn’t look any softer. Your bed is twice as large as her own, and you’re sure it’s quite a bit comfier. You tell Paige that if she wants to start sleeping with you again, the bed is open.
rows.translation: 你打量佩姬的床。它干净整齐，但床单看起来有些硬，床垫似乎也软不到哪里去。你的床比她的床大一倍，而且肯定舒服得多。你告诉佩姬，如果她想重新和你一起睡，你的床随时欢迎她。
rows.raw: "You eye Paige’s bed. It’s clean and tidy, but the sheets look a little stiff, and the mattress doesn’t look any softer. Your bed is twice as large as her own, and you’re sure it’s quite a bit comfier. You tell Paige that if she wants to start sleeping with you again, the bed is open."

rows.original: “Gods, I was kind of hoping you’d ask,” she says, laughing a bit. “I love travelling with you and all, captain, but these bunks you’ve got leave a little something to be desired, at least compared to my bed back on Tavros.”
rows.translation: “诸神在上，我其实一直盼着你开口呢，”她说着轻笑起来。“船长，我很喜欢和你一起旅行，但你这里的铺位实在有点不尽如人意，至少比不上我在塔夫罗斯站的床。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gods, I was kind of hoping you’d ask,” she says, laughing a bit. “I love travelling with you and all, captain, but these bunks you’ve got leave a little something to be desired, at least compared to my bed back on Tavros.”"

rows.original: She continues before you can interject. “And, of course, I’d love to spend the night cuddling with my favorite captain in the universe,” she says, throwing her arms loosely around your shoulders and giving you a quick peck on the [pc.lipsChaste]. “I’ll be seeing you tonight, sweet thing.”
rows.translation: 你还没来得及插话，她就继续说了。“当然，我也很想和我全宇宙最喜欢的船长搂着过一夜，”她说着，松松地把双臂搭上你的肩膀，在你[pc.lipsChaste]上快速啄了一下。“今晚见，小甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe continues before you can interject. “And, of course, I’d love to spend the night cuddling with my favorite captain in the universe,” she says, throwing her arms loosely around your shoulders and giving you a quick peck on the [pc.lipsChaste]. “I’ll be seeing you tonight, sweet thing.”"

rows.original: About Paige
rows.translation: 关于佩姬
rows.raw: "About Paige"

rows.original: You sit with Paige and ask her to tell you more of her story. You’re interested in learning more about your Ausar instructor.
rows.translation: 你坐到佩姬身边，请她多讲讲自己的故事。你有兴趣更多了解你这位奥萨尔教练。
rows.raw: "You sit with Paige and ask her to tell you more of her story. You’re interested in learning more about your Ausar instructor."

rows.original: She squints her eyes at you. “I don’t recall seeing you in my class today, sweet thing” she growls playfully. “Well, figuratively speaking, you know what I mean.” She smiles at you mischievously. “These sexy lips are staying sealed. But, you know, you could always bribe them open...”
rows.translation: 她眯起眼睛看着你。“我不记得今天在我的课上见过你啊，小甜心，”她打趣般低吼道。“当然，是比喻意义上的，你懂我的意思。”她顽皮地朝你一笑。“这双性感的嘴唇会继续守口如瓶。不过嘛，你随时可以用贿赂撬开它们...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe squints her eyes at you. “I don’t recall seeing you in my class today, sweet thing” she growls playfully. “Well, figuratively speaking, you know what I mean.” She smiles at you mischievously. “These sexy lips are staying sealed. But, you know, you could always bribe them open...”"

rows.original: As a matter of fact, you happen to have some of her favorite drink handy. It’s admittedly a bit of an expensive bribe, but hell, you’re a sucker for a face as cute as Paige’s. Do you give her your Honey Wine?
rows.translation: 事实上，你手边正好有一些她最喜欢的饮料。诚然，这份贿赂有点昂贵，但见鬼，面对佩姬这么可爱的脸，你就是毫无抵抗力。要把蜂蜜酒给她吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAs a matter of fact, you happen to have some of her favorite drink handy. It’s admittedly a bit of an expensive bribe, but hell, you’re a sucker for a face as cute as Paige’s. Do you give her your Honey Wine?"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 不
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: You elect to not mention the wine to Paige and keep it to yourself. It’s quite a bit more expensive to get Paige to talk with the wine than it is to just go to a class during the day. Hopefully she doesn’t find out that you’re holding out on her...
rows.translation: 你决定不跟佩姬提酒的事，把它留给自己。用酒让佩姬开口，比白天直接去上课要贵不少。希望她不会发现你瞒着她...
rows.raw: "You elect to not mention the wine to Paige and keep it to yourself. It’s quite a bit more expensive to get Paige to talk with the wine than it is to just go to a class during the day. Hopefully she doesn’t find out that you’re holding out on her..."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: You grin in response. “Don’t suppose I can bribe them open with money?”
rows.translation: 你咧嘴一笑作为回应。“我猜我不能用钱把它们买开吧？”
rows.raw: "You grin in response. “Don’t suppose I can bribe them open with money?”"

rows.original: “‘fraid not, sweet thing.”
rows.translation: “怕是不行，小甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘fraid not, sweet thing.”"

rows.original: You sigh. “In that case,” you say as you withdraw your bottle of Honey Wine, “I guess this Honey Wine will have to do instead.”
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。“既然那样，”你一边抽出那瓶蜂蜜酒，一边说，“那看来只能拿这瓶蜂蜜酒凑数了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. “In that case,” you say as you withdraw your bottle of Honey Wine, “I guess this Honey Wine will have to do instead.”"

rows.original: Her ears perk straight up when she hears the viscous sloshing of the alcohol in its bottle. “Hot damn!” she shouts, her grabby hands reaching for the wine. You let her snatch it from your grip. Within moments, her practiced yoga grip has the cork out, but she takes her time gargling it down and instead takes a heady whiff of the drink.
rows.translation: 听见瓶中黏稠酒液的晃荡声，她的双耳顿时竖得笔直。“太棒了！”她大喊着，急切的双手伸向酒瓶。你任她从你手中抢走。片刻间，她那经过瑜伽锻炼的灵巧握法就拔出了软木塞；但她没有急着咕咚咕咚灌下去，而是先深深闻了一口酒香。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears perk straight up when she hears the viscous sloshing of the alcohol in its bottle. “Hot damn!” she shouts, her grabby hands reaching for the wine. You let her snatch it from your grip. Within moments, her practiced yoga grip has the cork out, but she takes her time gargling it down and instead takes a heady whiff of the drink."

rows.original: “That’s the stuff,” she says dreamily. “Tonight’s gonna be a great night.” She puts the cork back in the neck of the bottle and faces you attentively, a sweet, sincere smile on her face. “Fair’s fair! So, where did we leave off?”
rows.translation: “就是这个味道，”她陶醉地说道。“今晚一定会很棒。”她把软木塞重新塞回瓶口，然后专注地转向你，脸上挂着甜美真诚的笑容。“公平交易！那么，我们说到哪里了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the stuff,” she says dreamily. “Tonight’s gonna be a great night.” She puts the cork back in the neck of the bottle and faces you attentively, a sweet, sincere smile on her face. “Fair’s fair! So, where did we leave off?”"

rows.original: PAIGES_WINES
rows.raw: "PAIGES_WINES"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You sit with Paige and ask her to tell you more of her story. You’re interested in learning more about your Ausar instructor.
rows.translation: 你坐到佩姬身边，请她多讲讲自己的故事。你有兴趣更多了解你这位奥萨尔教练。
rows.raw: "You sit with Paige and ask her to tell you more of her story. You’re interested in learning more about your Ausar instructor."

rows.original: She squints her eyes at you and her lips curl into a mischievous smirk. “Now now, what did I tell you before, sweet thing?” she asks playfully, batting you on the nose. “If you want to know a little more about me, you gotta come to my classes for some exercise. Or you can bribe me with some Honey Wine. I can’t give away all my secrets just because one of my favorite students asks. It’s give-and-take between us. You visit me at work, and I tell you what you want.
rows.translation: 她眯起眼睛看你，嘴角弯成一个促狭的笑。“好了好了，我之前怎么跟你说的，小甜心？” 她戏谑地问，还弹了一下你的鼻子。“你要想多了解我一点，就得来上我的课锻炼锻炼。或者你拿点蜂蜜酒贿赂我。我可不能因为一个最喜欢的学生开口问，就白送所有的秘密。我们之间是有来有往的。你到我工作的地方来看我，我就告诉你你想知道的。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe squints her eyes at you and her lips curl into a mischievous smirk. “Now now, what did I tell you before, sweet thing?” she asks playfully, batting you on the nose. “If you want to know a little more about me, you gotta come to my classes for some exercise. Or you can bribe me with some Honey Wine. I can’t give away all my secrets just because one of my favorite students asks. It’s give-and-take between us. You visit me at work, and I tell you what you want."

rows.original: Skid Row Bro, I think is the saying.” You try to tell her that it’s not. “No no, I know my pop culture references, and it’s definitely that
rows.translation: “贫民窟兄弟”，我想这就是那句俗话。”你试着告诉她并不是。“不不，我很懂流行文化梗，绝对就是这句
rows.raw: " Skid Row Bro, I think is the saying.” You try to tell her that it’s not. “No no, I know my pop culture references, and it’s definitely that"

rows.original: Quid Pro Quo, I think is the saying
rows.translation: “等价交换”，我想这就是那句俗话
rows.raw: " Quid Pro Quo, I think is the saying"

rows.original: Looks like you’re not getting anything out of Paige this time. May as well try something else while you’re here?
rows.translation: 看来这次你从佩姬身上什么也得不到了。既然都在这儿了，不如试试别的？
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like you’re not getting anything out of Paige this time. May as well try something else while you’re here?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Paige about herself. You could jump right to conclusions and ask how she got such a devastating scar, but apparently it’s a big secret, and you don’t want to rush her. You instead ask her how she came to be a yoga instructor.
rows.translation: 你向佩姬问起她自己。你本可以直接跳到结论，问她那道触目惊心的疤是怎么来的，但显然那是个大秘密，你不想逼她。于是你改问她是怎么当上瑜伽教练的。
rows.raw: "You ask Paige about herself. You could jump right to conclusions and ask how she got such a devastating scar, but apparently it’s a big secret, and you don’t want to rush her. You instead ask her how she came to be a yoga instructor.\n\n"

rows.original: Paige reels in surprise suddenly. It wasn’t the question she was expecting, clearly. “Well, it’s not too complicated. I was a tumbler when I was a kid – I liked to roll and flip and contort myself into all sorts of shapes. A lot of kids are like that, but,” she giggles, “I guess I never really grew out of it.”
rows.translation: 佩姬突然吃惊地向后一仰。显然，她没料到你会问这个。“嗯，也不算太复杂。我小时候练过翻滚体操，喜欢打滚、翻腾，把身体扭成各种各样的形状。很多孩子都会这样，但，”她咯咯笑道，“我想我只是一直没有真正告别这份爱好。”
rows.raw: "Paige reels in surprise suddenly. It wasn’t the question she was expecting, clearly. “Well, it’s not too complicated. I was a tumbler when I was a kid – I liked to roll and flip and contort myself into all sorts of shapes. A lot of kids are like that, but,” she giggles, “I guess I never really grew out of it.”"

rows.original: “You ever build a couch fort when you were younger?” You answer positively – what kid hasn’t built a couch fort at least once? “Couch forts weren’t really my thing, but what I liked to do was arrange the cushions so that there was only a small space between them, and then I’d curl myself small enough to fit into it. I’d keep making the hole smaller and smaller, even as my body got bigger and bigger. It’s not yoga, but the contortionist-thing was a good stepping stone toward it.”
rows.translation: “你小时候搭过沙发堡垒吗？”你回答搭过。哪个孩子没至少搭过一次沙发堡垒呢？“沙发堡垒其实不是我的菜，我喜欢的是把靠垫摆成中间只留一个小缝，然后把自己蜷得小小地钻进去。我会不断把那洞越弄越小，哪怕我的身体越长越大。那不算瑜伽，但那种柔术的路子算是通向瑜伽的好垫脚石。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You ever build a couch fort when you were younger?” You answer positively – what kid hasn’t built a couch fort at least once? “Couch forts weren’t really my thing, but what I liked to do was arrange the cushions so that there was only a small space between them, and then I’d curl myself small enough to fit into it. I’d keep making the hole smaller and smaller, even as my body got bigger and bigger. It’s not yoga, but the contortionist-thing was a good stepping stone toward it.”"

rows.original: “Then, when I was a teenager, my mom enrolled me in gymnastics.” Her eyes wander as she recalls her halcyon years fondly. “She thought it was the next logical step. It was a fun time! Met some of my closest friends today back then. It was my first introduction to some of the wilder species’ in our universe, like the Kui-Tan, too. I dropped out after a year, though. While I did have the sense of balance for it, I was better at stretching and contortion, not at prolonged spinning. To this day, I can’t do a cartwheel more than three times in a row.” She laughs sheepishly. “Being blind does not help. You’d think it would!”
rows.translation: “然后，在我十几岁的时候，我妈给我报了体操班。”她的目光游移，愉快地回忆着那些静好的岁月。“她觉得那是顺理成章的下一步。那段时间很好玩！我如今最亲密的一些朋友就是那时候认识的。也是在那时，我第一次接触到我们宇宙里一些更野的种族，比如奎坦。不过一年后我就退出了。虽然我确实有那个平衡感，但我更擅长拉伸和柔术，不擅长长时间旋转。直到今天，我连做三个以上的侧手翻都做不到。”她不好意思地笑了。“看不见也没什么帮助。你大概会以为有帮助吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then, when I was a teenager, my mom enrolled me in gymnastics.” Her eyes wander as she recalls her halcyon years fondly. “She thought it was the next logical step. It was a fun time! Met some of my closest friends today back then. It was my first introduction to some of the wilder species’ in our universe, like the Kui-Tan, too. I dropped out after a year, though. While I did have the sense of balance for it, I was better at stretching and contortion, not at prolonged spinning. To this day, I can’t do a cartwheel more than three times in a row.” She laughs sheepishly. “Being blind does not help. You’d think it would!”"

rows.original: “For my adult life, I tried a handful of jobs first. My first job was a desk job doing data entry for JoyCo. Pretty mindless stuff, just putting forms into computers. That didn’t really have a future, so the next thing I tried was photography – something that was artsy and had something of a future for me. I enjoyed it plenty: I was hired for weddings and some nature magazines hired me to go to some distant planets for some shots of their local fauna, but it was inconsistent and didn’t have benefits.”
rows.translation: “成年后，我先后试过几份工作。第一份是在欢乐公司坐办公室录入数据。挺不用脑子的，就是把表格输入电脑。那份工作没什么前途，所以接下来我试着当摄影师，做点有艺术性、也多少有些发展空间的事情。我很喜欢那份工作：有人雇我拍婚礼照，还有几家自然杂志雇我去遥远的星球，为当地动物拍照，但工作不稳定，也没有福利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“For my adult life, I tried a handful of jobs first. My first job was a desk job doing data entry for JoyCo. Pretty mindless stuff, just putting forms into computers. That didn’t really have a future, so the next thing I tried was photography – something that was artsy and had something of a future for me. I enjoyed it plenty: I was hired for weddings and some nature magazines hired me to go to some distant planets for some shots of their local fauna, but it was inconsistent and didn’t have benefits.”"

rows.original: Paige trails slightly as she recounts her next occupation. “My third job is what got me my injury,” she admits somberly. “I... It’s....” She puts quite a lot of effort into vocalizing her next sentence, stopping and starting twice more. “I... don’t regret taking it. I mean, I kind of do? I was friends with my employer. The job was fine. But, you know, it kind of sucks not being able to see anything. I was trying to help out a friend. I... don’t know if I would have taken the job if I knew what was going to happen.”
rows.translation: 佩姬讲到下一份职业时，声音渐渐低了下去。“第三份工作让我受了现在这身伤，”她阴郁地承认。“我...它....”她费了很大力气才试图说出下一句话，又两次欲言又止。“我...不后悔接下它。我的意思是，也有点后悔？我和雇主是朋友。工作本身没问题。但你知道，什么都看不见的感觉确实很糟。我当时只是想帮一个朋友。我...不知道如果早知会发生什么，自己还会不会接下那份工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige trails slightly as she recounts her next occupation. “My third job is what got me my injury,” she admits somberly. “I... It’s....” She puts quite a lot of effort into vocalizing her next sentence, stopping and starting twice more. “I... don’t regret taking it. I mean, I kind of do? I was friends with my employer. The job was fine. But, you know, it kind of sucks not being able to see anything. I was trying to help out a friend. I... don’t know if I would have taken the job if I knew what was going to happen.”"

rows.original: “Anyway, the money I got from that whole business,” she continues, perking back up, “was enough for me to get this suite in Tavros, with more than enough left to rent out the next door one and use it as a yoga class. I had been doing yoga as an exercise since before working at JoyCo, so I had plenty of years of experience in the field. It wasn’t hard getting a license and becoming a fully-fledged fitness instructor right here in the station. The money I get from the classes is more than enough to float two rents, and my savings and the benefits checks I get from the UGC are enough to keep me going for quite a while yet.”
rows.translation: “总之，那整件事给我的钱，”她继续说，重新振作起来，“足够让我在塔夫罗斯站买下这间套房，剩下的钱也绰绰有余，能租下隔壁房间当瑜伽教室。早在去欢乐公司工作前，我就一直把瑜伽当作锻炼，所以在这方面已经有多年经验。考取执照，在空间站这里成为一名正式的健身教练并不难。课程收入足以支付两间房的租金，而我的积蓄加上银河联合邦联发给我的福利金，也足够支撑我很长一段时间。”

I had been doing yoga as an exercise since before working at JoyCo, so I had plenty of years of experience in the field. It wasn’t hard getting a license and becoming a fully-fledged fitness instructor right here in the station. The money I get from the classes is more than enough to float two rents, and my savings and the benefits checks I get from the UGC are enough to keep me going for quite a while yet.”"

rows.original: You ask Paige to tell you more about her past. She talked about her professional life last time you asked, and she told you that one of her jobs is what caused her injury. You also remember that she had a hard time talking about it... so, instead, you ask her about her family.
rows.translation: 你请佩姬多讲讲自己的过去。上次你问起时，她谈过自己的职业生涯，还告诉你某份工作正是造成她受伤的原因。你也记得，她很难开口谈论那件事...所以这次，你转而问起她的家人。
rows.raw: "You ask Paige to tell you more about her past. She talked about her professional life last time you asked, and she told you that one of her jobs is what caused her injury. You also remember that she had a hard time talking about it... so, instead, you ask her about her family.\n\n"

rows.original: “Ah yes, the fam,” she says cheerily. “Well, I got a mom and a dad, and they love each other very much, I’m told. My mom’s a full-blown Ausar like myself, and I inherited the fur coloring from my granddad on her side. And on the other hand, my dad is pure-blood human.”
rows.translation: “啊，对，我家里人，”她兴高采烈地说道。“嗯，我有爸爸妈妈，而且听说他们非常相爱。我妈妈和我一样是纯血奥萨尔人，我的毛色遗传自她那边的外公。另一方面，我爸爸则是纯血人类。”
rows.raw: "“Ah yes, the fam,” she says cheerily. “Well, I got a mom and a dad, and they love each other very much, I’m told. My mom’s a full-blown Ausar like myself, and I inherited the fur coloring from my granddad on her side. And on the other hand, my dad is pure-blood human.”"

rows.original: “My dad was a bit of a workaholic; he was never too far from his ledger or from his codex or communicator. I never saw him on the weekdays – he was gone before I left for school and he was back when I was in bed – but he made the most out of every minute we had on the weekends. When I was really young, and still did a lot of tumbling, he would tumble all over the place with me.”
rows.translation: “我爸爸有点工作狂；他总离不开账本、百科终端或通讯器。工作日里我根本见不到他，他在我出门上学前就走了，等他回来时我已经上床睡觉；但周末相处的每一分钟，他都会尽量好好利用。我很小、还经常练翻滚体操时，他会陪着我到处翻滚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My dad was a bit of a workaholic; he was never too far from his ledger or from his codex or communicator. I never saw him on the weekdays – he was gone before I left for school and he was back when I was in bed – but he made the most out of every minute we had on the weekends. When I was really young, and still did a lot of tumbling, he would tumble all over the place with me.”"

rows.original: She laughs softly to herself as she reminisces. “He’s the one who introduced me to yoga. Probably because it was pretty tough for a man in his mid-thirties to do as much tumbling and somersaulting as a five-year-old, but he still wanted to be a part of my interests. At his peak, he was about as good at yoga as I am now, but... well, arthritis makes fools of us all, it turns out.”
rows.translation: 回忆至此，她轻声笑了起来。“就是他带我接触瑜伽的。大概因为一个三十多岁的男人很难像五岁孩子那样不停翻滚和翻筋斗，但他还是想参与我的兴趣。在巅峰时期，他的瑜伽练得和现在的我差不多好，可是...嗯，事实证明，关节炎会让我们所有人都束手无策。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs softly to herself as she reminisces. “He’s the one who introduced me to yoga. Probably because it was pretty tough for a man in his mid-thirties to do as much tumbling and somersaulting as a five-year-old, but he still wanted to be a part of my interests. At his peak, he was about as good at yoga as I am now, but... well, arthritis makes fools of us all, it turns out.”"

rows.original: “Now, my mom,” she began, changing her tone. “She’s the calculating sort: she likes to plan four or five steps ahead for anything. She’s the type that tries to get as many things done in one single move as possible. Putting me in gymnastics class killed a bunch of birds with one stone: it was social; it got me lots of exercise; it gave my poor dad’s back a break; and it may have just paved the way for my future, since I loved to tumble anyway. She even had contingencies for if it didn’t work out. She is impossible to beat at chess.”
rows.translation: “至于我妈妈，”她开口道，语气随之一变。“她是那种精于算计的人：做什么都喜欢提前规划四五步。她总想用一个行动同时办妥尽可能多的事情。让我参加体操课就是一石数鸟：既能社交，又能让我充分运动，还能让可怜的爸爸歇歇腰；而且既然我本来就喜欢翻滚，这或许也恰好为我的未来铺平了道路。就连事情不顺利时该怎么办，她都准备了后备方案。下国际象棋根本不可能赢她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, my mom,” she began, changing her tone. “She’s the calculating sort: she likes to plan four or five steps ahead for anything. She’s the type that tries to get as many things done in one single move as possible. Putting me in gymnastics class killed a bunch of birds with one stone: it was social; it got me lots of exercise; it gave my poor dad’s back a break; and it may have just paved the way for my future, since I loved to tumble anyway. She even had contingencies for if it didn’t work out. She is impossible to beat at chess.”"

rows.original: “My mom was the sort to push me to be the best I could be, but that’s not to say she was stiff or controlling. She always let me decide what it was I wanted to be, and she worked with me to achieve them. When I told her I didn’t want to be a gymnast because I couldn’t handle the motion sickness, she was completely supportive. When I tried being a photographer, she...” Paige pauses for a moment, blinking hard. “She took out a pretty big loan to get me the best camera on the market. I still have it, and you better believe I paid her back, but the price tag on it was astronomical. And we’re in space right now!”
rows.translation: “妈妈总会督促我做到最好，但这并不意味着她古板或控制欲强。她始终让我自己决定想成为什么样的人，并和我一起努力实现目标。我告诉她自己不想当体操运动员，因为受不了晕动症时，她完全支持我。我尝试当摄影师时，她...”佩姬停顿片刻，用力眨了眨眼。“她借了一大笔钱，给我买了市面上最好的相机。我至今还留着它，而且你最好相信我已经把钱还给她了，可那台相机的标价简直高到天文数字。而我们现在还真就在太空里！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My mom was the sort to push me to be the best I could be, but that’s not to say she was stiff or controlling. She always let me decide what it was I wanted to be, and she worked with me to achieve them. When I told her I didn’t want to be a gymnast because I couldn’t handle the motion sickness, she was completely supportive. When I tried being a photographer, she...” Paige pauses for a moment, blinking hard. “She took out a pretty big loan to get me the best camera on the market. I still have it, and you better believe I paid her back, but the price tag on it was astronomical. And we’re in space right now!”"

rows.original: “And finally, I got myself a little brother. His name’s Mason.” She rubs at the bottom of her muzzle as she remembers him. “He’s not the whole-nine-yard furry like yours truly: he’s half-Ausar and he looks like it. We actually don’t keep in touch all that often anymore. He’s got himself a job on our home planet Ausaril as a miner. Specifically, gold. But he doesn’t like it when I call him a gold digger, and he prefers I just call him a miner. He was promoted to senior something-or-other back before my third job. He likes to act aloof and distant, but only because he thinks it’s cool. If you know him well enough, it’s pretty easy to get him to laugh or cry.”
rows.translation: “最后，我还有个弟弟，名叫梅森。”她回忆着他，揉了揉口鼻下方。“他不像我这样从头到脚全是毛：他是半奥萨尔人，看起来也确实如此。其实我们现在已经不怎么联系了。他在我们的母星奥萨瑞尔当矿工，专门采金矿。不过我叫他‘淘金客’时，他会不高兴，坚持让我只叫他矿工。早在我做第三份工作前，他就升成了某种高级职位。他喜欢装得冷淡疏远，只因为觉得那样很酷。只要足够了解他，让他笑出来或哭出来其实都很容易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And finally, I got myself a little brother. His name’s Mason.” She rubs at the bottom of her muzzle as she remembers him. “He’s not the whole-nine-yard furry like yours truly: he’s half-Ausar and he looks like it. We actually don’t keep in touch all that often anymore. He’s got himself a job on our home planet Ausaril as a miner. Specifically, gold. But he doesn’t like it when I call him a gold digger, and he prefers I just call him a miner. He was promoted to senior something-or-other back before my third job. He likes to act aloof and distant, but only because he thinks it’s cool. If you know him well enough, it’s pretty easy to get him to laugh or cry.”"

rows.original: Once Paige is done describing her family, you broach another topic on a whim: if her mother is an Ausar and if she and her brother are only half-Ausars, why is Paige covered in fur from top to bottom? “Gene mods. Duh.” Well, okay, you concede, but why did she take gene mods? She opens her mouth to answer, but then quickly reconsiders. “You know, I could tell you,” she says. “But I won’t. We can save that one for some other time.”
rows.translation: 等佩姬介绍完家人，你一时兴起又提起另一个话题：如果她妈妈是奥萨尔人，而她和弟弟都只有一半奥萨尔血统，为什么佩姬从头到脚都覆盖着毛发？“基因改造啊。真笨。”好吧，你承认这说得通，但她为什么要接受基因改造？她张嘴准备回答，却又迅速改变主意。“你知道，我可以告诉你，”她说道，“但我不会说。这个问题留到下次吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce Paige is done describing her family, you broach another topic on a whim: if her mother is an Ausar and if she and her brother are only half-Ausars, why is Paige covered in fur from top to bottom? “Gene mods. Duh.” Well, okay, you concede, but why did she take gene mods? She opens her mouth to answer, but then quickly reconsiders. “You know, I could tell you,” she says. “But I won’t. We can save that one for some other time.”"

rows.original: You sigh in defeat. Well, if she’s not in the mood to talk about her gene mods, maybe you’ll get it out of her next time.
rows.translation: 你认输般叹了口气。好吧，既然她现在没心情谈基因改造，也许下次你能从她嘴里套出答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh in defeat. Well, if she’s not in the mood to talk about her gene mods, maybe you’ll get it out of her next time."

rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Paige if she’s willing to talk more about herself. The last time you chatted, she told you about her family. She’s been inching towards what her third job was and how she got her scar, but you’re not ready to push her to that just yet. You ask her what challenges she’s had to overcome since becoming blind.
rows.translation: 你问佩姬是否愿意再多谈谈自己。你们上次聊天时，她向你讲了她的家庭。她一直在慢慢谈到自己的第三份工作以及伤疤的来历，但你还不准备现在就逼她说出来。你问她失明以后克服过哪些困难。
rows.raw: "You ask Paige if she’s willing to talk more about herself. The last time you chatted, she told you about her family. She’s been inching towards what her third job was and how she got her scar, but you’re not ready to push her to that just yet. You ask her what challenges she’s had to overcome since becoming blind.\n\n"

rows.original: “Oh man, what challenges aren’t there?” she laughs. “It’s gotten easier, for sure. It’s been years since... since then, and I’ve had plenty of time to adjust. Getting Iddi early on was definitely a big plus as well!”
rows.translation: “天啊，哪有什么挑战是没有的？”她笑道。“当然，现在轻松多了。自从...自从那以后已经过去了好几年，我有充足的时间适应。早早有了伊迪也绝对帮了大忙！”
rows.raw: "“Oh man, what challenges aren’t there?” she laughs. “It’s gotten easier, for sure. It’s been years since... since then, and I’ve had plenty of time to adjust. Getting Iddi early on was definitely a big plus as well!”"

rows.original: “Well, to answer your question, the first challenge was coping with my new spatial awareness. I used to have a lot more furniture than I do now, but I got rid of most of it when I both couldn’t appreciate them, and when I kept stumbling over them. Getting dressed in the morning was difficult. Couldn’t find bras; shirts would be inside-out; pants would go on backwards. Doing my hair up was stressful.”
rows.translation: “好吧，回答你的问题，最初的挑战是适应全新的空间感知。我以前的家具比现在多得多，但后来我既没法欣赏它们，又总是被它们绊倒，于是大部分都处理掉了。早晨穿衣也很困难。找不到胸罩；衬衫会里外穿反；裤子会前后穿反。整理头发也让人压力很大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, to answer your question, the first challenge was coping with my new spatial awareness. I used to have a lot more furniture than I do now, but I got rid of most of it when I both couldn’t appreciate them, and when I kept stumbling over them. Getting dressed in the morning was difficult. Couldn’t find bras; shirts would be inside-out; pants would go on backwards. Doing my hair up was stressful.”"

rows.original: “As the months went on, I learned how to sort of ‘understand’ my environment. My other senses started to get sharper; I developed a way to notice people or objects if they’re about a body’s-length away from me by... sort of ‘feeling’ the air and listening to the sounds. I don’t do well in open areas or in especially noisy or crowded ones, but places like my own home, or my yoga studio, it’s almost as good as sight.”
rows.translation: “随着几个月过去，我学会了某种‘理解’周围环境的办法。我其他的感官开始变得更敏锐；我摸索出一种方式，能察觉大约一个身长之外的人和物体，靠的是...算是‘感觉’空气和听声音。我在开阔的地方，或者特别吵闹、拥挤的地方不太行，但像我自己家，或者我的瑜伽馆这种地方，它几乎跟看得见一样好使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As the months went on, I learned how to sort of ‘understand’ my environment. My other senses started to get sharper; I developed a way to notice people or objects if they’re about a body’s-length away from me by... sort of ‘feeling’ the air and listening to the sounds. I don’t do well in open areas or in especially noisy or crowded ones, but places like my own home, or my yoga studio, it’s almost as good as sight.”"

rows.original: “Like I said, getting Iddi was a huge help. The little guy paid for himself within the week! Couldn’t have asked for a better helper. He helped me get around my unit; he helped me get dressed; he helped me with cooking and cleaning; he still reads me my mail and my emails. He taught me how to be independent within my own unit – how to walk around without keeping my arms stretched all the time for obstacles. He taught me how to read braille. And he’s just the sweetest little thing, too!” She leans in close and lowers her voice to a whisper. “If I’m honest, [pc.name], I kind of hope that, if I ever had a kid, they take after Iddi a little.”
rows.translation: “就像我说的，得到伊迪帮了天大的忙。这个小家伙不到一周就值回了身价！再也找不到比他更好的助手了。他帮我在住处里行动；帮我穿衣；帮我做饭和打扫；直到现在还会把信件和电子邮件读给我听。他教会我如何在自己的住处里独立生活，如何不用一直伸着双臂探查障碍也能四处走动。他教我读盲文。而且他还是最贴心的小家伙！”她凑近一些，把声音压成耳语。“说实话，[pc.name]，如果我将来有了孩子，我还挺希望那孩子能有一点像伊迪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, getting Iddi was a huge help. The little guy paid for himself within the week! Couldn’t have asked for a better helper. He helped me get around my unit; he helped me get dressed; he helped me with cooking and cleaning; he still reads me my mail and my emails. He taught me how to be independent within my own unit – how to walk around without keeping my arms stretched all the time for obstacles. He taught me how to read braille. And he’s just the sweetest little thing, too!” She leans in close and lowers her voice to a whisper. “If I’m honest, [pc.name], I kind of hope that, if I ever had a kid, they take after Iddi a little.”"

rows.original: You ask her about the projector she wears to hide her scar. Did that come with Iddi? “Yes, as a matter of fact. It’s both a projector and a communicator – one way, from Iddi, on an encrypted channel. The projector hides my scar and it colors my eyes so people don’t assume anything, and if I’m out-and-about and Iddi isn’t with me, he can be my eyes and he can tell me if I’m about to walk into a person, or he can tell me what the going rate for vegetables is, or whatever.”
rows.translation: 你问起她用来遮掩伤疤的投影仪。那是和伊迪配套的吗？“没错，确实如此。它既是投影仪也是通讯器，通过加密频道接收伊迪单向传来的信息。投影仪会遮住我的伤疤，还会改变眼睛的颜色，免得别人妄加猜测；如果我在外面而伊迪不在身边，他可以充当我的眼睛，告诉我是不是快撞上别人了，或者蔬菜现在卖什么价之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her about the projector she wears to hide her scar. Did that come with Iddi? “Yes, as a matter of fact. It’s both a projector and a communicator – one way, from Iddi, on an encrypted channel. The projector hides my scar and it colors my eyes so people don’t assume anything, and if I’m out-and-about and Iddi isn’t with me, he can be my eyes and he can tell me if I’m about to walk into a person, or he can tell me what the going rate for vegetables is, or whatever.”"

rows.original: “It’s gotten to the point that I’m fairly autonomous. I can dress myself; I know my way around my units; and I can cook my own food. As long as it’s my own burner. I know where the dials are on mine.” She laughs and slaps her knee. “Like I said, my hearing has gotten so good that I can reasonably tell where a person is if they make noise within a body’s length of me. If I need to leave for anything, I prefer to not have Iddi with me if I can help it. Iddi can see everything through the earpiece, so he doesn’t need to be with me, but if I’m, like, going down to a planet or to someplace with lots of stairs or uneven footing, he kind of has to tag along.”
rows.translation: “现在我已经能做到相当自主了。我可以自己穿衣；熟悉自己住处里的路；也能自己做饭。只要用的是我自己的炉灶。我知道自家炉灶的旋钮都在哪里。”她笑着拍了拍膝盖。“就像我说的，我的听力已经好到只要有人在一臂之内发出声音，我就能大致判断对方的位置。如果有什么事必须出门，只要可以，我宁愿不带伊迪。伊迪能透过耳机看到一切，所以他并不需要和我待在一起；但如果我要去某颗行星，或者去楼梯很多、地面崎岖的地方，他就不得不跟着了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s gotten to the point that I’m fairly autonomous. I can dress myself; I know my way around my units; and I can cook my own food. As long as it’s my own burner. I know where the dials are on mine.” She laughs and slaps her knee. “Like I said, my hearing has gotten so good that I can reasonably tell where a person is if they make noise within a body’s length of me. If I need to leave for anything, I prefer to not have Iddi with me if I can help it. Iddi can see everything through the earpiece, so he doesn’t need to be with me, but if I’m, like, going down to a planet or to someplace with lots of stairs or uneven footing, he kind of has to tag along.”"

rows.original: “I’m not going to pretend that it’s not hard,” she finishes. “Every day is still a unique challenge that I have to tackle one step at a time. And I miss... seeing. I miss looking at my parent’s photo on my dresser. I don’t even know what Iddi looks like. I’m trying to save up some cash for synthetic eyes, but it’s, uh, it’s going to be a while yet.”
rows.translation: “我不会假装这不难，”她最后说道。“每天仍有独特的挑战，需要我一步一步应对。而且我想念...看得见东西的感觉。我想念看着梳妆台上父母的照片。我甚至不知道伊迪长什么样。我正努力攒钱买合成眼球，但，呃，恐怕还得等很久。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not going to pretend that it’s not hard,” she finishes. “Every day is still a unique challenge that I have to tackle one step at a time. And I miss... seeing. I miss looking at my parent’s photo on my dresser. I don’t even know what Iddi looks like. I’m trying to save up some cash for synthetic eyes, but it’s, uh, it’s going to be a while yet.”"

rows.original: You tell her that, whether her disability is difficult or not, that she’s overcome so many difficulties with it is an inspiration. And, autonomy and independence is always sexy. She laughs and gives you a friendly slug on the shoulder. “I don’t need to be told I’m sexy. Anyone doing yoga for as long as I’ve been would have an amazing body.” Her hand trails down your arm and finds your hand. She grips yours in hers and gives you a loving squeeze. “But it’s nice to hear it.”
rows.translation: 你告诉她，无论残障生活有多困难，她能克服这么多困难本身就很鼓舞人心。而且自主与独立永远都很性感。她笑了，友好地捶了你肩膀一下。“用不着别人告诉我自己很性感。任谁像我这样练了这么多年瑜伽，身材都会很棒。”她的手顺着你的手臂滑下，摸到了你的手。她将你的手握在手中，充满爱意地捏了一下。“不过听你这么说还是很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that, whether her disability is difficult or not, that she’s overcome so many difficulties with it is an inspiration. And, autonomy and independence is always sexy. She laughs and gives you a friendly slug on the shoulder. “I don’t need to be told I’m sexy. Anyone doing yoga for as long as I’ve been would have an amazing body.” Her hand trails down your arm and finds your hand. She grips yours in hers and gives you a loving squeeze. “But it’s nice to hear it.”"

rows.original: You sit with Paige as you gear yourself to ask her more about her life. The last time you spoke, she mentioned that she’s trying to save up for synthetic eye transplants, but that she doesn’t have enough cash to afford it. You take the plunge and ask her about the job that caused her blindness. Why would it not pay benefits for such a devastating work-related injury?
rows.translation: 你坐在佩姬身边，鼓足勇气想多问问她的生活。上次交谈时，她提到自己正努力攒钱做合成眼球移植，但手头的现金还不够。你终于开口，问她那份让她失明的工作。那么严重的工伤，怎么会不给赔付？
rows.raw: "You sit with Paige as you gear yourself to ask her more about her life. The last time you spoke, she mentioned that she’s trying to save up for synthetic eye transplants, but that she doesn’t have enough cash to afford it. You take the plunge and ask her about the job that caused her blindness. Why would it not pay benefits for such a devastating work-related injury?\n\n"

rows.original: Paige’s earlier demeanor slowly fades. She breathes through her nose as she considers whether to answer the question. Though she’s not looking directly into your eyes, her stare is piercing into you as she judges the question.
rows.translation: 佩姬先前的神态慢慢消退。她用鼻子呼吸，思考着是否要回答这个问题。虽然她没有直视你的眼睛，但审视这个问题时，那道目光仿佛刺穿了你。
rows.raw: "Paige’s earlier demeanor slowly fades. She breathes through her nose as she considers whether to answer the question. Though she’s not looking directly into your eyes, her stare is piercing into you as she judges the question."

rows.original: “[pc.name]...” she begins, hesitating on her syllables. She takes some more breaths, one of them rather deep. “At this point... I want you to know that I consider you to be more than a student to me. You’re a friend.” You keep silent. “I don’t have a lot of friends. In fact, my life has been pretty lonely since my injury. I haven’t drunk a drop since then and I haven’t had any lovers. I’m worried that if I do, I might blab to someone I don’t trust. And at this point,” she says, smiling as she places a hand on your shoulder, “I trust you. You’ve been very patient and selfless so far.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]...”她迟疑着开口，每个音节都说得犹犹豫豫。她又呼吸了几次，其中一次尤其深。“事到如今...我想让你知道，对我而言，你已经不只是学生了。你是朋友。”你保持沉默。“我的朋友不多。事实上，自从受伤以后，我一直过得很孤独。那以后我滴酒未沾，也没有任何情人。我担心自己要是那么做了，也许会对不信任的人说漏嘴。可是现在，”她说着，将一只手放在你的肩膀上，露出微笑，“我信任你。到目前为止，你一直很有耐心，也很无私。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]...” she begins, hesitating on her syllables. She takes some more breaths, one of them rather deep. “At this point... I want you to know that I consider you to be more than a student to me. You’re a friend.” You keep silent. “I don’t have a lot of friends. In fact, my life has been pretty lonely since my injury. I haven’t drunk a drop since then and I haven’t had any lovers. I’m worried that if I do, I might blab to someone I don’t trust. And at this point,” she says, smiling as she places a hand on your shoulder, “I trust you. You’ve been very patient and selfless so far.”"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” she says with a heavy sigh, and then quickly loses her thought process. She chews on her lip slightly as she considers your request. “I guess I don’t mind. I like to think that, as much as I hate what’s happened to me, I’ve made some peace with my past. Enough to recount it, in any case.” She laughs lightly. “How can I say no to you?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”她沉重地叹了口气说道，随即又一下子理不清思绪。她微微咬着嘴唇，考虑你的请求。“我想我不介意。虽然我憎恨发生在自己身上的一切，但我愿意相信自己已经与过去达成了某种和解。至少足以把它讲出来。”她轻笑一声。“我怎么能拒绝你呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name],” she says with a heavy sigh, and then quickly loses her thought process. She chews on her lip slightly as she considers your request. “I guess I don’t mind. I like to think that, as much as I hate what’s happened to me, I’ve made some peace with my past. Enough to recount it, in any case.” She laughs lightly. “How can I say no to you?”"

rows.original: You wait patiently for her to continue. It takes her another moment to steel her resolve. “I was a pirate for my third job,” she says, her voice dropping an octave halfway through the sentence. “Piracy doesn’t have health benefits.”
rows.translation: 你耐心地等她继续说下去。她又花了一会儿才鼓起决心。“我第三份工作当过海盗，”她说到一半时声音低了一个八度。“当海盗可没有医疗保险。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait patiently for her to continue. It takes her another moment to steel her resolve. “I was a pirate for my third job,” she says, her voice dropping an octave halfway through the sentence. “Piracy doesn’t have health benefits.”"

rows.original: You reel. Her face is smooth as glass; she’s not kidding, but you still have a hard time believing that Paige – your yoga instructor and such a wonderful woman to spend some nights talking with – was, at one point in her life, a pirate. But, now that you think about it, it answers some questions: why she was so hesitant to talk about it, for one.
rows.translation: 你一阵发懵。她的脸平滑得像玻璃；她没在开玩笑，但你还是很难相信佩姬 – 你的瑜伽教练，那个如此美好、能陪你聊上几晚的女人 – 曾经在她人生的某个阶段是个海盗。不过，现在回想起来，这倒解答了一些疑问：比如她为什么那么不愿提起这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reel. Her face is smooth as glass; she’s not kidding, but you still have a hard time believing that Paige – your yoga instructor and such a wonderful woman to spend some nights talking with – was, at one point in her life, a pirate. But, now that you think about it, it answers some questions: why she was so hesitant to talk about it, for one."

rows.original: “Officially speaking – or, as ‘officially’ as piracy gets – I was a navigator. I plotted our courses and made sure our way went between galactic patrols and stayed clear of a planet’s airspace. My captain was a Kui-Tan lady named Kiro Tamahime.” She laughs. “Maybe ‘lady’ is a bit of a strong word to describe any Kui-Tan. Have you met her?”
rows.translation: “正式来说 – 或者说，按海盗这行能有多‘正式’来讲 – 我是领航员。我规划航线，确保我们的路线从银河巡逻队之间穿过，也不会闯进任何行星的领空。我的船长是位叫琪罗·玉姬的奎坦女士。”她笑了。“也许‘女士’这个词拿来形容任何奎坦人，都稍微有点抬举了。你见过她吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Officially speaking – or, as ‘officially’ as piracy gets – I was a navigator. I plotted our courses and made sure our way went between galactic patrols and stayed clear of a planet’s airspace. My captain was a Kui-Tan lady named Kiro Tamahime.” She laughs. “Maybe ‘lady’ is a bit of a strong word to describe any Kui-Tan. Have you met her?”"

rows.original: RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS
rows.raw: "RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS"

rows.original: You reply that, um, you have. Yes, you have met Kiro. Paige’s expression twists just slightly. She probably knows what ‘meeting’ Kiro entails.
rows.translation: 你回答说，呃，是的。是的，你见过琪罗了。佩姬的表情微微扭曲了一下。她大概知道‘认识’琪罗意味着什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that, um, you have. Yes, you have met Kiro. Paige’s expression twists just slightly. She probably knows what ‘meeting’ Kiro entails."

rows.original: You reply that you aren’t familiar with the name. “Oh, really? I thought she’d be halfway famous by now. You’d probably love her, she’s a real hoot at parties.”
rows.translation: 你回答说自己没听过这个名字。“哦，真的吗？我还以为她现在应该有一半出名了。你大概会很喜欢她，她在派对上可真是个活宝。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you aren’t familiar with the name. “Oh, really? I thought she’d be halfway famous by now. You’d probably love her, she’s a real hoot at parties.”"

rows.original: <i>“Kiro is my closest friend. We actually met at gymnastics class. She dropped out earlier than I did, though. Turns out, being a maturing Kui-Tan and constantly surrounded by gymnasts kind of, uh, threw off their balance, considering their species’ attributes

rows.original: “It was a three-man operation: myself, my captain, and my brother, the gold miner. It was Kiro’s idea to begin with. I don’t know when she got into piracy or how she got so good at it, but after seeing some of the spoils a single haul could bring in, it was pretty hard to say no to the job offer. I couldn’t convince my brother, but Kiro could. I don’t know what she did and I don’t want to know, but after a weekend on Ausaril and a promise of a bigger cut, he was in.”
rows.translation: “那是一次三人行动：我、我的船长，还有我那个淘金客兄弟。一开始是琪罗的主意。我不知道她什么时候当上了海盗，也不知道她怎么会如此擅长，但见识过一次劫掠能带回多少战利品后，实在很难拒绝那份工作。我没能说服哥哥，但琪罗做到了。我不知道她做了什么，也不想知道；可在奥萨里尔度过一个周末，再加上分他更大份额的承诺之后，他就加入了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a three-man operation: myself, my captain, and my brother, the gold miner. It was Kiro’s idea to begin with. I don’t know when she got into piracy or how she got so good at it, but after seeing some of the spoils a single haul could bring in, it was pretty hard to say no to the job offer. I couldn’t convince my brother, but Kiro could. I don’t know what she did and I don’t want to know, but after a weekend on Ausaril and a promise of a bigger cut, he was in.”"

rows.original: “We had a pretty smooth thing going on. Every month I’d visit the family on Ausaril, including Mason. He’d give me handwritten times and coordinates for shipments of unprocessed gold to be sent from Ausaril to anywhere in the galaxy. When Kiro and I picked one, my job was to decide where along the caravan’s route was farthest and safest from any planet’s jurisdictional airspace, and Kiro’s job was to make sure the caravan didn’t cross paths with any patrol and to make sure we were geared appropriately for the mission.”
rows.translation: “我们那会儿干得挺顺的。每个月我都会去奥萨瑞尔看家里人，也包括梅森。他会把时间和坐标手写给我，让我把未提炼的黄金从奥萨瑞尔运到银河系任何地方。等琪罗和我挑中一单，我的活就是决定商队路线上哪一段离任何行星的管辖空域最远、最安全，琪罗的活则是确保商队不会撞上任何巡逻队，还得确保我们为任务备齐了家伙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We had a pretty smooth thing going on. Every month I’d visit the family on Ausaril, including Mason. He’d give me handwritten times and coordinates for shipments of unprocessed gold to be sent from Ausaril to anywhere in the galaxy. When Kiro and I picked one, my job was to decide where along the caravan’s route was farthest and safest from any planet’s jurisdictional airspace, and Kiro’s job was to make sure the caravan didn’t cross paths with any patrol and to make sure we were geared appropriately for the mission.”"

rows.original: Paige wrings her hands together, nervous about continuing. She closes her eyes tightly – so tight, it’s almost as if she’s trying to hide from something, and shutting her eyes would make it easier. “I loved it,” she said through stuttering breaths. “We lived like royalty. It was exhilarating. I could afford anything I wanted.”
rows.translation: 佩姬不安地绞着双手，对继续说下去感到紧张。她紧紧闭上眼睛，紧得仿佛正试图躲开什么，好像闭眼就能让这一切容易些。“我很喜欢，”她断断续续地呼吸着说道。“我们过着王公贵族般的生活。那令人兴奋。我想要什么都买得起。”

It was exhilarating. I could afford anything I wanted.”"

rows.original: “The Black Void thought so, too.”

rows.original: There isn’t much more you can think to ask Paige to elaborate on when it comes to her personal life. You know about her professional lives; her personal lives; and the injury and how it transformed her. Frankly, there isn’t much more that you’re curious about, and you’re worried that asking irresponsibly might come off as prying or creepy.
rows.translation: 说到佩姬的私人生活，你已经想不到还有什么值得让她详细说明了。你了解她的职业生涯、私人生活，也知道那场伤势以及它如何改变了她。坦白说，你已经没有多少好奇之处，也担心不负责任地追问会显得像是在窥探，甚至有些瘆人。

rows.original: Paige, in the meantime, takes the initiative as you juggle your potential questions. “I got a question to ask you,” she says, surprising you out of your stupor. “It’s gonna sound pretty dumb, but I think you can handle pretty and dumb, can’t ya, sweet thing?” You tell her that there are no dumb questions. “Ha! What a load.”
rows.translation: 与此同时，在你斟酌可能提出的问题时，佩姬主动开口了。“我有个问题想问你，”她说道，把发愣的你吓了一跳。“听起来会很蠢，不过我想漂亮又愚蠢的东西你应该应付得来，对吧，小甜心？”你告诉她，没有愚蠢的问题。“哈！真会胡扯。”

What a load.”"

rows.original: Paige clears her throat, but otherwise doesn’t seem too apprehensive. “So, I’m coming up on my next anniversary since my injury. It’s been a long while since I’ve lost my eyes, but I’ve gotten really good at dealing with my surroundings since then.” You listen attentively. “My yoga has kept me in great shape all my life. And, you know, I used to be a swashbucklin’, scallywaggin’ space scoundrel once upon a time.” You wonder where she might be going with this.
rows.translation: 佩姬清了清嗓子，除此之外倒没有显得太过不安。“所以，我受伤后的又一个周年快到了。我失去双眼已经很久了，这些年也越来越擅长应付周围的环境。”你专心听着。“瑜伽让我一辈子都保持着好身材。而且你也知道，很久以前，我曾是个挥着刀、满口海盗腔的太空恶棍。”你很想知道她到底要把话题引向哪里。

rows.original: “Then what’s the problem?” she asks, licking her lips. “We don’t have to go at it right this red hot second. But just keep in mind.” She flexes her ass and pushes her lower body out, filling your hands with more of herself. “The offer’s on the table.”
rows.translation: “那问题在哪？”她舔着嘴唇问。“我们不必就在这火热的当口立刻开干。但你只要记着。”她绷紧屁股，把下半身往后顶，让你的手里填满更多她的身体。“这个提议一直有效。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then what’s the problem?” she asks, licking her lips. “We don’t have to go at it right this red hot second. But just keep in mind.” She flexes her ass and pushes her lower body out, filling your hands with more of herself. “The offer’s on the table.”"

rows.original: She disengages from you, leaving you teased and tempted. You’re still not too thrilled with the idea of fighting a crewmate, but that said, something tells you that even if you did, it wouldn’t be the easiest lay of your life.
rows.translation: 她从你身上离开，留下受尽撩拨、心痒难耐的你。你依然不太喜欢和一名船员战斗的主意，但话虽如此，直觉告诉你，就算真打了，这也不会是你人生中最容易得手的一炮。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe disengages from you, leaving you teased and tempted. You’re still not too thrilled with the idea of fighting a crewmate, but that said, something tells you that even if you did, it wouldn’t be the easiest lay of your life."

rows.original: You both lose track of time as Paige retells her life story for you. rows.original: “Kiro and I were halfway done looting the place. We had a... slightly less chivalrous Robin Hood thing going on. We didn’t kill anybody. We generally leave ships intact – no guns or communications, but with enough juice to make it home.” Her eyes trail around the room, focusing on nothing. “The Black Void crashed the party. Outnumbered us three to one. They demanded our gold, our weapons, our armor, and our ship. We fought back.” She trails her fingers across the scar on her face, from one eye to the other. “Three each. I took down my three. Then one of Kiro’s came at me with a knife. Got me across the eyes.” She smiles, but only faintly. “Kiro won the fight.”
rows.translation: “琪罗和我已经把那里抢了一半。我们干的是一种...不那么侠义的罗宾汉勾当。我们不杀人。通常也会让飞船保持完整，枪炮和通讯设备会被拿走，但会留下足够的能源让他们返航。”她的双眼在房间里游移，却没有聚焦于任何东西。“黑色虚空闯进来搅局了。他们人数是我们的三倍。他们要我们的黄金、武器、护甲和飞船。我们还手了。”她用手指划过脸上的伤疤，从一只眼睛摸到另一只。“每人三个。我干掉了自己的三个。然后琪罗那边有一个拿刀冲向我。横着划过了我的双眼。”她笑了，但笑意很淡。“琪罗赢得了那场战斗。”
rows.raw: "“Kiro and I were halfway done looting the place. We had a... slightly less chivalrous Robin Hood thing going on. We didn’t kill anybody. We generally leave ships intact – no guns or communications, but with enough juice to make it home.” Her eyes trail around the room, focusing on nothing. “The Black Void crashed the party. Outnumbered us three to one. They demanded our gold, our weapons, our armor, and our ship. We fought back.” She trails her fingers across the scar on her face, from one eye to the other. “Three each. I took down my three. Then one of Kiro’s came at me with a knife. Got me across the eyes.” She smiles, but only faintly. “Kiro won the fight.”"

rows.original: She faces you and looks you in your eyes so precisely that you’d wouldn’t have believed she was blind. “To this day,” she says somberly, “my biggest fear, [pc.name], is that they find me. They find me, and through me, they find Mason, and they find my mom and dad. So, I’m hiding.”
rows.translation: 她转向你，目光精准地对上你的眼睛，你简直不会相信她是瞎的。“直到今天，”她阴沉地说，“我最大的恐惧，[pc.name]，就是他们找到我。找到我，再通过我找到梅森，找到我爸妈。所以，我在躲。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe faces you and looks you in your eyes so precisely that you’d wouldn’t have believed she was blind. “To this day,” she says somberly, “my biggest fear, [pc.name], is that they find me. They find me, and through me, they find Mason, and they find my mom and dad. So, I’m hiding.”"

rows.original: “You asked me once before why I took gene mods. They’re a disguise. I took them to throw off anyone that might be looking for me, whether they’re Black Void or UGC.”
rows.translation: “你以前问过我一次，我为什么接受基因改造。那是一种伪装。我做这些是为了甩开任何可能找我的人，不管是黑色虚空还是银河邦联。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You asked me once before why I took gene mods. They’re a disguise. I took them to throw off anyone that might be looking for me, whether they’re Black Void or UGC.” "

rows.original: . “I haven’t said any of this to Iddi. He records absolutely everything he hears. It’s to help him understand me better, but if I told him and he gets lost or captured or something, they could pull it all from his head. I was very careful to make sure that the earpiece was one-way. It’s also custom-fitted with a projector to hide the scar because it’s easily my most identifiable feature – I had hoped that the gene mods would cover it, but because the tissue is dead, they can’t be modified. I try not to take Iddi anywhere because a ‘perfectly healthy’ Ausar with a helper droid might raise suspicions.”
rows.translation: 。 “这些事我一点都没告诉伊迪。他会记录自己听到的所有东西。这是为了帮他更好地理解我，但如果我把这些告诉他，而他又走丢、被抓或者出了什么事，别人就能从他脑袋里把一切都取出来。我非常小心地确保耳机只能单向接收。它还特别加装了一台投影仪来遮住伤疤，因为那无疑是我最容易辨认的特征。我原本希望基因改造能盖住它，但因为那里的组织已经坏死，无法受到改造。我尽量不带伊迪去任何地方，因为一个‘完全健康’却带着辅助机器人的奥萨人可能会引起怀疑。”

It’s also custom-fitted with a projector to hide the scar because it’s easily my most identifiable feature – I had hoped that the gene mods would cover it, but because the tissue is dead, they can’t be modified. I try not to take Iddi anywhere because a ‘perfectly healthy’ Ausar with a helper droid might raise suspicions.”"

rows.original: You stay silent together for a while. Your hand is still in hers, and she still squeezes it occasionally. You have no words to respond with, and in a way, you think that’s the best response. Paige sighs in the comfortable silence between you two. “The only other people that know all this are Kiro and Mason,” she said. “I told my parents that it was a rock-climbing injury from my job as a photographer. My life has been pretty lonely since my injury. I couldn’t trust anyone with it, not even Iddi.”
rows.translation: 你们一起沉默了片刻。你的手仍被她握着，她偶尔还是会捏一下。你想不出任何话来回应，并且某种意义上觉得，这就是最好的回答。佩姬在你们之间舒适的寂静中叹了口气。“除此之外，知道这一切的只有琪罗和梅森，”她说道。“我告诉父母，那是我当摄影师时攀岩受的伤。自从受伤以来，我的生活一直很孤独。我无法把这件事托付给任何人，连伊迪都不行。”

You have no words to respond with, and in a way, you think that’s the best response. Paige sighs in the comfortable silence between you two. “The only other people that know all this are Kiro and Mason,” she said. “I told my parents that it was a rock-climbing injury from my job as a photographer. My life has been pretty lonely since my injury. I couldn’t trust anyone with it, not even Iddi.”"

rows.original: Without letting go of your hand, Paige leans into you, using her other hand to feel your face. When she finds your cheek, she leans in and kisses it gently. “Like I said, you’re more than a student to me.”
rows.translation: 佩姬没有松开你的手，靠向你，用另一只手摸索着你的脸。当她摸到你的脸颊时，她凑过来轻轻吻了一下。“我说过了，你对我来说不只是个学生。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout letting go of your hand, Paige leans into you, using her other hand to feel your face. When she finds your cheek, she leans in and kisses it gently. “Like I said, you’re more than a student to me.”"

rows.original: You stay together in the silence of her unit for a while, enjoying each other while you digest her story. You’ve remained silent the whole time, and from the way she’s leaning into you, your hand in hers, you’re convinced that that’s what she wants.
rows.translation: 你们在她住处的寂静中相依了一会儿，一边消化她的故事，一边享受彼此的陪伴。你始终保持沉默；从她靠在你身上、把你的手握在手中的样子来看，你确信这正是她想要的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stay together in the silence of her unit for a while, enjoying each other while you digest her story. You’ve remained silent the whole time, and from the way she’s leaning into you, your hand in hers, you’re convinced that that’s what she wants."

rows.original: “Um,” Paige says, cutting the silence. “As much as I’m having a good time right now, we’ve got some other things to do. I have some work to do for my yoga classes tomorrow.” You tell her that you don’t mind staying for a while longer if she doesn’t. “I don’t, but... I also kind of want some time to myself for now. We both have a lot to think about.”
rows.translation: “呃，”佩姬打破了沉默。“虽然我现在玩得挺开心，但我们还有些别的事要做。我明天瑜伽课还有活要干。”你告诉她，如果她不介意，你也不介意多待一会儿。“我不介意，不过...我现在也有点想自己待一会儿。我们俩都有很多事要想。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um,” Paige says, cutting the silence. “As much as I’m having a good time right now, we’ve got some other things to do. I have some work to do for my yoga classes tomorrow.” You tell her that you don’t mind staying for a while longer if she doesn’t. “I don’t, but... I also kind of want some time to myself for now. We both have a lot to think about.”"

rows.original: You understand, but you take your time pulling away from her. When you stand, she pulls you back down, giving you another kiss, this one on your [pc.lipsChaste]. It lasts a bit longer than the other one did. Then, she lets you go.
rows.translation: 你明白，但还是慢慢才从她身上退开。你站起身时，她又把你拉回去，再吻了你一次，这回吻在你的[pc.lipsChaste]上。这一吻比刚才那个久一点。然后，她放你走了。

rows.raw: "Purchase"

rows.original: You ask Paige about her robotic companion Iddi. You’ve never seen a helper droid like it before. Where did she get it?
rows.translation: 你向佩姬问起她的机器人伙伴伊迪。你从没见过那样的助手机器人。她是从哪儿弄来的？
rows.raw: "You ask Paige about her robotic companion Iddi. You’ve never seen a helper droid like it before. Where did she get it?"

rows.original: “Iddi is a brand of robot that’s designed to help people with special needs,” Paige replied. “Iddi’s actual name is ‘Personal Accessibility Assistant,’ or ‘PAA,’ but you can designate them as anything you want. You can get one for just about any sort of disability you have. For instance, Iddi is specially designed to be my eyes: he communicates to me by the earpiece to guide me without being loud or disruptive to the rest of the world.”
rows.translation: “伊迪是一种专为帮助有特殊需求的人设计的机器人品牌，”佩姬答道。“伊迪真正的名称是‘个人无障碍助理’，简称‘PAA’，不过你想给它们指定什么名字都行。无论你有什么样的残障，基本都能找到对应的型号。比如说，伊迪就是专门为我充当眼睛而设计的：他通过耳机与我交流，为我指引方向，又不会大声喧哗或打扰周围的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Iddi is a brand of robot that’s designed to help people with special needs,” Paige replied. “Iddi’s actual name is ‘Personal Accessibility Assistant,’ or ‘PAA,’ but you can designate them as anything you want. You can get one for just about any sort of disability you have. For instance, Iddi is specially designed to be my eyes: he communicates to me by the earpiece to guide me without being loud or disruptive to the rest of the world.”"

rows.original: “I’ve heard of models for just about anything. One model, for deaf users, has the projector attached to the earpiece display speech-to-text. Another model, for people with bum legs, is designed to be a sort of floating wheelchair; rather than a monitor, it’s basically a seat with antigravity pulsers and a personality. One really cool model for mute users doesn’t have an earpiece; they wear a special sort of brace on their teeth, like a retainer, and the model synthesizes speech based on the air flow in their throat and the way they’re moving their mouth.”
rows.translation: “我听说几乎什么需求都有对应型号。其中一种给失聪用户使用，耳机上的投影仪能把语音转换成文字显示出来。另一种给腿脚不便的人使用，被设计成某种悬浮轮椅；它并非显示器，基本就是一张配有反重力脉冲器和人格程序的座椅。有一种给失语用户用的型号特别酷，它没有耳机；使用者要在牙齿上戴一种类似牙齿保持器的特殊支架，而那种型号会根据他们喉咙里的气流与嘴部动作合成语音。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve heard of models for just about anything. One model, for deaf users, has the projector attached to the earpiece display speech-to-text. Another model, for people with bum legs, is designed to be a sort of floating wheelchair; rather than a monitor, it’s basically a seat with antigravity pulsers and a personality. One really cool model for mute users doesn’t have an earpiece; they wear a special sort of brace on their teeth, like a retainer, and the model synthesizes speech based on the air flow in their throat and the way they’re moving their mouth.”"

rows.original: Are the PAAs available for purchase by the general public? “I dunno for sure,” she responds. “But I think you need to be legally disabled in order to get one. They come free depending on your health insurance, but if you don’t have any, like I didn’t, then their price varies depending on what disability, or how many disabilities, you have, but they generally don’t run for more than a couple hundred credits because of some universal healthcare laws.”
rows.translation: 一般民众可以买到PAA吗？ “我也不太确定，”她答道。“不过我想，必须在法律上被认定为残障人士才能获得一台。根据医疗保险的不同，有时可以免费领取；但要是没有保险，就像我当时那样，价格会取决于你是哪一种残障，或者有多少种残障。不过由于某些全民医疗法案，它们一般不会超过几百信用点。”

They come free depending on your health insurance, but if you don’t have any, like I didn’t, then their price varies depending on what disability, or how many disabilities, you have, but they generally don’t run for more than a couple hundred credits because of some universal healthcare laws.”"

rows.original: You ask Paige how customizable the PAAs are. Can Iddi be programed to handle any other tasks besides the ones it’s been assigned as a visual aide? “Nope,” she answers simply. “Iddi’s only any good to handle blindness; if I were to wind up deaf and mute too, I’d need to get some more droids. I can’t even trade Iddi with another blind person because Iddi has been training these past years to be my assistant, not anyone else’s. Not that I’d ever want to.”
rows.translation: 你问佩姬，PAA能在多大程度上进行自定义。除了被指定的视觉辅助任务外，伊迪还能通过编程来处理其他工作吗？“不能，”她干脆地回答。“伊迪只擅长应对失明；要是我又聋又哑，就还得再买几台机器人。我甚至不能把伊迪转让给另一个盲人，因为这些年来，伊迪一直在训练成为我的助理，而不是别人的。不过我也绝不会想那么做。”
rows.raw: "You ask Paige how customizable the PAAs are. Can Iddi be programed to handle any other tasks besides the ones it’s been assigned as a visual aide? “Nope,” she answers simply. “Iddi’s only any good to handle blindness; if I were to wind up deaf and mute too, I’d need to get some more droids. I can’t even trade Iddi with another blind person because Iddi has been training these past years to be my assistant, not anyone else’s. Not that I’d ever want to.”"

rows.original: For your next question, you ask how customizable Iddi in particular is. Can it have other personalities? A different voice? “Yep! Every PAA can do all those things. They can speak other languages, too.” Paige leans forward and cups her hands around her mouth. “Iddi!” she hollers. “Could you come here, please?”
rows.translation: 接下来，你问起伊迪本身能在多大程度上自定义。它能拥有其他人格吗？能换一种声音吗？“当然！每台PAA都能做到这些。它们还能说其他语言。”佩姬向前探身，双手拢在嘴边。“伊迪！”她大声喊道。“能过来一下吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nFor your next question, you ask how customizable Iddi in particular is. Can it have other personalities? A different voice? “Yep! Every PAA can do all those things. They can speak other languages, too.” Paige leans forward and cups her hands around her mouth. “Iddi!” she hollers. “Could you come here, please?”"

rows.original: Within moments, the floating monitor is before you both. Its screen is filled with baby-blue pixels surrounding two tall, thin, pixelated, cartoony eyes. When it stops in front of Paige, its eyes shrink and turn to happy crescents to make way for a wide smile.
rows.translation: 没过一会儿，那台漂浮的显示器便来到你们俩面前。屏幕上满是淡蓝色的像素，中央是一对又高又细、像素化的卡通眼睛。当它停在佩姬面前时，那双眼睛缩小成开心的月牙形，让位给一个大大的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithin moments, the floating monitor is before you both. Its screen is filled with baby-blue pixels surrounding two tall, thin, pixelated, cartoony eyes. When it stops in front of Paige, its eyes shrink and turn to happy crescents to make way for a wide smile."

rows.original: “How can I help today, momma?” Iddi asks joyfully, its young, boyish voice accentuating its cutesy look.
rows.translation: “妈妈，今天我能帮什么忙？”伊迪愉快地问，那年轻、男孩气的声音更衬出它可爱的模样。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How can I help today, momma?” Iddi asks joyfully, its young, boyish voice accentuating its cutesy look."

rows.original: “Gimme administrative access, sweet thing. The password thirty-one four-five-seven decimal one.” She gives you a sweet smile. “That’s my birth date. You better not forget it, sweet thing.”
rows.translation: “给我管理员权限，小甜心。密码是三一四五七点一。”她冲你甜甜一笑。“那是我的生日。你最好别忘掉，小甜心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gimme administrative access, sweet thing. The password thirty-one four-five-seven decimal one.” She gives you a sweet smile. “That’s my birth date. You better not forget it, sweet thing.”"

rows.original: Iddi’s face goes blank and every pixel turns black. It’s as if someone had found its remote and switched it off. “Administrator access granted,” Iddi says – taking a far more masculine, yet robotic and monotonous voice. “Awaiting input.”
rows.translation: 伊迪的脸变得一片空白，所有像素都转为黑色，就像有人找到了遥控器并将它关掉。“已授予管理员权限，”伊迪说道 – 声音变得男性化许多，却仍带着机械感，语调单调。“等待输入。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s face goes blank and every pixel turns black. It’s as if someone had found its remote and switched it off. “Administrator access granted,” Iddi says – taking a far more masculine, yet robotic and monotonous voice. “Awaiting input.”"

rows.original: “I want to change your personality. Gimme... gimme a sultry, sexy and submissive mature momma droid.”
rows.translation: “我想更改你的人格。给我... 给我一个妖娆、性感又顺从的熟女妈妈机器人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I want to change your personality. Gimme... gimme a sultry, sexy and submissive mature momma droid.”"

rows.original: “Current profiles will be permanently overwritten after five minutes,” Iddi warns. “Confirm?”
rows.translation: “当前配置将在五分钟后被永久覆盖，”伊迪警告道。“确认吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Current profiles will be permanently overwritten after five minutes,” Iddi warns. “Confirm?”"

rows.original: Paige stops momentarily, taken by surprise. “I’ll lose my Iddi forever if I don’t change him back after five minutes?”
rows.translation: 佩姬愣了一下，显然吃了一惊。“要是五分钟后不把他改回来，我就会永远失去原来的伊迪？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige stops momentarily, taken by surprise. “I’ll lose my Iddi forever if I don’t change him back after five minutes?”"

rows.original: “Affirmative.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Affirmative.”"

rows.original: “Current PAA profile is built and catered toward the administrator. Older profiles must be overwritten so that newer profiles have adequate harddrive space to familiarize with the administrator of the PAA.”
rows.translation: “当前的PAA档案是围绕管理员建立并定制的。较旧的档案必须被覆写，以便较新的档案有足够的硬盘空间来熟悉PAA的管理员。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Current PAA profile is built and catered toward the administrator. Older profiles must be overwritten so that newer profiles have adequate harddrive space to familiarize with the administrator of the PAA.”"

rows.original: Paige says nothing at first. The thought of losing Iddi forever was a bit more than she had expected. But, apparently feeling adventurous, Paige smiles. “Confirm the switch,” she says. “I’ll switch you back after just one minute. Promise.”
rows.translation: 佩姬一开始没说话。永远失去伊迪这个念头，比她预想的要沉重一些。但显然她觉得自己想冒险一试，佩姬笑了。“确认交换吧，”她说，“就一分钟，之后我就把你换回来。我保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige says nothing at first. The thought of losing Iddi forever was a bit more than she had expected. But, apparently feeling adventurous, Paige smiles. “Confirm the switch,” she says. “I’ll switch you back after just one minute. Promise.”"

rows.original: Iddi’s screen remains completely black. “Processing,” it says, then, after a tense moment, sounds a single, robotic beep. “Complete.”
rows.translation: 伊迪的屏幕仍旧一片漆黑。“处理中，”它说道；紧张地等待片刻后，它发出一声机械蜂鸣。“完成。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s screen remains completely black. “Processing,” it says, then, after a tense moment, sounds a single, robotic beep. “Complete.”"

rows.original: “Resume operation,” Paige commands.
rows.translation: “恢复运行，”佩姬命令道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Resume operation,” Paige commands."

rows.original: Iddi’s screen turns back on, but except for the baby-blue pixels with cartoony eyes, it’s a pair of highly detailed, feminine eyes with long eyelashes and deep blue irises on top of a violet background. Iddi blinks once, and, seeing its ‘momma,’ flutters up to Paige.
rows.translation: 伊迪的屏幕重新亮起，但除了带着卡通眼睛的淡蓝色像素外，紫罗兰色背景上还出现了一双细节逼真、拥有纤长睫毛与深蓝虹膜的女性眼睛。伊迪眨了一下眼，看见自己的‘妈妈’后，便飘向佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s screen turns back on, but except for the baby-blue pixels with cartoony eyes, it’s a pair of highly detailed, feminine eyes with long eyelashes and deep blue irises on top of a violet background. Iddi blinks once, and, seeing its ‘momma,’ flutters up to Paige."

rows.original: “Ooooooh, momma,” Iddi says with its new, deep, feminine voice. “What can your... ‘personal assistant’ do for you today, baby?” Each syllable drips from Iddi’s speakers like butter, and Iddi lingers just a bit on every word, making sure that no meaning, literal or not, is lost on Paige.
rows.translation: “噢噢噢噢，妈妈，”伊迪用全新而低沉的女性嗓音说道。“你今天想让你的... ‘私人助理’为你做些什么，宝贝？”每个音节都如黄油般从伊迪的扬声器里滴落，它还故意在每个词上稍作停顿，确保佩姬不会错过其中任何一层含义，无论字面还是暗示。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooooooh, momma,” Iddi says with its new, deep, feminine voice. “What can your... ‘personal assistant’ do for you today, baby?” Each syllable drips from Iddi’s speakers like butter, and Iddi lingers just a bit on every word, making sure that no meaning, literal or not, is lost on Paige."

rows.original: Paige laughs heartily. “I didn’t expect it would work so well!” she guffaws. “I knew this was an option, but damn, JoyCo really wanted to cover every base with their clientele!” Paige leans towards Iddi, turning one cheek towards the monitor’s screen. “Give your momma a big kiss.”
rows.translation: 佩姬开怀大笑。“我没想到效果会这么好！”她笑道。“我知道有这个选项，但该死，JoyCo还真想满足客户的所有需求！”佩姬向伊迪凑近，将一侧脸颊转向显示器屏幕。“给妈妈一个大大的吻。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige laughs heartily. “I didn’t expect it would work so well!” she guffaws. “I knew this was an option, but damn, JoyCo really wanted to cover every base with their clientele!” Paige leans towards Iddi, turning one cheek towards the monitor’s screen. “Give your momma a big kiss.”"

rows.original: The eyes on the monitor vanish, replaced by a large pair of ruby-red human lips. Iddi, as instructed, gently places the cold glass of its screen against Paige’s cheek, and then makes a long, enunciated and exaggerated kissing noise. Paige can’t stop laughing through the whole debacle.
rows.translation: 显示器上的眼睛消失了，取而代之的是一双硕大、红宝石般的人类嘴唇。伊迪按照指示，轻轻将冰冷的玻璃屏幕贴上佩姬的脸颊，随后发出一声拖长、清晰而夸张的亲吻声。整场闹剧里，佩姬始终笑个不停。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe eyes on the monitor vanish, replaced by a large pair of ruby-red human lips. Iddi, as instructed, gently places the cold glass of its screen against Paige’s cheek, and then makes a long, enunciated and exaggerated kissing noise. Paige can’t stop laughing through the whole debacle."

rows.original: “Now, be a good girl,” Paige says, “and tend to our guest.”
rows.translation: “现在，做个性好的姑娘，”佩姬说道，“去照顾客人吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, be a good girl,” Paige says, “and tend to our guest.”"

rows.original: Paige motions to you, and then Iddi is on you like a bee on honey, its lips replaced with the eyes from earlier. <i>“Hello,
rows.translation: 佩姬朝你示意，然后伊迪就扑到你身上，像蜜蜂扑向蜂蜜，它的嘴唇换成了先前那些眼睛。<i>“你好，
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige motions to you, and then Iddi is on you like a bee on honey, its lips replaced with the eyes from earlier. <i>“Hello, "
