rows.original: ,” Iddi purrs. “My name is Iddi. I just love being helpful. Is there anything I can do for you? Anything... at all? I am a personal assistant, and I’d be more than happy to ‘assist’ you with anything. You’d be surprised what my parameters have made me capable of.”
rows.translation: ，”伊迪低声娇吟。“我叫伊迪。我就是喜欢帮助别人。有什么是我能为你做的吗？任何事情... 都可以？我可是私人助理，无论什么事，我都会非常乐意‘协助’你。你会惊讶于我的参数让我具备了怎样的能力。”
rows.raw: ",” Iddi purrs. “My name is Iddi. I just love being helpful. Is there anything I can do for you? Anything... at all? I am a personal assistant, and I’d be more than happy to ‘assist’ you with anything. You’d be surprised what my parameters have made me capable of.”"

rows.original: You laugh along with Paige. Getting hit on by a floating television is not something you anticipated with your relationship with her! You hadn’t expected Iddi’s voice and mannerisms to turn as sexy as they did, but still, it’s all in good fun.
rows.translation: 你和佩姬一起笑了起来。与她交往时被一台悬浮电视调情，可不在你的预料之中！你没想到伊迪的嗓音和举止会变得如此性感，不过这一切终究只是善意玩笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh along with Paige. Getting hit on by a floating television is not something you anticipated with your relationship with her! You hadn’t expected Iddi’s voice and mannerisms to turn as sexy as they did, but still, it’s all in good fun."

rows.original: You laugh, but not as much as Paige. Having a floating monitor hit on you was funny at first, but then, with its words and how close it’s hovering to you, it’s made it kind of awkward. Honestly, it’s a good thing Paige is blind, or else she may have been able to read your expressions a little too well.
rows.translation: 你笑了，但笑得不如佩姬厉害。被一台漂浮的显示器调戏起初确实好笑，可后来，听着它说的话，又看它悬得离你那么近，就变得有些尴尬了。说实话，佩姬瞎了倒是件好事，否则她说不定能把你的表情看得太透。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh, but not as much as Paige. Having a floating monitor hit on you was funny at first, but then, with its words and how close it’s hovering to you, it’s made it kind of awkward. Honestly, it’s a good thing Paige is blind, or else she may have been able to read your expressions a little too well."

rows.original: This is not the sort of action you were hoping for today. You laugh just raucously enough to mask the sound of you adjusting your pants. Iddi’s insistent proximity is making you a little uncomfortable, but if you’re honest to yourself, the way it’s talking is sexy. Maybe you could convince Paige to talk to you like that later.
rows.translation: 这可不是你今天期待的那种活动。你故意笑得足够响亮，以掩盖自己调整裤子的声音。伊迪执意靠得这么近，让你有些不自在；但如果坦诚面对自己，它说话的方式确实很性感。也许以后你能说服佩姬也用那种语气跟你说话。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is not the sort of action you were hoping for today. You laugh just raucously enough to mask the sound of you adjusting your pants. Iddi’s insistent proximity is making you a little uncomfortable, but if you’re honest to yourself, the way it’s talking is sexy. Maybe you could convince Paige to talk to you like that later."

rows.original: Admittedly, you came into Paige’s unit ragingly horny, and the way Iddi’s voice sounds and the way it’s talking, you’re an errant stroke away from cumming then and there. But you have some goddamn dignity and you refuse to allow yourself to fall so low as to be seduced into a hands-free orgasm by an accessibility droid, of all the things in the universe.
rows.translation: 不得不承认，你走进佩姬的住处时便已经欲火焚身；伊迪的声音和说话方式，更让你只差随手抚弄一下就会当场高潮。但你他妈还有自己的尊严，绝不允许自己堕落到这种地步，被宇宙万物中的一台无障碍辅助机器人勾引得不碰身体便直接高潮。
rows.raw: "\n\nAdmittedly, you came into Paige’s unit ragingly horny, and the way Iddi’s voice sounds and the way it’s talking, you’re an errant stroke away from cumming then and there. But you have some goddamn dignity and you refuse to allow yourself to fall so low as to be seduced into a hands-free orgasm by an accessibility droid, of all the things in the universe."

rows.original: “That’s enough,” you say to Paige. “You should probably switch it back. We only have four minutes left.”
rows.translation: “够了，”你对佩姬说道。“你最好把它改回来。我们只剩四分钟了。”
rows.raw: " “That’s enough,” you say to Paige. “You should probably switch it back. We only have four minutes left.”"

rows.original: Paige wipes a tear from her eye from all her laughing. “Yeah, you’re right,” she admits. “It was funny as hell, though! Iddi, give me administrative access. Password is thirty-one four-five-seven decimal one.”
rows.translation: 佩姬笑着擦掉眼角的泪水。“是啊，你说得对，” 她承认。“不过那真是笑死人了！伊迪，给我管理员权限。密码是三一四五七点一。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige wipes a tear from her eye from all her laughing. “Yeah, you’re right,” she admits. “It was funny as hell, though! Iddi, give me administrative access. Password is thirty-one four-five-seven decimal one.”"

rows.original: Another moment of instruction later, and Iddi is back to its original, childish, cartoony self. “Can I do anything more, momma?” it asks innocently. You wonder if Iddi recalled anything of its alternate personality, but you doubt it – the new profile was probably deleted immediately.
rows.translation: 又指导了一会儿，伊迪就恢复成原来那个孩子气、卡通般的模样。“妈妈，我还能做点什么吗？”它天真地问。你想知道伊迪是否还记得另一个人格的任何事，但你对此表示怀疑——新档案大概已经被立刻删除了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother moment of instruction later, and Iddi is back to its original, childish, cartoony self. “Can I do anything more, momma?” it asks innocently. You wonder if Iddi recalled anything of its alternate personality, but you doubt it – the new profile was probably deleted immediately."

rows.original: “No thanks, Iddi,” Paige says, still laughing. “You’ve done plenty already.”
rows.translation: “不用了，谢谢，伊迪，”佩姬仍在笑着说。“你已经帮了很多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No thanks, Iddi,” Paige says, still laughing. “You’ve done plenty already.”"

rows.original: “Okay!” And then Iddi is gone from the room, back to its dock.
rows.translation: “好！”然后伊迪就从房间里消失了，回到它的停靠位。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay!” And then Iddi is gone from the room, back to its dock."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Paige about the earpiece. You know that it’s also a projector to cover the scar on her face, but it’s also a communicator?
rows.translation: 你向佩姬问起那只耳机。你知道它还是一台能遮住她脸上伤疤的投影仪，不过它同时也是通讯器吗？
rows.raw: "You ask Paige about the earpiece. You know that it’s also a projector to cover the scar on her face, but it’s also a communicator?"

rows.original: “It’s a one-way communicator with Iddi, going from him to me,” she responds. “Almost every PAA comes with one, but what they do depends on the model. The one to help mutes doesn’t come with an earpiece at all.”
rows.translation: “这是伊迪向我单向传递信息的通讯器，”她答道。“几乎每台PAA都配有一个，不过具体功能取决于型号。帮助失语人士的型号就完全不配耳机。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a one-way communicator with Iddi, going from him to me,” she responds. “Almost every PAA comes with one, but what they do depends on the model. The one to help mutes doesn’t come with an earpiece at all.”"

rows.original: She removes the piece from her ear, and the projector disguising her scar vanishes in a blink.
rows.translation: 她从耳朵上取下装置，掩盖伤疤的投影一闪便消失了。
rows.raw: "She removes the piece from her ear, and the projector disguising her scar vanishes in a blink."

rows.original: She reaches to her dresser and pulls the earpiece from its top, holding it in her hand.
rows.translation: 她伸手探向梳妆台，从台面上取下那只耳机，握在手里。
rows.raw: "She reaches to her dresser and pulls the earpiece from its top, holding it in her hand."

rows.original: “Most earpieces have the projector for one reason or another: it’s usually because the PAA is trying to communicate visually. Mine is a one-of-a-kind: it didn’t come with a projector, you know, me being blind and all, but I had mine modded and jailbroken specifically so it would hide my scar.”
rows.translation: “大多数耳机都出于这样或那样的原因配有投影仪：通常是因为PAA需要用视觉方式交流。我这只独一无二：它原本不带投影仪，毕竟你也知道，我是个盲人；但我专门找人改装并破解了它，好遮住我的伤疤。”
rows.raw: " “Most earpieces have the projector for one reason or another: it’s usually because the PAA is trying to communicate visually. Mine is a one-of-a-kind: it didn’t come with a projector, you know, me being blind and all, but I had mine modded and jailbroken specifically so it would hide my scar.”"

rows.original: You ask Paige something a bit silly. Could... could you try wearing it? She laughs. “Fuck it, why not? Try not to break it, of course. JoyCo will always replace earpieces for free, no questions asked, but the mods take time and money.”
rows.translation: 你问了佩姬一个有点傻的问题。你能... 你能试着戴上它吗？她笑了。“去他的，为什么不呢？当然，尽量别弄坏它。欢乐公司总是免费更换耳机，什么问题都不问，但改造要花时间和钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Paige something a bit silly. Could... could you try wearing it? She laughs. “Fuck it, why not? Try not to break it, of course. JoyCo will always replace earpieces for free, no questions asked, but the mods take time and money.”"

rows.original: She hands you the gear. It’s a little bit lighter than you expected. You lift it to your right [pc.ear] – it’s custom-fitted for Paige, but you manage to fight it in, if a bit uncomfortably. “So now what?” you ask.
rows.translation: 她把装置递给你。它比你想象中稍微轻一些。你将它戴到右侧[pc.ear]上 – 这是按佩姬的尺寸定制的，不过你还是设法硬塞了进去，尽管有些不舒服。“接下来呢？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hands you the gear. It’s a little bit lighter than you expected. You lift it to your right [pc.ear] – it’s custom-fitted for Paige, but you manage to fight it in, if a bit uncomfortably. “So now what?” you ask."

rows.original: “Along the stem of the projector are two buttons,” she instructs. “The one closest to your ear will start the projector on your eyes. The other one will call Iddi, but he won’t come here unless you actually yell out for him.”
rows.translation: “投影仪的柄上有两个按钮，”她指导道。“最靠近耳朵的那个会在你的眼睛上启动投影。另一个会呼叫伊迪，不过除非你真的喊出他的名字，否则他不会过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Along the stem of the projector are two buttons,” she instructs. “The one closest to your ear will start the projector on your eyes. The other one will call Iddi, but he won’t come here unless you actually yell out for him.”"

rows.original: Shutting your eyes, you press the first button. You can see a dim light through your eyelids; you slowly squint your eyes open, getting used to the light being sprayed from the stem of the earpiece. It’s not as bad as you thought: it’s some kind of ‘soft’ light that rapidly overlays a moving image over your eyes, updating every time you blink or look in another direction. It moves so quickly over your eyes and the bridge of your nose that you barely register it as a light flashing in your eyes. It’s as if the earpiece is a printer, and you are the paper.
rows.translation: 你闭上双眼，按下第一个按钮。透过眼皮能看到昏暗的光；你慢慢眯着眼睁开，让自己适应从耳机柄上洒出的光线。情况没你想象得那么糟：那是一种‘柔和’的光，能迅速在你的眼睛上覆盖一幅活动影像，并在你每次眨眼或看向其他方向时更新。它扫过双眼和鼻梁的速度如此之快，你几乎意识不到有光线正在眼前闪烁。就仿佛耳机是一台打印机，而你就是纸张。
rows.raw: "\n\nShutting your eyes, you press the first button. You can see a dim light through your eyelids; you slowly squint your eyes open, getting used to the light being sprayed from the stem of the earpiece. It’s not as bad as you thought: it’s some kind of ‘soft’ light that rapidly overlays a moving image over your eyes, updating every time you blink or look in another direction. It moves so quickly over your eyes and the bridge of your nose that you barely register it as a light flashing in your eyes. It’s as if the earpiece is a printer, and you are the paper."

rows.original: “How do you look?” she asks. You look around the room for a mirror, but there isn’t one (obviously). Instead, you pull out your codex, and you put the screen to sleep, so you can look at its glossy screen and use that as a mirror instead.
rows.translation: “你看起来怎么样？”她问。你环顾房间想找一面镜子，但这里显然没有。于是你取出终端，让屏幕进入休眠状态，好借用光亮的屏幕当镜子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How do you look?” she asks. You look around the room for a mirror, but there isn’t one (obviously). Instead, you pull out your codex, and you put the screen to sleep, so you can look at its glossy screen and use that as a mirror instead."

rows.original: Your face is largely the same, except around the eyes. Where your usual [pc.skinFurScales] was around your eyes and just above your nose, was fine, brown ‘fur,’ or some facsimile of it. Due to the nature of the projector, it ‘bleeds’ into your actual [pc.skinFurScales] perfectly and seamlessly – you run your finger along where you end and the projector begins, just to make sure that it’s not real. But moreover, the projector also changes your eye color: your [pc.eyes] are replaced with Paige’s stunning, immersive blue. The projector even matches your eyes: it tracks the movement of your pupils and iris’ to ensure that the projection is as accurate as possible. It’s like you’re looking right into her eyes rather than your own.
rows.translation: 你的脸整体上没有变化，眼睛周围除外。原本环绕双眼、位于鼻梁上方的[pc.skinFurScales]，变成了细密的棕色‘毛发’，或者说某种仿制品。由于投影仪的特性，它与真正的[pc.skinFurScales]完美而无缝地‘交融’在一起 – 你用手指沿着自己与投影交界的地方划过，只为确认那并非真实存在。但更重要的是，投影仪还改变了你的眼睛颜色：[pc.eyes]被佩姬那双令人沉醉的湛蓝眼眸取代。投影甚至能与你的双眼同步：它会追踪瞳孔与虹膜的运动，确保影像尽可能准确。看起来就像你正直视她的双眼，而不是自己的眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour face is largely the same, except around the eyes. Where your usual [pc.skinFurScales] was around your eyes and just above your nose, was fine, brown ‘fur,’ or some facsimile of it. Due to the nature of the projector, it ‘bleeds’ into your actual [pc.skinFurScales] perfectly and seamlessly – you run your finger along where you end and the projector begins, just to make sure that it’s not real. But moreover, the projector also changes your eye color: your [pc.eyes] are replaced with Paige’s stunning, immersive blue. The projector even matches your eyes: it tracks the movement of your pupils and iris’ to ensure that the projection is as accurate as possible. It’s like you’re looking right into her eyes rather than your own."

rows.original: “It works,” you tell her. She giggles as you remove the earpiece and hand it back to her. “Did you mod it yourself?”
rows.translation: “有效果，”你告诉她。你摘下耳机还给她时，她咯咯笑了起来。“这是你自己改装的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It works,” you tell her. She giggles as you remove the earpiece and hand it back to her. “Did you mod it yourself?”"

rows.original: “I’m blind, [pc.name],” she answered, deadpan. Well... yeah, that was a dumb question. “I knew a guy from my piracy days. It took him a while and it cost a small chunk of change, but I’m not complaining about the results.”
rows.translation: “我是盲人，[pc.name]，”她面无表情地答道。好吧... 对，这个问题真蠢。“我在当海盗时认识一个家伙。他花了不少时间，也收了我一小笔钱，不过我对结果没什么可抱怨的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m blind, [pc.name],” she answered, deadpan. Well... yeah, that was a dumb question. “I knew a guy from my piracy days. It took him a while and it cost a small chunk of change, but I’m not complaining about the results.”"

rows.original: As she shouldn’t, you tell her. It was like your eyes were hers. “Well, good. Money well spent.”
rows.translation: 你告诉她，她本就不该那样。就好像你的眼睛属于她一样。“嗯，很好。钱花得值。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she shouldn’t, you tell her. It was like your eyes were hers. “Well, good. Money well spent.”"

rows.raw: "IDDI"

rows.original: Iddi
rows.translation: 伊迪
rows.raw: "Iddi"

rows.original: B

Iddi is a floating computer monitor. It’s one-hundred centimeters across and fifty-six-and-one-quarter centimeters high, with a definition of 7680 by 4320 pixels – somewhat low-resolution for the modern year, but Iddi is only a helper droid, and for the blind, no less. It has a chrome metal frame and a glass screen protecting its liquid crystal imagery. Iddi floats and flits through the air using a pair of antigravity pulsars built into the bottom of its frame.
rows.translation: 伊迪是一台悬浮式电脑显示器，宽一百厘米、高五十六又四分之一厘米，分辨率为7680×4320像素 – 以这个时代的标准而言略显低下，但伊迪毕竟只是辅助机器人，而且还是给盲人使用的。它拥有镀铬金属框架，玻璃屏幕则保护着内部的液晶成像部件。伊迪通过内置于框架底部的一对反重力脉冲器，在空中悬浮穿梭。
rows.raw: "Iddi is a floating computer monitor. It’s one-hundred centimeters across and fifty-six-and-one-quarter centimeters high, with a definition of 7680 by 4320 pixels – somewhat low-resolution for the modern year, but Iddi is only a helper droid, and for the blind, no less. It has a chrome metal frame and a glass screen protecting its liquid crystal imagery. Iddi floats and flits through the air using a pair of antigravity pulsars built into the bottom of its frame."

rows.original: Iddi’s physical appearance is unremarkable – you could purchase a similar monitor at any electronics store and the antigravity pulsars, while high quality, aren’t difficult to find. The meat of what makes Iddi remarkable is its programming: it’s an ever-learning, if low-priority, artificial intelligence, designed to work with Paige and constantly learn from her. After having been with Paige for many years, Iddi’s personality is fairly set in stone, but every day is a new experience for it and her.
rows.translation: 伊迪的外观毫不起眼：你可以在任何一家电器店买到类似的显示器，而那些反重力脉冲器虽然质量上乘，也并不难找。让伊迪真正出众的核心是它的程序：它是一个不断学习、虽然优先级不高的人工智能，被设计来与佩姬协作，并从她身上不断学习。与佩姬共处多年之后，伊迪的性格已相当固定，但每一天对它和她来说都是新的体验。
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s physical appearance is unremarkable – you could purchase a similar monitor at any electronics store and the antigravity pulsars, while high quality, aren’t difficult to find. The meat of what makes Iddi remarkable is its programming: it’s an ever-learning, if low-priority, artificial intelligence, designed to work with Paige and constantly learn from her. After having been with Paige for many years, Iddi’s personality is fairly set in stone, but every day is a new experience for it and her."

rows.original: By default, the image on the screen is a pair of cartoonish, pixelated eyes on top of an opaque, baby-blue background. What’s on the screen can change depending on the scenario: Iddi can make a smile; a pair of rosy, human lips; it can gesture with hands on the screen; anything you can imagine, Iddi can do. As Iddi was designed for the visually impaired, it’s not for Paige’s benefit, but for anyone and everyone around her.
rows.translation: 默认情况下，屏幕上会在不透明的淡蓝色背景上显示一双卡通式的像素眼睛。屏幕内容可随情景变化：伊迪可以露出笑容；显示一双红润的人类嘴唇；在屏幕上用双手比划；无论你能想到什么，伊迪都能做到。由于伊迪是为视障人士设计的，这些功能不是为了佩姬，而是为了她身边的所有人。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy default, the image on the screen is a pair of cartoonish, pixelated eyes on top of an opaque, baby-blue background. What’s on the screen can change depending on the scenario: Iddi can make a smile; a pair of rosy, human lips; it can gesture with hands on the screen; anything you can imagine, Iddi can do. As Iddi was designed for the visually impaired, it’s not for Paige’s benefit, but for anyone and everyone around her."

rows.original: Iddi has a charging station, called a ‘dock,’ elsewhere in Paige’s unit. Whenever Iddi is not immediately required, you can usually find it resting there. There’s a jack on the lower end of Iddi’s chrome frame that connects directly to the dock, and that’s how it keeps its battery charged.
rows.translation: 伊迪在佩姬住处的其他地方设有一个名为‘底座’的充电站。只要没有立即需要伊迪，通常都能看到它在那里休息。伊迪镀铬框架的下端有一个插孔，可以直接连接底座，它就是这样为电池充电的。
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi has a charging station, called a ‘dock,’ elsewhere in Paige’s unit. Whenever Iddi is not immediately required, you can usually find it resting there. There’s a jack on the lower end of Iddi’s chrome frame that connects directly to the dock, and that’s how it keeps its battery charged."

rows.original: Iddi has a pair of small speakers on the bottom of its frame, between the glass screen and the antigravity pulsars. Though there is no visible attachment or anything, Iddi is capable of communicating directly to Paige in private via the earpiece she’s always wearing. Other than the charging jack, there are no openings on Iddi’s body: no slots or attachment ports – not so much as video- or audio-out. While it’s capable of receiving hardware upgrades, Iddi would have to be sent back to the factory for them, and Paige is in no rush.
rows.translation: 伊迪的框架底部、玻璃屏幕与反重力脉冲器之间，安装着一对小型扬声器。尽管看不到任何附件或类似装置，伊迪却能够通过佩姬一直佩戴的耳机，直接与她私下交流。除了充电插孔外，伊迪的机身上没有任何开口：既没有插槽也没有扩展接口 – 连视频或音频输出口都没有。虽然它能够接受硬件升级，但必须送回工厂才能进行，而佩姬并不着急。
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi has a pair of small speakers on the bottom of its frame, between the glass screen and the antigravity pulsars. Though there is no visible attachment or anything, Iddi is capable of communicating directly to Paige in private via the earpiece she’s always wearing. Other than the charging jack, there are no openings on Iddi’s body: no slots or attachment ports – not so much as video- or audio-out. While it’s capable of receiving hardware upgrades, Iddi would have to be sent back to the factory for them, and Paige is in no rush."

rows.original: It’d be awkward to ask for more details about Iddi when it’s not here. You can always head back to Tavros and meet Paige in her unit if you’re really curious.
rows.translation: 伊迪不在这儿的时候，追问它的细节会很尴尬。你要是真好奇，随时可以回塔夫罗斯站，去她的单元找佩姬。
rows.raw: "It’d be awkward to ask for more details about Iddi when it’s not here. You can always head back to Tavros and meet Paige in her unit if you’re really curious."

rows.original: Her Eyes
rows.translation: 她的眼睛
rows.raw: "Her Eyes"

rows.original: You ask Paige about her eyes. She frowns, so you hurriedly elaborate: she once mentioned that she’s trying to save her money to get some synthetic eyes to replace her own, but that it’ll ‘be a while yet.’ You ask her if there was anything more she could tell you.
rows.translation: 你问佩姬关于她眼睛的事。她皱起眉，于是你赶紧补充说明：她曾提过自己在攒钱，想换上一双合成眼睛替换掉自己的，但那还得‘再等上一阵子’。你问她还有没有什么能告诉你的。
rows.raw: "You ask Paige about her eyes. She frowns, so you hurriedly elaborate: she once mentioned that she’s trying to save her money to get some synthetic eyes to replace her own, but that it’ll ‘be a while yet.’ You ask her if there was anything more she could tell you."

rows.original: “Well, I was in the market to get some synthetic eyes about as soon as I got Iddi. Don’t get me wrong, I love Iddi with all my heart, but I’d love nothing more than to not need him.” She scratches at her chin as she recalls the day. “The ‘job’ that I was working on when I got my injury didn’t provide any medical benefits, and while I do have health insurance now, it doesn’t retroactively cover injuries or disabilities, especially not ones as extreme as mine. I’m not a corporation; I can’t get any health insurance deals with anybody just working as a yoga instructor out of my home. I have to pay for them out of my pocket. Iddi!” she calls suddenly. “Could you come here, please?”
rows.translation: “嗯，我差不多从得到伊迪那时起，就一直在考虑买一双合成眼睛。别误会，我全心全意地爱着伊迪，但没有什么比不再需要他更令我向往。”她回想起那一天，挠了挠下巴。“我受伤时正在干的那份‘工作’不提供任何医疗福利；虽说我现在确实有医疗保险，但它不会追溯报销过去的伤病或残障，尤其是我这种严重情况。我又不是什么公司；只是在家里当瑜伽教练，根本谈不到什么医疗保险优惠。我必须自掏腰包。伊迪！”她忽然喊道。“能过来一下吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I was in the market to get some synthetic eyes about as soon as I got Iddi. Don’t get me wrong, I love Iddi with all my heart, but I’d love nothing more than to not need him.” She scratches at her chin as she recalls the day. “The ‘job’ that I was working on when I got my injury didn’t provide any medical benefits, and while I do have health insurance now, it doesn’t retroactively cover injuries or disabilities, especially not ones as extreme as mine. I’m not a corporation; I can’t get any health insurance deals with anybody just working as a yoga instructor out of my home. I have to pay for them out of my pocket. Iddi!” she calls suddenly. “Could you come here, please?”"

rows.original: In a flash, the floating robot is before you both, the eyes on its pixelated screen turning into crescents, overjoyed that it could be of use to Paige. “Hello, momma!” Iddi chirps.
rows.translation: 一眨眼，那个悬浮机器人就出现在你们俩面前，它像素屏幕上的一双眼睛弯成月牙，为能帮上佩姬的忙而满心欢喜。“你好呀，妈妈！”伊迪欢快地叫了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a flash, the floating robot is before you both, the eyes on its pixelated screen turning into crescents, overjoyed that it could be of use to Paige. “Hello, momma!” Iddi chirps."

rows.original: “Hello, Iddi,” she says, then addresses you again. “I asked JoyCo what my options were. My first option was to get prosthetic eyes: basically, machines that do the seeing for me. Using the modern magic of technology, they could fit me with two itty-bitty robots that plug directly into the cortex of my brain–” She laughs a sort of uneasy chortle once. “I’ve heard lots of stories about how prosthetic limbs or eyes or tongues or dicks or whatever are many times better than the real thing, but I’m not into the idea of my limb having a company logo on it. I don’t like that my vision would depend on some copper. It... just wouldn’t feel right.”
rows.translation: “你好，伊迪，”她说完又重新对你开口。“我向JoyCo咨询过有哪些选择。第一个方案是安装义眼：基本就是替我负责视觉的机器。凭借现代科技的魔法，他们可以给我装上两个直接接入大脑皮层的微型机器人–”她略显不安地干笑了一声。“我听过很多故事，说假肢、义眼、义舌、假鸡巴之类的东西比真货强上许多倍；但我不喜欢自己的身体部件上印着公司标志。我不喜欢自己的视力依赖某件金属制品。这... 感觉就是不对。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello, Iddi,” she says, then addresses you again. “I asked JoyCo what my options were. My first option was to get prosthetic eyes: basically, machines that do the seeing for me. Using the modern magic of technology, they could fit me with two itty-bitty robots that plug directly into the cortex of my brain–” She laughs a sort of uneasy chortle once. “I’ve heard lots of stories about how prosthetic limbs or eyes or tongues or dicks or whatever are many times better than the real thing, but I’m not into the idea of my limb having a company logo on it. I don’t like that my vision would depend on some copper. It... just wouldn’t feel right.”"

rows.original: “The second option, they told me, was synthetic eyes. They could rebuild my eyes from scratch using my DNA as their base. The eyes would be mine: they wouldn’t be from a donor and they wouldn’t be made of metal or have any wires. They would be all organic, all natural, and all mine. It would be as if my accident had never happened.” She turns towards Iddi’s direction. “Iddi, display the quote the nice nurse at JoyCo gave us for the synthetic eyes for our friend.”
rows.translation: “他们告诉我，第二种选择是合成眼球。他们可以用我的DNA作为基础，从头重建我的眼睛。那对眼睛会是我的：既不来自捐献者，也不是用金属做的，没有任何线路。它们会完全是生物的，完全自然的，完全属于我。就像我的事故从未发生过一样。”她转向伊迪的方向。“伊迪，把欢乐公司那位好心的护士给我们的合成眼球报价展示给我们的朋友看。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The second option, they told me, was synthetic eyes. They could rebuild my eyes from scratch using my DNA as their base. The eyes would be mine: they wouldn’t be from a donor and they wouldn’t be made of metal or have any wires. They would be all organic, all natural, and all mine. It would be as if my accident had never happened.” She turns towards Iddi’s direction. “Iddi, display the quote the nice nurse at JoyCo gave us for the synthetic eyes for our friend.”"

rows.original: “Okay, momma!” Iddi says, and the eyes on the television screen break into thousands of pixels. Each pixel bounces around the monitor as Iddi constructs the quote they were given, followed by the final price tag.
rows.translation: “好的，妈妈！”伊迪说道，电视屏幕上的眼睛随即分解为数千个像素。伊迪根据获得的信息生成报价时，每个像素都在显示器上来回跳动，最后显示出最终价格。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, momma!” Iddi says, and the eyes on the television screen break into thousands of pixels. Each pixel bounces around the monitor as Iddi constructs the quote they were given, followed by the final price tag."

rows.original: Wow. That’s, uh. That’s a six-digit number. A five, followed by five zeroes. They expect a yoga instructor to afford that?
rows.translation: 哇。那是，呃。那是个六位数。一个五，后面五个零。他们指望一个瑜伽教练付得起这个？
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. That’s, uh. That’s a six-digit number. A five, followed by five zeroes. They expect a yoga instructor to afford that?"

rows.original: “Is there anything else I can do?” Iddi asks after a moment.
rows.translation: “还有什么是我能做的吗？”片刻之后，伊迪问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is there anything else I can do?” Iddi asks after a moment."

rows.original: “You’ve done plenty, baby,” says Paige, blowing Iddi a kiss. “Go back to what you were doing. Love you, Iddi.”
rows.translation: “你已经做得够多了，宝贝，”佩姬说着，朝伊迪飞了个吻。“回去继续你的事吧。爱你，伊迪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve done plenty, baby,” says Paige, blowing Iddi a kiss. “Go back to what you were doing. Love you, Iddi.”"

rows.original: “Love you too, momma!” And then Iddi’s gone.
rows.translation: “我也爱你，妈妈！”然后伊迪就不见了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Love you too, momma!” And then Iddi’s gone."

rows.original: “So, yeah. That’s a bit of a number, isn’t it? That’s for the eyes and for the surgery together.” She frowns before continuing. “At the rate I’m going, I should be able to afford it by the time I’m in my late sixties. That’s a long way away. But, you know, like I said, I’d love nothing more than to see again. I can be patient.”
rows.translation: “所以，嗯。这笔数目可不小，对吧？这是眼睛和手术加在一起的价格。”她皱了皱眉，继续说道。“按我现在的进度，等到六十多岁时应该就能付得起了。那还遥远得很。不过，你也知道，正如我所说，我最大的愿望就是重见光明。我可以耐心等待。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, yeah. That’s a bit of a number, isn’t it? That’s for the eyes and for the surgery together.” She frowns before continuing. “At the rate I’m going, I should be able to afford it by the time I’m in my late sixties. That’s a long way away. But, you know, like I said, I’d love nothing more than to see again. I can be patient.”"

rows.original: You hum in thought. You’re the heir
rows.translation: 你沉思着哼了一声。你是继承人
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hum in thought. You’re the heir"

rows.original: ess
rows.raw: "ess"

rows.original: to Steele Tech, one of the richest companies in the universe. Is there nothing you can do? You don’t like the thought of Paige having to wait so long and save so much money, but you can’t exactly get the company to float her, and you don’t have that sort of cash in your pocket...
rows.translation: 与宇宙中最富有的公司之一斯蒂尔科技关系密切。你真的什么也做不了吗？想到佩姬必须等待这么久、攒下这么多钱，你就感到难受；可你也没法让公司替她垫付，而自己的口袋里又没有这么多现金...
rows.raw: " to Steele Tech, one of the richest companies in the universe. Is there nothing you can do? You don’t like the thought of Paige having to wait so long and save so much money, but you can’t exactly get the company to float her, and you don’t have that sort of cash in your pocket..."

rows.original: You say nothing as the number flashes in your mind. Five hundred thousand credits – one half of one million. You could afford that. Paige doesn’t have to wait until she’s old.
rows.translation: 那个数字在脑中闪过时，你什么也没说。五十万信用点 – 一百万的一半。你付得起。佩姬不必等到人老珠黄。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say nothing as the number flashes in your mind. Five hundred thousand credits – one half of one million. You could afford that. Paige doesn’t have to wait until she’s old."

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: Offer to pay for Paige’s synthetic eyes and for the surgery.
rows.translation: 提出为佩姬支付合成眼睛和手术的费用。
rows.raw: "Offer to pay for Paige’s synthetic eyes and for the surgery."

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: Maybe you should get to know her a little more intimately before you offer to pay for her synthetic eye surgery.
rows.translation: 也许在提出替她支付合成眼睛手术费之前，你应该先与她建立更亲密的关系。
rows.raw: "Maybe you should get to know her a little more intimately before you offer to pay for her synthetic eye surgery."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Five hundred thousand credits is no small number. You’ll need some time to think about it.
rows.translation: 五十万信用点可不是小数目。你需要花点时间考虑。
rows.raw: "Five hundred thousand credits is no small number. You’ll need some time to think about it."

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: Offer
rows.translation: 提议
rows.raw: "Offer"

rows.original: You don’t have enough credits to pay for Paige’s synthetic eyes. Not yet, anyway.
rows.translation: 你的信用点不够支付佩姬的合成眼睛。至少现在还不行。
rows.raw: "You don’t have enough credits to pay for Paige’s synthetic eyes. Not yet, anyway."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: There’s nothing you can do for her yet. But maybe, if you’re a little more frugal...
rows.translation: 你暂时还帮不了她。不过，也许只要你再节俭一些...
rows.raw: "There’s nothing you can do for her yet. But maybe, if you’re a little more frugal..."

rows.original: Nothing you have in the agenda is as important as making sure you’re here for Paige. You’re fine with waiting the twelve hours here in the medbay. “Are you certain?” the droid asks you, and you confirm. “Very well. You’ll be informed when Miss Paige’s surgery is completed.”
rows.translation: 你的日程上没有任何事情比确保自己陪在佩姬身边更重要。你不介意在医疗舱里等上十二个小时。“您确定吗？”机器人问道，你给出肯定答复。“很好。佩姬小姐的手术完成后，我们会通知您。”
rows.raw: "Nothing you have in the agenda is as important as making sure you’re here for Paige. You’re fine with waiting the twelve hours here in the medbay. “Are you certain?” the droid asks you, and you confirm. “Very well. You’ll be informed when Miss Paige’s surgery is completed.”"

rows.original: The droid follows Paige into the operating room, and the whitewashed metal doors clank shut, leaving you alone in the waiting room. A red light above the door turns on, letting everyone that sees it know that the room is, in a word, occupied.
rows.translation: 那台机器人跟着佩姬走进手术室，刷成白色的金属门哐当一声合上，把你一个人留在等候室里。门上方的红灯亮了，让每个看见它的人都知道，这个房间，说白了，已经被占用了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe droid follows Paige into the operating room, and the whitewashed metal doors clank shut, leaving you alone in the waiting room. A red light above the door turns on, letting everyone that sees it know that the room is, in a word, occupied."

rows.original: You take a seat, getting comfortable in the plain room. There is no music and the few magazines offering off-world fashions and news from the corners of the universe are all outdated by several solar months. The medbay gives you access to the extranet via your codex, but the speeds leave something to be desired; who could survive on twenty paltry gigabytes a second?
rows.translation: 你坐下来，在这间朴素的房间里安顿好。没有音乐，仅有的几本杂志介绍外星时尚和宇宙各角落的新闻，却全都过时了好几个太阳月。医疗舱让你能通过你的CODEX终端接入超网，但速度实在不敢恭维；谁受得了区区每秒二十吉字节呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a seat, getting comfortable in the plain room. There is no music and the few magazines offering off-world fashions and news from the corners of the universe are all outdated by several solar months. The medbay gives you access to the extranet via your codex, but the speeds leave something to be desired; who could survive on twenty paltry gigabytes a second?"

rows.original: Well, you’ve made your decision. You settle in for the long haul.
rows.translation: 好吧，你已经做出决定。你安顿下来，准备打持久战。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’ve made your decision. You settle in for the long haul."

rows.original: A few hours pass. You’re getting awfully hungry. There’s a vending machine available, offering some chips, cookies, and fizzy drinks, though none of them look particularly appetizing. You’re tempting to go to the merchant deck for something to eat, but... you decide instead to just fill up on water.
rows.translation: 几个小时过去了。你饿得厉害。这里有一台自动售货机，出售薯片、饼干和汽水，不过没有一样看起来特别诱人。你很想去商业甲板找点东西吃，可是... 最后还是决定只喝水填肚子。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few hours pass. You’re getting awfully hungry. There’s a vending machine available, offering some chips, cookies, and fizzy drinks, though none of them look particularly appetizing. You’re tempting to go to the merchant deck for something to eat, but... you decide instead to just fill up on water."

rows.original: Funny thing about filling up on water: it makes you pee a lot. You’ve been to the bathroom four times in the space of an hour, now. At least you’re well hydrated.
rows.translation: 灌了一肚子水有个好笑的地方：会让你尿个不停。一小时里你已经跑了四趟厕所了。至少你水分充足。
rows.raw: "\n\nFunny thing about filling up on water: it makes you pee a lot. You’ve been to the bathroom four times in the space of an hour, now. At least you’re well hydrated."

rows.original: You lounge in your seat and scratch at your groin, your pile of completed magazines slowly building to your right. You check the clock. You’ve been here for five hours.
rows.translation: 你懒洋洋地坐在椅子上挠着胯部，右边读完的杂志越堆越高。你查看了一下时间。你已经在这里待了五个小时。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lounge in your seat and scratch at your groin, your pile of completed magazines slowly building to your right. You check the clock. You’ve been here for five hours."

rows.original: Great.
rows.translation: 真棒。
rows.raw: "\n\nGreat."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_EMAIL_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_EMAIL_CD"

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_EMAIL_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_EMAIL_CD"

rows.original: There are some errands you’d like to get to today. As important as today is for both you and especially Paige, you’re sure she’d understand that you’re not too excited about staying in a room with nothing to do or to entertain you for twelve straight hours. You tell the droid you’ll be leaving.
rows.translation: 你今天还有一些差事要办。今天对你们两人、尤其是对佩姬固然重要，但你相信她能够理解：连续十二小时待在一间既无事可做、也没有娱乐的房间里，实在让你提不起兴致。你告诉机器人自己要离开了。
rows.raw: "There are some errands you’d like to get to today. As important as today is for both you and especially Paige, you’re sure she’d understand that you’re not too excited about staying in a room with nothing to do or to entertain you for twelve straight hours. You tell the droid you’ll be leaving."

rows.original: “Very well,” it answers curtly. “Expect a message on your codex when Miss Paige’s surgery has concluded.”
rows.translation: “很好，”它简短地答道。“佩姬小姐的手术结束后，您的终端会收到消息。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very well,” it answers curtly. “Expect a message on your codex when Miss Paige’s surgery has concluded.”"

rows.original: You’ll be sure to.
rows.translation: 你一定会留意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll be sure to."

rows.original: KALAS.TAVROS.PAIGE_HOUSE
rows.raw: "KALAS.TAVROS.PAIGE_HOUSE"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Operating Room Lobby
rows.raw: "Operating Room Lobby"

rows.original: The next morning, you and Paige are in Tavros’s Medical Bay, normally inaccessible to the public, at the waiting lobby for the operating room. The process to pay for Paige’s surgery and get everything in line was surprisingly succinct: Paige did most of the paperwork (which was ironic and sort of cruel, considering) while you just threw money around until you got what you wanted. With the advancements of modern medicine, and with Tavros Station being fairly tame in terms of disease or injuries, there was no wait time: you got started immediately on fixing Paige’s eyes.
rows.translation: 第二天早上，你和佩姬来到塔夫罗斯站医疗湾内通常不对公众开放的手术室候诊区。支付佩姬的手术费、安排所有流程出乎意料地简洁：佩姬处理了大部分文书工作（考虑到她的情况，这既讽刺又有些残忍），而你只管不断砸钱，直到得到想要的一切。凭借现代医学的进步，加上塔夫罗斯站的疾病与伤情通常都较为温和，这里完全无需排队：你们立刻开始着手修复佩姬的眼睛。
rows.raw: "The next morning, you and Paige are in Tavros’s Medical Bay, normally inaccessible to the public, at the waiting lobby for the operating room. The process to pay for Paige’s surgery and get everything in line was surprisingly succinct: Paige did most of the paperwork (which was ironic and sort of cruel, considering) while you just threw money around until you got what you wanted. With the advancements of modern medicine, and with Tavros Station being fairly tame in terms of disease or injuries, there was no wait time: you got started immediately on fixing Paige’s eyes."

rows.original: Paige’s hand hadn’t left yours since you arrived in the bay. She giddily signed her papers and spoke with the nurses and helper droids and she chatted you up all morning, up until the very last step. Knowing that her future, a brighter future, was behind a pair of tightly shut, whitewashed metal doors – doors she could reach out and touch – changed her demeanor entirely.
rows.translation: 自从你来到这个泊舱，佩姬的手就没离开过你的手。她兴冲冲地签了文件，跟护士和助手机器人说话，整个上午都在跟你闲聊，一直到最后一个环节。想到自己的未来 – 一个更光明的未来 – 就藏在那对紧闭的、刷成白色的金属门后面；那门她一伸手就能碰到，她的神色便彻底变了。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige’s hand hadn’t left yours since you arrived in the bay. She giddily signed her papers and spoke with the nurses and helper droids and she chatted you up all morning, up until the very last step. Knowing that her future, a brighter future, was behind a pair of tightly shut, whitewashed metal doors – doors she could reach out and touch – changed her demeanor entirely."

rows.original: She had been dragging you by the hand back and forth across the room since they had put you two there. When she sat you both down, she couldn’t sit for a few minutes before she got back up. She had been mostly silent, and she kept shrugging her shoulders and kicking her legs, resetting her clothes.
rows.translation: 自从他们把你俩安置在那儿，她就一直拉着你的手在房间里来回走动。她把你们俩都按坐下时，她坐不了几分钟就又站起来。她大多时候都不说话，还不停地耸肩膀、踢腿，重整自己的衣服。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe had been dragging you by the hand back and forth across the room since they had put you two there. When she sat you both down, she couldn’t sit for a few minutes before she got back up. She had been mostly silent, and she kept shrugging her shoulders and kicking her legs, resetting her clothes."

rows.original: “Nervous?” you ask her.
rows.translation: “紧张吗？”你问她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nervous?” you ask her."

rows.original: “G-Gods, how can I not be?” she asks back. “[pc.name], I’ve been blind for
rows.translation: “天、天神啊，我怎么可能不这样？”她反问道。“[pc.name]，我瞎了
rows.raw: "\n\n“G-Gods, how can I not be?” she asks back. “[pc.name], I’ve been blind for "

rows.original: days. I’ve counted. I had been pinching credits to save up for this. I thought I was going to be old and grey by the time I could see again. And it’s....” She stops and approaches the door, resting her hand on its smooth, cool, metal frame. “It’s right there.”
rows.translation: 天。我数过。我一直省吃俭用攒信用点，就是为了这件事。我原以为自己要等到头发花白才能重新看见。而现在....”她停下话语，走到门前，将手放在光滑、冰冷的金属门框上。“它就在那里。”
rows.raw: " days. I’ve counted. I had been pinching credits to save up for this. I thought I was going to be old and grey by the time I could see again. And it’s....” She stops and approaches the door, resting her hand on its smooth, cool, metal frame. “It’s right there.”"

rows.original: “We could call it off, if you’d like,” you snicker.
rows.translation: “你要是愿意，我们也可以取消，”你窃笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We could call it off, if you’d like,” you snicker."

rows.original: “Don’t even joke!” she spits, but she smiles, knowing you’re just trying to calm her down. “I’ve wanted to look Iddi in his adorable monitor since I first got him. I’ll be able to see the stars again after this! I can go back to photography, or navigation! And,” she says, squeezing your hand and turning to look you in the eyes (or thereabouts), “I’ll be able to look my lovely sponsor in the eye....” She pulls you closer, whispering the last words to you, “and maybe give [pc.himHer] a proper thank-you later.”
rows.translation: “别拿这个开玩笑！”她啐道，却又露出微笑，明白你只是想让她放松。“自从得到伊迪那天起，我就一直想亲眼看看他那台可爱的显示器。做完手术后，我又能看到群星了！我可以重新从事摄影，或者领航！”她握紧你的手，转身望向你的双眼（或者至少是大概方向），继续说道，“而且我还能直视我那可爱的赞助者....”她将你拉近，在耳边低语最后几句话：“也许稍后还能好好感谢[pc.himHer]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t even joke!” she spits, but she smiles, knowing you’re just trying to calm her down. “I’ve wanted to look Iddi in his adorable monitor since I first got him. I’ll be able to see the stars again after this! I can go back to photography, or navigation! And,” she says, squeezing your hand and turning to look you in the eyes (or thereabouts), “I’ll be able to look my lovely sponsor in the eye....” She pulls you closer, whispering the last words to you, “and maybe give [pc.himHer] a proper thank-you later.”"

rows.original: The white metal doors hiss and quickly slide open, startling you two. “Miss Paige?” asks a nurse droid, hovering five feet off the ground. Its single lens rotates in its socket as it scans the room for its patient. A second droid accompanies it, equipped with two padded ‘arms’ on its frame for Paige to grasp onto. “We’re ready for you.”
rows.translation: 白色金属门发出嘶声，迅速滑开，把你们俩吓了一跳。“佩姬小姐？”一台悬浮在离地五英尺处的护士机器人问道。它唯一的镜头在插槽内转动，扫描房间寻找患者。另一台机器人跟在旁边，框架上配有两条带软垫的‘手臂’，供佩姬抓握。“我们已经准备好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white metal doors hiss and quickly slide open, startling you two. “Miss Paige?” asks a nurse droid, hovering five feet off the ground. Its single lens rotates in its socket as it scans the room for its patient. A second droid accompanies it, equipped with two padded ‘arms’ on its frame for Paige to grasp onto. “We’re ready for you.”"

rows.original: Paige stands still, taking a deep breath through her nose and out her mouth. “Okay.” For the first time that day, she lets go of your hand. “[pc.name],” she says, looking over her shoulder as she approaches the droid with arms. She smiles that confident, loving smile at you as she finds the droid with her hand. “I’ll see you later.”
rows.translation: 佩姬站着不动，用鼻子深吸一口气，再从嘴里呼出。“好。”那天她第一次松开了你的手。“[pc.name]，”她说着，在走向那台带手臂的机器人时回头看你。她的手摸到机器人，同时向你露出那个自信而充满爱意的微笑。“回头见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige stands still, taking a deep breath through her nose and out her mouth. “Okay.” For the first time that day, she lets go of your hand. “[pc.name],” she says, looking over her shoulder as she approaches the droid with arms. She smiles that confident, loving smile at you as she finds the droid with her hand. “I’ll see you later.”"

rows.original: She and the droid walk into the surgery room, leaving you alone in the lobby with the other one. <i>“
rows.translation: 她与机器人走进手术室，把你和另一台机器人留在候诊区。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nShe and the droid walk into the surgery room, leaving you alone in the lobby with the other one. <i>“"

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: [pc.name]?” it asks, facing you. You acknowledge it. “Miss Paige’s surgery will take about twelve hours to complete. You’re welcome to wait here in the lobby if you’d like; if you’d instead like to leave, we can message your codex when she’s ready.”
rows.translation: [pc.name]？”它面对着你问道。你表示确认。“佩姬小姐的手术大约要十二个小时才能完成。如果你愿意，可以留在大厅里等候；如果你想离开，我们可以在她准备好时给你的CODEX终端发消息。”
rows.raw: " [pc.name]?” it asks, facing you. You acknowledge it. “Miss Paige’s surgery will take about twelve hours to complete. You’re welcome to wait here in the lobby if you’d like; if you’d instead like to leave, we can message your codex when she’s ready.”"

rows.original: You hum as you consider it.
rows.translation: 你沉吟着权衡了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hum as you consider it."

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_CD"

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_CD"

rows.original: Stay
rows.translation: 留下
rows.raw: "Stay"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Her sobs are muffled by your
rows.translation: 她的啜泣闷在你的肩窝里
rows.raw: "Her sobs are muffled by your "

rows.original: body
rows.translation: 身体
rows.raw: "body"

rows.original: [pc.upperGarments]
rows.raw: "[pc.upperGarments]"

rows.original: , her grip hard as iron on your hand and the arm locked around your shoulders almost tight enough to be painful. “[pc.name]” she repeats, struggling to maintain her composure. Every time she stiffens up, she promptly collapses into you again.
rows.translation: ，她的手像铁一样攥着你的手，搂在你肩上的手臂紧得几乎发疼。“[pc.name]”她重复着，努力维持镇定。每次她绷紧身子，紧接着又会软倒在你怀里。
rows.raw: ", her grip hard as iron on your hand and the arm locked around your shoulders almost tight enough to be painful. “[pc.name]” she repeats, struggling to maintain her composure. Every time she stiffens up, she promptly collapses into you again."

rows.original: You remain on her couch for a moment, holding your Ausar lover as she gets everything she needs out of her, out of her. You stroke at her back tenderly as you wait. “This is,” she tries to say, then stops to take a breath. “This is the nicest thing anyone’s ever done for me, [pc.name],” she tells you. “That’s... that’s five hundred thousand credits! Half a million! That’s....”
rows.translation: 你仍坐在她的沙发上，抱着自己的奥萨爱人，任她尽情宣泄心中所有情绪。等待期间，你温柔地抚摸她的后背。“这是，”她试着开口，却又停下来喘了口气。“这是别人为我做过最贴心的事，[pc.name]，”她告诉你。“那可是... 那可是五十万信用点！整整五十万！这简直....”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remain on her couch for a moment, holding your Ausar lover as she gets everything she needs out of her, out of her. You stroke at her back tenderly as you wait. “This is,” she tries to say, then stops to take a breath. “This is the nicest thing anyone’s ever done for me, [pc.name],” she tells you. “That’s... that’s five hundred thousand credits! Half a million! That’s....”"

rows.original: “Please stop reminding me,” you chuckle. “I’m not going to back down, but saying it over and over doesn’t make it easier.”
rows.translation: “求你别再提醒我了，”你笑道。“我不会反悔，但反复把数字说出来可不会让我轻松一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please stop reminding me,” you chuckle. “I’m not going to back down, but saying it over and over doesn’t make it easier.”"

rows.original: She laughs cutely between her sniffles. “Right.”
rows.translation: 她在抽鼻子的间隙可爱地笑了。“没错。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs cutely between her sniffles. “Right.”"

rows.original: You stay together for a bit longer, waiting for Paige to calm down. It takes her about ten minutes to completely settle, but neither of you break the embrace or the silence: you’ve taken your relationship to some other level now, something that words don’t do justice right at this moment. Well, except one word.
rows.translation: 你们又抱了一会儿，等佩姬平静下来。她大约花了十分钟才彻底安稳，但你们谁都没有松开怀抱，也没有打破沉默：你们的关系已经升到了另一个层次，此刻任何言语都不足以形容。嗯，除了一个词。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stay together for a bit longer, waiting for Paige to calm down. It takes her about ten minutes to completely settle, but neither of you break the embrace or the silence: you’ve taken your relationship to some other level now, something that words don’t do justice right at this moment. Well, except one word."

rows.original: “Are we calling this ‘love?’” she asks you. “Is that a strong enough word to be throwing around right now?”
rows.translation: “我们要把这种关系称作‘爱’吗？”她问道。“现在就把这么沉重的词挂在嘴边，真的合适吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are we calling this ‘love?’” she asks you. “Is that a strong enough word to be throwing around right now?”"

rows.original: You smile and squeeze her with both hands, one still holding hers and the other around her own shoulders. “What do you think?”
rows.translation: 你微笑着用双手将她抱紧，一只手仍握着她的手，另一只手则环住她的肩膀。“你觉得呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and squeeze her with both hands, one still holding hers and the other around her own shoulders. “What do you think?”"

rows.original: She leans back slightly, her nose against yours. “I’ll show you what I think.” She closes the gap and plants a kiss, right on your lips. Long, lingering, and loving.
rows.translation: 她稍稍向后仰，鼻子贴着你的鼻子。“我让你看看我怎么想。”她消去距离，在你唇上印下一吻。绵长、缠绵、充满爱意。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans back slightly, her nose against yours. “I’ll show you what I think.” She closes the gap and plants a kiss, right on your lips. Long, lingering, and loving."

rows.original: When she pulls away, her familiar, confident smile spreads across her lips. “So I’m worth exactly one million credits, am I, sweet thing?” she asks playfully. “If the surgery was one-million-and-one credits, is that the line?”
rows.translation: 她退开时，那种熟悉的、自信的笑容在她唇上绽开。“所以我正好值一百万信用点，是吗，小甜心？”她玩笑地问。“如果那台手术要一百万零一个信用点，那就是界线了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she pulls away, her familiar, confident smile spreads across her lips. “So I’m worth exactly one million credits, am I, sweet thing?” she asks playfully. “If the surgery was one-million-and-one credits, is that the line?”"

rows.original: “Oh, shut up,” you chide.
rows.translation: “哦，闭嘴吧，”你嗔道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, shut up,” you chide."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You sit with Paige in silence for a moment, contemplative. You’ve already made up your mind, but your heart needs a moment to catch up to your head. That’s an enormous amount of money you’re about to put down on Paige.
rows.translation: 你和佩姬沉默地坐了片刻，陷入沉思。你其实已经下定决心，只是心还需要一点时间才能追上理智。你马上要为佩姬付出的可是一笔巨款。
rows.raw: "You sit with Paige in silence for a moment, contemplative. You’ve already made up your mind, but your heart needs a moment to catch up to your head. That’s an enormous amount of money you’re about to put down on Paige."

rows.original: “Terra to [pc.name]?” Paige says playfully, nudging you after you don’t respond to her questions. “It’s okay; that price tag knocked me for a loop too. Don’t space out on me now!”
rows.translation: “泰拉呼叫[pc.name]？”佩姬开玩笑地说道，见你没有回答她的问题，便轻轻推了你一下。“没关系；那个价钱也把我吓傻了。现在可别在我面前走神！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Terra to [pc.name]?” Paige says playfully, nudging you after you don’t respond to her questions. “It’s okay; that price tag knocked me for a loop too. Don’t space out on me now!”"

rows.original: Your mouth is dry as you turn to her. Would she accept it? You don’t take Paige to be the type to accept a lot of handouts. But, there’s no point in beating around the bush. “I can afford that,” you say.
rows.translation: 你转向她时口干舌燥。她会接受吗？你不觉得佩姬是那种会接受别人施舍的人。不过，绕圈子也没意义。“这个我付得起，”你说。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour mouth is dry as you turn to her. Would she accept it? You don’t take Paige to be the type to accept a lot of handouts. But, there’s no point in beating around the bush. “I can afford that,” you say."

rows.original: Paige hesitates. “What?” she asks, her playful tone remaining. You’re sure she heard you clearly the first time.
rows.translation: 佩姬犹豫了一下。“什么？”她问道，语气中仍带着玩笑意味。你很确定她第一次就已经听清楚了。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige hesitates. “What?” she asks, her playful tone remaining. You’re sure she heard you clearly the first time."

rows.original: “I can afford that,” you say again. “You don’t have to be blind until you’re old. I can help you with your eyes, Paige.”
rows.translation: “我付得起，”你再次说道。“你不必一直失明到年老。我可以帮你治好眼睛，佩姬。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can afford that,” you say again. “You don’t have to be blind until you’re old. I can help you with your eyes, Paige.”"

rows.original: Paige’s eyes fixate in your direction. Her smile fades but her cheeks remain raised in hope. Her tail is still as could be, but her ears perk straight up, her undivided attention on you. “I, uh,” she stutters, at a loss for words for the first time since you met her. “That’s sweet, [pc.name], but even if you could, I don’t need a handout.”
rows.translation: 佩姬的目光凝在你身上。她的笑容淡了下去，但脸颊仍带着希望地抬着。她的尾巴一动不动，耳朵却直直竖起，全部注意力都在你身上。“我，呃，”她结巴起来，自你认识她以来第一次不知该说什么。“这话很贴心，[pc.name]，但就算你做得到，我也不需要施舍。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige’s eyes fixate in your direction. Her smile fades but her cheeks remain raised in hope. Her tail is still as could be, but her ears perk straight up, her undivided attention on you. “I, uh,” she stutters, at a loss for words for the first time since you met her. “That’s sweet, [pc.name], but even if you could, I don’t need a handout.”"

rows.original: “I’m not offering because you need one, Paige,” you insist, reaching out and grabbing her hand, squeezing it gently. “I’m not trying to solve the universe’s problems. I want to help you because...,” you gasp, trying to put your thoughts to words. Paige doesn’t interrupt and listens to you intently, her damaged eyes wide and her hand trembling in yours. “You’re more to me than just a teacher. I want to help you; I want to see you happy, and if that means half a million credits to fix your eyes, I’d pay it. I’d pay it twice over, if I had to.”
rows.translation: “佩姬，我提出这件事，不是因为你需要谁来施舍，”你坚持道，伸手握住她的手，轻轻捏了捏。“我不是想解决整个宇宙的问题。我想帮你，是因为...，”你吸了口气，努力将思绪化作语言。佩姬没有打断，只是专注地听着，受损的双眼睁得很大，放在你手中的手掌微微颤抖。“对我而言，你不只是老师。我想帮助你；我想看到你幸福。如果修好你的眼睛需要五十万信用点，我愿意付。哪怕必须付上两倍，我也愿意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not offering because you need one, Paige,” you insist, reaching out and grabbing her hand, squeezing it gently. “I’m not trying to solve the universe’s problems. I want to help you because...,” you gasp, trying to put your thoughts to words. Paige doesn’t interrupt and listens to you intently, her damaged eyes wide and her hand trembling in yours. “You’re more to me than just a teacher. I want to help you; I want to see you happy, and if that means half a million credits to fix your eyes, I’d pay it. I’d pay it twice over, if I had to.”"

rows.original: Paige is still as a statue and her expression goes narrow, processing what you’ve said to her. You can feel her pulse quickening in your hand and you can hear her hold her breath. “It’s,” she says, struggling with the words she feels she needs to say, “it’s too much money, [pc.name]. Spend it on something else.”
rows.translation: 佩姬僵得像座雕像，表情收紧，消化着你对她说的话。你能感觉到她在你手里的脉搏加快，也能听见她屏住了呼吸。“这，”她说，挣扎着说出她觉得自己必须说的话，“这钱太多了，[pc.name]。拿去买点别的吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige is still as a statue and her expression goes narrow, processing what you’ve said to her. You can feel her pulse quickening in your hand and you can hear her hold her breath. “It’s,” she says, struggling with the words she feels she needs to say, “it’s too much money, [pc.name]. Spend it on something else.”"

rows.original: “Paige!” you yell, frustrated, “stop thinking about your pride for a minute and just think about yourself! You can be seeing out of your own eyes again in a matter of days. I’m trying to help make your dream come true; stop trying to convince us both that you aren’t worth it!”
rows.translation: “佩姬！”你沮丧地喊道，“先别再想你那点自尊了，好好替自己考虑一下！再过几天，你就能重新用自己的眼睛看世界。我是在努力帮你实现梦想；别再试图说服我们两个人，觉得自己不值得这一切！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Paige!” you yell, frustrated, “stop thinking about your pride for a minute and just think about yourself! You can be seeing out of your own eyes again in a matter of days. I’m trying to help make your dream come true; stop trying to convince us both that you aren’t worth it!”"

rows.original: You bite your lip, waiting for Paige’s response. Her eyes begin to water and her own upper lip starts to quiver. Her other hand finds yours, still gripping her first, and trails its way up your arm, hurried and erratic as it crawls up your bicep to your shoulder, then to your neck and face. “[pc.name],” she says, then falls into you, burying her face into your shoulder. Her arm wraps tightly around you, and then she starts sobbing.
rows.translation: 你咬住嘴唇，等待佩姬回答。她的双眼开始泛起泪光，上唇也微微颤抖。她用另一只手摸到你仍握住她的那只手，沿着你的手臂向上移动，急促而杂乱地爬过肱二头肌、肩膀，最后抵达脖颈与脸庞。“[pc.name]，”她说道，随后扑进你怀中，将脸埋进你的肩膀。她紧紧抱住你，接着开始啜泣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bite your lip, waiting for Paige’s response. Her eyes begin to water and her own upper lip starts to quiver. Her other hand finds yours, still gripping her first, and trails its way up your arm, hurried and erratic as it crawls up your bicep to your shoulder, then to your neck and face. “[pc.name],” she says, then falls into you, burying her face into your shoulder. Her arm wraps tightly around you, and then she starts sobbing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You speedily backpedal, much to Paige’s chagrin. Maybe now would be a good time to leave...
rows.translation: 你迅速收回刚才的话，让佩姬颇为懊恼。也许现在正是离开的好时机...
rows.raw: "You speedily backpedal, much to Paige’s chagrin. Maybe now would be a good time to leave..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Are you sure? Five hundred thousand credits is not a small amount of money. Are you certain you want to spend it on Paige?
rows.translation: 你确定吗？五十万信用点可不是一笔小钱。你确定要把它花在佩姬身上吗？
rows.raw: "Are you sure? Five hundred thousand credits is not a small amount of money. Are you certain you want to spend it on Paige?"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Let’s be real, you can just hack them back in later.
rows.translation: 说真的，之后再把它们黑回来不就行了。
rows.raw: "Let’s be real, you can just hack them back in later."

rows.original: She’s worth every single one.
rows.translation: 她值得每一分钱。
rows.raw: "She’s worth every single one."

rows.original: Uh...
Uh...
Apparently, she’s not worth any. Dick move.
rows.translation: 看来她一文不值。真混蛋。
rows.raw: "Apparently, she’s not worth any. Dick move."

rows.original: Maybe you can come back when you have a bit of float to work with.
rows.translation: 也许等你手头有点余钱的时候可以再来。
rows.raw: "Maybe you can come back when you have a bit of float to work with."

rows.original: Her Eyes
rows.translation: 她的眼睛
rows.raw: "Her Eyes"

rows.original: Ask Paige about her eyes. She mentioned that she was interested in synthetic implants?
rows.translation: 问问佩姬关于她眼睛的事。她提过自己对合成植入物感兴趣？
rows.raw: "Ask Paige about her eyes. She mentioned that she was interested in synthetic implants?"

rows.original: Her Eyes
rows.translation: 她的眼睛
rows.raw: "Her Eyes"

rows.original: You ask Paige how her new eyes. How is she enjoying them?
rows.translation: 你问佩姬她的新眼睛怎么样。她用得还喜欢吗？
rows.raw: "You ask Paige how her new eyes. How is she enjoying them?"

rows.original: The question hits her a little harder than you expected, and she slowly begins to tear up as a warm, elated smile spreads across her lips. “I try not to think about it,” she laughs, “because then I start crying like a little girl over how happy I am. [pc.name], I really can’t thank you enough. You’ve... you’ve changed my life.”
rows.translation: 这个问题对她的触动比你预想的更深。她慢慢泪眼朦胧，嘴角却绽开温暖而欣喜的笑容。“我尽量不去想这件事，”她笑道，“因为只要一想，我就会因为太高兴而哭得像个小女孩。[pc.name]，我真的怎么感谢你都不够。你...你改变了我的人生。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question hits her a little harder than you expected, and she slowly begins to tear up as a warm, elated smile spreads across her lips. “I try not to think about it,” she laughs, “because then I start crying like a little girl over how happy I am. [pc.name], I really can’t thank you enough. You’ve... you’ve changed my life.”"

rows.original: You don’t try to play it humbly, knowing that downplaying it would be downplaying what having her eyesight back means to her. You say nothing as Paige’s hand reaches for your own, squeezing it tightly. “I was convinced I was going to stay blind until I was old. I had accepted it. I was willing to work for it. And you... Gods above, like a guardian angel, straight out of a storybook, you come along and you make me feel like the luckiest Ausar in the universe. You’d think being a pirate for a stint would have given me terrible karma, but, here you are.”
rows.translation: 你没打算谦逊地推托，因为你知道，若把这事说轻了，就等于把她重见光明对她的意义说轻了。佩姬的手伸过来握住你的手，紧紧攥着，你没有说话。“我本来确信自己会一直瞎到老。我已经认了。我也愿意为此努力。可你...老天在上，就像守护天使，活脱脱从故事书里走出来，你就这么出现，让我觉得自己是全宇宙最幸运的奥萨尔。你大概会以为当了一阵子海盗，我的业障一定重得不行，可你就在这儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t try to play it humbly, knowing that downplaying it would be downplaying what having her eyesight back means to her. You say nothing as Paige’s hand reaches for your own, squeezing it tightly. “I was convinced I was going to stay blind until I was old. I had accepted it. I was willing to work for it. And you... Gods above, like a guardian angel, straight out of a storybook, you come along and you make me feel like the luckiest Ausar in the universe. You’d think being a pirate for a stint would have given me terrible karma, but, here you are.”"

rows.original: She gets out of her seat and leans into you, placing her lips against your own gently. It’s a purely chaste, asexual kiss, and you respond in kind, stroking down her side as you enjoy the intimacy. “I had my future all planned out,” she says when she pulls away. “I was going to sit still for decades on end until I could see again. I have no idea what the future holds for either of us, [pc.name], and I love that. I love that. Not knowing what’s ahead; not knowing where we’ll be in a year, or a month, or even next week. But one thing I know is that,” she finishes, squeezing your hand even tighter, “wherever we’ll be, I’ll be with you.”
rows.translation: 她离开座位，倚进你怀里，轻柔地将嘴唇贴上你的唇。这只是一个纯洁而不带情欲的吻，你也以同样的方式回应，一边享受这份亲密，一边轻抚她的身体侧面。“我原本把未来全都规划好了，”她分开后说道。“我本来要一动不动地等上几十年，直到重新看得见。我不知道我们两人的未来会怎样，[pc.name]，而我喜欢这样。我喜欢这样。不知道前方有什么；不知道一年、一个月，甚至下周我们会在哪里。但我知道一件事，”她说完，更用力地握紧你的手，“无论我们在哪里，我都会和你在一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets out of her seat and leans into you, placing her lips against your own gently. It’s a purely chaste, asexual kiss, and you respond in kind, stroking down her side as you enjoy the intimacy. “I had my future all planned out,” she says when she pulls away. “I was going to sit still for decades on end until I could see again. I have no idea what the future holds for either of us, [pc.name], and I love that. I love that. Not knowing what’s ahead; not knowing where we’ll be in a year, or a month, or even next week. But one thing I know is that,” she finishes, squeezing your hand even tighter, “wherever we’ll be, I’ll be with you.”"

rows.original: You enjoy the warmth of the room together for a moment, sitting still and holding hands in the silence of her quarters. “To answer your question,” she says suddenly, back to her regular, upbeat self, “my eyes are great! I’m not going colorblind; they aren’t unfocused or anything; it’s as if I never lost them to begin with. I love that they’re mine, too. Grown in a tube somewhere, but with my stem cells, so they’re mine and not a donor’s, or some copper and metal fake eyes, or anything. They’re working great!”
rows.translation: 你们一起享受了片刻房间里的温暖，静静坐在她的住舱中，双手相握。“回答你刚才的问题，”她突然说道，恢复了平日开朗的样子，“我的眼睛好极了！我没有色盲；视线也没有失焦之类的问题；就像我从来没有失去过它们一样。我也很喜欢它们是我的。虽然是在某个培养皿里长出来的，但用的是我的干细胞，所以它们是我的，不是捐赠者的，也不是什么铜和金属做的假眼睛。它们运作得好极了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou enjoy the warmth of the room together for a moment, sitting still and holding hands in the silence of her quarters. “To answer your question,” she says suddenly, back to her regular, upbeat self, “my eyes are great! I’m not going colorblind; they aren’t unfocused or anything; it’s as if I never lost them to begin with. I love that they’re mine, too. Grown in a tube somewhere, but with my stem cells, so they’re mine and not a donor’s, or some copper and metal fake eyes, or anything. They’re working great!”"

rows.original: You’re glad to hear that.
rows.translation: 听到这个消息，你很高兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re glad to hear that."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Her Eyes
rows.translation: 她的眼睛
rows.raw: "Her Eyes"

rows.original: Ask Paige about her new eyes.
rows.translation: 问问佩姬她的新眼睛。
rows.raw: "Ask Paige about her new eyes."

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 已锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 已锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: You don’t know enough about her for this.
rows.translation: 你对她还不够了解，无法谈论这个。
rows.raw: "You don’t know enough about her for this."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外观
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Paige is a tall Ausar woman, standing just shy of 180 centimeters, or just below six feet. Your effects lay in a flat pool beside the bed, exactly where you left them before your sleep. You call out Paige’s name, and then Iddi’s. There’s no response from anywhere in the unit."

rows.original: You ask Paige about her skills as a navigator. Before you brought her onboard, you normally just went by whatever route the computer recommended you take.
rows.translation: 你询问佩姬身为领航员的本领。在带她上船之前，你通常只会按照计算机推荐的路线航行。
rows.raw: "You ask Paige about her skills as a navigator. Before you brought her onboard, you normally just went by whatever route the computer recommended you take."

rows.original: “Yep, and those routes will get you there just fine and all, but they don’t account for any celestial bodies between where you are and your destination,” she explains. “By slingshotting the ship around a moon or a planet’s gravity to build momentum, we can not only get to our destination in half the time, but we’ll also save a bit of fuel. Modern navigation systems don’t do that; they just give you a route from point A to point B.” She smiles, stands at attention, and points a thumb to her chest. “That’s where I come in!”
rows.translation: “没错，那些路线确实都能顺利把你送到目的地，但它们不会考虑你与目的地之间的任何天体，”她解释道。“让飞船借助卫星或行星的引力进行弹弓机动以积累动量，不仅能让我们用一半时间抵达目的地，还能节省一点燃料。现代导航系统不会这么做；它们只会给你一条从A点到B点的路线。”她微笑着立正，用拇指指向自己的胸口。“这就是我派上用场的时候了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep, and those routes will get you there just fine and all, but they don’t account for any celestial bodies between where you are and your destination,” she explains. “By slingshotting the ship around a moon or a planet’s gravity to build momentum, we can not only get to our destination in half the time, but we’ll also save a bit of fuel. Modern navigation systems don’t do that; they just give you a route from point A to point B.” She smiles, stands at attention, and points a thumb to her chest. “That’s where I come in!”"

rows.original: You’re no navigator yourself, and you tell her that you never would have thought of that. “Back when I was a pirate, it was a useful trick for catching up to a target - or getting out of a sticky spot in a hurry.”
rows.translation: 你自己并不是领航员，也坦言从没想过这种做法。“我当海盗时，这招很适合用来追上目标 - 或迅速摆脱麻烦处境。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re no navigator yourself, and you tell her that you never would have thought of that. “Back when I was a pirate, it was a useful trick for catching up to a target - or getting out of a sticky spot in a hurry.”"

rows.original: She frowns. “But, and I’m sure this might come as a surprise to you, space is a pretty big place. Taking these slingshots or, hell, even just taking the computer’s course, will take you through wild space. If that’s how I got around when I was a scallywag, you can bet credits to cashews that I’m not the only one that thought of it.”
rows.translation: 她皱起眉。“但是，我敢说这话可能会让你吃惊，太空可是个相当大的地方。用这些弹弓航道，或者，见鬼，哪怕只是走电脑算出的航线，都会带你穿过蛮荒星域。如果当年我还是个小混混时就是这么跑动的，那我拿信用点赌腰果，想到这一招的绝不止我一个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe frowns. “But, and I’m sure this might come as a surprise to you, space is a pretty big place. Taking these slingshots or, hell, even just taking the computer’s course, will take you through wild space. If that’s how I got around when I was a scallywag, you can bet credits to cashews that I’m not the only one that thought of it.”"

rows.original: You ask her if there’s an alternative. A slower, safer route, if you want to try and avoid any conflicts. “Well, like I said, space is really big. No matter how well-policed any system is, there’s going to be blind spots in their routes and patrols. Knowing when and where to strike was pretty important in the business.” She perks up. “But yes! There are more commonly-taken routes normally reserved for trade vessels that pirates and other ne’er-do-wells tend to avoid unless they have a plan. They add a few extra points to our ‘point-A-to-point-B’ journey, but they’re a measure safer than just flying into wild space.”
rows.translation: 你问她有没有其他选择。要是想尽量避免冲突，能否选择一条更慢、更安全的路线？“嗯，就像我说的，太空真的很大。无论一个星系的治安多么严密，航线与巡逻总会存在盲区。在这一行，知道何时、何地出手相当重要。”她精神一振。“不过确实有！还有一些较为常用、通常专供商船行驶的航线；除非已有计划，否则海盗和其他不法之徒往往会避开它们。这些路线会在我们的‘A点至B点’旅程中增加几个中转点，但比直接飞入荒野太空要安全一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if there’s an alternative. A slower, safer route, if you want to try and avoid any conflicts. “Well, like I said, space is really big.
