rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_CD"

rows.original: The lights in the room are very dim; it’s almost as if the room is candlelit. Paige rests on the hospital bed, sleeping soundly underneath the fresh covers, her arms and upper chest exposed. She’s wearing what appears to be a plain, baby-blue hospital gown – most discerningly, she has several layers of gauze wrapped around her head, pressed tightly against her eyes.
rows.translation: 房间里的灯光十分昏暗，几乎像只点着蜡烛。佩姬躺在病床上，在干净的被单下安稳沉睡，双臂与上胸裸露在外。她穿着一件看起来朴素的淡蓝色病号服。最引人注目的是，她的头上缠着好几层纱布，紧紧压在眼睛上。
rows.raw: "The lights in the room are very dim; it’s almost as if the room is candlelit. Paige rests on the hospital bed, sleeping soundly underneath the fresh covers, her arms and upper chest exposed. She’s wearing what appears to be a plain, baby-blue hospital gown – most discerningly, she has several layers of gauze wrapped around her head, pressed tightly against her eyes."

rows.original: Standing next to her bed is who you assume to be the surgeon that had worked on her. The doctor is a petite woman, standing up to Paige’s neck at her tallest; it’s difficult to make out her finer features in the shoddy lighting, other than her neck-length blonde hair and the fact that she’s human. She appears busy with some paperwork when you walk in; when you arrive, she lifts her head and smiles warmly at you.
rows.translation: 站在她床边的那个人，想必就是为她动手术的外科医生。这名医生身材娇小，即使站直也只到佩姬的颈部；昏暗的照明让人难以看清更细致的特征，只能看出她留着齐颈金发，而且是人类。你进门时，她似乎正忙着处理一些文件；见你到来，她抬起头，向你温暖地微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding next to her bed is who you assume to be the surgeon that had worked on her. The doctor is a petite woman, standing up to Paige’s neck at her tallest; it’s difficult to make out her finer features in the shoddy lighting, other than her neck-length blonde hair and the fact that she’s human. She appears busy with some paperwork when you walk in; when you arrive, she lifts her head and smiles warmly at you."

rows.original: “You must be [pc.name],” she says, her voice lower than you had expected. She reaches out her hand for you to shake, and you do so gladly. “My name is Tilim Hannoway. I’m the ophthalmologist that performed on Paige today.”
rows.translation: “你一定是[pc.name]，”她说道，嗓音比你预想的低沉。她伸出手与你握手，你欣然照做。“我叫蒂利姆·汉诺韦，是今天为佩姬动手术的眼科医生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must be [pc.name],” she says, her voice lower than you had expected. She reaches out her hand for you to shake, and you do so gladly. “My name is Tilim Hannoway. I’m the ophthalmologist that performed on Paige today.”"

rows.original: There’s a seat next to Paige that you gladly take once you release Hannoway’s hand. “That’s a five dollar word if I’ve ever heard one,” you laugh.
rows.translation: 佩姬旁边有个座位，与汉诺韦松开手后，你欣然坐下。“一听就是个值五美元的大词，”你笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a seat next to Paige that you gladly take once you release Hannoway’s hand. “That’s a five dollar word if I’ve ever heard one,” you laugh."

rows.original: “Imagine trying to spell it,” she laughs with you. “I’m happy to inform you that Paige’s operation was a complete success, with no complications at all. Miss Paige had asked us to wait for you before we woke her up, assuming she didn’t wake up herself first.” Hannoway smiles at you sweetly. “She probably wanted you to be the first thing she saw.”
rows.translation: “你想象一下那该怎么拼，”她跟你一起笑起来。“我很高兴地告诉你，佩姬的手术完全成功，一点并发症都没有。佩姬小姐要我们在叫醒她之前先等你来，除非她自己先醒了。”汉诺韦朝你甜甜一笑。“她大概是希望睁眼看到的第一个就是你了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Imagine trying to spell it,” she laughs with you. “I’m happy to inform you that Paige’s operation was a complete success, with no complications at all. Miss Paige had asked us to wait for you before we woke her up, assuming she didn’t wake up herself first.” Hannoway smiles at you sweetly. “She probably wanted you to be the first thing she saw.”"

rows.original: “Well, let’s not keep her waiting,” you implore, gesturing to her. “Let’s see those baby blues of hers!”
rows.translation: “好了，别让她等急了，”你催促道，朝她比了个手势。“让我们看看她那双蓝眼睛！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, let’s not keep her waiting,” you implore, gesturing to her. “Let’s see those baby blues of hers!”"

rows.original: “Of course.” Hannoway reaches for a needle sitting on a tray next to Paige’s bed, full of a clear liquid. With a practiced swing, she removes its cap and sticks it into Paige’s wrist, pressing the plunger. When it’s empty, she removes it and tosses it into a bin mounted on the wall. Then, you wait.
rows.translation: “当然。”汉诺韦伸手拿起佩姬床边托盘上的一支针筒，里面装满了透明液体。她熟练地一甩，取下针帽，把针头扎进佩姬的手腕，推下活塞。针筒空了以后，她把它拔出来，丢进挂在墙上的垃圾桶里。然后，你们就等着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course.” Hannoway reaches for a needle sitting on a tray next to Paige’s bed, full of a clear liquid. With a practiced swing, she removes its cap and sticks it into Paige’s wrist, pressing the plunger. When it’s empty, she removes it and tosses it into a bin mounted on the wall. Then, you wait."

rows.original: You sit in tense silence, waiting for any sign of consciousness. It takes only a minute for the drug to work: Paige begins to stir, moaning deliriously on her bed, twisting her head from side to side. Her breathing halts for a moment, then she lets out a long sigh. “Hello?” she asks, her mouth dry.
rows.translation: 你紧张地沉默坐着，等待任何苏醒的迹象。药物只用了一分钟就起效：佩姬开始动弹，在床上神志不清地呻吟，头左右扭动。她的呼吸停顿了一瞬，然后长长地叹了口气。“有人吗？”她问道，口干舌燥。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit in tense silence, waiting for any sign of consciousness. It takes only a minute for the drug to work: Paige begins to stir, moaning deliriously on her bed, twisting her head from side to side. Her breathing halts for a moment, then she lets out a long sigh. “Hello?” she asks, her mouth dry."

rows.original: “I’m here, Paige,” you say gently, cupping her right hand in yours, stroking it with your thumbs.
rows.translation: “我在这儿，佩姬，”你轻声说，把她右手捧在手心，用拇指摩挲着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m here, Paige,” you say gently, cupping her right hand in yours, stroking it with your thumbs."

rows.original: “Mmmm, [pc.name]?” she asks, her head facing your direction. “Where am I? Why can’t I see you?”
rows.translation: “嗯，[pc.name]？”她把头转向你的方向问道。“我在哪儿？为什么看不见你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmm, [pc.name]?” she asks, her head facing your direction. “Where am I? Why can’t I see you?”"

rows.original: “It’s because you have gauze over your eyes.”
rows.translation: “那是因为你眼睛上蒙着纱布。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s because you have gauze over your eyes.”"

rows.original: Paige tentatively raises her left hand, gently feeling at her eyes and trailing her furry fingers over the bandages wrapped around her head. “Checks out.”
rows.translation: 佩姬试探着抬起左手，轻轻摸了摸自己的眼睛，毛茸茸的手指又顺着缠在头上的绷带抚过。“没问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige tentatively raises her left hand, gently feeling at her eyes and trailing her furry fingers over the bandages wrapped around her head. “Checks out.”"

rows.original: Hannoway steps forward, interrupting you two. “Miss Paige?” she says. “I’m Tilim Hannoway, your ophthalmologist. I’d like to–”
rows.translation: 汉诺韦走上前来，打断了你们俩。“佩姬小姐？”她说。“我是蒂莉姆·汉诺韦，你的眼科医生。我想——”
rows.raw: "\n\nHannoway steps forward, interrupting you two. “Miss Paige?” she says. “I’m Tilim Hannoway, your ophthalmologist. I’d like to–”"

rows.original: “My what?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My what?”"

rows.original: “I’m... your doctor. I performed your operation today.”
rows.translation: “我是...你的医生。今天是我给你做的手术。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m... your doctor. I performed your operation today.”"

rows.original: “Oh yeah,” she says drolly, “the cute human. Sorry. I’m a little... I’m not all here, yet.”
rows.translation: “哦，对，”她懒洋洋地说道，“那个可爱的人类。抱歉。我还有点...脑子还没完全清醒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah,” she says drolly, “the cute human. Sorry. I’m a little... I’m not all here, yet.”"

rows.original: “Thank you for the compliment!” the doctor replies earnestly. “I’d like to inform you that your operation was a complete success. We’ve transplanted your eyes without any complications.”
rows.translation: “谢谢夸奖！”医生认真地答道。“我很高兴地通知你，手术取得了圆满成功。我们已经移植了你的眼睛，没有出现任何并发症。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for the compliment!” the doctor replies earnestly. “I’d like to inform you that your operation was a complete success. We’ve transplanted your eyes without any complications.”"

rows.original: “Wicked.” She leans into her pillow, returning your hand-holding lazily. “Let’s get this thing off of me.”
rows.translation: “太棒了。”她靠回枕头，懒洋洋地回握你的手。“把这东西从我身上拆下来吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wicked.” She leans into her pillow, returning your hand-holding lazily. “Let’s get this thing off of me.”"

rows.original: Without a word, Hannoway reaches for a pair of scissors off the same tray she pulled the syringe. With a little more caution than the needle, she snips off the end of the gauze, then makes half a circle around Paige’s head. When she gets to you, she offers you the end she’s holding. “Care to do the honors?”
rows.translation: 汉诺韦一言不发地伸手，从刚才取出注射器的托盘上拿起一把剪刀。她比使用针头时更加谨慎，剪断纱布末端，再绕着佩姬的头剪了半圈。来到你面前时，她把手中那一端递给你。“想亲自完成这件事吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout a word, Hannoway reaches for a pair of scissors off the same tray she pulled the syringe. With a little more caution than the needle, she snips off the end of the gauze, then makes half a circle around Paige’s head. When she gets to you, she offers you the end she’s holding. “Care to do the honors?”"

rows.original: You’d love to.
rows.translation: 你非常乐意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d love to."

rows.original: The lights in the room are very dim; it’s almost as if the room is candlelit. Paige rests on the hospital bed, her arms and upper chest exposed. She’s wearing what appears to be a plain, baby-blue hospital gown – most discerningly, she has several layers of gauze wrapped around her head, pressed tightly against her eyes.
rows.translation: 房间里的灯光十分昏暗，几乎像只点着蜡烛。佩姬躺在病床上，双臂与上胸裸露在外。她穿着一件看起来朴素的淡蓝色病号服。最引人注目的是，她的头上缠着好几层纱布，紧紧压在眼睛上。
rows.raw: "The lights in the room are very dim; it’s almost as if the room is candlelit. Paige rests on the hospital bed, her arms and upper chest exposed. She’s wearing what appears to be a plain, baby-blue hospital gown – most discerningly, she has several layers of gauze wrapped around her head, pressed tightly against her eyes."

rows.original: Standing next to her bed is who you assume to be the surgeon that had worked on her. The doctor is a petite woman, standing up to Paige’s neck at her tallest; it’s difficult to make out her finer features in the shoddy lighting, other than her neck-length blonde hair and the fact that she’s human. She and Paige are busy with some smalltalk by the time you walk in; when you do, she stops immediately and smiles at you warmly.
rows.translation: 站在她床边的那个人，想必就是为她动手术的外科医生。这名医生身材娇小，即使站直也只到佩姬的颈部；昏暗的照明让人难以看清更细致的特征，只能看出她留着齐颈金发，而且是人类。你进门时，她和佩姬正闲聊着；一见到你，她立刻停下，向你温暖地微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding next to her bed is who you assume to be the surgeon that had worked on her. The doctor is a petite woman, standing up to Paige’s neck at her tallest; it’s difficult to make out her finer features in the shoddy lighting, other than her neck-length blonde hair and the fact that she’s human. She and Paige are busy with some smalltalk by the time you walk in; when you do, she stops immediately and smiles at you warmly."

rows.original: “The guest of the hour is here, Miss Paige,” says the doctor. She extends her hand towards you. “I’m Tilim Hannoway, and I was Miss Paige’s acting ophthalmologist.”
rows.translation: “今晚的贵客来了，佩姬小姐，”医生说道。她向你伸出手。“我是蒂利姆·汉诺韦，曾担任佩姬小姐的主治眼科医生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The guest of the hour is here, Miss Paige,” says the doctor. She extends her hand towards you. “I’m Tilim Hannoway, and I was Miss Paige’s acting ophthalmologist.”"

rows.original: You accept the handshake, but stare at her blankly. “She was my surgeon,” Paige says. “It’s a bit of a five-dollar word, isn’t it, sweet thing?”
rows.translation: 你接受了握手，却茫然地盯着她。“她是我的外科医生，”佩姬说。“这词儿听着有点太高级了，对吧，小可爱？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou accept the handshake, but stare at her blankly. “She was my surgeon,” Paige says. “It’s a bit of a five-dollar word, isn’t it, sweet thing?”"

rows.original: Hannoway laughs. “Spelling it was a bit of a challenge at first,” she admits. “
rows.translation: 汉诺韦笑了。“一开始连拼写都是个不小的挑战，”她承认道。“
rows.raw: "\n\nHannoway laughs. “Spelling it was a bit of a challenge at first,” she admits. “"

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: [pc.name], you’ll be glad to hear that the operation on Miss Paige was a complete success; we’ve transplanted her new eyes without any complications.”
rows.translation: [pc.name]，你一定很高兴听到，佩姬小姐的手术取得了圆满成功；我们顺利移植了她的新眼睛，没有任何并发症。”
rows.raw: " [pc.name], you’ll be glad to hear that the operation on Miss Paige was a complete success; we’ve transplanted her new eyes without any complications.”"

rows.original: “Yes, the nurse droid told me,” you say, taking a seat next to Paige’s bed. You find her hand with yours, cupping it gently and stroking it with your thumb. Paige squeezes back lovingly, returning the gesture. “What’s left to do?”
rows.translation: “是的，护理机器人告诉我了，”你一边说，一边坐到佩姬的病床旁。你用自己的手找到她的手，轻柔地捧住，用拇指抚摸。佩姬充满爱意地握紧，回应你的动作。“接下来还要做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, the nurse droid told me,” you say, taking a seat next to Paige’s bed. You find her hand with yours, cupping it gently and stroking it with your thumb. Paige squeezes back lovingly, returning the gesture. “What’s left to do?”"

rows.original: “Nothing,” the doctor replies, “other than to remove the gauze. We were just waiting for you to get here.”
rows.translation: “什么也不用，”医生回答，“只要拆掉纱布。我们刚才只是在等你过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing,” the doctor replies, “other than to remove the gauze. We were just waiting for you to get here.”"

rows.original: “Sorry I’m late, then,” you say to Paige as Hannoway reaches for a tray next to the bed, pulling out a pair of scissors. With some caution, she makes one quick snip against the fabric, starting an unraveling line around Paige’s head. Paige herself is calm, and even a little apprehensive, nervous of the results of the surgery.
rows.translation: “那就抱歉来晚了，”你对佩姬说道。汉诺韦伸手拿起床边托盘上的剪刀。她小心翼翼地在布料上迅速剪了一下，开始沿佩姬头部绕圈拆开。佩姬本人很平静，却也有些忐忑，对手术结果感到紧张。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry I’m late, then,” you say to Paige as Hannoway reaches for a tray next to the bed, pulling out a pair of scissors. With some caution, she makes one quick snip against the fabric, starting an unraveling line around Paige’s head. Paige herself is calm, and even a little apprehensive, nervous of the results of the surgery."

rows.original: When Hannoway gets to you, she offers you the end of the gauze. “Care to do the honors?”
rows.translation: 汉诺韦走到你面前，把纱布的一端递给你。“愿意由你来动手吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen Hannoway gets to you, she offers you the end of the gauze. “Care to do the honors?”"

rows.original: You’d love to.
rows.translation: 你非常乐意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d love to."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You release your hold on Paige’s hand and stand next to the bed, slowly and gingerly unwrapping the cloth from Paige’s head. You go slowly, less from dramatic effect and more because you’re sure she must be a little sensitive from the operation. The grip the gauze has on her gets looser with your every orbit around her, until you get to the last layer, and it falls away.
rows.translation: 你松开佩姬的手，站到床边，缓慢而小心地解开佩姬头上的布。你动作很慢，倒不是为了戏剧效果，更多是因为你确信她手术之后一定有点敏感。你每绕她一圈，纱布对她的束缚就松一分，直到最后一层，它滑落下来。
rows.raw: "You release your hold on Paige’s hand and stand next to the bed, slowly and gingerly unwrapping the cloth from Paige’s head. You go slowly, less from dramatic effect and more because you’re sure she must be a little sensitive from the operation. The grip the gauze has on her gets looser with your every orbit around her, until you get to the last layer, and it falls away."

rows.original: You hand the scissors back to Hannoway and grip onto Paige’s hand once again. There is a large, circular incision going from the bridge of her nose and around both eyes that’s been stitched together. The scar going across both eyes is still there, the fur gone and the tissue scarred. Her eyes are closed, her brown eyelids fluttering lightly – and then, she opens them.
rows.translation: 你把剪刀交还给汉诺韦，再次握住佩姬的手。从她鼻梁绕过双眼，有一道缝合起来的大型环形切口。横贯双眼的旧伤疤依然存在，毛发脱落，组织也留下瘢痕。她闭着眼睛，棕色眼睑轻轻颤动，随后她睁开了双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hand the scissors back to Hannoway and grip onto Paige’s hand once again. There is a large, circular incision going from the bridge of her nose and around both eyes that’s been stitched together. The scar going across both eyes is still there, the fur gone and the tissue scarred. Her eyes are closed, her brown eyelids fluttering lightly – and then, she opens them."

rows.original: Before, her eyes were bluish-gray and clouded with cataracts, with asymmetrical pupils as a result of her injury. What you see instead are brilliantly blue eyes, with perfectly healthy irises and large, dilated, round pupils. She grunts in pain at first and squeezes her eyes shut – with concentrated effort, she slowly blinks them open, adjusting to the light of the room: even dim as it is, it’s a little much. Her eyes find your hand first, then trail up your arm, then lock onto yours.
rows.translation: 以前，她的眼睛是带点蓝的灰色，被白内障蒙住，瞳孔因为受伤而不对称。而你现在看到的是一双明亮的蓝眼睛，虹膜完全健康，瞳孔又大又圆、张得很开。她起初痛得哼了一声，紧闭双眼；经过一番专注的努力，她慢慢睁开眼，适应房间里的光线，即便光线很暗，对她也还是有点刺眼。她的目光先找到你的手，再沿着手臂往上，最后与你的目光锁在一起。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore, her eyes were bluish-gray and clouded with cataracts, with asymmetrical pupils as a result of her injury. What you see instead are brilliantly blue eyes, with perfectly healthy irises and large, dilated, round pupils. She grunts in pain at first and squeezes her eyes shut – with concentrated effort, she slowly blinks them open, adjusting to the light of the room: even dim as it is, it’s a little much. Her eyes find your hand first, then trail up your arm, then lock onto yours."

rows.original: You stare at each other for a moment. Paige’s grip on your hand tightens almost painfully as she studies you and your features: from your eyes, to your [pc.lips] and [pc.face], to your eyes, then to your [pc.face] and your [pc.ears], to your eyes, to your [pc.hair] and back to your eyes. She bites her lower lip and chokes out a single, joyful laugh through a pursed smile as her new, young, functional eyes begin to moisten. “Good news,” she says to you and Hannoway as the tears quickly stream unabated down her cheeks, “the tears work.”
rows.translation: 你们对视了一会儿。佩姬端详着你，端详着你的模样：从你的眼睛，到你的[pc.lips]和[pc.face]，再到你的眼睛，然后到你的[pc.face]和[pc.ears]，到你的眼睛，到你的[pc.hair]，再回到你的眼睛；她握着你的手几乎攥得发疼。她咬住下唇，从抿起的笑容里挤出一声欢快的笑，那双新换的、年轻而功能完好的眼睛开始湿润。“好消息，”她对你说，也对汉诺韦说，泪水已经不受控制地顺着她的脸颊奔流，“泪腺能用了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at each other for a moment. Paige’s grip on your hand tightens almost painfully as she studies you and your features: from your eyes, to your [pc.lips] and [pc.face], to your eyes, then to your [pc.face] and your [pc.ears], to your eyes, to your [pc.hair] and back to your eyes. She bites her lower lip and chokes out a single, joyful laugh through a pursed smile as her new, young, functional eyes begin to moisten. “Good news,” she says to you and Hannoway as the tears quickly stream unabated down her cheeks, “the tears work.”"

rows.original: You’re content to sit there for as long as she needs, letting her see new things for the first time in a lifetime for her. “You’re blurry,” Paige criticizes, lifting her left hand to your face and watching herself touch your facial features. “Unless that’s just what [pc.race]s look like now.”
rows.translation: 你愿意陪她坐多久就坐多久，让她有生以来第一次看见各种新事物。“你看起来很模糊，”佩姬批评道，抬起左手摸向你的脸，看着自己触碰你的面部特征。“除非现在的[pc.race]都长这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re content to sit there for as long as she needs, letting her see new things for the first time in a lifetime for her. “You’re blurry,” Paige criticizes, lifting her left hand to your face and watching herself touch your facial features. “Unless that’s just what [pc.race]s look like now.”"

rows.original: “Your vision is blurry because your brain is trying to ‘relearn’ how to see,” Hannoway explains. “It’s a skill it’s had to make do without for a very long time, now. Give it a day or two. We’ll be keeping the lights dim until then.”
rows.translation: “你的视线模糊，是因为你的大脑正在试图‘重新学习’如何看东西，”汉诺韦解释道。“这项技能它已经很久都只能将就着不用了。给它一两天时间。在那之前，我们会一直把灯光调暗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your vision is blurry because your brain is trying to ‘relearn’ how to see,” Hannoway explains. “It’s a skill it’s had to make do without for a very long time, now. Give it a day or two. We’ll be keeping the lights dim until then.”"

rows.original: “She’s staying here?” you ask the doctor, keeping your gaze on your Ausar.
rows.translation: “她要留在这儿？”你问医生，目光始终落在你的奥萨尔身上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s staying here?” you ask the doctor, keeping your gaze on your Ausar."

rows.original: “Just for another day or two. We still need to do some rudimentary tests – you know, making sure she’s not colorblind or anything. We also need to remove her stitches, of course.” Hannoway steps towards the door, her hands in the pockets of her coat. “I’ll leave you two alone for now; I have some reports to file and I’m sure I’d just ruin the moment.”
rows.translation: “只需要再待一两天。我们还得做些基础检查，比如确认她不是色盲之类的。当然，也要拆线。”汉诺韦走向门口，双手插在外套口袋里。“我先让你们单独待着；我还有些报告要填，而且留在这里肯定只会破坏气氛。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just for another day or two. We still need to do some rudimentary tests – you know, making sure she’s not colorblind or anything. We also need to remove her stitches, of course.” Hannoway steps towards the door, her hands in the pockets of her coat. “I’ll leave you two alone for now; I have some reports to file and I’m sure I’d just ruin the moment.”"

rows.original: “Thank you,” Paige says to Hannoway as she leaves. “Thank you!”
rows.translation: “谢谢你，” 佩姬离开时对汉诺威说。“谢谢你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you,” Paige says to Hannoway as she leaves. “Thank you!”"

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_CD"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You spend the next twenty-four hours with Paige, easing her into her new sense of vision. You play silly games with each other: you ask her about the shapes and colors of various objects around the room, and you hold up some fingers and ask her how many you’re holding up. You write your name on a piece of paper, then you ask her to write hers. She finds inventive ways to describe your [pc.face] and she
rows.translation: 接下来的二十四小时里，你一直陪着佩姬，帮助她逐渐适应新的视觉。你们一起玩些幼稚的游戏：你问她房间里各件物品的形状和颜色，也举起几根手指，让她说出数量。你在一张纸上写下自己的名字，再让她写下她的名字。她想出各种新奇的方式描述你的[pc.face]，而她
rows.raw: "You spend the next twenty-four hours with Paige, easing her into her new sense of vision. You play silly games with each other: you ask her about the shapes and colors of various objects around the room, and you hold up some fingers and ask her how many you’re holding up. You write your name on a piece of paper, then you ask her to write hers. She finds inventive ways to describe your [pc.face] and she "

rows.original: admires how you keep your [pc.hair]
rows.translation: 欣赏你把[pc.hair]保持得
rows.raw: "admires how you keep your [pc.hair]"

rows.original: jokes about how she can see herself in your hairless head
rows.translation: 开玩笑说，她从你光秃秃的脑袋上能看到自己的倒影
rows.raw: "jokes about how she can see herself in your hairless head"

rows.original: . She loves every second of it: she can’t stop smiling or laughing at the smallest or the silliest jokes. When you’re too tired to keep going, you sleep on your chair next to her, resting your head next to her hand.
rows.translation: 。她享受其中的每一秒：再小再傻的笑话也能让她笑个不停。当你累得撑不下去，就睡在她旁边的椅子上，把头枕在她手边。
rows.raw: ". She loves every second of it: she can’t stop smiling or laughing at the smallest or the silliest jokes. When you’re too tired to keep going, you sleep on your chair next to her, resting your head next to her hand."

rows.original: She passes Hannoway’s follow-up exams easily, picking out her greens from her blues and reds, and her circles from her squares and triangles. Throughout the day, Hannoway turns the brightness up in the room until it’s as bright as the rest of the medbay. Removing the stitches was a simple, quick process, and by the time hour twenty-three rolls around, Paige has Hannoway’s clean bill of health to leave and go back to her unit on the residential deck.
rows.translation: 她轻松通过了汉诺韦的复查，能够从蓝色和红色中分辨出绿色，也能从正方形和三角形中认出圆形。当天，汉诺韦逐渐调高房间亮度，直到和医务室其他地方一样明亮。拆线过程简单迅速，等到第二十三个小时来临时，佩姬已经得到汉诺韦的健康许可，可以离开这里，回到住宅层的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe passes Hannoway’s follow-up exams easily, picking out her greens from her blues and reds, and her circles from her squares and triangles. Throughout the day, Hannoway turns the brightness up in the room until it’s as bright as the rest of the medbay. Removing the stitches was a simple, quick process, and by the time hour twenty-three rolls around, Paige has Hannoway’s clean bill of health to leave and go back to her unit on the residential deck."

rows.original: You still have to lead her through the station by hand because she doesn’t recognize where she is, and her muscle memory is thrown off by her sight. She warmly greets nearly everyone she passes, smiling and waving to them, telling them how good they look and wishing them a nice day. She’s quivering in excitement by the time you get her to her unit, excited to see her own housing for the first time – and to see her helper droid.
rows.translation: 你仍得牵着她的手带她穿过空间站，因为她认不出自己在哪里，视力也扰乱了肌肉记忆。她热情地问候几乎每个经过的人，向他们微笑挥手，夸赞他们看起来多么精神，并祝他们度过愉快的一天。等你把她送到住处时，她已兴奋得浑身颤抖，迫不及待想第一次看看自己的家，也想看看她的助手机器人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou still have to lead her through the station by hand because she doesn’t recognize where she is, and her muscle memory is thrown off by her sight. She warmly greets nearly everyone she passes, smiling and waving to them, telling them how good they look and wishing them a nice day. She’s quivering in excitement by the time you get her to her unit, excited to see her own housing for the first time – and to see her helper droid."

rows.original: “Iddi?” Paige yells when she walks in, less concerned with the décor and more about her robot. Right on cue, you hear the gentle humming of levitating pulsars from around the corner, and Iddi’s large monitor flits about.
rows.translation: “伊迪？”佩姬一进门就喊道，她不太在意装潢，更在意她的机器人。就在此时，你听到拐角处传来悬浮脉冲星轻柔的嗡鸣，伊迪的大显示器飘了过来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Iddi?” Paige yells when she walks in, less concerned with the décor and more about her robot. Right on cue, you hear the gentle humming of levitating pulsars from around the corner, and Iddi’s large monitor flits about."

rows.original: “Hello momma!” Iddi greets as usual. Rather than the usual small-talk between Paige and her droid, she lunges forward, wrapping her arms around Iddi’s monitor and hugging it tightly to her chest. “Wow!” Iddi exclaims, its monitor turning bright pink and its eyes turning to small crescents. “This is nice!”
rows.translation: “你好呀，妈妈！”伊迪照例打着招呼。佩姬这次没有像平常那样和她的机器人闲聊，而是猛地扑上前，双臂缠住伊迪的显示器，紧紧抱在胸前。“哇！”伊迪惊呼，它的显示器变成亮粉色，眼睛眯成小小的月牙。“这感觉真好！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello momma!” Iddi greets as usual. Rather than the usual small-talk between Paige and her droid, she lunges forward, wrapping her arms around Iddi’s monitor and hugging it tightly to her chest. “Wow!” Iddi exclaims, its monitor turning bright pink and its eyes turning to small crescents. “This is nice!”"

rows.original: Paige pulls away, looking Iddi at its large, pixelated, cartoonish eyes. She begins sniffling, on the verge of crying again, but nothing could break the huge smile on her face. “It sure is, baby,” she says, rubbing her hands along Iddi’s smooth, chrome frame.
rows.translation: 佩姬稍稍退开，看着伊迪那双硕大、像素化而卡通的眼睛。她开始抽鼻子，眼看又要哭出来，但没有任何东西能打破她脸上灿烂的笑容。“当然是，宝贝，”她说道，双手抚过伊迪光滑的镀铬框架。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige pulls away, looking Iddi at its large, pixelated, cartoonish eyes. She begins sniffling, on the verge of crying again, but nothing could break the huge smile on her face. “It sure is, baby,” she says, rubbing her hands along Iddi’s smooth, chrome frame."

rows.original: “Are you okay, momma?” Iddi asks concernedly.
rows.translation: “你没事吧，妈妈？”伊迪关切地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you okay, momma?” Iddi asks concernedly."

rows.original: “I’ve never been better, Iddi.” She leans in, planting a kiss on Iddi’s frame. “I had my surgery the day before yesterday. I can see you.” She runs a finger along Iddi’s monitor, watching its trail as she goes. “I can see you, Iddi. I’ve waited to see you since the day I got you.”
rows.translation: “我从没这么好过，伊迪。”她靠过去，在伊迪的框架上亲了一口。“我前天做了手术。我能看见你了。”她用一根手指划过伊迪的显示器，看着指尖一路移动。“我能看见你，伊迪。从得到你的那天起，我就一直在等着看见你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve never been better, Iddi.” She leans in, planting a kiss on Iddi’s frame. “I had my surgery the day before yesterday. I can see you.” She runs a finger along Iddi’s monitor, watching its trail as she goes. “I can see you, Iddi. I’ve waited to see you since the day I got you.”"

rows.original: Unexpectedly, Iddi’s eyes arc with pixelated eyebrows, and its background turns a dark blue. Iddi seems... scared, all of a sudden. “Are,” it asks haltingly, “are you gonna get rid of me?”
rows.translation: 出乎意料，伊迪的眼睛配着像素化的眉毛弯了起来，它的背景变成深蓝色。伊迪突然显得...害怕。“你会，”它结结巴巴地问，“你会把我处理掉吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nUnexpectedly, Iddi’s eyes arc with pixelated eyebrows, and its background turns a dark blue. Iddi seems... scared, all of a sudden. “Are,” it asks haltingly, “are you gonna get rid of me?”"

rows.original: “What?! Of course not!”
rows.translation: “什么？！当然不是！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?! Of course not!”"

rows.original: Iddi’s expression doesn’t change, apparently unconvinced. “But you don’t need me anymore.”
rows.translation: 伊迪的表情没有变化，显然并不信服。“可你已经不再需要我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s expression doesn’t change, apparently unconvinced. “But you don’t need me anymore.”"

rows.original: Paige presses her nose against the glass of Iddi’s monitor, squinting her eyes and taking a softer tone. “Iddi, you’re more to me than a helper droid. Hell, you’re more than a pet, too. It doesn’t matter whether I ‘need’ you or not, sweet thing; you’re a part of my life now, and I wouldn’t give you up for the world. JoyCo doesn’t need to know I’m not blind anymore, and even if they did, I’d like to see them try to take you from me!”
rows.translation: 佩姬把鼻尖抵在伊迪显示器的玻璃上，眯起眼睛，语气柔和下来。“伊迪，对我来说，你不只是个帮忙的机器人。见鬼，你甚至不只是一只宠物。我‘需不需要’你根本不重要，小甜心；你现在是我生活的一部分，我绝不会为了全世界放弃你。欢乐公司没必要知道我眼睛已经不瞎了，就算他们知道了，我倒想看看他们怎么把你从我身边抢走！”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige presses her nose against the glass of Iddi’s monitor, squinting her eyes and taking a softer tone. “Iddi, you’re more to me than a helper droid. Hell, you’re more than a pet, too. It doesn’t matter whether I ‘need’ you or not, sweet thing; you’re a part of my life now, and I wouldn’t give you up for the world. JoyCo doesn’t need to know I’m not blind anymore, and even if they did, I’d like to see them try to take you from me!”"

rows.original: Iddi’s eyes turn to its usual, happy crescents, and configures its background into repeating hearts of pink and red. Its pulsars thrust up, pressing its metal body against Paige’s. “I love you, momma!”
rows.translation: 伊迪的眼睛变回平日里开心的月牙形，背景也变成不断重复的粉红与鲜红爱心。它的推进器向上推起，让金属身体紧贴佩姬。“我爱你，妈妈！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi’s eyes turn to its usual, happy crescents, and configures its background into repeating hearts of pink and red. Its pulsars thrust up, pressing its metal body against Paige’s. “I love you, momma!”"

rows.original: “I love you too, baby,” Paige replies, hugging Iddi tightly. “And if you’re really worried about being ‘useful’ to me, I have a couple ideas on how you can still help around the house.”
rows.translation: “我也爱你，宝贝，”佩姬紧紧抱住伊迪，回答道。“如果你真的担心自己对我是否‘有用’，我倒有几个主意，能让你继续帮忙照看家里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you too, baby,” Paige replies, hugging Iddi tightly. “And if you’re really worried about being ‘useful’ to me, I have a couple ideas on how you can still help around the house.”"

rows.original: “Like how?”
rows.translation: “比如什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like how?”"

rows.original: Paige, in response, turns to you. “Well, I first need to speak with [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 佩姬闻言转向你。“嗯，我得先和[pc.name]谈谈。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige, in response, turns to you. “Well, I first need to speak with [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Paige takes a deep breath, in through her nose and out through her mouth, just like she had practiced in yoga. Her gaze is locked onto you, watching your every move and detail, almost like she’s staring you down. “There’s no real way to lead into this, I don’t think,” she says, “so, I’m just going to say it. [pc.name], I want you to take me with you on your crew.”
rows.translation: 佩姬深吸一口气，从鼻子吸入，再从嘴里呼出，就像练瑜伽时那样。她的视线紧紧锁住你，观察你的一举一动和每个细节，几乎像在死死盯着你。“我想这件事没什么自然的开场方式，”她说道，“所以我就直说了。[pc.name]，我想让你带我加入你的船员。”
rows.raw: "Paige takes a deep breath, in through her nose and out through her mouth, just like she had practiced in yoga. Her gaze is locked onto you, watching your every move and detail, almost like she’s staring you down. “There’s no real way to lead into this, I don’t think,” she says, “so, I’m just going to say it. [pc.name], I want you to take me with you on your crew.”"

rows.original: You tell her that you’d love to.
rows.translation: 你告诉她你很乐意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’d love to."

rows.original: “It’s because I – wait, what?”
rows.translation: “这是因为我...等等，什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s because I – wait, what?”"

rows.original: You have all the reasons in the known universe to bring Paige onto your ship. She used to be a navigator for Kiro back before her injury, and you could definitely use one. She’s a yoga master, and you could use a fitness instructor onboard to keep you and the rest of your crew in shape. She an expert combatant, capable of bringing down three Black Void pirates by herself. She’s been cooped up in her unit on Tavros for such a long time, she’s probably anxious as anything to get out and start seeing the universe again. And finally... Paige is more to you personally than any of those. You’d love to explore the stars with her by your side.
rows.translation: 已知宇宙里有无数理由让你把佩姬带上飞船。受伤前，她曾经为琪罗担任导航员，而你绝对用得上一位。她是瑜伽大师，船上也需要一位健身教练，让你和其他船员保持体形。她还是战斗专家，能够独自放倒三名黑色虚空海盗。她已经被困在塔夫罗斯站的住处里太久，大概无比渴望出门，再次开始探索宇宙。最后...佩姬对你个人而言，比所有这些理由都更为重要。你很乐意让她陪在身边，一同探索群星。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have all the reasons in the known universe to bring Paige onto your ship. She used to be a navigator for Kiro back before her injury, and you could definitely use one. She’s a yoga master, and you could use a fitness instructor onboard to keep you and the rest of your crew in shape. She an expert combatant, capable of bringing down three Black Void pirates by herself. She’s been cooped up in her unit on Tavros for such a long time, she’s probably anxious as anything to get out and start seeing the universe again. And finally... Paige is more to you personally than any of those. You’d love to explore the stars with her by your side."

rows.original: Paige smirks as you list off all the reasons why you’d like to make Paige an addition to your crew. She studies you, noting your sincerity and your body language, appreciating every word that comes out of your mouth. “I see you’ve given this some thought, too.”
rows.translation: 你逐条列举为何想让佩姬加入船员时，她露出得意的笑容。她审视着你，留意你的真诚与肢体语言，珍视你说出的每一个字。“看来你也已经认真考虑过这件事了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige smirks as you list off all the reasons why you’d like to make Paige an addition to your crew. She studies you, noting your sincerity and your body language, appreciating every word that comes out of your mouth. “I see you’ve given this some thought, too.”"

rows.original: You shake your head. “I had my mind made up a while ago. I was going to ask if you weren’t going to offer.” Still, you have some concerns. What about her yoga class? Is she going to close up shop for your sake?
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。“我早就下定决心了。就算你不主动提，我也打算开口问。”不过，你仍有些顾虑。她的瑜伽课怎么办？她要为了你把店关掉吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. “I had my mind made up a while ago. I was going to ask if you weren’t going to offer.” Still, you have some concerns. What about her yoga class? Is she going to close up shop for your sake?"

rows.original: “That’s what Iddi’s going to help me with,” she says, patting Iddi on top of its frame before facing its screen. “Momma’s going to go with [pc.name], Iddi. We’re going to explore the stars together. I need you to stay here.”
rows.translation: “这就是伊迪要帮我的地方，”她说道，轻拍伊迪的框架顶部，然后面向它的屏幕。“妈妈要跟[pc.name]一起走了，伊迪。我们会共同探索群星。我需要你留在这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s what Iddi’s going to help me with,” she says, patting Iddi on top of its frame before facing its screen. “Momma’s going to go with [pc.name], Iddi. We’re going to explore the stars together. I need you to stay here.”"

rows.original: “What will I do, momma?”
rows.translation: “妈妈，我该做什么呀？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What will I do, momma?”"

rows.original: “You’re going to look after my unit; my yoga studio; and my class, Iddi. Here’s what we’re going to do: I’m going to set up a video stream on [pc.name]’s ship, two-way. I’ll be able to see everything you see, and you’ll be able to see me. That way, no matter where I am in the galaxy, I’ll never be too far away from you, okay?”
rows.translation: “你要替我照看住处、瑜伽馆和课程，伊迪。我们这样安排：我会在[pc.name]的飞船上架设双向视频流。我能看见你所看见的一切，你也能看见我。这样，无论我身在银河系何处，都不会离你太远，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re going to look after my unit; my yoga studio; and my class, Iddi. Here’s what we’re going to do: I’m going to set up a video stream on [pc.name]’s ship, two-way. I’ll be able to see everything you see, and you’ll be able to see me. That way, no matter where I am in the galaxy, I’ll never be too far away from you, okay?”"

rows.original: “That sounds like fun!” Iddi answers, its screen turning green in delight.
rows.translation: “听起来挺好玩！”伊迪答道，它的屏幕欣喜地变成绿色。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That sounds like fun!” Iddi answers, its screen turning green in delight."

rows.original: “That’s right! I’ll still be able to teach yoga through you, Iddi, but you know enough to help my students on your own when I’m busy working with [pc.name]. And I’ll visit you every time we visit Tavros again, okay?”
rows.translation: “没错！我还是能通过你来教瑜伽，伊迪，不过我在忙[pc.name]的事的时候，你已经懂得够多，可以自己去帮我的学生了。还有，我们每次再回塔夫罗斯站，我都会去看你，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s right! I’ll still be able to teach yoga through you, Iddi, but you know enough to help my students on your own when I’m busy working with [pc.name]. And I’ll visit you every time we visit Tavros again, okay?”"

rows.original: “Okay!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay!”"

rows.original: “That’s my baby,” she finishes, planting another kiss on Iddi’s frame. She straightens herself and turns to you once again. “So! All that’s left is for me to pack my things and establish that video stream with Iddi. Is there anything else I should know about before I get started?”

rows.translation: “把门锁上，”佩姬告诉你，你照做了。房间死一般寂静；你和佩姬都沉默着进行调查，竖起耳朵寻找任何能证明还有别人与你们同处一室的声音。呼吸声、脚步声，任何东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lock the door,” Paige tells you, and you do. The room is deathly quiet; you and Paige are both silent as you investigate, your ears peeled for anything that could imply that someone was with you. Breathing; footsteps; anything."

rows.original: You both pace around the room, quietly searching in places where a person could be hiding, but, it being an open yoga studio, there aren’t many. The studio has a utility closet to hold mops and brooms, but once that was cleared, you and Paige both are left with nothing to go by – and it’s visibly upsetting Paige.
rows.translation: 你们俩在房间里来回走动，安静地搜查所有可能藏人的地方；但这里是一间开阔的瑜伽馆，能藏身之处并不多。馆里有个放拖把和扫帚的杂物间，可连那里也检查完后，你和佩姬便再无任何线索，而佩姬显然很恼火。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both pace around the room, quietly searching in places where a person could be hiding, but, it being an open yoga studio, there aren’t many. The studio has a utility closet to hold mops and brooms, but once that was cleared, you and Paige both are left with nothing to go by – and it’s visibly upsetting Paige."

rows.original: “This sucks!” she curses, flapping her arms uselessly against her sides. “I got all hyped up to finally catch the fucker that’s been wrecking my studio, and there’s nobody here!”
rows.translation: “真他妈糟透了！”她咒骂道，双臂徒劳地拍打身体两侧。“我好不容易兴奋起来，准备抓住那个一直破坏我瑜伽馆的混蛋，结果这里根本没人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This sucks!” she curses, flapping her arms uselessly against her sides. “I got all hyped up to finally catch the fucker that’s been wrecking my studio, and there’s nobody here!” "

rows.original: She rests her face in her hands, grunting loudly into her palms.
rows.translation: 她把脸埋进双手，对着掌心大声哼着。
rows.raw: "She rests her face in her hands, grunting loudly into her palms."

rows.original: She kicks at one of the mats in frustration, flipping it over, while she curses some more.
rows.translation: 她懊恼地踢向一张瑜伽垫，把它掀翻，同时继续骂骂咧咧。
rows.raw: "She kicks at one of the mats in frustration, flipping it over, while she curses some more."

rows.original: “Is there, like, some kind of hatch or something I don’t know about? Is there some kind of fancy new warp technology that’s established a wormhole in my yoga studio and only my studio?”
rows.translation: “是不是有什么我不知道的舱门之类的？是不是有什么花哨的新曲速技术，在我的瑜伽馆里开了个虫洞，而且只在我的馆里？”
rows.raw: " “Is there, like, some kind of hatch or something I don’t know about? Is there some kind of fancy new warp technology that’s established a wormhole in my yoga studio and only my studio?”"

rows.original: “Maybe it’s haunted,” you joke.
rows.translation: “也许它闹鬼，”你开玩笑说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe it’s haunted,” you joke."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The lights flicker, then short-circuit with a loud ‘CLANG!’ The light of the room begins to strobe irregularly, subjecting you to the darkness more often than not.
rows.translation: 灯光闪了几下，然后随着一声响亮的‘哐当！’短路了。房间里的灯光开始不规则地频闪，让你大部分时间都陷在黑暗里。
rows.raw: "The lights flicker, then short-circuit with a loud ‘CLANG!’ The light of the room begins to strobe irregularly, subjecting you to the darkness more often than not."

rows.original: Suddenly, the noises return, and in much greater frequency and high decibels. The scraping comes back in full force, and the whistling has become something just short of a wail, making it difficult to hear anything else. A rhythmic thumping reverberates throughout the studio, slowly growing louder over time.
rows.translation: 突然，那些声响又回来了，频率高得多，分贝也大得多。刮擦声卷土重来，呼啸声已经近乎哀号，让人几乎听不见别的。一阵有节奏的闷响在工作室里回荡，随着时间慢慢变得更响。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, the noises return, and in much greater frequency and high decibels. The scraping comes back in full force, and the whistling has become something just short of a wail, making it difficult to hear anything else. A rhythmic thumping reverberates throughout the studio, slowly growing louder over time."

rows.original: The yoga mat you happened to be standing on is yanked from underneath you, knocking you off your feet and sending you tumbling; before you lose your balance, something hits you on the back of the head, rattling what little vision you have in the darkness.
rows.translation: 你恰好站着的瑜伽垫突然从脚下被抽走，将你掀翻在地、摔得滚了出去；失去平衡之前，有什么东西击中你的后脑，让你在黑暗中仅存的一点视野也震颤起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe yoga mat you happened to be standing on is yanked from underneath you, knocking you off your feet and sending you tumbling; before you lose your balance, something hits you on the back of the head, rattling what little vision you have in the darkness."

rows.original: As soon as Paige hears something nearby, she takes a wild swing with a clenched fist, punching hard into the air. Some smaller debris from the mess begin to rise and circle around her, trapping her in a cyclone of common items – some large, some small, some dull, and some sharp.
rows.translation: 佩姬刚听见附近有动静，就握紧拳头胡乱挥出，狠狠打向空气。狼藉中的一些较小碎片开始升起，绕着她旋转，把她困进由常见物品组成的旋风中：有大有小，有钝有利。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as Paige hears something nearby, she takes a wild swing with a clenched fist, punching hard into the air. Some smaller debris from the mess begin to rise and circle around her, trapping her in a cyclone of common items – some large, some small, some dull, and some sharp. "

rows.original: Paige calls for your name, her arms up and against her body protectively, listening for anything that makes sense around her, but, blind as she is, the noises all confuse and shut out the one sense she does have.
rows.translation: 佩姬呼喊你的名字，双臂护在身前，努力聆听周围任何说得通的动静；可她本就失明，各种噪声全都混在一起，反而压过了她唯一还能依靠的感官。
rows.raw: "Paige calls for your name, her arms up and against her body protectively, listening for anything that makes sense around her, but, blind as she is, the noises all confuse and shut out the one sense she does have."

rows.original: Paige keeps her arms tight against her chest protectively, but she keeps still, afraid to approach any part of the tornado around her. She was looking to punch a burglar – what is she up against now?
rows.translation: 佩姬将双臂紧紧护在胸前，却一动不动，害怕靠近身边旋风的任何一处。她原本只是想揍个窃贼，现在面对的到底是什么？
rows.raw: "Paige keeps her arms tight against her chest protectively, but she keeps still, afraid to approach any part of the tornado around her. She was looking to punch a burglar – what is she up against now?"

rows.original: You scramble to your [pc.feet] and rush to Paige, forgetting about your own safety for now; all you want is to get to her and then leave the studio if you can. But when you reach your hand out, you feel a tight, painful snap around it: something hard and round has latched around your wrist, and it yanks you backward, throwing you against the far wall and latching to the surface. It’s too small to wriggle your hand through – you pull and you pull, but try as you might, you can’t wrest yourself free from the thing pinning your arm down.
rows.translation: 你手忙脚乱地用[pc.feet]撑起身子，冲向佩姬，一时把自己的安危抛在脑后；你只想赶到她身边，然后能走就离开这间摄影棚。可当你伸出手去，手腕上一阵紧绷的剧痛咔地锁紧：某个又硬又圆的东西扣上了你的手腕，猛地把你向后拽，把你摔向远处的墙壁，并牢牢吸附在墙面上。那东西的开口太小，你的手根本钻不出来——你拉啊拉，可不管怎么使劲，都没法从压住你手臂的玩意儿里挣脱出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scramble to your [pc.feet] and rush to Paige, forgetting about your own safety for now; all you want is to get to her and then leave the studio if you can. But when you reach your hand out, you feel a tight, painful snap around it: something hard and round has latched around your wrist, and it yanks you backward, throwing you against the far wall and latching to the surface. It’s too small to wriggle your hand through – you pull and you pull, but try as you might, you can’t wrest yourself free from the thing pinning your arm down."

rows.original: Dust kicks up in the windy circle around Paige, adding to the chaos around her. For her part, she does not panic: she focuses intently on her surroundings, flexing her ears
rows.translation: 尘土在佩姬周围的风圈中扬起，让她周遭的混乱更甚。至于她，并没有惊慌：她专注地感知着周围，抖动着耳朵
rows.raw: "\n\nDust kicks up in the windy circle around Paige, adding to the chaos around her. For her part, she does not panic: she focuses intently on her surroundings, flexing her ears"

rows.original: and keeping her eyes peeled
rows.translation: 并睁大眼睛留意着
rows.raw: " and keeping her eyes peeled"

rows.original: , but between the high-pitched wailing; the scraping
rows.translation: ，但尖厉的哀号、刮擦声
rows.raw: ", but between the high-pitched wailing; the scraping"

rows.original: ; the cyclone around her; the constant flashing of the lights
rows.translation: ；她周围的旋风；灯光不停闪烁
rows.raw: "; the cyclone around her; the constant flashing of the lights"

rows.original: ; and everything else going on, she couldn’t focus on any single thing.
rows.translation: ；再加上发生的其他一切，她没法专注于任何一件事。
rows.raw: "; and everything else going on, she couldn’t focus on any single thing."

rows.original: The lights go out, submerging you both in the darkness, and you can’t even watch. The whistling gets higher in pitch, only for a moment, and you hear what you think is Paige gasping, or calling out for help, until... it all goes silent. The bits surrounding Paige in her twister fall to the floor, shuffling and clanking all against each other in the darkness, and you’re left with no sound whatsoever.
rows.translation: 灯光熄灭，把你们俩都沉入黑暗，你甚至无法观看。呼啸声的音调短暂地升得更高，你听见一个仿佛是佩姬倒吸凉气、或出声求救的声音，直到...一切突然归于寂静。旋风中围绕佩姬的杂物纷纷落地，在黑暗中彼此摩擦碰撞，而你再也听不到任何声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lights go out, submerging you both in the darkness, and you can’t even watch. The whistling gets higher in pitch, only for a moment, and you hear what you think is Paige gasping, or calling out for help, until... it all goes silent. The bits surrounding Paige in her twister fall to the floor, shuffling and clanking all against each other in the darkness, and you’re left with no sound whatsoever."

rows.original: You call Paige’s name a few times, and she never responds. The thing holding your wrist in place is steadfast, no matter how hard you try. Then, you hear footsteps....
rows.translation: 你几次呼喊佩姬的名字，她始终没有回应。无论如何挣扎，固定你手腕的东西都纹丝不动。随后，你听见了脚步声....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou call Paige’s name a few times, and she never responds. The thing holding your wrist in place is steadfast, no matter how hard you try. Then, you hear footsteps...."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You fall to the floor, the clasp keeping you against the wall bouncing off the floor with metallic tumbles. You fall to your knees and rub at your wrist to ease the pain there, your eyes ahead of you for anything, but you can’t see in the total darkness. You say Paige’s name once more, and once more, she doesn’t respond.
rows.translation: 你摔到地上，原本将你固定在墙上的扣环也跌落下来，发出一连串金属撞击声。你跪倒在地，揉着手腕缓解疼痛，双眼紧盯前方寻找任何动静，可绝对的黑暗让你什么也看不见。你又喊了一次佩姬的名字，她仍没有回应。
rows.raw: "You fall to the floor, the clasp keeping you against the wall bouncing off the floor with metallic tumbles. You fall to your knees and rub at your wrist to ease the pain there, your eyes ahead of you for anything, but you can’t see in the total darkness. You say Paige’s name once more, and once more, she doesn’t respond."

rows.original: The lights come on suddenly, brighter than before. They blind you, and you flinch your eyes closed, squinting through splayed fingers to try and see what happened to your Ausar. You see the silhouette of a figure in the room with you, and then footsteps once again. Paige doesn’t respond to anything.
rows.translation: 灯光突然亮起，比之前更加刺眼。光芒晃瞎了你，你猛地闭眼，从张开的指缝间眯眼查看佩姬出了什么事。你看见房间里有个人影，紧接着脚步声再度响起。佩姬对任何动静都毫无回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lights come on suddenly, brighter than before. They blind you, and you flinch your eyes closed, squinting through splayed fingers to try and see what happened to your Ausar. You see the silhouette of a figure in the room with you, and then footsteps once again. Paige doesn’t respond to anything."

rows.original: When your eyes adjust, you get a better image of the person in the room with you. It’s definitely Paige, you’d recognize her Ausar form and fur coloration anywhere – but she’s different. She’s facing away from you, and her hands run over her body inquisitively, unfamiliar with herself. Her tail, once adorned with fine, streamlined fur, is now bushy and fluffy, its fur standing on end and thick as her waist. Her previously-pointy, triangular ears are now slightly rounded, taking a more circular shape. Her hair is suddenly much longer: before, it only went to her shoulders, and now, it reaches halfway down her back.
rows.translation: 等眼睛适应了，你看清了和你同处一室的那个人。那绝对是佩姬，她奥萨尔的形体和毛色你绝不会认错 – 可她又不太一样。她背对着你，双手带着探究意味地抚过自己的身体，像是在摸索一个陌生的自己。她那条原本覆着细密顺滑毛发的尾巴，如今蓬松又毛茸茸，毛全都竖着，粗得跟她的腰一样。原先尖尖的三角耳，现在略微变圆，形状更接近圆形。她的头发忽然长了许多：以前只到肩膀，现在垂到后背一半。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen your eyes adjust, you get a better image of the person in the room with you. It’s definitely Paige, you’d recognize her Ausar form and fur coloration anywhere – but she’s different. She’s facing away from you, and her hands run over her body inquisitively, unfamiliar with herself. Her tail, once adorned with fine, streamlined fur, is now bushy and fluffy, its fur standing on end and thick as her waist. Her previously-pointy, triangular ears are now slightly rounded, taking a more circular shape. Her hair is suddenly much longer: before, it only went to her shoulders, and now, it reaches halfway down her back."

rows.original: “Paige?” you ask her, hoping she’ll respond. You have no idea what happened to her when the lights went out; you hope it really is Paige in the room with you.
rows.translation: “佩姬？”你问她，希望她能回应。灯灭时她遭遇了什么你完全不知道；你希望房间里和你在一起的真的是佩姬。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Paige?” you ask her, hoping she’ll respond. You have no idea what happened to her when the lights went out; you hope it really is Paige in the room with you."

rows.original: The figure turns about slowly, staring at her fingers and flexing them repeatedly. Her muzzle has become noticeably squashed and rounded, looking less like an Ausar
rows.translation: 那个人影慢慢转身，盯着自己的手指，反复屈伸。她的口鼻部明显变得扁平圆润，看起来不再那么像奥萨尔人
rows.raw: "\n\nThe figure turns about slowly, staring at her fingers and flexing them repeatedly. Her muzzle has become noticeably squashed and rounded, looking less like an Ausar"

rows.original: Kui-Tan
rows.raw: "Kui-Tan"

rows.original: , and more like... something else
rows.translation: ，更像...别的东西
rows.raw: ", and more like... something else"

rows.original: and more like a Kui-Tan
rows.translation: ，反而更像奎坦人
rows.raw: " and more like a Kui-Tan"

rows.original: . Her hands explore her torso, especially around her tummy, her fingers playing with the ridges of her abs there. And, most prominent of the figure in front of you, the loose sweatpants are tented with what could be nothing else but a massive, barely-restrained erection.
rows.translation: 。她的双手探索着自己的躯干，尤其是小腹周围，手指拨弄着那里腹肌的道道隆起。而眼前人影最显眼之处，是宽松运动裤被某样东西高高撑起，那除了一个巨大无比、几乎压制不住的勃起外不可能是别的东西。
rows.raw: ". Her hands explore her torso, especially around her tummy, her fingers playing with the ridges of her abs there. And, most prominent of the figure in front of you, the loose sweatpants are tented with what could be nothing else but a massive, barely-restrained erection."

rows.original: “‘Paige?’” the figure responds. It’s definitely Paige’s voice, and it looks like Paige’s body, but there are just too many differences to say that it’s truly Paige you’re speaking with. “Is that her name?” she asks-as-a-statement and not as a question.
rows.translation: “‘佩姬？’”那个人影回应道。声音无疑属于佩姬，身体看起来也像佩姬，可差异实在太多，让你无法断言正在交谈的真是佩姬。“她叫这个名字？”她用陈述而非疑问的语气问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Paige?’” the figure responds. It’s definitely Paige’s voice, and it looks like Paige’s body, but there are just too many differences to say that it’s truly Paige you’re speaking with. “Is that her name?” she asks-as-a-statement and not as a question."

rows.original: The figure hums in frustration as she studies her fingers, then her body and room around her. Her fingers lightly scratch at her eyes, then around her face, feeling for any obstructions or clothing. “She’s blind,” she says. “Poor girl. I don’t know if I can fix that.” She squeezes her eyes shut, scrunching her face tightly – and when she opens them again, her eyes glow an eerie, iridescent green, ghostly flames licking out from the sockets of her eyes. “This will have to do for now.”
rows.translation: 那个人影一边研究手指，又打量自己的身体和周围房间，一边烦躁地哼声。她用手指轻轻挠着眼睛和面部周围，摸索是否有什么障碍或衣物。“她失明了，”她说道。“可怜的姑娘。我不知道能不能治好。”她紧闭双眼，整张脸用力皱起；再睁开时，双眼散发着诡异的虹彩绿光，幽灵般的火焰从眼窝中舔出。“目前只能先这样了。”
rows.raw: "The figure hums in frustration as she studies her fingers, then her body and room around her. Her fingers lightly scratch at her eyes, then around her face, feeling for any obstructions or clothing. “She’s blind,” she says. “Poor girl. I don’t know if I can fix that.” She squeezes her eyes shut, scrunching her face tightly – and when she opens them again, her eyes glow an eerie, iridescent green, ghostly flames licking out from the sockets of her eyes. “This will have to do for now.”"

rows.original: As you study the figure’s form, you get a look at her face, past the muzzle and into her eyes. Paige’s deep, striking blue eyes are gone – and are replaced instead by vivid green ones. They shimmer every time she blinks or focuses her vision on something in the room.
rows.translation: 当你打量这具身躯的轮廓时，你越过口鼻看到了她的脸，望进她的眼睛。佩姬那双深邃夺目的蓝眼睛不见了 – 取而代之的是鲜亮的绿色双眼。每当她眨眼，或把视线聚焦在房间里某样东西上，它们都会微微闪光。
rows.raw: "As you study the figure’s form, you get a look at her face, past the muzzle and into her eyes. Paige’s deep, striking blue eyes are gone – and are replaced instead by vivid green ones. They shimmer every time she blinks or focuses her vision on something in the room."

rows.original: The figure nods appreciatively every time it finds a new facet of her own body to explore. She grips at nothing, enjoying the strength in her fingers; she hefts her breasts, admiring their pertness and tightness; she runs her fingers over her abs, cooing at the strength and flexibility within her belly; she unabashedly dips her hand underneath the waistband of her sweatpants, giving the raging hard-on a tug before dipping her hand a little lower and laughing delightedly at what she finds back there.
rows.translation: 每当发现自己身体又有一处值得探索的新特点，那个人影都会赞赏地点头。她对着空气抓握，享受手指中的力量；她托起乳房，欣赏那份挺翘紧实；她用手指抚过腹肌，为腹部蕴含的力量与柔韧娇声赞叹；她毫不避讳地把手伸进运动裤腰带下方，拉扯怒胀的勃起，随后把手探得更低，为后面摸到的东西欣喜地笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe figure nods appreciatively every time it finds a new facet of her own body to explore. She grips at nothing, enjoying the strength in her fingers; she hefts her breasts, admiring their pertness and tightness; she runs her fingers over her abs, cooing at the strength and flexibility within her belly; she unabashedly dips her hand underneath the waistband of her sweatpants, giving the raging hard-on a tug before dipping her hand a little lower and laughing delightedly at what she finds back there."

rows.original: “Not used to Ausar equipment, but gods damn, what a body!” she cheers excitedly, groping at herself at irregular intervals, unable to keep herself from herself. “Thirty-some-odd years without a body, and I fucking nail the jackpot!”
rows.translation: “不太习惯奥萨尔的这副装备，但老天啊，这身子真棒！”她兴奋地欢呼，时不时就摸自己一把，忍不住对自己动手。 “三十多年没有身体，结果我他妈一举中了头奖！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not used to Ausar equipment, but gods damn, what a body!” she cheers excitedly, groping at herself at irregular intervals, unable to keep herself from herself. “Thirty-some-odd years without a body, and I fucking nail the jackpot!”"

rows.original: Frankly, you’re not sure what to think or do. Whoever is standing right in front of you resembles Paige, quite a bit, but she’s not Paige. You don’t move, trying to process what’s happened in this room, and what’s happened to Paige, if that’s truly her.

rows.translation: 困难模式
rows.raw: "Hard Mode"

rows.original: That is still beyond your capabilities.
rows.translation: 那仍然超出了你的能力范围。
rows.raw: "That is still beyond your capabilities."

rows.original: Other
rows.translation: 其他
rows.raw: "Other"

rows.original: Other
rows.translation: 其他
rows.raw: "Other"

rows.original: This is for non-bipeds and creatures made of goo.
rows.translation: 这是给非双足生物和黏液生物用的。
rows.raw: "This is for non-bipeds and creatures made of goo."

rows.original: PAIGE_COMA_CD
rows.raw: "PAIGE_COMA_CD"

rows.original: You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with the door locked and the closed sign, you remember that Paige is currently undergoing her operation. It might be best to return after she has recovered from the procedure.
rows.translation: 你来到佩姬的瑜伽课程与讲习班前，却发现大门紧锁，还挂着歇业牌，于是想起佩姬目前正在接受手术。最好等她从手术中恢复后再来。
rows.raw: "You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with the door locked and the closed sign, you remember that Paige is currently undergoing her operation. It might be best to return after she has recovered from the procedure."

rows.original: You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with the door locked and the closed sign, you recall that Paige is unable to hold her seminars while she is employed as a crew member of your ship!
rows.translation: 你来到佩姬的瑜伽课程与讲习班前，却发现大门紧锁，还挂着歇业牌，于是想起佩姬受雇成为你的船员后，无法再举办讲习班！
rows.raw: "You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with the door locked and the closed sign, you recall that Paige is unable to hold her seminars while she is employed as a crew member of your ship!"

rows.original: You may be able to find her taking a break at her house, however.
rows.translation: 不过，你也许能在她家找到正在休息的她。
rows.raw: " You may be able to find her taking a break at her house, however."

rows.original: YOGA_HOUSE
rows.raw: "YOGA_HOUSE"

rows.original: You’ve never been in this area of the Residential Deck before. One of the units in this wing has a plaque on its door: Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, it reads. It also has a short paragraph about who Paige is and what she offers to teach as a yoga instructor. Beneath that is a list of prices and hours available.
rows.translation: 你以前从没来过居住甲板的这个区域。这一翼的某个单元门上挂着一块牌子：佩姬的瑜伽课与研讨会，牌子上这么写着。牌子上还有一小段文字，介绍佩姬是谁，以及她作为瑜伽教练能教些什么。下面列着价格和可预约的时段。
rows.raw: "You’ve never been in this area of the Residential Deck before. One of the units in this wing has a plaque on its door: Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, it reads. It also has a short paragraph about who Paige is and what she offers to teach as a yoga instructor. Beneath that is a list of prices and hours available."

rows.original: Looks as though the class is over for the day, but the class is in session between the hours of 09:00 and 17:00 every day. You make a note to check it out sometime between those hours.
rows.translation: 看来今天的课程已经结束，不过每天09:00至17:00之间都会上课。你记下了这个时间，准备哪天在这段时段内过来看看。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks as though the class is over for the day, but the class is in session between the hours of 09:00 and 17:00 every day. You make a note to check it out sometime between those hours."

rows.original: You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, ready to do some more yoga. Who knew yoga could be so much fun, and so relaxing! Now you see why some yoga practitioners are so Zen all the time.
rows.translation: 你来到佩姬的瑜伽课程与讲习班，准备再练一些瑜伽。谁能想到瑜伽可以如此有趣又如此放松！现在你终于明白，为什么有些瑜伽练习者总是那么禅意十足。
rows.raw: "You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, ready to do some more yoga. Who knew yoga could be so much fun, and so relaxing! Now you see why some yoga practitioners are so Zen all the time."

rows.original: You reach out to the knob and give it a twist – and it doesn’t yield. A twist a few more times, but it’s locked as locked could be. You read the message on the door, and you look over the hours listed. No wonder: class is over for the day. You missed the boat.
rows.translation: 你伸手握住门把拧了一下 – 它纹丝不动。又拧了几次，但锁得死死的。你读了门上的留言，又看了看列出的时间。难怪：今天的课已经结束了。你赶不上了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach out to the knob and give it a twist – and it doesn’t yield. A twist a few more times, but it’s locked as locked could be. You read the message on the door, and you look over the hours listed. No wonder: class is over for the day. You missed the boat."

rows.original: Well. You blush in embarrassment. You’ll be sure to not make the same mistake again by coming between the hours of 09:00 and 17:00.
rows.translation: 好吧。你尴尬地脸红了。你保证不再重蹈覆辙，就在09:00到17:00之间来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell. You blush in embarrassment. You’ll be sure to not make the same mistake again by coming between the hours of 09:00 and 17:00."

rows.original: Gel Body
rows.raw: "Gel Body"

rows.original: You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, checking the plaque on the door and the time on your codex to confirm that you’ve arrived during working hours. You show yourself into the classroom.
rows.translation: 你来到佩姬的瑜伽课程与讲习班，查看门上的铭牌和法典上的时间，确认自己是在营业时间到达。你自行走进教室。
rows.raw: "You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, checking the plaque on the door and the time on your codex to confirm that you’ve arrived during working hours. You show yourself into the classroom."

rows.original: There are a number of students around the classroom, each at a mat, all of them facing toward the door you just entered. They’ve all contorted themselves into a number of strenuous positions, flexing and stretching their muscles to their teacher’s instructions. Standing among them is a tall, modded Ausar woman, helping one of her students with their position, and floating at one end of the classroom is a monitor displaying what appear to be eyes.
rows.translation: 教室里散落着不少学生，每人一张垫子，全都朝着你刚进来的那扇门。他们各自扭成种种吃力的姿势，随老师的口令绷紧、拉伸肌肉。他们中间站着一位身材高挑、经过改造的奥萨尔女人，正帮一名学生调整姿势，教室的一端还悬浮着一台显示器，上面显示的东西看着像是一双眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are a number of students around the classroom, each at a mat, all of them facing toward the door you just entered. They’ve all contorted themselves into a number of strenuous positions, flexing and stretching their muscles to their teacher’s instructions. Standing among them is a tall, modded Ausar woman, helping one of her students with their position, and floating at one end of the classroom is a monitor displaying what appear to be eyes."

rows.original: The teacher stands and looks in your direction when she hears you enter. “Hello! she says, waving towards you. You respond with your own greeting – and as you do, you notice that the monitor in the back of the room has shifted its visage somewhat.
rows.translation: 老师听见你进来，站起身朝你的方向望去。“你好！她一边说，一边向你挥手。你也向她问好——与此同时，你注意到房间后方的显示器稍稍改变了面容。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe teacher stands and looks in your direction when she hears you enter. “Hello! she says, waving towards you. You respond with your own greeting – and as you do, you notice that the monitor in the back of the room has shifted its visage somewhat."

rows.original: Suddenly, the teacher’s face grows concerned. “Um, would you mind speaking with me outside for just a moment?” That’s a confusing request, but you oblige, and you step out of the classroom, the Ausar close behind.
rows.translation: 老师的神色突然变得担忧。“呃，你介意跟我到外面谈一小会儿吗？”这个请求令人困惑，但你还是答应了，走出教室，奥萨尔人紧随其后。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, the teacher’s face grows concerned. “Um, would you mind speaking with me outside for just a moment?” That’s a confusing request, but you oblige, and you step out of the classroom, the Ausar close behind."

rows.original: Gel Body
rows.raw: "Gel Body"

rows.original: “Um,” she says gently, “this is, uh... I’m going to be totally honest, but I don’t think I’m capable of teaching a Galotian, or a Rahn, or any of the goo subtypes. I can only teach solid bipeds.”
rows.translation: “呃，”她轻声说道，“这个，嗯...我就完全坦白了，我觉得自己没能力教加洛提亚人、拉恩，或任何黏胶亚种。我只能教实体双足生物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um,” she says gently, “this is, uh... I’m going to be totally honest, but I don’t think I’m capable of teaching a Galotian, or a Rahn, or any of the goo subtypes. I can only teach solid bipeds.”"

rows.original: You reel in surprise. She can’t teach Galotians yoga? Or she won’t?
rows.translation: 你惊讶得一愣。她是不能教加洛提亚人瑜伽？还是不愿？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reel in surprise. She can’t teach Galotians yoga? Or she won’t?"

rows.original: “Let’s not be unfair,” she says, defensive at your implication. “Yoga is about stretching muscles and ligaments to make the form limber and flexible. I mean this as... politically-correctly as possible, sweet thing, but you have no muscles or ligaments to stretch. Your body is liquid; by definition, you’re as limber as you’re ever going to get.”
rows.translation: “我们别这么不讲理，”她因你的暗示而防备地说道。“瑜伽是通过拉伸肌肉与韧带，让身体柔软灵活的练习。我这么说已经尽可能...政治正确了，小可爱，可你没有可供拉伸的肌肉或韧带。你的身体是液体；从定义上说，你已经不可能比现在更加柔软了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s not be unfair,” she says, defensive at your implication. “Yoga is about stretching muscles and ligaments to make the form limber and flexible. I mean this as... politically-correctly as possible, sweet thing, but you have no muscles or ligaments to stretch. Your body is liquid; by definition, you’re as limber as you’re ever going to get.”"

rows.original: You counter by replying that you can make your body solid if you desire. To demonstrate, you increase the viscosity of your gooey body, until it’s, by every definition, solid. “Yeah, but if you can do that, you can also undo that, as often as you like, as many times as you like. Look, if you really, really want to, I’ll take you on as a student. But you won’t be accomplishing much. I’ll teach you how to perform yoga, and you can do what you want with that knowledge, but I’m afraid that’s about all you’ll get.”
rows.translation: 你回嘴说，只要你想，就能让自己的身体变成实体。为了示范，你提高了黏稠身体的黏度，直到按任何定义都算得上固态。“是啊，但你要是能做到那个，你也能把它撤销，想多频繁就多频繁，想多少次就多少次。听着，如果你真的真的很想，我可以收你当学生。但你也成不了什么事。我会教你做瑜伽，学到之后你想拿它干什么随你，但我怕你能得到的也就这些了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou counter by replying that you can make your body solid if you desire. To demonstrate, you increase the viscosity of your gooey body, until it’s, by every definition, solid. “Yeah, but if you can do that, you can also undo that, as often as you like, as many times as you like. Look, if you really, really want to, I’ll take you on as a student. But you won’t be accomplishing much. I’ll teach you how to perform yoga, and you can do what you want with that knowledge, but I’m afraid that’s about all you’ll get.”"

rows.original: You harrumph at her argument, but you can’t deny it. You suppose that yoga is better meant for people that, well, have a body to improve, but with how malleable you are, your body is basically a puddle with a face. “I’ll be here if you decide you’re interested,” Paige says, and she disappears back into her classroom.
rows.translation: 你对她的论点不满地哼了一声，却无法否认。你想，瑜伽大概更适合那些确实有身体可以改善的人；而你如此容易变形，身体基本就是一摊长着脸的水。“如果你决定感兴趣，我会在这里等你，”佩姬说道，随后消失在教室里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou harrumph at her argument, but you can’t deny it. You suppose that yoga is better meant for people that, well, have a body to improve, but with how malleable you are, your body is basically a puddle with a face. “I’ll be here if you decide you’re interested,” Paige says, and she disappears back into her classroom."

rows.original: Just one of the difficulties of having taken those pills one too many times.
rows.translation: 这只是那些药丸吃得太多带来的麻烦之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust one of the difficulties of having taken those pills one too many times."

rows.original: “I have to bring this up with every naga or centaur that wants to learn yoga,” she says. “I can teach you if you want, but I’m afraid it’ll be a bit tougher for someone of your particular musculature.”
rows.translation: “每个想学瑜伽的娜迦或半人马，我都得先说明这件事，”她说道。“如果你愿意，我可以教你，但恐怕像你这种特殊肌肉结构的学生，学起来会稍微困难一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have to bring this up with every naga or centaur that wants to learn yoga,” she says. “I can teach you if you want, but I’m afraid it’ll be a bit tougher for someone of your particular musculature.”"

rows.original: You reply that you’re honestly not that surprised. Being a
rows.translation: 你回答说其实你并不太惊讶。作为一个
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you’re honestly not that surprised. Being a "

rows.original: monoped
rows.translation: 单足生物
rows.raw: "monoped"

rows.original: tauric creature
rows.translation: 兽体生物
rows.raw: "tauric creature"

rows.original: in today’s modern, bipedal-dominated universe has always been kind of tough going.
rows.translation: 在如今这个由双足生物主导的现代宇宙里，一直都不太好过。
rows.raw: " in today’s modern, bipedal-dominated universe has always been kind of tough going."

rows.original: “I’m glad you understand, but that’s not to say I can’t teach you,” she insists. “It’s just that, yoga is a practice that requires a bipedal form. Every pose requires the lower body to affect the upper body, and most stretches involve legs and the gap between them. Have you ever heard of a horse or a snake doing yoga?” You frown. “There are some poses that use only the upper body, but you won’t be getting the most out of my class, I’m afraid. I’ll have you if you’ll have me, of course. I’m just letting you know that it’ll be a little less rewarding for you.”
rows.translation: “我很高兴你能理解，但这并不意味着我不能教你，”她坚持道。“只是瑜伽这项练习需要双足形态。每个姿势都要求下半身影响上半身，大多数拉伸动作也涉及双腿及双腿之间的空隙。你听说过马会做瑜伽，或蛇会做瑜伽吗？”你皱起眉。“确实有些姿势只使用上半身，但恐怕你无法从我的课程中得到最大收益。当然，只要你愿意学，我就愿意教。我只是先告诉你，课程对你的帮助会稍微小一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m glad you understand, but that’s not to say I can’t teach you,” she insists. “It’s just that, yoga is a practice that requires a bipedal form. Every pose requires the lower body to affect the upper body, and most stretches involve legs and the gap between them. Have you ever heard of a horse or a snake doing yoga?” You frown. “There are some poses that use only the upper body, but you won’t be getting the most out of my class, I’m afraid. I’ll have you if you’ll have me, of course. I’m just letting you know that it’ll be a little less rewarding for you.”"

rows.original: You sigh. Well, you have to admit, you haven’t ever heard of a horse or a snake doing yoga, so you’re not frustrated with her. You tell her that you’ll mull it over. “I hope to see you in my class all the same!” she says, trying to cheer you both up, before disappearing into her classroom.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。好吧，你不得不承认，自己确实没有听说过马会做瑜伽或蛇会做瑜伽，所以并不怪她。你告诉她，自己会好好考虑。“不过我还是希望能在课堂上见到你！”她试着让你们俩都振作起来，说完便消失在教室里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. Well, you have to admit, you haven’t ever heard of a horse or a snake doing yoga, so you’re not frustrated with her. You tell her that you’ll mull it over. “I hope to see you in my class all the same!” she says, trying to cheer you both up, before disappearing into her classroom."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’ve never been in this area of the Residential Deck before. One of the units in this wing has a plaque on its door: Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, it reads. It also has a short paragraph about who Paige is and what she offers to teach as a yoga instructor. Beneath that is a list of prices and hours available.
rows.translation: 你以前从没来过居住甲板的这个区域。这一翼的某个单元门上挂着一块牌子：佩姬的瑜伽课与研讨会，牌子上这么写着。牌子上还有一小段文字，介绍佩姬是谁，以及她作为瑜伽教练能教些什么。下面列着价格和可预约的时段。
rows.raw: "You’ve never been in this area of the Residential Deck before. One of the units in this wing has a plaque on its door: Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, it reads. It also has a short paragraph about who Paige is and what she offers to teach as a yoga instructor. Beneath that is a list of prices and hours available."

rows.original: You hear some voices coming from inside, along with the general noise of movement. You gingerly twist the knob and open the door, showing yourself uninvited into the classroom.
rows.translation: 你听见里面传来一些说话声，还有人们活动时的各种动静。你小心翼翼地转动门把，推开房门，未经邀请便自行走进教室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear some voices coming from inside, along with the general noise of movement. You gingerly twist the knob and open the door, showing yourself uninvited into the classroom."

rows.original: “Now, point your toes,” you hear a woman say, “as straight as you can, and keep your back straight at a perpendicular angle. Now, grip onto your knees without bending any part of your body. We call this pose the ‘Boat.’”
rows.translation: “现在，把脚尖绷直，”你听见一个女人说，“能绷多直就绷多直，背也要挺直，保持垂直的角度。然后，抓住你的膝盖，身体任何部位都不要弯。我们把这个姿势叫作‘小船’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, point your toes,” you hear a woman say, “as straight as you can, and keep your back straight at a perpendicular angle. Now, grip onto your knees without bending any part of your body. We call this pose the ‘Boat.’”"

rows.original: The class consists of about twelve other patrons of all different shapes, species, body-types, and genders. Some of them are veteran yoga practitioners, flexing into the pose easily, while others are having some difficulty, struggling to maintain their position.
rows.translation: 班上还有大约十二名学员，身形、种族、体型和性别各不相同。其中一些是经验丰富的瑜伽练习者，轻松地弯进姿势；另一些则遇到了困难，努力维持自己的姿势。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe class consists of about twelve other patrons of all different shapes, species, body-types, and genders. Some of them are veteran yoga practitioners, flexing into the pose easily, while others are having some difficulty, struggling to maintain their position."

rows.original: A tall Ausar woman walks between her students silently. When she passes one of them that’s having difficulty, she kneels beside them, feeling her hand across the student’s legs, pausing where their knees bend. “It’s alright,” she says reassuringly, placing a hand beneath the bent leg and straightening it. “It’s not the easiest pose. You’ll get it if you keep at it.”
rows.translation: 一名高挑的奥萨尔女性默默穿行在学生之间。经过一个遇到困难的学生时，她在其身旁跪下，用手摸过学生的双腿，并在膝盖弯曲处停下。“没关系，”她安慰道，把一只手托在弯曲的腿下，将其伸直。“这不是最简单的姿势。只要坚持练习，你会掌握的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA tall Ausar woman walks between her students silently. When she passes one of them that’s having difficulty, she kneels beside them, feeling her hand across the student’s legs, pausing where their knees bend. “It’s alright,” she says reassuringly, placing a hand beneath the bent leg and straightening it. “It’s not the easiest pose. You’ll get it if you keep at it.”"

rows.original: You clear your throat, still standing in the doorframe. The Ausar woman stands up and faces you. She has dirty brown hair with streaks of black through her mane, and she has perky, triangular, wolfish ears pointing straight up a whole twelve centimeters from her scalp. Attached to her right ear is an earpiece with a small antenna extending to her eyes – likely a microphone of some kind. She’s wearing a sleeveless, flexible jumper vest on her torso and a pair of yoga shorts covering her waist, then nothing down to her toes. Her fur is colored brown, like her hair, and she has black and white splotches all throughout her body. Unlike a typical Ausar, her entire body is covered head-to-toe in fur, like some modded humans, and she has the appropriately elongated face to match. She has a long, bushy-but-not-fluffy tail, all black fur on top and all beige-brown on the bottom, reaching to just above her tendons. Even though she’s across the room, you can tell just how stunningly blue her eyes are when they meet yours.
rows.translation: 你清了清嗓子，仍站在门框里。奥萨尔女性起身面对你。她有一头夹杂黑色发丝的暗棕色头发，一对活泼的三角形狼耳笔直竖起，足足高出头皮十二厘米。右耳上戴着一枚耳机，一根小天线延伸至眼前——大概是某种麦克风。她上身穿着无袖柔韧连身背心，腰间是一条瑜伽短裤，往下直到脚趾再无其他衣物。她的毛发与头发一样呈棕色，全身遍布黑白斑块。与典型奥萨尔人不同，她从头到脚都覆盖着毛发，就像某些改造过的人类，还配有相称的修长口鼻。她有一条长而浓密、却并不蓬松的尾巴，上方全是黑毛，下方全是米棕色毛，一直垂到肌腱上方。尽管她身在房间另一头，当那双眼睛与你相遇时，你仍能看清它们是多么惊艳的蓝色。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clear your throat, still standing in the doorframe. The Ausar woman stands up and faces you. She has dirty brown hair with streaks of black through her mane, and she has perky, triangular, wolfish ears pointing straight up a whole twelve centimeters from her scalp. Attached to her right ear is an earpiece with a small antenna extending to her eyes – likely a microphone of some kind. She’s wearing a sleeveless, flexible jumper vest on her torso and a pair of yoga shorts covering her waist, then nothing down to her toes. Her fur is colored brown, like her hair, and she has black and white splotches all throughout her body. Unlike a typical Ausar, her entire body is covered head-to-toe in fur, like some modded humans, and she has the appropriately elongated face to match. She has a long, bushy-but-not-fluffy tail, all black fur on top and all beige-brown on the bottom, reaching to just above her tendons. Even though she’s across the room, you can tell just how stunningly blue her eyes are when they meet yours."

rows.original: Floating around the room is a monitor, displaced in the air by a glowing, thrumming device. On the monitor is a disarming, cutesy picture of a face, drawn with cartoonish eyes and a tiny mouth. It’s silent as it goes between practitioners; it stops at one and whispers to them to straighten their knees and elbows, then displays an image of the position’s proper form. Maybe it’s some kind of assistant for the teacher? A literal, mechanical teacher’s pet?
rows.translation: 房间里漂浮着一台显示器，由一枚发光嗡鸣的装置悬托在空中。屏幕上是一张令人放松的可爱面孔，以卡通般的双眼和小巧嘴巴绘成。它默默穿行在练习者之间；在其中一人身旁停下，低声提醒其伸直膝盖与手肘，随后显示正确姿势的图像。也许它是老师的某种助手？一只货真价实的机械“教师宠儿”？
rows.raw: "\n\nFloating around the room is a monitor, displaced in the air by a glowing, thrumming device. On the monitor is a disarming, cutesy picture of a face, drawn with cartoonish eyes and a tiny mouth. It’s silent as it goes between practitioners; it stops at one and whispers to them to straighten their knees and elbows, then displays an image of the position’s proper form. Maybe it’s some kind of assistant for the teacher? A literal, mechanical teacher’s pet?"

rows.original: You introduce yourself and say that you’re interested in giving the class a try. “Of course!” she says. “
rows.translation: 你自我介绍，并说你有兴趣试试这门课。“当然！”她说。“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou introduce yourself and say that you’re interested in giving the class a try. “Of course!” she says. “"

rows.original: You’re that potential student from earlier, right? My name is Paige. I’m glad you decided to join us! Your first session is free; just pick a mat and follow along
rows.translation: 你就是之前那个有意向来上课的学员，对吧？我叫佩姬。很高兴你决定加入我们！第一节课免费；随便挑一张垫子跟着做就行
rows.raw: "You’re that potential student from earlier, right? My name is Paige. I’m glad you decided to join us! Your first session is free; just pick a mat and follow along"
