rows.original: My name is Paige. I don’t recognize you, sweet thing... you must be new to my class. The first session is free. Just pick a mat and follow along with us
rows.translation: 我叫佩姬。我不认识你，小可爱...你一定是第一次来上我的课。第一节免费。随便选张垫子，跟着我们做就好
rows.raw: "My name is Paige. I don’t recognize you, sweet thing... you must be new to my class. The first session is free. Just pick a mat and follow along with us"

rows.original: You undress slightly, just enough to make yourself a bit more flexible, and pick a mat closest to the far wall. “And, breathe out,” Paige instructs. “And breathe in...”
rows.translation: 你稍微脱掉一些衣物，只到让自己更灵活的程度，然后挑了离最远那面墙最近的垫子。“然后，呼气，”佩姬指导道。“再吸气...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou undress slightly, just enough to make yourself a bit more flexible, and pick a mat closest to the far wall. “And, breathe out,” Paige instructs. “And breathe in...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: An hour passes. You’ve done the best you can to follow along with Paige’s instructions, breathing when she told you to and holding all the different positions she spelled out for you. By the end of it, your body aches in places that never ached before, but you have to admit, if nothing else, you certainly feel looser.
rows.translation: 一个小时过去了。你已经尽力跟上佩姬的指示，在她叫你呼吸的时候呼吸，把她讲的每一个姿势都保持住。到结束时，你身上一些从来没酸过的地方都酸痛起来，但你不得不承认，至少你确实感觉身体松快了些。
rows.raw: "An hour passes. You’ve done the best you can to follow along with Paige’s instructions, breathing when she told you to and holding all the different positions she spelled out for you. By the end of it, your body aches in places that never ached before, but you have to admit, if nothing else, you certainly feel looser."

rows.original: “That’s enough for today,” Paige says, clapping her furry hands together once. “Wonderful work today everyone, I’m very proud of you all. Hopefully you’ll all grace me with your talent again tomorrow!”
rows.translation: “今天就到此为止，”佩姬说着，毛茸茸的双手拍了一下。“今天大家表现得非常棒，我为你们所有人感到骄傲。希望明天你们还能赏光，再让我见识见识你们的天赋！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s enough for today,” Paige says, clapping her furry hands together once. “Wonderful work today everyone, I’m very proud of you all. Hopefully you’ll all grace me with your talent again tomorrow!”"

rows.original: Her other students thank her for the lessons as they pass her on the way out of the unit. You’re the last one to leave as you put your effects back on.
rows.translation: 其他学生离开场地时从她身边经过，纷纷感谢她的教导。你重新穿戴好自己的装备，是最后一个离开的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer other students thank her for the lessons as they pass her on the way out of the unit. You’re the last one to leave as you put your effects back on."

rows.original: “You said your name was [pc.name]?” Paige asks you. You confirm. “Thank you for being a part of my class today, sweet thing. How did you enjoy it?”
rows.translation: “你说你的名字是[pc.name]？”佩姬问你。你确认了。“谢谢你今天来参加我的课程，小可爱。你觉得怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You said your name was [pc.name]?” Paige asks you. You confirm. “Thank you for being a part of my class today, sweet thing. How did you enjoy it?”"

rows.original: You tell her that you’ve never felt the pains your body is going through before, but it’s a good kind of pain, the type you get after a hearty workout. Paige laughs. “Yoga can be pretty intense, especially if you’ve never done it before. But I’m glad to hear that you enjoyed it!” You tell her that you’ll definitely consider coming back for another lesson or two in the future.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，你从没感受过身体正在经历的这些酸痛，但这是种舒服的痛，像痛快锻炼之后那种。佩姬笑了。“瑜伽可以相当激烈，尤其是你以前从没练过。不过听你说喜欢，我很高兴！”你告诉她，将来你肯定会考虑再来上一两节课。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ve never felt the pains your body is going through before, but it’s a good kind of pain, the type you get after a hearty workout. Paige laughs. “Yoga can be pretty intense, especially if you’ve never done it before. But I’m glad to hear that you enjoyed it!” You tell her that you’ll definitely consider coming back for another lesson or two in the future."

rows.original: “My regular rate is twenty credits per lesson. If you have a codex or a personal tablet, my buddy in the corner,” she says, pointing to the monitor with the face in the corner of the room, “can take payments automatically, so don’t worry about making them yourself. If it’s not too expensive, I’ll be waiting for you here!”
rows.translation: “我的常规收费是每节课二十信用点。如果你有法典或个人平板，角落里的伙伴，”她指向房间角落里那台带着面孔的显示器，“可以自动收款，所以不用担心亲自支付。如果不算太贵，我会在这里等你！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My regular rate is twenty credits per lesson. If you have a codex or a personal tablet, my buddy in the corner,” she says, pointing to the monitor with the face in the corner of the room, “can take payments automatically, so don’t worry about making them yourself. If it’s not too expensive, I’ll be waiting for you here!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PaigeYoga
rows.raw: "PaigeYoga"

rows.original: You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out.
rows.translation: 你转动佩姬瑜伽教室的门把，迫不及待地想重新进入她课程的节奏。她正忙着当前的课，帮助一名学生纠正姿势，没有起身迎接你。“你好！”她高声喊道。
rows.raw: "You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out."

rows.original: You respond your greeting. At that, Paige gets up, spinning towards you. “[pc.name]?” she asks. “No no, I’m afraid you’ve already had your session today, sweet thing. You mustn’t do another!”
rows.translation: 你回了句问候。听到这话，佩姬站起身，转身朝向你。“[pc.name]？”她问。“不不，恐怕你今天已经上过课了，小甜心。你可不能再来一次！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond your greeting. At that, Paige gets up, spinning towards you. “[pc.name]?” she asks. “No no, I’m afraid you’ve already had your session today, sweet thing. You mustn’t do another!”"

rows.original: You ask her what the harm is. “You risk hyperextending your ligaments if you do too much yoga in one day. Your body needs to rest! There is too much of a good thing, [pc.name]. For your own safety, I won’t have you in my class for the rest of the day. Came back after you’ve had a good night’s rest.”
rows.translation: 你问她这有什么危害。“一天做太多瑜伽，可能会导致韧带过度伸展。你的身体需要休息！好东西也会过犹不及，[pc.name]。为了你的安全，今天剩下的时间我不会让你再上课。好好睡一晚后再回来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what the harm is. “You risk hyperextending your ligaments if you do too much yoga in one day. Your body needs to rest! There is too much of a good thing, [pc.name]. For your own safety, I won’t have you in my class for the rest of the day. Came back after you’ve had a good night’s rest.”"

rows.original: “But...,” you protest. Paige ignores you.
rows.translation: “可是...，”你抗议道。 佩姬不理你。
rows.raw: " “But...,” you protest. Paige ignores you."

rows.original: You sigh. You were kind of looking forward to another round of yoga. But, on Paige’s insistence, you leave her class. You’ll just have to come back tomorrow.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。你本来还挺期待再来一轮瑜伽。但拗不过佩姬的坚持，你还是离开了她的课堂。只好明天再来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. You were kind of looking forward to another round of yoga. But, on Paige’s insistence, you leave her class. You’ll just have to come back tomorrow."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with your residual soreness, it would be best to sleep somewhere and recover first.
rows.translation: 你走向佩姬的瑜伽课 & 讲座，但带着残余的酸痛，最好先找个地方睡一觉恢复一下。
rows.raw: "You approach Paige’s Yoga Class & Seminar, but with your residual soreness, it would be best to sleep somewhere and recover first."

rows.original: PaigeYoga
rows.raw: "PaigeYoga"

rows.original: You show yourself into Paige’s yoga classroom and are greeted by the all-too-familiar sight of Paige personally instructing a student on how to hold their form properly. It’s a little nostalgic for you – it seemed like just yesterday when you first walked into her class and introduced yourself. You two have come an awfully long way.
rows.translation: 你走进佩姬的瑜伽教室，眼前是再熟悉不过的一幕：佩姬正在亲自指导一名学生如何正确保持姿势。这让你有些怀念——仿佛昨天才第一次走进她的课堂，向她介绍自己。你们俩已经走了很远。
rows.raw: "You show yourself into Paige’s yoga classroom and are greeted by the all-too-familiar sight of Paige personally instructing a student on how to hold their form properly. It’s a little nostalgic for you – it seemed like just yesterday when you first walked into her class and introduced yourself. You two have come an awfully long way."

rows.original: Paige looks up from her student, her eyes locking onto yours, and she smiles brightly. “Hey there, [pc.name],” she calls, snickering a little bit at the fact that she doesn’t have to call you ‘captain’ while she’s on shore-leave. “It’s good to see you here! Are you interested in joining my class today? You know what to do if you are.”
rows.translation: 佩姬从学生身上抬起目光，双眼与你对视，露出灿烂笑容。“你好啊，[pc.name]，”她招呼道；想到自己休岸假期间不用称你为“船长”，便略微窃笑。“很高兴在这里见到你！今天有兴趣来上课吗？愿意的话，你知道该怎么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige looks up from her student, her eyes locking onto yours, and she smiles brightly. “Hey there, [pc.name],” she calls, snickering a little bit at the fact that she doesn’t have to call you ‘captain’ while she’s on shore-leave. “It’s good to see you here! Are you interested in joining my class today? You know what to do if you are.”"

rows.original: You consider it.
rows.translation: 你考虑了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider it."

rows.original: You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out.
rows.translation: 你转动佩姬瑜伽教室的门把，迫不及待地想重新进入她课程的节奏。她正忙着当前的课，帮助一名学生纠正姿势，没有起身迎接你。“你好！”她高声喊道。
rows.raw: "You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out."

rows.original: You respond with your greeting. “Oh, hello [pc.name]!” she says, standing to greet you properly. “You’re right on time for our next lesson! Just take an open mat anywhere.”
rows.translation: 你向她问好。“哦，你好，[pc.name]！”她站起身，正式迎接你。“正好赶上下一节课！随便找张空垫子就行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond with your greeting. “Oh, hello [pc.name]!” she says, standing to greet you properly. “You’re right on time for our next lesson! Just take an open mat anywhere.”"

rows.original: The monitor floats silently at the front of the room, quietly watching some of the practitioners. When your eyes meet its wide, colorful, cartoony eyes, you hear the faintest of beeps from its speakers.
rows.translation: 显示器静静地漂在房间前方，安静地注视着一些练习者。当你的目光与它那对宽大、色彩鲜艳的卡通眼睛相遇时，你听到它的扬声器发出最微弱的哔声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe monitor floats silently at the front of the room, quietly watching some of the practitioners. When your eyes meet its wide, colorful, cartoony eyes, you hear the faintest of beeps from its speakers."

rows.original: “Oh,” Paige says suddenly. She approaches you in a hurry and leans in close to you. “[pc.name],” she whispers, “my buddy is telling me that... you can’t afford today’s lesson.”
rows.translation: “哦，”佩姬突然说道。她匆忙走近，贴到你身边。“[pc.name]，”她低声说，“我的伙伴告诉我...你付不起今天的课程费。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” Paige says suddenly. She approaches you in a hurry and leans in close to you. “[pc.name],” she whispers, “my buddy is telling me that... you can’t afford today’s lesson.”"

rows.original: You pause, then smile, embarrassed. Couldn’t even afford twenty credits for a yoga lesson. You apologize, then leave the room hastily. Maybe you can offload some excess cargo in the Merchant Deck for a quick buck?
rows.translation: 你顿了顿，然后尴尬地笑了。连二十信用点的一节瑜伽课都付不起。你道了歉，匆匆离开房间。也许你可以去商贩甲板卸掉些多余货物，赚点快钱？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause, then smile, embarrassed. Couldn’t even afford twenty credits for a yoga lesson. You apologize, then leave the room hastily. Maybe you can offload some excess cargo in the Merchant Deck for a quick buck?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out.
rows.translation: 你转动佩姬瑜伽教室的门把，迫不及待地想重新进入她课程的节奏。她正忙着当前的课，帮助一名学生纠正姿势，没有起身迎接你。“你好！”她高声喊道。
rows.raw: "You twist the knob to Paige’s yoga class, eager to get back into the swing of her session. She’s busy with her current class and is helping one student correct their posture, and she doesn’t rise to greet you. “Hello!” she calls out."

rows.original: You respond with your greeting. “Oh, hello [pc.name]!” she says, standing to greet you properly. “You’re right on time for our next lesson! Just take an open mat anywhere.”
rows.translation: 你向她问好。“哦，你好，[pc.name]！”她站起身，正式迎接你。“正好赶上下一节课！随便找张空垫子就行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond with your greeting. “Oh, hello [pc.name]!” she says, standing to greet you properly. “You’re right on time for our next lesson! Just take an open mat anywhere.”"

rows.original: You strip off your effects and do as instructed, taking an open mat nearer to the front of the class. You notice that the monitor from the other day is now at the front of the classroom, its disarming eyes quietly watching the room. “The position we’re doing now is called the ‘staff.’ Sit on your bum and stretch your legs directly in front of you, toes up. Be sure to keep your back straight, and place your palms flat on the floor by your sides.”
rows.translation: 你脱下装备，依照指示走到教室前方附近的一张空垫子上。你注意到前些天见过的显示器如今位于教室前方，那双令人放松的眼睛正静静观察房间。“我们现在做的姿势叫‘手杖式’。坐在臀部上，双腿向前伸直，脚趾朝上。务必保持背部挺直，双掌平放在身体两侧的地板上。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou strip off your effects and do as instructed, taking an open mat nearer to the front of the class. You notice that the monitor from the other day is now at the front of the classroom, its disarming eyes quietly watching the room. “The position we’re doing now is called the ‘staff.’ Sit on your bum and stretch your legs directly in front of you, toes up. Be sure to keep your back straight, and place your palms flat on the floor by your sides.”"

rows.original: A simple sitting position, but not something you do when sitting leisurely. You follow Paige’s instructions to the word and you quickly feel the stretch in your arms and legs as you hold.
rows.translation: 一个简单的坐姿，但不是你闲坐时会摆的姿势。你一字不差地照佩姬的指示做，保持住，很快就感觉到手臂和腿被拉伸开来。
rows.raw: "\n\nA simple sitting position, but not something you do when sitting leisurely. You follow Paige’s instructions to the word and you quickly feel the stretch in your arms and legs as you hold."

rows.original: “Breathe in,” Paige instructs as she approaches you. You glance up to her, for her confirmation if you’re holding the position correctly – and instead, Paige places her own hands on you, slowly caressing up your arms and down your legs, being careful not to break your rigor in holding the pose. The fur on her hands is moderately ticklish to you. Paige doesn’t even look you in the eye. “No bending your knees, [pc.name],” she whispers to you, and you straighten your legs again. “And breathe out.”
rows.translation: “吸气，”佩姬一边指导，一边走近你。你抬头望向她，等她确认自己的姿势是否正确——佩姬却把双手放在你身上，缓缓沿手臂向上、双腿向下爱抚，小心不破坏你维持姿势的紧绷。她手上的毛发让你觉得有些痒。佩姬甚至没有看你的眼睛。“膝盖不要弯，[pc.name]，”她贴着你低语，你再次伸直双腿。“呼气。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Breathe in,” Paige instructs as she approaches you. You glance up to her, for her confirmation if you’re holding the position correctly – and instead, Paige places her own hands on you, slowly caressing up your arms and down your legs, being careful not to break your rigor in holding the pose. The fur on her hands is moderately ticklish to you. Paige doesn’t even look you in the eye. “No bending your knees, [pc.name],” she whispers to you, and you straighten your legs again. “And breathe out.”"

rows.original: That was weird.
rows.translation: 刚才真奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat was weird."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The lesson winds down, and Paige walks your class through some less-demanding stretches to ease you back into your average life. By the end of her class, though you’re tired and your muscles are hurt from their unusual exertions, you feel very limber. It’s only been two classes and you think you can tell the difference already!
rows.translation: 课程渐渐收尾，佩姬带着你们全班做一些不那么费力的拉伸，好让你慢慢回到平常的生活里。到她的课结束时，尽管你很累，肌肉也因不寻常的用力而酸痛，你却觉得自己非常柔韧。才上了两节课，你就觉得自己已经能看出差别了！
rows.raw: "The lesson winds down, and Paige walks your class through some less-demanding stretches to ease you back into your average life. By the end of her class, though you’re tired and your muscles are hurt from their unusual exertions, you feel very limber. It’s only been two classes and you think you can tell the difference already!"

rows.original: Paige personally sees all her students out of the class, and her students thank her for another lesson as they leave. By the time you strap all of your effects back to your body, you are the last one to leave. “And that just leaves you, [pc.name],” says Paige, placing the backs of her wrists on the waist of her yoga shorts. “How was your second class? Can I expect you for a third?”
rows.translation: 佩姬亲自送所有学生离开教室，学生们离开时纷纷感谢她又上了一课。等你把所有装备重新固定到身上时，已经成了最后一个离开的人。“现在只剩你了，[pc.name]，”佩姬说道，将手腕背面搭在瑜伽短裤腰间。“第二节课感觉怎么样？我能期待你来上第三节吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige personally sees all her students out of the class, and her students thank her for another lesson as they leave. By the time you strap all of your effects back to your body, you are the last one to leave. “And that just leaves you, [pc.name],” says Paige, placing the backs of her wrists on the waist of her yoga shorts. “How was your second class? Can I expect you for a third?”"

rows.original: You reply that, like before,
rows.translation: 你回答说，和之前一样，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that, like before, "

rows.original: you don’t really feel any physically different, but you enjoy the atmosphere of her class and the lessons she’s teaching you all the same.
rows.translation: 你其实没觉得身体有什么不同，但仍然很喜欢课堂氛围和她教给你的内容。
rows.raw: "you don’t really feel any physically different, but you enjoy the atmosphere of her class and the lessons she’s teaching you all the same."

rows.original: you had never before experienced such a tightness – or a looseness – in some of your muscles, but you definitely are feeling something.
rows.translation: 你的某些肌肉从未体验过如此紧绷——或如此松弛——的感觉，但你确实感受到了变化。
rows.raw: "you had never before experienced such a tightness – or a looseness – in some of your muscles, but you definitely are feeling something."

rows.original: “That’s good to hear. A lot of people give yoga a try only once, but I appreciate that you’re giving it its fair shot, sweet thing. How are you enjoying the lessons? Is there anything you might be stopped up on?”
rows.translation: “很高兴听你这么说。很多人只尝试一次瑜伽，但我很感谢你愿意公平地给它机会，小可爱。你觉得课程怎么样？有没有什么地方卡住了？”
rows.raw: " “That’s good to hear. A lot of people give yoga a try only once, but I appreciate that you’re giving it its fair shot, sweet thing. How are you enjoying the lessons? Is there anything you might be stopped up on?”"

rows.original: You hesitate. You kind of want to bring up the touching during the Staff pose, but you decide against it. Paige is the expert, after all. You tell her that there’s nothing you can think of right off the bat. “Perfect! Sometimes I feel like I might not be doing enough for my students.”
rows.translation: 你犹豫了。你有点想提起手杖式期间的触碰，最后却作罢。毕竟佩姬才是专家。你告诉她，自己一时想不到任何问题。“太好了！有时候我觉得自己可能为学生做得还不够。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hesitate. You kind of want to bring up the touching during the Staff pose, but you decide against it. Paige is the expert, after all. You tell her that there’s nothing you can think of right off the bat. “Perfect! Sometimes I feel like I might not be doing enough for my students.”"

rows.original: If you’re feeling this different after only two lessons, you tell Paige that she’s definitely getting something right. She laughs good-naturedly. “I have to get ready for my next class, but hopefully I’ll be seeing you sometime tomorrow.”
rows.translation: 仅仅两节课之后你就感觉这么不一样，你告诉佩姬她肯定是做对了什么。她好脾气地笑了。“我得去准备下一节课了，但希望明天什么时候能再见到你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you’re feeling this different after only two lessons, you tell Paige that she’s definitely getting something right. She laughs good-naturedly. “I have to get ready for my next class, but hopefully I’ll be seeing you sometime tomorrow.”"

rows.original: You tell her that it’s a safe bet.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，这么认为准没错。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that it’s a safe bet."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You enter Paige’s yoga classroom once more. The familiar scene of the mats of the room occupied by other practitioners taking a difficult-looking pose greets you once again. You can see Paige closer to the front, helping out another student in keeping their elbows straight, and off in the distance is the monitor, gently reminding another student to keep their toes pointed straight.
rows.translation: 你再次走进佩姬的瑜伽教室。熟悉的景象再次映入眼帘：房间里的垫子上坐满了其他练习者，正摆出看起来颇为困难的姿势。你能看见佩姬就在前方附近，帮助另一名学生保持手肘伸直；远处的显示器则轻声提醒另一名学生把脚趾笔直指向前方。
rows.raw: "You enter Paige’s yoga classroom once more. The familiar scene of the mats of the room occupied by other practitioners taking a difficult-looking pose greets you once again. You can see Paige closer to the front, helping out another student in keeping their elbows straight, and off in the distance is the monitor, gently reminding another student to keep their toes pointed straight."

rows.original: You’ve been here enough times to not need the instruction to remove your effects. Paige and the monitor both glance in your direction for a moment. “[pc.name], good to see you!” says Paige. “Not that I was to presume anything, but I’m sure you’re here for another lesson?” When you confirm, you hear a beep from your codex, and you know you’ve been deducted the regular twenty credits.
rows.translation: 你来过的次数已经够多，不需要别人提醒你卸下随身物品了。佩姬和显示器都朝你的方向看了一眼。“[pc.name]，很高兴见到你！”佩姬说道。“我不是想擅自揣测，不过你肯定是来再上一课的吧？”你确认后，百科终端传来一声提示音，你知道常规的二十信用点已经扣除了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve been here enough times to not need the instruction to remove your effects. Paige and the monitor both glance in your direction for a moment. “[pc.name], good to see you!” says Paige. “Not that I was to presume anything, but I’m sure you’re here for another lesson?” When you confirm, you hear a beep from your codex, and you know you’ve been deducted the regular twenty credits."

rows.original: You take a position at an open mat, and you begin trying to mimic what everyone else is doing. “Today we’re doing a pose called the back-bend. It’s not an advanced position, but it’ll challenge your sense of balance.”
rows.translation: 你在一张空垫子上站好，开始试着模仿其他人的动作。“今天我们要做一个叫后弯的姿势。这不算高难度动作，但会考验你的平衡感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a position at an open mat, and you begin trying to mimic what everyone else is doing. “Today we’re doing a pose called the back-bend. It’s not an advanced position, but it’ll challenge your sense of balance.”"

rows.original: Everyone is bent backward, their bodies stretched into a wide, broad C-shape with their arms straight and over their heads. It looks like the idea is to take up as much horizontal space as possible while bending backwards and with both feet on the ground. You can understand how it might be a bit challenging on the balance
rows.translation: 所有人都向后弯腰，身体拉伸成宽大的C字形，双臂伸直越过头顶。这个动作似乎要求双脚着地、身体后仰，同时尽可能占据更多横向空间。你能理解它为什么会有些考验平衡
rows.raw: "\n\nEveryone is bent backward, their bodies stretched into a wide, broad C-shape with their arms straight and over their heads. It looks like the idea is to take up as much horizontal space as possible while bending backwards and with both feet on the ground. You can understand how it might be a bit challenging on the balance"

rows.original: , and there are some additional obstacles in the way, with your chest as heavy as it is
rows.translation: ，而且路上还有不少额外的障碍，你的胸口又那么沉
rows.raw: ", and there are some additional obstacles in the way, with your chest as heavy as it is"

rows.original: , and considering a chunk of your body weight is in your chest, this might be a bit tougher than you thought.
rows.translation: ，再说你身体重量有一大块都在胸口上，这事可能比你想的要费劲一些。
rows.raw: ", and considering a chunk of your body weight is in your chest, this might be a bit tougher than you thought."

rows.original: But hey, so should most other tasks at this point.
rows.translation: 不过话说回来，到这个份上，其他大多数活儿大概也一样难。
rows.raw: " But hey, so should most other tasks at this point."

rows.original: “Keep your arms and legs straight,” Paige instructs you, “and reach as high as you can, like you’re trying to get to the highest shelf in your cupboard. Then slowly bend backwards as far as you can. Thrust out your hips to help keep your forward balance. Nice, slow, and easy.”
rows.translation: “手臂和腿都伸直，”佩姬指导你，“尽量往高处够，就像要够到橱柜里最高的那层架子。然后慢慢向后弯，能弯多少就弯多少。把胯挺出去，帮助保持向前的平衡。慢慢地，轻松地来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Keep your arms and legs straight,” Paige instructs you, “and reach as high as you can, like you’re trying to get to the highest shelf in your cupboard. Then slowly bend backwards as far as you can. Thrust out your hips to help keep your forward balance. Nice, slow, and easy.”"

rows.original: You do your best to follow Paige’s instructions to the word, but she’s on you soon enough to inspect your form. You wince in effort, then gasp in surprise as you feel her hands on your body. She feels along your legs first, making sure they’re straight as can be, then up your laterals and across your [pc.belly]. One hand travels across your pit and up your arm, while the other boldly rakes across your [pc.chest]!
rows.translation: 你尽力一字不差地照佩姬的指示做，但她很快就过来检查你的姿势。你使劲得皱起脸，随后感觉到她的手落在你身上，惊得倒吸一口气。她先顺着你的腿摸过去，确认它们绷得笔直，然后往上到你的侧腹，再横过你的[pc.belly]。一只手扫过你的腋下、爬上你的手臂，另一只手则大胆地划过你的[pc.chest]！
rows.raw:
"

You do your best to follow Paige’s instructions to the word, but she’s on you soon enough to inspect your form. You wince in effort, then gasp in surprise as you feel her hands on your body. She feels along your legs first, making sure they’re straight as can be, then up your laterals and across your [pc.belly]. One hand travels across your pit and up your arm, while the other boldly rakes across your [pc.chest]!

"

rows.original: Paige hums to herself as she examines your body with her hands. <i>“I appreciate that you’re here, [pc.name]. We can make you a solid, fit-for-a-
rows.translation: 佩姬一边用手检查你的身体，一边轻声哼着。<i>“我很高兴你能来，[pc.name]。我们很快就能把你塑造成一副结实、配得上
rows.raw: "Paige hums to herself as she examines your body with her hands. <i>“I appreciate that you’re here, [pc.name]. We can make you a solid, fit-for-a-"

rows.original: king
rows.translation: 国王
rows.raw: "king"

rows.original: queen
rows.translation: 女王
rows.raw: "queen"

rows.original: body before you know it.” You’re rather insulted, after the brazen invasion of your personal bubble, to be given such a negative review.
rows.translation: 称号的身体。”在如此肆无忌惮地侵入你的私人空间之后，还得到这样的负面评价，你相当不爽。
rows.raw: " body before you know it.” You’re rather insulted, after the brazen invasion of your personal bubble, to be given such a negative review."

rows.original: Paige ‘humphs’ to herself as she appraises what she finds, then gives you another once-over. “Remember to keep your limbs straight,” she reminds you. “Follow my instructions to the letter and we’ll be keeping this body in tip-top shape, I guarantee.” While your personal space has been invaded, Paige was far from the worst thing to invade it.
rows.translation: 佩姬一边打量自己的发现，一边自顾自地“哼”了一声，随后又从头到脚审视了你一遍。“记得保持四肢伸直，”她提醒道。“一丝不差地照我说的做，我保证能让这副身体始终保持最佳状态。”你的私人空间的确遭到了侵犯，不过佩姬远不是侵入其中最糟糕的东西。
rows.raw: "Paige ‘humphs’ to herself as she appraises what she finds, then gives you another once-over. “Remember to keep your limbs straight,” she reminds you. “Follow my instructions to the letter and we’ll be keeping this body in tip-top shape, I guarantee.” While your personal space has been invaded, Paige was far from the worst thing to invade it."

rows.original: Paige’s breath catches in her throat as her fingers bounce off the ridges of your abs and explore the definition in your arms. She tries to hide it, but you can see her bite the corner of her lip. She examines your body once again, although you doubt it was to make sure your form was correct. “Your form is perfect, [pc.name],” she says. She sounds dehydrated. “Practically flawless. I wish I had your body.” Her fingers go over your [pc.belly] a second time, dipping a little further down the lowest set of abs then she should have. She stops eventually, and you almost wish she hadn’t.
rows.translation: 佩姬的呼吸卡在喉咙里，她的手指在你的腹肌棱线上弹跳，又探过你手臂上的线条。她想掩饰，但你看得见她在咬嘴角。她又审视了一遍你的身体，不过你怀疑她并不是在确认你的姿势对不对。“你的姿势完美，[pc.name]，”她说。声音干涩得像脱了水。“几乎毫无瑕疵。真希望我有你这样的身体。”她的手指第二次抚过你的[pc.belly]，比该有的位置又往下多探了一点，越过最下面那组腹肌。她终究还是停下了，而你几乎希望她没有停。
rows.raw: "Paige’s breath catches in her throat as her fingers bounce off the ridges of your abs and explore the definition in your arms. She tries to hide it, but you can see her bite the corner of her lip. She examines your body once again, although you doubt it was to make sure your form was correct. “Your form is perfect, [pc.name],” she says. She sounds dehydrated. “Practically flawless. I wish I had your body.” Her fingers go over your [pc.belly] a second time, dipping a little further down the lowest set of abs then she should have. She stops eventually, and you almost wish she hadn’t."

rows.original: Paige runs her fingers gently over every facet of your body. You’ve put a lot of effort into it – frankly, you don’t mind if a pretty lady like Paige helps herself a little. But to your surprise, she frowns. “Yoga is about being loose and keeping your body flexible,” she says, almost not to you. “Try not to make yourself so tense all the time, [pc.name]. Breathe in.” And like that, she’s done, off to another student. That was, uh...
rows.translation: 佩姬的手指轻柔地抚过你身体的每一处。你在这副身体上花了不少心血——说实话，如果是佩姬这样的漂亮姑娘稍微享用一下，你并不介意。但出乎意料的是，她皱起了眉。“瑜伽讲究的是放松，让身体保持柔韧，”她说道，听起来几乎不像在对你说话。“别总把自己绷得这么紧，[pc.name]。吸气。”就这样，她检查完了，转身走向另一名学员。刚才那算是，呃...
rows.raw: "Paige runs her fingers gently over every facet of your body. You’ve put a lot of effort into it – frankly, you don’t mind if a pretty lady like Paige helps herself a little. But to your surprise, she frowns. “Yoga is about being loose and keeping your body flexible,” she says, almost not to you. “Try not to make yourself so tense all the time, [pc.name]. Breathe in.” And like that, she’s done, off to another student. That was, uh..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Another hour passes, and your lessons are done for the day. Like before, Paige is at the door, waving all of her students out and wishing them a good day. Like before, you are the last one to leave – you have more effects to put away than most, usually. Besides, you’d like to talk to Paige about something this time.
rows.translation: 又一个小时过去，今天的课程结束了。和之前一样，佩姬站在门边，挥手送别所有学员，祝他们度过愉快的一天。也和之前一样，你是最后离开的——通常来说，你要收好的随身物品比大多数人都多。而且这次你还想跟佩姬谈件事。
rows.raw: "Another hour passes, and your lessons are done for the day. Like before, Paige is at the door, waving all of her students out and wishing them a good day. Like before, you are the last one to leave – you have more effects to put away than most, usually. Besides, you’d like to talk to Paige about something this time."

rows.original: You approach the modded Ausar non-threateningly. She doesn’t get a read on your body language at all. “Good work again today, [pc.name],” she tells you, smiling warmly. “You’re making great progress, sweet thing. I’m looking forward to your next visit!”
rows.translation: 你以毫无威胁的姿态走向这名接受过改造的奥萨尔人。她完全看不出你的肢体语言。“今天也做得很好，[pc.name]，”她热情地微笑着告诉你。“你进步很大，小可爱。我很期待你下次再来！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou approach the modded Ausar non-threateningly. She doesn’t get a read on your body language at all. “Good work again today, [pc.name],” she tells you, smiling warmly. “You’re making great progress, sweet thing. I’m looking forward to your next visit!”"

rows.original: “Yeah, about that,” you interrupt. Paige’s expression softens and her ears perk.
rows.translation: “嗯，关于那个，”你打断道。佩姬的表情缓和下来，耳朵竖了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, about that,” you interrupt. Paige’s expression softens and her ears perk."

rows.original: You ask her about the way she’s been conducting herself in her own classroom. Twice now, she’s shoved herself into your personal space and started touching you and pressing at you. The first time wasn’t quite so bad, and you chalked it up to her just trying to confirm good posture, but today, she was a little more... invasive than you appreciated
rows.translation: 你问起她在自己课堂上的举止。她已经两次闯进你的私人空间，开始在你身上摸摸按按。第一次还不算太过分，你只当她是在确认你的姿势是否正确；可今天，她的举动比你能接受的程度稍微更...冒犯了一些
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her about the way she’s been conducting herself in her own classroom. Twice now, she’s shoved herself into your personal space and started touching you and pressing at you. The first time wasn’t quite so bad, and you chalked it up to her just trying to confirm good posture, but today, she was a little more... invasive than you appreciated"

rows.original: even if you kinda liked it
rows.translation: ，哪怕你其实还有点喜欢
rows.raw: " even if you kinda liked it"

rows.original: . Frankly, it wasn’t behavior you had come to expect from a professional.
rows.translation: 。坦白说，这可不像是专业人士该有的行为。
rows.raw: ". Frankly, it wasn’t behavior you had come to expect from a professional."

rows.original: “I’m just trying to make sure your form is correct, that’s all,” she assures you, taking a submissive tone in her voice. “Yoga is a very physical practice, and sometimes I need to take a more hands-on form of teaching to make sure my students don’t hurt themselves.”
rows.translation: “我只是想确保你的姿势正确，仅此而已，”她用顺从的语气向你保证。“瑜伽是一种非常注重身体的练习，有时我得采用更直接的肢体指导，才能确保学员不会弄伤自己。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m just trying to make sure your form is correct, that’s all,” she assures you, taking a submissive tone in her voice. “Yoga is a very physical practice, and sometimes I need to take a more hands-on form of teaching to make sure my students don’t hurt themselves.”"

rows.original: You reply that the floating monitor-thing helps just as well, and it doesn’t have hands to touch people with. Paige becomes visibly nervous, and you consider backing down – you didn’t want to start a fight or anything, but she may be getting the wrong message.
rows.translation: 你回答说那台漂浮的显示器一样能帮上忙，而且它没有手可以碰人。佩姬明显紧张起来，你考虑要不要退让 – 你并不想挑起争吵之类的，但她可能会误会你的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that the floating monitor-thing helps just as well, and it doesn’t have hands to touch people with. Paige becomes visibly nervous, and you consider backing down – you didn’t want to start a fight or anything, but she may be getting the wrong message."

rows.original: “Look, sweet thing, I have another class coming up very shortly. Can you do me a favor and stop by my unit later tonight, after 17:00 but before midnight? I live in the unit directly next to this classroom. We can pick up from there.”
rows.translation: “听我说，小甜心，我马上还有一节课要上。能不能帮我个忙，今晚晚点来我住处一趟，17:00以后、午夜之前？我就住在这间教室旁边那一间。我们可以从那儿接着来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, sweet thing, I have another class coming up very shortly. Can you do me a favor and stop by my unit later tonight, after 17:00 but before midnight? I live in the unit directly next to this classroom. We can pick up from there.”"

rows.original: That wasn’t the response you were expecting, but it’s a modest request. You tell her to expect you there later tonight. “Thanks a lot,” she says, and you’re soon out of her classroom.
rows.translation: 这回答出乎你的意料，不过她的请求并不过分。你让她今晚晚些时候等着你。“太感谢了，”她说道，没过多久你便离开了教室。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat wasn’t the response you were expecting, but it’s a modest request. You tell her to expect you there later tonight. “Thanks a lot,” she says, and you’re soon out of her classroom."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You show yourself into Paige’s Yoga class. She’s busy helping one of her other students work their way into a different position, making sure their knees are bent where they’re supposed to and that their backs are completely straight.
rows.translation: 你不请自来地走进佩姬的瑜伽课。她正忙着帮另一名学员摆成另一个姿势，确认他们的膝盖弯在该弯的地方、背也完全挺直。
rows.raw: "You show yourself into Paige’s Yoga class. She’s busy helping one of her other students work their way into a different position, making sure their knees are bent where they’re supposed to and that their backs are completely straight. "

rows.original: Paige’s robotic helper Iddi
rows.translation: 佩姬的机器人助手伊迪
rows.raw: "Paige’s robotic helper Iddi"

rows.original: The floating monitor with eyes
rows.translation: 长着眼睛的悬浮显示器
rows.raw: "The floating monitor with eyes"

rows.original: flits about the room, working as her assistant, and when it notices you enter the room, it makes a light beeping noise.
rows.translation: 在房间里飞来飞去，当她的助手，当它注意到你走进房间时，发出轻轻的哔哔声。
rows.raw: " flits about the room, working as her assistant, and when it notices you enter the room, it makes a light beeping noise."

rows.original: “Ah, [pc.name]!” says Paige once she’s done with her first student. “Welcome back to my classroom! You know the drill and the rates.”
rows.translation: “啊，[pc.name]！”佩姬完成对第一名学员的指导后说道。“欢迎回到我的课堂！规矩和收费标准你都知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, [pc.name]!” says Paige once she’s done with her first student. “Welcome back to my classroom! You know the drill and the rates.”"

rows.original: You shuffle your effects off your body and you take a position on one of the empty mats. Before you get started mimicking the other students on their position, Paige is by your side.
rows.translation: 你把随身的东西从身上卸下来，在一张空垫子上摆好姿势。你还没来得及开始模仿其他学员的姿势，佩姬就来到了你身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shuffle your effects off your body and you take a position on one of the empty mats. Before you get started mimicking the other students on their position, Paige is by your side."

rows.original: “You know what?” she asks you. “You’ve been to enough of my classes that I think you might be ready for something a little more advanced. If you’d like, we can try to get you into some more... exotic poses, to really give those limbs a good stretch. You into it?
rows.translation: “你知道吗？”她问你。“你上我的课已经够多了，我觉得你或许可以试试更进阶一点的东西。如果你愿意，我们可以试着让你摆一些更... 异域的姿势，好好给那些肢体拉伸一下。你有兴趣吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know what?” she asks you. “You’ve been to enough of my classes that I think you might be ready for something a little more advanced. If you’d like, we can try to get you into some more... exotic poses, to really give those limbs a good stretch. You into it?"

rows.original: “So, what’s our goal today?” she asks you. “Want to relax with the easy stuff? Or do you want something a little tougher?
rows.translation: “那么，我们今天的目标是什么？”她问道。“想做些简单动作放松一下？还是想来点更有挑战性的？
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what’s our goal today?” she asks you. “Want to relax with the easy stuff? Or do you want something a little tougher?"

rows.original: Or... do you really want to test your limits? You’re ready for the intense stuff.
rows.translation: 还是说...你真想试试自己的极限？你已经准备好迎接激烈的玩法了。
rows.raw: " Or... do you really want to test your limits? You’re ready for the intense stuff."

rows.original: You walk away from Paige’s after yet another intense session. They’ve been getting easier and easier lately: your limbs move with a different sort of fluidity since you’ve started, and your body feels very flexible and loose. You wonder if this sort of limberness could be applied to anything else in your everyday life....
rows.translation: 又一次高强度训练结束后，你离开了佩姬那里。最近的课程变得越来越轻松了：自从开始练习以来，你的四肢活动起来多了一种别样的流畅感，身体也感觉十分柔韧放松。你不禁想，这种柔韧性是否还能运用到日常生活中的其他方面....
rows.raw: "You walk away from Paige’s after yet another intense session. They’ve been getting easier and easier lately: your limbs move with a different sort of fluidity since you’ve started, and your body feels very flexible and loose. You wonder if this sort of limberness could be applied to anything else in your everyday life...."

rows.original: New Perk Unlocked: Limber: you have an additional 20% chance to escape all grapples! You must perform Hard yoga with Paige every now and again to maintain this perk.
rows.translation: 解锁新特长：柔韧：你摆脱所有擒抱的几率额外提高20%！你需要时不时和佩姬做高难度瑜伽来维持这个特长。
rows.raw: "\n\nNew Perk Unlocked: Limber: you have an additional 20% chance to escape all grapples! You must perform Hard yoga with Paige every now and again to maintain this perk."

rows.original: Limber
rows.raw: "Limber"

rows.original: Grants an addition 20% chance to escape from grapples!
rows.translation: 额外提供20%的挣脱擒抱几率！
rows.raw: "Grants an addition 20% chance to escape from grapples!"

rows.original: LimberTime
rows.raw: "LimberTime"

rows.original: LimberTime
rows.raw: "LimberTime"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You check your codex for the time as you approach the unit next to Paige’s classroom. It’s the right time, and it’s the right place. The door is made of an opaque type of glass that conceals everything behind it in a thick fog. You knock on it and wait.
rows.translation: 你一边走近佩姬教室旁边的单元房，一边用百科终端确认时间。时间没错，地点也没错。房门由一种不透明的玻璃制成，浓雾般的表面遮住了后方的一切。你敲了敲门，静静等待。
rows.raw: "You check your codex for the time as you approach the unit next to Paige’s classroom. It’s the right time, and it’s the right place. The door is made of an opaque type of glass that conceals everything behind it in a thick fog. You knock on it and wait."

rows.original: In a moment, the glass becomes clear and you can see into the unit, but the door remains shut. Instead of Paige, the little floating monitor that helps her in her class shows instead. It regards you for a moment before turning back into the apartment. “Momma!” you hear it shout with its young-boy vocals as it turns back into the apartment. “[pc.name] is here!”
rows.translation: 片刻后，玻璃变得透明，你能看见单元房内部，但门依然关着。出现的并非佩姬，而是课堂上协助她的那台小型悬浮显示器。它端详了你片刻，随后转身朝公寓里面飞去。“妈妈！”它转回公寓时，用小男孩的声音高喊。“[pc.name]来了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a moment, the glass becomes clear and you can see into the unit, but the door remains shut. Instead of Paige, the little floating monitor that helps her in her class shows instead. It regards you for a moment before turning back into the apartment. “Momma!” you hear it shout with its young-boy vocals as it turns back into the apartment. “[pc.name] is here!”"

rows.original: It vanishes around the corner, and soon Paige arrives, the monitor close behind her. She opens the door and shows you in. “Thanks for coming by,” she says. She’s wearing casual clothing: a purple cotton top with a folded collar, with sleeves that go halfway down her biceps, and a set of jeans that go to her ankles. Aside from the earpiece in her right ear, this is the first time you’ve seen her out of her yoga set. “I, uh, didn’t want to risk an argument or anything in the classroom.”
rows.translation: 它消失在拐角处，很快佩姬便赶了过来，显示器紧随其后。她打开门，请你进去。“谢谢你过来，”她说道。她穿着休闲服：一件带翻领的紫色棉质上衣，袖子垂到上臂中段，搭配一条长及脚踝的牛仔裤。除了右耳里的听筒外，这是你第一次见她没穿瑜伽服。“我，呃，只是不想冒险在教室里争起来什么的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt vanishes around the corner, and soon Paige arrives, the monitor close behind her. She opens the door and shows you in. “Thanks for coming by,” she says. She’s wearing casual clothing: a purple cotton top with a folded collar, with sleeves that go halfway down her biceps, and a set of jeans that go to her ankles. Aside from the earpiece in her right ear, this is the first time you’ve seen her out of her yoga set. “I, uh, didn’t want to risk an argument or anything in the classroom.”"

rows.original: You assure her that you didn’t intend to get overly confrontational from the beginning; just that you were a bit concerned about how touchy she got in the last lesson. You didn’t mind all that much
rows.translation: 你向她保证，自己从一开始就没打算表现得太过咄咄逼人；你只是有点担心她上节课动手动脚的程度。其实你并没有多么介意
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her that you didn’t intend to get overly confrontational from the beginning; just that you were a bit concerned about how touchy she got in the last lesson. You didn’t mind all that much"

rows.original: (you lie)
rows.translation: （你撒谎了）
rows.raw: " (you lie)"

rows.original: , but there isn’t any guarantee that every student will be as... receptive.
rows.translation: ，但没人能保证每个学员都会这么...乐于接受。
rows.raw: ", but there isn’t any guarantee that every student will be as... receptive."

rows.original: Paige’s apartment is modest: a spacious living room with a loveseat and a lounging leather chair facing a coffee table and a large flatscreen television meshed into the far wall, along with a narrow strip of kitchen and a door leading to her bedroom off in one corner. The unit is about the same size as her classroom, but much better furnished.
rows.translation: 佩姬的公寓很朴素：宽敞的客厅里摆着一张双人沙发和一把皮质躺椅，正对着咖啡桌和嵌入远端墙壁的大型平板电视；此外还有一条狭窄的厨房区域，角落里的一扇门则通往她的卧室。单元房面积和她的教室差不多，但家具齐全得多。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige’s apartment is modest: a spacious living room with a loveseat and a lounging leather chair facing a coffee table and a large flatscreen television meshed into the far wall, along with a narrow strip of kitchen and a door leading to her bedroom off in one corner. The unit is about the same size as her classroom, but much better furnished."

rows.original: Paige takes a seat on the loveseat and waits for you to take a seat yourself. You opt for the lounger next to the couch.
rows.translation: 佩姬在双人沙发上坐下，等你也找地方落座。你选择了沙发旁的躺椅。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige takes a seat on the loveseat and waits for you to take a seat yourself. You opt for the lounger next to the couch."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You stumble your way through an apology. You had never seen such a vicious scar on anyone before. You had no idea she was in such a condition. “And I’d prefer to keep it that way,” she says. “Not a lot of people know about my condition.”
rows.translation: 你磕磕绊绊地道了歉。你从未在任何人身上见过如此狰狞的伤疤，根本不知道她的情况竟如此严重。“我希望继续保持这样，”她说道。“没多少人知道我的状况。”
rows.raw: "You stumble your way through an apology. You had never seen such a vicious scar on anyone before. You had no idea she was in such a condition. “And I’d prefer to keep it that way,” she says. “Not a lot of people know about my condition.”"

rows.original: You say that her behavior in the classroom makes total sense now, and it does. Paige can’t see anything at all, so she has to use her hands to make sure your posture is correct.
rows.translation: 你说她在课堂上的举动现在完全说得通了，而事实确实如此。佩姬什么都看不见，所以必须用手确认你的姿势是否正确。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say that her behavior in the classroom makes total sense now, and it does. Paige can’t see anything at all, so she has to use her hands to make sure your posture is correct."

rows.original: “You got it,” she smiles. “You’re actually not the first person to complain to me about my hands-on approach, and I doubt you’ll be the last. Most people are fine with me just telling them that it’s because of the subject. Sometimes people don’t buy it and they get flustered and walk out after a class or two. But not only do you keep coming back, but you’ve been very patient about the whole thing. So, I figure, I could probably trust you with a secret.”
rows.translation: “没错，”她笑道。“你其实不是第一个抱怨我这种亲身指导方式的人，我想也不会是最后一个。只要告诉他们这是课程需要，大多数人就能接受。有些人不信，慌慌张张地上一两节课后就再也不来了。但你不仅一直回来，对整件事还非常有耐心。所以我觉得，或许可以把一个秘密托付给你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You got it,” she smiles. “You’re actually not the first person to complain to me about my hands-on approach, and I doubt you’ll be the last. Most people are fine with me just telling them that it’s because of the subject. Sometimes people don’t buy it and they get flustered and walk out after a class or two. But not only do you keep coming back, but you’ve been very patient about the whole thing. So, I figure, I could probably trust you with a secret.”"

rows.original: You ask her how she got such a bad wound, and why she needs to keep it a secret so badly. Is she just too proud to admit that she needs help? “That is one part of it, for sure,” she nods. “I was always raised to not be co-dependent on anyone. Honestly, even admitting that I need Iddi around is a bit of a blow.”
rows.translation: 你问她这么严重的伤是怎么来的，又为什么非得严守这个秘密。她是不是只是太骄傲，不愿承认自己需要帮助？“那确实是其中一个原因，”她点头道。“我从小受到的教育就是不要依赖任何人。老实说，就连承认自己需要伊迪陪在身边，都让我有点受打击。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how she got such a bad wound, and why she needs to keep it a secret so badly. Is she just too proud to admit that she needs help? “That is one part of it, for sure,” she nods. “I was always raised to not be co-dependent on anyone. Honestly, even admitting that I need Iddi around is a bit of a blow.”"

rows.original: “Momma?” Iddi asks, apparently wounded by her words.
rows.translation: “妈妈？”伊迪问道，似乎被她的话刺伤了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Momma?” Iddi asks, apparently wounded by her words."

rows.original: “Hey, I don’t mean anything by that, baby,” she says soothingly, rubbing her hand across the top of Iddi’s chrome frame. “You’re definitely the best thing that’s happened to me after the fact. I’d be totally lost without you.” She plants a soft kiss on Iddi’s screen; its pixels turn bright pink, and then back to baby blue, taking its place beside her again.
rows.translation: “嘿，我没别的意思，宝贝，”她安抚地说，手掌在伊迪镀铬的机架上端来回抚摸。“在那之后发生的一切里，你绝对是最好的那一件。没有你，我肯定会完全迷失。”她在伊迪的屏幕上轻轻落下一吻；屏幕上的像素亮成粉红，又变回婴儿蓝，重新在她身旁就位。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I don’t mean anything by that, baby,” she says soothingly, rubbing her hand across the top of Iddi’s chrome frame. “You’re definitely the best thing that’s happened to me after the fact. I’d be totally lost without you.” She plants a soft kiss on Iddi’s screen; its pixels turn bright pink, and then back to baby blue, taking its place beside her again."

rows.original: “As for the whole story, like how I got this sucker,” she says, drawing a line all the way from one side of the wound to the other with her finger, “that’s a story you’ll have to work for.” She places a finger on your chest playfully, just underneath your collarbone. “My favorite drink in the galaxy is Honey Wine, found only on the planet of Myrellion. Or you can keep coming to my classes. Come back to my unit after we’ve done a class, or if you have a bottle of wine, and I’ll yak your ears off.”
rows.translation: “至于完整的来龙去脉，比如我这条疤是怎么来的，”她说着，用手指从伤口的一头划到另一头，“那故事你得自己去挣。”她俏皮地把一根手指点在你胸口，就在锁骨下方。“全银河我最爱喝的酒是哈妮酒，只有米瑞利昂星球上才有。或者你可以继续来上我的课。上完课之后来我住舱，或者你手上有瓶酒，我就能跟你聊到耳朵起茧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As for the whole story, like how I got this sucker,” she says, drawing a line all the way from one side of the wound to the other with her finger, “that’s a story you’ll have to work for.” She places a finger on your chest playfully, just underneath your collarbone. “My favorite drink in the galaxy is Honey Wine, found only on the planet of Myrellion. Or you can keep coming to my classes. Come back to my unit after we’ve done a class, or if you have a bottle of wine, and I’ll yak your ears off.”"

rows.original: She seems to be in good spirits. You talk a bit more, about her yoga class and about the Honey Wine drink, but ultimately it’s just chatter. You’ve got what you wanted from her, so after an hour passes, you show yourself out of her unit, promising her that you’ll be back soon, either for another lesson, or for some of that sweet honey she wants.
rows.translation: 她看起来心情不错。你们又聊了一会儿她的瑜伽课和蜂蜜酒，不过归根结底只是闲谈。你已经从她这里得到了想要的东西，于是一个小时后，你自行离开了她的单元房，答应很快就会回来——要么再上一课，要么来品尝她想给你的那份甜蜜蜂蜜。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to be in good spirits. You talk a bit more, about her yoga class and about the Honey Wine drink, but ultimately it’s just chatter. You’ve got what you wanted from her, so after an hour passes, you show yourself out of her unit, promising her that you’ll be back soon, either for another lesson, or for some of that sweet honey she wants."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I was telling the truth when I said my teaching requires a bit more of a hands-on approach than most other teaching subjects,” she says. You’re quick to say that you believed her from the start. “But you’re also right in that my teaching tends to get a little more... explorative than you might think is necessary. And you’re right in that Iddi doesn’t need hands to help my other students like I do.”
rows.translation: “我说过我的教学方式比大多数其他课程更需要一点亲自动手，当时我说的可是实话，”她说。你赶紧说自己从一开始就相信她。“但你也说对了，我的教学确实会变得比你以为必要的程度更... 探索性一些。而且你说得也没错，伊迪不需要用手就能像我那样帮我教其他学生。”
rows.raw: "“I was telling the truth when I said my teaching requires a bit more of a hands-on approach than most other teaching subjects,” she says. You’re quick to say that you believed her from the start. “But you’re also right in that my teaching tends to get a little more... explorative than you might think is necessary. And you’re right in that Iddi doesn’t need hands to help my other students like I do.”"

rows.original: You interrupt her by asking her who ‘Iddi’ is. “He’s the floating TV that’s been helping me with the class.” She turns towards Iddi’s direction and calls his name.
rows.translation: 你打断她，问“伊迪”是谁。“就是课堂上一直帮我的那台悬浮电视。”她转向伊迪所在的方向，呼唤它的名字。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou interrupt her by asking her who ‘Iddi’ is. “He’s the floating TV that’s been helping me with the class.” She turns towards Iddi’s direction and calls his name."

rows.original: “Yes, momma?” Iddi says, floating itself until the projected cartoony eyes are level with hers.
rows.translation: “怎么了，妈妈？”伊迪说着，飘浮着让投影出的卡通眼睛与她平齐。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, momma?” Iddi says, floating itself until the projected cartoony eyes are level with hers."

rows.original: “Introduce yourself to our guest,” she instructs.
rows.translation: “向我们的客人自我介绍吧，”她指示道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Introduce yourself to our guest,” she instructs."

rows.original: Iddi floats up to you, the eyes on its screen shrinking into crescent lines as a mouth forms on its pixels, spreading into a wide, open-mouthed, toothless grin. “My name is Iddi!” it says. “What is your name?”
rows.translation: 伊迪飘到你面前，屏幕上的眼睛眯成两道弯月，像素里浮现出一张嘴，咧成一个张得大大的、没有牙齿的笑容。“我叫伊迪！” 它说。“你叫什么名字？”
rows.raw: "\n\nIddi floats up to you, the eyes on its screen shrinking into crescent lines as a mouth forms on its pixels, spreading into a wide, open-mouthed, toothless grin. “My name is Iddi!” it says. “What is your name?”"

rows.original: You introduce yourself to the monitor. “Hello, [pc.name]! Have a good day!” Iddi then makes its way back to Paige’s side, the mouth disappearing to make way for the eyes again. Iddi apparently isn’t much for conversation.
rows.translation: 你向显示器作了自我介绍。“你好，[pc.name]！祝你今天愉快！”随后伊迪回到佩姬身边，嘴巴消失，再次给眼睛腾出位置。伊迪显然不怎么爱聊天。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou introduce yourself to the monitor. “Hello, [pc.name]! Have a good day!” Iddi then makes its way back to Paige’s side, the mouth disappearing to make way for the eyes again. Iddi apparently isn’t much for conversation."

rows.original: “Iddi is a personal droid for elderly and disabled people. Technically, Iddi is designated as a ‘Personal Accessibility Assistant,’ but I think ‘PAA’ was a lame name for him, so I named him Iddi.”
rows.translation: “伊迪是专为老人和残障人士设计的个人机器人。严格来说，伊迪被定名为‘个人无障碍助手’，但我觉得‘PAA’这名字对他来说太逊了，所以我给他取名伊迪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Iddi is a personal droid for elderly and disabled people. Technically, Iddi is designated as a ‘Personal Accessibility Assistant,’ but I think ‘PAA’ was a lame name for him, so I named him Iddi.”"

rows.original: You look Paige over and mention that she appears neither elderly nor disabled. She chuckles nervously. “I like to tell people that I got Iddi just because I’m really lazy. Iddi does a lot of shopping for me down in the Merchant Deck. But, the truth is...”
rows.translation: 你上下打量佩姬，指出她看起来既不年迈，也不像身有残疾。她紧张地笑了笑。“我喜欢告诉别人，买伊迪只是因为我实在太懒。伊迪会替我去商业甲板买很多东西。不过，真相是...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look Paige over and mention that she appears neither elderly nor disabled. She chuckles nervously. “I like to tell people that I got Iddi just because I’m really lazy. Iddi does a lot of shopping for me down in the Merchant Deck. But, the truth is...”"

rows.original: She clenches her left fist and takes a deep breath. She reaches for her earpiece and then clicks an unseen button somewhere closer to the canal of her ear. Then, suddenly, the area around her eyes seems to flicker.
rows.translation: 她握紧左拳，深吸一口气。她伸手去摸耳麦，然后在更靠近耳道某处按下一个看不见的按钮。接着，她眼睛周围的区域突然闪动了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe clenches her left fist and takes a deep breath. She reaches for her earpiece and then clicks an unseen button somewhere closer to the canal of her ear. Then, suddenly, the area around her eyes seems to flicker."

rows.original: A green light going across both eyes and over the bridge of her nose flashes twice, and then the battery light in her earpiece shuts off. Where before Paige had stunningly beautiful blue eyes and a perfect complexion (as perfect a complexion a furry face can get, anyway), her eyes become nearly egg-white shells with barely any hint of a colored iris, and the pitch-black pupils are replaced with light-gray dots.
rows.translation: 一道绿光扫过她双眼、越过鼻梁，闪了两下，接着她耳机上的电量灯熄灭了。先前佩姬还有一双惊艳的蓝色眼睛和完美的肤色（反正，一张毛茸茸的脸能有的完美肤色也就到这份上了），此刻她的眼睛却变成了近乎蛋壳白的球体，几乎看不出还有带颜色的虹膜，漆黑的瞳孔也换成了浅灰色的小点。
rows.raw: "\n\nA green light going across both eyes and over the bridge of her nose flashes twice, and then the battery light in her earpiece shuts off. Where before Paige had stunningly beautiful blue eyes and a perfect complexion (as perfect a complexion a furry face can get, anyway), her eyes become nearly egg-white shells with barely any hint of a colored iris, and the pitch-black pupils are replaced with light-gray dots."

rows.original: But, more shockingly, there’s a massive scar going across both her eyes, reaching practically ear-to-ear. The fur you thought was there had been cut away to reveal her dead, scarred skin, about a centimeter wide, reaching all the way across her face, over her nose, and through her eyes.
rows.translation: 但更令人震惊的是，一道巨大的伤疤横贯她的双眼，几乎从一只耳朵一直延伸到另一只。你原以为那里覆盖着毛发，可那些毛已经被剃去，露出下方坏死、结疤的皮肤。疤痕约有一厘米宽，横跨整张脸，越过鼻梁，穿过双眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, more shockingly, there’s a massive scar going across both her eyes, reaching practically ear-to-ear. The fur you thought was there had been cut away to reveal her dead, scarred skin, about a centimeter wide, reaching all the way across her face, over her nose, and through her eyes."

rows.original: “I’m blind as a bat,” she finishes.
rows.translation: “我瞎得跟蝙蝠一样，”她说完。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m blind as a bat,” she finishes."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You enter Paige’s unit, looking for your favorite Ausar yoga instructor for some company. She’s always a good way to end a night, even if it doesn’t end sexily.
rows.translation: 你走进佩姬的住处，想找你最喜欢的奥萨尔瑜伽教练做个伴。她总是结束一夜的好方式，哪怕最后并不以性爱收场。
rows.raw: "You enter Paige’s unit, looking for your favorite Ausar yoga instructor for some company. She’s always a good way to end a night, even if it doesn’t end sexily."

rows.original: Although Iddi is quick to show you in and holler for his owner, Paige isn’t with you as quickly as she normally is. “Over here,” she yells back, from the opposite end of her unit. She’s huddled into a ball, one ear tightly pressed against the wall. She’s got a tense look of concentration on her face: one eye closed, her nose scrunched as her breath is held. Her ears are straight up and attentive, flicking at any sound she hears.
rows.translation: 尽管伊迪很快就请你进门，并大声呼唤主人，但佩姬并没有像往常那样迅速出现。“在这边，”她从单元房另一端喊道。她蜷成一团，一只耳朵紧紧贴在墙上。她神情紧绷而专注：一只眼睛闭着，鼻子皱起，屏住呼吸。双耳笔直竖起，警觉地捕捉着每一道声响。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough Iddi is quick to show you in and holler for his owner, Paige isn’t with you as quickly as she normally is. “Over here,” she yells back, from the opposite end of her unit. She’s huddled into a ball, one ear tightly pressed against the wall. She’s got a tense look of concentration on her face: one eye closed, her nose scrunched as her breath is held. Her ears are straight up and attentive, flicking at any sound she hears."

rows.original: You ask her what she’s doing down there. She whispers tersely, speaking in hushed, quick words. “Around this time, every three-hundred-fifty or sixty solar cycles,” she begins, then stops, listening for something in the walls, “I always hear some kind of rummaging in my yoga studio. I’m keeping an ear open for it right now.”
rows.translation: 你问她蹲在那儿干什么。她压低声音，用又轻又快的语气急促地说。“差不多这个时候，每隔三百五六十个恒星周期，”她开口道，然后停下，听着墙里的动静，“我总听见瑜伽室里有什么在翻东西。我现在正竖着耳朵听。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what she’s doing down there. She whispers tersely, speaking in hushed, quick words. “Around this time, every three-hundred-fifty or sixty solar cycles,” she begins, then stops, listening for something in the walls, “I always hear some kind of rummaging in my yoga studio. I’m keeping an ear open for it right now.”"

rows.original: You ask the most obvious question first: thieves? “You’d think, but no,” she answers, prepared for the question. “The next morning, the studio is a mess, but nothing is ever missing. I set up cameras once, but someone disconnects them before they do whatever it is they do. The one and only time I sent Iddi in, I found him deactivated the next morning.
rows.translation: 你先问最显而易见的问题：小偷？“你也会这么想，但不是，”她回答，显然早有准备。“第二天早上，工作室一团乱，但从来什么都没少。我装过一次摄像头，可有人会在他们做那些事之前先把摄像头断开。我唯一一次把伊迪派进去，第二天早上发现他停机了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask the most obvious question first: thieves? “You’d think, but no,” she answers, prepared for the question. “The next morning, the studio is a mess, but nothing is ever missing. I set up cameras once, but someone disconnects them before they do whatever it is they do. The one and only time I sent Iddi in, I found him deactivated the next morning. "

rows.original: If I weren’t blind, I’d go in there and fuck up whoever’s messing with my stuff myself, but... I’ve been a little wary of confrontation ever since my last one didn’t end well for me
rows.translation: 要不是我瞎了，我早就亲自进去把那个乱动我东西的家伙揍趴下了，可是...自从上次冲突的结果不太好之后，我对正面冲突一直有点警惕
rows.raw: "If I weren’t blind, I’d go in there and fuck up whoever’s messing with my stuff myself, but... I’ve been a little wary of confrontation ever since my last one didn’t end well for me"

rows.original: This is the first time it’s happened since I’ve gotten my eyesight back, and I’ve just been itching for whoever is doing it to show up again
rows.translation: 这是我恢复视力后第一次发生这种事，我一直都迫不及待地等着那个家伙再次现身
rows.raw: "This is the first time it’s happened since I’ve gotten my eyesight back, and I’ve just been itching for whoever is doing it to show up again"

rows.original: Paige is clearly taking whatever this is seriously, so you decide to humor her and take a spot next to her, one ear pressed against the wall, listening for any noise. You two sit in silence for a while, the minutes ticking by slowly, your combined breathing as the only ambience–
rows.translation: 佩姬显然非常认真地对待这件事，于是你决定顺着她，挨着她坐下，把一只耳朵贴到墙上，倾听任何动静。你们沉默着坐了一会儿，时间一分一秒缓慢流逝，周围只有彼此交织的呼吸声–
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige is clearly taking whatever this is seriously, so you decide to humor her and take a spot next to her, one ear pressed against the wall, listening for any noise. You two sit in silence for a while, the minutes ticking by slowly, your combined breathing as the only ambience–"

rows.original: Then, you hear it.
rows.translation: 接着，你听见了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, you hear it."

rows.original: Shuffling, at first, like someone was dragging their feet across the floor. Then, you hear a loud crash, as though a dresser or cabinet had been knocked over. Followed by a whistling noise, or maybe a rushing wind.
rows.translation: 起初是拖沓的脚步声，像是有人在拖着脚走过地板。接着，你听到一声巨响，仿佛梳妆台或柜子被撞倒了。随后是一阵呼啸声，也可能是疾风。
rows.raw: "\n\nShuffling, at first, like someone was dragging their feet across the floor. Then, you hear a loud crash, as though a dresser or cabinet had been knocked over. Followed by a whistling noise, or maybe a rushing wind."

rows.original: Paige’s fur stands on end, her tail straight, as the sounds start playing. She leans closer against the wall, listening for the one thing you both want to hear: a voice. But there aren’t any. Not so much as a grunt of exertion, or a gasp for air.
rows.translation: 声音开始播放时，佩姬的毛全都竖了起来，尾巴绷得笔直。她更贴近墙壁，倾听着你们俩都想听到的那样东西：人声。但一点都没有。连一声用力的闷哼、一次喘气都没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige’s fur stands on end, her tail straight, as the sounds start playing. She leans closer against the wall, listening for the one thing you both want to hear: a voice. But there aren’t any. Not so much as a grunt of exertion, or a gasp for air."

rows.original: “Right on cue,” she whispers to herself, her ear flinching at every little noise you both hear. She bites her lower lip in excitement and indecision. “
rows.translation: “来得正是时候，”她自言自语地低声说，每听到一点细小的声响，她的耳朵就一颤。她在兴奋与犹豫中咬住下唇。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right on cue,” she whispers to herself, her ear flinching at every little noise you both hear. She bites her lower lip in excitement and indecision. “"

rows.original: The difference between every other time and now, [pc.name],” she says, “is that you’re here.
rows.translation: 以往每一次和现在的区别，[pc.name]，”她说，“就是你在这里。
rows.raw: "The difference between every other time and now, [pc.name],” she says, “is that you’re here."

rows.original: I can’t wait to get over there and finally see for myself who has the balls to break into my studio!
rows.translation: 我等不及要过去，亲眼看看到底是谁有那个胆量敢闯进我的工作室！
rows.raw: "I can’t wait to get over there and finally see for myself who has the balls to break into my studio!"

rows.original: ” She grabs you by the wrist, barely able to contain herself. “You and I together could fuck up any burglar. Let’s get over there!”
rows.translation: ”她抓住你的手腕，几乎按捺不住自己。“你我联手，什么窃贼都能收拾。我们过去吧！”
rows.raw: "” She grabs you by the wrist, barely able to contain herself. “You and I together could fuck up any burglar. Let’s get over there!”"

rows.original: Okay!
rows.translation: 好的！
rows.raw: "Okay!"

rows.original: Uhh...

When you enter Paige’s unit again, she’s at her now-familiar corner, her body pulled into a tight ball and her ear against the wall. She waves you over when Iddi invites you in, motioning for you to sit next to her.
rows.translation: 你再次走进佩姬的房间时，她正待在那个你已经熟悉的角落，身体蜷成一团，耳朵贴着墙。伊迪请你进去时，她朝你招手，示意你坐到她旁边。
rows.raw: "When you enter Paige’s unit again, she’s at her now-familiar corner, her body pulled into a tight ball and her ear against the wall. She waves you over when Iddi invites you in, motioning for you to sit next to her."

rows.original: “I’m still on the lookout,” she tells you matter-of-factly. “Once the noises start, they go for about seven solar days, and I’m going to be keeping an ear out for them every single night until then.”
rows.translation: “我还在守着，” 她一本正经地告诉你。“那些声音一旦开始，会持续大约七个太阳日，在那之前我每晚都会留一只耳朵听着。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m still on the lookout,” she tells you matter-of-factly. “Once the noises start, they go for about seven solar days, and I’m going to be keeping an ear out for them every single night until then.”"

rows.original: Just as she says that, the eerie noises begin to sound through the thick walls of her unit. Like before, they started with a rough shuffling, followed by a crash, and followed by a cacophony of other noises, particularly whistles, but no voices. You both listen to the noises for a moment, listening for anything that could pin the intrusion to a person, but you hear nothing of the sort.
rows.translation: 她话音刚落，那些诡异的声响便穿透单元房厚实的墙壁传来。和之前一样，先是粗重的拖动声，随后是一声撞击，紧接着响起其他各种杂音，其中尤其多的是口哨声，却听不见人声。你们一起听了片刻，试图捕捉任何能证明入侵者是某个人的线索，却什么也没听到。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as she says that, the eerie noises begin to sound through the thick walls of her unit. Like before, they started with a rough shuffling, followed by a crash, and followed by a cacophony of other noises, particularly whistles, but no voices. You both listen to the noises for a moment, listening for anything that could pin the intrusion to a person, but you hear nothing of the sort."

rows.original: “What’dya say?” Paige asks you, her eyes gleaming with excitement. “You feel up to beating up some bad guys tonight?
rows.translation: “你觉得怎么样？”佩姬问道，双眼因兴奋而闪闪发亮。“今晚有兴趣去揍几个坏蛋吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’dya say?” Paige asks you, her eyes gleaming with excitement. “You feel up to beating up some bad guys tonight?"

rows.original: I’d love to see the look on their faces when we bust them!
rows.translation: 我真想看看我们抓住他们时，他们脸上会是什么表情！”
rows.raw: " I’d love to see the look on their faces when we bust them!"

rows.original: Okay!
rows.translation: 好的！
rows.raw: "Okay!"

rows.original: Uhh...
You step into Paige’s unit. Everything is exactly as she left it when she was made your ship’s navigator.
rows.translation: 你走进佩姬的舱室。一切都保持着她被任命为你飞船领航员时的样子。
rows.raw: "You step into Paige’s unit. Everything is exactly as she left it when she was made your ship’s navigator."

rows.original: Paige is there, lounging on her couch and enjoying her shore-leave from your ship. Despite the constant traveling to new and exotic lands, there is, after all, no place like home. Her helper droid, Iddi, sits on its charging dock in the next room.
rows.translation: 佩姬就在那儿，懒洋洋地躺在沙发上，享受着她从你船上放的下船假。尽管总是往新的异乡跑，可说到底，没有什么地方比得上家。她的助手机器人伊迪正待在隔壁房间的充电座上。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige is there, lounging on her couch and enjoying her shore-leave from your ship. Despite the constant traveling to new and exotic lands, there is, after all, no place like home. Her helper droid, Iddi, sits on its charging dock in the next room."

rows.original: “Hey there, [pc.name]!” she says, waving you in. You mock-frown at her, putting your hands on your [pc.hips]. “Hey we’re not on any ship, I ain’t calling you ‘captain’ anything when we’re in my own house.” She laughs and sits up, patting the seat next to her. “Come on in, let’s burn some candlelight before we leave again. I could use the company!”
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]！”她一边说，一边挥手招你进去。你故意皱眉，把双手叉在[pc.hips]上。“嘿，我们又不在船上，在我自己家里，我才不会叫你什么‘船长’。”她笑着坐直身体，拍了拍身旁的座位。“进来吧，趁我们再次出门前共度一段烛光时光。我正好想有人陪陪！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there, [pc.name]!” she says, waving you in. You mock-frown at her, putting your hands on your [pc.hips]. “Hey we’re not on any ship, I ain’t calling you ‘captain’ anything when we’re in my own house.” She laughs and sits up, patting the seat next to her. “Come on in, let’s burn some candlelight before we leave again. I could use the company!”"

rows.original: You knock on Paige’s glass door. Iddi answers it before turning back into the apartment to holler for its momma; very soon, Paige is there, opening the door and showing you into her home.
rows.translation: 你敲了敲佩姬的玻璃门。伊迪前来应门，随即转身飞回公寓，大声呼唤它的妈妈；很快佩姬便出现，打开门请你进了家。
rows.raw: "You knock on Paige’s glass door. Iddi answers it before turning back into the apartment to holler for its momma; very soon, Paige is there, opening the door and showing you into her home."

rows.original: “It’s good to see you again, sweet thing.” She laughs. “Well, you know, figure of speech with me. Go ahead and make yourself at home! I’ll be with you in just a moment.”
rows.translation: “又见到你真好，小甜心。”她笑了。“呃，你知道的，这话对我来说只是比喻。你随便坐，就当自己家！我马上就过来陪你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s good to see you again, sweet thing.” She laughs. “Well, you know, figure of speech with me. Go ahead and make yourself at home! I’ll be with you in just a moment.”"

rows.original: Paige vanishes into her bedroom while you take your seat at the lounger next to the loveseat. She’s back after a moment, her hair done up into a ponytail and the projection is on, hiding her scar from your view. Despite her disability, she seems to know exactly where you’re sitting, and she deftly walks around you and the rest of her furniture to take a seat on the couch.
rows.translation: 你在双人沙发旁的躺椅上坐下时，佩姬消失在卧室里。片刻后她便回来了，头发扎成马尾，投影也已经开启，将伤疤遮在你的视线之外。尽管身有残疾，她似乎清楚地知道你坐在哪里，灵巧地绕过你和其他家具，在沙发上坐下。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige vanishes into her bedroom while you take your seat at the lounger next to the loveseat. She’s back after a moment, her hair done up into a ponytail and the projection is on, hiding her scar from your view. Despite her disability, she seems to know exactly where you’re sitting, and she deftly walks around you and the rest of her furniture to take a seat on the couch."

rows.original: “So what’s cookin’, good lookin’?” she says, laughing again.
rows.translation: “帅哥，最近忙什么呢？”她再次笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s cookin’, good lookin’?” she says, laughing again."

rows.original: UNDERWEAR
rows.raw: "UNDERWEAR"

rows.original: You show yourself into Paige’s unit and holler her name, letting her know that you’re there. Iddi, as usual, is there to greet you first, confirming that you are who you say you are, before it rushes off to find its momma.
rows.translation: 你自行走进佩姬的单元房，喊了她一声，让她知道你来了。和往常一样，伊迪最先来迎接你；确认你确实是自己所说的那个人后，它便匆匆去找妈妈了。
rows.raw: "You show yourself into Paige’s unit and holler her name, letting her know that you’re there. Iddi, as usual, is there to greet you first, confirming that you are who you say you are, before it rushes off to find its momma."

rows.original: Paige is with you shortly.
rows.translation: 佩姬很快就过来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige is with you shortly. "

rows.original: She’s wearing some casual, done-up clothing that hugs her tight yoga body very well, and her hair is done up in a cute ponytail between her ears. She has a warm smile on her lips as she approaches you, her arms out and open, looking for you to embrace her. The projection on her eyes is on, hiding her scar from your sight.
rows.translation: 她穿着一身精心搭配的休闲服，紧贴着经过瑜伽锻炼的匀称身体，双耳之间扎着一条可爱的马尾。她面带温暖的微笑向你走来，张开双臂，等你拥抱。她眼睛上的投影已经开启，遮住了那道伤疤。
rows.raw: "She’s wearing some casual, done-up clothing that hugs her tight yoga body very well, and her hair is done up in a cute ponytail between her ears. She has a warm smile on her lips as she approaches you, her arms out and open, looking for you to embrace her. The projection on her eyes is on, hiding her scar from your sight."

rows.original: She’s down to her underwear; her bra pressing into her C-cups and deepening their natural cleavage for you. She has nothing covering her abs, gloriously displaying her tight six-pack for you to marvel over, and her panties cling to every facet of her hips and ass as she sashays towards you sexily, her tail swishing against her lower calves as she does. Her hair is let down, dropping to her shoulder blades, and her projector has been shut off, displaying the scar across her face. Her arms are open and her mouth is curled into a sultry grin, waiting for you to embrace her.
rows.translation: 她身上只剩内衣；胸罩压着她的C罩杯，为你把天生的乳沟挤得更深。她的腹部什么也没遮，骄傲地展示那紧实的六块腹肌供你赞叹；她性感地扭着腰朝你走来，内裤贴着她髋部和屁股的每一处曲线，尾巴随着步伐在小腿肚上扫过。她的头发放了下来，垂到肩胛骨，投影器已经关掉，露出横过脸颊的那道疤。她张开双臂，嘴角弯成一个撩人的笑，等着你抱住她。
rows.raw: "She’s down to her underwear; her bra pressing into her C-cups and deepening their natural cleavage for you. She has nothing covering her abs, gloriously displaying her tight six-pack for you to marvel over, and her panties cling to every facet of her hips and ass as she sashays towards you sexily, her tail swishing against her lower calves as she does. Her hair is let down, dropping to her shoulder blades, and her projector has been shut off, displaying the scar across her face. Her arms are open and her mouth is curled into a sultry grin, waiting for you to embrace her."

rows.original: “Hey there, sexy,” she says when you finally meet her hug. She gives you a quick kiss on the lips – no tongue, and not for long, but just long enough. “It’s good to see you again. Metaphorically,” she snickers.
rows.translation: “嘿，性感宝贝，”当你终于投入她怀中时，她说道。她在你唇上飞快地亲了一下——没有伸舌头，时间也不长，但恰到好处。“真高兴再次见到你。打个比方而已，”她窃笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there, sexy,” she says when you finally meet her hug. She gives you a quick kiss on the lips – no tongue, and not for long, but just long enough. “It’s good to see you again. Metaphorically,” she snickers."

rows.original: She grabs you by the hand and leads you back into her bedroom. She takes a seat on the edge of the bed and waits for you to join her. You do.
rows.translation: 她拉住你的手，把你带回她的卧室。她在床边坐下，等你过去陪她。你过去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grabs you by the hand and leads you back into her bedroom. She takes a seat on the edge of the bed and waits for you to join her. You do."

rows.original: “So what’s the plan for tonight, good lookin’?” she asks you.
rows.translation: “那今晚有什么安排，小美人？” 她问你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s the plan for tonight, good lookin’?” she asks you."

rows.original: Surgery Alert!
rows.translation: 手术通知！
rows.raw: "Surgery Alert!"

rows.original: B
The familiar tone of receiving a new message rings through the air. You bring your codex off your hip, checking who it’s from – it’s from Tavros’ Infirmary!
rows.translation: 收到新消息时熟悉的提示音在空气中响起。你从腰间取下百科终端，查看发件人——消息来自塔夫罗斯医务室！
rows.raw: "The familiar tone of receiving a new message rings through the air. You bring your codex off your hip, checking who it’s from – it’s from Tavros’ Infirmary!"

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 小姐
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: [pc.name],” it reads, “you’re receiving this message as Miss Paige’s partner and sponsor. We’re happy to report that her surgery to replace her damaged eyes with a synthetic, biologically identical set has been a success.” That’s a relief. And that’s exciting! Paige will be able to see again! “Miss Paige is currently in an induced coma; we request your presence within the next twelve hours to proceed.”
rows.translation: [pc.name]，”消息写道，“您作为佩姬女士的伴侣及资助人收到这则通知。我们很高兴地报告，她用一套合成且在生物学上完全相同的眼睛替换受损双眼的手术已成功完成。”这下你放心了。而且实在令人激动！佩姬马上就能重见光明！“佩姬女士目前正处于诱导昏迷状态；我们请您在接下来的十二小时内到场，以便继续后续程序。”
rows.raw: " [pc.name],” it reads, “you’re receiving this message as Miss Paige’s partner and sponsor. We’re happy to report that her surgery to replace her damaged eyes with a synthetic, biologically identical set has been a success.” That’s a relief. And that’s exciting! Paige will be able to see again! “Miss Paige is currently in an induced coma; we request your presence within the next twelve hours to proceed.”"

rows.original: Hell, those twelve hours went by like they were nothing! There’s no time to lose: you need to get to the Medical Bay right now!
rows.translation: 见鬼，那十二个小时居然一晃就过去了！不能再耽误了：你得马上赶到医疗舱去！
rows.raw: "\n\nHell, those twelve hours went by like they were nothing! There’s no time to lose: you need to get to the Medical Bay right now!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The first thing to greet you when you step onto your ship is Paige, walking casually up to you with a bit of a sashay in her hips. It’s good to see that she found the place just fine
rows.translation: 一踏上你的飞船，迎接你的就是佩姬，她随意地朝你走来，胯部带着一点摇曳的步态。很高兴看到她这么顺利就找到了这地方
rows.raw: "The first thing to greet you when you step onto your ship is Paige, walking casually up to you with a bit of a sashay in her hips. It’s good to see that she found the place just fine"

rows.original: , although you wonder how she got here before you. Eh, fuck it
rows.translation: ，不过你有点好奇她怎么会比你先到这里。呃，管他的
rows.raw: ", although you wonder how she got here before you. Eh, fuck it"

rows.original: “You didn’t tell me you had any other crew on this ship,” she starts. You were dreading this conversation, although Paige seems to have a fairly casual tone to her voice.
rows.translation: “你没告诉我这艘船上还有其他船员，”她开口说道。你一直害怕谈起这件事，不过佩姬的语气听起来相当随意。
rows.raw: " “You didn’t tell me you had any other crew on this ship,” she starts. You were dreading this conversation, although Paige seems to have a fairly casual tone to her voice."

rows.original: “I had the chance to meet some of your other crew,” she starts. You’re curious to hear what she thinks about the rest of your merry bunch. “You’ve sure got a... unique taste in company. Present company included, I suppose.”
rows.translation: “我有机会见到了你的其他几名船员，”她开口说道。你很好奇她对这群欢乐伙伴有什么看法。“你挑选同伴的口味还真是...独特。当然，我想也包括眼前这位。”
rows.raw: " “I had the chance to meet some of your other crew,” she starts. You’re curious to hear what she thinks about the rest of your merry bunch. “You’ve sure got a... unique taste in company. Present company included, I suppose.”"

rows.original: “I see I’m not the first Ausar to catch your fancy. I mean, damn, I can see why: the first thing I see when I step foot on this ship is a bombshell like Anno? You sure know how to pick them, stud! I wonder if she’d be down for a little bit of extra fun on the side.”
rows.translation: “看来我不是第一个引起你兴趣的奥萨尔人。我的意思是，天啊，我完全理解原因：我一踏上这艘船，第一眼见到的就是安诺那样的性感尤物？你可真会挑人，猛男！不知道她愿不愿意私下再找点乐子。”
