rows.raw: "\n\n“I see I’m not the first Ausar to catch your fancy. I mean, damn, I can see why: the first thing I see when I step foot on this ship is a bombshell like Anno? You sure know how to pick them, stud! I wonder if she’d be down for a little bit of extra fun on the side.”"

rows.original: “That Galotian of yours is pretty bubbly. I’m not gonna judge you on your sense of character – after all, you chose me, and I’m pretty great – but I kinda wonder what Celise’s story is. Is she a pet? Is she, like, some kind of master gunner or something under that liquid exterior?”
rows.translation: “你那个加洛提亚人还挺活泼的。我不会评判你看人的眼光——毕竟你选了我，而我相当出色——但我有点好奇赛丽丝的来历。她是宠物吗？还是说，那副液态外表下其实藏着某种炮术大师之类的人物？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That Galotian of yours is pretty bubbly. I’m not gonna judge you on your sense of character – after all, you chose me, and I’m pretty great – but I kinda wonder what Celise’s story is. Is she a pet? Is she, like, some kind of master gunner or something under that liquid exterior?”"

rows.original: <i>“Your gray-goo, uh, companion is... she’s awfully forward. I love a good hug as much as the next gal, but funny thing about goo people is that their hugs are kinda... full-body. And she’s got enough ‘material’ to make it a whole other experience, if you get me.

I’m assuming she’s some kind of rescue case and not something a little more sinister on your part.”

She gave me some sob story about her being a slave before you bought her contract? She seems to like being with you, so that’s pretty sweet, I guess. Also, I love her hair.”

She gave me some sob story about her being a slave before you bought her contract? She seems to like being with you, so that’s pretty sweet, I guess. Also, I love her hair.”"

rows.original: “I have no idea what Yammi even is. I hope that’s not speciesist. She seems cool; apparently she’s onboard as your chef? And she and the pexiga are a part of a package somehow? rows.translation: “是吗？”她回答，眼睛睁开，望着你的眼睛。房间里的光很暗，但你仍能看见那仅有的微光在她眼中反射。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah?” she replies, her eyes open and on yours. The room’s light is very dim, but you can still see what little light there is reflect off her eyes."

rows.original: You say nothing for a moment, keeping her in suspense. You just watch each other for a time, admiring each other’s features without saying or doing anything to break the mood – and then, of course, you do exactly that: you lean forward slightly, and you touch your nose to hers. <i>“
rows.translation: 你沉默片刻，让她继续悬着心。你们只是彼此注视了一会儿，静静欣赏对方的面容，不说也不做任何破坏气氛的事——然后你当然就做了：你稍稍向前倾身，用鼻尖碰上她的鼻尖。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say nothing for a moment, keeping her in suspense. You just watch each other for a time, admiring each other’s features without saying or doing anything to break the mood – and then, of course, you do exactly that: you lean forward slightly, and you touch your nose to hers. <i>“"

rows.original: Boop!
rows.translation: 戳！
rows.raw: "Boop!"

rows.original: shake
rows.raw: "shake"

rows.original: ” you loudly exclaim once your nose taps hers.
rows.translation: ” 你的鼻子一碰到她的，你就大声喊起来。
rows.raw: "” you loudly exclaim once your nose taps hers."

rows.original: “Nooooo!” she wails, thrashing her limbs beneath the sheets of your bed in mock dismay, “my nose has been booped! Gosh hecking darn it!”
rows.translation: “不——！”她哀号着，在你床上的被单下夸张地挥舞四肢，装出一副悲痛欲绝的样子，“我的鼻子被戳了！真是见鬼了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nooooo!” she wails, thrashing her limbs beneath the sheets of your bed in mock dismay, “my nose has been booped! Gosh hecking darn it!”"

rows.original: In retaliation, her limbs tighten around yours, clutching you tighter to her body so that you can’t get away. “This can’t go unpunished!” she says, her tone angry, yet she can’t mask the occasional giggle. “Prepare for some mutually-assured boopage,
rows.translation: 作为报复，她的四肢缠紧你的，把你更紧地搂向她的身体，让你逃不掉。“这件事不能就这么算了！”她说，语气里带着怒气，却掩不住不时漏出的咯咯笑。“准备迎接互相保证式的点鼻子，
rows.raw: "\n\nIn retaliation, her limbs tighten around yours, clutching you tighter to her body so that you can’t get away. “This can’t go unpunished!” she says, her tone angry, yet she can’t mask the occasional giggle. “Prepare for some mutually-assured boopage, "

rows.original: mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "mister"

rows.original: miss
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "miss"

rows.original: She closes the gap between you and meshes her wet ausar nose against yours, saying ‘boop!’ as she does so. But she doesn’t stop: she continues assaulting you, rubbing her nose back and forth against yours, sometimes pulling back just to press forward once more. She resists the urge to giggle every time she says the word ‘boop,’ and outwardly laughs whenever you return the assault with each ‘boop’ of your own.
rows.translation: 她缩短你们之间的距离，用湿润的奥萨鼻子蹭上你的鼻尖，同时说了一声“戳！”但她没有停下：她继续向你发动攻击，鼻子贴着你的来回磨蹭，有时还会稍稍后退，只为再次向前顶来。她每次说“戳”时都努力忍住咯咯笑的冲动，而每当你也用自己的“戳”发动反击，她便会放声大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe closes the gap between you and meshes her wet ausar nose against yours, saying ‘boop!’ as she does so. But she doesn’t stop: she continues assaulting you, rubbing her nose back and forth against yours, sometimes pulling back just to press forward once more. She resists the urge to giggle every time she says the word ‘boop,’ and outwardly laughs whenever you return the assault with each ‘boop’ of your own."

rows.original: You run your fingers through the coarse hairs of her fur, feeling along her strong upper-back and her shoulders, keeping her clamped to your own body. Eventually, the booping assault slowly winds down into gentle, closed-mouth kisses along each other’s jawlines and cheeks – though, to establish dominance, you’re sure to kiss her on the nose at least once more for every time she kisses yours.
rows.translation: 你的手指穿过她粗硬的毛发，沿着强壮的上背与肩膀摸索，把她紧紧按在自己怀中。最终，这场戳鼻大战渐渐平息，变成彼此在下颌线与脸颊上轻柔的闭口亲吻——不过为了确立优势，她每亲你鼻子一次，你都会至少再亲回一次。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou run your fingers through the coarse hairs of her fur, feeling along her strong upper-back and her shoulders, keeping her clamped to your own body. Eventually, the booping assault slowly winds down into gentle, closed-mouth kisses along each other’s jawlines and cheeks – though, to establish dominance, you’re sure to kiss her on the nose at least once more for every time she kisses yours."

rows.original: Over time, you’ve sunk into each other, and into the mattress of your bed, calming down from the war between you two. Paige still ‘hee!’s to herself as she leans into you, her neck resting on the crook of your own, while you two enjoy each other’s presence.
rows.translation: 随着时间流逝，你们逐渐陷进彼此怀中，也陷进床垫里，从刚才的战争中平静下来。佩姬靠着你时仍会自顾自地轻声“嘻！”一下，颈部枕在你的颈窝里，你们就这样享受彼此相伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nOver time, you’ve sunk into each other, and into the mattress of your bed, calming down from the war between you two. Paige still ‘hee!’s to herself as she leans into you, her neck resting on the crook of your own, while you two enjoy each other’s presence."

rows.original: There has never been a better time to capitalize on her vulnerability! Do you go in for the kill, or do you call this one a draw?
rows.translation: 再没有比现在更适合利用她脆弱状态的时机了！你要发动致命一击，还是宣布这一局平手？
rows.raw: "\n\nThere has never been a better time to capitalize on her vulnerability! Do you go in for the kill, or do you call this one a draw?"

rows.original: Hold Her
rows.translation: 抱住她
rows.raw: "Hold Her"

rows.original: You decide to put an end to this silly debacle between you. It isn’t about who is more boopable or who is the boopinest between you. It’s about holding your ausar woman in your arms in your bed and embracing her, sharing the warmth between you. Booping is neither here nor there, in the grand scheme of things.
rows.translation: 你决定结束这场愚蠢的争斗。重点不在于谁更适合被戳，也不在于谁才是你们之中最会戳的那个。重要的是在自己的床上把你的奥萨女人抱在怀里，彼此相拥、分享温暖。说到底，戳不戳鼻子根本无关紧要。
rows.raw: "You decide to put an end to this silly debacle between you. It isn’t about who is more boopable or who is the boopinest between you. It’s about holding your ausar woman in your arms in your bed and embracing her, sharing the warmth between you. Booping is neither here nor there, in the grand scheme of things."

rows.original: You two hold each other, keeping your limbs tight around one-another, but not so hard as to be difficult or constraining. Once the giggles and laughter have calmed from Paige’s lungs, her breathing settles into a gentle, familiar pattern, one you can’t help but subconsciously match: in through the nose; hold for a second or two; then back out.
rows.translation: 你们抱住彼此，四肢紧紧环绕对方，却没有紧到令人难受或受到束缚。等佩姬胸腔里的咯咯笑声逐渐平息，她的呼吸也稳定成温和而熟悉的节奏，你不由自主地跟着同步：用鼻子吸气；屏息一两秒；再缓缓呼出。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou two hold each other, keeping your limbs tight around one-another, but not so hard as to be difficult or constraining. Once the giggles and laughter have calmed from Paige’s lungs, her breathing settles into a gentle, familiar pattern, one you can’t help but subconsciously match: in through the nose; hold for a second or two; then back out."

rows.original: Each inhale gives you a good lungful of her scent, and you know the same is happening with her. You fret over the littlest, most inconsequential things – do you smell bad? Is it going to be your scent that imprints on her, or will it be your stink? You feel her hands shift across your back. Do you have zits on your back that you aren’t aware of, and what if she finds one? Gods, you’re breathing against her ear – is that annoying her? What about your breath, does it smell bad?
rows.translation: 每次吸气，你都能满满闻到她的气味，也知道她同样闻得到你。你开始担心最微不足道、最无关紧要的小事——自己闻起来难闻吗？烙进她记忆里的会是你的气味，还是你的臭味？你感觉她的手在你背上移动。你背上会不会长着连自己都不知道的痘痘？要是她摸到一颗怎么办？天啊，你正对着她耳边呼吸——会不会惹她心烦？还有你的口气，它闻起来难闻吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nEach inhale gives you a good lungful of her scent, and you know the same is happening with her. You fret over the littlest, most inconsequential things – do you smell bad? Is it going to be your scent that imprints on her, or will it be your stink? You feel her hands shift across your back. Do you have zits on your back that you aren’t aware of, and what if she finds one? Gods, you’re breathing against her ear – is that annoying her? What about your breath, does it smell bad?"

rows.original: Paige’s body shifts, pulling away from you just enough so she can crook her head down, pressing her other ear against your chest. You’re more acutely aware than ever of your own heartbeat as it thump-thump-thump against your ribs; your every beat pulses throughout your body, practically bouncing Paige off of you.
rows.translation: 佩姬挪动身体，稍稍离开你一些，好让她低下头，把另一只耳朵贴在你胸口。你从未如此清楚地意识到自己的心跳；它砰、砰、砰地撞击肋骨，每一下都让脉动传遍全身，几乎要把佩姬从你身上弹开。
rows.raw: "\n\nPaige’s body shifts, pulling away from you just enough so she can crook her head down, pressing her other ear against your chest. You’re more acutely aware than ever of your own heartbeat as it thump-thump-thump against your ribs; your every beat pulses throughout your body, practically bouncing Paige off of you."

rows.original: And although you can’t hear it from where you are, you can feel Paige’s own heart against your body, particularly your arms and hands as they clamp against Paige’s back. You’re a bit off-sync with each other – hers is beating slower than yours, which you attribute to her yoga giving her a lower resting beat-per-minute – but that just makes you cherish the few seconds when your heartbeat and hers line up just perfectly.
rows.translation: 虽然你从现在的位置听不见，但能感觉到佩姬的心脏也贴着你的身体跳动，尤其是你紧按着她后背的手臂与双手。你们的节奏有些错开——她的心跳比你慢，你把这归因于瑜伽让她拥有更低的静息心率——可这只会让你更加珍惜你们两颗心恰好完美同步的那短短几秒。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd although you can’t hear it from where you are, you can feel Paige’s own heart against your body, particularly your arms and hands as they clamp against Paige’s back. You’re a bit off-sync with each other – hers is beating slower than yours, which you attribute to her yoga giving her a lower resting beat-per-minute – but that just makes you cherish the few seconds when your heartbeat and hers line up just perfectly."

rows.original: With a discerning hum, Paige pulls back, straightening her neck a bit. “Hey, [pc.name],” she says, nudging you with her nose to get your attention. When you open your eyes, you see her own, narrowed and focused on yours.
rows.translation: 佩姬带着审慎的哼声往后一撤，稍稍直起脖子。“嘿，[pc.name]，”她用鼻子蹭了蹭你以引起你的注意。你睁开眼时，看到她的眼睛眯着，正盯着你的眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a discerning hum, Paige pulls back, straightening her neck a bit. “Hey, [pc.name],” she says, nudging you with her nose to get your attention. When you open your eyes, you see her own, narrowed and focused on yours."

rows.original: “Tell me you love me,” she implores. She doesn’t hesitate with the statement, but she does with the follow-up, stuttering for a second before catching her own tongue. “I mean, I don’t need to hear it. But I want to hear it. Or... for you to show me, or something. Sometimes, a girl just wants to know, you know?”
rows.translation: “说你爱我，”她恳求道。这句话她说得毫不迟疑，但接下来的话却卡了一下，结巴了一秒才找回舌头。“我是说，我并不是非要听。但我想听。或者...让你做给我看，什么的。有时候，姑娘就是想知道，你懂吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me you love me,” she implores. She doesn’t hesitate with the statement, but she does with the follow-up, stuttering for a second before catching her own tongue. “I mean, I don’t need to hear it. But I want to hear it. Or... for you to show me, or something. Sometimes, a girl just wants to know, you know?”"

rows.original: How will you express yourself to Paige?
rows.translation: 你要如何向佩姬表达自己？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow will you express yourself to Paige?"

rows.original: Tell Her
rows.translation: 告诉她
rows.raw: "Tell Her"

rows.original: Paige wants to know what she means to you. That sounds like a pretty simple no-brainer to you: the words come easily and naturally.
rows.translation: 佩姬想知道她对你意味着什么。对你来说，这简直是不假思索便能回答的问题：那些话轻易而自然地脱口而出。
rows.raw: "Paige wants to know what she means to you. That sounds like a pretty simple no-brainer to you: the words come easily and naturally."

rows.original: “Paige,” you say, placing your hand beneath her chin and angling her gaze upward, towards yours. You can’t make out the details of her face in the dim light of your quarters, but you can see the gleam of the room’s emergency lighting in her eyes. She’s completely focused on you and your next move – her breath is held and her heartbeat is going a mile a minute.
rows.translation: “佩姬，”你说着，把手放到她下巴下面，让她的目光向上抬，迎向你的目光。在你舱室昏暗的光线里，你看不清她脸上的细节，但你能看见房间应急灯的光在她眼中闪动。她完全专注于你和你的下一步–她屏住呼吸，心跳快得要命。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Paige,” you say, placing your hand beneath her chin and angling her gaze upward, towards yours. You can’t make out the details of her face in the dim light of your quarters, but you can see the gleam of the room’s emergency lighting in her eyes. She’s completely focused on you and your next move – her breath is held and her heartbeat is going a mile a minute."

rows.original: “I love you,” you say, cutting the tension with the phrase she had wanted you to say.
rows.translation: “我爱你，”你说道，用她一直想听到的这句话划破紧张气氛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you,” you say, cutting the tension with the phrase she had wanted you to say."

rows.original: She makes a few movements, but they’re all so slight that you wouldn’t have been able to tell if her body wasn’t currently wrapped around yours. She takes a sharp inward breath. Her hands tense on your back. Her arms and head shake, ever so slightly.
rows.translation: 她动了几下，但动作都极其轻微；若不是她此刻正缠在你身上，你根本察觉不到。她猛吸一口气。按在你背上的双手绷紧。她的双臂和脑袋都极其轻微地颤抖起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe makes a few movements, but they’re all so slight that you wouldn’t have been able to tell if her body wasn’t currently wrapped around yours. She takes a sharp inward breath. Her hands tense on your back. Her arms and head shake, ever so slightly."

rows.original: Her head lowers and she lays the crook of her chin against your neck. She’s tense, and you don’t think she realizes it. Her limbs wrap tighter around you, holding you closer to her; you can feel her heart press into you with each of its excited heartbeats. After a time, she remembers to exhale.
rows.translation: 她低下头，把下巴的弯处搁在你颈上。她绷得很紧，你觉得她自己并没意识到。她的四肢把你缠得更紧，将你搂得更近；你能感到她的心随着每一次兴奋的跳动顶着你。过了一会儿，她才想起来呼气。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer head lowers and she lays the crook of her chin against your neck. She’s tense, and you don’t think she realizes it. Her limbs wrap tighter around you, holding you closer to her; you can feel her heart press into you with each of its excited heartbeats. After a time, she remembers to exhale."

rows.original: “I love you too, [pc.name],” she whispers into your ear.
rows.translation: “我也爱你，[pc.name]，”她贴着你的耳朵低语。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love you too, [pc.name],” she whispers into your ear."

rows.original: You think of a myriad of other things you could tell her. Like, when you first realized that you loved her, or if there’s more you could do for her. But every time you think you have a sentence formed in your mouth, it falls apart when another part of your mind reasons that you’ve said everything you could possibly say, and that adding to it would break the immersion she has into you.
rows.translation: 你想到还有无数事情可以告诉她。比如你最初何时意识到自己爱她，或者还能为她做些什么。可每当你觉得一句话已在嘴里成形，脑海的另一部分便会告诉你：该说的话你已经全都说尽，再添什么反而会破坏她沉浸于你的感觉；于是那句话又随之瓦解。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think of a myriad of other things you could tell her. Like, when you first realized that you loved her, or if there’s more you could do for her. But every time you think you have a sentence formed in your mouth, it falls apart when another part of your mind reasons that you’ve said everything you could possibly say, and that adding to it would break the immersion she has into you."

rows.original: Judging from the way her breath sporadically holds in her lungs, and the way you can feel her jaw move as she mouths silent words to herself, you get the feeling that she’s doing the exact same thing, and coming to the exact same conclusion.
rows.translation: 从她的呼吸时不时憋在肺里的样子，还有你能感觉到她的下巴在动、无声地对自己说着什么，你觉得她正在做完全一样的事，也正得出完全一样的结论。
rows.raw: "\n\nJudging from the way her breath sporadically holds in her lungs, and the way you can feel her jaw move as she mouths silent words to herself, you get the feeling that she’s doing the exact same thing, and coming to the exact same conclusion."

rows.original: There’s nothing more to be said or done tonight. You have Paige in your arms, holding her tightly to your body in the warmth of your bed, in the security of your ship, and in the comfort and darkness of your quarters. You close your eyes. Sleep comes quickly and smoothly.
rows.translation: 今晚再没什么可说的，也没什么可做的了。佩姬就在你怀里，你把她紧紧搂在身上，在你温暖的床上，在你安全的飞船里，在你舱室的舒适与黑暗之中。你闭上眼睛。睡意很快、很顺地来了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s nothing more to be said or done tonight. You have Paige in your arms, holding her tightly to your body in the warmth of your bed, in the security of your ship, and in the comfort and darkness of your quarters. You close your eyes. Sleep comes quickly and smoothly."

rows.original: PCSTH
rows.raw: "PCSTH"

rows.original: Kiss Her
rows.translation: 亲吻她
rows.raw: "Kiss Her"

rows.original: It’s easy to say that words are cheap. But the three, itty-bitty little words that Paige wants you to say... they simultaneously carry a ton of power behind them, and at the same time, they simply aren’t enough.
rows.translation: 人们很容易说言语廉价。可佩姬想听你说出的那三个小小的词……它们既承载着无比沉重的力量，同时又远远不足以表达一切。
rows.raw: "It’s easy to say that words are cheap. But the three, itty-bitty little words that Paige wants you to say... they simultaneously carry a ton of power behind them, and at the same time, they simply aren’t enough."

rows.original: You place your hand beneath Paige’s chin, tilting her gaze upward, towards yours. Her breath catches in her throat, and you can see the gleam of the room’s emergency lighting in her eyes. You can’t make out the finer details of her face in this light, but you can feel her heartbeat through her body, and you can see her lips quiver in nervousness. Hopefully you’re making the right move.
rows.translation: 你把手托在佩姬下巴下，将她的视线抬向你。她呼吸一滞，你能看见房间应急灯光在她眼中闪烁。这样的光线下，你无法看清她脸上更细微的神情，却能透过身体感觉到她的心跳，也能看见她的嘴唇因紧张而颤抖。希望你做出了正确的选择。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou place your hand beneath Paige’s chin, tilting her gaze upward, towards yours. Her breath catches in her throat, and you can see the gleam of the room’s emergency lighting in her eyes. You can’t make out the finer details of her face in this light, but you can feel her heartbeat through her body, and you can see her lips quiver in nervousness. Hopefully you’re making the right move."

rows.original: You lean in the few millimetres separating you, and you press your [pc.lipsChaste] to hers. You try and visualize how you want your lips to feel as you kiss her, and the first thing you think of is the velvety-soft feel of a rose’s petals. You try to mimic that texture: not too hard, and not too insistent–
rows.translation: 你越过彼此间仅剩的几毫米，将[pc.lipsChaste]贴上她的双唇。亲吻她时，你试着想象自己希望嘴唇呈现怎样的触感，最先想到的是玫瑰花瓣天鹅绒般的柔软。你尝试模仿那种质感：不要太用力，也不要太急切——
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in the few millimetres separating you, and you press your [pc.lipsChaste] to hers. You try and visualize how you want your lips to feel as you kiss her, and the first thing you think of is the velvety-soft feel of a rose’s petals. You try to mimic that texture: not too hard, and not too insistent–"

rows.original: Paige leans into you, tilting her head to one side, as her lips move in sync with yours, kissing you back, and you realize that you’re overthinking it. There is no ‘secret’ or ‘technique’ to kissing your lover (at least, not when you aren’t trying to be sexy) – everything Paige needs to be shown or told is right there, on your lips, pressing against hers. You’re pouring your heart and feelings into this kiss, whether you realize it or not, and she’s matching your soul by the action.

rows.translation: 你向两人露出最迷人的微笑。“听起来很有趣。我加入！” “太好了！我想我们先去找波鲁伊常春藤[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE | |和一棵芒果树 ]。[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |它 |听说它们 ]生长在纳林人的领地附近，”紫色亚马逊女郎宣布道。 眨眼之间，她带爪的手便抓住你，拖着你穿过茂盛植被。你花了几秒才适应她快得惊人却并不连贯的节奏。她实在太高兴能置身于繁盛花朵和覆满苔藓的树林之间，完全没有意识到你们有多么显眼、多么吵闹。看着这样一位经过高度改造的姑娘像初次认识世界的孩子般双眼闪闪发亮，令人心中温暖；那种深切的人性和真诚，与她致命义肢的人造感截然不同。与此同时，达贝比埃斯紧抓货运机器人；当你们潜入[silly |毛茸茸的面条 |猫科娜迦 ]的猎场时，他享受着气流吹过核心。 “我们不该更加小心吗？我在草地和土壤上发现了盘绕痕迹。” “别担心，[pc.name]，只要使用正确工具，就能轻易对付她们[silly |——例如一支红色激光笔 ]，”你们来到一片结满成熟果实的树林时，半机械人咧嘴笑道。“[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |也许途中可以摘些芒果，它们看起来又甜又好吃，”她说道，面对眼前垂挂的低矮多汁果实垂涎欲滴。她不再耽搁， |好吧，我们带走一棵小树和根部周围的一些泥土。就这棵吧，”她说道，指向一棵长势良好的幼树，大概两三岁，覆盖着柔嫩树皮。你和紫色半机械人小心地将小树挖出，从肥沃土壤中取出这株生机勃勃的植物，再放进装满湿润沉积物和泥浆的宽大花盆。波莱特将它放入货运机器人的安全储存区时， ]你从周围繁茂树枝上摘下一颗低垂的芒果，随后继续冒险，寻找健康的波鲁伊常春藤。 你能听见附近树叶沙沙、枝条折断，却始终没有近到足以让你们看清是谁或什么制造了声音。扎伊卡船员保持警戒——肢体语言不会说谎——但周围一切似乎仍令她着迷。“这里太美妙了。我觉得它正呼唤着我体内的某种东西，某种深邃、粗粝而原始的东西。你们也能感受到吗？”她问道，电蓝色双眼先望向你，又转向达贝比埃斯。腼腆的异星人不以为然地摇了摇头。这一定与她种族的生理特征有关[pc.ra zaika |，因为你也能感觉到 |，因为这次你无法感同身受 ]。“群星在上，我的心跳快得脑子都要着火了...这让我想起被莱亚克毒液迷得飘飘然是什么感觉。” 还没等你继续争论，从高耸树冠垂下的彩色藤蔓瀑布便以虹彩之美吸引了目光。花朵沿着藤蔓全长绽放，如同一颗颗璀璨星辰散布在枝叶星座之中。 “真漂亮，”两名异星人异口同声地说；你惊讶了一瞬，毕竟难得听到内向的莱亚克开口。波莱特也花了几秒才理解刚才发生什么，随后重新看向你。“我爬上去切割，你们两个负责收集，再放进货运机器人的罐子。” 她不再耽搁，跃上树干，以仿佛一生都在这样做的自然轻松姿态向上攀爬。她一次次跳跃，从浓密花帘中切下多彩藤条，让数十根鲜艳绳索洒落地面。你尽职地收集茂盛常春藤，将其存进装满营养丰富苔藓沉积物的大桶时，一小团团甜美花粉挑逗着鼻孔。大约五分钟的林业作业后，紫色半机械人滑翔回地面，金色长发和肩头披着纤细植物斗篷。 “太好玩了！达尔的孩子们为了有机会在异星树冠里活动，肯定什么都愿意做。来看看常春藤落地后状况如何，”她喘息着说道，随后长久沉默地检查自动背包里的内容。“太棒了！它们已经开始愈合，并从营养丰富的泥浆中摄取养分。” 接下来呢？ “雾气弥漫的雨林。为了平衡常春藤吸干水分的能力，我还需要[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |几朵海葵 |一棵绍勒树幼苗和一束法库海葵 ]。
rows.raw: " You give the duo your most charming smile. “Sounds like a fun time. I’m in!” “Wonderful! I think we’ll look for Porui ivy[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE | | and a mango tree ] first. [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |T |I’ve been told t ]hey grow around the Naleen territory,” the purple amazon decrees. In the blink of an eye, her clawed hand closes on you and drags you through the lush vegetation. It takes you a few seconds to get accustomed to her fast-paced but disjointed rhythm. She’s just so happy to dwell amidst luxurious flowers and moss-covered trees she doesn’t realize how exposed and noisy you are. There’s something heartwarming about seeing such a heavily-modified gal behave like a child discovering the world with sparkles in her eyes, something deeply humane and sincere far from the artificiality of her deadly limbs. Meanwhile, Dabbebieth holds onto the cargobot, appreciating the winds flowing against his core as you prowl into the [silly |fluffy noodles |feline nagas ]’ hunting grounds. “Shouldn’t we be more careful? I can spot traces of coil patterns in the grass and soil.” “Don’t worry [pc.name], they can be easily dealt with if you use the right tools[silly | - a red laser pointer for example ],” the cyborg smirks as you come across an area filled with trees bearing ripe fruits. “[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |Maybe we can get some mangoes on the way, they look so sweet and tasty,” she says, drooling at all of the juicy, low-hanging fruits dangling in front of you. Without further ado, |Alright, we’ll take a small one and some of the earth around its roots. Maybe this one,” she says, pointing at a well-built sproutling, maybe two or three years old with some tender bark covering it. Carefully, you dug the tiny tree out of the ground with the purple cyborg, unearthing the vigorous plant from the fertile soil, and put it into a wide pot filled with moist sediments and mud. While Paulette places it into the cargobot’s safe storage, ] you take one of the mangos hanging down the surrounding trees’ bountiful branches then resume your adventures in search for some healthy Porui ivy. You can hear leaves ruffle and twigs crack near you but never close enough for either of you to see who or what’s producing these sounds. Your zaika crewmate is on her guard — her body language can’t lie — and yet everything seems to enchant her. “This place is marvelous. I feel like it’s calling something inside me, something deep, raw, primal. Do you feel it too?” she asks, turning her electric blue eyes on you then on Dabbebieth. The shy alien shakes his features dismissively. It must be something related to her specie’s biology [pc.ra zaika |because you can feel it too |because you can’t relate to her this time ]. “Stars, my heart’s racing so fast my brain’s on fire... it reminds me of how it’s to be high on leyak venom.” Before you can argue further, colorful waterfalls of vines falling from a towering canopy draw your eyes with their iridescent beauty. Flowers bloom all along their lengths, a bit like brilliant stars arranged all over a leafy constellation. “So pretty,” the two aliens say, stunning you a second from hearing the introverted leyak for once. Paulette takes a few seconds to register what just happened before focusing back on you. “I’ll climb and cut, you two will gather them and put them in one of the cargobot’s jars.” Without further ado, she leaps up the tree, climbing it with a natural ease — as if she did this her whole life. Jump after jump, she slices multicolor cords from the dense floral curtain, showering the ground with dozens of vibrant ropes. Small clouds of sweet pollen titillate your nostrils as you dutifully collect the luscious ivy and store it in a big barrel filled with nutritious, mossy sediment. About five minutes of forestry later, the purple cyborg glides back to the ground, her golden locks and shoulders clad with a slender vegetal mantle. “That was so fun! Kids back on Dhaal would kill to have a chance to dwell in an exotic canopy. Let’s see how the ivy survived the landing,” she pants before eyeing her automated backpack’s content for long, silent seconds. “Magnificent! They are already healing and feeding from the nutrients-heavy mud.” What’s next? “The foggy rainforest. I need [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |a couple more anemones |a Saole tree seedling and a bunch of Fah’ku anemones ] to balance the ivy’s moisture-drying abilities. "

rows.original: Step by step, you go deeper into the dense forest, passing by exotic trees, tropical plants, and dozens of clear streams of lukewarm water on your way to the cloudiest part of the jungle. Fruit-bearing trees become scarcer and scarcer as a moist, warm fog slowly rises all over you. It doesn’t take you longer than a minute to walk by the first Saole tree towering way over the other trunks. You can almost hear it breathe as you pass by its bark-covered core and stumble into a darker, wetter realm filled with twilight flowers and bioluminescent squidgirls. Taking advantage of the thic[silly |c |k ], humid mist dimming the grove, Dabbebieth propels himself through the air, floating gracefully through the interlaced branches looming over you. The airborne [silly |jellyfish |alien ] swirls and glides through the sap-leaking trees with glee, savoring his complete freedom of movement while the former XO oversees your surroundings with her heightened senses and combat systems. Just as she did before, she propels herself through the leafy ceilings from time to time then swoops back a few feet next to you. “There’s three heat signatures close to us but none of them dares to approach... for now. Stay on your guard [pc.name].” “[pc.reflexesRange 60 |I spot another one sneaking standing atop this sick tree. If any of them tries anything, regroup to my position,” |Understood. Watch the skies and I’ll supervise the ground. If they come any closer, return to my position,” ] you reply, [pc.eyes] open and scouring for any sign that can betray an approaching Vanae’s gait. The vaguely-draconic cyborg soars through the moist fog, her long shadow the only evidence of her presence as you come closer and closer to your goal. She’s behaving in a rather primal manner, leaping and striding through the flexible canopy. There’s a feral joy in her moves, a deeply-rooted glee in dwelling within these living skyscrapers and moving between them with a feline deftness. If you didn’t know her better, you’d assume she’s an indigenous lifeform scouring her territory for fruits and milk. [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |Every ten or so steps, you notice something moving at the edge of your sight, ethereal shapes that disappear instantly into the dense fog shrouding this side of the jungle. The atmosphere is almost soothing: between the gentle streams of water, the tropical fog hugging you tight, and the dim lighting of the lively, local flora, the rainforest feels almost like a romantic setup waiting for a couple of lovebirds to claim it and consummate their union together. Just as you were about to let your desires take you over, a cool caress brushes your cheek and a large, pristine lake rises from behind dense leaves. The water’s almost shining with light, a mesmerizing swirl of small stars beckoning you to submerge yourself in it. You also spot Severine — the emerald sacae — [silly |playing with toy boats |putting primitive fishnet stockings on her wriggling legs ]. “Maybe we can trade some of her flowers with her again. Let’s say hello.” Slowly, you shed your [pc.gear] and enter the water, announcing yourself with dim claps on the pond’s surface. “Oh! it’s you again! I could recognize you with my eyes closed,” she teases. “Did you come to play?” Paulette speaks up a little too quickly, the taste of milk nearly on her tongue. “We’ve come to gather some anemones again. If you let us take a couple of them, we’ll gladly return the favor.” “Well then, take them and be my guests,” she teases, reaching for her precious growths. Your zaika companion barely has the time to prepare a small tank for them before the glowing squidgirl fills it with a pair of magnificent underwater flowers. “I’ve done my part of the deal. Now, time for you to repay me,” she giggles, making her wide assets quiver with delight. |Long minutes of walking later, you arrive in a bountiful bosque full of juvenile growths[silly |, maybe a shrubbery. |. ] In the blink of an eye, your alien companions land in front of you, inches away from a frail replica of the giant, misty trees. “This one looks in need of a new home, so let’s give him some breathing room,” Paulette whispers before starting to dig it out. You barely have the time to recover a pot from her hovering cargobot before she plants it back into the terracotta vase and places it in a special containment unit. “I’m surprised the Vanae didn’t attack us already; these trees mean a lot to them. Either we are scaring them or they are waiting for a better occasion to trap us — in either case, we should move on and continue: we’ve got only the Fah’ku anemones left to collect.” Without further ado, you leave the luxurious glade and follow the small rivers running through the forest in the hope you’ll find a pond or swamp big enough on the way to have a chance to find the last flowers on Paulette’s list. Every ten or so steps, you notice something moving at the edge of your sight — ethereal shapes that disappear instantly in the dense fog choking this side of the jungle. The atmosphere is almost soothing: between the gentle streams of water, the tropical fog hugging you tight, and the dim lighting of the lively, local flora, the rainforest feels almost like a romantic setup waiting for a couple of lovebirds to claim it and consummate their union together. Just as you were about to let your desires take you over, a cool caress brushes your cheek and a large, pristine lake rises from behind dense leaves. The water’s almost shining with light, a mesmerizing swirl of small stars beckoning you to submerge yourself in it. “Look friends, under the surface — these anemones are beautiful! Quick, let’s get some before the locals decide to assault us in this exposed spot.” [pc.Weapon] at the ready, you approach the sandy bank together, pots at the ready to gather some of the sensitive, wiggly flora peacefully dancing underwater. To your surprise, Paulette dives into the clear liquid with a suula’s swiftness, not encumbered in the slightest by her armored prosthetics. A few seconds later, Dabbebieth hands you a small, empty tank with his tiny tentacles, a perfect receptacle to house your findings. When your zaika companion surfaces with the freshly gathered flowers. You shed your [pc.gear] and follow her in the water to fill the reservoir with some pure water. As soon as it’s two-third full, she places two colorful anemones into it, planting them into the muddy, nutrient-filled sludge lining the container. “HEY! THAT’S MY STUFF!” In the blink of an eye, a plush, emerald squidgirl surges from the lake’s depths and points spiky gauntlets at you. “DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEA OF HOW LONG IT TOOK ME TO GREW MY SWEET BABIES?! NOBODY TAKES FROM SEVERINE WITHOUT FACING THE CONSEQUENCES!” “Wait a[silly | hot ] minute. If they belong to you, maybe we can offer something in exchange,” you reply, noticing her exposed, milk-leaking nipples, and — surprisingly — two big, knotted, prehensile cocks towering over a pair of apple-sized balls. “An exchange? Let’s see what you three have to offer,” she frowns, body markings glowing as much as her cheeks. ]
rows.translation: 你一步步深入茂密森林，沿途经过异星树木、热带植物和数十条清澈温热的小溪，朝丛林雾气最浓的区域前进。湿热雾气逐渐在周围升腾，结果树木也变得越来越稀少。不到一分钟，你便经过第一棵远高于其他树干的绍勒树。你从覆盖树皮的核心旁走过，跌入一个更加黑暗潮湿、遍布暮色花朵和生物发光鱿鱼女的世界，几乎能听见它在呼吸。 达贝比埃斯利用浓[silly |得要命的 |厚的 ]湿雾遮暗树林，推动身体飞上天空，优雅漂过头顶交织的枝杈。空中的[silly |水母 |异星人 ]开心地在渗出树液的树木间盘旋滑翔，享受完全自由的移动；前副官则利用强化感官和战斗系统监视四周。她和先前一样，时不时冲过枝叶穹顶，再俯冲回你身旁几英尺处。 “附近有三个热信号，但目前...没有一个敢靠近。保持警戒，[pc.name]。” “[pc.reflexesRange 60 |我发现另一个躲在这棵病树顶端的家伙。她们胆敢做什么，就到我的位置会合，” |明白。你监视天空，我负责地面。她们继续接近，就回到我的位置，” ]你回答道，[pc.eyes]睁大，不断搜寻任何可能暴露接近中瓦奈步态的迹象。略带龙形特征的半机械人在湿雾中翱翔；随着你们越来越接近目标，只有她长长的影子能证明其存在。她的行为颇为原始，在柔韧树冠间跳跃跨步。动作中有种野性喜悦，一种置身这些活体摩天楼、以猫科般灵巧在其间穿行的根深蒂固欢欣。如果你不了解她，大概会以为这是某种原生生命，正在领地内搜寻水果和奶汁。 [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |每走十步左右，你都会注意到视野边缘有东西移动；那些虚幻形体瞬间消失在笼罩丛林这侧的浓雾中。气氛近乎舒缓：温柔溪流、紧紧拥抱你们的热带雾气，以及本地鲜活植物的昏暗光芒，共同令雨林如同等待一对爱侣占据、并在此圆房结合的浪漫布景。 欲望正要将你吞没时，一阵清凉爱抚擦过脸颊，茂密枝叶后方浮现出一片巨大纯净的湖泊。水面几乎闪烁着光芒，迷人的细小星辰旋涡召唤你潜入其中。你还看见塞弗琳——那位翠绿色萨凯——正在[silly |玩玩具船 |给扭动的双腿穿上原始渔网袜 ]。“也许我们能再次拿她的花做交易。去打个招呼吧。” 你缓缓脱下[pc.gear]走进水中，以池面上轻微的拍击声宣告到来。“噢！又是你们！就算闭着眼睛我也能认出来，”她挑逗道。“你们是来玩的吗？” 波莱特开口得稍微太快，仿佛已经尝到奶汁滋味。“我们又来收集几朵海葵。如果你愿意让我们拿走几朵，我们很乐意回报。” “那就拿走吧，别客气，”她伸手摸向宝贵的生长物，挑逗道。发光鱿鱼女用一对华丽水下花朵装满容器，你的扎伊卡同伴几乎来不及为它们准备小水箱。“交易里我的部分已经完成。现在该你们回报了，”她咯咯笑着，宽大丰满的身体因喜悦而颤动。 |又走了漫长的几分钟，你们抵达一片生机盎然、遍布幼小植物的树林[silly |，或许该说灌木丛。 |。 ]眨眼之间，两名异星同伴降落在你面前，距离那些巨型雾树的脆弱复制品只有几英寸。“这棵看来需要一个新家，我们给它腾点呼吸空间吧，”波莱特低声说道，随后开始挖掘。你刚从悬浮货运机器人上取回花盆，她就已经将幼树重新种进赤陶花盆，放入特殊收容装置。“我很惊讶瓦奈还没有袭击我们；这些树对她们意义重大。要么是我们吓住了她们，要么是她们等待更好的时机设下陷阱——无论如何，我们都该继续前进：现在只剩法库海葵需要收集。” 你们不再耽搁，离开繁茂林间空地，沿贯穿森林的小河前进，希望途中能找到足够大的池塘或沼泽，有机会发现波莱特清单上最后的花朵。每走十步左右，你都会注意到视野边缘有东西移动——那些虚幻形体瞬间消失在扼住丛林这侧的浓雾中。气氛近乎舒缓：温柔溪流、紧紧拥抱你们的热带雾气，以及本地鲜活植物的昏暗光芒，共同令雨林如同等待一对爱侣占据、并在此圆房结合的浪漫布景。 欲望正要将你吞没时，一阵清凉爱抚擦过脸颊，茂密枝叶后方浮现出一片巨大纯净的湖泊。水面几乎闪烁着光芒，迷人的细小星辰旋涡召唤你潜入其中。“朋友们快看，水面下——这些海葵真漂亮！快点，在本地人决定袭击这个暴露地点前拿几朵。” 你们准备好[pc.Weapon]，带着花盆一同接近沙岸，准备收集在水下安静舞动的敏感植物。令你惊讶的是，波莱特以苏拉般的速度跃入清澈水中，装甲义肢完全没有造成阻碍。几秒后，达贝比埃斯用细小触手递给你一只空水箱，正适合容纳发现的东西。扎伊卡同伴带着新采集的花朵浮上水面时，你脱下[pc.gear]跟着进入水中，为容器装入清水。水箱装到三分之二后，她放入两朵彩色海葵，将其种在容器底部富含营养的泥泞淤泥里。 The three of you give her a deep, sultry kiss before leaving the water-bound native and return to Esbeth. The trip is rather uneventful since you bear the matron-sized squidgirl’s scent on you, except for Paulette startling every time the slightest noise reaches her ears, torn between the drive to protect Dabbebieth and you from harm... and the opportunity to suck down more sweet, warm cream from an unlucky bypasser. The purple cyborg calms down by the time you reach the recent settlement, coming down from her rabid high and refocusing herself for her vulnerable friend’s — and her frailer plants’ - sake. “Thanks for coming with us [pc.name], I had a pretty good time with you,” the amazon confesses before dropping a quick peck on your cheek. “I felt at home here, alive, as if I was in symbiosis with everything around me. My visor took so many beautiful pictures of the place! I think I’ll need some time to recover — and Dabbebieth will need some too to digest Severine’s rich cream,” she teases, poking at the blushing leyak’s ro[silly |t ]und figure. “I’ll see you on board captain, don’t make us wait too long[silly |~ |. ]” The alien duo waves at you then head toward the city proper, their overloaded cargobot in tow. If all of her [silly |sexcapades |excursions ] are like this, you’ll gladly have another exotic trek with them. "

rows.original: Slowly, you reach for your backpack and recover the mango you picked earlier then present it to Severine. The displaced huntress tilts her head and takes deep breaths, trying to decipher what you’ve got in hands. “I-Is that a fresh mango? GIVE IT TO ME, NOW!” Before you can, she snatches it out of your hands and takes a deep bite, swallowing a big chunk of juicy, tangy pulp. “Soooooooooooo tasty[silly |~ |! ] Do you have any idea how hard it is for a sacae to get one of these sweet, ripe fruits? The last time I tried, I almost got eaten by a couple of mean naleen! Our tentacle legs are far too slow to evade jungle predators — even vanae have a hard time leaving a fight unscathed with their stupid, sexy tree-legs,” she says before taking another mouthful. “Are we even then?” The hungry gal turns her sightless eyes on you. “This time you are good, [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |but don’t think you’ll get away with food over and over again |but you better ask for my permission to pick my little water babies the next time you come ]. Growing anemones isn’t hard but keeping them well-trimmed and healthy is a serious responsibility, so at least show some respect to their caretaker,” she grumbles before resuming her meal. It takes Paulette and you a long minute to find and convince a peacefully drifting Dabbebieth to get out the water and return to Esbeth. The trip is rather uneventful, except from a swollen kerokoras hopping in front of you without noticing your presence at all, then leaving as fast as she came. Your zaika crewmate leaps and glides through the canopy with a feral glee, giggling and swirling through the air with a demure, childish innocence — this warm environment really has an influence on her. The dense flora and the sultry aroma of musky flowers and ripe, tropical fruits accompany you through the humid warmth of the rainforest up until the shadow of prefabricated buildings and the loud cacophony of a multicultural crowd swallow your ragtag squad of alien adventurers. “Thanks for coming with us [pc.name], I had a pretty good time with you,” the amazon confesses before dropping a quick peck on your cheek. “I felt at home here, alive, as if I was in symbiosis with everything around me. I think I’ll need some time to recover from the experience, sort the pictures my visor took, and take care of our findings,” she says, running her clawed hand on the cargobot’s containment shells. “I’ll see you on board captain, don’t make us wait too long[silly |~ |. ]” The alien duo waves at you then head toward the city proper, their overloaded cargobot in tow. If all of her [silly |sexcapades |excursions ] are like this, you’ll gladly have another exotic trek with them.
rows.translation: 你慢慢伸手探进背包，取出之前摘到的芒果，递给塞弗琳。流落异乡的女猎手歪了歪头，深深吸气，试图辨认你手里拿着什么。“那、那是新鲜芒果吗？快给我！” 你还没来得及递过去，她便一把从你手中抢走，狠狠咬下一口，吞下大块多汁酸甜的果肉。 “太————好吃了[silly |~ |！ ]你知道萨凯想弄到一颗这种香甜成熟的水果有多难吗？上次我试着去摘，差点被两条凶巴巴的纳林吃掉！我们的触手腿实在太慢，根本躲不开丛林里的掠食者——就连瓦奈靠着她们那笨拙又性感的树腿，也很难毫发无伤地脱离战斗。”她说着，又大口咬下一块。 “那我们扯平了？” 饥肠辘辘的姑娘用无神的双眼转向你。“这回就算你过关了，[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |但别以为你每次都能拿食物蒙混过关 |但你下次来摘我的水中小宝贝时，最好先征得我的允许 ]。种海葵不难，但要把它们修剪整齐、照料健康可是份重任，所以至少要尊重一下它们的照料者。”她嘟囔着，又继续享用芒果。 你和波莱特花了好一会儿，才找到正安详漂浮着的达贝比埃斯，并说服他离开水中返回埃斯贝斯。一路上颇为平静，只有一只肿胀的凯洛科拉斯蹦到你们面前，完全没注意到你们的存在，随后又来得快去得也快。你的扎伊卡船员带着野性的喜悦在林冠间跃起滑翔，咯咯笑着在空中旋转，透出矜持而孩子气的天真——这片温暖的环境确实对她影响很大。茂密的植被、麝香花朵与成熟热带水果的馥郁香气，陪伴你们穿过雨林湿润的热气，直到预制建筑投下的阴影和多元人群的嘈杂声浪，将你们这支东拼西凑的异星冒险小队彻底吞没。 “谢谢你陪我们来，[pc.name]，我跟你玩得很开心。”亚马逊女战士坦言，随即在你脸颊上轻啄一下。“我在这里有种回到家的感觉，充满活力，仿佛和周围的一切共生。我想我需要一点时间从这次经历中恢复过来，整理面罩拍下的照片，再照料我们的收获。”她说着，用利爪手掌抚过货运机器人的收纳舱。“船上见，船长，别让我们等太久[silly |~ |。 ]” 异星二人组向你挥手，随后拖着满载的货运机器人朝城市中心走去。如果她每次的[silly |性爱历险 |远足 ]都像这样，你很乐意再和她们来一场异域之旅。

rows.original: “Maybe another time. I’m sure you’ll have a lot of fun together.” Paulette’s ears droop for a moment before her features recover their usual assertiveness. “As you wish [pc.name]. [flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |I won’t go to the most dangerous parts without you, so we’ll go see the nearby waterfalls instead |We’ll go see the nearby waterfalls then go back to the ship ]. See you around~” In a matter of seconds, the two aliens and the cargobot disappear from your sight, completely swallowed by the jungle’s dense flora. You know they’ll be fine but you can’t stop thinking about the kind of encounter they’ll make on their way — or rather, pity the fools that’ll cross their path. Maybe you’ll see a couple of cumflated kerokoras or a zil sucked dry on your trip through the exotic rainforest?
rows.translation: “下次吧。你们一起肯定会玩得很开心。” 波莱特的耳朵耷拉了片刻，随后神情又恢复了往常的果断。“如你所愿，[pc.name]。[flags.PAULETTE_MHENGA_DATE |没有你陪着，我不会去最危险的地方，所以我们会改去看看附近的瀑布 |那我们就去看看附近的瀑布，然后回飞船 ]。回头见~” 短短几秒内，两名异星人和货运机器人便从你的视野中消失，被丛林的茂密植被彻底吞没。你知道她们不会有事，但还是忍不住想象她们一路上会遇到怎样的遭遇——或者更确切地说，替那些会撞上她们的倒霉蛋感到可怜。或许你下次穿越这片异域雨林时，会看到几只被精液灌胀的凯洛科拉斯，或一只被榨干的泽尔？

rows.original: “Hey [pc.name], over here! We managed to get passes to enter gold myr territory; how about exploring it together? Dabbebieth yearns to see this underground people’s cultural wonders and he spiked my curiosity enough to drag me along. Would you like to join us? It could be a nice occasion to spend more time together and see what these chitinous ladies have to offer.” Gildenmere suffered from the war and its people too. Without the U.G.C’s arrival, this place — and gold myr civilization at large — might be nothing but ruins now. The situation might escalate if the negotiations don’t go well. Maybe it’ll be your last occasion to appreciate what the myrmedion have to offer? The choice is up to you.
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]，这边！我们拿到了进入金米尔领地的通行证，要不要一起去逛逛？达贝比埃斯很想见识这个地下民族的文化奇观，他也成功勾起了我的好奇心，让我跟着来了。你愿意加入我们吗？这可是个相处更久一点、看看这些甲壳姑娘能拿出什么好东西的绝佳机会。” 吉尔登米尔饱受战争摧残，这里的人民也不例外。若没有联合银河邦联到来，这个地方——乃至整个金米尔文明——如今或许只剩一片废墟。如果谈判不顺利，局势可能再次升级。也许这会是你最后一次领略米尔梅迪翁能提供的一切？选择权在你手中。

rows.original: “Be my guests,” you reply, offering your arm to the former XO. The blue leyak swirls with glee before perching himself on Paulette’s armored shoulder. Without a word, she wraps her left arm around yours and lets you guide them through the gold myrs’ capital. It takes you some minutes to stroll through the caverns, admiring the big mushrooms and the exotic growths that compose this place’s stunning flora as you come closer and closer to the dynamic streets of the merchant district. Soon, the vegetation becomes less prominent around you, replaced by an array of buildings not unlike the ones from ancient Terra’s pre-space exploration era — buildings sometimes pockmarked by the apparent scars of war. Here and there, you notice some rubbles left to clear, craters freckling the paved roads, or scaffolds hugging injured buildings while the locals fix them the best they can in the hope that the cease fire will turn into a lasting peace. Your crewmates contemplate this uncanny spectacle with wide, enchanted eyes, entranced by how lively and active this place is in spite of how close the frontlines are. You have to stop from time to time as the two of them stay gawking for long, silent moments at a particular spot then resume their trek through the crowded district again. Your companion’s visor flickers whenever you pass near an interesting piece of architecture that survived the bombardments, small memories of a place that might disappear if peace isn’t achieved soon. People give the three of you weird, pensive glances as you cross the streets, pondering if what they see is real or a vivid dream — you notice even other offworlders puzzled by your presence. “This place reminds me of Dhaal a bit, minus the civil war of course. Lots of beautiful things scattered around, but with rough edges here and there that show the deep cracks hidden under the fancy facade.” “[var0 |Isn’t the zaibatsu rivalry akin to the myr war |Don’t you have conflicts on your homeworld ]?” Paulette nods, gazing at her sleek prosthetics. “Yes and no. The three zaibatsu controlling Dhaal are always fighting for dominance but ultimately, they are codependent. The XO process was designed by their common effort to better control the working classes and choke out any attempt to organize counter powers. Here, it looks more like a full-fledged war that ravaged both sides. I heard from the red ambassadors’ gossip that they lost so many males on both sides, their species were in danger of extinction before the U.G.C showed up and forced them to see a way bigger picture.” “Yeah, they’ll have to adapt. If I may ask, which side would you back if you had to choose?” you ask as you pass next to a military checkpoint. “I’d rather not be involved in their war. When we asked for accreditation, the gold and red agents tried to recruit us as mercenaries. This world is far from peaceful but I’d rather keep it far from war instead — I don’t trust any of them to solve their respective people’s problems. The reds’ society was built by and for conflict; I doubt they’ll fare well in times of peace. Especially if they have to lead a society incorporating the golds after all they’ve gone through. As for the golds, look how quick their society became belligerent and authoritarian as soon as they were in trouble, lightyears away from their shining ideals. I just hope that whatever happens, they won’t achieve peace via mutual destruction. This planet has a lot more to offer than hatred and greed,” she says. Mustering his courage and overcoming his shyness, Dabbebieth bounces on the cyborg’s arm and sets his eyes on you. “They must be like ganraels — neither soft nor hard, solid nor liquid — they must adapt as individuals and as a society.” It takes you a few seconds to understand what happened, leaving enough time for the poetic leyak to hop back onto Paulette’s shoulder and turn his attention to a nearby source of music. Shaking the confusion away, you slowly approach the gold myr and vulkrim couple playing a beautiful duet together. The latter’s air sounds familiar to you, a melancholic whine played with a wooden flute while the native plays a more nostalgic tune with her own metallic pipe. There’s a magnificent harmony between their instruments, complementing each other rather than fighting for dominance. One tune feels like finally reaching the end of a fruitful journey while the other reads more like returning home after a tedious ordeal — then they meet and cross the door, together at long last. When the music ends, you turn around, noticing the state of your music-ravished poet and a misty-eyed Paulette. “[pc.kmhbb |Our resident artist wasn’t the most touched of the bunch, |I see you choose to be like a ganrael today, |Not so tough and serious anymore, are you? |Daww, you wanted to hear more, didn’t you? |It hits you in the feels too? ]” you tease, flustering the purple cutie and making the shy leyak laugh merrily. “No, I’ve got something in my eyes.” “What’s blocking your sight then?” “Tears!” The emotive zaika wipes her brow carefully, inhaling deep breaths to calm her racing heart while the assembled spectators tip the players with gemstones and credit chips. In the blink of an eye, Dabbebieth’s tentacles recover a small shard from Paulette’s satchel and drop it in the hat the couple uses to collect their wage to the breathless myr’s delight. After a long minute of hyperventilating, the violet cyborg tightens her grip on your arm and lets you guide her through the city again, still a bit concussed by the whirlwind of emotions that rocked her to her core. She stays quiet for long minutes, leaving the blue leyak free to enjoy and feel their way through Gildenmere’s warmth and cultural melting pot as you cross stone arteries boiling with life. Small restaurants and shops attract a lot of visitors and locals, a curtain of normalcy shrouding the cruel fate that awaits this place if anyone revokes the cease fire. Life continues on despite everything that’s happened, slowly healing the gruesome wounds the conflict inflicted to this planet’s civilisations and people. Maybe with the U.G.C’s active help and a good amount of pride and self-preservation, the myrmedions will spread their hopes and dreams across the stars. [flags.PAULETTE_MYR_DATE |As your date comes to an end, you take a last stop at Silly Slimes, Amaranthe’s shop. You find the orange myr at the same spot she was on your first visit, but this time filling her empty shelves with colorful toys. “Hey! If it isn’t my favorite customer. I don’t know what you did but my shop was swarmed by orders after your visit. They got so popular I had to hire two full time workers to help me produce and ship them.” “Glad to be of service,” Paulette giggles, eyeing the new accessories displayed near the counter. “Is anything here to your fancy? My employees will be out for a couple more hours if your desires lie in something more... adult oriented,” the cheeky myr teases. |Paulette suddenly freezes a few yards from the district’s end, her eyes locked on a small figure smiling to her from across a workshop’s display. Her mind seems charmed, hypnotized by the innocent stuffed creature, a demure ganrael plushie the same color as her prosthetics’ plates. Unable to break its grasp on her, you follow her inside the unassuming shop, startling its owner as she finishes sewing another plushie’s grateful features. Paulette snatches the stuffie from its comfy shelf and places it on the counter, brilliant stars shining in her electric blue eyes. “Nice choice, it’s one of my favorite silly slimes. Out of all my plush children, this is the one that I had the most fun designing,” the seamstress confesses, a tan-skinned myr with orange plates of chitin, a fanged mouth, and a pair of honey-laden breasts bulging her buttoned sweater. A small tag over her left boob identifies her as Amaranthe. “If I may ask, are you a red myr?” The mature ant girl chuckles. “My mother is one, but I’m more of a hybrid thanks to my father. Before the war started, there were scarce interactions between our people — some mean and brutal, some sweet and kind. Father was an entertainer, he went on a small tour across the reds’ continent and my mother was his bodyguard. Long story short, I was raised in the Scarlet Federation, did my military service there, then my mother and I moved to Gildenmere when my father’s health declined. I’ve always been a stranger wherever I go, too gold to live with the reds and too red to live with the golds. I used to create costumes for shows before the war, then I was requisitioned to make uniforms, and now that we are on the verge of peace or destruction, I’m selling peaceful-looking toys in the hope to soothe heated minds and appease broken hearts.” “Well, you healed one today,” Paulette replies, hugging her new belongings tight. “Thanks a lot [pc.name], and you too Dabbebieth. You’re brightening my days — and you too Miss Amaranthe.” The seamstress giggles. “Stop it, you’ll make me blush! If I were a few years younger I’d be a lot more daring with you. These shiny scales of yours are beautiful and really suit you, and your companions are stunning as well. I wonder what an offworlder’s touch is like,” she muses. ] The choice is up to you. Will you get some mutual fun with the mature myr and Paulette or be on your way?
rows.translation: “二位请便。”你答道，并向前任大副伸出手臂。蓝色莱亚克欢欣地打着旋，随后栖在波莱特覆甲的肩头。她一言不发地用左臂挽住你，让你领着她们穿行于金米尔的首都。你们花了几分钟漫步穿过洞窟，一边欣赏硕大的蘑菇和构成此处壮丽植被的异域植物，一边逐渐接近商贸区生机勃勃的街道。 很快，你们周围的植被渐渐稀疏，取而代之的是一排排建筑，与古代泰拉尚未进入太空探索时代的建筑颇为相似——只是这些建筑有时还布满明显的战争伤痕。你不时能看到尚待清理的瓦砾、点缀铺石道路的弹坑，或是包裹受损建筑的脚手架；当地人正尽其所能修缮，希望停火最终能化为长久的和平。你的船员睁大着迷的双眼凝望这幕奇异景象，明明前线近在咫尺，这里却依旧如此鲜活而繁忙，令她们深深陶醉。你不得不时常停下脚步，等她们对某个角落久久无言地看个够，再重新踏上穿越拥挤街区的路。 rows.raw: " “Be my guests,” you reply, offering your arm to the former XO. The blue leyak swirls with glee before perching himself on Paulette’s armored shoulder. Without a word, she wraps her left arm around yours and lets you guide them through the gold myrs’ capital. It takes you some minutes to stroll through the caverns, admiring the big mushrooms and the exotic growths that compose this place’s stunning flora as you come closer and closer to the dynamic streets of the merchant district. Soon, the vegetation becomes less prominent around you, replaced by an array of buildings not unlike the ones from ancient Terra’s pre-space exploration era — buildings sometimes pockmarked by the apparent scars of war. Here and there, you notice some rubbles left to clear, craters freckling the paved roads, or scaffolds hugging injured buildings while the locals fix them the best they can in the hope that the cease fire will turn into a lasting peace. Your crewmates contemplate this uncanny spectacle with wide, enchanted eyes, entranced by how lively and active this place is in spite of how close the frontlines are. You have to stop from time to time as the two of them stay gawking for long, silent moments at a particular spot then resume their trek through the crowded district again. Your companion’s visor flickers whenever you pass near an interesting piece of architecture that survived the bombardments, small memories of a place that might disappear if peace isn’t achieved soon. People give the three of you weird, pensive glances as you cross the streets, pondering if what they see is real or a vivid dream — you notice even other offworlders puzzled by your presence. “This place reminds me of Dhaal a bit, minus the civil war of course. Lots of beautiful things scattered around, but with rough edges here and there that show the deep cracks hidden under the fancy facade.” “[var0 |Isn’t the zaibatsu rivalry akin to the myr war |Don’t you have conflicts on your homeworld ]?” Paulette nods, gazing at her sleek prosthetics. “Yes and no. The three zaibatsu controlling Dhaal are always fighting for dominance but ultimately, they are codependent. The XO process was designed by their common effort to better control the working classes and choke out any attempt to organize counter powers. Here, it looks more like a full-fledged war that ravaged both sides. I heard from the red ambassadors’ gossip that they lost so many males on both sides, their species were in danger of extinction before the U.G.C showed up and forced them to see a way bigger picture.” “Yeah, they’ll have to adapt. If I may ask, which side would you back if you had to choose?” you ask as you pass next to a military checkpoint. “I’d rather not be involved in their war. When we asked for accreditation, the gold and red agents tried to recruit us as mercenaries. This world is far from peaceful but I’d rather keep it far from war instead — I don’t trust any of them to solve their respective people’s problems. The reds’ society was built by and for conflict; I doubt they’ll fare well in times of peace. Especially if they have to lead a society incorporating the golds after all they’ve gone through. As for the golds, look how quick their society became belligerent and authoritarian as soon as they were in trouble, lightyears away from their shining ideals. I just hope that whatever happens, they won’t achieve peace via mutual destruction. This planet has a lot more to offer than hatred and greed,” she says. Mustering his courage and overcoming his shyness, Dabbebieth bounces on the cyborg’s arm and sets his eyes on you. “They must be like ganraels — neither soft nor hard, solid nor liquid — they must adapt as individuals and as a society.” It takes you a few seconds to understand what happened, leaving enough time for the poetic leyak to hop back onto Paulette’s shoulder and turn his attention to a nearby source of music. Shaking the confusion away, you slowly approach the gold myr and vulkrim couple playing a beautiful duet together. The latter’s air sounds familiar to you, a melancholic whine played with a wooden flute while the native plays a more nostalgic tune with her own metallic pipe. There’s a magnificent harmony between their instruments, complementing each other rather than fighting for dominance. One tune feels like finally reaching the end of a fruitful journey while the other reads more like returning home after a tedious ordeal — then they meet and cross the door, together at long last. When the music ends, you turn around, noticing the state of your music-ravished poet and a misty-eyed Paulette. “[pc.kmhbb |Our resident artist wasn’t the most touched of the bunch, |I see you choose to be like a ganrael today, |Not so tough and serious anymore, are you? |Daww, you wanted to hear more, didn’t you? |It hits you in the feels too? ]” you tease, flustering the purple cutie and making the shy leyak laugh merrily. “No, I’ve got something in my eyes.” “What’s blocking your sight then?” “Tears!” The emotive zaika wipes her brow carefully, inhaling deep breaths to calm her racing heart while the assembled spectators tip the players with gemstones and credit chips. In the blink of an eye, Dabbebieth’s tentacles recover a small shard from Paulette’s satchel and drop it in the hat the couple uses to collect their wage to the breathless myr’s delight. After a long minute of hyperventilating, the violet cyborg tightens her grip on your arm and lets you guide her through the city again, still a bit concussed by the whirlwind of emotions that rocked her to her core. She stays quiet for long minutes, leaving the blue leyak free to enjoy and feel their way through Gildenmere’s warmth and cultural melting pot as you cross stone arteries boiling with life. Small restaurants and shops attract a lot of visitors and locals, a curtain of normalcy shrouding the cruel fate that awaits this place if anyone revokes the cease fire. Life continues on despite everything that’s happened, slowly healing the gruesome wounds the conflict inflicted to this planet’s civilisations and people. Maybe with the U.G.C’s active help and a good amount of pride and self-preservation, the myrmedions will spread their hopes and dreams across the stars. [flags.PAULETTE_MYR_DATE |As your date comes to an end, you take a last stop at Silly Slimes, Amaranthe’s shop. You find the orange myr at the same spot she was on your first visit, but this time filling her empty shelves with colorful toys. “Hey! If it isn’t my favorite customer. I don’t know what you did but my shop was swarmed by orders after your visit. They got so popular I had to hire two full time workers to help me produce and ship them.” “Glad to be of service,” Paulette giggles, eyeing the new accessories displayed near the counter. “Is anything here to your fancy? My employees will be out for a couple more hours if your desires lie in something more... adult oriented,” the cheeky myr teases. |Paulette suddenly freezes a few yards from the district’s end, her eyes locked on a small figure smiling to her from across a workshop’s display. Her mind seems charmed, hypnotized by the innocent stuffed creature, a demure ganrael plushie the same color as her prosthetics’ plates. Unable to break its grasp on her, you follow her inside the unassuming shop, startling its owner as she finishes sewing another plushie’s grateful features. Paulette snatches the stuffie from its comfy shelf and places it on the counter, brilliant stars shining in her electric blue eyes. “Nice choice, it’s one of my favorite silly slimes. Out of all my plush children, this is the one that I had the most fun designing,” the seamstress confesses, a tan-skinned myr with orange plates of chitin, a fanged mouth, and a pair of honey-laden breasts bulging her buttoned sweater. A small tag over her left boob identifies her as Amaranthe. “If I may ask, are you a red myr?” The mature ant girl chuckles. “My mother is one, but I’m more of a hybrid thanks to my father. Before the war started, there were scarce interactions between our people — some mean and brutal, some sweet and kind. Father was an entertainer, he went on a small tour across the reds’ continent and my mother was his bodyguard. Long story short, I was raised in the Scarlet Federation, did my military service there, then my mother and I moved to Gildenmere when my father’s health declined. I’ve always been a stranger wherever I go, too gold to live with the reds and too red to live with the golds. I used to create costumes for shows before the war, then I was requisitioned to make uniforms, and now that we are on the verge of peace or destruction, I’m selling peaceful-looking toys in the hope to soothe heated minds and appease broken hearts.” “Well, you healed one today,” Paulette replies, hugging her new belongings tight. “Thanks a lot [pc.name], and you too Dabbebieth. You’re brightening my days — and you too Miss Amaranthe.” The seamstress giggles. “Stop it, you’ll make me blush! If I were a few years younger I’d be a lot more daring with you. These shiny scales of yours are beautiful and really suit you, and your companions are stunning as well. I wonder what an offworlder’s touch is like,” she muses. ] The choice is up to you. Will you get some mutual fun with the mature myr and Paulette or be on your way? "

That was incredible,” the orange myr pants as she puts her long skirt and buttons her pull-over once more, faceted eyes still burning with leyak venom. “[flags.PAULETTE_MYR_NURSING |I’ll never get used to your intense, loving treatment. I’ll have to be careful if I don’t want to get addicted to you |Don’t forget to take your plushie home! It’ll love to have a new mommy ].” “Are you going to be fine? We can stay and help you clean the mess we made if you want.” The seamstress shakes her head. “The sheets are made from a waterproof, nyrea fabric. It’ll take me a minute to clean. You’ve got your whole life ahead of you so go out and have fun,” she orders, leading you back to the shop then outside her store. “Don’t hesitate to come back, you’ll always be welcome in my domain.” [flags.PAULETTE_MYR_NURSING | |With her plushie [silly |lodged between her chest |in hands ], ]Paulette drops a quick peck on the mature myr’s cheek then leaves with you, waving at her as she returns to Silly Slimes on weak legs. The trip back to Gildenmere’s park is rather uneventful, except for a [flags.PAULETTE_MYR_NURSING |for a group of over-excited students begging for Dabbebieth’s autograph. It seems the shy poet’s reputation crossed the stars up to this war-torn planet. Somehow |large group of young gold girls going on a trip with their preceptors. You aren’t sure if they are gawking at you or at the cyborg’s smiling stuffie as you pass by them, but you surely made a stunning impression on the next generation of chitinous indigenous people ]. Long minutes of walking later, you reach the elevator to the DMZ together. “We’ve had a lot of fun with you today, but I think we’ll need to rest for a while after our recent [silly |sexcapades |adventures ]. See you on board [pc.name].” The purple cyborg drops a quick kiss on your cheek before stepping into the lift, leaving you free to experience Myrellion by yourself again, albeit with a good dose of red myr venom in your veins and a bellyful of gold myr honey. "

rows.original: You slowly shake your head. It’s a nice proposition but you aren’t in the mood today. Paulette’s perky ears droop, giving her a sad expression for a couple of seconds until Dabbebieth earns her attention back. “O-Okay, maybe another time then. We’ve got two passes for the Thollum, so I’ll finally get to see what a real school is and my lil’ poet might get a chance to sample the locals’ culture. I hope the girls won’t be scared of us... we aren’t the most [silly |fren-shaped |friendly-looking ] folks around.[silly | If we play our cards well, maybe we’ll be allowed to see the Myramids! ] Anyway, see you on board [pc.name]!” The alien duo waves at you before heading toward the city’s child-rearing caves. It’s good to see they can have fun without you. Maybe you’ll join their excursion next time.
rows.translation: 你缓缓摇头。这个提议很不错，但你今天没那个兴致。波莱特挺立的耳朵耷拉下来，让她显得伤心了几秒，直到达贝比埃斯重新吸引了她的注意。 “好、好吧，那就下次。我们有两张通往托勒姆的通行证，所以我终于能见识真正的学校是什么样，我的小诗人或许也有机会体验当地文化。希望那些姑娘不会怕我们...毕竟我们不算这里最[silly |像朋友 |和善 ]的人。[silly | 要是表现得好，说不定还能获准参观米尔金字塔！ ]总之，船上见，[pc.name]！” 异星二人组向你挥手，随后朝城里的育儿洞窟走去。看到她们没有你陪伴也能玩得开心，真是件好事。也许下次你会加入她们的远足。

rows.original: Slowly, you step closer to them, doing your best not to slip on the frozen road. Your companions are so concentrated on their map that they don’t see you until you are close enough to tackle them both into the dense layer of snow. A large smile settles on the zaika’s face despite the bone-chilling winds biting her vulnerable assets. “Hey [pc.name]! We were planning to go on a trip to the Shimmering Vale, a megalith-heavy place known to be a hotspot for aurora sightseeing. It also attracts a lot of potentially dangerous folks, so I’d love to have you with us, just in case.”
rows.translation: 你慢慢走近她们，尽力避免在冰封的道路上滑倒。你的同伴太过专注于地图，直到你靠得足够近、可以将她们一起扑进厚厚的积雪里时，才终于发现你。尽管刺骨寒风正啃咬着扎伊卡毫无遮掩的敏感部位，她脸上依然绽开了灿烂的笑容。 “嘿，[pc.name]！我们正打算去一趟辉光谷，那里遍布巨石，也是观赏极光的热门地点。那里也吸引着许多可能很危险的人，所以我很希望你能和我们一起去，以防万一。”
