rows.original: You give the two aliens a cheeky smile. “I wouldn’t mind seeing another side of this moon’s raw, brutal beauty. So, what’s the plan?” Dabbebieth makes a small victory dance perched on Paulette’s spaulder as she shows you the holomap. “Irestead is here and the Shimmering Vale is there,” she says, pointing to a spot about two miles south of the city. “[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |We’ll take the short road again. It’s more dangerous and colder but it’s the only way to get the best spots for the show.” |The safest road takes a long detour along the glacier, where the hostile locals tend to avoid going. Or, we could make it in about an hour if we cut through the big rift splitting the frozen mountain and we’ll get a better spot... but we’ll be more exposed to indigenous huntresses. I’d rather take the latter option; I don’t know how long we’ll survive the cold winds,” she admits. ] “Then we’ll trek through the canyon. We’ll just have to stay on our guard and find a nice shelter once we’re here.” The zaika nods before stowing her map in one of her layered vest’s pockets. “Alright then, let’s press on.” Without any more preparations, you step outside of Irestead’s bounds, hands close to your weapons in case you need to defend yourself against an aggressive, furry hunter. The winds howl as your [pc.isNaga |coils |[pc.legs] ] leave deep marks into the fresh snow, a sorrowful bellow that negates all hopes for any of you to take flight and glide through this pass of frosted rocks and frozen water. Your companions clearly aren’t in their element: Dabbebieth hugs the cyborg’s self-heating body the tightest he can, while the latter tries her best to stroll through the ragged terrain despite the intense chill assaulting her prosthetics. About twenty minutes after your departure from Irestead, you finally arrive where the path to the valley begins. A big stone engraved with runes indicates the way to the city, to the tundra, and to the canyon in a handful of different languages. “The dangerous part of the trip begins now. [flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |I hope the local tribes are still at peace, I wouldn’t want to risk triggering an avalanche with a stray shot |According to a stormguard ranger, the korgonne have been rather quiet for a while, implying that they could be preparing for a nasty move. I hope it won’t be the case ].” “Do you think they’ll try to ambush us?” Paulette shakes her head. “No, but the way is narrow and slippery enough to put us in trouble by itself. I’d rather not fall into a crevice because of a bad step,” she says before activating her legs’ hardlight talons. Slowly, you enter the trench dug through the mountain, eyeing any suspicious snowflake that falls too close to you. Ice covers most of the solid ore, leaving only a few layers visible through the mirroring surface. You might not be an expert in geology, but Vic showed you enough of the family business for you to identify traces of salt, silicon, and basalt in the natural fortress’s walls. Long ago, this mountain range was part of an abyssal array of volcanic chimneys, but it doesn’t tell you how it got here. Did the moon’s seas dry enough to reach the surface or did a geologic catastrophe catapult them from the oceanic floor, then through the many layers of ice, to finally pierce the surface and tower over the tundra and glaciers? Unfortunately, you don’t have the time to answer these questions. The cool winds dancing over your companions’ bodies and the growing likelihood of being attacked force you to hasten your pace. Step by step, you cross the pass, admiring the shining shards piercing through the dense coats of snow. “Those must be the phosphorescent stones the ranger told me about. The locals use them to plot safe passages for their c[silly |u |o ]mrades and to guide the souls of their ancestors through the darkest nights.” “Maybe that’s what gives the Shimmering Vale its name,” you remark as the exit from the canyon appears in front of you. After a couple more minutes of walking through the treacherous ice, you finally enter the brightly lit location. It’s a large plain stuck between ribcage-like spires of frosted, magmatic rock. Hundreds of big, stone monoliths shine with monochromatic light, turning the snow around them into a mottled palette. The foggy air hugs the pass with an iridescent mist filled with ethereal snowflakes. Dabbebieth, Paulette, and you are left gawking by this place’s raw beauty, contemplating this preserved, unaltered wonder. You spot a circle of igloos near the other entrance of the vale — taking the rougher road was the right choice. “Magnificent,” the leyak poet whispers, a flawless tune that bounces on the closest obelisk and makes it glisten with argent light. Paulette takes a few seconds to snap out of the luminescent spectacle’s hypnotic grasp. “[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |There’s still danger in here, I think we should go to Margoth’s place if we want to spend some quality time here |Looks like there’s a small promontory dug in the left cliff. We’ll be safe there ]. Ready for a quick aerial trip?” Before you can reply, Paulette activates her hardlight wings[pc.hasWings | and takes flight. A couple of seconds later, you unfold yours and follow her through the snowy sky |, grabs you by the waist, then takes flight ]. Chill gusts caress your face as you glide together through the particle-heavy clouds, towering over domesticated beasts and shepherds as you swoop toward what must have been an auxiliary chimney dug through the peak’s side. There’s a sizable, circular home built up here, a big igloo large enough to house a family of twelve — you’ll be able to take shelter inside if it gets too cold. Paulette lands unceremoniously on the promontory[pc.hasWings |, followed by yourself a few seconds later | then carefully releases you on the snowy plateau ]. You barely have the time to appreciate your surroundings before [flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |Margoth greets you with her cheeky smile. “You again? The last time must have left a stunning impression on you,” she teases. “I’ll make us some drinks and bring you blankets before the next aurora starts. It shouldn’t be long.” |the augmented zaika aims her right arm at the frosty home’s entrance, ready to open fire. “I can see your pulse on my readings. Show yourself, I promise not to fire.” In the blink of an eye, a glowing creature surges from the ground, hardlight longbow ready to unleash a piercing arrow through the former XO’s armor. “Who are you and why did you come here?” the plump, curvy huntress shouts. She’s got a mix of essyra and leithan features: her arms and legs are clad in soft scales and seven, white-furred tails with blue-frosted tips wag behind her. She’s wearing a dense, orange and green vest that fails to hide her fat physique and chitin-covered scales. A dim, pink light comes from her plates, a light akin to the one running through her weapon. Her leithan pupils stare at you while her perky fox ears track your breathings in search for any sign of hostility. “My companions and I came here to see an aurora. We traveled through the mountain then flew here to have a better place to observe it. I’m [pc.name] and these are my friends, Paulette and Dabbebieth,” you reply, lowering your cyborg companion’s deadly arm and stepping between her and the furry archer. A moment later, she deactivates her weapon and offers you a kind smile. “Visitors usually observe it from the village down below. It’s been years since someone went through the howling canyon. The crystals down there can ruin any machinery that comes too close to them. You’re lucky it didn’t fry your limbs and systems. Oh! where are my manners? I’m Margoth, Rhenworld researcher in charge of the singing quartz’s studies. You must be frozen from the trip; I’ll fetch you some blankets and some hot chocolate before the next aurora begins,” she says before glancing at her codex. “There should be one in five minutes, so try to stay warm for a little longer.” ] The field researcher returns into her igloo as you find a nice spot to observe the vale below. As the time draws near, the glowing stones’ intensity weakens to the point of emitting no more than dim sparks that barely surface from the white coat of snow. Margoth emerges from her glacial home a couple of minutes later, her hands burdened with wooly linens, a big, fuming thermos, and metallic cups strapped to her belt. She offers Paulette and Dabbebieth the thic[silly |c |k ]est wraps before handing you a green blanket and serving the creamy beverage to her guests. “Just in time. Beware, it’s very hot.” The hybrid barely has the time to fill her own cup and to sit next to you before the show begins. You take a sip of the rich, sweet drink as the first electromagnetic wave scars the sky, followed by dozens more ethereal tides. Chromatic flames dance in front of your [pc.eyes], carried by the snowflakes and loaded particles swarming the vale’s foggy air. In a matter of seconds, the entirety of the plain turns into an iridescent supernova of colors, passing from gold, emerald, then sapphire and ruby lights at a supernatural pace. It’s a wonder this debauchery doesn’t hurt your mind. Quite the contrary instead — just looking at it soothes you and calls to your innocent inner child’s naive curiosity. “Absolutely magnificent,” the former XO gasps before taking another set of pictures with her visor and chugging more of her heart-warming beverage. The spectacle in front of her eyes is so charming, so wonderful, so resplendent that it seems to quench her body’s primal reaction to milk-based products. The furry [silly |nerd |scientist ] next to you giggles. “Wait: the best part is yet to come.” Puzzled by her remark, you focus back onto the mesmerizing waves’ sultry ballet. As soon as the electromagnetic disturbance reaches the quartz, the sensitive stones start irradiating their surroundings with crackling jolts of energy, releasing more beautiful, shimmering shards and producing a pure, immaculate melody. Dabbebieth, entranced by the exotic symphony, adds his own chant to the stormy performance, making the whole experience even more magical. The melody goes up and down, flowing through the air like tap water caressing smooth stones: a velvety caress that subjugates your [pc.ears] while the glistening rays seduce your [pc.eyes] through a crystalline mist filled with tiny, icy mirrors. As swiftly as it started, the aurora slowly fades away. The singing monoliths whisper one last time before their music stops and they start to emit their respective, monochromatic light again. The frosted hybrid is the first one to react after the show’s end, looking down the valley for any sign of trouble. “My instruments didn’t explode this time. I guess you’re my lucky charms!” she teases. “I really liked your voice, little jellyfish guy — you should consider joining an orchestra.” The blue leyak bounces on Paulette’s lap as she finishes her milky drink. “Thanks for the hot chocolate and the blankets. Is there anything we could do to repay you?” Paulette asks, a deep blush on her cheeks and an intoxicated eagerness in her voice. “Your visit already warmed my half-leithan blood — observing dangerous phenomena can be lonely from time to time, but every second is worth the trouble. I think that’s what led my mother to Uveto and to my essyra sire: sharing a wonderful time with those who mattered to her. Speaking of which, if you really want to repay me, I wouldn’t be against feeling someone’s warm touch. But beware: I’ve got some clingy tentacles and a womanhood so warm, a thermal pack will feel cold in comparison.” The choice is up to you.
rows.translation: 你朝两个外星人露出顽皮的笑容。“我不介意看看这颗卫星原始而残酷之美的另一面。那么，计划是什么？” 达贝比埃斯站在波莱特的肩甲上跳起小小的胜利舞，同时向你展示全息地图。“艾尔斯泰德在这里，辉光谷在那里，”他说着，指向城市以南约两英里的位置。“[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |我们还走那条近路。那里更危险也更寒冷，但只有这样才能占到观看表演的最佳位置。” |最安全的道路会沿冰川绕很大一圈，敌对的当地人往往不愿靠近那里。或者，如果穿过那道劈开冰封山脉的巨大裂谷，我们大约一小时就能抵达，还能找到更好的位置...但也会更容易暴露在本地女猎手面前。我更愿意选后者；我不知道我们能在寒风中撑多久，”她承认道。 ] “那就徒步穿过峡谷。我们只需要保持警惕，到了那里再找个舒适的避难处。” 这名扎伊卡点点头，把地图收进多层背心的一个口袋。“好，那就继续前进。” 你们没有再做准备，直接走出艾尔斯泰德边界。双手始终靠近武器，以便在碰上富有攻击性的毛茸茸猎人时保护自己。狂风呼啸，你的[pc.isNaga |蛇躯 |[pc.legs] ]在新雪中留下深深痕迹。那悲凉的怒号粉碎了你们起飞、滑翔穿越这条霜岩与冻水隘口的一切希望。你的同伴显然不适应这种环境：达贝比埃斯尽可能紧地抱住半机械人自行发热的身体，后者则顶着侵袭义肢的刺骨严寒，竭力在崎岖地形中前行。 离开艾尔斯泰德约二十分钟后，你们终于抵达通往山谷的道路起点。一块刻满符文的巨石以数种不同语言指示着通往城市、苔原和峡谷的方向。“旅程危险的部分现在开始。[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |希望当地部落仍然和平相处，我可不想冒险让一发流弹引起雪崩 |据一名风暴卫士游骑兵所说，科尔贡人已经安静了一阵子，这可能意味着他们在准备什么恶毒行动。希望不是如此 ]。” “你觉得她们会伏击我们吗？” 波莱特摇摇头。“不会，但道路本身已经狭窄湿滑，足以让我们陷入麻烦。我可不想因为一步踩错掉进裂缝，”她说着，启动腿部的硬光利爪。 你们缓缓进入凿穿山体的壕沟，警惕地打量每一片落得太近的可疑雪花。坚冰覆盖了大部分坚硬矿石，只有少数岩层透过镜面般的表面显露出来。你或许不是地质专家，但维克让你了解了足够多的家族生意，使你能够辨认这座天然堡垒墙壁上的盐、硅和玄武岩痕迹。很久以前，这片山脉曾是一排深渊火山烟囱的一部分，但这并不能解释它如何来到这里。是卫星海洋干涸到足以让它们露出水面，还是一场地质灾难将它们从海床抛起，贯穿层层冰盖，最终刺破地表，耸立在苔原与冰川之上？ 遗憾的是，你没时间回答这些问题。冷风在同伴身上起舞，而遭受袭击的可能性不断增加，迫使你们加快脚步。你们一步步穿过隘口，欣赏刺穿厚重积雪的闪亮碎晶。“那些一定就是游骑兵提到的磷光石。当地人用它们为c[silly |u |o ]mrades标示安全通道，也为祖先的灵魂指引穿越最黑暗夜晚的道路。” “也许辉光谷正是因此得名，”你说道，此时峡谷出口出现在眼前。又在危险冰面上行走几分钟，你们终于进入这个灯火通明的地方。这是一片夹在如肋骨般耸立的覆霜岩浆岩尖塔间的广阔平原。数百座巨大石质巨柱闪耀单色光芒，将周围积雪染成斑驳色盘。雾气以虹彩薄霭笼罩隘口，其中飘满空灵雪花。达贝比埃斯、波莱特和你都被这里原始的美景震撼得目瞪口呆，凝视这处保存完好、未经改变的奇观。你看见山谷另一处入口附近围着一圈冰屋——选择更崎岖的道路果然正确。 “壮丽，”莱亚克诗人低声吟道。那无瑕的音调在最近的方尖碑上回荡，令其闪耀银白光芒。 波莱特花了几秒才挣脱这片发光奇景的催眠魅力。“[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |这里仍有危险。如果想好好享受一段时光，我觉得应该去玛戈斯住处 |左侧峭壁似乎凿出了一块小型岬台。那里会很安全 ]。准备好来一趟短途飞行了吗？” 你还没来得及回答，波莱特便启动硬光翅膀[pc.hasWings |并飞上天空。几秒后，你也展开翅膀，跟随她穿越飘雪的天空 |，搂住你的腰，随后飞上天空 ]。你们一同滑翔穿过粒子密布的云层，寒冷阵风轻抚脸颊。你们从家养野兽与牧民上方掠过，俯冲向那道似乎凿穿山峰侧面的辅助烟囱。这里建着一座相当宽敞的圆形住宅，一间足以容纳十二口之家的巨大冰屋——如果太冷，你们可以进去避寒。 波莱特毫不优雅地降落在岬台上[pc.hasWings |，几秒后你也跟着落地 |，随后小心翼翼地把你放在积雪平台上 ]。你还没来得及欣赏周围环境，[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |玛戈斯便带着顽皮笑容向你问候。 “又是你？上次一定给你留下了惊艳印象，”她调侃道。“下一场极光开始前，我会给大家准备饮料和毯子。应该不用等太久。” |经过强化改造的扎伊卡将右臂对准冰屋入口，随时准备开火。 “读数显示出了你的脉搏。现身吧，我保证不开火。” 眨眼间，一只发光生物从地下冲出，硬光长弓蓄势待发，箭矢足以贯穿前任大副的装甲。“你们是谁，为什么来这里？”这名丰满又曲线玲珑的女猎手大喊。她兼具埃西拉与莱坦人的特征：四肢覆盖柔软鳞片，七条白色毛皮、蓝霜尾尖的尾巴在身后摆动。厚实的橙绿背心遮不住她肥美的体型与覆盖甲壳素的鳞片。甲片散发昏暗粉光，与武器中流淌的光芒相似。莱坦人的瞳孔凝视着你，俏立的狐耳则追踪你们的呼吸，寻找任何敌意迹象。 “我和同伴来这里看极光。我们穿过山脉又飞到这里，为的是找个更好的观察位置。我是[pc.name]，这两位是我的朋友波莱特与达贝比埃斯，”你回答道，一边压下半机械同伴致命的手臂，挡在她和毛茸茸的弓手之间。片刻后，她关闭武器，向你露出亲切微笑。 “访客通常在下面村庄观看极光。已经好几年没人穿过呼啸峡谷了。下面的晶体能毁掉任何靠得太近的机器。你们很幸运，它没有烧坏四肢和系统。哦！瞧我这礼数。我叫玛戈斯，是负责研究歌唱石英的雷恩世界研究员。一路过来肯定冻坏了；下一场极光开始前，我去给你们拿些毯子和热巧克力，”她说着瞥了眼终端。“大约五分钟后就有一场，所以再坚持保暖一会儿。” ] 这名野外研究员回到冰屋，而你们则找了个观察下方山谷的好位置。时间临近，发光石的亮度逐渐减弱，最终只能透过白色雪层散发微弱火花。几分钟后，玛戈斯从冰屋中出来，双手抱着羊毛织物、一只冒着热气的大保温瓶，腰带上还挂着金属杯。她先把最thic[silly |c |k ]est的包裹递给波莱特和达贝比埃斯，然后给你一条绿色毯子，又为客人们倒上奶香饮料。 “正好赶上。小心，很烫。” 这名混血儿刚来得及倒满自己的杯子，在你身旁坐下，表演便开始了。第一道电磁波在天空留下伤痕，随后数十道空灵潮汐接踵而至；你啜饮浓郁甜美的饮料，彩色火焰则在[pc.eyes]前舞动，由雪花与充斥谷地雾气的带电粒子承载。短短几秒，整片平原化作虹彩斑斓的超新星，以超自然速度在金色、翡翠、蓝宝石和红宝石般的光芒间切换。如此放纵的色彩竟没有伤害你的心智，实在令人惊奇。恰恰相反——仅仅凝望它，便足以抚慰你，唤起内心纯真孩童天真的好奇。 “绝对壮丽，”前任大副喘息着说道，又用面罩拍下一组照片，大口喝下更多暖心饮料。眼前景象如此迷人、如此美妙、如此璀璨，仿佛平息了她身体面对乳制品时的原始反应。 你身旁毛茸茸的[silly |书呆子 |科学家 ]咯咯笑道。“等等，最精彩的部分还没来呢。” 她的话令你困惑，你重新专注于迷人波涛那撩人的芭蕾。电磁扰动一触及石英，敏感的石头便开始向周围辐射噼啪作响的能量电流，释放更多美丽闪耀的碎光，并奏出纯净无瑕的旋律。达贝比埃斯被异域交响迷住，也把自己的吟唱融入风暴般的演出，让整场体验更加魔幻。旋律上下起伏，如自来水抚过光滑石块般流淌在空气中：那天鹅绒般的爱抚征服[pc.ears]，闪亮光线则透过充满细小冰镜的水晶雾气诱惑[pc.eyes]。 极光来得迅疾，消退得也同样缓慢。歌唱巨柱最后低语一次，音乐随即停止，各自重新散发单色光芒。覆霜的混血儿第一个从表演结束后的恍惚中回神，低头查看谷地里有无麻烦迹象。“我的仪器这次没有爆炸。看来你们是我的幸运符！”她调侃道。“我很喜欢你的声音，小水母——你该考虑加入一支管弦乐团。” 蓝色莱亚克在波莱特腿上弹跳着喝完乳饮。“谢谢热巧克力和毯子。我们能做些什么回报你吗？”波莱特问道，脸颊染上深深红晕，声音里透着醉意般的急切。 “你们的来访已经温暖了我的半莱坦人血液——观察危险现象有时会很孤独，但每一秒都值得付出。我想，正是这种感受把母亲带到乌维托，也带到我的埃西拉生父身边：与重要的人共同度过美好时光。说到这个，如果你们真想报答，我不介意感受某人的温暖触碰。不过要小心：我有些黏人的触手，还有温暖到足以让热能包都相形冰冷的女性部位。” 选择权在你。
rows.raw: " You give the two aliens a cheeky smile. “I wouldn’t mind seeing another side of this moon’s raw, brutal beauty. So, what’s the plan?” Dabbebieth makes a small victory dance perched on Paulette’s spaulder as she shows you the holomap. “Irestead is here and the Shimmering Vale is there,” she says, pointing to a spot about two miles south of the city. “[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |We’ll take the short road again. It’s more dangerous and colder but it’s the only way to get the best spots for the show.” |The safest road takes a long detour along the glacier, where the hostile locals tend to avoid going. Or, we could make it in about an hour if we cut through the big rift splitting the frozen mountain and we’ll get a better spot... but we’ll be more exposed to indigenous huntresses. I’d rather take the latter option; I don’t know how long we’ll survive the cold winds,” she admits. ] “Then we’ll trek through the canyon. We’ll just have to stay on our guard and find a nice shelter once we’re here.” The zaika nods before stowing her map in one of her layered vest’s pockets. “Alright then, let’s press on.” Without any more preparations, you step outside of Irestead’s bounds, hands close to your weapons in case you need to defend yourself against an aggressive, furry hunter. The winds howl as your [pc.isNaga |coils |[pc.legs] ] leave deep marks into the fresh snow, a sorrowful bellow that negates all hopes for any of you to take flight and glide through this pass of frosted rocks and frozen water. Your companions clearly aren’t in their element: Dabbebieth hugs the cyborg’s self-heating body the tightest he can, while the latter tries her best to stroll through the ragged terrain despite the intense chill assaulting her prosthetics. About twenty minutes after your departure from Irestead, you finally arrive where the path to the valley begins. A big stone engraved with runes indicates the way to the city, to the tundra, and to the canyon in a handful of different languages. “The dangerous part of the trip begins now. [flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |I hope the local tribes are still at peace, I wouldn’t want to risk triggering an avalanche with a stray shot |According to a stormguard ranger, the korgonne have been rather quiet for a while, implying that they could be preparing for a nasty move. I hope it won’t be the case ].” “Do you think they’ll try to ambush us?” Paulette shakes her head. “No, but the way is narrow and slippery enough to put us in trouble by itself. I’d rather not fall into a crevice because of a bad step,” she says before activating her legs’ hardlight talons. Slowly, you enter the trench dug through the mountain, eyeing any suspicious snowflake that falls too close to you. Ice covers most of the solid ore, leaving only a few layers visible through the mirroring surface. You might not be an expert in geology, but Vic showed you enough of the family business for you to identify traces of salt, silicon, and basalt in the natural fortress’s walls. Long ago, this mountain range was part of an abyssal array of volcanic chimneys, but it doesn’t tell you how it got here. Did the moon’s seas dry enough to reach the surface or did a geologic catastrophe catapult them from the oceanic floor, then through the many layers of ice, to finally pierce the surface and tower over the tundra and glaciers? Unfortunately, you don’t have the time to answer these questions. The cool winds dancing over your companions’ bodies and the growing likelihood of being attacked force you to hasten your pace. Step by step, you cross the pass, admiring the shining shards piercing through the dense coats of snow. “Those must be the phosphorescent stones the ranger told me about. The locals use them to plot safe passages for their c[silly |u |o ]mrades and to guide the souls of their ancestors through the darkest nights.” “Maybe that’s what gives the Shimmering Vale its name,” you remark as the exit from the canyon appears in front of you. After a couple more minutes of walking through the treacherous ice, you finally enter the brightly lit location. It’s a large plain stuck between ribcage-like spires of frosted, magmatic rock. Hundreds of big, stone monoliths shine with monochromatic light, turning the snow around them into a mottled palette. The foggy air hugs the pass with an iridescent mist filled with ethereal snowflakes. Dabbebieth, Paulette, and you are left gawking by this place’s raw beauty, contemplating this preserved, unaltered wonder. You spot a circle of igloos near the other entrance of the vale — taking the rougher road was the right choice. “Magnificent,” the leyak poet whispers, a flawless tune that bounces on the closest obelisk and makes it glisten with argent light. Paulette takes a few seconds to snap out of the luminescent spectacle’s hypnotic grasp. “[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |There’s still danger in here, I think we should go to Margoth’s place if we want to spend some quality time here |Looks like there’s a small promontory dug in the left cliff. We’ll be safe there ]. Ready for a quick aerial trip?” Before you can reply, Paulette activates her hardlight wings[pc.hasWings | and takes flight. A couple of seconds later, you unfold yours and follow her through the snowy sky |, grabs you by the waist, then takes flight ]. Chill gusts caress your face as you glide together through the particle-heavy clouds, towering over domesticated beasts and shepherds as you swoop toward what must have been an auxiliary chimney dug through the peak’s side. There’s a sizable, circular home built up here, a big igloo large enough to house a family of twelve — you’ll be able to take shelter inside if it gets too cold. Paulette lands unceremoniously on the promontory[pc.hasWings |, followed by yourself a few seconds later | then carefully releases you on the snowy plateau ]. You barely have the time to appreciate your surroundings before [flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |Margoth greets you with her cheeky smile. “You again? The last time must have left a stunning impression on you,” she teases. “I’ll make us some drinks and bring you blankets before the next aurora starts. It shouldn’t be long.” |the augmented zaika aims her right arm at the frosty home’s entrance, ready to open fire. “I can see your pulse on my readings. Show yourself, I promise not to fire.” In the blink of an eye, a glowing creature surges from the ground, hardlight longbow ready to unleash a piercing arrow through the former XO’s armor. “Who are you and why did you come here?” the plump, curvy huntress shouts. She’s got a mix of essyra and leithan features: her arms and legs are clad in soft scales and seven, white-furred tails with blue-frosted tips wag behind her. She’s wearing a dense, orange and green vest that fails to hide her fat physique and chitin-covered scales. A dim, pink light comes from her plates, a light akin to the one running through her weapon. Her leithan pupils stare at you while her perky fox ears track your breathings in search for any sign of hostility. “My companions and I came here to see an aurora. We traveled through the mountain then flew here to have a better place to observe it. I’m [pc.name] and these are my friends, Paulette and Dabbebieth,” you reply, lowering your cyborg companion’s deadly arm and stepping between her and the furry archer. A moment later, she deactivates her weapon and offers you a kind smile. “Visitors usually observe it from the village down below. It’s been years since someone went through the howling canyon. The crystals down there can ruin any machinery that comes too close to them. You’re lucky it didn’t fry your limbs and systems. Oh! where are my manners? I’m Margoth, Rhenworld researcher in charge of the singing quartz’s studies. You must be frozen from the trip; I’ll fetch you some blankets and some hot chocolate before the next aurora begins,” she says before glancing at her codex. “There should be one in five minutes, so try to stay warm for a little longer.” ] The field researcher returns into her igloo as you find a nice spot to observe the vale below. As the time draws near, the glowing stones’ intensity weakens to the point of emitting no more than dim sparks that barely surface from the white coat of snow. Margoth emerges from her glacial home a couple of minutes later, her hands burdened with wooly linens, a big, fuming thermos, and metallic cups strapped to her belt. She offers Paulette and Dabbebieth the thic[silly |c |k ]est wraps before handing you a green blanket and serving the creamy beverage to her guests. “Just in time. Beware, it’s very hot.” The hybrid barely has the time to fill her own cup and to sit next to you before the show begins. You take a sip of the rich, sweet drink as the first electromagnetic wave scars the sky, followed by dozens more ethereal tides. Chromatic flames dance in front of your [pc.eyes], carried by the snowflakes and loaded particles swarming the vale’s foggy air. In a matter of seconds, the entirety of the plain turns into an iridescent supernova of colors, passing from gold, emerald, then sapphire and ruby lights at a supernatural pace. It’s a wonder this debauchery doesn’t hurt your mind. Quite the contrary instead — just looking at it soothes you and calls to your innocent inner child’s naive curiosity. “Absolutely magnificent,” the former XO gasps before taking another set of pictures with her visor and chugging more of her heart-warming beverage. The spectacle in front of her eyes is so charming, so wonderful, so resplendent that it seems to quench her body’s primal reaction to milk-based products. The furry [silly |nerd |scientist ] next to you giggles. “Wait: the best part is yet to come.” Puzzled by her remark, you focus back onto the mesmerizing waves’ sultry ballet. As soon as the electromagnetic disturbance reaches the quartz, the sensitive stones start irradiating their surroundings with crackling jolts of energy, releasing more beautiful, shimmering shards and producing a pure, immaculate melody. Dabbebieth, entranced by the exotic symphony, adds his own chant to the stormy performance, making the whole experience even more magical. The melody goes up and down, flowing through the air like tap water caressing smooth stones: a velvety caress that subjugates your [pc.ears] while the glistening rays seduce your [pc.eyes] through a crystalline mist filled with tiny, icy mirrors. As swiftly as it started, the aurora slowly fades away. The singing monoliths whisper one last time before their music stops and they start to emit their respective, monochromatic light again. The frosted hybrid is the first one to react after the show’s end, looking down the valley for any sign of trouble. “My instruments didn’t explode this time. I guess you’re my lucky charms!” she teases. “I really liked your voice, little jellyfish guy — you should consider joining an orchestra.” The blue leyak bounces on Paulette’s lap as she finishes her milky drink. “Thanks for the hot chocolate and the blankets. Is there anything we could do to repay you?” Paulette asks, a deep blush on her cheeks and an intoxicated eagerness in her voice. “Your visit already warmed my half-leithan blood — observing dangerous phenomena can be lonely from time to time, but every second is worth the trouble. I think that’s what led my mother to Uveto and to my essyra sire: sharing a wonderful time with those who mattered to her. Speaking of which, if you really want to repay me, I wouldn’t be against feeling someone’s warm touch. But beware: I’ve got some clingy tentacles and a womanhood so warm, a thermal pack will feel cold in comparison.” The choice is up to you. "

rows.original: “Let’s see if you’re as hot and cozy as you claim to be,” you reply, making the furry hybrid and your milk-drunk crewmate giggle. You then collect her stuff and follow her inside, doing your best to handle a squealing, stumbling Paulette and the blankets at the same time without bumping against the large igloo’s cool walls. 人群某处，一名经过重度强化的乌托邦天空对等体发出干笑，粗粝的声音腐蚀着你的人工耳朵。“哦，真的吗？我倒想看看，这个装腔作势的东西能不能对付我们任何一名保镖，”她反驳道。数十道声音随她之后一同响起，要求亲眼看看那些承诺是否属实。 “那就试试看吧，”触手对等体答道，命令你走下舞台，迈向一片更为宽敞的空地。大约三十名执行官进入房间，拔出武器将你团团包围。“你们所有赛博战士对阵我的强化步行机。听起来很公平。”她补充道；核心单元A的战斗系统嗡鸣启动，锁定了机器人敌人的弱点。 眨眼之间，数百条末端鼓胀的强力触手从你的躯壳中涌出，袭向冲锋的维和官，碾碎她们的强化部件、撕开锁住尾巴的套子，继而用你敏感的伪阴茎侵入刚刚暴露的性器官与淫荡的甜甜圈状嘴唇。每一次无情抽送落在受辱守卫身上，都会有成千上万道幸福电流冲击你的内在欢愉，让有机部位重新焕发生机。对，就是这样！被侵入的孔洞如天鹅绒般包裹你扭动的伪足，是供你填满、宣泄压抑挫折的美丽肉鞘。 战斗开始约一分钟后，核心单元B终于迎来第一次微弱高潮，将发光蓝色精华深深泵进残破受害者被撑开的仿生穴与弹性喉咙。相连的器官愉悦颤抖，推动融合意识一同释放，而你无情的肢体则让那些不堪重负、不断扭动的人偶在生理与机械层面彻底失去抵抗。为了完整彰显你对她们的胜利，你又给每个落败人偶涂上一层冰凉、快速硬化的黏液，把她们封进耗尽精液形成的泥泞沼泽。这道开胃菜很不错：一次支配如此多弱小战士，感觉美妙极了。 刚才挑衅女主人的那些傲慢对等体站在那里，显然对你的破坏潜力印象深刻。“没想到这台华丽机器竟如此残暴。它甚至没有试图干扰或电击我们的执行官。” 锂花大笑着抚摸你坚实的侧腹。“因为它运行的并非普通扎伊卡科技所用的软件。凭借独特设计，我的[silly |UWU |咆哮步行机 ]完全免疫电子与灵能战。顺便，我还有另一项功能要展示给你们，”她咯咯笑道。周围高层皱起眉头，既对你主人的盘算好奇，又感到不安。“核心单元B，执行六十九号命令。” 终于轮到你的时刻了。随着电路与引擎启动的尖锐长鸣，核心单元A从遍布身体的隐藏接口中释放出另外数千条肢体，每一次横扫都能抓住数十名对等体。震惊的扎伊卡拼命还击，可触手解除她们的武装、将她们压制，再迅速填满她们多汁的身体，根本不给任何逃跑机会，尤其是在她们的强化维和官已经倒下之后。这一次，如同海啸般的幸福浪潮冲击你的核心，抹去附着在身上的痛苦麻木，代之以传遍每一个生物细胞的纯粹温暖狂喜。甜美的乳脂感与更为thi[silly |c |k ]、更加香甜多汁的柔软感充盈感官，带来一种你早已遗忘的兴奋陶醉；那是亲密与依偎的感受，又被酸痛敏感的器官中涌出的液态爱意洪流进一步强化。 紫色生物一个接一个倒下，身体与心智都被类似于撼动你的浪潮淹没，只是又略有不同。你继续粗暴撞击、挤压，一路潜行逼近最后仍站立的女人：制造元帅本人。 “奥里安！立刻命令你的仆从停下，”她呻吟道，随即被你和女主人的镀金触手解除武装、剥去衣服。 “我看不必。是时候更换领导者了，”她咯咯笑道。 “奥里安！你这个叛逆的舔尾巴混——” 你末端张开的尾巴肉棒蜂拥扑向那位重度改造的元帅，同时堵住她所有孔洞，继而迎来又一场强烈高潮。数百名扭动呻吟的扎伊卡与这位高大女人一同颤抖，发光蓝色精液如喷泉般灌入她们的腹部、喉咙与子宫，用令人安宁的温暖将其撑胀。 “干得漂亮，宠物。把她们全部捆在一起，带去法罗设施。等她们在铬合金中重获新生，我们就会粉碎民众与最后几个对等体家系的任何反抗迹象，把这里变成它本该成为的赛博天堂。在那之前，你可以尽情蹂躏任何想要占有的孔洞，”她低声说道，亲吻你装甲那雕像般的嘴唇；而你则满心欢喜地扑向下一轮，继续享用已经绑在哥特式底盘上喘息的紫罗兰色仿生穴。 沉浸在喜悦与幸福中的核心单元A和B，轻柔拥抱着女主人崇高的曲线，背着固定在蝎形背甲上的无数残破、沾满精液的肉块，向巨型工厂进发。
rows.raw: " You awaken an unknown amount of time later, standing still in a dark, fancy spot of what your combat systems identify as a large, crowded room. Your chromed-up limbs are hidden behind a red, velvety curtain, awaiting for Mistress’s command to step closer according to the glowing orders displayed directly into your fused mind. Despite feeling full and bloated with nutrients, you feel thirsty, famished, empty, and yearning for a kind of sustenance you’ve been denied for long days, if not years. On the outside, you’re beautiful, contained, resplendent... but on the inside, you’re sore, on edge, and numb despite how good the pricks ramming into your core units feel. What little joy they bring you almost feels painful to your otherwise love-deprived organs. It’ll soon be your owner’s turn to enter the spotlight. “This exposition has been soooo boring. I doubt this minuscule engineer’s project can brighten this disaster,” moans a disdainful voice in the audience, no doubt a Bright Water Peer like many others that came to this fancy party. All of the higher ups are here with their escorts, weaker XOs that won’t stand a chance against your reinforced shielding and armored plates. The familiar clink of Mistress’s tentacular limbs reach your electronic ears as she climbs up the stage. “My fellow Peers, let me introduce to you the new jewel of cybernetic enforcement: the [silly |UWU |Unbreakable Wrecking Unit ]!” It’s the signal. The curtains parts, revealing your shining, chromed beauty to the surprised audience. “This cybernetic combat platform can withstand anything! No need for a cohort of XOs to protect you anymore, one of my gothic wonders suffice,” she bravely boasts, presenting your refined curves, agile legs, and sturdy shell. The assembled zaikas are more dubious. Some admire and gush at your sight while others spit with disdain — and some visceral fear. Core Unit B’s targeting systems are ready, aiming for their tails and mouth, waiting for Lithium Flower’s command — the feast will begin soon. Somewhere in the crowd, a heavily-augmented Utopian Skies Peer laughs, a dry sound that corrodes your artificial ears with their coarseness. “Oh really? I wonder if this pretentious thing can handle any of our bodyguards,” she retorts. Dozens more voices rise in her wake, demanding to see if her promises are true. “Let’s give it a try then,” the tentacular Peer retorts, commanding you to step down the stage and stride toward a larger, open spot. About thirty XOs enter the room, surrounding you with their drawn weapons. “All your cybernetic warriors versus my reinforced walker. Sounds like a balanced fight,” she adds as Core Unit A’s combat systems hum to life, locking on the robotic foes’ weak spots. In a blink of an eye, hundreds of powerful, bulbous-tipped tentacles surge from your frame and assault the storming peacekeepers, crushing their augmentics and breaking their tails’ locked socks before invading their newly-freed sexes and whorish, donut-like lips with your own sensitive pseudo-penises. Thousands of blissful jolts rock your inner bliss, driving your organic parts into life again with each new merciless pump delivered to the molested guards. Yes, that’s the stuff! Their invaded holes feel like velvet on your wriggling pseudopods, beautiful sheaths for you to stuff and vent your own pent up frustrations into. About a minute into the fight, Core Unit B finally reaches a first, weak orgasm, pumping glowing blue essence deep into its broken victims’ stretched bionaholes and elastic throats. Your linked organs shiver with joy, fueling your fused mind’s release as your uncaring limbs neutralize the overwhelmed, writhing drones’ biology and machinery. To completely assert your victory upon them, you coat each of the defeated dolls with a cool, fast-hardening slime, sealing them in a swampy mess of spent spunk. This was a nice appetizer: the delicious feeling of dominating all these weak warriors at once. The cocky Peers that defied your Mistress stand, clearly impressed by your destructive potential. “I didn’t expect this ornate machine to be so brutal. It didn’t even try to jam or shock our XOs.” Lithium Flower laughs, caressing your solid flanks. “It’s because it doesn’t run on the same software as normal zaika tech. My [silly |UWU |roaring walker ] is impervious to electronic and psionic warfare, thanks to its unique design. By the way, I’ve got another feature to show you,” she giggles. The surrounding high ups frown, intrigued and concerned about your owner’s schemes. “Core Unit B, Initiate order sixty nine.” That’s your moment, finally. With a loud whine of circuits and engines coming to life, core unit A deploys thousands more limbs from hidden sockets spread across your body, snatching dozens of Peers with each new cleaving arc. The stunned zaika try their best to fight back, but your tentacles disarm, pin, and stuff their saucy assets far too fast to leave them any chances to escape, especially now that their augmented peacekeepers are down. A proverbial tsunami of blissful tides rocks you to your core this time, deleting the painful torpor clinging to you and replacing it with a pure, warm ecstasy spreading through all your biological cells. A sweet creaminess and a thic[silly |c |k ]er, fruitier plushness fills your senses with an exhilarating, intoxicating feeling you forgot about long ago; a feeling of closeness and intimacy reinforced by the deluge of liquid love coming from your sore, sensitive organs. One after the other, the purple creatures fall, their bodies and mind overwhelmed by ripples akin to the ones shaking you, but somewhat different. You continue your rough hammerings and squeezes as you prowl toward the last lady standing: the Fabricator-Marshal herself. “Oriann! Stop your servant immediately,” she groans before being disarmed and stripped by your — and Mistress’s — gilded tentacles. “I think not. A change in leadership is in order,” she giggles. “Oriann! You treasonous tailsucke-” Your flared tailcocks swarm the heavily-modified Marshal, plugging all of her holes at once before reaching another powerful climax. Hundreds of squirming, moaning zaika join the amazon as geysers of glowing blue cum swell their bellies, throats, and wombs with a tranquilizing warmth. “Nicely done, pet. Tie them all together and bring them to the Farrow Facility. Once they’re reborn in chrome, we’ll crush any semblance of resistance in the masses and the last Peer lineages and make this place the cybernetic heaven it was meant to be. Until then, you are free to ravish any hole you desire to claim,” she whispers, kissing your armor’s statuesque lips as you gleefully go for another round with the panting, violet bionaholes already strapped to your gothic undercarriage. Submerged by joy and bliss, Core Units A and B gently hug Mistress’s sublime curves as they head toward the gigafactory with countless broken, cum-stained messes secured on their scorpion-like back. rows.original: “H-Hey [pc.name]. I didn’t see you coming,” she admits in a confused voice. “I was lost in my thoughts and in time. Returning to my homeworld reminds me why the younger me wanted to writhe out of this wretched world’s crushing grasp. This damn city — by its mere presence — mauls the weak and the broken,” she spits, glancing at her chromed limbs. Does she need a comforting shoulder or a bodyguard in these troubled times? Paulette smiles. “I wouldn’t be against it to be honest. I can deal with local gangs and other XOs without a problem, but there’s places I don’t want to go alone — places where I belong. If you can spare the time, maybe I’ll have the power to [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |see |face ] them again.”
rows.translation: “嘿、嘿，[pc.name]。我没注意到你过来，”她语气迷茫地承认。“我迷失在自己的思绪里，也忘记了时间。回到故乡，让我想起年少的自己为什么拼命想挣脱这个可悲世界令人窒息的掌控。这座该死的城市——仅仅是它的存在——就在摧残弱者和破碎之人，”她啐道，瞥了一眼自己镀铬的四肢。 在这段艰难时期，她需要的是一个可以依靠的肩膀，还是一名贴身保镖？ 波莱特笑了。“老实说，我不反对。我对付本地帮派和其他XO不成问题，但有些地方我不想独自前往——那些本该属于我的地方。如果你能抽出时间，也许我就有力量再次[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |见到 |面对 ]他们。”

rows.original: “Let’s go then,” you say, taking her clawed hand in a tight grasp. You can feel a strong shiver rock her spine. “O-Okay. G-give me a moment to prepare, please. If this place is just as I remember, then we’ll be in for a very rough ride,” she says, breathing deeply a few times before setting her eyes on a large, noisy building’s heavy door. You notice a half-erased sign towering over the entrance, welcoming you to the Little Blossoms Shelter. A big egg and a caretaker holding a juvenile zaika in her arms are barely noticeable on both sides of the label that reads more like Little Bosoms Shelter the closer you get. Paulette rings the doorbell, a simple move that seems to require all of her might. The cacophony inside stops for long, quiet seconds. An alien silence seems to fill the usually frantic district as well, a deafening bellow [silly |preceding a cheap jumpscare |not unlike an old behemoth’s last breaths ]. Discreet but still noticeable footsteps come closer and closer from behind the metallic gate. “Auntie Lappis, [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |XO auntie and her friends are here |there’s a weird XO, a floating jellyfish, and [pc.ra zaika |a bizarre zaika |an offworlder ] outside ],” a young voice whispers before somebody starts fidgeting with the lock. [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |Lappis answers the door, this time with a big smile on her freckled face |An unaugmented zaika answers the door. She’s wearing a white apron over a red, worn-out uniform that designates her as an Utopian Skies caretaker. Round glasses and a pair of messy buns highlight her freckled, frowning face ]. “Lappis,” Paulette says. “[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |Paulette.” |That’s the girl next door,” she replies, her right hand holding something you can’t make out from here. ] Your crewmate removes her helmet and raises her tail in an elaborate spiral that stops its course at about crotch height. [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |Her sister reproduces their secret tailshake instinctively, melting together like snakes around an invisible caduceus |The other zaika’s tail reproduces the same movement, almost instinctively as her yellow eyes recognize who’s in front of her ]. In the blink of an eye, she hugs your cybernetic friend tight, [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |an air of serenity on her tired features. “It’s so good to see you and your friends,” she mutters. “Please come in, the kids will love to have some visitors.” |warm tears flowing down her cheeks. “I can’t believe it. Do you have any idea of how long we looked for you after you left Mother’s funeral in tears? We thought you died years ago,” the teacher sobs. Paulette’s clawed hand slowly brushes her back, a comforting massage proving that she’s indeed here. “I’m so sorry Lappis, I wasn’t strong enough and the Gyre gulped me. Fortunately, I found beautiful people that stopped my downfall,” she says before introducing Dabbebieth and you with laconic nods. About a minute later, the flustered child rearer breaks the hug and wipes her eyes from the dewy mist invading them. “Where are my manners? Please come in, we’ve got so many things to share.” ] Lappis greets you inside the shelter, leading you through a large corridor in which colorful drawings serve as makeshift wallpaper, hiding the cold concrete under many sheets of heart-warming doodles. You pass by a big dormitory, a surprisingly well-kept kitchen, and an improvised classroom furnished with rugs and dominated by an old holoboard. It must be a herculean effort to offer her pupils the best education she can provide in Dhaal’s nasty slums. You finally arrive into what passes for the building’s living room: the ground is covered in blankets and rugs, lowering the risks of injuries in case one of her kids falls from one of the many couches and pieces of furniture spread across the room. About twenty young girls turn their eyes on you the moment you step into their comfort zone. Their conversations and laughter stops in a second, silenced by an offworlder’s presence in the orphanage. “Alright everyone, say hello to Paulette[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |, Dabbebieth, and [pc.name].” |, um...” “Dabbebieth and [pc.name],” the cyborg adds, placing a warm hand on the shy leyak’s veils then [pc.hasHair |through your [pc.hair] |on your scalp ]. ] In a matter of seconds, you are swarmed by over-excited zaika children who climb up your [pc.legs] or hug you tight. Lappis chuckles as her sister swoops three toddlers in one go and counterattacks with her own salvo of smooches for the little [silly |scamps |ones ]’ delight. The shy leyak manages to bounce out of reach of their grabby hands just in time before inadvertently dosing them on his intoxicating juices. With the help of a couple of leaps, the blue poet perches himself on top of a sofa then produces a small serenade, subjugating the bubbling audience just long enough for you to sit comfortably on a large couch with your chromed-up crewmate. Now that the juvenile zaika are a bit calmer, you have all the time you need to observe them. Most of them range from toddler to adolescent with only a handful of them being close to adulthood. Knowing how fast they grow up, the younger ones must be a few days old while the older ones must be close to reaching their first birthday. They don’t have augments yet, but they all sport sturdy visors that filter the light assaulting their eyes. A couple of the more adventurous gals climb onto your lap or get a feel of your [pc.legs], brilliant stars shining in their eyes. “It feels so weird and yet so good to be back home,” Paulette says. “Everything feels different and familiar at once.” Lappis nods. “Yeah, the more things change the more they stay the same. Maybe not this time, since the U.G.C’s arrival might give us a future away from the Gyre. Well... not for me. I’ll never be able to abandon mom’s project. I’m so glad you’re back and in good health, mother Kemmie couldn’t have handled your loss — you were her favorite back when we were little.” “The three terrors really played with her nerves,” the purple cyborg replies in a voice laced with a mix of sadness and joy. “How many times did we try to level this place?” “Far too many for my little treasures to ever outmatch us,” the nurse says, glancing at a duo of especially mischievous ladies. One of the less bratty girls raises her hand. [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |“Auntie Paulette, what’s a Dabbebieth?” Your companion chuckles, hiding her blushing cheeks behind her claw. “He’s one of the reasons I’m free and sitting here with you. He’s a leyak, a peaceful race of sentient beings from the planet Mome. The Peer that owned me bought him from a slaver and kept him as a pet. If her enemies didn’t steal him, I would never have boarded the pirate ship where my systems fried — and I wouldn’t have crashed on a world where I met [pc.name],” she adds, an amethyst inferno raging under her cheeks. |“Are you an XO, Auntie Paulette?” Your companion blushes. “I used to be one, but an electromagnetic discharge fried my control chip. I replaced most of my parts with special ones I found in a spaceship wreckage to put this part of my life away. Paragon stole three years of my life... but considering how things turned out, if I could go back in time, I don’t think I’d make different decisions,” she confesses, setting her electric blue eyes on the whispering leyak then on you. ] Your crewmate’s sister leans closer to you. “So tell me [pc.name], do you work for any alien zaibatsu?” Steele Tech is not quite the same as a Dhaalian Zaibatsu, but it’s close enough in some senses. It takes you some time to explain what your father’s company is like and how it’s a bit different from the more aggressive — and less concerned about ethics — organizations on Dhaal. The younger girls quickly lose interest in the details and recover toys and pens to pass the time instead. Lappis understands most of your discourse and links your examples with local equivalences to help the puzzled pupils imagine what life is like in the rest of the galaxy. “I see. It’s good to hear that corporate hell didn’t corrupt everything — at least for now. I’m pretty sure Utopian Skies are the ones paying for the many orphanages and shelters spread across the Gyre. For them, it’s a way to reduce the amount of gangs and to get a more healthy workforce out of us. I’m doing my best with Harvvey to grant our daughters some love and to offer them a good enough upbringing to not get crushed by this world’s merciless maws,” the teacher says. “In the end, we are only cogs grinding inside this soulless machine until we break and are replaced by new ones. Some of our girls managed to get better jobs here and there thanks to Harvvey’s contacts, though. She’s a glamor performer now, dancing and singing for the Peers’ amusement.” The loud thump of boots walking through the corridor reaches your [pc.ears] moments before [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |Paulette’s other sister |a modded zaika wearing Bright Water’s colors ] enters the room. Her skintight suit glimmers in the dim lighting, turning her into an agile, emerald will-o-wisp sporting a beautiful pair of gossamer, fairy wings and a noticeable baby bump. Her hair is shaped in an elegant crown braid of fiery locks. “You’re awfully quiet today, what’s captivating you so mu- No way! Paullie, is that you?” she mutters before leaping in the direction of your augmented companion. The slender dancer lands face first into her sister’s bosom, making her gasp through clenched teeth. “[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |It’s so hard to know you’re away! I can’t stop myself from thinking you’ll never return |I can’t believe you’re here! Please, tell me you’re real ].” The cybernetic cutie rubs her beautiful relative’s ears. “I told you I’d be back, it just took me way longer than I wanted to.” It takes you long minutes to calm Harvvey and the kids down with a little story of your adventures together — a slightly watered down version devoid of the sauciest and most brutal details for your young and not-so-young audience. Feeling the tension going down, the leyak poet overcomes his visceral shyness and starts chanting a rolling melody filled with crystalline tunes. The blue alien’s honeyed voice hypnotizes the zaika assembly, subjugating them in a second with his smooth song. Entranced by the swinging rhythm, the professional performer leaves her seat and starts dancing on the blanketed floor, followed moments later by a couple more girls. The children do their best to follow their caretaker’s tempo while Lappis organizes a makeshift choir and orchestra to back the lead singer’s magnificent ode. A large smile settles on Paulette’s face, this is something she needed to ease her mind and to finally put an end to the thoughts that troubled her. In the blink of an eye, she joins her sister on hardlight wings, swirling and twirling together with a supernatural grace. The two zaika move in sync, following each other’s steps and flailing their tails in an elaborate tango. Minute after minute, they let their bodies talk, sharing their stories, struggles, and dreams with their feverish moves. The music eventually ends in a dim whisper and in a sultry pose in the dancers’ case. Lappis and the singing girls clap while the dancing ladies bow for their audience. Most of them don’t know how to do it correctly and trip to the ground, making their comrades laugh with them as the adults return to their seats. “Stars, I needed that! I’m sure we could have been a duo of exquisite ballerina if things turned differently,” Harvvey murmurs, rubbing her expecting belly. “At least you don’t have to deal with high-class Peers anymore; power makes them really insufferable. If it weren’t for our sweet little blossoms’ future, I’d have pulled the plug already,” she adds, ruffling one of the violet kid’s hair as she falls asleep in her lap. You spend a few more minutes together before a couple more toddlers dozing out and the others’ growing interests in your crewmate’s modded bosom entices you to say goodbye and leave. Paulette and you smooch the tired children on the forehead before following Lappis and Harvvey outside. “Take care of yourself Paullie. The world is cold and hard, and I don’t want to lose you again,” the pregnant performer says, hugging her cybernetic sibling tight. “You’ll always be welcome here, and that counts for you too,” Lappis adds, winking at Dabbebieth and sending you a kiss. “If I learned anything from what’s happened to me, it’s [silly |to rely on the power of friendship |that you just need a good friend’s help to brighten your life ],” Paulette adds, caressing Dabbebieth’s scalp and holding you close. You leave the zaika caretakers together, waving at them as the mottled crowd of raskvels and gabilani swallows you in multicolor tides. It takes you a couple of minutes to find a calmer spot to wind down and rest a little. “It felt so good seeing them again, thank you [pc.name].” “The pleasure was all mine. [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_FLOWER |Look, right there! Isn’t that...?” The chromed-up cutie blinks a few times, unable to process what’s happening. Lithium Flower swirls on her agile tentacles, making her rich jewelry clink and her suit creak as she strides through a field dispensary’s alley, fixing broken cybernetics while a Caesseli doctor tends the patients’ flesh wounds. “I can’t believe it... She learned her lesson and became a better person. She’s even smiling and laughing sincerely,” Paulette babbles, still stunned by how things turned out. |By the way, do you have any idea of who renamed it the Little Bosoms Shelter?” The chromed cutie chuckles. “That was Lappis following Harvvey’s idea. The sign was already in bad shape so it took them only a minute to commit their crime.” “I’m surprised you weren’t involved.” “W-Well... I was the one distracting mother Kemmie,” she confesses, cheeks ablaze with a deep blush. ] |By the way, why did you call yourselves the three terrors?” The chromed-up cutie chuckles. “That’s a moniker mother Kemmie gave us. We were dropped at the Little Blossoms Shelter in the same batch and hatched the same day — it’s as simple as that. We were also insufferable [silly |gremlins |brats ], but that’s just a coincidence,” she giggles. ] “Anyway, I think we need a nap too after this fine adventure. See you on board, captain!” Paulette drops a wet smooch on your cheek then soars through [silly |Night City |the cosmopolitan district ]’s neon-lit sky in the direction of the landing pads.
rows.translation: “那就走吧，”你说着，紧紧握住她那只带爪的手。你能感觉到一阵强烈的颤抖掠过她的脊背。 “好-好的。请、请给我一点时间准备。如果这里还和我记忆中一样，那我们恐怕要经历一场非常难熬的旅程，”她说着，做了几次深呼吸，随后将目光投向一栋巨大而嘈杂建筑的沉重大门。你注意到入口上方耸立着一块被擦掉一半的招牌，欢迎你来到小花朵收容所。标签两侧勉强能看出一枚大蛋，以及一名怀抱幼年扎伊卡的看护者；可越靠近，那标签看起来就越像小乳房收容所。 波莱特按响门铃，这个简单的动作似乎耗尽了她全部的勇气。里面的喧嚣停了下来，持续了漫长而安静的几秒。某种异样的寂静似乎也笼罩了这个平日躁动不休的街区，一声震耳欲聋的吼叫[silly |预示着一场廉价的突然惊吓 |宛如一头年迈巨兽临终前的喘息 ]。 金属门后传来小心却依然清晰的脚步声，越来越近。“拉皮斯阿姨，[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |XO阿姨和她的朋友们来了 |外面有一个奇怪的XO、一只漂浮水母，还有[pc.ra zaika |一名古怪的扎伊卡 |一个外星人 ] ]，”一个稚嫩的声音低声说道，随后有人开始摆弄门锁。[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |拉皮斯打开门，这次她那张长着雀斑的脸上挂着灿烂笑容 |一名没有接受改造的扎伊卡打开了门。她在一身破旧的红色制服外套着白围裙，那制服表明她是乌托邦天空公司的看护者。圆框眼镜和一对凌乱的发髻衬托着她那张长着雀斑、微微皱起的脸 ]。 “拉皮斯，”波莱特说道。 “[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |波莱特。” |那是隔壁家的姑娘，”她回答，右手里握着某样你从这里看不清的东西。 ] 你的船员摘下头盔，将尾巴抬起，盘成一个精巧的螺旋，末端停在大约胯部的高度。[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |她的姐妹本能地复现了她们秘密的尾巴握手，两条尾巴像蛇一样绕着一根无形的双蛇杖缠在一起 |另一名扎伊卡的尾巴几乎本能地复现了同样的动作；她那双黄色眼睛已经认出了眼前的人 ]。眨眼之间，她紧紧抱住你的机械义体朋友，[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |疲惫的面容上浮现出安宁之色。 “能见到你和你的朋友们真是太好了，”她低声说道。“请进，孩子们一定会很喜欢有客人来访。” |温热的泪水沿着她的脸颊流下。 “我简直不敢相信。你知道你哭着离开母亲的葬礼之后，我们找了你多久吗？我们还以为你多年前就死了，”这名教师抽泣着说道。波莱特带爪的手缓缓抚过她的后背，以安慰的轻抚证明自己确实就在这里。 “真的很对不起，拉皮斯。我当时不够坚强，被漩涡吞了进去。幸好，我遇到了一些美好的人，他们阻止了我的堕落，”她说着，用简短的点头分别介绍达贝比埃斯和你。 大约一分钟后，情绪激动的幼儿看护者结束拥抱，擦去蒙住双眼的湿润水雾。“瞧我这礼数。请进吧，我们有太多事情要聊了。” ] 拉皮斯在收容所内迎接你，领着你穿过一条宽阔的走廊。五颜六色的画作充当着临时墙纸，用一张张暖人心扉的涂鸦遮住冰冷的混凝土。你们经过一间大宿舍、一间维护得出人意料地好的厨房，以及一间铺着地毯、由一块老旧全息黑板占据视觉中心的临时教室。要在达尔肮脏的贫民窟里尽可能为学生提供最好的教育，她一定付出了极其艰辛的努力。最后，你来到勉强算是这栋建筑客厅的地方：地面覆盖着毛毯和地毯，以防哪个孩子从房间里随处摆放的沙发或家具上摔下来时受伤。 你刚踏进她们的舒适区，大约二十名小女孩便齐刷刷地看向你。她们的谈话和笑声瞬间停止，孤儿院里因为一名外星人的出现而安静下来。“好了，各位，向波莱特[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |、达贝比埃斯和[pc.name]问好。” |，呃...” “达贝比埃斯和[pc.name]，”这名机械义体人补充道，一只温暖的手先放在害羞莱雅克的帷幕上，随后[pc.hasHair |穿过你的[pc.hair] |放在你的头皮上 ]。 ] 转眼间，一群兴奋过头的扎伊卡儿童便将你团团围住；她们有的爬上你的[pc.legs]，有的紧紧抱住你。拉皮斯轻笑着看自己的姐妹一口气抱起三个幼童，又以一连串亲吻还击，逗得小[silly |淘气鬼们 |家伙们 ]喜不自胜。害羞的莱雅克及时跳出她们乱抓的小手够得到的范围，以免无意中让她们沾上自己令人迷醉的体液。蓝色诗人借助几次跳跃落到一张沙发顶端，随后唱出一小段小夜曲，刚好让沸腾的听众安静下来，好让你和那名满身铬金属的船员在一张大沙发上舒适地坐好。 这些年幼的扎伊卡稍微平静下来后，你便有充足时间观察她们。她们大多处在幼儿到青少年阶段，只有少数几个接近成年。考虑到她们成长得有多快，最小的可能才出生几天，年长的则大概快到一岁生日了。她们还没有植入改造体，却都戴着坚固的护目镜，过滤刺激眼睛的光线。几个更富冒险精神的姑娘爬上你的腿，或摸索着感受你的[pc.legs]，眼中闪烁着璀璨星光。 “回到家里的感觉好奇怪，却又这么美好，”波莱特说道。“一切都既陌生又熟悉。” 拉皮斯点点头。“是啊，改变得越多，没变的东西也就越多。也许这次不同，因为联合银河邦联的到来或许能给我们一个远离漩涡的未来。唔...但我不行。我永远不可能抛弃妈妈的事业。我真高兴你平安健康地回来了；凯米妈妈承受不了失去你的痛苦——我们小时候，你可是她最疼爱的那个。” “三个小魔王确实把她折腾得够呛，”紫色机械义体人用交织着悲伤与喜悦的语气回答。“我们有多少次想把这里夷为平地来着？” “多得数不清，我的小宝贝们永远也比不上我们，”护士说着，看向两个格外顽皮的姑娘。一个没那么淘气的女孩举起了手。 [flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |“波莱特阿姨，达贝比埃斯是什么呀？” 你的同伴轻笑起来，用爪子遮住泛红的脸颊。“他是让我得以自由、能够坐在这里陪伴你们的原因之一。他是一名莱雅克，来自莫姆星球的和平智慧种族。拥有我的那名对等体从奴隶贩子手里买下他，把他当成宠物。如果她的敌人没有把他偷走，我就永远不会登上那艘让我的系统烧毁的海盗船——也不会坠毁在我遇见[pc.name]的那个星球，”她补充道，双颊下燃烧着紫水晶般的烈焰。 |“波莱特阿姨，你是XO吗？” 你的同伴脸红了。“我曾经是，但一次电磁放电烧毁了我的控制芯片。我用在一艘飞船残骸里找到的特殊部件替换了身体的大部分零件，想把那段人生抛在身后。典范夺走了我三年的人生...不过考虑到后来发生的一切，如果能回到过去，我想我不会作出不同的选择，”她坦白道，电蓝色的眼睛先看向低声吟唱的莱雅克，随后又看向你。 ] 你船员的姐妹向你靠近。“那么告诉我，[pc.name]，你为哪家外星财阀工作吗？” 斯蒂尔科技与达尔的财阀并不完全相同，但在某些方面已经足够接近。你花了一些时间解释父亲的公司是什么样子，以及它和达尔那些更具侵略性——也更不在乎道德——的组织有何区别。年幼的女孩们很快对细节失去兴趣，转而拿出玩具和笔打发时间。拉皮斯听懂了你谈话中的大部分内容，并将你的例子与当地的对应事物联系起来，帮助困惑的学生想象银河系其他地方的生活。 “明白了。听说企业地狱没有腐蚀一切真好——至少目前如此。我很确定，是乌托邦天空公司在资助遍布漩涡的众多孤儿院和收容所。对他们来说，这既能减少帮派数量，也能让我们成为更健康的劳动力。我正尽力和哈维一起给予女儿们关爱，为她们提供足够好的成长环境，免得被这个世界无情的巨口碾碎，”这名教师说道。“归根结底，我们不过是在这台没有灵魂的机器里不断研磨的齿轮，直到损坏，再被新的齿轮替代。不过，我们的一些女孩凭借哈维的人脉，确实在各处找到了更好的工作。她现在是一名魅惑表演者，为取悦对等体而跳舞和歌唱。” 靴子穿过走廊的沉重脚步声传入你的[pc.ears]，片刻之后，[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |波莱特的另一名姐妹 |一名身穿碧水公司配色服装的改造扎伊卡 ]走进房间。她的紧身衣在昏暗灯光下闪闪发亮，让她看起来像一团灵巧的翠绿色鬼火，身后长着一对美丽的薄纱仙翼，腹部则有明显的隆起。她火红的头发编成优雅的冠状辫。 “你们今天安静得出奇，是什么这么吸引你们——不可能！波莉，是你吗？”她低声说着，随即朝你的改造同伴一跃而去。纤细的舞者一头扎进姐妹的胸脯，让对方咬紧牙关倒吸一口气。“[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |知道你在外面真的好难受！我总忍不住担心你再也不会回来 |我不敢相信你真的在这里！求你了，告诉我你是真的 ]。” 机械义体美人揉了揉漂亮亲人的耳朵。“我说过我会回来，只是花的时间比我预想的长得多。” 你花了很长时间，才用一则你们共同冒险的故事让哈维和孩子们平静下来——这是略经删减的版本，去掉了最情色、最残酷的细节，以照顾在场的年幼与不那么年幼的听众。感觉紧张气氛逐渐消退后，莱雅克诗人克服本能的羞怯，开始吟唱一段充满水晶般音色的流动旋律。蓝色外星人甜美的歌声催眠了扎伊卡听众，以柔和的歌曲瞬间征服了她们。专业表演者被摇曳的节奏迷住，离开座位，在铺着毛毯的地板上跳起舞来；片刻之后，又有几个女孩加入。孩子们尽力跟随看护者的节拍，拉皮斯则组织起临时合唱团和乐队，为主唱那首壮丽的颂歌伴奏。波莱特脸上浮现灿烂的笑容；她正需要这一切来放松心情，彻底摆脱困扰自己的念头。 眨眼之间，她便借助硬光翅膀加入姐妹，在空中以超凡的优雅一同旋转飞舞。两名扎伊卡动作同步，彼此追随对方的舞步，尾巴则在一支精巧的探戈中摆动。时间一分一秒地过去，她们让身体代为诉说，以热烈的动作分享各自的故事、挣扎与梦想。音乐最终消逝在低声呢喃中，而舞者则以妩媚的姿态收尾。拉皮斯和歌唱的女孩们鼓掌，跳舞的姑娘们则向观众鞠躬。她们大多不懂得正确鞠躬，纷纷摔倒在地，惹得同伴和她们一起大笑；成年人则回到座位上。 “星辰啊，我太需要这个了！如果事情的发展有所不同，我们一定能成为一对出色的芭蕾舞演员，”哈维低声说道，揉着怀孕的肚子。“至少你再也不用应付那些上流社会的对等体；权力真的会让他们变得非常讨厌。要不是为了我们可爱小花朵们的未来，我早就不干了，”她补充道，同时揉乱一个在她腿上睡着的紫色孩子的头发。 你们又一起待了几分钟。随后，又有几个幼童开始打瞌睡，其他孩子对你船员那对改造胸脯的兴趣也越来越浓，于是你决定告别离开。你和波莱特亲吻疲倦孩子们的额头，随后跟着拉皮斯和哈维走到外面。“照顾好自己，波莉。这个世界又冷又残酷，我不想再失去你了，”怀孕的表演者说着，紧紧拥抱自己的机械义体姐妹。 “这里永远欢迎你，对你们也一样，”拉皮斯补充道，朝达贝比埃斯眨眨眼，又向你送来一个飞吻。 “如果我从自己的遭遇中学到了什么，那就是[silly |要相信友谊的力量 |只需要一位好朋友伸出援手，就能照亮你的人生 ]，”波莱特补充道，一边抚摸达贝比埃斯的头皮，一边将你紧紧搂住。 你把两名扎伊卡看护者留在一起，向她们挥手告别，斑驳的拉斯克维尔与加比拉尼人群则像五彩浪潮一般将你们吞没。你花了几分钟才找到一个比较安静的地方放松下来，稍作休息。 “能再次见到她们真是太好了，谢谢你，[pc.name]。” “这是我的荣幸。[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE |[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_FLOWER |看，就在那里！那不是...？” 满身铬金属的美人眨了几次眼，无法理解眼前发生的一切。锂花用灵活的触手旋转前行，昂贵的珠宝叮当作响，衣装也随着她穿过一家野战诊所的小巷时吱呀作响；她负责修复损坏的机械义体，而一名凯塞利医生则处理病人的血肉伤口。“我不敢相信...她吸取了教训，成为了更好的人。她甚至在发自内心地微笑和欢笑，”波莱特喃喃说道，仍然被事情的结局震惊得不知所措。 |顺便问一句，你知道是谁把它改名成小乳房收容所的吗？” 满身铬金属的美人轻笑起来。“那是拉皮斯照着哈维的主意干的。招牌本来就已经破破烂烂，所以她们只花一分钟就完成了这桩罪行。” “真意外，你居然没参与。” “这-这个嘛...当时负责分散凯米妈妈注意力的人就是我，”她坦白道，脸颊因深深的羞赧而烧得通红。 ] |顺便问一句，你们为什么自称三个小魔王？” 满身铬金属的美人轻笑起来。“那是凯米妈妈给我们的绰号。我们同一批被送进小花朵收容所，又在同一天孵化——就这么简单。我们也确实是让人受不了的[silly |小妖怪 |小淘气 ]，但那只是巧合，”她咯咯笑道。 ] “总之，这场精彩的冒险过后，我们也该睡个午觉了。船上见，船长！” 波莱特在你的脸颊上留下一个湿吻，随后朝停机坪方向飞去，穿过[silly |夜之城 |这个大都会区 ]霓虹闪烁的天空。
rows.raw: " “Let’s go then,” you say, taking her clawed hand in a tight grasp. You can feel a strong shiver rock her spine. “O-Okay. G-give me a moment to prepare, please. They trust each other, eat together, work together — I even saw a gabilani and a raskvel have a makeshift wedding ceremony between two acid rains. It’s a place where beauty blooms against all odds.” She’s right: you found her and Dabbebieth [var0|here|there] after all. The blue leyak’s cheeks turn cobalt, blushing and flustered so much that it disrupts its flight. “You filthy tease, I’ll have you know I was transplanted [var0|here|to Tarkus], not homegrown. It reminds me of the Gyre in some ways: a horrible, dangerous place in which the worst or the best can happen. Be it a zaika ganger or a vicious sydian, chances are you’ll get robbed of some chrome at a moment’s notice — if a rough machine doesn’t crush you first that is. Tarkus isn’t a place for softies, but it reveals if we are monsters or heroes.” So... which one is she? “I don’t know, but I certainly met my heroes,” she says, glancing at Dabbebieth, then longingly gazing at you. ]
rows.translation: [flags.TARKUS_DESTROYED |“我不太想谈这件事。[var0|这|那]堆悲惨的尘土与垃圾固然只是靠锈迹和祈祷勉强维系，可从某种意义上说，那是我的尘土与垃圾。我只希望星缆断裂前，他们尽可能救出了更多人。没人该失去自己的家，”她以干涩如荒漠的声音低语。 |“甜蜜的家，”宝蕾特带着出人意料的尖刻与讽刺[silly |射出一句 |挖苦道 ]，“我不知道自己是否特别讨厌[var0|这|那]颗由碎金属与荒芜土地组成的尘球。别误会，我不希望任何人被困在[var0|这里|那里]，可我在那里并不觉得难受或悲惨。那里当然不是天堂，却也并非地狱。当地有足够多的敌对生物与机器，足以让人放弃社会生活，可人们依然共同生活、共同奋斗。他们彼此信任，一起吃饭，一起工作——我甚至见过一名加比拉尼人和一名拉斯克维尔人在两场酸雨之间举行简陋的婚礼。那是一个美丽会冲破万难绽放的地方。” 她说得没错：毕竟你就是在[var0|这里|那里]找到了她和达贝比斯。蓝色莱亚克的脸颊染成钴蓝，羞赧慌乱得连飞行都受到影响。 “你这个下流的坏家伙，告诉你吧，我是被移植到[var0|这里|塔库斯]的，可不是土生土长。它有些地方让我想起环带：一个可怕而危险的地方，最坏或最好的事情都可能发生。不论遇上扎伊卡帮派成员还是凶狠的希迪安人，你随时都可能被抢走几件植入体——前提是没先被某台粗野的机器压扁。塔库斯不适合软弱的人，却能揭示我们究竟是怪物还是英雄。” 所以……她是哪一种？ “我不知道，但我确实遇到了属于我的英雄，”她说着先瞥向达贝比斯，继而深情地凝望着你。 ]

rows.original: [var0 |“I’d rather not talk about it. I hoped that the Myr and the U.G.C weren’t cold-blooded enough to allow a massacre, but here we are. It’s such a shame that their story in the great theater of life ended like this, their strings cut just before reaching a potentially nicer act. Stars above, I didn’t have any real friends [var1|down ]there but I still feel like something was taken away from me,” she confesses, “they deserved a chance to see the stars, to live a fulfilling life, to make the galaxy a better place.” |“On the one hand, I really appreciate the humid tunnels’ darkness, on the other, it breaks my heart to know that [var1|this world’s been|Myrellion has been] — and still is — so close to turning into a glassed graveyard. War ruins everything: plants, fields, cities, culture, art, and even people. Especially the people. I’d have loved to see the raw, unpolished wonder [var1|this|the] planet was before the Gold and Red Myr let their spite ravage their homes.” She’s very emotional about it. Did something similar happen to her homeworld? Paulette shrugs. “I’m not sure, only the Peers have access to a good enough education to learn our species’ - and our world’s — history. One lone, cold night on Tarkus, I browsed through the UGC’s reports, looking for data related to Dhaal. According to their orbital scans and publicly-released documents, it’s been tidally-locked for eons and life didn’t bloom on it before — it’s almost terrifying to know that our world had to become a volcanic mess and a glacial hellhole for its equator to flourish with biological marvels. I’d love to see the terraforming projects come to life and grant us tropical forests all over our home. I hope the Myrs, Bothriocs, and Nyrea will find a way to unite and build a civilisation that’ll turn their scarred world into a shining beacon of peace.” ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“我本来还希望米尔人和联合银河邦联不至于冷血到坐视一场屠杀，可事情还是走到了这一步。生命大剧场中属于他们的故事竟以这种方式落幕，丝线在可能迎来更美好一幕之前就被剪断，实在太遗憾了。群星在上，虽说我在[var1|下面的]那里没有真正的朋友，却依然感觉某样东西被夺走了，”她坦白道，“他们理应有机会看见群星，过上充实的人生，让银河变得更美好。” |“一方面，我真的很喜欢那些潮湿隧道里的黑暗；另一方面，一想到[var1|这个世界曾经|米瑞利昂曾经]——而且现在依然——如此接近变成一座被玻璃化的坟场，我就心痛不已。战争会摧毁一切：植物、田野、城市、文化、艺术，甚至人。尤其是人。我真想亲眼看看金米尔与红米尔任由怨恨蹂躏家园之前，[var1|这颗|那颗]星球未经雕琢的原始奇景。” 她对此非常动情。她的母星也发生过类似的事吗？ 宝蕾特耸耸肩。“我不确定，只有对等体才能接受足够优质的教育，了解我们种族以及世界的历史。在塔库斯一个孤寂寒冷的夜晚，我浏览过联合银河邦联的报告，寻找与达尔有关的资料。根据他们的轨道扫描和公开文件，这颗星球已被潮汐锁定亿万年，而生命此前并未在那里繁盛——一想到我们的世界必须变成一半火山炼狱、一半冰封地狱，赤道地区才能绽放出生物奇迹，几乎令人恐惧。我希望看到那些地球化工程成为现实，让整颗母星遍布热带森林。也希望米尔人、博斯里奥克人和尼瑞亚人能找到团结的方法，共同建立一个文明，将他们伤痕累累的世界化作和平的璀璨灯塔。” ]

rows.original: “A lair of scoundrels, ne’er-do-well, and slaves. I don’t know if I should love or hate [var0|this|that] place.” Weird answer considering she used to be a slave to a very brutal owner. Can she elaborate? Paulette runs an orange hand through her projected plumage. “It reminds me of Dhaal in some ways: the rampant criminality, the lawlessness, the fear of being enslaved or beaten down at any corner — all [var0|these|those] struggling lives, broken dreams, and injustices feel way too real for my little zaika heart. Alone, I wouldn’t be able to save more than a handful of souls and even so, I’m not sure we could fly away from all the cutthroats. But I’d gladly make a ruckus just to see some pirates abducted by their former playthings and turned into drooling cumdumps,” she says, her eyes glowing with a devilish light. [var0|You’ll have to be even more careful up here, chances are there’ll be a lot more random brawls and surprise uprisings with her in the vicinity.]
rows.translation: “一处恶棍、无赖与奴隶盘踞的巢穴。我不知道自己该喜欢还是憎恨[var0|这个|那个]地方。” 她曾经是一个残暴主人手下的奴隶，这个回答听起来很奇怪。她能详细说说吗？ 宝蕾特用橙色的手梳过投影出的羽毛。“它在某些方面让我想起达尔：猖獗的犯罪、无法无天的环境，以及随时可能在某个街角遭到奴役或毒打的恐惧——所有[var0|这些|那些]挣扎求生的人、破碎的梦想与不公，对我这颗小小的扎伊卡之心而言都太过真实。单凭我一个人，最多只能拯救寥寥几个灵魂，即便如此，我也不确定我们能否逃过所有亡命徒。不过，要是能看着一些海盗反被他们昔日的玩物绑走，变成只会流着口水的泄欲工具，我很乐意大闹一场，”她说着，双眼亮起恶魔般的光芒。 [var0|她在附近时，你得更加小心；随机斗殴与突然暴动恐怕会多上不少。]

rows.original: “It’s weird [var0|to be back here|every time I go back there], nothing[var0|| has] changed and yet everything [var0|did|has].” Could she elaborate? Paulette looks down on her orange limbs, a deep melancholy burning in her eyes. “Even though I’m free from my burdened past, I still feel powerless and minuscule... crushed by the Gyre’s giant buildings and choking on acrid smoke as if I were a nameless factory worker all over again. Don’t get me wrong, I’m very glad to live with you[crewRange 2 | and your friends, ] but deep down I feel like I’m still the weak, frail zaika I used to be.[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE | Seeing Lappis and Harvvey again helped a little but I can’t stop myself from thinking that I — out of all of mom’s daughters — was the one who failed her. ]” Her blue leyak friend slowly presses his face against her right cheek and wraps his tentacles around her shoulders in what must pass for a tight hug for him while you place a comforting hand over her clawed chrome. “You’ve gone through a lot. It’s a miracle you didn’t give up and let yourself rot on Tarkus. I’m sure your adoptive mother would be proud of the zaika you’ve become.” “Thank you [pc.name], for everything — and to you as well, my floating friendo,” she whispers, dragging you all together in a snug hug. “I wouldn’t be here without you... I don’t think I’ll ever be able to repay you.” “As far as I’m concerned, we’re even. I don’t know about Dabbebieth’s point of view though, he might be a little bit more demanding for babysitting you for so long.” “I’m sure we’ll come to a mutual understanding,” she teases, her doubts and sadness but a distant souvenir already.
rows.translation: “[var0|重新回到这里|每次回到那里]都感觉很奇怪，什么[var0||都没有]改变，可一切却[var0|都变了|已经变了]。” 她能详细说说吗？ 宝蕾特低头看着自己橙色的四肢，眼中燃烧着深沉的忧郁。“即使已经摆脱沉重的过去，我依然觉得自己无力而渺小……仿佛又变回那个无名的工厂工人，被环带的巨型建筑压得喘不过气，在刺鼻烟雾中窒息。别误会，我很高兴能和你[crewRange 2 |以及你的朋友们 ]一起生活，可内心深处，我仍觉得自己还是从前那个软弱、脆弱的扎伊卡人。[flags.PAULETTE_DHAAL_DATE | 再次见到拉皮斯和哈维后，感觉稍微好了一点，可我还是忍不住认为，妈妈所有女儿之中，偏偏是我辜负了她。 ]” 她的蓝色莱亚克朋友缓缓把脸贴到她右颊上，用触手环住她的肩膀；对他而言，这大概已经算是紧紧拥抱。与此同时，你把安慰的手放在她带爪的植入体上。“你经历了太多。你没有放弃自己，任由自己烂在塔库斯，已经是个奇迹。我相信你的养母会为如今的你感到骄傲。” “谢谢你，[pc.name]，谢谢你所做的一切——也谢谢你，我那漂浮的朋友，”她低声说着，把你们全都拉进温暖的拥抱。“没有你们，我不会站在这里……我想自己永远都报答不了你们。” “对我而言，我们已经两清了。不过我不知道达贝比斯怎么想，毕竟照看你这么久，他的要求可能会稍微高一点。” “我相信我们会达成双方都满意的共识，”她调侃道，疑虑和悲伤早已化为遥远的回忆。

rows.original: Paulette shivers. “[var0|This|That] place, it scares me down to my bones, metallic ones included.” It[var0|’s scaring| scares] her? How so? “It’s not about the radiation-heavy wastes or the raiders roaming them that freezes me to my core... it’s what happened to [var0|this|that] place. What — or rather, who’s responsible for [var0|this|that] planet’s state terrifies me. To think that one day, something can absolutely ruin the shit out of an entire planet and doom its surviving denizens to a life of strife and suffering, that fills me with pure dread.” Yeah, voiced like this, it’s indeed scary. Doesn’t she feel awe at the local flora and fauna’s resilience? The former XO tilts her head. “I do, but it only deepens my worries. They are so strong, so inventive, so alive, fighting tooth and nail to claim [var0|these|the] glassed deserts and poisoned oases — if they can be so powerful and resilient, the one that disfigured [var0|this|the] planet must be capable of anything. Promise me you’ll be careful out there.” “[pc.kmhbb |Don’t worry Paulette, I won’t do anything stupid[var0| out there],” you reply, placing a comforting hand on her cybernetic thigh |I’ll try to avoid troubles, but [silly |the scenario wants me to be an issue magnet |I seem to attract dangerous weirdos,” you tease ]” |Getting into trouble runs in the family. You don’t have to worry, I’m the one who knocks[silly | | up ],” you boast |Don’t worry Polly cutie, I’ll stay out of trouble. It’ll be vewwy hard if trouble’s got some meaty bitsies though,” you giggle |I won’t flex over my foes too much, I promise,” you grunt ]. Your zaika crewmate smiles, not completely reassured but charmed by your natural charisma and confidence. “Y-You know what? Fine, I trust your fighting skills and survival instincts. You wouldn’t have come this far if you were a frail, weak, and pathetic [pc.race] after all,” she says — a weird way to compliment your abilities. “Maybe we could go out together — you know — to better protect ourselves while we discover [var0|this planet’s|Phaedra’s] peculiar growths and landscapes,” she says, with darkening cheeks. It’s unsettling how such a strong, deadly cyborg can behave like a blushing violet whenever she tries to do something slightly romantic.
rows.translation: 宝蕾特打了个寒颤。“[var0|这个|那个]地方让我怕到了骨子里，包括金属做的骨头。” 那里[var0|正在吓到|会吓到]她？为什么？ “让我彻骨冰寒的不是辐射严重的荒地，也不是游荡其间的掠夺者……而是[var0|这个|那个]地方曾经发生的事。更确切地说，真正让我恐惧的是把[var0|这颗|那颗]星球变成如今模样的东西——或者说，是某个人。一想到有朝一日某种存在能把整颗星球彻底毁掉，让幸存居民注定在争斗与苦难中度过一生，我就充满纯粹的恐惧。” 这样说来，的确很可怕。可她不为当地动植物的顽强生命力感到敬畏吗？ 这位前执行官歪了歪头。“当然会，可那只会加深我的忧虑。它们如此强壮、如此善于适应、如此生机勃勃，为争夺[var0|这些|那些]玻璃化荒漠和中毒绿洲而拼尽全力——如果它们都能如此强大而顽强，那么毁掉[var0|这颗|那颗]星球的存在必定无所不能。答应我，你在外面一定要小心。” “[pc.kmhbb |别担心，宝蕾特，我不会在[var0|那里]做什么蠢事，”你回答着，把安慰的手放在她的机械大腿上 |我会尽量避开麻烦，可[silly |剧本偏偏要让我变成麻烦磁铁 |我似乎总能吸引危险的怪人，”你调侃道 ]” |惹麻烦是家族传统。你不用担心，我才是那个上门敲门[silly | |兼让人怀孕 ]的人，”你夸口道 |别担心，宝莉小可爱，我会躲开麻烦的。不过要是麻烦身上长着几块肉肉，那可就太——难啦，”你咯咯笑道 |我不会对敌人炫耀太多肌肉的，我保证，”你哼声说道 ]。你的扎伊卡船员露出微笑，虽然并未完全放心，却被你天生的魅力和自信打动。 “你、你知道吗？好吧，我相信你的战斗技巧和生存本能。毕竟，要是你只是个脆弱、软弱又可悲的[pc.race]，也走不到今天，”她说道——这种称赞能力的方式有点古怪。“也许我们可以一起出去——你知道的——一边探索[var0|这颗星球|菲德拉]独特的生长物与地貌，一边更好地保护彼此，”她说着，脸颊渐渐变深。如此强悍致命的机械战士，每逢尝试做一点浪漫的事就会像害羞的紫罗兰，实在令人不安。
rows.raw: " Paulette shivers. “[var0|This|That] place, it scares me down to my bones, metallic ones included.” It[var0|’s scaring| scares] her? How so? “It’s not about the radiation-heavy wastes or the raiders roaming them that freezes me to my core... it’s what happened to [var0|this|that] place. What — or rather, who’s responsible for [var0|this|that] planet’s state terrifies me. To think that one day, something can absolutely ruin the shit out of an entire planet and doom its surviving denizens to a life of strife and suffering, that fills me with pure dread.” Yeah, voiced like this, it’s indeed scary. Doesn’t she feel awe at the local flora and fauna’s resilience? The former XO tilts her head. “I do, but it only deepens my worries. They are so strong, so inventive, so alive, fighting tooth and nail to claim [var0|these|the] glassed deserts and poisoned oases — if they can be so powerful and resilient, the one that disfigured [var0|this|the] planet must be capable of anything. Promise me you’ll be careful out there.” “[pc.kmhbb |Don’t worry Paulette, I won’t do anything stupid[var0| out there],” you reply, placing a comforting hand on her cybernetic thigh |I’ll try to avoid troubles, but [silly |the scenario wants me to be an issue magnet |I seem to attract dangerous weirdos,” you tease ]” |Getting into trouble runs in the family. It’ll be vewwy hard if trouble’s got some meaty bitsies though,” you giggle |I won’t flex over my foes too much, I promise,” you grunt ]. You wouldn’t have come this far if you were a frail, weak, and pathetic [pc.race] after all,” she says — a weird way to compliment your abilities. “Maybe we could go out together — you know — to better protect ourselves while we discover [var0|this planet’s|Phaedra’s] peculiar growths and landscapes,” she says, with darkening cheeks. rows.original: “What do you think of New Texas, the pastoral paradise?” you say, making the former XO startle. “I-I’ve conflicting feelings about the place. On the one hand, I’d love to live in a place so verdant and blooming with life but on the other hand, [var0|this place’s|the place is] just a giant trap for weak-willed zaikas.” “Because of the milk?” “Indeed. Even a heavily chromed-up Paragon Peer or Bright Water [silly |nerd |scientist ] would lose it in the span of a day. Send a colonial ship [var0|here|there] and you’ll have a zaika petslave per household by the end of the day, I could bet my legs on it.” Did she visit the Governor’s Ranch and if so, how was it? “I did. It would have been better if doing so didn’t turn me into the biggest piece of entertainment, though. The barman told me I would make for a perfect new recruit for the Living Kegs’ ranks — an offer I politely declined even though I’d look stunning in cowprint lingerie,” she teases, an amethyst blush burning her cheeks. “I also brought this fancy hat back[var0| from the surface], but I don’t know where I snatched it,” she adds, pointing at a cowboy hat branded with the security forces’ golden star — chances are she’s now a New Texas Ranger.
rows.translation: “你觉得新德州这个田园天堂怎么样？”你问道，让这位前执行官吓了一跳。 “我、我对那里怀有矛盾的感情。一方面，我很想生活在如此翠绿、充满生机的地方；但另一方面，[var0|这个地方|那里]根本就是为意志薄弱的扎伊卡人准备的巨大陷阱。” “因为牛奶？” “没错。哪怕是重度植入改造的典范对等体，或是清水集团的[silly |书呆子 |科学家 ]，一天之内也会失去理智。派一艘殖民船到[var0|这里|那里]，当天结束前，每户人家都能领到一个扎伊卡宠物奴隶，我敢拿自己的腿打赌。” 她去过总督牧场吗？如果去过，感觉如何？ “去过。如果没有因此变成全场最大的娱乐节目，体验本来会更好。酒保说我很适合加入活酒桶的队伍——我礼貌地拒绝了，尽管穿上奶牛纹内衣的我肯定非常迷人，”她调侃着，双颊燃起紫晶色的红晕。“我还从[var0|地表]带回了这顶漂亮帽子，可我不记得是从哪里顺来的，”她又说道，指向一顶印着安保部队金色星徽的牛仔帽——看来她如今很可能成了新德州游骑兵。

rows.original: “I[var0||’ve] talked with some of Canadia Station’s workers; the place sounds lovely.” Interesting. Is she thrilled by the cool climate and the resilient flora or rather by the large amount of tauric individuals populating it? The zaika’s cheeks take a deep, amethyst blush. “I-I don’t see what you mean. I’m sincerely fond of what the settlers have done with [var0|this|the] place. The fact that their society was designed around the cohabitation of tauric and bipedal citizens makes it a very endearing proof of intelligence and wisdom. I wish we had the same luck back on Dhaal. We could be developing in a verdant, bountiful paradise rather than spreading a dark, industrialized hellscape spread across our world’s equator. My younger self would have killed to smell the peculiar scent of a pine or a maple tree. I’ll let you imagine what I would have done to live surrounded by them.” Yeah, you can see what she means. Some people will do anything to escape their shackles. Maybe you’ll spend some well-earned holidays on Vesperia with her once your quest will be over. “Count me in. But be warned, I might get accustomed to flannel shirts and cozy fireplaces,” she teases.
rows.translation: “我[var0||曾经]和加拿大站的一些工作人员聊过；那个地方听起来很可爱。” 有意思。令她兴奋的是凉爽气候和顽强植物，还是那里数量众多的兽身居民？ 扎伊卡人的双颊染上深深的紫晶色。“我、我不明白你是什么意思。我是真心喜欢定居者对[var0|这个|那个]地方所做的一切。他们的社会从一开始便围绕兽身与双足公民共处而设计，这项事实本身就是智慧与远见的可爱证明。真希望达尔也有同样的幸运。那样我们就能在翠绿丰饶的天堂里发展，而不是让黑暗的工业炼狱横跨整个世界的赤道。年轻时的我为了闻一闻松树或枫树独特的气味，什么都做得出来。至于生活在它们环绕之中，我会付出什么，就留给你想象吧。” 嗯，你明白她的意思。有些人为了摆脱枷锁，什么都愿意做。等你的任务结束，也许可以和她一起去维斯佩里亚度过一段应得的假期。 “算我一个。不过先警告你，我可能会迷上法兰绒衬衫和温暖的壁炉，”她调侃道。

rows.original: “Stars, [var0|this moon’s|Uveto is] colder than Dhaal’s dark hemisphere. The fact that locals can survive the freezing gusts without wearing heat belts just drives me insane!” So you take it she’d rather stay [var0|up here|far away], where it’s warm and comfy? Paulette nods. “Yeah but a mean little guy keeps pushing me to go planetside[var0|| whenever we’re nearby],” she grumbles, sending Dabbebieth a death stare. The floating leyak retorts by offering her a mocking face that makes the purple XO even madder. “He’s even more vulnerable to the frost than I am and yet he keeps begging me to lead him through the glaciers in search of inspiration. Don’t get me wrong, I’d love to see [flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |another magical |an ] aurora under a snowy sky but [silly |the cold really bothers me, FUCK YOU ELSA!!!! |I’m not geared for arctic exploration ].” “So you’re telling me the dreadful cyborg’s scared of going outside in the snow? I thought you were tougher than that. I guess I’m friends with a chilly coward,” you tease. The chromed-up cutie pouts. “I-I’ll show you who’s a chilly coward. [var0|Next time we’re there, ]I dare you to meet us at Irestead’s exit for a polar trek, then we’ll see who’s gonna beg the other to go back to the ship,” she roars, a bravado that was intended to be scary but rendered funny in its delivery. “As long as Dabbebieth wears a fluffy cap, I’ll be happy to travel Uveto’s permafrost with you.”
rows.translation: “群星在上，[var0|这颗卫星|乌维托]比达尔的暗半球还冷。当地人不戴热能腰带也能扛住刺骨寒风，简直让我发疯！” 所以她宁愿待在[var0|这上面|远处]这个温暖舒适的地方？ 宝蕾特点点头。“是啊，可有个刻薄的小家伙总在[var0||我们靠近那里时]逼我去星球表面，”她抱怨着，狠狠瞪了达贝比斯一眼。漂浮的莱亚克冲她做了个嘲弄的鬼脸，惹得紫色执行官更加恼火。“他比我更怕严寒，却总求着我带他穿过冰川寻找灵感。别误会，我很想在雪天下再看一次[flags.PAULETTE_UVETO_DATE |那片神奇的 |一片 ]极光，可[silly |严寒真的让我很烦，去你的艾莎！！！！ |我的装备不适合极地探险 ]。” “所以你是在说，那个可怕的机械战士害怕在雪地里出门？我还以为你更坚强呢。看来我交了个怕冷的胆小鬼朋友，”你调侃道。 这个全身植入体的可爱姑娘撅起嘴。“我、我会让你看看谁才是怕冷的胆小鬼。[var0|下次我们去那里时，]我敢你到艾尔斯特德出口和我们来一次极地远足，到时候再看看谁会求着对方回船上，”她吼道。这番虚张声势本想吓人，说出口却显得滑稽。 “只要达贝比斯戴上毛茸茸的帽子，我就很乐意和你一起穿越乌维托的永久冻土。”
