rows.original: Paulette & Shekka
rows.translation: 宝拉与谢卡
rows.raw: "Paulette & Shekka"

rows.original: Weird noises lure you to the engine room, clinking metal and gears grinding in a very concerning, asynchronous rhythm. Fortunately, it’s not your ship’s reactor or systems that are involved, but your zaika and raskvel crewmates busy on the former’s orange arm. “Damn girl, look at how dirty these false muscles are! No wonder your moves look so rough and basic,” the short mechanic remarks while she applies a nice sheen of oil all over the pistons lining Paulette’s detached limb. “I’ve seen a lot of cyborgs and tech fiends on Novahome but you’re the first one to use actual companion droid parts. Wanna talk about it?” Paulette shrugs. “It’s nothing fancy, really. These Pyrexxx products are cheap, powerful, energy efficient, and easy to maintain — things you’ll be looking for if you live in alone with nobody else to rely on. Dabbebieth might be a nerdy little poet and a genius when it comes to empathic behavior but he knows nothing about robotics and logistics. I had to rely on my basic knowledge to keep an operational body. And as you know, basic knowledge means little to no access to advanced systems or optimized machinery.” Before Shekka can retort, you join them and hand a screwdriver to the hyperactive raskvel. “Hey [pc.name], how long have you been here? I’m almost done updating the Ghod’Mluss’ipn’s synthetic bits and teaching her how to repair them. It’s a miracle she could move at all considering the low-quality of her prosthetics and the replacement parts she used to fix them.” You explain that you just arrived, how long have they been at it? “Maybe a couple of hours? I didn’t keep track of time,” Paulette confesses. “I was too busy appreciating how my legs move now that my gyrators are perfectly balanced[silly |, as all things shall be | again ]. I think Shekka spent half of the time on my hardlight wings.” The pink raskvel nods. “The projectors’ synchronicity was completely out of place. I wonder how you could even use them as anything other than cumbersome shields. I couldn’t do miracles with the plates’ alloys but I gave her the best synth-muscles and robotic organs on the market — black markets included. It’s fortuitous that her dhaalian design was compatible with the U.G.C’s standardized ports... it’s as if her race and culture developed following blueprints exactly the same way as the rest of the galaxy did — but I’ve got a lot of doubts about the latter’s likelihood.” “M-Mother told me that the zaibatsu’s rule over Dhaal was fairly recent in the planet’s history and the publicly available data on my homeworld mention a quick development of our society a few years after scouting probes reached the sector so... that might be it. In the end, it doesn’t really matter, unless your tech comes with a surprise backdoor that can make my homeworld a better place,” she says as Shekka finishes polishing her left arm and fits it back to her joint. “And voila! It’s as good as new — if not better. Thanks for thinking about me for fixing your body. I had a pretty good time experimenting with your prosthetics’ systems and I learned a lot from it. With some funds and some time, I could craft a big, powerful exoskeleton for myself, too — for research purposes of course,” the tiny mechanic mutters. Your zaika crewmate tests her fingers and arm’s new swiftness before turning a blushing face to her smaller friend. “Thanks a lot. It feels so light and flexible now, it’s almost surreal. By the way, could you please let go of my tail?” Shekka’s cheeks turn crimson as she realizes what her augmented tail’s been up to, quickly withdrawing it from her purple c[silly |u |o ]mrade’s sensitive limb before standing up together and stretching their sore bodies. “S-Sorry for the inconvenience, I get a little carried away when I’m dealing with fascinating technologies,” she confesses. “Let’s go to the board room; we can test your chrome on the way and I could really use a drink after all this work. The offer stands for you too, [pc.name].” “Maybe another time. I wouldn’t want to disturb you two lovebirds,” you tease, making Paulette’s chest swell and Shekka’s [shekka.hasCock |horsecock |tail ] twitch. The two of them storm together out of the room, leaving you behind amidst the humming engines. It’s endearing to see how nerdy and flustered the rask can become as soon as gadgets are involved, especially if the gadget in question is a heavily-chromed up roommate respecting her skills.
rows.translation: 奇怪的声音把你引到引擎室：金属叮当作响，齿轮以一种令人十分担忧、彼此不同步的节奏摩擦。幸好出问题的并非飞船反应堆或系统，而是你的扎伊卡与拉斯克维尔船员；她们正忙着摆弄前者的橙色手臂。 “见鬼，姑娘，瞧瞧这些人造肌肉有多脏！难怪你的动作看起来又僵硬又粗糙，”矮小的机械师一边说，一边给排列在宝拉拆卸肢体上的活塞涂上一层亮闪闪的润滑油。“我在新星之家见过不少改造人和技术狂，但你还是第一个真正使用伴侣机器人零件的人。愿意聊聊吗？” 宝拉耸耸肩。“其实没什么特别的。这些焚火产品便宜、强劲、省电又容易维护——如果你独自生活、无依无靠，这些正是你会看重的东西。达贝比埃斯或许是个书呆子小诗人，在共情行为方面也是个天才，但他对机器人技术和后勤一窍不通。我只能依靠自己的基础知识维持一具能够运作的身体。你也知道，基础知识意味着几乎接触不到先进系统或优化机械。” 谢卡还没来得及反驳，你便加入她们，把一把螺丝刀递给亢奋的拉斯克维尔人。“嘿，[pc.name]，你在这里多久了？我差不多已经完成了对这只戈德·姆鲁斯·伊普恩人造部件的升级，也教会了她怎么修理。考虑到她的义肢质量那么差，维修时使用的替换零件也不怎么样，她居然还能动，简直是奇迹。” 你解释说自己刚到，然后问她们已经忙了多久。 “也许几个小时？我没注意时间，”宝拉坦白道。“我的回转器现在完美平衡了，我一直忙着体会双腿如今的动作有多么流畅[silly |，正如万物都应当达到的状态 | ]。我想谢卡有一半时间都花在我的硬光翅膀上。” 粉色拉斯克维尔人点点头。“投影器的同步性完全错乱了。我都不知道你除了把它们当成笨重护盾之外，还能怎么使用。我没法在装甲合金上创造奇迹，但我给她换上了市面上最好的合成肌肉和机器人器官——包括黑市货。幸好她的达哈尔设计与联合银河邦联的标准化接口兼容...仿佛她的种族和文化所遵循的发展蓝图，跟银河系其他地方完全一样——不过我很怀疑后一种可能性。” “母——母亲告诉我，财阀统治达哈尔，在这颗星球的历史中其实是很近期的事；关于我母星的公开资料也提到，侦察探测器抵达该星区几年后，我们的社会便迅速发展，所以...也许就是这个原因。说到底，这其实无所谓，除非你的技术附带某种意外后门，能让我的母星变得更好，”她说道；与此同时，谢卡抛光完她的左臂，把它重新装回关节。 “好啦！它跟新的一样——甚至比新的还好。谢谢你修理身体时能想到我。研究你的义肢系统很有趣，我也从中学到了很多。有了资金和时间，我也能为自己打造一套庞大而强劲的外骨骼——当然纯粹是为了研究，”小机械师喃喃道。 你的扎伊卡船员活动手指，测试手臂如今的敏捷度，然后红着脸转向比自己矮小的朋友。“非常感谢。现在感觉又轻又灵活，几乎不像真的。顺便问一句，你能放开我的尾巴吗？” 谢卡意识到自己的强化尾巴在做什么后，双颊变得通红；她赶紧把它从紫色同[silly |伴 |伴 ]敏感的肢体上收回来，然后两人一起站起，舒展酸痛的身体。“给——给你添麻烦了，抱歉。我一接触到迷人的技术，就容易有点忘乎所以，”她坦白道。“我们去会议室吧；路上可以测试你的金属肢体，而且干完这么多活，我真的很想喝一杯。[pc.name]，这个邀请也对你有效。” “还是下次吧。我可不想打扰你们这对小情侣，”你调侃道，让宝拉的胸膛起伏起来，也让谢卡的[shekka.hasCock |马根 |尾巴 ]抽动。两人一起冲出房间，把你留在嗡嗡作响的引擎之间。看着这个拉斯克一碰上小装置就变得如此书呆子气又慌乱，实在惹人喜爱；尤其当那个所谓的装置，是一位高度机械化、又尊重她技术的室友时。

rows.original: Paulette & Dizzy
rows.translation: 宝拉与迪兹
rows.raw: "Paulette & Dizzy"

rows.original: A potent, smoky scent lures you to the ship’s kitchen. The tasty smell coming from the boiling pot isn’t very unorthodox since you got your own chef[yammi.isCrew |s ] on board but there’s something special today, something more exotic, more out of place, more refined. Determined to find out what’s brewing and to maybe have a pleasant dish, you quickly [pc.isNaga |slither |stride ] through your moving home’s bulkheads up until your [pc.eyes] set on a very busy Dizzy seasoning a thic[silly |c |k ] plate with the help of a hyper focused Paulette wearing a frilly, bright pink apron. “And for the finishing touch, a tablespoon of creamy, Liashu juice-based sauce,” the former XO mumbles while her orange hand glazes the pan fried vegetables and carbs with the ruby concoction. She’s rather skilled, as if she were a cook in a past life, a cook almost matching your kaithrit matriarch[yammi.isCrew | and sparadat chef ]’s skills.Your chromed-up crewmates notice your presence just as they were about to sit down and dig into their dishes. “Hey there [pc.name]. Would you like to eat with us? I can serve you a nice, big plate of Paulette’s gorgeous cuisine. She’s got all it takes to be a great cook,” the fat feline remarks, bringing a slight blush to her c[silly |u |o ]mrade’s cheek. “I-It’s nothing fancy at all, really. I used to be the one in charge of the food with Mother when I was younger — we didn’t have much, but she always found ways to turn basic rations into a Peer-class meal.” Intrigued by the weird mix of colorful nuts, sliced vegetables, and grilled potatoes, you take a seat and let Dizzy serve you a rather generous portion fresh from the steamy pots. Sublime scents fill your nostrils moments before the three of you dig into the juicy delicacies, flaring your taste buds with a pleasant mix of sweet and salty flavors exhausted by the rich, ruby cream topping it. It must be a recipe from Paulette’s homeworld since you haven’t heard of Liashu fruits in the core or fringe worlds at large — a real shame considering how its unique flavor turns this simple dish into a savory explosion. “I’m glad the end result feels so balanced,” the zaika confesses, “I tried to recreate my favorite meal but we couldn’t find most of the original ingredients. It makes for a good proxy but I feel like something’s missing.” Dizzy tilts her head. “I think it’s fine as is. Adding or removing anything would ruin it in my opinion. By the way, can you tell me what your little blue friend likes? I’d like to make something special for him.” “Dabbebieth? Truth be told, I don’t know what he likes in terms of food. He siphons my tail or breasts to keep his cognitive abilities up but I really have no clue of what leyaks appreciate beside thic[silly |c |k ], protein-heavy fluids or jellies.” The mature kaithrit thinks for a couple of seconds before resuming her meal, certainly pondering what to do with this data. It doesn’t take you long to finish your plates and to wash them clean of the remaining traces of its exotic dressing. You can see how happy your two crewmates are together, behaving like mother and daughter even though their races are nothing alike. It’s quite endearing to see them have such a good alchemy, how complementary they are to one another as they prepare the ingredients for what you suspect will be a mango milkshake. “Thanks for the meal you two. I’ll see you later,” you say, dropping a quick peck on the busy ladies’ cheeks and hugging them tight before leaving them to their devices. The moment you leave the room, you hear an ecstatic whine produced by the former XO, a moan not unlike the one of a cowgirl being milked — this special zaika treat’s getting saucier by the second.
rows.translation: 一股浓郁的烟熏香气把你引到飞船厨房。自从船上有了自己的厨师[yammi.isCrew |们 ]，沸腾锅中飘出的诱人气味就算不上反常；但今天有些特别，有种更加异域、更加格格不入、也更加精致的感觉。为了弄清楚锅里煮着什么，也许还能享用一道美味佳肴，你迅速[pc.isNaga |滑行 |大步走 ]穿过这个移动家园的舱壁，直到[pc.eyes]看见忙得不可开交的迪兹；她正与全神贯注、穿着亮粉色荷叶边围裙的宝拉一起，给一大盘厚[silly |实 |实 ]食物调味。 “最后再加上一汤匙以利阿舒果汁为底的浓稠酱汁，”这位前XO喃喃道，用橙色手掌把红宝石色调料浇在煎过的蔬菜和碳水食物上。她相当熟练，仿佛前世曾做过厨师，手艺几乎能与那位凯斯瑞特主母[yammi.isCrew |兼斯帕拉达厨师 ]媲美。就在你这两位满身金属的船员准备坐下享用各自餐点时，她们注意到了你的存在。 “嘿，[pc.name]。要和我们一起吃吗？我可以给你盛一大盘宝拉的精美料理。她具备成为优秀厨师的一切条件，”丰腴的猫女说道，让她的同[silly |伴 |伴 ]脸颊微微泛红。 “其——其实一点也不特别。我小时候跟母亲在一起，通常由我负责食物——我们拥有的不多，但她总能想办法把基础口粮做成对等体级别的佳肴。” 你对这道由彩色坚果、切片蔬菜和烤土豆组成的奇怪混合物很感兴趣，于是坐下来，让迪兹从热气腾腾的锅中给你盛了相当丰厚的一份。三人开始享用多汁佳肴前，绝妙的香气先一步灌满你的鼻腔；甜味与咸味的愉悦交融，再由覆盖其上的浓郁红宝石色奶油加以升华，令味蕾尽情绽放。这一定是宝拉母星的食谱，因为无论核心世界还是边缘世界，你都从未听说过利阿舒果实——实在可惜，它独特的风味能让这道简单的菜肴化为鲜香的爆发。 “很高兴最后做出来的味道这么均衡，”扎伊卡承认道，“我试着重现自己最喜欢的一餐，可我们找不到大部分原始食材。这个替代品已经不错，但我总觉得少了点什么。” 迪兹歪了歪头。“我觉得现在就很好。照我看，增减任何东西都会毁掉它。对了，你能告诉我那个蓝色小朋友喜欢什么吗？我想为他做点特别的东西。” “达贝比埃斯？说实话，我不知道他在食物方面喜欢什么。他会吸食我的尾巴或乳房，来维持认知能力；但除了富含蛋白质的浓[silly |稠 |稠 ]液体或果冻之外，我真的不知道莱亚克喜欢什么。” 成熟的凯斯瑞特思索了几秒才继续用餐，显然在考虑如何利用这项信息。你们很快便吃光了盘中食物，又把残留的异域酱汁清洗干净。你看得出两位船员相处得多么开心；尽管种族毫不相似，她们却像母女一般。看着她们如此合拍、如此互补地准备食材，实在令人温暖；而你猜，她们接下来要做的是芒果奶昔。 “谢谢你们的饭。回头见，”你说着，在忙碌女士们的脸颊上迅速亲了一口，又紧紧拥抱她们，然后任由两人继续忙活。你刚离开房间，便听到这位前XO发出欣喜若狂的呜咽；那呻吟酷似一个正在被挤奶的牛女——这份扎伊卡特餐正变得越来越多汁。

rows.original: Dimmer than usual “Moos” coming from Reaha’s room lure you into the cowgirl’s personal space. To your surprise, the ginger gal isn’t alone here, but sitting on Paulette’s lap, head nested between the chromed-up zaika’s chest while she squeezes rivers of milk out of the bovine cutie’s prominent mounds. “Howdy [pc.name], look who I found to help me relieve myself today. I don’t know where you found her, but this lovely cyborg over here knows how to play with a lady’s [silly |milk tanks |bosom ]. I wouldn’t be against keeping her as my personal milker,” she giggles, pressing her head against the former XO’s [silly |chestpillows |cushioned chest ]. “G-Glad to be of service,” Paulette mumbles as another stream of creamy goodness surges from Reaha’s sore nipples and trickles down a large bucket already sloshing with the delicious liquid. “We zaika have very sensitive breasts. It’s not unusual to see two of us fondling and groping each other to make our orgasms stronger — there’s also a popular rumor that doing so will ensure impregnation and that the baby will be healthy and clever, although no scientific studies can back this claim. I hope my metallic, clawed hands aren’t too rough on your beautiful boobflesh.” Reaha shakes her head. “Nah, they feel gorgeous. Your kind touch is way better than my best milker’s sweet pressure. By the way, why isn’t your floating friend with us? I’m sure he’d be glad to have some fresh milk to feast upon.” “He’s very shy and doesn’t feel confident with new faces quickly. Give him a bit more time and he’ll gladly suckle on your swollen chest. But be warned, his poisonous tentacles and saliva will fuck with your productivity and trigger a strong high. It took me months of daily milking to develop a resistance to the numbness induced by his drug-laced body but I still feel the psychotropic effects,” she warns through clenched teeth. No matter how hard she resists, the former XO struggles to resist the strong, primal drive to jump the cowgirl and drain her dry — it must require all of her willpower to stop herself from surrendering to her basic urges, from turning into a moaning milk junkie. rows.original: Paulette approaches you, concerned. “Hey [pc.name].” You ask her if something is the matter. Is she having trouble finding her marks on your ship? “No, it’s nothing like that. I was looking for your name online, to get to know you a little better,” she says, a wild blush slowly brightening her face, “when I came across this.” She taps on her glasses. A second later, an in-built projector displays an official Steele Tech tab. It’s a notice from one of the subsidiaries based on Uveto, a scientific research facility if you recall correctly. “Looking for a job as a test subject?” The former XO frowns. “[pc.name], I’ve been somebody’s plaything in the past and I don’t want to go through that ever again. This company of yours is looking for volunteers for their limb-replacement technology. I’d like to participate too.” “Do you want to regrow your lost arms and legs?” “I’d lie if I said no,” she admits, “but that’s not my goal. It’s just... I’d like to see what the galaxy can offer to someone like me. I love my prosthetics, sure, but most of my people don’t have access to these quality standards – and I’m talking about sexbot-grade limbs,” she says, lifting her arms. You nod. “I understand. We can go there if you want. Who knows, maybe they’ll make you test tentacle arms or spider legs,” you tease. “Beware, [pc.name]! I’ll be sure to thoroughly test them on you if you mock me.” Well, it’s settled. The next time you’ll land on Uveto, you’ll give the Steele Tech lab a visit.

rows.original: You reach for your Codex and dial Paulette’s contact. You stay on hold for a couple of seconds before your purple crewmate answers. A small holopic displays her face on your device’s screen. “[pc.name]? What’s up? Need some help on this cold moon?” You smile. “I’m at the Steele Tech lab. Are you still up to test their new cybernetics? They are still looking for aliens with physical disabilities.” Paulette nods. “I’ll be there in a moment.” You take a seat and wait for her. Ten minutes later, the former XO steps through the entrance. You barely spot her face under her thic[silly |c |k ] pink parka’s hood. Uveto’s cold must be horrible to her sensitive skin, even after her augments. She casually approaches you, doing her best to stay cool despite a few workers’ intrigued stares. “Stars, how can they survive on this frozen moon? I spent three minutes outside in the warmest clothes I could find and I’m chilled to the bones.” You look around, spotting a wolfmorph and holstaur chatting next to a water fountain. “You don’t have fur; no wonder you struggle with the cold.” “Maybe. Anyway, where can I apply for the tests?” Before you can answer, a chromed Xhelarfog greets you. “Welcome to the Steele Tech Research lab. What can I do for you?” she asks, her metallic fingers dancing on her Codex. “Hello. I’d like to participate in the tests for your experimental cybernetics. I... lack arms and legs,” she says, showing her the sleek, orange limbs attached to her violet muscles. The gold-scaled scientist nods. “And you?” “I just brought her here. I don’t think I can help you.” “Not quite,” [flags.MET_DR_LESSAU |Dr. Lessau says, gliding your way. “You bear my microsurgeons, correct? I’d like to scan them, to check how efficient they are, compared to their older version – if it’s alright for you.” |a chimera says, slithering your way. The tag on his lab coat identifies him as Dr. Lessau. “What do you mean?” The heavily-modded physician reaches for his Codex, an almost perfect copy of yours. “You are [pc.name], Victor’s child, correct?” You nod. “I’m Dr. Lessau, a long time friend of your father, and the person that designed the experimental microsurgeons in your veins. I’d like to scan them quickly if you don’t mind. I’d like to check how well they handle taint and alien DNA compared to their earlier version – if it’s okay to you.” ] You look at Paulette. She seems confident, calm, relaxed; she’ll be fine on her own. “Alright. See you later Paulette. Don’t make a fuss,” you tease. The purple zaika giggles. “I doubt they’ll give me combat droid equipment. Don’t worry, I’ll behave.” The Xhelarfog brings Paulette to a small room, leaving you alone with the chimeric doctor. He gently guides you to his office, offering you his best seat and some herbal tea. “I’m glad you could come. Your microsurgeons are unique, the apex of Steele Tech’s genetic engineering. They have a high potential, so it’s only fair you’d be the one to test them first,” he says, reaching for a portable scanner. “Please, stay still for about ten seconds. I need to establish a link with their VI.” [pc.isAss |Reluctantly, y |Y ]ou stop breathing, not moving an inch as deep blue rays scour your body. The device tints a moment later, allowing you to relax and savor some of the herbal tea. The chimeric researcher connects it to his Codex and consults a couple holo-screens filled with intricate lines of code. “Did you feel an unusual warmth while I examined you? Any change of habit in your tastes or behavior?” You shake your head. [pc.isTreated |“I’ve had mood swings when I took the Treatment, but nothing since then.” “It’s a normal side effect. What isn’t, however, is how little taint it gave you. Your genes were altered but your metabolism adapted and stabilized smoothly to this transformative cocktail. |“Not really. My skin crawled a couple of times for no reason after I received them, but nothing else.” “It’s a normal side effect. It’s just your body reacting to a foreign body. ] Interesting, your microsurgeons memorized each mutating event you’ve experienced. Small radiation, transformative drugs, even alien food you tasted; everything’s stored. It’s almost frightening. Let me just- there.” What has he done? “I added another layer of encryption to the microsurgeons data. I wouldn’t want a hacker to get access to so much personal information on your metabolism. On a brighter note, I’m very happy with these readings. They don’t have the ability to erase taint, but we are a step closer to mastering gene-modding,” the doctor proudly says. Is there anything else he wants to do with you? “I think that’s enough for now. Torioh should be done with your friend now. You should check on them.” Without further ado, you finish your drink and salute the busy physician. You barely have the time to take a few steps outside Dr. Lessau’s room before being attacked by a flailing tentacle. The hardlight limb weakly bounces on you, failing to grasp anything with its bulbous tip. Looking at it more closely, you recognize the familiar shape of a zaika’s flared tip. “Paulette? Is everything alright?” you ask, following the writhing [silly |noodle |tendril ] to its source. “I’m... having some issues,” the former XO mumbles from inside the small room. Not reassured by her answer, you carefully enter the compact office. Your eyes go wide as you face a very tentacular Paulette. Her orange limbs rest on the ground, replaced by fancy hardlight projectors crackling with power and projecting a swarm of zaika tails from every limb. Torioh, the xhelarfog scientist, tries to wriggle out of your crewmate’s tight, glowing embrace. Something must have come wrong with the interfacing. “What happened?” The gold-scaled scientist wriggles out of the restraining tendrils and reaches for her Codex. Paulette’s ‘arms’ flail around one last time before her experimental assets disappear in a glint of rainbow light. The former XO falls on the carpeted ground. “Ouch. I think hardlight members aren’t for me,” she chuckles, blushing deeply. Torioh’s four, chromed arms scribble notes and gather sheets spread all across the room. “That’s quite the adverse reaction. The projectors failed to mimic your species’ arms and legs, so they identified the next best thing and replicated it. We will have to make more adjustments to prevent this from happening again,” she says, removing Paulette’s new attachments. “Can you please help her fit her prosthetics back on?” You nod. While you fix your crewmate’s arms and legs back in place, the alien scholar fills a rather meaty report. Their dev team will surely have a lot of work on their plate. Paulette sighs. “I’m a bit sad it didn’t work.” The xhelarfog blinks. “That’s how science works: trial and error. Don’t worry, we’ll learn far more from this than from all the flawless other tests we’ve made before. Can you please come back later? We’d like to test an older design on you. This one will be easier to control and shut down.” Paulette shrugs, adjusting her left arm and leg. “Sure. When can we resume the tests?” “Tomorrow. It should give us the time to adapt our program to your zaika biology,” she replies. “That’s all for today. Thank you for your cooperation. Would you like something to drink or eat?” “No. I think I’ll need to rest a little,” your crewmate says, reaching for her pink parka. “See you later, Torioh. I’ll be on the ship if you need me, [pc.name].” That was... something. Let’s hope the next experience goes more smoothly. You’d rather not find your crewmate turned into a cybernetic monster again.

波莱特耸耸肩，调整左臂和左腿。“好。什么时候可以继续测试？” “明天。这样我们就有时间让程序适配你的扎伊卡生理结构，”她回答道。“今天就到这里。感谢配合。想吃点或喝点什么吗？” “不用。我想自己得休息一会儿，”你的船员伸手拿起粉色派克大衣。“回头见，托里奥。如果你需要我，我会待在船上，[pc.name]。” 这还真是...不同寻常。希望下一次实验顺利些，你可不想再看到船员变成赛博怪物。
rows.raw: " You reach for your Codex and dial Paulette’s contact. You stay on hold for a couple of seconds before your purple crewmate answers. A small holopic displays her face on your device’s screen. “[pc.name]? What’s up? Need some help on this cold moon?” You smile. “I’m at the Steele Tech lab. Are you still up to test their new cybernetics? They are still looking for aliens with physical disabilities.” Paulette nods. “I’ll be there in a moment.” You take a seat and wait for her. Ten minutes later, the former XO steps through the entrance. You barely spot her face under her thic[silly |c |k ] pink parka’s hood. Uveto’s cold must be horrible to her sensitive skin, even after her augments. She casually approaches you, doing her best to stay cool despite a few workers’ intrigued stares. “Stars, how can they survive on this frozen moon? I spent three minutes outside in the warmest clothes I could find and I’m chilled to the bones.” You look around, spotting a wolfmorph and holstaur chatting next to a water fountain. “You don’t have fur; no wonder you struggle with the cold.” “Maybe. Anyway, where can I apply for the tests?” Before you can answer, a chromed Xhelarfog greets you. “Welcome to the Steele Tech Research lab. What can I do for you?” she asks, her metallic fingers dancing on her Codex. “Hello. I’d like to participate in the tests for your experimental cybernetics. I... lack arms and legs,” she says, showing her the sleek, orange limbs attached to her violet muscles. The gold-scaled scientist nods. “And you?” “I just brought her here. I don’t think I can help you.” “Not quite,” [flags.MET_DR_LESSAU |Dr. Lessau says, gliding your way. “You bear my microsurgeons, correct? I’d like to scan them, to check how efficient they are, compared to their older version – if it’s alright for you.” |a chimera says, slithering your way. The tag on his lab coat identifies him as Dr. Lessau. “What do you mean?” The heavily-modded physician reaches for his Codex, an almost perfect copy of yours. “You are [pc.name], Victor’s child, correct?” You nod. “I’m Dr. Lessau, a long time friend of your father, and the person that designed the experimental microsurgeons in your veins. I’d like to scan them quickly if you don’t mind. I’d like to check how well they handle taint and alien DNA compared to their earlier version – if it’s okay to you.” ] You look at Paulette. She seems confident, calm, relaxed; she’ll be fine on her own. “Alright. See you later Paulette. Don’t make a fuss,” you tease. The purple zaika giggles. “I doubt they’ll give me combat droid equipment. Don’t worry, I’ll behave.” The Xhelarfog brings Paulette to a small room, leaving you alone with the chimeric doctor. He gently guides you to his office, offering you his best seat and some herbal tea. “I’m glad you could come. Your microsurgeons are unique, the apex of Steele Tech’s genetic engineering. They have a high potential, so it’s only fair you’d be the one to test them first,” he says, reaching for a portable scanner. “Please, stay still for about ten seconds. I need to establish a link with their VI.” [pc.isAss |Reluctantly, y |Y ]ou stop breathing, not moving an inch as deep blue rays scour your body. The device tints a moment later, allowing you to relax and savor some of the herbal tea. The chimeric researcher connects it to his Codex and consults a couple holo-screens filled with intricate lines of code. “Did you feel an unusual warmth while I examined you? Any change of habit in your tastes or behavior?” You shake your head. [pc.isTreated |“I’ve had mood swings when I took the Treatment, but nothing since then.” “It’s a normal side effect. What isn’t, however, is how little taint it gave you. Your genes were altered but your metabolism adapted and stabilized smoothly to this transformative cocktail. |“Not really. My skin crawled a couple of times for no reason after I received them, but nothing else.” “It’s a normal side effect. It’s just your body reacting to a foreign body. ] Interesting, your microsurgeons memorized each mutating event you’ve experienced. Small radiation, transformative drugs, even alien food you tasted; everything’s stored. It’s almost frightening. Let me just- there.” What has he done? “I added another layer of encryption to the microsurgeons data. I wouldn’t want a hacker to get access to so much personal information on your metabolism. On a brighter note, I’m very happy with these readings. They don’t have the ability to erase taint, but we are a step closer to mastering gene-modding,” the doctor proudly says. Is there anything else he wants to do with you? “I think that’s enough for now. Torioh should be done with your friend now. You should check on them.” Without further ado, you finish your drink and salute the busy physician. You barely have the time to take a few steps outside Dr. Lessau’s room before being attacked by a flailing tentacle. The hardlight limb weakly bounces on you, failing to grasp anything with its bulbous tip. Looking at it more closely, you recognize the familiar shape of a zaika’s flared tip. “Paulette? Is everything alright?” you ask, following the writhing [silly |noodle |tendril ] to its source. “I’m... having some issues,” the former XO mumbles from inside the small room. Not reassured by her answer, you carefully enter the compact office. Your eyes go wide as you face a very tentacular Paulette. Her orange limbs rest on the ground, replaced by fancy hardlight projectors crackling with power and projecting a swarm of zaika tails from every limb. Torioh, the xhelarfog scientist, tries to wriggle out of your crewmate’s tight, glowing embrace. Something must have come wrong with the interfacing. “What happened?” The gold-scaled scientist wriggles out of the restraining tendrils and reaches for her Codex. Paulette’s ‘arms’ flail around one last time before her experimental assets disappear in a glint of rainbow light. The former XO falls on the carpeted ground. “Ouch. I think hardlight members aren’t for me,” she chuckles, blushing deeply. Torioh’s four, chromed arms scribble notes and gather sheets spread all across the room. “That’s quite the adverse reaction. The projectors failed to mimic your species’ arms and legs, so they identified the next best thing and replicated it. We will have to make more adjustments to prevent this from happening again,” she says, removing Paulette’s new attachments. “Can you please help her fit her prosthetics back on?” You nod. While you fix your crewmate’s arms and legs back in place, the alien scholar fills a rather meaty report. Their dev team will surely have a lot of work on their plate. Paulette sighs. “I’m a bit sad it didn’t work.” The xhelarfog blinks. “That’s how science works: trial and error. Don’t worry, we’ll learn far more from this than from all the flawless other tests we’ve made before. Can you please come back later? We’d like to test an older design on you. This one will be easier to control and shut down.” Paulette shrugs, adjusting her left arm and leg. “Sure. When can we resume the tests?” “Tomorrow. It should give us the time to adapt our program to your zaika biology,” she replies. “That’s all for today. Thank you for your cooperation. Would you like something to drink or eat?” “No. I think I’ll need to rest a little,” your crewmate says, reaching for her pink parka. “See you later, Torioh. I’ll be on the ship if you need me, [pc.name].” That was... something. Let’s hope the next experience goes more smoothly. You’d rather not find your crewmate turned into a cybernetic monster again. rows.original: A small concussion draws your attention as you give the local Steele Tech research division a quick visit. It doesn’t take you long to find its source: Paulette removing her legs and fitting a chromed belt around her waist with the help of an anat scientist. “Are you sure this will work? This nanite-based technology sounds very concerning and dangerous.” “Don’t worry, it’s perfectly safe,” the slender avian retorts. “Microsurgeons are widely used across the nearly the entire span of UGC-controlled space. If everything goes well, we’ll have a new morphic alternative to standard cybernetic implants and flash-grown replacement limbs. Our oldest prototypes worked flawlessly on human and ausar test subjects. A zaika shouldn’t need too many adjustments. Let’s start with a serpentine shape, could you?” Paulette shrugs and closes her eyes. Suddenly, a swarm of semi-liquid crystals leak from her new adornment and hugs her from the hips down. Inch by inch, they spread and rest atop each other in successive, scaly layers. It takes her about twenty seconds to acquire a long, purple tail not unlike a caesseli’s tapered lower body. The former XO’s eyes go wide as she discovers her new, serpentine-like shape. “I-It can’t be,” she whispers, giving her new muscles a few experimental wriggles. “It’s as real as you and I. Would you like to try and walk with it?” Without uttering a word, Paulette leaps from her seat and slithers gracefully across the room. Her movements look so fluid, it’s as if she knew how to use her coils since her first breath. “I think I like it. Is there any other form it can take?” The scientist raises a hand to his chin. “It’s only an early prototype, so it doesn’t have the same amount of pre-set alternatives our most recent ones have. You might be able to summon a tauric undercarriage with some effort?” The zaika closes her eyes again. Just as the nanites shaped themselves into a naga’s lower body before, now they split and restructure themselves, slowly building her a centaur’s body. Metallic hooves and strong, powerful legs replace her sinewy coils. Her tail is drawn into the violet horseback, leaving only her flower-like tip accessible from where a horse pussy would be; while the nanomachines give her another bulbous tail where a normal mare’s one ought to be. “I love this form. It’s so strong, so vigorous, so fancy,” she says, trotting around the room. After a minute of [silly |horsing |fooling ] around, she returns to the bench and closes her eyes again. The amethyst swarm of liquid crystals slowly recedes back into her belt, leaving her just enough time to sit before her lower body vanishes. As soon as her cybernetic ports emerge from the microsurgeons tides, she fixes her draconic legs back on. Then, sets her eyes back on the anat researcher. “That was so cool! This technology could help a lot of zaika if it were fully-developed, galaxy-wise. I wish I could keep it.” “You can have it if you want. This series is rather old compared to the ones we are designing right now. It’s very reassuring to see it work with even the most alien and augmented physiques. By the way, I think we are having a visitor,” he remarks, waving at you. A large smile settles on the zaika’s face the moment she spots you. “Hello [pc.name]! It’s good to see yooooou-” she says as her belt reactivates and generates a fat, prehensile, barbed prick between her legs. The purple rod wriggles greedily, its large, knotted base and big, grapefruit-sized balls quivering with barely-contained, wanton lust. The flustered cyborg’s cheeks adopt a fiery blush and her breasts inflate a few cups. “I-I can explain!” “I see you’re very happy to see me,” you tease, making her blush even harder and coaxing a blue bubble of pre out of her growth-lined length. “Interesting. We haven’t had this kind of reaction happen before... with anyone. We’ll have to be more careful with our end product or this scenario will surely occur again – certainly at the wrong moment. Can you try to control it?” Paulette closes her eyes again and takes deep breaths, doing her best to calm herself down and recover full control of her body. It takes her a long minute to impose her will on the newly-grown assets and to turn the flowing microsurgeons down, leaving her crotch free from the massive bitchbreaker she unintentionally summoned. “S-Sorry about that. I don’t know what happened – well I kinda know what triggered it but not why it did. At least I can control it when it’s active,” the flustered zaika says, removing her belt. “Are you sure I can keep it? Somebody could steal or sell it to reverse engineer the technology.” The scientist shakes his feathered head. “I had to attune it to your biology for it to work, so for anyone else, it’ll be a mere belt filled with useless nanomachine microsurgeons. And besides, I don’t think somebody will be stupid enough to dare take it from you,” he adds. “Thank you again! Can we go now, or do you need me for more tests involving a disabled individual?” “You are free to go. I’ll have to report this happy little incident to my superiors. I’m sure Dr. Lessau will eagerly capitalize on this unexpected discovery.” Without further ado, Paulette shakes the anat’s hand, grabs her thic[silly |c |k ], pink parka, and recovers a snoring Dabbebieth, swollen with cheap, tove-branded blueberry jelly. She then takes your hand and follows you to the lab’s exit. “So... are you going to use it again?” The former XO blushes. “I-If you want to spice things up, sure. Having these strong bodies and that pulsing pecker at my disposal made me feel so... powerful. “尖叫、转动的锯片、激光灼烧血肉、金属炙烤、水流沸腾——在溺水时被烧灼的感觉，生命一块接一块地离开身体——然后什么都没有。黑暗，接着是咆哮的风暴，无数灯光熄灭，复杂的一切被压缩成简单词语，荒芜、服从、死亡，”她喃喃自语，浑身颤抖。 她的眼睛不安地转动，双手画出一张扎伊卡面孔：长耳朵、圆脸颊、邪恶的笑容和一副硕大圆眼镜。她大汗淋漓，几乎就要哭出来，同时在两个白色圆圈中央各添上一枚大大的X。这也许只是一幅黑白标志，但它的存在本身就令你毛骨悚然。“一个热情的声音，是锂花——有人在训斥她。她变得更刻薄、更冷酷、更尖锐。我感受到她的怒火、失望，以及她有多厌恶这些结果。仁慈的GU对我毫无用处！她尖叫着，开始对GU-2进行教化！” 你把一只手搭在波莱特肩上。“你、你还好吗？” 扎伊卡吓了一跳。她眨了几次眼，然后摇摇头。“我没事。还有一个词：E.G.G.——然后有一阵子什么都没有。接着我在锂花的房间里醒来。她很生气——有人偷了她的宠物。她要我立刻把它找回来。” 达贝比埃斯倒吸一口气。“你、你梦见我了，”他调侃道，像一只开心的海葵般挥舞触手。 波莱特努力维持严肃，但看见朋友滑稽的动作后，还是忍不住呼出一口气。“某种意义上是。一切都清晰无比：追猎、登上薄暮号、制服守卫、进入货舱、找到你的水箱、船长和一半船员举起枪、激光瞄准点落在我的面罩与胸口，然后一切再度陷入黑暗。” 等等！她不是说过，因为海盗的EMP手榴弹烧毁了抑制器，所以她才恢复了所有记忆吗？ 波莱特摇摇头。“我原本也这么认为……但故事里仍有一处空白。系统日志显示发生严重错误，在黑暗中过了两小时零两分钟，之后一切恢复正常。但我清楚记得的只有：我把达贝比埃斯抱在胸前，因雷亚克毒液而神志不清，右臂接口上胡乱接着一门派雷克斯湮灭者，同时把最后一个海盗赶向逃生舱。警报长鸣、飞船向下坠落、货箱压碎双腿，我踮着脚走向一箱橙色性爱机器人零件，感受外星电子设备与残肢对接时的疼痛，风吹过脸庞，油海近得令人恐惧。” 你看向达贝比埃斯。小雷亚克举起触手，勉强做出耸肩动作。“那时候我营养不良，还被注射了镇静剂。我只记得波莱特闷哼着第一次展开翼模块，并且大喊‘[silly |这航班预算也太低了，没吃的也没电影？我不坐啦！ |别担心，小家伙，一切都会好起来的！ ]’” 波莱特脸红了。“也没那么糟。我们平稳降落在塔库斯了，不是吗？” 达贝比埃斯眯起眼睛。“我可不觉得翻了三个筋斗、吃了一脸沙子算平稳降落，”雷亚克评论道。“第一次尝试能基本毫发无伤，已经不错了。我更担心你的记忆。E.G.G.是什么，GU又是什么？” “我不知道，”前任大副回答。“我和你一样毫无头绪。也许……只要有条线索。” “我们已经有了，”你举起图画说道。“达尔肯定有人知道些什么。这个标志太有辨识度，不可能完全没人注意——我敢肯定关于E.G.G.或GU会有传闻。” 波莱特点点头。“我想E.G.G.是GU的总部。它非常大，也许像仓库，或者一座有着……嗡鸣反应堆的大工厂？” 这是个不错的开始。知道去哪里寻找线索吗？ 达贝比埃斯托住下巴。“也许可以问地下艺术家。我敢肯定他们当中有人在哪里见过这个徽记。” “帮派成员和黑市商人也可能掌握可靠线索，”波莱特补充道。“信任和人情对他们非常重要——力量也是。要是想从他们嘴里榨出情报，就做好打一架的准备。” 你点点头。“要不要考虑一下锂花？” 紫色扎伊卡咧嘴一笑。“你可以试试，但我怀疑她不会吐露实情。我们会自行调查。在外面小心点，[pc.name]。” “会的，”你答道。帮派分子、艺术家、非法场所、锂花——这应该会很有趣。
rows.raw: " On your way to the cockpit, you spot a very messy Paulette trying to eat breakfast. Her blonde hair hangs loosely, draping her shoulders in cascades of yellow knots and stray locks. Her heavy eyelids pin her down as much if not more than her huge, swaying tits.[silly|[flags.PAULETTE_MYR_DATE| Mr. Cuddlydoo, her orange plushie, smiles at you from between her violet cleavage — lucky bastard!]] She isn’t wearing pants either, and she’s clearly got a left leg in place of her right one. Somebody had a nightmare — and a pretty bad one at that! “[pc.name]?” she yawns, doing her best to stay awake. Her chin hovers dangerously close to her bowl of honeyed porridge — it’s a miracle she didn’t have an oat-filled [silly |facial |bath ] yet. “Y-You look funny. Did you see a ghost?” “[pc.kmhbb |Paulette, you’re the one looking like a revenant,” you reply. |Pleased to meet you, Ms. Spirit. Don’t mind if I peek a little, you’re rather intoxicating,” you tease. |Maybe? What kind of monster are you? A specter? A banshee? [silly |Booooobies? |A dullahan ]?” |Can I play with your Booobies Ms. Ghosty?” you reply. |Can I play with your Booobies Ms. Ghosty?” you reply. ] The cyborg blinks, confused. She frowns, lifting her spoon at eye level. She gawks in shock at her own reflection. “Stars, I look like a piece of trash! This day can’t get worse.” What’s the matter? Did something happen? “I... memories came back during my nap — unpleasant ones.” [pc.isAss |You shrug. She’s a strong girl, she can handle some post traumatic stress. Your Codex blips, picking up a potential threat. The screen chirps with warning signs for biohazards, chemhazards, and crushing hazards, all pointing at your purple crewmate. |You step closer and give the shocked zaika a hug. Her heart races in her augmented chest, [silly |pumping like a roaring Straight-69 engine |beating as if she were fighting for her life ]. ] You can only imagine the harrowing horrors she saw to be in this state. “Wanna talk about it?” “I... don’t know,” Paulette whispers. “Everything’s so confused and chaotic in my head.” Dabbebieth smoothly floats through the room and lands on Paulette’s left shoulder. “If you keep these bad memories buried, they’ll slowly gnaw their way into you, devouring everything you love, rotting you from the inside until you are nothing but a chromed husk. No need to fret, you are safe here.” The former XO sighs deeply. She glares at her oldest friend for a couple of seconds then sets her eyes on you. She stays silent for a moment, lost in her thoughts. “[pc.name], can I have a pen and paper?” You nod. Without further ado, you search the room for a blank sheet and a pen. After some fumbling and rummaging, you recover a notebook and a pink crayon from a shelf. Paulette gently takes them and starts drawing. At first, she hesitates, but after a few seconds, her fingers start scribbling something on the paper: a sigil, maybe an emblem? “Screams, saws revving, lasers searing my flesh, metal simmering, water bubbling — the feeling of burning while drowning, life leaving my body, one piece at a time — then nothing. Darkness, then a roaring storm, millions of lights snuffed, complexity reduced to simple words, bleakness, obedience, death,” she murmurs, shaking to her core. Her eyes move erratically as her hands scribble a zaika face with long ears, full cheeks, a wicked smile, and big, round glasses. She’s sweating profusely, almost on the verge of tears as she adds two big Xs in the middle of the two white Os. It might be just a black and white logo, but its mere existence gives you the creeps. “An enthusiastic voice, Lithium Flower’s — someone’s berating her. She’s meaner, colder, sharper. I feel her wrath, her disappointment, how she loathes the results. A merciful GU is no use to me! she screams, Start GU-2’s indoctrination!” You put a hand on Paulette’s shoulder. “A-Are you alright?” The zaika startles. She blinks a couple of times then shakes her head. “I’m okay. There’s one more word: E.G.G. - then nothing for a moment. Then, I woke up in Lithium Flower’s room. She’s angry – somebody stole her pet. She wants me to recover it posthaste.” Dabbebieth gasps. “Y-You dreamt of me,” he teases, waving his tentacles around like a happy anemone. Paulette tries to stay stern and serious, but seeing her friend’s silly moves makes her puff out a sigh. “In a way. Everything’s crystal clear: the hunt, boarding the Gloaming, neutralizing the guards, entering the cargo bay, finding your tank, the captain and the half the crew raising their guns, the laser sights on my visor and chest, then everything goes black again.” Wait! Didn’t she say that she remembered everything because the pirates’ EMP grenades fried her inhibitors? Paulette shakes her head. “I thought so... but there’s still a blank in the story. The systems log signals a critical error, two hours and two minutes in the dark, then everything is back to normal, but all I clearly remember is holding Dabbebieth against my chest, high on leyak venom, a Pyrexxx Annihilator ramshackled to my right arm’s socket as I repel the last pirate to the escape pods. Sirens blaring, the ship plunging down, crates crushing my legs, tiptoeing toward a box of orange sexbot parts, the pain of alien electronics coupling to my stubs, wind blowing against my face as the Oil Sea comes awfully close.” You look at Dabbebieth. The little leyak raises his tentacles in a makeshift shrug. “I was underfed and sedated back then. The only thing I remember is Paulette grunting, deploying her wing module for the first time, and screaming ’[silly |Talk about low budget flights, no food or movies? I’m outta here! |Don’t worry lil’ guy, everything will be okay! ]’” Paulette blushes. “It wasn’t that bad. We landed smoothly on Tarkus, didn’t we?” Dabbebieth squints. “I wouldn’t call three somersaults and getting a faceful of sand a smooth landing,” the leyak remarks. “We made it mostly unharmed for a first try. I’m more concerned about your memories. What is the E.G.G. and what is a GU?” “I don’t know,” the former XO replies. “I’m as clueless as you are. Maybe... if we had a lead.” “We’ve got one,” you remark, raising the drawing. “Somebody on Dhaal certainly knows something. This logo is far too iconic to go unnoticed — I’m sure there’s rumors about the E.G.G. or the GUs.” Paulette nods. “I think the E.G.G. was the GUs’ headquarters. It was very big, maybe like a warehouse, or a large factory with a... humming reactor?” That’s a good start. Any idea where to look for clues? Dabbebieth takes his chin. “Underground artists maybe. I’m sure one of them saw the emblem somewhere.” “Gangers and black market dealers can have good leads too,” Paulette adds. “Trust and favors are very important to them — strength, too. If you want to milk them for data, be ready for a fight.” You nod. “Do you think we should consider Lithium Flower?” The purple zaika grins. “You can try, but I doubt she’ll spill the beans. We’ll do our own investigations. Be careful out there, [pc.name].” “Will do,” you reply. Gangers, artists, illegal establishments, Lithium Flower — this should be fun. "

rows.original: “Did you find something?” Paulette shakes her head. “Not a damn thing. I investigated all of the Stacks without finding anything linked to the E.G.G. or GUs. I swear, it wasn’t just a nightmare — everything was so real, so visceral, so-” “We’ll unveil the truth. I’m sure of it,” you reply. “You can’t give up now.” The former XO nods. “Yes. Thank you [pc.name], for everything.”
rows.translation: “你发现了什么吗？” 波莱特摇了摇头。“屁都没有。我把整个斯塔克斯翻了个遍，也没找到任何跟E.G.G.或GU有关联的东西。我发誓，那不只是场噩梦—一切都那么真实，那么鲜明，那么-” “我们会揭开真相的。我确定，”你回答。“你现在不能放弃。” 这位前XO点了点头。“是的。谢谢你，[pc.name]，谢谢你做的一切。”

rows.original: Amidst the crowd of drunk gabilani, sweaty fanfirs, and busty zaika, you spot a pretty native with jugs as fat as her thighs. She’s enjoying a fizzy cocktail at the bar, unbothered by the brutes and sluts roughing it out a few inches from her. Her neon stockings shine in the room’s flickering lighting, luring you to her exposed curves. Her micro skirt and crop top barely hide her inflating bosom and flared hips. Speaking of her risqué shirt, it bears the same, faded logo as the one Paulette drew. It’s her! “Is this spot taken?” you ask. She smirks. “Be my guest, offwolder,” she replies in a suave voice. You casually claim the high chair and turn to face her. Her long hair hides most of her face, but her chromed eyes shine bright under her flowing curtains. Spinning galaxies feast upon the sight of your alien body as you rummage through your belongings. “So... my room or your pla-” The moment you place the piece of paper on the bar, the zaika’s smile fades. “Oh! You don’t want to get into this mess, trust me.” So she knows the E.G- “Hush! The walls have ears. I barely escaped them and I’m not going back!” You don’t want to bring her back, you want to know where the E.G.G. is. The cyborg brings her cocktail to her lips, desperately trying to stay chill and fit into this den of debauchery. “Dozens raided it, none returned. Nothing inside this hellhole is worth your life.” It’s not about you. It never was. You are doing it for a dear friend. The scantily-clad zaika sighs. “Nothing will make you see reason then? So be it,” she mutters. “Do you have a map?” You nod and open your Codex. The [silly |space drow |party-goer ] whistles, admiring your high-tech device while you open the map feature. “Where is it?” She points at the edge of the Gyre. “It’s a very large factory — the last building before the city meets the sun-kissed plains. The warden itself will give you a run for your money. She can take multiple XOs at once.” In a fight? Right? “Unfortunately, yes. I barely escaped her when they purged the workforce. If it weren’t for some giant raskvel mechbot’s fat ass blocking the way, I wouldn’t be here!” You’ll come armed and prepared then. You owe it to Paulette. “The girl you are doing this for, is she worth it?” “Definitely,” you reply. The zaika smiles. “I see. Good luck, offworlder — you’ll need it.” Paulette will definitely want to hear about this.
rows.translation: 在一群醉醺醺的加比拉尼人、汗流浃背的凡菲尔人与丰乳扎伊卡当中，你发现了一位漂亮的本地姑娘，巨乳就像大腿一样肥硕。她在吧台悠闲享用冒泡鸡尾酒，对几英寸外打得火热的壮汉与荡妇毫不在意。霓虹丝袜在房内闪烁的灯光下熠熠生辉，吸引你走向她裸露的曲线。迷你裙与露脐上衣几乎遮不住不断膨胀的胸脯和外扩臀部。说到这件大胆上衣，它印着与波莱特画中相同的褪色标志。就是她！ “这里有人吗？”你问道。 她坏笑起来。“请便，外乡人，”她以圆滑的嗓音回答。 你随意占据高脚椅，转身面对她。长发遮住大半张脸，但镀铬双眼在流动发帘下明亮闪耀。你翻找随身物品时，旋转的银河贪婪欣赏着你的外星身体。“那么……去我的房间，还是你那——” 你刚把那张纸放到吧台上，扎伊卡的笑容便消失了。 “哦！相信我，你绝对不想卷进这团烂摊子。” 所以她知道E.G—— “嘘！隔墙有耳。我好不容易才逃出来，绝不会回去！” 你不是想把她带回去，只是想知道E.G.G.在哪里。 半机械人把鸡尾酒送到唇边，竭力保持镇定，融入这处纵欲巢穴。“几十个人袭击过那里，没有一个回来。这鬼地方里面没有任何东西值得你送命。” 这不是为了你自己，从来都不是。你是为了一个挚友才这么做。 衣着暴露的扎伊卡叹了口气。“看来什么都无法让你恢复理智？那好吧，”她喃喃说道。“有地图吗？” 你点点头，打开法典。这个[silly |太空卓尔 |派对客 ]吹了声口哨，赞叹你的高科技装置，而你打开地图功能。“在哪里？” 她指向旋环区边缘。“那是一座非常庞大的工厂——城市与阳光普照的平原交界前的最后一栋建筑。单是典狱长就够你大费周章了。她能一次对付多个大副。” 是在战斗中，对吧？ “很遗憾，是的。他们清洗工人时，我才勉强从她手下逃走。要不是某台巨型拉斯克维尔机械人的肥屁股挡住了路，我现在根本不会坐在这里！” 那么你会全副武装，做好准备。为了波莱特，你必须这么做。 “你为之冒险的那个女孩，值得吗？” “当然，”你回答。 扎伊卡笑了。“我明白了。祝你好运，外乡人——你会需要的。” 波莱特肯定想听听这件事。

rows.original: “I found something!” Dabbebieth lands on Paulette’s shoulder. The two aliens stare at you with hopeful eyes. “What is it? Rumors? An ancient employee? A place to investigate?” [var0 |“An underground artist gave me a lead. She saw this symbol on an old factory at the edge of the Gyre — where the city meets the ardent steppes. Unfortunately, the place isn’t empty.” “How so?” Paulette asks. “They shipped leyaks into the building some time ago. She couldn’t investigate more, as she feared being spotted by the warden: a tall zaika with weapons and gear she hasn’t seen before — not even on XOs.” Dabbebieth gasps. “I can’t imagine what they are doing to my people. [pc.name], we must go – now!” Before he can leap out of the room, Paulette grabs him by the sails and keeps him close. “I know you are angry, but don’t rush in unprepared. They’ll easily capture you if you go alone,” the purple zaika says, rubbing the flustered jellyfish’s head. “We’ll go together. Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” |“A young hacker gave me a lead. She tracked huge energy sinks in the power grid to an old factory at the edge of the Gyre — where the city meets the ardent steppes. Most of the data was heavily-encrypted, but she found something: blueprints for cyborg parts.” “What kind of parts?” Paulette asks. “Arachnoid legs, visors, drug injectors. About a month ago, they received a huge shipment of captured leyaks and hired a powerful psionic to guard the place.” Dabbebieth gasps. “I can’t imagine what they are doing to my people. [pc.name], we must go, now!” Before he can leap out of the room, Paulette grabs him by the sails and keeps him close. “I know you are angry, but don’t rush in unprepared. They’ll easily capture you if you go alone,” the purple zaika says, rubbing the flustered jellyfish’s head. “We’ll go together. Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” |“I had to try a few times, but a ganger spilled the beans. She used to work in a place with the GU emblem stamped on the walls, machines, and jackets. It’s at the Gyre’s edge, where the city meets the ardent steppes. The last shipment she docked there was full of cybernetic parts.” “What kind of parts?” Paulette asks. “Arachnoid legs, visors, drug injectors. My source narrowly escaped a personnel purge just after the delivery.” Paulette grins. “I have a modular compatibility for insectoid limbs; it wouldn’t surprise me if they decided to make spider XOs out of their workforce. Good job [pc.name].” You smile. “I did my best. She also mentioned a new warden appointed to the building overnight — an XO-smasher, no less. It won’t be a walk in the park.” Dabbebieth floats your way. “This warden gal sounds strong and scary, but this won’t stop us from getting to the bottom of it!” “That’s the spirit,” Paulette adds, patting her friend’s head. “Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” ]
rows.translation: “我发现线索了！” 达贝比埃斯落在波莱特肩头。两个外星人满怀希望地盯着你。“是什么？传闻？以前的员工？可以调查的地点？” [var0 |“一位地下艺术家给了我线索。她在旋环区边缘——城市与炽热草原交界处——的一座旧工厂上见过这个标志。可惜那里并非空无一人。” “怎么回事？”波莱特问道。 “一段时间前，他们把雷亚克运进了那栋建筑。她担心被典狱长发现，没敢继续调查：那是个高大的扎伊卡，装备着她从未见过的武器和设备——就连大副身上也没见过。” 达贝比埃斯倒吸一口气。“我无法想象他们在对我的族人做什么。[pc.name]，我们必须走–现在就走！” 他还没来得及冲出房间，波莱特便抓住他的帆，把他留在身边。“我知道你很愤怒，但不要毫无准备地闯进去。要是独自前往，他们会轻易抓住你，”紫色扎伊卡一边说，一边揉着这只激动水母的脑袋。“我们一起去。独自一人时我们很强，团结起来便不可阻挡。你准备好时，我也准备好了，[pc.name]。” |“一位年轻黑客给了我线索。她沿着电网中的巨大能量消耗一路追踪，找到旋环区边缘——城市与炽热草原交界处——的一座旧工厂。大部分数据经过重度加密，但她找到了一样东西：半机械零件的蓝图。” “什么样的零件？”波莱特问道。 “蛛形腿、面罩、药物注射器。大约一个月前，他们收到了大批被俘雷亚克，还雇用了一名强大的灵能者看守那里。” 达贝比埃斯倒吸一口气。“我无法想象他们在对我的族人做什么。[pc.name]，我们必须走，现在就走！” 他还没来得及冲出房间，波莱特便抓住他的帆，把他留在身边。“我知道你很愤怒，但不要毫无准备地闯进去。要是独自前往，他们会轻易抓住你，”紫色扎伊卡一边说，一边揉着这只激动水母的脑袋。“我们一起去。独自一人时我们很强，团结起来便不可阻挡。你准备好时，我也准备好了，[pc.name]。” |“我试了几次，终于让一名帮派分子吐露实情。她曾在某个地方工作，那里的墙壁、机器和夹克上都印着GU徽记。它位于旋环区边缘，也就是城市与炽热草原的交界处。她最后一次停靠那里时，运送的是一整批半机械零件。” “什么样的零件？”波莱特问道。 “蛛形腿、面罩、药物注射器。货物送达后不久，我的消息来源险些死于一次人员清洗。” 波莱特咧嘴一笑。“我的模块兼容昆虫肢体；要是他们决定把工人改造成蜘蛛大副，我一点也不会惊讶。干得好，[pc.name]。” 你微笑起来。“我已经尽力了。她还提到，一夜之间有位新典狱长被派往那栋建筑——而且还是个大副粉碎者。这不会是轻松差事。” 达贝比埃斯飘向你。“那个典狱长姑娘听起来又强又吓人，但这阻止不了我们查明真相！” “就是这种精神，”波莱特一边补充，一边拍着朋友的脑袋。“独自一人时我们很强，团结起来便不可阻挡。你准备好时，我也准备好了，[pc.name]。” ]
rows.raw: " “I found something!” Dabbebieth lands on Paulette’s shoulder. The two aliens stare at you with hopeful eyes. “What is it? Rumors? An ancient employee? A place to investigate?” [var0 |“An underground artist gave me a lead. She saw this symbol on an old factory at the edge of the Gyre — where the city meets the ardent steppes. Unfortunately, the place isn’t empty.” “How so?” Paulette asks. “They shipped leyaks into the building some time ago. She couldn’t investigate more, as she feared being spotted by the warden: a tall zaika with weapons and gear she hasn’t seen before — not even on XOs.” Dabbebieth gasps. “I can’t imagine what they are doing to my people. [pc.name], we must go – now!” Before he can leap out of the room, Paulette grabs him by the sails and keeps him close. “I know you are angry, but don’t rush in unprepared. They’ll easily capture you if you go alone,” the purple zaika says, rubbing the flustered jellyfish’s head. “We’ll go together. Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” |“A young hacker gave me a lead. She tracked huge energy sinks in the power grid to an old factory at the edge of the Gyre — where the city meets the ardent steppes. Most of the data was heavily-encrypted, but she found something: blueprints for cyborg parts.” “What kind of parts?” Paulette asks. “Arachnoid legs, visors, drug injectors. About a month ago, they received a huge shipment of captured leyaks and hired a powerful psionic to guard the place.” Dabbebieth gasps. “I can’t imagine what they are doing to my people. [pc.name], we must go, now!” Before he can leap out of the room, Paulette grabs him by the sails and keeps him close. “I know you are angry, but don’t rush in unprepared. They’ll easily capture you if you go alone,” the purple zaika says, rubbing the flustered jellyfish’s head. “We’ll go together. Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” |“I had to try a few times, but a ganger spilled the beans. She used to work in a place with the GU emblem stamped on the walls, machines, and jackets. It’s at the Gyre’s edge, where the city meets the ardent steppes. The last shipment she docked there was full of cybernetic parts.” “What kind of parts?” Paulette asks. “Arachnoid legs, visors, drug injectors. My source narrowly escaped a personnel purge just after the delivery.” Paulette grins. “I have a modular compatibility for insectoid limbs; it wouldn’t surprise me if they decided to make spider XOs out of their workforce. Good job [pc.name].” You smile. “I did my best. She also mentioned a new warden appointed to the building overnight — an XO-smasher, no less. It won’t be a walk in the park.” Dabbebieth floats your way. “This warden gal sounds strong and scary, but this won’t stop us from getting to the bottom of it!” “That’s the spirit,” Paulette adds, patting her friend’s head. “Alone, we are strong, together, we are unstoppable. I’m ready when you are, [pc.name].” ] "

rows.original: When you reach Paulette’s room, you find it empty: no zaika, no leyak, only a cozy pillow fort, dozens of exotic plants, and hundreds of chaotically-arranged books. You could have sworn that she was here a moment ago. Your Codex blips. “Looking for me [pc.name]?” “Where are you?” The former XO chuckles. “I’m waiting for you in the meeting room. Don’t be too long or you won’t get your present.” Well, if that isn’t a promise. You turn around and head to the ship’s heart. The halls are suspiciously silent and empty, almost devoid of life. Something evil’s stirring in here. Carefully, you open the door, expecting to be jumped by the ferocious XO. “Surprise!” Dabbebieth{zero plus is crew:, Zero Plus,} and Paulette shout. Your crewmates have prepared a little party for you, how sweet! There’s snacks, drinks, balloons, and a big chocolate cake almost bursting with cream. They really outdid themselves. “What’s this little party for?” Paulette wraps her arms around your waist and places a soft kiss on your cheek. “For everything. In our times of need, you’ve always been here for us. Come, take a seat and enjoy yourself a little. You deserve it.” “Alright,” you reply. “What’s for dinner?” “[zp.isCrew |Zero Plus and Dabbebieth plundered the food stalls |We plundered the food stalls ] to find the best goods on Dhaal. There’s Liashu buns, Firedrake peanuts, Chillkatrice gummies, potato chips, kui-tan nuts, motorblitz, rak’ys liquor, and a cherry-chocolate cake — lactose free of course. I also bought a sweet peach cheesecake but someone ate it before you arrived,” she says, giving the eye to [zp.isCrew |the dollified doctor and Dabbebieth. “The icing looked so shiny and tasty,” she replies, glancing away in shame. “And the jam looked so plump and creamy,” the shy leyak murmurs, cheeks ablaze. |Dabbebieth. “S-Sorry. The jam filling looked so plump and creamy,” the shy leyak murmurs, cheek ablaze. ] It’s not a big deal, there’s still lots of stuff to eat and drink. You can’t wait to dig in. “That’s the spirit. Here, take a seat,” Paulette proposes. Without further ado, you take place at the table and gather some local treats. The motorblitz is strong, especially with Firedrake peanuts, but fortunately, the buns and gummies quickly quench your ardors. Paulette [zp.isCrew |and Zero Plus share some rak’ys together, diluting it with lots of water and syrup before drinking the colorful cocktail. Their cheeks rapidly darken as the alcohol sips into their veins. A few more drinks and they’re likely start making out on top of the table |dilutes it with syrup and lots of water before drinking her colorful cocktail. Her cheeks rapidly darken under the influence of alcohol. Her tail becomes more adventurous too. A few more drinks and she’ll bend you over the table. ] Before the party becomes too intense, you slice the creamy cake and give a piece to everyone. Luckily, the biscuit is soaked in liquorous syrup. The baking steamed the alcohol away, leaving only the fruity flavors to enjoy. “Stars, I adore cherries. The way they pop in your mouth is just divine.” “Dark chocolate’s the best,” Dabbebieth retorts. “I wish we had more on Mome. The planet’s a bit too cold to grow them so they are pretty rare — especially for us leyaks.” [zp.isCrew |“Did you have some before? This stuff’s soooo good!” The little leyak turns cobalt. “I... once stole some when my tribe’s yukkoth flew close to the ground. It took us hours to break the fruits and grind the beans into an edible paste, but it was worth every drop.” |“Didn’t you steal some back on your homeworld?” Paulette asks. The little leyak turns cobalt. “Only a couple of times. It took us hours to break the fruits and grind the beans into an edible paste, but it was worth every drop.” ] You take another bite. Stars, it’s so sweet and light — it’s like tasting a caramel cloud. “[pc.name]?” “Yes Paulette.” “I just... wanted to thank you again. Without you, I’d still be a lost girl stranded on a polluted wasteland. These memories you found for me, they are priceless. Now I know who I am and what I want.” “And what do you want?” you inquire. The former XO blushes. “To make the galaxy a brighter place, for you, for me, for Dabbebieth, for my sisters, for their daughters,{zero plus is crew: for Zero Plus,} and for everyone else!” “That’s very nice of you — and very ambitious. Beware not to go overboard. You don’t need to save the stars alone.” [zp.isCrew |The bimbo nurse nods. “Yeah! We’re here too! Nobody can resist our cutie powers!” Dabbebieth laughs softly. “Count on me. I’ll spread your legend across time and space, one ballad at a time.” |Dabbebieth nods. “You can count on me. I’ll spread your legend across time and space, one ballad at a time.” ] “Not so shy anymore, aren’t you?” The shy leyak pumps his inexistant bust. “That’s what headbutting a mutant chimera and an invincible goo beast does to you,” he proudly boasts. You [pc.mf |chuckle |giggle ]. “Your Grande Finales are impressive, that’s for sure. It was nice teaming up with you, [pc.isAss |kill-stealer |Dabbebieth ].” “The pleasure was all mine,” he impishly replies, bowing down theatrically. His silly demeanor makes Paulette[zp.isCrew]{zero plus is crew: and Zero Plus} laugh. “Dabbebieth, never change.” You enjoy the snacks and drinks, retelling the events fondly, despite how close you were to dying — or to meeting a more sinister end. It feels so nice to see Paulette happy and relaxed again. Her tortured dreams plagued her for far too long. Her body always felt tense, on the edge, as if a monster waited in her shadow, ready to backstab her if she dropped her guard. She’s a completely different zaika now! Paulette raises her glass. “To new horizons!” “To new horizons!” You cheerfully reply[zp.isCrew |, although the bimbo nurse’s reply sounded more like new whorizons ]. The future’s gonna be bright — you’re sure of it.
rows.translation: 抵达波莱特的房间时，你发现里面空无一人：没有扎伊卡，没有雷亚克，只有一座舒适的枕头堡、几十株异域植物，以及数百本杂乱摆放的书籍。你明明可以发誓，片刻前她还在这里。 你的法典响了一声。“在找我吗，[pc.name]？” “你在哪里？” 前任大副轻声笑了。“我在会议室等你。别拖太久，不然就拿不到礼物了。” 好吧，这可真是个承诺。你转过身，前往飞船心脏地带。走廊安静而空旷得可疑，几乎看不见任何生命。这里正酝酿着某种邪恶。 你小心翼翼地打开门，等着凶猛的大副扑向自己。 “惊喜！”达贝比埃斯{zero plus is crew:、泽罗·普拉斯}和波莱特齐声喊道。 船员们为你准备了一场小派对，真贴心！这里有零食、饮料、气球，还有一只几乎要被奶油撑爆的大巧克力蛋糕。他们真的下足了功夫。 “这场小派对是为了什么？” 波莱特双臂环住你的腰，在脸颊上轻轻一吻。“为了这一切。在我们需要帮助时，你一直陪着我们。来，坐下来稍微享受一下吧。你值得。” “好吧，”你回答。“晚餐吃什么？” “[zp.isCrew |泽罗·普拉斯和达贝比埃斯洗劫了食品摊 |我们洗劫了食品摊 ]，寻找达尔最棒的美食。这里有莉阿舒包子、火龙花生、寒鸡蛇软糖、薯片、狸猫坚果、摩托闪电酒、拉基斯烈酒，还有樱桃巧克力蛋糕——当然不含乳糖。我还买了香甜的桃子芝士蛋糕，可是你来之前，某人就把它吃了，”她一边说，一边瞪向[zp.isCrew |那个玩偶化医生和达贝比埃斯。 “糖霜看起来又亮又好吃，”她羞愧地移开视线，回答道。 “果酱看起来也那么饱满香浓，”害羞的雷亚克喃喃说道，双颊滚烫。 |达贝比埃斯。 “抱、抱歉。果酱馅看起来那么饱满香浓，”害羞的雷亚克喃喃说道，脸颊滚烫。 ] 没什么大不了的，仍有许多东西可以吃喝。你已经等不及开动了。 “就是这种精神。来，坐下吧，”波莱特提议道。 你不再耽搁，在桌旁坐下，拿了些本地美食。摩托闪电酒劲很大，尤其是搭配火龙花生时；不过幸好，包子和软糖很快便浇灭了你的燥热。波莱特[zp.isCrew |与泽罗·普拉斯分享了一些拉基斯酒，加入大量水和糖浆稀释后，喝下这杯色彩缤纷的鸡尾酒。酒精渗入血管，她们的脸颊迅速变暗。再喝几杯，她们可能就要在桌上热吻起来 |加入糖浆和大量水稀释，再喝下这杯色彩缤纷的鸡尾酒。受酒精影响，她的脸颊迅速变暗，尾巴也更加大胆。再喝几杯，她就会把你按倒在桌上。 ]趁派对还没变得太过火，你切开奶油蛋糕，给每个人分了一块。幸好，蛋糕胚浸满了酒味糖浆。烘烤蒸发了酒精，只留下水果风味供人享受。 “诸星啊，我太喜欢樱桃了。它们在嘴里爆开的感觉简直神圣。” “黑巧克力才是最棒的，”达贝比埃斯反驳。“真希望莫姆有更多巧克力。那颗行星太冷，不适合种植，所以相当稀有——尤其对我们雷亚克而言。” [zp.isCrew |“你以前吃过吗？这东西太——好吃了！” 小雷亚克变成钴蓝色。“我...有一次，部落的尤科斯贴近地面飞行时，我偷过一些。我们花了几个小时才敲开果实，把豆子磨成可食用的糊状，不过每一滴都值得。” |“你以前不是在故乡偷过一些吗？”波莱特问道。 小雷亚克变成钴蓝色。“只有几次。我们花了几个小时才敲开果实，把豆子磨成可食用的糊状，不过每一滴都值得。” ] 你又咬了一口。诸星啊，它如此香甜轻盈——就像在品尝一朵焦糖云。 “[pc.name]？” “怎么了，波莱特？” “我只是...想再向你道一次谢。如果没有你，我仍会是个被困在污染荒原上、迷失方向的女孩。你帮我找回的这些记忆是无价之宝。现在我知道自己是谁，也知道自己想要什么。” “那么你想要什么？”你问道。 前任大副脸红了。“让银河变成一个更明亮的地方，为了你、为了我、为了达贝比埃斯、为了我的姐妹们、为了她们的女儿们，{zero plus is crew:为了泽罗·普拉斯，}也为了其他所有人！” “你真好——也非常有雄心。不过要小心，别做过头。你不必独自拯救群星。” [zp.isCrew |花瓶护士点点头。“没错！还有我们！没人能够抵挡我们的可爱力量！” 达贝比埃斯轻声笑道。“尽管交给我。我会一首接一首地唱着歌谣，让你的传奇传遍时空。” |达贝比埃斯点点头。“尽管交给我。我会一首接一首地唱着歌谣，让你的传奇传遍时空。” ] “你不再那么害羞了，对吧？” 害羞的雷亚克挺起并不存在的胸脯。“用脑袋撞过变异奇美拉和无敌黏液怪之后，人自然就会变成这样，”他自豪地吹嘘。 你[pc.mf |轻笑 |咯咯笑 ]起来。“你的终幕绝唱确实令人印象深刻。很高兴与你并肩作战，[pc.isAss |抢人头的家伙 |达贝比埃斯 ]。” “荣幸之至，”他顽皮地回答，以戏剧性的姿势鞠躬。 他的滑稽举止让波莱特[zp.isCrew]{zero plus is crew:和泽罗·普拉斯}笑了起来。“达贝比埃斯，永远别变。” 你享用着零食和饮料，愉快地复述一路经历，尽管你们曾那么接近死亡——或是某种更加阴暗的结局。能再次看见波莱特快乐放松的模样，感觉真好。那些痛苦梦境折磨她太久了。她的身体总是紧绷着，处于警戒边缘，仿佛有头怪物藏在影子里，只要她放松戒备就会从背后捅上一刀。如今的她已经完全是另一个扎伊卡了！ 波莱特举起酒杯。“敬新的地平线！” “敬新的地平线！”你兴高采烈地回应[zp.isCrew |，不过那个花瓶护士说起来更像是在讲“新的淫平线” ]。 未来一定会很光明——你对此深信不疑。
