Deciding that less is more, and that actions are louder, you opt to say nothing."

rows.original: You stand; gently, you pull on Penny’s hands, which are both still wrapped around yours, getting her to her feet, and you pull her into an embrace.
rows.translation: 你站起身，轻轻拉动佩妮仍紧握着你的双手，让她也站起来，随后将她拥入怀中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand; gently, you pull on Penny’s hands, which are both still wrapped around yours, getting her to her feet, and you pull her into an embrace."

rows.original: Neither of you say anything, but you can feel the passion pouring from Penny: her arms hook underneath yours and wrap around your back, holding you to her tightly. Very tightly, like you’d float away and leave her forever if she didn’t squeeze you so adamantly to her. She’s hugging you like she’s only just discovered what a hug feels like, and she isn’t sure when she’ll be ready for it to end.
rows.translation: 你们谁也没有说话，但你能感受到佩妮倾泻而出的热情：她的双臂从你的手臂下方穿过，环住后背，把你紧紧抱住。非常紧，仿佛只要她不如此坚决地把你勒在怀里，你就会飘走，永远离开她。她拥抱你的模样像是刚刚才发现拥抱是什么感觉，而且不知道自己何时才愿意让它结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nNeither of you say anything, but you can feel the passion pouring from Penny: her arms hook underneath yours and wrap around your back, holding you to her tightly. Very tightly, like you’d float away and leave her forever if she didn’t squeeze you so adamantly to her. She’s hugging you like she’s only just discovered what a hug feels like, and she isn’t sure when she’ll be ready for it to end."

rows.original: Minutes pass in the quiet office. The only sound you hear, apart from your breathing, is hers; you keep her against you, letting her adrenaline wear through her arms and through her ragged breathing. Even when her breath begins to even out and the strength in her arms begins to wane, neither of you release just yet – you will when you’re good and ready.
rows.translation: 数分钟在安静的办公室里流逝。除彼此的呼吸外，你唯一听到的声音就是她的；你一直把她抱在怀中，让肾上腺素从她的双臂和粗重呼吸中逐渐消退。即使呼吸开始平稳，双臂的力量也开始减弱，你们仍没有立刻松开——等你们真正准备好时，自然会放手。
rows.raw: "\n\nMinutes pass in the quiet office. The only sound you hear, apart from your breathing, is hers; you keep her against you, letting her adrenaline wear through her arms and through her ragged breathing. Even when her breath begins to even out and the strength in her arms begins to wane, neither of you release just yet – you will when you’re good and ready."

rows.original: After what must have been a quarter-hour, Penny takes a long, deep breath through her nose to calm herself down – and to take in your scent. “Give me one day, [pc.name],” she says, her voice muffled through her face being buried into you. “If I could trust anyone in this universe with Esbeth, it would be Flahne. That’ll give me time to teach her how to work the sentries. And the U.G.C. will be sending down a new peacekeeper within the week; I can give Flahne the key to my locker, and she can give it to them.”
rows.translation: 大概过了一刻钟后，佩妮才用鼻子长长地深吸一口气，让自己冷静下来，也吸入你的气味。“给我一天时间，[pc.name]，”她说道，脸仍埋在你身上，声音显得含糊。“如果这个宇宙里真有谁值得让我把埃斯贝斯托付给她，那就是弗拉妮。这样我就有时间教她如何操作哨戒炮。而且银河联合邦联会在一周内派来新的维和官；我可以把储物柜钥匙交给弗拉妮，再让她转交给对方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter what must have been a quarter-hour, Penny takes a long, deep breath through her nose to calm herself down – and to take in your scent. “Give me one day, [pc.name],” she says, her voice muffled through her face being buried into you. “If I could trust anyone in this universe with Esbeth, it would be Flahne. That’ll give me time to teach her how to work the sentries. And the U.G.C. will be sending down a new peacekeeper within the week; I can give Flahne the key to my locker, and she can give it to them.”"

rows.original: You think to ask her if she’s sure – it’s her home, and her job, and her weapons she’s giving up, and all – but you think better of it. She wouldn’t have asked you to wait a day if she wasn’t already as sure as she could be. Instead, you promise her that you’ll wait. It’s only a day, after all.
rows.translation: 你本想问她是否确定——她即将放弃的是自己的家、工作和武器，以及其他一切——但转念还是作罢。要不是已经确信到了极点，她就不会要求你再等一天。于是，你向她保证自己会等待。毕竟只有一天。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think to ask her if she’s sure – it’s her home, and her job, and her weapons she’s giving up, and all – but you think better of it. She wouldn’t have asked you to wait a day if she wasn’t already as sure as she could be. Instead, you promise her that you’ll wait. It’s only a day, after all."

rows.original: Penny laughs once, somewhat derisively, to herself. “Okay,” she says, “the hardest thing I’ve done lately is make you wait this long, [pc.name]. My mate.” Her grip on you is still tight in her embrace, but her hands rub soothingly at your [pc.skinFurScales]. “The third-hardest thing was taking down that mining operation. And the second–”
rows.translation: 佩妮带着几分自嘲地独自笑了一声。“好吧，”她说道，“我最近做过最困难的事，就是让你等上这么久，[pc.name]。我的伴侣。”她仍用力抱紧你，双手却安抚地摩挲[pc.skinFurScales]。“第三困难的是摧毁那处采矿作业。而第二困难的——”
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny laughs once, somewhat derisively, to herself. “Okay,” she says, “the hardest thing I’ve done lately is make you wait this long, [pc.name]. My mate.” Her grip on you is still tight in her embrace, but her hands rub soothingly at your [pc.skinFurScales]. “The third-hardest thing was taking down that mining operation. And the second–”"

rows.original: Finally, she pulls away from you, and she looks around her office. To its walls; to her desk; to her computer; and to the window overlooking Esbeth. “Is... letting all this go. I love it all. I love my job.” She doesn’t pull you back into a fifteen-minute, ironclad hug, but she does rest her head against your shoulder. “But I’ve made my choice.”
rows.translation: 最后，她终于松开你，环顾自己的办公室。她看向墙壁、书桌、电脑，以及俯瞰埃斯贝斯的窗户。“就是...放下这一切。我爱这里的一切，也爱自己的工作。”她没有再次把你拉入持续十五分钟、铁钳般牢固的拥抱，不过确实把头靠在你肩上。“但我已经做出选择。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, she pulls away from you, and she looks around her office. To its walls; to her desk; to her computer; and to the window overlooking Esbeth. “Is... letting all this go. I love it all. I love my job.” She doesn’t pull you back into a fifteen-minute, ironclad hug, but she does rest her head against your shoulder. “But I’ve made my choice.”"

rows.original: Reluctantly, she lets you go, pulling away from you and heading towards the door. Her hands trail down your arms and hold you by the fingers until distance pulls them apart, too. “Come find me this time tomorrow. I’ll be ready by then.” She opens the door and steps outside, but not before giving you one last look and one earnest smile. “I have to go make my rounds.”
rows.translation: 她依依不舍地放开你，抽身走向门口。双手沿你的手臂滑下，一直握着手指，直到距离最终也将它们分开。“明天这个时候来找我。到时我会准备好。”她打开门走到外面，不过离开前仍最后看了你一眼，露出真挚笑容。“我得去巡逻了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nReluctantly, she lets you go, pulling away from you and heading towards the door. Her hands trail down your arms and hold you by the fingers until distance pulls them apart, too. “Come find me this time tomorrow. I’ll be ready by then.” She opens the door and steps outside, but not before giving you one last look and one earnest smile. “I have to go make my rounds.”"

rows.original: And, just like that, you’re left alone in her office.
rows.translation: 就这样，你独自留在了她的办公室里。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, just like that, you’re left alone in her office."

rows.original: You decide to head back to your ship. Twenty-four hours isn’t enough time to go traipsing through the stars, and you wouldn’t want to risk venturing into the jungle when you and Penny made a promise to each other.
rows.translation: 你决定回自己的飞船。二十四个小时不够你跑去星海间游荡，而且你和佩妮彼此许过承诺，你也不想冒险闯进丛林。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to head back to your ship. Twenty-four hours isn’t enough time to go traipsing through the stars, and you wouldn’t want to risk venturing into the jungle when you and Penny made a promise to each other."

rows.original: You doubt you’ll be getting much sleep in the next twenty-four hours, though....
rows.translation: 不过，你觉得接下来二十四小时里大概睡不了多少觉了....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou doubt you’ll be getting much sleep in the next twenty-four hours, though...."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: B
“Look, I love myself.”
rows.translation: “听着，我很爱我自己。”
rows.raw: "“Look, I love myself.”"

rows.original: You tell her that that’s a very positive thing to say.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，这种说法十分积极。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that that’s a very positive thing to say."

rows.original: “I... Yeah, it is, but, I mean, physically. Because of the mods, I mean. I love what I am. But it cost me a shitload of money. Those mods, and my tuition at the U.G.C. academy – I wasn’t sure if I was ever going to get myself out of the hole. And me being the stubborn asshole I am, I couldn’t just accept a handout.”
rows.translation: “我...对，是这样，但我的意思是身体上。因为那些模组，我是说。我喜欢现在的自己。但它们花了我一大笔钱。那些模组，还有银河联合邦联学院的学费——我当时根本不知道自己能不能摆脱债务深坑。而像我这样固执的混蛋，又不可能直接接受施舍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... Yeah, it is, but, I mean, physically. Because of the mods, I mean. I love what I am. But it cost me a shitload of money. Those mods, and my tuition at the U.G.C. academy – I wasn’t sure if I was ever going to get myself out of the hole. And me being the stubborn asshole I am, I couldn’t just accept a handout.”"

rows.original: She squeezes your hand affectionately, referring to the time you offered to help chip in.
rows.translation: 她亲昵地捏了捏你的手，指的是你曾经提出帮忙出钱的那次。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe squeezes your hand affectionately, referring to the time you offered to help chip in."

rows.original: “And I love Esbeth. Sure, it doesn’t have a lot. We have a landing pad; a bar; a shop; and a drive-through hospital. Our population is less than most research stations. And it’s right next to a jungle that’s full of things that would want nothing more than to get a piece of us. But it’s my jurisdiction. Those are my people. Esbeth is my... my home.”
rows.translation: “而且我爱埃斯贝斯。当然，它没多少东西。我们有一个停机坪；一间酒吧；一家商店；还有一家免下车医院。我们的人口比大多数研究站都少。而且它就挨着一片丛林，里面全是只想从我们身上咬下一块的东西。但它是我的辖区。那些是我的子民。埃斯贝斯是我的...我的家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I love Esbeth. Sure, it doesn’t have a lot. We have a landing pad; a bar; a shop; and a drive-through hospital. Our population is less than most research stations. And it’s right next to a jungle that’s full of things that would want nothing more than to get a piece of us. But it’s my jurisdiction. Those are my people. Esbeth is my... my home.”"

rows.original: “And I love my job! I’ve wanted to be an officer since I was a little girl. When that one cop took down that mugger with just a move or two? Gods, [pc.name], it was love at first sight. I knew on the spot what I wanted to be, and now,” she says, motioning to the station around you, “I have my own station. Forget just having an office. I have my own station, in my own jurisdiction, serving my own people. I thought I had everything!”
rows.translation: “而且我热爱自己的工作！我从小就想当一名警官。那个警察只用一两招就制服了抢劫犯，还记得吗？天哪，[pc.name]，那是一见钟情。我当场就知道自己想成为什么人，而现在，”她一边说道，一边示意你们周围的警局，“我拥有属于自己的警局。何止一间办公室。我有自己的警局、自己的辖区，为自己的人民服务。我原以为自己已经拥有一切！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I love my job! I’ve wanted to be an officer since I was a little girl. When that one cop took down that mugger with just a move or two? Gods, [pc.name], it was love at first sight. I knew on the spot what I wanted to be, and now,” she says, motioning to the station around you, “I have my own station. Forget just having an office. I have my own station, in my own jurisdiction, serving my own people. I thought I had everything!”"

rows.original: Finishing her train of thought, she places her other hand atop yours, and she leans into you, her voice dropping to a whisper. “I... I thought I had everything.” Once more, she breaks into a giddy smile, and she chokes on her own laughter, trying to suppress it. “And then you had to go and change that, you asshole.”
rows.translation: 她说完心中所想，将另一只手覆到你的手上，身体靠向你，声音降至耳语。“我……我原以为自己已经拥有一切。”她再次露出兴高采烈的笑容，努力压抑，却被自己的笑声呛住。“结果你这个混蛋偏偏要跑来改变这一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFinishing her train of thought, she places her other hand atop yours, and she leans into you, her voice dropping to a whisper. “I... I thought I had everything.” Once more, she breaks into a giddy smile, and she chokes on her own laughter, trying to suppress it. “And then you had to go and change that, you asshole.”"

rows.original: You smile well-meaningly and let her continue. “It was one thing after another with you, [pc.name]. First, you come in and help me with those zil freaks when I couldn’t stay in the same room as them for more than five minutes. Then, you – you and I, we b-became mates. Then, we, we fucking,” she says, getting louder and excited and animated and active as she recalls the scene, “we fucking shut down that illegal mining business! Those beta bitches thought they could stand on my jurisdiction and undermine me and my mate!”
rows.translation: 你善意地微笑，让她继续说下去。“和你在一起时，事情一件接一件，[pc.name]。一开始，你来到这里，在我连和那些兹尔怪胎同处一室五分钟都做不到时帮了我。然后，你——你和我，我们成、成为了伴侣。然后，我们，我们他妈的，”她回忆起那一幕，声音越来越响亮，情绪越来越激动，动作也越来越活跃，“我们他妈端掉了那桩非法采矿生意！那些贝塔母狗以为自己可以站在我的辖区里，破坏我和我伴侣的事业！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile well-meaningly and let her continue. “It was one thing after another with you, [pc.name]. First, you come in and help me with those zil freaks when I couldn’t stay in the same room as them for more than five minutes. Then, you – you and I, we b-became mates. Then, we, we fucking,” she says, getting louder and excited and animated and active as she recalls the scene, “we fucking shut down that illegal mining business! Those beta bitches thought they could stand on my jurisdiction and undermine me and my mate!”"

rows.original: She settles down and recollects herself, but only just. Her hands haven’t left yours the whole time. “[pc.name], I’m not going to lie to you. When I saw you going after those Venus Ziltraps, and when we dismantled that mining crew – I got to thinking about you, and you going through so much effort for me. The way you fought for me, and for our stake in that Oxonium. How you didn’t even hesitate to show your strength, your guile, your dominance over them. It fucking turned me on. I’ll say it.”
rows.translation: 她平静下来，重新整理思绪，但也只是勉强如此。她的双手始终没有离开你的手。“[pc.name]，我不打算对你撒谎。看着你追捕那些维纳斯兹尔陷阱，又和我一起瓦解采矿团伙时——我开始想着你，想着你为了我付出这么多努力。你为了我，也为了我们在奥克索尼姆中的权益而战。你毫不犹豫地向他们展现自己的力量、狡诈，以及对他们的支配。这他妈让我兴奋了。我承认。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe settles down and recollects herself, but only just. Her hands haven’t left yours the whole time. “[pc.name], I’m not going to lie to you. When I saw you going after those Venus Ziltraps, and when we dismantled that mining crew – I got to thinking about you, and you going through so much effort for me. The way you fought for me, and for our stake in that Oxonium. How you didn’t even hesitate to show your strength, your guile, your dominance over them. It fucking turned me on. I’ll say it.”"

rows.original: You blush a bit and try to wave it off as in-the-moment praise. You’re not always like that. “I know you’re not,” Penny says, then leans into you and brings her mouth against your ear. “But don’t be afraid to show me some of that aggression sometime....”
rows.translation: 你微微脸红，试图把它解释成当时情境下的赞美。你并不总是那个样子。“我知道你不是，”佩妮说道，随后贴近你，把嘴凑到耳边。“但哪天也别害怕对我展现一点那样的侵略性……”
rows.raw: "You blush a bit and try to wave it off as in-the-moment praise. You’re not always like that. “I know you’re not,” Penny says, then leans into you and brings her mouth against your ear. “But don’t be afraid to show me some of that aggression sometime....”"

rows.original: You grin and bask in Penny’s praise. You remember the time and the emotions and energies you were feeling, clear as day, back then. “That’s right, my mate, it was your moment. Go ahead and feel like a champion.” She leans into you, bringing her mouth against your ear. “And no champion would be complete without their grand prize....”
rows.translation: 你咧嘴笑着，沉浸在佩妮的赞美中。你还清楚记得当时的时光、情绪和能量，仿佛就在昨天。“没错，我的伴侣，那是属于你的时刻。尽管把自己当成一名冠军吧。”她贴近你，把嘴凑到耳边。“而任何冠军都少不了自己的大奖……”
rows.raw: "You grin and bask in Penny’s praise. You remember the time and the emotions and energies you were feeling, clear as day, back then. “That’s right, my mate, it was your moment. Go ahead and feel like a champion.” She leans into you, bringing her mouth against your ear. “And no champion would be complete without their grand prize....”"

rows.original: Suddenly, she pulls away and sits herself straight, her hands still in yours. “No. No, I need to focus. This is important. I can’t start fantasizing now.”
rows.translation: 突然，她抽身坐直，双手仍握着你的手。“不行。不行，我得专注。这很重要。我现在不能开始胡思乱想。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, she pulls away and sits herself straight, her hands still in yours. “No. No, I need to focus. This is important. I can’t start fantasizing now.” "

rows.original: You, as always, sit and stay patient for her.
rows.translation: 你像往常一样坐着，耐心等待她。
rows.raw: "You, as always, sit and stay patient for her."

rows.original: You muse to yourself that you wouldn’t mind a little more fantasizing, but, like she said, this isn’t the time.
rows.translation: 你暗自想，再多一点点幻想倒也不错，但就像她说的，现在不是时候。
rows.raw: "You muse to yourself that you wouldn’t mind a little more fantasizing, but, like she said, this isn’t the time."

rows.original: “The whole event really got me thinking. About your offer, but, more importantly, about... us. I started to ask myself, ‘if I let that walk away from me, will I regret it forever?’ Could I live a life without you, and your... your... youness?”
rows.translation: “整件事真的让我思考了很多。关于你的提议，但更重要的是，关于... 我们。我开始问自己，‘如果我任由那一切离我而去，会不会后悔一辈子？’没有你，没有你的... 你的...独特自我，我还能过下去吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The whole event really got me thinking. About your offer, but, more importantly, about... us. I started to ask myself, ‘if I let that walk away from me, will I regret it forever?’ Could I live a life without you, and your... your... youness?”"

rows.original: Her earlier energy dissolves quickly, though her determination remains as steadfast as ever. “I love Mhen’ga. I love Esbeth, and I love everyone on it. I love my job and I love how far I’ve come. I love my jurisdiction and I love the feeling I get whenever I help someone, whether it’s solving a dispute or it’s fending off some horny local.”
rows.translation: 她先前的活力很快消散，但她的决心一如既往地坚定。“我爱门加。我爱埃斯贝斯，也爱那上面的每一个人。我爱我的工作，也爱自己走到今天这一步。我爱我的辖区，也爱我每次帮到别人时的感觉，不管是调解纠纷，还是赶走某个发情的本地人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer earlier energy dissolves quickly, though her determination remains as steadfast as ever. “I love Mhen’ga. I love Esbeth, and I love everyone on it. I love my job and I love how far I’ve come. I love my jurisdiction and I love the feeling I get whenever I help someone, whether it’s solving a dispute or it’s fending off some horny local.”"

rows.original: “But then, I thought–”
rows.translation: “可后来，我想到–”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But then, I thought–”"

rows.original: Immediately, her breath catches once again, and her words begin to stutter, forming in her mouth as solid blocks and then spilling from her lips like crumbs. Her lips quiver as she struggles her way through the next few words. “I s-started to think...,” she says, then sighs another quivering sigh. “That maybe I... I started to love something... more than all of that. I started to think that, i-if I loved anything more than all of that, i-it would be....”
rows.translation: 立刻，她的呼吸又一次卡住，话开始结巴，在嘴里凝成一块块固体，然后像碎屑一样从唇间洒落。她的嘴唇颤抖着，艰难地挤出接下来的几个字。“我开-开始想...,”她说着，又叹出一口颤抖的气。“也许我...我开始爱上什么...胜过那一切的东西。我开始想，如-如果我爱着什么胜过那一切，那-那就是....”
rows.raw: "\n\nImmediately, her breath catches once again, and her words begin to stutter, forming in her mouth as solid blocks and then spilling from her lips like crumbs. Her lips quiver as she struggles her way through the next few words. “I s-started to think...,” she says, then sighs another quivering sigh. “That maybe I... I started to love something... more than all of that. I started to think that, i-if I loved anything more than all of that, i-it would be....”"

rows.original: Respond
rows.translation: 回应
rows.raw: "Respond"

rows.original: Respond
rows.translation: 回应
rows.raw: "Respond"

I uninstalled the software and gave him the boot – but not before taking a screenshot of the results. Every white dot that you see is a positive reading.”
rows.translation: “这是奥克索尼姆扫描仪的截图，[pc.name]，”她说道，向后靠去，让你更清楚地看见显示器。“空间站顶部有一面主要用于行星际通信的碟形天线，所以我偶尔能向银河联合邦联汇报。不过有天晚上，我下班时抓到一个混账冲袭者，想把它改装成奥克索尼姆矿藏扫描仪。我卸载了软件，把他踢了出去，不过在此之前先截下了扫描结果。你看到的每一个白点都代表阳性读数。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is a screenshot of an Oxonium scanner, [pc.name],” she says, leaning back to give you a better view of the monitor. “The station has a dish on the top that is primarily used for interplanetary communications, so I can report into the U.G.C. every now and then, but one night I caught some shithead rusher trying to rig it to scan for Oxonium deposits while I was off-duty. I uninstalled the software and gave him the boot – but not before taking a screenshot of the results. Every white dot that you see is a positive reading.”"

rows.original: You ask her what the significance is. “Oxonium is a mineral used in holographic displays, like the one in your Codex. It’s not that easy mineral to come by, which is why holographic projectors don’t come cheap. And... that means Oxonium is worth a pretty penny on its own.”
rows.translation: 你问她这意味着什么。“奥克索尼姆是一种用于全息显示器的矿物，比如你CODEX终端里的那种。这种矿物不容易找到，所以全息投影仪才会那么昂贵。而且...这也意味着奥克索尼姆本身就能卖个好价钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what the significance is. “Oxonium is a mineral used in holographic displays, like the one in your Codex. It’s not that easy mineral to come by, which is why holographic projectors don’t come cheap. And... that means Oxonium is worth a pretty penny on its own.”"

rows.original: The news takes you by surprise –
rows.translation: 这消息让你吃了一惊 –
rows.raw: "\n\nThe news takes you by surprise – "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.TAGGED_MHENGA_OXONIUM_DEPOSIT
                                  ? "you’re aware of just how valuable a single deposit of Oxonium is, and "
                                  : ""

rows.original: you’re aware of just how valuable a single deposit of Oxonium is, and
rows.translation: 你很清楚单是一处奥克索尼姆矿藏有多值钱，而且
rows.raw: "you’re aware of just how valuable a single deposit of Oxonium is, and "

rows.original: she has a screenshot that just tells her of all the Oxonium within twenty miles? “Don’t go spreading the word; this wasn’t the most legal use of U.G.C. tech in the handbook, and if word gets back to base, the photo will be confiscated. Worse, I’ll be reprimanded for taking advantage of a sour situation.”
rows.translation: 她有一张截图，就那么告诉她方圆二十英里内所有的奥克索尼姆？“别到处张扬；这可不是手册里U.G.C.技术最合法的用法，要是消息传回基地，照片会被没收。更糟的是，我会因为利用一个糟糕的处境而受到训斥。”
rows.raw: "she has a screenshot that just tells her of all the Oxonium within twenty miles? “Don’t go spreading the word; this wasn’t the most legal use of U.G.C. tech in the handbook, and if word gets back to base, the photo will be confiscated. Worse, I’ll be reprimanded for taking advantage of a sour situation.”"

rows.original: You stare at all the white dots on the screen. You avoid the obvious question first, and ask instead why she hasn’t tried to track down all the stray little dots littered across the screen. “A lot of them are false positives,” she answers. “I tried. The ones that do pay off only get me about three grand in credits or so, which I don’t think is worth the risk.”
rows.translation: 你盯着屏幕上那些白点。你先避开那个显而易见的问题，转而问她为什么没去追查散落在屏幕各处的那些零散小点。“很多都是误报，”她回答。“我试过。真有收获的那些，一次也就给我带来三千信用点左右，我觉得不值得冒这个险。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at all the white dots on the screen. You avoid the obvious question first, and ask instead why she hasn’t tried to track down all the stray little dots littered across the screen. “A lot of them are false positives,” she answers. “I tried. The ones that do pay off only get me about three grand in credits or so, which I don’t think is worth the risk.”"

rows.original: So, then, you broach the obvious question – what about the massive cluster in the corner?
rows.translation: 于是，你提出了那个显而易见的问题：角落里那一大簇东西是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, then, you broach the obvious question – what about the massive cluster in the corner?"

rows.original: “That,” she says, adjusting herself in her seat, “is from a cave located a couple miles deep into the bush. A cave with that much Oxonium in it would easily give me enough leeway to consider joining you as a rusher. But I haven’t gone for it because the partners of that one shithead that jacked my dish went after the cave, and they never came back. So I had the place cordoned off.” She plants both her elbows on the table and strains her fingers, angrily snarling at the monitor. “Argh, it’s been torture knowing that so much money is sitting right there, but I haven’t been able to do a damn thing about it!”
rows.translation: “那个，”她一边说，一边在座位上调整姿势，“来自一座深入丛林数英里的洞穴。里面有那么多奥克索尼姆，绝对足以让我获得充足余地，考虑作为开拓者加入你。但我一直没去，因为偷走我天线的那个混蛋还有一群同伙，他们去了洞穴后就再也没回来。所以我封锁了那里。”她把双肘撑在桌上，绷紧十指，愤怒地朝显示器低吼。“啊，明知道有那么多钱就放在那里，我却他妈什么也做不了，这简直是一种折磨！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That,” she says, adjusting herself in her seat, “is from a cave located a couple miles deep into the bush. A cave with that much Oxonium in it would easily give me enough leeway to consider joining you as a rusher. But I haven’t gone for it because the partners of that one shithead that jacked my dish went after the cave, and they never came back. So I had the place cordoned off.” She plants both her elbows on the table and strains her fingers, angrily snarling at the monitor. “Argh, it’s been torture knowing that so much money is sitting right there, but I haven’t been able to do a damn thing about it!”"

rows.original: You can probably guess what the next words out of Penny’s mouth are going to be, but you let her go ahead. “That’s where you come in,” she says, her hand clasping securely onto your shoulder. “It would be crazy for me to go there alone... but if I had my mate at my side, we could make it work. After I saw you handle those two Zil, I knew that, if anyone would be willing to risk going after it, it’d be you. You and me, [pc.name], we could make that jungle our bitch. Our prey!”
rows.translation: 你大概猜得到佩妮接下来要说什么，但还是让她继续。 “这就轮到你登场了，”她说道，一只手牢牢抓住你的肩膀。“让我独自去那里实在太疯狂了...可要是有伴侣陪在身边，我们就能成功。看到你摆平那两只兹尔后，我就知道，如果有谁愿意冒险去取那东西，那个人一定是你。[pc.name]，你和我，我们能把那片丛林收拾得服服帖帖。让它成为我们的猎物！”
rows.raw: " You can probably guess what the next words out of Penny’s mouth are going to be, but you let her go ahead. “That’s where you come in,” she says, her hand clasping securely onto your shoulder. “It would be crazy for me to go there alone... but if I had my mate at my side, we could make it work. After I saw you handle those two Zil, I knew that, if anyone would be willing to risk going after it, it’d be you. You and me, [pc.name], we could make that jungle our bitch. Our prey!”"

rows.original: “Let’s go get it, then,” you offer. “You and me.”
rows.translation: “那我们就去把它弄到手吧，”你提议道。“就你和我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s go get it, then,” you offer. “You and me.”"

rows.original: “Well, there’s no sense in standing around, is there? That Oxonium isn’t going to go claim itself.”
rows.translation: “好吧，继续站在这里也没意义，对吧？那些奥克索尼姆又不会自己把自己送上门。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, there’s no sense in standing around, is there? That Oxonium isn’t going to go claim itself.”"

rows.original: “I was hoping you’d say that, my mate,” she replies with a smug, self-satisfied grin. “As soon as you handled those Zil, I knew you were crazy enough to go and tackle that deposit with me.”
rows.translation: “我就希望你会这么说，我的伴侣，”她带着得意、自满的笑容答道。“你一解决那些兹尔，我就知道你有足够的疯劲，敢跟我去啃下那座矿藏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was hoping you’d say that, my mate,” she replies with a smug, self-satisfied grin. “As soon as you handled those Zil, I knew you were crazy enough to go and tackle that deposit with me.”"

rows.original: She leans into you and nuzzles her cheek against yours affectionately. “Making you into my mate just happened to be a bonus.”
rows.translation: 她靠进你怀里，亲昵地用脸颊蹭着你的脸。“顺便让你成为我的伴侣，只不过是额外收获。”
rows.raw: " She leans into you and nuzzles her cheek against yours affectionately. “Making you into my mate just happened to be a bonus.”"

rows.original: Penny closes the image, returning her monitor to its previous state. “I’ve had the coordinates for the cave mapped out for some time, now. We don’t have to go to it right now; I’ll give you some time to get ready. You know where I am when you are.”
rows.translation: 佩妮关掉图像，让显示器恢复先前的画面。“我早就绘制好了洞穴的坐标。我们不用现在就去；我会给你一点时间准备。等你准备好了，知道去哪里找我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny closes the image, returning her monitor to its previous state. “I’ve had the coordinates for the cave mapped out for some time, now. We don’t have to go to it right now; I’ll give you some time to get ready. You know where I am when you are.”"

rows.original: You stand and make for the door – but, as soon as you do, you feel a hard, hearty slap against your [pc.ass], making you jump in surprise, followed by a five-fingered grope.
rows.translation: 你站起身，朝门口走去 – 可你刚一迈步，就感到一记结实有力的巴掌拍在你的[pc.ass]上，惊得你跳起来，紧接着是一只用五根手指的揉摸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand and make for the door – but, as soon as you do, you feel a hard, hearty slap against your [pc.ass], making you jump in surprise, followed by a five-fingered grope."

rows.original: You turn back to Penny, and to her narrow-eyed, devious, predatory expression, her tongue coyly licking at one corner of her mouth. “There’ll be more in it for you than just a take if it all works out, my mate,” she promises.
rows.translation: 你转回佩妮那边，迎上她眯着眼、狡黠又带着捕食意味的表情，她的舌头娇俏地舔着嘴角。“要是全都成了，你拿到手的可不只是分成，我的伴侣，”她保证道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn back to Penny, and to her narrow-eyed, devious, predatory expression, her tongue coyly licking at one corner of her mouth. “There’ll be more in it for you than just a take if it all works out, my mate,” she promises."

rows.original: With that in mind, you leave her station – for now.
rows.translation: 抱着这个想法，你离开了她的工作站——暂时如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that in mind, you leave her station – for now."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You fold your [pc.legs] under your lower half and seat yourself
rows.translation: 你把[pc.legs]收在身下，坐好身子
rows.raw: "You fold your [pc.legs] under your lower half and seat yourself"

rows.original: You take a seat
rows.translation: 你坐了下来
rows.raw: "You take a seat"

rows.original: across from Penny
rows.translation: 在佩妮对面
rows.raw: " across from Penny"

joinAfter.expression: pc.isTaur() ? "" : ", in one of her office chairs"

rows.original: , in one of her office chairs
rows.translation: ，坐在她的一张办公椅上
rows.raw: ", in one of her office chairs"

rows.original: . You tell her that you have a very serious question you want to ask her.
rows.translation: 。你告诉她，自己有一个非常严肃的问题想问。
rows.raw: ". You tell her that you have a very serious question you want to ask her."

rows.original: “This sounds awfully familiar,” she snarks. “Good to see you’re pumping the breaks a bit this time, at least.”
rows.translation: “听起来熟悉得要命，”她挖苦道。“至少这一次，很高兴看到你稍微踩了点刹车。”
rows.raw: "“This sounds awfully familiar,” she snarks. “Good to see you’re pumping the breaks a bit this time, at least.”"

rows.original: Sensing your sincerity, Penny puts down her paperwork and turns her chair to face you, sitting upright. Her large ears are perked and are facing towards you. “You have my undivided attention, [pc.name],” she says, and you can tell, she means it.
rows.translation: 感受到你的真诚，佩妮放下文书，转动椅子面朝你，挺直身体坐好。她那双大耳朵竖了起来，朝向你。“我会全神贯注地听，[pc.name]，”她说道，而你看得出，她是认真的。
rows.raw: "Sensing your sincerity, Penny puts down her paperwork and turns her chair to face you, sitting upright. Her large ears are perked and are facing towards you. “You have my undivided attention, [pc.name],” she says, and you can tell, she means it."

rows.original: When you asked her about her goals in life, she mentioned towards the end that she might consider retiring and traveling the stars with you as an adventurer. You know that she has a lot on her plate right now, but... you ask her what it would take to get her to seriously consider it. You’d love to have her with you on your ship.
rows.translation: 你曾问过她的人生目标；在谈话末尾，她提到自己或许会考虑退休，与你一起以冒险者身份遨游群星。你知道她眼下肩负着许多事情，可是...你还是问她，究竟怎样才能让她认真考虑这件事。你很希望她能和你一起登上飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you asked her about her goals in life, she mentioned towards the end that she might consider retiring and traveling the stars with you as an adventurer. You know that she has a lot on her plate right now, but... you ask her what it would take to get her to seriously consider it. You’d love to have her with you on your ship."

rows.original: At the question, Penny takes a long, deep sigh. Her gaze falters and focuses elsewhere in the room as she considers the question. “There’s a lot to keep in mind with a question like that, [pc.name],” she says. “It’s more than just picking up and leaving. Esbeth may only have a handful people in it to call it a community, but, fuck, I can’t just leave them. I’m the only law enforcement here.”
rows.translation: 听到这个问题，佩妮长长地深叹一声。她的目光动摇，转而落到房间别处，思考起这个问题。“面对这种问题，有许多事情需要考虑，[pc.name]，”她说道。“这可不只是收拾东西离开。埃斯贝斯可能只有寥寥几人，勉强能称作社区，可操，我不能就这样抛下他们。我是这里唯一的执法人员。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the question, Penny takes a long, deep sigh. Her gaze falters and focuses elsewhere in the room as she considers the question. “There’s a lot to keep in mind with a question like that, [pc.name],” she says. “It’s more than just picking up and leaving. Esbeth may only have a handful people in it to call it a community, but, fuck, I can’t just leave them. I’m the only law enforcement here.”"

rows.original: So, the challenge is to find a replacement for her? “It would be a good start, for sure,” she says, her fingers twiddling senseless patterns on her desk. “But I still have payments and debts of my own to worry about. I won’t doubt that being a rusher can be lucrative, but I need something more stable than the occasional lucky gold dig or whatever.”
rows.translation: 所以，挑战就是给她找个替代者？“那肯定是个好的开始，”她说着，手指在桌面上胡乱画着毫无意义的图案。“但我还有自己的付款和债务要操心。我不怀疑当行星开拓者能赚大钱，但我需要比偶尔幸运挖到金子之类更稳定的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, the challenge is to find a replacement for her? “It would be a good start, for sure,” she says, her fingers twiddling senseless patterns on her desk. “But I still have payments and debts of my own to worry about. I won’t doubt that being a rusher can be lucrative, but I need something more stable than the occasional lucky gold dig or whatever.”"

rows.original: You’re pretty loaded. You could offer to help her out.
rows.translation: 你手头相当宽裕。你可以主动提出帮她一把。
rows.raw: "You’re pretty loaded. You could offer to help her out."

rows.original: You could offer to help her out with that, even if you’re not exactly [pc.misterMiss] moneybags at the moment.
rows.translation: 你可以主动提出帮她解决这个问题，即使眼下你还算不上[pc.misterMiss]有钱人。
rows.raw: "You could offer to help her out with that, even if you’re not exactly [pc.misterMiss] moneybags at the moment."

rows.original: Offer Creds
rows.translation: 提供信用点
rows.raw: "Offer Creds"

rows.original: B

In that case, you offer to pay off whatever outstanding debts Penny has on the spot. You’ve got some pretty hefty pockets, and if it means giving Penny a more exhilarating future than just sitting at a desk and waiting for danger to come to her, you’d gladly pay it.
rows.translation: 那样的话，你提出当场替佩妮还清她所有未偿的债务。你的口袋很鼓，如果这能让佩妮得到一个比坐在桌前等危险找上门更刺激的未来，你乐意掏这笔钱。
rows.raw: "In that case, you offer to pay off whatever outstanding debts Penny has on the spot. You’ve got some pretty hefty pockets, and if it means giving Penny a more exhilarating future than just sitting at a desk and waiting for danger to come to her, you’d gladly pay it."

rows.original: You ask her if she isn’t averse to getting a donation or two to help dig her out of whatever hole she’s in. If it means getting Penny out of this cramped office and out from behind that desk so she can live a more exciting life, you wouldn’t mind putting in a few extra hours to raise the funds and help her out.
rows.translation: 你问她是否介意接受一两笔捐款，帮助自己从眼下的困境中脱身。如果这能让佩妮离开这间狭窄的办公室，从那张桌子后面走出来，过上更加精彩的生活，你不介意多花几个小时筹集资金，助她一臂之力。
rows.raw: "You ask her if she isn’t averse to getting a donation or two to help dig her out of whatever hole she’s in. If it means getting Penny out of this cramped office and out from behind that desk so she can live a more exciting life, you wouldn’t mind putting in a few extra hours to raise the funds and help her out."

rows.original: “Hey!” Penny barks, extending an authoritative finger towards you – but, as soon as the command rises in her throat, it dissipates, and her expression softens. “I’m sorry. You’re just trying to be a good mate to me, and I shouldn’t have snapped at you like that.”
rows.translation: “嘿！”佩妮厉声呵斥，威严地伸出一根手指指向你——但命令才刚涌到喉咙便消散了，她的表情也柔和下来。“对不起。你只是在努力做我的好伴侣，我不该那样对你发火。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey!” Penny barks, extending an authoritative finger towards you – but, as soon as the command rises in her throat, it dissipates, and her expression softens. “I’m sorry. You’re just trying to be a good mate to me, and I shouldn’t have snapped at you like that.”"

rows.original: You ask her why she did. “Because I don’t like the idea of being dependent. It’s a generous offer, [pc.name], but, mate or not, I’d just be going from one debt to another. I can’t rely on handouts all my life. I dug this hole, and I’m going to climb out with my own two hands.”
rows.translation: 你问她为什么这么做。“因为我不喜欢依赖别人的感觉。这是个慷慨的提议，[pc.name]；但不管是不是伴侣，我都只是从一笔债务转向另一笔债务。我不能一辈子依赖施舍。这个坑是我自己挖的，我也会用自己的双手爬出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her why she did. “Because I don’t like the idea of being dependent. It’s a generous offer, [pc.name], but, mate or not, I’d just be going from one debt to another. I can’t rely on handouts all my life. I dug this hole, and I’m going to climb out with my own two hands.”"

rows.original: Offer Creds
rows.translation: 提供信用点
rows.raw: "Offer Creds"

rows.original: Help a girl out.
rows.translation: 帮女孩一把。
rows.raw: "Help a girl out."

rows.original: Don’t Offer
rows.translation: 不提供
rows.raw: "Don’t Offer"

rows.original: B & Fenoxo
rows.raw: "B & Fenoxo"

rows.original: You offer a sober nod. <i>“I understand. You wanna
rows.translation: 你郑重地点点头。<i>“我明白。你想
rows.raw: "You offer a sober nod. <i>“I understand. You wanna "

rows.original: like, make your own money and stuff, even if it’s totally hard.” You stifle a giggle.
rows.translation: 比如，自己挣钱什么的，就算真的很难。”你忍住了笑。
rows.raw: "like, make your own money and stuff, even if it’s totally hard.” You stifle a giggle."

rows.original: lift yourself up on your own two feet - er, paws.”
rows.translation: 靠你自己的双脚站起来——呃，是爪子。”
rows.raw: "lift yourself up on your own two feet - er, paws.”"

rows.original: “Exactly!” Penny barks, extending an authoritative finger. “That’s why you’re my fucking mate, right there. I don’t like the idea of being dependent. Taking a loan to look like this damn near killed me inside, but I don’t need handouts any more. I’m going to climb out of this hole with my own two hands.”
rows.translation: “没错！”佩妮大声说道，威严地伸出一根手指。“正因为这一点，你才是我他妈的伴侣。我不喜欢依赖别人的感觉。为了变成这副模样而贷款，差点从内心把我杀死；但我不再需要施舍了。我要用自己的双手从这个坑里爬出去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly!” Penny barks, extending an authoritative finger. “That’s why you’re my fucking mate, right there. I don’t like the idea of being dependent. Taking a loan to look like this damn near killed me inside, but I don’t need handouts any more. I’m going to climb out of this hole with my own two hands.”"

rows.original: Don’t Offer
rows.translation: 不提供
rows.raw: "Don’t Offer"

rows.original: Penny’s a strong, independent furry who don’t need no creds.
rows.translation: 佩妮是个坚强独立的兽人，才不需要什么信用点。

You follow Penny’s instruction to the word: exactly twenty-four hours later, you show yourself back into her station.
rows.translation: 你一字不差地遵照佩妮的指示：整整二十四小时后，你再次出现在她的空间站里。
rows.raw: "You follow Penny’s instruction to the word: exactly twenty-four hours later, you show yourself back into her station."

rows.original: “...and I think that about covers it,” you hear Penny say as you show yourself into, what is officially, formerly her office. Standing behind her desk in the distance is the woman of the hour herself, and Flahne, the customs secretary for Esbeth; on top of the desk is a single travel suitcase, bloated with belongings.
rows.translation: “...我想差不多都讲完了，”你走进这间名义上已经不再属于佩妮的办公室时，听见她说道。远处的办公桌后站着今天的主角本人，还有埃斯贝斯的海关秘书弗兰；桌面上放着一只旅行箱，被行李塞得鼓鼓囊囊。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...and I think that about covers it,” you hear Penny say as you show yourself into, what is officially, formerly her office. Standing behind her desk in the distance is the woman of the hour herself, and Flahne, the customs secretary for Esbeth; on top of the desk is a single travel suitcase, bloated with belongings."

rows.original: Penny, for the first time since you’ve met her, is wearing what appears to be her civilian clothing: her top is a too-small T-shirt with sleeves that go halfway to her elbows and leaves her midriff bare. It’s white, but there’s a cutesy cartoon character pasted onto the front, with a phrase underneath it written in a language you don’t immediately understand. And, for her legs, she has a pair of cut-off jeans that end above her knees.
rows.translation: 自从你认识佩妮以来，这是她第一次穿着看起来像是平民便服的衣服：上身是一件小了一号的T恤，袖子只到小臂中段，把腰腹露在外面。T恤是白色的，正面印着一个可爱的卡通角色，下面还有一句你一时看不懂是什么语言的文字。下身则是一条截短的牛仔裤，裤脚停在膝盖上方。
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny, for the first time since you’ve met her, is wearing what appears to be her civilian clothing: her top is a too-small T-shirt with sleeves that go halfway to her elbows and leaves her midriff bare. It’s white, but there’s a cutesy cartoon character pasted onto the front, with a phrase underneath it written in a language you don’t immediately understand. And, for her legs, she has a pair of cut-off jeans that end above her knees."

rows.original: They’re both busy looking at Penny’s monitor, but from your angle, you can’t see what’s on it. Both of the ladies look in your direction as you enter unannounced. “Ah, speak of the devil and [pc.heShe] will appear,” Flahne says, a comforting smile on her lips.
rows.translation: 她们俩正忙着看佩妮的显示器，但从你的角度看不见上面的内容。你未经通报便走进来，两位女士都朝你望去。“啊，说曹操，[pc.heShe]就到了，”弗兰说道，嘴角挂着令人安心的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey’re both busy looking at Penny’s monitor, but from your angle, you can’t see what’s on it. Both of the ladies look in your direction as you enter unannounced. “Ah, speak of the devil and [pc.heShe] will appear,” Flahne says, a comforting smile on her lips. "

rows.original: “So, this is the scoundrel that’s taking you away from me, Penny?”
rows.translation: “那么，就是这个要把你从我身边带走的无赖，佩妮？”
rows.raw: "“So, this is the scoundrel that’s taking you away from me, Penny?”"

rows.original: “I can see how [pc.heShe]’s done such a wonderful job of charming you.” Flahne winks.
rows.translation: “看得出[pc.heShe]把你迷住这活儿干得真漂亮。”弗兰眨眨眼。
rows.raw: "“I can see how [pc.heShe]’s done such a wonderful job of charming you.” Flahne winks."

rows.original: Penny’s cheeks are lifted, and her lips are rosy red – even from where you’re standing, you can tell she isn’t wearing lipstick. She must have spent the last twenty-four hours smiling nonstop.
rows.translation: 佩妮双颊上扬，双唇红润–即使站在这里，你也看得出她没有涂口红。过去二十四小时里，她一定始终笑个不停。
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny’s cheeks are lifted, and her lips are rosy red – even from where you’re standing, you can tell she isn’t wearing lipstick. She must have spent the last twenty-four hours smiling nonstop."

rows.original: “Yeah,” Penny answers dreamily, her eyes positively sparkling when she sees you. With one hand on her keyboard, she beckons you forward with her other. “Although, [pc.name] came here in a spaceship. Don’t devils come from underground? I thought it was angels that descended from the sky.”
rows.translation: “是啊，”佩妮如梦似幻地回答。看见你时，她的双眼简直闪闪发光。她一只手放在键盘上，另一只手招呼你过去。“不过，[pc.name]是坐宇宙飞船来的。恶魔不是从地下冒出来的吗？我还以为从天而降的是天使。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah,” Penny answers dreamily, her eyes positively sparkling when she sees you. With one hand on her keyboard, she beckons you forward with her other. “Although, [pc.name] came here in a spaceship. Don’t devils come from underground? I thought it was angels that descended from the sky.”"

rows.translation: 用左臂环住佩妮的腰背，一只手扶在她胯部，将她拥入怀中。她主动转向你，在你脸颊上亲了一口–那不过是充满爱意的欢快轻吻，但你能感觉到有你陪在身边令她何等雀跃。你也回吻了她。

rows.original: “Wow,” Flahne says, leaning back and putting her gelatinous hand against her chin, “all joking aside, it’s like you’re a completely different person, Penny. One day, you’re a professional officer looking after a little hamlet in the jungle, and the next, you’re acting like a lovestruck schoolgirl that doesn’t know left from right.”
rows.translation: “哇，”弗兰一边说，一边向后靠去，将胶质手掌抵在下巴上，“不开玩笑了，佩妮，你简直变成了另一个人。前一天，你还是个在丛林里照看小村落的专业警官，转眼间，你却表现得像个坠入爱河、左右不分的女学生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow,” Flahne says, leaning back and putting her gelatinous hand against her chin, “all joking aside, it’s like you’re a completely different person, Penny. One day, you’re a professional officer looking after a little hamlet in the jungle, and the next, you’re acting like a lovestruck schoolgirl that doesn’t know left from right.”"

rows.original: Penny laughs, but doesn’t deny a word; in fact, you feel her long, fluffy tail wrap gracefully around your own [pc.legOrLegs], snuggling her closer to you.
rows.translation: 佩妮笑了起来，却一句也没有否认；事实上，你感觉她那条毛茸茸的长尾巴优雅地缠上你的[pc.legOrLegs]，让她更加亲密地依偎着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny laughs, but doesn’t deny a word; in fact, you feel her long, fluffy tail wrap gracefully around your own [pc.legOrLegs], snuggling her closer to you."

rows.original: “Flahne and I were just going over the last lessons of her looking after the sentries,” Penny says to you, leaning her head against your shoulder. “You got it all, right Flahne? It’s pretty simple, right?”
rows.translation: “我和弗兰刚刚正在复习她照看哨兵的最后几课，”佩妮把脑袋靠在你肩上，对你说道。“你都记住了吧，弗兰？这很简单，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Flahne and I were just going over the last lessons of her looking after the sentries,” Penny says to you, leaning her head against your shoulder. “You got it all, right Flahne? It’s pretty simple, right?”"

rows.original: “Goodness gracious, Penny, relax, would you?” she replies good-naturedly. “For the past few hours, it’s been this-and-that about protocol, and routines, and sentries, and passwords – there are so few people in Esbeth and there’s so little crime that I promise you, my job handling customs is harder than yours. Yes, girl, I have it under control!”
rows.translation: “天哪，佩妮，放松一点，好吗？”她脾气很好地回答。“过去几个小时里，你一直在说这个规程、那个日常，还有哨兵和密码–埃斯贝斯人口那么少，犯罪也那么少，我向你保证，我负责海关的工作都比你的更难。是的，姑娘，我能处理好！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Goodness gracious, Penny, relax, would you?” she replies good-naturedly. “For the past few hours, it’s been this-and-that about protocol, and routines, and sentries, and passwords – there are so few people in Esbeth and there’s so little crime that I promise you, my job handling customs is harder than yours. Yes, girl, I have it under control!”"

rows.original: Penny giggles a surprisingly girlish laugh, for her. She really is acting like a different person today. “Just in case–”
rows.translation: 佩妮发出对她而言出奇少女气的咯咯笑声。今天的她确实像是变了一个人。“以防万一–”
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny giggles a surprisingly girlish laugh, for her. She really is acting like a different person today. “Just in case–”"

rows.original: “Yes, I know your extranet address,” Flahne interrupts, tapping her lips with a finger. “Honestly, Penny. Go and explore the stars already!”
rows.translation: “是的，我知道你的外网地址，”弗兰打断道，用手指点了点嘴唇。“说真的，佩妮。赶紧去探索星空吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, I know your extranet address,” Flahne interrupts, tapping her lips with a finger. “Honestly, Penny. Go and explore the stars already!”"

rows.original: At that, Penny visibly hesitates. It takes her time and effort to reach her hand into her pocket, and you can hear the jingling of keys between her fingers as she pulls them out. Her smile hasn’t left, but her actions are slower and labored.
rows.translation: 听到这话，佩妮明显犹豫了。她费了些时间和力气才把手伸进口袋，你能听见她掏出钥匙时指间叮当作响。她的笑容还没消失，可动作却更慢、更吃力了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that, Penny visibly hesitates. It takes her time and effort to reach her hand into her pocket, and you can hear the jingling of keys between her fingers as she pulls them out. Her smile hasn’t left, but her actions are slower and labored."

rows.original: “I, uh,” she stutters. She brings her closed fist to her face, and she looks at her clenched fingers like she was delicately holding a child rather than some keys. “I guess this is it, Flahne.”
rows.translation: “我，呃，”她结巴着。她把攥紧的拳头举到面前，看着自己紧握的手指，仿佛那里面小心翼翼地捧着的是个孩子，而不是几把钥匙。“我想就这样了，弗兰。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I, uh,” she stutters. She brings her closed fist to her face, and she looks at her clenched fingers like she was delicately holding a child rather than some keys. “I guess this is it, Flahne.”"

rows.original: “Penny,” Flahne starts, taking a softer tone. She steps forward and places a delicate, understanding hand against Penny’s unoccupied bicep. “If you think for one second that I’m not going to message you every day, asking you how your new adventure with your mate is going, well....” She stops herself, a few words playing soundlessly on her lips. “I was going to say something playfully demeaning, but, just, you’d be wrong. I am absolutely going to be living vicariously through you every day I get.”
rows.translation: “佩妮，”弗兰开口说道，语气变得柔和。她向前一步，将温柔而理解的手搭在佩妮空着的那条上臂上。“如果你有哪怕一秒钟以为我不会每天给你发消息，问你和伴侣的新冒险进展如何，那么....”她打住话头，几句话无声地在唇间酝酿。“我本来想开玩笑地说点贬损你的话，但你就是错了。只要有机会，我绝对会每天都通过你的经历来满足自己的冒险心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Penny,” Flahne starts, taking a softer tone. She steps forward and places a delicate, understanding hand against Penny’s unoccupied bicep. “If you think for one second that I’m not going to message you every day, asking you how your new adventure with your mate is going, well....” She stops herself, a few words playing soundlessly on her lips. “I was going to say something playfully demeaning, but, just, you’d be wrong. I am absolutely going to be living vicariously through you every day I get.”"

rows.original: Penny chuckles, then wipes at her eye with her knuckle.
rows.translation: 佩妮轻笑出声，然后用指节擦了擦眼角。
rows.raw: "\n\nPenny chuckles, then wipes at her eye with her knuckle."

rows.original: “This is not ‘it,’ Penny,” she continues. “Even if we never see each other in person again, and even if we didn’t have the extranet, you’ll never leave my thoughts. This isn’t ‘goodbye;’ this is ‘farewell’ and ‘good luck.’”
rows.translation: “这不是‘结束’，佩妮，”她继续说道。“即使我们再也无法亲眼见到彼此，即使我们没有外网，你也永远不会离开我的思绪。这不是‘再见；’而是‘珍重’和‘祝你好运。’”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is not ‘it,’ Penny,” she continues. “Even if we never see each other in person again, and even if we didn’t have the extranet, you’ll never leave my thoughts. This isn’t ‘goodbye;’ this is ‘farewell’ and ‘good luck.’”"

rows.original: With that said, Flahne extends her outstretched hand. Once more, Penny hesitates, but, with a sniffle, she puts her hand in Flahne’s and opens her fingers – the keys to the station, the last things keeping her tethered to Esbeth, jingle from her hand and into the Rahn’s.
rows.translation: 说完，弗兰伸出摊开的手。佩妮又一次犹豫了，但抽了抽鼻子，还是把手放进弗兰掌中，松开手指–空间站的钥匙、将她与埃斯贝斯相连的最后几件东西，从她手里叮当落进拉恩人的掌中。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that said, Flahne extends her outstretched hand. Once more, Penny hesitates, but, with a sniffle, she puts her hand in Flahne’s and opens her fingers – the keys to the station, the last things keeping her tethered to Esbeth, jingle from her hand and into the Rahn’s."

rows.original: Flahne pulls Penny in for a quick hug and a similar, but different, kiss on the cheek. “Have fun, you two,” Flahne says when she pulls away, her eyes flitting between yours and Penny’s. “Don’t do anything or anyone I wouldn’t.”
rows.translation: 弗兰把佩妮拉过来匆匆抱了一下，又在她脸颊上印下一个相似却又不同的吻。“玩得开心，你们俩，”弗兰退开时说，目光在你和佩妮之间来回移动。“别做我不会做的事，也别上我不会上的人。”

rows.original: At this question, she smiles and answers, “No particular reason. That you caught me here is just coincidence. My plan is to move around from place to place every now and then, seeing new things, eating new foods. I actually lived in New Texas previously, and I hadn’t planned to move on, but....” She trails off before continuing, “Well, I liked New Texas, and I like sex as much as the next girl, but it got old. It was so hard to even have a real conversation with someone. And so, I found myself here.”
rows.translation: 听到这个问题，她笑着回答：“没什么特别的理由。你会在这里遇见我只是巧合。我的打算是时不时从一个地方搬到另一个地方，看看新鲜事物，品尝新的食物。其实我以前住在新德克萨斯，也没打算搬走，但....”她的声音渐渐低了下去，随后继续道：“嗯，我喜欢新德克萨斯，也和其他女孩一样喜欢性爱，可时间久了也会厌倦。想和某个人真正交谈几句都那么困难。所以，我最后来到了这里。”

Eventually, I started selling my services to classmates.

rows.translation: “哦。你可真是个俊俏的小伙子，不是吗？”那个棕色皮肤的凯斯里特靠在凳子上往后一仰，带着淫荡的坏笑，毫不遮掩地上下打量你。“觉得自己挺了不起，是吧？像你这样健壮的小伙子随时都欢迎加入——只要你觉得自己跟得上。”她拍了拍吧台，酒保赶紧拿着一瓶琥珀色液体和几只新杯子过来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh. You’re a right lookin’ boyo, aren’t you?” the brown-skinned kaithrit leans back on her stool and openly eyeballs you with a lascivious sneer. “Fancy yourself, do we? Fit lookin’ lad like you’s always welcome to join in - if you think you can keep up.” She slaps the counter, and the barkeep hurries over with a bottle of amber fluid and several fresh glasses."

rows.original: Ramis is capable of draining brightly-colored and evil-looking fishbowls to the bottom without it apparently having any effect on her - however you’re practiced enough, and have beaten your liver into being rubbery enough, to pace yourself alongside her. After knocking back a few more at Anon’s, she whisks you out into the messy, blaring neon of Tavros’s nightlife. In between hurling yourself around the sweaty ruck of a heaving dance floor, she orders a steady stream of liquor “for the dehydration”. She watches with rapt, intoxicated attention, blue light flaring over her long, sculpted face as you finish another shot and bang the glass down next to hers
rows.translation: 拉米斯能够把颜色鲜艳、模样邪恶的鱼缸杯鸡尾酒一饮而尽，表面上却似乎毫无影响；不过你也足够老练，早已把肝脏锻炼得足够坚韧，能够陪她控制好饮酒速度。在阿农酒吧又灌下几杯后，她拉着你闯进塔夫罗斯站杂乱喧闹、霓虹闪烁的夜生活。你们在起伏舞池上汗津津的人群中纵情冲撞，她还源源不断地点酒，声称是“为了防止脱水”。当你又喝完一杯，把杯子砰地放到她的杯子旁边时，她满怀陶醉与醉意地注视着你，蓝光在她修长而轮廓分明的脸上闪烁

rows.original: Somehow you find yourself in another club - this one even wilder, with writhing foam, anti-gravitational fields and all-conquering bass that gets inside your spine and brain - through which you and Ramis spill, careen and thrash. The kaithrit dances and starts conversations at the top of her voice with other clubbers seemingly at random, a trait which either endears or infuriates.
rows.translation: 不知怎么的，你发现自己又进了一家俱乐部 - 这一家更疯狂，有翻涌的泡沫、反重力场，还有那种征服一切的贝斯，钻进你的脊椎和脑子里 - 你和拉米斯在其中晃荡、冲撞、翻腾。这只凯斯里特跳着舞，扯着嗓子跟别的客人搭话，对象看上去完全是随机的，这特点要么让人喜欢，要么让人火大。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow you find yourself in another club - this one even wilder, with writhing foam, anti-gravitational fields and all-conquering bass that gets inside your spine and brain - through which you and Ramis spill, careen and thrash. The kaithrit dances and starts conversations at the top of her voice with other clubbers seemingly at random, a trait which either endears or infuriates."

rows.original: It’s difficult for you to do much on a dancefloor without seriously injuring people, however that doesn’t deter Ramis from finding a cowboy hat from somewhere, leaping onto your back and slapping your hind, laughing raucously as you rear instinctively. The other clubbers cheer you on, and giddy with alcohol you buck and leap without restraint, attempting to dislodge the guffawing, hiccupping weight on your [pc.legOrLegs].
rows.translation: 你在舞池里想做什么都很难不把人弄成重伤，但这并没拦住拉米斯不知从哪儿弄来一顶牛仔帽，跳上你的背，拍你的后臀，在你本能地人立而起时放声大笑。其他俱乐部客人给你叫好，而你在酒精的作用下晕乎乎的，毫无顾忌地蹦跳、腾跃，想把[pc.legOrLegs]上那团又笑又打嗝的重量甩下去。

rows.original: When she dances with you, her tails send very clear and inviting signals, writhing and twisting around her body, drawing attention to her sumptuous curves and rippling muscles. The moment you think about pressing your lips to hers however she’s off again, either to the bar or butting into somebody else’s fledgling one night stand.
rows.translation: 她与你共舞时，尾巴发出的信号既明确又充满邀请，在身体周围扭动盘绕，把注意力引向丰美曲线与起伏肌肉。然而你刚想到把嘴唇贴上她的，她就再次溜走，不是奔向吧台，就是插进别人刚刚萌芽的一夜情里。

The moment you think about pressing your lips to hers however she’s off again, either to the bar or butting into somebody else’s fledgling one night stand."

rows.original: Dancing with her is like being caught in a tumble dryer - a very sweaty and booby tumble dryer. Rough, clawed hands grip at your shoulders and hurl you around, and it’s all you can do to throw shapes that will stop you being thrown headfirst into other dancers.
rows.translation: 和她跳舞就像被卷进烘干机 - 一台汗淋淋又满是奶子的烘干机。粗粝带爪的手抓住你的肩膀，把你甩来甩去，你只能拼命摆出各种姿势，免得被一头甩进别的舞者身上。
rows.raw: " Dancing with her is like being caught in a tumble dryer - a very sweaty and booby tumble dryer. Rough, clawed hands grip at your shoulders and hurl you around, and it’s all you can do to throw shapes that will stop you being thrown headfirst into other dancers."

rows.original: Ramis gets wilder and wilder, however despite the world swimming with alcohol and endorphins you keep your wits about you, and manage to tear her away from the place before she’s thrown out. You can’t stop her from setting off into the vast space station almost at random, and high on the buzz you kind of want to see where her anarchy and fathomless energy will take you next. She knocks over shop stands... you run away from security... she shimmies up the giant mushroom trees on the res deck... you try to activate escape pods... she finds a pod of vodka somewhere... you run away from more security...
rows.translation: 拉米斯变得越来越狂野，然而尽管世界在酒精和内啡肽中旋转，你依然保持清醒，成功在她被赶出去之前把她拖离那里。你无法阻止她几乎随机地冲进广阔空间站，亢奋之下，你也有点想看看她的混乱和无穷精力接下来会把你们带到哪里。她撞翻商铺摊位... 你们逃离保安追赶... 她扭着身体爬上居住甲板的巨型蘑菇树... 你们试图启动逃生舱... 她不知从哪里找到一整荚伏特加... 你们又一次逃离保安追赶...
rows.raw: "\n\nRamis gets wilder and wilder, however despite the world swimming with alcohol and endorphins you keep your wits about you, and manage to tear her away from the place before she’s thrown out. You can’t stop her from setting off into the vast space station almost at random, and high on the buzz you kind of want to see where her anarchy and fathomless energy will take you next. She knocks over shop stands... you run away from security... she shimmies up the giant mushroom trees on the res deck... you try to activate escape pods... she finds a pod of vodka somewhere... you run away from more security..."

rows.original: “Up already?” trills Ramis, striding into the room from the bathroom in her underwear, toweling her hair. “Nice shower unit you have. Way better than the communal ones you get on merc cruisers, lemme tell you.” She knocks a bedside cabinet askew as she advances on the pile of clothes in the middle of the floor. “I feel- oof! I have never run into someone who can keep it up like you can, Steele. You usually around on Tavros? You come‘n find me in Anon’s whenever you can. You’re a rock star!” She wrenches on her tank top. “Right, I’m gonna go find some breakfast. I’ll let myself out [pc.name] - you have a nap, ‘n then find me when you’re ready for more.”
rows.translation: “已经起来了？”拉米斯尖声说道，穿着内衣从浴室大步走进房间，一边用毛巾擦拭头发。“你的淋浴设备真不错。比雇佣兵巡洋舰上的公共淋浴间强多了，我跟你说。”她朝地板中央那堆衣服走去时，撞歪了床头柜。“我感觉-哎哟！我从没碰到过像你这样一直撑得住的人，斯蒂尔。你通常都在塔弗罗斯活动吗？有空就来阿农酒吧找我。你简直是个大明星！”她用力套上背心。“好了，我要去找点早餐。我自己出去就行，[pc.name]，你睡上一觉，然后准备好再来找我继续。”

rows.original: You moan as you slowly regain consciousness. Oh Void... today is going to be hard. Very hard indeed. You feel like you’ve got a simultaneous case of flu and food poisoning, as well as if someone hit you around the [pc.legOrLegs] with a baseball bat a few times. The one good piece of news is, as you woozily cast your gaze around you, is that you did somehow manage to get back into your bed aboard your ship last night. You took something with you, though - there’s a large, hard object lying next to you. You moan again when you pull down the duvet and see what it is. A breadbin-sized conical construction bot in standby mode. Of course.
rows.translation: 你呻吟着缓缓恢复意识。哦，虚空啊...今天会很难熬。真的非常难熬。你感觉自己像是同时患上流感和食物中毒，还像有人拿棒球棍朝你的[pc.legOrLegs]抡了好几下。唯一的好消息是，当你晕乎乎地环顾四周时，发现昨晚不知怎么还是设法回到了飞船上的床铺。不过，你也带了件东西回来，身旁正躺着一个又大又硬的物体。你拉下羽绒被，看清那是什么后再次呻吟起来。一个面包箱大小、呈锥形的建筑机器人，正处于待机模式。当然了。

rows.original: “You’re not my type. Sorry,” she says. “Ramis needs a bit’ve meat with her dinner. Shame: I love a bonny looken lad who’s got ba- who’s big’n brave.” She grins at you. “Aw. I feel bad now. Why don’t you stay and have a few bevvies? We’ll find someone who’s into you, soon enough.”

You heave against Ramis’s steady force, forcing her back the other way with all your strength... then she grits her teeth, and the leverage in that warm, rough, needled grip feels like it’s been doubled. But two can play at that game!

rows.translation: “那得看是谁在问，伙计，不是吗？”拉米斯在吧凳上转过身，用一副露着牙、不带偏袒的冷笑打量你。“你当然是想把全银河有史以来最棒的炮术军官弄上你那破船，你当然想！可我可不是给随随便便哪个老家伙打工的。要是我在酒吧里就能被人这么捡走，我还算什么名声...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well now mate, that depends on who’s asken, doesn’t it?” Ramis swivels around on her bar stool to consider you with a toothy, impartial sneer. “Course you’re wanten the best gunnery officer the galaxy’s ever known on board your tub, of course you do! But I don’t just work for any old spod. What kind of reputation would I have, if I could just be picked up in a bar like...”"

rows.original: Her bald-headed human friend has been drifting closer as she’s talked, his eye on you, and now interrupts now by murmuring quietly in one of her blunt, triangular ears. Over the hubbub of the bar you don’t catch exactly what he says, but you definitely hear the phrase ‘Steele Tech’. The ears twitch.
rows.translation: 她说话时，那个光头人类朋友一直逐渐靠近，目光落在你身上；此刻他贴近她一只钝而呈三角形的耳朵，低声打断她。酒吧里人声嘈杂，你没听清他说了什么，但肯定听见了“斯蒂尔科技”这个词。她的耳朵抽动了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer bald-headed human friend has been drifting closer as she’s talked, his eye on you, and now interrupts now by murmuring quietly in one of her blunt, triangular ears. Over the hubbub of the bar you don’t catch exactly what he says, but you definitely hear the phrase ‘Steele Tech’. The ears twitch."

rows.original: “...alright then, let’s say I am willen to work for you,” Ramis continues, lips abruptly closing into a polite smile. “12 grand, up front, for the contract. I ent cheap, but...” She flexes her arms, and laughs. “You’ll be getten the best.”
rows.translation: “...那行吧，就当俺愿意替你干活了，”拉米斯接着说，嘴唇忽然合拢成一个礼貌的微笑。“一万二，预付，签合同。俺可不便宜，不过...”她活动了下胳膊，笑了。“你能得到最好的。”

rows.original: Your heart flutters a little bit when you obediently follow her into the bathroom - but why would you ever say no to an Amazonian goddess like her? It feels saintly to do exactly what she wants, submit yourself to the whims of all of that firm, brown, wilful flesh.
rows.translation: 当你乖乖跟着她走进浴室时，心脏稍稍悸动了一下；可面对她这样一位亚马逊女神，你又怎么可能拒绝呢？完全按照她的要求行事，将自己交给这一大片坚实、棕色而意志强烈的肉体随意支配，简直像是圣洁之举。

rows.raw: "\n\n“Aren’t I nice, captain?” Ramis says merrily, face bouncing around close to yours. “Sharen my big piece of man-meat with you. I should be your, umm. Getten stuff officer instead!”"

rows.original: “Umm no, not exactly,” replies Ramis, with a fond little giggle. “That’s [pc.name], my captain. And my bit of stuff. [pc.He]’s luvley. Say hullo and curtsey for Ohrskun, knickers.”
rows.translation: “呃，不，不完全是，”拉米斯带着亲昵的轻笑回答。“这是[pc.name]，我的舰长。也是我的小宝贝。[pc.He]很可爱。小裤裤，跟奥尔斯昆问好，行个屈膝礼。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Umm no, not exactly,” replies Ramis, with a fond little giggle. “That’s [pc.name], my captain. And my bit of stuff. [pc.He]’s luvley. Say hullo and curtsey for Ohrskun, knickers.”"

rows.original: “Oh. Ohhhh,” rumbles Ohrskun, dark eyes moving down to your [pc.chest]. They gleam with a dawning excitement. “So you two come as a pair, hmm?”
rows.translation: “哦。哦哦哦，”奥尔斯昆低沉地说，黑眼睛向下移到你的[pc.chest]上。那眼神因渐渐升起的兴奋而发亮。“所以你们俩是一对，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh. Ohhhh,” rumbles Ohrskun, dark eyes moving down to your [pc.chest]. They gleam with a dawning excitement. “So you two come as a pair, hmm?”"

rows.original: “Weeelll, that depends,” leers the kaithrit, leaning back. “Thinken I’d only let my sissy off the leash for a real man, who could be trusted to be in charge’ve maken two people feel like girlees for the night...”
rows.translation: “嗯——，那得看情况，”那个凯斯里特色眯眯地笑着，向后靠去。“我想，只有真正的男人才配让我解开小娘娘腔的牵绳；他得值得信任，有本事掌控局面，让两个人整晚都觉得自己像小姑娘...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Weeelll, that depends,” leers the kaithrit, leaning back. “Thinken I’d only let my sissy off the leash for a real man, who could be trusted to be in charge’ve maken two people feel like girlees for the night...”"

rows.original: “Hmm. Here’s my plan, then,” the malachite-skinned colossus says. “I’m gonna carry that dainty little sweetheart of yours out of here. And you’re gonna have to come with, if you ever want to see [pc.him] again. How’s that sound?”
rows.translation: “嗯。那我的计划是这样，”那个孔雀石色皮肤的巨人说道。“我要把你那位娇小可爱的甜心带出去。要是你还想再见到[pc.him]，就必须跟上来。听起来怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. Here’s my plan, then,” the malachite-skinned colossus says. “I’m gonna carry that dainty little sweetheart of yours out of here. And you’re gonna have to come with, if you ever want to see [pc.him] again. How’s that sound?”"

rows.original: “I’d love to see you try!” Ramis shoots back, grin widening.
rows.translation: “我倒想看看你怎么试！”拉米斯回嘴道，笑容越咧越大。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d love to see you try!” Ramis shoots back, grin widening."

rows.original: Before you’re able to do or say anything about this, Ohrskun scrapes his stool back, wraps his warm, muscular arm around your waist and hoiks you over his shoulder, [pc.ass] in the air. You squeal and your stomach lurches... but he’s not even that rough, just implacably strong and utterly assured about what he’s doing. The room drunkenly claps and cheers as he ponderously hefts you towards the exit.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及对此做什么或说什么，奥尔斯昆就把凳子往后一刮，用温暖而肌肉发达的手臂环住你的腰，把你猛地扛上肩膀，[pc.ass]高高翘在空中。你尖叫出声，胃也猛地一沉... 但他甚至称不上粗暴，只是有着不可撼动的力量，对自己正在做的事充满绝对把握。房间里醉醺醺的人们鼓掌喝彩；他迈着沉重的步伐，把你扛向出口。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you’re able to do or say anything about this, Ohrskun scrapes his stool back, wraps his warm, muscular arm around your waist and hoiks you over his shoulder, [pc.ass] in the air. You squeal and your stomach lurches... but he’s not even that rough, just implacably strong and utterly assured about what he’s doing. The room drunkenly claps and cheers as he ponderously hefts you towards the exit."

rows.original: “Aren’t I luvley, captain?” Ramis says merrily, following you along behind. “Sharen my big piece of man-meat with you. I should be your, umm. Getten stuff officer instead!”
rows.translation: “舰长，我是不是很贴心？”拉米斯欢快地说着，跟在你身后。“跟你分享我的大块男根。我应该改当你的，呃，搜罗东西官！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aren’t I luvley, captain?” Ramis says merrily, following you along behind. “Sharen my big piece of man-meat with you. I should be your, umm. Getten stuff officer instead!”"

rows.original: “Ohhh. It’s you two again,” Ohrskun the ponytailed thraggen rumbles, as he slowly clocks you appearing at his other elbow. His eyes gleam as certain memories come back to him, and he reaches out to hoik both of you into his warm, solid sides. “Do you always do this type of thing together?”
rows.translation: “哦哦哦。又是你们两个，”扎着马尾的特拉根奥尔斯昆用低沉的声音说道，慢慢注意到你出现在另一只手肘旁。某些回忆涌回脑海，他双眼发亮，伸手猛地把你们两人都搂进自己温暖坚实的身体两侧。“你们总是一起做这种事吗？”
rows.raw: "“Ohhh. It’s you two again,” Ohrskun the ponytailed thraggen rumbles, as he slowly clocks you appearing at his other elbow. His eyes gleam as certain memories come back to him, and he reaches out to hoik both of you into his warm, solid sides. “Do you always do this type of thing together?”"

rows.original: “Nah,” Ramis replies breezily, claws squeezing into his thick, muscular backside. “Just with lads with the stamina.”
rows.translation: “才不，”拉米斯轻松地答道，爪子捏进他厚实而肌肉发达的屁股。“只跟耐力够好的小伙子一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah,” Ramis replies breezily, claws squeezing into his thick, muscular backside. “Just with lads with the stamina.”"

rows.original: “Hmm.” One thick index finger has found your inner thigh, and is stroking up and down as he considers the pair of you. “You gonna come quietly? Or are we gonna do this the hard way.”
rows.translation: “嗯。”他一根粗壮的食指已经摸上你的大腿内侧，一边上下抚摸，一边打量你们两个。“你们要乖乖跟我走？还是要逼我来硬的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm.” One thick index finger has found your inner thigh, and is stroking up and down as he considers the pair of you. “You gonna come quietly? Or are we gonna do this the hard way.”"

rows.original: “Hard way,” the kaithrit shoots back. “Should make sure the big arsehole’s not got soft on us...”
rows.translation: “走硬路，”那凯斯里特回嘴道。“得确认那个大混蛋没对我们软下来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hard way,” the kaithrit shoots back. “Should make sure the big arsehole’s not got soft on us...”"

rows.original: Without another word Ohrskun scrapes his stool back and hefts all seven foot something of her over one shoulder, so that her head is dangling back over his shoulder. The thraggen grunts, then wraps his other warm, meaty arm around your waist, and with one thrust of his legs swings you over the other shoulder. Your stomach swings with glee... you know already he won’t hurt you, he’s just strong enough to do whatever he wants with
rows.translation: 奥尔斯昆没再多说一个字，把凳子往后一刮，把她那七英尺多高的身子整个扛上一侧肩膀，让她的头倒挂在他肩后。这个斯拉根人咕哝一声，然后用另一条温暖粗壮的手臂环住你的腰，双腿一蹬就把你甩到另一侧肩膀上。你的胃欢快地晃荡起来...你已经知道他不会弄伤你，他只是强壮到想对你做什么都行

The thraggen grunts, then wraps his other warm, meaty arm around your waist, and with one thrust of his legs swings you over the other shoulder. rows.original: Let Ramis have her fun; it’s not to your taste. You turn and ascend back to the main dancefloor, determined to wring the last dizzying drops out of the night on your own, and easily drunk enough to do so.
rows.translation: 让拉米斯自己享受吧，这不合你的口味。你转身回到主舞池，决心独自榨尽这个夜晚最后几滴令人眩晕的乐趣；你也醉得足以做到这一点。
rows.raw: "Let Ramis have her fun; it’s not to your taste. You turn and ascend back to the main dancefloor, determined to wring the last dizzying drops out of the night on your own, and easily drunk enough to do so."

rows.original: You’re trying to get the attention of the bartender (even androids are capable of blanking customers, it seems), when someone taps you on the arm. You turn to find yourself confronted with 7 feet of blonde she-cat, beaming at you. Ramis pulls you into a rough hug.
rows.translation: 你正想引起酒保的注意（看来连仿生人也能把顾客当空气），这时有人拍了拍你的手臂。你转过身，迎面是七英尺高的金发母猫，冲你笑得灿烂。拉米斯把你粗暴地拉进一个拥抱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re trying to get the attention of the bartender (even androids are capable of blanking customers, it seems), when someone taps you on the arm. You turn to find yourself confronted with 7 feet of blonde she-cat, beaming at you. Ramis pulls you into a rough hug."

rows.original: “You stayen? Then I’m stayen,” she shouts into your ear. “Sisters before misters. You’re way more fun to be around then some random shag anyway! D’you think this place does champagne? D’you fancy haven a wander after this, cause a bit of mischief?”
rows.translation: “你要留下？那我也留下，”她冲着你耳朵大喊。“姐妹要比男人重要。反正和某个随便找来打一炮的人相比，跟你一起有趣多了！你觉得这里有香槟吗？等结束后想不想四处逛逛，搞点恶作剧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You stayen? Then I’m stayen,” she shouts into your ear. “Sisters before misters. You’re way more fun to be around then some random shag anyway! D’you think this place does champagne? D’you fancy haven a wander after this, cause a bit of mischief?”"

rows.original: She pulls you out onto the dancefloor. Feeling an elated second wind, you join her in throwing shapes that only grow wilder and wilder as the night continues, and you spill out into the space station’s night, on the scan for even more fun.
rows.translation: 她把你拉进舞池。感到兴奋的第二股精力涌来，你和她一起摆出各种舞姿；夜晚继续时，动作也变得越来越狂野。随后你们涌入空间站的夜色，搜寻更多乐趣。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls you out onto the dancefloor. Feeling an elated second wind, you join her in throwing shapes that only grow wilder and wilder as the night continues, and you spill out into the space station’s night, on the scan for even more fun."

rows.original: You’re carrying a couple more mysterious bruises and are definitely hanging, but your body is used to coping with the amount you tied on last night, and you know a solid, stodge-heavy breakfast will cure it.
rows.translation: 你身上又多了几块来历不明的淤青，而且绝对宿醉得厉害，但你的身体已经习惯应付你昨晚灌下去的那个量，你也知道一顿扎实油腻的早餐就能治好它。

rows.original: You moan as your body begins to explain how much it hates you. You feel like you’ve got a simultaneous case of flu and food poisoning, as well as if someone hit you around the [pc.legs] with a baseball bat a few times. The one good piece of news is, as you woozily cast your gaze around you, is that you did somehow manage to get back into your bed aboard your ship last night. Void... trying to keep up with Ramis is not for the faint-hearted.
rows.translation: 身体开始解释它有多么憎恨你，令你发出呻吟。感觉就像同时患上流感与食物中毒，又像有人拿棒球棍在[pc.legs]周围打了好几下。唯一的好消息是：当你昏沉地环顾四周，发现昨晚不知怎么还是成功回到了飞船上的床铺。虚空在上... 想跟上拉米斯可不适合胆小的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou moan as your body begins to explain how much it hates you. You feel like you’ve got a simultaneous case of flu and food poisoning, as well as if someone hit you around the [pc.legs] with a baseball bat a few times. The one good piece of news is, as you woozily cast your gaze around you, is that you did somehow manage to get back into your bed aboard your ship last night. Void... trying to keep up with Ramis is not for the faint-hearted."

rows.original: You wonder momentarily how your semi-tame gunnery officer got on herself - until you hear the faint, hearty strains of that awful spacer song from last night, emanating from her room. Clearly just fine. You sink back into your bed-clothes, wondering if there’s anyone on board you could order to make and bring breakfast up to you.
rows.translation: 你短暂好奇那位半驯服的炮术官自己过得怎样——直到昨晚那首糟糕的太空人歌曲从她房间传来，微弱却精神十足。显然她完全没事。你重新缩进被褥，想着船上是否有人能受你命令做好早餐送来。

rows.original: “Oh man. Here it comes!” sighs Ramis, rolling her eyes. “The manager wanten to get to know you, cuz [pc.he] wants you to think of [pc.him] as more’ve a friend than a boss, y’see.
rows.translation: “哦天。来了来了！”拉米斯叹着气翻了个白眼。“经理想跟你熟络熟络，因为[pc.he]想让你把[pc.him]当朋友，而不只是当老板，你懂吧。

rows.original: As if you didn’t already know the most important things about me, right?” She jerks her hips at you unsubtly. “
rows.translation: 好像你还不知道关于我最重要的那些事似的，对吧？”她毫不含蓄地朝你顶了顶胯。“
rows.raw: "As if you didn’t already know the most important things about me, right?” She jerks her hips at you unsubtly. “"

rows.original: You’ve been on nights out with me mate, you’ve already gotten to know me the best way possible.
rows.translation: 你和我一起出去喝过酒，伙计，已经用最好的方式了解我了。
rows.raw: "You’ve been on nights out with me mate, you’ve already gotten to know me the best way possible. "

rows.original: Alright, tell you what,
rows.translation: 好吧，这样，
rows.raw: "Alright, tell you what, "

rows.original: ...” She gestures at a drink dispenser nearby. It’ll synthesize almost anything, but will have to be recharged when you’re next in port. “...get a bottle of scotch. It’ll make this seem less like a job interview. And you’ll definitely get to hear all of my boren stories once I’ve had a few glasses!”
rows.translation: ...”她指向附近的饮料合成器。它几乎能合成任何东西，但下次停靠港口时必须重新补充。“...弄一瓶苏格兰威士忌来。这样就不太像工作面试了。而且等我喝上几杯，你就绝对能听到我所有无聊故事！”

It’ll make this seem less like a job interview. And you’ll definitely get to hear all of my boren stories once I’ve had a few glasses!”"

rows.original: “You wanna pass the bottle around a bit, get sloppy?” grins Ramis. “Nice. Your ship, your treat, though.”
rows.translation: “想把酒瓶传着喝，喝个烂醉吗？”拉米斯咧嘴一笑。“不错。不过是在你的船上，所以你请客。”
rows.raw: "“You wanna pass the bottle around a bit, get sloppy?” grins Ramis. “Nice. Your ship, your treat, though.”"

rows.original: You ask where she was born.
rows.translation: 你问她出生在哪里。
rows.raw: "You ask where she was born."

rows.original: “Don’t know mate,” the big kaithrit replies. “I’m an orphan. My mum left me on Newydd Casnewydd. Not offended you don’t know it, don’t worry - it’s a Snugglé agriworld. The corporation adopted and raised me. The second name you get is just the batch you were raised in, 29 other people my age out there called Ramis. Because it was Snugglé, if you were a boy your first name was a fruit, if you were a girlee a flower. So my first name is Hyacinth. Which you’re not ever goen to use,” she adds warningly.
rows.translation: “不知道啊，伙计，”这只高大的凯斯里特回答。“我是孤儿。我妈把我丢在纽伊德卡斯纽伊德。你不认识那地方也不冒犯，别担心 - 那是个斯纳格利的农业世界。公司收养了我，把我养大。你得到的第二个名字就是你被养大的那一批，外面还有 29 个跟我同龄的人叫拉米斯。因为那是斯纳格利，男孩的第一个名字是水果，女孩就是花。所以我的第一个名字是海厄辛斯。这名字你永远也不会用，”她带着警告补上一句。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t know mate,” the big kaithrit replies. “I’m an orphan. My mum left me on Newydd Casnewydd. Not offended you don’t know it, don’t worry - it’s a Snugglé agriworld. The corporation adopted and raised me. The second name you get is just the batch you were raised in, 29 other people my age out there called Ramis. Because it was Snugglé, if you were a boy your first name was a fruit, if you were a girlee a flower. So my first name is Hyacinth. Which you’re not ever goen to use,” she adds warningly."

rows.original: You watch her take a pull on her scotch.
rows.translation: 你看着她抿了一口苏格兰威士忌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch her take a pull on her scotch."

rows.original: “It’s quite common in kaithrit territory, y’know. The girls want to do whatever they want with the guys, the [herms|npc|f] get to do whatever they want with anyone, and then the girls want to keep on keepen on, don’t they? Particularly with the Rush on, kaithrit are mad for it. The Roshan Hegemony have a deal with a bunch of mega companies. Soft-claw tax and OHS laws, in exchange for them taken in any littel bundles of joy left on their doorsteps. Works out pretty nice for the corporations: More profit, and a child labor force.”
rows.translation: “在凯斯里特的地盘上这种事挺常见的，你知道吧。姑娘们想对小伙子们做什么就做什么，那些[herms|npc|f]想对谁做什么就做什么，然后姑娘们还想接着一直干下去，不是吗？尤其现在行星开拓潮正盛，凯斯里特对这事儿可是疯得很。罗尚霸权跟一堆巨型公司有笔交易。软爪税和 OHS 法规，换他们收下任何被丢在门口的小小快乐包袱。对各家大公司来说这买卖相当不错：更多利润，还有一支童工劳动力。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s quite common in kaithrit territory, y’know. The girls want to do whatever they want with the guys, the [herms|npc|f] get to do whatever they want with anyone, and then the girls want to keep on keepen on, don’t they? Particularly with the Rush on, kaithrit are mad for it. The Roshan Hegemony have a deal with a bunch of mega companies. Soft-claw tax and OHS laws, in exchange for them taken in any littel bundles of joy left on their doorsteps. Works out pretty nice for the corporations: More profit, and a child labor force.”"

rows.original: You ask what it was like, being raised by a corporation.
rows.translation: 你问起被一家公司养大是什么感觉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what it was like, being raised by a corporation."

rows.original: “Boren,” Ramis says ruminatively, and then laughs. “Really fucken boren. It could’ve been way worse, you hear stuff about the Xenogen and ApoSynthesis orphanages that makes your blood run cold. So thanks for abandoning me on a planet where I just had to pick beans every day between the ages of 6 and 15, mum! They taught us and kept us clean and stuff as well, don’t get me wrong. Also, because I got big fast nobody tried picking on me and my friends after I got to about 12. Could definitely have been worse.
rows.translation: “博伦，”拉米斯若有所思地说，然后笑了。“真他妈的博伦。本来可能糟得多，你听说过异源和阿波合成那些孤儿院的事，能听得你血都凉了。所以多谢你把我丢在一颗星球上，让我从6岁到15岁天天就只用摘豆子，妈！他们也教我们东西，还让我们保持干净什么的，别误会。还有，因为我长得快，我到差不多12岁之后就没人敢找我跟我朋友的麻烦了。确实可能糟得多。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Boren,” Ramis says ruminatively, and then laughs. “Really fucken boren. It could’ve been way worse, you hear stuff about the Xenogen and ApoSynthesis orphanages that makes your blood run cold. So thanks for abandoning me on a planet where I just had to pick beans every day between the ages of 6 and 15, mum! They taught us and kept us clean and stuff as well, don’t get me wrong. Also, because I got big fast nobody tried picking on me and my friends after I got to about 12. Could definitely have been worse."

rows.original: But... y’know.” Ramis taps a claw on the table surface, looking at her glass. “It is difficult when you’re a sprog, if nobody cares. The orphanage’n field staff cared, but they cared in the same way you care about a parcel you’re deliveren, y’know? You’re an item they’re processen through the system. And, once I got big, I had to be the tough one for all the smaller kids. I never... had anyone. I didn’t really know that, think about it as... somethen missen about me, until I met a few people with kids.” She sniffs snottily, before hitting the glass back again.
rows.translation: 但是...你懂的。”拉米斯用一根爪子敲着桌面，望向自己的酒杯。“小时候要是没人在乎你，日子很难熬。孤儿院和田地里的员工确实在乎，可他们那种在乎，就像你在乎手中正在派送的包裹，懂吗？你只是他们通过系统处理的一件物品。等我长大以后，还必须替所有更小的孩子充当那个坚强的人。我从来...没有任何人。直到见过几个有孩子的人，我才真正意识到这一点，才开始把它当成...自己身上缺失的东西。” 她鼻音浓重地吸了吸鼻子，随后再次仰头灌下杯中酒。
