The orphanage’n field staff cared, but they cared in the same way you care about a parcel you’re deliveren, y’know? You’re an item they’re processen through the system. And, once I got big, I had to be the tough one for all the smaller kids. I never... had anyone. I didn’t really know that, think about it as... somethen missen about me, until I met a few people with kids.”\n\nShe sniffs snottily, before hitting the glass back again."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Getten off Newydd Casnewydd was tough,” Ramis says. “Snugglé land you with a bunch of debt once you reach 16, the cost of your upbringing. It’s great bein’ a corporate orphan, you know: the prezzie you get when you become’n adult is a bank statement five figures in the red. It’s part of the whole graft - by that point you’re sort’ve a unique asset to them, somebody young on-site who knows all of their systems instinctively, they want you to stay. So they immediately offer you a job to work off the debt, ‘n then they’ll offer you some more debt so they can sponsor you through higher education... fuck that. Fuck ALL of that.” She bangs her glass down vehemently. “I didn’t care how dirty or dangerous it was, I wanted off that fucken sterile green rock so bad I cried until one of the staff drove me down to the spaceport and left me there. Like my mum, only in reverse.”
rows.translation: “离开纽伊德·卡斯纽伊德可不容易，”拉米斯说道。“你一到16岁，舒适乐就会把一大笔债压到身上，说是养育你的成本。做公司孤儿可真棒，知道吗：成年时收到的礼物，就是一张五位数赤字的银行账单。这是整套套路的一部分 - 到了那时候，你算是他们手里一种独特资产，一个身在当地、凭直觉熟悉所有系统的年轻人，他们想让你留下。所以他们立刻给你一份工作，让你靠工作还债，然后又会给你更多债务，说是资助你接受高等教育...去他妈的。全都去他妈的。”她狠狠将酒杯砸在桌上。“我根本不在乎工作多脏、多危险，只想离开那块他妈毫无生气的绿色石头。我哭得太厉害，最后有个员工开车把我送到太空港，丢下我就走了。就像我妈当年做的，只是反了过来。”

Fuck ALL of that.” She bangs her glass down vehemently. “I didn’t care how dirty or dangerous it was, I wanted off that fucken sterile green rock so bad I cried until one of the staff drove me down to the spaceport and left me there. Like my mum, only in reverse.”"

rows.original: You ask how she proceeded from there.
rows.translation: 你问她后来是怎么继续的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask how she proceeded from there."

rows.original: “With the first vessel who were willen to listen to a broke, pleaden teenager. Bunch of pirates who were there maken a bulk purchase of plonk. Once we were off-world they passed me around a bit, couple of gangbangs when the drink really flowed. I didn’t mind; they sort of made clear from the get go what they umm, saw my ship role as bein’.” She makes a wry face. “They were kind in other ways. Certainly generous with the drink. And I picked up a few things about ships and weapons. Slipped off when we were docked at a big spaceport, and there I signed on with a merc company. Pretenden to be way older and experienced than I was.” She leans back, flexes her arms, and grins. “Bein’ a big wun has its perks.”
rows.translation: “跟着第一艘愿意听一个身无分文、苦苦哀求的少女说话的船走。那是一帮来大批采购廉价酒的海盗。离开星球后，他们把我传着玩了几次，酒喝得真上头时还搞过几场群交。我不介意；他们从一开始就算是说清楚了，呃，他们觉得我在船上该扮演什么角色。”她苦笑了一下。“他们在其他方面对我很好。酒肯定给得大方。我也学到了一些飞船和武器方面的东西。我们停靠在一座大型太空港时，我偷偷溜走，在那里加入了一家雇佣兵公司。假装自己比实际年龄大得多，也更有经验。”她向后靠去，绷起双臂肌肉，咧嘴一笑。“做个大块头还是有好处的。”

rows.original: You ask if she’s paid off what she owed Snugglé.
rows.translation: 你问她欠斯纳格莱的债还清了没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she’s paid off what she owed Snugglé."

rows.original: “Bloody hell, yeah,” the kaithrit replies, shaking her head. “Took the most dangerous and sketchiest work I could, lived in a hotel compartment slightly longer than I am for the best part of 3 years, just so I could afford the payments. No way was I getten some dead-eyed bounty hunter on my tail, draggen me back to that bloody planet-wide farm.”
rows.translation: “他妈的，当然还清了，”凯斯里特摇着头回答。“我接下能找到的最危险、最不靠谱的工作，在一个只比自己身长一点点的旅馆舱室里住了将近整整3年，只为了付得起那些款项。我绝不能让某个眼神空洞的赏金猎人追上来，把我拖回那座他妈覆盖整颗星球的农场。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bloody hell, yeah,” the kaithrit replies, shaking her head. “Took the most dangerous and sketchiest work I could, lived in a hotel compartment slightly longer than I am for the best part of 3 years, just so I could afford the payments. No way was I getten some dead-eyed bounty hunter on my tail, draggen me back to that bloody planet-wide farm.”"

rows.original: She smacks her lips appreciatively as she sips her scotch.
rows.translation: 她啜着威士忌，赞赏地咂了咂嘴。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smacks her lips appreciatively as she sips her scotch."

rows.original: “You know every month when I paid them their pound of flesh, they sent me back a message detailen job opportunities?” she slurs. “Given me updates about where all my old friends were, and how easy it would be to see them again if I just came back? Like, they worked out I was worken as a merc almost straight away, and started senden me stuff about their security division and prison work schemes? Mega-corps fucken hate it when you walk away from them. Hate it, don’t understand it. Once they get their umm, mosquito-nose into you, they expect it to be there for good.” She laughs. “I’d like to load a surface buzzer up with lava missiles, then do exactly what they want, go back to Newydd Casnewydd. If I could do it without hurten anyone, I’d be there in an instant. Sow those fields of beans ‘n adverts ‘n debt with fire. Bloody hell that would be satisfyen!”
rows.translation: “你知道吗，每个月我割肉般把钱交给他们时，他们都会回一条消息，详细介绍工作机会？”她含糊地说道。“还会告诉我以前所有朋友的近况，说只要回去，要再见到他们有多容易？比如，他们几乎立刻就查出我在当雇佣兵，开始给我发安保部门和监狱劳动计划的资料？你离开巨型企业时，他们他妈恨得要死。既痛恨，又无法理解。一旦他们把，呃，蚊子般的长鼻子扎进你身体，就指望它永远留在那里。”她笑了。“我想给一艘地表飞梭装满熔岩导弹，然后完全照他们的要求，回到纽伊德·卡斯纽伊德。要是能不伤到任何人，我立刻就会过去。用烈火播种那些长满豆子、广告和债务的田地。他妈的，那一定爽透了！”

rows.original: She flings her arms out, goes ‘Woosh’ and then laughs even more heartily - until her gaze returns to you and she bites down on it a bit.
rows.translation: 她张开双臂，喊了声‘嗖’，然后笑得更起劲了 - 直到目光重新回到你身上，才稍稍咬住了唇。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe flings her arms out, goes ‘Woosh’ and then laughs even more heartily - until her gaze returns to you and she bites down on it a bit."

rows.original: “Uhh... just somethen to think about, captain. When you’re the owner of that massive minen company of yours, like.”
rows.translation: “呃...只是给你一个考虑方向，船长。等你成了自己那家大型采矿公司的老板之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhh... just somethen to think about, captain. When you’re the owner of that massive minen company of yours, like.”"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You ask about her mercenary career.
rows.translation: 你问起她的雇佣兵生涯。
rows.raw: "You ask about her mercenary career."

rows.original: “You want to hear about some guts’n glory, do you?” Ramis laughs. She swirls her scotch, gazes into the roiling amber. “Hmm. Let me have a think...”
rows.translation: “你想听点血与荣耀的故事，是吧？”拉米斯笑道。她晃了晃威士忌，凝视着杯中翻滚的琥珀色。“嗯。让我想想...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to hear about some guts’n glory, do you?” Ramis laughs. She swirls her scotch, gazes into the roiling amber. “Hmm. Let me have a think...”"

rows.original: “Would you like to hear about my very first mission?” she says. “First mission, they always tell you: take some corpo guard duty. Get signed on to a merchant convoy. The pay’ll be piss, but you’ll learn the ropes, make some mates, get the sense of how bloody boring 90% of the work is. Get yourselve experienced. Me?” She turns her big, gleaming, fanged smile on you. “I joined a joint company expedition, taken out a major pirate base in an unclaimed, uncharted system.”
rows.translation: “想听听我的第一次任务吗？”她说道。“他们说第一次出任务总该先去做点公司警卫工作，签约加入商队护航。报酬少得可怜，但你能学会门道、结交几个伙伴，还能体会这份工作有九成到底有多他妈无聊。先给自己积累点经验。至于我？”她将闪闪发亮、露出獠牙的灿烂笑容转向你。“我加入了一次联合公司远征，前往无人认领、尚未绘入星图的星系，摧毁一座大型海盗基地。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Would you like to hear about my very first mission?” she says. “First mission, they always tell you: take some corpo guard duty. Get signed on to a merchant convoy. The pay’ll be piss, but you’ll learn the ropes, make some mates, get the sense of how bloody boring 90% of the work is. Get yourselve experienced. Me?” She turns her big, gleaming, fanged smile on you. “I joined a joint company expedition, taken out a major pirate base in an unclaimed, uncharted system.”"

rows.original: “The mad lads had built their gaff into a giant asteroid, right in the middle of a belt. They had a custom AI in there which mapped the belt and auto-navigated their ships out of there, bloody impossible to get in or out otherwise. They must’ve thought nobody could get at them - ‘ticularly given the way they spread their raids out, bloody hell. We had to blast our way in with nukes and kinetic cannons, all the while they were firing missiles and laser discharge out in every direction. Bloody amazen light show.”
rows.translation: “那帮疯子把老窝修在一颗巨型小行星里，就在小行星带正中间。他们在里面装了套定制的 AI，能测绘整个带子，自动把他们的船导航出去，不然想进想出根本他妈不可能。他们准以为没人能摸到他们 - 尤其是看他们那种把袭击分散开的搞法，真他妈的。我们只能靠核弹和动能炮轰出一条路进去，而他们一直朝四面八方发射导弹和激光。真他妈好看的一场灯光秀。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The mad lads had built their gaff into a giant asteroid, right in the middle of a belt. They had a custom AI in there which mapped the belt and auto-navigated their ships out of there, bloody impossible to get in or out otherwise. They must’ve thought nobody could get at them - ‘ticularly given the way they spread their raids out, bloody hell. We had to blast our way in with nukes and kinetic cannons, all the while they were firing missiles and laser discharge out in every direction. Bloody amazen light show.”"

rows.original: She pauses, takes a sip.
rows.translation: 她停下来，喝了一口。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses, takes a sip."

rows.original: “The ship to portside of the one I was in took a hit, slap on the bridge, made it lurch toward us. In a panic I shouted at our pilot to boost us forward, which he did - right into a small asteroid. The armor held. No reason it should have. Doing that meant a missile aimed at us missed, hit the other ship instead. No-one on board survived. Well, we got the pirates in the end, brought in most of them alive even. It didn’t feel like much of a victory to me... but the rest of the crew celebrated like it was. I went along with it, and I guess after a few drinks it did.” She shrugs. “Learned a hard lesson that day,
rows.translation: “我们左舷那艘船挨了一炮，正中舰桥，朝我们这边猛地倾来。我慌忙大喊，让飞行员加速前冲，他也照做了 - 结果径直撞上一颗小行星。装甲居然撑住了，根本没有理由能撑住。正因为这么做，一枚瞄准我们的导弹射偏，反而击中了另一艘船。船上无人生还。好吧，我们最终还是拿下了海盗，甚至活捉了大部分人。我感觉这根本算不上胜利...可其他船员却像打赢了一样庆祝。我也跟着他们去了，喝过几杯后，大概真觉得那算是胜利了。”她耸耸肩。“那天我学到了惨痛教训，

rows.original: : You can be as skillful’n experienced as much as you like. Once the shooten starts, whether you survive or not is mostly down to luck. That’s why I live the way I do - in every fucken moment.”
rows.translation: ：无论你多有技巧、多有经验，一旦开火，能不能活下来大多都得看运气。所以我才会像现在这样生活 - 活在每一个他妈的瞬间。”
rows.raw: ": You can be as skillful’n experienced as much as you like. Once the shooten starts, whether you survive or not is mostly down to luck. That’s why I live the way I do - in every fucken moment.”"

rows.original: <i>“My last big mission! Ohh
rows.translation: <i>“我上一次的大任务！哦，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“My last big mission! Ohh "

rows.original: , I lived off’ve that for months!” Ramis cries, eyes gleaming like marbles in the dark. “After you’ve been in the business as long as I have, you get to learn which jobs are bad, ‘n which ones’ll be good, just from who’s payen, how much, and what they DON’T put in the description. This one was posted by a local colonial government - good, not corpos - looken for someone to bust up a slaven ring - good, get to take down real trash - and they DIDN’T ask for a certified company. Which meant that somebody like Black Void was involved, so nobody big’n established was willen to touch it.”
rows.translation: ，我靠那玩意儿过了好几个月！”拉米斯嚷道，眼睛在黑暗里像弹珠一样发亮。“你在这行混得跟我一样久，就能光凭是谁付钱、付多少、还有他们不往描述里写什么，看出哪些活是烂活、哪些活是好活。这一单是本地殖民政府发的，好，不是那些大公司；找人是去端掉一个奴隶团伙，好，能收拾真正的垃圾；而且他们没要求什么有认证的公司。这就说明背后有黑色虚空这类角色掺和，所以有点名头、有根基的人都不肯碰。”

rows.original: Tails lashing, Ramis positions cutlery and glasses on the table, so you can see exactly how things played out. She’s well into this.
rows.translation: 拉米斯甩着尾巴，把餐具和杯子摆到桌上，好让你看清事情到底是怎么发展的。她玩得相当投入。
rows.raw: "\n\nTails lashing, Ramis positions cutlery and glasses on the table, so you can see exactly how things played out. She’s well into this."

rows.original: “I got my best crew together, we scouted that rodenian colony out, and we worked out how things must be goen down - the slavers’d paid off a couple of peeps in the spaceport to look the other way, and then they were snafflen workers and travellers off-world in one unmarked tanker or another. I almost didn’t blame them. Those wee little mice...” she bats a salt-shaker back and forth. “You just want to play with them, y’know?”
rows.translation: “我召集了最精锐的船员，侦察那座罗德尼安殖民地，弄清了事情大概是怎么运作的 - 奴隶贩子收买了太空港里的几个人，让他们睁一只眼闭一只眼，然后用一艘又一艘没有标记的油轮，把工人和旅客偷偷运离星球。我差点都没法怪他们。那些小小的老鼠...”她来回拨弄一只盐瓶。“你就是会想玩弄他们，懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I got my best crew together, we scouted that rodenian colony out, and we worked out how things must be goen down - the slavers’d paid off a couple of peeps in the spaceport to look the other way, and then they were snafflen workers and travellers off-world in one unmarked tanker or another. I almost didn’t blame them. Those wee little mice...” she bats a salt-shaker back and forth. “You just want to play with them, y’know?”"

rows.original: “Anyways. We staked that place out well secretly like, had our ship in low orbit cloaked’n watchen. I was off the sauce the whole time, believe it or not! We caught them in the act - a daynar girlee, a tarratch ‘n a gryvain, done up to the nines and showing off their bits, flashin’ colors, transfixen mice’n then getting at that suggest-y spot they’ve got at the back of their bonces. When I came out with a chain laser cannon, you know what they did? Tried it on with me!” Ramis laughs harshly, banging her glass. “Guess they worked out I’m not into girlees when I atomized the daynar.”
rows.translation: “反正呢。我们把那地方偷偷摸得清清楚楚，飞船隐着形在低轨道上蹲着盯。整个过程我滴酒没沾，信不信由你！我们正好撞见他们干那事儿 - 一个戴纳尔小妞、一个塔拉特，还有一个格里文，打扮得花里胡哨，露着那话儿，闪着颜色，把老鼠都看呆了，然后就去弄她们后脑勺上那个撩人的地儿。我拎着链式激光炮出去的时候，你知道他们干了啥？还想勾搭我！” 拉米斯粗声大笑，把杯子砸得咚咚响。“等我把那戴纳尔轰成原子，他们大概就明白我对小妞没兴趣了。”

When I came out with a chain laser cannon, you know what they did? Tried it on with me!” Ramis laughs harshly, banging her glass. “Guess they worked out I’m not into girlees when I atomized the daynar.”"

rows.original: “The Black Void lot completely lost the plot after that. Half uvvem started shooten up the place, a bunch of them ran into the tanker and scarpered. I left my crew to deal with the ones on the ground, buzzed our pilot to come pick me up, and then we tailed the tanker. Fucken muppets led us straight to their orbital slave pen!”
rows.translation: “黑色虚空那伙人之后彻底乱了阵脚。一半人开始朝四处开火，一群人跑进油轮溜之大吉。我把地面上的人交给船员处理，呼叫飞行员来接我，随后我们一路追踪那艘油轮。那帮他妈的蠢货直接把我们带到了他们的轨道奴隶监狱！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Black Void lot completely lost the plot after that. Half uvvem started shooten up the place, a bunch of them ran into the tanker and scarpered. I left my crew to deal with the ones on the ground, buzzed our pilot to come pick me up, and then we tailed the tanker. Fucken muppets led us straight to their orbital slave pen!”"

rows.original: The kaithrit finger guns the room, swivelling in her seat, taking careful aim with her claws and thumping her arms back with imaginary recoil.
rows.translation: 这个凯斯里特人用手比成枪对着房间四处点射，在座位上转着圈，用爪子仔细瞄准，还让手臂随想象中的后坐力往后一顿。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kaithrit finger guns the room, swivelling in her seat, taking careful aim with her claws and thumping her arms back with imaginary recoil."

rows.original: “They thought they could drive us off with half a dozen plasma launchers. They might’ve done... except if you’re packing that much firepower AND you’ve got a slave grid, your generator is probably overclocked to the bloody max. Just needed to get two clean shots on that to shut the whole station down... then I took out their emplacements, one by one.”
rows.translation: “他们以为半打等离子发射器就能把我们赶走。他们本来或许真能做到...但如果你装了那么多火力，又有一整套奴隶控制网，发电机大概早就超频到他妈的极限了。只要干净利落地命中两炮，就能让整座空间站瘫痪...然后我把他们的炮位一个个端掉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They thought they could drive us off with half a dozen plasma launchers. They might’ve done... except if you’re packing that much firepower AND you’ve got a slave grid, your generator is probably overclocked to the bloody max. Just needed to get two clean shots on that to shut the whole station down... then I took out their emplacements, one by one.”"

rows.original: She beams at you, rosy-cheeked.
rows.translation: 她容光焕发地朝你笑，双颊泛红。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe beams at you, rosy-cheeked."

rows.original: “Bloody amazen result, captain. We got most of the rodenians back, didn’t take one casualty, merked a dozen of the worst scumbags in the galaxy, decked a whole bunch of Void hardware AND got paid premium to do it all. The party we had afterwards!” She swigs her glass of scotch, bangs it down with a sigh. “Course, the Void who surrendered got one guy to carry the can ‘n the rest got off on technicals thanks to their legal department, and they made sure to blacklist me afterwards so I can’t work for any of the major merc companies now even if I wanted to. I’m more’n happy about that.”
rows.translation: “成果他妈漂亮极了，船长。我们救回大部分罗德尼安人，没出现一名伤亡，干掉了银河里十几个最恶心的人渣，摧毁一大批黑色虚空的硬件，而且做完这一切还拿到了最高档报酬。之后那场派对啊！”她大喝一口苏格兰威士忌，叹息着把杯子重重放下。“当然，投降的黑色虚空成员推出一个人背锅，其余人靠法务部门钻技术漏洞脱了身，之后还确保把我列入黑名单，所以现在就算我愿意，也没法给任何大型佣兵公司工作。我对此满意得很。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bloody amazen result, captain. We got most of the rodenians back, didn’t take one casualty, merked a dozen of the worst scumbags in the galaxy, decked a whole bunch of Void hardware AND got paid premium to do it all. The party we had afterwards!” She swigs her glass of scotch, bangs it down with a sigh. “Course, the Void who surrendered got one guy to carry the can ‘n the rest got off on technicals thanks to their legal department, and they made sure to blacklist me afterwards so I can’t work for any of the major merc companies now even if I wanted to. I’m more’n happy about that.”"

rows.original: “After that first bloody mission of mine went tits up, I went in for more safe work for a bit,” Ramis sighs. “Began thinken about all my debt, decided I needed steady work anyway. Supply convoys want merc crews with them on the frontier, no matter how much of a milk run it is - pirates’ve gone crazy in this Rush, so many reports of bad stuff happenen out on remote colonies’n systems. Works out alright for me, cuz then I get paid to just stare at space elevators in a corvette for twenty hours.”
rows.translation: “我的第一次该死任务彻底搞砸后，有段时间我接了些更安全的活，”拉米斯叹道。“我开始考虑自己欠的那些债，觉得无论如何都需要一份稳定工作。边疆的补给船队总想让佣兵小队随行，不管任务多么轻松 - 这场行星开拓潮里，海盗已经彻底疯了，偏远殖民地和星系发生坏事的报告多得数不清。这对我倒也不错，因为我只要坐在护卫舰里盯着太空电梯看上二十个小时，就能拿到报酬。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“After that first bloody mission of mine went tits up, I went in for more safe work for a bit,” Ramis sighs. “Began thinken about all my debt, decided I needed steady work anyway. Supply convoys want merc crews with them on the frontier, no matter how much of a milk run it is - pirates’ve gone crazy in this Rush, so many reports of bad stuff happenen out on remote colonies’n systems. Works out alright for me, cuz then I get paid to just stare at space elevators in a corvette for twenty hours.”"

rows.original: She laughs with an uncharacteristically bitter edge.
rows.translation: 她笑了起来，带着一反常态的苦涩。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs with an uncharacteristically bitter edge."

rows.original: “Took me a while to figure out the two were linked. Merc companies worken with peeps like the Black Void, runnen protection rackets, everyone gets a cut. You don’t get in on that shite until you’ve been worken with one crew or another for a while. I suppose I got too distracted to put two ‘n two together at the time.” She smiles more warmly. “Cuz you get to spend downtime on those distant stations ‘n mining platforms. And my word, are the worken boyos ‘n girlees happy to see anyone new. Oh, we had some amazen parties back then, drunker then I’ve ever been!”
rows.translation: “我过了一阵子才弄明白这两件事彼此有关。佣兵公司和黑色虚空之类的人合作，经营保护费生意，人人都能分一杯羹。你得先跟某支队伍合作一段时间，才有资格参与这种狗屁事。我猜自己当时太容易分心，没能把二加二算明白。”她笑得更加温暖。“因为休息时间可以待在那些遥远的空间站和采矿平台上。我的天，那里的工人男孩和姑娘们可太高兴见到新面孔了。噢，我们那时办过一些棒极了的派对，醉得比我过去任何时候都厉害！”

And my word, are the worken boyos ‘n girlees happy to see anyone new. Oh, we had some amazen parties back then, drunker then I’ve ever been!”"

rows.original: “Spacewalks whilst half-cut, chucken conc grenades into zero grav minen shafts, tryen out the weirdest temporary TF combos we could think of... we were so lucky we didn’t kill ourselves,” the kaithrit reminisces happily, leaning back on her chair. “And, of course, I had the pick of the boyos. I’d have a fit lad on Saturday, a sissy on Sunday, back on board ‘n back to port on Monday, never hear from either again. What a life.” She sips her drink. “If the pay wasn’t so shite, and it wasn’t so bloody boren the rest of the time, I’d probably still be doin’ that.”
rows.translation: “喝得半醉去太空行走，把震荡手榴弹扔进零重力矿井，尝试我们能想到的最奇怪临时变形组合... 我们没把自己玩死真是太幸运了，”凯斯里特人开心地回忆着，向后靠上椅背。“当然，小伙子们也任我挑选。星期六找个健壮帅哥，星期日再来个娘炮；星期一回到船上、返回港口，此后再也不联系他们任何一个。那日子可真快活。”她抿了一口酒。“如果薪水没那么烂，其余时间也没那么他妈无聊，我大概现在还干着那一行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spacewalks whilst half-cut, chucken conc grenades into zero grav minen shafts, tryen out the weirdest temporary TF combos we could think of... we were so lucky we didn’t kill ourselves,” the kaithrit reminisces happily, leaning back on her chair. “And, of course, I had the pick of the boyos. I’d have a fit lad on Saturday, a sissy on Sunday, back on board ‘n back to port on Monday, never hear from either again. What a life.” She sips her drink. “If the pay wasn’t so shite, and it wasn’t so bloody boren the rest of the time, I’d probably still be doin’ that.”"

rows.original: “Every bounty hunter’s got the story of the one that got away,” Ramis declares, yellow pupils now thoroughly dilated. “They’re talken shite, there’s always more’n one, no job involven a dozen secondary school dropouts armed to the teeth goes ezackly smoothly. I’ve got one story I always tell, though... this shipping company operating out of the Nokador Sector sent out an APB for any mercs willen to take down this one pirate who kept raiden their stuff. I normally wouldn’t’ve taken it, bounty hunten’s for mums, but they were offeren an arm’n a leg for a successful capture. Whoever it was must’ve really been taken the piss.”
rows.translation: “每个赏金猎人都会讲一个漏网之鱼的故事，”拉米斯宣称道，黄色瞳孔此刻已经完全放大。“他们都在胡扯，漏网的从来不止一个。让十几个全副武装的中学辍学生一起干活，哪有任务能完全顺利。我倒是总会讲一个故事... 有家在诺卡多尔星区经营的航运公司发布全境通告，征集愿意干掉一个海盗的佣兵，那家伙一直在劫他们的货。我平时根本不会接，赏金猎杀是老妈子才干的活，但他们为成功抓获开出了高得吓人的天价。无论是谁，肯定把他们耍得太过分了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Every bounty hunter’s got the story of the one that got away,” Ramis declares, yellow pupils now thoroughly dilated. “They’re talken shite, there’s always more’n one, no job involven a dozen secondary school dropouts armed to the teeth goes ezackly smoothly. I’ve got one story I always tell, though... this shipping company operating out of the Nokador Sector sent out an APB for any mercs willen to take down this one pirate who kept raiden their stuff. I normally wouldn’t’ve taken it, bounty hunten’s for mums, but they were offeren an arm’n a leg for a successful capture. Whoever it was must’ve really been taken the piss.”"

rows.original: “So there was about twenty’ve us. Cyrilians, cundarians, all sorts, we agreed that whoever got the final shot on this kui-tan piece of work got a third of the bounty, en everyone else would share the rest. Fair craic. We used shippen logs to track her, hunted her down to this knocken shop in a hive city on Sigius VI.” Ramis lowers her voice, getting into her retelling. “Five of us went inside, the rest surrounded the building, dismal fucken place in the lower strata. I s’pose somebody must’ve tipped her off, cuz just as we were about to burst into her room she jumped out of the window bollock naked, the only really good look I got of her was her tail and arse disappearen through the curtains, the pro she had bin with screamen fit to burst.”
rows.translation: “所以我们大约有二十个人。西利里安人、昆达里安人，各种族都有。大家约好，谁给那个奎坦混蛋最后一击，谁就拿三分之一的赏金，其他人平分剩下的。挺公平。我们利用航运记录追踪她，一路追到西吉乌斯六号某座蜂巢都市里的妓院。”拉米斯压低声音，渐渐投入复述。“我们五个人进去，其余人包围大楼；那是下层区一个他妈阴沉的破地方。我猜肯定有人给她通风报信，因为就在我们准备闯进房间时，她一丝不挂地跳出了窗户。我唯一真正看清的，只有她的尾巴和屁股穿过窗帘消失，而刚和她干过的性工作者叫得几乎要爆炸。”

We used shippen logs to track her, hunted her down to this knocken shop in a hive city on Sigius VI.” Ramis lowers her voice, getting into her retelling. “Five of us went inside, the rest surrounded the building, dismal fucken place in the lower strata. I s’pose somebody must’ve tipped her off, cuz just as we were about to burst into her room she jumped out of the window bollock naked, the only really good look I got of her was her tail and arse disappearen through the curtains, the pro she had bin with screamen fit to burst.”"

rows.original: The kaithrit guffaws, spilling her drink as her muscles wriggle, reliving the chase. “She got past the boys we posted outside somehow, don’t ask me how, and we wound up chasen that stark naked little slag across half the lower levels of the hive. Best fun I’ve ever had on a job, bloody hell, how did she do it? Jumpen across buildens, snatchen onto auto-trams and then button-hooken into sub-tunnels, all with that ridiculass willy of hers wagglen everywhere like an elephant’s trunk!”
rows.translation: 那个凯斯里特放声大笑，肌肉随着笑声颤动，饮料也洒了出来，仿佛重新经历着那场追逐。“她不知怎么就突破了我们部署在外面的那些小伙子，别问我怎么办到的；最后我们追着那个一丝不挂的小骚货，跑遍了蜂巢下层的近一半区域。这是我工作时经历过最有趣的事；该死，她究竟是怎么办到的？在楼宇之间纵跃、抓住自动有轨车，又突然拐进地下隧道；她那根荒唐的鸡巴像大象鼻子一样到处晃荡，全程就这么跑！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kaithrit guffaws, spilling her drink as her muscles wriggle, reliving the chase. “She got past the boys we posted outside somehow, don’t ask me how, and we wound up chasen that stark naked little slag across half the lower levels of the hive. Best fun I’ve ever had on a job, bloody hell, how did she do it? Jumpen across buildens, snatchen onto auto-trams and then button-hooken into sub-tunnels, all with that ridiculass willy of hers wagglen everywhere like an elephant’s trunk!”"

rows.original: She mimics the movement with her forearm, laughing, before framing the situation firmly in front of her face as soberly as she can.
rows.translation: 她用前臂模仿那种晃动，笑了起来，随后尽力摆出严肃神情，继续清楚交代当时的局面。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe mimics the movement with her forearm, laughing, before framing the situation firmly in front of her face as soberly as she can."

rows.original: “So. Me’n the rest, we got our heads together, sent people ahead, eventually cornered her in a warehouse right on the very wall of that filthy hive. There was no way she was getten out this time, it was deserted for yards all around, and we really had it bare surrounded this time. We combed it, nice’n methodical, floor by floor. We knew she’d be in the cellar. We were ready for a real fight.”
rows.translation: “然后，我和其他人凑在一起商量，派人赶到前面，最后把她堵在那座肮脏蜂巢最外围的一间仓库里。这次她绝不可能逃掉，周围好几码都荒无人烟，而且我们这回真的把那里围了个水泄不通。我们一层一层，仔细而有条不紊地搜查。我们知道她会在地下室里。我们已经做好了迎接一场恶战的准备。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So. Me’n the rest, we got our heads together, sent people ahead, eventually cornered her in a warehouse right on the very wall of that filthy hive. There was no way she was getten out this time, it was deserted for yards all around, and we really had it bare surrounded this time. We combed it, nice’n methodical, floor by floor. We knew she’d be in the cellar. We were ready for a real fight.”"

rows.original: She leaves you hanging for a few seconds, swirling her scotch.
rows.translation: 她把你晾在那儿几秒钟，晃着手里的威士忌。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leaves you hanging for a few seconds, swirling her scotch."

rows.original: “Nobhead wasn’t in there, was she? Worked out eventually she’d wriggled her way right out of the city through a sewer pipe. Two feet wide and almost a mile long it was, so caked in filth we didn’t even spot it until it was too late. Un-fucken-believable.” She takes a big gulp, shaking her head with a wry grin after she’s swallowed down the burning liquid. “We did put the wind up her enough to stop raiden that sector, so after a lot of wranglen we did get the company to stump up half of the bounty. Which shared around twenty bods was roughly nothen.”
rows.translation: “那个蠢货不在里头吧？后来才琢磨出来，她硬是从下水道管子里挤出城去了。两英尺宽，快一英里长，脏得糊了一层，我们直到太晚才发现。真他妈难以置信。”她灌了一大口，把那口灼人的烈酒咽下去之后摇着头，露出一个苦笑。“我们确实把她吓得够呛，让她那边停了劫掠那个星区，所以扯皮了好一阵，总算让公司掏出了一半赏金。二十来号人一分，基本等于啥也没有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nobhead wasn’t in there, was she? Worked out eventually she’d wriggled her way right out of the city through a sewer pipe. Two feet wide and almost a mile long it was, so caked in filth we didn’t even spot it until it was too late. Un-fucken-believable.” She takes a big gulp, shaking her head with a wry grin after she’s swallowed down the burning liquid. “We did put the wind up her enough to stop raiden that sector, so after a lot of wranglen we did get the company to stump up half of the bounty. Which shared around twenty bods was roughly nothen.”"

rows.original: Ramis taps her empty glass wistfully.
rows.translation: 拉米斯怅然地敲了敲空酒杯。
rows.raw: "\n\nRamis taps her empty glass wistfully."

rows.original: “I’d love to get another go at punchen that kui-tan’s ticket, whoever she was. Not cuz I resent her or anythen. Just chasen her was one of the funnest things I’ve ever done.”
rows.translation: “我真想再来一回，给那个奎坦的票打个孔，管她是谁。倒不是我跟她有仇。光是追她，就已经是我干过最带劲的事儿了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d love to get another go at punchen that kui-tan’s ticket, whoever she was. Not cuz I resent her or anythen. Just chasen her was one of the funnest things I’ve ever done.”"

rows.original: “Hmm.” Ramis twists her glass round and around, her yellow eyes on the glittering crystal and booze. She’s good and drunk now, and you sense a secret inside her beginning to yaw open, like a gate off the latch. “Did I ever tell you I used to work for SagiTom,
rows.translation: “嗯。”拉米斯把酒杯转来转去，黄色双眼盯着闪亮的水晶杯和杯中酒液。她现在醉得厉害，你感觉她内心的一桩秘密正开始缓缓敞开，如同一道脱开门闩的门。“我有没有告诉过你，我以前在萨吉托姆工作，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm.” Ramis twists her glass round and around, her yellow eyes on the glittering crystal and booze. She’s good and drunk now, and you sense a secret inside her beginning to yaw open, like a gate off the latch. “Did I ever tell you I used to work for SagiTom, "

rows.original: SagiTom
rows.raw: "SagiTom"

rows.original: You nod at her to continue.
rows.translation: 你朝她点头，示意她继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod at her to continue."

rows.original: “SagiTom?”
rows.translation: “萨吉托姆？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“SagiTom?”"

rows.original: “They’re a mercenary group, one of the best - or dead professional, anyway,” Ramis says. “They don’t let just any random spod join, you’ve got to have years of work behind you, and even then they vet you very carefully. I was dead chuffed when I was approached. I thought I was finally maken my way in the work.”
rows.translation: “他们是一支佣兵团，是最顶尖的几支之一，至少专业得要命，”拉米斯说道。“他们可不会随便让哪个蠢货加入；你必须有多年的工作经验，即便如此，他们还是会非常仔细地审查你。他们找上我时，我高兴坏了。我以为自己终于要在这一行里闯出名堂了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They’re a mercenary group, one of the best - or dead professional, anyway,” Ramis says. “They don’t let just any random spod join, you’ve got to have years of work behind you, and even then they vet you very carefully. I was dead chuffed when I was approached. I thought I was finally maken my way in the work.”"

rows.original: She flexes out all the claws in one hand, examining them silently. For a few moments you think she’s not going to continue.
rows.translation: 她伸出一只手里所有的爪子，默默地端详着。有那么一会儿，你以为她不打算继续说下去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe flexes out all the claws in one hand, examining them silently. For a few moments you think she’s not going to continue."

rows.original: “My first mission was to deal with these terrorists who were targeten a synth template plant on some core world. I suppose that should’ve been my warnen - what kind’ve terrorists target corpos? But the whole operation was so slick and well-organized, we all knew exactly what our roles were, the tech we had so bang new it seemed impossible anythen would go wrong. Some of the officers, the serious business ones with the tats and implants, they had secondary orders us grunts didn’t get to know - you’d see them in tactical after we’d finished goen over stuff after we’d finished - but in the moment, you know, that just impressed me. Like, it was such a carefully arranged plan there were moven parts that us soldiers didn’t have to think about, right?”
rows.translation: “我的第一次任务，是去对付一群以某个核心世界的合成人模板工厂为目标的恐怖分子。我想那本该是给我的警告：什么样的恐怖分子会把企业当成目标？但整个行动太利落、太有条理了；我们所有人都确切知道自己的职责，配发的技术装备又新得惊人，仿佛绝不可能出任何差错。有些军官，也就是那些身上有纹身和植入体、严肃办事的家伙，还接到了我们这些小兵无权知晓的次要命令。每次我们把该讲的事情讲完后，你都会在战术室里看到他们继续处理那些命令。不过在当时，你懂的，这只让我觉得很厉害。就好像这是个安排得极其周密的计划，里面还有我们这些士兵根本不用操心的活动部件，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My first mission was to deal with these terrorists who were targeten a synth template plant on some core world. I suppose that should’ve been my warnen - what kind’ve terrorists target corpos? But the whole operation was so slick and well-organized, we all knew exactly what our roles were, the tech we had so bang new it seemed impossible anythen would go wrong. Some of the officers, the serious business ones with the tats and implants, they had secondary orders us grunts didn’t get to know - you’d see them in tactical after we’d finished goen over stuff after we’d finished - but in the moment, you know, that just impressed me. Like, it was such a carefully arranged plan there were moven parts that us soldiers didn’t have to think about, right?”"

rows.original: “So we get to that sodden planet, we come in on our lander, we’re all done up in our fancy armor and our heads-up feeden us everything, all of us primed like nades in the tube, the doors open and...” Ramis swings her fist slowly through the air, opens it with a poof of her cheeks. “It ent terrorists. It’s a protest. Street filled right back with people, all ages, all races, homemade placards, holo-boomers en the lot. Corny handpainted slogans on their signs about not wanten their world taken over by ApoSynthesis, color drainen from all their faces as they looked at us. And then we piled into them.”
rows.translation: “于是我们抵达那个湿漉漉的星球，乘登陆艇进入；所有人都穿着漂亮的装甲，抬头显示器不断把一切信息传给我们，个个蓄势待发，像发射管里的手榴弹。舱门打开，然后...”拉米斯缓缓挥拳划过空中，双颊噗地鼓起，同时摊开拳头。“根本没有什么恐怖分子。那是一场抗议。街道上挤满了人，男女老少、各种种族都有，还有自制标语牌、全息扩音器，什么都有。牌子上写着俗气的手绘标语，说他们不希望自己的世界被阿波合成接管；他们看见我们时，脸上的血色全都褪去了。接着，我们冲进了人群。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So we get to that sodden planet, we come in on our lander, we’re all done up in our fancy armor and our heads-up feeden us everything, all of us primed like nades in the tube, the doors open and...” Ramis swings her fist slowly through the air, opens it with a poof of her cheeks. “It ent terrorists. It’s a protest. Street filled right back with people, all ages, all races, homemade placards, holo-boomers en the lot. Corny handpainted slogans on their signs about not wanten their world taken over by ApoSynthesis, color drainen from all their faces as they looked at us. And then we piled into them.”"

rows.original: Ramis drains the whole glass in one gulp. Drink pours in, words pour out.
rows.translation: 拉米斯一口喝光整杯酒。酒液灌了进去，话语也倾泻而出。
rows.raw: "\n\nRamis drains the whole glass in one gulp. Drink pours in, words pour out."

rows.original: “I don’t know why I didn’t - we were told there were goen to be civilians in the vicinity en to remain calm, but not specifically... but what did I do? I did my job. Whole thing went like clockwork, slick machine, like we’d practiced. Like I wanted it to. Beaten back mobs of screamen, frightened people, some fallen over and breaken bones, formen that cordon of kinetic shields so the secondary crew could ‘neutralise the terrorists’.” She bitterly air-quotes with two pairs of claws. “The protest organizers en union reps. Think I heard one of them ask about their rights before she got beaten to the ground. I didn’t even see what happened to ‘em - there was a second lander, the one the higher ups came in, and that’s the one the organizers were taken off in.”
rows.translation: “我不知道自己当时为什么没有停下来；我们确实被告知附近会有平民，要保持冷静，可没有明确说明... 但我做了什么？我完成了自己的工作。一切像钟表般精准运转，像台流畅的机器，就跟演练时一样。就像我希望的那样。我们击退一群群尖叫、惊恐的人，有些人跌倒摔断了骨头；我们组成动能护盾封锁线，让后续小队可以‘清除恐怖分子’。”她用两对爪子苦涩地在空中比出引号。“那些人其实是抗议组织者和工会代表。我好像听见其中一个人在被打倒前问起自己的权利。我甚至没看见他们后来遭遇了什么；还有第二艘登陆艇，是高层乘坐的那一艘，组织者就是被那艘船带走的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know why I didn’t - we were told there were goen to be civilians in the vicinity en to remain calm, but not specifically... but what did I do? I did my job. Whole thing went like clockwork, slick machine, like we’d practiced. Like I wanted it to. Beaten back mobs of screamen, frightened people, some fallen over and breaken bones, formen that cordon of kinetic shields so the secondary crew could ‘neutralise the terrorists’.” She bitterly air-quotes with two pairs of claws. “The protest organizers en union reps. Think I heard one of them ask about their rights before she got beaten to the ground. I didn’t even see what happened to ‘em - there was a second lander, the one the higher ups came in, and that’s the one the organizers were taken off in.”"

rows.original: She stares into the middle distance, tails lashing.
rows.translation: 她凝视着远处的虚空，双尾猛烈甩动。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stares into the middle distance, tails lashing."

rows.original: “And the whole time I was doin’ it, beneath the ‘stay calm, keep focused, stay calm’ beaten through my mind, I was thinken about how much I hated Snugglé. All the shite they do, the way they do just take over planets and give two fingers to anyone on them who doesn’t happen to like it. How I’d done everythen possible not to just become one of their drones, taken a nice pay-packet and not thinken about where it came from. And... there I was. Breaken up an anti-corpo demonstration, breaken students’ teeth. Bloody hell, I got a fucken commendation for it.” She spits the word. “Operation scored 98% in the evaluation, all of us wet-behind-the-ears got a clap on the back and a small bonus. I went to the trouble of looken up the extranet reports of what’d happened. ‘Police Forced Into Action After Extremists Instigate Riot’. Fuck me.”
rows.translation: “而我做这一切的时候，在脑海里反复敲打着的‘保持冷静、集中注意、保持冷静’之下，我一直在想自己有多么憎恨舒适乐。我憎恨他们干的所有破事，憎恨他们直接接管星球、对星球上所有不喜欢这种做法的人竖起两根手指的态度。我明明已经竭尽全力，避免变成他们的又一架无人机，领着丰厚薪水，却不去想钱是从哪里来的。可是... 我还是站在了那里。驱散一场反企业示威，打掉学生的牙齿。该死，我他妈居然还因此得到了一次嘉奖。”她咬牙吐出那个词。“行动在评估中得了98%，我们这群乳臭未干的新人都得到一句表扬和一小笔奖金。我特地去查了关于事件经过的星网报道。‘极端分子煽动骚乱，警方被迫采取行动’。操他妈的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And the whole time I was doin’ it, beneath the ‘stay calm, keep focused, stay calm’ beaten through my mind, I was thinken about how much I hated Snugglé. All the shite they do, the way they do just take over planets and give two fingers to anyone on them who doesn’t happen to like it. How I’d done everythen possible not to just become one of their drones, taken a nice pay-packet and not thinken about where it came from. And... there I was. Breaken up an anti-corpo demonstration, breaken students’ teeth. Bloody hell, I got a fucken commendation for it.” She spits the word. “Operation scored 98% in the evaluation, all of us wet-behind-the-ears got a clap on the back and a small bonus. I went to the trouble of looken up the extranet reports of what’d happened. ‘Police Forced Into Action After Extremists Instigate Riot’. Fuck me.”"

rows.original: “I’m guessing you stopped working for SagiTom,” you say.
rows.translation: “我猜你已经不再替萨吉托姆干活了，”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m guessing you stopped working for SagiTom,” you say."

rows.original: <i>“Ooh, you’re a quick one, aren’t you
rows.translation: <i>“哦，你倒是挺快的，不是吗
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ooh, you’re a quick one, aren’t you "

rows.original: ?” the big kaithrit replies, a glimmer of good humor returning to her ruddy complexion. “I worked out afterwards that them droppen you into stuff like that as your first mission is ackshullee the last part of their vetten process. Maybe you got the stats but not the mindset, right? Well - I definitely didn’t. I quit the very next day. Been an indie ever since. Doesn’t pay anywhere near as well, but I’m not in it for the money anymore. And it does mean that sometimes...” She spreads her arms, indicating the room and you, grinning toothily. “...you happen on really magic gigs.”
rows.translation: ？” 高大的凯斯里特答道，她那红润的脸上又浮起一丝好心情。“我后来才弄明白，他们把你丢进那种烂摊子当第一个任务，其实正是他们考察流程的最后一步。也许你的数据够了，但心态不够，对吧？嗯，我肯定是不够。第二天我就辞了。从那以后一直单干。钱远没有那么多，但我不再是为钱干这行了。而且这也意味着，有时候...”她张开双臂，指了指这个房间和你，露齿一笑。“...能碰上真正神奇的好活。”

Maybe you got the stats but not the mindset, right? Well - I definitely didn’t. I quit the very next day. Been an indie ever since. Doesn’t pay anywhere near as well, but I’m not in it for the money anymore. And it does mean that sometimes...” She spreads her arms, indicating the room and you, grinning toothily. “...you happen on really magic gigs.”"

rows.original: You grin back, and click your glass into hers.
rows.translation: 你回以一笑，把杯子碰向她的杯子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grin back, and click your glass into hers."

rows.original: SagiTom
rows.raw: "SagiTom"

rows.original: Ramis is so drunk she only manages to mumble something about you notifying the developers about an error in her talk scenes. Maybe you should please do that.
rows.translation: 拉米斯醉得厉害，只勉强嘟囔了几句，大意是让你把她对话场景里的一个错误报告给开发者。 也许你真该照做。
rows.raw: " Ramis is so drunk she only manages to mumble something about you notifying the developers about an error in her talk scenes. Maybe you should please do that."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You ask what she enjoys doing the most.
rows.translation: 你问她最喜欢做什么。
rows.raw: "You ask what she enjoys doing the most."

rows.original: “You, mostly,” she replies with a big grin. You roll your eyes; you should have seen that coming. “It’s great to be worken on a ship where I can get my teeth into a mincen little sissy whenever I want. And most home boyos only let me do it to them once! You’re the best boss I ever had, Steele.”
rows.translation: “主要就是你，”她咧嘴一笑。你翻了个白眼，早该料到。“在一条船上干活真爽，我想什么时候啃一口那个扭扭捏捏的小伪娘都行。而且老家那帮小子大多只让我干他们一次！你是我有过的最好的老板，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You, mostly,” she replies with a big grin. You roll your eyes; you should have seen that coming. “It’s great to be worken on a ship where I can get my teeth into a mincen little sissy whenever I want. And most home boyos only let me do it to them once! You’re the best boss I ever had, Steele.”"

rows.original: “You, mostly,” she replies with a big grin. You roll your eyes; you should have seen that coming. “Most guys talk a good game, but’d rather hide in the bogs then take me on. So all I get are kui-tan girls tryen their luck, cuz they think they can shag anythen! You, though: you do it like you mean it. Then you’re just a mate afterwards. You’re the best boss I ever had, Steele.”
rows.translation: “主要是你，”她咧嘴大笑着回答。你翻了个白眼，早该料到她会这么说。“大多数男人嘴上吹得厉害，真要对付我时却宁可躲进厕所。所以我遇到的全是想碰碰运气的奎坦姑娘，因为她们觉得自己谁都能操！可你不一样：你干起来是真心实意。干完以后又只是个朋友。你是我遇过最棒的老板，斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You, mostly,” she replies with a big grin. You roll your eyes; you should have seen that coming. “Most guys talk a good game, but’d rather hide in the bogs then take me on. So all I get are kui-tan girls tryen their luck, cuz they think they can shag anythen! You, though: you do it like you mean it. Then you’re just a mate afterwards. You’re the best boss I ever had, Steele.”"

rows.original: She sips her scotch and thinks about it for a bit.
rows.translation: 她抿了一口苏格兰威士忌，思索了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sips her scotch and thinks about it for a bit."

rows.original: “I dunno, it’s all kind’ve the same thing to me,” she replies. “I work out so I have enough energy’n strength to do my job but also really go to town when I’m in port, and I do that so I ent sad when I sign on for a dangerous mission. No regrets, see? If my AVP gets hit by a remote plasma det in some armpit of a warzone, or the fly boy doesn’t carry the one and FTLs our bird into an asteroid, it’ll be fine. I’ll have lived the life I wanted to live, seen bloody loads, not leave anythen behind except a great fucken body. Not bad for an orphan who started with less then nothen.”
rows.translation: “我说不好，对我来说这些都差不多是一回事，”她回答。“我锻炼是为了有足够的体力和力气干活，也是为了回港的时候能好好疯一场；我这么做，是为了接危险任务时不会难过。没有遗憾，懂吗？要是我的AVP在某个鬼地方的战区被遥控等离子炸药打中，或者那个飞行员没算对进位，直接超光速把我们的船开进小行星，那也没关系。我活过我想活的日子，见过大把血光，除了这副好得要命的身子，什么都不会留下。对一个一开始什么都没有的孤儿来说，不算差了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I dunno, it’s all kind’ve the same thing to me,” she replies. “I work out so I have enough energy’n strength to do my job but also really go to town when I’m in port, and I do that so I ent sad when I sign on for a dangerous mission. No regrets, see? If my AVP gets hit by a remote plasma det in some armpit of a warzone, or the fly boy doesn’t carry the one and FTLs our bird into an asteroid, it’ll be fine. I’ll have lived the life I wanted to live, seen bloody loads, not leave anythen behind except a great fucken body. Not bad for an orphan who started with less then nothen.”"

rows.original: The life of an itinerant frontiersperson has its moments, but you also know it isn’t exactly sustainable. It’s not as if you can’t still have fun, is it? As best you can with the amount of scotch currently circulating your system, you put all of that to Ramis.
rows.translation: 流动拓荒者的生活有它的精彩时刻，但你也清楚这并不算长久之计。你在外面见得够多了，知道自己有这份遗产是极其幸运的，而且你绝对打算照维克托的意愿接过家里的生意。这又不是说你从此就不能玩了，对吧？趁着现在血液里还转着那么多威士忌，你尽可能清楚地把这些想法都讲给了拉米斯。

rows.original: You’ve known this quest was total nonsense, right from the start. What could surviving out here on the frontier possibly teach you about running a mega corporation like Steele Tech? Frankly, the only reason you’re doing it is to stop your rotten cousin from grabbing it - and to hang on to some of the most valuable assets Victor left you, like the incredible nursery and hangar on Tavros. Once you’ve succeeded, you fully intend to immediately step down as CEO, then carry on the exciting, fulfilling, sexy life you’ve found for yourself out here.
rows.translation: 从一开始，你就知道这场任务完全是胡闹。生活在边境并幸存下来，究竟能教会你什么有关经营斯蒂尔科技这种巨型企业的知识？坦白说，你这么做的唯一原因，是阻止那个混蛋堂亲夺走公司，同时保住维克托留给你的一些最宝贵资产，例如塔夫罗斯站那间不可思议的育儿室与机库。成功以后，你完全打算立刻辞去首席执行官职务，然后继续自己在外面找到的这段刺激、充实而性感的生活。

rows.translation: 你让萨姆聊聊她自己。 [sam.trustRange 0 25 75 |“好吧，当然可以，”她轻声说道。“我喜欢电脑和网络。我觉得自己还挺擅长这些的。我组装过很多电脑，也维护过服务器。我玩过许多不同的电子游戏，还喜欢试探自己能把黑客手段玩到什么地步，直到那些版主想出办法封禁我。”萨姆微微摇着尾巴，看起来颇为自豪。 “以前没怎么看电视，不过如今我确实有的是时间。书也是我多年来一直想补，却始终没能抽空读的东西，所以我想，这算是整件‘成为你的囚犯’之事的一线好处吧。”她若有所思地用手指梳过尾毛，努力想着还有什么可说。“我会尽量锻炼，基本上只做有氧运动。我喜欢把别人耍得团团转，不管是在现实里还是网上。关于我差不多就这些。作为一名前黑色虚空黑客，恐怕我并没有那么有趣。”萨姆难为情地挠了挠后脑勺。 你感谢她与你分享这些私人信息。 “随时都行吧。反正我也没别的事可做...”金发技师郁郁寡欢地低头看着地板。 |“好吧，所以你只是想多了解我一点？这倒挺合理。”萨姆对你温柔一笑，犬尾缓缓摇动。“能重新接触电脑，我真的很开心。爪子摸不到电脑时，我总觉得自己不完整。我一直在祸害以前玩过的那些老游戏社区。没有哪个版主或管理员能阻止我的自动瞄准外挂！”这名深色皮肤的黑客双手合拢，伸出食指和拇指，模仿开枪的动作，然后顽皮地咧嘴一笑。“哦，我还发现了一款很有意思的文字游戏，叫‘黯淡群星中的磨难’，让我总忍不住一玩再玩。除此以外，我最近只是在收集一些，呃，‘床上娱乐’用的装备——你懂我的意思吧。” 你[pc.isBimbo | 困惑地看了萨姆一会儿，完全没明白她是什么意思。她说的是做爱吗？那她为什么不直说呢？可她一点提示也不给你，所以你只是 ]听到这个消息后咧嘴一笑，自己也有点兴奋。萨姆见你如此反应，微微脸红，然后继续说下去。 “嗯，主要是我很高兴自己又有事可做了。看电视和读书也还不错，但我对那些事并没有多少热情，你懂吧？” 得知你的犬族囚犯适应得很好，你很欣慰。你感谢她抽出时间。 “随时都行，[pc.name]，”她微微一笑说道。 |“到现在你还不了解我的一切吗？”萨姆问道，毛茸茸的尾巴飞快摇摆，脸上挂着顽皮的笑容。<>“我想我终究还是挺有趣的，对吧？不过我最近没发生多少新鲜事。飞船的网络和硬件一直运转得非常完美。我还在一些地方做了改进，并修补了所有能找到的网络安全漏洞。”她显然十分自豪，满面笑容地解释着。“我正考虑为游戏‘黯淡群星中的磨难’写点代码。我发现他们几乎总有多到做不完的内容要加入游戏，所以现在我也想回馈一下。除此以外，我如今差不多已经备齐了所有想要的束缚用具。你要是想在我身上用几件，只管告诉我，好吗？”萨姆向你抛了个挑逗的媚眼。 你感谢她抽出时间，并告诉她你一定会考虑她的提议。 “我可记住你这句话了，[pc.name]！”她说道，尾巴高兴得摇成一片模糊的影子。 ]
rows.raw: " You ask Sam to tell you about herself. [sam.trustRange 0 25 75 |“Alright, sure,” she says softly. “I like computers and networks. I’m pretty good with them, I think. I’ve built a lot of computers, and I used to maintain servers too. I played a lot of different video games, and I liked to see how far I could push the hacking before the mods figured out how to ban me.” Sam wags her tail a bit, looking fairly proud of herself. “Didn’t really watch much TV before now, but I’ve sure got the time these days. Books are something I’ve been meaning to catch up on for years, but never got around to, so I guess that’s a silver lining to this whole ‘being your prisoner’ gig.” She runs her fingers through her tail fur thoughtfully, trying to come up with anything else to say. “I exercise all that I can; pretty much nothing but cardio. I love being able to run circles around people, in real life, or on the net. That’s about it for me. I’m afraid I’m not all that interesting for a former Black Void hacker.” Sam scratches the back of her head sheepishly. You thank her for sharing some personal information with you. “Anytime, I guess. I’ve got nothing better to do...” the blonde techie looks down at the floor morosely. |“Okay, so you just wanted to hear more about me? Seems reasonable.” Sam smiles softly at you and wags her canine tail slowly. “I’m really happy to be able to work with computers again. I didn’t really feel whole without my claws on one. I’ve been terrorizing all the old gaming communities I used to play in. No mod or admin can stop my aimbots!” The dark-skinned hacker puts her hands together with her index fingers and thumbs extended, pantomiming firing a gun before grinning cheekily. “Oh, I also found this neat little text game called ‘Tribulations in Tarnished Stars’ that I just keep coming back to. Other than that, I’ve just been gathering the gear for some uh, ‘bedroom fun,’ if you know what I mean.” You[pc.isBimbo | look at Sam in confusion for a moment, like, totally at a loss as to what she means. Did she mean sex? Why wouldn’t she just say that then? She’s not giving you even a hint though, so you just ] grin at that news, feeling a little excited yourself. Sam blushes a bit at your reaction before moving on. “Um, mostly I’m just happy to have something to do again. Watching TV and reading was nice enough, but I’m not really passionate about those things, you know?” You’re glad to hear that your canine convict is adjusting nicely. You thank her for her time. “Anytime, [pc.name],” she says with a slight grin. |“Don’t you know all about me by now?” Sam asks, wagging her fluffy tail rapidly with an impish smile. <>“I guess I am pretty interesting after all, huh? Well, there’s not too much new going on with me. Everything’s been just perfect with the ship’s network and hardware. I’ve even made some improvements here and there, and fixed up all the gaps I could find in the cyber security.” She beams in obvious pride as she explains herself. “I’m considering doing some coding for the game ‘Tribulations in Tarnished Stars’. I found out they’re practically always overwhelmed with things to add to the game, and I’d like to give back to it at this point. Other than that, I’ve got pretty much all the bondage gear I could ask for by now. If you ever want to use some of it on me, just let me know, okay?” Sam shoots you a flirtatious wink. You thank her for her time, telling her you’ll definitely consider her offer. “I’ll hold you to that, [pc.name]!” she says as she wags her tail in a happy blur. ] "

rows.original: You ask Sam how she’s feeling now that she’s out of prison. [sam.trustRange 0 25 75 |The petite ausar stares at you questioningly, likely trying to discern if you really do want her to tell you the truth. When she finally speaks, her tone is meek and guarded. “It’s nice not to have to watch my back as much, but...” she trails off, looking afraid to speak her mind. You [pc.nmh |kindly assure her that you do want to hear her real thoughts. |jokingly ask her if the cat’s got her tongue. |bark at her to spit it out. ] The venom dripping from her answer takes you by surprise, given how meek she was just a moment ago. “It feels almost exactly the same. I’m still a prisoner here. The only benefit is that there are fewer people I have to watch my back around!” Sam immediately braces herself, as if she expects some sort of punishment for speaking to you in this way. You’re momentarily taken aback, but you find your tongue again quickly. You thank Sam for her forthright answer, and assure her that she can always be honest with you, even if you won’t like what she has to say. It’s the ausar’s turn to be taken aback. She blinks at you in surprise, then the anger melts away from her face and the tension leaves her body. “Thank you...” she mutters, almost a whisper. You smile awkwardly at Sam and tell her to think nothing of it. Maybe if you ask her again tomorrow she might open up more. |She cracks a small smile and perks her tail up slightly when she hears your question. “I think I like it here. It’s nice to be able to do something productive again, and I feel like I can let my guard down some now.[yammi.isCrew | Your cook also makes way better food than Gastigoth served. Even the stuff in the breeding program wasn’t as tasty. ]” You thank Sam for her time. The ausar wags her tail gently. “You’re welcome, [pc.name].” |The petite former pirate smiles broadly and wags her tail rapidly at your question, answering you before she can even open her mouth. She confirms what her body language is telling you in a joyful tone, “I’m really, truly happy now, for the first time in years.[crewRange 3 | I’ve gotten to meet so many kind people. I never thought anyone could be so nice to me without having a reason. ] I’m so glad I ended up here.” So much of Sam’s apprehension and fear is gone. She really does look happy with her lot in life now. You thank her for her time, and tell her you’re glad she’s enjoying herself. “No, thank you, [pc.name]. I’d still be miserable in prison right now if it weren’t for you.” You ruffle Sam’s hair in response, and she presses her head happily into your hand. ]
rows.translation: 你问萨姆，离开监狱以后感觉如何。 [sam.trustRange 0 25 75 |这个娇小的奥萨女孩疑惑地凝视着你，大概是在判断你是否真的想听她说实话。她终于开口时，语气温顺而戒备。“不用再那么提防身后确实不错，可是...”她没有继续说下去，似乎不敢吐露心声。 你[pc.nmh |温和地向她保证，你确实想听她的真实想法。 |开玩笑地问她，是不是猫叼走了她的舌头。 |厉声命令她赶紧说出来。 ] 她的回答中滴淌的恶意令你吃惊，毕竟片刻前她还那么温顺。“感觉几乎一模一样。我在这里仍然是个囚犯。唯一的好处就是，需要提防的人少了一些！”萨姆立刻绷紧身体，仿佛料定自己用这种口气对你说话会遭到惩罚。 你一时愣住，却很快重新找回言语。你感谢萨姆坦率回答，并向她保证，她永远可以对你说实话，即便你不喜欢她要说的内容。 这次轮到奥萨女孩愣住了。她惊讶地眨眼，随后脸上的怒意融化，身体也放松下来。“谢谢...”她几乎用耳语般的声音嘟囔。 你尴尬地对萨姆微笑，告诉她不必放在心上。也许明天再问她一次，她会愿意吐露更多。 |她听见你的问题后露出浅浅笑容，尾巴也稍稍竖起。“我想我喜欢这里。能再次做些有意义的事情真好，而且我觉得自己现在可以稍微放松警惕了。[yammi.isCrew | 你的厨师做的食物也比加斯蒂戈斯提供的好太多。就连生育计划里的食物也没这么美味。 ]” 你感谢萨姆抽出时间。 奥萨女孩轻轻摇着尾巴。“不客气，[pc.name]。” |这个娇小的前海盗听见你的问题后灿烂地笑着，尾巴飞快摆动，甚至还没张嘴，身体语言就已经给出了回答。她用喜悦的语气证实了这一点：“这些年来，我第一次感到真正的幸福。[crewRange 3 | 我认识了这么多善良的人。我以前从没想过，会有人不图什么就对我这么好。 ] 我真庆幸自己最终来到了这里。” 萨姆身上的忧虑和恐惧大多已经消失。她现在看起来确实很满意自己的生活。你感谢她抽出时间，并告诉她，你很高兴她过得愉快。 “不，该说谢谢的是你，[pc.name]。如果不是你，我现在还在监狱里受苦。” 作为回应，你揉乱萨姆的头发；她开心地把脑袋贴进你掌心。 ]

rows.original: You ask Sam if she’d like to come to the nursery with you and spend time with your child[sam.pupsRange 2 |ren ]. Though the ausar regards you coldly when you first start speaking, the instant she realizes what you’re asking her eyes fill with warmth and her ears shoot straight up. “YES! Of course I do! I want to see my little pup[sam.pupsRange 2 |s ] more than anything in the galaxy!!!” She shouts ‘yes’ louder than you’ve ever heard her, even during her heat. The former pirate is [sam.isPregnant |literally bouncing on the spot, jumping up and down |practically bouncing on the spot, rocking on her feet ] and wagging her tail in a blur. You can’t help but [pc.nmh |laugh |laugh |grin ][pc.isBro |grin ] at her enthusiastic response. Apparently nothing makes Sam come out of her shell like her children. You offer her your arm, which she [sam.trustRange 25 75 |eagerly accepts, locking her own furry arm around it |lovingly accepts, pressing [sam.isPregnant |the swell of your future children |herself ] against you ] before encouraging you to lead the way. Like a leashed dog that’s too eager to go somewhere, Sam tugs on your arm repeatedly to speed you up on the way to the nursery. Thanks to the frantic pace she insists on, you reach your destination in no time at all.

The anxious ausar flinches and locks up, but before you can even say anything, she’s already melted into the matronly synthetic’s soothing embrace. She’ll make sure you’re always safe and happy. Promise.” Seeing how well Sam has taken to being a mother fills you with happiness. Almost without thought, you place a hand on top of her head, patting her softly. When she leans into your touch with a soft gasp, you begin scratching her scalp absentmindedly. Not long after, you feel gentle taps against your back, and when you glance behind you, you realize the ausar’s tail is wagging wide enough to brush into you. You grin at the effect you’re having on her and redouble your efforts, stroking her blonde mop and massaging her scalp more vigorously. “Ooohh, I didn’t know I could feel like this... Please, scratch my ears too...” she sighs happily, perking the fuzzy appendages for you to better touch. Sparing Sam your laugh, you grant her request and then some, alternating between rubbing and massaging the base of her ears and gently dragging your nails along their length. You whisper sweet nothings to her as you do, letting her know that she’s a good girl and a good mother and that you’re proud of her. By the time your fingers have begun to feel sore, the nursing ausar is practically a puddle in your arms. If not for the pups at her breasts you’re certain she’d be sleeping sprawled across your lap like an oversized dog. Her eyes are shut, and she has a dopey, contented smile on her face. If she weren’t still wagging her tail, you might think she actually had fallen asleep. The little fluffballs at her breasts are passed out, having long since drained their mother and broken their latch on her nipples. You pat her on the head one last time and whisper a final “Good girl.” Sam opens her eyes, looking more than a bit bleary as she watches you stand up. “Awww, do I have to go already, [pc.name]?” She whispers to you, crestfallen and afraid to wake her pups again. You whisper to her that you have to leave, but she can stay longer. Though you’d love to do this forever, you have other obligations. Bidding your lover a wordless farewell, you make your way back to the nursery proper, still feeling warm and fuzzy inside. "

rows.original: Your pups are old enough to crawl, and they do it as much as they can. Sam could hardly be more delighted by this, and [sam.isPregnant |even in spite of her pregnancy ] she takes every opportunity to crawl around with them. As soon as you enter the room, the blonde ausar rushes over to the colorful, padded play area that’s been set up for your pups and drops to her knees, gleefully calling her children over to her with her tail wagging high. “Momma’s here, little ones! Come to Momma!” They all notice her immediately, and as they pick up her comforting scent, their tails mimic their mother’s, [var0] tufts of blonde fuzz swishing through the air as the precocious half-breed pups crawl towards the most important person in their world. They giggle and coo in excitement like any human child as they move, but some of their noises sound almost canine. That resemblance is only reinforced when they finally reach Sam and begin to wriggle energetically all over her. Your children are so excited that they barely even notice your presence, though whenever they do they yip and beam at you. The pups tug at their mother until she relents and collapses on her back in a giggling fit as they swarm all over her.[sam.isPregnant | She instinctively uses her tail to gently guide them away from the swell of her belly, preventing her overeager pups from possibly harming their unborn siblings. ] Sam’s giggling grows even louder as her children unintentionally tickle her with their wagging tails, and her laughter excites them even further. You settle on the floor next to this writhing mass of blonde fur and watch with amusement as the little ones vie for attention. Sam and your children are all practically screaming in delight after just a few moments like this, and the swamped ausar turns to you to beg for help, barely able to draw breath or speak between fits of laughter. “Ahahaha! [pc.name], please! Hahahaha! You’ve gottahahaha- you’ve gotta save me!!!” Such an earnest plea moves you to help immediately, and with an exaggerated growl you start grabbing pups at random, placing them on yourself and playfully roughhousing as much as is safe. Thanks to their ausar genetics, your offspring have developed faster than humans of their age, and this sort of minor horseplay is exactly what they love right now. Sam initially chides you, but when she sees how much the children enjoy it, she soon joins in, albeit more gently. The nursery is quickly filled with the sound of all your little pups squealing in delight. Sam sounds just as happy as they do, and even long after you start feeling worn down she plays with her pups tirelessly, filled with the boundless energy of a young mother. Her continued enthusiasm in the face of your waning stamina draws the children on you back to their mother. Luckily for her, they don’t have the staying power of an adult, and one by one the pups settle down until eventually they’re all asleep. The exertion seems to catch up with Sam all at once, and she practically crashes when the last pair of big blue eyes rolls shut. She pants softly under the pile of half-breeds, turning her head back towards you with a radiant smile. “Thank you,” she whispers, “for everything.” You smile back before leaning in to kiss her forehead. You pass the time by scratching between your lover’s ears, much to her delight. Sam rolls her head into your touch, and in no time at all her eyelids have closed just like her pups’. You continue lavishing the mother of your children with affection until you’re certain she’s asleep. Then you climb to your [pc.feet] again as quietly as possible, fighting the temptation to just wrap your arms around your strange little family and fall asleep with them. You’ve got a company to inherit, for their sakes too, and reminders of what you’re striving for like this one make for powerful motivation.
rows.translation: 你的幼崽们已经长到会爬的年纪，而且一有机会就爬个不停。萨姆对此简直开心得不能再开心，[sam.isPregnant |即使怀着孕 ]，她也会抓住每个机会陪孩子们一起爬。你刚走进房间，这个金发奥萨尔人便冲向为幼崽们布置好的彩色软垫游乐区，跪倒在地，高高摇着尾巴，欢喜地呼唤孩子们过来。“妈妈来了，小宝贝们！快到妈妈这里来！” 他们立刻全都注意到了她；闻到令人安心的母亲气味后，尾巴也模仿着她摆动，[var0]撮金色绒毛在空中摇曳，这些早慧的混血幼崽爬向他们世界中最重要的人。他们移动时像任何人类孩子一样兴奋地咯咯笑、咿呀低语，但有些声音听来几乎像小狗。 幼崽们终于爬到萨姆身边，开始精力充沛地在她身上扭来扭去，这份相似便更加明显。孩子们兴奋得几乎没注意到你的存在，不过偶尔发现你时，都会朝你轻叫、露出灿烂笑容。幼崽们不断拉扯母亲，直到她终于让步，在笑声中仰面倒下，任他们蜂拥爬遍全身。[sam.isPregnant |她本能地用尾巴轻柔引导他们远离隆起的腹部，避免过分热情的幼崽伤到尚未出生的兄弟姐妹。 ]孩子们摇摆的尾巴无意中挠得萨姆发痒，她笑得更加响亮，而笑声又令他们愈发兴奋。 你在这团扭动的金色毛球旁坐到地板上，饶有兴致地看着小家伙们争夺关注。才过片刻，萨姆与孩子们便几乎全都欢喜得尖叫起来；被彻底淹没的奥萨尔人转向你求救，一阵阵笑声让她几乎喘不过气，也说不出完整的话。“啊哈哈哈！[pc.name]，救命！哈哈哈哈！你得哈哈哈，你得救救我！！！” 如此恳切的请求令你立刻出手相助。你夸张地低吼一声，开始随手抓起幼崽放到自己身上，在安全范围内尽情和他们打闹。得益于奥萨尔基因，你的后代发育速度快于同龄人类，如今恰好最喜欢这种轻微的嬉闹。萨姆起初责备了你几句，但看到孩子们有多么享受，很快也加入进来，只是动作更加温柔。 育儿室很快充满所有小幼崽欢喜的尖叫声。萨姆听起来和他们一样开心；即使你早已开始感到疲惫，她仍带着年轻母亲无穷无尽的精力，不知疲倦地陪幼崽玩耍。面对你逐渐耗尽的体力，她始终热情不减，于是趴在你身上的孩子们又回到了母亲身边。 幸运的是，他们没有成年人的持久力。幼崽们一个接一个安静下来，最终全部睡着。劳累似乎突然一股脑追上萨姆；最后一双蓝色大眼睛合上时，她也几乎瞬间瘫倒。她被一堆混血幼崽压在下面轻轻喘息，转头朝你露出灿烂的笑容。“谢谢你，”她低声说道，“谢谢你做的一切。” 你回以微笑，凑过去亲吻她的额头。你轻挠爱人双耳之间的位置来消磨时间，令她非常享受。萨姆把脑袋迎向你的抚摸，没过多久，眼皮便像幼崽们一样合上了。你继续把疼爱倾注给孩子们的母亲，直到确定她已经入睡。随后，你尽可能安静地重新站上[pc.feet]，努力抵抗抱住这个古怪小家庭、陪他们一同睡去的冲动。为了他们，你也得继承一家公司；而眼前这种对奋斗目标的提醒，正是无比强大的动力。

rows.original: Okay, a lot of that went right over your head. You nod politely, hoping she’ll move on to something else. “I was raised in the Black Void by my father, who was also a hacker. He might be a pirate, but he’s a pretty good dad, and I’m a big-time daddy’s girl. I still kept in touch with him before I was arrested. Maybe now that I have my own computer again I’ll reach out to him, since I don’t have to worry about our communications being traced.” Sam looks much more relaxed than usual as she talks about her father, obviously feeling nostalgic as she thinks over her fondest memories with a big smile. All too soon though, her brow is clouded by her usual angst, and her tail ceases its joyful motions. “Umm... that’s it for my past. Maybe I’ll tell you more later.” Deciding not to pry when Sam is, for the most part, happy, you thank her for telling you about her personal history. “You’re welcome, [pc.name],” she says with a thin smile. |Sam sighs heavily and adopts a weary look when she hears your question. She dutifully pulls herself together though, muttering “I guess I can tell you everything now. Where to begin though?” Sam rubs her forearm thoughtfully before choosing her topic. “Well, the scars on my face. They’re from my first boyfriend, both directly and indirectly. See, he was an ausar guy and really possessive of me... unhealthily so. He was really controlling, and I realize now that he was emotionally abusive. When I tried to leave him one night, he went to grab me by the hair. He missed though, and ended up clawing me really deeply.” You’re appalled at the thought of someone treating Sam so badly, much less actually injuring her. When Sam sees your reaction, she’s quick to elaborate, waving her blonde-furred hands disarmingly and stuttering in her haste to explain. “It’s not what you think! He didn’t scratch me on purpose, but it still scared the hell out of me, bad enough that I stayed that night instead of leaving. I was too afraid of him after that to even think about leaving. I never got the chance to find out if he ever would have actually gotten more physically abusive though. Just a few months after that, some rival pirates raided the base we were living on. My boyfriend and I got pinned in our room and cut off, and he used me as a distraction to try to run away.” Sam’s tone is one of anger now. “He got gunned down in the attempt, and I got slashed in the face by a big thraggen bitch’s sword since I couldn’t hold the door by myself. Just a few seconds later, some of the other Black Void on the base showed up and saved me. If he’d just stayed with me and helped me defend our room, he’d be alive, and I wouldn’t have these other scars. I mourned him at the time, but now that I’m older, I realize how horrible of a person he was. Good damn riddance!” Sam’s face is twisted in an angry snarl, surprising you a bit with her passion. “I’ve had other bad relationships, even a girl who pretended to love me so she could steal my code. I don’t hate any of them the same way I hate him though.” You pat Sam on the arm comfortingly and tell her that her past lovers didn’t deserve her. At that, her anger vanishes, replaced with a sorrowful look. “I’m not anything great that someone has to deserve,” she mutters quietly. The ausar bends her tail in front of herself and strokes it nervously for a moment as she gathers her thoughts. Finally, she starts explaining, “I was actually born in Gastigoth. My mom was heavily pregnant when she was arrested, and she gave birth shortly after arriving at the prison. It had been a difficult pregnancy for her, and I was her only pup. Although she hadn’t signed up for the breeding program, Gastigoth still does some basic genetic modification to all children born in the prison unless they’re a product of the breeding program and their free parent opts out of it. I didn’t really get all the usual enhancements, but they upped my intelligence and a few other things and removed the ‘potentially criminal’ traits from my genome, like violent tendencies.” You’re not even sure if you’re surprised to hear that or not. Involuntary prenatal modifications are extremely rare in most sectors, but it doesn’t sound so surprising for Gastigoth. Sam pauses for a moment to take a deep breath. This topic is apparently very emotional for her, but she soldiers on through her story, her gaze shifting down to the floor in an effort to hide her distress. “It wasn’t a free service. Gastigoth holds any babies they do this to until they’re an adult by the standards of their species if nobody pays for the mods, but my dad didn’t have enough money both to post bond for my mom and to pay for my gene mods. My dad really loved my mom, but she said she’d never forgive him if he left me to grow up in jail, so he chose me instead. Before my dad could save up more money to buy my mom out, some rich asshole swooped in and bought her. We’ve never seen her since. Gods only know what awful things may have happened to her.” Sam seems on the verge of crying as she continues her story. “I’ve always blamed myself for my mom getting sold like that. If I hadn’t been born, my dad wouldn’t have had to waste all of his money on me and he could’ve saved her. I can’t even be proud of my talents without feeling guilty. They all come from those stupid fucking gene mods that my dad had to pay for instead of paying for the woman he loved. He always told me he didn’t regret his choice, but he still misses my mom so much. I just feel so horrible for separating them like that, like I’m a burden for my dad that just reminds him what he could’ve had instead.” Sam sniffles pitifully as hot tears begin to stream down her scarred face. “I’m a horrible daughter, a cowardly pirate, and a terrible person. It’s my fault my mom’s a slave somewhere. I don’t want to hurt people physically, so I couldn’t even be a proper Black Void member, but I’ve hurt so many people in so many other ways with all of my hacking. I’ve ruined hundreds of lives, maybe thousands, including my own parents’. I don’t know how I can ever make up for all this.” The ausar puts her face in her hands and sobs quietly. [pc.nmh |Without a second thought, |Without a second thought, |In spite of yourself, you’re moved by her words, so ] you wrap your arms around Sam and hold her as tightly as you can, stroking her canine ears reassuringly. Rather than tensing up like usual, she melts into your embrace, throwing her arms around you tightly and burying her face in your [pc.heightRange 0 72 |neck |[pc.chest] ]. You can feel her hot tears as she shudders against you, and you whisper to her comfortingly. You assure her that she’s very brave to have handled her situation so well, and that after spending so much time with her you know she’s a good person. Her talents are no less legitimate for having come from genetic engineering, because she still worked hard to become as skilled as she is. Her father might miss her mother, but there’s no way he couldn’t be proud to have such a wonderful daughter who worries so much about his happiness and the happiness of a mother she never met. Gradually, Sam calms down and stops crying. Her tail begins to wag slowly, and her ears perk up a hint under your touch. She sniffles for a bit before sighing heavily against you. Then she pulls back a bit and looks [pc.heightRange 0 72 |down |up ] at you, the two of you still embracing tightly. “Thank you, [pc.name]. I don’t know if I can forgive myself, but it means alot to me if you really believe those things.” You put a finger to Sam’s lips and tell her she’s not allowed to doubt herself anymore. She starts to make some excuse, “But I-”, but you silence her with a kiss, sealing your [pc.lipsChaste] against her delicate lips and cupping her cheek protectively. Sam swoons and totally loses herself in the kiss, rolling her blue eyes shut and surrendering to your [pc.tongue] as you thrust it into her mouth. You taste each other passionately until Sam moans softly into your kiss and her blonde tail can be heard swishing through the air. The two of you separate breathlessly, both blushing as much with passion as with lust. “Wow,” Sam whispers, “maybe I should break down crying more often...” She smiles weakly at her joke. You wag your finger jokingly and tell her that she can expect exactly the same “punishment” any time she does. Sam blushes, but her smile just grows larger. You thank the ex-pirate for opening up to you like this. “You’re welcome, [pc.name]. I’m... I’m glad I met you.” ]
rows.translation: 好吧，刚才有很多内容你完全没听懂。你礼貌地点点头，希望她转而谈些别的。 “我是父亲在黑色虚空里养大的，他也是个黑客。他或许是海盗，但也是个相当不错的爸爸，而我特别黏他。被捕以前，我一直和他保持联系。现在我又有自己的电脑了，也许会主动找他，毕竟不必担心通信遭到追踪。”谈到父亲时，萨姆显得比平常放松许多；她显然陷入怀旧，回忆着最美好的往事，脸上挂着灿烂笑容。但没过多久，惯常的忧郁又笼罩眉间，尾巴也不再欢快摆动。“嗯...关于我的过去就这些。以后或许会再告诉你一些。” 萨姆总体上心情不错，你决定不再追问，感谢她分享自己的经历。 “不客气，[pc.name]，”她勉强笑道。 |听见你的问题，萨姆重重叹气，露出疲惫的神情。不过她还是尽职地振作起来，咕哝道：“我想现在可以把一切都告诉你了。可该从哪里说起呢？” 萨姆若有所思地揉着前臂，随后选定话题。“那就说我脸上的伤疤吧。它们都来自我的第一任男友，有些直接，有些间接。你看，他是个奥萨尔男人，对我的占有欲很强...强得不健康。他控制欲极强，我如今才明白那是情感虐待。有天晚上我想离开他，他伸手来抓我的头发。结果没抓到，反而用爪子在我脸上划出了很深的伤口。” 想到有人如此恶劣地对待萨姆，甚至真的伤害她，你感到无比震惊。看到你的反应，萨姆连忙进一步解释；她安抚地挥动覆着金色毛发的双手，急着说明，话都说得结结巴巴。 “不是你想的那样！他不是故意抓伤我的，但那还是把我吓坏了，怕得那晚没敢离开。从那以后，我太害怕他，连离开的念头都不敢再有。我始终没机会知道他以后是否真会变得更加暴力，因为仅仅几个月后，一群敌对海盗袭击了我们居住的基地。我和男友被堵在房间里，与其他人隔绝，他竟拿我当诱饵，试图独自逃跑。” 萨姆的语气此刻满是愤怒。“他逃跑时被枪打死了；我一个人守不住房门，脸又被一个高大的特拉根臭婊子的剑砍伤。仅仅几秒后，基地里的其他黑色虚空成员赶到，救下了我。如果他留下来陪我守住房间，他就不会死，我也不会留下其他伤疤。当时我为他哀悼过，但如今年纪大了，才意识到他是个多么糟糕的人。死得他妈真好！”萨姆愤怒地龇牙，激烈的情绪令你有些惊讶。“我还经历过其他糟糕的恋情，甚至有个女孩假装爱我，只为了偷走我的代码。但我对他们的恨都比不上对他的恨。” 你安慰地拍了拍萨姆的手臂，告诉她过去那些恋人根本配不上她。 她的怒火顿时消失，被悲伤取代。“我没有好到需要别人配得上，”她低声咕哝。这个奥萨尔人把尾巴弯到身前，紧张地抚摸片刻，整理着思绪。最终，她开始解释：“其实我出生在加斯蒂戈斯。我母亲被捕时已经身怀六甲，抵达监狱不久便生下了我。那次怀孕对她很辛苦，而我是她唯一的幼崽。虽然她没有加入生育计划，但加斯蒂戈斯仍会对监狱里出生的所有孩子进行一些基础基因改造，除非孩子是生育计划的产物，而且自由身份的父母选择退出。我没有获得所有常规强化，不过他们提高了我的智力和其他几项能力，还从基因组里删除了‘潜在犯罪’特征，比如暴力倾向。” 你甚至不确定自己是否该对此感到惊讶。非自愿产前改造在大多数星区极为罕见，但发生在加斯蒂戈斯似乎又没那么意外。 萨姆停下来深吸一口气。这个话题显然令她情绪激动，但她仍勉力讲述，目光转向地板，试图隐藏痛苦。“那并不是免费服务。如果没人支付改造费用，加斯蒂戈斯会扣留所有接受这种改造的婴儿，直到他们按所属种族的标准成年。可我父亲的钱不够同时替母亲交保释金和支付我的基因改造费。爸爸真的很爱妈妈，但她说，如果他把我留在监狱里长大，就永远不会原谅他，所以他选择了我。父亲还没攒够钱赎出母亲，就有个有钱混蛋突然出现，把她买走了。此后我们再也没见过她。只有诸神知道她可能遭遇了多么可怕的事情。” 萨姆继续讲述时已经快要哭出来。“我一直责怪自己害得妈妈就这样被卖掉。如果我没有出生，爸爸就不用把所有钱浪费在我身上，本可以救下她。就连为自己的才能骄傲都会让我愧疚。那些才能全来自爸爸不得不付钱购买的该死愚蠢基因改造，而那笔钱原本可以用来赎回他深爱的女人。他总说自己不后悔这个选择，可他还是非常想念妈妈。我让他们就这样分离，心里难受极了；仿佛自己只是爸爸的负担，不断提醒他原本能够拥有什么。” 萨姆可怜地抽泣起来，滚烫的泪水开始沿满是伤疤的脸流淌。“我是个糟糕的女儿、胆小的海盗，也是个恶劣的人。妈妈在某处沦为奴隶都是我的错。我不想亲手伤害别人，所以连合格的黑色虚空成员都当不了，但我用黑客技术以许多其他方式伤害了太多人。我毁掉了几百人的生活，也许有几千人，包括自己父母的人生。我不知道怎样才能弥补这一切。”这个奥萨尔人双手掩面，低声啜泣。 [pc.nmh |你不假思索地 |你不假思索地 |尽管并非本意，她的话仍打动了你，于是你 ]伸手紧紧抱住萨姆，安抚地抚摸她的犬耳。她没有像平常那样绷紧，反而融化在你的怀抱中，双臂紧紧搂住你，把脸埋进你的[pc.heightRange 0 72 |颈窝 |[pc.chest] ]。她靠着你颤抖，你能感觉到滚烫泪水，于是温柔地低声安慰。你告诉她，能如此妥善地应对自己的处境，已经证明她非常勇敢；与她相处这么久，你也知道她是个善良的人。才能来自基因工程，并不会让它们变得不真实，因为她依然付出了努力，才达到如今的水平。她父亲或许思念她的母亲，但拥有这样一个如此关心他幸福、也关心素未谋面母亲幸福的优秀女儿，他不可能不感到骄傲。 渐渐地，萨姆平静下来，不再哭泣。尾巴开始缓慢摆动，耳朵也在你的抚摸下微微竖起。她抽泣片刻，贴着你重重叹息。随后，她略微后退，望着[pc.heightRange 0 72 |下方 |上方 ]的你，而你们仍紧紧相拥。“谢谢你，[pc.name]。我不知道自己能不能原谅自己，但如果你真的相信那些话，对我而言意义重大。” 你将一根手指抵在萨姆唇上，告诉她以后不许再怀疑自己。 她刚想找借口，“可是我-”，你便用亲吻堵住她的话，让[pc.lipsChaste]贴紧她精致的嘴唇，保护般托住她的脸颊。萨姆神魂颠倒，彻底沉浸在亲吻中，闭起蓝色眼睛；你将[pc.tongue]探入她口中，她也顺从地接纳。你们热烈地品尝彼此，直到萨姆贴着你的吻轻轻呻吟，金色尾巴在空气中摇摆出声。两人喘息着分开，脸颊既因深情也因欲望而涨红。 “哇，”萨姆低声说道，“或许我该更经常崩溃大哭...”她为自己的玩笑勉强一笑。 你开玩笑地摇摇手指，告诉她每次这么做，都可以期待同样的“惩罚”。萨姆红了脸，笑容却变得更加灿烂。你感谢这个前海盗愿意如此敞开心扉。 “不客气，[pc.name]。我...我很高兴遇见了你。” ]

The ausar bends her tail in front of herself and strokes it nervously for a moment as she gathers her thoughts. Finally, she starts explaining, “I was actually born in Gastigoth. Involuntary prenatal modifications are extremely rare in most sectors, but it doesn’t sound so surprising for Gastigoth. Sam pauses for a moment to take a deep breath. This topic is apparently very emotional for her, but she soldiers on through her story, her gaze shifting down to the floor in an effort to hide her distress. “It wasn’t a free service. You assure her that she’s very brave to have handled her situation so well, and that after spending so much time with her you know she’s a good person. Her talents are no less legitimate for having come from genetic engineering, because she still worked hard to become as skilled as she is. Her father might miss her mother, but there’s no way he couldn’t be proud to have such a wonderful daughter who worries so much about his happiness and the happiness of a mother she never met. Gradually, Sam calms down and stops crying. Her tail begins to wag slowly, and her ears perk up a hint under your touch. She sniffles for a bit before sighing heavily against you. Then she pulls back a bit and looks [pc.heightRange 0 72 |down |up ] at you, the two of you still embracing tightly. “Thank you, [pc.name]. I don’t know if I can forgive myself, but it means alot to me if you really believe those things.” You put a finger to Sam’s lips and tell her she’s not allowed to doubt herself anymore. She starts to make some excuse, “But I-”, but you silence her with a kiss, sealing your [pc.lipsChaste] against her delicate lips and cupping her cheek protectively. I’m looking forward to it as well.” While you and Sam make your way out of cargo bay, she leans over to whisper in your [pc.ear], “I like him. He’s very kind and, um...” she pauses as she searches for the right word. “Endowed?” you offer with a grin. Sam looks at the floor with a blush before she manages to respond, “No! I was going to say ‘earnest’. He’s polite and nice to me, but it doesn’t feel like he has ulterior motives. I just don’t feel right when people praise or compliment me or are nice to me. It makes me think they’re just buttering me up to take advantage of me. Not that I think you’re doing that! It’s just- shit, this all came out wrong...” Sam looks downtrodden as she realizes she’s said more than she meant to. You reach out and pat her comfortingly on the back. She doesn’t flinch or shy away from you, but her tail still hangs limply until you give her some reassurance that you understand what she really meant. To show Sam your trust in her, you tell her to go back to Kase’s station by herself to hear about her new job in more detail. “Wait, really? By myself?” Sam stares at you with a very guarded expression. When you confirm your sincerity, she allows herself to perk up again. “Wow, um... thanks. I really appreciate this, [pc.name]. Or should I say ‘boss’ now?” She grins mischievously at you. You give Sam a good natured roll of your eyes before petting her right between her big, blonde ears. The canine girl tenses up momentarily in surprise, but she quickly melts under your touch, shutting her eyes and nuzzling happily into your hand. You only scratch her head for a few moments, not wanting to overwhelm the introverted girl. When you’re done, you give her a final pat and tell her to get to work. ] ] "

rows.original: You inform her she’s welcome to stay. You don’t want to force her to do anything she doesn’t want to. Sam whirls around, mouth agape and eyes wide. “Are... are you serious?!?” Her ears are twitching beyond her control, flicking nervously. You reaffirm to her that she’s free to stay in the nursery, but you do make sure to let her know that whenever she’s ready to rejoin your crew, you’ll make things as enjoyable for her as you can. Her tail is wagging at blinding speeds before you’re even halfway through your sentence. In fact, you’re not even sure if she’s listening to anything after the first few words. Somehow restraining herself to just a small arm pump and a nearly-silent “Shit yeah!” as celebration, Sam soon clears her throat to calm down. “Uuuhhh... sorry, I just didn’t really think you’d say okay. I... truly, genuinely appreciate this, [pc.name].” You ruffle her hair and, smiling, tell her to just remember this the next time she thinks it’ll be unbearable to live with you. Blushing enough for you to see it through her dark skin, Sam looks at the floor and nods vigorously. “Yeah... I’ll think about it next time.” You genuinely believe she will.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，她想留下也没关系。你不想强迫她做任何不愿意做的事。 萨姆猛地转过身来，嘴巴大张，双眼圆睁。“你...你是认真的吗？！？”她的耳朵不受控制地抽动着，紧张地弹来弹去。 你再次向她保证，她可以自由留在育儿室；但你也明确告诉她，只要她准备好重新加入你的船员，你会尽力让她过得愉快。 你的话才说到一半，她的尾巴就已经摇得快到让人眼花。事实上，开头几句话之后她到底还有没有在听，你都不敢确定。萨姆不知怎么忍住了，只小小挥了一下手臂，几乎无声地以一句“太他妈棒了！”庆祝，随后很快清了清嗓子，让自己冷静下来。“呃...抱歉，我只是真的没想到你会答应。我...真的、发自内心地感激你，[pc.name]。” 你揉乱她的头发，微笑着告诉她，下次她再觉得和你一起生活会难以忍受时，记得想起这件事。 萨姆脸红得连深色皮肤都遮不住，她望着地板，用力点头。“嗯...下次我会想想的。” 你真心相信她会这么做。
