rows.original: Sometimes the classics are best, and when it comes to submissive ausar, headpats are among the truest of classics. Without telling Sam what you’re doing, you have her take a seat in order to give you full, easy access to her scalp. You start slowly at first, letting the anticipation build by just running your fingers through her hair. When she starts to get impatient though, you jump in all at once, eliciting a quiet yip of surprise from Sam. Your fingers rub her scalp, gently at first, but then with much more firmness. You keep a varied touch all over Sam’s head for a bit, saturating the whole area with every level of firmness she could possibly want until you figure out exactly where and how hard she wants to be massaged. As easy to read as ausar typically are, it doesn’t take long to suss out the best places, and Sam is soon letting out appreciative gasps and relieved groans as you stimulate her sensitive blonde noggin. Sam’s tail wags slowly as the tension oozes out of her, and after a few minutes she surprises you by laying her head across your lap. “Oooo, I hope you don’t mind, [pc.name].” You assure her that you don’t mind at all, giving her a few reassuring pats on the head until she settles in and relaxes again. Once she’s comfortably lying on you, you ratchet up your efforts, barely scratching at the base of her ears and the oh-so-sensitive skin between them, producing a shiver and a pleased whimper from Sam. You take your time from there, alternating between massaging, rubbing, and scratching, drawing happy little coos and moans from your submissive puppy. Eventually you work up to massaging and scratching the full length of the ausar’s canine ears. The blonde fur covering them is so fine and so soft that it’s a joy just to touch their velvety surface, and it seems to bring Sam just as much joy to have them touched. With gentle pinches up and down their length and soft scritches to their edges, you turn the ausar’s blonde-furred ears into lightning rods of pure animal pleasure for her. If Sam weren’t so relaxed, her tail would undoubtedly be flying behind her, but aside from twitching her leg and tail whenever you pet a particularly good spot, the furry appendage is barely moving anymore, staying slack against its owner’s languid form. In barely more than a whisper, you begin praising Sam for everything you can think of she might like: how cute she is, how soft her hair is, what a good mother she is, her impeccable physical condition. And of course there’re the all-important words of praise that so many ausar feel so strongly about: “Good girl!” you whisper. Sam blushes and giggles whenever you say it to her, feigning objection to it, and to the admittedly very bestial way you’re treating her. “Heeeeyyy! -oh! Hohohohohahaha! Don’t- don’t tease me like thahahahaaaat!” You of course ignore her plea, instead redoubling your efforts and informing Sam that you’re not teasing her at all, that she really is a cute, motherly, good girl[sam.trustRange 75 | and that you love her very much ]. The brown beauty’s struggles die down quickly, ending in a single, quiet grunt of false protest before she just resigns herself to melting into a boneless puddle of happy ausar in your lap. Eventually her joyful noises are replaced by light snoring, and you slow down your petting. You don’t stop though, still idly lavishing care and affection on your lover until she eventually stirs again from her quick nap. “Mmmm, sorry about, [pc.name],” Sam yawns as she sits up. “I didn’t mean to... hhhhaaaahhhhh, fall asleep on you like that.” You laugh and tell her to think nothing of it, stretching your hands and fingers while the athletic ausar stretches her back and neck. Back when I lived on Tarkus the only thing that scared me was the dangers I already knew about. Tavros? Sweet stars and suns [pc.boyGirl]! There is now so much I don’t know. And somehow I’m fairly sure I could fix every last part of it!”"

rows.original: Her cheerful smile becomes a briefly bashful grin “Nearly got in trouble trying to tweak some girl’s engine, apparently ship security? Noooot fans of unsolicited repairs on dry-docked stuff, even if it looks half like scrap. Maybe I was just nostalgic.”
rows.translation: 她爽朗的笑容短暂变成了羞怯的咧嘴笑“差点惹上麻烦，我想去调校某个姑娘的引擎，那好像是飞船安保？他们可不太——喜欢别人擅自修理停在干船坞里的东西，哪怕那东西看起来有一半像废铁。也许我只是怀旧了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer cheerful smile becomes a briefly bashful grin “Nearly got in trouble trying to tweak some girl’s engine, apparently ship security? Noooot fans of unsolicited repairs on dry-docked stuff, even if it looks half like scrap. Maybe I was just nostalgic.”"

rows.original: “It couldn’t be, could it?”
rows.translation: “不会真是这样吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It couldn’t be, could it?”"

rows.original: “The drinking is cool, the totally open sexual stuff is as exciting as it is mind-blowing... although I admit I’d have more fun doing that stuff with you than any other random spacer,” she giggles when you roll your eyes before continuing. “It’s a space station, except it’s right here in the middle of galactic fuck-nowhere, drawing in more varieties of aliens and droids and sex and drugs and foods than I’ve literally ever been able to dream of. And I dream pretty big.”
rows.translation: “喝酒很不错，那些完全开放的性爱活动既令人兴奋又让人大开眼界...不过我承认，比起任何随便碰上的太空人，我更乐意和你一起做那些事，”你翻了个白眼，她咯咯笑着继续说道。“它是一座空间站，却坐落在银河系鸟不拉屎的正中央，吸引来的外星人、机器人、性爱、毒品和食物种类，比我真正梦想过的还要多。而我的梦想向来很宏大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The drinking is cool, the totally open sexual stuff is as exciting as it is mind-blowing... although I admit I’d have more fun doing that stuff with you than any other random spacer,” she giggles when you roll your eyes before continuing. “It’s a space station, except it’s right here in the middle of galactic fuck-nowhere, drawing in more varieties of aliens and droids and sex and drugs and foods than I’ve literally ever been able to dream of. And I dream pretty big.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, I think it’s a cool place too.”
rows.translation: “是啊，我也觉得那地方挺酷的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I think it’s a cool place too.”"

rows.original: “Ohmigosh, I love it too Shekka!”
rows.translation: “天哪，我也超爱它，谢卡！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohmigosh, I love it too Shekka!”"

rows.original: “It certainly sounds like a glowing endorsement to me then.”
rows.translation: “那么在我听来，这显然是一番热情洋溢的推荐。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It certainly sounds like a glowing endorsement to me then.”"

rows.original: Shekka smirks, shaking her head a little. “It is still scary though. I’m a small girl and there is so much I don’t know about the UGC. I’m like an oil-pit to a scrak-lizard for all manner of fast-talking scammers. I wasn’t aware that so many of the various bipedal species were total pieces of shit.”
rows.translation: 谢卡咧嘴一笑，轻轻摇了摇头。“但确实还是挺吓人的。我只是个小姑娘，对UGC了解得太少。在那些花言巧语的骗子眼里，我就像对着斯克拉蜥蜴的油坑。我原来都不知道，这些形形色色的两足种族里居然有这么多彻头彻尾的烂货。”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... care to explain why?”"

rows.original: “Don’t get me wrong, the sex part of the whole planet is great. The attractions are great, and the attractions are attractive.” Shekka pauses to enjoy her silly word-play, nodding to herself. “It’s the circumstance though. What they’ve done to their people is literally the opposite of what I did to mine. I can’t express how fucking terrifying that is. They want to be idiots, incapable of thinking about nothing but sex so that they can’t cause trouble. Sure, their planet is idyllic, but they had the luck to start off human. The only people who can take advantage of them are their own.”
rows.translation: “别误会，整个星球在性爱方面确实很棒。景点很棒，那些‘景色’也很诱人。”谢卡停下来品味自己这句傻乎乎的双关，满意地点点头。“但问题在于它背后的处境。他们对自己人民所做的事，简直和我对族人做的完全相反。我根本无法形容那有多他妈可怕。他们想要变成白痴，除了性爱什么都无法思考，这样就不会惹麻烦。当然，他们的星球如同世外桃源，可他们很幸运，一开始就是人类。唯一能占他们便宜的人，只有他们自己人。”

rows.original: The Raskvel pauses, looking you up and down a few times. “You know I don’t mean to offend you too, right? You stand out as a prime example of someone who can still get things done even with a terrible case of cockbrain. But I’m going to assume you didn’t start your life like that. Right?” You nod; that’s right.
rows.translation: 拉斯克维尔停下来，将你上下打量了几遍。“你知道我也不是想冒犯你，对吧？即使患了严重的肉棒脑，你仍是能够把事情做成的典范。不过我猜，你的人生并不是一开始就这样的。对吗？”你点点头；确实如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Raskvel pauses, looking you up and down a few times. “You know I don’t mean to offend you too, right? You stand out as a prime example of someone who can still get things done even with a terrible case of cockbrain. But I’m going to assume you didn’t start your life like that. Right?” You nod; that’s right."

rows.original: “Also? Calling it ‘The Treatment’ just makes it kind of scary, as if you weren’t a citizen until you got your brain all jacked up... Which, again, I recognize the hypocrisy of that statement coming from me. I’ve literally done the same. You can see why I don’t like this place. The other side of the coin is a shitty place to be when you realize it’s probably just as shineless as the other.”
rows.translation: “还有？把它称作‘改造疗程’，听起来就有点吓人，仿佛在脑子被彻底改造之前，你根本不算公民...不过话说回来，我也明白这话从我嘴里说出来很虚伪。我确实做过完全相同的事。你应该明白我为什么不喜欢这里了。当你意识到硬币的另一面可能和这一面同样毫无光泽时，待在那里也一样糟糕。”

Which, again, I recognize the hypocrisy of that statement coming from me. I’ve literally done the same. You can see why I don’t like this place. The other side of the coin is a shitty place to be when you realize it’s probably just as shineless as the other.”"

rows.translation: “嗯...那些红米尔，我...我有机会见过几个。那真是...嗯。”谢卡咬着下唇，责怪般盯着你的脸。“不过和你一起更好。”

rows.original: “Hmmn... there is something appealing about those hard-body Reds. All that order they preach about makes them almost like machines, ya know? And that’s sort of exciting to me, like if I studied them long enough, I could puzzle out a way to squeeze a little bit of extra efficiency out of their society. They’re less like jerks than I expected, too. I even saw a few smile!”
rows.translation: “嗯...那些身体强健的红米尔确实有种吸引力。她们宣扬的秩序让她们几乎像机器一样，你懂吧？而这对我来说有点令人兴奋，仿佛只要研究得足够久，我就能想出办法，从她们的社会里再挤出一点效率。她们也没有我预想的那么讨厌。我甚至还看见几个笑了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmn... there is something appealing about those hard-body Reds. All that order they preach about makes them almost like machines, ya know? And that’s sort of exciting to me, like if I studied them long enough, I could puzzle out a way to squeeze a little bit of extra efficiency out of their society. They’re less like jerks than I expected, too. I even saw a few smile!”"

rows.original: “The golds are a hot sticky mess. I mean their boobs are freaking ginormous, but that hasn’t really done them any favors... and the way they breed is just so... alien. Everybody should get to lay eggs, not just one, big egged-up slut! Queens aside, the golds I’ve met have been perfectly friendly. More than friendly. And while they’re real organized, sort of like the reds, they seem to be a lot less strict about it. I like that. Appeals to my inner chaos-lizard, ya know?”
rows.translation: “金米尔就是一团又热又黏的烂摊子。我是说，她们的奶子真他妈大得离谱，可这并没给她们带来什么好处... 而且她们繁殖的方式实在太... 异类了。所有人都应该有机会产卵，而不是只有一个浑身塞满卵的大骚货能生！先不谈女王，我遇到的金米尔都非常友善。不只是友善。而且她们虽然组织严密，有点像红米尔，却似乎没那么严格。我喜欢这一点。很对我内心那条混沌蜥蜴的胃口，懂吧？”

Seeing snow for the first time was awesome, but I damn-near froze my scales off just standing around.” The cold was an obvious thing to mention, but you push her for a little more info.

rows.translation: “呃... 我可没去过荒原，因为我不像你这样是个疯疯癫癫的太空旅人。第一次去过之后，我基本只待在温暖的空间站里。哦！我倒是被一个体型更大、毛更蓬松的奥萨尔姑娘软乎乎地抱过。那让我暖和了一点。”

rows.original: “Azra, huh? Well... it would be intimidating how she’s as tall as four of me stood on my shoulders. But she’s been nothing but cool. I admire that she’s determined to learn more about the Galaxy.” She hesitates for a moment, looking up at you carefully. “That said, it does seem like an awful lot of danger is involved. I’d never forgive her if she got you hurt chasing after some kind of fuckable lilypad.”
rows.translation: “阿兹拉啊？嗯...她有那么高，四个我叠在我肩膀上才够得着她，这本来挺吓人的。但她一直都很酷。我欣赏她那种想多了解这个银河系的决心。”她迟疑了一下，小心地抬头看你。“话虽如此，这事牵扯的危险好像真的很多。要是她追着什么能操的睡莲叶害你受了伤，我永远不会原谅她。”

rows.original: “Hey Shekka, you think you could...?” You fall silent as the tingling irritation rises to a muscle-twitching sting. Instead of talking anymore, you sharply gesture to the painful collar. “Help.”
rows.translation: “嘿，谢卡，你能不能...？”那刺痒的不适升为让肌肉抽搐的刺痛，你沉默了。你不再说话，只是猛地指了指那勒得难受的项圈。“救命。”
rows.raw: "“Hey Shekka, you think you could...?” You fall silent as the tingling irritation rises to a muscle-twitching sting. Instead of talking anymore, you sharply gesture to the painful collar. “Help.”"

rows.original: “Oooh, you got yourself in a real bind! Never thought you’d be the type to get yourself locked into an obedience collar. Harder to handle by yourself than a cracked crankshaft, but lucky for you, you’ve got the galaxy’s top fixer and mechanic at your beck and call. Hold tight, Cap’n!” The raskvel launches into her tools face first, climbing out a moment later with a lit plasma cutter and a pair of sparking, needle-sharp pliers. “Hold still, and it’ll hurt a little bit!”
rows.translation: “噢，你可真把自己弄得进退两难了！没想到你居然会让自己被锁进服从项圈里。自己处理这玩意儿可比修裂开的曲轴还难，不过你运气不错，银河系最顶尖的维修高手兼机械师正听候你的差遣。撑住，船长！”这名拉斯克维尔一头扎进自己的工具堆，片刻后又爬了出来，手里拿着点亮的等离子切割器和一把冒着火花、针尖般锋利的钳子。“别动，会有一点点疼！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oooh, you got yourself in a real bind! Never thought you’d be the type to get yourself locked into an obedience collar. Harder to handle by yourself than a cracked crankshaft, but lucky for you, you’ve got the galaxy’s top fixer and mechanic at your beck and call. Hold tight, Cap’n!” The raskvel launches into her tools face first, climbing out a moment later with a lit plasma cutter and a pair of sparking, needle-sharp pliers. “Hold still, and it’ll hurt a little bit!”"

rows.original: You immediately recoil.
rows.translation: 你立刻往后一缩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou immediately recoil."

rows.original: Shekka scowls. “Let me rephrase that: hold still if you don’t want third degree burns.” She advances slowly
rows.translation: 谢卡皱起眉。“我换个说法：不想被三度烧伤就给我别动。”她慢慢逼近
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka scowls. “Let me rephrase that: hold still if you don’t want third degree burns.” She advances slowly"

rows.original: , climbing onto a nearby bench to help stretch out toward your neck
rows.translation: ，爬上旁边的长椅，好够得着你的脖子
rows.raw: ", climbing onto a nearby bench to help stretch out toward your neck"

rows.original: You do your best, but the little junker lied. It doesn’t hurt at all. There’s a slight prickle as she deactivates the battery and a flash of heat when she cracks the collar’s casing, but nothing that hurts in the slightest.
rows.translation: 你尽力照做，可这个小拾荒匠骗了你。根本不疼。她关掉电池时只有一点轻微的刺麻，撬开项圈外壳时也只有一闪的热意，可完全没有半点疼痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do your best, but the little junker lied. It doesn’t hurt at all. There’s a slight prickle as she deactivates the battery and a flash of heat when she cracks the collar’s casing, but nothing that hurts in the slightest."

rows.original: The useless metal bangs heavily on the deck below.
rows.translation: 那块没用的金属重重地砸在下面的甲板上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe useless metal bangs heavily on the deck below."

rows.original: “All done. So what now? Got anything else I can take care of?”
rows.translation: “都搞定了。那现在呢？还有什么要我处理的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All done. So what now? Got anything else I can take care of?” "

rows.original: Shekka adjusts a growing bulge meaningfully.
rows.translation: 谢卡意味深长地调整了一下逐渐隆起的胯间。
rows.raw: " Shekka adjusts a growing bulge meaningfully."

rows.original: Shekka smiles coyly, stroking an ear with a single finger. The heavy piercings jingle.
rows.translation: 谢卡娇羞地笑了，用一根手指抚着一只耳朵。沉重的耳饰叮当作响。
rows.raw: " Shekka smiles coyly, stroking an ear with a single finger. The heavy piercings jingle."

rows.raw: "You let Shekka know that you need to do some reorganizing of your current crew and ship layout, which means sending her away for the time being."

rows.original: “Oh,” Shekka mouths, momentarily crestfallen. “Hopefully the old shop didn’t burn down or nuttin’.” She turns away, scooping tools and parts off the floor in heavy armloads. “You know where to find me when you change your mind.” An avalanche of clanks, clangs, and sharp pings assaults your ears as she upends her collection into a box.
rows.translation: “哦。”谢卡无声地说，一时间满脸沮丧。“希望那家老店没烧掉或者出啥事儿。”她转过身，一大捧一大捧地把地上的工具和零件抄进怀里。“等你改变主意，就知道该去哪里找我。”她把收集起来的东西倒进箱子，一阵排山倒海般的铿锵、哐当与尖锐叮响冲击着你的耳朵。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” Shekka mouths, momentarily crestfallen. “Hopefully the old shop didn’t burn down or nuttin’.” She turns away, scooping tools and parts off the floor in heavy armloads. “You know where to find me when you change your mind.” An avalanche of clanks, clangs, and sharp pings assaults your ears as she upends her collection into a box."

rows.original: The raskvel mechanic brushes by you slowly, tail cradling your thigh. “And if for some reason you don’t - thanks, [pc.name]. Thanks for everything.” Shekka chews her lip, nods once, and departs.
rows.translation: 这名拉斯克维尔机械师慢慢与你擦身而过，尾巴轻托着你的大腿。“而要是你因为某种原因没有改变主意，那还是谢谢你，[pc.name]。谢谢你所做的一切。”谢卡咬着嘴唇，点了一下头，随后离去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe raskvel mechanic brushes by you slowly, tail cradling your thigh. “And if for some reason you don’t - thanks, [pc.name]. Thanks for everything.” Shekka chews her lip, nods once, and departs."

rows.original: The obvious answer here is to just take the both of these fine women to bed, and you tell them as much. It takes a few moments for confusion to change into something wholly more curious, and Shekka is the first to speak up. “I... I’unno. I was prepared for one bedbuddy.”
rows.translation: 显而易见的答案，就是把这两位漂亮女人一起带上床，而你也把这个想法告诉了她们。过了片刻，她们的困惑才转为纯粹的好奇，谢卡首先开口。“我...我不知道。我本来只准备了一个床伴。”
rows.raw: "The obvious answer here is to just take the both of these fine women to bed, and you tell them as much. It takes a few moments for confusion to change into something wholly more curious, and Shekka is the first to speak up. “I... I’unno. I was prepared for one bedbuddy.”"

rows.original: Despite the nervousness of the shortstack’s voice, Anno leans in, tail wagging. “Awww, can’t handle all this fluffy softness? These sweet sweet chest-pillows?” responds the white-fluffed Ausar with an eye-capturing bounce of said chest-pillows. Trust her to dispel the tension with her ‘assets’. She squeals and giggles when you push her onto the bed, before rolling onto her back to give both you and Shekka her very best bedroom-eyes, trailing one fluffy limb down her front to her fragrant gulf.
rows.translation: 尽管这个小矮个的声音里透着紧张，安诺却摇着尾巴凑近了。“啊呜，你承受不住这一身毛茸茸的柔软吗？还有这对甜美可口的胸枕？”这名白绒奥萨尔说着，让那对胸枕夺人眼球地弹跳了一下。果然还得靠她的‘本钱’来化解紧张气氛。你把她推倒在床上时，她尖叫着咯咯直笑，随后翻身仰躺，用自己最勾人的卧房媚眼看向你和谢卡，同时将一条毛茸茸的手臂沿着身前滑向她芬芳的幽谷。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite the nervousness of the shortstack’s voice, Anno leans in, tail wagging. “Awww, can’t handle all this fluffy softness? These sweet sweet chest-pillows?” responds the white-fluffed Ausar with an eye-capturing bounce of said chest-pillows. Trust her to dispel the tension with her ‘assets’. She squeals and giggles when you push her onto the bed, before rolling onto her back to give both you and Shekka her very best bedroom-eyes, trailing one fluffy limb down her front to her fragrant gulf."

rows.original: Your hands help slip Shekka out of her tight-fitting suit, freeing her to the open air of your ship. Despite a few of her motions lacking surety, Anno practically helps you pull your new lover into the bed before you climb in after them.
rows.translation: 你动手帮谢卡脱下她那身紧身衣，让她赤身裸体地暴露在你飞船的空气中。尽管她有些动作还显得犹豫不决，安诺几乎是和你一起把你的新情人拉上了床，随后你也跟着她们爬了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hands help slip Shekka out of her tight-fitting suit, freeing her to the open air of your ship. Despite a few of her motions lacking surety, Anno practically helps you pull your new lover into the bed before you climb in after them."

rows.original: You run your fingers through your [pc.hair], looking over the two of them and trying to keep your expression plain. It may seem unfair, but Anno was here first. It’s not right to supplant her just because of that.
rows.translation: 你用手指梳过[pc.hair]，打量着她们两个，努力让表情保持平淡。这也许显得不公平，但安诺是先来的。就因为那点就把她取而代之，并不合适。
rows.raw: "You run your fingers through your [pc.hair], looking over the two of them and trying to keep your expression plain. It may seem unfair, but Anno was here first. It’s not right to supplant her just because of that."

rows.original: Shekka lets out a deep-seated sigh and nods bashfully. “You’re right, you’re right. Sorry for losing my temper.” she directs the second part of her apology at Anno, who appears just as embarrassed to have started up an argument. You give them both head-ruffle, and Shekka slips out again, starting to unzip her suit.
rows.translation: 谢卡深深叹了口气，难为情地点点头。“你说得对，你说得对。抱歉，我刚才发脾气了。”她把后半句道歉说给安诺听，而安诺似乎也同样为自己挑起争执感到尴尬。你揉了揉她们两人的脑袋，谢卡再次溜了出去，开始拉开自己紧身衣的拉链。
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka lets out a deep-seated sigh and nods bashfully. “You’re right, you’re right. Sorry for losing my temper.” she directs the second part of her apology at Anno, who appears just as embarrassed to have started up an argument. You give them both head-ruffle, and Shekka slips out again, starting to unzip her suit."

rows.original: Not wanting to hear anything from Anno, you give her a nudge towards the bed, earning a surprised yelp before tossing the covers over the both of you.
rows.translation: 你不想听安诺说任何话，便推着她往床边去，惹得她惊讶地轻叫了一声，随后把被子盖在你们两人身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot wanting to hear anything from Anno, you give her a nudge towards the bed, earning a surprised yelp before tossing the covers over the both of you."

rows.original: It takes a valiant force of will not to look at the puppy-dog-eyes Anno is beaming your way. Judging by the look on Shekka’s face, she wasn’t prepared for that particular trap. A gentle boop on Anno’s nose breaks the spell, and she lets out a soft whine before giving up. “Okay, okay... I understand. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.”
rows.translation: 你靠着英勇的意志力才忍住不去看安诺朝你投来的那双小狗般的可怜眼神。从谢卡的表情来看，她也没料到会有这一招。你轻轻点了一下安诺的鼻尖，打破了这道魔咒；她轻声呜咽，随后放弃了。“好吧，好吧...我明白。如果你改变主意，知道去哪里找我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a valiant force of will not to look at the puppy-dog-eyes Anno is beaming your way. Judging by the look on Shekka’s face, she wasn’t prepared for that particular trap. A gentle boop on Anno’s nose breaks the spell, and she lets out a soft whine before giving up. “Okay, okay... I understand. If you change your mind, you know where to find me.”"

rows.original: The snowy-furred Ausar gives you a peck on the cheek, plucks up her towel and clothing, and slips out of the room, giving you both a hip-swaying show as she goes. Your red-scaled shortstack looks up, appearing guilty as all hell. “Crap... I’m sorry...”
rows.translation: 那只雪白皮毛的奥萨尔在你脸颊上啄了一下，抓起她的毛巾和衣服，溜出房间，走时还给你们俩来了一段扭胯秀。你那红鳞的小矮个抬起头，一脸愧疚得要命。“糟了... 对不起...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe snowy-furred Ausar gives you a peck on the cheek, plucks up her towel and clothing, and slips out of the room, giving you both a hip-swaying show as she goes. Your red-scaled shortstack looks up, appearing guilty as all hell. “Crap... I’m sorry...”"

rows.original: Putting your hands up in mock surrender, you announce there’s nothing you hate more than drama. It takes a few more babbled apologies, but eventually Shekka gives up and agrees, scrambling into your bed. “Well then Captain, if that’s the case... think you could help me out of my suit?” she licks her lips, waving her egg-layer-hips in your face enticingly.
rows.translation: 你举起双手做出假投降的样子，宣称你最讨厌的就是闹剧。又结结巴巴地道了几次歉，谢卡终于放弃追究，答应了，爬进你的床上。“那好吧，舰长，既然这样...能不能帮我从这身衣服里脱出来？”她舔了舔嘴唇，把产卵者特有的胯部在你面前诱惑地摆来摆去。
rows.raw: "\n\nPutting your hands up in mock surrender, you announce there’s nothing you hate more than drama. It takes a few more babbled apologies, but eventually Shekka gives up and agrees, scrambling into your bed. “Well then Captain, if that’s the case... think you could help me out of my suit?” she licks her lips, waving her egg-layer-hips in your face enticingly."

rows.original: Although it’s far smaller than the one in her warehouse, you flip Shekka around and nudge her towards the bench. “Go ahead and work on... whatever that piece of my ship is. Just let me do all the work.” Your fingers trace up her spine to her neck where a small, hidden clasp resides. Shekka shivers in anticipation once you find it. You artfully twist your thumb and index finger, releasing the catch and revealing her jumpsuit’s seam. The fabric parts slowly, opening just enough to let her pale crimson flesh peek through, the light sparkling off glossy scales as they’re exposed. “Well? I’m waiting. I want to see maximum satisfaction here.”
rows.translation: 虽然这里的工作台远比她仓库里的那张小，但你还是让谢卡转过身，轻推着她靠近台面。“继续摆弄...我飞船上的那块东西吧。所有体力活都交给我就好。”你的手指沿着她的脊柱向上滑到颈后，那里藏着一枚小小的搭扣。你找到它时，谢卡因期待而浑身一颤。你巧妙地转动拇指与食指，解开搭扣，露出了她连身衣的接缝。布料缓缓分开，刚好让她淡绯色的肌肤从中窥露；光线落在逐渐显露的光亮鳞片上，闪闪发亮。“怎么样？我等着呢。我要看到你拿出最令人满意的表现。”
rows.raw: "Although it’s far smaller than the one in her warehouse, you flip Shekka around and nudge her towards the bench. “Go ahead and work on... whatever that piece of my ship is. Just let me do all the work.” Your fingers trace up her spine to her neck where a small, hidden clasp resides. Shekka shivers in anticipation once you find it. You artfully twist your thumb and index finger, releasing the catch and revealing her jumpsuit’s seam. The fabric parts slowly, opening just enough to let her pale crimson flesh peek through, the light sparkling off glossy scales as they’re exposed. “Well? I’m waiting. I want to see maximum satisfaction here.”"

rows.original: Shekka, usually sassy and quick to react, looks at you uncertainly. Her tail swishes back and forth nervously, but she does as you ask, plucking up some (frankly expensive looking) parts from all over her workbench into a small pile before you. rows.translation: 谢卡说道：“真的吗？我还以为你有...我也不知道，无限的钱呢！我大概能匀出几信用点，但你肯定能找到更好的地方出手这些东西...”
rows.raw: "Shekka remarks, “Really? I thought you had... I dunno, infinite money! I can probably spare a few credits, but there’s gotta be a better place for you to offload...”\n"

rows.original: “I’d like to buy something,” you offer. “What have you got for sale?” Shekka spreads her arms to encompass her entire shop. “Just about anything you see is for sale, but you probably don’t have much interest in buying your gadgets by the part. I’ve got a few items that seem pretty popular among you rushers. One second.” She fiddles with a slim, sparking device atop her workbench to little effect. Growling, she grabs a wrench and whacks it. A flickering, holographic menu displays her wares and their prices. “There we go!”
rows.translation: “我想买点东西，”你开口道。“你有什么可卖的？” 谢卡张开双臂，把整间店铺都圈了进去。“你看到的差不多都能卖，不过你大概没什么兴趣把那些小玩意儿按零件买回去。我这儿有几样在你们这些行星开拓者里挺受欢迎的东西。稍等。”她拨弄着工作台上一台细长、冒着火花的装置，没什么效果。她低吼一声，抓起扳手砸了下去。一个闪烁的全息菜单显示出了她的货物和价格。“行了！”

rows.original: Shekka circles you, looking your equipment over with a practiced eye before blurting out, “Oh, wow! The projector is all corroded, and I can see some degradation of the cabling here and here!” She jabs a finger into your side and your chest before launching herself onto your back to get at your shield projector directly. You stumble around the shop under the surprise weight, trying to catch yourself on the piles of junk. Shekka’s hands seem to be everywhere at once, and she never stops streaming technobabble into your ears.
rows.translation: 谢卡绕着你转了一圈，用熟练的目光检查装备，随后脱口而出：“噢，哇！投射器全都腐蚀了，而且这里和这里的线路也有些老化！”她用手指戳了戳你的身侧和胸口，接着一跃跳上你的后背，直接摆弄起护盾投射器。突如其来的重量压得你在店里踉跄起来，竭力扶住一堆堆废品稳住身体。谢卡的双手仿佛同时出现在各个地方，嘴里也从未停止往你耳中灌输技术黑话。

rows.original: “Sure thing.” You transfer the credits as fast as you can with sixty pounds of rambunctious alien prodding you everywhere. rows.original: Shekka grins. “You know, if you keep visiting me like this, I’m going to think you’re developing a raskvel kink.” She whispers, “You wouldn’t be the first.” You start to answer, but she cracks up with infectious laughter. “Relax, [pc.name], it’s not a big deal. As a species, we, well... we like to fuck - a lot. It’s a fact. If you put together a chart of the sluttiest races in the galaxy, we’d be in the top twenty five percent, if not higher.” She snorts, “I guess we’re getting popular, in a way. I can’t say I really mind.”

rows.original: “I can tell you what my people know, which is about as limited as a sexbot’s vocabulary, unfortunately. We’ve never been much for record-keeping,” the raskvel notes, “but so far as we can tell, Tarkus is put together from two different half-planets of about the same size and composition. We figure the gabilani must have trashed them both and then picked up the pieces rather than jumping out of system. There’s more than a few asteroid belts out there thanks to them.” She sighs. “They might be the only ones on this rust ball more destructive than my own people.”
rows.translation: “我可以告诉你我族人所知道的东西，可惜那大概跟性爱机器人的词汇量一样有限。我们从来不太重视记录，”这只拉斯克维尔说道，“但据我们所知，塔库斯是由两颗大小和成分都差不多的半行星拼起来的。我们猜是加比拉尼人把这两颗都毁掉了，然后捡走碎片，而不是跳出这个星系。多亏了他们，外面可不止一条小行星带。”她叹了口气。“在这颗锈球上，他们可能是唯一比我族人更具破坏性的存在。”

rows.original: Sighing even more heavily, Shekka goes on, “Most raskvel don’t really... What’s the word you humans have for it? Oh! Plan! They don’t really plan ahead. If a tribe is already straining their food supply, they’ll keep on fucking like nobody’s business. If there’s no more room in the warrens for any more of us, they’ll just keep laying eggs and kick out the least popular among them.” She puffs out her cheeks in frustration. “We’re the same way with machines too. Put a radiation-spewing reactor a few miles away from a tribe, and in a few weeks we’ll either have it fixed or be dying from radiation poisoning.”
rows.translation: 谢卡叹得更沉重，继续说道：“大多数拉斯克维尔其实不太会...你们人类管那个词叫什么？噢！规划！他们根本不会提前规划。要是一个部落的食物供应已经不堪重负，他们仍会不管不顾地继续交配。要是洞穴里再也容不下更多同胞，他们照样会不断产卵，再把其中最不受欢迎的赶出去。”她沮丧地鼓起双颊。“我们对待机器也是一样。把一座喷吐辐射的反应堆放在部落几英里外，几周后，我们要么已经把它修好，要么正在死于辐射中毒。”

rows.original: Really? You can’t help but look a little incredulous.
rows.translation: 真的吗？你忍不住露出几分难以置信的神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nReally? You can’t help but look a little incredulous."

rows.original: Shekka nods. “Really. We can’t help it. When we see something broken - the more technological the better - we get almost like this itch in the back of our heads. We have to go poke around it, prod it, and try to fix it. It’s impossible not to! And then when we do fix something?” She sags a little bit against the bench, her fingers gripping it hard. “It’s almost as good as sex. Not as passionate or pleasure-filled, but the satisfaction... ohhh, the satisfaction. You ever have a nice meal after having to go hungry for a while? Turning something from garbage into a working, productive machine is at least twice that good.” Her pink, slitted eyes twinkle. “Why do you think I’m here, making my living fixing and selling gadgets?”
rows.translation: 谢卡点点头。“真的。我们就是忍不住。每当看到什么坏掉的东西 - 越高科技越好 - 我们后脑就几乎会泛起一种瘙痒。我们非得过去四处摸索、戳弄，再设法把它修好。根本不可能忍住！而当我们真的修好某件东西时呢？”她稍稍靠上长椅，手指用力抓住椅面。“那几乎和性爱一样美妙。没有那么激情四射，也没有充满快感，可那种满足感...噢噢噢，那种满足感。你有没有在饿了一段时间后，美美吃上一顿的经历？把某件垃圾变成一台正常运转、能够生产的机器，至少比那还要棒上一倍。”她粉红而细长的双眼闪闪发亮。“不然你以为我为什么待在这里，靠修理和出售设备谋生？”

rows.original: “Not on your life, [pc.name]. I’m the best mechanic in Novahome, and you’re nuts if you think that I’m going to cheapen my skills just because I get a thrill out of practicing them!” She shakes her head. “Anyways, the gabilani fucked this planet up something fierce. Some of ‘em live in the filth around us, but a fair portion of them moved up into their space station. Now they just make us mine up resources or enslave us while the rest of us try to make a living off their garbage.” Scowling, Shekka pushes off her workbench and paces. “They treat us like animals.”
rows.translation: “想都别想，[pc.name]。我是诺瓦之家最优秀的机械师；如果你觉得我会因为练习这些技能能带来快感，就自降身价，那你一定是疯了！”她摇摇头。“总之，加比拉尼把这颗星球祸害得非常惨。他们中有些还住在我们周围的污秽里，但相当一部分已经搬进了太空站。现在他们只会逼我们开采资源，或是奴役我们，而其余人则设法靠他们的垃圾谋生。”谢卡皱着眉，从工作台边起身踱步。“他们把我们当成动物。”

rows.original: “That’s... an uncomfortable question, [pc.name],” Shekka quietly answers. “It was our our home - our cradle. We didn’t just live on it, it shaped us into what we are today, and now... now it’s gone.” The short-statured mechanic shivers. “In a way, it feels wrong that we survived when Tarkus died. She was a shit-heap, but she was our shit-heap.”
rows.translation: “这是个...令人不舒服的问题，[pc.name]，”谢卡低声回答。“那是我们的家园 - 我们的摇篮。我们不只是生活在上面；是它塑造了今天的我们，而现在...现在它消失了。”这个身材矮小的机械师颤抖了一下。“从某种意义上说，塔库斯死去而我们却活了下来，感觉很不应该。她是个垃圾堆，但那是我们的垃圾堆。”

We figure the gabilani must have trashed them both and then picked up the pieces rather than jumping out of system. rows.original: Sighing even more heavily, Shekka goes on, “Most raskvel don’t really... What’s the word you humans have for it? Oh! Plan. They don’t really plan ahead. If a tribe is already straining their food supply, they’d keep on fucking like nobody’s business. If there’s no more room in the warrens, they’d just keep laying eggs and kick out the least popular among them. Of course, that’s not an option now. We need a better solution before we starve.” She puffs out her cheeks in frustration. “We’re the same way with machines too. Put a radiation-spewing reactor a few miles away from a tribe, and in a few weeks we’ll either have it fixed or be dying from radiation poisoning.”
rows.translation: 谢卡叹得更沉重了，继续说道：“大多数拉斯克维尔人都不太会...你们人类管那个叫什么来着？噢！规划。他们不太会为将来打算。要是一个部落的食物供应已经不堪重负，他们还是会像什么事都没有一样不停做爱。要是巢穴里已经没地方了，他们照样会继续下蛋，再把最不受欢迎的成员赶出去。当然，现在这招行不通了。我们必须在饿死之前找出更好的解决办法。”她懊恼地鼓起脸颊。“我们对机器也是这副德行。把一台不断喷出辐射的反应堆放在离部落几英里远的地方，几周以后，我们不是已经把它修好了，就是快死于辐射中毒。”

If there’s no more room in the warrens, they’d just keep laying eggs and kick out the least popular among them. Of course, that’s not an option now. We need a better solution before we starve.” She puffs out her cheeks in frustration. “We’re the same way with machines too. Put a radiation-spewing reactor a few miles away from a tribe, and in a few weeks we’ll either have it fixed or be dying from radiation poisoning.”"

rows.original: Really? You can’t help but look a little incredulous.
rows.translation: 真的吗？你忍不住露出几分难以置信的神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nReally? You can’t help but look a little incredulous."

rows.original: Shekka nods. “Really. We can’t help it. When we see something broken - the more technological the better - we get almost like this itch in the back of our heads. We have to go poke around it, prod it, and try to fix it. It’s impossible not to! And then when we do fix something?” She sags a little bit against the bench, her fingers gripping it hard. “It’s almost as good as sex. Not as passionate or pleasure-filled, but the satisfaction... ohhh, the satisfaction. You ever have a nice meal after having to go hungry for a while? Turning something from garbage into a working, productive machine is at least twice that good.” Her pink, slitted eyes twinkle. “Why do you think I’m here, making my living fixing and selling gadgets?”
rows.translation: 谢卡点点头。“真的。我们控制不了。每当看见坏掉的东西，科技含量越高越好，我们脑后就会产生一种近乎瘙痒的感觉。非得过去到处摸摸、戳戳，再试着修好它。根本忍不住！而等我们真的修好某样东西时？”她略微瘫靠在长凳上，手指紧紧抓住边缘。“那感觉几乎和做爱一样棒。没有那么激情四射、充满快感，但那份满足... 噢噢，那份满足。你有没有饿上一段时间后吃到一顿美餐的经历？把某样垃圾变成能够运转、发挥作用的机器，感觉至少要好上两倍。”她粉色的竖瞳闪闪发亮。“不然你以为我为什么待在这里，靠修理和售卖小玩意谋生？”

I’m the best mechanic in Novahome, and you’re nuts if you think that I’m going to cheapen my skills just because I get a thrill out of practicing them!” She shakes her head. “Anyways, the planet’s gone now. All that’s left of us are the ones living in this ship, and maybe a few over in the gabilani station.
rows.translation: “你想都别想，[pc.name]。我是诺瓦之家最出色的机械师；要是你以为我仅仅因为从实践技术中获得快感，就会自降身价，那你一定疯了！”她摇摇头。“不管怎样，那颗星球如今已经没了。我们只剩下住在这艘飞船上的人，也许加比拉尼空间站里还住着一些。

rows.translation: 一台看起来不过是将缠绕管道绑在显示器上的装置突然喷出一股蒸汽，把你们俩都吓了一跳。谢卡挺直身体，肩头却仿佛承载着某种未曾言明的责任。“看来工作来找我了，[pc.name]。以后再聊，好吗？”

rows.original: Trailing off as she navigates through a web of charging cables, the sad-eyed raskvel looks for a battery among hundreds. “I never really thought about this kind of stuff until we found Novahome, and even then, I never dwelled on it till the Rush found us. rows.original: “Now it’s all I can think about - aside from finding new tech to fiddle with. If we don’t do something fast, we’re going to wind up as little more than slaves, either to the gabilani or the rest of the universe.” You think you see a little moisture pooling at the corner of one slitted eye, but she wipes her hand past it before you can be sure. “Naturally, I realized that we were broken, and it suddenly made sense why I was thinking about this so much.”
rows.translation: “现在我满脑子都是这件事，除了寻找新科技来鼓捣以外。如果不赶快采取行动，我们最终只会沦为奴隶，不是受加比拉尼奴役，就是受宇宙其他种族奴役。”你好像看见一只竖瞳眼角聚起些许湿意，但还没来得及确认，她便抬手将其擦去。“自然而然地，我意识到我们也坏掉了，于是突然明白自己为什么会如此频繁地思考这件事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now it’s all I can think about - aside from finding new tech to fiddle with. If we don’t do something fast, we’re going to wind up as little more than slaves, either to the gabilani or the rest of the universe.” You think you see a little moisture pooling at the corner of one slitted eye, but she wipes her hand past it before you can be sure. “Naturally, I realized that we were broken, and it suddenly made sense why I was thinking about this so much.”"

rows.original: You retort, “But how could you fix yourselves? That seems impossible, or at least improbable.”
rows.translation: 你反驳道：“可你们要怎么修复自己？这似乎不可能，至少可能性很小。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou retort, “But how could you fix yourselves? That seems impossible, or at least improbable.”"

rows.original: Shekka plucks a battery from a charging bay and hooks it on her belt before straightening to look you dead in the eye. “It’s that or give up, and I don’t give up.”
rows.translation: 谢卡从充电槽中取下一块电池，挂在腰带上，随后直起身体，直视你的双眼。“要么这么做，要么放弃，而我绝不放弃。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka plucks a battery from a charging bay and hooks it on her belt before straightening to look you dead in the eye. “It’s that or give up, and I don’t give up.”"

rows.original: “Well, how do you propose to fix an entire species?” It seems a task far beyond a simple mechanic.
rows.translation: “那你打算怎么修复整个种族？”这任务似乎远不是个普通机械师能及的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, how do you propose to fix an entire species?” It seems a task far beyond a simple mechanic."

rows.original: Shekka starts off again, her tail looping over your [pc.butt] to tug you along after her. “I didn’t know at first, but your extranet gave me the idea.” She clicks her tongue. “That’s a fantastic piece of work, let me tell you. A galactic network of data exchange at near synchronous speeds is quite the panty-soaking technological feat. Luckily, I don’t wear any.” She turns to wink slyly at you. Her footsteps have almost carried her back to her workbench, specifically a part of it that houses a powered-down robot.
rows.translation: 谢卡又迈开步子，尾巴绕过你的[pc.butt]把你拽着跟上她。“一开始我还没想到，是你那个外联网给了我灵感。”她啧了一声。“我跟你说，那玩意儿真是了不起的手笔。一个能以近乎同步的速度交换数据的银河网络，湿内裤级别的技术壮举。幸好我不穿内裤。”她转过头，朝你狡黠地眨了眨眼。她的脚步已经快把她带回工作台了，确切地说，是工作台上放着具断电机器人的那一部分。

rows.original: Setting the gathered components next to this obvious side project, the raskvel tries to hide her blushing from you. It isn’t that obvious, but you can pick out a certain crimson brightness on her pale red cheeks. “When it comes down to it, we’re all basically biological machines. Sure, we have more freedom than a ‘bot, but ultimately we’re still prisoners to our body’s drives. A few terrans may manage chastity, but most can’t. We’re better about some things but worse about lots of others. Ya know?”
rows.translation: 这只拉斯克维尔人把收集来的部件放在这个显然属于副业的项目旁，试图向你掩饰脸红。其实并不算明显，但你依然能从她淡红色的脸颊上看出一抹绯红的亮色。“归根结底，我们基本都是生物机器。当然，我们比机器人更自由，但最终依旧是身体本能的囚徒。有少数泰伦人或许能保持禁欲，可大多数都做不到。有些方面我们更出色，许多其他方面却更糟。你明白吧？”

rows.original: “Well... for starters, there’s the ethical quandaries it brings to the table,” Shekka explains while wringing her hands. “Anything we do isn’t likely to have that big of an effect on adults treated with it, since our thought patterns and drives are fairly developed and entrenched. We wouldn’t really be changing our way of life at all, but we would be essentially reprogramming our youngs’ mental processes. Even if it’s for the better, it gives me the willies knowing that I’d be responsible for widespread, biological mind control.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 首先，它会带来一些伦理困境，”谢卡一边绞着双手，一边解释。“无论我们做什么，都不太可能对接受处理的成年人产生太大影响，因为我们的思维模式与欲望已经相当成熟且根深蒂固。我们其实完全不会改变自己的生活方式，却等于是在重新编写后代的心智运作方式。即使结果会更好，一想到自己要为这种大范围的生物性思维控制负责，我还是不寒而栗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... for starters, there’s the ethical quandaries it brings to the table,” Shekka explains while wringing her hands. “Anything we do isn’t likely to have that big of an effect on adults treated with it, since our thought patterns and drives are fairly developed and entrenched. We wouldn’t really be changing our way of life at all, but we would be essentially reprogramming our youngs’ mental processes. Even if it’s for the better, it gives me the willies knowing that I’d be responsible for widespread, biological mind control.”"

rows.original: Shivering, the little alien wraps her arms around herself, looking very small and more than a little out of her element. “Then I remind myself that I’m just trying to fix the fucked up drives that mother nature gave us. That’s enough to get me to sleep at night, but I still toss and turn thinking about it. Who am I - or even the elders - to judge something like this? By my own admission, we’re pretty fucked up as a race.” She nervously fidgets, grabbing hold of one of her ears and lifting it in front of her, holding onto it like a life preserver.
rows.translation: 娇小的外星人颤抖着用双臂抱住自己，显得无比渺小，而且远远不只是有点不知所措。“然后我会提醒自己，我只是想修复大自然赋予我们的那些操蛋欲望。这足以让我晚上睡得着，可一想到这件事，我还是会辗转反侧。我算什么人，甚至那些长老又算什么人，凭什么评判这种事？按我自己的说法，我们整个种族都相当操蛋。”她紧张地坐立不安，抓住一只耳朵举到身前，像抓着救生圈一样紧握不放。

rows.original: You put an arm around and try to lighten the mood, joking that if she didn’t feel that way. Her sobbing only intensifies, coming in fits and awkward, stuttering cries. She gasps for air like a fish out of water, clinging as her emotions overwhelm her.
rows.translation: 你伸手搂住她，试图缓和气氛，还开玩笑说，要是她没有这种感觉才奇怪。她反而哭得更厉害了，抽泣一阵阵袭来，变成别扭而断断续续的哭声。情绪将她彻底淹没，她像离水的鱼一样大口喘气，紧紧依附着你。
rows.raw: "You put an arm around and try to lighten the mood, joking that if she didn’t feel that way. Her sobbing only intensifies, coming in fits and awkward, stuttering cries. She gasps for air like a fish out of water, clinging as her emotions overwhelm her."

rows.original: You stand there, looking down at her as she shudders and shakes. “You’re not going to accomplish anything by wasting time on tears.”
rows.translation: 你站在那里，低头看着她不断颤抖。“把时间浪费在眼泪上，什么也做不成。”
rows.raw: "You stand there, looking down at her as she shudders and shakes. “You’re not going to accomplish anything by wasting time on tears.”"

rows.original: Eventually, she breaks away, slapping her visor back onto her head and down before you can get a look at her tear-stained scales. “Thanks for not freaking out, [pc.name]. I should work.”
rows.translation: 最终，她挣脱开来，赶在你看清那片被泪水沾湿的鳞片之前，把面罩啪地扣回头上并拉了下来。“谢谢你没有大惊小怪，[pc.name]。我该工作了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, she breaks away, slapping her visor back onto her head and down before you can get a look at her tear-stained scales. “Thanks for not freaking out, [pc.name]. I should work.”"

rows.original: It’d be good to give her some time.
rows.translation: 最好给她一些时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’d be good to give her some time."

rows.original: “I know, I know, but it’s good to consider all the options. The worst part of it all is that even if we get a treatment designed, we won’t be able to force all the tribes to take it. Those of us in Novahome shouldn’t be a problem - we can see the problems first hand now that we have the rest of the galaxy to measure against, but the wilders won’t accept something like this. Nor are we the type to force it on them.” Dropping her ear, she starts drumming on the countertop as she thinks. “The wilders will outbreed the civilized raskvel dozens to one, and I fear that outside of well-defended towns like this one, there will be no change.”
rows.translation: “我知道，我知道，但把所有选项都考虑一遍是好事。最糟的是，就算我们设计出了治疗方案，也没法强迫所有部落都接受。我们诺瓦之家的人应该不是问题，现在我们有了整个银河作为对照，能亲眼看到问题所在，但野外部落不会接受这种东西。我们也不是那种会强加给他们的人。”她垂下耳朵，一边思考一边开始敲打台面。“野外部落繁衍的速度会以几十比一压过文明的拉斯克维尔人，我担心除了像这样防御良好的城镇之外，什么都不会改变。”
rows.raw: "“I know, I know, but it’s good to consider all the options. The worst part of it all is that even if we get a treatment designed, we won’t be able to force all the tribes to take it. Those of us in Novahome shouldn’t be a problem - we can see the problems first hand now that we have the rest of the galaxy to measure against, but the wilders won’t accept something like this. Nor are we the type to force it on them.” Dropping her ear, she starts drumming on the countertop as she thinks. “The wilders will outbreed the civilized raskvel dozens to one, and I fear that outside of well-defended towns like this one, there will be no change.”"

rows.original: You think aloud, “Though your civilized brothers and sisters would be better able to put down roots and develop their own safe havens. They might get a little watered down through crossbreeding, but once they established proper towns and farming, they’d outlive the wilders by a massive margin.”
rows.translation: 你把想法说出口：“不过，你那些文明化的兄弟姐妹更有能力扎下根来，发展属于自己的安全避风港。异族通婚或许会稍微稀释他们的血统，但一旦建立起正规的城镇和农业，他们的存续时间会远远超过野外部落。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think aloud, “Though your civilized brothers and sisters would be better able to put down roots and develop their own safe havens. They might get a little watered down through crossbreeding, but once they established proper towns and farming, they’d outlive the wilders by a massive margin.”"

rows.original: Shekka nods. “That’s the best case scenario anyway. We’ll have to see how it all pans out in the long run.” She runs a hand through her feathers to buy her time to gather her thoughts. “If I keep talking about this, I’m probably going to start rambling about interstellar philosophy. Maybe it’s best we wrapped this up for now.”
rows.translation: 谢卡点点头。“不管怎么说，那已经是最好的结果了。长远来看会怎样，还得再看。”她伸手从羽毛间穿过，借这个动作给自己时间整理思绪。“再聊下去，我大概就要开始滔滔不绝地讲星际哲学了。也许我们最好先到此为止。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka nods. “That’s the best case scenario anyway. We’ll have to see how it all pans out in the long run.” She runs a hand through her feathers to buy her time to gather her thoughts. “If I keep talking about this, I’m probably going to start rambling about interstellar philosophy. Maybe it’s best we wrapped this up for now.”"

rows.original: “Oh isn’t it just the best!” Shekka throws her arms up in the air and practically dances in place, revealing the flighty side that most of her race seem to spend all their time exposing. “It’s way better than living in some smoky hole in the ground, fighting the sydians or rogue bots every rotation.
rows.translation: “哦，它简直是最棒的地方！”谢卡把双臂高高举起，几乎原地跳起舞来，显露出她族人大多时刻都毫不掩饰的轻浮一面。“这可比住在地下某个烟雾弥漫的洞里，每个周期都要跟西迪安人或者失控机器人交战强多了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh isn’t it just the best!” Shekka throws her arms up in the air and practically dances in place, revealing the flighty side that most of her race seem to spend all their time exposing. “It’s way better than living in some smoky hole in the ground, fighting the sydians or rogue bots every rotation. "

rows.original: ” She puffs her chest out in pride, clearly outlining the curves of her small bosom for all to see. Her nipples stick out like tiny, sore thumbs, begging to be tweaked or touched. You restrain yourself for now, wanting to hear the rest of her words.

rows.original: Shekka explains, “I was pretty young when my tribe moved in. I can still remember huddling in a leaky old cave around the warmth of a dozen half-repaired generators at night. Luckily, one of our neighboring tribes, the Gyss, found the Nova while foraging. They wanted to make it their home, but there were too many sydians inside for them to take on their own, not to mention all the aquiara inside.”
rows.translation: 谢卡解释道：“我的部落搬进来时，我还很年轻。我仍记得夜里蜷缩在四处漏水的古老洞穴里，围着十几台只修好一半的发电机取暖。幸运的是，我们邻近的吉斯部落在外出搜寻物资时发现了诺瓦号。他们想把这里变成家园，但里面的西迪安人太多，单靠他们无法应付，更别提里面还有那么多阿奎亚拉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka explains, “I was pretty young when my tribe moved in. I can still remember huddling in a leaky old cave around the warmth of a dozen half-repaired generators at night. Luckily, one of our neighboring tribes, the Gyss, found the Nova while foraging. They wanted to make it their home, but there were too many sydians inside for them to take on their own, not to mention all the aquiara inside.”"

rows.original: “Aquiara?” you wonder.
rows.translation: “阿奎亚拉？”你疑惑地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aquiara?” you wonder."

rows.original: “Sorry, the translators are still playing catch-up with some of our slang. I’m surprised you understand so many of the idioms I’ve been throwing out,” Shekka dutifully apologizes. “I think most rushers have taken to calling them... gray... goo? Something like that.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，翻译器还没完全跟上我们的一些俚语。我倒挺惊讶，你居然能听懂我随口抛出的这么多习惯说法。”谢卡认真地道歉。“我想大多数星际开拓者已经开始叫它们...灰色...史莱姆？差不多是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, the translators are still playing catch-up with some of our slang. I’m surprised you understand so many of the idioms I’ve been throwing out,” Shekka dutifully apologizes. “I think most rushers have taken to calling them... gray... goo? Something like that.”"

rows.original: You tip your head to let her know that you understand now.
rows.translation: 你歪了歪头，让她知道你现在明白了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tip your head to let her know that you understand now."

rows.original: Shekka smirks. “So anyway, the Nova was full of sydians and gray goo. Rather than fighting each other, they had actually settled into an odd sort of symbiosis. The rust monsters were in a paradise of food, of course. They used their secretions to render the metals digestible. At the same time, the gray goo already in the ship found another use for them: lubricant and protein supply. Somehow, they got the sydians to keep their corrosive tendrils away from them, and in exchange, they served sexually in every way.”
rows.translation: 谢卡得意地一笑。“总之，诺瓦号里到处都是西迪安人与灰色史莱姆。他们非但没有互相争斗，反而形成了一种奇特的共生关系。那些锈蚀怪物自然身处食物天堂。他们用分泌物让金属变得可以消化。与此同时，飞船里原有的灰色史莱姆发现了他们的另一种用途：提供润滑液与蛋白质。不知怎么回事，它们让西迪安人别再用腐蚀性触须碰自己；作为交换，它们以一切方式提供性服务。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka smirks. “So anyway, the Nova was full of sydians and gray goo. Rather than fighting each other, they had actually settled into an odd sort of symbiosis. The rust monsters were in a paradise of food, of course. They used their secretions to render the metals digestible. At the same time, the gray goo already in the ship found another use for them: lubricant and protein supply. Somehow, they got the sydians to keep their corrosive tendrils away from them, and in exchange, they served sexually in every way.”"

rows.original: The little alien giggles, her eyes a little wistful. “Apparently the goo got so good at fucking the sydians that they all but stopped breeding with each other, content to let the pliant artificial creatures service them while they lounged around, consuming untouched metals from the interior of the ship.” As an aside, she adds, “That’s why so many of the hatches in here are corroded shut. Too many sydians lived here for too long, and all the original tech in central Novahome was eaten or ruined as well.”
rows.translation: 这个小外星人咯咯笑起来，眼神有点怅然。“据说那些黏液体操西迪安人操得太好了，他们几乎就不再彼此交配，乐得让那些顺从的人造生物服侍自己，而他们就懒散地待着，啃食飞船内部未被碰过的金属。”她像是顺带一提地补充道：“这就是为什么这里这么多舱门都锈死了。太多西迪安人在这儿住了太久，诺瓦之家中心区所有原装的设备也都被吃掉了或者弄坏了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe little alien giggles, her eyes a little wistful. “Apparently the goo got so good at fucking the sydians that they all but stopped breeding with each other, content to let the pliant artificial creatures service them while they lounged around, consuming untouched metals from the interior of the ship.” As an aside, she adds, “That’s why so many of the hatches in here are corroded shut. Too many sydians lived here for too long, and all the original tech in central Novahome was eaten or ruined as well.”"

rows.original: You say, “So how did you guys take over?”
rows.translation: 你说，“那你们是怎么接手的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say, “So how did you guys take over?”"

rows.original: Shekka smirks. “They got complacent. That’s how! Most of the sydians inside the Nova were old by the time we found it. If they had brought in new blood or produced their own offspring, we would’ve never stood a chance.” Shekka pulls a wrench off the table and gestures with it, mock fighting. “Our tribe, the Gyss, and the Plo banded together our best warriors and took it overnight.”
rows.translation: 谢卡得意地一笑。“他们松懈了。就是这么回事！我们发现诺瓦号的时候，里面大部分西迪安人都已经老了。要是他们带进了新的血脉，或者自己繁衍了后代，我们根本不可能有机会。”谢卡从桌上抄起一把扳手，比划着，假装打斗。“我们部落、吉斯，还有普洛，把最精锐的战士凑到一起，一夜之间就把它拿下了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka smirks. “They got complacent. That’s how! Most of the sydians inside the Nova were old by the time we found it. If they had brought in new blood or produced their own offspring, we would’ve never stood a chance.” Shekka pulls a wrench off the table and gestures with it, mock fighting. “Our tribe, the Gyss, and the Plo banded together our best warriors and took it overnight.”"

rows.original: You frown. They killed all the sydians?
rows.translation: 你皱起眉。他们把西迪安人都杀了？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown. They killed all the sydians?"

rows.original: The raskvel’s confident expression slips, and she puts up her hands while shaking her head. “No-no-no, we didn’t even kill any of them. We did drive most of them off, but a few of the less combative ones wanted to stay. The gray goo had to go, though. We get off on birthing eggs more than sex alone, so we weren’t going to slip into the same trap as those metal-eaters.”
rows.translation: 拉斯克维尔自信的表情垮了下来，她一边摇头一边举起双手。“不不不，我们一个都没杀。我们的确赶走了其中大部分，但有几个没那么好斗的想留下来。不过，那些灰色史莱姆必须离开。比起单纯做爱，我们更喜欢产卵带来的快感，所以才不会掉进与那些金属吞食者相同的陷阱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe raskvel’s confident expression slips, and she puts up her hands while shaking her head. “No-no-no, we didn’t even kill any of them. We did drive most of them off, but a few of the less combative ones wanted to stay. The gray goo had to go, though. We get off on birthing eggs more than sex alone, so we weren’t going to slip into the same trap as those metal-eaters.”"

rows.original: “All of them?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所有史莱姆？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All of them?” you ask."

rows.original: “Well... most of them,” Shekka admits. “The sydians that stayed behind kept their ‘wives’ and ‘husbands’ of course. We made them swear to stop eating the ship itself, and we give them machinery that’s too far gone to fix instead. They’re kind of like our own garbage disposals, albeit ones that you can talk to or bed down for a fun, inter-species three-way.”
rows.translation: “嗯...大部分吧，”谢卡承认。“留下来的西迪安人当然保留了他们那些‘妻子’和‘丈夫’。我们逼他们发誓别再啃飞船本身，改成给他们那些坏得没法修的机器。他们差不多算是我们自己的垃圾处理机，只不过这些机器你能跟它说话，还能跟它上床来一场有趣的跨物种三人行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... most of them,” Shekka admits. “The sydians that stayed behind kept their ‘wives’ and ‘husbands’ of course. We made them swear to stop eating the ship itself, and we give them machinery that’s too far gone to fix instead. They’re kind of like our own garbage disposals, albeit ones that you can talk to or bed down for a fun, inter-species three-way.”"

rows.original: You chuckle at that. “Maybe I should go visit them sometime, then.”
rows.translation: 你听了笑起来。“那我改天该去看看他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle at that. “Maybe I should go visit them sometime, then.”"

rows.original: Shekka looks you up and down and suggests, “If you do, bring me too. I could use a good lay.”

rows.original: <i>“So we took the Novahome, but it took us the better part of a decade to get it built up to where it is now. There weren’t even any working power plants back then, and the electrical systems were fried.

Unfortunately, when this thing crashed, all the repulsors along the underside were completely decimated. It won’t be going orbital without a few years of excavation and repairs.”

Unfortunately, when this thing crashed, all the repulsors along the underside were completely decimated. It won’t be going orbital without a few years of excavation and repairs.”"

rows.translation: 我们至今仍在努力让飞船西半部得到适当照明。”谢卡朝她那间“小小”工坊的一扇窗户示意。“我们已经让引擎重新运转，生命维持系统也勉强启动了。你可以说，在弄到更多零件以前，生命维持系统本身也得靠生命维持。诺瓦号甚至无法在亚轨道区域的任何地方着陆。她坠毁时，底部的反重力装置全都被彻底摧毁了。”
rows.raw: "We’re still trying to get the west half of the ship lit properly.” Shekka gestures towards a window in her “little” workshop. “We got the engines up and running, and life support barely going. You might say life support is on life support until we can get some more parts in. The Nova can’t even land anywhere sub-orbital. The repulsors along the underside were totally decimated when she crashed.”"

rows.original: Shekka sighs and pats the wall affectionately. “The Nova is Novahome now. She’s our home. Maybe someday she’ll be the first capital ship in the raskvel navy, once we get ourselves sorted out.”

rows.original: , I think. It’s hot in the sun and cold in the night. Actual food is scarce - finding healthy plants is like discovering buried treasure, and seeds are guarded with our lives. We can usually rig up small underground fields to feed ourselves, but once there’s enough of us in a tribe, we wind up either leaving eggs in the wilds or kicking out a few unlucky souls.” She shudders. “It’s a pretty horrible life, to be honest.”
rows.translation: ，我想。太阳底下热，夜里冷。真正的食物很稀少 - 找到健康的植株就像发现埋藏的宝藏，种子我们用命守着。我们一般能搭起小小的地下田来养活自己，但一旦部落里的人多起来，我们就只能把蛋留在荒野里，或者赶走几个倒霉蛋。” 她打了个寒颤。“说实话，这日子挺可怕的。”

rows.original: “It sounds awful.”
rows.translation: “听起来太糟糕了。”

rows.original: “It is,” Shekka agrees. “You’ve got to forage for supplies without raising the ire of the other tribes or running into something worse, like a thirsty goo or an irritable sydian. Bam!” She pounds one fist into the other out of nowhere. “You lose a whole day worth of foraging and wind up laying in the dirt, holes stretched. Sure, you got your rocks off, but you’re left hungry, empty-handed, and alone.”
rows.translation: “是这样，”谢卡同意道。“你得在采集补给时不惹恼其他部落，也别撞上更糟的东西，比如一个饥渴的黏液体，或者一只脾气暴躁的西迪安。砰！”她突然一拳砸在另一只手掌上。“你损失一整天的采集工夫，最后躺在泥土里，洞都被撑开了。没错，你是爽到了，但你落得又饿、两手空空，还孤身一人。”

rows.translation: “该死，”这个红皮拉斯克维尔低声说道，“看来你的日子也没那么轻松。”她轻敲下巴，陷入思考。

rows.original: “There’s other areas like the wastes that are just about as bad if not worse. For one, there’s the scything glades. Trees grow there, metallic, predatory trees that lash out at anything that comes too close with razor-sharp blades. There’s usually a few safe paths through them, but you’d best keep your wits about you if you don’t want to wind up cut to ribbons with your blood used as fertilizer.”
rows.translation: “还有些地方和荒原差不多糟，甚至可能更糟。比如镰刃林地。那里生长着树木，一种金属构成、会捕食猎物的树；只要有什么靠得太近，它们便会用剃刀般锋利的刀刃抽打。通常有几条安全路径可以穿过，但如果你不想被切成碎布条，再让鲜血充当肥料，最好时刻保持警觉。”

rows.original: “Then there’s the Oil Sea. It isn’t really just oil either. It’s full of liquid metals, pollutants, corrosives, and the like. The place has been swarming with the goos since we kicked them out of Novahome. I guess the lubricants and moisture there have helped them reproduce.” She moves on to the next finger. “Watch out around the iron ridges too. All these metal plates make it the perfect place for ambushes. Our tribe never really went there
rows.translation: “然后是油海。那里其实也不只有油，而是充满液态金属、污染物、腐蚀性物质之类的东西。自从我们把黏液体赶出诺瓦之家，那地方就挤满了它们。我猜那里的润滑剂和水分帮助它们繁殖。”她数到下一根手指。“铁脊附近也要小心。那些金属板让那里成为了伏击的绝佳地点。我们部落从来不太去那里

rows.original: Shekka runs a hand along her workbench lovingly. “She’s not much, but she’s mine. I moved in back before our tribes grew to fill this place to the brim, so getting a decent-sized area classified as mine wasn’t that hard. I just had to build the shop here.” She knocks a wrench on the wall. “Turns out that if you aren’t bumping uglies all day, you can get a lot done!”
rows.translation: 谢卡爱惜地用手抚过工作台。“这地方不怎么样，但它属于我。我搬进来的时候，我们的部落还没发展到把这里塞得满满当当，所以划出一块大小还算过得去的区域归我，并不算太难。我只需要在这里把店建起来。”她用扳手敲了敲墙。“事实证明，只要你不整天忙着做爱，就能完成很多事情！”

rows.translation: 这多少有点令人失望，你还以为她要给你看些更特别的东西呢！没有裸体男女，也没有人在做爱...不过这些看起来确实很重要。大概越大越好，而图上没多少柱子算得上高。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s kind of disappointing; you thought she was going to show you something a little more special! No naked men or women, nobody’s fucking... It does look important though. Bigger is probably better, and not many bars are big."

rows.original: Fuck, what is this nerd shit? With a sigh you look over the graphs, trying to figure some of it out. Looks like... money and names, and something that goes larger and... smaller. Man, you have no idea...
rows.translation: 操，这他妈是什么书呆子玩意儿？你叹了口气，扫了一眼那些图表，想弄明白一点。看起来像...钱和名字，还有某个会变大又...变小的东西。天哪，你完全搞不懂...
rows.raw: "\n\nFuck, what is this nerd shit? With a sigh you look over the graphs, trying to figure some of it out. Looks like... money and names, and something that goes larger and... smaller. Man, you have no idea..."

rows.original: From the outset, it seems to be a project analysis, the names of some scientists, and their funds. Wait, those are costs. Population projections... time estimates too.
rows.translation: 乍看之下，这似乎是一份项目分析，列着一些科学家的姓名和他们的资金。等等，那些是成本。还有人口预测...以及时间估算。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the outset, it seems to be a project analysis, the names of some scientists, and their funds. Wait, those are costs. Population projections... time estimates too."

rows.original: It’s hard to say what you are looking at... there’s something about money projections, a few scientist names.
rows.translation: 很难说你正在看什么...里面有些资金预测，还有几个科学家的姓名。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s hard to say what you are looking at... there’s something about money projections, a few scientist names."

rows.original: Shekka takes back the pad with a weak smile, fighting hard to keep a yawn down. Okay, you bite, what exactly is the reason for all of this?
rows.translation: 谢卡勉强笑了笑，把平板拿回去，努力忍着一个哈欠。好吧，你开口问道，这一切到底是为了什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka takes back the pad with a weak smile, fighting hard to keep a yawn down. Okay, you bite, what exactly is the reason for all of this?"

rows.original: “Well, we talked about it before. The short version is that mature adults can’t get fixed up. So instead a treatment has to be given to them that won’t try to alter their thinking patterns... and at the same time pass it on to their children.” She hops off of her stool again, starting to pace from side-to-side. There’s a musical jingle-jangle from her ears as she does so. “If we started giving the treatment to Raskvel children post-birth then honestly it feels kind of... brain-washy. And also, just going to put it out there, I don’t like the idea of sticking needles into eggs. Or babies.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我们之前聊过这个。简单说吧，成年的个体没办法再做修正了。所以只能给她们用上一种治疗，这种治疗不会试图改变她们的思维模式...同时还能遗传给她们的孩子。”她又从凳子上跳下来，开始左右来回踱步。随着她的动作，耳朵上传来一串悦耳的叮当声。“要是我们等拉斯克维尔的孩子们出生后再给他们治疗，说实话，那感觉有点...洗脑。而且，我就直说了吧，我不喜欢把针扎进蛋里。或者扎进婴儿身上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, we talked about it before. The short version is that mature adults can’t get fixed up. So instead a treatment has to be given to them that won’t try to alter their thinking patterns... and at the same time pass it on to their children.” She hops off of her stool again, starting to pace from side-to-side. There’s a musical jingle-jangle from her ears as she does so. “If we started giving the treatment to Raskvel children post-birth then honestly it feels kind of... brain-washy. And also, just going to put it out there, I don’t like the idea of sticking needles into eggs. Or babies.”"

rows.original: The next question is of course; where do you come in? She looks uncomfortable when you finally breach the question. “Money is the first thing. I know you might not have any right now, that’s... I understand that. But I know you can make it an awful lot faster than I ever could on this glorified junk-heap.” Before you get a chance to speak up, she shakes her hands in alarm. “I-it’s not just money, [pc.name], really! I... your name is a big deal, scientists will actually listen to me! Even if you can’t help with the money part... would you be willing to sign your name to it, so that I can get to work?”
rows.translation: 接下来的问题自然是，你能在其中发挥什么作用？当你终于问出口时，她显得很不自在。“首先是钱。我知道你现在可能一分钱都拿不出来，这点...我理解。但我知道你赚钱的速度肯定比我守着这堆被美化过的垃圾快得多。”你还没来得及开口，她便惊慌地挥起双手。“不、不只是钱，[pc.name]，真的！我...你的名字很有分量，科学家们真的会听我说话！就算你在钱这方面帮不上忙...你愿意在计划上署名，让我可以开始工作吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next question is of course; where do you come in? She looks uncomfortable when you finally breach the question. “Money is the first thing. I know you might not have any right now, that’s... I understand that. But I know you can make it an awful lot faster than I ever could on this glorified junk-heap.” Before you get a chance to speak up, she shakes her hands in alarm. “I-it’s not just money, [pc.name], really! I... your name is a big deal, scientists will actually listen to me! Even if you can’t help with the money part... would you be willing to sign your name to it, so that I can get to work?”"

rows.original: Shekka looks at you with earnest desperation, and you smile warmly, holding out a hand. Shekka’s eyes well up with moisture, which is quickly rubbed away. She flips out her quilled hair before slapping her smaller hand into your [pc.hand]. “Th-thank you... I never doubted you for a second...”
rows.translation: 谢卡用恳切而绝望的眼神看着你，你温暖地笑了笑，伸出一只手。谢卡眼里涌起水光，又很快被擦掉。她甩了甩那满头棘刺似的头发，才把自己那只更小的手拍进你的[pc.hand]。“谢、谢谢你...我一秒都没怀疑过你...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka looks at you with earnest desperation, and you smile warmly, holding out a hand. Shekka’s eyes well up with moisture, which is quickly rubbed away. She flips out her quilled hair before slapping her smaller hand into your [pc.hand]. “Th-thank you... I never doubted you for a second...”"

rows.original: Shekka beams a smile at you, hands idly toying with her data-pad. “Hey [pc.name]! The moment I put your name out I got a whole bunch of response.” she pauses for a moment, clearing her throat uncomfortably. “Not all of it great, but for the most part rather positive. Seems your daddy’s last few years were spent making a good name for himself in genetics-based uplift and some quality of life stuff. I might be able to... uh... use, some of that.”
rows.translation: 谢卡朝你露出灿烂笑容，双手漫不经心地摆弄着数据板。“嘿，[pc.name]！我刚把你的名字放出去，就收到了大批回应。”她停顿片刻，不自在地清了清嗓子。“并非全是好消息，不过大部分都相当积极。看来你爸爸最后几年为自己在基因提升和改善生活质量方面挣下了不错的名声。我或许能够...呃...利用其中一部分。”
rows.raw: "Shekka beams a smile at you, hands idly toying with her data-pad. “Hey [pc.name]! The moment I put your name out I got a whole bunch of response.” she pauses for a moment, clearing her throat uncomfortably. “Not all of it great, but for the most part rather positive. Seems your daddy’s last few years were spent making a good name for himself in genetics-based uplift and some quality of life stuff. I might be able to... uh... use, some of that.”"

rows.original: You rock on your heels for a moment, soaking in Shekka’s excitement a little yourself. Hopefully she isn’t getting too far ahead of herself. At the very least it seems promising news. “Of course, while I’m waiting for a few call-backs, how about you and me do something to pass the time?”
rows.translation: 你用脚跟来回晃了一会儿，自己也稍稍沉浸在谢卡的兴奋中。希望她没有想得太超前。至少这消息听起来很有希望。“当然，在等几通回电的时候，你我何不做点事情打发时间？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rock on your heels for a moment, soaking in Shekka’s excitement a little yourself. Hopefully she isn’t getting too far ahead of herself. At the very least it seems promising news. “Of course, while I’m waiting for a few call-backs, how about you and me do something to pass the time?”"

rows.original: You mention the UGC Peacekeepers to Shekka and she immediately interrupts you. “Oh yeah, those guys? Geez, what a mess, am I right? Dozens of raskvel go missing to the Mess and nobody blinks an eye, but some wanted criminal from the core turns up on Tarkus and the police are out here faster than a jump start! I wouldn’t be surprised if the Confederacy was riding shotgun with slavers from day one.”

I’ll make sure it’ll be WELL worth your time,” you hint, suggestively pursing your lips together.
rows.translation: 你把她的双手按到自己的[pc.breasts]上，几乎一边上下蹦跳，一边恳求她帮忙。“谢卡啊啊啊啊啊啊...”你哀求道，“你这么聪明，而我真的需要进入獾博士的地盘，你就不能帮我这个小小小小的忙吗？我保证，这绝对会让你觉得物超所值，”你暗示道，意味深长地噘起嘴唇。

I’ll make sure it’ll be WELL worth your time,” you hint, suggestively pursing your lips together."

rows.original: The crimson scaled girl eyes your pexiga warily before turning back to you. “Hey, I’d love a chance to get some salvage from that bimbo-place. And, of course, the UGC and me get along about as well as a sparkplug and a bucket of anti-freeze. But I’ve got a business to think of. I can’t go around making trouble for Johnny Law just as a distraction for your weird monster there.”
rows.translation: 那个深红鳞片的女孩警惕地打量了一下你的佩克西加，然后转回来看你。“嘿，我倒很想去那个无脑花瓶的地盘弄点打捞品。而且，当然，UGC 和我相处得就像火花塞和一桶防冻液。但我得为生意着想。我不能为了给你那只怪东西打个掩护，就去给条子找麻烦。”

I can’t go around making trouble for Johnny Law just as a distraction for your weird monster there.”"

rows.original: Her tail whips back and forth in agitation. “Sorry, sorry, I’m just a bit punchy, I guess. You find anything of interest, bring it back and I’ll give it a look, but count me out on the infiltration bit. I’ve spent too long looking into the Mess to risk getting picked up for petty Breaking and Entering, you know?”

rows.original: She kisses you on the lips, long and slow. She doesn’t quite using her tongue, choosing to show her affection with the fierce press of mouth to mouth and the soft embrace of scaled arms around the back of your neck. Her eyes slowly drift closed as every ounce of tension leaves her body. Pulling back at last, Shekka’s eyes twinkle. “Thanks.”

rows.raw: "\n\nShe kisses you on the lips, long and slow. She doesn’t quite using her tongue, choosing to show her affection with the fierce press of mouth to mouth and the soft embrace of scaled arms around the back of your neck. Her eyes slowly drift closed as every ounce of tension leaves her body. Pulling back at last, Shekka’s eyes twinkle. “Thanks.”"

rows.original: Her ears flap and jingle musically for a moment as her face scrunches in consternation. “There have been some complaints that we’re changing all of our children against their will. It’s... kind of a valid point, I guess. The alternative though is being a bunch of tinker-obsessed-sluts, birthing more children than we can maintain, and getting walked all over by the established UGC races and companies,” as she gets fully invested in her complaints, she stamps her foot a few times. “Never mind that we’re smart. We’re smart for fuck’s sake. We could do and be amazing things if we weren’t being totally destroyed by outdated biology. It’s–uh... right. Sorry. Repeating myself.”
rows.translation: 她的双耳拍动片刻，发出悦耳叮当声，而脸也因困扰皱成一团。“有人抱怨我们违背所有孩子的意愿改造他们。我想这...多少算是个合理的观点。可另一种选择，就是让我们继续当一群痴迷修补东西的骚货，生下多到养不起的孩子，再被银河联合邦联那些根基稳固的种族与公司任意践踏，”当她彻底投入抱怨时，连着跺了几次脚。“别忘了我们很聪明。我们他妈真的很聪明。要不是过时的生理结构把我们彻底毁掉，我们本可以做出惊人的事业、成为了不起的人。这个——呃...对。抱歉。又重复了一遍。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears flap and jingle musically for a moment as her face scrunches in consternation. “There have been some complaints that we’re changing all of our children against their will. It’s... kind of a valid point, I guess. The alternative though is being a bunch of tinker-obsessed-sluts, birthing more children than we can maintain, and getting walked all over by the established UGC races and companies,” as she gets fully invested in her complaints, she stamps her foot a few times. “Never mind that we’re smart. We’re smart for fuck’s sake. We could do and be amazing things if we weren’t being totally destroyed by outdated biology. It’s–uh... right. Sorry. Repeating myself.”"

rows.original: Shekka’s cheeks blush a cute little purple as she reclaims her datapad. “You didn’t see that, right?” Your only response is a toothy grin and a knowing eyebrow wiggle.
rows.translation: 谢卡的脸颊泛起一小片可爱的紫色，她把数据板收了回去。“你没看到吧？”你唯一的回应就是一个咧嘴露齿的笑，和意味深长的挑眉。
rows.raw: "\n\nShekka’s cheeks blush a cute little purple as she reclaims her datapad. “You didn’t see that, right?” Your only response is a toothy grin and a knowing eyebrow wiggle."

rows.original: “A-anyway. Thanks for this, I’ll get this out to a few of them in no time... hopefully we won’t come up against any issues.” She gives your leg a quick hug before scampering over to her workbench, casting an eye over everything in an attempt to get her brain back on track again.
rows.translation: “总、总之。谢谢你，我很快就会把这个发给其中几个人...希望我们不会遇到任何问题。”她迅速抱了一下你的腿，随后飞奔到工作台旁，扫视所有东西，试图让自己的思绪重新回到正轨。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-anyway. Thanks for this, I’ll get this out to a few of them in no time... hopefully we won’t come up against any issues.” She gives your leg a quick hug before scampering over to her workbench, casting an eye over everything in an attempt to get her brain back on track again."

rows.original: Shekka looks rather tired now that you look her over. Still, she manages a bright smile in her cluttered little warehouse. “Heeey [pc.name].” she says, plucking up a v-drink and knocking it back in a few gulps. Her tail goes on end at the rush of chemicals, forcing her to shudder a few times. “Blech. Like a kick in the egg-hole, that stuff. Oh! Oh! Look!” she bunny-hops over, waving her datapad at you.
rows.translation: 仔细打量一番后，你发现谢卡显得相当疲惫。尽管如此，她还是在凌乱的小仓库里向你露出灿烂的笑容。“嘿——，[pc.name]。”她说着，拿起一瓶V饮料，几口灌了下去。化学物质猛然涌入体内，她的尾巴顿时根根竖起，身体也被迫颤抖了好几下。“呸。这玩意儿就像一脚踢进蛋孔。噢！噢！快看！”她像兔子般蹦跳过来，朝你挥舞着数据板。
rows.raw: "Shekka looks rather tired now that you look her over. Still, she manages a bright smile in her cluttered little warehouse. “Heeey [pc.name].” she says, plucking up a v-drink and knocking it back in a few gulps. Her tail goes on end at the rush of chemicals, forcing her to shudder a few times. “Blech. Like a kick in the egg-hole, that stuff. Oh! Oh! Look!” she bunny-hops over, waving her datapad at you."

rows.original: No homescreen to make fun of this time; it appears to be a video. You press the play button and it kicks into place. It’s a cross-section of an egg. Before you have a chance to be utterly horrified, she warns you that it’s a digital render, and to keep on watching. The beginning isn’t particularly interesting; it’s just growing (into an admittedly adorable mini-Rask).
rows.translation: 这次没有可供取笑的主屏幕；眼前似乎是一段视频。你按下播放键，画面随即启动。那是一颗卵的剖面图。还没等你彻底吓坏，她便提醒你这只是数字渲染图，让你继续看下去。开头并没有什么特别有趣的内容；它只是在生长（长成一只不可否认十分可爱的迷你拉斯克）。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo homescreen to make fun of this time; it appears to be a video. You press the play button and it kicks into place. It’s a cross-section of an egg. Before you have a chance to be utterly horrified, she warns you that it’s a digital render, and to keep on watching. The beginning isn’t particularly interesting; it’s just growing (into an admittedly adorable mini-Rask)."

rows.original: At that point there is a freeze-frame, and a split-off showing a list of numbers.
rows.translation: 到这时画面定格，旁边分出一块，显示出一串数字。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt that point there is a freeze-frame, and a split-off showing a list of numbers."

rows.original: Although it takes a few moments to muddle through, you realize it’s a rolling series of estimations on development. There’s a particularly huge hormone gland that now only seems to grow to half of its size. Likewise a number of small tweaks seem to have been added on. You blink and look down at Shekka. Did they just cure all of the known birth defects?
rows.translation: 虽然花了片刻才理清内容，但你发现这是一系列不断滚动更新的发育估算。有一处特别巨大的激素腺体，如今似乎只会长到原本一半的大小。同样，画面中似乎还加入了许多细微调整。你眨眨眼，低头看向谢卡。他们刚才是治好了所有已知的先天缺陷吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough it takes a few moments to muddle through, you realize it’s a rolling series of estimations on development. There’s a particularly huge hormone gland that now only seems to grow to half of its size. Likewise a number of small tweaks seem to have been added on. You blink and look down at Shekka. Did they just cure all of the known birth defects?"

rows.original: Her tail whips around and her ears jingle cheerfully, very obviously proud. “It seemed like a good thing to include while they were at it. Apparently way easier than fixing the brainpower-consuming breed-mania we have.” Huh, shit...
rows.translation: 她的尾巴来回甩动，耳朵欢快地叮当作响，显然十分自豪。“他们既然都已经着手了，把这个也包括进去似乎挺好的。显然，这比解决那种消耗脑力的繁殖狂热容易多了。”呃，见鬼...
rows.raw: "\n\nHer tail whips around and her ears jingle cheerfully, very obviously proud. “It seemed like a good thing to include while they were at it. Apparently way easier than fixing the brainpower-consuming breed-mania we have.” Huh, shit..."

rows.original: Sadly you can’t make sense of it all, but Shekka takes the time to patiently point out a bunch of numbers, a half-size hormone gland, and also “for shits and giggles” one of the scientists working on the solution happened to engineer out all of her race’s known birth defects.
rows.translation: 遗憾的是，你无法完全看懂这一切，但谢卡耐心地花时间指出了一大串数字、一个尺寸缩小了一半的激素腺体，还提到“纯粹为了找乐子”，参与研究解决方案的一位科学家顺便剔除了她种族所有已知的先天缺陷。
rows.raw: "\n\nSadly you can’t make sense of it all, but Shekka takes the time to patiently point out a bunch of numbers, a half-size hormone gland, and also “for shits and giggles” one of the scientists working on the solution happened to engineer out all of her race’s known birth defects."

rows.original: You give her a proud hug and ask what she needs next. After a brief moment of nuzzle your [pc.chest] she snaps back to reality. <i>“Uuuuh... right. The cure has been designed, we just need the manufacturing to get it off the ground. Y’know... pay people to distribute it to the many Raskvel out there over the next few weeks.
