rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s moments like this when you really appreciate this whole quest. You’d probably never see any of this from behind a desk at Steele Tech. As you’re taking it in, your comms pick up a distress signal. It’s too garbled to decipher anything beyond them being stranded. The message seems to be automated, which could mean that either the people sending it aren’t doing so well, or it’s a trap."

rows.original: Nobody ever said interstellar travel was fun. You find yourself on the same route you’re always on, seeing the same things. Your mind drifts back to that side path you took; it didn’t take that much longer than your normal route, and you barely got to explore. The tourist inside you is screaming at you to go see more of it, and you can’t ignore [pc.him] anymore.
rows.translation: 从来没人说过星际旅行很有趣。你发现自己又在那条一贯使用的航线上，看着一成不变的景物。你的思绪飘回曾走过的那条支线；它并没有比正常路线多花多少时间，而你几乎没来得及探索。你内心的游客正尖叫着要你去多看看那里，而你再也无法忽视[pc.him]了。
rows.raw: "Nobody ever said interstellar travel was fun. You find yourself on the same route you’re always on, seeing the same things. Your mind drifts back to that side path you took; it didn’t take that much longer than your normal route, and you barely got to explore. The tourist inside you is screaming at you to go see more of it, and you can’t ignore [pc.him] anymore."

rows.original: You take your time to observe more this time. In addition to the nebula there’s also a binary star system consisting of a larger star and a white dwarf star. Matter from the large star has accreted into a series of beautiful rings and tails around the dwarf star.
rows.translation: 这一次，你花时间观察了更多景象。除了星云之外，这里还有一个由一颗较大恒星与一颗白矮星组成的双星系统。来自大恒星的物质在白矮星周围吸积成一系列美丽的环带与尾迹。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your time to observe more this time. In addition to the nebula there’s also a binary star system consisting of a larger star and a white dwarf star. Matter from the large star has accreted into a series of beautiful rings and tails around the dwarf star."

rows.original: You could just sit here for hours and watch these wonderful sights, but just as you’re getting comfortable, the comm rings up. It’s a distress signal, the same one from before. If this is a trap, it’s a damn persistent one. Or maybe there really are people who need your help.
rows.translation: 你完全可以坐在这里欣赏这些美景数个小时，可就在你刚要安顿舒服时，通讯器响了起来。那是一道求救信号，和上次的一模一样。如果这是陷阱，那还真是个该死的执着陷阱。又或许，真的有人需要你的帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could just sit here for hours and watch these wonderful sights, but just as you’re getting comfortable, the comm rings up. It’s a distress signal, the same one from before. If this is a trap, it’s a damn persistent one. Or maybe there really are people who need your help."

rows.original: Who cares if it’s a trap? You’ll get through it, you always do.
rows.translation: 是陷阱又怎样？你总能挺过去，你一向如此。
rows.raw: "Who cares if it’s a trap? You’ll get through it, you always do."

rows.original: You have better things to do than put your ass on the line like that.
rows.translation: 你还有更重要的事可做，没必要这样拿自己的性命冒险。
rows.raw: "You have better things to do than put your ass on the line like that."

rows.original: You can’t let uncertainty stop you from doing the right thing.
rows.translation: 你不能让不确定性阻止自己去做正确的事。
rows.raw: "You can’t let uncertainty stop you from doing the right thing."

rows.original: It’s too much of a risk; better hope it’s actually a trap.
rows.translation: 风险太大了；最好祈祷它真的是个陷阱。
rows.raw: "It’s too much of a risk; better hope it’s actually a trap."

rows.original: Maybe there’ll even be some hotties to reward you for your heroism.
rows.translation: 说不定甚至还会有几个美人因你的英勇之举而奖励你。
rows.raw: " Maybe there’ll even be some hotties to reward you for your heroism."

rows.original: SHIZZY_TRAP_ENCOUNTERED
rows.raw: "SHIZZY_TRAP_ENCOUNTERED"

rows.original: What do you do?
rows.translation: 你要怎么做？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat do you do?"

rows.original: Investigate
rows.translation: 调查
rows.raw: "Investigate"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: If there really is someone in danger, then it’s worth risking the possible trap. Just in case, though, you take a route that keeps you closer to the nebula. The concentration of plasma and scattered material will make you harder to detect.
rows.translation: 如果真的有人身处险境，那么冒险面对可能存在的陷阱也值得。不过为了以防万一，你选择了一条更靠近星云的路线。集中的等离子体与散布的物质会让你更难被侦测到。
rows.raw: "If there really is someone in danger, then it’s worth risking the possible trap. Just in case, though, you take a route that keeps you closer to the nebula. The concentration of plasma and scattered material will make you harder to detect."

rows.original: You remember that from some of the technical manuals you read.
rows.translation: 这是你从读过的一些技术手册里记住的。
rows.raw: " You remember that from some of the technical manuals you read."

rows.original: One of your buddies from back in the day taught you that, saved your ass a few times already.
rows.translation: 你过去的一位老朋友教过你这招，已经救过你好几次了。
rows.raw: " One of your buddies from back in the day taught you that, saved your ass a few times already."

rows.original: Eventually you get close enough to be able to see the ship. It’s an old Pyrite Industries freighter. Probably broke down out here. Pyrite ships aren’t exactly known for their reliability, especially as they get up there in age. You pull out of the nebula’s range and try and open a comm channel. As you’d expect, the ship’s communication systems are down. Time for a rescue mission.
rows.translation: 最终，你靠得足够近，终于看清了那艘飞船。这是一艘黄铁矿工业的老旧货船。大概是在这里抛锚了。黄铁矿工业的飞船本来就不以可靠著称，尤其是上了年头之后。你驶出星云范围，尝试建立通讯频道。不出所料，那艘船的通讯系统已经瘫痪。该执行救援任务了。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually you get close enough to be able to see the ship. It’s an old Pyrite Industries freighter. Probably broke down out here. Pyrite ships aren’t exactly known for their reliability, especially as they get up there in age. You pull out of the nebula’s range and try and open a comm channel. As you’d expect, the ship’s communication systems are down. Time for a rescue mission."

rows.original: The second you start to close in, your sensors pick up an unknown weapon’s discharge, and before you can react, you’re hit. The whole ship shudders from the impact, the projectile seeming to go right through your shields. Lights dim, power failure warnings start blasting before fading out. Soon you’re down to nothing but emergency life support and a few lights.
rows.translation: 就在你开始接近的那一刻，传感器探测到一件未知武器开火；你还没来得及反应，便被击中了。整艘飞船都因冲击而震颤，弹体似乎直接穿透了护盾。灯光变暗，电力故障警报开始大作，随后又逐渐消失。很快，你只剩下紧急生命维持系统和几盏灯还能运作。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe second you start to close in, your sensors pick up an unknown weapon’s discharge, and before you can react, you’re hit. The whole ship shudders from the impact, the projectile seeming to go right through your shields. Lights dim, power failure warnings start blasting before fading out. Soon you’re down to nothing but emergency life support and a few lights."

rows.original: Anno comes barreling into the bridge, pulls out a maintenance panel from the wall and starts to work.
rows.translation: 安诺风风火火地冲进舰桥，从墙上拆下一块维修面板，开始动手检修。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno comes barreling into the bridge, pulls out a maintenance panel from the wall and starts to work."

rows.original: “What just hit us?” You ask, thinking she might know a bit more about this stuff than you.
rows.translation: “刚才撞上我们的是什么？”你问道，想着她也许比你更懂这些事。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What just hit us?” You ask, thinking she might know a bit more about this stuff than you."

rows.original: “If it blew through the shields like that, then it was at least a Class 3 EMP shell. Which means we need to get the fuck out of here. That’s military-grade shit, boss; if they have that level of tech, then we don’t want to mess with th-” A sudden flurry of sparks cuts her off, as smoke starts billowing out of the hole. Anno comes out, coughing up a fit as she starts cursing in irritation.
rows.translation: “要是它能那样打穿护盾，那至少是三级的EMP弹。也就是说我们他妈得赶紧离开这儿。那是军用级的东西，老板；要是他们有那种水平的技术，那我们可不想招惹这-”一阵火花突然爆开，打断了她的话，烟也开始从那洞里滚滚涌出。安诺从里面出来，咳得停不下来，一边恼火地骂着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If it blew through the shields like that, then it was at least a Class 3 EMP shell. Which means we need to get the fuck out of here. That’s military-grade shit, boss; if they have that level of tech, then we don’t want to mess with th-” A sudden flurry of sparks cuts her off, as smoke starts billowing out of the hole. Anno comes out, coughing up a fit as she starts cursing in irritation."

rows.original: “I’m guessing we’re fucked now?”
rows.translation: “我猜我们现在完蛋了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m guessing we’re fucked now?”"

rows.original: Another shock rocks the ship. This time it doesn’t feel like an explosion, and you hear noises coming from the airlock.
rows.translation: 又一次震动撼动了飞船。这次感觉不像爆炸，你听到气闸那边传来声响。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother shock rocks the ship. This time it doesn’t feel like an explosion, and you hear noises coming from the airlock."

rows.original: “Well, at least they’re boarding us instead of just blowing us up. I’ll go grab some weapons and meet you at the airlock. If we’re lucky, their bark is a lot worse than their bite.” She dashes out as another series of small quakes ring out. You grab your [pc.weapon] and head to the airlock ahead of her.
rows.translation: “好吧，至少他们是登船，而不是直接把我们炸掉。我去拿些武器，然后到气闸和你会合。运气好的话，他们只是叫得凶，咬起来没那么狠。”又一连串轻微震动响起，她随即飞奔而去。你抓起[pc.weapon]，赶在她前面前往气闸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, at least they’re boarding us instead of just blowing us up. I’ll go grab some weapons and meet you at the airlock. If we’re lucky, their bark is a lot worse than their bite.” She dashes out as another series of small quakes ring out. You grab your [pc.weapon] and head to the airlock ahead of her."

rows.original: You pull off a maintenance panel and get to work, seeing if there’s any way to restore at least some power. Shit, this is bad; some of the wiring and circuitry is already burned out. You try and rewire it to bypass the damaged parts, but only manage to make things worse. You’re not getting out of this with any quick repairs, and there’s no time to do anything in-depth.
rows.translation: 你拆下一块维修面板，开始动手，看看有没有办法至少恢复一点电力。妈的，情况很糟；有些线路和电路已经烧毁了。你试着重新接线绕过损坏的部分，却只把事情弄得更糟。靠快速修理是摆脱不了这个困境的，而你也没有时间做任何彻底的检修。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pull off a maintenance panel and get to work, seeing if there’s any way to restore at least some power. Shit, this is bad; some of the wiring and circuitry is already burned out. You try and rewire it to bypass the damaged parts, but only manage to make things worse. You’re not getting out of this with any quick repairs, and there’s no time to do anything in-depth."

rows.original: You’re way out of your depth with any of this. Things are broke, shit doesn’t work, and you have no idea where to start, how to start, or what you’d even start doing.
rows.translation: 这些东西完全超出了你的能力范围。设备坏了，什么都不运转，而你根本不知道该从哪里开始、怎么开始，甚至不知道自己究竟该做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re way out of your depth with any of this. Things are broke, shit doesn’t work, and you have no idea where to start, how to start, or what you’d even start doing."

rows.original: Another shock rocks the ship. This time it doesn’t feel like an explosion, and you hear noises coming from the airlock. They’ve docked with your ship. At least they didn’t just blow you to bits. You grab your [pc.weapon] and set off for the airlock. Hopefully you’ll have a better chance fighting them in person.
rows.translation: 又一次震动摇撼着飞船。这次感觉不像是爆炸，你还听见气闸那边传来响动。他们和你的船对接了。至少他们没有直接把你炸成碎片。你抓起[pc.weapon]，朝气闸出发。希望亲自和他们交手能多点胜算。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother shock rocks the ship. This time it doesn’t feel like an explosion, and you hear noises coming from the airlock. They’ve docked with your ship. At least they didn’t just blow you to bits. You grab your [pc.weapon] and set off for the airlock. Hopefully you’ll have a better chance fighting them in person."

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: WINSTON
rows.raw: "WINSTON"

rows.original: Winston
rows.translation: 温斯顿
rows.raw: "Winston"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: “Seabook, huh? I know that name.”
rows.translation: “西布克，是吧？我知道这个名字。”
rows.raw: "“Seabook, huh? I know that name.”"

rows.original: “Oh boy, you’re going to bring it up aren’t you?” Bring what up? Wait, was there something? You never really paid much attention to him beyond the basics. Oh right, he...
rows.translation: “天啊，你要提起那件事了，对吧？”提起什么？等等，是有什么事来着？除了基本情况，你从没真正留意过他。哦，对了，他...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh boy, you’re going to bring it up aren’t you?” Bring what up? Wait, was there something? You never really paid much attention to him beyond the basics. Oh right, he..."

rows.original: “So what if I blew my boss’s head off and collapsed Emeraude overnight in a sea of blood and bullets? People do bad shit all the time. Why I bet you haven’t even paid your taxes, have you?” Oh, yeah, that was the thing. Wait, taxes? Are you supposed to pay those? “In all seriousness, I had good damn reasons to do what I did.”
rows.translation: “我把老板的脑袋轰掉、一夜之间让埃默罗德陷进血与子弹的海洋里，那又怎样？人总在干坏事。我说，你怕是连税都没交过吧，是不是？”哦，对，就是这个。等等，税？这东西是要交的吗？“说正经的，我那么做有我他妈充分的理由。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what if I blew my boss’s head off and collapsed Emeraude overnight in a sea of blood and bullets? People do bad shit all the time. Why I bet you haven’t even paid your taxes, have you?” Oh, yeah, that was the thing. Wait, taxes? Are you supposed to pay those? “In all seriousness, I had good damn reasons to do what I did.”"

rows.original: “Which are?”
rows.translation: “什么理由？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Which are?”"

rows.original: “I said we had time to kill, not time to stuff in a burlap sack, drag down to the river, and hold it down until the bubbles stop.” ... Wow. “You want to keep talking about this now, or are we moving on?”
rows.translation: “我说我们有时间可以消磨，可没说有时间把它塞进麻袋、拖到河边，再按进水里直到气泡停止。”...哇。“你现在还想继续聊这件事，还是我们接着往下？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I said we had time to kill, not time to stuff in a burlap sack, drag down to the river, and hold it down until the bubbles stop.” ... Wow. “You want to keep talking about this now, or are we moving on?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, let’s just move on,” you agree.
rows.translation: “是啊，我们继续吧，”你同意道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, let’s just move on,” you agree."

rows.original: “You’re a pretty good shot; military, merc?”
rows.translation: “你枪法不错；军队出身，还是雇佣兵？”
rows.raw: "“You’re a pretty good shot; military, merc?”"

rows.original: “Oh, I scaled the tallest peaks of the most dangerous planets in order to find the greatest gunmen to teach me their ways. But it turned out that they either didn’t live up there, or they were ungodly expensive; so I just became a merc and learned from there.”
rows.translation: “哦，我攀登过最危险星球上的最高山峰，想找到最厉害的枪手，向他们拜师学艺。结果他们要么根本不住在山顶，要么贵得丧尽天良；所以我干脆当了雇佣兵，就这么学会了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I scaled the tallest peaks of the most dangerous planets in order to find the greatest gunmen to teach me their ways. But it turned out that they either didn’t live up there, or they were ungodly expensive; so I just became a merc and learned from there.”"

rows.original: “You just have a story for everything, don’t you?”
rows.translation: “你真是什么事都能编出个故事，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You just have a story for everything, don’t you?”"

rows.original: “Not everything, but I’ve got some killers if you want to know where the bathroom is. It’s not all bullshit either. I did climb a mountain, once, and the fucker up there was charging an arm and a leg, and probably about a fifth of a gallbladder for lessons.”
rows.translation: “不是什么都行，但你要想知道厕所在哪儿，我这儿有几招杀手锏。也不全是吹牛。我确实爬过一座山，有一次，山上那家伙收费要一条胳膊一条腿，大概还要五分之一个胆囊才肯教你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not everything, but I’ve got some killers if you want to know where the bathroom is. It’s not all bullshit either. I did climb a mountain, once, and the fucker up there was charging an arm and a leg, and probably about a fifth of a gallbladder for lessons.”"

rows.original: “Alright alright, let’s get to some actual questions,” you say.
rows.translation: “好了好了，咱们来说点真正的问题吧，”你说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright alright, let’s get to some actual questions,” you say."

rows.original: “What’s with the arm?”
rows.translation: “你的手臂是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: " “What’s with the arm?”"

rows.original: “Ah, you see my father was a warm-blooded spaceican who loved wearing black and had an unreasonable hatred of sand. One day we were playing on the rafters of one of his factories and he cut it off with his laser sword.”
rows.translation: “啊，你看，我父亲是个热血的太空人，喜欢穿黑衣服，还对沙子怀有不合情理的仇恨。有一天，我们在他一座工厂的椽梁上玩耍，他用激光剑把它砍了下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, you see my father was a warm-blooded spaceican who loved wearing black and had an unreasonable hatred of sand. One day we were playing on the rafters of one of his factories and he cut it off with his laser sword.”"

rows.original: “... Can you give a serious answer for once.”
rows.translation: “... 你能不能就认真回答一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“... Can you give a serious answer for once.”"

rows.original: “Well that’d just ruin the illusion wouldn’t it? Don’t want people thinking I’m smart or something.” This is getting maddening!
rows.translation: “那样不就破坏神秘感了吗？可不能让人以为我很聪明什么的。”这开始让人抓狂了！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well that’d just ruin the illusion wouldn’t it? Don’t want people thinking I’m smart or something.” This is getting maddening!"

rows.original: “Okay, where are you from?”
rows.translation: “好吧，你来自哪里？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, where are you from?”"

rows.original: You ask, expecting another nonsense answer. “Melkia, it’s a huskar colony in the Gilgamesh system.” Wow, a straight answer for once.
rows.translation: 你开口问了，本以为又会听到一句胡扯的回答。“梅尔基亚，是吉尔伽美什星系的一处赫斯卡殖民地。”哇，总算有一次直截了当的回答了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask, expecting another nonsense answer. “Melkia, it’s a huskar colony in the Gilgamesh system.” Wow, a straight answer for once."

rows.original: “Yep, my mom was a dickgirl, and I was born out of my dad’s asshole.” Well, it was nice while it lasted.
rows.translation: “对，我妈是个鸡巴娘，我是从我爹的屁眼里生出来的。”好吧，美好的时光总是短暂的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep, my mom was a dickgirl, and I was born out of my dad’s asshole.” Well, it was nice while it lasted."

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: “Well, I don’t have much to do around here. I’ll come back if I think of something else stupid to say.” With that, he walks back through the airlock, striking a pose that seems genuinely thoughtful.
rows.translation: “呃，我在这儿没什么事可做。要是我又想到什么蠢话，我会再回来的。”说完，他从气闸走了回去，还摆出一个看起来真在沉思的姿势。
rows.raw: "“Well, I don’t have much to do around here. I’ll come back if I think of something else stupid to say.” With that, he walks back through the airlock, striking a pose that seems genuinely thoughtful."

rows.original: That just leaves you and Shizuya. Many awkward minutes filled with nothing but the occasional clatter of metal as
rows.translation: 那就只剩下你和静夜了。许多尴尬的分钟里，什么都没有，只有偶尔传来的金属碰撞声，
rows.raw: "\n\nThat just leaves you and Shizuya. Many awkward minutes filled with nothing but the occasional clatter of metal as "

rows.original: Anno and Mika work
rows.translation: 安诺和米卡在工作
rows.raw: "Anno and Mika work"

rows.original: Mika works
rows.translation: 米卡在工作
rows.raw: "Mika works"

rows.original: on getting your ship back in working order. Shizuya finishes her drink in short order, and just sits and stares at you.
rows.translation: 让你的飞船恢复正常运作。静夜很快喝完了她的酒，然后只是坐着，盯着你看。
rows.raw: " on getting your ship back in working order. Shizuya finishes her drink in short order, and just sits and stares at you."

rows.original: You finally have time to just look over the massive kaithrit. She has short, unkempt red hair, parted by a pair of cat ears, one of which has a large chunk of it missing. She also has a pair of large ram horns that wrap around behind her head. Her face has several noticeable scars across it. They’re not fully faded yet, so they must be recent. Her eyes fade from green to red as they approach her slitted iris, though the red is very slight.

It feels like you could learn a lot about a ton of different cultures just from being here; that is, assuming both of you aren’t too drunk to talk coherently, because the drinks, right now at least, flow like water around here, and they’re strong. They’re the kind of drinks that would knock most people out, and even stuff that would put the unconditioned in the hospital.
rows.translation: 。至少可以说，这是一群古怪的人，其中几乎囊括你能想到的所有种族。光是待在这里，似乎就能了解大量不同的文化；当然，前提是你和交谈对象都没有醉到说不清话，因为这里的酒水，至少眼下，简直像水一样源源不断，而且酒劲很强。这些酒足以让大多数人当场倒下，其中甚至有些能把没有耐受力的人直接送进医院。
rows.raw: " of the crew. It’s an odd bunch to say the least, filled with people of almost every race you can think of. It feels like you could learn a lot about a ton of different cultures just from being here; that is, assuming both of you aren’t too drunk to talk coherently, because the drinks, right now at least, flow like water around here, and they’re strong. They’re the kind of drinks that would knock most people out, and even stuff that would put the unconditioned in the hospital."

rows.original: You eventually settle into a large lounge, where you
rows.translation: 你最终在一间宽敞的休息室里坐下，在那里你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou eventually settle into a large lounge, where you"

rows.original: , Anno
rows.translation: ，安诺
rows.raw: ", Anno"

rows.original: , Shizuya, and pals take some time to just shoot the shit, and by the time you decide it’s time to part ways, it’s already been several hours.
rows.translation: 、静夜和朋友们花时间闲聊了一通，等你们决定该分道扬镳时，已经过去好几个小时了。
rows.raw: ", Shizuya, and pals take some time to just shoot the shit, and by the time you decide it’s time to part ways, it’s already been several hours."

rows.original: “Well, shit, has it been that long? Alright, guess we better get movin’ on here. Addy, you been watching the coms?”
rows.translation: “好吧，见鬼，居然已经过了这么久？行了，我想咱们最好动身了。阿迪，你一直有留意通讯吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, shit, has it been that long? Alright, guess we better get movin’ on here. Addy, you been watching the coms?”"

rows.original: “Of course, someone has to have been working this whole time. Judau hasn’t been seen in... Wait, we might have something. One of our moles just got contacted, Leda-squad is moving in, and is requesting back-up.”
rows.translation: “当然，总得有人在这整段时间里一直工作。朱道一直没有露面... 等等，可能有情况了。我们的一名内线刚刚收到联系，莱达小队正在进场，并请求支援。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, someone has to have been working this whole time. Judau hasn’t been seen in... Wait, we might have something. One of our moles just got contacted, Leda-squad is moving in, and is requesting back-up.”"

rows.original: “Fuck yeah!” Everyone hops up immediately, and excitedly. “Um, yeah, gotta deal with this. But, uh, you know, if you see us around, ya can stop by anytime.
rows.translation: “操，当然！”大家立刻兴奋地跳了起来。“呃，对，得去处理这事了。不过，呃，你知道的，要是在附近看到我们，随时都能过来坐坐。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck yeah!” Everyone hops up immediately, and excitedly. “Um, yeah, gotta deal with this. But, uh, you know, if you see us around, ya can stop by anytime."

rows.original: You too, Anno. Sorry we couldn’t, uh, ya know, today. Offer’s still open, ‘specially if you bring your friend along.” Anno blows Shizuya a quick kiss, before turning to you. “Looking forward to it. Both of us, I hope.”
rows.translation: 你也是，安诺。抱歉我们今天没法，呃，你懂的。邀请还算数，尤其是你把你朋友也带上的话。” 安诺朝静夜送了个飞吻，然后转向你。“我很期待。希望我们俩都期待。”
rows.raw: " You too, Anno. Sorry we couldn’t, uh, ya know, today. Offer’s still open, ‘specially if you bring your friend along.”\n\nAnno blows Shizuya a quick kiss, before turning to you. “Looking forward to it. Both of us, I hope.” "

rows.original: With that, you follow Shizuya and company out of the room, parting ways at the hallway as you head back to the airlock, and back to your ship, where you replot your original course, and set off.
rows.translation: 说完这些，你跟着静夜一行人离开房间，在走廊上与她们分道扬镳。你返回气闸，回到自己的飞船，重新规划最初的航线，随后启程。
rows.raw: "With that, you follow Shizuya and company out of the room, parting ways at the hallway as you head back to the airlock, and back to your ship, where you replot your original course, and set off."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You all make your way down the hall and to the airlock. Once you pass through to her ship, you find not much to get excited about. The wide, tall hallway is mostly steel colored, with some red accents. There’s a stack of signs in front of you, with different colored lines going from them, along the walls. One leads to the left, and says “Hangar Elevator”, the other two lead to the right and say, “Crew Quarters: Block 4” and “Mess Hall/Kitchen”. You assume that’s where you’re going.
rows.translation: 你们一行人沿着走廊走到气闸。穿过气闸登上她的飞船后，你会发现没什么值得兴奋的。又宽又高的走廊大多是钢色，点缀着一些红色。你面前立着一叠指示牌，上面引出的彩色线条沿着墙壁延伸。一条指向左边，写着“机库电梯”，另外两条指向右边，分别写着“船员舱室：第4区”和“食堂/厨房”。你猜你们要去的就是那儿。
rows.raw: "You all make your way down the hall and to the airlock. Once you pass through to her ship, you find not much to get excited about. The wide, tall hallway is mostly steel colored, with some red accents. There’s a stack of signs in front of you, with different colored lines going from them, along the walls. One leads to the left, and says “Hangar Elevator”, the other two lead to the right and say, “Crew Quarters: Block 4” and “Mess Hall/Kitchen”. You assume that’s where you’re going."

rows.original: Shizuya pulls out her codex and starts to speak into it. “Hey guys, food time! Everyone get your asses to the mess hall.” Her voice echoes throughout the hall, presumably from an intercom system. Faint voices start echoing down the hall, growing steadily louder. Shizuya puts her hand on your shoulder and pushes you along.
rows.translation: 静夜拿出终端，对着它说起话来。“嘿，各位，开饭了！所有人都把屁股挪到食堂来。”她的声音在整条走廊里回荡，大概是通过内部广播系统传出的。远处隐约的人声开始沿着走廊传来，逐渐变得越来越响。静夜把手搭在你肩上，推着你往前走。
rows.raw: "\n\nShizuya pulls out her codex and starts to speak into it. “Hey guys, food time! Everyone get your asses to the mess hall.” Her voice echoes throughout the hall, presumably from an intercom system. Faint voices start echoing down the hall, growing steadily louder. Shizuya puts her hand on your shoulder and pushes you along."

rows.original: “Come on, don’t want to get stampeded before we serve up.” She shepherds you to the mess hall, passing a colorful collection of crew
rows.translation: “快走吧，别等咱们上菜之前就被人群踩扁了。”她把你往食堂引，一路上经过形形色色的船员
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on, don’t want to get stampeded before we serve up.” She shepherds you to the mess hall, passing a colorful collection of crew "

rows.original: memebers
rows.translation: 们
rows.raw: "memebers"

rows.original: members
rows.translation: 成员
rows.raw: "members"

rows.original: on the way. You burst into the mess hall, a group of at least 80 in tow. The mess is certainly big enough, at least; it looks more like a large dance hall with how spacious it is.
rows.translation: 。你们闯进食堂时，身后至少跟着八十人。至少食堂肯定足够大；从它宽敞的程度来看，更像是一座大型舞厅。
rows.raw: " on the way. You burst into the mess hall, a group of at least 80 in tow. The mess is certainly big enough, at least; it looks more like a large dance hall with how spacious it is."

rows.original: You look over and see where the kitchen is. Or, well, where it used to be. They weren’t exaggerating when they said a grenade blew up in there; you can hardly make anything out through all the soot. There’s a few people in there that were cleaning up, who come out as soon as you enter. One of them approaches you directly, though they’re all wearing gas masks, so it’s hard to make out her face. A mask can’t hide her whole body though, and it’s obvious that she’s a gryvain. Wings, tail, and scales all on full display, all pitch black, her skin is a chocolate tone, smooth and supple, the darkness contrasted by long, flowing locks of blonde hair. She’s also military, a pair of military pips decorating her simple, white shirt.
rows.translation: 你望向一旁，看见了厨房所在的位置。或者更确切地说，厨房曾经所在的位置。他们说有颗手雷在里面爆炸，这话一点也不夸张；隔着满屋的煤烟，你几乎什么都辨认不出来。里面原本有几个人正在清理，你一进门，他们便走了出来。其中一人径直走向你，不过他们全都戴着防毒面具，所以很难看清她的脸。面具却无法遮住她整个身体，显然她是一名格里文。翅膀、尾巴与鳞片全都一览无余，而且无一例外都是漆黑色；她的皮肤呈巧克力色，光滑柔软，深色肌肤与一头金色长发形成鲜明对比，发丝如瀑般垂落。她还是军人，朴素的白衬衫上装饰着一对军衔徽章。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look over and see where the kitchen is. Or, well, where it used to be. They weren’t exaggerating when they said a grenade blew up in there; you can hardly make anything out through all the soot. There’s a few people in there that were cleaning up, who come out as soon as you enter. One of them approaches you directly, though they’re all wearing gas masks, so it’s hard to make out her face. A mask can’t hide her whole body though, and it’s obvious that she’s a gryvain. Wings, tail, and scales all on full display, all pitch black, her skin is a chocolate tone, smooth and supple, the darkness contrasted by long, flowing locks of blonde hair. She’s also military, a pair of military pips decorating her simple, white shirt."

rows.original: She removes her gas mask, revealing a pair of piercing, slitted pink eyes, long eyelashes, and supple, black lips. One odd thing you note, is that there’s a slight glow emanating from her mouth.
rows.translation: 她摘下防毒面具，露出一双锐利的粉色竖瞳、长长的睫毛，以及柔软的黑色嘴唇。你还注意到一件奇怪的事：她的口中散发着微弱光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe removes her gas mask, revealing a pair of piercing, slitted pink eyes, long eyelashes, and supple, black lips. One odd thing you note, is that there’s a slight glow emanating from her mouth."

rows.original: “You must be [pc.name] Steele. Lieutenant Commander Aerowyn Alsmith.”
rows.translation: “你一定是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。艾洛温·阿尔斯密斯少校。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must be [pc.name] Steele. Lieutenant Commander Aerowyn Alsmith.”"

rows.original: “Military?”
rows.translation: “军方的人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Military?”"

rows.original: “Miss Tamaran and crew are actin’ under a UGC assignment. As such, an active duty officer of Lieutenant rank or higher is required to be present in order to enforce regulations and make regular progress reports.”
rows.translation: “塔玛兰女士和她的船员正在执行银河联合邦联的任务。因此，必须有一名中尉或更高军衔的现役军官在场，以确保规章得到执行，并定期提交进度报告。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Miss Tamaran and crew are actin’ under a UGC assignment. As such, an active duty officer of Lieutenant rank or higher is required to be present in order to enforce regulations and make regular progress reports.”"

rows.original: “Okay, why come up to me, though?”
rows.translation: “好吧，可你为什么来找我？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, why come up to me, though?”"

rows.original: <i>“What you did on Tarkus turned a few heads, including mine.
rows.translation: <i>“你在塔库斯做的事让不少人回头，包括我。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“What you did on Tarkus turned a few heads, including mine."

rows.original: Ya did good kid: Single-handedly taking out a group of entrenched, heavily armed pirates by yourself. That’s the kind of thing that gets people promoted, sometimes more than once. I should know.
rows.translation: 你干得不错，孩子：单枪匹马解决了一群盘踞据点、全副武装的海盗。这种事足以让人获得晋升，有时还不止升一级。我对此再清楚不过。
rows.raw: " Ya did good kid: Single-handedly taking out a group of entrenched, heavily armed pirates by yourself. That’s the kind of thing that gets people promoted, sometimes more than once. I should know."

rows.original: You may not ‘ave been successful, but your bravery, and the fact that you survived at all is impressive. That’s worth at least a commendation, a promotion or two if you had succeeded; I know that bit from experience.
rows.translation: 你也许没能成功，但你的勇气，还有你居然活了下来，这本身就令人佩服。至少够得上一枚嘉奖；要是你成功了，还能升上一两级；这点我凭经验就知道。
rows.raw: " You may not ‘ave been successful, but your bravery, and the fact that you survived at all is impressive. That’s worth at least a commendation, a promotion or two if you had succeeded; I know that bit from experience."

rows.original: She points toward the pips on her shirt. “See that red one? That’s the Republic Medal of Valor. I’d recount ya the tale, but it looks like the men don’t wanna wait any longer, ey?” Cheers erupt from behind you, calling for you to get on with the food serving.
rows.translation: 她指向衬衫上的军衔徽章。“看见那枚红色的吗？那是共和国英勇勋章。我本来可以给你讲讲那段经历，不过这些人似乎不愿再等了，对吧？”你身后爆发出一阵欢呼，催你赶紧开始分发食物。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points toward the pips on her shirt. “See that red one? That’s the Republic Medal of Valor. I’d recount ya the tale, but it looks like the men don’t wanna wait any longer, ey?” Cheers erupt from behind you, calling for you to get on with the food serving."

rows.original: You do so with gusto, setting it up buffet style with large plates of food in the middle of one of the larger tables on one side of the room, and setting out enough plates and silverware for everyone. The crew sieges the food table, tearing down the walls of food, and taking the fruits of their conquest to their tables. Thankfully, Shizuya prepared more than enough, and you’re able to serve yourself a hearty portion.
rows.translation: 你兴致勃勃地照办，把它布置成自助餐的形式，把几大盘食物摆在房间一侧较大的桌子上，并为所有人摆好足够的盘子和餐具。船员们围攻了那张餐桌，像推墙一样把食物一扫而空，然后带着战利品回到自己的桌边。幸好静夜准备得远不止够吃，你也能给自己盛上满满一份。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do so with gusto, setting it up buffet style with large plates of food in the middle of one of the larger tables on one side of the room, and setting out enough plates and silverware for everyone. The crew sieges the food table, tearing down the walls of food, and taking the fruits of their conquest to their tables. Thankfully, Shizuya prepared more than enough, and you’re able to serve yourself a hearty portion."

rows.original: Your stomach growls heavily as you look at the platter you’ve prepared for yourself. Your main course is a huge platter of smoked brisket, heavily seasoned and seared, red in the middle, and so moist and tender that your fork almost glides through it. On the side, you have a large bowl of rich, creamy, crisp coleslaw, and one of those baked potatoes from earlier, filled with sour cream, melted cheese of all kinds, chives, and bacon bits, all fried into a nice crust; they’re practically overflowing with how stuffed they are. For dessert, you grabbed the last piece of a delicious looking neapolitan cake, with delicious buttercream frosting, and is just delectably moist.
rows.translation: 看着为自己准备的餐盘，你的肚子响亮地咕咕叫起来。主菜是一大盘烟熏牛胸肉，调味浓郁、表面煎得焦香，中央仍透着红色；肉质湿润柔嫩，叉子几乎能直接滑过去。配菜是一大碗味道浓郁、口感爽脆的奶油凉拌卷心菜，还有先前那种烤土豆，里面塞满酸奶油、各式融化奶酪、细香葱和培根碎，所有材料都烤成了诱人的焦脆外壳；馅料多得几乎要溢出来。甜点则是你抢到的最后一块美味可口的三色蛋糕，覆着香甜的奶油霜，湿润得令人垂涎。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour stomach growls heavily as you look at the platter you’ve prepared for yourself. Your main course is a huge platter of smoked brisket, heavily seasoned and seared, red in the middle, and so moist and tender that your fork almost glides through it. On the side, you have a large bowl of rich, creamy, crisp coleslaw, and one of those baked potatoes from earlier, filled with sour cream, melted cheese of all kinds, chives, and bacon bits, all fried into a nice crust; they’re practically overflowing with how stuffed they are. For dessert, you grabbed the last piece of a delicious looking neapolitan cake, with delicious buttercream frosting, and is just delectably moist."

rows.original: You dig in and start eating as much as you possibly can. Unfortunately you bit off more than your tiny body could chew, and you quickly stuff yourself, barely having finished half of your food. Shizuya is sitting across from you, and softly comments on your predicament. <i>“There there little
rows.translation: 你埋头开吃，尽可能多地往嘴里塞。遗憾的是，你这副娇小身体承受不了自己揽下的食物，很快便撑得不行，盘里的东西连一半都没吃完。静夜坐在你对面，轻声评论起你的困境。<i>“好了，好了，小
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dig in and start eating as much as you possibly can. Unfortunately you bit off more than your tiny body could chew, and you quickly stuff yourself, barely having finished half of your food. Shizuya is sitting across from you, and softly comments on your predicament. <i>“There there little "

rows.translation: 伙子
rows.raw: "guy"

rows.original: girl
rows.translation: 女孩
rows.raw: "girl"

rows.original: , you don’t have to eat all of it, just finish what you want.” She reaches over and starts petting you. Your body is so heavy with food, that you couldn’t work up the strength to get her off, if you wanted too. She stays there for about a minute, before pulling off, and blowing you a soft kiss.
rows.translation: ，你不必全部吃完，只要吃完你想吃的就好。”她伸手过来，开始抚摸你。你的身体被食物撑得太沉，就算你想让她从你身上挪开，也使不上力气。她在那里待了大约一分钟，才把手收回，朝你轻轻吹了个吻。
rows.raw: ", you don’t have to eat all of it, just finish what you want.” She reaches over and starts petting you. Your body is so heavy with food, that you couldn’t work up the strength to get her off, if you wanted too. She stays there for about a minute, before pulling off, and blowing you a soft kiss."

rows.original: You dig in and start chowing down.
rows.translation: 你埋头开始大吃起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dig in and start chowing down. "

rows.original: You’ve barely
rows.translation: 你几乎还没
rows.raw: "You’ve barely"

rows.original: You haven’t
rows.translation: 你还没
rows.raw: "You haven’t"

rows.original: had a bite to eat since this whole thing started, and you’re going to get your fill, damn it! Shizuya watches as you gorge yourself, outpacing you, despite having to deal with her much larger portion. It almost becomes a silent competition between you and her, seeing whose appetite is stronger. You both finish at around the same time, though, ending whatever perceived bout the two of you were in, in a draw. “Love that enthusiasm, it’s infectious. Suppose that means the food was good?”
rows.translation: 吃上一口东西，整件事就开始了，而你他妈一定要填饱肚子！静夜看着你狼吞虎咽；尽管她得对付比你大得多的份量，进食速度却还是超过了你。这几乎演变成你们之间一场无声的较量，看谁的胃口更强。不过你们差不多同时吃完，于是两人自以为在进行的这场比赛最终以平局告终。 “我喜欢这股热情，真有感染力。这是不是说明食物很好吃？”
rows.raw: " had a bite to eat since this whole thing started, and you’re going to get your fill, damn it! Shizuya watches as you gorge yourself, outpacing you, despite having to deal with her much larger portion. It almost becomes a silent competition between you and her, seeing whose appetite is stronger. You both finish at around the same time, though, ending whatever perceived bout the two of you were in, in a draw.\n\n“Love that enthusiasm, it’s infectious. Suppose that means the food was good?”"

rows.original: “Definitely.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Definitely.”"

rows.original: You recline back in your seat, content to ride out the food coma until the end of this, when you suddenly feel something brush against your leg. You’re about to look under the table and see when suddenly
rows.translation: 你靠回座椅上，心满意足地熬过饭后的困倦，等着这一切结束，这时你忽然感觉有什么东西擦过你的腿。你正要往桌下看个究竟，突然
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recline back in your seat, content to ride out the food coma until the end of this, when you suddenly feel something brush against your leg. You’re about to look under the table and see when suddenly"

rows.translation: 你感觉到有个小东西被推进你的[pc.anus]里。
rows.raw: " you feel a small object being pushed into your [pc.anus]."

rows.original: You jump a bit and quietly yelp, getting immediately shushed by whoever is under the table.
rows.translation: 你吓了一跳，小声叫了出来，立刻被桌子底下不知谁发出的嘘声制止。
rows.raw: " You jump a bit and quietly yelp, getting immediately shushed by whoever is under the table."

rows.original: “Initiation time, meat.” The voice starts speaking softly, and of course it’s Mika. Wait, “initiation”?
rows.translation: “该入门了，肉。”那个声音轻轻地开口，当然是米卡。 等等，“入门”？
rows.raw: " “Initiation time, meat.” The voice starts speaking softly, and of course it’s Mika. Wait, “initiation”?"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh, probably not. I’d hope we would, be better than paperwork, but the UGC isn’t gonna let a bunch of nobodies and an old psycho handle a big job, are they? Oh well.”"

rows.original: Them
rows.translation: 他们
rows.raw: "Them"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 不
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 不
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No more questions.
rows.translation: 没有更多问题了。
rows.raw: "No more questions."

rows.original: WINSTON
rows.raw: "WINSTON"

rows.original: Winston & Shizuya
rows.translation: 温斯顿与静夜
rows.raw: "Winston & Shizuya"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: Here you are, face to face with the strange intruders. For people who must be professionals, given the hardware they have, they’re very... What’s a nice word for dysfunctional? Winston and Adelline are back at arguing. What they’re arguing about escapes you, and Shizuya too, apparently.
rows.translation: 你就在这里，与这群奇怪的闯入者面对面。看他们拥有的装备，这些人肯定是专业人士，可他们实在非常... 要怎么委婉地形容失调呢？温斯顿和阿德琳又吵了起来。你完全不知道他们在争论什么，静夜显然也一样。
rows.raw: "Here you are, face to face with the strange intruders. For people who must be professionals, given the hardware they have, they’re very... What’s a nice word for dysfunctional? Winston and Adelline are back at arguing. What they’re arguing about escapes you, and Shizuya too, apparently."

rows.original: She’s taken to squatting on the floor and cracking open a bottle of vodka. She takes a big sip before offering some to you. “Suka blyat.” What? “Want some?” “No thanks.” “Suit yourself, comrade.”
rows.translation: 她索性蹲在地上，打开一瓶伏特加。她灌了一大口，然后递给你，问你要不要也来点。 “苏卡不列。”什么？“来点吗？” “不用了，谢谢。” “随你便，同志。”
rows.raw: " She’s taken to squatting on the floor and cracking open a bottle of vodka. She takes a big sip before offering some to you. “Suka blyat.” What? “Want some?” “No thanks.” “Suit yourself, comrade.”"

rows.original: She’s taken to sitting on the floor and cracking open a soda. She takes a big sip before offering some to you. “Want some?” “No thanks.” “Suit yourself.”
rows.translation: 她近来喜欢坐在地上开一罐汽水。她先灌了一大口，然后递过来让你也来点。 “要来点吗？” “不用了，谢谢。” “随你便。”
rows.raw: " She’s taken to sitting on the floor and cracking open a soda. She takes a big sip before offering some to you. “Want some?” “No thanks.” “Suit yourself.”"

rows.original: A blonde gryvain woman interrupts the argument, dragging Adelline away, leaving Winston all by himself. Without anything else to do, he comes over to you and introduces himself.
rows.translation: 一名金发格里文女性打断争吵，把阿德琳拖走，只留下温斯顿独自一人。无事可做的他走到你身旁，作起自我介绍。
rows.raw: "\n\nA blonde gryvain woman interrupts the argument, dragging Adelline away, leaving Winston all by himself. Without anything else to do, he comes over to you and introduces himself."

rows.original: “Winston Seabook, nice to meet you.” He extends his hand out, and you meet his gesture, if only to not make this too awkward.
rows.translation: “温斯顿·西布鲁克，很高兴认识你。”他伸出手，你也回握过去，只为了不让场面太尴尬。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Winston Seabook, nice to meet you.” He extends his hand out, and you meet his gesture, if only to not make this too awkward."

rows.original: You take the time to look him over: He’s a tall man, a little over seven feet and very grizzled despite his youthful energy, easily over fifty from his looks. His hair is short and blonde, and an equally short, well-trimmed beard wraps around his squared jaw-line. His eyes are a piercingly bright shade of blue, almost white. He’s definitely muscular, built like a small tank, with a washboard stomach that you could probably grate cheese on. The biggest thing to note, however, is the massive amount of scars across his body.
rows.translation: 你花时间仔细打量了他一番：他身材高大，略高于七英尺；虽然精力显得年轻，外表却饱经风霜，看起来很容易就能判断已经超过五十岁。他留着金色短发，同样短且修剪整齐的胡须环绕着方正的下颚。他的双眼呈现一种锐利明亮、近乎白色的蓝色。他显然肌肉发达，体格如同一辆小型坦克，还有一副仿佛能拿来擦奶酪的搓衣板腹肌。不过最引人注意的，还是遍布他身体的大量伤疤。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the time to look him over: He’s a tall man, a little over seven feet and very grizzled despite his youthful energy, easily over fifty from his looks. His hair is short and blonde, and an equally short, well-trimmed beard wraps around his squared jaw-line. His eyes are a piercingly bright shade of blue, almost white. He’s definitely muscular, built like a small tank, with a washboard stomach that you could probably grate cheese on. The biggest thing to note, however, is the massive amount of scars across his body."

rows.original: The arm he’s shaking your hand with is covered in large bald spots along its blonde fur, giving way to various burns and scars. The simple white tank top he sports is low cut enough for you to see a large gash just below his neck, barely visible under his fluffy, blonde mane. And, lastly, his other arm is completely bandaged up, small glints of metal showing between the wrappings. His massive tail is extremely large and fluffy. Unlike the rest of him, it looks pristine, groomed, and incredibly soft.
rows.translation: 他和你握手的那条手臂上，金色的毛里东一块西一块地秃着，露出各种烧伤和疤痕。他身上那件简单的白色背心领口开得够低，你能看见他脖子下方一道长长的裂口，在他蓬松的金色鬃毛下几乎看不出来。最后，他另一条手臂整个缠满了绷带，缝隙间闪着金属的微光。他巨大的尾巴极其粗大蓬松。和他身体的其他部分不同，它看上去洁净、梳理得当，而且柔软得不可思议。
rows.raw: " The arm he’s shaking your hand with is covered in large bald spots along its blonde fur, giving way to various burns and scars. The simple white tank top he sports is low cut enough for you to see a large gash just below his neck, barely visible under his fluffy, blonde mane. And, lastly, his other arm is completely bandaged up, small glints of metal showing between the wrappings. His massive tail is extremely large and fluffy. Unlike the rest of him, it looks pristine, groomed, and incredibly soft."

rows.original: Wait, Seabook? Why does that name sound familiar? Oh wait, you remember! He was a big shot at one of the larger merc companies, back in the day. No wonder he was so accurate.
rows.translation: 等等，西布鲁克？为什么这名字听着耳熟？哦，等等，你想起来了！当年他在一家规模较大的佣兵公司里可是个大人物。难怪他枪法那么准。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, Seabook? Why does that name sound familiar? Oh wait, you remember! He was a big shot at one of the larger merc companies, back in the day. No wonder he was so accurate."

rows.original: “So, Steele’s kid, huh?”
rows.translation: “所以，你是斯蒂尔家的孩子，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, Steele’s kid, huh?”"

rows.original: “Yeah? You knew him?”
rows.translation: “是吗？你认识他？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah? You knew him?”"

rows.original: “Naaaaaaaaaah, I just looked you up a few minutes ago after I thought this didn’t seem right. I thought Steele Tech made ice cream or some shit, but I guess they do other stuff.” You get the impression that he’s not being completely honest.
rows.translation: “不——啦，我就是几分钟前觉得这事不太对劲，才去查了查你。我还以为斯蒂尔科技是做冰淇淋之类的玩意儿，看来他们也干别的。”你感觉他并没有完全说实话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Naaaaaaaaaah, I just looked you up a few minutes ago after I thought this didn’t seem right. I thought Steele Tech made ice cream or some shit, but I guess they do other stuff.” You get the impression that he’s not being completely honest."

rows.original: “Questions, comments, suggestions? We got plenty of time to kill.”
rows.translation: “有什么问题、意见或建议吗？我们还有很多时间要打发。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Questions, comments, suggestions? We got plenty of time to kill.”"

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: Him
rows.translation: 他
rows.raw: "Him"

rows.original: Who is he?
rows.translation: 他是谁？
rows.raw: "Who is he?"

rows.original: Them
rows.translation: 他们
rows.raw: "Them"

rows.original: Them
rows.translation: 他们
rows.raw: "Them"

rows.original: Who are they?
rows.translation: 他们是谁？
rows.raw: "Who are they?"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 不
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 不
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: You should at least ask who they are.
rows.translation: 你至少该问问他们是谁。
rows.raw: "You should at least ask who they are."

rows.original: As soon as you reach the airlock, the doors slam open and a massive explosion rings from them, knocking you to ground and disorienting you. Your [pc.weapon] is blown clear and your vision is cut off by a large cloud of smoke, but you can make out a large figure stepping toward you from the airlock. Before it even gets through the doors, it begins to speak in a distinctly female voice.
rows.translation: 你刚走到气闸门前，门就轰然打开，一声巨大的爆炸从那里响起，把你掀翻在地，震得你晕头转向。你的[pc.weapon]被炸飞了，视线被一大团烟雾遮住，但你能看清一个巨大的身影正从气闸里朝你走来。它还没走出门口，就用一个明显是女性的声音说起话来。
rows.raw: "As soon as you reach the airlock, the doors slam open and a massive explosion rings from them, knocking you to ground and disorienting you. Your [pc.weapon] is blown clear and your vision is cut off by a large cloud of smoke, but you can make out a large figure stepping toward you from the airlock. Before it even gets through the doors, it begins to speak in a distinctly female voice."

rows.original: “Well well well, ya fell for that one quick, didn’t ya? I thought you were supposed to be smart? Well, doesn’t matter much, you’re gonna tell me what I need to know or else this won’t be-”
rows.translation: “好啊，好啊，好啊，你这么快就上当了，对吧？我还以为你应该很聪明呢？不过也没什么关系，你得把我需要知道的事告诉我，否则这就不会-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well well well, ya fell for that one quick, didn’t ya? I thought you were supposed to be smart? Well, doesn’t matter much, you’re gonna tell me what I need to know or else this won’t be-”"

rows.original: “Ya sure took your sweet fucking time! I was starting to think that you’d figured it out, but here we are. Now, you’re going to tell me everything, or else this won’t be-”
rows.translation: “你他妈可真会磨蹭！我都开始以为你已经识破了，可我们还是在这里碰面了。现在，你得把一切都告诉我，否则这就不会-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ya sure took your sweet fucking time! I was starting to think that you’d figured it out, but here we are. Now, you’re going to tell me everything, or else this won’t be-”"

rows.original: A loud clang rings out as the figure that was talking screams and falls forward, splitting the leftover smoke from the explosion as she impacts the floor.
rows.translation: 一声巨响突然传来，正在说话的身影尖叫着向前摔倒。她撞上地板时，将爆炸残留的烟雾从中劈开。
rows.raw: "\n\nA loud clang rings out as the figure that was talking screams and falls forward, splitting the leftover smoke from the explosion as she impacts the floor."

rows.original: “WINSTON, YOU AND MIKA WERE SUPPOSED TO FIX THAT LOOSE STRUT!” She screams at a large, scruffy looking huskar man.
rows.translation: “温斯顿，你和米卡本来应该修好那根松动的支柱！”她冲着一个身材高大、外表邋遢的赫斯卡男人尖叫道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“WINSTON, YOU AND MIKA WERE SUPPOSED TO FIX THAT LOOSE STRUT!” She screams at a large, scruffy looking huskar man."

rows.original: “There’s a hell of a lot more broken in this old piece of shit than that strut, give me a break!” The man replies in a deep voice.
rows.translation: “这艘老破烂上坏掉的东西比那根支柱多得他妈离谱，饶了我吧！”男人用低沉的声音回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s a hell of a lot more broken in this old piece of shit than that strut, give me a break!” The man replies in a deep voice."

rows.original: “Yeah, we barely got this thing in shape for today.” Another female voice says. You can’t see this one. She must be pretty far back there.
rows.translation: “对，我们好不容易才让这东西勉强能应付今天。”另一个女性声音说道。你看不到这个人。她一定在里面相当远的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, we barely got this thing in shape for today.” Another female voice says. You can’t see this one. She must be pretty far back there."

rows.original: “Fiiiiiine, sorry.” The first woman says as she picks herself up off the ground. As she stands up, you realize that, sweet fuck, she’s tall!
rows.translation: “好——吧，对不起。”第一个女人一边说，一边从地上爬起来。等她站直身体时，你才意识到，操，她可真高！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fiiiiiine, sorry.” The first woman says as she picks herself up off the ground. As she stands up, you realize that, sweet fuck, she’s tall!"

rows.original: She’s about on par with Brynn, maybe even taller. Of course, it doesn’t seem to matter how many eleven foot tall people you see, it never stops being surprising.
rows.translation: 她的身高与布琳不相上下，甚至可能更高。当然，无论你见过多少个身高十一英尺的人，这种场面永远都会令人惊讶。
rows.raw: " She’s about on par with Brynn, maybe even taller. Of course, it doesn’t seem to matter how many eleven foot tall people you see, it never stops being surprising."

rows.original: At about eleven feet, by your estimation, she’s about the tallest normal person you’ve seen so far.
rows.translation: 据你估计有大约十一英尺高，是你目前为止见过最高的普通人。
rows.raw: " At about eleven feet, by your estimation, she’s about the tallest normal person you’ve seen so far."

rows.original: “I knew we should have just let Mika rip the ship open and drag him out.”
rows.translation: “我就知道我们该让米卡把船撕开，直接把他拖出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew we should have just let Mika rip the ship open and drag him out.”"

rows.original: Wait, him?
rows.translation: 等等，他？
rows.raw: " Wait, him?"

rows.original: “Please don’t encourage her, Shizuya.” A calm, but stern toned voice calls out. The woman steps into view, revealing herself, and
rows.translation: “拜托，别鼓励她，静夜。”一个平静却严厉的声音传来。那个女人走进视线，露出自己的身形，而
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please don’t encourage her, Shizuya.” A calm, but stern toned voice calls out. The woman steps into view, revealing herself, and"

rows.original: you recognize her as one of the Vanae. A weird thing you see immediately is that she seems to have a working pair of eyes. Though, on closer inspection, her eyes appear to be cybernetic, or at least enhanced in some way.
rows.translation: 你认出她是瓦奈人。你立刻注意到一件奇怪的事：她似乎有一双能正常工作的眼睛。不过仔细观察后，她的眼睛看起来像是义眼，或者至少接受过某种强化。
rows.raw: " you recognize her as one of the Vanae. A weird thing you see immediately is that she seems to have a working pair of eyes. Though, on closer inspection, her eyes appear to be cybernetic, or at least enhanced in some way."

rows.original: you don’t quite recognize her species, but your codex beeps out that she’s something called a vanae. Weird, it says their eyes are vestigial, but hers seem to be working fine, must be implants or something.
rows.translation: 你不太认得她的种族，但终端发出提示，说她属于一种名叫瓦奈的种族。奇怪，资料说她们的眼睛已经退化，可她的似乎工作正常，肯定是植入体之类的东西。
rows.raw: " you don’t quite recognize her species, but your codex beeps out that she’s something called a vanae. Weird, it says their eyes are vestigial, but hers seem to be working fine, must be implants or something."

rows.original: “You know that would have been far too risky.”
rows.translation: “你知道那样风险太大了。”
rows.raw: " “You know that would have been far too risky.”"

rows.original: “You mean it would have been far too fun?” The unseen woman calls out, mockingly.
rows.translation: “你是说那样就太好玩了？”那个看不见的女人嘲弄地喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean it would have been far too fun?” The unseen woman calls out, mockingly."

rows.original: “Ugh.” The vanae grunts out, not paying any more thought to the comment. “Now, captain, your plan worked; are you going to stop beating yourself up over it now?” She says to the tall woman, smiling expectantly.
rows.translation: “呃。” 那个瓦奈人咕哝道，不再多想那句评论。“好了，舰长，你的计划奏效了；现在你总该停止自责了吧？” 她对那个高个子女人说道，满怀期待地笑着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ugh.” The vanae grunts out, not paying any more thought to the comment. “Now, captain, your plan worked; are you going to stop beating yourself up over it now?” She says to the tall woman, smiling expectantly."

rows.original: “It was a pretty bad plan, honestly. I’m surprised it worked!” The tall woman says, somewhat dejectedly in response. The vanae’s smile quickly disappears, and she just grunts out again. While nobody’s looking at you, you quietly reach for your [pc.weapon]. You’re not sure if you can take three of them, and probably a lot more from the sounds deeper in, but you’re not willing to go out without a fight. A shot suddenly lands between your hand and your weapon just as you get within reach. The huskar is holding a large handgun, twirling and flipping it around his finger.
rows.translation: “说实话，这计划相当糟糕。它居然成功了，连我都很惊讶！”高个女人有些沮丧地回应道。瓦奈人的笑容迅速消失，只是又哼了一声。趁没人看着你，你悄悄伸手去摸[pc.weapon]。你不确定自己能不能对付他们三个，而且听深处传来的动静，里面的人很可能多得多；但你不愿束手就擒。就在你的手快要够到武器时，一发子弹突然落在手与武器之间。那个赫斯卡手持一把大型手枪，让枪绕着手指旋转翻飞。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a pretty bad plan, honestly. I’m surprised it worked!” The tall woman says, somewhat dejectedly in response. The vanae’s smile quickly disappears, and she just grunts out again. While nobody’s looking at you, you quietly reach for your [pc.weapon]. You’re not sure if you can take three of them, and probably a lot more from the sounds deeper in, but you’re not willing to go out without a fight. A shot suddenly lands between your hand and your weapon just as you get within reach. The huskar is holding a large handgun, twirling and flipping it around his finger."

rows.original: “Good grief, did you really think I wouldn’t see that? You kids today aren’t that bright. Back in my day we kept emergency grenades up our asses; it worked great, until Jenkins had to ruin everything. Remember kids, loose anuses sink ships, literally in this case.” What the hell is he talking about?
rows.translation: “天哪，你真以为我看不见吗？你们这些年轻人可没那么机灵。我年轻那会儿，我们都把应急手雷塞在屁眼里；这法子一直好用得很，直到詹金斯把一切搞砸了。记住了孩子们，屁眼松，船会沉，这次是字面意思上的沉船。” 他到底在说什么鬼话？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good grief, did you really think I wouldn’t see that? You kids today aren’t that bright. Back in my day we kept emergency grenades up our asses; it worked great, until Jenkins had to ruin everything. Remember kids, loose anuses sink ships, literally in this case.” What the hell is he talking about?"

rows.original: “You know I only have so many grunts I can make in a row before my throat starts to hurt?” The vanae quips.
rows.translation: “你知道我一连哼几声，喉咙就会开始疼吧？”这个瓦奈人打趣道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know I only have so many grunts I can make in a row before my throat starts to hurt?” The vanae quips."

rows.original: “Wow, Adelline makes a joke! Anyone see a flying pig around here? If you do, tell that fucker he owes me two-hundred credits.” The two get into a back-and-forth scuff, trying to one-up each other. You’d think the huskar would be distracted by this, but the way he aims his gun at you when you try to move says otherwise. The tall woman has mostly been engrossed in their conversation, but the occasional glances in your direction tell you that she’s also still keenly aware of you.
rows.translation: “哇，阿德琳居然会开玩笑！有人看见这附近有猪在天上飞吗？要是看见了，告诉那个混蛋，它还欠我两百信用点。”两人你-来-我-往地拌起嘴来，都想压-过对方一头。你或许会以为那个赫斯卡会因此分心，可每当你试图移动，他便把枪口对准你，显然并非如此。高个女人大多沉浸在他们的争论里，但偶尔投向你的目光说明，她仍然清楚留意着你的一举一动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, Adelline makes a joke! Anyone see a flying pig around here? If you do, tell that fucker he owes me two-hundred credits.” The two get into a back-and-forth scuff, trying to one-up each other. You’d think the huskar would be distracted by this, but the way he aims his gun at you when you try to move says otherwise. The tall woman has mostly been engrossed in their conversation, but the occasional glances in your direction tell you that she’s also still keenly aware of you."

rows.original: She looks over at you with a puzzled look on her face. “Aren’t ya supposed to be a guy?”
rows.translation: 她一脸困惑地看向你。“你不应该是个男人吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks over at you with a puzzled look on her face. “Aren’t ya supposed to be a guy?”"

rows.original: “I am.” “Okay, okay, I see.”
rows.translation: “我就是。” “好吧，好吧，我明白了。”
rows.raw: " “I am.” “Okay, okay, I see.”"

rows.original: “Says who?” “I mean, whatever.”
rows.translation: “谁说的？” “我是说，随便吧。”
rows.raw: " “Says who?” “I mean, whatever.”"

rows.original: She turns to you fully, an act that seems to signal to her arguing companions that it’s time to get serious. “Alright Judau, you know exactly why we’re here. Your contact already squealed on ya, told us you knew where to find one of the bigwigs of the operation. It’d work a lot better for ya if you just spilled it right now.”
rows.translation: 她彻底转过身来面对你，这个动作仿佛在向仍在争吵的同伴示意，该认真办事了。“好了，朱达，你很清楚我们为什么来这里。你的联系人已经把你供出来了，告诉我们，你知道该去哪里找这场行动的一位大人物。你要是现在就老实交代，事情会好办得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns to you fully, an act that seems to signal to her arguing companions that it’s time to get serious. “Alright Judau, you know exactly why we’re here. Your contact already squealed on ya, told us you knew where to find one of the bigwigs of the operation. It’d work a lot better for ya if you just spilled it right now.”"

rows.original: judau
rows.raw: "judau"

rows.original: Contacts? Bigwigs? What is she talking about?
rows.translation: 联系人？大人物？她到底在说什么？
rows.raw: " Contacts? Bigwigs? What is she talking about?"

rows.original: Who the hell is Judau? What is she even talking about?
rows.translation: 朱达到底是谁？她到底在说什么？
rows.raw: " Who the hell is Judau? What is she even talking about?"

rows.original: “Um, I think you have the wrong person. I have no idea what you’re talking about.”
rows.translation: “呃，我想你认错人了。我完全不知道你在说什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um, I think you have the wrong person. I have no idea what you’re talking about.”"

rows.original: “Wow, you know I really appreciate you frying my ship because you can’t get your facts straight.”
rows.translation: “哇，你知道吗，我可真感谢你因为自己没搞清楚事实就把我的船烧了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, you know I really appreciate you frying my ship because you can’t get your facts straight.”"

rows.original: “Bitch, what are you even talking about?”
rows.translation: “贱货，你到底在说什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bitch, what are you even talking about?”"

rows.original: “Don’t try and weasel out of this! We knew you’d be coming by this route, who the hell else would?”
rows.translation: “别想狡辩脱身！我们知道你会经过这条路线，不然他妈还能是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t try and weasel out of this! We knew you’d be coming by this route, who the hell else would?”"

rows.original: “What do you mean?”
rows.translation: “你什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do you mean?”"

rows.original: “What do ya mean what do I mean? This route is only safe for a very small amount of time, and only smugglers like you, and bitches like us who have to be on your ass, keep track of that.” Say what? Before she can say anything else, the huskar man comes up to her and begins whispering in her ear.
rows.translation: “什么叫我什么意思？这条路线安全的时间只有很短一段，而且只有像你这样的走私贩，还有像我们这样得盯着你们屁股的婊子，才会记着这事。”什么？她还没来得及再说别的，那个赫斯卡男人就走到她身旁，开始在她耳边低语。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What do ya mean what do I mean? This route is only safe for a very small amount of time, and only smugglers like you, and bitches like us who have to be on your ass, keep track of that.” Say what? Before she can say anything else, the huskar man comes up to her and begins whispering in her ear."

rows.original: “What?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?”"

rows.original: <i>“I SAID THAT’S
rows.translation: <i>“我说那是
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I SAID THAT’S "

rows.original: STEELE!” The man comically yells.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔！”那男人滑稽地大喊。
rows.raw: " STEELE!” The man comically yells."

rows.original: “I DIDN’T MEAN TO SCREAM IT!” The woman replies.
rows.translation: “我不是故意喊出来的！”那女人回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I DIDN’T MEAN TO SCREAM IT!” The woman replies."

rows.original: “I KNOW!” Winston screams back. The large woman raises her hands like she’s about to throttle him, but slams them into her own face instead. She holds her double face-palm for at least a minute, occasionally shrieking into her palms. Eventually she slides her hands down off her face.
rows.translation: “我知道！”温斯顿吼了回去。那个高大女人举起双手，像是要掐死他，却转而拍在自己脸上。她双手捂着脸至少有一分钟，偶尔对着掌心尖叫。最后，她把手从脸上滑下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I KNOW!” Winston screams back. The large woman raises her hands like she’s about to throttle him, but slams them into her own face instead. She holds her double face-palm for at least a minute, occasionally shrieking into her palms. Eventually she slides her hands down off her face."

rows.original: “Okay. Okay, okay, okay, okay, okay, O. FUCKIN’. KAY! This is why you don’t let me come up with the plans.” She says, looking back at her other crew members. Adelline keeps up a disappointed scowl while Winston just blows a quick raspberry. She turns back to you.
rows.translation: “好吧。好吧，好吧，好吧，好吧，好吧，好。他。妈。的。吧！所以才不能让我来制定计划。”她一边说，一边回头望向其他船员。阿德琳仍然失望地板着脸，温斯顿则飞快地吐了吐舌头。她重新转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay. Okay, okay, okay, okay, okay, O. FUCKIN’. KAY! This is why you don’t let me come up with the plans.” She says, looking back at her other crew members. Adelline keeps up a disappointed scowl while Winston just blows a quick raspberry. She turns back to you."

rows.original: “Ya okay, buddy? You can probably figure out that there was, uh, a little mix up here.” You stand up and stare at her, wordlessly and angrily. “I guess we owe ya an explanation huh?” Damn right they do! Part of you wants to lay into them, but you also realize that they still massively outgun you, so you need to take this carefully.
rows.translation: “你还好吗，朋友？你大概也能看出来，这里，呃，出了点小误会。”你站起身，一言不发地怒视着她。“我想我们欠你一个解释，对吧？”他们当然欠！你有一部分冲动想把他们痛骂一顿，可你也意识到，他们的火力依旧远远强过你，所以必须谨慎处理。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ya okay, buddy? You can probably figure out that there was, uh, a little mix up here.” You stand up and stare at her, wordlessly and angrily. “I guess we owe ya an explanation huh?” Damn right they do! Part of you wants to lay into them, but you also realize that they still massively outgun you, so you need to take this carefully."

rows.original: Shizuya & Anno
rows.translation: 静夜与安诺
rows.raw: "Shizuya & Anno"

rows.original: Suddenly Anno bursts out from behind you, brandishing what looks like the biggest rifle she could find. “Don’t worry [pc.name], I got your ba-” Anno stops, staring at the woman with a confused look on her face, as if she’s trying hard to remember something. The woman has the same look, but she quickly perks up and starts to speak.
rows.translation: 安诺突然从你身后冲出来，挥舞着一把看起来是她能找到的最大号步枪。“别担心，[pc.name]，我来掩护-”安诺停了下来，一脸困惑地盯着那个女人，仿佛正拼命回想什么。那个女人也露出同样的表情，不过她很快便精神一振，开口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly Anno bursts out from behind you, brandishing what looks like the biggest rifle she could find. “Don’t worry [pc.name], I got your ba-” Anno stops, staring at the woman with a confused look on her face, as if she’s trying hard to remember something. The woman has the same look, but she quickly perks up and starts to speak."

rows.original: “Anno? Is that you? Holy crap, I haven’t seen you since... well, ya know.” Anno takes a few more moments surveying, before everything seems to click. “Shizuya?” She hesitantly asks. The woman nods enthusiastically in response. “Wh-what the hell did you do to yourself? Better yet, why did you attack us?” She raises her gun up, leveling it at Shizuya.
rows.translation: “安诺？真的是你吗？天哪，自从...嗯，你知道的那件事之后，我就再也没见过你。”安诺又打量了她片刻，随后像是终于把一切都联系起来。“静夜？”她迟疑地问道。那个女人兴奋地点头回应。“你-你他妈把自己弄成什么样了？更重要的是，你为什么袭击我们？”她举起枪，瞄准静夜。
rows.raw: " “Anno? Is that you? Holy crap, I haven’t seen you since... well, ya know.” Anno takes a few more moments surveying, before everything seems to click. “Shizuya?” She hesitantly asks. The woman nods enthusiastically in response. “Wh-what the hell did you do to yourself? Better yet, why did you attack us?” She raises her gun up, leveling it at Shizuya. "

rows.original: “What did I do to myself? Look at you, all, uh... umm...” She devolves into gibberish as she looks over Anno’s new curves, utterly lost until Anno feins a loud cough and draws the kaithrit’s attention back to the husky’s heavy gun.
rows.translation: “我对自己做了什么？看看你，浑身都，呃...嗯...”她打量着安诺崭新的曲线，逐渐退化成含糊不清的胡言乱语，完全不知所措；直到安诺故意大声咳嗽，才把这个凯斯里特的注意力重新拉回赫斯卡手中的重枪上。
rows.raw: "“What did I do to myself? Look at you, all, uh... umm...” She devolves into gibberish as she looks over Anno’s new curves, utterly lost until Anno feins a loud cough and draws the kaithrit’s attention back to the husky’s heavy gun. "

rows.original: Shizuya sighs.
rows.translation: 静夜叹了口气。
rows.raw: "Shizuya sighs."

rows.original: “Look, it’s really complicated; we thought you were someone else, so we kinda jumped the gun here.” Anno still looks a bit unconvinced, and only slightly lowers her weapon. Suddenly the weapon is yanked from her hands and, before she can react, a box of tools is shoved in its place. Looking down, you all see a small, dark skinned cowgirl in front of Anno. How did she get there without you seeing?
rows.translation: “听着，这事真的很复杂；我们把你当成了别人，所以算是有点操之过急了。”安诺仍显得不太信服，只把武器稍稍放低。武器突然被人从她手中夺走，她还没来得及反应，一个工具箱就被塞进原来的位置。你们低头一看，只见一个深色皮肤的小奶牛娘站在安诺面前。她到底是怎么在你毫无察觉的情况下跑到那里的？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, it’s really complicated; we thought you were someone else, so we kinda jumped the gun here.” Anno still looks a bit unconvinced, and only slightly lowers her weapon. Suddenly the weapon is yanked from her hands and, before she can react, a box of tools is shoved in its place. Looking down, you all see a small, dark skinned cowgirl in front of Anno. How did she get there without you seeing?"

rows.original: You take the time to examine her. She can’t be any taller than about four and a half feet, though she certainly manages to pack a lot into her small frame. The loose-fitting, black tank top she wears lets you see how ripped her arms and back are. They flex with an unnatural strength, and several odd bulges and metal protrusions tell you that she’s had some augmentation done. Her short, black hair is tied up into a small ponytail, letting you see one more augment going down her neck.
rows.translation: 你花了些时间打量她。她顶多只有四英尺半高，娇小的身躯里却着实塞进了不少东西。她穿着宽松的黑色背心，让你能看见手臂与背部的肌肉何等结实。那些肌肉迸发着不自然的力量，几处古怪的隆起与金属突起则说明她接受过某些强化。她将黑色短发扎成一小束马尾，让你还能看见另一处沿着颈部向下延伸的强化装置。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the time to examine her. She can’t be any taller than about four and a half feet, though she certainly manages to pack a lot into her small frame. The loose-fitting, black tank top she wears lets you see how ripped her arms and back are. They flex with an unnatural strength, and several odd bulges and metal protrusions tell you that she’s had some augmentation done. Her short, black hair is tied up into a small ponytail, letting you see one more augment going down her neck."

rows.original: It’s a thin metallic strip leading from her head to a small set of openings at the base of her neck.
rows.translation: 那是一条细细的金属条，从她头部一直延伸到她颈根处的一小组开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a thin metallic strip leading from her head to a small set of openings at the base of her neck."

rows.original: You remember reading about something like this not too long ago. It’s a form of power armor interface, used to provide the user with quick, accurate control over larger power armor frames. You don’t recall reading about a price, but you’d certainly think that it would be out of the reach of a bunch of normal bounty hunters.
rows.translation: 你记得不久前读到过类似的东西。这是一种动力装甲接口，能让使用者快速、精准地控制更大型的动力装甲框架。你不记得读到过它的价格，但可以肯定，这绝不是一群普通赏金猎人负担得起的东西。
rows.raw: " You remember reading about something like this not too long ago. It’s a form of power armor interface, used to provide the user with quick, accurate control over larger power armor frames. You don’t recall reading about a price, but you’d certainly think that it would be out of the reach of a bunch of normal bounty hunters."

rows.original: You’re certainly not well-versed enough in this kind of thing to really know what they’re for, but it looks way too expensive for a bunch of bounty hunters.
rows.translation: 你对这类东西绝对算不上精通，无法真正判断它们有什么用途，但这看起来实在太昂贵了，不像是一群赏金猎人能负担得起的。
rows.raw: " You’re certainly not well-versed enough in this kind of thing to really know what they’re for, but it looks way too expensive for a bunch of bounty hunters."

rows.original: Then again, they’ve already shown that they have some access to some pretty beefy hardware.
rows.translation: 不过话说回来，他们已经证明过自己能用上一些相当强力的硬件。
rows.raw: " Then again, they’ve already shown that they have some access to some pretty beefy hardware."

rows.original: “Come on then, we’re not getting this heap fixed up by standing around.” The little lady says, aggravatedly. Anno tries to say something, but the little cowgirl just walks off, carrying her own toolbox. Anno’s eyes dart between you and her, trying to decide what to do. Shizuya chimes in. “Relax, I’m not gonna do anything bad back here, and Mika’s not gonna bite ya unless you ask.”
rows.translation: “那就快点吧，光站着可修不好这堆破烂。”小个子女人恼火地说。安诺想说点什么，但那小奶牛娘已经拎着自己的工具箱走开了。安诺的目光在你和她之间来回转，拿不定主意该做什么。静夜插了句话：“放松，我在后头不会干什么坏事，米卡也不会咬你，除非你求她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on then, we’re not getting this heap fixed up by standing around.” The little lady says, aggravatedly. Anno tries to say something, but the little cowgirl just walks off, carrying her own toolbox. Anno’s eyes dart between you and her, trying to decide what to do. Shizuya chimes in. “Relax, I’m not gonna do anything bad back here, and Mika’s not gonna bite ya unless you ask.”"

rows.original: Anno still seems a bit flustered about the situation. not sure how to go about dealing with it. “HEY SNOWY, THE SHIP ISN’T FIXING ITSELF. GET YOUR ASS OVER HERE!” Anno jumps at the sudden shout from Mika, letting out an irritated growl before finally deciding to go with her.
rows.translation: 安诺似乎仍被眼前的情形弄得有些慌乱，不知该如何应对。“嘿，小白，这艘船可不会自己修好。赶紧给我滚过来！”米卡突然大喊一声，吓得安诺猛然一跳；她恼火地低吼一声，最终还是决定跟她走。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno still seems a bit flustered about the situation. not sure how to go about dealing with it. “HEY SNOWY, THE SHIP ISN’T FIXING ITSELF. GET YOUR ASS OVER HERE!” Anno jumps at the sudden shout from Mika, letting out an irritated growl before finally deciding to go with her."

rows.original: You see a dark skinned cowgirl walking out from behind the rest of them. She’s about on par with you, in terms of height. She’s carrying a large toolbox, and has an irritated look on her face. She approaches you surprisingly quickly and quietly; if she weren’t near eye-to-eye with you, you might not even notice her coming up.
rows.translation: 你看见一个深色皮肤的牛女从其他人身后走出来。她身高和你差不多。她提着个大工具箱，脸上带着不耐烦的神色。她靠近你的速度快得惊人，而且悄无声息；要不是她几乎与你视线齐平，你可能根本不会注意到她走过来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see a dark skinned cowgirl walking out from behind the rest of them. She’s about on par with you, in terms of height. She’s carrying a large toolbox, and has an irritated look on her face. She approaches you surprisingly quickly and quietly; if she weren’t near eye-to-eye with you, you might not even notice her coming up."

rows.original: A sudden tug on your leg brings your attention to a little, dark skinned cowgirl at your feet.
rows.translation: 腿上突如其来的一阵拉扯，将你的注意力引向脚边一个深色皮肤的小奶牛娘。
rows.raw: "\n\nA sudden tug on your leg brings your attention to a little, dark skinned cowgirl at your feet."

rows.translation: 你对这类东西绝对算不上精通，无法真正判断它们有什么用途，但这看起来实在太昂贵了，不像是一群赏金猎人能负担得起的。

rows.original: Then again, they’ve already shown that they have some access to some pretty beefy hardware.
rows.translation: 不过话说回来，他们已经证明过自己能用上一些相当强力的硬件。
rows.raw: " Then again, they’ve already shown that they have some access to some pretty beefy hardware."

rows.original: “Hey, do you know how to fix this heap up?”
rows.translation: “嘿，你知道该怎么把这堆破烂修好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, do you know how to fix this heap up?”"

rows.original: You explain that you’ve never really gotten too deep into how to fix it up, but you could... “Ugh, never mind, don’t have time to teach a noobie.”
rows.translation: 你解释说自己从来没真正深入研究过该怎么修它，不过你可以... “唉，算了，没空教一个新手。”
rows.raw: " You explain that you’ve never really gotten too deep into how to fix it up, but you could... “Ugh, never mind, don’t have time to teach a noobie.”"

rows.original: Little cunt.
rows.translation: 小婊子。
rows.raw: " Little cunt."

rows.original: You tell her that you have no fucking clue. “Figures.” She rolls her eyes.
rows.translation: 你告诉她你他妈的一点头绪都没有。 “果然。”她翻了个白眼。
rows.raw: " You tell her that you have no fucking clue. “Figures.” She rolls her eyes. "

rows.original: You hear a soft squealing from behind her, and see Shizuya staring at you, delightedly. “Soooooooo cute!” She whispers under her breath. The little cowgirl goes red on hearing that.
rows.translation: 你听到她身后传来一声轻细的尖叫，回头看见静夜正满心欢喜地盯着你。 “太——可爱了！”她压低声音耳语。小奶牛娘一听这话就红了脸。
rows.raw: "You hear a soft squealing from behind her, and see Shizuya staring at you, delightedly.\n\n“Soooooooo cute!” She whispers under her breath. The little cowgirl goes red on hearing that. "

rows.original: She hoists her toolbox and goes into your ship.
rows.translation: 她提起工具箱，走进你的飞船。
rows.raw: "She hoists her toolbox and goes into your ship."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Investigate
rows.translation: 调查
rows.raw: "Investigate"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: You decide to ignore the signal and return to your business. You take one last look into the beautiful nebula before getting back to the helm and piloting to your destination.
rows.translation: 你决定无视那个信号，回去做你的事。你最后看了一眼那美丽的星云，然后回到驾驶位，驾驶飞船前往目的地。
rows.raw: "You decide to ignore the signal and return to your business. You take one last look into the beautiful nebula before getting back to the helm and piloting to your destination."

rows.original: Next

rows.original: “Okayokayokay! So here’s wifey, here’s her preggy, here’s her with the babes.” She goes on and on, gushing about each picture. In many of them you see the woman who must be her wife. She’s tall, probably about six and a half to seven feet, comparing her to Shizuya’s behemoth stature. She has a grizzled, but feminine look about her. She’s muscled, but fairly slender, with wide hips. Her face is covered in nicks and scars, but not enough to heavily mar her smooth, rich, caramel skin. Her hair is long, but well kept, with a flat fringe and a lustrous sheen. That is, except in the picture of her and Shizuya with their newborns, where she’s obviously worn down by labor, but still manages to smile as she cradles three mewling little half-breed pups, Shizuya hugging her close with tears in her eyes.
rows.translation: “好好好！这是我老婆，这是她怀孕的时候，这是她和孩子们。”她说个不停，兴致勃勃地介绍每一张照片。在许多照片中，你都能看到那个想必就是她妻子的女人。拿她和静夜那庞然身躯相比，她身材高挑，大概有六英尺半到七英尺。她看起来饱经风霜，却又不失女性气质。她肌肉发达，但相当苗条，髋部宽阔。她脸上布满细小伤口与疤痕，不过还不至于严重破坏那光滑浓郁的焦糖色肌肤。她留着长发，却打理得十分整洁，刘海平齐，光泽亮丽。只有那张她和静夜抱着新生儿的照片例外；她显然因分娩而疲惫不堪，却依然设法露出笑容，怀里抱着三只喵喵叫的混-血幼崽，静夜则眼含泪水地紧紧拥着她。

rows.original: “I hate long missions, [pc.name]. Ya might not think it, looking at me and how I act, but I’ve started to be more of a homebody these days. Just, ya know, I used to think being out here, doing the adventurer stuff was all there was, this was going to be my new life.”
rows.translation: “我讨厌漫长的任务，[pc.name]。看我的模样和行事作风，你可能想不到，但这些年来我越来越喜欢待在家里了。只是，你知道，我以前觉得待在外面干冒险者的活儿就是人生的全部，这会成为我的新生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hate long missions, [pc.name]. Ya might not think it, looking at me and how I act, but I’ve started to be more of a homebody these days. Just, ya know, I used to think being out here, doing the adventurer stuff was all there was, this was going to be my new life.”"

rows.original: “I used to be kind of a bastard; it’s hard to even think I’m still the same person. Back when I first joined up, I was just so into it; huntin’ people down, bringing them in or just wiping them out, it felt right. But, then when Kenka, when I... when she told me she was pregnant... I don’t know, it’s like everythin’ that was hard and jagged in me just softened up. Might have also had something to do with her mother almost blowing my head off when she figured out.”
rows.translation: “我以前有点混蛋；很难想象我还是同一个人。刚入行时，我完全沉迷其中；追捕别人、把他们抓回来，或者干脆赶尽杀绝，这一切都让我觉得理所当然。可是，后来肯卡，她...当她告诉我自己怀孕时...我不知道，就好像我心里所有坚硬而尖锐的东西都软化了。或许也和她母亲发现这件事后差点轰掉我的脑袋有关。”

Back when I first joined up, I was just so into it; huntin’ people down, bringing them in or just wiping them out, it felt right. But, then when Kenka, when I... when she told me she was pregnant... I don’t know, it’s like everythin’ that was hard and jagged in me just softened up. Might have also had something to do with her mother almost blowing my head off when she figured out.”"

rows.original: “What?”

rows.original: “Yeah, Kenka’s family aren’t exactly the kindest people. But Kenka stood up for me, and eventually she came around. When we got to the wedding, I felt... I don’t know.”
rows.translation: “是啊，肯卡的家人不算是多和善的人。但肯卡为我挺身而出，最后她也想通了。等我们到了婚礼上，我感觉...我不知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, Kenka’s family aren’t exactly the kindest people. But Kenka stood up for me, and eventually she came around. When we got to the wedding, I felt... I don’t know.”"
