rows.original: “Sort of, but, I think it’s better to say I felt like... me. It was like wakin’ up from a long dream; one that had been goin’ on since before I got Treated. It was the first time I felt like I knew myself in so long.” She roots through the pile of pictures and brings up one of her and Kenka. Kenka in a beautiful, white wedding dress, and Shizuya in a tuxedo that looks at least two sizes too small for her, and with tears streaming down her face.
rows.translation: “算是吧，不过，我觉得更准确的说法是，我感觉自己像是...真正的自己。就像从一场漫长的梦里醒来；那场梦从我接受改造疗程前就一直延续至今。这是这么久以来，我第一次觉得自己真正了解自己。”她翻找着那堆照片，拿出一张自己和肯卡的合影。肯卡穿着漂亮的白色婚纱，静夜则穿着一套看起来至少小了两个尺码的燕尾服，泪水正沿着脸颊滚滚流下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sort of, but, I think it’s better to say I felt like... me. It was like wakin’ up from a long dream; one that had been goin’ on since before I got Treated. It was the first time I felt like I knew myself in so long.” She roots through the pile of pictures and brings up one of her and Kenka. Kenka in a beautiful, white wedding dress, and Shizuya in a tuxedo that looks at least two sizes too small for her, and with tears streaming down her face."

rows.original: “She didn’t know if we should do a kaithrit wedding or an ausar wedding, so we met in the middle with a terran one. I didn’t even know why I was crying, it felt so overwhelming. There I was, standing up there with the love of my life, and kids on the way. When I was just a dumpy little dork getting bullied in school, I thought I’d end up being some loser working a dead-end job, in an unhappy marriage, if anyone even took enough pity to even have me.”
rows.translation: “她不知道我们该办凯斯里特式婚礼还是奥萨尔式婚礼，所以我们折中办了一场泰伦式的。我甚至不知道自己为什么会哭，那感觉太强烈了。我就站在那里，身边是我一生的挚爱，孩子们也即将降生。当年我还只是个在学校里受人欺负、又矮又胖的呆子时，我以为自己最后会成为一个做着没有前途工作的失败者，困在不幸的婚姻里，前提是有人可怜我到愿意要我。”

rows.original: “What about Mika?”

rows.original: “Mika’s our little workhorse. If there’s one thing that girl loves more than fuckin’, it’s tech. Ya need something fixed, or need to know what guns blow stuff up the best, ya go to Mika. She knows every system, bit of electronics, panel, vent, and rivet on this ship. And ho boy, that girl loves her guns. She used to keep a bunch of them in her room. That was before she nearly blew a hole in the hull, and Addy made her tone it down to just a pistol. Now she’s got that workshop down in the hangar, with nice, reinforced walls.”
rows.translation: “米卡是我们的小劳模。要说有什么比操更让那姑娘喜欢，那就是科技。你需要修东西，或者想知道哪种枪炸东西最厉害，就去找米卡。她熟悉这艘船上的每套系统、每件电子设备、每块面板、每条通风道和每颗铆钉。而且，嚯，那姑娘可太爱枪了。她以前在房间里放了一大堆。后来她差点在船壳上炸出一个洞，阿迪便让她收敛点，只准留一把手枪。现在她在机库下面有了那间工坊，墙壁结实，还经过了加固。”

Ya need something fixed, or need to know what guns blow stuff up the best, ya go to Mika. She knows every system, bit of electronics, panel, vent, and rivet on this ship. And ho boy, that girl loves her guns. She used to keep a bunch of them in her room. That was before she nearly blew a hole in the hull, and Addy made her tone it down to just a pistol. rows.original: “New Texas. She was just wandering around, lookin’ pretty sad. Apparently she’d just gotten fired for gettin’ into a fight at work and was pretty close to givin’ up. When I told her that I was a ship captain, she begged me to come on board. I was like, I ain’t gonna’ take this random kid on missions, she’s just gonna get hurt. Then she told me about how she’d been studying UGC technical manuals that her uncle got her her whole life, and that she could fix a ship better than any stuffed shirt college shit; her words, not mine. She proved that by fixin’ that shitty old aft machine gun. She could shoot too, way better than me, at least, which is good enough. So we took her on.”
rows.translation: “新德克萨斯。她当时只是在四处游荡，看起来非常沮丧。据说她刚因为在工作时打架而被开除，已经快要放弃了。我告诉她自己是一名船长后，她便求我让她上船。我当时想，我可不会带这个来路不明的小鬼去出任务，她只会受伤。接着她告诉我，自己一辈子都在研究叔叔给她弄来的银河联合邦联技术手册，修飞船比任何穿着体面的大学废物都厉害；这是她的原话，不是我的。她修好了那挺破旧的船尾机枪，证明自己所言非虚。她枪也打得不错，至少比我强多了，那就已经够好。所以我们收下了她。”

When I told her that I was a ship captain, she begged me to come on board. I was like, I ain’t gonna’ take this random kid on missions, she’s just gonna get hurt. Then she told me about how she’d been studying UGC technical manuals that her uncle got her her whole life, and that she could fix a ship better than any stuffed shirt college shit; her words, not mine. She proved that by fixin’ that shitty old aft machine gun. She could shoot too, way better than me, at least, which is good enough. So we took her on.”"

rows.original: “Yep. Normally they get taller, but apparently there’s a rare effect where they get really short, and really dense. They call them ‘minizons’ and Mika says it’s kinda like being a faux-cow, ‘cept instead of getting subby, ya just get really irritable. Don’t know if they get more angry than normal, or if it’s just gettin’ teased that makes them more mad, but Mika’s got a mean streak. Strong as shit, too. Even before she got those implants she was a tough little thing.”
rows.translation: “对。通常他们会变高，但据说有种罕见的效应，会让他们变得特别矮、特别结实。他们管这叫‘迷你亚马逊’，米卡说这有点像当伪奶牛，只不过不是变得顺从，而是变得特别易怒。不知道他们是本来就比平时更爱生气，还是被逗弄才更火大，反正米卡脾气挺坏。力气也大得要命。还没装那些植入物之前，她就已经是个硬邦邦的小家伙了。”

They call them ‘minizons’ and Mika says it’s kinda like being a faux-cow, ‘cept instead of getting subby, ya just get really irritable. Don’t know if they get more angry than normal, or if it’s just gettin’ teased that makes them more mad, but Mika’s got a mean streak. Strong as shit, too. Even before she got those implants she was a tough little thing.”"

rows.original: “Why get the implants then?”
rows.translation: “那为什么还要装植入物？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why get the implants then?”"

rows.original: “Power armor, obviously. She said she wasn’t gonna be too much use if she couldn’t even get up to most people’s crotches to punch them. So she took it to the boss, and got approved for the implants. The suit they gave her was garbage, at least that’s what she says. So, she saved up for a while to get that frame and the attachments. I chipped in too, cause all I ever buy is food and cheap thongs.” She takes out a wastebasket near her bed, revealing a small mountain of torn cloth. rows.original: You ask her to tell you about Kenka, a request which causes her to perk up. “Ooooh she’s the best! She comes off really strict and uptight, but that’s just for the men. When ya get to really know her, she’s just the sweetest. She has this soft, but commanding voice that just melts me whenever she talks. She’s so sweet with the kids too. When she found out she was pregnant, she wasn’t mad, she wasn’t even upset, she was actually happy. Through the whole pregnancy she was just an angel, never got moody, always stayed positive. I was just a damn wreck the whole time. Every time she’d be even slightly uncomfortable, I’d just freak out.”

rows.original: She starts chuckling to herself. “Oh stars, I remember one time she called me while she was having stomach cramps, and when I heard she was in pain, I almost cancelled the mission to run back to her.”

rows.raw: "\n\nShe starts chuckling to herself. “Oh stars, I remember one time she called me while she was having stomach cramps, and when I heard she was in pain, I almost cancelled the mission to run back to her.”"

rows.original: Her chuckles turn to outright laughing. “Oh man, hard to believe I used to be more of a wreck than I am now. Just, all that emotions I was feeling, starting a family with someone I really loved. I just didn’t think I’d ever get there, so I sure as void never really prepared myself for it.”
rows.translation: 她的轻笑变成放声大笑。“天哪，真难相信我从前比现在还要一团糟。只是，我当时的那些情绪，想和一个我真正爱的人组建家庭。我从没想过自己能走到那一步，所以我敢向虚空担保，我压根没为此做好准备。”

Just, all that emotions I was feeling, starting a family with someone I really loved. I just didn’t think I’d ever get there, so I sure as void never really prepared myself for it.”"

rows.original: “How’d you meet?”
rows.translation: “你们怎么认识的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d you meet?”"

rows.original: “Remember when I told ya I met her when we got in the middle of that ambush?”
rows.translation: “还记得我跟你说过吗，我是在我们卷进那场伏击时遇见她的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Remember when I told ya I met her when we got in the middle of that ambush?”"

rows.original: “Well, back before I was with Black Iron, I struck out on my own for a bit. I tried my hand at being a real pirate, with only two guys for a crew, and my first hit turned out to be part of a Black Iron ambush crew. We tried our best, well, I tried my best. The others gave up pretty quick, but I was going head on, cracking heads. I managed to make my way to the bridge. When I got there, she was waiting, gun in hand, ready to shoot. I was dumb, but even I realized that I was gonna get myself killed if I kept goin’, so I gave up. Instead of blowing my head off, or turning me into the cops, she hired me on.”
rows.translation: “嗯，在加入黑铁之前，我曾独自闯荡过一阵。我试着当一名真正的海盗，手下只有两个船员，而第一次下手就撞上了一支黑铁伏击队。我们尽了全力，呃，至少我尽了全力。其他人很快便投降了，可我仍正面猛冲，见人就揍。我一路打进了舰桥。等我到那里时，她正持枪等候，随时准备开火。我很蠢，但就连我也意识到，再继续下去只会让自己送命，于是便投降了。她没有一枪轰掉我的脑袋，也没有把我交给警察，反而雇用了我。”

The others gave up pretty quick, but I was going head on, cracking heads. I managed to make my way to the bridge. When I got there, she was waiting, gun in hand, ready to shoot. I was dumb, but even I realized that I was gonna get myself killed if I kept goin’, so I gave up. Instead of blowing my head off, or turning me into the cops, she hired me on.”"

rows.original: “Mostly ‘cause I managed to take out most of her men by myself, partly because I was givin’ off pheromones like a shower gives off water, and she was kinda into it. I worked under her for a few months, gettin’ up there, eventually earning my own ship. We were gettin’ to know each other, bit by bit that whole time. One day she invited me to her ship, ‘personal visit’. We had lunch, talked a lot... fucked for about five hours straight.”
rows.translation: “主要是因为我一个人就设法干掉了她手下的大部分人，部分原因则是我当时释放的信息素就像淋浴器喷水一样猛，而她还挺喜欢的。我在她手下干了几个月，一路往上爬，最后挣到了一艘自己的船。那段时间里，我们一点一点地了解彼此。有一天，她邀请我去她的船上‘私人拜访’。我们吃了午饭，聊了很多...然后一口气操了大约五个小时。”

rows.original: She takes on a bashful look as she says that. “We sat in bed for a few hours after she recovered. I don’t think it was what either of us intended to happen, and we knew she was knocked-up right away. I mean, how couldn’t she be? She looked like a dog balloon until we drained her.”
rows.translation: 说到这里，她露出了腼腆的表情。“她恢复过来后，我们在床上坐了几个小时。我觉得那并不是我们任何一方原本想要的结果，而且我们立刻就知道她怀上了。我是说，她怎么可能没怀上？把她体内的精液排出来之前，她看着就像一只狗狗气球。”

rows.original: She lays back and sighs. “It was fine, we were ready to take it to the end. Of course, her mom wasn’t. When she found out, she kicked my ass, then put a fuckin’ gun to my head. I guess that’s what ya get for fuckin’ the boss’s daughter and knockin’ her up. If Kenka didn’t get in the way and convince her that we really loved each other, well, I wouldn’t be talking right now. Elhora demanded that we get married; no bastards in the Jinn family. That was fine by us, even if she gave me a death stare the whole ceremony. She lightened up on me after that, and I think we’re pretty good now.”
rows.translation: 她向后躺下，叹了口气。“本来挺好的，我们都准备好走到最后了。当然，她妈不这么想。她知道以后，先揍了我一顿，然后拿把该死的枪顶在我头上。我猜这就是操了老板女儿还把她肚子搞大的下场。要不是肯卡挡在中间，说服她我们是真的相爱，嗯，我现在就没法说话了。艾尔霍拉要我们结婚；金恩家不能有私生子。我们倒不介意，就算整个仪式上她都拿能杀死人的眼神瞪着我。那之后她对我就温和多了，我觉得我们现在处得挺好。”

Kenka’s so busy, usually, so it ends up being me most of the time. I don’t mind that. In fact, I love them, and I love takin’ care of them. Honestly, I just wanna take a few years off of this to make sure they grow up right. ‘Course, we have to finish this up before that. I guess we better get back to that; enough gushing about the family. Unless you wanted to talk about something else?”
rows.translation: 她朝你竖起大拇指。“总之，我们的孩子过了一阵便出生了，我们一直轮流照顾这些小家伙。肯卡平时太忙，所以多数时候最后都是我在带。我并不介意。事实上，我爱他们，也喜欢照顾他们。说真的，我只想放下这边的事休息几年，确保他们好好长大。当然，在那之前，我们得先把这里的事做完。我想咱们最好回去干活了；关于家人的话已经说得够肉麻啦。除非你还想聊点别的？”

rows.original: She flops back on the bed and sighs heavily. “Yeah, yeah, might as well. I grew up on a colony called Olivier. That place was a fuckin’ shithole; the only way you got anywhere there was if you were one of the rich bitches who ran the place, one of their groupies, or one of their fuckpets, if you weren’t a chick. I was born a herm; not too rare with kaithrit, but that doesn’t stop us from being that one friend that nobody knows how to talk to because they just look funny. Ya either get treated like shit or ya don’t. Best ya could hope for as a herm on Olivier was gettin’ born with a nice, big cock and fucking one of the rich cunts. I didn’t have that. I had four inches to work with; and yes, I burned that fuckin’ number into my brain, because it was something I had to deal with for years.”
rows.translation: 她向后一倒躺在床上，重重叹了口气。“好吧，好吧，讲讲也无妨。我在一个叫奥利维尔的殖民地长大。那地方就是个他妈的粪坑；想在那里出人头地，要么你是统治那里的有钱婊子之一，要么是她们的跟班；如果你不是女人，那就得当她们的性奴。我天生是半性；这在凯斯里特人中不算太罕见，可我们还是会变成朋友圈里那个只因长相奇怪，就让所有人都不知道该怎么搭话的家伙。别人要么把你当垃圾，要么不这么做。半性在奥利维尔能指望的最好命运，就是生来有根漂亮的大鸡巴，然后操上某个有钱的贱货。我没有那东西。我能用的只有四英寸；没错，我把这个他妈的数字刻进了脑子里，因为我不得不忍受它好多年。”

rows.original: She’s visibly angry at this point, gritting her teeth and balling up her sheets in her fists. “Thank FUCK I got out of there! Graduation came around, I didn’t even go, why would I? I went out to eat and was just happy for a second, tryin’ not to think about the fact that the job market was gonna be just as much of a bitch as school. I stayed there all day, to the point where the college recruiters got done at the graduation ceremony, and one of them came over to eat. We actually hit it off, talked about my schooling, grades, what I wanted to do. Apparently I graduated in the top three of my class. Looking back it’s not that surprising since I had no social life, and I’d either binge eat or study all night to try and forget everything. He offered me a scholarship to an off-world college, and I almost hugged him for that. I went home, said goodbye to Dad and...”
rows.translation: 她这时显然已经怒火中烧，咬紧牙关，双拳攥着床单。“谢天谢地，我他妈终于离开了那里！毕业那天到了，我压根没去，为什么要去？我出去吃了顿饭，只想开心片刻，努力不去想就业市场会和学校一样操蛋。我在那里待了一整天，等到大学招生人员忙完毕业典礼，其中一人也过来吃饭。我们居然很谈得来，聊了我的学业、成绩，还有我想做的事。显然，我毕业成绩排在全班前三。现在回头看，这也不奇怪，毕竟我根本没有社交生活；为了忘掉一切，我要么暴饮暴食，要么整夜学习。他给了我一份外星大学的奖学金，为了这事我差点抱住他。我回到家，向爸爸道别，然后...”

He raised me all by himself, got a ton of shit for it too. Felt like every year there was some chick trying to get in his pants while they treated me like shit. He didn’t take any of that, he told them to respect his family or fuck off!” She has a huge grin on her face as she waxes on about her father.

rows.original: “That man was the only thing that really kept me going. We talked a lot, but I didn’t see him in person for a long time after I went to college. Of course, that was after I got Treated, so there was some... catching up to do.” Whew. “It wasn’t as awkward as you’d think. He always taught me to be happy with my body, so when I explained it to him, he was fine with it.”

rows.original: “He is. Anyway, college. Tel’Adre university; kind of a dump, but still a great place. The place was famous for its theoretical physics courses, mostly because of Professor Cheret, who was a researcher and a member of the board of directors at Akkadi R&D. He had a lab just off campus where he did his own, private experiments. I got the last spot in the class, mostly ‘cause it seemed like the option that would get me the furthest, didn’t actually care what I did, but I ended up really liking it. I don’t know, something about all those big, heady concepts really got me excited, and Cheret was just a nice guy. I even volunteered to help him out in his lab, something that wasn’t too popular after one kid got his leg fused into a table...”
rows.translation: “他确实很棒。总之，说回大学。特尔·阿德雷大学；地方有点破，但依然是所很棒的学校。那里以理论物理课程闻名，主要归功于谢雷教授；他既是研究员，也是阿卡迪研发董事会的成员。他在校外不远处有一间实验室，专门做自己的私人实验。我拿到了班上最后一个名额，主要是因为这似乎是能让我走得最远的选择；我当时其实不在乎自己做什么，最后却真的喜欢上了它。我也说不清，那些宏大又烧脑的概念就是让我非常兴奋，而且谢雷人也很好。我甚至自愿去他的实验室帮忙；自从有个学生的腿和桌子融合在一起后，这可算不上什么热门差事...”

rows.raw: "\n\n“Interesting, but why wouldn’t he just do that at Akkadi?”"

rows.original: “Like I said, they didn’t see it as viable, so they weren’t going to devote resources to it. His lab and all of his experiments were self-funded. He wasn’t even trying to move anything big. It was basically set up to move a very small amount of matter through a solid wall, and that took a massive amount of hardware just to do that. I actually helped out, not much, but I impressed him enough to get a job.”
rows.translation: “就像我说的，他们认为这东西不可行，所以不肯为它投入资源。他的实验室和所有实验都是自掏腰包。他甚至没打算移动什么大型物体。那套设备基本只是为了把极少量物质送过一堵实心墙，而仅仅实现这一点，就需要海量硬件。我确实帮了些忙，虽然不多，但给他留下的印象足以让我得到一份工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, they didn’t see it as viable, so they weren’t going to devote resources to it. His lab and all of his experiments were self-funded. He wasn’t even trying to move anything big. It was basically set up to move a very small amount of matter through a solid wall, and that took a massive amount of hardware just to do that. I actually helped out, not much, but I impressed him enough to get a job.”"

rows.original: “What did you do?”
rows.translation: “你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did you do?”"

rows.original: “Mostly, just help out around the lab, clean up, organize stuff, carry some equipment around. During the last two years, though, I started getting more into reading his research. It was next level shit, way beyond even the stuff he was teaching in class. I figured if I could wrap my head around this stuff, I can make one hell of a final project! I was right about that, though not in the way I imagined at the time. I dug up an old formula that he had just thrown out, half done. Spent about eight months or so working through it. When I showed it to him, he was impressed. I didn’t get it all right, but I was close.”
rows.translation: “主要就是在实验室里帮忙，打扫卫生、整理东西、搬运设备。不过最后两年，我开始更深入地阅读他的研究。那些可都是更高层次的玩意儿，甚至远远超出他课堂上教的内容。我寻思，要是能弄懂这些东西，就能做出一个他妈绝顶厉害的毕业项目！这点我猜对了，虽然结果并不是当时想象的那样。我翻出一份被他随手丢掉的旧公式，只完成了一半。我花了大约八个月去钻研它。拿给他看时，他很惊讶。我并没有全做对，但已经很接近了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mostly, just help out around the lab, clean up, organize stuff, carry some equipment around. During the last two years, though, I started getting more into reading his research. It was next level shit, way beyond even the stuff he was teaching in class. I figured if I could wrap my head around this stuff, I can make one hell of a final project! I was right about that, though not in the way I imagined at the time. I dug up an old formula that he had just thrown out, half done. Spent about eight months or so working through it. When I showed it to him, he was impressed. I didn’t get it all right, but I was close.”"

rows.original: She has a huge smirk as she says that. “More than that, though, that formula was part of a chain that he’d forgotten about months ago that was key in gettin’ the project done, and me reminding him by finishing that part let him finish it before graduation. During finals he got everyone to the lab, turned on the machine, and it worked! Of course, keep in mind that this was inorganic matter, so it was always going to be easier to get through. The college was impressed, but the board wasn’t. Too expensive, not enough results. Bad news. Good news, though, my grades were good enough, and he vouched for me enough that I was able to get a junior position at Akkadi straight out of college!”
rows.translation: 说到这里，她脸上挂起大大的得意笑容。“更重要的是，那条公式属于一整串推导中的一环，他几个月前就把这条线忘了，而它正是完成项目的关键。我补完那一部分，让他想起这件事，也让他得以在毕业前完成项目。期末考试期间，他把所有人叫到实验室，启动机器，然后它真的成功了！当然，要记住，当时传送的是无机物，所以本来就比较容易通过。学院对此印象深刻，董事会却不买账。太昂贵，成果又太少。这是坏消息。不过好消息是，我的成绩够好，他又极力为我担保，于是我一毕业就直接在阿卡迪拿到了初级职位！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has a huge smirk as she says that. “More than that, though, that formula was part of a chain that he’d forgotten about months ago that was key in gettin’ the project done, and me reminding him by finishing that part let him finish it before graduation. During finals he got everyone to the lab, turned on the machine, and it worked! Of course, keep in mind that this was inorganic matter, so it was always going to be easier to get through. The college was impressed, but the board wasn’t. Too expensive, not enough results. Bad news. Good news, though, my grades were good enough, and he vouched for me enough that I was able to get a junior position at Akkadi straight out of college!”"

rows.original: “You must have been proud.”
rows.translation: “你当时一定很自豪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must have been proud.”"

rows.original: “Damn right! I minored in chemistry too, so I was able to get into experimental chemical testing in addition to the physics department. It was pretty boring stuff for the most part. Testing fuel mixtures, new stimulants and body enhancers, not on myself, of course. Physics was a lot of dull shit too. Through it all though, Cheret was sorta grooming me and a few of the others, said he was close to gettin’ the warp gate project off the ground, and he wanted a team lined up to go. So, between projects he gave us a bunch of material on it, even got us military clearance. Of course, it still took a few years before that got off the ground. In the meantime, the only really interesting project was this stupid wormhole drive. It was supposed to tunnel through space itself to go faster than the speed of light. All that really happened with that is that we ended up embedding a few of them into a wall. One of them did kinda work, in the sense that it disappeared and we never quite figured out where it went.”
rows.translation: “那他妈当然！我还辅修了化学，所以除了物理部门，也能参与实验性化学测试。大部分都是相当无聊的活儿：测试燃料混合物、新型兴奋剂和身体强化剂，当然不是在我自己身上试。物理那边也有一大堆无聊破事。不过在这整个过程中，谢雷特算是在培养我和另外几个人；他说曲速门项目快要正式启动了，想提前组好一支随时可以出发的团队。所以各个项目的间隙，他给了我们一大堆相关资料，甚至帮我们拿到了军方许可。当然，项目真正启动还是花了好几年。与此同时，唯一真正有意思的项目就是那个愚蠢的虫洞引擎。它原本要在空间本身打出隧道，以超越光速航行。可实际结果只是我们把其中几台嵌进了墙里。有一台倒算是成功了：它消失了，而我们始终没能弄清它去了哪里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right! I minored in chemistry too, so I was able to get into experimental chemical testing in addition to the physics department. It was pretty boring stuff for the most part. Testing fuel mixtures, new stimulants and body enhancers, not on myself, of course. Physics was a lot of dull shit too. Through it all though, Cheret was sorta grooming me and a few of the others, said he was close to gettin’ the warp gate project off the ground, and he wanted a team lined up to go. So, between projects he gave us a bunch of material on it, even got us military clearance. Of course, it still took a few years before that got off the ground. In the meantime, the only really interesting project was this stupid wormhole drive. It was supposed to tunnel through space itself to go faster than the speed of light. All that really happened with that is that we ended up embedding a few of them into a wall. One of them did kinda work, in the sense that it disappeared and we never quite figured out where it went.”"

rows.original: She holds her hands up toward you, and gives you a look like a kid telling a story by the campfire.
rows.translation: 她朝你举起双手，脸上的神情像个在篝火边讲故事的孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds her hands up toward you, and gives you a look like a kid telling a story by the campfire."

rows.original: “Spooky, right? Anyway, that was the project where I met Roy. He was a JAF officer who was supposed to test pilot a craft with the engine in it. Of course, that plan assumed the damn thing worked, so he ended up just hanging around. He was the cutest little ausar you’d ever seen; short and stout, with big ears and a teeny little tail. We hit it off after the third engine decided to explode on us, and the cleaning crew had to come in. After the project went south, we both took a day off and went out on a date.”
rows.translation: “挺瘆人的，对吧？总之，那就是我遇见罗伊的那个项目。他是个 JAF 军官，本来该试飞一架装了那台引擎的飞行器。当然，那个计划的前提是这鬼东西能正常工作，所以他最后就只是在那儿闲着。他是你见过的最可爱的小奥萨尔；矮矮壮壮，大耳朵，一条小小的尾巴。第三次引擎决定在我们面前爆炸、清洁队不得不进来之后，我们就熟起来了。项目黄了以后，我们俩都请了一天假，出去约会了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spooky, right? Anyway, that was the project where I met Roy. He was a JAF officer who was supposed to test pilot a craft with the engine in it. Of course, that plan assumed the damn thing worked, so he ended up just hanging around. He was the cutest little ausar you’d ever seen; short and stout, with big ears and a teeny little tail. We hit it off after the third engine decided to explode on us, and the cleaning crew had to come in. After the project went south, we both took a day off and went out on a date.”"

rows.original: A big smile goes across her face. “That was an amazing night; the food was great, the places he took me were so beautiful, Roy was such a charmer. I remember sitting on the grass, him holding me in his arms while we looked over the city lights... I miss him.”
rows.translation: 她脸上绽开灿烂的笑容。“那真是美妙的一夜；食物很棒，他带我去的地方也那么美，罗伊又特别会讨人喜欢。我还记得坐在草地上，他把我抱在怀里，我们一同俯瞰城市灯火...我想他了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA big smile goes across her face. “That was an amazing night; the food was great, the places he took me were so beautiful, Roy was such a charmer. I remember sitting on the grass, him holding me in his arms while we looked over the city lights... I miss him.”"

rows.original: She takes a more solemn look as she finishes that thought. <i>“Anyway, a bit after that,
rows.translation: 说完这个念头，她的神情变得更加肃穆。<i>“总之，在那之后不久，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a more solemn look as she finishes that thought. <i>“Anyway, a bit after that, "

rows.raw: "Ms. Dorna"

rows.original: was put in charge, and me and the others he was grooming got assigned to her team. And then... I think we covered what happened after that enough, let’s move on.”
rows.translation: 被任命为负责人，而我和其他那些受他栽培的人被分到了她的队里。然后...之后发生了什么，我想我们已经说得够多了，跳过吧。”
rows.raw: " was put in charge, and me and the others he was grooming got assigned to her team. And then... I think we covered what happened after that enough, let’s move on.”"

rows.original: You ask her about the weird outfit she wore during your fight.
rows.translation: 你问起她在与你战斗时穿的那套古怪服装。
rows.raw: "You ask her about the weird outfit she wore during your fight."

rows.original: “Oh yeah, those. That was just something I whipped together a while back. I saw it on clearance at a costume shop, so I bought a few, stuck some shield boosters and shock resonators on them. The gauntlets were something I also whipped up myself. Kind of a first attempt, not as good as something Mika would have made, but they also won’t blow you up, probably. I got two of them, too, managed to work that. Why, did you want a pair?”
rows.translation: “哦，对，那些啊。那只是我前一阵随手拼出来的东西。我在一家服装店看到它们清仓，就买了几套，往上面装了些护盾增幅器和电击共振器。那副臂铠也是我自己随手做的。算是第一次尝试，不如米卡做出来的东西好，不过它们大概也不会把你炸飞。我还做成了两套，也算成功了。怎么，你想要一套？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah, those. That was just something I whipped together a while back. I saw it on clearance at a costume shop, so I bought a few, stuck some shield boosters and shock resonators on them. The gauntlets were something I also whipped up myself. Kind of a first attempt, not as good as something Mika would have made, but they also won’t blow you up, probably. I got two of them, too, managed to work that. Why, did you want a pair?”"

rows.original: “Maybe.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe.”"

rows.original: “Hmmmm, tell ya what, cap, ya beat me, ya get the gear. Deal?” You suppose that’s fair. “You’re on!” You say excitedly. “Allllright! just tell me when you’re ready.”
rows.translation: “嗯——，这样吧，船长，你打赢我，装备就归你。成交？”你觉得这很公平。“一言为定！”你兴奋地说道。“好——啦！准备好时告诉我就行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmmm, tell ya what, cap, ya beat me, ya get the gear. Deal?” You suppose that’s fair. “You’re on!” You say excitedly. “Allllright! just tell me when you’re ready.”"

rows.original: “Like I said, cap, ya gotta beat me to get the goods.”
rows.translation: “我说过了，船长，想拿货就得先打赢我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, cap, ya gotta beat me to get the goods.”"

rows.original: “Oh yeah, those. That was just something I whipped together a while back. I saw it on clearance at a costume shop, so I bought a few, stuck some shield boosters and shock resonators on them. The gauntlets were something I also whipped up myself. rows.original: “Maybe.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe.”"

rows.original: “Hmmmm, ya know what, ya won fair and square, I’ll give ya the spare pair.” She pulls a second metal box out from under her bed, and hands it to you. “Enjoy!” You open it up and pull out a pair of black gauntlets and greaves, and a bright yellow set of clothes.
rows.translation: “嗯——，这样吧，你赢得光明正大，我把备用的那套给你。”她从床底又抽出一个金属箱，递给你。“好好享受！”你打开箱子，从中取出一对黑色臂铠和胫甲，以及一套亮黄色衣服。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmmm, ya know what, ya won fair and square, I’ll give ya the spare pair.” She pulls a second metal box out from under her bed, and hands it to you. “Enjoy!” You open it up and pull out a pair of black gauntlets and greaves, and a bright yellow set of clothes."

rows.original: “Ya did good, cap.” She pulls a second metal box out from under her bed, and hands it to you. “Enjoy!” You open it up and pull out a pair of black gauntlets and greaves, and a bright yellow set of clothes.
rows.translation: “干得不错，船长。”她从床底又抽出一个金属箱，递给你。“好好享受！”你打开箱子，从中取出一对黑色臂铠和胫甲，以及一套亮黄色衣服。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ya did good, cap.” She pulls a second metal box out from under her bed, and hands it to you. “Enjoy!” You open it up and pull out a pair of black gauntlets and greaves, and a bright yellow set of clothes."

rows.original: “Alright, enough messing around, time to talk about Black Iron.”
rows.translation: “好了，别再瞎扯了，该谈谈黑铁了。”
rows.raw: "“Alright, enough messing around, time to talk about Black Iron.”"

rows.original: She pauses in thought, trying to figure out how to answer you. “Uh, okay, ya remember when Winston said shit was complicated? He really meant that Black Iron is complicated. Ya could say that it’s really two companies; there’s the core world operation, which is your standard PMC, providing military aid, supplies, occasionally gettin’ our hands dirty, but not nearly as much as you’d think. Really wholesome shit, not even Nova Securities level stuff there, since there’s a ton of oversight. Then you’ve got us out here; bounty hunters, assassins, professional hackers, little to no oversight.”
rows.translation: 她停下来想了想，琢磨着该怎么回答你。“呃，好吧，你还记得温斯顿说这事儿很复杂吗？他真正的意思是黑铁很复杂。你可以说它其实是两家公司；一家是核心星域的运作，就是标准的私营军事承包商，提供军事援助、物资，偶尔也弄脏我们的手，但远没有你想的那么多。都是些特别干净正当的活儿，连新星安保那种程度都够不上，因为监督多得要命。然后就是在外面的我们；赏金猎人、刺客、职业黑客，几乎没什么监督。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses in thought, trying to figure out how to answer you. “Uh, okay, ya remember when Winston said shit was complicated? He really meant that Black Iron is complicated. Ya could say that it’s really two companies; there’s the core world operation, which is your standard PMC, providing military aid, supplies, occasionally gettin’ our hands dirty, but not nearly as much as you’d think. Really wholesome shit, not even Nova Securities level stuff there, since there’s a ton of oversight. Then you’ve got us out here; bounty hunters, assassins, professional hackers, little to no oversight.”"

rows.original: “How does that even work?”
rows.translation: “那怎么可能行得通？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How does that even work?”"

rows.original: “The big boss knows how to play the system. She’s old, experienced, and has enough strings to pull, and pockets greased that, as long as we don’t do something toooo stupid out here, we’re golden. ‘Course, personally, we don’t get into the kinds of things that would get ya in real trouble. We’re what they call ‘squeakies’, people who can run the UGC jobs and only get our hands dirty in ways that we can easily wash off, if we even need to.”
rows.translation: “大老板很懂得怎么利用这套体制。她年纪大、经验丰富，手里牵得动的关系够多，打点过的人也够多，所以只要我们在外面别干出太太太蠢的事，就不会有问题。当然，就我们自己来说，也不会沾上那种真会惹出大麻烦的事。我们就是他们所谓的‘洁净仔’，可以承接银河联合邦联的任务，弄脏手的方式也都很容易洗干净，前提是手真的会脏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The big boss knows how to play the system. She’s old, experienced, and has enough strings to pull, and pockets greased that, as long as we don’t do something toooo stupid out here, we’re golden. ‘Course, personally, we don’t get into the kinds of things that would get ya in real trouble. We’re what they call ‘squeakies’, people who can run the UGC jobs and only get our hands dirty in ways that we can easily wash off, if we even need to.”"

rows.original: “Like?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like?”"

rows.original: “Bounty hunting, for the most part. We get jobs to take down a lot of different people; smugglers, slavers, terrorists, the usual stuff. Sounds all nice and shit, and you’d think we’d get on some bad sides. But something you figure out pretty quick is that a lot of the ‘concerned citizens’ that put these jobs out are Black Void proxies.”
rows.translation: “主要是赏金猎人的活。我们的任务是拿下各种不同的人；走私犯、奴隶贩子、恐怖分子，都是些常见货色。听起来当然挺正派，你也会以为这样会得罪某些人。但有件事很快就能看明白：发布这些任务的许多‘热心市民’，其实都是黑色虚空的代理人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bounty hunting, for the most part. We get jobs to take down a lot of different people; smugglers, slavers, terrorists, the usual stuff. Sounds all nice and shit, and you’d think we’d get on some bad sides. But something you figure out pretty quick is that a lot of the ‘concerned citizens’ that put these jobs out are Black Void proxies.”"

rows.original: “What?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, most of the people we take out or take in are people who just so happen to be on the Void’s bad side. Either they didn’t pay their dues, or they just pissed someone high up off. Not as bad as it sounds, not like we’re handing them right to the Void; in fact, most jobs have us turning them into the UGC. Gets them out of the Void’s hair, either way, and keeps us in the green. Not all of them are about that, but we generally seem to wind up taking out their trash. Most of the time that’s not really a bad thing, still gets those people put away.”
rows.translation: “是啊，我们干掉或抓起来的人，大多都恰好得罪了虚空。要么是没交够份子钱，要么只是惹恼了某个高层。事情没有听起来那么糟，我们又不是把人直接交给虚空；事实上，大多数任务都要求我们把他们移交银河联合邦联。无论如何，这既能替虚空清除眼中钉，又能让我们保持盈利。并非所有任务都是这样，但我们往往都会替他们清理垃圾。大多数时候这也不算什么坏事，毕竟那些人最终还是会被关起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, most of the people we take out or take in are people who just so happen to be on the Void’s bad side. Either they didn’t pay their dues, or they just pissed someone high up off. Not as bad as it sounds, not like we’re handing them right to the Void; in fact, most jobs have us turning them into the UGC. Gets them out of the Void’s hair, either way, and keeps us in the green. Not all of them are about that, but we generally seem to wind up taking out their trash. Most of the time that’s not really a bad thing, still gets those people put away.”"

rows.original: “Still seems shady.”
rows.translation: “还是感觉挺可疑的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still seems shady.”"

rows.original: “Welcome to life on the frontier, cap; ya make compromises to make it, and as far as compromises go, I’d rather be shady and live a good life, than be a good guy and wind up in a shallow grave. Besides, ya wanna hear about real shady shit? Ask Winston what it’s like on the really bad side of Black Iron. Let me tell ya, a lot of people here are ex- or just inactive members of the Black Void or some of the other big groups, and I’m not talking about randos who got kicked out for fucking up too much. Dio Braik, the captain of Leda squad, was on his way to being a fuckin’ Dread Lord before he quit. Those are the guys who do the real bad shit. Even then, Dio never struck me as a monster. Hell, him and Winston used to do a lot together, and he’s got nothin’ but good things to say about him.”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到边疆生活，船长；为了活下去就得作出妥协，而说到妥协，我宁愿当个阴险的人过上好日子，也不愿做个好人，最后躺进一座浅坟里。再说了，你想听真正阴险的事吗？去问温斯顿，看看站在黑铁真正恶劣的那一边是什么滋味。我跟你说，这里有很多人曾经是黑色虚空或其他大型组织的成员，有些只是暂时不再活动；而且我说的可不是那些因为搞砸太多事情而被踢出去的无名小卒。勒达小队的队长迪奥·布雷克退出以前，眼看就要当上他妈的恐惧领主。真正干尽坏事的就是那帮人。即便如此，迪奥也从没让我觉得他像个怪物。妈的，他和温斯顿以前经常一起行动，而温斯顿说起他时全是好话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to life on the frontier, cap; ya make compromises to make it, and as far as compromises go, I’d rather be shady and live a good life, than be a good guy and wind up in a shallow grave. Besides, ya wanna hear about real shady shit? Ask Winston what it’s like on the really bad side of Black Iron. Let me tell ya, a lot of people here are ex- or just inactive members of the Black Void or some of the other big groups, and I’m not talking about randos who got kicked out for fucking up too much. Dio Braik, the captain of Leda squad, was on his way to being a fuckin’ Dread Lord before he quit. Those are the guys who do the real bad shit. Even then, Dio never struck me as a monster. Hell, him and Winston used to do a lot together, and he’s got nothin’ but good things to say about him.”"

rows.original: “So what’s the difference between you and the Void?”
rows.translation: “那你和虚空之间有什么区别？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s the difference between you and the Void?”"

rows.original: “Values and principles. The big boss values tradition, camaraderie, and a certain sense of right and wrong. Even at the worst; we don’t kill or enslave people who didn’t do anything to us, we don’t backstab each other, we’re not out to fuck things up without any reason. The big boss, Elhora, she’s part of a dying breed, the old crime boss who values family and tradition over constantly pushing the bottom line beyond reason. I imagine a lot of people disconnected themselves from the Void to join Black Iron for the same reason she created it in the first place. The Void is almost corporate in its function; individual Dread Lords can have their own ideals, but the main incentive is always the same; move slaves, make money, support the bottom line, expand influence. They’re all drones, mindlessly feeding into a massive, uncaring maw that’s just waiting for them to be used up so it can swallow them too!”
rows.translation: “价值观和原则。大老板看重传统、同伴情谊，以及某种是非观。即使在最糟的时候，我们也不会杀害或奴役那些根本没招惹过我们的人，不会在彼此背后捅刀，也不会毫无理由地四处搞破坏。大老板艾尔霍拉属于一个正在消亡的群体，是那种把家族与传统看得比毫无节制地追逐利润更重要的老派犯罪首脑。我想，许多人脱离虚空加入黑铁，理由就和她当初创立黑铁一样。虚空的运作方式几乎与企业无异；每位恐惧领主可以拥有自己的理念，但核心动力始终相同：转运奴隶、赚取金钱、保障利润、扩张影响力。他们全都是工蜂，毫无思想地供养一张庞大而冷漠的巨口；那张嘴只等着他们耗尽价值，再把他们也一口吞掉！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Values and principles. The big boss values tradition, camaraderie, and a certain sense of right and wrong. Even at the worst; we don’t kill or enslave people who didn’t do anything to us, we don’t backstab each other, we’re not out to fuck things up without any reason. The big boss, Elhora, she’s part of a dying breed, the old crime boss who values family and tradition over constantly pushing the bottom line beyond reason. I imagine a lot of people disconnected themselves from the Void to join Black Iron for the same reason she created it in the first place. The Void is almost corporate in its function; individual Dread Lords can have their own ideals, but the main incentive is always the same; move slaves, make money, support the bottom line, expand influence. They’re all drones, mindlessly feeding into a massive, uncaring maw that’s just waiting for them to be used up so it can swallow them too!”"

rows.original: She seems very... passionate about this, holding a much sterner face than you’ve seen on her before. “Sorry if I get really into this, that’s just what happens when you get thrown in with someone like Elhora who takes the time out of her day to give you lectures about this stuff. Did I tell ya Kenka is Elhora’s daughter? I think I did. Whatever. People join Black Iron looking for more structure and concrete ideology. Believe it or not, even bad people can want standards. And that lure spreads to more than just Black Void people or pirates in general. I’ve seen former military, private security, mercs, and even just random people who heard about it somehow. They all come in because they want somewhere that values them, even if it sometimes requires some more scummy actions. And of course, ya don’t have to do that stuff; I choose not to get involved in that side of things, and I don’t get treated any less for it.”
rows.translation: 她似乎对这件事非常... 热衷，脸上的神情比你以前见过的任何时候都要严肃。“抱歉，我一谈到这件事就特别投入。跟艾尔霍拉这样的人混在一起就是会变成这样，她甚至会专门从一天中抽出时间，给你讲这些事情。我告诉过你肯卡是艾尔霍拉的女儿吗？应该说过。算了。人们加入黑铁，是为了寻找更明确的结构和具体的理念。信不信由你，就连坏人也可能想要一套规矩。而这种吸引力影响的不只是黑色虚空成员，甚至不只是一般意义上的海盗。我见过退役军人、私人安保、佣兵，甚至还有不知从哪里听说黑铁的普通人。他们全都因为想找到一个重视自己的地方而来，即使有时必须做些更卑鄙的事。当然，你也不必做那些事；我选择不参与那一面的事务，也没因此受到任何轻视。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems very... passionate about this, holding a much sterner face than you’ve seen on her before. “Sorry if I get really into this, that’s just what happens when you get thrown in with someone like Elhora who takes the time out of her day to give you lectures about this stuff. Did I tell ya Kenka is Elhora’s daughter? I think I did. Whatever. People join Black Iron looking for more structure and concrete ideology. Believe it or not, even bad people can want standards. And that lure spreads to more than just Black Void people or pirates in general. I’ve seen former military, private security, mercs, and even just random people who heard about it somehow. They all come in because they want somewhere that values them, even if it sometimes requires some more scummy actions. And of course, ya don’t have to do that stuff; I choose not to get involved in that side of things, and I don’t get treated any less for it.”"

rows.original: Her stern face melts away a bit as she finishes up. “I guess, to answer the question, Black Iron is a family, a very complicated, messy family, but it’s one I’m happy I’m a part of. And that’s that.”
rows.translation: 她收尾时，严峻的表情稍微化开了些。“我想，要回答这个问题的话，黑铁是个家庭，一个非常复杂、混乱的家庭，但我很高兴自己是其中一员。就是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer stern face melts away a bit as she finishes up. “I guess, to answer the question, Black Iron is a family, a very complicated, messy family, but it’s one I’m happy I’m a part of. And that’s that.”"

rows.original: “How exactly did you get Treated?” It’s strange, nothing about what she’s told you would lead you to believe that she’d be wealthy or important enough to go to New Texas. She’s taken aback a bit by your question, seeming to fumble over what she should say.
rows.translation: “你到底是怎么接受‘治疗’的？”很奇怪，她告诉你的任何事都无法让你相信她有钱或有地位到能去新德克萨斯。你的问题让她有点吃惊，她似乎在为难该怎么说。
rows.raw: "“How exactly did you get Treated?” It’s strange, nothing about what she’s told you would lead you to believe that she’d be wealthy or important enough to go to New Texas. She’s taken aback a bit by your question, seeming to fumble over what she should say."

rows.original: “Uh, I really hoped ya wouldn’t ask about that; it’s not my best story. Oh well, just to warn ya, it gets kinda weird.”
rows.translation: “呃，我真希望你不会问起这个；这可不是什么光彩的故事。算了，先提醒你一声，事情会变得有点古怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, I really hoped ya wouldn’t ask about that; it’s not my best story. Oh well, just to warn ya, it gets kinda weird.”"

rows.original: “Oh, I love weird!”
rows.translation: “哦，我就喜欢古怪的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I love weird!”"

rows.original: “Fine by me.”
rows.translation: “我无所谓。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine by me.”"

rows.original: “Alright, here it goes. You remember when I said I left Akkadi after the incident? Well, I never told you where I went, because I didn’t really go anywhere. I bounced around bars, getting drunk off my ass, feeling like I was at the end.”
rows.translation: “好吧，那就说了。还记得我说过，事发后我离开了阿卡迪吗？其实我从没告诉你去了哪里，因为我根本没有真正去任何地方。我在一家又一家酒吧之间辗转，把自己灌得烂醉，感觉人生已经走到了尽头。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, here it goes. You remember when I said I left Akkadi after the incident? Well, I never told you where I went, because I didn’t really go anywhere. I bounced around bars, getting drunk off my ass, feeling like I was at the end.”"

rows.original: “It hit you that bad?”
rows.translation: “这件事对你的打击有那么大？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It hit you that bad?”"

rows.original: “I-It wasn’t just that, it was everythin’ before that. My whole life, all I ever got told is that I was just this little useless thing that would never get anything right. I tried to prove them wrong, I tried to be useful and successful, but it just never worked out quite right. I wasn’t a complete failure or anything like that, but all I could think, back then, when I looked back over what I’d done, I couldn’t help but just feel... mediocre. And when... when that happened, it was like, what else could I do? My career was ruined, my boyfriend was dead, and it was my fault.”
rows.translation: “我、我指的不只是那件事，是那之前的一切。我这辈子，听到的都是我只是个没用的小东西，什么都做不对。我试着证明他们错了，我试着变得有用、变得成功，可就是怎么都不对。我不是彻底的失败者之类的，但那时候，回头看自己做过的那些事，我忍不住只觉得...平庸。而当...当那件事发生的时候，就像，我还能怎么办？我的事业毁了，我男友死了，而那是我的错。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-It wasn’t just that, it was everythin’ before that. My whole life, all I ever got told is that I was just this little useless thing that would never get anything right. I tried to prove them wrong, I tried to be useful and successful, but it just never worked out quite right. I wasn’t a complete failure or anything like that, but all I could think, back then, when I looked back over what I’d done, I couldn’t help but just feel... mediocre. And when... when that happened, it was like, what else could I do? My career was ruined, my boyfriend was dead, and it was my fault.”"

rows.original: “What did you do?”
rows.translation: “你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did you do?”"

rows.original: “I left, I took my ship and I flew off, just anywhere; I could have wound up on some ass-nowhere colony, cleaning up old ship parts to sell for scrap, hell, I could have wound up back home, begged to be the pet of some rich cunt. Anything was better than stickin’ to my old life. ‘Course it didn’t work out like that: I ran out of fuel mid-trip and was so drunk I could barely see straight. I passed out, figured the auto-distress would get me picked up by somebody. Hell, I probably would have been fine if it was a slaver, nothing says new life like being pimped out and sold to the highest bidder.”
rows.translation: “我走了，开上我的船就飞了出去，随便往哪儿都行；我本来可能落到某个屁都不通的殖民地，捡旧船零件卖废铁，见鬼，我也可能一路回到家，求着给哪个有钱的婊子当宠物。什么都比继续过我以前那种日子强。当然，事情没那么发展：我半路烧光了燃料，还醉得连直线都看不清。我昏了过去，想着自动求救信号总能让某个人把我捞起来。见鬼，就算来的是奴隶贩子，我大概也无所谓，没什么比被拉去卖淫、卖给出价最高的人更像新生活了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I left, I took my ship and I flew off, just anywhere; I could have wound up on some ass-nowhere colony, cleaning up old ship parts to sell for scrap, hell, I could have wound up back home, begged to be the pet of some rich cunt. Anything was better than stickin’ to my old life. ‘Course it didn’t work out like that: I ran out of fuel mid-trip and was so drunk I could barely see straight. I passed out, figured the auto-distress would get me picked up by somebody. Hell, I probably would have been fine if it was a slaver, nothing says new life like being pimped out and sold to the highest bidder.”"

rows.original: She’s shaking and gnashing her teeth as she recounts that last part. “I was so fucking pathetic... just giving up like that. Fuck... Anyway, I didn’t get picked up by slavers, I got picked up these two Treated dorks, dad was some rich fuck on an offworld colony, wasn’t allowed on New Texas.”
rows.translation: 她在讲到最后那部分时浑身发抖，咬着牙。“我他妈太可悲了...就那么放弃了。操...总之，我不是被奴隶贩子捡走的，我是被这两个改造过的呆子捡走的，我爸是外星球殖民地上某个有钱的混蛋，不被允许进新德克萨斯。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s shaking and gnashing her teeth as she recounts that last part. “I was so fucking pathetic... just giving up like that. Fuck... Anyway, I didn’t get picked up by slavers, I got picked up these two Treated dorks, dad was some rich fuck on an offworld colony, wasn’t allowed on New Texas.”"

rows.original: “There’s an unwritten rule on New Texas; ya can have whatever weird, crazy opinions you want about the Treatment, but don’t go blabbing to people about them. Don’t want some dumbass tourist going off and telling people they’re going to put the Treatment in the water supply or something. Usually doesn’t get that crazy, except with this guy.”
rows.translation: “新德克萨斯有条不成文的规矩：你对改造疗程有什么古怪疯狂的想法都行，但别到处跟人瞎嚷嚷。总不希望哪个傻逼游客跑出去跟人说他们要把改造疗程加进供水里什么的。一般也没那么离谱，除了这家伙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s an unwritten rule on New Texas; ya can have whatever weird, crazy opinions you want about the Treatment, but don’t go blabbing to people about them. Don’t want some dumbass tourist going off and telling people they’re going to put the Treatment in the water supply or something. Usually doesn’t get that crazy, except with this guy.”"

rows.original: “Bad. Ya know, most of the time you’ll get people who think that the Treatment should be mandatory for tourists, or, hell, people who don’t want tourists at all. Loonies who don’t really know what they’re talking about. This guy wasn’t like that, this guy is the guy who the loonies stay away from because he’s too far out there. Get this; this guy thought that the Treatment was a literal gift from some god, and that it was the next step in evolution for sentient life.”
rows.translation: “很糟。你知道，大多数时候你会遇到那种认为改造疗程对游客该是强制的人，或者更狠，压根不想要游客的人。都是些根本不懂自己在说什么的疯子。这家伙不是那样，这哥们儿是连疯子都躲着走的那种，因为他太离谱了。你听听这个：这家伙认为改造疗程是某位神明实打实的恩赐，是有感知生命进化的下一步。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad. Ya know, most of the time you’ll get people who think that the Treatment should be mandatory for tourists, or, hell, people who don’t want tourists at all. Loonies who don’t really know what they’re talking about. This guy wasn’t like that, this guy is the guy who the loonies stay away from because he’s too far out there. Get this; this guy thought that the Treatment was a literal gift from some god, and that it was the next step in evolution for sentient life.”"

rows.original: She’s smiling and laughing at this point, so at least the conversation is at a happier place. “I know! That’s the kind of shit that gets you banned from the big parties, imagine what people were thinking when he got up on a literal soapbox and started preaching about it.”
rows.translation: 说到这里，她已经面带笑容、笑出声来，至少谈话变得轻松愉快了一些。“我知道！这种破事足以让人被大型聚会拒之门外。想象一下，他真的站上肥皂箱开始宣讲时，其他人心里都在想什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s smiling and laughing at this point, so at least the conversation is at a happier place. “I know! That’s the kind of shit that gets you banned from the big parties, imagine what people were thinking when he got up on a literal soapbox and started preaching about it.”"

rows.original: “Really?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?”"

rows.original: “Really! Apparently a pair of rangers had to tranq him after he got in a fight with some old chick. ‘Course, she actually started it, so they couldn’t pin it on him, and throwing him in the slammer for having a stupid, insane opinion wasn’t gonna be the best PR move either, especially since he was part of a big, rich family. So they chose to exile him, strip him of his titles, family name, everything but the shirt on his back and an old family house on a distant colony.”
rows.translation: “真的！听说他和某个老太婆打起来以后，一对巡警不得不用麻醉枪放倒他。当然，其实是她先动的手，所以他们不能把责任扣在他头上；而且只因为愚蠢疯狂的观点就把他关进牢里，也不是什么理想的公关手段，尤其是他还出身于一个富裕的大家族。所以他们选择流放他，剥夺他的头衔、家族姓氏，除了身上的衬衫和遥远殖民地上的一栋家族老宅外，把一切都夺走了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really! Apparently a pair of rangers had to tranq him after he got in a fight with some old chick. ‘Course, she actually started it, so they couldn’t pin it on him, and throwing him in the slammer for having a stupid, insane opinion wasn’t gonna be the best PR move either, especially since he was part of a big, rich family. So they chose to exile him, strip him of his titles, family name, everything but the shirt on his back and an old family house on a distant colony.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, of course his stupid kids went with him, and they ended up finding me drifting out in space. Apparently their old man had still been making money on the side, enough to get them a nice ship, and some... other things. They took me in, fed me, heard me whine about my shitty life. I guess they felt bad for me, cause they offered me what we thought was a Treatment needle.”
rows.translation: “是啊，当然他那几个蠢孩子也跟着他，结果他们在太空里漂着的时候发现了我。看来他们老爹一直在私下赚钱，够给他们弄艘不错的飞船，还有些...别的东西。他们收留了我，给我吃的，听我抱怨自己那烂透了的人生。我猜他们挺可怜我，因为他们给了我一支我们以为是改造疗程针的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, of course his stupid kids went with him, and they ended up finding me drifting out in space. Apparently their old man had still been making money on the side, enough to get them a nice ship, and some... other things. They took me in, fed me, heard me whine about my shitty life. I guess they felt bad for me, cause they offered me what we thought was a Treatment needle.”"

rows.original: The Treatment
rows.raw: "The Treatment"

rows.original: “Outside New Texas? That’s illegal.” “Sure is.
rows.translation: “在新德克萨斯之外？那可是违法的。” “确实违法。
rows.raw: " “Outside New Texas? That’s illegal.” “Sure is."

rows.original: “Outside New Texas? That’s unusual.” “And illegal.
rows.translation: “新德克萨斯之外？那可不常见。” “而且违法。
rows.raw: " “Outside New Texas? That’s unusual.” “And illegal."

rows.original: Of course, it wasn’t the normal Treatment. Apparently ol’ daddy made some... less than upstanding friends during his exile, ‘cause he got his hands on a few needles of Overdose.”
rows.translation: 当然，那不是普通的改造疗程。看来老爹在流放期间交了些...算不上正派的朋友，因为他弄到了几支超量改造剂。”
rows.raw: " Of course, it wasn’t the normal Treatment. Apparently ol’ daddy made some... less than upstanding friends during his exile, ‘cause he got his hands on a few needles of Overdose.”"

rows.original: “Overdose?”
rows.translation: “超量改造剂？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Overdose?”"

rows.original: “I can’t actually remember if I’m supposed to tell you about this, but oh well. Overdose is basically the Treatment on steroids, with all the lumps and instability that come with that. It’s been around for a couple of years, but it flew under the radar until recently.”
rows.translation: “其实我不记得自己该不该把这事告诉你，不过管它呢。超量改造剂基本就是用了类固醇的改造疗程，连同由此产生的一切肿块和不稳定性。它已经存在好几年了，但直到最近才引起人们注意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t actually remember if I’m supposed to tell you about this, but oh well. Overdose is basically the Treatment on steroids, with all the lumps and instability that come with that. It’s been around for a couple of years, but it flew under the radar until recently.”"

rows.original: “Wait, is that the drug Winston was talking about?”
rows.translation: “等等，那是温斯顿说的那种药吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, is that the drug Winston was talking about?”"

rows.original: “Yeah. That’s its own thing, though. Back on topic, they offered me the needle, said it would fix everything. I’d heard of the Treatment before, but I didn’t think I’d ever actually get my hands on it. Plus, I was scared shitless that I’d be some brain dead cow, but at that point, I wasn’t particularly picky. I was sick of being little, sick of feeling like shit. This was my chance to start over, so I did it.”
rows.translation: “是啊。不过那是另一回事了。说回正题，他们给了我那针，说能解决一切。我以前听说过改造疗程，但从没想过真能弄到手。而且，我吓得要死，怕自己会变成那种脑子坏掉的母牛，但那时候我已经不怎么挑剔了。我受够了自己个子小，受够了那种烂透了的感觉。这是我重新来过的机会，所以我打了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. That’s its own thing, though. Back on topic, they offered me the needle, said it would fix everything. I’d heard of the Treatment before, but I didn’t think I’d ever actually get my hands on it. Plus, I was scared shitless that I’d be some brain dead cow, but at that point, I wasn’t particularly picky. I was sick of being little, sick of feeling like shit. This was my chance to start over, so I did it.”"

rows.original: She pauses for a second. “Yeah, time for the weird part. I stuck myself and it felt like fucking fire. Everything hurt, I could barely breathe. rows.original: Seeing that the droid is inactive, you glance around its -- her? -- frame until you notice that the tendril-tail has a power jack on its tip, tucked away between three smaller ones that branch out from the end. rows.original: The siegwulfe takes a moment to orient herself before her towering ausar-like ears clue her in to your presence. She rises to her feet and turns your way with a sensuous, predatory grace. Razor-sharp claws click on the deck, and her arms fold under her chest, drawing your attention to a pair of hardlight cuffs on her wrists -- where her combat blades come from, if you remember the promotional picture right.

rows.translation: 标志。她没什么必要遮掩金属下半身，而且似乎很乐意展示自己紧实的小腹和强壮的手臂。一条配有身份牌的紧身皮革项圈贴在她脖子上 -- 它同时象征着顺从、忠诚，以及你对她的所有权。
rows.raw: " logo. She has little need to cover her metallic lower body, and seems to find showing off her toned belly and strong arms agreeable enough. A tight leather collar, complete with dog-tags, clings to her neck -- a sign of submission, loyalty, and your ownership of her all at once."

rows.original: “Do you find me to your satisfaction, [pc.master]?” [wulfe.name] purrs pleasantly, taking a step closer. Her slender tail coils happily around one of her legs, as close to a wagging tail as the ausar-built companion can get.
rows.translation: “您对我还满意吗，[pc.master]？”[wulfe.name]愉悦地低鸣着，向前迈了一步。她纤细的尾巴快活地缠上自己一条腿，这已经是这只奥萨尔制造的伴侣最接近摇尾巴的动作了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you find me to your satisfaction, [pc.master]?” [wulfe.name] purrs pleasantly, taking a step closer. Her slender tail coils happily around one of her legs, as close to a wagging tail as the ausar-built companion can get."

rows.translation: 返回

rows.translation: 离开

rows.raw: "Siegwulfe's Leash"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: You catch [wulfe.name]’s eye and wave her down. She bounds over to you almost bowling you over in her eagerness, and immediately curls her body around yours.
rows.translation: 你迎上[wulfe.name]的目光，挥手把她叫来。她朝你一跃而来，急切得几乎把你撞倒，随即立刻用身体缠住你。
rows.raw: "You catch [wulfe.name]’s eye and wave her down. She bounds over to you almost bowling you over in her eagerness, and immediately curls her body around yours."

rows.original: “Yes, [wulfe.pcname]?” she purrs, her big metallic ears focused on you. “Looking for something?”
rows.translation: “是，[wulfe.pcname]？”她愉悦地低鸣着，一对金属大耳朵专注地朝向你。“在找什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, [wulfe.pcname]?” she purrs, her big metallic ears focused on you. “Looking for something?”"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: Smiling, [wulfe.name] looks at you expectantly. There’s a hungry gleam in her eyes.
rows.translation: [wulfe.name]微笑着，满怀期待地看着你。她眼里闪着饥饿的光。
rows.raw: "Smiling, [wulfe.name] looks at you expectantly. There’s a hungry gleam in her eyes."

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: How do you call out for her without being disrespectful? Before you can really think about it, you feel something soft pressing against your back and then on your shoulder.
rows.translation: 怎样呼唤她才不会显得无礼？你还没来得及认真思考，便感觉某个柔软的东西先贴上后背，又压到肩头。
rows.raw: "How do you call out for her without being disrespectful? Before you can really think about it, you feel something soft pressing against your back and then on your shoulder."

rows.original: “Hi, [wulfe.pcname]!” she says excitedly, her head laid next to yours. “Were you looking for me?”
rows.translation: “嗨，[wulfe.pcname]！”她兴奋地说，头靠在你旁边。“你是在找我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi, [wulfe.pcname]!” she says excitedly, her head laid next to yours. “Were you looking for me?”"

rows.original: You give a sharp whistle and call [wulfe.name]’s name. After a few moments, your loyal combat companion comes trotting over from her neck of the ship, all wagging tails and dark-lipped smiles.
rows.translation: 你吹了声响亮的口哨，喊出[wulfe.name]的名字。片刻后，你忠诚的战斗伴侣从船上属于她的那一片区域小跑过来，尾巴欢快摇摆，黑色嘴唇挂着笑容。
rows.raw: "You give a sharp whistle and call [wulfe.name]’s name. After a few moments, your loyal combat companion comes trotting over from her neck of the ship, all wagging tails and dark-lipped smiles."

rows.original: “Yes, [pc.master]?” she smiles, planting herself on the deck in front of you.
rows.translation: “是，[pc.master]？”她笑着，在你面前的地板上坐定。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, [pc.master]?” she smiles, planting herself on the deck in front of you."

rows.original: “[pc.Master], you look unwell. Have your adventures been hard on you without me? Please, let me serve you -- or better yet, come with you! I’ll protect you out there... and comfort you here, if you’d like.”
rows.translation: “[pc.Master]，你看起来不太好。没有我在身边，你的冒险一定很艰难吧？请让我侍奉你——或者更好，让我跟你走！我会在外面保护你...也会在这里安慰你，如果你愿意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.Master], you look unwell. Have your adventures been hard on you without me? Please, let me serve you -- or better yet, come with you! I’ll protect you out there... and comfort you here, if you’d like.”"

rows.original: “Oh, no! Did someone hurt you, [pc.master]!?” she gasps, seeing the state you’re in. Growling, she snaps her visor down and brandishes her claw-mounts. “Point them out, and I’ll cut them down, [pc.master]!”
rows.translation: “哦，不！有人伤害您了吗，[pc.master]！？”她看见你的状态，倒吸了一口气。她低吼着放下面罩，亮出爪刃挂架。“指出是谁，我会把他们全都砍倒，[pc.master]！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, no! Did someone hurt you, [pc.master]!?” she gasps, seeing the state you’re in. Growling, she snaps her visor down and brandishes her claw-mounts. “Point them out, and I’ll cut them down, [pc.master]!”"

rows.original: “Oh, [pc.master], you look a little flushed,” [wulfe.name] murmurs, pawing the deck in front of you. “Would you like me to serve you in any way?”
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.master]，您看起来有些脸红，”[wulfe.name]低声说道，用爪子扒着你面前的甲板。“您希望我以任何方式侍奉您吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, [pc.master], you look a little flushed,” [wulfe.name] murmurs, pawing the deck in front of you. “Would you like me to serve you in any way?”"

rows.original: You give a sharp whistle and call for your battle-companion to heel. Obediently, [wulfe.name] halts on a dime and plants her robotic butt on the ground, tail swishing expectantly.
rows.translation: 你吹了声尖锐的口哨，唤自己的战斗伙伴回到脚边。[wulfe.name]乖乖地骤然停下，将机器人屁股坐到地上，尾巴满怀期待地来回摆动。
rows.raw: "You give a sharp whistle and call for your battle-companion to heel. Obediently, [wulfe.name] halts on a dime and plants her robotic butt on the ground, tail swishing expectantly."

rows.original: “Yes, [pc.master]?” she purrs, wobbling her big metallic ears towards you.
rows.translation: “什么事，[pc.master]？”她低声呢喃，把两只大金属耳朵朝你晃了晃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, [pc.master]?” she purrs, wobbling her big metallic ears towards you."

rows.original: “[pc.Master], it looks like things have been hard on you! Please, you should rest awhile. Let me ease your burdens for a little bit, please...”
rows.translation: “[pc.Master]，看样子你最近过得很辛苦！求你了，你应该休息一会儿。让我帮你分担一点负担吧，求你了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.Master], it looks like things have been hard on you! Please, you should rest awhile. Let me ease your burdens for a little bit, please...”"

rows.original: “Oh, no! [pc.Master], you’re hurt! Please, let’s find a nurse-droid to tend to you, or at least rest for a while. I can only protect you so much if you don’t take care of yourself.”
rows.translation: “哦，不！[pc.Master]，你受伤了！求你了，我们找个护士机器人来照料你吧，要不至少先休息一会儿。你要是不好好照顾自己，我能护住你的也有限。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, no! [pc.Master], you’re hurt! Please, let’s find a nurse-droid to tend to you, or at least rest for a while. I can only protect you so much if you don’t take care of yourself.”"

rows.original: “Oh, [pc.master], you look a little flushed,” [wulfe.name] murmurs, pawing the ground in front of you. “Would you like me to serve you in any way?”
rows.translation: “哦，[pc.master]，你看起来有点脸红，”[wulfe.name]低声说着，在你面前用爪子刨着地面。“要我用什么方式伺候你吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, [pc.master], you look a little flushed,” [wulfe.name] murmurs, pawing the ground in front of you. “Would you like me to serve you in any way?”"

rows.original: With a smile, [wulfe.name] patiently awaits your action.
rows.translation: [wulfe.name]面带微笑，耐心等待你的行动。
rows.raw: "With a smile, [wulfe.name] patiently awaits your action."

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: Doctor Badger
rows.translation: 獾医生
rows.raw: "Doctor Badger"

rows.original: As you approach the Doctor, cautiously avoiding stepping on the trash she has piled up in the shop, she looks up and gives you a nod.
rows.translation: 你走近医生，小心避开她堆在店里的垃圾；她抬起头，朝你点了点头。
rows.raw: "As you approach the Doctor, cautiously avoiding stepping on the trash she has piled up in the shop, she looks up and gives you a nod."

rows.original: “My number one customer. Interested in anything today? Some happy pills? Something with a bit more kick? Or...” she trails off, noting the presence of your faithful canine companion, [wulfe.name]. “Oh, hello. I’d just been thinking about you.”
rows.translation: “我的头号顾客。今天对什么感兴趣？快乐药丸？来点更带劲的？还是...”她的声音逐渐停下，注意到了你忠实的犬类伙伴[wulfe.name]。“哦，你好。我刚才还在想着你呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My number one customer. Interested in anything today? Some happy pills? Something with a bit more kick? Or...” she trails off, noting the presence of your faithful canine companion, [wulfe.name]. “Oh, hello. I’d just been thinking about you.”"

rows.translation: “嗯哼，”獾医生点头赞同，走到虚拟智能面前打量起来。她伸出手，把手指放在[wulfe.name]的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm-hmm,” Badger nods in assent, crossing over to the VI and inspecting it. She reaches out and puts her finger on [wulfe.name]’s "

wulfe.isBimbo()
                  ? "happy and carefree"
                  : "completely impassive and impenetrable"

rows.original: happy and carefree
rows.translation: 快乐又无忧无虑
rows.raw: "happy and carefree"

rows.original: completely impassive and impenetrable
rows.translation: 全然冷漠，难以看透
rows.raw: "completely impassive and impenetrable"

rows.original: , though her gaze shifts to you to ensure you’re not overly concerned.
rows.translation: ，不过她的目光转向你，确认你没有太过担心。
rows.raw: ", though her gaze shifts to you to ensure you’re not overly concerned."

rows.original: “I’ve been thinking about some upgrades to this model...” Badger muses, moving her hand lower. In a blur of movement, [wulfe.name] catches her wrist and holds it in place, her fingers wrapped around the Doctor’s arm. She looks at her captive,
rows.translation: “我一直在考虑给这个型号做些升级...”獾医生一边沉思，一边把手向下移去。[wulfe.name]动作快得只剩残影，一把扣住她的手腕，将其牢牢制住，手指紧紧环住医生的手臂。她看着被自己制住的人，
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been thinking about some upgrades to this model...” Badger muses, moving her hand lower. In a blur of movement, [wulfe.name] catches her wrist and holds it in place, her fingers wrapped around the Doctor’s arm. She looks at her captive, "

rows.original: seemingly completely unconcerned.
rows.translation: 看上去完全不在意。
rows.raw: "seemingly completely unconcerned."

rows.original: uncaring.
rows.translation: 漠不关心。
rows.raw: "uncaring."

rows.original: “Like, you’re not my [pc.master]!” she says, rolling her eyes. “You can’t just go touching me all willy-nilly without [pc.himHer] saying so, duh.”
rows.translation: “拜托，你又不是我的[pc.master]！”她翻着白眼说道。“没有[pc.himHer]允许，你不能就这么随随便便摸我，懂不懂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, you’re not my [pc.master]!” she says, rolling her eyes. “You can’t just go touching me all willy-nilly without [pc.himHer] saying so, duh.”"

rows.original: “You are not my [pc.master],” she says. “Your touch is heretofore disallowed.”
rows.translation: “你不是我的[pc.master]，”她说道。“从现在起禁止你触摸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are not my [pc.master],” she says. “Your touch is heretofore disallowed.”"

rows.original: Badger sighs, pulling her hand back as [wulfe.name] releases her. “You’d think that’d piss me off, but I had that one coming. Oops! Anyway, the upgrades.” She taps her chin, lost in thought. “I had a couple of physical changes in mind, along with a big subroutine switchup.”
rows.translation: [wulfe.name]松开手后，獾医生叹了口气，把手抽了回来。“你也许以为这会惹恼我，但刚才确实是我自找的。哎呀！总之，继续说升级。”她若有所思地轻敲下巴。“我想到了几项外形改造，还要大幅调整子程序。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBadger sighs, pulling her hand back as [wulfe.name] releases her. “You’d think that’d piss me off, but I had that one coming. Oops! Anyway, the upgrades.” She taps her chin, lost in thought. “I had a couple of physical changes in mind, along with a big subroutine switchup.”"

rows.original: “Mind telling me what they are?” you inquire, lifting an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “介意告诉我具体是什么吗？”你扬起眉毛问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mind telling me what they are?” you inquire, lifting an eyebrow."

rows.original: “That’d spoil the fun,” Badger says with a leering grin. “And it’s going to be a lot of fun.”
rows.translation: “那可就不好玩了，”獾医生露出色眯眯的笑。“而且这会非常好玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’d spoil the fun,” Badger says with a leering grin. “And it’s going to be a lot of fun.”"

rows.original: Whatever Dr. Badger’s going to do, you have a feeling [wulfe.name] will return to you completely different...
rows.translation: 无论獾医生打算做什么，你都有种感觉，[wulfe.name]回到你身边时会变得截然不同...
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever Dr. Badger’s going to do, you have a feeling [wulfe.name] will return to you completely different..."

rows.original: Warning: This will be an irreversible change. Save your game first and revisit her if you want to go through with it.
rows.translation: 警告：这将是不可逆的改变。请先保存游戏，如果你确实想这么做，再来找她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWarning: This will be an irreversible change. Save your game first and revisit her if you want to go through with it."

rows.original: Do It
rows.translation: 动手
rows.raw: "Do It"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: Doctor Badger
rows.translation: 獾医生
rows.raw: "Doctor Badger"

rows.original: What is science for if not pushing boundaries? Especially Dr. Badger’s particular brand of it. Actually, you’re almost certain she enjoys science specifically to push boundaries. You shrug and nod.
rows.translation: 科学若不是为了突破边界，又有什么意义？尤其是獾医生那一派的科学。事实上，你几乎可以肯定，她享受科学正是为了突破边界。你耸耸肩，点了点头。
rows.raw: "What is science for if not pushing boundaries? Especially Dr. Badger’s particular brand of it. Actually, you’re almost certain she enjoys science specifically to push boundaries. You shrug and nod."

rows.original: “Alright, surprise me.”
rows.translation: “好吧，给我个惊喜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, surprise me.”"

rows.original: “Oh, it’ll be a big surprise, alright,” Badger says, flashing her sharp teeth in a predatory smile. “Come on, bot. Let’s make you more fun, shall we? You’ll probably enjoy it just as much as your ‘[pc.master]’ does.”
rows.translation: “哦，这当然会是个大大的惊喜，”獾医生说道，露出尖牙，绽开捕食者般的笑容。“来吧，机器人。让我们把你变得更有趣，好不好？你大概会和自己的‘[pc.master]’一样享受。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’ll be a big surprise, alright,” Badger says, flashing her sharp teeth in a predatory smile. “Come on, bot. Let’s make you more fun, shall we? You’ll probably enjoy it just as much as your ‘[pc.master]’ does.”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes and nod at [wulfe.name]. “Go with the Doctor, [wulfe.name]. It’ll just be a little while and then you’ll be back with me in no time. Just obey her instructions.”
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，冲[wulfe.name]点点头。“跟医生去吧，[wulfe.name]。只要一小会儿，你很快就能回到我身边。照她的指示做就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes and nod at [wulfe.name]. “Go with the Doctor, [wulfe.name]. It’ll just be a little while and then you’ll be back with me in no time. Just obey her instructions.”"

rows.original: “Okay, [pc.master]!” [wulfe.name] cheers,
rows.translation: “好的，[pc.master]！”[wulfe.name]欢呼道，
rows.raw: "“Okay, [pc.master]!” [wulfe.name] cheers,"

rows.original: “Yes, [pc.master],” [wulfe.name] says,
rows.translation: “是的，[pc.master]，”[wulfe.name]说，
rows.raw: "“Yes, [pc.master],” [wulfe.name] says,"

rows.original: getting up and following the Doctor into the back of her shop.
rows.translation: 起身跟着医生走进她店铺的里间。
rows.raw: " getting up and following the Doctor into the back of her shop."

rows.original: “Hey, she better not come back as a pile of scrap metal,” you call out after Badger.
rows.translation: “喂，她回来时最好别变成一堆废金属，”你朝离去的獾医生喊道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, she better not come back as a pile of scrap metal,” you call out after Badger."

rows.original: She stops for a second as if remembering something, and turns back to you. “Do you happen to have any Ovilium on you? About, say, 10 bottles?”
rows.translation: 她停了一下，像是想起了什么，然后转回身看你。“你身上碰巧带着产卵素吗？大概，比如说，10瓶？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stops for a second as if remembering something, and turns back to you. “Do you happen to have any Ovilium on you? About, say, 10 bottles?”"

rows.original: “I do, but what do you want it for?” you reply warily.
rows.translation: “我有，但你要它做什么？”你警惕地回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I do, but what do you want it for?” you reply warily."

rows.original: “Something of an experiment to do with your little pet here,” she says, motioning towards your droid. “Can’t say too much or that’d spoil the surprise, wouldn’t it?”
rows.translation: “要拿你这只小宠物做个实验之类的东西，”她朝你的机器人示意着说道。“不能透露太多，否则不就破坏惊喜了吗？”

rows.original: You ask Syri what she’s reading lately, gesturing towards her data slate. The ausar shrugs, “Some [rand |shitty historical fiction I got on Congo. It’s set on the dzaan homeworld, about the first contact with Confederate colonists... but somehow the author’s turned it into this planetary romance with swashbuckling on a gas giant and there’s a good alpha and an evil alpha competing for the same beta. For some reason; she’s not exactly a catch... though I guess ‘biggest breeding hips’ counts for something. Seriously, that’s the plot. She picked the most interesting period in a whole planet’s history and turned it into a bodice ripper adventure. Ugh. |weird historical drama I got for free off public domain, about something called the ‘War of 1812’ on Terra. I had to read a whole wiki page just to figure out the context... the author really did a terrible job setting it up. Then again I think this book is like two thousand years old. Anyway it’s about some country getting invaded by its former suzerain or something, at least it’s trying to be, but most of the time it’s just some plantation damsel pining after an army officer who’s gone to fight. I wish I could care if he lives or not, but like, his defining character trait is his chest hair and square chin. Ugh. |really cool retro-future adventure I picked up on Congo, about the first War in the Stars — that’s when the first ausar star-kings opened the Warp Gates and immediately proceeded to blast each other back to the stone age. God, can you believe just about the first thing to go through the gates were nukes? We’re the worst. What makes it worse is I think this was written before the war, and this poor bastard just predicted it when the Gates were still being built. It’s amazing, but... man it’s depressing. |non-fiction book about the first contact with the galotians. It’s really interesting — nobody realized the galo-babes were even sentient for years, thought they were just monsters outta one of Kaede’s favorite RPGs. Of course, the goos didn’t make it easy, what with eating people to death a bunch. The book’s actually written by a galotian, one of the daughters of Galos, about her mother’s long struggle to understand meat-sacks like us and make contact. Well, I say ‘her mother’ but I guess it’s really herself a few splits back... I wonder how identity gets passed between galotians anyway; are all of Galos’s daughters just Galos two-point-oh or what? Ugh, my head. ] I need to go back to reading Sci-Fi or something...” You chuckle at that, mentioning that you’re all practically living Science Fiction. Or at least, the sci-fi of yesteryear. “Yeah, that’s why I stopped reading it. Every time someone would put out a new idea, it was reality a couple years later. Takes the imagination out of everything when I figure, ‘hey, my sister could make that.’ I can just imagine what the guy who wrote Dark Space Revelation thought when the warp gates opened. Those were the books that inspired them, and the first gates were built in the author’s lifetime. There’s a statue of him in the square of Capital Bay back home.” You ask Syri to tell you a little bit about the gates — her race’s crowning achievement. She shrugs lightly sipping at her drink. “Hey, I’m not exactly an expert: you want to know the deep quantum physics shit, talk to my sister. She’s a genius about warp gates and wormholes and stuff. I’m just a dumb grunt. But hey, thank all the gods for the gates. Without them, I’d never have met you,” she grins, giving you an affectionate wink. “But back to reading... so, what’re you into these days, [syri.isLover |babe |cap ]? Any good reads lately?”

rows.original: You shrug and mention that you really haven’t read anything at all lately. Syri makes a mock gasp of horror at the notion, and grabs her data slate. “Well, we’ll just have to rectify that, Captain Steele. Now, let’s start you off with some new Rondell Ramus books... and maybe a little Capser van Beck. Oh, and Imono Flaest’s new one -- the sequel to his best seller just came out. Fifty billion copies sold by the time I woke up.” “Here we go...” she grins, tapping her screen. A moment later you codex announces that you have mail.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，说自己最近真是什么都没读。希莉听了，装出一副惊恐地倒抽气的样子，抓起她的数据板。“那我们就得把这事儿补上，斯蒂尔船长。来，先从几本新的朗德尔·拉穆斯开始...也许再来点卡普瑟·范·贝克。哦，还有伊莫诺·弗莱斯特的新作 -- 他那本畅销书的续集刚出。等我醒来的时候已经卖了五百亿本了。” “来吧...”她咧嘴一笑，敲了敲屏幕。片刻之后，你的CODEX终端提示你有新邮件。

rows.original: Engineering
rows.translation: 工程学
rows.raw: "Engineering"

rows.original: You remember Syri was an engineer on Mhen’ga — does she ever miss that line of work at all? “Miss my old gig? Eh. I mean, I was damn good at it! I spent eight years in the Royals learning how to be the best, and a bunch of time civvy contracting after... got a whole degree and everything. But do I miss it? I don’t know. As much as I complained about how boring and repetitive the stuff I did was, cuz it was mostly prefabs y’know, there was this real sense that I was helping people. Connecting places on frontier worlds, bringing clean water to places and helping with sanitation. It was hard, dirty work most days, but you’d be shocked how many people even in Rush Twelve worlds still don’t have basic infrastructure.” She chuckles. “Well, maybe a Planet Rusher like you wouldn’t be surprised... but even with how hostile the natives sometimes were on Mhen’ga, the villages that would let us come and help them, we were building aqueducts and roads — in the middle of building the huge bridge to cross a gap so naleen could actually come to Esbeth from across this valley in the north of town. I guess... on a purely personal level I love what I’m doing now, but it was nice to really make a difference in peoples’ lives. That’s not a perspective I ever really had when I was doing it, but now that I’m not, I can see that I was doing some real good. At least once in a while.” You wonder, with an attitude like that — would she ever think of going back? “Nope,” she answers flatly. “Thing about being a concrete conjurer is that you kinda got to stay in one place, and you... you’re going all over the galaxy. I know it’s selfish, but I’d rather be on your crew any day.” You lean in and give Syri a [syri.isLover |big ol’ kiss |big hug ]. You’re glad to have her around, too, as long as she’s happy. Maybe when this adventure of yours is over, and you’ve settled into Steele Tech, she can consider taking up a post with the company’s engineers? “Heh, yeah, maybe!” she says, tail swishing in your lap. “But let’s not count our eggs before they hatch, captain. From where I’m sitting, you’ve still got a ways to go... and I’m not queen of the whole gaming circuit yet. No quitting before everyone in the galaxy is officially my bitch.” Attagirl.
rows.translation: 你记得希莉曾在门加当工程师 — 她会怀念那一行吗？ “怀念以前的工作？呃。我是说，我当时干得可他妈好了！我花了八年时间在皇家军队学习怎样成为最优秀的工程师，之后又当了很长一段时间的民间承包商...学位什么的也全拿到了。但我怀念吗？我不知道。尽管我总抱怨自己的工作有多么无聊、多么千篇一律，毕竟大多都是预制建筑，你懂吧，可我当时真切感觉自己在帮助别人。连接边疆世界上的各个地方，为当地带来净水，改善卫生条件。大多数时候，那都是又苦又脏的工作，可即使在第十二次开拓潮涉及的世界里，仍有那么多人连基础设施都没有，保证会让你大吃一惊。” 她轻声笑了。“好吧，像你这样的行星开拓者或许不会惊讶...不过即使门加的原住民有时充满敌意，那些愿意让我们进去提供帮助的村庄里，我们也修建了引水渠和道路 — 当时还在镇北修建一座横跨山谷缺口的巨桥，让纳林真正能够越过山谷来到埃斯贝斯。我想...就我个人而言，我热爱现在的生活，但能够真正改变别人的生活也很好。做这份工作时，我从未真正以这种角度看待它，可如今离开以后，我才发现自己确实做了些好事。至少偶尔如此。” 你不禁想，她既然抱着这种态度 — 是否会考虑回去？ “不会，”她直截了当地回答。“当混凝土魔法师的问题在于，你多少得留在同一个地方，可你...你要去银河各处。我知道这很自私，可我无论如何都更愿意待在你的船员队伍里。” 你俯身给了希莉一个[syri.isLover |大大的吻 |大大的拥抱 ]。只要她开心，你也很高兴能让她陪在身边。也许等你的这场冒险结束，你在斯蒂尔科技安顿下来以后，她可以考虑在公司的工程部门谋个职位？ “嘿，嗯，也许吧！”她说着，尾巴在你腿上扫来扫去。“不过别在蛋孵出来前就开始数有几只，船长。在我看来，你还有很长的路要走...而且我也还没成为整个竞技游戏圈的女王。在银河系里的每个人正式成为我的婊子以前，我绝不会退出。” 好姑娘。
