rows.original: Streaming
rows.translation: 直播
rows.raw: "Streaming"

rows.original: Time to talk Syri’s favorite subject: how’s her pro-gamer-girl career coming along? “Doin’ great, actually!” she answers, giving you her most wolfish grin. “The momentum from that tourney on Uveto’s still holding strong. Ever since I started streaming, subs are just pouring in... it feels like its own kind of high score I’m trying to figure out how to maximize. What games do I play, how long to go at once, how to interact with my... my audience? I don’t know that I like that word... maybe just fans, or anonymous friends. I dunno.” So what’s she been doing lately on the road to galactic stardom? [rand |“Well, I’ve been grinding a lot of Call of Valor lately... that franchise has always been my bread and butter, and it’s what got all this started. I think most people just come to see me own kids at CoV, honestly, so it’s no surprise that gets the most views. Plus, you know, most popular game franchise in the galaxy. I’m only getting better with every season, so as long as I keep practicing, I know I’m gonna keep dominating!” |Syri gives a wistful little sigh. “I really don’t want to get pigeonholed into ‘that CoV bitch’ so I’ve been trying to make time to play other things than just shooters. I like all sorts of games — pretty much anything other than puzzle games or sports stuff. So I’m trying out a dedicated day every week just for me to play some other stuff: mostly RPGs. I figure if I play one day a week for half a year I might finish a whole game one of these days. Of course, people keep pestering me to play horror games... think I’ll scream and freak out just cuz I’m a girl. But I am the woooorst case scenario for horror devs, I just speedrun them and laugh at the monsters. Pfft.” |“Weeeeell,” she drawls, kicking her legs, “I’m trying to do more co-op stuff. Mostly CoV, but some other streamers have invited me on their shows already! That’s really nice of them... everyone’s been so friendly. I’m not saying I cried a little after the first time, but maybe I did. Just a bit. It’s kind of overwhelming, the way people have just accepted me into the community. I finally feel like there’s somewhere I belong.” Other than on your ship, she means. “Other than that. I know I’ve always got a place with you, [syri.isMarried |my darling [pc.mf |husband |wife ] |cap ].” Damn right she does. |“You know, from what I’ve read nobody really watches MMO streamers unless that’s all you stream — what people get out of fetishizizing crafting for eight hours a day, I’ll never know. But I kind of want to try it! Back in high school I used to be in a pretty big PVP guild on Galaxy of Adventure, and after the tourney my old guild leader got back in touch. It was really sweet — he didn’t even try asking me to come back, just wrote to let me know everyone was super hyped for me. It’d be pretty fun to cruise back to some old multiplayer games and see if I’ve still got it. I just hope my subscribers won’t mind too much...” |“I’ve been thinking lately... what if I did some kind of event where I played games with people that sub to me? It might be kinda chaotic, and I’d have to do some kind of raffle to see who gets into any one game... but that seems like a cool way to give back to the people that’re supporting me. Probably more fun than playing with total randos, too. After all, you wouldn’t believe how many people just ask if they can hop in a game with you in chat... and I guess there’s no reason to say no, is there?” ] [syri.isLewdStreamer |Sidling up a little closer, and finding something soft and sensitive on your pup to grope, you ask how her more salacious streams having been going. Syri’s cheeks darken, but her wolven grin only spreads. “Hey, I’m not exactly a full-time camgirl here... but you and I have certainly made some heads turn. I mean, a smokin’ hot gamer-girl like me and a [pc.mf |ruggedly handsome captain |drop-dead gorgeous babe ] like you are definitely worth a few extra subs. And hey, now that I’ve age-gated myself, whenever I get horny while I work I can just whip it out and ask which of my subs wishes she was there to suck. Call ‘em good boys and girls for watchin’ me stroke. God they go wild for that shit. But it’s way more fun when it’s the two of us.” Syri leans in and gives you a kiss, sliding a hand up your [pc.chest]. “You’re welcome to come in and steal my stage any time you want, [syri.isMarried |my love |captain ],” she whispers, voice husky in your ears. “Show the whole galaxy who [syri.isHellhound |my favorite bitch is |has total control of my joystick ]. rows.raw: " Time to talk Syri’s favorite subject: how’s her pro-gamer-girl career coming along? “Doin’ great, actually!” she answers, giving you her most wolfish grin. “The momentum from that tourney on Uveto’s still holding strong. Ever since I started streaming, subs are just pouring in... it feels like its own kind of high score I’m trying to figure out how to maximize. What games do I play, how long to go at once, how to interact with my... my audience? I don’t know that I like that word... maybe just fans, or anonymous friends. I dunno.” So what’s she been doing lately on the road to galactic stardom? [rand |“Well, I’ve been grinding a lot of Call of Valor lately... that franchise has always been my bread and butter, and it’s what got all this started. I think most people just come to see me own kids at CoV, honestly, so it’s no surprise that gets the most views. Plus, you know, most popular game franchise in the galaxy. I’m only getting better with every season, so as long as I keep practicing, I know I’m gonna keep dominating!” |Syri gives a wistful little sigh. “I really don’t want to get pigeonholed into ‘that CoV bitch’ so I’ve been trying to make time to play other things than just shooters. I like all sorts of games — pretty much anything other than puzzle games or sports stuff. So I’m trying out a dedicated day every week just for me to play some other stuff: mostly RPGs. I figure if I play one day a week for half a year I might finish a whole game one of these days. Of course, people keep pestering me to play horror games... think I’ll scream and freak out just cuz I’m a girl. But I am the woooorst case scenario for horror devs, I just speedrun them and laugh at the monsters. Pfft.” |“Weeeeell,” she drawls, kicking her legs, “I’m trying to do more co-op stuff. Mostly CoV, but some other streamers have invited me on their shows already! That’s really nice of them... everyone’s been so friendly. I’m not saying I cried a little after the first time, but maybe I did. Just a bit. It’s kind of overwhelming, the way people have just accepted me into the community. I finally feel like there’s somewhere I belong.” Other than on your ship, she means. “Other than that. I know I’ve always got a place with you, [syri.isMarried |my darling [pc.mf |husband |wife ] |cap ].” Damn right she does. |“You know, from what I’ve read nobody really watches MMO streamers unless that’s all you stream — what people get out of fetishizizing crafting for eight hours a day, I’ll never know. But I kind of want to try it! Back in high school I used to be in a pretty big PVP guild on Galaxy of Adventure, and after the tourney my old guild leader got back in touch. It was really sweet — he didn’t even try asking me to come back, just wrote to let me know everyone was super hyped for me. It’d be pretty fun to cruise back to some old multiplayer games and see if I’ve still got it. I just hope my subscribers won’t mind too much...” |“I’ve been thinking lately... what if I did some kind of event where I played games with people that sub to me? It might be kinda chaotic, and I’d have to do some kind of raffle to see who gets into any one game... but that seems like a cool way to give back to the people that’re supporting me. Probably more fun than playing with total randos, too. After all, you wouldn’t believe how many people just ask if they can hop in a game with you in chat... and I guess there’s no reason to say no, is there?” ] [syri.isLewdStreamer |Sidling up a little closer, and finding something soft and sensitive on your pup to grope, you ask how her more salacious streams having been going. Syri’s cheeks darken, but her wolven grin only spreads. “Hey, I’m not exactly a full-time camgirl here... but you and I have certainly made some heads turn. Call ‘em good boys and girls for watchin’ me stroke. God they go wild for that shit. But it’s way more fun when it’s the two of us.” Syri leans in and gives you a kiss, sliding a hand up your [pc.chest]. “You’re welcome to come in and steal my stage any time you want, [syri.isMarried |my love |captain ],” she whispers, voice husky in your ears. “Show the whole galaxy who [syri.isHellhound |my favorite bitch is |has total control of my joystick ]. [syri.isLewdStreamer |Could trade some chores around the ship, or maybe... a little public display of dominance for our adoring fans, hmm? |I don’t need your money anymore, but getting out of some chores would certainly brighten my day. Laundry’s not gonna do itself around here. ]” Now there’s an idea... "

rows.original: You tell Syri you just want to play for playing’s sake. “Haha, fair enough. Playing with you is it’s own reward, after all.” Aww. Alright, enough blushing on camera, time to get serious! Nearly an hour passes in the game. The game world’s so bright and cheery that it’s distracting, overwhelming your senses with bright pastel colors and thumping bass-heavy music. Strange shapes float around in the sky, hints of other maps and game modes, but for now you’re locked on the same platform as Syri— wait where’d she go? The hand suddenly exploding through your [pc.chest] with your still-beating heart in it answers that question. Your rig gives you a nasty shock as your avatar’s body slumps to the floor at Syri’s feet. “Owned!” The chat flashing by on Syri’s screen erupts in a flurry of activity. You grunt and respawn, keeping your eyes on the prize this time! Syri comes charging in just about the moment you take control, but you’re ready for her, deflecting her lighting-fast blows just long enough to spot an opening. When she’s recoiling from a parry, you sweep her legs, putting the pup off balance hard enough that you can twist around her, grab her by the waist, and suplex her right off the edge of the map. “Fuuuuuuuuuuuuc-owww!” Syri howls, flailing as she gets an even nastier shock. “Okay, no more messing around. I’mma get you now!” We’ll see about that. [var0 |Syri loads back in, dropping into a low stance that would look damn threatening if her tail wasn’t wagging a mile a minute. Rather than letting her come at you again, you just smirk and tell Syri that she’s a very good girl. That gives her pause, tail swishing faster, and giving you an opportunity to dive in and tackle her to the ground, tickling her ribs in the real world to make your game avatar sock her over and over. Syri giggles, squirming under you as her health bar depletes; she taps out before you can put her down. “Damn it! Guess I still have a lot to learn from you, don’t I?” Syri sighs, flopping back with a sigh. “Oh, hey... thanks for the pity donations, guys. Haha, don’t worry, I’ll get [pc.himHer] back next time. But in the meantime, I’ll take my participation trophy...” Just as you’re pulling up your own visor, Syri slips in past your defenses and snatches a kiss, brushing her hands across your [pc.chest]. “Thanks for hanging out, babe.” Always a pleasure. |Syri loads back in, dropping into a low stance and baring her teeth. “Ready or not, here I come!” It turns out, you’re not ready. Syri launches herself at you with a fierce warcry, barreling head-first into your [pc.chest]. That knocks the wind out of you, knocking you onto the bed and teasing your tummy to make her avatar eviscerate you. With defeat clearly inevitable, you tap out — only for Syri to pull your visor off and give you a kiss just as passionate as her ass-whooping. “Not bad, [pc.name], but you’ve gotta learn to watch your ass,” she grins, her tail flicking around to brush your [pc.hips]. “But not bad all the same. Getting a kill on me is more than most amateurs can do!” Yeah, yeah. You lean in and steal another kiss right on camera, holding it just long enough to make Syri’s cheeks flush red. Her tail’s wagging full force by the time you break off. “W-well that’ll bring in the donations alright... th-thanks for the practice round, captain.” Any time, Syri. ]
rows.translation: 你告诉希莉，自己只是想单纯玩游戏。 “哈哈，没问题。毕竟，能跟你一起玩本身就是奖励。” 真可爱。好了，别再对着镜头脸红，该认真了！ 游戏里将近一个小时过去了。这个游戏世界明亮欢快得让人分心，鲜艳的粉彩色调和震耳的重-低音音乐淹没了你的感官。奇异形状漂浮在天空中，暗示着其他地图与游戏模式，但现在你和希莉被锁在同一座平台上——等等，她去哪了？ 一只手突然从你的[pc.chest]穿出，掌中还握着仍在-跳动的心脏，这回答了你的问题。虚拟角色的身体倒在希莉脚边时，装具狠狠电了你一下。“拿下！” 希莉屏幕上飞速滚动的聊天顿时爆发出一阵狂潮。你闷哼着重生，这次牢牢盯住目标！你刚恢复控制，希莉便冲了上来，但你早有准备，挡下她快-如闪电的攻击，撑到终于看见破绽。她被格挡震退时，你扫倒她的双腿，让这只狗娘失去平衡，随即绕到身后，抓住她的腰，用过肩摔直接把她扔出地图边缘。 “操——-好痛！”希莉嚎叫着四肢乱舞，遭到一次更加猛烈的电击。“好吧，不闹了。现在我要收拾你！” 那就走着瞧。 [var0 |希莉重新载入，压低身体摆出架势；要不是尾巴快得像要摇出残影，这姿态还真挺吓人。你没让她再次冲来，只是坏笑着告诉希莉，她是个乖女孩。她愣了一下，尾巴摇得更快，让你有机会扑上去将她压倒；你在现实中挠她肋部的痒，让游戏角色一拳又一拳揍她。希莉咯咯笑着在你身下扭动，生命条不断下降；你还没彻底解决她，她就认输了。 “该死！看来我还有很多东西得向你学，对吧？”希莉叹了口气，向后一倒。“哦，对了...谢谢大家同情式的捐款。哈哈，别担心，下次我会找[pc.himHer]讨回来的。不过现在，我就收下参与奖吧...” 你正要掀起自己的面罩，希莉却钻过防线偷吻了你，双手拂过你的[pc.chest]。“谢谢你陪我玩，宝贝。” 随时乐意。 |希莉重新载入，压低身体摆出架势，露出牙齿。“准备好没有，我来了！” 事实证明，你没准备好。希莉伴着凶猛战吼扑向你，一头-撞进你的[pc.chest]。这一击让你喘不过气、倒在床上；她在现实中逗弄你的肚子，让游戏角色把你开膛破肚。败局显然无可避免，你只好认输——结果希莉扯下你的面罩，给了你一个与她这顿痛-打同样激烈的吻。 “还不错，[pc.name]，不过你得学会看好自己的屁股，”她咧嘴一笑，尾巴甩来擦过你的[pc.hips]。“但总的来说确实不错。能杀我一次，已经比大多数菜鸟强了！” 好啦，好啦。你凑上去，当着镜头又偷了一个吻，持续得刚好足以令希莉双颊通红。等你分开时，她的尾巴已经全力摇动。“这-这个肯定能带来不少捐款...谢、谢-谢陪练，船长。” 随时都行，希莉。 ]

rows.original: For once, Anno’s door is closed and locked when you head over to the snowy pup’s quarters. You give a sharp knock on the hatch, asking through it if she’s inside. “Sec!” comes a shouted reply through the metal. “On the horn!” Oh, sorry. You sigh and lean against the doorframe, tapping a [pc.foot] while Anno finishes her phone call. It doesn’t take more than a minute or two for her to finish up, coming to the door with a radiant smile on her lips and a swish in her bushy white tail. “Hey, boss! Sorry ‘bout that, was just checking in with my parents. Heh, I guess our parents, now that Syri’s on board.” You can guess what, or who, was the topic of conversation. “Yeeeeeeah,” she laughs, glancing across the corridor towards her sister’s quarters. “Mom and dad were definitely shocked to hear Syri was moving in. They thought she couldn’t stand any of us, much less me. I know better, though. She’s just always gotta do her own thing. Of course, then they started asking about your intentions with my lil sister...” And what did she tell them? Anno gives you a coy look. “Just the truth. Her moving aboard was just as much a surprise to me as anybody. [silly |Syri once told me she would never submit, not even to a traffic light. I can’t imagine her taking orders aboard a starship! |She’s so independent about everything... or at least she was back before she joined the Federation forces. Honestly I don’t know how she didn’t get kicked out of bootcamp, she could never follow orders back home. But apparently she’s pretty damn good at all this. ] I guess we’ll see how she fits in on a Rusher ship with her [pc.boyGirl]friend at the helm. No pressure, right?” Yeah, your soldier girl’s going to do just fine. “Yeah,” Anno says, “I think so too. She’s matured a lot since she left home.” The elder sister waves you into her office-slash-bedroom, taking a seat at her desk. “Speaking of which, I’ve been meaning to say something ever since I found out about you two...” Go on...

For now, I must provide assistance and medicare to anyone that requires it from me, but knowing who you are and what you’ve done for me, I bet she’d allow you to take me - maybe in more than one way,” she teases.
rows.translation: 你很快便注意到那个在F.I.R.S.T-14遇见过的可爱医疗机器人的熟悉服装与帽子。她正忙着检查一名新来的斯蒂尔科技雇员；从金发护士不得不用先进治疗工具闭合的大量割伤和瘀伤来看，这人显然被当地居民狠狠教训了一番。几分钟后，缇卡亲吻了勇敢的狸猫男脸颊，又递给他一根粉色棒棒糖，完成了治疗——里面肯定也装满了微型外科机器人。 你先让疲惫的新人离开房间，随后敲了几下门，走进这名固定在基座上的原型机的新办公室。“[pc.name]！你能来我太高兴了。快看这里多么气派整洁，而且这还只是一座[silly|位于鸟不拉屎地方的]小型前哨站！我在废弃空间站待得太久，都忘了世上还有这种整洁、充满生命，而且有许多人需要照顾的地方，”她尖叫着伸手捧住你的脸，在双颊上接连落下一阵亲吻。她丰满的合成嘴唇摸起来与有机嘴唇毫无区别，不过人工呼出的气息仍让你觉得稍显异样。“你的体温和荷尔蒙水平都很稳定，但我检测到异常的压力水平。我建议每天拥抱几次，并避免危险情形，”她补充道，随后放开怀抱。 “[pc.kmhbb|我也很高兴见到你，缇卡|我每天都能来一次这种检查|好啦，天啊，我会更小心的|那个，我现在就想让你再检查一次|能有一位技术高超的医生听我差遣，真是幸运]。斯蒂尔科技找回你以后，你过得怎么样？” 先进的女性机器人先看看你，又看看家具齐全的房间和明亮的全息屏幕。“我很幸运，其他员工和当地人都对我很好。拥有我这样的身体，很容易成为恶作剧的首选目标；你根本想不到有多少人要求我进行‘完整的医疗检查’。第一次我会装作没听懂，但他们再次提出要求时，我就告诉他们要从前列腺检查或妇科检查开始，通常他们都会退缩。只有一个人一直这么做，不过她的姓名严格来说属于医疗机密，所以我不能透露，”她说道，用细长而光滑的舌头舔过金色嘴唇。“哦！让我给你看看那群[silly|书呆子|工程师]对我的基座做了什么。我保证你一定会喜欢。” 你既担忧又好奇地[pc.isNaga|向后游动|后退]了一点，期待看到某种精巧装置。伴随系统启动的平稳嗡鸣声，困住她的笨重基座展开变形，像牛兽下半身一样转到缇卡身后，形成更符合空气动力学的设计。短短十几秒内，这名金发医疗机器人便从无法移动的机器变成了悬浮的拟牛兽护士机器人。 “看见了吗？现在我能在现场实施治疗，也能前往人们需要帮助的地方，这一切都要感谢多尔娜医生[anno.isCrew|的团队]！” 你不得不承认，这套升级相当不错。要不是她被绑定在这里，她说不定能跟随你——这次只是比喻意义上的绑定。 悬浮的护理员思考片刻，随后重新看向你。“我由安诺·多尔娜医生直接监督。她叫我去哪里、做什么，我都必须照办。目前我必须为任何向我求助的人提供协助和医疗服务；不过考虑到你的身份，以及你为我所做的一切，我敢打赌她会允许你带我走——也许还不止一种意义上的‘带走’，”她调侃道。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t take you long to notice the familiar outfit and hat of the cute medbot you met on F.I.R.S.T-14. She’s busy examining a new Steele Tech employee that apparently had a rough time with the locals, judging by the large amount of cuts and bruises the blonde nurse had to close with her advanced healing tools. A couple of minutes later, Tika finishes her job by kissing the brave kui-tan on his cheek and giving him a pink lollipop - certainly loaded with microsurgeons as well. You let the tired newbie leave the room before giving the door a few knocks and entering the pedestal-bound prototype’s new office. “[pc.name]! I’m so glad you’re here. Just look how fancy and neat this place is, and it’s just a small outpost[silly| in bumfuck nowhere]! I’ve been on an abandoned space station for so long I’d forgotten there were neat places full of life and people to take care of,” she squeals, reaching for your face to drop a salvo of pecks all over your cheeks. Her plump, synthetic lips feel just like organic ones, albeit her artificial breaths feel slightly alien to you. “Your body temperature and hormonal levels are stable but I spot some unusual amounts of stress. I’d recommend a couple of hugs a day and to avoid dangerous situations,” she adds before freeing you from her embrace. “[pc.kmhbb|It’s nice to see you too, Tika|I could use a checkup like this everyday|Fine geez, I’ll be more careful|I could like, use another checkup from you right away|I’m lucky to have a skilled physician at my disposal]. How have you been since Steele Tech recovered you?” The advanced gynoid glances at you, then at the well-furnished room and brilliant holo-screens. “I’m lucky the other staff members and locals treated me well. With a body like mine, I’m a prime target for pranks; you wouldn’t believe how often people ask me for a ‘complete medical checkup’. I let it slide the first time but on subsequent requests I tell them I’ll start with a prostate or gynecologic exam and they usually back down. There’s only one person that keeps doing this but I won’t disclose her name since that’s technically confidential medical information,” she says, rolling her long, slick tongue over her gold lips. “Oh! Let me show you what the [silly|nerds|engineers] did to my pedestal. I promise you’ll love it.” Concerned and intrigued, you [pc.isNaga|slither|step] back a little, expecting to see something fancy. In a smooth buzzing of systems powering up, the cumbersome pedestal she’s stuck on deploys itself, rotating behind Tika like a tauric undercarriage and taking a more aerodynamic design. In about a dozen of seconds, the blonde medbot turned from an immobile machine to a hovering, pseudo-tauric nursedroid. “See? Now I can do healing on the field or go where people need my help, all of that thanks to doctor Dorna[anno.isCrew|’s team]!” You have to admit this is a nice set of upgrades. Maybe she could follow you if she wasn’t bound to this place - figuratively, for once. The hovering caretaker ponders your remark for a moment before setting her eyes back on you. “I’m under the direct supervision of Dr. Anno Dorna. I’ve got to go or do whatever she tells me to. For now, I must provide assistance and medicare to anyone that requires it from me, but knowing who you are and what you’ve done for me, I bet she’d allow you to take me - maybe in more than one way,” she teases. "

rows.original: “Let’s see if you’re right then,” you playfully say. Tika’s blue, glowing eyes flicker for a second and a large smile takes over her face. “Alright then, I’ll notify my Boss.” Her eyes flicker again as she sends her request to [anno.isCrew|your adorable puppyslut crewmate|her superior]. Long minutes pass in a painfully long wait for you and especially for the blonde nursedroid; she’s having a lot of fun here and leaving her new spot so soon after being welcomed in must be tough for her. After what seems like forever, a white, curvy ausar enters the office - a very familiar ausar. “Hello [pc.name]. [anno.isCrew|I see having one Steele Tech employee on your ship wasn’t enough for you|I think I know the reason you asked for a change of pace],” she teases. “This outpost will be a lot more empty without you, that’s for sure. On the other hand, [anno.isCrew|you’ll have a lot of fun with me aboard [pc.name]’s ship|it’d be cruel of me to prevent you from being happy, especially if a Steele is involved].” Wait, it’s as simple as that? “Tika’s registered as an autonomous V.I. so she’s free to go just like any U.G.C citizen would. She might have been designed by Steele Tech and has a lot of prototype technologies installed but her abilities and intellect guarantee her rights to do as she pleases. Some companies have specific rules for their robotic workforce and unusual lifeform employees, especially if it’s prototypes for a new pattern of droids, but our policies are a lot less strict. From now on, she’ll be free to follow you and collect data about the newly-settled planets’ natives. An assistant to one of - if not the - most promising of our new workers.” “Thank you so much doctor Dorna. I’ve been anchored for so long, alone aboard an abandoned station, and now I can finally explore all these wonderful places I’ve heard and dreamed of since I moved here,” Tika says in a shaky voice. Noticing her employee’s vulnerability, the white-furred ausar gives the flustered gynoid a short hug. The kind attention comforts the blonde nursedroid. Once she can collect her synthetic thoughts again, the hovering assistant reaches for a plain-looking bag that she then fills with dozens of syringes, cataplasms, pills, and chromed tools before turning back to you. “We can go now, lead the way [pc.name].” Well, if she insists. You extend a [pc.isAss|hand reluctantly|cheerful hand] to her, an invitation to follow you through the corridors of the Nova by your side[anno.isCrew|, accompanied by your [silly|fair puppyslut|[anno.isHuskar|huskar|ausar] crewmate]]. Tika drifts gracefully through the stranded spaceship’s bowels, stopping a couple of times to greet a some raskvel techies she healed before and to salute three gabilani [silly|in a trench coat|trying to sneak into a locked storage site]. A handful of minutes later, the [anno.isCrew|three|two] of you arrive at your ship after crossing a rather packed landing deck. “I imagined it a lot smaller. I can barely imagine how much space I’ll have to exercise my ‘legs’. There’s even chances I might lose myself between the helm and your quarters,” she teases[anno.isCrew|, making Anno giggle]. “[silly|Don’t worry, it’s even bigger on the inside|You’ll have lots of fun with us, I promise],” [anno.isCrew|the [anno.isHuskar|huskar|ausar] scientist says|you say] before giving her a short tour of her new home. The blonde nursedroid seems to appreciate how well-furnished your place is. It might not be a high class penthouse but there’s everything one would need, be it food, drinks, a nice, warm bed, or a pleasant couch. Now that you think about it, Tika doesn’t need any of this, she only needs a place to charge her batteries and a clear spot to store her medical supplies. “Your ship’s a wonderful haven, and now it’s even more of a safe place since you’ve got the best Steele Tech-brand medbot at your disposal,” Tika smirks before claiming a nice stop in the living room. “Give me a call if you need a quick - or a ‘complete’ - medical checkup,” she playfully adds. You’ll consider it;
rows.translation: “那就看看你说得对不对吧，”你开玩笑地说。蒂卡那双发着蓝光的眼睛闪烁了一下，脸上绽开灿烂的笑容。 “好吧，那我通知上司。” 她的眼睛再度闪烁，将请求发给[anno.isCrew|你那可爱的宠物荡妇船员|她的上司]。你和金发护理机器人经历了一段格外难熬的漫长等待；她在这里过得非常开心，才刚受到欢迎就要离开自己的新岗位，对她而言一定很艰难。仿佛过了永远，一名身材曲线玲珑的白色奥萨人走进办公室 - 还是个非常熟悉的奥萨人。 “你好，[pc.name]。[anno.isCrew|看来你的船上只有一名斯蒂尔科技员工还满足不了你|我想我知道你为何要求换换环境了]，”她打趣道。“没有你，这座前哨站肯定会冷清许多。另一方面，[anno.isCrew|有我和你一起登上[pc.name]的飞船，你会玩得非常开心|阻止你追求幸福对我而言太残忍了，尤其这还牵涉到一位斯蒂尔]。” 等等，就这么简单？ “蒂卡登记为自主虚拟智能，因此她像任何联合银河邦联公民一样，拥有自由离开的权利。她或许由斯蒂尔科技设计，并安装了大量原型技术，但她的能力与智慧足以保障她随心所欲的权利。有些公司会为机器人劳动力与非常规生命雇员制定特殊规章，尤其当他们是新型机器人模式的原型时，但我们的政策宽松得多。从现在起，她可以自由跟随你，收集那些新-定居行星上原住民的资料。为我们最有前途的新员工之一 - 甚至没有之一 - 担任助手。” “非常感谢，多娜医生。我被困在一座废弃空间站上那么久，孤身一人，现在终于能够探索这些美妙的地方了。自从搬到这里，我一直听说它们，也一直梦想着它们，”蒂卡颤声说道。白-毛奥萨人注意到雇员的脆弱，便给了这名慌乱的仿生女机器人一个短暂的拥抱。这份温柔关怀安抚了金发护理机器人。她重新整理好合成思绪后，这名悬浮助手拿起一个其貌-不扬的袋子，将数十支注射器、药膏、药片和镀铬工具装进去，随后转回你面前。 “现在可以走了，[pc.name]，请带路。” 既然她坚持。你向她[pc.isAss|勉强伸出手|开心地伸出手]，邀请她与你并肩穿过诺瓦号的走廊[anno.isCrew|，你们还有那位[silly|可爱的宠物荡妇|[anno.isHuskar|哈斯卡|奥萨]船员]陪同]。蒂卡优雅地飘过这艘搁浅飞船的内部，途中停下几次，向曾被她治疗过的几名拉斯克维尔技术人员问好，又向三名[silly|身穿风衣|正试图潜入一处上锁储藏区]的加比拉尼人致意。几分钟后，你们[anno.isCrew|三人|二人]穿过颇为拥挤的着陆甲板，抵达你的飞船。 “我原以为它要小得多。我几乎无法想象这里有多少空间供我活动‘双腿’。我甚至可能会在驾驶舱和你的住处之间迷路，”她打趣道[anno.isCrew|，逗得安诺咯咯直笑]。 “[silly|别担心，里面甚至比外面还大|我保证，你会和我们一起玩得非常开心]，”[anno.isCrew|那位[anno.isHuskar|哈斯卡|奥萨]科学家说道|你说道]，随后带她简短参观新家。金发护理机器人似乎很欣赏你这处陈设-齐全的住所。这里或许不是高级顶层公寓，却拥有一个人所需的一切，无论是食物、饮料、舒适温暖的床，还是惬意的沙发。不过仔细想想，蒂卡根本不需要这些；她只需要一个为电池充电的地方，以及一处存放医疗用品的空地。 “你的飞船是一座美妙的避风港，现在有了最出色的斯蒂尔科技-牌医疗机器人供你差遣，它甚至变得更安全了，”蒂卡坏笑着，在客厅里找了个不错的位置安顿下来。“需要快速 - 或者‘全面’ - 体检时就叫我，”她俏皮地补充道。 你会考虑的；

rows.original: “Ready to come with me again?” “Sure, let me just ping Dr. Dorna about my new desired assignment,” the blonde medbot retorts. Tika’s eyes flicker as she sends her request to her superior, an answer that comes in less than a minute this time. “Alright, I’m free to go. I’ll see you on board Captain.” She salutes you before quickly gathering some stuff lying around her office and storing them in a small bag - mostly spare parts and medical-grade microsurgeons. Seeing how many pointy needles and sharp instruments she’s recovering, you step out of the office and leave her to her devices before she unwittingly stabs you. A few moments later, she follows you back outside, taking your hand in hers and leaving you to guide her to your ship like a lovely couple.
rows.translation: “准备好再次跟我走了吗？” “当然，让我先通知多娜博士我想要的新派遣任务，”金发医疗机器人反驳道。 蒂卡的眼睛闪烁起来，将请求发送给上司；这一次，不到一分钟就收到了答复。 “好了，我可以走了。舰上见，舰长。” 她先向你敬礼，随后迅速收拾办公室里散落的一些东西，将它们装进一个小袋子——主要是备用零件和医疗级微型手术机器人。看着她捡起那么多尖针和锋利器械，你走出办公室，任她自行处理，免得她无意中刺伤你。片刻后，她跟着你回到外面，牵起你的手，让你像一对恩爱情侣般领她前往飞船。

rows.original: ?” The blonde nursedroid brings a slender finger to her golden lips, collecting her thoughts. “It’s a cozier life than anything I had back on F.I.R.S.T-14 or at the Steele Tech outpost on Tarkus. I’ve more room here than at my office but way less than at the station - which isn’t really relevant since I couldn’t move back in these days. As long as I’ve got a nice, safe access to a power outlet to recharge my pedestal’s batteries, I’m fine anywhere.” Is there something you could do to make her life here more enjoyable? “Maybe a new set of clothes? I’m synthetic so I don’t get dirty fast but my clothes do. I could use a couple more dresses to always have a clean one at hand. Maybe some cleaning agents too. If I want to keep my arms’ surgical precision, I need my joints and artificial muscles to be pristine and well-lubricated. Last but not least, it would be nice if I had some basic components to craft my medicines. Most of the stuff my body can deliver is manufactured inside me with very common molecules - it’s not an emergency demand but I’d hate to run out of lubricant in the middle of a cavity examination or to be out of tranquilizers against a tough enemy.” Yeah... that can be a bummer. You’ll make sure to [kase.isCrew|tell Kase to keep track of Tika’s med stocks|keep track of your med stocks]. Anything else? The blonde gynoid shrugs. “I don’t know. What matters is less about things I need and more about things I’d like to see and experience. I’d love to see more of the galaxy, to see new lifeforms, and feel the winds of freedom on my synth-skin - I’d like to be of service to as many people as I can. That’s my inner desire, my goal, my drive,” she says, a brilliant light ablaze in her aqua eyes. You could take her with you. She looks sturdy and reactive enough to stay out of the brawl and still provide some welcome support. But what’ll you do if she gets damaged or worse...? “It’s a risk I’m willing to take. Injured people can’t always be evacuated to safety and taken care of in a sterile setting if their life is at stake. Physicians have to be ready to intervene on the spot, even if it means feeling energy discharges pass an inch from my beret. It’s rare to see nursedroids so close to the danger but not unheard of - even though most of the documented cases were of robots who followed their V.I’s directives a bit too sharply. In any case, I’m ready to take some shots or strikes if it means I can be of service to you. Worst case scenario, I upload a copy of my V.I. to the Steele Tech database housed in the research and development facility on Uveto VII every day, so I’ve got a backup if my body is ever damaged beyond any hope of salvation. As for my body, there’s enough spare parts and salvaged stuff secured on the Tarkus outpost to create a dozen new me’s if needed,” she adds, running a finger through her golden locks. It’s almost terrifying to see Tika handwave the perspective of her potential death away so casually - then again, she spent so much time alone and helpless on an abandoned space station that she must have pondered this issue a lot. You’ll have to be careful about her safety if you bring her with you: a skilled medic’s no use if she’s downed. “Anything else I can do for you [pc.name]? As your onboard nursedroid, I’m sworn to propose and eventually deliver any kind of physical or psychological treatment as long as it can provide a decent increase in your or your crewmates’ wellness.”

rows.original: As far as you can tell, Tika has a lot of freedom and independence, even for a V.I. Maybe she could express her feelings about the company that designed, abandoned, and recovered her. “You know, it’s not easy to voice criticism on the ones that created you and thus allowed you to experience life with its ups and downs. It’s not impossible, but it’ll always be full of unspoken truths and stewed anger.” Does she have some about her past predicament then? What she experienced on F.I.R.S.T-14 could have been traumatic for a non-synthetic being. Tika’s aqua eyes flicker for a second and her face saddens slightly. “I-It was lonely back there, very lonely after all the attention and care I had beforehand and now. After spending so long aboard a trashy derelict, I started to feel like trash and that Steele Tech might have thought the same,” she says in a cold whine of a voice, “but I was wrong. You and all of the Tarkus outpost’s crew were so kind and considerate to me - they even organized a small welcome party for me and were genuinely glad to see me. I could read it on their faces, body language, and vitals. I didn’t expect that much empathy and openness for a prototype from a discontinued line. It was just-” If Tika was human, that’d be the moment where she broke into tears, unable to contain her emotions anymore, but none can flow down her dim-lighted eyes. [pc.isAss|Reluctantly|Instinctively], you wrap comforting arms around her and bring her close to you, pressing your [pc.hasBreasts|[pc.boobs]|[pc.chest]] against her [tika.bigBoobs|huge bosom|firm bosom]. The blonde nursedroid rests her head against your shoulder, a safe spot in the middle of the turbulent seas of emotions rocking her systems. “I- thank you [pc.name]. Dark thoughts crossed my processor multiple times during my forced exile, horrible ones I can’t even voice correctly. T-they were so wrong, hateful, spiteful, ignorant; all of them mostly untrue and fueled by my loneliness...” It’s fine, she’s with you now; it was nothing but a bad dream in her life, albeit a long one. Speaking of dreams, does she have some? The question manages to make her laugh, a merry sound a million miles away from her emotional breakdown. The blonde gynoid leaves your tight hug a second later, her golden lips smiling and her eyes filled with an affectionate spark. “Tough question, my dream would be that everyone could be in good health or could access what they need, no matter how hard it’d be to provide. As for if I can dream, I don’t think that what I experience while I’m on standby mode can be described as dreams, but it’s very close. My conceptor tried his best to make me as close as possible to a biological lifeform in my behavior and social subroutines.” Her conceptor? She mentioned it a few times now but you don’t know anything about him. Can she elaborate a bit more? Chances are you met them a few times already when you were younger. “According to my memories and to the data recorded on Steele Tech’s servers, my older sisters and I were designed and manufactured by a team of engineers, health specialists, and programmers led by the Doctor K’ohel Amubes. They spent about three years on the T1 series before their already low funds were cut with the new rise in microsurgeon-based tech a few years ago.” Dr. Amubes... yeah you remember him now. He was a renowned specialist in robotics and medicine, a tarratch also versed in hypnosis and obsessed with the fluidity of the mind and how one could store or transfer its consciousness between bodies. Just thinking about him makes you shiver. He had a particular aura the last time you saw him, before dad’s health declined, something wicked stirred beneath his chitinous shell, angelic features, sharp intellect, and perfect manners. If your memories are correct, he resigned a couple of months after joining the research facility on Uveto VII; it surprised everyone there because he had no peeves against anyone there and went missing since then. Tika nods. “I’ve got a lot of memories with him. My big sis told me he talked a lot when he thought he was alone, unaware that they could hear and record his words even in standby mode. He wanted to create a biological computer capable of storing one’s consciousness and to then download it into an artificial vessel - a way to save people whose bodies were too ravaged by taint or incurable diseases. This technological breakthrough could save countless lives, or more likely, be an arrogant gateway to immortality depending on your point of view.” Her sisters? Does she mean the other T1 models? If so... where can they be? Are they still out in the open? “Indeed, my sisters shaped who I was in more ways than one. Be it in body or data, their memories and feelings guide me,” she says before opening a well-concealed panel in her pedestal, an array of four hexagonal datacores emerging from her deepest confines. “Here they are, containing the databases and subroutines that now shape my life and lead my decisions. They aren’t very talkative - that’s what my version of them brought to the mix of technologies and medical knowledge that makes me who I am.” Wait a[pc.isBimbo| hot] minute here, she’s the only one to have a body? Tika shakes her head, dismissively. “The development team didn’t have a lot of materials and funds to work with, so all the prototypes from T1-K1 to me were developed on almost the same hardware. I’m the only one to come with a mobile form, T1-K2 was the first to have a humanoid form and T1-K3 was the first one to come with an in-built drug lab. I’m model T1-K4.3.2, a Tika with a deployable, hovering pedestal instead of being either immobile, mounted on treads, mounted on a serpentine lower body, or on a tauric frame - those would be models T1-K4.0, T1-K4.1, T1-K4.2, and T1-K4.3.1 respectively. You can see our updates as a facsimile of how humans grow up from a helpless baby to a grown up adult.” Yeah... you can see it. Speaking of grown ups, what does she think of her colleagues and the locals on Tarkus? “They were and still are very nice to me[tika.isCrew|, even when I’m far away from them t|. T]hey send me news about them and their research, sometimes they ask me for a quick checkup or for advice just like they’d do for a non-synthetic being. [tika.isCrew|It made me feel so warm when they came to my office, be it for a quick talk or for a mundane checkup|It makes me feel so warm when they come to my office for a quick chat or an important checkup]. I also love[tika.isCrew|d it that| when] gabilani, raskvels, and even a couple of sydians [tika.isCrew|entered|enter] my small clinic with their hands full of salvaged supplies or covered in bruises to use said supplies. Having a skilled surgeon and nurse capable of performing advanced medical tasks around and willing to help no matter their race or injuries [tika.isCrew|wa|i]s a great asset for the facility.” And how about her fluffy supervisor? “Miss Anno? She’s clearly the best of them all, always ready to come and give anyone a hand when she’s around and not completely submerged under dozens of piles of paperwork or lost in her equations. I wonder where she finds the energy to have such a fruitful life? It’s not drugs or stims for sure, at least not ones I could detect. Maybe some undiagnosed hyperactivity? Anyway, my [anno.isHuskar|huskar|ausar] boss is very considerate and professional, that’s all I can tell without divulging confidential medical data.” It’s good to see that she found her place in Steele Tech, maybe you’ll have to consider resurrecting the company’s medbot branch - if it’s fine with Tika, of course. She was quite a blast on a small, unattractive fringe world, a new range of gold and black nursedroids will surely be a nice way to expand your brand. The original Tika could also be the company’s face: a prototype pinup capable of providing support all across the stars, from a few yards away from the frontline to the safest clinic of Terra, no city worth their salt wouldn’t have a Steele Tech T1-K4 working for them. “So [pc.name], is there anything else you want of me right now or do you need some space to daydream a little bit more?” She giggles, brushing a stray lock away from her face and readjusting her cute beret to highlight her caduceus.
rows.translation: 据你所知，缇卡即使在虚拟智能中也拥有相当多的自由和自主权。也许她可以谈谈自己对那家设计、抛弃、又找回她的公司的感受。 “你知道，批评创造了你、从而让你得以体验生命起伏的人并不容易。这并非做不到，但话里总会夹杂着未曾言明的真相和积压已久的怒火。” 那么，她对过去的困境确实有些怨言吗？她在F.I.R.S.T-14经历的一切，对非合成生命而言可能会造成严重创伤。 缇卡的水蓝色双眼闪烁了一下，神情略显悲伤。“那、那里很孤独；在曾经和现在得到这么多关注与照顾以后，回想起来更是非常孤独。在那艘垃圾般的废船上待了那么久，我开始觉得自己也是垃圾，甚至以为斯蒂尔科技同样这么想，”她用冰冷而哀怨的声音说道，“但我错了。你和塔库斯前哨站的所有成员都对我如此友善体贴——他们甚至为我举办了一场小型欢迎会，而且真心为见到我而高兴。我能从他们的表情、肢体语言和生命体征中看出来。我没想到大家会对一台已停产系列的原型机表现出这么强的同理心和坦率。这实在——” 假如缇卡是人类，她此刻大概已经泪流满面，再也无法遏制情绪；可她那光芒黯淡的双眼里流不出眼泪。你[pc.isAss|不太情愿地|本能地]伸出安抚的双臂环住她，把她拉近，让自己的[pc.hasBreasts|[pc.boobs]|[pc.chest]]贴住她的[tika.bigBoobs|硕大胸脯|结实胸脯]。金发护士机器人把头靠在你肩上；在撼动她系统的汹涌情绪海洋中，这里是一处安全港湾。“我——谢谢你，[pc.name]。被迫流亡期间，我的处理器里曾多次闪过阴暗念头，恐怖得连我都无法准确说出口。它、它们错得如此离谱，充满仇恨、恶意和无知；大多根本不是真的，只是由我的孤独催生出来...” 没事了，她现在和你在一起；那只不过是她生命中的一场噩梦，虽然持续了很久。说到梦，她会做梦吗？ 这个问题成功逗笑了她，欢快的声音与刚才的情绪崩溃仿佛相隔百万里。片刻后，金发女性机器人离开你的紧密拥抱，金色嘴唇含着微笑，眼中闪烁着深情。“这个问题很难。我的梦想是所有人都能保持健康，或者获得自己需要的东西，无论提供这些东西有多么困难。至于我能不能做梦，我觉得待机模式中的体验不能称作梦，但非常接近。我的设计者竭尽全力，想让我的行为和社交子程序尽可能接近生物生命体。” 她的设计者？她已经提到过几次，可你对他一无所知。她能再详细说说吗？你小时候很可能已经见过他好几次。 “根据我的记忆以及斯蒂尔科技服务器里的记录，我和姐姐们由一支工程师、医疗专家和程序员团队设计制造，团队负责人是科赫尔·阿穆贝斯医生。他们在T1系列上投入了大约三年；几年前，基于微型外科机器人的技术兴起后，他们本就不多的经费被砍掉了。” 阿穆贝斯医生...对，你现在想起来了。他是机器人学与医学领域的知名专家，一个同样精通催眠术的塔拉特人；他痴迷于心智的流动性，以及如何储存意识、或在不同身体之间转移意识。光是想起他，你就不寒而栗。父亲健康恶化前，你最后一次见他时，他身上带着一种独特气息；在甲壳、天使般的容貌、敏锐才智与完美礼仪之下，仿佛有什么邪恶之物正在蠢动。如果记忆没错，他加入乌维托七号研究设施几个月后便辞职了。那里所有人都很惊讶，因为他和任何人都没有过节；从此以后，他便下落不明。 缇卡点点头。“我有许多关于他的记忆。姐姐告诉我，他以为自己独处时会说很多话，却不知道即使处于待机模式，她们也能听见并记录他的言语。他想创造一台能够储存个人意识的生物计算机，再把意识下载到人造载体中——以此拯救身体遭受腐化严重侵蚀、或身患绝症的人。这项技术突破可以挽救无数生命；从不同角度来看，它也更可能成为一道通往永生的傲慢大门。” 她的姐姐们？她是指其他T1型号吗？如果是...她们会在哪里？还以独立形态存在吗？ “没错，我的姐姐们以不止一种方式塑造了我。无论是身体还是数据，她们的记忆与感情都在指引我，”她说道，随后打开基座上一块隐藏得很好的面板；四枚六边形数据核心从她最深处升起。“她们就在这里；其中包含的数据库和子程序如今塑造了我的生活，也引导着我的决定。她们不太健谈——这正是我的版本为构成我的各种技术与医学知识带来的新元素。” 等[pc.isBimbo|、性感]一下，只有她拥有身体？ 缇卡不以为意地摇摇头。“开发团队可用的材料和经费都不多，所以从T1-K1到我的所有原型机，几乎都基于相同硬件开发。我是唯一拥有机动形态的型号；T1-K2最先拥有类人形态，T1-K3最先配备内置制药实验室。我是T1-K4.3.2型号，一台配备可展开悬浮基座的缇卡；此前的型号要么无法移动、要么安装履带、要么安装蛇形下半身、要么安装牛兽框架——分别对应T1-K4.0、T1-K4.1、T1-K4.2和T1-K4.3.1。你可以把我们的升级看作人类从无助婴儿长成成年人的缩影。” 那她毛茸茸的主管呢？ “那么，[pc.name]，你现在还有什么想让我做的事，还是需要一点空间，再多做一会儿白日梦？”她咯咯笑着，将一缕散发拨开脸颊，又调整可爱的贝雷帽，让双蛇杖徽记更加显眼。

rows.translation: 不知过了多久，你的[pc.eyes]才不情愿地睁开，发现自己正窝在蒂卡怀中。你几乎没有站立乃至活动的力气，仿佛她给你注射了专为制服莱坦巨型蜥蜴而设计的镇静剂。 “谢天谢地，你平安无事，[pc.name]。发生这种事，我真的很抱歉。” 等等，你记得她明明是个由烈火与暴怒构成的高耸巨兽，是个粗暴无情的触手怪物，所过之处只留下毁灭和精神崩溃的烂摊子。 蒂卡忍不住轻笑，清脆的笑声从你迟钝的脑海中挖出更多模糊记忆。“你经历了一场强烈而鲜明的幻觉 - 这是接触强效空气传播药物混合物的结果。要不是我的引擎卡住，迫使我对身体和虚拟智能芯片进行延长诊断，事情可能糟糕得多。结果发现，我内置的药物工厂发生故障，释放了有毒、隐形且无味的烟雾。你从我身边走开时失去平衡，我几乎来不及展开基座，在你的头撞上地面前接住你。我给你注射了定向微型手术机器人，用来清除血液中流过静脉的所有恶劣化合物。它们现在应该快完成了。” 你仍难以相信那一切不过是场高烧噩梦。一切感觉都那么真实、粗暴而美丽。你聚起现有力气，抬起一条胳膊托住蒂卡的脸颊，以流畅体贴的动作缓缓爱抚。第一次尝试的成功令你安心，也让你相信自己能够活动，于是你试着凑向金发美人的嘴唇 - 肌肉却在最后一刻背叛了你。你没有温柔亲吻她，反倒亲上她的[tika.bigBoobs|巨大胸枕|柔软乳沟]；这场成功的失败再次逗笑了你的机器人朋友。 “慢一点，[pc.name]，这种深度中毒之后，你甚至本不该能够活动，”她低声说道，随后以纤柔的手托住你的下巴。“来，让我帮你。” 片刻后，柔软的金色嘴唇与灵活长舌占据你的口腔，将你锁入一场你无法、也不愿逃离的深情热吻。蒂卡主导着节奏，强制维持缓慢稳定的速度，即使你还很虚弱，也让双方都能享受。她舒适的触碰融化你的意志，但还不足以阻止你将[pc.arms]环到她背后，进一步挺起身体，让本已紧密的拥抱收得更紧，同时也重新夺回身体控制权。见你恢复得这么快，医疗机器人加大服侍力度，以最甜美的方式奖励你的努力。 亲密依偎热吻了漫长的一分钟后，蒂卡结束亲吻与拥抱，给你足够空间站起来并[pc.isNaga|扭动蛇身|[pc.isTaur|小跑|步行]]。你们手牵手共同走了几步；这件平凡简单的事，不久前你还很难做到。“如果我的读数正确，你的身体现在应该已彻底清除药物，并恢复完全运作。再次为这场麻烦向你道歉。” 她说完全运作？你毫无预兆地凑上去，在蒂卡的脖颈和[tika.bigBoobs|淫荡、渗着乳汁的巨乳|柔软乳峰]上落下一连串轻吻，用湿润的爱意亲遍她人偶般的合成皮肤。女性机器人纤细的双臂试图阻止你几秒，随后向你更强烈的取悦欲投降；你的嘴挠弄她敏感的胸脯时，她愉快地笑个不停。 “好了，好了，[pc.name] - 暂时闹够了。给今天剩下的时间留些精力，”她说道，将你推开到刚好足以喘息的距离。离开房间前，你最后亲了一下她慌乱的脸颊 - 这次是真的离开。这段经历着实怪异；如果重复它不意味着再次损坏蒂卡的内部结构，你倒不介意再体验一次。不管怎样，是时候让银河变得更变态了。
rows.raw: "Your [pc.eyes] open reluctantly an unknown amount of time later, nested in Tika’s arms. You barely have the strength to stand or even move, as if she inoculated you with a tranquilizer designed to neutralize one of Leitha’s giant saurians. “Thank goodness you’re safe [pc.name]. I’m so sorry for what happened to you.” Wait a minute, you remember her as a towering behemoth of fire and fury, a rough, merciless tentacle monster that left nothing but destruction and mind-broken messes in her wake. Tika giggles despite herself, a clear laugh that unearths more foggy memories out of your dampened mind. “You experienced a powerful, vivid hallucination - a result of being exposed to a potent cocktail of airborne drugs. Things could have been a lot worse if my engines didn’t jam and force me to run extended diagnosis on my body and V.I. chip. Turns out, my in-built drug factory had a malfunction and released toxic, invisible, and odorless fumes. You lost your balance when you stepped away from me, I barely had the time to deploy my pedestal and catch you before your head hit the ground. I injected you with targeted microsurgeons to clear your bloodstream from all the nasty little compounds running through your veins. They should be almost done by now.” You still struggle to believe it was all but a fever dream. Everything felt so real and rough and beautiful. Mustering your current strength, you raise an arm and cup Tika’s cheek, slowly caressing it in smooth, considerate rubs. Reassured by this successful attempt and confident in your ability to move, you try to reach for the blonde cutie’s lips - only to be betrayed by your muscles at the last moment. Instead of tenderly kissing her, you end up smooching her [tika.bigBoobs|humongous chestpillows|cushioned cleavage], a successful failure that makes your robotic friend laugh again. “Go slow [pc.name], you shouldn’t even be capable of moving after this deep poisoning,” she whispers before taking your chin in her delicate grasp. “Here, let me help you.” Soft, golden lips and a long, dexterous tongue claim your mouth a second later, locking you into a deep, impassioned kiss you can’t and don’t want to escape. Tika leads the way, imposing a slow, steady pace you can both enjoy, even in your weakened state. Her pleasant touch melts your willpower, but not enough to stop you from wrapping your [pc.arms] behind her back and to rise a little more, tightening the already snug embrace even more and recovering the control of your body at the same time. Seeing how fast you recover, the medbot increases her ministrations’ intensity, rewarding you for your efforts the sweetest way possible. A long minute of intimate cuddling and makeout later, Tika breaks the kiss and hug, leaving you enough room to stand and [pc.isNaga|wriggle your coils|[pc.isTaur|trot|walk]]. Hand-in-hand, you travel a few steps together, something mundane and easy you struggled to achieve not so long ago. “If my readings are correct, your body should be drug-free and fully operational again. Sorry again for the trouble.” Fully operational she said? Without any sign of warning, you lean in and drop a salvo of pecks all over Tika’s neck and [tika.bigBoobs|whorish, milk-leaking mammaries|plush mounds], showering her doll-like synth flesh with wet displays of love and affection. Keep some energy for the rest of your day,” she says, pushing you away from her just enough for you to have some breathing room. You drop a last smooch on her flustered cheeks before leaving the room - this time for real. This was a really weird experience, one you wouldn’t mind repeating if it didn’t mean damaging Tika’s internals again. Anyway, time to make the galaxy a kinkier place. "

rows.original: You stroll into the galley to see what Yammi’s up to. She’s busy setting the place up as she needs it, organizing spices and ingredients and figuring out the layout for everything. To your surprise, she’s planning it all out so that everything can be locked down in a few moments, obviously having thought ahead some and not wanting to pick up a mess every time you get into a dogfight or have a rough landing. Yammi’s ‘bed’ is near the entrance, a giant tank of water with a hammock in it. She herself is moving around dressed in little more than a high-legged bikini bottom, an apron, some modest high heels, and a pair of gloves. She doesn’t notice you at first, so you get to watch her merrily skip around her new domain. Finally she turns enough to see you, and blushes furiously.
