rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: You see Yammi standing in front of the oven, mulling over something. You walk up and look over her shoulder, seeing a line of long, fried foods, covered and stuffed with fruit.
rows.translation: 你看见雅米站在烤箱前，琢磨着什么。你走过去从她肩后望过去，看到一排长长的油炸食物，外面裹着、里面塞着水果。
rows.raw: "You see Yammi standing in front of the oven, mulling over something. You walk up and look over her shoulder, seeing a line of long, fried foods, covered and stuffed with fruit."

rows.original: “Oh, hey boss, I was just wondering what I should do with these.”
rows.translation: “哦，嘿，老板，我刚才还在想该怎么处理这些东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, hey boss, I was just wondering what I should do with these.”"

rows.original: “What are they?”
rows.translation: “它们是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What are they?”"

rows.original: <i>“Cunt snakes. You’ve been to Mhen’ga a good bit, so you’ve probably seen them. Apparently some people... eat them, without the ‘bits’ of course.
rows.translation: <i>“阴穴蛇。你经常去门加，所以大概见过它们。听说有些人会...吃掉它们，当然不包括那些‘零件’。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Cunt snakes. You’ve been to Mhen’ga a good bit, so you’ve probably seen them. Apparently some people... eat them, without the ‘bits’ of course."

rows.original: Adelline told me it’s kind of a thing that some of the more eccentric vanae do, and apparently it’s actually pretty good, so she gave me the recipe...
rows.translation: 阿德琳告诉我，这是某些比较古怪的瓦奈人会做的事，而且据说味道其实相当不错，所以她把配方给了我...
rows.raw: " Adelline told me it’s kind of a thing that some of the more eccentric vanae do, and apparently it’s actually pretty good, so she gave me the recipe..."

rows.original: I was out getting ingredients and I met this... big woman who said she knew you. We talked for a bit, and when I mentioned that I cooked for you, she gave me this recipe.
rows.translation: 我出去采购食材时，遇到了这个...高大的女人，她说自己认识你。我们聊了一会儿，我提到自己为你做饭，她便把这份食谱给了我。
rows.raw: " I was out getting ingredients and I met this... big woman who said she knew you. We talked for a bit, and when I mentioned that I cooked for you, she gave me this recipe."

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: You pick up a knife and fork and start to cut off a piece. There’s a flakey, satisfying crunch as you carve through the fried skin. It’s not tough or dry. In fact, despite the crunch, it’s very easy to get through. The flesh is tender, almost like cutting through a layer of butter, and there’s a nice, juicy squelch when you cut through the fruit in the middle. You pick up the small piece that you’ve cut for yourself, making sure to keep it over the plate so that the copious juices don’t drip all over the floor.
rows.translation: 你拿起刀叉，开始切下一块。刀刃划过炸脆的表皮，传来令人满足的酥脆咔嚓声。它既不坚韧，也不干柴。事实上，尽管口感酥脆，刀子却很容易切过。肉质柔嫩，几乎就像切开一层黄油；当你切过中间的水果时，还会传出多汁的悦耳湿响。你叉起为自己切下的那一小块，小心地让它留在盘子上方，免得丰沛汁液滴得满地都是。
rows.raw: "You pick up a knife and fork and start to cut off a piece. There’s a flakey, satisfying crunch as you carve through the fried skin. It’s not tough or dry. In fact, despite the crunch, it’s very easy to get through. The flesh is tender, almost like cutting through a layer of butter, and there’s a nice, juicy squelch when you cut through the fruit in the middle. You pick up the small piece that you’ve cut for yourself, making sure to keep it over the plate so that the copious juices don’t drip all over the floor."

rows.original: She wasn’t kidding when she said it smelled good. It’s very sweet, but not overwhelmingly so, and with an undertone of what smells like roasted pork. You bite into it, finding it almost candy-like in sweetness at first, then you get into the meat. It’s an explosion of savoriness; for as little meat as there is, it feels like you just chewed a thick, over-seasoned steak. Somehow, though, the sweetness of the fruit and sweet crust manage to balance it out perfectly.
rows.translation: 她说闻起来很香，这话一点不假。你舀起一勺，感受到浓厚汤汁中乳白色酱汁的丝滑与肉块的柔嫩。味道相当辛辣，却不是那种会灼烧口腔的辣；雅米用某种香料让你的嘴唇发麻，带来奇妙又令人兴奋的感觉。不过这还不是全部，水果的甜味和甜香酥皮将辣味完美中和。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wasn’t kidding when she said it smelled good. It’s very sweet, but not overwhelmingly so, and with an undertone of what smells like roasted pork. You bite into it, finding it almost candy-like in sweetness at first, then you get into the meat. It’s an explosion of savoriness; for as little meat as there is, it feels like you just chewed a thick, over-seasoned steak. Somehow, though, the sweetness of the fruit and sweet crust manage to balance it out perfectly."

rows.original: The softness and the balance of sweetness and savoriness makes it seem more like a dessert than a main course, and it’s pretty easy to forget exactly what it is.
rows.translation: 柔软的口感与甜咸之间的平衡让它更像一道甜点而不是主菜，而且很容易就忘了它到底是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe softness and the balance of sweetness and savoriness makes it seem more like a dessert than a main course, and it’s pretty easy to forget exactly what it is."

rows.original: “So, are we putting this on the menu?”
rows.translation: “那么，要把这个加进菜单吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, are we putting this on the menu?”"

rows.original: “I’d say so.”
rows.translation: “我也这么认为。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d say so.”"

rows.original: “Great! Just a heads up, these come with the aphrodisiac venom separate, so if you want that extra kick, just ask.” You nod, realizing that you’ve been eating without thinking, and the plate is empty, save a few crumbs and splatters of juice.
rows.translation: “太好了！先提醒一下，这些东西附带单独包装的催情毒液，所以如果你想要额外刺激，开口说一声就行。”你点点头，意识到自己刚才一直不假思索地吃着；如今盘子已经空了，只剩下几颗碎屑和几滴飞溅的汁液。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great! Just a heads up, these come with the aphrodisiac venom separate, so if you want that extra kick, just ask.” You nod, realizing that you’ve been eating without thinking, and the plate is empty, save a few crumbs and splatters of juice."

rows.original: Yammi chuckles. “Alright, boss, anything else?”
rows.translation: 雅米轻笑起来。“好吧，老板，还有别的事吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi chuckles. “Alright, boss, anything else?”"

rows.original: (Yammi will now cook Fried and Stuffed Cunt Snake.)
rows.translation: （雅米现在将烹饪油炸填馅阴穴蛇。）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Yammi will now cook Fried and Stuffed Cunt Snake.)"

rows.original: QuestyRobo
rows.raw: "QuestyRobo"

rows.original: “No, that’s weird.” Yammi sighs. “Oh well, not everything is going to work out.” She takes the plate and scrapes the food off into the garbage. “Anyway, boss, did you want anything else?”
rows.translation: “不，那太奇怪了。” 雅米叹了口气。“好吧，也不是什么事都能成。”她接过盘子，把食物刮进垃圾桶。“那么，老板，你还要别的吗？”
rows.raw: "“No, that’s weird.”\n\nYammi sighs. “Oh well, not everything is going to work out.” She takes the plate and scrapes the food off into the garbage. “Anyway, boss, did you want anything else?”"

rows.original: I can get them from the same guys I get the Ginder Fish from, so it’s not hard to come by.”
rows.translation: 我可以从供应金德鱼的那帮人手里弄到它们，所以并不难找。”
rows.raw: " I can get them from the same guys I get the Ginder Fish from, so it’s not hard to come by.”"

rows.original: “Sounds... odd.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds... odd.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, kinda. I mean, it sounds good, it’s seasoned well, it smells great, but it is a bit weird.”
rows.translation: “嗯，差不多。我是说，听着不错，调味挺好，闻着也香，就是有点怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, kinda. I mean, it sounds good, it’s seasoned well, it smells great, but it is a bit weird.”"

rows.original: “Have you tried it?”
rows.translation: “你试过吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have you tried it?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, it’s good, but I’m not sure if you’d like it enough for me to really commit too much to it.”
rows.translation: “对，是挺好吃的，但我不确定你会不会喜欢到值得我投入太多心思。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, it’s good, but I’m not sure if you’d like it enough for me to really commit too much to it.”"

rows.original: Do you want to try it?
rows.translation: 你想试试吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you want to try it?"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Give it a go.
rows.translation: 试一试。
rows.raw: "Give it a go."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No thanks. She probably won’t be serving this if you don’t try it.
rows.translation: 不了，谢谢。如果你不尝的话，她大概不会再端上这个了。
rows.raw: "No thanks. She probably won’t be serving this if you don’t try it."

rows.original: The kitchen’s a busy place, with steam rising from boiling soups and hot food hissing as it is fried. A stove in back seems to be baking something. In the center of this storm of culinary chaos is Yammi, humming to herself and stirring, flipping, and chopping various foodstuffs, wearing nothing but an apron, gloves, and a bikini bottom. She smiles when she sees you.
rows.translation: 厨房里一片忙碌，沸腾的汤冒着蒸汽，热食在煎炸中滋滋作响。后方的炉子似乎正在烘烤某种面包，因为空气中飘着宜人的香气。你看见一个穿着极少的斯帕拉达特女孩正准备大餐；她除了围裙、手套和比基尼下装外什么也没穿。看见你时，她露出微笑。
rows.raw: "The kitchen’s a busy place, with steam rising from boiling soups and hot food hissing as it is fried. A stove in back seems to be baking something. In the center of this storm of culinary chaos is Yammi, humming to herself and stirring, flipping, and chopping various foodstuffs, wearing nothing but an apron, gloves, and a bikini bottom. She smiles when she sees you."

rows.original: “Heya, Boss! What’s up?” She inquires, setting down her spatula and turning the heat down so nothing burns. “Can I get you anything?”
rows.translation: “嘿，老板！有什么事？”她一边询问，一边放下锅铲、调低火力，免得东西烧焦。“需要我为你拿点什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heya, Boss! What’s up?” She inquires, setting down her spatula and turning the heat down so nothing burns. “Can I get you anything?”"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Did you want to have a normal chat, or talk about the Pexiga?
rows.translation: 你想正常聊聊天，还是谈谈佩克西加的事？
rows.raw: "Did you want to have a normal chat, or talk about the Pexiga?"

rows.original: Normal Talk
rows.translation: 普通交谈
rows.raw: "Normal Talk"

rows.original: Pet Talk
rows.translation: 宠物闲聊
rows.raw: "Pet Talk"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Yammi tilts her head slightly and offers a friendly shrug. “What’s up, boss? Seems like you’ve got something on your mind.”
rows.translation: 雅米微微歪了歪头，友善地耸了耸肩。“怎么了，老板？看来你心里有事。”
rows.raw: "Yammi tilts her head slightly and offers a friendly shrug. “What’s up, boss? Seems like you’ve got something on your mind.”"

rows.original: When you mention the pexiga pet she’s keeping, Yammi folds her arms defensively. “I thought we talked about this already, captain. She’s harmless! Practically a vegetable. They all get that way after mating. It’s just hard-coded in their chemistry.”
rows.translation: 当你提到她养着的那只佩克西加宠物时，雅米防备地抱起双臂。“我以为我们已经谈过这个了，船长。她不会伤人的！几乎跟植物没区别。它们交配后都会变成那样，那是写死在它们生化机制里的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you mention the pexiga pet she’s keeping, Yammi folds her arms defensively. “I thought we talked about this already, captain. She’s harmless! Practically a vegetable. They all get that way after mating. It’s just hard-coded in their chemistry.”"

rows.original: You give the slight cook a playful shove. “You’re so silly! People aren’t vegitables! Or, maybe some people are? But anyway, the pexiga isn’t! Probably.” You explain you just don’t think the blue girl is enjoying herself very much and it’d be like way more fun if she was having a good time too!
rows.translation: 你顽皮地推了推这个娇小的厨师。“你真傻！人又不是蔬菜！或者，也许有些人是？但总之，佩克西加不是！大概吧。”你解释说，自己只是觉得那个蓝色姑娘玩得不太开心；如果她也能享受其中，那肯定会有趣得多！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the slight cook a playful shove. “You’re so silly! People aren’t vegitables! Or, maybe some people are? But anyway, the pexiga isn’t! Probably.” You explain you just don’t think the blue girl is enjoying herself very much and it’d be like way more fun if she was having a good time too!"

rows.original: You assure the slight cook that she’s not in trouble. Mainly, you’re asking
rows.translation: 你向那位瘦小的厨师保证她没有惹麻烦。你主要是想问
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure the slight cook that she’s not in trouble. Mainly, you’re asking "

rows.original: out of sympathy for the poor creature.
rows.translation: 出于对那可怜生灵的同情。
rows.raw: "out of sympathy for the poor creature."

rows.original: more out of curiosity than anything else.
rows.translation: 更多是出于好奇，而不是别的什么。
rows.raw: "more out of curiosity than anything else."

rows.original: because the idea of an aggressive carnivore onboard isn’t a comforting thought, no matter how tame it might appear to be.
rows.translation: 因为船上养着一头好斗的食肉动物可不是什么让人安心的事，不管它看起来有多温顺。
rows.raw: "because the idea of an aggressive carnivore onboard isn’t a comforting thought, no matter how tame it might appear to be."

rows.original: Isn’t there some way to improve her state?
rows.translation: 难道就没有办法改善她的状态吗？
rows.raw: " Isn’t there some way to improve her state?"

rows.original: Yammi scratches her head, looking a little uncomfortable. “Well, I know the UGC sometimes does a whole ‘uplift’ thing, where they help rudimentary races get up to speed with the rest of the galaxy. But I think that’s mostly with new technology and better education. If you wanted to fix the pexiga, you’d have to dabble in some genetic tinkering.”
rows.translation: 雅米挠了挠头，看起来有些不自在。“嗯，我知道银河联合邦联有时会搞一套所谓的‘升格’，帮助那些发展尚浅的种族赶上银河其他地区的水平。不过，我想那主要是靠新技术和更好的教育。如果你想治好佩克西加，就得在基因上做些调整。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi scratches her head, looking a little uncomfortable. “Well, I know the UGC sometimes does a whole ‘uplift’ thing, where they help rudimentary races get up to speed with the rest of the galaxy. But I think that’s mostly with new technology and better education. If you wanted to fix the pexiga, you’d have to dabble in some genetic tinkering.”"

rows.original: Her gills trill slightly and the sparadat girl fixes you with big, moist eyes. “But, look, don’t go messing with people who do that kind of stuff. I don’t want anything to happen to you, and anybody who could rewire the pexiga is not the kind of person you want to indebt yourself to. Trust me on this - I know a thing or two about debt!”
rows.translation: 她的鳃轻轻颤鸣，斯帕拉达特女孩用湿润的大眼睛凝视你。“不过，听着，别去招惹那些做这种生意的人。你欠他们一点钱，下一秒就会深陷在永远还不清的债务里。把钱花在维修、燃料之类的东西上吧。别把自己绑在任何东西上。相信我 - 我对债务可是略知一二！”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer gills trill slightly and the sparadat girl fixes you with big, moist eyes. “But, look, don’t go messing with people who do that kind of stuff. I don’t want anything to happen to you, and anybody who could rewire the pexiga is not the kind of person you want to indebt yourself to. Trust me on this - I know a thing or two about debt!”"

rows.original: You set the girl at ease with a casual grope of her pert breasts and a few nibbling kisses along the gill-slits of her neck. Your mind, such as it is, is still focused on the pexiga, though. Seems like you’ll need a real smarty for this. Who do you know with big brains?
rows.translation: 你随手揉捏她挺翘的乳房，又沿着她颈部的鳃裂轻咬亲吻，让女孩放松下来。不过你那姑且算是脑子的东西依然想着佩克西加。看来这件事需要一个真正聪明的人。你认识哪些脑子特别灵光的人？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou set the girl at ease with a casual grope of her pert breasts and a few nibbling kisses along the gill-slits of her neck. Your mind, such as it is, is still focused on the pexiga, though. Seems like you’ll need a real smarty for this. Who do you know with big brains?"

rows.original: You set the girl at ease with a few sympathetic words, but the whole time, your mind is trying to work through the pexiga problem. Who do you know with genetic expertise and a relaxed attitude towards ethical issues?
rows.translation: 你用几句同情的话让女孩安心，可你的脑海一直在设法解决佩克西加的问题。你认识谁既懂基因技术，又对伦理问题态度宽松？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou set the girl at ease with a few sympathetic words, but the whole time, your mind is trying to work through the pexiga problem. Who do you know with genetic expertise and a relaxed attitude towards ethical issues?"

rows.original: Pet Talk
rows.translation: 宠物闲聊
rows.raw: "Pet Talk"

rows.original: Talk with Yammi about the Pexiga. Is there anything you can do to improve its lot in life?
rows.translation: 与雅米谈谈那只佩克西加。你能做点什么来改善她的境遇吗？
rows.raw: "Talk with Yammi about the Pexiga. Is there anything you can do to improve its lot in life?"

rows.original: You grab a seat and tell her you’d like to have a few words with her about herself. She nods and continues working.
rows.translation: 你找了张椅子坐下，告诉她你想跟她聊几句关于她自己的事。她点点头，继续干活。
rows.raw: "You grab a seat and tell her you’d like to have a few words with her about herself. She nods and continues working."

rows.original: “Of course, Boss! Ask me anything!” she agrees.
rows.translation: “当然可以，老板！什么都能问我！”她欣然答应。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Boss! Ask me anything!” she agrees."

rows.original: Naturally you start with her. Specifically, you ask what she can tell you about her kind.
rows.translation: 你自然先从她本人问起。具体来说，你询问她能介绍多少有关自己种族的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nNaturally you start with her. Specifically, you ask what she can tell you about her kind."

rows.original: “Oh, right! I never filled you in about us. Keep in mind I was raised apart from my kin, but I did a lot of research. I’m a sparadat. We’re from a hot world with all sorts of shallow-water stretches and rocky terrain. I think I mentioned we’re amphibians?” She glances over to you, and you nod for her to continue. “Those of my race have live births like most humanoids. We also have a highly developed sense of smell and taste; I think that’s why I became such a fussy cook!” she laughs.
rows.translation: “哦，对！我从来没跟你讲过我们的事。要知道我是离开族人独自长大的，但我做过很多研究。我是斯帕拉达特人。我们来自一个炎热的星球，那里到处是浅水区和岩石地形。我好像提过我们是两栖类吧？”她瞥向你，你点头让她继续。“我的族人像大多数类人生物一样是胎生的。我们还有高度发达的嗅觉和味觉；我想这就是我为什么成了这么挑剔的厨师！”她笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, right! I never filled you in about us. Keep in mind I was raised apart from my kin, but I did a lot of research. I’m a sparadat. We’re from a hot world with all sorts of shallow-water stretches and rocky terrain. I think I mentioned we’re amphibians?” She glances over to you, and you nod for her to continue. “Those of my race have live births like most humanoids. We also have a highly developed sense of smell and taste; I think that’s why I became such a fussy cook!” she laughs."

rows.original: Makes sense. She pauses to get a few things moved around in their pans, then starts cutting up some vegetables.
rows.translation: 有道理。她停下来把几样东西在锅里挪了挪，然后开始切菜。
rows.raw: "\n\nMakes sense. She pauses to get a few things moved around in their pans, then starts cutting up some vegetables."

rows.original: “So, we live for a long while, but nobody’s sure how long. Our world doesn’t have enough on it to really catch most people’s interest, no major wealth, just us. So we’ve kind of slipped through the cracks of the galaxy, and I think most sparadat are pretty good with that. Still, someone had use for a couple of us, or I wouldn’t be out here. I just hope my ancestors were adventurous, not captured specimens!”
rows.translation: “所以，我们的寿命很长，但没人确切知道有多长。我们的世界没什么能真正引起大多数人兴趣的东西，没有巨额财富，只有我们。因此我们算是从银河的缝隙里溜了过去，我想大多数斯帕拉达特人都挺满意这样。不过，既然有人需要我们中的几个，我才会来到这里。我只希望我的祖先是喜欢冒险，而不是被抓走的标本！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, we live for a long while, but nobody’s sure how long. Our world doesn’t have enough on it to really catch most people’s interest, no major wealth, just us. So we’ve kind of slipped through the cracks of the galaxy, and I think most sparadat are pretty good with that. Still, someone had use for a couple of us, or I wouldn’t be out here. I just hope my ancestors were adventurous, not captured specimens!”"

rows.original: You decide to switch topics before she thinks too hard on that, and ask about how her people fare on their world.
rows.translation: 你决定在她对那件事想太多之前换个话题，问她族人在他们星球上的生活如何。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to switch topics before she thinks too hard on that, and ask about how her people fare on their world."

rows.original: “Oh, they’re top of the food chain. Most of the water is only as deep as about twice my height. The few places it gets really deep have big fish, but since my kind are poisonous to most native critters, they don’t bother us. I think that’s why we have such bright colors, to alert other creatures we’re dangerous to eat.” She scoops the cut veggies into a pot and stirs it for a second. Then a flash of realization crosses her face and she hurries to add: “By the way, just for your peace of mind and all, we’re not poisonous to humanoids! You know, so you’re not worried I might kill you while cooking or anything!”
rows.translation: “哦，我们位于食物链顶端。大部分水域只有大约我身高两倍那么深。少数特别深的地方有大鱼，但因为我的种族对多数本地生物有毒，它们不会招惹我们。我想这就是我们拥有如此鲜艳色彩的原因，用来警告其他生物，我们吃起来很危险。”她把切好的蔬菜舀进锅里，搅拌片刻。随后她脸上闪过恍然大悟的神色，连忙补充：“顺便说一句，为了让你放心，我们对类人生物没有毒！你知道的，免得你担心我做饭时会害死你之类的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, they’re top of the food chain. Most of the water is only as deep as about twice my height. The few places it gets really deep have big fish, but since my kind are poisonous to most native critters, they don’t bother us. I think that’s why we have such bright colors, to alert other creatures we’re dangerous to eat.” She scoops the cut veggies into a pot and stirs it for a second. Then a flash of realization crosses her face and she hurries to add: “By the way, just for your peace of mind and all, we’re not poisonous to humanoids! You know, so you’re not worried I might kill you while cooking or anything!”"

rows.original: You breathe out a sigh of relief. The thought had crossed your mind. You both have a quick nervous laugh, then she hands you a small plate with several fresh buns on it.
rows.translation: 你松了口气。这个念头确实曾在脑中闪过。你们紧张地轻笑几声，随后她递给你一个小盘子，上面放着几只刚出炉的面包。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou breathe out a sigh of relief. The thought had crossed your mind. You both have a quick nervous laugh, then she hands you a small plate with several fresh buns on it."

rows.original: “Not to tell you your job, but hadn’t you better make sure everything’s good at the helm from time to time? Besides, I’m really going to be cranking up the heat in here in a minute.”
rows.translation: “不是想教你怎么做事，不过你是不是该时不时确认一下驾驶台一切正常？而且，我马上就要把这里的火力开得非常大了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not to tell you your job, but hadn’t you better make sure everything’s good at the helm from time to time? Besides, I’m really going to be cranking up the heat in here in a minute.”"

rows.original: You thank her for the warning and take your snack to go.
rows.translation: 你感谢她的提醒，带着点心走了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank her for the warning and take your snack to go."

rows.original: You lean on the edge of the counter and ask Yammi if she’s got a minute. She nods and runs something through a blender. When the noise cuts out, you inquire about how she was raised.
rows.translation: 你靠在柜台边上，问雅米有没有空。她点点头，把一些东西放进搅拌机里打。噪音停下后，你问起她是怎么被养大的。
rows.raw: "You lean on the edge of the counter and ask Yammi if she’s got a minute. She nods and runs something through a blender. When the noise cuts out, you inquire about how she was raised."

rows.original: “Hm? Well, I guess not much different from most people. I mean, there was a lot more focus on company loyalty and all that, but we got a decent education about how things work. I learned the bare bones of galactic navigation and stuff in case I got used as a server on a ship, picked up a bunch of basic chatter in several languages, there was a ton of phys-ed....” She sighs as she mixes something with the blended substance. “It was a nice time. Then they got into training us and we started getting all rebellious and adolescent, and boy! I earned myself more than a few wallops across the arse.”
rows.translation: “嗯？呃，我想跟大多数人没多大区别吧。我是说，那时候更强调对公司的忠诚之类的，不过我们也接受了不错的教育，学了事情是怎么运转的。我学了点星际航行的皮毛之类的，以防哪天被派到船上当服务生，还学了一堆好几种语言的基础闲聊，体育课多得要命....”她一边把什么东西和那团糊状物搅在一起，一边叹气。“那段时间挺好的。后来他们开始训练我们，我们就都变得又叛逆又青春期，天哪！我屁股上挨的巴掌可不止几下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm? Well, I guess not much different from most people. I mean, there was a lot more focus on company loyalty and all that, but we got a decent education about how things work. I learned the bare bones of galactic navigation and stuff in case I got used as a server on a ship, picked up a bunch of basic chatter in several languages, there was a ton of phys-ed....” She sighs as she mixes something with the blended substance. “It was a nice time. Then they got into training us and we started getting all rebellious and adolescent, and boy! I earned myself more than a few wallops across the arse.”"

rows.original: You express some disbelief that she could be a troublemaker, considering the things you’ve seen her put up with. She just laughs.
rows.translation: 你表示难以相信她会是个惹麻烦的人，毕竟你见过她忍受的那些事情。她只是笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou express some disbelief that she could be a troublemaker, considering the things you’ve seen her put up with. She just laughs."

rows.original: “Oh, you wouldn’t believe the things I did! Cooking and chemistry are related, you know, and I used to find all sorts of ways to blow things up or stain things. I only got caught once in a while though. Lucky me! They weren’t above locking us in little boxes to force us to think about how terrible we were, if they felt we needed a time out.”
rows.translation: “哦，你简直不敢相信我干过些什么！烹饪和化学是相通的，你知道吧，我以前总能想出各种办法把东西炸掉或者弄脏。不过我也只是偶尔被抓到而已。算我走运！要是他们觉得我们需要冷静一下，也不介意把我们锁在小箱子里，逼我们反思自己有多糟糕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you wouldn’t believe the things I did! Cooking and chemistry are related, you know, and I used to find all sorts of ways to blow things up or stain things. I only got caught once in a while though. Lucky me! They weren’t above locking us in little boxes to force us to think about how terrible we were, if they felt we needed a time out.”"

rows.original: You assure her that she’s safe from that kind of treatment around here. She smiles to you and finishes mixing whatever she’s been making.
rows.translation: 你向她保证，在这里她不会遭到那种对待。她朝你微笑，继续完成手头正在调制的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her that she’s safe from that kind of treatment around here. She smiles to you and finishes mixing whatever she’s been making."

rows.original: “Thanks, Boss! Here, taste this, see what you think?”
rows.translation: “谢谢，老板！来，尝尝这个，告诉我你的看法？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, Boss! Here, taste this, see what you think?”"

rows.original: She feeds you a spoonful of what appears to be red scrambled eggs. The taste isn’t bad... for a second. Then, your stomach heaves and you grab the trash can. Alarmed, she holds your head up and waits for you to finish clearing out your lunch. When you can, you ask her what that was.
rows.translation: 她喂了你一勺看起来像红色炒蛋的东西。味道还不坏... 至少头一秒是这样。随后，你的胃猛地一阵翻腾，赶紧抓住垃圾桶。她惊慌地托住你的头，等你把午饭全吐干净。等你终于能够开口，便问她刚才那到底是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe feeds you a spoonful of what appears to be red scrambled eggs. The taste isn’t bad... for a second. Then, your stomach heaves and you grab the trash can. Alarmed, she holds your head up and waits for you to finish clearing out your lunch. When you can, you ask her what that was."

rows.original: “That was the last time I listen to an article saying something very, very healthy is ‘a little bit unappealing to some,’ Boss. I’m so sorry!” She hugs you gently, then helps you upright. “Tell you what, you go sit down a minute, and I’ll get you something to settle your stomach!”
rows.translation: “老板，我再也不会相信那些把某种非常、非常健康的东西说成‘对有些人来说不太诱人’的文章了。真的非常抱歉！”她轻轻抱住你，随后扶你站直。“这样吧，你先坐一会儿，我去拿点能让你的胃舒服些的东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That was the last time I listen to an article saying something very, very healthy is ‘a little bit unappealing to some,’ Boss. I’m so sorry!” She hugs you gently, then helps you upright. “Tell you what, you go sit down a minute, and I’ll get you something to settle your stomach!”"

rows.original: You catch your breath, then with a chuckle you note “If you don’t want me asking about your school days, just say so!”
rows.translation: 你缓过气来，然后轻笑着指出“你要是不想我问你上学时候的事，直说就行！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou catch your breath, then with a chuckle you note “If you don’t want me asking about your school days, just say so!”"

rows.original: “Har-Dee-Har-Har, Boss.” She shakes her head and points, sending you from her kitchen.
rows.translation: “哈-嘀-哈-哈，真好笑啊，老板。”她摇摇头，指向门口，把你赶出厨房。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Har-Dee-Har-Har, Boss.” She shakes her head and points, sending you from her kitchen."

rows.original: At least the milkshake she sends you later settles your stomach nicely!
rows.translation: 至少她后来送来的奶昔让你的胃舒服了不少！
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least the milkshake she sends you later settles your stomach nicely!"

rows.original: You stroll into the kitchen to find your cook finishing the latest batch of dishes. She glances over to you and smiles. You give her a hand putting some things away, noting that she loves to cook way more than you really thought possible.
rows.translation: 你信步走进厨房，发现厨师正在完成最新一批菜肴。她转头看向你，露出微笑。你搭手帮她把一些东西收好，同时注意到她对烹饪的热爱远远超过了你的想象。
rows.raw: "You stroll into the kitchen to find your cook finishing the latest batch of dishes. She glances over to you and smiles. You give her a hand putting some things away, noting that she loves to cook way more than you really thought possible."

rows.original: “I guess. Never really thought about it. I just like to cook! It’s something I’m good at, and with all the flavors I got to try around the ice cream shop it just made sense to look for more. What can I say, I’m glad my metabolism is insanely fast compared to most species’, or I’d be a blimp!”
rows.translation: “大概吧。我真没怎么想过。我就是喜欢做饭！这是我擅长的事，而且在冰淇淋店周围尝过那么多风味之后，想去找更多就很自然了。我能说什么呢，我很庆幸自己的新陈代谢比大多数种族快得离谱，不然我早胖成飞艇了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess. Never really thought about it. I just like to cook! It’s something I’m good at, and with all the flavors I got to try around the ice cream shop it just made sense to look for more. What can I say, I’m glad my metabolism is insanely fast compared to most species’, or I’d be a blimp!”"

rows.original: You note you’re not complaining, since you’re getting most of the benefit. It does dawn on you to inquire about how she got to learn so much about culinary arts as a cashier.
rows.translation: 你注意到自己并不抱怨，因为好处大多落在你身上。你确实想到该问问她，一个收银员怎么会对厨艺懂得这么多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou note you’re not complaining, since you’re getting most of the benefit. It does dawn on you to inquire about how she got to learn so much about culinary arts as a cashier."

rows.original: “Oh, that. Yeah, they didn’t have a lot to throw at me at first, so I saved up tips and bought access to some awesome info-casts about cooking. Just ran them through the store receiver and listened to them when there were no customers. Then they got the idea to maybe open a company restaurant, so I volunteered to work there and studied like a madwoman.” She sighs heavily and shrugs. “The idea went blooey, but I got my hands on more recipes and the like. The other girls I occasionally worked with were happy to try my experiments, and when there was nobody else I’d feed it to the spare ice cream girls.”
rows.translation: “哦，那个啊。是啊，一开始他们没多少东西可教我，所以我把小费攒起来，买了一些超棒的烹饪资讯播客的权限。就在店里的接收器上播放，没客人的时候听。后来他们想开一家公司餐厅，我就自告奋勇去那边干活，学得跟疯了一样。”她重重叹了口气，耸耸肩。“那主意最后泡汤了，不过我倒是弄到了更多食谱之类的。偶尔跟我一起干活的那些姑娘很乐意试我的新花样，没别人的时候，我就喂给那些备用的冰淇淋女孩吃。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that. Yeah, they didn’t have a lot to throw at me at first, so I saved up tips and bought access to some awesome info-casts about cooking. Just ran them through the store receiver and listened to them when there were no customers. Then they got the idea to maybe open a company restaurant, so I volunteered to work there and studied like a madwoman.” She sighs heavily and shrugs. “The idea went blooey, but I got my hands on more recipes and the like. The other girls I occasionally worked with were happy to try my experiments, and when there was nobody else I’d feed it to the spare ice cream girls.”"

rows.original: You chuckle at the mental image of the girls trapped in the ice cream machines, being spoon-fed her latest experiment. Rather mad-scientist like! Yammi’s face goes a deeper orange as she huffs out a peevish breath.
rows.translation: 想到那些女孩被困在冰淇淋机里、被她一勺一勺喂下最新的实验品，你忍不住笑出声。真像十足的疯狂科学家！雅米的脸涨成更深的橙色，气呼呼地哼了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle at the mental image of the girls trapped in the ice cream machines, being spoon-fed her latest experiment. Rather mad-scientist like! Yammi’s face goes a deeper orange as she huffs out a peevish breath."

rows.original: “I’ll have you know those girls appreciated something with a little flavor as often as they could get it!” She snaps in irritation. “Evidently a little more than a certain wise-cracking captain does!”
rows.translation: “我得让你知道，那些女孩只要能吃到带点味道的东西，就感激得不得了！” 她恼火地尖声道。“显然比某个爱耍嘴皮子的船长还懂得感激！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll have you know those girls appreciated something with a little flavor as often as they could get it!” She snaps in irritation. “Evidently a little more than a certain wise-cracking captain does!”"

rows.original: Worried that you might lose snacking privileges, you throw her into a quick headlock and tousle her hair, reminding her you’re very happy to have her and letting her know you’re just kidding around. She rolls her eyes and has to brush back her hair again.
rows.translation: 担心自己会失去享用点心的特权，你迅速用胳膊夹住她的脑袋，揉乱她的头发，提醒她有她在身边让你非常开心，也告诉她自己只是在开玩笑。她翻了个白眼，只好再次把头发理顺。
rows.raw: "\n\nWorried that you might lose snacking privileges, you throw her into a quick headlock and tousle her hair, reminding her you’re very happy to have her and letting her know you’re just kidding around. She rolls her eyes and has to brush back her hair again."

rows.original: “Yeah yeah. If you really appreciate the effort, maybe you could get me a new set of knives, or some new dishes. Ooooh, how about a Kazimsta roast-pit? They use collected solar radiation to flash-cook things; it’d be really quick. They’re not too expensive!”
rows.translation: “好好好。你要是真的看重这份心意，也许可以给我弄一套新刀，或者几个新盘子。哦哦哦，来台卡齐姆斯塔烤炉怎么样？它们用收集来的太阳辐射给东西瞬间加热，快得很。价钱也不算太贵！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah yeah. If you really appreciate the effort, maybe you could get me a new set of knives, or some new dishes. Ooooh, how about a Kazimsta roast-pit? They use collected solar radiation to flash-cook things; it’d be really quick. They’re not too expensive!”"

rows.original: You swallow a lump in your throat and note that you’ve seen those things before, and that the phrase ‘not too expensive’ needs to drop the first word. Last time you saw one it was priced at something like half your ship.
rows.translation: 你咽下哽在喉咙里的硬块，指出自己以前见过那些东西，而且‘不太昂贵’这句话应该去掉第一个字。你上次看到一个时，它的标价差不多相当于半艘你的飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou swallow a lump in your throat and note that you’ve seen those things before, and that the phrase ‘not too expensive’ needs to drop the first word. Last time you saw one it was priced at something like half your ship."

rows.original: “Fine!” She sticks her tongue out like a little kid. “You could at least show up before I finish the dishes next time!”
rows.translation: “好吧！”她像小孩一样吐了吐舌头。“至少下次在我洗完碗之前出现啊！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine!” She sticks her tongue out like a little kid. “You could at least show up before I finish the dishes next time!”"

rows.original: You make no promises as something alerts you that you should be on the bridge. Hopefully just some stellar debris, but it’s a good way to duck out of dishpan hands!
rows.translation: 你没有作出任何承诺，因为某种警报提醒你应该前往舰桥。希望只是一些星际碎片，不过这倒是逃避洗碗洗到手皱的好借口！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make no promises as something alerts you that you should be on the bridge. Hopefully just some stellar debris, but it’s a good way to duck out of dishpan hands!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Sit down and talk with your chef for a bit.
rows.translation: 坐下来，和你的厨师聊一会儿。
rows.raw: "Sit down and talk with your chef for a bit."

rows.original: Help Out
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help Out"

rows.original: “You want to help out? Oh, you’re such a sweetie!” She kisses you on the cheek. “Okay, you any good with a knife?”
rows.translation: “你想帮忙？哦，你真贴心！”她吻了吻你的脸颊。“好吧，你擅长用刀吗？”
rows.raw: "“You want to help out? Oh, you’re such a sweetie!” She kisses you on the cheek. “Okay, you any good with a knife?”"

rows.original: You proudly note you’re a galaxy-wandering space explorer, and that nothing’s beyond your capacity. She laughs and sets out a row of vegetables you don’t recognize, then hands you a big knife to chop them with. As you set to work, you idly chat about various things... not least of all those topics being ‘Why are you cooking all the time?!’
rows.translation: 你自豪地说自己是漫游银河的太空探险家，没有什么超出你的能力。她笑了，摆出一排你不认识的蔬菜，然后递给你一把大刀让你切。你动手干活时，随口聊起各种事情...其中也包括‘你为什么老是在做饭？！’这类话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou proudly note you’re a galaxy-wandering space explorer, and that nothing’s beyond your capacity. She laughs and sets out a row of vegetables you don’t recognize, then hands you a big knife to chop them with. As you set to work, you idly chat about various things... not least of all those topics being ‘Why are you cooking all the time?!’"

rows.original: <i>“Oh, uhm... well,
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh, uhm... well, "

rows.original: we have to feed the crew well
rows.translation: 我们得让船员们吃好
rows.raw: "we have to feed the crew well"

rows.original: I’ve got to keep you fed
rows.translation: 我得让你吃饱
rows.raw: "I’ve got to keep you fed"

rows.original: , and I like to cook, so I like to make sure there’s a lot of options ready and waiting.” She quickly turns to wash something in a basin.
rows.translation: ，而且我喜欢做饭，所以总喜欢确保有很多选择备好等着。”她迅速转身去盆里洗什么东西。
rows.raw: ", and I like to cook, so I like to make sure there’s a lot of options ready and waiting.” She quickly turns to wash something in a basin."

rows.original: You caught the shifty eyes. You also know for a fact she cooks entirely too much.
rows.translation: 你注意到了她游移的眼神。你也非常清楚，她每次做的饭都多得过头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou caught the shifty eyes. You also know for a fact she cooks entirely too much. "

rows.original: Even if your ship was stuffed to capacity you wouldn’t have enough people to eat everything she cooks in a day
rows.translation: 即使你的飞船塞满了人，也没有足够的人手吃完她一天做的所有食物
rows.raw: "Even if your ship was stuffed to capacity you wouldn’t have enough people to eat everything she cooks in a day"

rows.original: Even with such a large crew, there always seems to be so much left over
rows.translation: 就算船员这么多，似乎总还是剩下那么多
rows.raw: "Even with such a large crew, there always seems to be so much left over"

rows.original: . So you just wait patiently until she gets tired of the building awkwardness: her natural chatty nature gets the better of her, as you expected.
rows.translation: 。于是你只是耐心等着，直到她受不了越来越浓的尴尬：她天生爱说话的本性占了上风，正如你所料。
rows.raw: ". So you just wait patiently until she gets tired of the building awkwardness: her natural chatty nature gets the better of her, as you expected."

rows.original: “Okay, look, I have a few ‘live’ specimens aboard to feed. Like the Tulpa on the menu, they’re absolutely terrible if you store them!” She admits. “I also cook a lot and preserve it for ingredients later, like herbs and things. Some of it I stash to trade every time we land somewhere interesting so I can get new spices and ingredients and recipes without costing you cash.”
rows.translation: “好吧，你看，我在船上养了几个需要喂食的‘活体’样本。就像菜单上的图尔佩鱼一样，如果储存起来，它们的味道简直糟透了！”她承认道。“我也会烹饪很多东西，再把它们保存起来，日后充当香草之类的食材。每次我们降落在某个有趣的地方，我都会把一部分存货拿去交易，这样不用花你的钱，就能换到新的香料、食材和食谱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, look, I have a few ‘live’ specimens aboard to feed. Like the Tulpa on the menu, they’re absolutely terrible if you store them!” She admits. “I also cook a lot and preserve it for ingredients later, like herbs and things. Some of it I stash to trade every time we land somewhere interesting so I can get new spices and ingredients and recipes without costing you cash.”"

rows.original: You roll your eyes and ask about these ‘live specimens’. As captain and owner of this ship, you feel you should know about anything like that aboard. You pick up the latest thing to chop up while you remind her that she has certain obligations to keep you on the up and up.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，问起这些‘活体样本’。作为这艘船的船长和船主，你觉得船上任何这类东西你都该知情。你拿起最新一批要切的东西，同时提醒她，她有义务让你时刻知情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes and ask about these ‘live specimens’. As captain and owner of this ship, you feel you should know about anything like that aboard. You pick up the latest thing to chop up while you remind her that she has certain obligations to keep you on the up and up."

rows.original: “Alright, true, I just... Um, Boss?” She raises a finger just as you raise your knife.
rows.translation: “好吧，确实，我只是... 嗯，老板？”就在你举起刀时，她也竖起一根手指。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, true, I just... Um, Boss?” She raises a finger just as you raise your knife."

rows.original: Foolishly you tell her to continue, since you won’t be distracted. Unfortunately, the object you picked up happens to be a gups... a slippery, tough veggie that your knife slides sideways on and puts a slim but nasty gash in your palm. Worse, the veggie juices on your hand include some major irritant, and you can’t help but stand there with what must be a comical look of pain on your face, hand held high and all of your willpower going into not clenching it into a fist!
rows.translation: 你愚蠢地让她继续，因为自己绝不会分心。不幸的是，你拿起的东西偏偏是古普斯...一种又滑又硬的蔬菜，刀刃从它表面侧滑出去，在你的掌心划开一道细窄却十分难受的伤口。更糟的是，沾到手上的蔬菜汁含有某种强烈刺激物；你只能站在那里，高高举着手，脸上肯定挂着滑稽的痛苦表情，把全部意志力都用在不让自己握紧拳头上！
rows.raw: "\n\nFoolishly you tell her to continue, since you won’t be distracted. Unfortunately, the object you picked up happens to be a gups... a slippery, tough veggie that your knife slides sideways on and puts a slim but nasty gash in your palm. Worse, the veggie juices on your hand include some major irritant, and you can’t help but stand there with what must be a comical look of pain on your face, hand held high and all of your willpower going into not clenching it into a fist!"

rows.original: “Ummm... look, I’ll explain after you get that all cleaned up.” She winces at your hiss of pain. “Here, let me see?”
rows.translation: “嗯...听着，等你把那些都清理干净，我再解释。”听见你因疼痛而抽气，她不禁皱起脸。“来，让我看看？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ummm... look, I’ll explain after you get that all cleaned up.” She winces at your hiss of pain. “Here, let me see?”"

rows.original: She cleans your cut and puts some salve on it which causes it to stop hurting almost immediately. A quick dab of sealant and you’re pretty well good as new. You decide to leave the question for now, since you feel pretty foolish. Where’s a pirate attack or oncoming asteroid when you need a quick exit!?
rows.translation: 她清洗了你的伤口，涂上些药膏，疼痛几乎立刻就消失了。再快速抹上一点封闭剂，你基本上就完好如初了。你决定暂时把那个问题放下，因为你觉得挺丢脸的。需要赶紧脱身的时候，海盗袭击或者迎面而来的小行星都跑哪儿去了！？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe cleans your cut and puts some salve on it which causes it to stop hurting almost immediately. A quick dab of sealant and you’re pretty well good as new. You decide to leave the question for now, since you feel pretty foolish. Where’s a pirate attack or oncoming asteroid when you need a quick exit!?"

rows.original: “Look, don’t worry about it. I’ll show you next time, nothing dangerous. Meanwhile, you go relax and I’ll whip you up a nice snack! You grab a can of suds or a bottle of good stuff,” Yammi offers.
rows.translation: “听着，别担心。下次我教你，不危险。这会儿你去放松一下，我给你弄点好吃的！你拿罐啤酒或者一瓶好酒，”雅米提议道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, don’t worry about it. I’ll show you next time, nothing dangerous. Meanwhile, you go relax and I’ll whip you up a nice snack! You grab a can of suds or a bottle of good stuff,” Yammi offers."

rows.original: You decide that sounds fair enough. Yammi’s not stupid, you know she wouldn’t bring anything deliberately dangerous aboard. Still, you remind yourself to check back in about that as you head to get a seat and see what she whips up.
rows.translation: 你觉得这话听着挺公道。雅米不傻，你知道她不会故意把危险东西带上船。不过你还是提醒自己之后要回来查一下这件事，一边走过去找位子坐下，看她能做出什么花样来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide that sounds fair enough. Yammi’s not stupid, you know she wouldn’t bring anything deliberately dangerous aboard. Still, you remind yourself to check back in about that as you head to get a seat and see what she whips up."

rows.original: “Oh, you want to lend me a hand again? No knives this time, I promise!” She chuckles. “Actually, here! You wanted to know what live specimens I have aboard? You can help with one!”
rows.translation: “哦，你又想帮我一把？我保证这次不用刀！”她咯咯笑道。“其实，就这个吧！你不是想知道我船上有哪些活体标本吗？你可以帮我处理一只！”
rows.raw: "“Oh, you want to lend me a hand again? No knives this time, I promise!” She chuckles. “Actually, here! You wanted to know what live specimens I have aboard? You can help with one!”"

rows.original: You shrug and follow her into a back room, where a faint blue light holds back the cold. Inside you are somewhat surprised to see a woman! She has light blue scales that turn into lighter, armor-looking bands across the chest. She has a mostly-serpentine face, and dark blue eyes that have no pupil. She’s sitting on her knees on the floor and thrusting her meaty rump into the air, leaving her long spaded tail to flick back and forth. Her arms are supporting her front, locked around what looks like a doggy dish. Her fingers display the stumps of filed-down claws. A ring-gag holds her mouth open, and a very heavy-looking metal piercing onto the tip of her very, very long tongue forces her to leave it hanging out. She has frilled ears, strands of wispy spines where hair should be, and has some small breast-like lumps in the chest plating tipped with big, dark blue nipples.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，跟她走进后面的房间；微弱的蓝光抵御着寒冷。你有些惊讶地发现里面有个女人！她有淡蓝色鳞片，到了胸口则变成颜色更浅、仿佛盔甲般的条带。她的脸大体呈蛇形，一双深蓝眼睛没有瞳孔。她双膝跪在地板上，将肉感十足的臀部高高翘起，长长的铲形尾巴左右甩动。她用双臂支撑上身，环抱着某个看似狗食盆的东西。她手指上的爪子已经锉平，只剩短桩。一只环形口塞撑开她的嘴；一枚看起来极其沉重的金属穿孔饰物挂在她非常、非常长的舌尖，迫使她只能将舌头垂在外面。她有带褶边的耳朵，本该长头发的地方生着一缕缕纤细棘刺；胸甲上还有几处乳房般的小隆起，顶端是硕大的深蓝色乳头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug and follow her into a back room, where a faint blue light holds back the cold. Inside you are somewhat surprised to see a woman! She has light blue scales that turn into lighter, armor-looking bands across the chest. She has a mostly-serpentine face, and dark blue eyes that have no pupil. She’s sitting on her knees on the floor and thrusting her meaty rump into the air, leaving her long spaded tail to flick back and forth. Her arms are supporting her front, locked around what looks like a doggy dish. Her fingers display the stumps of filed-down claws. A ring-gag holds her mouth open, and a very heavy-looking metal piercing onto the tip of her very, very long tongue forces her to leave it hanging out. She has frilled ears, strands of wispy spines where hair should be, and has some small breast-like lumps in the chest plating tipped with big, dark blue nipples."

rows.original: “This is a pexiga. Most are eaten by their own kind on their native planet... seriously, something like 90-something percent of them. They’re born in huge clusters of eggs. This one has lived over three hundred times as long as your average pexiga female by becoming a harvest girl.” Yammi explains, indicating the tongue. “Pexiga generate a really super-sweet gel in their mouths that serves sort of as saliva. It’s way sweeter than honey. You can’t find a really good kitchen or restaurant around that doesn’t have one of these.”
rows.translation: “这是一只佩克西加。在它们的母星上，大多数都会被同类吃掉... 说真的，大概有百分之九十几都是如此。它们一出生就是一大群卵。这个个体成了采收女郎，因此寿命已经超过普通雌性佩克西加的三百倍。”雅米指着那条舌头解释道。“佩克西加的嘴里会生成一种超级甜的凝胶，作用有点像唾液。它可比蜂蜜甜多了。附近真正称得上优秀的厨房或餐厅里，没有哪一家会缺少这种生物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is a pexiga. Most are eaten by their own kind on their native planet... seriously, something like 90-something percent of them. They’re born in huge clusters of eggs. This one has lived over three hundred times as long as your average pexiga female by becoming a harvest girl.” Yammi explains, indicating the tongue. “Pexiga generate a really super-sweet gel in their mouths that serves sort of as saliva. It’s way sweeter than honey. You can’t find a really good kitchen or restaurant around that doesn’t have one of these.”"

rows.original: You turn to Yammi with a concerned expression. How did she get a... pexiga... aboard your ship without
rows.translation: 你带着担忧的表情转向雅米。她是怎么把一只...佩克西加...弄上你的飞船，还没让你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn to Yammi with a concerned expression. How did she get a... pexiga... aboard your ship without "

rows.original: you knowing
rows.translation: 你知道
rows.raw: "you knowing"

rows.original: your knowledge
rows.translation: 你的知情
rows.raw: "your knowledge"

rows.original: ? Is this creature dangerous? And why is Yammi, someone who was in indentured servitude herself, keeping a gagged woman in your pantry?
rows.translation: ？这生物危险吗？还有，雅米自己都曾是个契约奴仆，为什么要把一个堵着嘴的女人关在你的食品储藏室里？
rows.raw: "? Is this creature dangerous? And why is Yammi, someone who was in indentured servitude herself, keeping a gagged woman in your pantry?"

rows.original: Yammi looks at you with a huff. “You know how they catch a pexiga? They find one that’s lived more than eight years and then wait. Pexigas are deadly predators, but they have a sort of biological clock inside them. After eight years they’ve spawned all their young, so they’re infertile, and their brains just sort of... stop working. A pexiga that’s used up all her eggs just stops doing things. She stands there like an idiot, not hurting anybody, just waiting there to get eaten. They barely even feed themselves. You can walk right up and pose them like dummies and they’ll just stand there. By eight years, no exceptions. And their years are just over half a standard one.” Yammi tells you, fetching a bowl.
rows.translation: 雅米轻哼一声，看着你。“你知道他们怎么捕捉佩克西加吗？他们找到一只活过八年的，然后等着。佩克西加是致命的捕食者，但体内有某种生物钟。八年后，她们已经产完所有幼崽，因此失去生育能力，脑子也就... 停止运转了。卵子耗尽的佩克西加就这么不再做任何事。她像个傻瓜一样站在那里，不伤害任何人，只等着被吃掉。她们甚至几乎不会自己进食。你可以直接走过去，把她们摆成假人的姿势，她们只会站着。八岁时一定会如此，没有例外。而她们的一年只有标准年的一半多一点。”雅米一边告诉你，一边取来一只碗。
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi looks at you with a huff. “You know how they catch a pexiga? They find one that’s lived more than eight years and then wait. Pexigas are deadly predators, but they have a sort of biological clock inside them. After eight years they’ve spawned all their young, so they’re infertile, and their brains just sort of... stop working. A pexiga that’s used up all her eggs just stops doing things. She stands there like an idiot, not hurting anybody, just waiting there to get eaten. They barely even feed themselves. You can walk right up and pose them like dummies and they’ll just stand there. By eight years, no exceptions. And their years are just over half a standard one.” Yammi tells you, fetching a bowl."

rows.original: “Trust me, I’m not above indentured service... what was good enough for me is fine for others for a little while! But this one’s different, it’s literally lived its entire life and would otherwise be waiting to die. But as long as I feed her, and keep her muzzled so she doesn’t eat anybody, she’s fine!”
rows.translation: “相信我，我并不反对契约劳役...既然这对我来说都够好，让别人短时间做一下也没什么！但这只不一样，它真的一辈子都这样活着，否则也只能等死。可只要我喂饱她，再给她戴好口套，免得她吃掉别人，她就不会有事！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Trust me, I’m not above indentured service... what was good enough for me is fine for others for a little while! But this one’s different, it’s literally lived its entire life and would otherwise be waiting to die. But as long as I feed her, and keep her muzzled so she doesn’t eat anybody, she’s fine!”"

rows.original: Eat anybody?
rows.translation: 会吃人吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nEat anybody?"

rows.original: “Like I said, they’re cannibals. But now that she’s passed her young, she’s totally lethargic. Won’t even try to take the gag out, and even that’s just a safety precaution. She probably wouldn’t hurt anybody even if she could. Really, she’s a sweetie!”
rows.translation: “我说过，它们是食人种。不过现在她已经产完幼崽了，整个人完全没精打采。连塞口的东西都不想去掏，而那也不过是安全措施。就算她真能动，大概也伤不到谁。说真的，她可甜了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, they’re cannibals. But now that she’s passed her young, she’s totally lethargic. Won’t even try to take the gag out, and even that’s just a safety precaution. She probably wouldn’t hurt anybody even if she could. Really, she’s a sweetie!”"

rows.original: Yammi smiles and pats the pexiga on the hair, careful to move her hand along the way its spines grow. The lizard-creature makes a soft, almost feline purring sound and swishes its tail, but otherwise doesn’t react much.
rows.translation: 雅米微笑着拍了拍佩克西加的脑袋，小心地让手掌顺着尖刺生长的方向移动。这只蜥蜴生物发出轻柔得近似猫咪的咕噜声，甩了甩尾巴，除此之外便没什么反应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi smiles and pats the pexiga on the hair, careful to move her hand along the way its spines grow. The lizard-creature makes a soft, almost feline purring sound and swishes its tail, but otherwise doesn’t react much."

rows.original: Yammi giggles and hands you the bowl. “I promise, she’s totally harmless! So you here to help or no?”
rows.translation: 雅米咯咯笑着，把碗递给你。“我保证，她完全无害！所以你到底要不要来帮忙？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYammi giggles and hands you the bowl. “I promise, she’s totally harmless! So you here to help or no?”"

rows.original: You shrug and then nod, inquiring what you have to do. Yammi kneels on her opposite side. The captive reptilian flits her gaze back and forth between you two with barely any interest.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，然后点头，问自己该做些什么。雅米在她另一侧跪下。被囚的爬行类女人目光在你们两人之间来回游移，几乎提不起兴趣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug and then nod, inquiring what you have to do. Yammi kneels on her opposite side. The captive reptilian flits her gaze back and forth between you two with barely any interest."

rows.original: “Okay, hold her tongue from low down. Then firmly rub your thumbs up either side of the top. This will fool her body into thinking food’s coming, and she’ll start to, well, drool more or less.” She instructs you. “I think it’s because they eat each other and they must taste awful, so they make something they like to taste naturally.”
rows.translation: “好，从下面托住她的舌头。然后用拇指沿着上面两侧用力往上搓。这样能骗过她的身体，让它以为食物要来了，她就会开始，呃，多多少少流口水。”她指导你。“我觉得是因为它们互相吃，而彼此的味道一定很糟糕，所以它们会自然分泌出自己喜欢的那种味道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, hold her tongue from low down. Then firmly rub your thumbs up either side of the top. This will fool her body into thinking food’s coming, and she’ll start to, well, drool more or less.” She instructs you. “I think it’s because they eat each other and they must taste awful, so they make something they like to taste naturally.”"

rows.original: You press on her tongue and massage your way up. It’s very warm despite the low temperature in the room, and soft as silk. The pexiga’s eyes roll upwards and she lets out faint gulping sounds as her reflexes tell her to swallow. Soon, a thick, clear gel starts to trickle down her tongue.
rows.translation: 你按住她的舌头，一路向上按摩。尽管房间温度很低，舌头却非常温暖，触感柔滑如丝。佩克西加双眼向上翻起，吞咽反射令她发出微弱的咕咚声。很快，浓稠透明的凝胶开始沿着她的舌头流下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou press on her tongue and massage your way up. It’s very warm despite the low temperature in the room, and soft as silk. The pexiga’s eyes roll upwards and she lets out faint gulping sounds as her reflexes tell her to swallow. Soon, a thick, clear gel starts to trickle down her tongue."

rows.original: “Perfect!” Yammi exclaims happily. “Now, to keep from disappointing her you give her one of these.” She hands you a white soft tube about two inches long. “It’s a dietary supplement for them. Just slide it into her mouth and poke it back until her throat gets a hold. When she stops secreting gel, you massage her tongue again and give her another one. Repeat until the bowl is mostly full. It takes about twenty minutes. Simple, right?”
rows.translation: “完美！”雅米高兴地喊道。“现在，为了不让她失望，你给她一根这个。”她递给你一根约两英寸长的白色软管。“这是给她们用的营养补充剂。把它滑进她嘴里，往里推，直到她喉咙咬住。等她不再分泌凝胶，你就再按摩她的舌头，再给她一根。重复到碗差不多装满。大概要二十分钟。很简单，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perfect!” Yammi exclaims happily. “Now, to keep from disappointing her you give her one of these.” She hands you a white soft tube about two inches long. “It’s a dietary supplement for them. Just slide it into her mouth and poke it back until her throat gets a hold. When she stops secreting gel, you massage her tongue again and give her another one. Repeat until the bowl is mostly full. It takes about twenty minutes. Simple, right?”"

rows.original: You agree, and she leaves you with a little packet of food and the bowl. You do as instructed, rubbing her extremely soft, warm tongue for a minute or two until she can’t resist drooling, then rewarding her for her efforts. The Pexiga greedily gulps down her food, and seems quite content to let you use her as a sweets factory. Yammi seems to be right about them being pretty simple creatures in their, well, dotage. You find yourself grumbling about how nice it must be to have someone looking after all your needs!
rows.translation: 你答应了，她给你留下一小包食物和那只碗。你照吩咐去做，揉搓她那条极其柔软、温热的舌头一两分钟，直到她忍不住流口水，然后因她的努力给她奖励。佩克西加贪婪地把食物吞下去，似乎很乐意让你把她当成糖果工厂使用。雅米说得没错，在她们，呃，暮年的时候，她们确实是相当单纯的生物。你不由地嘟囔起来：要是有人照顾你所有的需要，那该多好！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou agree, and she leaves you with a little packet of food and the bowl. You do as instructed, rubbing her extremely soft, warm tongue for a minute or two until she can’t resist drooling, then rewarding her for her efforts. The Pexiga greedily gulps down her food, and seems quite content to let you use her as a sweets factory. Yammi seems to be right about them being pretty simple creatures in their, well, dotage. You find yourself grumbling about how nice it must be to have someone looking after all your needs!"

rows.original: The pexiga murmurs wordlessly at you, and you notice its tail-tip is rubbing absently at her sex. Curious, you look around the reptile-girl’s body, and see that her dark blue lips are quite puffy and wet. Does she get off to this? The pexiga’s vacant eyes don’t reveal much, though she occasionally glances up at you and blinks slowly.
rows.translation: 这个佩克西加人对你含混地低声呢喃，你注意到她的尾尖正在心不在焉地摩擦自己的阴部。你好奇地绕着这个爬虫姑娘的身体看去，发现她那对深蓝色肉唇相当肿胀湿润。她会因这种事兴奋吗？佩克西加人空洞的双眼没有透露多少信息，不过她偶尔会抬头看你，缓缓眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pexiga murmurs wordlessly at you, and you notice its tail-tip is rubbing absently at her sex. Curious, you look around the reptile-girl’s body, and see that her dark blue lips are quite puffy and wet. Does she get off to this? The pexiga’s vacant eyes don’t reveal much, though she occasionally glances up at you and blinks slowly."

rows.original: Then you remember you have work to do. You head out with the bowl full.
rows.translation: 然后你想起自己还有活要干。你端着装满的碗走了出去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen you remember you have work to do. You head out with the bowl full."

rows.original: “All done? Good stuff! Now I can make you an awesome dessert!” Yammi takes the bowl and sets it into a cooling tray. “Thanks a bunch, Boss! I’ve been trying to get around to her all day!”
rows.translation: “全都弄完了？干得漂亮！现在我可以给你做一份超棒的甜点了！”雅米接过碗，把它放进冷却盘。“太谢谢你了，老板！我一整天都想抽空照顾她！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All done? Good stuff! Now I can make you an awesome dessert!” Yammi takes the bowl and sets it into a cooling tray. “Thanks a bunch, Boss! I’ve been trying to get around to her all day!”"

rows.original: You wave it off as no big deal, since you benefit from the food she makes all the time. She laughs and assures you that “You ain’t seen nothing yet, Boss!”
rows.translation: 你摆摆手说这没什么，反正你一直白吃她做的东西。她笑着向你保证：“你还没见识到真正的本事呢，老板！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave it off as no big deal, since you benefit from the food she makes all the time. She laughs and assures you that “You ain’t seen nothing yet, Boss!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Help Out
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help Out"

rows.original: Offer to help Yammi out around in the kitchen.
rows.translation: 主动提出在厨房里帮雅米干活。
rows.raw: "Offer to help Yammi out around in the kitchen."

rows.original: Pexiga

rows.original: You tell Yammi to keep on cooking; you’re just going to wander around the kitchen. She flashes you a bright smile and goes back to the dish she’s working on at the moment, and once she’s nice and distracted, you make your way into the pantry she keeps the pexiga in.
rows.translation: 你让雅米继续做菜，你只是在厨房里转转。她冲你亮出一个笑容，又低头忙起手头那道菜；等她彻底分了神，你就往她存放佩克西加的储藏室走去。
rows.raw: "You tell Yammi to keep on cooking; you’re just going to wander around the kitchen. She flashes you a bright smile and goes back to the dish she’s working on at the moment, and once she’s nice and distracted, you make your way into the pantry she keeps the pexiga in."

rows.original: The reptilian alien is still sitting on her knees in the pantry, leaning over her doggy dish with her mouth around a ring gag. Her spaded tail swishes gently behind her raised, meaty rump; spiny hair falls down around her shoulders in messy locks. The creature glances up at you with disinterest, slowly returning her attention to the deck.
rows.translation: 那个爬虫类外星人还跪在储藏室里，俯身对着她的狗食盆，嘴里套着一个环形口塞。她那铲形的尾巴在翘起的丰满臀部后面轻轻摆动；刺状的头发乱糟糟地垂在肩头。那生物漫不经心地抬眼看你一下，又慢慢把注意力转回甲板。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe reptilian alien is still sitting on her knees in the pantry, leaning over her doggy dish with her mouth around a ring gag. Her spaded tail swishes gently behind her raised, meaty rump; spiny hair falls down around her shoulders in messy locks. The creature glances up at you with disinterest, slowly returning her attention to the deck."

rows.original: Still, you notice her big ol’ tail raise up a little over her back, leaving her blue-green sex completely exposed.
rows.translation: 不过，你注意到她那大大的尾巴在背上方稍稍抬起，把她蓝绿色的性器完全露了出来。
rows.raw: " Still, you notice her big ol’ tail raise up a little over her back, leaving her blue-green sex completely exposed."

rows.original: Remembering Yammi’s lesson, you decide to get some of the pexiga’s sweet saliva for yourself. You slip down to the reptile-girl’s level, brushing some of her spine-hair out of her eyes. She blinks at you and murmurs, wiggling her pierced tongue slightly. Like she knows what’s coming.
rows.translation: 想起雅米教过你的事，你决定为自己弄些佩克西加甜美的唾液。你俯身来到这个爬虫女孩的高度，把几缕脊毛从她眼前拨开。她眨眼看着你，轻声呢喃，略微扭动穿有饰环的舌头。仿佛她知道接下来会发生什么。
rows.raw: "Remembering Yammi’s lesson, you decide to get some of the pexiga’s sweet saliva for yourself. You slip down to the reptile-girl’s level, brushing some of her spine-hair out of her eyes. She blinks at you and murmurs, wiggling her pierced tongue slightly. Like she knows what’s coming."

rows.original: You press on her tongue and massage your way up. It’s very warm despite the low temperature in the room, and soft as silk. The pexiga’s eyes roll upwards and she lets out faint gulping sounds as her reflexes tell her to swallow. Soon, a thick, clear gel starts to trickle down her tongue.
rows.translation: 你按住她的舌头，一路向上按摩。尽管室温很低，那条舌头依然十分温暖，而且柔若丝绸。佩克西加的双眼向上翻去，吞咽反射让她发出微弱的咕咚声。很快，浓稠透明的凝胶开始顺着她的舌头流下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou press on her tongue and massage your way up. It’s very warm despite the low temperature in the room, and soft as silk. The pexiga’s eyes roll upwards and she lets out faint gulping sounds as her reflexes tell her to swallow. Soon, a thick, clear gel starts to trickle down her tongue."

rows.original: Her bag of dietary supplements is nearby, hooked on the wall just out of her reach. After rubbing her extremely soft, warm tongue for a minute or two until she can’t resist drooling, you put one through her ring gag, rewarding her for letting you milk her.
rows.translation: 她那袋膳食补充剂就在附近，挂在墙上，恰好超出她能触及的范围。你揉弄她极其柔软温热的舌头一两分钟，直到她忍不住流出口水，随后把一颗补充剂穿过环形口枷塞给她，作为她让你挤奶的奖励。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer bag of dietary supplements is nearby, hooked on the wall just out of her reach. After rubbing her extremely soft, warm tongue for a minute or two until she can’t resist drooling, you put one through her ring gag, rewarding her for letting you milk her."

rows.original: The pexiga greedily gulps down her food, and seems quite content to let you use her as a sweets factory in return. Yammi was right about them being pretty simple creatures in their old age. You find yourself grumbling about how nice it must be to have someone looking after all your needs!
rows.translation: 佩克西加贪婪地吞下食物，作为交换，她似乎非常乐意让你把自己当成糖果工厂。雅米说得没错，这些生物上了年纪以后确实头脑简单。你忍不住嘟囔，有人照料自己的一切需求肯定舒服极了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pexiga greedily gulps down her food, and seems quite content to let you use her as a sweets factory in return. Yammi was right about them being pretty simple creatures in their old age. You find yourself grumbling about how nice it must be to have someone looking after all your needs!"

rows.original: The pexiga murmurs wordlessly at you, and you notice its tail-tip is rubbing absently at her sex. Curious, you look around the reptile-girl’s body, and see that her dark blue lips are quite puffy and wet. Does she get off to this? The pexiga’s vacant eyes don’t reveal much, though she occasionally glances up at you and blinks slowly.
rows.translation: 这个佩克西加人对你含混地低声呢喃，你注意到她的尾尖正在心不在焉地摩擦自己的阴部。你好奇地绕着这个爬虫姑娘的身体看去，发现她那对深蓝色肉唇相当肿胀湿润。她会因这种事兴奋吗？佩克西加人空洞的双眼没有透露多少信息，不过她偶尔会抬头看你，缓缓眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pexiga murmurs wordlessly at you, and you notice its tail-tip is rubbing absently at her sex. Curious, you look around the reptile-girl’s body, and see that her dark blue lips are quite puffy and wet. Does she get off to this? The pexiga’s vacant eyes don’t reveal much, though she occasionally glances up at you and blinks slowly."

rows.original: Then you remember you have work to do. You bottle up the saliva you gathered and stick it in your pack, leaving the pexiga with a light pat on the head. She gurgles at you, tongue lolling listlessly from her mouth.
rows.translation: 随后你想起自己还有工作要做。你将收集到的唾液装进瓶子，塞进背包，轻轻拍了拍佩克西加的头后便离开了。她朝你咕噜一声，舌头无精打采地垂在嘴外。
rows.raw:
"

Then you remember you have work to do. You bottle up the saliva you gathered and stick it in your pack, leaving the pexiga with a light pat on the head. She gurgles at you, tongue lolling listlessly from her mouth.

rows.original: Feeling sorry for the lethargic reptilian beauty, you draw close and run your fingers through her spiny hair. The pexiga murmurs around her ring-gag, swishing her tail across the deck as you massage her scaly scalp. The big piercing on her tongue swishes ever so slightly, and her somewhat vacant expression shifts to something like a smile, and her eyes follow you as you move. With no food on offer, and without your hand working to milk her for her sweet saliva, she seems somewhat more attentive than usual. If only just.
rows.translation: 你有些可怜这个无精打采的爬虫美人，便凑近过去，用手指梳过她带刺的头发。你按摩着她覆满鳞片的头皮，佩克西加隔着口环低声咕哝，尾巴在甲板上扫来扫去。她舌头上的大穿环极轻微地摆动了一下，她那有些茫然的表情变成了类似微笑的样子，目光随着你的动作移动。没有食物可给，你的手也没有在挤她甜美的唾液，她似乎比平常更专注了一些。也就那么一点点。
rows.raw: "Feeling sorry for the lethargic reptilian beauty, you draw close and run your fingers through her spiny hair. The pexiga murmurs around her ring-gag, swishing her tail across the deck as you massage her scaly scalp. The big piercing on her tongue swishes ever so slightly, and her somewhat vacant expression shifts to something like a smile, and her eyes follow you as you move. With no food on offer, and without your hand working to milk her for her sweet saliva, she seems somewhat more attentive than usual. If only just."
