rows.original: Containing neither raskvel nor lapinara, this dish is comprised of half a loaf of bread, hollowed out and filled with a thick curry. Extremely popular on Tarkus, it’s a versatile and portable dish. This version uses thick chunks of vegetables and a vaguely chicken-like protein.
rows.translation: 这道菜既不含拉斯克维尔，也不含拉皮纳拉，而是把半条面包挖空，填入浓稠咖喱。在塔克斯极受欢迎，是一道用途广泛又便于携带的菜肴。这个版本使用大块蔬菜，以及一种味道隐约类似鸡肉的蛋白质。
rows.raw: "Containing neither raskvel nor lapinara, this dish is comprised of half a loaf of bread, hollowed out and filled with a thick curry. Extremely popular on Tarkus, it’s a versatile and portable dish. This version uses thick chunks of vegetables and a vaguely chicken-like protein."

rows.original: Vesp.Poutine
rows.raw: "Vesp.Poutine"

rows.original: POUTINE
rows.raw: "POUTINE"

rows.original: Vesperian Poutine
rows.raw: "Vesperian Poutine"

rows.original: This plate of deep fried potatoes has been smothered in cheese curds and gravy. It’s intensely savory, fatty, and salty-all the best things in life, and just the thing to keep you sustained through those long Vesperian winters.
rows.translation: 这盘炸透的土豆上盖满了奶酪凝块和肉汁。味道极其鲜美、油润、咸香-尽是人生中最美好的东西，也正适合在维斯佩里亚漫长的冬季里为你维持体力。
rows.raw: "This plate of deep fried potatoes has been smothered in cheese curds and gravy. It’s intensely savory, fatty, and salty-all the best things in life, and just the thing to keep you sustained through those long Vesperian winters."

rows.original: Oriab San-Nakji
rows.raw: "Oriab San-Nakji"

rows.original: ORIAB
rows.raw: "ORIAB"

rows.original: Oriab San-Nakji
rows.raw: "Oriab San-Nakji"

rows.original: A popular tourist dish on the beach resorts of Mome, this plate full of anemone tentacles lies limp until a salty sauce is added, bringing the tentacles to squirmy “life.” It can be difficult to eat, particularly since the tentacles fight back, often “stinging” an adventurous gourmand with a minor aphrodisiac.
rows.translation: 这是莫姆海滨度假村很受欢迎的一道游客菜肴；盘子里装满软趴趴的海葵触手，直到加入咸味酱汁，触手才会扭动着恢复“生机”。这道菜可能很难入口，尤其是触手还会反抗，经常以少量催情剂“蜇伤”勇于冒险的美食家。
rows.raw: "A popular tourist dish on the beach resorts of Mome, this plate full of anemone tentacles lies limp until a salty sauce is added, bringing the tentacles to squirmy “life.” It can be difficult to eat, particularly since the tentacles fight back, often “stinging” an adventurous gourmand with a minor aphrodisiac."

rows.original: The pie is about as big around as the plate it’s served on, three inches tall, and smells plenty spicy. There are four rolls to go with it. Yammi watches you from nearby as you dig in, taking an experimental bite. It’s exploding with strong flavors, mostly bold hot ones with an undertone of sweetness. You finish the first quarter before the slow-building heat catches up to you. You wolf down one of the buns and gesture to Yammi, who quickly hands you a mixed drink of something creamy. It quenches the burn down to a light throb.
rows.translation: 这派的直径差不多和盛它的盘子一样大，三英寸高，闻起来相当辛辣。旁边还配了四个面包卷。你开动起来，试探着咬了一口，雅米就在旁边看着。浓烈的味道在嘴里炸开，主要是大胆的辣味，底下还压着一丝甜。你吃完第一个四分之一，那股慢慢蓄起来的辣劲才追上你。你狼吞虎咽地啃下一个面包卷，朝雅米打了个手势，她立刻递给你一杯混调的奶油饮品。它把灼烧感压成了一阵轻轻的搏动。
rows.raw: "The pie is about as big around as the plate it’s served on, three inches tall, and smells plenty spicy. There are four rolls to go with it. Yammi watches you from nearby as you dig in, taking an experimental bite. It’s exploding with strong flavors, mostly bold hot ones with an undertone of sweetness. You finish the first quarter before the slow-building heat catches up to you. You wolf down one of the buns and gesture to Yammi, who quickly hands you a mixed drink of something creamy. It quenches the burn down to a light throb."

rows.original: “You okay, Boss?” Yammi inquires, worried. “I didn’t make it too hot, did I?”
rows.translation: “你还好吗，老板？”雅米担心地问道。“我没做得太辣吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You okay, Boss?” Yammi inquires, worried. “I didn’t make it too hot, did I?”"

rows.original: You answer her with a grin and immediately begin to chow down again. It’s absolutely fantastic, you just have to indulge in a drink from time to time to control the burn! It takes you about ten minutes to wolf down the whole thing, then you decide you’d better get back to work. Yammi seems pleased you liked it.
rows.translation: 你咧嘴一笑算是回答，立刻又埋头大吃起来。实在太好吃了，只是你每隔一会儿就得喝口东西压一压那股辣劲！你花了大约十分钟把整份吞完，然后觉得该回去干活了。雅米看你喜欢，似乎很高兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer her with a grin and immediately begin to chow down again. It’s absolutely fantastic, you just have to indulge in a drink from time to time to control the burn! It takes you about ten minutes to wolf down the whole thing, then you decide you’d better get back to work. Yammi seems pleased you liked it."

rows.original: Oddly, you feel like the meal digests away quickly. It seems Yammi’s got your weight on her mind.
rows.translation: 奇怪的是，你觉得这顿饭消化得很快。看来雅米很在意你的体重。
rows.raw: "\n\nOddly, you feel like the meal digests away quickly. It seems Yammi’s got your weight on her mind."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Who doesn’t love a good steak? You take your seat and wait. A few minutes later Yammi rolls out the biggest hunk of meat you’ve ever laid eyes on. It’s more than two feet across and over an inch thick, marbled with enough fat to make sure the meat is tender and juicy. She has to bring it out on a cart, still sizzling.
rows.translation: 谁不爱一块好牛排呢？你坐下等着。几分钟后，雅米推出了你见过的最大的肉块。它有超过两英尺宽，厚度超过一英寸，肥肉纹理足够多，保证肉又嫩又多汁。她不得不用一辆推车把它送出来，还在滋滋作响。
rows.raw: "Who doesn’t love a good steak? You take your seat and wait. A few minutes later Yammi rolls out the biggest hunk of meat you’ve ever laid eyes on. It’s more than two feet across and over an inch thick, marbled with enough fat to make sure the meat is tender and juicy. She has to bring it out on a cart, still sizzling."

rows.original: “Here ya go, Boss! Take what you like and I’ll use the rest for steaks and sandwiches later!” She giggles, and you slice yourself a big hunk off to enjoy.
rows.translation: “给你，老大！你爱拿多少拿多少，剩下的我晚点用来做肉排和三明治！”她咯咯笑着，你给自己切下一大块享用。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here ya go, Boss! Take what you like and I’ll use the rest for steaks and sandwiches later!” She giggles, and you slice yourself a big hunk off to enjoy."

rows.original: It tastes an awful lot like beef. Well, what can you say? It’s about the best steak you’ve had in a long time! You can tell it was grilled on an open flame, and it’s been given just a hint of spice. You consider yourself one lucky explorer to be getting fresh barbecued steaks in the middle of space!
rows.translation: 这味道非常像牛肉。嗯，还能说什么呢？这差不多是你很久以来吃过最好的牛排了！你尝得出它是用明火烤的，只加了一点点香料。你觉得自己真是个幸运的探险家，能在太空深处吃到新鲜的炭烤牛排！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt tastes an awful lot like beef. Well, what can you say? It’s about the best steak you’ve had in a long time! You can tell it was grilled on an open flame, and it’s been given just a hint of spice. You consider yourself one lucky explorer to be getting fresh barbecued steaks in the middle of space!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide on something sweet. Yammi pours you a frothy white liquid from a pitcher and tops it with a couple flakes of shaved nuts, then presents it to you with a big straw. The drink is served in a glass that sits on the floor and stands over three feet tall, but is very narrow.
rows.translation: 你决定来点甜食。雅米从壶里给你倒出一种泛着泡沫的白色液体，在上面撒了几片刨好的坚果，然后插上一根大吸管递给你。盛放饮料的玻璃杯摆在地板上，足足有三英尺多高，却十分细长。
rows.raw: "You decide on something sweet. Yammi pours you a frothy white liquid from a pitcher and tops it with a couple flakes of shaved nuts, then presents it to you with a big straw. The drink is served in a glass that sits on the floor and stands over three feet tall, but is very narrow."

rows.original: “Traditional serving glass.” Yammi explains as you sip at it. “The race that made the recipe are really tall but very skinny so they don’t eat much. I had to modify the mix a lot since their foods tend to be deadly to most life, but I think I got the essence of it!”
rows.translation: “传统饮用杯。”你小口啜饮时，雅米解释道。“发明这份配方的种族个子很高，却非常纤瘦，所以吃得不多。因为他们的食物对大多数生命都有致命危险，我不得不大幅调整配方，不过我觉得自己保留住了其中的精髓！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Traditional serving glass.” Yammi explains as you sip at it. “The race that made the recipe are really tall but very skinny so they don’t eat much. I had to modify the mix a lot since their foods tend to be deadly to most life, but I think I got the essence of it!”"

rows.original: Well, it’s certainly sweet! A nutty-creamy blend of taste that would be perfect for any dessert. You’re not complaining, until you realize you’ve downed it so fast that you’re getting a headache. Yammi giggles and hugs you, chiding you for being such an overeager little kid with the sugary stuff. On the upside, she informs you that all the sugars are natural and so they won’t make you fat as long as you exercise.
rows.translation: 嗯，确实很甜！坚果-奶油般的混合滋味，非常适合任何甜点。你本来毫无怨言，直到意识到自己喝得太快，脑袋都开始疼了。雅米咯咯笑着抱住你，数落你面对甜食时像个心急的小孩子。好在她告诉你，里面的糖分全是天然的，只要坚持锻炼，就不会让你发胖。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, it’s certainly sweet! A nutty-creamy blend of taste that would be perfect for any dessert. You’re not complaining, until you realize you’ve downed it so fast that you’re getting a headache. Yammi giggles and hugs you, chiding you for being such an overeager little kid with the sugary stuff. On the upside, she informs you that all the sugars are natural and so they won’t make you fat as long as you exercise."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yammi puts a big bowl in front of you, and there it is, a pastry dome full of greatness. You pick it up, take a bite, and immediately spill warm gravy back into the bowl where dark grains are waiting to soak it up. It’s a wave of different flavors with every bite, and you enjoy each one. It’s also a very heavy meal, and you have to pause halfway through. Yammi chuckles to herself as she watches you power through it, then she grabs a spoon.
rows.translation: 雅米把一个大碗放在你面前，碗里正是那座装满美味的酥皮穹顶。你拿起它咬了一口，温热的肉汁立刻漏回碗里，底下的深色谷物正等着将其吸收。每一口都有不同风味如浪潮般涌来，而你享受着其中每一种。这顿饭也非常顶饱，吃到一半时你不得不停下来歇一歇。雅米看着你奋力吃下去，暗自轻笑，随后拿起一把勺子。
rows.raw: "Yammi puts a big bowl in front of you, and there it is, a pastry dome full of greatness. You pick it up, take a bite, and immediately spill warm gravy back into the bowl where dark grains are waiting to soak it up. It’s a wave of different flavors with every bite, and you enjoy each one. It’s also a very heavy meal, and you have to pause halfway through. Yammi chuckles to herself as she watches you power through it, then she grabs a spoon."

rows.original: “Don’t worry, Boss, I’ll snack on the grains.” She offers, helping you to your feet. “You go have a sit down and let that settle!”
rows.translation: “别担心，老板，我会拿这些谷物当点心。”她一边主动说道，一边扶你站起来。“你去坐着休息，让肚子消化一下！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, Boss, I’ll snack on the grains.” She offers, helping you to your feet. “You go have a sit down and let that settle!”"

rows.original: You agree that after a nobblur, it’s probably best to take things slow. You go to
rows.translation: 你同意，吃过诺布勒之后，最好还是放慢节奏。你走去
rows.raw: "\n\nYou agree that after a nobblur, it’s probably best to take things slow. You go to "

rows.original: coil your naga tail
rows.translation: 盘起你的娜迦蛇尾
rows.raw: "coil your naga tail"

rows.original: put your [pc.feet]
rows.translation: 把你的[pc.feet]
rows.raw: "put your [pc.feet]"

rows.original: up in your favorite chair.
rows.translation: ，坐进你最喜欢的椅子。
rows.raw: " up in your favorite chair."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yammi takes about ten minutes to put together a sampler from all the things she’s got on the go. You are amazed at the tray’s layout, snacks spiraling out from the dip trays in the middle. Cut fruit, fresh veggies, nuts, pastries, pasta, finger sized meat cuts, small fish samples, chips, and more. It’s less a meal than a munch-fest, and you and Yammi both contribute to the demise of the mighty snack tray. Fifteen minutes later you excuse yourself with a smaller tray of leftovers to go do your rounds. There’s just so many things to eat!
rows.translation: 雅米花了大约十分钟，把她手头上正在做的各种东西拼成了一份试吃拼盘。托盘上的摆法让你惊叹，小吃以中央的蘸酱盘为中心螺旋排开。切好的水果、新鲜蔬菜、坚果、糕点、意面、手指大小的肉块、小鱼样品、薯片，还有更多。这与其说是一顿饭，不如说是一场零食盛宴，你和雅米一起为那座雄伟的零食托盘的覆灭出了一份力。十五分钟后，你端着一小盘剩菜告退，去巡视你的地盘。能吃的东西真是太多了！
rows.raw: "Yammi takes about ten minutes to put together a sampler from all the things she’s got on the go. You are amazed at the tray’s layout, snacks spiraling out from the dip trays in the middle. Cut fruit, fresh veggies, nuts, pastries, pasta, finger sized meat cuts, small fish samples, chips, and more. It’s less a meal than a munch-fest, and you and Yammi both contribute to the demise of the mighty snack tray. Fifteen minutes later you excuse yourself with a smaller tray of leftovers to go do your rounds. There’s just so many things to eat!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yammi presents to you a specialty of her species. It’s a golden-brown fried fish fillet. It’s also almost a foot long. The spud-like tubers served with it are an appetizing baked red. You dig in, and find that it’s a little bland but very filling. The tubers are nice and soft. It’s very much a proper home-cooked meal, in space, far from home. You feel pretty good about your mission, as a little twinge of homesickness you were unaware of goes away for a while.
rows.translation: 雅米向你端上她们种族的一道特色菜。那是一块炸成金棕色的鱼排，而且差不多足有一英尺长。搭配的马铃薯状块茎烤成诱人的红色。你开始享用，发现味道稍显清淡，却非常顶饱。块茎美味而柔软。这是一顿地地道道的家常饭，只不过是在远离家乡的太空之中。你对自己的任务感觉相当不错，连一丝此前未曾察觉的思乡之情也暂时消退。
rows.raw: "Yammi presents to you a specialty of her species. It’s a golden-brown fried fish fillet. It’s also almost a foot long. The spud-like tubers served with it are an appetizing baked red. You dig in, and find that it’s a little bland but very filling. The tubers are nice and soft. It’s very much a proper home-cooked meal, in space, far from home. You feel pretty good about your mission, as a little twinge of homesickness you were unaware of goes away for a while."

rows.original: “Hope you enjoyed it, Boss. It’s one of my favorite, for obvious reasons.” She smiles. “I stock quite a few tulpe. I know, plain, but they’re quite healthy, I assure you!”
rows.translation: “希望你喜欢，老板。理由很明显，这是我最爱的食物之一。”她笑道。“我储备了不少图尔佩鱼。我知道，确实朴素了点，但我保证，它们非常健康！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hope you enjoyed it, Boss. It’s one of my favorite, for obvious reasons.” She smiles. “I stock quite a few tulpe. I know, plain, but they’re quite healthy, I assure you!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Per your request, captain,” Yammi says with a hint of a giggle as she delivers a plate of smoking, grilled mhen’gan ginder fish to you. You take one sniff, and are instantly transported back to the lush jungle world, and the embrace of your kitty-snake lover there... your heart beats a little faster as you take a bite, letting the fish practically melt on your [pc.tongue]. Yammi looks on expectantly, until you flash her a sated smile and tell her it’s positively delicious.
rows.translation: “按照你的要求，舰长，”雅米带着一丝笑意说道，将一盘冒着热气的烤门加金德鱼端给你。你只嗅了一下，便瞬间回到那颗郁郁葱葱的丛林星球，以及那里猫蛇爱人的怀抱... 你咬下一口时心跳微微加快，让鱼肉几乎在[pc.tongue]上融化。雅米满怀期待地看着，直到你露出满足的笑容，告诉她这绝对美味。
rows.raw: "“Per your request, captain,” Yammi says with a hint of a giggle as she delivers a plate of smoking, grilled mhen’gan ginder fish to you. You take one sniff, and are instantly transported back to the lush jungle world, and the embrace of your kitty-snake lover there... your heart beats a little faster as you take a bite, letting the fish practically melt on your [pc.tongue]. Yammi looks on expectantly, until you flash her a sated smile and tell her it’s positively delicious."

rows.original: “Thanks, Boss,” she smiles. “I don’t have quite as much experience with Rush-world dishes, but if you find any more like this, don’t hesitate to let me know. I think it turned out pretty sweet!”
rows.translation: “谢了，老板，”她笑道。“我对行星开拓星球的菜式没那么多经验，但你要是再找到这种的，可别犹豫，尽管告诉我。我觉得这回做得还挺不错的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks, Boss,” she smiles. “I don’t have quite as much experience with Rush-world dishes, but if you find any more like this, don’t hesitate to let me know. I think it turned out pretty sweet!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yammi rolls out a trolley with a four foot long monster of a sandwich on it. It smells of cooked meat and fish, and practically oozes with cheese. You’re stunned at the sight of this monster.
rows.translation: 雅米推出一辆小推车，上面放着一份四英尺长的巨型三明治。它散发着熟肉和鱼的香气，奶酪几乎要从中淌出来。眼前这个庞然大物把你看呆了。
rows.raw: "Yammi rolls out a trolley with a four foot long monster of a sandwich on it. It smells of cooked meat and fish, and practically oozes with cheese. You’re stunned at the sight of this monster."

rows.original: “My favorite!” She giggles. “Of course I usually eat one over the entire day, but it’s not like I can’t just hack a piece off and eat on the run, which is what makes it so nice.”
rows.translation: “这是我的最爱！”她咯咯笑道。“当然，我平时会用整整一天吃完一个；不过我随时都能砍下一块，边走边吃，这正是它这么棒的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My favorite!” She giggles. “Of course I usually eat one over the entire day, but it’s not like I can’t just hack a piece off and eat on the run, which is what makes it so nice.”"

rows.original: You measure out a good chunk to slice off and dig in. The meat and seafood don’t blend as smoothly as you might have thought, but they complement each other well at least, and the cheese she used is different from others you’ve tried. You greedily devour the whole thing in a couple minutes, to Yammi’s delight.
rows.translation: 你估量好大小，切下一大块吃了起来。肉类与海鲜融合得并不像想象中那般顺滑，但至少彼此相得益彰；她使用的奶酪也与其他尝过的品种不同。你短短几分钟便贪婪地吃光整块食物，令雅米喜不自胜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou measure out a good chunk to slice off and dig in. The meat and seafood don’t blend as smoothly as you might have thought, but they complement each other well at least, and the cheese she used is different from others you’ve tried. You greedily devour the whole thing in a couple minutes, to Yammi’s delight."

rows.original: “Now, don’t eat too many of these! They’re a bit heavy for your kind, Boss!” She cautions you, rolling the rest back to its storage space.
rows.translation: “可别吃太多！对你这样的种族来说，这东西有点太顶肚了，老板！”她一边提醒你，一边把剩下的推回储藏处。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, don’t eat too many of these! They’re a bit heavy for your kind, Boss!” She cautions you, rolling the rest back to its storage space."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Still like your ice cream fresh from the tap, eh, Boss?” Yammi teases, pulling a bag of ice-cold Reaha milk from the fridge and dumping it into a machine. “Thanks to your cute little cow friend, I guess I can still put those Iced Teats years to good use. Not, uh, not that I’m using their methods. Because that’d probably be illegal.”
rows.translation: “还是喜欢刚从龙头接出来的新鲜冰淇淋，对吧，老板？”雅米打趣道，从冰箱取出一袋冰-凉的蕾娅乳汁，倒进机器。“多亏你那位可爱的小奶牛朋友，我想自己在冰乳工作的那些年还算能派上用场。不是，呃，我不是说自己用了他们的方法。因为那很可能违法。”
rows.raw: "“Still like your ice cream fresh from the tap, eh, Boss?” Yammi teases, pulling a bag of ice-cold Reaha milk from the fridge and dumping it into a machine. “Thanks to your cute little cow friend, I guess I can still put those Iced Teats years to good use. Not, uh, not that I’m using their methods. Because that’d probably be illegal.”"

rows.original: “Right, right. I did say that,” Kaede yawns. “Let’s see... like I said, Cass and I grew up together. That was back before the Rush, when there weren’t nearly so many people on Tavros. Not a lot of kids, for sure, so we all sort of gravitated to one another. Especially us non-humans. Cass and I both wanted to grow up as spacers, just like our parents; we went to school together; Cass even went with me for my first Estrobloom battery when I hit my teens. We were close... I wanted to be closer, but I was so shy and awkward back then. Even more than I am now, if you can believe it.”
rows.translation: “对，对。这话我确实说过，”枫打了个哈欠。“让我想想...就像我说的，卡丝和我是从小一起长大的。那还是在行星开拓潮之前，塔夫罗斯站上的人还没这么多。小孩子的确不多，所以我们这些人自然而然就凑到了一起。尤其是我们这些非人类。卡丝和我都想跟父母一样，长大当太空船员；我们一起上学；我十几岁第一次接受雌激素绽放剂疗程时，卡丝还陪我去过。我们很亲近...我本想跟她更亲近，可那时候我又害羞又笨拙。你信不信，比我现在还要严重。”

rows.translation: “抱歉，枫，我这儿正忙着呢，”你道歉道，尽量温和地让这可怜的小家伙知难而退。
rows.raw: "“Sorry, Kaede, I’m kind of in the middle of something,” you apologize, trying to let the poor pup down easy."

rows.original: “Oh, uh, yeah. Sure,” she says with a sigh, rubbing the back of her neck. “I guess I’ll head back to my ship and take that nap anyway. God knows I need it.”
rows.translation: “哦，呃，好吧。当然，”她叹了口气，揉着后颈说道。“我想我还是回自己的飞船睡一觉吧。老天知道我有多需要休息。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, uh, yeah. Sure,” she says with a sigh, rubbing the back of her neck. “I guess I’ll head back to my ship and take that nap anyway. God knows I need it.”"

rows.original: You give her a nod and part ways with her, letting Kaede head off while you turn your attentions back to the garden world before you.
rows.translation: 你朝她点了点头，与她分开，让枫先走，而你把注意力转回眼前的田园世界。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a nod and part ways with her, letting Kaede head off while you turn your attentions back to the garden world before you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “So, uh,” Kaede says, quickly stepping ahead of Cass. “Would you mind taking Kayla home, Cass? She’s looking pretty sleepy, and I’d love to catch up with [pc.name]...”
rows.translation: “那个，嗯，”枫说着，快步走到卡丝前面。“卡丝，你介意送凯拉回家吗？她看起来挺困了，我还想跟[pc.name]叙叙旧...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, uh,” Kaede says, quickly stepping ahead of Cass. “Would you mind taking Kayla home, Cass? She’s looking pretty sleepy, and I’d love to catch up with [pc.name]...”"

rows.original: The cow-girl gives her lover a pouty look, but as if on cue her daughter makes a very loud, expressive yawn and nuzzles against her chest. “Oh, alright. Somebody needs a nap, I guess! I’ll see you around, Captain,” she winks before sashaying off, her broodmare-like hips swaying hypnotically as she walks down the road.
rows.translation: 这个奶牛-女孩撅着嘴看向爱人，但仿佛算准时机一般，她的女儿打了个格外响亮而夸张的哈欠，贴着她的胸口蹭起来。“哦，好吧。我想有人该睡午觉了！回头见，船长，”她眨眨眼，扭着腰离开了。她沿路走去时，那对种母马-般的胯部催眠似地左右摇摆。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cow-girl gives her lover a pouty look, but as if on cue her daughter makes a very loud, expressive yawn and nuzzles against her chest. “Oh, alright. Somebody needs a nap, I guess! I’ll see you around, Captain,” she winks before sashaying off, her broodmare-like hips swaying hypnotically as she walks down the road."

rows.original: The moment Cass has her back to you, Kaede slumps forward face-first into your chest, almost barreling you over. She clutches at your shoulders, a huge sigh escaping her lungs, and her big ears flop down against her head.
rows.translation: 卡丝刚一背对你们，枫便向前瘫倒，一头埋进你的胸膛，差点把你撞翻。她紧紧抓住你的肩膀，从肺里发出一声长叹，那对大耳朵也垂下来贴在头上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe moment Cass has her back to you, Kaede slumps forward face-first into your chest, almost barreling you over. She clutches at your shoulders, a huge sigh escaping her lungs, and her big ears flop down against her head."

rows.original: “I am sooooo exhausted,” the half-ausar whines, leaning heavily against you. “Cass’s Treatment made it so she can’t think straight without just getting fucked constantly. I... I can’t keep up, [pc.name]. She’s draining me dry - I can’t feel anything between my legs. Heeeelp.”
rows.translation: “我真是累——死了，”这个半奥萨尔人哀怨地说，重重地靠在你身上。“卡丝的改造疗程把她弄成这样，不被人不停地干就没法正常思考。我...我跟不上了，[pc.name]。她要把我榨干了 - 我两腿之间什么都感觉不到了。救——命啊。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am sooooo exhausted,” the half-ausar whines, leaning heavily against you. “Cass’s Treatment made it so she can’t think straight without just getting fucked constantly. I... I can’t keep up, [pc.name]. She’s draining me dry - I can’t feel anything between my legs. Heeeelp.”"

rows.original: You wrap your arms around the drained girl’s arms, supporting her as best you can - for such a skinny thing, she’s got some weight!
rows.translation: 你伸手环住这个精疲力尽的姑娘的双臂，尽力支撑住她 - 她这么瘦，分量倒还真不轻！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wrap your arms around the drained girl’s arms, supporting her as best you can - for such a skinny thing, she’s got some weight!"

rows.original: Must be all that tail-floof.
rows.translation: 一定是那一身尾巴蓬毛的缘故。
rows.raw: " Must be all that tail-floof."

rows.original: You give her a few affectionate pats until she’s recovered enough to stand back up, running a hand through her bright orange hair.
rows.translation: 你亲昵地轻拍她几下，直到她恢复到足以重新站起身来，又用一只手梳过她亮橙色的头发。
rows.raw: " You give her a few affectionate pats until she’s recovered enough to stand back up, running a hand through her bright orange hair."

rows.original: “Sorry,” she sighs. “I’m sure you didn’t want to hear that. I just... God, I need a break.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，”她叹了口气。“我肯定你不想听这些。我只是... 天啊，我需要歇一歇。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry,” she sighs. “I’m sure you didn’t want to hear that. I just... God, I need a break.”"

rows.original: You assure her that it’s alright. What’re friends for, after all? That said, you had no idea Kaede had a daughter. You have to admit you’re rather surprised.
rows.translation: 你向她保证没关系。毕竟朋友是干什么用的？话虽如此，你完全不知道枫有个女儿。你得承认自己挺意外的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her that it’s alright. What’re friends for, after all? That said, you had no idea Kaede had a daughter. You have to admit you’re rather surprised."

rows.original: “Did Anno never mention? Seems like she never stops talking about Kayla when we’re together,” she laughs. “But, uh, yeah... I’ve got a baby girl. Believe me, I’m as surprised as you are. Cass and I go way back, though. I mean, we grew up together on Tavros, and I kind of had a crush on her in my teens, but I never would have expected... not with her, anyway. Not to say I’m not happy - Kayla’s absolutely amazing, isn’t she? I wouldn’t trade her for the world.”
rows.translation: “安诺从来没提过吗？我们在一起时，她好像总在不停聊凯拉，”她笑道。“不过，呃，没错... 我有个女儿。相信我，我和你一样惊讶。不过卡丝和我很早以前就认识了。我的意思是，我们一起在塔弗罗斯长大，十几岁时我还有点暗恋她，可我从没想过会... 至少没想过会和她这样。倒不是说我不开心 - 凯拉棒极了，不是吗？拿全世界来换，我也不愿意失去她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did Anno never mention? Seems like she never stops talking about Kayla when we’re together,” she laughs. “But, uh, yeah... I’ve got a baby girl. Believe me, I’m as surprised as you are. Cass and I go way back, though. I mean, we grew up together on Tavros, and I kind of had a crush on her in my teens, but I never would have expected... not with her, anyway. Not to say I’m not happy - Kayla’s absolutely amazing, isn’t she? I wouldn’t trade her for the world.”"

rows.original: She certainly was doting on the wide-eyed little crossbreed she fathered, though the way she’s talking, you imagine there’s got to be some kind of juicy story behind Kaede becoming a parent. She blushes a little at the question, saying, “Tell you what: Talon’s parked in the weird barn-spaceport-thing down the street. Why don’t we go back to my place, and I’ll tell you the story over a drink... and maybe a lie-down? I really could use a nap.”
rows.translation: 她确实很宠爱那个由她播种孕育出、睁着大眼睛的小混血儿，不过听她的说法，你觉得枫成为家长的背后肯定藏着什么有趣的故事。听到你的问题，她微微脸红，说道：“这样吧：利爪号就停在街那头那个奇怪的谷仓兼太空港之类的地方。我们何不回我那里，边喝一杯边听我讲这个故事...也许再躺一会儿？我真的很需要打个盹。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe certainly was doting on the wide-eyed little crossbreed she fathered, though the way she’s talking, you imagine there’s got to be some kind of juicy story behind Kaede becoming a parent. She blushes a little at the question, saying, “Tell you what: Talon’s parked in the weird barn-spaceport-thing down the street. Why don’t we go back to my place, and I’ll tell you the story over a drink... and maybe a lie-down? I really could use a nap.”"

rows.original: Well, that’s a tempting offer. Do you go cuddle up with Kaede and let her tell you a tale, or do you have something else in mind?
rows.translation: 嗯，这提议确实诱人。你要和枫依偎在一起，让她给你讲个故事，还是另有打算？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s a tempting offer. Do you go cuddle up with Kaede and let her tell you a tale, or do you have something else in mind?"

rows.original: Go With Her
rows.translation: 跟她走
rows.raw: "Go With Her"

rows.original: Go With Her
rows.translation: 跟她走
rows.raw: "Go With Her"

rows.original: You’d be happy to go with her and hear Kaede’s story.
rows.translation: 你很乐意陪她一起去，听听枫的故事。
rows.raw: "You’d be happy to go with her and hear Kaede’s story."

rows.original: Meet Cass
rows.translation: 见卡丝
rows.raw: "Meet Cass"

rows.original: Meet Cass
rows.translation: 见卡丝
rows.raw: "Meet Cass"

rows.original: Actually, you’d rather meet back up with her baby momma. Cass was giving you some pretty obvious signals, and if poor Kaede can’t sate the kitty-cow’s needs, well...
rows.translation: 其实，你更想回头去找她那位孩子他妈。卡丝给你的暗示相当明显，要是可怜的枫满足不了那只猫牛的需求，那...
rows.raw: "Actually, you’d rather meet back up with her baby momma. Cass was giving you some pretty obvious signals, and if poor Kaede can’t sate the kitty-cow’s needs, well..."

rows.original: Meet Cass
rows.translation: 见卡丝
rows.raw: "Meet Cass"

rows.original: Meet Cass
rows.translation: 见卡丝
rows.raw: "Meet Cass"

rows.original: Cass won’t want to hang out with someone who can’t have a little sexy fun.
rows.translation: 卡丝可不想和不愿享受一点性感乐趣的人待在一起。
rows.raw: "Cass won’t want to hang out with someone who can’t have a little sexy fun."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You’ve got places to be and things to do. Leave Kaede to her own devices.
rows.translation: 你还有地方要去、有事要做。就让枫自己待着吧。
rows.raw: "You’ve got places to be and things to do. Leave Kaede to her own devices."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Cass & Kaede
rows.translation: 卡丝与枫
rows.raw: "Cass & Kaede"

rows.original: CASS_NUDE
rows.raw: "CASS_NUDE"

rows.original: CASS
rows.raw: "CASS"

rows.original: A few minutes later, you manage to hand the giggling child back to her bovine parent, who all but rests her atop her gravity-defying tits.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你终于把咯咯笑个不停的孩子交还给她的奶牛母亲；对方几乎直接把她安置在那对违抗重力的乳房顶上。
rows.raw: " A few minutes later, you manage to hand the giggling child back to her bovine parent, who all but rests her atop her gravity-defying tits."

rows.original: “So, what brings you to New Texas, Captain?” Cass smiles. “Business or pleasure?”
rows.translation: “那么，是什么风把你吹来新德州的，船长？”卡丝笑道。“公事还是享乐？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what brings you to New Texas, Captain?” Cass smiles. “Business or pleasure?”"

rows.original: Business
rows.translation: 正事
rows.raw: "Business"

rows.original: Business
rows.translation: 正事
rows.raw: "Business"

rows.original: You came to New Texas strictly for business - a wealthy planet like this is bound to get the attention of a soon-to-be business magnate like yourself.
rows.translation: 你来新德克萨斯纯粹是为了生意 - 像这样富庶的星球，必然会吸引像你这样即将成为商业巨头的人。
rows.raw: "You came to New Texas strictly for business - a wealthy planet like this is bound to get the attention of a soon-to-be business magnate like yourself."

rows.original: Pleasure
rows.translation: 享乐
rows.raw: "Pleasure"

rows.original: Pleasure
rows.translation: 享乐
rows.raw: "Pleasure"

rows.original: New Texas is a pleasure resort world, after all. What else would you come here for?
rows.translation: 新德克萨斯毕竟是个享乐度假星球。不然你来这儿还能为了什么？
rows.raw: "New Texas is a pleasure resort world, after all. What else would you come here for?"

rows.original: Iced Teats
rows.translation: 冰乳
rows.raw: "Iced Teats"

rows.original: The shop interior is made up of row after row of clear plastic devices with trays in front for bowls, and handles to draw the ice cream treats. On taking a second look, you realize each one appears to be occupied by a female form! Before you can make much of this, your attention is called to the right, where the cashier calls to you.
rows.translation: 店内是一排又一排透明塑料装置，前方设有放碗的托盘，还有用来取出冰淇淋甜点的拉杆。你再看一眼，才发现每台装置里似乎都装着一名女性！你还没来得及弄清楚情况，注意力便被引向右侧，收银员正在那里招呼你。
rows.raw: "The shop interior is made up of row after row of clear plastic devices with trays in front for bowls, and handles to draw the ice cream treats. On taking a second look, you realize each one appears to be occupied by a female form! Before you can make much of this, your attention is called to the right, where the cashier calls to you."

rows.original: “Hello! Welcome to Iced Teats!”
rows.translation: “你好！欢迎来到冰乳！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello! Welcome to Iced Teats!”"

rows.original: This tall orange skinned woman has short lime green hair and bright red eyes. She wears a bright red miniskirt and vest combo that she must have to squeeze her C-cups into with a shoehorn. Her eye shadow, nail polish, and lipstick all share the hue of her hair. Her ears are bony fans, her fingers webbed, and she has gill slits on her neck, betraying an amphibious origin. Her smile is inviting and warm as you step up to the counter.
rows.translation: 这个身材高挑、橙色皮肤的女人留着青柠色的短发，眼睛鲜红。她穿着一身亮红色的迷你裙配马甲，那对C罩杯想必得用鞋拔子才塞得进去。她的眼影、指甲油和口红都与发色相同。她的耳朵是骨质的扇形，手指间有蹼，脖子上还有鳃裂，透露出两栖的出身。你走到柜台前时，她的笑容热情而温暖。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis tall orange skinned woman has short lime green hair and bright red eyes. She wears a bright red miniskirt and vest combo that she must have to squeeze her C-cups into with a shoehorn. Her eye shadow, nail polish, and lipstick all share the hue of her hair. Her ears are bony fans, her fingers webbed, and she has gill slits on her neck, betraying an amphibious origin. Her smile is inviting and warm as you step up to the counter."

rows.original: “My name is Yammi! What can I get for you today?” She chirps happily, indicating the large flavor list behind her. “We have cones, bowls, or frozen feasts, in any combination of flavors you prefer!”
rows.translation: “我叫雅米！今天想给你来点什么？”她欢快地叽叽喳喳，指了指身后那张大大的口味单。“我们有甜筒、碗装，或者冰宴，口味随你喜欢怎么搭配都行！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My name is Yammi! What can I get for you today?” She chirps happily, indicating the large flavor list behind her. “We have cones, bowls, or frozen feasts, in any combination of flavors you prefer!”"

rows.original: You head over to Iced Teats, hoping for a quick snack to fill in a little time. As you approach, a small gang of unruly-looking young bulls storm out. Several look disgruntled, the rest are laughing. You wait until they’re gone, then head inside. Immediately you catch the sound of Yammi sniffling, trying not to cry. She’s standing behind her cash register and is covered in ice cream! They must have thrown half a dozen bowls at her.
rows.translation: 你走向冰乳，想吃点小吃打发点时间。快走到时，一小群看着就不安分的年轻公牛冲了出来。有几个一脸不爽，其余的在大笑。你等到他们走远，然后走了进去。立刻你就听见雅米抽鼻子的声音，她在努力忍住不哭。她站在收银台后面，身上全是冰淇淋！他们准是朝她扔了半打碗。
rows.raw: "You head over to Iced Teats, hoping for a quick snack to fill in a little time. As you approach, a small gang of unruly-looking young bulls storm out. Several look disgruntled, the rest are laughing. You wait until they’re gone, then head inside. Immediately you catch the sound of Yammi sniffling, trying not to cry. She’s standing behind her cash register and is covered in ice cream! They must have thrown half a dozen bowls at her."

rows.original: “I’m sorry. We’re closed for the moment, I have to... Oh! It’s you, hello.” She chokes back a sob. “Sorry, you kind of caught me at a bad time.”
rows.translation: “对不起。我们这会儿打烊了，我得...哦！是你，你好。”她压下一声啜泣。“抱歉，你正好撞见我不太好的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry. We’re closed for the moment, I have to... Oh! It’s you, hello.” She chokes back a sob. “Sorry, you kind of caught me at a bad time.”"

rows.original: You can see that. You ask what happened, flipping the sign on the door around to ‘Momentary Delay.’ You note you saw the gaggle of troublemakers.
rows.translation: 这点你看得出来。你问发生了什么，同时将门上的标牌翻到‘暂时延误’那一面。你提到自己看见了那群闹事者。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see that. You ask what happened, flipping the sign on the door around to ‘Momentary Delay.’ You note you saw the gaggle of troublemakers."

rows.original: “Yeah, those guys are always a problem. They demand free stuff because they eat half their bowl and then decide they don’t like that flavor; they scream and yell at me all the time... they’re just really unpleasant people.” She finally picks up a cloth and wipes her face off. “Those are the kind of people that make me want to buy out my contract. Immediately. If it weren’t for that kind of jerk, I’d probably be happy working here!”
rows.translation: “对，那些家伙总是很麻烦。他们吃掉半碗，才决定自己不喜欢那个口味，然后要求免费；还成天对我大喊大叫... 实在是一群很讨厌的人。”她终于拿起一块布，擦了擦脸。“就是这种人让我想赎回自己的合同。立刻赎回。要不是有这种混蛋，我在这里工作大概还会很开心！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, those guys are always a problem. They demand free stuff because they eat half their bowl and then decide they don’t like that flavor; they scream and yell at me all the time... they’re just really unpleasant people.” She finally picks up a cloth and wipes her face off. “Those are the kind of people that make me want to buy out my contract. Immediately. If it weren’t for that kind of jerk, I’d probably be happy working here!”"

rows.original: You ask if they’re really common
rows.translation: 你问它们是不是真的很常见
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if they’re really common"

rows.original: , as you pick up a cloth to help her wipe the counter
rows.translation: ，同时拿起一块抹布，帮她擦拭柜台
rows.raw: ", as you pick up a cloth to help her wipe the counter"

rows.original: . She nods.
rows.translation: 。她点点头。
rows.raw: ". She nods."

rows.original: “There’s quite a few. Mostly young hotshots who know I can’t do anything so they get away with acting like jerks, but there’s a lot of people who just think they should be accommodated no matter how stupid their gripe is or whose fault it is.” She chuckles a little. “This one Deditonian woman we get in here is always trying to get her ice cream free because it’s too cold. Really! Ice Cream, from the Iced Teats company, is too cold? I can’t imagine why it isn’t warmer, you know? And she’ll sit here and look down her nose at me for half an hour sometimes and inform me that it’s my job to please the customer and blah blah blah.”
rows.translation: “这样的人还不少。大多是些年轻气盛的家伙，知道我拿他们没办法，所以可以逍遥自在地表现得像混蛋；不过也有许多人觉得，不管自己的抱怨有多蠢、是谁的错，别人都该迁就他们。”她轻笑了一声。“我们这里有个德迪托尼亚人女人，总想因为冰淇淋太冷而免费拿走它。真的！冰乳公司生产的冰淇淋太冷？你知道吗，我简直无法想象它为什么不热一点。有时她还会坐在这里，用鼻孔看我整整半小时，教训我说取悦顾客是我的职责，诸如此类，没完没了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s quite a few. Mostly young hotshots who know I can’t do anything so they get away with acting like jerks, but there’s a lot of people who just think they should be accommodated no matter how stupid their gripe is or whose fault it is.” She chuckles a little. “This one Deditonian woman we get in here is always trying to get her ice cream free because it’s too cold. Really! Ice Cream, from the Iced Teats company, is too cold? I can’t imagine why it isn’t warmer, you know? And she’ll sit here and look down her nose at me for half an hour sometimes and inform me that it’s my job to please the customer and blah blah blah.”"

rows.original: You ask her what she does. She smiles and hugs herself.
rows.translation: 你问她是做什么的。她笑了笑，抱住自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what she does. She smiles and hugs herself."

rows.original: “I put up with it, of course. What else can I do? With her I usually just listen until her ice cream starts to melt, then point out it’s warmed up for her. She usually gets insulted and tells my boss, so I get hit with a small fine. Again.”
rows.translation: “我当然只好忍着。我还能怎么办？跟她在一起时，我通常就听着，等她的冰淇淋开始化，再提醒她冰淇淋已经温了。她一般会觉得自己被侮辱了，然后去告诉我老板，于是我又被罚一小笔钱。又一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I put up with it, of course. What else can I do? With her I usually just listen until her ice cream starts to melt, then point out it’s warmed up for her. She usually gets insulted and tells my boss, so I get hit with a small fine. Again.”"

rows.original: You offer to stick around and help clean up, but she shakes her head.
rows.translation: 你提出留下来帮忙收拾，但她摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou offer to stick around and help clean up, but she shakes her head."

rows.original: “Thank you, I appreciate it, but I’ll get it. I could use a little time without customers to clear my head. I think I might just have a good cry and then open up again after I change.”
rows.translation: “谢谢，我很感激，不过还是让我来吧。我正好需要一段没有顾客的时间清醒一下。我想自己大哭一场，换过衣服后再重新营业。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, I appreciate it, but I’ll get it. I could use a little time without customers to clear my head. I think I might just have a good cry and then open up again after I change.”"

rows.original: You give her a reassuring smile, then head out, leaving her to catch her breath. You imagined customer service work could suck, but you didn’t really think about how badly.
rows.translation: 你给了她一个安慰的微笑，然后走了出去，留她喘口气。你想象过客服工作会很糟，但没真想过能糟到什么程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a reassuring smile, then head out, leaving her to catch her breath. You imagined customer service work could suck, but you didn’t really think about how badly."

rows.original: You stroll into Iced Teats looking for something tasty. You notice something’s amiss when Yammi doesn’t immediately greet you in her usual happy manner. Instead she is leaned on the counter looking glum, chin rested on her fist. You stroll over and inquire as to the source of her woes?
rows.translation: 你走进冰乳，想找些好吃的东西。雅米没有像往常那样立刻开心地招呼你，你因此察觉有些不对劲。她反而愁眉苦脸地靠在柜台上，下巴抵着拳头。你走过去，询问她为何烦恼？
rows.raw: "You stroll into Iced Teats looking for something tasty. You notice something’s amiss when Yammi doesn’t immediately greet you in her usual happy manner. Instead she is leaned on the counter looking glum, chin rested on her fist. You stroll over and inquire as to the source of her woes?"

rows.original: “My bosses have decided that since I get so many fines, they’re upping my shelter and food bills, effective tomorrow. It’s going to double the cost of me getting out of here.” She sighs and stands up, then shakes her head. “I’ve tried telling them it’s not my fault but they don’t care. This is the second time they’ve done this to me! I’m starting to wonder if I’ll ever get out of here.”
rows.translation: “我的老板们决定，既然我收到这么多罚款，他们就从明天开始提高我的住宿费和伙食费。我离开这里要花的钱会翻倍。”她叹了口气，站起身，又摇摇头。“我试着告诉他们这不是我的错，可他们根本不在乎。他们已经第二次这样对我了！我开始怀疑自己究竟还能不能离开这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My bosses have decided that since I get so many fines, they’re upping my shelter and food bills, effective tomorrow. It’s going to double the cost of me getting out of here.” She sighs and stands up, then shakes her head. “I’ve tried telling them it’s not my fault but they don’t care. This is the second time they’ve done this to me! I’m starting to wonder if I’ll ever get out of here.”"

rows.original: You tell her to keep her hopes up, then ask how much she owes.
rows.translation: 你告诉她别灰心，接着问她欠了多少债。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her to keep her hopes up, then ask how much she owes."

rows.raw: " credits. As of opening tomorrow, it’ll basically be twice that. And I was so close! I could have been out of here in seven standard pay-cycles!”"

rows.original: You agree that seems really bad.
rows.translation: 你同意这看起来真的很糟。

rows.translation: 不过你知道，情况本可能糟得多...
rows.raw: "You know, though, that it could be a lot worse... "

rows.original: With a faint grin you do mention that they clearly can’t afford to lose her!
rows.translation: 你淡淡一笑，还是提到他们显然承受不起失去她！
rows.raw: "With a faint grin you do mention that they clearly can’t afford to lose her!"

rows.original: “Yeah... well yeah. I guess. Still, this is no good. I want to get out there and see something other than this shop. I mean, I owe them, that’s fair, but if they keep pulling this whenever I get close, I’m seriously going to flip out at some point!”
rows.translation: “对...嗯，对吧。我想是的。但这还是不行。我想出去看看这家店以外的东西。我的意思是，我欠他们的，这很公平；可要是我每次快要还清时他们都来这一套，我迟早真的会彻底发飙！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah... well yeah. I guess. Still, this is no good. I want to get out there and see something other than this shop. I mean, I owe them, that’s fair, but if they keep pulling this whenever I get close, I’m seriously going to flip out at some point!”"

rows.original: You agree it’s not fair. Still, you tell her that it will all work out. After all, she has her faithful customers. You assure her that the tips won’t stop from you at least.
rows.translation: 你同意这并不公平。不过你还是告诉她，一切都会好起来的。毕竟她还有那些忠实的老顾客。你向她保证，至少你给的小费不会断。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou agree it’s not fair. Still, you tell her that it will all work out. After all, she has her faithful customers. You assure her that the tips won’t stop from you at least."

rows.original: “That’s true! Alright, enough of me feeling sorry for myself.” She puts on a smile. “So! Welcome to Iced Teats! What can I get you today?”
rows.translation: “说得对！好了，我不再自怨自艾了。”她露出微笑。“那么！欢迎光临冰乳！今天想要什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s true! Alright, enough of me feeling sorry for myself.” She puts on a smile. “So! Welcome to Iced Teats! What can I get you today?”"

rows.original: The shop interior is made up of row after row of clear plastic devices with trays in front for bowls, and handles to draw the ice cream treats. Just like last time, you spot women occupying the space inside the machinery. Yammi calls to you almost as soon as you step inside the door.
rows.translation: 店内由一排又一排透明塑料装置组成，前方设有放碗的托盘，还有用来接取冰淇淋甜点的手柄。和上次一样，你发现机器内部的空间里装着女人。你刚踏进门，雅米几乎立刻就朝你喊了起来。
rows.raw: "The shop interior is made up of row after row of clear plastic devices with trays in front for bowls, and handles to draw the ice cream treats. Just like last time, you spot women occupying the space inside the machinery. Yammi calls to you almost as soon as you step inside the door."

rows.original: “Welcome back to Iced Teats! When you’d like to order, just say the word.” The orange-skinned alien is dressed the same as the last time you saw her, sporting a bright red miniskirt and vest combo that would threaten sensibilities on a more modest world. Her cheerful eyes watch you curiously as you make your way around the shop.
rows.translation: “欢迎回到冰乳！想点单的时候，说一声就行。”这位橙皮肤的外星人穿得和你上次见她时一样，一身鲜红的迷你裙配马甲，在更保守的世界上足以惊世骇俗。你在店里转悠时，她那快活的眼睛好奇地注视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back to Iced Teats! When you’d like to order, just say the word.” The orange-skinned alien is dressed the same as the last time you saw her, sporting a bright red miniskirt and vest combo that would threaten sensibilities on a more modest world. Her cheerful eyes watch you curiously as you make your way around the shop."

rows.original: You head into the Iced Teats shop, looking to enjoy something cool and delicious. When you enter, a blue skinned woman with black hair smiles at you, her light blue vest barely holding her bulging D-cup breasts in place. She greets you with the familiar “Welcome to Iced Teats! My name is Salire, what can I get for you today?” She has the eager happiness of someone new to their job and looking to make a good impression.
rows.translation: 你走进冰乳店，想享用些清凉美味的东西。进门后，一位蓝皮肤、黑头发的女人朝你微笑；她那件浅蓝色背心几乎兜不住鼓胀的D罩杯乳房。她用那句熟悉的问候招呼你：“欢迎光临冰乳！我叫萨利雷，今天想来点什么？”她身上洋溢着那种初入职场、急于留下好印象的人才有的热情与喜悦。
rows.raw: "You head into the Iced Teats shop, looking to enjoy something cool and delicious. When you enter, a blue skinned woman with black hair smiles at you, her light blue vest barely holding her bulging D-cup breasts in place. She greets you with the familiar “Welcome to Iced Teats! My name is Salire, what can I get for you today?” She has the eager happiness of someone new to their job and looking to make a good impression."

Various tubes and devices are in place to feed them, please them, and clean them. As you examine the flavor tags on each machine, the occupant watches you from inside; some are expectant, some a bit tired, and some look pleading, their massive melons overfull.
rows.translation: 你打量眼前的选择，每台装置中都有一名女性；她的乳房被绑带网紧紧包裹，随时准备献出带有不同风味的乳汁，供你当作点心享用。各类导管与装置负责喂养、取悦和清洁她们。你查看每台机器上的口味标签时，里面的住客也在注视你；有些满怀期待，有些略显疲惫，还有些人投来恳求的目光，硕大乳瓜已经胀得过满。

rows.original: When you pull the lever, she closes her eyes slowly. It takes a couple seconds, but the machine quick-freezes and whips her fresh breast-juice into a kiwi-green ice cream. You can feel the vibration of the machine as it works pumps and motors inside, then your cone is full, leaving her visibly sighing and looking disappointed.
rows.translation: 你拉下拉杆时，她缓缓闭上眼睛。过了几秒，机器将她新鲜的乳汁速冻搅打成猕猴桃绿色的冰淇淋。机器内部的泵和马达运转时，你能感到它的震动；随后你的蛋筒被灌满，而她明显叹了口气，看起来颇为失望。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you pull the lever, she closes her eyes slowly. It takes a couple seconds, but the machine quick-freezes and whips her fresh breast-juice into a kiwi-green ice cream. You can feel the vibration of the machine as it works pumps and motors inside, then your cone is full, leaving her visibly sighing and looking disappointed."

rows.original: The ice cream is very savory, and you take your time to finish it. It feels like it fills you more than maybe it should.
rows.translation: 冰淇淋味道非常鲜美，你慢慢把它吃完。它带来的饱腹感似乎超出了应有的程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ice cream is very savory, and you take your time to finish it. It feels like it fills you more than maybe it should."

rows.original: You decide the Gewinfruit was worth a second go. The gray skinned dispenser girl watches you approach and you almost hear a groan. Clearly she gets a lot of small time cones and not as many bowls as she would like. While you sympathize, you’re only here for a treat. The cone is slow to fill again, proving her continued popularity. You leave her somewhat disappointed again, but enjoy your savory green ice cream anyways.
rows.translation: 你觉得格温果值得再来一次。那位灰皮肤的售货女孩看着你走近，你几乎能听见一声呻吟。显然她卖出的多是小小的甜筒，而不是她希望的那样多的碗装。虽然你同情她，但你来这儿只是为了吃点好东西。甜筒又一次装得很慢，说明她的人气依旧。你又让她有些失望了，不过你还是很享受这份咸香的绿色冰淇淋。
rows.raw: "You decide the Gewinfruit was worth a second go. The gray skinned dispenser girl watches you approach and you almost hear a groan. rows.translation: 嗯，这倒把产品解释得挺清楚了，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that explains the product fairly well, doesn’t it?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You glance at the machines nearby, noting the shapes of women trapped inside, and inquire with Yammi about them. Surely that can’t be a comfortable job.
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼附近的机器，注意到里面困着的女人轮廓，便向雅米打听她们。那肯定不是什么舒服的工作。
rows.raw: "You glance at the machines nearby, noting the shapes of women trapped inside, and inquire with Yammi about them. Surely that can’t be a comfortable job."

rows.original: “All production servants are fed, sheltered, and comfortably orgasmed well in excess of galactic minimum standards. Genetic engineering has been involved to bring each one to production output and produce appropriate flavoring. All indentured workers and servers are almost considered legal property of the Iced Teats Confectionery Company,” she recites.
rows.translation: “所有生产仆从获得的食物、住所和舒适高潮都远超银河最低标准。我们运用基因工程，使每个人达到生产指标，并产生适当的风味。所有契约工人与服务人员几乎都被视为冰乳糖果公司的合法财产，”她背诵道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All production servants are fed, sheltered, and comfortably orgasmed well in excess of galactic minimum standards. Genetic engineering has been involved to bring each one to production output and produce appropriate flavoring. All indentured workers and servers are almost considered legal property of the Iced Teats Confectionery Company,” she recites."

rows.original: You roll your eyes. Even ice cream stores have legal jargon these days! Calling her attention back to the point of your question, you indicate the discomfort they must feel in those machines.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼。现在就连冰淇淋店都有法律术语了！你把她的注意力重新拉回问题重点，指出她们待在那些机器里肯定很不舒服。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes. Even ice cream stores have legal jargon these days! Calling her attention back to the point of your question, you indicate the discomfort they must feel in those machines."

rows.original: “It’s really hard for me to sympathize with them, actually. They get one day on, two days off, spa treatments, exercise, great food, entertainments... It’s really not fair!” Yammi’s expression turns somewhat sour. “They’re indentured servants, almost all of them were bred specifically for this role, so they don’t know any other life. The machines are carefully made to be comfortable as can be, and they have massaging devices to keep them from getting stiff and achy. Plus every time they make more than a cone, they get an orgasm.”
rows.translation: “说真的，我很难同情她们。她们上一天班、休息两天，还有水疗护理、锻炼、美食和娱乐... 这实在太不公平了！”雅米的表情变得有些不悦。“她们都是契约仆役，几乎所有人都是专门为这个岗位培育的，所以根本不知道其他生活是什么样。那些机器经过精心设计，力求尽可能舒适，还有按摩装置防止她们身体僵硬酸痛。更何况，每当她们生产的量超过一个蛋筒，就能获得一次高潮。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s really hard for me to sympathize with them, actually. They get one day on, two days off, spa treatments, exercise, great food, entertainments... It’s really not fair!” Yammi’s expression turns somewhat sour. “They’re indentured servants, almost all of them were bred specifically for this role, so they don’t know any other life. The machines are carefully made to be comfortable as can be, and they have massaging devices to keep them from getting stiff and achy. Plus every time they make more than a cone, they get an orgasm.”"

rows.original: That seems like not too bad of a job, except for the bit about being enslaved. You note as much to Yammi, and she rolls her eyes.
rows.translation: 除了被奴役那一部分之外，这工作听起来似乎没那么糟糕。你把这点告诉雅米，她翻了个白眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat seems like not too bad of a job, except for the bit about being enslaved. You note as much to Yammi, and she rolls her eyes."

rows.original: “Just between us, I kind of wish I’d made the cut. I mean sure, I actually have the chance to buy out my own contract and get out of here eventually, but they get all the good things, you know?”
rows.translation: “只在我们之间说，我其实有点希望自己当初通过筛选。我的意思是，没错，我确实有机会买断自己的合同，最终离开这里；但她们什么好东西都能享受到，你懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just between us, I kind of wish I’d made the cut. I mean sure, I actually have the chance to buy out my own contract and get out of here eventually, but they get all the good things, you know?”"

rows.original: You let her know your curiosity is piqued by the ‘buying out contract’ comment. Sounds like there’s a loophole in this arrangement.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，那个“买断合同”的说法勾起了自己的好奇心。听起来这种安排里存在一道漏洞。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let her know your curiosity is piqued by the ‘buying out contract’ comment. Sounds like there’s a loophole in this arrangement."

rows.original: <i>“Well, indentured servants have to work to pay off all the food, shelter, and so on that their master has given to them. It’s like being in deep debt. Since I just have those bills to pay off, I just need to squirrel away enough tips and make a bit of
rows.translation: <i>“嗯，契约仆役必须工作，偿还主人为他们提供的全部食物、住所之类的费用。就像背负巨额债务一样。既然我只需要还清那些账单，我只要悄悄攒够小费，再赚上一点
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Well, indentured servants have to work to pay off all the food, shelter, and so on that their master has given to them. It’s like being in deep debt. Since I just have those bills to pay off, I just need to squirrel away enough tips and make a bit of "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "credit"

rows.original: on the side. Eventually I’ll be able to afford it!” She smiles cheerfully at the idea. “The producers though, their bills are huge and they only get more expensive. Spas and gyms aren’t cheap! They’re in it for life, so they should be happy that life is going to be mostly pleasant.” Yammi seems to have a hint of jealousy in her voice.
rows.translation: 作为额外收入。总有一天我能攒够钱赎身！”想到这里，她开心地微笑起来。“不过生产员就不同了，她们欠下的账额巨大，而且只会越来越高。水疗和健身房可不便宜！她们一辈子都会待在这里，所以应该庆幸这辈子大部分时间都会过得很舒适。”雅米的声音里似乎带着一丝嫉妒。
rows.raw: " on the side. Eventually I’ll be able to afford it!” She smiles cheerfully at the idea. “The producers though, their bills are huge and they only get more expensive. Spas and gyms aren’t cheap! They’re in it for life, so they should be happy that life is going to be mostly pleasant.” Yammi seems to have a hint of jealousy in her voice."

rows.original: Well, their situation could certainly be worse, you are forced to admit. Still, what a job. You imagine it must be a punishing task to make so much ice cream in a day.
rows.translation: 好吧，你不得不承认，她们的处境当然还可能更糟。不过，这工作可真够呛。你猜想，一天制造如此多冰淇淋肯定是项折磨人的任务。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, their situation could certainly be worse, you are forced to admit. Still, what a job. You imagine it must be a punishing task to make so much ice cream in a day."

rows.original: “It absolutely is. Some of our best selling flavors have to be switched out once a day, twice on some holidays! The extractor is also a little on the merciless side. The intense squeezing and suction occasionally bruises overused flavors a little. One or two of them that are adapted for hot environments also bitch endlessly about the ice coils being so close to their nipples.” Yammi crosses her arms and shrugs. “But really, they have hyper metabolisms as far as digesting food and making cream. I’ve never yet seen one run out! They just slow down a little bit. And the constant feed ensures they have ample fuel for the process. As for their aches and gripes, they should just be happy they don’t have to deal with screaming angry customers throwing things at them and cursing at them all the time.” Realizing she just resorted to grousing about her job, Yammi’s cheeks flush a cute blood-orange color and she covers her mouth, then notes: “I’m just going to stop talking now! Sorry!”
rows.translation: “绝对是这样。有些最畅销的口味每天必须轮换一次，某些节假日甚至要换两次！提取器也有点无情。强烈的挤压和吸吮偶尔会让那些使用过度的口味出现轻微瘀伤。其中还有一两个适应炎热环境的人，总没完没了地抱怨制冰线圈离乳头太近。”雅米抱起双臂，耸了耸肩。“不过说真的，在消化食物和制造乳脂方面，她们都拥有超强代谢。我还从未见过有谁耗尽产量！她们只会稍微慢下来。而持续投喂也保证她们有充足燃料完成这一过程。至于身体酸痛和那些抱怨，她们应该庆幸自己不必整天面对尖叫着的愤怒顾客，被扔东西、被咒骂。”意识到自己刚才又开始抱怨工作，雅米的脸颊染上一层可爱的血橙-色。她捂住嘴，随后说道：“我还是闭嘴吧！抱歉！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It absolutely is. Some of our best selling flavors have to be switched out once a day, twice on some holidays! The extractor is also a little on the merciless side. The intense squeezing and suction occasionally bruises overused flavors a little. One or two of them that are adapted for hot environments also bitch endlessly about the ice coils being so close to their nipples.” Yammi crosses her arms and shrugs. “But really, they have hyper metabolisms as far as digesting food and making cream. I’ve never yet seen one run out! They just slow down a little bit. And the constant feed ensures they have ample fuel for the process. As for their aches and gripes, they should just be happy they don’t have to deal with screaming angry customers throwing things at them and cursing at them all the time.” Realizing she just resorted to grousing about her job, Yammi’s cheeks flush a cute blood-orange color and she covers her mouth, then notes: “I’m just going to stop talking now! Sorry!”"

rows.original: You chuckle and tell her it’s alright, to put her at ease. No point getting her in trouble.
rows.translation: 你轻笑着告诉她没事，让她放下心来。没必要害她惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle and tell her it’s alright, to put her at ease. No point getting her in trouble."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask about the company. It sounds like a big one, you might trip over them somewhere down the line. It can’t hurt to know a thing or two about them.
rows.translation: 你问起那家公司。听起来规模很大，将来某处说不定就会碰上他们。了解他们一两件事总没坏处。
rows.raw: "You ask about the company. It sounds like a big one, you might trip over them somewhere down the line. It can’t hurt to know a thing or two about them."

rows.original: “Iced Teats is one of the oldest confections companies still in operation. They are careful to manage their recruitment programs and keep ample stocks of indentured workers on hand in case opportunities for expansion pop up. The males they use for breeding are also typically used for light labor or office work.” She leans on her counter and looks thoughtful. “The company prides itself on never retiring a flavor. They’re also proud to note that because of their stocks of indentured servants, no less than three species have been saved from extinction after galactic calamities wiped out every other viable genetic deposit. They are also on the leading edge of collecting new species, snatching up breeders as soon as they are legally able and rapidly expanding their stores.”
rows.translation: “冰乳是仍在营业的最古老甜品公司之一。他们谨慎管理招募项目，手头始终保有充足的契约工库存，以便扩张机会出现时随时利用。他们用于繁殖的男性通常也会从事轻体力劳动或办公室工作。”她靠在柜台上，若有所思。“公司以从不淘汰任何口味为荣。他们还自豪地指出，凭借契约仆役库存，在银河灾难摧毁所有其他可用基因储藏后，至少有三个物种因此免于灭绝。他们也站在收集新物种的最前沿，只要法律允许，就立刻抢购繁殖者，迅速扩充库存。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Iced Teats is one of the oldest confections companies still in operation. They are careful to manage their recruitment programs and keep ample stocks of indentured workers on hand in case opportunities for expansion pop up. The males they use for breeding are also typically used for light labor or office work.” She leans on her counter and looks thoughtful. “The company prides itself on never retiring a flavor. They’re also proud to note that because of their stocks of indentured servants, no less than three species have been saved from extinction after galactic calamities wiped out every other viable genetic deposit. They are also on the leading edge of collecting new species, snatching up breeders as soon as they are legally able and rapidly expanding their stores.”"

rows.original: Well, that sounds not terrible, given that it’s a giant soulless corporation. You then notice Yammi leaning closer, and suspect she has more to add.
rows.translation: 嗯，考虑到那是一家庞大而没有灵魂的公司，这听起来还不算太糟。随后你注意到雅米凑得更近，猜她还有话要说。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that sounds not terrible, given that it’s a giant soulless corporation. You then notice Yammi leaning closer, and suspect she has more to add."

rows.original: “Just between you, me, and the stars? I’m not entirely convinced that they have all that legality in mind. I’ve seen some new girls get hauled in and they weren’t all that cooperative. Others came in and I had only just heard of their species a month prior.” She says hushedly. “It doesn’t happen often, but in a company this big they could be kidnapping and enslaving thousands of new girls. Not at gunpoint, mind you. One I remember seeing came up in a newspaper as vanishing because of huge gambling debts, and another one was a sports player who lost them a huge amount of money after they funded her career.”
rows.translation: “只告诉你、我和星辰？我不太相信他们真的把所有法律问题放在心上。我见过一些新姑娘被拖进来，她们一点也不配合。还有些刚被送来时，我一个月前才刚听说过她们所属的种族。”她压低声音说道。“这种事不常发生，可在这么大的公司里，他们可能绑架并奴役了成千上万的新姑娘。注意，我不是说他们用枪逼人。我记得见过其中一个，后来报纸说她因为欠下巨额赌债而失踪；还有另一个是运动员，他们资助了她的职业生涯，而她害他们损失了一大笔钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just between you, me, and the stars? I’m not entirely convinced that they have all that legality in mind. I’ve seen some new girls get hauled in and they weren’t all that cooperative. Others came in and I had only just heard of their species a month prior.” She says hushedly. “It doesn’t happen often, but in a company this big they could be kidnapping and enslaving thousands of new girls. Not at gunpoint, mind you. One I remember seeing came up in a newspaper as vanishing because of huge gambling debts, and another one was a sports player who lost them a huge amount of money after they funded her career.”"

rows.original: Well, that’s pretty interesting. You make a mental note to keep your ears open for further news. When you ask Yammi if she has more details, she shakes her head.
rows.translation: 嗯，这挺有意思的。你在心里记下，要多留意后续的消息。你问雅米有没有更多细节，她摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s pretty interesting. You make a mental note to keep your ears open for further news. When you ask Yammi if she has more details, she shakes her head."

rows.original: “I’m just a cashier. And look, these people raised me. They’ve given me everything I have. Not all of them are bad. But somewhere in the middle of the company, something’s gone a little rotten.”
rows.translation: “我只是个收银员。而且你看，是这些人把我养大的。他们给了我拥有的一切。并不是每个人都很坏。但公司中层的某个地方，确实有些东西开始腐烂了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m just a cashier. And look, these people raised me. They’ve given me everything I have. Not all of them are bad. But somewhere in the middle of the company, something’s gone a little rotten.”"

rows.original: She suddenly goes back to fiddling with her register, and you can’t get her to approach the topic any more. She must sense something extraordinary in you to have risked such a sensitive bit of information. You decide not to press further.
rows.translation: 她突然又开始摆弄收银机，无论如何都不肯继续谈论这个话题。她一定从你身上感受到了某种非凡之处，才会冒险透露如此敏感的信息。你决定不再追问。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe suddenly goes back to fiddling with her register, and you can’t get her to approach the topic any more. She must sense something extraordinary in you to have risked such a sensitive bit of information. You decide not to press further."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Eh? Me?” Yammi blushes a darling blood-orange. “I’m nobody special. Just an indentured servant who didn’t have the right genes for production use. I just work here as a cashier.”
rows.translation: “欸？我吗？”雅米可爱地涨红成血橙色。“我没什么特别的。只是一个基因不符合生产用途的契约仆人。我只在这里当收银员。”
rows.raw: "“Eh? Me?” Yammi blushes a darling blood-orange. “I’m nobody special. Just an indentured servant who didn’t have the right genes for production use. I just work here as a cashier.”"

rows.original: You invite her to fill you in a little more. After all, everyone is someone, right?
rows.translation: 你请她再多告诉自己一些。毕竟，每个人都不是无名之辈，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou invite her to fill you in a little more. After all, everyone is someone, right?"

rows.original: “Well, I am an amphibian, that’s pretty neat. I even sleep in a tub of water. Very comfortable!” She wracks her brain to try and find anything interesting to say about herself. “Nope. That’s about it. I was bred and raised by the company and I’ve worked for them my whole life. I’m hoping to buy out my contract and get out and about soon. Apparently my people live a looong time, so I should have plenty of opportunities.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我是两栖的，这还挺妙。我甚至睡在一缸水里。非常舒服！”她绞尽脑汁想找点关于自己的趣事。“没了。就这些。我是公司培育养大的，一辈子都在给他们干活。我希望能买断自己的合同，很快就能出去走走。听说我们这族活得可长——了，所以机会应该多得是。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I am an amphibian, that’s pretty neat. I even sleep in a tub of water. Very comfortable!” She wracks her brain to try and find anything interesting to say about herself. “Nope. That’s about it. I was bred and raised by the company and I’ve worked for them my whole life. I’m hoping to buy out my contract and get out and about soon. Apparently my people live a looong time, so I should have plenty of opportunities.”"

rows.original: You see an opening and slip right in, inquiring about what she would do and where she’d go when she’s free of contractual obligations?
rows.translation: 你看准机会顺势切入，问她摆脱合同义务之后会做什么，又会去哪里？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see an opening and slip right in, inquiring about what she would do and where she’d go when she’s free of contractual obligations?"

rows.original: “Well, think first I’d find some warm water-world and take a vacation. I get one day out of ten off around here. It’s terrible. I need a little unwinding time, you know?” She looks off into the middle distance and sighs. “Just somewhere nice and relaxing to spend some time, maybe get a job to pay my way and stay there longer. After that, maybe I’d try my hand at this space traveling stuff. I’m sure I could get on as a cook on some ship! Seems like there’s a lot out there to do and see, and so many meals to prepare. Cooking’s kind of a hobby of mine.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我想我首先会找个温暖的水世界去度假。我在这里每十天才能休息一天，实在太糟了。我需要一点放松的时间，你懂吧？”她望向远处，叹了口气。“找个舒适又放松的地方住上一阵，也许找份工作养活自己，好在那里待得更久。之后，我也许会试试太空旅行这一行。我肯定能在某艘飞船上当厨师！外面似乎有那么多事情可以做、那么多地方可以看，还有那么多饭菜要准备。烹饪算是我的一种爱好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, think first I’d find some warm water-world and take a vacation. I get one day out of ten off around here. It’s terrible. I need a little unwinding time, you know?” She looks off into the middle distance and sighs. “Just somewhere nice and relaxing to spend some time, maybe get a job to pay my way and stay there longer. After that, maybe I’d try my hand at this space traveling stuff. I’m sure I could get on as a cook on some ship! Seems like there’s a lot out there to do and see, and so many meals to prepare. Cooking’s kind of a hobby of mine.”"

rows.original: You assure her there is a lot out there, and there’s no end to it in sight. She giggles and smiles.
rows.translation: 你向她保证外面还有很多，而且看不到尽头。她咯咯笑着，露出微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her there is a lot out there, and there’s no end to it in sight. She giggles and smiles."

rows.original: “Thanks! It’s sweet of you to say that. Of course, first I’ve got to finish here.” She shrugs. “One thing at a time, right?”
rows.translation: “谢谢！你这么说真贴心。当然，我得先把这里弄完。”她耸耸肩。“一次一件，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks! It’s sweet of you to say that. Of course, first I’ve got to finish here.” She shrugs. “One thing at a time, right?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You don’t feel shy mentioning that so many beauties around is pretty stimulating, not the least of which is Yammi herself. Her face goes blood-orange in blush.
rows.translation: 你毫不害羞地提到周围这么多美人实在很刺激，尤其是雅米本人。她的脸羞得像血橙一样红。
rows.raw: "You don’t feel shy mentioning that so many beauties around is pretty stimulating, not the least of which is Yammi herself. Her face goes blood-orange in blush."

rows.original: “Officially the company doesn’t condone unauthorized breeding and/or sexual interaction with our employees,” she says calmly. When you inquire about unofficially, she smiles a little. “Well, some of the girls are stored in back in case we need to switch flavors, and a friendly visit is possible, sometimes. They do enjoy warm flesh after all the cold machines. For a slight tip of course... a girl’s got to pay her way somehow!” She taps the counter nervously. “Not today though. The girls who would be up for that aren’t in. But... maybe for a big enough tip, I might be convinced to put up the ‘Momentary Delay’ sign and lock the door for a little personal time. A woman has needs.”
rows.translation: “公司在官方层面不赞成员工进行未经授权的繁殖和／或性接触，”她平静地说道。当你追问非官方情况时，她微微一笑。“嗯，有些姑娘会存放在后面，以便需要更换口味时使用；有时候，友善的拜访也是可以的。在冰冷机器里待了那么久，她们确实很喜欢温暖的肉体。当然，要给一点小费...姑娘总得想办法赚生活费！”她紧张地敲着柜台。“不过今天不行。愿意这么做的姑娘今天没来。但是...只要小费足够丰厚，也许你能说服我挂上‘暂时延误’的牌子，再锁上门，享受一会儿私人时间。女人也有需求。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Officially the company doesn’t condone unauthorized breeding and/or sexual interaction with our employees,” she says calmly. When you inquire about unofficially, she smiles a little. “Well, some of the girls are stored in back in case we need to switch flavors, and a friendly visit is possible, sometimes. They do enjoy warm flesh after all the cold machines. For a slight tip of course... a girl’s got to pay her way somehow!” She taps the counter nervously. “Not today though. The girls who would be up for that aren’t in. But... maybe for a big enough tip, I might be convinced to put up the ‘Momentary Delay’ sign and lock the door for a little personal time. A woman has needs.”"

rows.original: “I appreciate the sentiment, but... wait, really?!” She looks stunned when you nod. Speechless, she jumps the counter and hugs you tightly, then looks around at the shop. “Okay um... just give me a moment! Help yourself to some ice cream, I have a couple things to shut down and a bag to grab and I’ll be right back!”
rows.translation: “你的心意我领了，但是... 等等，真的吗？！”你点头时，她一脸震惊。她说不出话来，直接跳过柜台，紧紧抱住你，随后环视店里。“好吧，呃... 稍等我一下！你自己随便吃点冰淇淋，我得关掉几样东西，再拿上一个包，马上就回来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I appreciate the sentiment, but... wait, really?!” She looks stunned when you nod. Speechless, she jumps the counter and hugs you tightly, then looks around at the shop. “Okay um... just give me a moment! Help yourself to some ice cream, I have a couple things to shut down and a bag to grab and I’ll be right back!”"

rows.original: You idly sample some flavors while she’s gone, and you suspect the girls in the machines know she’s leaving. Most look happy, some look a bit sad, many give you thankful looks. Only a few are upset, but you chalk that up to jealousy. Finally, Yammi comes back to the front, locking the back door behind her.
rows.translation: 她不在的时候你随手尝了几种口味，你觉得机器里的那些女孩知道她要离开。大多数看起来很开心，有些有点难过，许多都向你投来感激的目光。只有少数几个显得不高兴，但你把那归结为嫉妒。最后，雅米回到前台，随手把后门锁上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou idly sample some flavors while she’s gone, and you suspect the girls in the machines know she’s leaving. Most look happy, some look a bit sad, many give you thankful looks. Only a few are upset, but you chalk that up to jealousy. Finally, Yammi comes back to the front, locking the back door behind her."

rows.original: “My ex-owners are really angry. I don’t care though!” She laughs, then hugs your arm. “Okay! Where to, Boss? Your ship has a kitchen, right? Galley? Whatever it’s called? I can cook; I promise you won’t regret this!”
rows.translation: “我以前的东家可生气了。不过我才不在乎！”她笑着，抱住你的胳膊。“好啦！去哪儿，老板？你的船上有厨房吧？舰上厨房？管它叫什么？我会做饭；我保证你不会后悔的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My ex-owners are really angry. I don’t care though!” She laughs, then hugs your arm. “Okay! Where to, Boss? Your ship has a kitchen, right? Galley? Whatever it’s called? I can cook; I promise you won’t regret this!”"

rows.original: You inquire if she isn’t perhaps interested in her freedom instead of latching onto you so quickly. She kisses you on the cheek.
rows.translation: 你问她，是不是其实更想要自己的自由，而不是这么快就缠上你。她在你脸颊上亲了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou inquire if she isn’t perhaps interested in her freedom instead of latching onto you so quickly. She kisses you on the cheek."

rows.original: “You have a ship. You’re going all over the place. Don’t tell me you couldn’t use a fresh-made hot meal! And don’t worry, I can take care of myself. If we get boarded, I’ll just duck into my water tank and turn it real cold, it slows my life signs down to undetectable levels. And I have basic self defense training, in case of robbery!” She insists, picking up her bag of clothes and whatever personal effects she has. “I won’t be in your way and I won’t charge you anything for the services. I promise! Besides, I can breathe underwater. I can be useful for finding things!”
rows.translation: “你有一艘船，还会去往各个地方。别告诉我，你用不上一顿现做的热腾腾饭菜！而且别担心，我能照顾好自己。有人登船袭击的话，我只要躲进水箱，把水温调得非常低，就能让生命体征减缓到无法侦测的程度。而且我受过基础自卫训练，可以应付抢劫！”她坚持说道，同时拿起装着衣服和所有私人物品的包。“我不会碍你的事，也不会向你收取任何服务费用。我保证！而且我能在水下呼吸。我找东西时可以派上用场！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have a ship. You’re going all over the place. Don’t tell me you couldn’t use a fresh-made hot meal! And don’t worry, I can take care of myself. If we get boarded, I’ll just duck into my water tank and turn it real cold, it slows my life signs down to undetectable levels. And I have basic self defense training, in case of robbery!” She insists, picking up her bag of clothes and whatever personal effects she has. “I won’t be in your way and I won’t charge you anything for the services. I promise! Besides, I can breathe underwater. I can be useful for finding things!”"

rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.original: You shrug. If she wants to come with, you can’t imagine it will hurt. And it might be nice to have an actual meal prepared for you once in a while. You agree.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。既然她想跟来，你想象不出这会有什么坏处。而且偶尔有人给你做一顿真正的饭菜，或许也挺不错。你答应了。
rows.raw: "You shrug. If she wants to come with, you can’t imagine it will hurt. And it might be nice to have an actual meal prepared for you once in a while. You agree."

rows.original: “You won’t regret this! I promise! Let’s go, Boss, I have to make sure the kitchen’s all stocked up before we go anywhere!” She locks the front door behind you and then slides the keycard back under the door.
rows.translation: “你不会后悔的！我保证！走吧老板，出发前我得先确认厨房里的东西都备齐了！”她在你身后锁上前门，然后把门卡从门缝下塞了回去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You won’t regret this! I promise! Let’s go, Boss, I have to make sure the kitchen’s all stocked up before we go anywhere!” She locks the front door behind you and then slides the keycard back under the door."

rows.original: “Oh,” she says, more than a little dejectedly. “I just thought... since you paid off my debts. Well! I guess I’ll have to make my own path, then!” she says, flashing you a green-lipped smile.
rows.translation: “哦，”她语气相当沮丧地说道。“我只是以为... 既然你替我还清了债务。好吧！我想我只能走自己的路了！”她说道，向你露出绿色嘴唇的微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh,” she says, more than a little dejectedly. “I just thought... since you paid off my debts. Well! I guess I’ll have to make my own path, then!” she says, flashing you a green-lipped smile."
